<a id="p-001"></a>

## Welcome to OPNsense’s documentation!｜歡迎閱讀 OPNsense 的文檔！

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/index.html>

![_images/docs-deciso-header.jpg](<../images/fe1e0149-docs-deciso-header.jpg>)

---


[OPNsense®](https://opnsense.org/) is an open source, easy-to-use and easy-to-build FreeBSD based firewall and routing platform.

[OPNsense®](https://opnsense.org/)是一個開源、易於使用且易於建立的基於 FreeBSD 的防火牆和路由平台。

**OPNsense** includes most of the features available in expensive commercial firewalls, and more in many cases. It brings the rich feature set of commercial offerings with the benefits of open and verifiable sources.

**OPNsense** 包含了大多數昂貴商業防火牆的功能，在許多情況下甚至更多。它不僅擁有商業產品的豐富功能，還具備開放且可驗證原始碼的優勢。

<a id="p-002"></a>

## Introduction｜介紹

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/intro.html>

Welcome to the OPNsense documentation & wiki project! The documentation is a work in progress and is updated frequently. If you would like to contribute in any way, please take a look at our guide on how to [Contribute](#p-380).

歡迎來到 OPNsense 文件和 wiki 專案！文件仍在不斷改進中，我們會經常更新。如果您想以任何方式做出貢獻，請參閱我們的[貢獻指南](#p-380) 。

[![_images/opnsense_logo_horizontaal.png](<../images/2f7274d9-opnsense_logo_horizontaal.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/opnsense_logo_horizontaal.png)

### Welcome to OPNsense’s documentation!｜歡迎閱讀 OPNsense 的文檔！

[OPNsense®](https://opnsense.org/) is an open source, easy-to-use and easy-to-build FreeBSD based firewall and routing platform.

[OPNsense®](https://opnsense.org/)是一個開源、易於使用且易於建構的基於 FreeBSD 的防火牆和路由平台。

**OPNsense** includes most of the features available in expensive commercial firewalls, and more in many cases. It brings the rich feature set of commercial offerings with the benefits of open and verifiable sources.

**OPNsense** 包含了大多數昂貴商業防火牆的功能，在許多情況下甚至更多。它不僅擁有商業產品的豐富功能，還具備開放且可驗證原始碼的優勢。

### Mission Statement｜使命宣言

> Give users, developers and businesses a friendly, stable and transparent environment. Make OPNsense the most widely used open source security platform. The project’s name is derived from open and sense and stands for: “Open (source) makes sense.”
>
> 為使用者、開發者和企業提供友善、穩定、透明的環境。使 OPNsense 成為應用最廣泛的開源安全平台。此專案名稱源自 open 和 sense，意為：「開源即有意義」。

![_images/OPNsense-Deciso-Screenshot.png](<../images/08e305f0-OPNsense-Deciso-Screenshot.png>)

### Reading guide｜閱讀指南

While reading the documentation, it is good to know how the various topics are structured, what their purpose is and how to find what you are looking for. Maybe even more important is what this documentation does not offer.

閱讀文件時，了解各個主題的結構、用途以及如何找到所需內容非常重要。但或許更重要的是，要了解這份文件沒有提供哪些資訊。

If you are looking for deeper insights about networking and best practices in designing them, this might not be the best place to look. Most of our documents and how-to’s focus on how to use functionality included in our software and/or one of its plugins. Quite a lot of books are written about networking, there are (online) courses available and Wikipedia contains a lot of relevant articles as well. Some interesting reads include the fundamentals about the [OSI model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OSI_model), [IP addressing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IP_address), [routing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IP_routing) and [network address translation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Network_address_translation). These resources are likely more suitable for learning about general network concepts. Although we do try to include some context in our documents, there are often assumptions made about the readers knowledge on (basic) networking.

如果您想深入了解網路及其設計的最佳實踐，這裡可能並非最佳選擇。我們的大部分文件和操作指南都專注於如何使用我們軟體及其插件中包含的功能。關於網路的書籍汗牛充棟，還有許多（線上）課程可供選擇，維基百科也包含大量相關文章。一些值得一讀的資料包括[OSI模型](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OSI_model) 、[IP尋址](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IP_address) 、[路由](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IP_routing)和[網路位址轉換](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Network_address_translation)的基礎知識。這些資源可能更適合學習通用的網路概念。儘管我們努力在文件中提供一些背景信息，但通常會假設讀者俱備（基礎）網路知識。

Like many products and projects, ours grows over time, functionality extends and changes, which sometimes makes it difficult to find what you need for the version you are using. Although we try to keep our documentation up to date, sometimes its contents do not reflect reality anymore. If that is the case and you think you found an omission, do not hesitate to open a report using one of our templates on [GitHub](https://github.com/opnsense/docs/issues/new/choose) or a pull request if you are able to.

與許多產品和項目一樣，我們的產品也會隨著時間的推移而不斷發展，功能不斷擴展和變化，這有時會導致您難以找到當前版本所需的資訊。儘管我們努力保持文件的更新，但有時其內容可能已不再反映實際情況。如果您發現任何遺漏，請隨時使用我們在 [GitHub](https://github.com/opnsense/docs/issues/new/choose)上的範本提交報告，或者如果您有能力，也可以提交 pull request。

Always assume the text is intended for the latest version of our product, in time we might add a version selector in the documentation, but given OPNsense is a security product, we advise to keep it up to date anyway to protect yourself against the latest threats.

請務必假設文字適用於我們產品的最新版本，我們可能會在文件中添加版本選擇器，但鑑於 OPNsense 是一款安全產品，我們建議您無論如何都要保持其更新，以保護自己免受最新威脅的侵害。

The releases section contains the changelogs for all versions we published over the years, if there are remarks for an upgrade, this is a useful resource to collect the details.

發布部分包含我們多年來發布的所有版本的變更日誌，如果有升級方面的說明，這是一個收集詳細資訊的有用資源。

Installation and setup is all about getting you started using one of the target options available.

安裝和設定的全部意義就在於幫助您開始使用可用的目標選項之一。

The next sections should be quite familiar when working with OPNsense, as they reflect the options in the product’s menu. If you are not yet used to OPNsense, you can always use the search input in the top-left corner of the screen to find your topic.

接下來的章節內容對於使用 OPNsense 的使用者來說應該相當熟悉，因為它們與產品選單中的選項相對應。如果您還不熟悉 OPNsense，可以隨時使用螢幕左上角的搜尋框尋找所需主題。

Both community and third-party plugins have their own area available, although they eventually register into the same menu structure, it is good to know about possible differences between add-ons and standard functionality. The level of support may differ between core functionality, as also explained in the “Support options” section, feature requests and bugs may be treated different as well (a lot of questions for a plugin which is being developed by a single person, maybe less active than a group of people improving a plugin together for example).

社群外掛程式和第三方外掛都有各自的專屬區域，雖然它們最終都會出現在同一個選單結構中，但了解外掛程式和標準功能之間的差異仍然很有幫助。核心功能的支援等級可能有所不同，正如「支援選項」部分所述，功能請求和錯誤報告的處理方式也可能不同（例如，由個人開發的插件可能會收到很多問題，因此其支援力度可能不如團隊合作開發的插件）。

When it comes to building software on top of OPNsense or extending existing functionality, the development chapter is the one to read. It explains all about our architecture, coding style, how to hook into available facilities and much more.

如果要在 OPNsense 之上建立軟體或擴展現有功能，開發章節是必讀之作。它詳細解釋了我們的架構、編碼風格、如何連接可用功能等等。

Some pointers when it comes to troubleshooting can be found in the section with the same name, it explains a bit about our issue workflow and some tips we collected over the years.

有關故障排除的一些提示可以在同名章節中找到，它簡要介紹了我們的問題處理流程以及我們多年來收集的一些技巧。

Last but not least our documentation includes some pages around project relations, legal guidelines and ways to contribute to the project.

最後，我們的文件還包括一些關於專案關係、法律準則以及如何為專案做出貢獻的頁面。

---

### Feature set｜功能集

The feature set of OPNsense includes high-end features such as forward caching proxy, traffic shaping, intrusion detection and easy OpenVPN client setup. The latest release is based on a recent FreeBSD for long-term support and uses a newly developed MVC-framework based on Phalcon. OPNsense’s focus on security brings unique features such as easy to use one time password authentication for various components.

OPNsense 的功能集包含許多高階功能，例如前向快取代理、流量整形、入侵偵測以及簡易的 OpenVPN 用戶端設定。最新版本基於最新的 FreeBSD 系統，以確保長期支持，並採用基於 Phalcon 開發的全新MVC框架。 OPNsense 著重於安全性，並為此提供了許多獨特功能，例如針對各種元件的便利一次性密碼驗證。

The robust and reliable update mechanism gives OPNsense the ability to provide important security updates in a timely fashion.

強大且可靠的更新機制使 OPNsense 能夠及時提供重要的安全性更新。

### [Intro](#p-003)｜[引言](#p-003)

As a trusted open source security product, we do care a lot about security and, with our regular release schedule, we try to stay ahead of possible incidents. Even though we are cautious and stay informed, sometimes issues do occur, in which case it is good to know what to do.

作為一款值得信賴的開源安全產品，我們非常重視安全性，並透過定期發布更新來努力預防潛在安全事件的發生。儘管我們保持謹慎並密切關注安全動態，但有時問題仍然會發生，在這種情況下，了解應對措施至關重要。

### [Staying ahead](#p-003)｜[保持領先](#p-003)

Even though we always encourage people to update regularly, sometimes it is not possible to do so for various reasons.

儘管我們一直鼓勵大家定期更新，但有時由於各種原因，這是不可能的。

Luckily, OPNsense comes with an integrated security check for known vulnerabilities, which can be found in our firmware module. In which case you do have the opportunity to validate for yourself what the risk is to keep using the current version for a bit longer.

幸運的是，OPNsense 內建了已知漏洞的安全檢查功能，該功能位於我們的韌體模組中。因此，您可以自行驗證繼續使用目前版本一段時間的風險。

You can reach it via System -> Firmware in the status pane, the button “Run an Audit”（進行審核） will bring you right into the security report.

您可以透過狀態窗格中的「系統」->「韌體」存取它，按鈕“Run an Audit”（進行審核）將直接帶您進入安全性報告。

If all goes well, a report like the one below will be shown:

如果一切順利，將會顯示以下報告：

```
***GOT REQUEST TO AUDIT SECURITY***
Currently running OPNsense 22.1.8_1 (amd64/OpenSSL) at Tue May 31 09:01:04 CEST 2022
vulnxml file up-to-date
0 problem(s) in 0 installed package(s) found.
***DONE***
```

Note

筆記

We do not offer community support on assessing if incidents on older versions do warrant an immediate upgrade on your end as this often depends on features used and settings configured. Our advice always will be to upgrade into the latest community or business version.

我們不提供社群支持，幫助您評估舊版中出現的問題是否需要立即升級，因為這通常取決於您使用的功能和配置的設定。我們始終建議您升級到最新的社群版或企業版。

Warning

警告

Please do not report issues to us reported by the security health check, they are already known and highly likely a fix is pending for the next release.

請不要向我們報告安全健康檢查中發現的問題，這些問題我們已經知道，並且很可能會在下一個版本中修復。

### [Assessing risks](#p-003)｜[風險評估](#p-003)

As with all software, understanding how software is being developed helps a lot assessing the risks involved when using with it. Most software components are built on top of other components, which all have their own security challenges. From an architecture perspective, we do try to minimize the external dependencies as much as possible, but obviously need various software components for the broad spectrum of features that we offer.

與所有軟體一樣，了解軟體的開發方式對於評估其使用風險大有裨益。大多數軟體元件都建構在其他元件之上，而每個元件都存在自身的安全挑戰。從架構角度來看，我們力求盡可能減少外部依賴，但顯然，為了實現我們提供的廣泛功能，各種軟體元件不可或缺。

When we add functionality ourselves (supported under [tiers 1 and 2](#p-379)), we tend to ask ourselves at least the following questions:

當我們自行添加功能時（在 [第 1 層和第 2 層](#p-379)下支援），我們通常至少會問自己以下問題：

-   Does the new component we plan to add replace something we already use, and how are we going to make sure we don’t end up with just one more component?  
    我們計劃添加的新組件是否會替換我們已經使用的組件？我們如何確保最終不會只增加一個組件？
    
    -   A good example of this is the use of [tabulator](https://www.tabulator.info/) which gradually replaced bootgrid we used earlier  
        一個很好的例子就是[tabulator](https://www.tabulator.info/)的使用，它逐漸取代了我們之前使用的 bootgrid。
        
-   How active is the development of the component in question, and what level of support can be expected?  
    該組件的開發進度如何？可以獲得怎樣的支持？
    
-   What is the expected maintenance burden, and is it reasonable in relation to the added functionality?  
    預計維護負擔有多大？相對於新增功能而言是否合理？
    
    -   When a library offers minimal additional functionality compared to the tools already available in the language being used, it’s often better to build and maintain the functionality ourselves to keep dependencies more manageable.  
        當一個函式庫與所用語言中已有的工具相比，提供的功能微乎其微時，為了更好地管理依賴關係，通常最好自己建構和維護這些功能。
        
    -   Also, when we already have a component offering almost the same functionality, does adding another one make sense?  
        此外，既然我們已經有一個元件提供了幾乎相同的功能，那麼再增加一個元件還有意義嗎？
        
-   Could we \[easily\] replace a component with an alternative or maintain the software ourselves?  
    我們能否輕鬆地用替代品替換某個組件，或自行維護軟體？
    
    -   An example of this is our previous use of Phalcon to support most of our MVC code, which has since been largely rewritten using standard PHP code.  
        例如，我們之前使用 Phalcon 來支援我們的大部分MVC程式碼，而這些程式碼後來大多已使用標準的PHP程式碼重寫。
        

Although our development manual contains a lot of detail on how we work, it doesn’t hurt to explain our approach here at a high level, with more focus on its security aspects. Different components in the stack may take slightly different approaches to handling security issues. While planning and building releases, all these topics are taken under consideration.

雖然我們的開發手冊詳細介紹了我們的工作流程，但在這裡簡要概述我們的方法，並重點關注其安全性方面，也並無壞處。技術堆疊中的不同元件在處理安全問題時可能會採用略有不同的方法。在規劃和建造版本時，所有這些問題都會被納入考慮範圍。

#### [\[FreeBSD\] Base system and kernel](#p-003)｜[\[FreeBSD\] 基礎系統與核心]( https://docs.opnsense.org/security.html#id18 )

Although we prefer to use release versions of our operating system software, the release cadence between OPNsense and FreeBSD differs, which in practice means we start with a release version (e.g. `15.1`) and track upstream security issues when planning releases on our end. The FreeBSD advisories are publicly available [1](#p-003). in case of doubt, the ones we implemented are mentioned in our release notes [2](#p-003). and recorded in our publicly available source repository [3](#p-003).

儘管我們更傾向於使用作業系統軟體的發布版本，但 OPNsense 和 FreeBSD 的發布節奏有所不同，這意味著我們在實際應用中會先使用一個發布版本（例如`15.1` ），並在規劃發佈時跟踪上游的安全問題。 FreeBSD 的安全公告已公開提供 [1](#p-003) 。如有疑問，我們已實施的安全公告已在發布說明 [2](#p-003)中提及，並記錄在我們公開的源代碼庫 [3](#p-003)中。

[1](#p-003)

[https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/)

[2](#p-003)

[https://docs.opnsense.org/releases.html](#p-004)

[3](#p-003)

[https://github.com/opnsense/src](https://github.com/opnsense/src)

#### [\[ports\] External software](#p-003)｜[\[埠\] 外部軟體]( https://docs.opnsense.org/security.html#id19 )

External software in most BSD’s is managed via a “ports collection”, which is more or less a recipe book describing how to construct different pieces of software. OPNsense hosts a (partial) mirror of the upstream collection with some specific software additions on top for binary software we maintain ourselves.

大多數BSD系統中的外部軟體都是透過「連接埠集合」進行管理的，它更像是一本配方手冊，描述如何建立不同的軟體元件。 OPNsense 託管上游連接埠集合的（部分）鏡像，並在此基礎上添加了一些我們自己維護的二進位軟體。

In order to track vulnerabilities, one can use VuXML [4](#p-003) ., which can also be queried directly from the OPNsense interface using the “security audit” feature in the firmware section.

為了追蹤漏洞，可以使用 VuXML [4](#p-003) .，也可以使用韌體部分的「安全審計」功能直接從 OPNsense 介面查詢。

Although not all security incidents on software installed may have impact on your setup, this information offers insights into the risks involved with your running configuration.

尽管并非所有已安装软件的安全事件都会影响您的设置，但此信息可让您深入了解与运行配置相关的风险。

Below an example of a report extracted via the audit feature.

下面是通过审核功能提取的报告示例。

```
 python313-3.13.15 is vulnerable:
   Python -- poplib module, when passed a user-controlled command, can have additional commands injected using newlines
   CVE: CVE-2025-15367
   WWW: https://vuxml.FreeBSD.org/freebsd/6d3488ae-2e0f-11f1-88c7-00a098b42aeb.html
```

The first line (1) explains which software package the jeopardy refers to, next (2) there are some details about the incident which helps assessing if this particular issue impacts you, when one or more CVE’s are attached you can find them in the following lines (3), followed by a link to more information (4).

第一行 (1) 解释了危险所指的软件包，接下来 (2) 有一些有关该事件的详细信息，有助于评估此特定问题是否影响您，当附加一个或多个 CVE 时，您可以在以下行 (3) 中找到它们，后面是更多信息的链接 (4)。

When planning releases, we use the same information to determine impact on our product.

在规划版本时，我们使用相同的信息来确定对我们产品的影响。

如下文进一步提到的，我们软件中的安全事件可以通过我们的 GitHub 跟踪器 [5](#p-003) 报告，在这种情况下，可以通知用户，并且可以选择根据问题类型分配CVE。

We work closely with security researchers around the world to identify and address issues that may have slipped into our software, just as we do with the software we use.

我们与世界各地的安全研究人员密切合作，以识别和解决我们软件中可能存在的问题，就像我们处理我们使用的软件一样。

These days, we tend to use this tracker as our primary source of communication when it comes to security-relevant issues.

如今，當涉及到安全相關問題時，我們傾向於使用此追蹤器作為我們的主要通訊來源。

Our release notes [6](#p-003) also refer to these fixes.

我們的發行說明 [6](#p-003) 也參考了這些修復。

### [Upstream vulnerabilities](#p-003)｜[上游漏洞](#p-003)

Since OPNsense is a collection of open source software, when finding an issue, it is always a good idea to inspect where it should be fixed first. In case you do not know or are not sure, you can still ask on our end, just know that we do not have the manpower to act as an intermediary between various projects.

由于 OPNsense 是开源软件的集合，因此在发现问题时，最好首先检查应该修复的位置。如果您不知道或不確定，您仍然可以向我們詢問，只要知道我們沒有人力在各個專案之間充當中介即可。

### [Deployment considerations](#p-003)｜[部署注意事項](#p-003)

A firewall is a security tool and should be deployed and operated accordingly. While OPNsense provides mechanisms to help secure a network environment, no firewall can compensate for weak operational practices or excessive trust relationships.

防火牆是一種安全工具，應相應地部署和操作。虽然 OPNsense 提供了帮助保护网络环境的机制，但没有任何防火墙可以弥补薄弱的操作实践或过度的信任关系。

Users who are granted access to the firewall typically perform administrative or operational tasks and therefore require an elevated level of trust. Administrative access should be limited to users who require it for their role, and permissions should be assigned according to the principle of least privilege whenever possible.

被授予防火牆存取權限的使用者通常會執行管理或操作任務，因此需要更高的信任等級。管理访问权限应仅限于需要其角色的用户，并且应尽可能根据最小特权原则分配权限。

Trusted administrators only

僅限受信任的管理員

Some access control roles provide capabilities that effectively allow complete control over the system, either directly or indirectly, and should therefore only be assigned to fully trusted administrators or administrative peers.

某些访问控制角色提供的功能可以有效地直接或间接地完全控制系统，因此只能分配给完全信任的管理员或管理同级。

Examples include privileges such as `XMLRPC Library`, which can be used for remote configuration synchronisation and automation, and `System: Configuration: Backups`, which provides access to configuration exports containing sensitive information. In practice, any privilege that grants access to configuration data, remote management interfaces, backup material or automation mechanisms should be considered security-sensitive and assigned with care.

示例包括`XMLRPC Library`等权限，可用于远程配置同步和自动化，以及`System: Configuration: Backups`，可提供对包含敏感信息的配置导出的访问。在实践中，任何授予对配置数据、远程管理接口、备份材料或自动化机制的访问权限的权限都应被视为安全敏感的，并应谨慎分配。

Fine-grained permissions and trust

細粒度的權限和信任

Access control lists can provide fine-grained permissions for operational convenience, delegation and improved visibility. Depending on the use case, these permissions may also serve as effective security boundaries.

存取控制清單可以提供細粒度的權限，以實現操作便利、委派和提高可見性。根據用例，這些權限也可以充當有效的安全邊界。

Administrators should, however, consider the effective capabilities granted by a role rather than relying solely on the apparent scope of individual privileges. Some permissions may appear limited in scope while still allowing users to influence or bypass related security controls indirectly.

然而，管理員應該考慮角色授予的有效能力，而不是僅僅依賴個人特權的明顯範圍。某些權限可能看起來範圍有限，但仍允許使用者間接影響或繞過相關安全控制。

For example, a user who is permitted to manage port forwarding rules may be able to create access paths to systems or services that would otherwise remain inaccessible.

例如，被允許管理連接埠轉送規則的使用者可能能夠建立對系統或服務的存取路徑，否則這些系統或服務將無法存取。

Permission assignments should therefore reflect both the intended task and the level of trust placed in the user receiving them.

因此，權限分配應反映預期任務和接收它們的使用者的信任程度。

Legacy components

遺留組件

Some legacy components, identified by URIs ending in `.php`, originate from earlier parts of the codebase and may implement fewer validation and access control safeguards than newer components. Access to these pages should therefore be restricted to fully trusted administrators whenever possible.

一些遺留元件（由以 `.php` 結尾的 URI 標識）源自於程式碼庫的早期部分，並且可能比新元件實現更少的驗證和存取控制保護措施。因此，只要有可能，對這些頁面的存取應僅限於完全信任的管理員。

Access to the management interface should be restricted to trusted networks and secured using strong authentication mechanisms. Administrative accounts should use unique passwords and additional authentication factors where supported and appropriate.

對管理介面的存取應僅限於受信任的網絡，並使用強大的身份驗證機制進行保護。管理帳戶應在支援和適當的情況下使用唯一的密碼和其他身份驗證因素。

To reduce the attack surface, unnecessary services, plugins and user accounts should be disabled or removed. Systems should be kept up to date by installing security and maintenance updates in a timely manner.

為了減少攻擊面，應停用或刪除不必要的服務、外掛程式和使用者帳戶。應透過及時安裝安全性和維護更新來使系統保持最新狀態。

Regular reviews of firewall rules, user accounts, exposed services and remote access methods help ensure that configurations continue to reflect operational requirements and do not unintentionally introduce security risks.

定期審查防火牆規則、使用者帳戶、公開服務和遠端存取方法有助於確保配置繼續反映操作要求，並且不會無意中引入安全風險。

Configuration backups should be created regularly and stored securely to facilitate recovery from hardware failures, configuration errors or security incidents. Logging and monitoring should be enabled to assist with troubleshooting, auditing and the detection of unexpected behaviour.

應定期建立配置備份並安全存儲，以便於從硬體故障、配置錯誤或安全事件中恢復。應啟用日誌記錄和監控以協助故障排除、審核和偵測意外行為。

Security is not a single configuration option or deployment step, but an ongoing process of review, maintenance and adaptation to changing requirements and threats.

安全性不是單一的配置選項或部署步驟，而是一個持續的審查、維護和適應不斷變化的需求和威脅的過程。

### [Reporting an incident](#p-003)｜[檢舉事件](#p-003)

Security incidents on our product can be reported using our [GitHub repository](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security). You may also create a new issue and select “Report a security vulnerability”, which will redirect you to the same page. Alternatively, you can report security issues to our security team available at **security** @ **opnsense.org**.

可以使用我們的 [GitHub 儲存庫](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security) 報告我們產品的安全事件。您也可以建立一個新問題並選擇“報告安全漏洞”，這會將您重新導向到同一頁面。或者，您可以向我們的安全團隊報告安全性問題，網址為 **security**@**opnsense.org**。

All reports should contain at least the following information:

所有報告應至少包含以下資訊：

-   A clear description of the vulnerability at hand  
    對當前漏洞的清晰描述
    
-   Which versions of our product seem to be affected  
    我們產品的哪些版本似乎受到影響
    
-   Any known workaround  
    任何已知的解決方法
    
-   When possible, some example code  
    如果可能的話，一些範例程式碼
    

### [Information handling policies](#p-003)｜[資訊處理政策](#p-003)

As a general policy we do favor full disclosure of vulnerability information after a reasonable amount of time to permit safe analysis and correction as well as appropriate testing for the correction at hand.

作為一般政策，我們確實贊成在合理的時間後全面披露漏洞信息，以便進行安全分析和糾正，並對當前的糾正進行適當的測試。

In order to coordinate with other affected parties, we might share parts of the information provided to us to them as well or ask the reporter to do so.

為了與其他受影響方進行協調，我們也可能會向他們分享我們提供的部分信息，或要求報告者這樣做。

When the submitter is interested in a coordinated disclosure process, this should be indicated in any submission to avoid discussions later on.

當提交者對協調揭露流程感興趣時，應在提交的任何內容中註明這一點，以避免以後的討論。

### [Third party security verification](#p-003)｜[第三方安全驗證](#p-003)

#### [Intro](#p-003)｜[簡介](#p-003)

Within the OPNsense team and community, we spend a lot of time safeguarding our software and keeping up with the latest threats, like checking used software against CVEs on every release, implementing best practices in our development methods and offering clear and transparent release engineering.

在 OPNsense 團隊和社群中，我們花費了大量時間來保護我們的軟體並跟上最新的威脅，例如根據每個版本的 CVE 檢查所使用的軟體、在我們的開發方法中實施最佳實踐以及提供清晰透明的發布工程。

To improve this even further, we decided to bring a third party on board and mold a process around our security verification by trained security professionals.

為了進一步改進這一點，我們決定引入第三方，並由經過培訓的安全專業人員圍繞我們的安全驗證制定流程。

#### [Business Edition](#p-003)｜[商業版](#p-003)

As our Business Edition is aimed at professional users, it does make sense to offer additional safeguards, like even more extensive testing on this product. Looking at the lifecycle of our software, this is also the most mature stage of what we do have to offer:

由於我們的商業版面向專業用戶，因此提供額外的保護措施確實有意義，例如對此產品進行更廣泛的測試。看看我們軟體的生命週期，這也是我們所提供的最成熟的階段：

-   Development version  
    開發版
    
    -   Available at every release, it offers a glimpse of what to expect in the near future.  
        它在每個版本中都可用，讓您可以一睹在不久的將來會發生什麼。
        
-   Community version  
    社群版
    
    -   When changes survive the development version, these are included in the community version, these are internally tested and feedback has been offered by community members.  
        當變更在開發版本中倖存下來時，這些變更將包含在社群版本中，這些內容經過內部測試並由社群成員提供回饋。
        
-   Business Edition  
    商業版
    
    -   Functional changes are being included in a more conservative manner, more feedback has been collected from development and community, leading to a mission-critical version of the well-known OPNsense firewall.  
        功能變更以更保守的方式進行，從開發和社群收集了更多回饋，從而形成了著名的 OPNsense 防火牆的關鍵任務版本。
        

As security testing is quite time-consuming, we aim to offer a full qualification cycle for every major release.

由於安全測試非常耗時，我們力求為每個主要版本提供完整的認證週期。

#### [Framework / Type of testing (LINCE)](#p-003)｜[框架/測試類型 ( LINCE )](#p-003)

In our quest for a framework to use, we found the LINCE methodology.

在尋找合適的框架時，我們發現了LINCE方法論。

LINCE is a lightweight methodology for evaluating and certifying ICT products, created by Spain’s National Cryptologic Center ([CCN](https://cpstic.ccn.cni.es/en/)), based on Common Criteria principles and oriented around vulnerability analysis and penetration tests.

LINCE是一種輕量級的評估和認證ICT產品的方法，由西班牙國家密碼中心 ([CCN](https://cpstic.ccn.cni.es/en/) ) 創建，基於通用準則原則，並圍繞漏洞分析和滲透測試展開。

LINCE’s strengths over other methodologies mainly consist of reduced effort and duration. However, the way in which it is applied also makes it possible to pay more attention to the critical points of each product, giving more weight to concrete and practical tests that combat real threats than to dense documentation or exhaustive functionality tests.

LINCE相較於其他方法的主要優點在於工作量和時間投入的減少。此外，其應用方式也使得我們能夠更加關注每個產品的關鍵點，更加重視針對實際威脅的特定實用測試，而非繁瑣的文檔編寫或詳盡的功能測試。

As most frameworks are not intended to be repeated very regularly, together with [jtsec](https://www.jtsec.es/) we came up with an approach which makes it possible to pass the test twice a year, which is needed to align with our Business Edition releases.

由於大多數框架並非旨在經常重複使用，因此我們與 [jtsec](https://www.jtsec.es/)一起提出了一種方法，使得每年進行兩次測試成為可能，這對於與我們的商業版發布保持一致是必要的。

During every cycle, there is always a chance that (small) issues appear which should be fixed, in close accordance with jtsec, the OPNsense team prepares fixes for the findings and makes sure that these are included in a future (minor) release.

在每個週期中，總有可能出現一些（小的）問題需要解決。根據 jtsec 的規定，OPNsense 團隊會針對發現的問題準備修復方案，並確保這些方案包含在未來的（次要）版本中。

#### [Steps in the process](#p-003)｜[流程步驟](#p-003)

To better understand where a version of OPNsense is at in terms of verification, we distinguish the following stages in the process, which we will also note on the version at hand.

為了更了解 OPNsense 的某個版本在驗證方面的位置，我們將流程分為以下階段，我們也會在目前版本中註明這些階段。

1.  In testing - Software delivered to jtsec, in process (interaction between OPNsense and jtsec).  
    測試中 - 交付給 jtsec 的軟體，正在進行中（OPNsense 和 jtsec 之間的交互作用）。
    
2.  Tested - Software verified / tested, documentation not yet published.  
    已測試 - 軟體已驗證/測試，文件尚未發布。
    
3.  LINCE Compliant - Test complete including a summarised report (by jtsec).  
    LINCE符合標準 - 測試完成，包括一份總結報告（由 jtsec 提供）。
    
4.  Certification pending - Offered for formal certification.  
    認證待定 - 可提供正式認證。
    
5.  LINCE Certified - Certified by CCN.  
    LINCE認證 - 由CCN認證。
    

The certification steps are executed twice a year, once for each Business Edition release. This process is quite time consuming, but adds another independent party to the mix.

認證步驟每年執行兩次，每次針對商業版版本發布。這個過程相當耗時，但引入了另一個獨立的第三方機構。

#### [Timeline](#p-003)｜[時間軸](#p-003)

The first fully certified product has been a community version (21.7.1), which offered us insights into the process and helped us improve the process which we would like to use for the Business Edition. We started this cycle with version 22.4 including full testing by jtsec.

第一款獲得全面認證的產品是社群版（ 21.7.1 ），它讓我們深入了解了整個流程，並幫助我們改進了流程，我們希望將這些改進應用於商業版。我們以版本22.4開啟了這一週期，該版本由jtsec進行了全面測試。

<a id="p-006"></a>

#### 26.7 “Xenial Xenops”（非洲爪蟾） Series｜26.7 “Xenial Xenops”（非洲爪蟾）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_26.7.html>

For over 11 a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates, modern IPv6 support, as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

超過 11 年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用、現代 IPv6 支援以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

26.7, nicknamed “Xenial Xenops”（非洲爪蟾）, features interface assignments and gateway groups via MVC/API, firewall rules now defaulting to MVC/API, outbound NAT to source NAT migration assistant, captive portal IPv6 support, Kea DDNS/custom options/dynamic prefix delegation, FreeBSD 15.1, OpenSSL 3.5, OpenVPN 2.7, PHP 8.5, Python 3.13, plus much more.

26.7，綽號 “Xenial Xenops”（非洲爪蟾），具有介面分配和網關組透過 MVC/API，防火牆規則現在預設為 MVC/API, 出境 NAT 來源 NAT 遷移助手、強制門戶 IPv6 支援、Kea DDNS/自訂選項/動態前綴委託，FreeBSD 15.1, OpenSSL 3.5, 開放VPN 2.7, PHP 8.5、Python 3.13，還有更多。

The upgrade path for 26.1 will likely be unlocked later today. We want to ensure the upgrade goes as smoothly as possible so please be patient! :)

26.1的升級路徑可能會在今天稍後解鎖。我們希望確保升級盡可能順利，請耐心等待！ :)

Download links, an installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結、安裝指南 [\[1\]](#p-055) 以及圖像的校驗和也可以在下面找到。

-   Europe: [https://opnsense.c0urier.net/releases/26.7/](https://opnsense.c0urier.net/releases/26.7/)  
    歐洲：[https://opnsense.c0urier.net/releases/26.7/](https://opnsense.c0urier.net/releases/26.7/)

##### 26.7.4 (September 15, 2026)｜26.7.4（2026 年 9 月 15 日）

Today we are rolling out the wireless device MVC/API rework and a final push for better source NAT replacement over outbound NAT.

今天，我們正在推出無線設備MVC/API返工，並最終推動更好的源NAT替換出站NAT。

StrongSwan was updated to 6.1.0 and the GUI now offers a small recommended set of post-quantum key exchanges.

StrongSwan 已更新為 6.1.0，GUI 現在提供一小部分建議的後量子金鑰交換。

You may also find the GUI tweaks for advanced option marker and a dialog search field helpful.

您可能還會發現 GUI 對進階選項標記和對話方塊搜尋欄位的調整很有幫助。

There is a lot more going on as you can see from this changelog, but more on this and future plans later!

正如您從這個變更日誌中看到的，還有很多事情正在發生，但稍後會詳細介紹這一點和未來的計劃！

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: audit log injection via login username in auth\_log() [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-jjm2-jg4p-3v9q)  
    系統：透過 auth\_log() [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-jjm2-jg4p-3v9q) 中的登入使用者名稱進行審核日誌注入
    
-   system: add pfsync version 1500 to HA settings (contributed by Bjoern Jakobsen)  
    系統：將 pfsync 版本 1500 新增至 HA 設定（由 Bjoern Jakobsen 貢獻）
    
-   system: add hidden services so they can be operated by pluginctl -s  
    system：新增隱藏服務，以便可以透過pluginctl -s操作它們
    
-   system: privlege separated reload in static PHP pages  
    系統：靜態PHP頁面中的權限分離重新載入
    
-   system: lower priority of automatic wg/ipsec gateways  
    系統：自動 wg/ipsec 網關的優先權較低
    
-   system: fix disk widget loading issue (contributed by Konstantinos Spartalis)  
    系統：修復磁碟小工具載入問題（由 Konstantinos Spartalis 貢獻）
    
-   system: add back the service widget link

##### 26.7.3 (August 27, 2026)｜26.7.3（2026 年 8 月 27 日）

Here is your biweekly dose of bugfixes and quality of life improvements! This update offers several new features: VLANs on bridges, “received-on” firewall rule support, persistent rule label tracking, repeatable WireGuard QR codes, menu favourites and full screen grid support. On top of that it bundles the recent FreeBSD 15.1-RELEASE-p3, fixes and cleanups as well as third party updates such as OpenSSL 3.5.8 and OpenSSH 10.5p1. Enjoy. :)

這是您每兩週一次的錯誤修復和生活品質改進！此更新提供了多項新功能：網橋上的 VLAN、「接收」防火牆規則支援、持久規則標籤追蹤、可重複的 WireGuard QR 代碼、選單收藏夾和全螢幕網格支援。除此之外，它還捆綁了最新的 FreeBSD 15.1-RELEASE-p3、修復和清理以及第三方更新，例如 OpenSSL 3.5.8 和 OpenSSH 10.5p1。享受。 :)

Meanwhile, development is busy with adding interface settings to the new MVC assignments page, which includes building wireless MVC/API support. That is all for now. Need to get back to work.

##### 26.7.2 (August 12, 2026)｜26.7.2（2026 年 8 月 12 日）

This update addresses the WireGuard MAC authentication issue people have been talking about, 4 core security advisories and the usual volume of quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

此更新解決了人們一直在談論的 WireGuard MAC 身份驗證問題、4 個核心安全建議以及通常的生活品質改進和錯誤修復。

We are currently improving the compatibility with the legacy pages in full privilege separation, working on feature parity between Outbound NAT and Source NAT and will also provide a road map in the next weeks for 27.1. Stay tuned.

我們目前正在改進與完全權限分離的遺留頁面的兼容性，致力於出站NAT和源NAT之間的功能對等，並將在接下來的幾週內提供27.1的路線圖。敬請關注。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: use /var/lib/php/tmp in static pages for proper privilege separation  
    系統：在靜態頁面中使用 /var/lib/php/tmp 進行適當的權限分離
    
-   system: improve “user-config-readonly” in static pages where write\_config() was denied  
    系統：改進 write\_config() 被拒絕的靜態頁面中的“user-config-readonly”
    
-   system: service widget changes based on further community feedback  
    系統：服務小部件根據進一步的社群回饋進行更改
    
-   system: support 7680 bit RSA type for certificates and authorities  
    系統：支援7680位元RSA類型的憑證和權限
    
-   system: add redirection capability to SSO provider  
    系統：為SSO提供者新增重定向功能
    
-   reporting: correctly map NetFlow indexes when there are gaps (contributed by Thomas Cheyney)  
    報告：在有間隙時正確繪製 NetFlow 索引（由 Thomas Cheyney 貢獻）
    
-   reporting: improve parsing in NetFlow for overlapping flow timestamps and use UTC for cleanups  
    報告：改進 NetFlow 中重疊流時間戳的解析並使用 UTC 進行清理
    
-   reporting: make parsing iftop lines more robust for traffic graphs (contributed by Brendan Bank)  
    報告：使 iftop 行的解析對於流量圖更加穩健（由 Brendan Bank 貢獻）
    
-   reporting: map ARC and laundry to cache memory stats (contributed by Konstantinos Spartalis)  
    報告：映射 ARC 和洗衣到快取記憶體統計資料（由 Konstantinos Spartalis 貢獻）
    
-   reporting: stop NetFlow service before reloading configuration  
    報表：在重新載入設定之前停止 NetFlow 服務
    
-   interfaces: fix assignment of wireless devices  
    介面：修復無線設備的分配
    
-   interfaces: strict description fields in new assignments page [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-9h93-hhcx-957c) (reported by call-AX)  
    介面：新作業頁面[\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-9h93-hhcx-957c)中嚴格的描述欄位（由call-AX報告）
    
-   interfaces: fix typos in GIF reconfiguration script  
    介面：修復GIF重新配置腳本中的拼字錯誤
    
-   interfaces: add “noclamp” flag for GIF  
    介面：為GIF新增「noclamp」標誌
    
-   interfaces: add separate link types for IPv4 and IPv6 in overview  
    介面：在概述中為 IPv4 和 IPv6 新增單獨的連結類型
    
-   interfaces: return the proper UUID when assigning an interface (contributed by Kemoy Campbell)  
    介面：分配介面時回傳正確的UUID（由 Kemoy Campbell 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: improve VIP page save when no subnet was posted  
    介面：改進VIP未發布子網路時的頁面保存
    
-   firewall: use htmlSafe() on action search value in live log [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-9h93-hhcx-957c) (reported by call-AX)  
    防火牆：對即時日誌中的操作搜尋值使用 htmlSafe() [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-9h93-hhcx-957c)（透過呼叫-AX報告）

-   firewall: fix missing well-known ports in local-port in destination NAT

##### 26.7.1 (July 21, 2026)｜26.7.1（2026 年 7 月 21 日）

This is a small stable release addressing some of the upgrade related issues that were reported last week as well as 4 new security advisories for the core code.

這是一個小型穩定版本，解決了上週報告的一些升級相關問題以及針對核心程式碼的 4 個新安全建議。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: add correct release name to boot splash screen for 26.7  
    系統：為 26.7 新增正確的版本名稱到啟動畫面
    
-   system: disable web GUI KTLS use for the time being  
    系統：暫時停用網頁GUI KTLS使用
    
-   system: do not let the components selectpicker grow indefinitely in defaults page  
    系統：不要讓元件 selectpicker 在預設頁面中無限成長
    
-   system: DTLSv1.1 is forcefully rejected by OpenSSL 3.5, migrate to DTLSv1.2  
    系統：DTLSv1.1被OpenSSL3.5強制拒絕，移轉到DTLSv1.2
    
-   system: use Bootstrap “btn” styles in services widget  
    系統：在服務小工具中使用 Bootstrap“btn”樣式
    
-   system: use serialNumberHex for CRL so high-bit serials are not dropped (contributed by chrstnth)  
    系統：對CRL使用serialNumberHex，這樣高位序列就不會被丟棄（由chrstnth貢獻）
    
-   system: lower max-request-size to roughly max post size in lighttpd configs [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-h4qj-j2x9-q553) (reported by lujiefsi)  
    系統：將lighttpd配置中的最大請求大小降低到大約最大帖子大小[\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-h4qj-j2x9-q553)（由lujiefsi報告）
    
-   system: fixed several PHP 8.5 warnings  
    系統：修復了幾個PHP 8.5警告
    
-   firewall: use “urgent” as empty default for firewall debug messages  
    防火牆：使用「緊急」作為防火牆調試訊息的預設空值
    
-   firewall: skip message banner if searchPhrase set  
    防火牆：如果設定了 searchPhrase，則跳過訊息橫幅
    
-   firewall: fix PHP warning when scrub yields no interfaces  
    防火牆：修復 PHP 清理時沒有產生任何介面的警告
    
-   captive portal: automatic block rule should be evaluated after the anti-lockout rule  
    強制門戶：應在反鎖定規則之後評估自動阻止規則
    
-   openvpn: client export can export private keys for unlisted certificate references [\[2\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-rw63-4hw9-p4v7) (reported by iys8 and lujiefsi)  
    openvpn：客戶端匯出可以匯出未列出的憑證所引用的私鑰[\[2\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-rw63-4hw9-p4v7)（由iys8和lujiefsi報告）
    
-   backend: remove cache file on execution error in script\_output  
    後端：在 script\_output 中執行錯誤時刪除快取文件
    
-   mvc: fix tab/subtab form generation for plugins  
    mvc：修復外掛程式的選項卡/子選項卡表單生成
    
-   mvc: fix default labels in selectpickers  
    mvc：修正 selectpickers 中的預設標籤
    
-   mvc: form labels can be empty so make sure to add them to avoid warnings in forms  
    mvc：表單標籤可以為空，因此請確保新增它們以避免表單中出現警告
    
-   mvc: safeguard some write operations with missing throwReadOnly() actions for custom action [\[3\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-vw8q-pqq7-2q7v) (reported by lujiefsi)  
    mvc：透過自訂操作 [\[3\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-vw8q-pqq7-2q7v) 缺少 throwReadOnly() 操作來保護某些寫入操作（由 lujiefsi 報告）
    
-   ui: fix multiple stored XSS [\[4\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-jm2f-ch62-rpxr) (reported by lujiefsi)  
    ui: 修正多個儲存的XSS [\[4\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-jm2f-ch62-rpxr) (lujiefsi 報告)
    
-   plugins: os-theme-rebellion 1.9.5 (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    插件：os-theme-rebellion 1.9.5（由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）
    
-   ports: ca\_root\_nss / nss 3.125 [\[5\]](https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/security/nss/releases/nss_3_125.html)  
    埠： ca\_root\_nss / nss 3.125 [\[5\]](https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/security/nss/releases/nss_3_125.html)

##### 26.7 (July 15, 2026)｜26.7（2026 年 7 月 15 日）

For over 11 a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates, modern IPv6 support, as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

超過 11 年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用、現代 IPv6 支援以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

26.7, nicknamed “Xenial Xenops”（非洲爪蟾）, features interface assignments and gateway groups via MVC/API, firewall rules now defaulting to MVC/API, outbound NAT to source NAT migration assistant, captive portal IPv6 support, Kea DDNS/custom options/dynamic prefix delegation, FreeBSD 15.1, OpenSSL 3.5, OpenVPN 2.7, PHP 8.5, Python 3.13, plus much more.

26.7，綽號 “Xenial Xenops”（非洲爪蟾），具有介面分配和網關組透過 MVC/API，防火牆規則現在預設為 MVC/API, 出境 NAT 來源 NAT 遷移助手、強制門戶 IPv6 支援、Kea DDNS/自訂選項/動態前綴委託，FreeBSD 15.1, OpenSSL 3.5, 開放VPN 2.7, PHP 8.5、Python 3.13，還有更多。

The upgrade path for 26.1 will likely be unlocked later today. We want to ensure the upgrade goes as smoothly as possible so please be patient! :)

26.1的升級路徑可能會在今天稍後解鎖。我們希望確保升級盡可能順利，請耐心等待！ :)

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   The privileges “page-system-groupmanager” and “page-system-usermanager-addprivs” were merged into “page-system-groupmanager” and are no longer available separately. This was done to avoid the misconception that access to a user management page gives constrained rights to each page, but that is not the case. User management is a process involving all 3 pages.  
    權限「page-system-groupmanager」和「page-system-usermanager-addprivs」已合併到「page-system-groupmanager」中，不再單獨可用。這樣做是為了避免錯誤地認為存取使用者管理頁面會限制每個頁面的權限，但事實並非如此。使用者管理是一個涉及所有3個頁面的過程。
    
-   The static PHP pages for firewall rule management have been moved to the “os-firewall-legacy” plugin which can be manually installed before or after the upgrade. All rules will continue to work regardless of the plugin being installed or not and are easily migrated using the given assistant.  
    用於防火牆規則管理的靜態PHP頁面已移至「os-firewall-legacy」插件，該插件可以在升級之前或之後手動安裝。無論是否安裝插件，所有規則都將繼續有效，並且可以使用給定的助手輕鬆遷移。
    
-   Hyper-V guests may be producing panics on certain hosts with more than one virtual processor assigned. Make sure to snapshot beforehand and stay on 26.1.x until the situation is clear.  
    Hyper-V 來賓可能會在分配了多個虛擬處理器的某些主機上產生恐慌。確保事先拍攝快照並停留在26.1.x上，直到情況清楚為止。
    
-   Since this is a major OS upgrade and OpenSSL changes from 3.0 to 3.5 third party repositories may interfere with your upgrade experience. Removing offending repositories and plugins may help; or wait for affirmation from the respective repository owners.  
    由於這是主要的 OS 升級，並且 OpenSSL 從 3.0 更改為 3.5 第三方存儲庫可能會幹擾您的升級體驗。刪除有問題的存儲庫和插件可能會有所幫助；或等待相應存儲庫所有者的確認。
    
-   The CPU microcode early loading has been known to be flaky on some setups. A fix is in the FreeBSD 15.1 boot loader code, but can only be reached by reinstall or manually updating the boot code of your system after the upgrade succeeded. If you want to be on the safe side during the upgrade itself please remove the plugin before proceeding.  
    眾所周知，CPU 微碼早期載入在某些設定上是不穩定的。 FreeBSD 15.1 引導程式程式碼中已修復，但只能在升級成功後透過重新安裝或手動更新系統的引導程式碼來實現。如果您想在升級過程中確保安全，請在繼續之前刪除該外掛程式。

#### 26.1 “Witty Woodpecker”（機智的啄木鳥） Series｜26.1 “Witty Woodpecker”（機智的啄木鳥）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_26.1.html>

For over 11 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates, modern IPv6 support, as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

11 年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用、現代 IPv6 支援以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

26.1, nicknamed “Witty Woodpecker”（機智的啄木鳥）, features almost a full firewall MVC/API experience as automation rules have been promoted to the new rules GUI, Suricata version 8 with inline inspection mode using “divert”, assorted IPv6 reliability and feature improvements, router advertisements MVC/API, full code shell command escaping revamp, default IPv6 mode now using Dnsmsaq for client connectivity, Unbound blocklist source selection, an automatic host discovery service, plus much more.

26.1，暱稱“Witty Woodpecker”（機智的啄木鳥） ，具有幾乎完整的防火牆 MVC/API 體驗，自動化規則已升級到新的規則 GUI，Suricata 版本 8，使用「divert」的內聯檢查模式，各種 IPv6 可靠性和功能改進，路由器通告 MVC/API，完整的代碼 shell IPv 客戶轉義改進，Unfid-li阻止清單來源​​選擇，自動主機發現服務，以及更多功能。

The upgrade path for 25.7 will likely be unlocked on January 29, which is probably tomorrow if anyone is asking why it is not there yet. We want to ensure the upgrade goes as smoothly as possible so please be patient! :)

25.7的升級路徑可能會在1月29日解鎖，如果有人問為什麼還沒有的話，那可能就是明天了。我們希望確保升級盡可能順利，請耐心等待！ :)

##### 26.1.11 (July 01, 2026)｜26.1.11（2026 年 7 月 1 日）

Back already with a bag of security advisories also for FreeBSD which came out just yesterday. We highly appreciate the increased amount of reports we are getting for the core code and we are working through them, but need to improve our process and guidelines somewhat in order to make more sense of the result for all of you. This will probably take additional effort after 26.7 is out.

回來時已經帶著一包昨天剛發布的針對 FreeBSD 的安全建議。我們非常感謝我們收到的核心程式碼報告數量的增加，我們正在解決這些報告，但需要稍微改進我們的流程和指南，以便讓大家更了解結果。 26.7 推出後，這可能需要額外的努力。

Note that this update brings the outbound to source NAT migration page, but it is only a formality as outbound NAT will stay in 26.7 although the legacy firewall rules page will move to a plugin during the major upgrade. It is the same process that was employed with ISC-DHCP. Due to this addition, however, the source NAT rules entered in the system will no longer work unless the mode is set to either “manual” or “hybrid”.

請注意，此更新將出站到來源NAT遷移頁面，但這只是一種形式，因為出站NAT將保留在26.7中，儘管舊防火牆規則頁面將在主要升級期間移動到插件。這與 ISC-DHCP 所採用的過程相同。然而，由於此添加，除非模式設定為“手動”或“混合”，否則輸入到系統中的來源NAT規則將不再起作用。

And thanks everyone for early 26.7-BETA testing! We are content to ship 26.7-RC1 early next week as a follow-up. The final release of 26.7 is planned for July 15.

感謝大家早期的26.7-BETA測試！我們很樂意在下週初發貨26.7-RC1作為後續。 26.7 預定於 7 月 15 日發售。

Here are the full patch notes:

-   system: add missing legacy\_html\_escape\_form\_data() for $a\_cert on administration settings [\[2\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58394) (reported by Jonas Ampferl of Hacking Cult)  
    系統：在管理設定 [\[2\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58394) 上為 $a\_cert 新增缺少的 Legacy\_html\_escape\_form\_data() (由 Hacking Cult 的 Jonas Ampferl 報告)
    
-   system: lockout: address newline injection and correct IP parsing [\[3\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-57155) (reported by lujiefsi)  
    系統：鎖定：解決換行注入並修正IP解析[\[3\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-57155)（由lujiefsi報告）
    
-   system: add “local\_uri” type in SanitizeFilter() and use it to avoid hardcoding

##### 26.1.10 (June 15, 2026)｜26.1.10（2026 年 6 月 15 日）

This update is the obvious answer to recent reports throughout the ecosystem: There are 3 core security issues fixed, FreeBSD security advisories, third party updates as well as assorted fixes plus improvements in the new rules GUI.

這次更新是對整個生態系統最近報告的明顯答案：修復了 3 個核心安全問題、FreeBSD 安全建議、第三方更新以及各種修復以及新規則GUI 的改進。

The firmware page had a number of minor regressions that should be sorted out with this release. They did not affect updates, but made the process a bit less smooth than usual. Be assured that each minor update is tested quite extensively, but non-functional issues like these can always slip through a test cycle and will be found in the next one. In the worst case that means two stable releases: the issues appeared with 26.1.8 but were not visible before 26.1.9 was being tested.

韌體頁面有一些小問題，應該透過此版本進行解決。它們不會影響更新，但使過程比平常稍微不那麼順利。請放心，每個小更新都會經過相當廣泛的測試，但像這樣的非功能性問題總是可能會漏過測試週期，並在下一個測試週期中被發現。在最壞的情況下，這意味著兩個穩定版本：26.1.8出現了問題，但在測試26.1.9之前不可見。

Under the hood the preparation for Source NAT migration, MVC/API support for interface assignments and FreeBSD 15.1 support is underway. We expect a 26.7-BETA in the near future once we are satisfied with the overall quality.

在幕後，原始碼 NAT 遷移、MVC/API 對介面分配的支援和 FreeBSD 15.1 支援的準備工作正在進行中。一旦我們對整體品質感到滿意，我們預計在不久的將來會獲得26.7-BETA。

##### 26.1.9 (June 02, 2026)｜26.1.9（2026 年 6 月 2 日）

As a sign of the times this update ships 3 core security fixes as well as OS and third party updates. Kea dynamic prefix delegation is also included plus more GUI improvements.

作為時代的標誌，此更新包含 3 個核心安全修復程序以及 OS 和第三方更新。還包括 Kea 動態前綴委託以及更多 GUI 改進。

Time to 26.7 is short. See you soon! :)

到達26.7的時間很短。再見！ :)

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system remove unused data-tooltip that is not properly escaped from certificates widget [\[1\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-49132)  
    系統刪除未從憑證小工具中正確轉義的未使用的資料工具提示 [\[1\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-49132)
    
-   system: tighten landing page redirect (contributed by Konstantinos Spartalis)  
    系統：收緊登陸頁面重定向（由 Konstantinos Spartalis 貢獻）
    
-   system: fix passing null into getRealInterface()  
    系統：修復將 null 傳遞到 getRealInterface() 的問題
    
-   system: fix regression in selective group delete introduced previously  
    系統：修復先前引入的選擇性組刪除中的回歸
    
-   system: allow unregistered plugin cron actions to be deleted  
    系統：允許刪除未註冊的插件 cron 操作
    
-   system: disable MAILTO for cron jobs  
    系統：為 cron 作業停用 MAILTO
    
-   reporting: render NaN values as empty values and omit leading empty records from data set for health graphs  
    報告：將 NaN 值呈現為空值，並省略健康圖資料集中的前導空記錄
    
-   reporting: add max on Y axis for traffic graphs  
    報告：在流量圖的 Y 軸上新增最大值
    
-   interfaces: dhclient.conf does not cope with multi-line request/require  
    介面：dhclient.conf 不處理多行請求/要求
    
-   interfaces: account for multiple UUIDs in VIP deletion  
    介面：在VIP刪除中考慮多個UUID
    
-   interfaces: more safe iteration through config\_read\_array()  
    介面：透過 config\_read\_array() 進行更安全的迭代
    
-   interfaces: fix wrong DUID-UUID format but keep accepting the wrong one  
    介面：修復錯誤的DUID-UUID格式，但繼續接受錯誤的格式
    
-   interfaces: fix regression in selective device delete introduced previously  
    介面：修復先前引入的選擇性設備刪除中的回歸
    
-   interfaces: IAID selection and prefix range reservation for WAN DHCPv6  
    介面：IAID WAN DHCPv6 選擇和前綴範圍預留
    
-   firewall: fix for missing HTML escape in description render in legacy rules GUI [\[2\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-49131)  
    防火牆：修正了舊規則中描述渲染中遺失的 HTML 轉義 GUI [\[2\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-49131)
    
-   firewall: add an alias formatter to show content fields as “dynamic” when populated by other components  
    防火牆：新增別名格式化程序，以便在由其他元件填滿時將內容欄位顯示為“動態”
    
-   firewall: fix Tabulator regression with alias batch delete  
    防火牆：透過別名批量刪除修復製表符回歸
    
-   firewall: use safe config iteration in interface registration  
    防火牆：在介面註冊中使用安全配置迭代
    
-   firewall: fix unintended change in filtering logic for new rules GUI  
    防火牆：修正新規則過濾邏輯的意外變更GUI
    
-   firewall: fix action, ipprotocol and protocol translations for legacy rules in new rules GUI

##### 26.1.8 (May 12, 2026)｜26.1.8（2026 年 5 月 12 日）

This updated fixes two recently reported vulnerabilities in the core code pertaining to WAN DHCPv4 configuration and user management. It also includes third party updates to Dnsmasq, OpenSSH and Unbound amongst others.

此更新修復了最近報告的與 WAN DHCPv4 配置和用戶管理相關的核心程式碼中的兩個漏洞。它還包括 Dnsmasq、OpenSSH 和 Unbound 等的第三方更新。

Captive portal IPFW accounting rules will regain a performance boost by bringing back hash lookups. Since this update does not issue a reboot by itself either do so or restart the captive portal instances to activate this change.

強制門戶IPFW會計規則將透過恢復哈希查找來重新獲得效能提升。由於此更新本身不會重新啟動，因此請執行此操作或重新啟動強制門戶實例以啟動此變更。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: properly escape username in sync\_user.php command invoke [\[1\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-44194) (contributed by Konstantinos Spartalis)  
    系統：在sync\_user.php指令呼叫[\[1\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-44194)中正確轉義使用者名稱（由Konstantinos Spartalis貢獻）
    
-   system: fix XMLRPC sync with VIP and “nosync” option  
    系統：修復XMLRPC與VIP同步和「nosync」選項
    
-   system: link CA references after all changes  
    系統：所有更改後連結CA參考
    
-   system: parse certificate “key\_type” and “digest”  
    系統：解析憑證“key\_type”和“digest”
    
-   system: allow flushing legacy OpenVPN legacy config  
    系統：允許刷新舊版 OpenVPN 舊版配置
    
-   system: audit “staticroute” config access  
    系統：審核“staticroute”配置訪問
    
-   system: use safe config iteration in core\_user\_changed\_groups()  
    系統：在 core\_user\_changed\_groups() 中使用安全性設定迭代
    
-   interfaces: safeguard DHCPv4 settings against arbitrary command injection [\[2\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-45158) (reported by Kchigo)  
    介面：保護 DHCPv4 設定免受任意指令注入 [\[2\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-45158)（由 Kchigo 報告）
    
-   interfaces: add missing config locks in device controllers  
    介面：在設備控制器中新增缺少的配置鎖
    
-   interfaces: use safe iteration in backend code  
    介面：在後端程式碼中使用安全迭代
    
-   interfaces: adjust and annotate interface\_dhcpv6\_id()  
    Interfaces：調整並註解interface\_dhcpv6\_id()
    
-   firewall: use save method from ApiMutableModelControllerBase for log command, move rule command and savepoint action  
    防火牆：使用 ApiMutableModelControllerBase 中的 save 方法進行日誌指令、移動規則指令和儲存點操作
    
-   firewall: safe config access in list\_legacy\_rules.php  
    防火牆：list\_legacy\_rules.php 中的安全設定存取
    
-   firewall: remove duplicated CSV button hook  
    防火牆：刪除重複的CSV按鈕掛鉤
    
-   firewall: fix NPTv6 validation for empty external subnet  
    防火牆：修復空外部子網路的 NPTv6 驗證
    
-   firewall: make getRealInterface() a static utility function  
    防火牆：使 getRealInterface() 成為靜態實用函數
    
-   firewall: refactor searchRuleAction() to use the same filtering and sorting logic on MVC and legacy data  
    防火牆：重構 searchRuleAction() 以對 MVC 和舊資料使用相同的過濾和排序邏輯
    
-   firewall: fix inverted source/destination cosmetic issue in SNAT and One-to-One NAT grids  
    防火牆：修復SNAT和一對一NAT網格中的反向來源/目標裝飾問題
    
-   captive portal: re-introduce hash lookup for accounting purposes  
    強制門戶：出於會計目的重新引入哈希查找

    強制門戶：在強制門戶上重新載入 IPFW 也重新配置

    dnsmasq：忽略「wpad」的DHCP名稱來修復CERT漏洞VU#598349

##### 26.1.7 (April 30, 2026)｜26.1.7（2026 年 4 月 30 日）

This includes all very recent FreeBSD SA/EN patches, a number of system improvements (how are you doing, Kea!) and third party updates for OpenVPN and StrongSwan.

這包括所有最新的 FreeBSD SA/EN 補丁、許多系統改進（Kea，你好嗎！）以及 OpenVPN 和 StrongSwan 的第三方更新。

It also includes one high and one medium advisory for our code. GitHub has not issued a CVE for this yet, unfortunately, but this announcement will be updated as soon as that happens. See below for details.

它還包括針對我們程式碼的一項高級和一項中級建議。不幸的是，GitHub 尚未為此發布CVE，但此公告將在發布後立即更新。詳情請參閱下文。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

    系統：使用 exec\_safe() [\[1\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-44193) 保護 popen()
    
-   system: lockout bypass fix [\[2\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-44195) (contributed by Konstantinos Spartalis)  
    系統：鎖定繞過修復 [\[2\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-44195)（由 Konstantinos Spartalis 貢獻）

##### 26.1.6 (April 09, 2026)｜26.1.6（2026 年 4 月 9 日）

Yes, we are obviously still alive! This update addresses a number of security issues – first and foremost an injection into LDAP authentication that can bypass group restrictions during login. Also included are Curl and OpenSSL third party updates as well as FreeBSD security advisories.

是的，我們顯然還活著！此更新解決了許多安全問題 - 首先也是最重要的是注入LDAP身份驗證，可以在登入期間繞過群組限制。還包括 Curl 和 OpenSSL 第三方更新以及 FreeBSD 安全建議。

Further UX tweaks reached the new firewall rules GUI, the MVC grid system and surprising movement in the Kea corner. But maybe most importantly: the captive portal finally gained native IPv6 support. Let us know what you think about it!

進一步的UX調整達到了新的防火牆規則GUI、MVC網格系統以及Kea角的令人驚訝的移動。但也許最重要的是：強制門戶最終獲得了原生 IPv6 支援。讓我們知道您的想法！

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: escape LDAP username during search [\[1\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-34578) (reported by Matt Andreko)  
    系統：在搜尋期間轉義LDAP用戶名[\[1\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-34578)（由Matt Andreko報告）
    
-   system: dashboard gauge improvements (contributed by Konstantinos Spartalis)  
    系統：儀表板儀表改進（由 Konstantinos Spartalis 貢獻）
    
-   system: compress height of the log viewer grid  
    system：日誌檢視器網格的壓縮高度
    
-   firewall: fix wrong “pass” on DNAT rule when using register rule  
    防火牆：修正使用註冊規則時DNAT規則上的錯誤“通過”
    
-   interfaces: configurable cleanups for automatic neighbor discovery via hostwatch  
    介面：透過 Hostwatch 自動發現鄰居的可設定清理
    
-   interfaces: refactor PPP CARP hook  
    介面：重構PPP CARP鉤子
    
-   firewall: adjust sort order in networks and aliases in new rules GUI  
    防火牆：調整新規則中網路和別名的排序順序GUI
    
-   firewall: change sorting to interface/group name and stop caring about counted rules in new rules GUI  
    防火牆：將排序更改為介面/群組名稱，不再關心新規則中的計數規則GUI
    
-   firewall: change category sorting using names instead of counted rules in new rules GUI  
    防火牆：在新規則中使用名稱而不是計數規則來更改類別排序GUI
    
-   firewall: remove tokenizer from categories and use selectpicker instead in new rules GUI  
    防火牆：從類別中刪除分詞器並在新規則中使用 selectpicker GUI
    
-   dnsmasq: prevent “\*” from being collected as “client\_id”  
    dnsmasq：防止“\*”被收集為“client\_id”
    
-   firmware: repeat the update after pkg reinstall  
    韌體：重新安裝 pkg 後重複更新
    
-   kea: add DDNS subnet-specific qualifying suffix and prevent updates if no server is set  
    kea：新增 DDNS 子網路特定的限定後綴，並在未設定伺服器的情況下阻止更新
    
-   kea: add sockets max-retries and retry-wait-time options  
    kea：新增套接字最大重試和重試等待時間選項
    
-   kea: add delete lease command and use socket for up-to-date lease collection  
    kea：新增刪除租約指令並使用套接字收集最新的租約
    
-   kea: move pool-in-subnet validation logic mostly to KeaPoolsField  
    kea：將子網路中的池驗證邏輯主要移至 KeaPoolsField
    
-   kea: remove KeaCtrlAgent dependency on HA configuration  
    kea：刪除 KeaCtrlAgent 對 HA 配置的依賴
    
-   kea: use SetConstraint for match\_data to allow 0 as valid value  
    kea：使用 SetConstraint 進行 match\_data 以允許 0 作為有效值
    
-   ipsec: add 4 insecure proposals for compatibility (contributed by Bjoern Jakobsen)  
    ipsec：新增 4 個不安全的相容性提案（由 Bjoern Jakobsen 貢獻）
    
-   captive portal: add IPv6 support (partially contributed by Alex Goodkind)  
    強制門戶：新增 IPv6 支援（部分由 Alex Goodkind 貢獻）
    
-   radvd: when adding a manual instance for an automatic “track6” interface do not ignore its settings  
    radvd：為自動「track6」介面新增手動實例時，不要忽略其設置
    
-   unbound: limit duckdb to a single thread in write mode to reduce logger memory usage

##### 26.1.3 (March 04, 2026)｜26.1.3（2026 年 3 月 4 日）

This update finally brings in Python 3.13 after the struggle we had with 3.11 and missing security patches. A number of things were fixed for the new rules GUI as well as assorted minor things in all areas of the code base. Two FreeBSD security advisories are also included and a reboot is needed to finish this update.

經過與 3.11 的鬥爭和缺少安全補丁之後，這次更新終於引入了 Python 3.13。新規則GUI修復了許多問題，以及程式碼庫所有區域中的各種小問題。還包括兩個 FreeBSD 安全建議，並且需要重新啟動才能完成此更新。

Of note are the recent modifications of the firmware scripting as they follow a fix in 26.1.2 that seems to have resolved the partial upgrade failures people have been reporting over the last 2 years. It turned out that the issue was a cleanup routine in the core package that removed temporary files in the background while the package manager was still attempting to install more packages.

值得注意的是最近對韌體腳本的修改，因為它們遵循26.1.2中的修復，該修復似乎解決了人們在過去兩年中報告的部分升級失敗問題。事實證明，問題是核心包中的清理例程在後台刪除了臨時文件，而套件管理器仍在嘗試安裝更多套件。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 26.1.2 (February 12, 2026)｜26.1.2（2026 年 2 月 12 日）

This is a smallish update with a number of fixes and another round of Python CVEs addressed. New images based on this stable version are planned for next week.

這是一個較小的更新，包含一些修復和另一輪 Python CVE 的解決方案。基於此穩定版本的新鏡像計劃於下週發布。

At the moment work focuses on the IPv6 support for the captive portal which should not be too far away now. The 26.7 roadmap will also be published at the end of this month.

目前的工作重點是對強制門戶的 IPv6 支持，現在應該不會太遠了。 26.7路線圖也將於本月底發布。

##### 26.1.1 (February 04, 2026)｜26.1.1（2026 年 2 月 4 日）

This ships OpenSSL and Python security updates as well as address a number of shortcomings of the initial 26.1 and community-infused improvements of the new rules GUI which we would not have dreamed of to get this quickly.

這帶來了 OpenSSL 和 Python 安全性更新，並解決了最初的 26.1 的許多缺點，以及社區注入的新規則 GUI 的改進，這是我們做夢也想不到的。

We are very happy with the current state of the new rules GUI and all the discussions we have had on how it can be further improved. It is just the beginning. A roadmap for 26.7 will be in the works later this month.

我們對新規則GUI的現狀以及我們就如何進一步改進它進行的所有討論感到非常滿意。這只是一個開始。 26.7 的路線圖將於本月稍後制定。

Looking back 11 years it appears that the best hopes we had for the project back then have all come true. It took lot longer than expected but we got there together with you, our beloved community. It will only take a bit more work now to achieve MVC/API support for all core components and remove root access from the web GUI. And we hope that you will be up for it in the coming years as well.

回顧11年，我們當時對這個計畫最好的希望都實現了。花費的時間比預期要長得多，但我們與你們，我們心愛的社區一起到達了那裡。現在只需要做更多的工作即可實現對所有核心組件的MVC/API支持，並從網路上刪除root存取權限GUI。我們希望您在未來幾年也能做好準備。

Images will likely be reissued based on this release, but it is not an immediate priority. Upgrade paths from 25.7 will also be updated in the near future to ensure the best possible upgrade experience.

圖像可能會根據此版本重新發布，但這不是當務之急。 25.7的升級路徑也將於近期更新，以確保最佳的升級體驗。

##### 26.1 (January 28, 2026)｜26.1（2026 年 1 月 28 日）

For over 11 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates, modern IPv6 support, as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

11 年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用、現代 IPv6 支援以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

26.1, nicknamed “Witty Woodpecker”（機智的啄木鳥）, features almost a full firewall MVC/API experience as automation rules have been promoted to the new rules GUI, Suricata version 8 with inline inspection mode using “divert”, assorted IPv6 reliability and feature improvements, router advertisements MVC/API, full code shell command escaping revamp, default IPv6 mode now using Dnsmsaq for client connectivity, Unbound blocklist source selection, an automatic host discovery service, plus much more.

26.1，暱稱“Witty Woodpecker”（機智的啄木鳥） ，幾乎具備完整的防火牆 MVC/API 體驗，自動化規則已升級到新的規則 GUI，Suricata 版本 8 具有使用「divert」的內聯檢查模式，各種 IPv6 可靠性和功能改進，路由器通告 MVC/API，完整的代碼 shell 客戶連接，阻止清單來源​​選擇，自動主機發現服務，以及更多功能。

The upgrade path for 25.7 will likely be unlocked on January 29, which is probably tomorrow if anyone is asking why it is not there yet. We want to ensure the upgrade goes as smoothly as possible so please be patient! :)

25.7的升級路徑可能會在1月29日解鎖，如果有人問為什麼還沒有的話，那可能就是明天了。我們希望確保升級盡可能順利，請耐心等待！ :)

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   ISC-DHCP moves to a plugin. It will be automatically installed during upgrades. It is not installed on new installations because it is not being used, but you can still install and keep using it.  
    ISC-DHCP 移至插件。升級過程中會自動安裝。它不會安裝在新安裝中，因為它未被使用，但您仍然可以安裝並繼續使用它。
    
-   To accommodate the change away from ISC-DCHP defaults the “Track interface” IPv6 mode now has a sibling called “Identity Association”（身分關聯） which does the same except it is not automatically starting ISC-DHCPv6 and Radvd router advertisements to allow better interoperability with Kea and Dnsmasq setups.  
    為了適應ISC-DCHP預設的變化，「追蹤介面」IPv6模式現在有一個名為“Identity Association”（身分關聯）的兄弟，它具有相同的功能，只是它不會自動啟動ISC-DHCPv6和Radvd路由器通告，以允許與Kea和Dnsmasq設定更好的互通性。
    
-   Dnsmasq is now the default for DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 as well as RA out of the box. One thing that the upstream software cannot cover is prefix delegation so that is no longer offered by default. Use another DHCPv6 server in this case.  
    Dnsmasq 現在是 DHCPv4 和 DHCPv6 以及 RA 的預設設定。上游軟體無法涵蓋的一件事是前綴委託，因此預設不再提供。在這種情況下，請使用另一個 DHCPv6 伺服器。
    
-   Due to command line execution safety concerns the historic functions mwexec\_bg() and mwexec() will be removed in 26.1.x. Make sure your custom code is not using them and use mwexecf(), mwexecfb() and mwexecfm() instead.  
    由於命令列執行安全性問題，歷史函數 mwexec\_bg() 和 mwexec() 將在 26.1.x 中刪除。確保您的自訂程式碼沒有使用它們，而是使用 mwexecf()、mwexecfb() 和 mwexecfm()。
    
-   The function sessionClose() has also been removed from the MVC code and is no longer needed. Make sure to remove it from your custom code.  
    函數 sessionClose() 也已從 MVC 程式碼中刪除，不再需要。確保將其從您的自訂程式碼中刪除。
    
-   The custom.yaml support has been removed from intrusion detection. Please migrate to the newer /usr/local/etc/suricata/conf.d override directory.  
    custom.yaml 支援已從入侵偵測中刪除。請遷移到較新的 /usr/local/etc/suricata/conf.d 覆蓋目錄。
    
-   The new host discovery service “hostwatch” is enabled by default (since 25.7.11). You can always turn it off under Interfaces: Neighbors: Automatic Discovery if you so choose.  
    預設啟用新的主機發現服務「hostwatch」（自 25.7.11 起）。如果您願意，您可以隨時在「介面：鄰居：自動發現」下將其關閉。
    
-   The firewall migration page is not something you need to jump into right away. Please make yourself familiar with the new rules GUI first and check the documentation for incompatibilities. Single interface from the floating interface will not be considered “floating” in priorities.  
    您不需要立即跳到防火牆遷移頁面。請先熟悉新規則GUI，並檢查文件是否不相容。浮動介面中的單一介面在優先權上不會被視為「浮動」。
    
-   Firewall: NAT: Port Forwarding is now called “Destination NAT”（目標 NAT）. Firewall rule associations are no longer supported, but the old associated firewall rules remain in place with their last known configuration and can now be edited to suit future needs.  
    防火牆：NAT：連接埠轉送現在稱為“Destination NAT”（目標 NAT）。不再支援防火牆規則關聯，但舊的關聯防火牆規則仍保留其最後已知的配置，現在可以進行編輯以滿足未來的需求。
    
-   Firewall: NAT: Source NAT is from the set of pages formerly known as automation, but Outbound NAT is still the main page for these types of rules.  
    防火牆：NAT：來源NAT來自以前稱為自動化的頁集，但出站NAT仍然是這些類型規則的主頁。

The second release candidate for 26.1 brings fixes for issues found by our awesome community. As an online-only update you need 26.1-RC1 to install it.

##### 26.1.r1 (January 22, 2026)｜26.1.r1（2026 年 1 月 22 日）

Here we are now with the first release candidate to kickstart the 26.1 series. While this marks the end of an era as ISC-DHCP functionality moves to a plugin it is only the beginning of structural improvements and further innovation of topics that are important to our users: firewall GUI and API, IPv6, intrusion detection using Suricata and overall security.

現在我們有了第一個候選版本來啟動 26.1 系列。雖然隨著ISC-DHCP功能轉移到插件，這標誌著一個時代的結束，但這只是結構改進和對我們用戶重要的主題進一步創新的開始：防火牆GUI和API、IPv6、使用Suricata的入侵檢測和整體安全性。

Keep in mind this is mostly an image-based pre-production test release. Upgrades from the 25.7.11 development version will be available at some point, but it is not clear when. An online-only RC2 will probably follow as well. The final release date for 26.1 is January 28.

請記住，這主要是基於影像的預生產測試版本。 25.7.11開發版本的升級將在某個時候推出，但具體時間尚不清楚。僅限線上的RC2也可能隨之而來。 26.1 的最終發布日期是 1 月 28 日。

[https://pkg.opnsense.org/releases/26.1/](https://pkg.opnsense.org/releases/26.1/)

Here are the development highlights since version 25.7 came out:

以下是25.7版本發布以來的開發亮點：

-   Introduce a new consistent rules GUI using MVC/API (formerly known as “Automation”（自動化）)  
    使用MVC/API（以前稱為“Automation”（自動化））引入新的一致規則GUI
    
-   Suricata version 8 and new inline inspection mode using “divert”  
    Suricata 版本 8 和使用「轉移」的新線上檢查模式
    
-   NAT port forwarding migrated to “Destination NAT”（目標 NAT） as MVC/API  
    NAT 埠轉送遷移至“Destination NAT”（目標 NAT），如MVC/API
    
-   Various IPv6 stability improvements and additional features  
    各種 IPv6 穩定性改進和附加功能
    
-   Setup wizard improvements including use case selection  
    設定嚮導改進，包括用例選擇
    
-   Services: Router Advertisements migrated to MVC/API  
    服務：路由器通告遷移到MVC/API
    
-   Shell command escaping improvements and audit  
    Shell 指令轉義改進與審核
    
-   Interfaces: Settings migrated to MVC/API  
    介面：設定已移轉到MVC/API
    
-   Default IPv6 setup now relies on Dnsmasq  
    預設 IPv6 設定現在依賴 Dnsmasq
    
-   Factory reset for individual components  
    各個組件恢復出廠設置
    
-   The firewall live log was rewritten  
    防火牆即時日誌被重寫
    
-   Unbound blocklist source selection  
    未綁定黑名單源選擇
    
-   Automatic host discovery service  
    自動主機發現服務
    

A more detailed change log will follow!

更詳細的變更日誌將隨之而來！

    ISC-DHCP 移至插件。升級過程中會自動安裝。它不會安裝在新安裝中，因為它未被使用，但您仍然可以安裝並繼續使用它。
    
-   To accommodate the change away from ISC-DCHP defaults the “Track interface” IPv6 mode now has a sibling called “Identity Association”（身分關聯） which does the same except it is not automatically starting ISC-DHCPv6 and Radvd router advertisements to allow better interoperability with Kea and Dnsmasq setups.  
    為了適應從ISC-DCHP默認值“跟踪接口”IPv6 模式的改變，現在有一個名為“Identity Association”（身分關聯）的同級模式，它執行相同的操作，只是不會自動啟動ISC -DHCPv6 和 Radvd 路由器通告，從而更好地與 Kea 和 Dnsmasq 設置互操作。
    
-   Due to command line execution safety concerns the historic functions mwexec\_bg() and mwexec() will be removed in 26.1.x. Make sure your custom code is not using them and use mwexecf(), mwexecfb() and mwexecfm() instead.  
    由於命令列執行安全性問題，歷史函數 mwexec\_bg() 和 mwexec() 將在26.1 .x 中移除。請確保您的自訂程式碼沒有使用它們，並改用 mwexecf()、mwexecfb() 和 mwexecfm()。
    
-   The function sessionClose() has also been removed from the MVC code and is no longer needed. Make sure to remove it from your custom code.  
    sessionClose() 函數已從MVC程式碼移除，不再需要。請確保從您的自訂程式碼中也移除它。
    
-   The custom.yaml support has been removed from intrusion detection. Please migrate to the newer /usr/local/etc/suricata/conf.d override directory.  
    入侵偵測功能已移除對 custom.yaml 的支援。請遷移到更新的 /usr/local/etc/suricata/conf.d 覆蓋目錄。

#### 25.7 “Visionary Viper”（有遠見的毒蛇） Series｜25.7 “Visionary Viper”（有遠見的毒蛇）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_25.7.html>

For over a decade now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

十多年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

25.7, nicknamed “Visionary Viper”（有遠見的毒蛇）, features reusable and thoroughly revamped frontend code, an SFTP backup plugin, experimental privilege separation for the GUI, JSON container support for aliases, a new and improved firewall automation GUI, performance enhancements especially for numerous aliases being used at once, Dnsmasq DHCP support, Kea DHCPv6 support, Greek as a new language, FreeBSD 14.3 plus much more.

25.7，綽號 “Visionary Viper”（有遠見的毒蛇）具有可重複使用且徹底改進的前端程式碼，以及 SFTP 備份插件，實驗性權限分離 GUI, JSON 容器別名支持，以及全新改良的防火牆自動化功能 GUI效能提升，尤其是同時使用多個別名時，Dnsmasq DHCP 支援、Kea DHCPv6 支援、希臘語作為新語言、FreeBSD 14.3 還有更多。

##### 25.7.11 (January 15, 2026)｜25.7.11（2026 年 1 月 15 日）

25.7.11 comes at a strange point in time but we will try to offer a bit of familiarity and common sense as we probably all need more of this. <3

25.7.11 出現在一個奇怪的時間點，但我們會盡力提供一些熟悉和常識，因為我們可能都需要更多這些。 <3

This release brings the new host discovery service which resolves and remembers MAC addresses for IPv4 and IPv6 hosts in your connected networks and provides this data for the firewall MAC aliases and captive portal clients. It is now enabled by default, but you can choose to opt out by disabling the automatic discovery option.

此版本帶來了新的主機發現服務，可解析並記住連接網路中 IPv4 和 IPv6 主機的 MAC 位址，並為防火牆 MAC 別名和強制入口網站用戶端提供此資料。現在預設啟用它，但您可以透過停用自動發現選項來選擇退出。

Note to people who were already on 25.7.11 and 27.7.11\_1: a modified hostwatch version was published disabling two excessive log messages. Applying the hotfix 25.7.11\_2 will not restart hostwatch. Please do so under Interfaces: Neighbors: Automatic Discovery by either using “apply” or the restart button in the service widget. Other reported issues will be addressed shortly.

已經使用 25.7.11 和 27.7.11\_1 的使用者請注意：已發布修改後的 hostwatch 版本，停用兩個過多的日誌訊息。應用修補程式 25.7.11\_2 將不會重新啟動 Hostwatch。請在「介面：鄰居：自動發現」下使用「應用」或服務小工具中的重新啟動按鈕執行此操作。其他報告的問題將很快解決。

A lot of work went into IPv6 improvements over the holidays as is tradition with the help of users debugging their networks during that time. A number of kernel fixes have been supplied and dhcp6c will also receive a larger update in 26.1 soon.

按照傳統，在假期期間，在用戶調試網路的幫助下，IPv6 的改進進行了大量工作。已經提供了許多核心修復程序，dhcp6c 很快就會在 26.1 中收到更大的更新。

The changes are otherwise clustered around preparation for the major upgrade which brings an number of fundamental changes with the ongoing removal of ISC-DHCP from core. A plugin is already available through the development version and should auto-install. If not make sure you install it before attempting a reboot there. For the stable version everything is as it was.

這些變化主要圍繞著重大升級的準備工作，隨著不斷從核心中刪除ISC-DHCP，帶來了許多根本性的變化。插件已經可以透過開發版本使用並且應該自動安裝。如果沒有，請確保在嘗試重新啟動之前安裝它。對於穩定版本，一切都保持原樣。

That being said, 26.1-RC1 will be out early next week and RC2 likely follows quickly. We are still set for a final release date of January 28. See you on the other side!

話雖如此，26.1-RC1 將於下週初發布，RC2 可能很快就會發布。我們仍將最終發布日期定為 1 月 28 日。我們另一邊見！

##### 25.7.10 (December 18, 2025)｜25.7.10（2025 年 12 月 18 日）

This update is released mainly due to the fact that FreeBSD-SA-25:12.rtsold [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-25:12.rtsold.asc) has impact on WAN-facing DHCPv6 connectivity being used, but also offers a mid-size batch of improvements like CARP VHID awareness for DHCRelay and a thorough cleanup and improvement pass over the Suricata integration we have been discussing during Suricon in November.

此次更新主要是因為 FreeBSD-SA-25:12.rtsold [\[2\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-25:12.rtsold.asc ) 對正在使用的面向 WAN 的 DHCPv6 連接產生了影響，但也提供了一批中等規模的改進，例如 DHCRelay 的 CARP VHID 連接產生了影響，但也提供了一批中等規模的改進

Of special note is that the captive portal accounting moves back to ipfw(4) from pf(4) because in larger deployments accounting rules are much faster this way and the use case of Ethernet-less captive portals such as on top of WireGuard now work properly again. The hook for pluggable pf(4) “ether” rules remains for now but will be removed in 26.1 as we do not intend to advocate its use.

特別值得注意的是，強制門戶計費從 pf(4) 移回 ipfw(4)，因為在大型部署中，計費規則通過這種方式要快得多，並且無以太網強制門戶的用例（例如在 WireGuard 之上）現在可以再次正常工作。可插入 pf(4)“以太”规则的钩子目前仍然存在，但将在 26.1 中删除，因为我们不打算提倡使用它。

Also, Python has reported security issues of which a DoS in http.client could potentially affect existing installations given that an HTTP server sends a malicious response which “can consume a large amount of memory and CPU time and cause swapping”. Python has not released an update for version 3.11 at this point in time.

此外，Python 還報告了安全性問題，其中 http.client 中的 DoS 可能會影響現有安裝，因為 HTTP 伺服器發送惡意回應，「可能消耗大量記憶體和 CPU 時間並導致交換」。 Python 目前尚未发布版本 3.11 的更新。

##### 25.7.9 (December 04, 2025)｜25.7.9（2025 年 12 月 4 日）

A bug snuck into the last release that did not properly disable the caching of DNS entries when using multiple blocklists with different network restrictions. We have used the opportunity to polish the notification code and apply behaviour during the migration of the old blocklist to the new format.

上一個版本中存在一個錯誤，該錯誤在使用具有不同網路限制的多個封鎖清單時未正確停用 DNS 條目的快取。我們利用這個機會完善了通知程式碼並應用了將舊阻止清單遷移到新格式期間的行為。

The saga around safe command execution continues in this release as well. Otherwise it is a rather quiet release and 2025 is almost over. Happy holidays!

圍繞安全命令執行的傳奇故事也在這個版本中繼續。除此之外，這是一個相當安靜的版本，2025 年也快結束了。節日快樂！

##### 25.7.8 (November 26, 2025)｜25.7.8 （2025年11月26日）

So we are making way for safer command execution since a comment was added to the certification of the business version about a possible injection into interfaces\_pfsync\_configure() – note that it was a comment and not a security issue since the exploit requires to edit the config.xml and/or do a configuration import.

因此，我們正在為更安全的命令執行鋪平道路，因為在業務版本的認證中添加了一條關於可能向 interfaces\_pfsync\_configure() 注入的註釋——請注意，這只是一條註釋，而不是一個安全問題，因為該漏洞利用需要編輯 config.xml 和/或進行配置。

The issue in interfaces\_pfsync\_configure() has now been fixed, but as mentioned the idea was to get rid of these problems once and for all so the Shell class was rewritten and every call was audited. You will see more movement on our way to 26.1 in this area as we do not want to push all changes into the 25.7 series immediately so that they can be properly verified first. Suffice to say most of the code we worked on over the years was already much safer due to the introduction of exec\_safe() very early in the project history.

interfaces\_pfsync\_configure() 中的問題現已修復，但正如之前提到的，我們的目標是徹底解決這些問題，因此我們重寫了 Shell 類，並對每次呼叫都進行了審核。在26.1版本發布之前，您會看到我們在這方面取得更多進展，因為我們不想立即將所有更改都推送到25.7系列，以便先進行充分的驗證。可以說，由於在專案早期就引入了 exec\_safe() 函數，我們多年來編寫的大部分程式碼已經安全得多。

The Unbound blocklists feature formerly known as a business feature is now a community feature! Since this required merging both the existing community one with the business one you need to make sure to reapply the blocklist settings after the reboot since it will not generate a new and actually incompatible format. Make sure to check your automatically migrated settings while at it.

Unbound 黑名單功能（原為企業版功能）現已升級為社群版功能！由於此次升級需要將現有的社群版和企業版合併，因此重啟後請務必重新應用黑名單設置，因為系統不會產生新的、實際上不相容的格式。同時，也請檢查一下自動遷移的設定。

What does all of this mean? It means security matters. It also means that community matters. We will continue to improve the community version because it is the base for the business version and that is exactly how it should be so that everybody can benefit from these changes!

這一切意味著什麼？這意味著安全至關重要。這也意味著社區至關重要。我們將繼續改進社群版，因為它是企業版的基礎，也應該如此，這樣才能讓每個人都能從這些改進中受益！

Note this release includes a new kernel with a lot of improvements in the vtnet(4) driver department. It is stable code according to release engineering procedures of FreeBSD but if you are seeing specific issues let us know.

請注意，此版本包含一個新內核，其中對 vtnet(4) 驅動程式進行了大量改進。根據 FreeBSD 的發布工程流程，程式碼穩定，但如果您遇到任何具體問題，請告知我們。
