##### 25.7.7 (November 06, 2025)｜25.7.7 （2025 年 11 月 6 日）

This update ships a number of third party security updates, firewall live log improvements based on user feedback from 25.7.6, plus minor fixes and improvements like usual.

本次更新包含多項第三方安全更新、根據25.7.6用戶回饋改進的防火牆即時日誌，以及一些常規的小修復和改進。

One focus at the moment is to get rid of the unsafe shell use in the backend which has been the source of multiple security issues in the project history. A few other things are coming to 25.7.x soon: a neighbor watch daemon, a new NDP proxy plugin and a community theme. Stay tuned. :)

目前的一個重點是消除後端不安全的 shell 使用，這一直是專案歷史上多個安全問題的根源。 25.7.x 很快還會推出其他一些功能：鄰居監視守護進程、新的 NDP 代理外掛程式和社群主題。敬請關注。 :)

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: simplify RRD backup code and remove exec() usage [\[1\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2025-13698) (reported by Alex Williams from Pellera Technologies working with Trend Zero Day Initiative)  
    系統：簡化RRD備份程式碼並移除 exec() 使用 [\[1\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2025-13698 ) （由 Pellera Technologies 的 Alex Williams 報告，他與 Trend Zero Day Initiative 合作）
    
-   system: move valid\_from search criteria to log\_matcher for faster end of search  
    系統：將有效值從搜尋條件移至日誌匹配器，以加快搜尋結束速度。
    
-   system: use file\_safe() in gateway monitor watcher  
    系統：在網關監視器中使用 file\_safe()
    
-   system: refactor factory reset page to MVC and add a reset per component operating on models  
    系統：重構恢復出廠設定頁面至MVC ，並為每個運行於不同型號的組件新增重設選項。
    
-   interfaces: ifctl: always allow reads to internal state files  
    介面：ifctl：始終允許讀取內部狀態文件
    
-   firewall: automation: fix alias IP address search  
    防火牆：自動化：修復別名IP地址搜索
    
-   firewall: automation: allow interface parameter to contain a list of interfaces for API users  
    防火牆：自動化：允許介面參數包含API用戶的介面列表
    
-   firewall: aliases: replace invalid unicode chars (contributed by Marius Halden)  
    防火牆：別名：取代無效的 Unicode 字元（由 Marius Halden 提供）
    
-   firewall: live log: only execute redraw on visibility state transition  
    防火牆：即時日誌：僅在可見性狀態轉換時執行重繪
    
-   firewall: live log: optimize viewbuffer rendering  
    防火牆：即時日誌：最佳化視圖緩衝區渲染
    
-   firewall: live log: prevent re-resolving in-flight requests and move host lookup to current filtered view  
    防火牆：即時日誌：阻止重新解析正在處理的請求，並將主機查找移至目前已過濾視圖
    
-   firewall: live log: fix data ordering and add table/history limit options  
    防火牆：即時日誌：修復資料排序並新增表格/歷史記錄限制選項
    
-   firewall: live log: use “badge” class like before  
    防火牆：即時日誌：像以前一樣使用「徽章」類
    
-   firewall: states: fix delete\_selected firewall states (contributed by Alexander Sulfrian)  
    防火牆：狀態：修正刪除選定的防火牆狀態（由 Alexander Sulfrian 提供）
    
-   dnsmasq: add optgroup support to DHCP option fields and expose all DHCPv4 options  
    dnsmasq：為DHCP選項欄位新增optgroup支援並公開所有DHCPv4選項
    
-   ipsec: sessions: add datakey property for row mapping  
    IPsec：會話：為行映射新增資料鍵屬性
    
-   ipsec: status: search phase 2 triggered twice on click and cleanup tooltip event as well  
    IPsec：狀態：點擊和清理工具提示事件均觸發了搜尋階段 2。
    
-   openvpn: use file\_safe() to write CRL files  
    openvpn：使用 file\_safe() 寫入CRL文件
    
-   mvc: OptionField: properly translate optgroup  
    MVC：OptionField：正確翻譯選項組
    
-   mvc: JsonKeyValueStoreField: fix race condition when using SourceField in the model  
    MVC：JsonKeyValueStoreField：修正在模型中使用 SourceField 時出現的競態條件
    
-   mvc: persist models description in root attribute of its respective configuration  
    MVC：將模型描述持久化到其對應配置的根屬性中
    
-   rc: secure an exec() in the recovery script  
    rc：確保復原腳本中的 exec() 函數可用

A hotfix release was issued as 25.7.7\_2:

-   system: fix a HA sync regression introduced in 25.7.6 that prevented a sync from succeeding in an edge case

##### 25.7.6 (October 22, 2025)｜25.7.6 （2025年10月22日）

The usual lot of additions and reliability fixes is being rounded off with Suricata version 8 and a new package manager version 2 almost two years in the making – at least for our project.

Suricata 版本 8 和新的軟體包管理器版本 2 完成了通常的大量新增功能和可靠性修復，該版本開發了近兩年——至少對於我們的專案而言是如此。

Please be aware that during the update check the new package manager will be installed, but will fail to report the update status like it always had before and so you will end up with an error that will require checking for updates again. The fix is in this update, but impossible to install without upgrading the package manager first. We hope this will only be a minor inconvenience during the process.

請注意，在更新檢查過程中，新的軟體包管理器將被安裝，但它將無法像以前那樣報告更新狀態，因此您最終會遇到錯誤，需要再次檢查更新。此更新已修復此問題，但如果不先升級軟體套件管理器，則無法安裝此更新。我們希望這只會給您帶來一些小小的麻煩。

Syslog-ng is also being updated and includes a fix that previously prevented 2.9.x from shipping since it would hang the boot during daemonize. Many thanks to the authors for quickly picking this up and providing a fixed version!

Syslog-ng 也已更新，其中包含一個修復程序，該程序之前會導致2.9 .x 版本在守護程序運行時卡住啟動，從而無法發布。非常感謝作者們迅速發現並提供了修復版本！

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: safeguard config history delete and revert by requiring HTTP POST method  
    系統：透過要求使用HTTP POST方法來保護配置歷史記錄的刪除和還原。
    
-   system: change atrun interval to every minute  
    系統：將運行間隔變更為每分鐘
    
-   system: use new file\_safe() in two instances  
    系統：在兩個實例中使用 new file\_safe()
    
-   system: improve the HA VIP sync code  
    系統：改進HA VIP同步程式碼
    
-   interfaces: fix permission of packet capture file in strict security mode  
    介面：修正嚴格安全模式下封包擷取檔案的權限問題
    
-   firewall: refactor live log using a ring buffer  
    防火牆：使用環形緩衝區重構即時日誌
    
-   firewall: add toggles to disable selected automatic rules  
    防火牆：新增開關以停用選定的自動規則
    
-   firewall: enable “safe delete” for categories  
    防火牆：為類別啟用“安全刪除”
    
-   firewall: improved stats rendering on automation rules  
    防火牆：改進了自動化規則的統計資訊渲染
    
-   firewall: allow searching aliases in automation rules inspect mode by IP address  
    防火牆：允許在自動化規則檢查模式下透過IP位址搜尋別名
    
-   dnsmasq: strict hostname and domain validation plus improved ipset validations  
    dnsmasq：嚴格的主機名稱和網域驗證，以及改進的ipset驗證
    
-   firmware: package manager upgrade changes for pkg 2.x

Updates are slower than usual at the moment, but it is also relatively calm out there security-wise. While this finally ships Kea version 3 we are still working on the package manager version 2 and Suricata 8 with good results. Stay tuned!

##### 25.7.3 (September 09, 2025)｜25.7.3 （2025年9月9日）

The Tabulator introduction into MVC grid views was a major success with virtually no complaints. Did you notice? Maybe you will now that more features have been unlocked: Dnsmasq grids group by interfaces, firewall automation rules now can show folders using categories and row count default and selections have been increased. A few performance and UX tweaks were carried out as well while at it.

Tabulator 引入MVC網格視圖取得了巨大成功，幾乎沒有收到任何投訴。您注意到了嗎？現在更多功能已解鎖，您或許會更加關注：Dnsmasq 網格現在按介面分組，防火牆自動化規則現在可以使用類別和預設行數顯示資料夾，並且選擇範圍也已擴大。此外，我們也進行了一些效能最佳化和UX的調整。

StrongSwan moves to version 6.0.1 now after elaborate testing. The “make\_before\_break” value was flipped from off to on in their version jump, but the settings will still default to off for everyone unless already otherwise configured.

經過詳盡的測試，StrongSwan 現已升級至6.0.1版本。版本更新中，「make_before_break」 的值已從關閉切換為開啟，但除非另有配置，否則所有使用者的預設設定仍為關閉。

##### 25.7.2 (August 21, 2025)｜25.7.2 （2025年8月21日）

This stable update has the look and feel of a typical update across all corners of the project: FreeBSD advisories and errata, fixes and quality of life improvements in core, several plugin and third party software updates.

這次穩定更新在專案的各個方面都呈現出典型的更新風格：FreeBSD 公告和勘誤表、核心修復和生活品質改進、多個插件和第三方軟體更新。

We are also compiling the roadmap for 26.1 at the moment. Stay tuned.

我們目前也在製定26.1的路線圖。敬請期待。

##### 25.7 (July 23, 2025)｜25.7 （2025年7月23日）

For over a decade now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

十多年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

25.7, nicknamed “Visionary Viper”（有遠見的毒蛇）, features reusable and thoroughly revamped frontend code, an SFTP backup plugin, experimental privilege separation for the GUI, JSON container support for aliases, a new and improved firewall automation GUI, performance enhancements especially for numerous aliases being used at once, Dnsmasq DHCP support, Kea DHCPv6 support, Greek as a new language, FreeBSD 14.3 plus much more.

25.7，綽號 “Visionary Viper”（有遠見的毒蛇）具有可重複使用且徹底改進的前端程式碼，以及 SFTP 備份插件，實驗性權限分離 GUI, JSON 容器別名支持，以及全新改良的防火牆自動化功能 GUI效能提升，尤其是同時使用多個別名時，Dnsmasq DHCP 支援、Kea DHCPv6 支援、希臘語作為新語言、FreeBSD 14.3 還有更多。

Download links, an installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: the setup wizard was rewritten using MVC/API  
    系統：安裝精靈已使用MVC/API重寫。
    
-   system: change default DHCP use from ISC to Dnsmasq for factory reset and console port and address assignments  
    系統：將預設的DHCP用法從ISC更改為 Dnsmasq，用於恢復出廠設定以及控制台連接埠和位址分配。
    
-   system: numerous permission, ownership and directory alignments for web GUI privilege separation  
    系統：針對 Web 的權限、所有權和目錄對齊方式GUI權限分離
    
-   system: allow experimental feature to run web GUI privilege separated as “wwwonly” user  
    系統：允許實驗性功能以「wwwonly」使用者身分運行，web GUI權限已隔離
    
-   system: add a banner when trying to revert the privilege separated GUI back to root at run time  
    系統：嘗試在執行時將權限GUI還原為 root 時新增橫幅
    
-   system: consistently use empty() checks on “blockbogons”, “blockpriv”, “dnsallowoverride” and “dnsallowoverride\_exclude”  
    系統：總是對「blockbogons」、「blockpriv」、「dnsallowoverride」和「dnsallowoverride\_exclude」使用 empty() 檢查
    
-   system: change default system domain to “internal” (contributed by Self-Hosting-Group)  
    系統：將預設系統網域變更為「internal」（由 Self-Hosting-Group 提供）
    
-   system: add missing “kernel” application for remote logging  
    系統：新增缺少的「核心」應用程式以進行遠端日誌記錄
    
-   system: remove the “optional” notion of tunables known to the system  
    系統：移除系統中已知的可調參數的「可選」概念
    
-   system: enable kernel timestamps by default  
    系統：預設啟用核心時間戳
    
-   system: allow CSR to be downloaded from System/Trust/Certificates (contributed by Gavin Chappell)  
    系統：允許從 System/Trust/Certificates 下載CSR （由 Gavin Chappell 提供）
    
-   reporting: removed the unused second argument in getSystemHealthAction()  
    報表：已移除 getSystemHealthAction() 函數中未使用的第二個參數
    
-   reporting: renamed getRRDlistAction() to getRrdListAction()  
    報表：將 getRRDlistAction() 重新命名為 getRrdListAction()
    
-   interfaces: fix media settings write issue since 24.7 as it would not apply when “autoselect” result already matched  
    介面：修正媒體設定寫入問題（自24.7起），因為當「自動選擇」結果已符合時，寫入操作將無法生效。
    
-   interfaces: removed defunct SLAAC tracking functionality (SLAAC on WAN still works fine)  
    接口：已移除失效的SLAAC追蹤功能（ SLAAC在WAN上仍然有效）
    
-   interfaces: no longer fix improper WLAN clone naming at run time as it should be ensured by code for a long time now  
    介面：不再在運行時修復不正確的WLAN克隆命名問題，因為程式碼早已確保了這一點。
    
-   interfaces: remove the functions get\_configured\_carp\_interface\_list() and get\_configured\_ip\_aliases\_list()  
    介面：移除函數 get\_configured\_carp\_interface\_list() 和 get\_configured\_ip\_aliases\_list()
    
-   interfaces: add VIP grid formatter to hide row field content based on the set mode  
    介面：新增VIP網格格式化程序，根據設定的模式隱藏行字段內容
    
-   interfaces: drop redundant updates in rtsold\_resolvconf.sh (contributed by Andrew Baumann)  
    interfaces：刪除 rtsold\_resolvconf.sh 中的冗餘更新（由 Andrew Baumann 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: add expire option to external aliases to automatically cleanup tables via cron  
    防火牆：為外部別名新增過期選項，以便透過 cron 自動清理表。
    
-   firewall: removed the expiretable binary use in favour of the builtin pfctl  
    防火牆：已移除使用過期二進位文件，改用內建的 pfctl。
    
-   firewall: speed up alias functionality by using the new model caching  
    防火牆：利用新的模型快取來加快別名功能
    
-   firewall: consolidated ipfw/dnctl scripting and fix edge case reloads  
    防火牆：整合了ipfw/dnctl腳本並修復了極端情況下的重新載入問題
    
-   firewall: code cleanup and performance improvements for alias diagnostics page  
    防火牆：別名診斷頁面的程式碼清理和效能改進
    
-   firewall: fix AttributeError: DNAME object has no attribute address on DNS fetch for aliases  
    防火牆：修正 AttributeError： DNAME物件在DNS取得別名時沒有屬性 address
    
-   firewall: assorted UI updates for automation pages  
    防火牆：自動化頁面的各種UI更新
    
-   captive portal: make room for additional authentication profiles  
    強制門戶：為其他身份驗證設定檔騰出空間
    
-   captive portal: API dispatcher is now privilege separated via “wwwonly” user and group  
    強制入口網站： API調度程式現在透過「wwwonly」使用者和群組進行權限隔離
    
-   dnsmasq: add optional subnet mask to “dhcp-range” to satisfy DHCP relay requirements  
    dnsmasq：在「dhcp-range」中加入可選子網路遮罩，以符合DHCP中繼要求
    
-   dnsmasq: sync CSV export with ISC and Kea structure  
    dnsmasq：同步CSV導出與ISC和 Kea 結構
    
-   dnsmasq: add CNAME configuration option to host overrides  
    dnsmasq：將CNAME設定選項新增至主機覆蓋
    
-   dnsmasq: add ipset support  
    dnsmasq：新增 ipset 支持
    
-   firmware: opnsense-version: build time package variable replacements can now be read at run time  
    韌體：opnsense-version：建置時包變數替換現在可以在運行時讀取
    
-   firmware: hide community plugins by default and add a checkbox to unhide them on the same page  
    韌體：預設隱藏社區插件，並在同一頁面上新增一個複選框以取消隱藏它們。
    
-   firmware: introduce a new support tier 4 for development and otherwise unknown plugins  
    韌體：為開發和其他未知插件引入新的第四級支持
    
-   firmware: disable the FreeBSD-kmods repository by default  
    韌體：預設為停用 FreeBSD-kmods 軟體倉庫

    韌體：sunset mirror dns-root.de（非常感謝 Alexander Lauster 近十年來對其進行維護！）
    
-   intrusion detection: add an override banner for custom.yaml use

-   isc-dhcp: hide IPv4 menu items when Dnsmasq DHCP is enabled to improve out of the box experience  
    isc-dhcp：啟用 Dnsmasq DHCP時隱藏 IPv4 選單項，以改善開箱即用的體驗

-   src: FreeBSD 14.3-RELEASE-p1 plus assorted stable/14 networking commits [\[7\]](https://www.freebsd.org/releases/14.3R/relnotes/)  
    src: FreeBSD 14.3-RELEASE -p1 以及各種 stable/14 網路提交 [\[7\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/releases/14.3R/relnotes/ )
    

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   Deprecated Google Drive backups due to upstream policy changes and moved to plugins for existing users.  
    由於上游政策變更，Google 雲端硬碟備份功能已棄用，現有用戶已將其遷移至插件。
    
-   API URLs registered in the default ACLs have been switched from “camelCase” to “snake\_case”.  
    API預設 ACL 中註冊的 URL 已從「駝峰式」切換為「蛇形式」。
    
-   API grid return values now offer “%field” for a value description when available. “field” will now always be the literal value from the configuration. The API previously returned a display value for some field types, but not all.  
    API 網格傳回值現在提供「%field」作為值描述（如果可用）。 「field」現在將始終是配置中的文字值。 API 之前傳回了某些欄位類型的顯示值，但不是全部。
    
-   Reverted tunables “hw.ibrs\_disable” and “vm.pmap.pti” to FreeBSD defaults. If you want these set differently, then add them with an explicit value.  
    已將「hw.ibrs\_disable」和「vm.pmap.pti」這兩個可調參數還原為FreeBSD預設值。如果您希望將它們設為其他值，請明確新增它們。
    
-   While the mirror dns-root.de has been removed it will not be stripped from a running configuration and may keep working for a while longer. To ensure updates, however, please choose a different mirror at your own convenience.  
    雖然鏡像 dns-root.de 已移除，但它不會從正在運行的配置中移除，可能還能繼續工作一段時間。但為了確保及時更新，請自行選擇其他鏡像。
    
-   Moved OpenVPN legacy to plugins as a first step to deprecation.  
    將 OpenVPN 的舊版本遷移到插件中，這是棄用的第一步。
    
-   Moved IPsec legacy to plugins as a first step to deprecation.  
    將 IPsec 傳統功能遷移到外掛程式中，作為棄用的第一步。

##### 25.7.r2 (July 17, 2025)｜25.7 .r2（2025年7月17日）

This is the second release candidate for your consideration. A kernel update was included to keep up with FreeBSD stable/14. A few nice things have been added to Dnsmasq as well. This is an online update only.

這是供您參考的第二個候選版本。此次更新包含了核心更新，以與 FreeBSD stable/14 保持同步。此外，Dnsmasq 還添加了一些實用功能。本次更新僅限線上。

Here are the development highlights since version 25.1 came out:

以下是自25.1版本發布以來的主要開發進展：

-   Replace the setup wizard with a modern MVC/API variant  
    將設定精靈替換為現代的MVC/API版本
    
-   Switch to reusable frontend code  
    切換到可重複使用的前端程式碼
    
-   ChartJS 4 update and related functionality migrations  
    ChartJS 4 更新及相關功能遷移
    
-   User manager CSV export and import option  
    用戶管理器CSV匯出和匯入選項
    
-   New plugin for SFTP configuration backups  
    用於SFTP配置備份的新插件
    
-   Move frontend grid from Bootgrid to Tabulator  
    將前端網格從 Bootgrid 遷移到 Tabulator
    
-   Optional privilege separation for the web GUI (running as non-root)  
    可選的 Web 權限分離GUI （以非 root 使用者身分執行）
    
-   User/group manager adds optional source network constraint  
    使用者/群組管理器新增了可選的來源網路約束
    
-   JSON container support for aliases  
    JSON容器別名支持
    
-   Firewall automation GUI revamp  
    防火牆自動化GUI改造
    
-   Performance improvements when using large amounts of aliases  
    使用大量別名時效能有所提升
    
-   Dnsmasq DHCP support for small and medium sized setups  
    Dnsmasq DHCP支援中小型部署
    
-   Support advanced (manual) configurations in Kea  
    支援 Kea 中的高級（手動）配置
    
-   Add IPv6 support (including prefix delegation) to Kea  
    為 Kea 新增 IPv6 支援（包括前綴委派）
    
-   Bridges MVC migration  
    橋樑MVC遷移
    
-   Migrate IPsec mobile page to MVC  
    將 IPsec 行動頁面移轉到MVC
    
-   Greek as a new language  
    希臘語作為一種新語言
    
-   FreeBSD 14.3

    dnsmasq：修復空DHCP選項值所導致的多餘逗號

##### 25.7.r1 (July 14, 2025)｜25.7 .r1（2025年7月14日）

#### 25.1 “Ultimate Unicorn”（終極獨角獸） Series｜25.1 “Ultimate Unicorn”（終極獨角獸）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_25.1.html>

For an entire decade now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

十年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

25.1, nicknamed “Ultimate Unicorn”（終極獨角獸）, features numerous MVC/API conversions, improved security zones support and documentation, ZFS snapshot support, a new UI look with a light and dark theme, PHP 8.3, FreeBSD 14.2 plus much more.

25.1，暱稱“Ultimate Unicorn”（終極獨角獸），具有大量 MVC/API 轉換、改進的安全區域支援和文件、ZFS 快照支援、帶有淺色和深色主題的新 UI 外觀、PHP 8.3、FreeBSD 14.2 等等。

##### 25.1.12 (July 22, 2025)｜25.1.12 （2025年7月22日）

This EoL release after an EoL release is unexpected, but certainly not unnecessary. A bug in the shared library naming in Sqlite was briefly introduced in FreeBSD ports going into 25.1.11 which is also a likely cause for reported update issues with missing packages after reboot. This was only uncovered yesterday during upgrade testing for 25.7.

在上一個版本發布終止支援 (EoL) 後又發布一個 EoL 版本，這雖然出乎意料，但並非毫無必要。 Sqlite 共享庫命名中的一個 bug 在 FreeBSD ports 中短暫出現，並被引入到25.1.11版本中，這很可能是導致重啟後出現軟體包缺失更新問題的原因之一。這個問題直到昨天在25.7的升級測試中才被發現。

To ensure proper upgrades it was decided to roll a full stable release with added benefits like security fixes for Unbound, LibXML and a “modern browser” fix for the firewall rules page which could not be saved under particular circumstances.

為了確保正確升級，決定推出完整的穩定版本，並添加一些額外功能，例如修復 Unbound 和 LibXML 的安全問題，以及修復防火牆規則頁面在特定情況下無法保存的「現代瀏覽器」問題。

25.7 itself is still scheduled for tomorrow pending green light during testing its rebuild. The firmware components have already been wired to detect the upgrade once it becomes visible on the mirror. There will likely be no further hotfix this time to pick up the release. Just check again for updates some hours after the 25.7 release announcement to allow for mirrors to synchronize.

25.7本身仍計劃於明日發布，但需通過重建測試。韌體組件已完成連接，以便在鏡像伺服器上顯示升級資訊後立即檢測到。此次可能不會再發布其他熱補丁來同步版本。請在25.7發佈公告發佈數小時後再次檢查更新，以便鏡像伺服器同步。

##### 25.1.11 (July 16, 2025)｜25.1.11 （2025年7月16日）

This maintenance release will also be the EoL version for the 25.1 series. It ships the latest FreeBSD SA/EN patches plus other third party security updates and a few minor fixes.

此次維護版本也將是25.1系列的最終版本。它包含了最新的FreeBSD SA/EN補丁以及其他第三方安全更新和一些小的修復。

We did see issues with the “e2fsprogs-libuuid” dependency lately obsoleted by FreeBSD ports and while packages such as “netdata” may refuse updating in the first update it should eventually reinstall correctly using the new “libuuid” package. If you see related issues make sure you are not using multi-repo setups that still provide the obsoleted dependency.

我們最近發現 FreeBSD ports 已棄用“e2fsprogs-libuuid”依賴項，雖然像“netdata”這樣的軟體包在首次更新時可能拒絕更新，但最終應該會使用新的“libuuid”軟體包正確重新安裝。如果您遇到相關問題，請確保您沒有使用仍提供已棄用依賴項的多倉庫設定。

That being said, 25.7-RC1 is already out, but RC2 likely follows tomorrow. We are still set for a final release date of July 23. See you on the other side!

也就是說， 25.7-RC1已經發布， RC2很可能明天就會發布。我們仍然計劃在7月23日最終發布。我們到時見！

##### 25.1.10 (July 01, 2025)｜25.1.10 （2025年7月1日）

We are getting close to 25.7. In fact, the release date is July 23. As such minimal changes are going into this stable release for the usual reasons.

##### 25.1.8 (June 12, 2025)｜25.1.8 （2025年6月12日）

This update addresses a few security issues in third party software, but take note that libxml is currently stuck in an old release in FreeBSD ports that was decided not to be fixed there for the time being.

本次更新解決了第三方軟體中的一些安全性問題，但請注意，libxml 目前仍停留在 FreeBSD ports 的舊版本中，該版本暫時決定不進行修復。

Dnsmasq receives more improvements as you all explore the limits of the current implementation and what the software can still offer beyond that. Thank you for all the good feedback on this front!

隨著大家不斷探索目前實現的限制以及軟體的更多潛力，Dnsmasq 也得到了更多改進。感謝大家在這方面提供的所有寶貴回饋！

The FreeBSD kernel was updated with a number of upstream stable commits while we get closer to evaluating the jump to a newer FreeBSD release for 25.7.

FreeBSD 核心已透過一些上游穩定提交進行了更新，同時我們也越來越接近評估25.7向更新的 FreeBSD 版本躍升的可行性。

Lastly, we are preparing for a historic moment: offering privilege separation for the GUI meaning the web server can stop running as a root user. This may still be optional in the next major version, but it makes fixing the remaining incompatibilities much easier.

最後，我們正在為一個歷史性的時刻做準備：為GUI提供權限分離，這意味著Web伺服器可以停止以root使用者身分運作。在下一個主要版本中，這可能仍然是可選的，但它將大大簡化修復剩餘不相容性的過程。

##### 25.1.7 (May 19, 2025)｜25.1.7 （2025年5月19日）

Dnsmasq DHCP is here and now it is going to be even better with multiple fixes thanks to the swift feedback we received. We are aware of the complex topic of DHCP in the recent years so keep in mind we added Dnsmasq to fill a specific need for smaller installations that other services cannot offer. There are still areas where Kea shines so having both options is the best way forward.

Dnsmasq DHCP現已推出，由於我們收到了許多快速回饋，因此修復了多個問題，使其性能更加完善。我們了解近年來DHCP的複雜性，因此請記住，我們添加 Dnsmasq 是為了滿足其他服務無法滿足的小型部署的特定需求。 Kea 在某些方面仍然表現出色，因此同時提供這兩種選擇是最佳方案。

Here are the full patch notes:

    系統：保護 local\_group\_set()，因為使用者可能由於正當理由而不存在。

    interfaces：模擬 ifconfig 中 legacy\_interface\_create() 的邊緣情況的裝置名稱返回

    介面：改進私有網路和 Bogon 網路過濾器（由 Maurice Walker 提供）

##### 25.1.6 (May 08, 2025)｜25.1.6 （2025年5月8日）

After some back and forth today we are rolling back a console default change done in FreeBSD 14.2 that we do not think is necessary at this particular point in time. The bridge configuration code was also refactored to introduce it to MVC/API in an upcoming stable release.

經過今天的反覆討論，我們決定撤銷在 FreeBSD 14.2中對控制台預設設定的更改，我們認為目前沒有必要進行此項更改。橋接配置程式碼也已重構，以便在即將發布的穩定版本MVC/API中引入。

A few more problems with the new captive portal backend have also been addressed in order to make it match the behaviour of the previous one. It is now possible to disable the automatic rules to further refine the desired captive portal behaviour.

為了使新的強制門戶後端與先前的版本保持一致，我們還修復了一些其他問題。現在可以停用自動規則，以便進一步優化所需的強制門戶行為。

Last but not least: Kea DHCPv6 is here. And with it full DHCP and router advertisement support in Dnsmasq to bridge the gap for ISC users who do not need or want Kea. We are going to make Dnsmasq DHCP the default in new installations starting with 25.7, too. ISC DHCP will still be around as a core component in 25.7 but likely moves to plugins for 26.1 next year.

最後但並非最不重要的一點是：Kea DHCPv6 已上線。並透過 Dnsmasq 中的完整DHCP和路由器通告支援來彌補不需要或不需要 Kea 的ISC用戶的差距。我們也將把 Dnsmasq DHCP 作為從 25.7 開始的新安裝中的預設設定。 ISC DHCP 仍將作為 25.7 的核心組件存在，但明年可能會成為 26.1 的插件。

##### 25.1.5 (April 10, 2025)｜25.1.5 （2025年4月10日）

This release improves overall RADIUS support, moves the captive portal from IPFW to PF, creates visibility of external certificate sources in the system and offers a glimpse into the filter automation GUI revamp which could one day replace the remaining static firewall rules edit pages.

此版本改進了對RADIUS整體支持，將強制門戶從IPFW移至PF ，創建了系統中外部證書源的可見性，並提供了對過濾器自動化GUI改進一日的一瞥，該改進有朝一日可能會取代剩餘的朝內設備。

Speaking of static pages: MVC/API conversions are almost 80% complete now and we would really like to continue that trend. Also brace for impact as we crash-land Dnsmasq DHCP support in a stable release within the next 90 days!

說到靜態頁面： MVC/API轉換工作目前已完成近 80%，我們非常希望能夠維持這股動能。此外，請做好準備，我們將在未來 90 天內透過穩定版本緊急推出 Dnsmasq DHCP的支援！

##### 25.1.4 (March 26, 2025)｜25.1.4 （2025年3月26日）

This update offers support for “jq” syntax in JSON-based URL table aliases, new OpenVPN instance features and the mandatory batch of stability improvements in numerous parts of the GUI and backend.

本次更新為基於JSON的URL表別名中的「jq」語法提供了支持，新增了 OpenVPN 實例功能，並對GUI和後端的多個部分進行了一系列必要的穩定性改進。

Upcoming in 25.1.5 are better RADIUS integration and enabling message authentication. We are also replacing the captive portal implementation by moving from ipfw(4) to pf(4). Last but not least the firewall automation filter rules GUI received a generous revamp for a far better UX than before. You can preview these changes by switching to the development release type and let us know about any remaining bug that you may encounter.

即將推出的25.1.5版本將改進RADIUS整合並啟用訊息驗證。我們也將取代強制門戶的實現，從 ipfw(4) 遷移到 pf(4)。最後，防火牆自動化過濾規則GUI也進行了大幅改進，使其比以往更加完善UX 。您可以切換到開發版本預覽這些更改，並告知我們您可能遇到的任何其他錯誤。

##### 25.1.3 (March 11, 2025)｜25.1.3 （2025年3月11日）

This time around a patch from OpenBSD has been added that fixes the state tracking for ICMPv6 neighbour discovery packets through pf. The user management gained a CSV import/export. Also, the bug of the missing PPP logs has been fixed in the upstream MPD package.

這次新增了一個來自 OpenBSD 的補丁，修復了透過 pf MPD ICMPv6 鄰居發現封包的狀態追蹤問題。用戶管理新增了一個CSV導入/匯出功能。此外，上游PPP軟體包中日誌缺失的錯誤也已修復。

Please note that the FRR plugin now uses the new configuration file layout mandated by upstream and also gained reload support.

請注意， FRR插件現在使用上游規定的新設定檔佈局，並且還獲得了重新載入支援。

Since Google Drive is being phased out by Google, a new plugin now covers backups via SFTP. The old Google Drive backup functionality will move to plugins in 25.7 since it will only be useful for existing installs.

由於 Google 正在逐步淘汰 Google 雲端硬碟，現在透過SFTP提供新的插件來支援備份。舊的 Google 雲端硬碟備份功能將在25.7中遷移到插件，因為它僅適用於已安裝的 Google 雲端硬碟。

##### 25.1.2 (February 28, 2025)｜25.1.2 （2025年2月28日）

This was supposed to hit earlier this week, but some weeks are like this one now where QA takes more time than usual. Of note is the move of Dnsmasq to MVC and the ChartJS update to version 4 which is bundled with nice updates for widgets and the system health graphs.

原計劃本週早些時候發布，但像本週這樣， QA的發佈時間比平時要長一些。值得注意的是，Dnsmasq 已遷移至MVC ，ChartJS 也更新至版本 4，此次更新還包含對小部件和系統健康圖表的諸多改進。

The roadmap for 25.7 was also published [\[1\]](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/) . The IPsec and OpenVPN legacy parts will move to the plugins so that the functionality can live there in community support tier. Since Kea remains a bit of an odd choice we will be offering DHCP support via Dnsmasq as a new standard feature which also offers seamless DHCP lease registration some people keep looking for.

25.7的路線圖也已發布 [\[1\]]( https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/ )。 IPsec 和 OpenVPN 的舊版功能將會遷移到外掛程式中，以便在社群支援層級中保留這些功能。由於 Kea 仍然是一個略顯特殊的選擇，我們將透過 Dnsmasq 提供DHCP支持，作為一項新的標準功能，該功能還提供一些用戶一直期待的無縫DHCP租約註冊。

The roadmap for 25.7 is being worked on at the moment and should be ready for publication next week / release.

##### 25.1 (January 29, 2025)｜25.1 （2025年1月29日）

For an entire decade now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

十年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

25.1, nicknamed “Ultimate Unicorn”（終極獨角獸）, features numerous MVC/API conversions, improved security zones support and documentation, ZFS snapshot support, a new UI look with a light and dark theme, PHP 8.3, FreeBSD 14.2 plus much more.

25.1，暱稱“Ultimate Unicorn”（終極獨角獸），具有大量 MVC/API 轉換、改進的安全區域支援和文件、ZFS 快照支援、帶有淺色和深色主題的新 UI 外觀、PHP 8.3、FreeBSD 14.2 等等。

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   The access management was rewritten in MVC and contains behavioural changes including not rendering UNIX accounts for non-shell users. The integrated authentication via PAM has been the default for a long time so the option to disable it has been removed. The manual LDAP importer is no longer available since LDAP/RADIUS authenticators support on-demand creation and default group setup option. The “page-system-groupmanager-addprivs” privilege was removed since the page does not exist anymore. A multi-purpose privilege editor has been added under the existing “page-system-usermanager-addprivs” instead.  
    存取管理功能已在MVC中重寫，並包含一些行為變更，例如不再為非 shell 使用者渲染UNIX帳戶。透過PAM集成的身份驗證長期以來一直是預設設置，因此已移除禁用選項。由於LDAP/RADIUS身份驗證器支援按需建立和預設群組設定選項，因此不再提供手動LDAP導入器。 「page-system-groupmanager-addprivs」權限已移除，因為該頁面已不存在。取而代之的是，在現有的「page-system-usermanager-addprivs」下新增了一個多用途權限編輯器。
    
-   PPP devices can no longer be configured on the interface settings page. To edit the device settings use the native PPP device edit page instead.  
    PPP設備無法再透過介面設定頁面進行設定。若要編輯設備設置，請改用原生PPP設備編輯頁面。
    
-   FreeBSD 14.2 comes with the stock pf(4) behaviour regarding ICMPv6 neighbour discovery state tracking which was avoided so far in 24.7.x.  
    FreeBSD 14.2帶有關於 ICMPv6 鄰居發現狀態追蹤的 pf(4) 標準行為，而24.7 .x 中一直避免這種情況。
    
-   Let’s Encrypt ends support for the OCSP Must Staple extension on 30.01.2025. Issuance requests will fail if this option is still enabled past this date.  
    Let's Encrypt 將於30.01.2025版本停止支援OCSP Must Staple 擴充。如果在此日期之後仍啟用此選項，則發行請求將失敗。

##### 25.1.r2 (January 24, 2025)｜25.1 .r2（2025年1月24日）

Just a small update to ship the latest changes and fixes. The anti-lockout not working was finally addressed. Thanks for all the valuable feedback on the forum!

本次更新包含一些最新更改和修復。防鎖定功能失效的問題已最終解決。感謝大家在論壇上提供的寶貴回饋！

以下是針對版本25.1-RC1完整更新說明：

-   system: prioritize index page and prevent redirection to a /api page on login

    防火牆：在一對一NAT頁面上新增缺少的列

##### 25.1.r1 (January 22, 2025)｜25.1 .r1（2025年1月22日）

The 25.1 series is nigh! This offers images based on an RC1 state with stable packages and online upgrades for the development version of 24.7. We will likely release a small RC2 online update in the near future. The final release date for 25.1 is January 29.

    存取管理功能已在MVC中重寫，並包含一些行為變更，例如不再為非shell使用者渲染UNIX帳戶。透過PAM集成的身份驗證長期以來一直是預設設置，因此已移除禁用選項。由於LDAP/RADIUS身份驗證器支援按需建立和預設群組設定選項，因此手動LDAP導入器不再可用。 「page-system-groupmanager-addprivs」權限已移除，因為該頁面已不存在。取而代之的是，在現有的「page-system-usermanager-addprivs」下新增了一個多用途權限編輯器。
    
-   PPP devices can no longer be configured on the interface settings page. To edit the device settings use the native PPP device edit page instead.  
    PPP設備無法再透過介面設定頁面進行設定。若要編輯設備設置，請改用原生PPP設備編輯頁面。
    
-   FreeBSD 14.2 comes with the stock pf(4) behaviour regarding ICMPv6 neighbour discovery state tracking which was avoided so far in 24.7.x.  
    FreeBSD 14.2帶有關於 ICMPv6 鄰居發現狀態追蹤的 pf(4) 標準行為，而24.7 .x 版本則避免了這種情況。
    
-   Let’s Encrypt ends support for the OCSP Must Staple extension on 30.01.2025. Issuance requests will fail if this option is still enabled past this date.  
    Let's Encrypt 將於30.01.2025版本停止支援OCSP Must Staple 擴充。如果在此日期之後仍啟用此選項，則發行請求將失敗。

##### 25.1.b (December 19, 2024)｜25.1 （2024 年 12 月 19 日）

The 25.1 series will include FreeBSD 14.2 so we are putting this BETA version out based on the latest development state. This is not meant for production use but all plugins are provided and future updates of installations based on these images will be possible.

25.1系列將包含 FreeBSD 14.2 ，因此我們基於最新的開發狀態發布了BETA版本。此版本不適用於生產環境，但所有插件均已提供，並且基於這些鏡像的安裝未來可以進行更新。

[https://pkg.opnsense.org/releases/25.1/](https://pkg.opnsense.org/releases/25.1/)

There is a bit more work to be done yet most of the milestones have already been reached. If you have a test deployment or would like to check out some of the new features these images are for you. Together we can make OPNsense better than it ever was.

雖然還有一些工作要做，但大部分里程碑已經達成。如果您需要進行測試部署或想體驗一些新功能，這些鏡像檔案正適合您。讓我們攜手合作，共同打造更強大的 OPNsense。

The final release date for 25.1 is January 29. A release candidate will follow in early January.

25.1的最終發布日期為 1 月 29 日。候選版本將於 1 月初發布。

    報告： RRD健康圖重構

    防火牆：改進了安全區域支援和文檔

#### 24.7 “Thriving Tiger”（旺虎） Series｜24.7 “Thriving Tiger”（旺虎）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_24.7.html>

For more than 9 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

9 年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

24.7, nicknamed “Thriving Tiger”（旺虎）, features a new dashboard, system trust MVC/API support, GRE and GIF MVC/API support, NAT 1-to-1 MVC/API support, WireGuard QR code generator, dynamic IPsec VTI tunnel support, experimental OpenVPN DCO support, FreeBSD 14.1, Python 3.11 plus much more.

24.7，綽號 “Thriving Tiger”（旺虎），具有新的儀表板、系統信任 MVC/API 支持， GRE 和 GIF MVC/API 支持， NAT 1對1 MVC/API 支持，WireGuard QR 代碼產生器、動態 IPsec VTI 隧道支持，實驗性 OpenVPN DCO 支持，FreeBSD 14.1、Python 3.11 還有更多。

The upgrade path from 24.1.x will follow tomorrow. Do not be hasty. The major operating system upgrade has not happened in while and should be taken with the appropriate amount of care.

從24.1 .x 版本升級的路徑將於明日發布。請勿操之過急。此次作業系統大版本升級已有一段時間未曾進行，務必謹慎看待。

##### 24.7.12 (January 15, 2025)｜24.7.12 （2025年1月15日）

One last stable update before the switch to the 25.1 series. Security-wise it has bee rather quiet over the past few weeks. A new kernel is included with a number of smaller reliability fixes and amendments.

這是切換到25.1系列之前的最後一次穩定更新。過去幾週，系統在安全方面幾乎沒有任何變化。此次更新包含一個新內核，以及一些較小的可靠性修復和改進。

The 25.1-RC1 images follow next week based on a full build using FreeBSD 14.2. Thanks all for testing the beta version so far! The release date for the final 25.1 version is January 29.

基於 FreeBSD 14.2完整構建的25.1-RC1鏡像將於下週發布。感謝大家迄今為止對 beta 版本的測試！最終版25.1的發售日期為 1 月 29 日。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: re-enable support for subjectAltName when creating CSRs  
    系統：重新啟用建立 CSR 時對 subjectAltName 的支持
    
-   system: remove spurious backup() during config revert  
    系統：在設定還原期間移除多餘的備份()
    
-   reporting: add daemon -f parameter to close file descriptors for NetFlow local capture (contributed by Ben Smithurst)  
    報告：為 NetFlow 本機擷取新增 daemon -f 參數以關閉檔案描述符（由 Ben Smithurst 提供）
    
-   firmware: use output\_cmd/output\_txt helpers in remaining scripts  
    韌體：在其餘腳本中使用 output\_cmd/output\_txt 輔助函數。
    
-   ipsec: fix mobile clients reload missing system.inc  
    ipsec：修正行動用戶端重新載入缺少的 system.inc 檔案的問題
    
-   isc-dhcp: IPv6 prefixes script can fail to restart (contributed by Ben Smithurst)  
    isc-dhcp：IPv6 前綴腳本可能無法重新啟動（由 Ben Smithurst 提供）
    
-   kea-dhcp: align hostname validation with manual host entries  
    kea-dhcp：使主機名稱驗證與手動主機條目保持一致
    
-   mvc: add serialNumber and issuer in Store::parseX509()  
    mvc：在 Store::parseX509() 中加入 serialNumber 和 issuer
    
-   mvc: restore support for JSON input data without configd callout in JsonKeyValueStoreField  
    MVC：恢復對 JsonKeyValueStoreField 中無 configd 呼叫的JSON輸入資料的支持
    
-   ui: add classes to system history diff content so themes can override the defaults

-   ui: load CSV as text to prevent encoding issues in SimpleFileUploadDlg()

##### 24.7.11 (December 17, 2024)｜24.7.11 （2024年12月17日）

This is a minor update all things considered, but it does bring you the long sought after Tailscale plugin courtesy of Sheridan Computers. Suricata is also updated to its latest version to fix a couple of CVEs.

總的來說，這次更新幅度不大，但它帶來了大家期待已久的由 Sheridan Computers 提供的 Tailscale 插件。 Suricata 也更新到了最新版本，修復了幾個 CVE 漏洞。

In other news, 25.1 will contain FreeBSD 14.2 which will be available for BETA preview using images later this week as well. The 25.1-BETA will also include a rewritten theme (light and dark) using the new OPNsense logo already being used in the documentation. It also has MVC/API support for the user and group management plus more you can always find on the roadmap [\[1\]](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/) in detail.

在其他訊息中，25.1 將包含 FreeBSD 14.2，也將在本週晚些時候使用圖像用於 BETA 預覽。 25.1-BETA 還將包括使用文件中已使用的新 OPNsense 標誌重寫的主題（淺色和深色）。它還具有對使用者和群組管理的 MVC/API 支持，以及您始終可以在路線圖 [\[1\]](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/) 上找到的詳細資訊。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: show multiple SAN entries when supplied by the certificate  
    系統：當憑證提供多個SAN條目時，顯示這些條目
    
-   system: traffic dashboard widget should persist interface identifiers  
    系統：交通儀錶板小工具應持久化介面識別碼。
    
-   system: reset dashboard widget options to the default if none of the options match  
    系統：如果沒有任何選項匹配，則將儀表板小部件選項重設為預設值
    
-   system: mismatch in returned “change” attribute for route toggle  
    系統：路由切換回傳的「change」屬性不匹配
    
-   system: suppress XML parse errors in announcement widget when forum is unreachable

##### 24.7.10 (December 03, 2024)｜24.7.10 （2024年12月3日）

This ships a number of base system changes, kernel fixes and driver updates. The time-loop authentication change is back with the fixed TOTP case and the Unbound domain overrides are now found in query forwarding since this offers the same functionality anyway.

此次更新包含多項基礎系統變更、核心修復和驅動程式更新。時間循環身份驗證變更已恢復，並修復了TOTP問題；未綁定域覆蓋現在位於查詢轉發中，因為兩者功能相同。

Please note we had to hotfix the kernel which will not reinstall automatically if you caught the bad version. If you experience panics on 24.7.10 relating to pf(4) please reinstall from the GUI (which includes an automatic reboot) or run “opnsense-update -fk” from the shell followed by a manual reboot. The correct kernel identifies itself as “stable/24.7-n267981-8375762712f” using “uname -v”.

請注意，我們已對核心進行了緊急修復，如果您遇到的是錯誤版本，則不會自動重新安裝。如果您在24.7.10處遇到與 pf(4) 相關的核心崩潰，請從GUI重新安裝（包含自動重新啟動），或在 shell 中執行「opnsense-update -fk」命令，然後手動重新啟動。正確的核心版本為“stable/ 24.7-n267981 -8375762712f”，可透過“uname -v”指令查看。

With the year almost over we are shifting focus to finishing the items on the roadmap and it is nice to note that the MVC/API conversions are already over 75% complete. That means it will not take another decade to migrate the other 25%. ;)

隨著年末臨近，我們將重心轉移到完成路線圖上的各項任務，值得一提的是， MVC/API轉換工作已完成超過 75%。這意味著剩餘 25% 的遷移工作無需再耗費十年時間。 ;)

##### 24.7.9 (November 20, 2024)｜24.7.9 （2024年11月20日）

This is a minor update that further tweaks the trust store integration and firmware updates tying into it although in practice it does not change the current behaviour from a user perspective. If something is not behaving as usual afterwards please let us know.

本次更新幅度較小，主要調整了信任庫整合及其相關的韌體更新，但實際上從使用者角度來看，並不會改變目前的使用體驗。如果更新後出現任何異常情況，請告知我們。

A new plugin has been added to finally allow proxying ND messages for those people stuck on a single /64 prefix delegation. Otherwise it has been pretty quiet as you can see. But we will be back soon. ;)

我們新增了一個插件，終於可以為那些只能使用單一 /64 前綴的用戶代理ND郵件了。除此之外，正如你所見，我們最近比較安靜。不過，我們很快就會回來。 ;)

##### 24.7.6 (October 09, 2024)｜24.7.6（2024 年 10 月 9 日）

A few security and reliability issues this week. Most notably Suricata and Unbound. The dashboard rework seems to be concluded now as the ACL behaviour was aligned and should match the user expectation on the “Lobby”（大堂） section privileges. Note not all widgets have separate ACLs as it aims to provide a minimal safe selection of system widgets associated with the access to the dashboard page in general.

本週出現一些安全性和可靠性問題。最引人注目的是 Suricata 和 Unbound。儀表板返工現在似乎已經結束，因為ACL行為已對齊，並且應該符合用戶對“Lobby”（大堂）部分權限的期望。請注意，並非所有小部件都有單獨的 ACL，因為它的目的是提供與一般儀表板頁面存取相關的系統小部件的最小安全選擇。

We will, however, continue to improve the dashboard further while we also tackle other interesting areas for 25.1. That being said have a look at the new roadmap [\[1\]](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/) we published recently.

然而，我們將繼續進一步改進儀表板，同時我們也將解決25.1的其他有趣領域。話雖這麼說，請看看我們最近發布的新路線圖 [\[1\]](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/)。

You may notice the increased activity on the trust store side due to our LINCE certification efforts. Valuable feedback and code changes have come from this process that will also find their way into other related projects in the near future.

您可能會注意到，由於我們的 LINCE 認證工作，信任儲存方面的活動增加。這個過程帶來了寶貴的回饋和程式碼更改，這些回饋和程式碼更改也將在不久的將來進入其他相關項目。

##### 24.7.5 (September 26, 2024)｜24.7.5（2024 年 9 月 26 日）

This release removes significant processing overhead from larger setups due to being able to coalesce parallel configuration requests for the same component instead of iterating over the list of selected interfaces one by one. A number of third party software updates and FreeBSD security advisories are included as well.

此版本消除了較大設定中的大量處理開銷，因為能夠合併相同元件的平行配置請求，而不是逐一迭代所選介面的清單。還包括許多第三方軟體更新和 FreeBSD 安全建議。

This update also disables NUMA by default which can bring a boost in network throughput on affected systems. And of course we are still working on dashboard improvements so now the treasured picture widget is back with a better integration approach.

此更新也預設為停用NUMA，這可以提高受影響系統上的網路吞吐量。當然，我們仍在致力於儀表板改進，因此現在珍貴的圖片小部件以更好的整合方法回來了。

Also take note that the NTP default changes to “restrict noquery” so that the system cannot externally be queried for revealing system internals anymore unless explicitly allowed.

另請注意，NTP 預設更改為“限制 noquery”，以便系統無法再從外部查詢以揭示系統內部結構，除非明確允許。

The technical stuff out of the way we would simply like to add that we had a great time at EuroBSDCon in Dublin over the weekend. Lots of good and productive conversations. Looking forward to more of those! :)

技術方面的問題我們只想補充一下，週末我們在都柏林的 EuroBSDCon 上度過了愉快的時光。許多良好且富有成效的對話。期待更多這樣的內容！ :)

##### 24.7.4 (September 12, 2024)｜24.7.4（2024 年 9 月 12 日）

Since we are currently having a vivid discussion about what constitutes a downstream or upstream issue in the FreeBSD scope we will revert the FreeBSD-SA-24:05.pf advisory until further notice. As confirmed by many users this brings ICMPv6 and therefore IPv6 back to an uneventful stable state. We will be trying to work with FreeBSD on the issue as it seems unavoidable that we meet it again when working on FreeBSD 14.2 inclusion.

由於我們目前正在就 FreeBSD 範圍內的下游或上游問題的構成進行生動的討論，因此我們將恢復 FreeBSD-SA-24:05.pf 公告，直至另行通知。正如許多用戶所證實的那樣，這使 ICMPv6 以及 IPv6 恢復到平穩的穩定狀態。我們將嘗試與 FreeBSD 合作解決這個問題，因為在處理 FreeBSD 14.2 包含問題時，我們似乎不可避免地會再次遇到它。

In other IPv6 news we found a strange regression in dhcp6c introduced in 24.7.2 and reverted the offending commits for now. What this tells us, though, is that we did uncover an inherent issue with the timeout value generation that may be present since two decades in the code at least.

在其他 IPv6 新聞中，我們發現 24.7.2 中引入的 dhcp6c 出現了奇怪的回歸，並暫時恢復了有問題的提交。不過，這告訴我們的是，我們確實發現了超時值產生的一個固有問題，可能至少在程式碼中存在了二十年。

Apart from smaller fixes for the dashboard, trust pages, this update also ships the first backwards-compatible PPP rework patch. The ultimate goal here is to offer IPv6-only connectivity which requires untangling old code to be IP family agnostic. Should you note any change in behaviour please do not hesitate to contact us.

除了對儀表板、信任頁面進行較小的修復之外，此更新還附帶了第一個向後相容的PPP返工補丁。這裡的最終目標是提供僅限 IPv6 的連接，這需要理清舊程式碼，使其與IP 系列無關。如果您發現行為有任何變化，請隨時與我們聯繫。

BTW, the roadmap for 25.1 has been decided and will be published soon.

BTW，25.1的路線圖已經確定，即將發布。

##### 24.7.3 (August 29, 2024)｜24.7.3（2024 年 8 月 29 日）

Today we are switching pf stateful tracking of ICMPv6 neighbour discoveries off in order to fix the previous instability with the FreeBSD security advisory first shipped in 24.7.1. We do this in order to provide the same reliable IPv6 functionality that was on all previous versions prior to 24.7.1 at the cost of resurfacing CVE-2024-6640 until a better solution has been devised. A link to the long and difficult upstream bug report is included below.

今天，我們將關閉 ICMPv6 鄰居發現的狀態跟踪，以修復先前在 24.7.1 中發布的 FreeBSD 安全公告帶來的不穩定性。我們這樣做是為了提供與 24.7.1 之前的所有先前版本相同的可靠 IPv6 功能，但代價是重新設計 CVE-2024-6640，直到設計出更好的解決方案。下麵包含了冗長且困難的上游錯誤報告的連結。

But that is not all. The GUI gains snapshot support on ZFS installations by implementing what is called “boot environments” which allows one to move seamlessly from one snapshot to another via reboot. This functionality can also be accessed from the boot loader menu option “8” for a quick recovery ensuring that at least one other snapshot was created to boot into. A very special thank you to Sheridan Computers for contributing this feature.

但這還不是全部。 GUI 透過實現所謂的「啟動環境」來獲得對 ZFS 安裝的快照支持，該環境允許用戶透過重新啟動從一個快照無縫移動到另一個快照。還可以從引導程式選單選項「8」存取此功能，以進行快速恢復，確保至少建立一個其他快照來引導。特別感謝 Sheridan Computers 貢獻此功能。

##### 24.7.2 (August 21, 2024)｜24.7.2（2024 年 8 月 21 日）

Today a follow-up for the FreeBSD security advisory for pf/ICMP ships that addresses the undesired traceroute behaviour. A few dashboard improvements are included as well as better IPv6 recovery for dhcp6c and assorted stability fixes.

今天，針對 pf/ICMP 的 FreeBSD 安全公告的後續內容解決了不需要的追蹤路由行為。其中包括一些儀表板改進以及更好的 dhcp6c IPv6 恢復和各種穩定性修復。

As a special note we now have native CPU microcode update plugins for either AMD or Intel to install from the GUI. Apart from a reboot these plugins require no further user interaction and will keep the applicable microcode at the latest known version as shipped in the packages repository.

特別注意的是，我們現在有用於 AMD 或 Intel 的原生 CPU 微程式碼更新插件，可以從 GUI 安裝。除了重新啟動之外，這些插件不需要進一步的用戶交互，並且會將適用的微代碼保留在軟體包存儲庫中提供的最新已知版本。

We are currently working on making PPP capable of running in IPv6-only deployments; additionally ZFS snapshots (a.k.a boot environments) are coming to the next stable release and can already be previewed in the bundled development version.

我們目前正在努力使 PPP 能夠在純 IPv6 部署中運行；此外，ZFS快照（又稱引導環境）將出現在下一個穩定版本中，並且已經可以在捆綁的開發版本中預覽。

Last but not least, an “importmap” free dashboard version is also ready for testing in the development release. We hereby ask for feedback so that it can be included in a subsequent stable release.

最後但並非最不重要的一點是，「importmap」免費儀表板版本也已準備好在開發版本中進行測試。我們特此請求回饋，以便將其包含在後續的穩定版本中。

##### 24.7.1 (August 08, 2024)｜24.7.1（2024 年 8 月 8 日）

This release includes a batch of dashboard changes due to the reliable feedback we have received from you all so far. There will be more dashboard changes in the future mostly relating to UX and sane default behaviour so just know we are aware.

由於迄今為止我們從大家那裡收到了可靠的回饋，此版本包括一批儀表板變更。未來將會有更多的儀表板更改，主要與 UX 和合理的預設行為有關，所以只要知道我們知道即可。

A few smaller regressions due to the Phalcon module replacement efforts have been fixed as well. IPv6 behaviour has been adjusted for SLAAC and the web GUI.

由於 Phalcon 模組更換工作而導致的一些較小的回歸也已修復。 IPv6 行為已針對 SLAAC 和網路 GUI 進行了調整。

Last but not least we found and fixed a number of issues with FreeBSD 14.1 and are including its security advisories from yesterday while at it.

最後但並非最不重要的一點是，我們發現並修復了 FreeBSD 14.1 的一些問題，並包含了昨天的安全建議。

MVC/API conversions are already being carried out in the development version and it seems that PPP-related connectivity will get a bigger makeover too. The roadmap for 25.1 will be discussed and likely published later this month.

MVC/API的轉換已經在開發版本中進行，看來與PPP相關的連接也將得到更大的改造。 25.1 的路線圖將在本月稍後進行討論並可能發布。

##### 24.7 (July 25, 2024)｜24.7（2024 年 7 月 25 日）

For more than 9 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

九年半多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

24.7, nicknamed “Thriving Tiger”（旺虎）, features a new dashboard, system trust MVC/API support, GRE and GIF MVC/API support, NAT 1-to-1 MVC/API support, WireGuard QR code generator, dynamic IPsec VTI tunnel support, experimental OpenVPN DCO support, FreeBSD 14.1, Python 3.11 plus much more.

24.7，綽號 “Thriving Tiger”（旺虎），具有新的儀表板、系統信任 MVC/API 支持， GRE 和 GIF MVC/API 支持， NAT 1對1 MVC/API 支持，WireGuard QR 代碼產生器、動態 IPsec VTI 隧道支持，實驗性 OpenVPN DCO 支持，FreeBSD 14.1、Python 3.11 還有更多。

The upgrade path from 24.1.x will follow tomorrow. Do not be hasty. The major operating system upgrade has not happened in while and should be taken with the appropriate amount of care.

24.1.x 的升級路徑將於明天進行。不要操之過急。主要的作業系統升級已經有一段時間沒有發生了，應該要謹慎看待。

Here are the full changes against version 24.1.10:

以下是針對版本24.1.10的完整變更：

-   system: remove “load\_balancer” configuration remnants from core  
    系統：從核心中刪除「load\_balancer」配置殘留
    
-   system: replace usage of mt\_rand() with random\_int()  
    系統：以 random\_int() 取代 mt\_rand() 的使用
    
-   system: rewrote Trust configuration using MVC/API  
    系統：使用MVC/API重寫信任配置
    
-   system: add XMLRPC option for OpenDNS  
    系統：為OpenDNS新增XMLRPC選項
    
-   system: rewrote the high availability settings page using MVC/API  
    系統：使用MVC/API重寫了高可用性設定頁面
    
-   system: remove obsolete SSH DSA key handling  
    系統：刪除過時的SSH DSA金鑰處理
    
-   system: replaced the dashboard with a modern alternative with streaming widgets  
    系統：用帶有串流媒體小部件的現代替代方案替換了儀表板
    
-   system: harden a number of PHP settings according to best practices  
    系統：依據最佳實務強化多項PHP設置
    
-   system: support streaming of log files for the new dashboard widget  
    系統：支援新儀表板小工具的日誌檔案流
    
-   system: assorted dashboard widget tweaks  
    系統：各種儀表板小工具調整
    
-   system: sidebar optimisation and fixes (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    系統：側邊欄優化和修復（由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）
    
-   system: set short Cache-Control lifetime for widgets  
    系統：為小工具設定較短的快取控制生命週期
    
-   interfaces: rewrote GRE configuration using MVC/API  
    介面：使用MVC/API重寫GRE配置
    
-   interfaces: rewrote GIF configuration using MVC/API  
    介面：使用MVC/API重寫GIF配置
    
-   interfaces: temporary flush SLAAC addresses in DHCPv6 WAN mode to avoid using them primarily  
    介面：暫時刷新 DHCPv6 WAN 模式下的 SLAAC 位址，以避免主要使用它們
    
-   interfaces: add peer/peer6 options to CARP VIPs  
    介面：將peer/peer6選項加入CARP VIP
    
-   interfaces: allow to assign a prefix ID to WAN interface in DHCPv6 as well  
    介面：也允許在 DHCPv6 中為 WAN 介面分配前綴 ID
    
-   interfaces: allow to set manual interface ID in DHCPv6 and tracking modes  
    介面：允許在 DHCPv6 和追蹤模式下設定手動介面ID
    
-   firewall: performance improvements in alias handling  
    防火牆：別名處理的效能改進
    
-   firewall: refactor pftop output, move search to controller layer and implement cache for sessions page  
    防火牆：重構 pftop 輸出，將搜尋移至控制器層並實作會話頁面快取
    
-   firewall: support streaming of filter logs for the new dashboard widget  
    防火牆：支援新儀表板小工具的過濾器日誌流
    
-   captive portal: add “Allow inbound” option to select interfaces which may enter the zone  
    強制門戶：新增「允許入站」選項以選擇可以進入該區域的接口
    
-   captive portal: remove defunct transparent proxy settings  
    強制門戶：刪除已失效的透明代理設置
    
-   captive portal: clean up the codebase  
    強制門戶：清理程式碼庫
    
-   ipsec: prevent gateway when remote gateway family does not match selected protocol in legacy tunnel configuration  
    ipsec：當遠端網路關係列與舊隧道設定中選定的協定不符時，阻止網關
    
-   isc-dhcp: do not reload DNS services when editing static mappings to match behaviour with Kea  
    isc-dhcp：編輯靜態映射以與 Kea 匹配行為時，請勿重新載入 DNS 服務
    
-   monit: expose HTTPD username and password settings to GUI  
    monit：將 HTTPD 使用者名稱和密碼設定暴露給 GUI
    
-   openvpn: optionally support DCO devices for instances  
    openvpn：選用支援DCO設備實例
    
-   openvpn: remove duplicate and irrelevant data for the client session in question  
    openvpn：刪除相關客戶端會話的重複和不相關數據
    
-   openvpn: add “remote\_cert\_tls” option to instances  
    openvpn：為實例新增「remote\_cert\_tls」選項
    
-   backend: add “cache\_ttl” parameter to allow for generic caching of actions  
    後端：新增“cache\_ttl”參數以允許對操作進行通用緩存
    
-   backend: run default action “configd actions” when none was specified  
    後端：未指定時執行預設操作“configd actions”
    
-   backend: extended support for streaming actions  
    後端：對流操作的擴展支持
    
-   installer: update the ZFS install script to the latest FreeBSD 14.1 code  
    安裝程式：將ZFS安裝腳本更新為最新的FreeBSD14.1程式碼
    
-   installer: prefer ZFS over UFS in main menu selection  
    安裝程式：在主選單選擇中喜歡ZFS而不是UFS
    
-   ui: assorted improvements for screen readers (contributed by Jason Fayre)  
    ui：螢幕閱讀器的各種改進（由 Jason Fayre 貢獻）
    
-   ui: add “select all” to standard form selectors and remove dialog on “clear all” for tokenizers  
    ui：將「全選」新增至標準表單選擇器，並刪除標記器的「全部清除」對話框
    
-   ui: lock save button while in progress to prevent duplicate input on Bootgrid  
    ui：在進行過程中鎖定儲存按鈕，以防止在 Bootgrid 上重複輸入
    
-   ui: backport accessibility fix in Bootstrap  
    ui：Bootstrap 中的向後移植可訪問性修復
    
-   mvc: replaced most of the Phalcon MVC use with a native band compatible implementation  
    mvc：用本地頻段相容實作替換了大部分 Phalcon MVC 使用
    
-   mvc: improve searchRecordsetBase() filtering capabilities  
    mvc：改進 searchRecordsetBase() 過濾功能
    
-   mvc: improve container field cloning  
    mvc：改進容器現場克隆
    
-   mvc: remove obsolete getParams() usage in ApiControllerBase  
    mvc：刪除 ApiControllerBase 中過時的 getParams() 使用
    
-   mvc: hook default index action in API handler  
    mvc：在 API 處理程序中掛鉤預設索引操作

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   The dashboard has been replaced. Widgets from the old format are no longer supported and need to be rewritten by the respective authors.  
    儀表板已更換。舊格式的小部件不再受支持，需要由各自的作者重寫。
    
-   ISC DHCP will no longer reload DNS services on static mapping edits. This is for feature parity with Kea DHCP and avoiding cross-service complications. If you expect your static mappings to show up in a particular DNS service please restart this service manually.  
    ISC DHCP 將不再在靜態地圖編輯時重新載入 DNS 服務。這是為了與 Kea DHCP 功能相同並避免跨服務複雜化。如果您希望靜態映射顯示在特定的 DNS 服務中，請手動重新啟動該服務。

##### 24.7.r1 (July 16, 2024)｜24.7.r1（2024 年 7 月 16 日）

If you have not heard: 24.7-RC1 is an online update. You can update from the 24.7-BETA and switch to the community release type for the stable track which leads into 24.7.x. The development version of the upcoming 24.1.11 release will also be able to update to the RC. An RC2 will follow up with the relevant images and additional information at the end of the week.

如果你還沒聽過：24.7-RC1是線上更新。您可以從24.7-BETA更新並切換到社群發布類型以獲得穩定軌道，從而進入24.7.x。即將發布的24.1.11的開發版本也將能夠更新到RC。 RC2 將在本週末跟進相關圖像和其他資訊。

Here are the full changes against version 24.1.10:

以下是針對版本24.1.10的完整更改：

-   system: remove “load\_balancer” configuration remnants from core  
    系統：從核心中刪除「load\_balancer」配置殘留
    
-   system: replace usage of mt\_rand() with random\_int()  
    系統：以 random\_int() 取代 mt\_rand() 的使用
    
-   system: rewrote Trust configuration using MVC/API  
    系統：使用MVC/API重寫信任配置
    
-   system: add XMLRPC option for OpenDNS  
    系統：為OpenDNS新增XMLRPC選項
    
-   system: rewrote the high availability settings page using MVC/API  
    系統：使用MVC/API重寫了高可用性設定頁面
    
-   system: remove obsolete SSH DSA key handling  
    系統：刪除過時的SSH DSA金鑰處理
    
-   system: replaced the dashboard with a modern alternative with streaming widgets  
    系統：用帶有串流媒體小部件的現代替代方案替換了儀表板
    
-   system: harden a number of PHP settings according to best practices  
    系統：根據最佳實務強化多項PHP設置
    
-   system: support streaming of log files for the new dashboard widget  
    系統：支援新儀表板小工具的日誌檔案流
    
-   interfaces: rewrote GRE configuration using MVC/API  
    介面：使用MVC/API重寫GRE配置
    
-   interfaces: rewrote GIF configuration using MVC/API  
    介面：使用MVC/API重寫GIF配置
    
-   interfaces: temporary flush SLAAC addresses in DHCPv6 WAN mode to avoid using them primarily  
    介面：暫時刷新 DHCPv6 WAN 模式下的 SLAAC 位址，以避免主要使用它們
    
-   interfaces: add peer/peer6 options to CARP VIPs  
    介面：將peer/peer6選項加入CARP VIP
    
-   interfaces: allow to assign a prefix ID to WAN interface in DHCPv6 as well  
    介面：也允許在 DHCPv6 中為 WAN 介面分配前綴 ID
    
-   interfaces: allow to set manual interface ID in DHCPv6 and tracking modes  
    介面：允許在 DHCPv6 和追蹤模式下設定手動介面ID
    
-   firewall: performance improvements in alias handling  
    防火牆：別名處理的效能改進
    
-   firewall: refactor pftop output, move search to controller layer and implement cache for sessions page  
    防火牆：重構 pftop 輸出，將搜尋移至控制器層並實作會話頁面快取
    
-   firewall: support streaming of filter logs for the new dashboard widget  
    防火牆：支援新儀表板小工具的過濾器日誌流
    
-   captive portal: add “Allow inbound” option to select interfaces which may enter the zone  
    強制門戶：新增「允許入站」選項以選擇可以進入該區域的接口
    
-   captive portal: remove defunct transparent proxy settings  
    強制門戶：刪除已失效的透明代理設置
    
-   captive portal: clean up the codebase  
    強制門戶：清理程式碼庫
    
-   ipsec: prevent gateway when remote gateway family does not match selected protocol in legacy tunnel configuration  
    ipsec：當遠端網路關係列與舊隧道設定中選定的協定不符時，阻止網關
    
-   isc-dhcp: do not reload DNS services when editing static mappings to match behaviour with Kea  
    isc-dhcp：編輯靜態映射以與 Kea 匹配行為時，請勿重新載入 DNS 服務
    
-   monit: expose HTTPD username and password settings to GUI  
    monit：將 HTTPD 使用者名稱和密碼設定暴露給 GUI
    
-   openvpn: optionally support DCO devices for instances  
    openvpn：選用支援DCO設備實例
    
-   openvpn: remove duplicate and irrelevant data for the client session in question  
    openvpn：刪除相關客戶端會話的重複和不相關數據
    
-   openvpn: add “remote\_cert\_tls” option to instances  
    openvpn：為實例新增「remote\_cert\_tls」選項
    
-   backend: add “cache\_ttl” parameter to allow for generic caching of actions  
    後端：新增“cache\_ttl”參數以允許對操作進行通用緩存
    
-   backend: run default action “configd actions” when none was specified  
    後端：未指定時執行預設操作“configd actions”
    
-   backend: extended support for streaming actions  
    後端：對流操作的擴展支持
    
-   ui: assorted improvements for screen readers (contributed by Jason Fayre)  
    ui：螢幕閱讀器的各種改進（由 Jason Fayre 貢獻）
    
-   ui: add “select all” to standard form selectors and remove dialog on “clear all” for tokenizers  
    ui：將「全選」新增至標準表單選擇器，並刪除標記器的「全部清除」對話框
    
-   ui: lock save button while in progress to prevent duplicate input on Bootgrid  
    ui：在進行過程中鎖定儲存按鈕，以防止在 Bootgrid 上重複輸入
    
-   ui: backport accessibility fix in Bootstrap  
    ui：Bootstrap 中的向後移植可訪問性修復
    
-   mvc: replaced most of the Phalcon MVC use with a native band compatible implementation  
    mvc：用原生頻段相容實作取代了大部分 Phalcon MVC 使用
    
-   mvc: improve searchRecordsetBase() filtering capabilities  
    mvc：改進 searchRecordsetBase() 過濾功能
    
-   mvc: improve container field cloning  
    mvc：改進容器現場克隆
    
-   plugins: os-acme-client 4.4 [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/24.7/security/acme-client/pkg-descr)  
    插件： os-acme-client 4.4 [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/24.7/security/acme-client/pkg-descr)
    
-   plugins: os-etpro-telemetry 1.7 replaces dashboard widget  
    插件：os-etpro-telemetry 1.7 替換儀表板小部件
    
-   src: FreeBSD 14.1-RELEASE [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/releases/14.1R/relnotes/)  
    原始碼: FreeBSD 14.1-RELEASE [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/releases/14.1R/relnotes/)
    
-   ports: phalcon 5.8.0 [\[3\]](https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/v5.8.0)  
    埠：phalcon 5.8.0 [\[3\]](https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/v5.8.0)
    

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   The dashboard has been replaced. Widgets from the old format are no longer supported and need to be rewritten by the respective authors.  
    儀表板已更換。舊格式的小部件不再受支持，需要由各自的作者重寫。
    
-   ISC DHCP will no longer reload DNS services on static mapping edits. This is for feature parity with Kea DHCP and avoiding cross-service complications. If you expect your static mappings to show up in a particular DNS service please restart this service manually.

##### 24.7.b (June 13, 2024)｜24.7.b（2024 年 6 月 13 日）

Since OPNsense 24.7 will be based on a newer FreeBSD major version it is crucial for us to release these BETA images based on the latest development state. This is not meant for production use but all plugins are provided and future updates of installations based on these images will be possible.

由於 OPNsense 24.7 將基於較新的 FreeBSD 主要版本，因此我們根據最新的開發狀態發布這些 BETA 映像至關重要。這並不意味著用於生產用途，但提供了所有插件，並且將來可以基於這些映像進行安裝更新。

[https://pkg.opnsense.org/releases/24.7/](https://pkg.opnsense.org/releases/24.7/)

There is a bit more work to be done yet most of the milestones have already been reached. If you have a test deployment or would like to check out some of the new features these images are for you. Together we can make OPNsense better than it ever was.

雖然還有一些工作要做，但大部分里程碑已經達成。如果您需要進行測試部署或想體驗一些新功能，這些鏡像檔案正適合您。讓我們攜手合作，共同打造更強大的 OPNsense。

The final release date for 24.7 is July 24. A release candidate will follow in early July.

24.7 的最終發布日期是 7 月 24 日。候選版本將於 7 月初發布。

Highlights over the current 24.1 series include:

目前24.1系列的亮點包括：

-   Dashboard replacement with streaming widgets  
    用串流媒體小工具取代儀表板
    
-   System: High Availability: Settings page has been converted to MVC  
    系統：高可用性：設定頁面已轉換為MVC
    
-   System: Trust section has been converted to MVC/API  
    系統：信任部分已轉換為MVC/API
    
-   Interfaces: GIF section has been converted to MVC/API  
    接口：GIF部分已轉換為MVC/API
    
-   Interfaces: GRE section has been converted to MVC/API  
    接口：GRE部分已轉換為MVC/API
    
-   Firewall: NAT 1-to-1 has been converted to MVC/API  
    防火牆：NAT 1對1已轉換為MVC/API
    
-   Added experimental OpenVPN DCO device type support  
    新增了實驗性 OpenVPN DCO 設備類型支援
    
-   Added unicast CARP support to Virtual IPs  
    新增了虛擬 IP 的單播 CARP 支持
    
-   DHCPv6 on WAN can now assign a prefix subnet to itself and support static interface identifiers  
    WAN 上的 DHCPv6 現在可以為其自身分配前綴子網並支援靜態介面標識符
    
-   Built-in cache capability for backend commands  
    內建後端指令快取功能
    
-   Captive portal backend refactor and new “Allow inbound interfaces” option  
    強制門戶後端重構和新的「允許入站介面」選項
    
-   Large portions of Phalcon MVC have been replaced by native PHP implementation  
    Phalcon MVC 的大部分已被本機 PHP 實作取代
    
-   FreeBSD 14.1

<a id="p-011"></a>

#### 24.1 “Savvy Shark”（精明的鯊魚） Series｜24.1 “Savvy Shark”（精明的鯊魚）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_24.1.html>

For more than 9 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

9 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

24.1, nicknamed “Savvy Shark”（精明的鯊魚）, features ports-based OpenSSL 3, Suricata 7, several MVC/API conversions, a new neighbor configuration feature for ARP/NDP, core inclusion of the os-firewall and os-wireguard plugins, CARP VHID tracking for OpenVPN and WireGuard, functional Kea DHCPv4 server with HA support plus much more.

24.1，綽號 “Savvy Shark”（精明的鯊魚），具有基於連接埠的 OpenSSL 3、Suricata 7、幾個 MVC/API 轉換，一個新的鄰居配置功能 ARP/NDP，核心包含 os-firewall 和 os-wireguard 插件， CARP VHID 追蹤 OpenVPN 和 WireGuard，功能性 Kea DHCPv4 伺服器 HA 支持以及更多。

##### 24.1.10 (July 11, 2024)｜24.1.10（2024 年 7 月 11 日）

Today a number of security advisories in third party software are being addressed. Also, a bad dhcp6c patch has been reverted which requires a manual reboot to take full effect.

CAUTION: The OpenSSH update prevents SSH sessions from being established. You need to restart OpenSSH from the GUI or run the console command “pluginctl -s openssh restart” or reboot the system in order to unbreak it.

##### 24.1.9 (June 18, 2024)｜24.1.9（2024 年 6 月 18 日）

This is the last bit of preparation for the upcoming 24.7 series reimplementing one-to-one NAT using MVC/API and a number of plumbing changes. IPv6 has also been improved with the dhcp6c client having received a number of new fixes and features.

這是為即將推出的24.7系列做最後的準備，使用MVC/API和一些管道更改重新實現一對一的NAT。 IPv6 也得到了改進，dhcp6c 用戶端收到了許多新的修復和功能。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: do not create an interface route without an address  
    系統：不建立沒有位址的介面路由
    
-   system: add pluginctl -x/-X modes for digesting XMLRPC options  
    系統：新增pluginctl -x/-X模式來消化XMLRPC選項
    
-   system: replace rand() with random\_int() in remote backup script  
    系統：在遠端備份腳本中將 rand() 替換為 random\_int()
    
-   firewall: migrate one-to-one NAT to MVC/API  
    防火牆：一對一遷移NAT至MVC/API
    
-   interfaces: make SLAAC flush a feature of ifctl for incoming reuse  
    介面：使 SLAAC 刷新 ifctl 的一項功能以供傳入重複使用
    
-   interfaces: in SLAAC tracking prevent accepting our own radvd configuration  
    介面：在SLAAC中追蹤防止接受我們自己的radvd配置
    
-   interfaces: move SLAAC tunables to system requirements  
    介面：將 SLAAC 可調參數移至系統需求
    
-   interfaces: disable IPv6 interface modes when IPv6 is disabled globally  
    介面：全域禁用 IPv6 時禁用 IPv6 介面模式
    
-   interfaces: avoid pluginctl giving out IPv4 info for non-interfaces  
    介面：避免 pluginctl 為非介面提供 IPv4 信息
    
-   dhcrelay: add logging into its own space  
    dhcrelay：將日誌記錄加入自己的空間中
    
-   firmware: change default fetch of changelog to 30 seconds  
    韌體：將更改日誌的預設取得時間更改為 30 秒
    
-   firmware: dump TLS information for firmware server(s) in use  
    韌體：轉儲正在使用的韌體伺服器的TLS訊息
    
-   isc-dhcp: allow root domain input as “.” (contributed by Skyler Mantysaari)  
    isc-dhcp：允許根域輸入為“.” （斯凱勒·曼蒂薩裡供稿）

    mvc：將 checkAndThrowSafeDelete() 重構並改良為 checkAndThrowValueInUse()

    ui：防止頂級選單項目斷字

##### 24.1.8 (May 29, 2024)｜24.1.8（2024 年 5 月 29 日）

The endless loop packet read in the new dhcrelay daemon has been fixed. A new kernel is included in this release bringing the latest stable/13 state in the relevant networking areas. A number of small changes have also been made. Thanks for all the reports and support!

新 dhcrelay 守護程式中讀取的無限循環資料包已修復。此版本中包含一個新內核，在相關網路領域帶來了最新的 stable/13 狀態。也進行了一些小的更改。感謝大家的檢舉與支持！

To spread the news… 24.7 will be based on FreeBSD 14.1. Stay tuned.

傳播訊息…24.7將基於FreeBSD14.1。敬請關注。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: fix regression in gateways migration causing far gateway option to be set incorrectly  
    系統：修復網關遷移中的回歸導致遠網關選項設定不正確
    
-   system: work around fatal password\_hash() change in PHP 8.2.18  
    系統：解決PHP 8.2.18中的致命密碼\_hash()更改
    
-   system: move net.inet.icmp.drop\_redirect sysctl to automatic mode  
    系統：將 net.inet.icmp.drop\_redirect sysctl 移至自動模式
    
-   system: add Google Drive configuration as an XMLRPC sync target  
    系統：新增 Google Drive 配置作為 XMLRPC 同步目標
    
-   interfaces: detect and ignore “detached” state for IPv6  
    介面：偵測並忽略 IPv6 的「分離」狀態
    
-   interfaces: remove unused imports from sockstat list  
    介面：從sockstat清單中刪除未使用的導入
    
-   firewall: use the new $.replaceInputWithSelector() for source/destination networks in MVC filter pages  
    防火牆：對 MVC 過濾器頁面中的來源/目標網路使用新的 $.replaceInputWithSelector()
    
-   firewall: fix empty rule label rendered as “null” on sessions page  
    防火牆：修正會話頁面上呈現為「null」的空白規則標籤
    
-   ipsec: fix faulty “-” usage in URIs  
    ipsec：修正 URI 中錯誤的「-」用法
    
-   isc-dhcp: take into account that multiple ia-pd can be delegated  
    isc-dhcp：考慮到可以委派多個ia-pd
    
-   kea-dhcp: simplified the controller code  
    kea-dhcp：簡化了控制器程式碼
    
-   unbound: change blocklist processing in \_blocklist\_reader()  
    未綁定：更改 \_blocklist\_reader() 中的區塊列表處理
    
-   unbound: allow RFC 2181 compatible names in query forwarding  
    未綁定：在查詢轉發中允許 RFC 2181 相容名稱
    
-   mvc: silence spurious validation message when explicitly asked to ignore them  
    mvc：當明確要求忽略虛假驗證訊息時，將其靜音
    
-   ui: prevent vertical modal overflows and instead present a scrollbar  
    ui：防止垂直模式溢出並顯示捲軸
    
-   ui: add $.replaceInputWithSelector() action  
    ui：新增 $.replaceInputWithSelector() 操作
    
-   ui: handle static page CSRF without Phalcon  
    ui：在沒有 Phalcon 的情況下處理靜態頁CSRF

    插件: os-caddy 1.5.6 [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/24.1/www/caddy/pkg-descr)
    
-   src: pfsync: fix use of invalidated stack variable  
    src：pfsync：修復無效堆疊變數的使用
    
-   src: pfsync: cope with multiple pending plus messages  
    src: pfsync: 處理多個待處理的加訊息

##### 24.1.7 (May 16, 2024)｜24.1.7（2024 年 5 月 16 日）

Python was updated to version 3.11 along with the usual reliability patches in the core, plugins and third party software.

Python 已更新至版本 3.11 以及核心、外掛程式和第三方軟體中常見的可靠性修補程式。

At the moment we are working on removing most of the Phalcon framework dependencies which have the side effect of speeding up the MVC/API bits. The new dashboard is also taking shape. Try it on the development version if you can and let us know what you think.

目前，我們正在努力刪除大部分 Phalcon 框架依賴項，這些依賴項會帶來加速 MVC/API 位的副作用。新的儀表板也已初步成形。如果可以的話，在開發版本上嘗試一下，並告訴我們您的想法。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: fix maximum log file size being ignored when there is only one file  
    系統：修復只有一個檔案時被忽略的最大日誌檔案大小
    
-   system: make log rotate action available to Cron  
    系統：使日誌輪替操作可用於 Cron
    
-   system: remove get\_current\_theme() and improve static page templating  
    系統：刪除 get\_current\_theme() 並改進靜態頁面模板

##### 24.1.6 (April 18, 2024)｜24.1.6（2024 年 4 月 18 日）

Today we are happy to announce another milestone regarding ISC DHCP removal: the arrival of a DHCRelay replacement based on code forked and maintained by OpenBSD. While here the whole DHCP relay section was moved to MVC/API for the usual reasons and now offers a combined GUI for both DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 relay. As a special treat this also includes being able to run ISC DHCP as well as any desired relay at the same time.

今天，我們很高興地宣布關於 ISC DHCP 刪除的另一個里程碑：基於由 OpenBSD 分叉和維護的程式碼的 DHCRelay 替代品的到來。由於通常的原因，整個 DHCP 中繼部分已移至 MVC/API，現在為 DHCPv4 和 DHCPv6 中繼提供組合的 GUI。作為一項特殊待遇，這還包括能夠同時運行ISC DHCP以及任何所需的繼電器。

The feedback for the WireGuard peer generator was quite extensive so a few more tweaks and fixes have been done in that area. Thank you for all the responses regarding that feature addition!

WireGuard 對等產生器的回饋相當廣泛，因此在該領域進行了更多調整和修復。感謝您對添加該功能的所有回應！

Otherwise this update simply moves ahead with security-related third party updates in OpenSSL and PHP.

否則，此更新只是繼續推進 OpenSSL 和 PHP 中與安全相關的第三方更新。

Last but not least we are releasing the OPNProxy (formerly business) plugin to the community version for fine-grained access control using Squid with Redis as a database backend. For more details please consult the available documentation linked below.

最後但並非最不重要的一點是，我們將 OPNProxy（以前稱為商業）外掛程式發佈到社群版本，以使用 Squid 和 Redis 作為資料庫後端進行細粒度存取控制。有關更多詳細信息，請參閱下面鏈接的可用文檔。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

##### 24.1.5 (April 04, 2024)｜24.1.5（2024 年 4 月 4 日）

Today the kernel receives a number of minor updates that have accumulated since 24.1.2 was released. The primary focus for the time being is adding fixes and MVC improvements for upcoming feature backports into the next 24.1.x versions.

今天，核心收到了自 24.1.2 發布以來累積的一些小更新。目前的主要重點是為即將推出的功能向後移植到下一個 24.1.x 版本添加修復和 MVC 改進。

The update presents itself as a hotfix release 24.1.5\_1 but that is only due to catching an issue during the last QA stage with an update of the gettext library.

該更新以修補程式版本 24.1.5\_1 的形式出現，但這只是由於在最後 QA 階段更新 gettext 庫時發現了一個問題。

##### 24.1.4 (March 20, 2024)｜24.1.4（2024 年 3 月 20 日）

Suricata and Unbound have been updated to their latest versions. Support for dynamic DNS VTI connections has also been added amongst other things.

Suricata 和 Unbound 已更新至最新版本。除此之外，還增加了對動態DNS VTI連接的支援。

We would like to thank Cedrik Pischem (Monviech) for upstreaming his Caddy plugin to the official packages. If you already have this plugin installed no further action has to be taken and updates should proceed through the standard firmware channel from now on. Documentation for it was added to the manual as well.

我們要感謝 Cedrik Pischem (Monviech) 將他的 Caddy 外掛程式上游到官方軟體包中。如果您已經安裝了此插件，則無需採取進一步操作，從現在開始，更新應通過標準韌體通道進行。它的文檔也被添加到手冊中。

For 24.7, we are currently working on a DHCP-Relay replacement, a rewrite of the trust section in MVC as well as a new dashboard implementation. It has been busy and we will keep it that way. :)

對於24.7，我們目前正在開發DHCP-Relay 替代品、重寫MVC 中的信任部分以及新的儀表板實作。它一直很忙，我們會保持這種狀態。 :)

##### 24.1.3 (March 06, 2024)｜24.1.3（2024 年 3 月 6 日）

This update fixes minor issues in the software and adds a CSV import/export to the Kea DHCP reservations to make bulk edits much easier. It also fixes defaults in Suricata 7 that would negatively impact the IPS mode usage and updates the curl package to its current latest version.

此更新修復了軟體中的小問題，並向 Kea DHCP 預留添加了 CSV 匯入/匯出功能，使大量編輯變得更加容易。它還修復了 Suricata 7 中可能對IPS模式使用產生負面影響的預設設置，並將curl套件更新到當前的最新版本。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: prevent gateway removal when it is currently bound to an interface  
    系統：防止目前綁定到介面的網關被刪除

    系統：修復各種PHP棄用警告
    
-   firewall: add optional advanced property “State policy” to influence state creation on a per rule base

    防火牆：修復ICMP工具提示的顯示（由lin-xianming貢獻）
    
-   firmware: fix missing space in audit message  
    韌體：修復審核訊息中缺少的空格
    
-   kea-dhcp: add import/export as CSV on reservations  
    kea-dhcp：在預訂中新增匯入/匯出為 CSV

    入侵偵測：將 exception-policy 和 app-layer.error-policy 設定為其公佈的預設值

    unbound：製作 root.hints 檔案的原子副本，以期解決 Unbound 啟動問題

##### 24.1.2 (February 20, 2024)｜24.1.2（2024 年 2 月 20 日）

It is time to move back to Suricata version 7 after identifying the relevant default option changes in order to keep IPS/Netmap happy when running it. Kea also received a number of tweaks and updates as well as our VPN service integrations.

在確定相關的預設選項變更後，是時候回到 Suricata 版本 7 了，以便讓 IPS/Netmap 在運行時保持滿意。 Kea 還收到了許多調整和更新以及我們的 VPN 服務整合。

Last but not least this includes FreeBSD 13.2-p10 and the recent DNS denial of service attack mitigation.

最後但並非最不重要的一點是，這包括 FreeBSD 13.2-p10 和最近的 DNS 拒絕服務攻擊緩解。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: accept colon character in log queries  
    系統：在日誌查詢中接受冒號字符
    
-   system: add issuer and logo to OTP link  
    系統：將發行機構和標識添加到OTP鏈接
    
-   system: fix gateway migration issue causing individual items to be skipped  
    系統：修復網關遷移問題，導致個別項目被跳過
    
-   reporting: update traffic graph colors to be contrast and consistent (contributed by brotherla)  
    報告：將流量圖顏色更新為對比和一致（由 Brotherla 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: fix strpos() deprecation null haystack  
    介面：修復 strpos() 棄用 null haystack
    
-   interfaces: add missing ACL entries for ARP/NDP tables  
    介面：為 ARP/NDP 表新增缺少的 ACL 條目
    
-   interfaces: fix VXLAN validation  
    接口：修復VXLAN驗證
    
-   firewall: change default traffic normalization behavior and choose “in” as standard direction for manual rules  
    防火牆：變更預設流量標準化行為並選擇「in」作為手動規則的標準方向
    
-   firewall: make select width more consistent on alias diagnostics table selection  
    防火牆：使選擇寬度在別名診斷表選擇上更一致
    
-   dhcp: set RemoveAdvOnExit to off in CARP mode for router advertisements  
    dhcp：在路由器通告的CARP模式下將RemoveAdvOnExit設定為關閉
    
-   dhcp: make sure the register DNS leases options reflect that this is only supported for ISC DHCP  
    dhcp：確保寄存器 DNS 租用選項反映僅支援 ISC DHCP
    
-   dhcp: make option\_data\_autocollect option more explicit in Kea  
    dhcp：在 Kea 中讓 option\_data\_autocollect 選項更明確
    
-   dhcp: gather missing Kea leases another way since the logs are unreliable  
    dhcp：由於日誌不可靠，因此以另一種方式收集遺失的 Kea 租約
    
-   dhcp: add address constraint to Kea reservations  
    dhcp：向 Kea 保留添加地址約束
    
-   dhcp: add unique constraint for MAC address + subnet in Kea  
    dhcp：在 Kea 中為 MAC 位址 + 子網新增唯一約束
    
-   dhcp: add domain-name to client configuration in Kea  
    dhcp：將網域加入 Kea 中的客戶端配置
    
-   dhcp: loosen constraints for TFTP boot in Kea  
    dhcp：放寬 Kea 中對 TFTP 啟動的限制
    
-   intrusion detection: adjust for default behaviour changes in Suricata 7  
    入侵偵測：調整 Suricata 7 中的預設行為更改
    
-   ipsec: improve enable button placement on connections page  
    ipsec：改進連線頁面上的啟用按鈕位置
    
-   ipsec: show EAP-RADIUS settings only when legacy tunnels are being used  
    ipsec：僅在使用舊隧道時顯示 EAP-RADIUS 設定
    
-   ipsec: allow % to support %any in ID for connections  
    ipsec：允許 % 支援 ID 中的 %any 連接
    
-   openvpn: when “cert\_depth” is left empty it should ignore the value  
    openvpn：當「cert\_depth」留空時，它應該忽略該值
    
-   openvpn: data-ciphers-fallback should be a single option  
    openvpn：data-ciphers-fallback 應該是選項

    openvpn：修復對 /30 p2p/net30 實例的支持

    openvpn：為連接中的簡單布林伺服器推送選項新增「various\_push\_flags」字段
    
-   unbound: prevent os.write() on None when another thread closed the pipe in Python module  
    unbound：當另一個執行緒關閉Python模組中的管道時，阻止 os.write() on None

    src: bhyveload: 使用 dirfd 來支持 -h [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-24:01.bhyveload.asc)

    src: setusercontext(): 僅在符合有效的UID [\[4\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-24:02.libutil.asc) 時套用個人設定

    src: re: 如果 EEPROM 中沒有位址，則產生一個位址

##### 24.1.1 (February 06, 2024)｜24.1.1（2024 年 2 月 6 日）

Apart from rolling back Suricata 7 to 6 the new major version is looking good. The two intertwined Suricata default config changes in version 7 have been identified and fixed in the development version so that we can move back to version 7 in 24.1.2.

除了將 Suricata 7 回滾到 6 之外，新的主要版本看起來還不錯。版本 7 中兩個相互交織的 Suricata 預設配置變更已在開發版本中確定並修復，以便我們可以在24.1.2中回到版本 7。

This minor release is intended as a small round of fixes and third party updates to ensure reliability and security.

此次要版本旨在進行小輪修復和第三方更新，以確保可靠性和安全性。

##### 24.1 (January 30, 2024)｜24.1（2024 年 1 月 30 日）

For more than 9 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

9 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

24.1, nicknamed “Savvy Shark”（精明的鯊魚）, features ports-based OpenSSL 3, Suricata 7, several MVC/API conversions, a new neighbor configuration feature for ARP/NDP, core inclusion of the os-firewall and os-wireguard plugins, CARP VHID tracking for OpenVPN and WireGuard, functional Kea DHCPv4 server with HA support plus much more.

24.1，綽號 “Savvy Shark”（精明的鯊魚），具有基於連接埠的 OpenSSL 3、Suricata 7、幾個 MVC/API 轉換，一個新的鄰居配置功能 ARP/NDP，核心包含 os-firewall 和 os-wireguard 插件， CARP VHID 追蹤 OpenVPN 和 WireGuard，功能性 Kea DHCPv4 伺服器 HA 支持以及更多。
