Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   Audits and certifications are requiring us to restrict system accounts for non-administrators (without wheel group in particular). It will no longer be possible to use non-adminstrator accounts with shell access and permissions for sensitive files have been tightened to not be world-readable. This may cause custom tooling to stop working, but can easily be fixed by giving these required accounts the full administration rights.  
    審核和認證要求我們限制非管理員（特別是無輪組）的系統帳戶。將不再可能使用具有 shell 存取權限的非管理員帳戶，且敏感檔案的權限已被收緊，無法被所有人讀取。這可能會導致自訂工具停止運作，但可以透過為這些所需帳戶授予完整的管理權限來輕鬆修復。
    
-   ISC DHCP functionality is slowly being deprecated with the introduction of Kea as an alternative. The work to replace the tooling of ISC DHCP is ongoing, but feature sets will likely differ for a long time therefore.  
    隨著 Kea 作為替代方案的引入，ISC DHCP 功能正在慢慢被棄用。替換ISC DHCP工具的工作正在進行中，但功能集可能會在很長一段時間內有所不同。
    
-   The move to the FreeBSD ports version of OpenSSL 3.0 is included and may disrupt third party repository use until those have been fixed and rebuilt accordingly. Please note that we do not vet third party repositories and do not have control over them so their response time may vary.  
    遷移到 OpenSSL 3.0 的 FreeBSD 移植版本可能會中斷第三方儲存庫的使用，直到這些儲存庫被相應修復和重建。請注意，我們不會審查第三方儲存庫，也無法控制它們，因此它們的回應時間可能會有所不同。
    
-   The Squid web proxy functionality moves to a plugin and will no longer be installed by default for new installations. However, if you have Squid enabled the plugin will automatically be installed during the upgrade. There is no code difference in the implementation and integration of the plugin compared to the core version.  
    Squid Web 代理功能已移至插件，新安裝時將不再預設安裝。但是，如果您啟用了 Squid，則該外掛程式將在升級過程中自動安裝。與核心版本相比，插件的實現和整合沒有程式碼差異。

##### 24.1.r1 (January 19, 2024)｜24.1.r1（2024 年 1 月 19 日）

For more than 9 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

9 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you. <3

我們感謝大家幫助測試、塑造該專案並為該專案做出貢獻！我們知道如果沒有你，一切都會不一樣。 <3

24.1-RC1 is an online uppgrade only. We will be publishing images with the final 24.1 release of course.

24.1-RC1 僅是線上升級。當然，我們將在最終的 24.1 版本中發布圖像。

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   Audits and certifications are requiring us to restrict system accounts for non-administrators (without wheel group in particular). It will no longer be able to use non-adminstrator accounts with shell access and permissions for sensitive files have been tightened to not be world-readable. This may cause custom tooling to stop working, but can easily be fixed by giving these required accounts the full administration rights.  
    審核和認證要求我們限制非管理員（特別是無輪組）的系統帳戶。它將不再能夠使用具有 shell 存取權限的非管理員帳戶，並且敏感檔案的權限已被收緊，無法被所有人讀取。這可能會導致自訂工具停止運作，但可以透過為這些所需帳戶授予完整的管理權限來輕鬆修復。
    
-   ISC DHCP functionality is slowly being deprecated with the introduction of Kea as an alternative. The work to replace the tooling of ISC DHCP is ongoing, but feature sets will likely differ for a long time therefore.  
    隨著 Kea 作為替代方案的引入，ISC DHCP 功能正在慢慢被棄用。替換ISC DHCP工具的工作正在進行中，但功能集可能會在很長一段時間內有所不同。
    
-   The move to the FreeBSD ports version of OpenSSL 3.0 is included and may disrupt third party repository use until those have been fixed and rebuilt accordingly. Please note that we do not vet third party repositories and do not have control over them so their response time may vary.  
    包括向 FreeBSD ports 版本的 OpenSSL 3.0 的迁移，并且可能会中断第三方存储库的使用，直到这些存储库得到相应的修复和重建。請注意，我們不會審查第三方儲存庫，也無法控制它們，因此它們的回應時間可能會有所不同。
    
-   The Squid web proxy functionality moves to a plugin and will no longer be installed by default for new installations. However, if you have Squid enabled the plugin will automatically be installed during the upgrade. There is no code difference in the implementation and integration of the plugin compared to the core version.  
    Squid Web 代理功能已移至插件，新安裝時將不再預設安裝。但是，如果您啟用了 Squid，則該外掛程式將在升級過程中自動安裝。與核心版本相比，插件的實現和整合沒有程式碼差異。

#### 23.7 “Restless Roadrunner”（不安分的走鵑） Series｜23.7 “Restless Roadrunner”（不安分的走鵑）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_23.7.html>

For more than 8 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

8 年半多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

23.7, nicknamed “Restless Roadrunner”（不安分的走鵑）, features numerous MVC/API conversions including the new OpenVPN “instances” configuration option, OpenVPN group alias support, deferred authentication for OpenVPN, FreeBSD 13.2, PHP 8.2 plus much more.

23.7，綽號為 “Restless Roadrunner”（不安分的走鵑），具有大量 MVC/API 轉換，包括新的 OpenVPN「實例」設定選項、OpenVPN 群組別名支援、OpenVPN 的延遲身份驗證、FreeBSD 13.2, PHP 8.2 等等。

##### 23.7.12 (January 16, 2024)｜23.7.12（2024 年 1 月 16 日）

One more release it was indeed. We have added considerable backend work for improving security and adding a streaming function to avoid memory exhaustion for data-intense data exchanges. Note this is in preparation for 24.1 where these will be used, but direct use in 23.7 is avoided to lower the possibility for regressions.

這確實是另一個版本。我們添加了大量的後端工作來提高安全性，並添加串流功能以避免資料密集型資料交換的記憶體耗盡。請注意，這是為24.1做準備，其中將使用這些，但避免在23.7中直接使用，以降低迴歸的可能性。

The release date for 24.1 is January 30 and we approaching this differently this time with release candidates only being available from the development version meaning there will be no installation media before the final release.

24.1 的發布日期是 1 月 30 日，這次我們的處理方式有所不同，候選版本僅在開發版本中可用，這意味著在最終版本之前不會有安裝媒體。

While RC1 is mostly ready the publication is currently on hold due to chasing down a kernel panic. Watch out for the release notes of the RC1. It should be available this week with a follow-up RC2 in the following week.

雖然 RC1 已基本準備就緒，但由於追蹤內核恐慌，該出版物目前處於擱置狀態。請留意 RC1 的發行說明。它應該在本週發布，後續版本 RC2 將在下週發布。

##### 23.7.11 (January 04, 2024)｜23.7.11（2024 年 1 月 4 日）

The final test phase for 24.1 is starting just as 23.7 strechtes towards its inevitable end of life. At the moment it is unclear if this release will be the last one or not so we shall refrain from stating something that may not be true in the coming weeks. ;)

##### 23.7.9 (November 23, 2023)｜23.7.9（2023 年 11 月 23 日）

As the end of the year inches closer the changes published today are naturally smaller additions and cleanups, notably changes for IPsec VTI connection for IPv6 and dual-stack operation, a possible OpenVPN CSO mismatch bug and optional support for SHA-512 password hashing.

隨著年底的臨近，今天發布的更改自然是較小的添加和清理，特別是針對 IPv6 和雙棧操作的 IPsec VTI 連接的更改、可能的 OpenVPN CSO 不匹配錯誤以及對 SHA-512 密碼哈希的可選支持。

Note that the HTTPS bump for the firmware mirrors updates the published URLs in the firmware selection, but if you already use LeaseWeb or NYC BUG you need to reselect them in order to move from HTTP to HTTPS connectivity.

請注意，韌體映像檔的 HTTPS 碰撞會更新韌體選擇中已發布的 URL，但如果您已經使用 LeaseWeb 或 NYC BUG，則需要重新選擇它們才能從 HTTP 移動到 HTTPS 連接。

Of further note is that the Squid web proxy will be moved to a plugin in version 24.1 but for everyone using it the upgrade procedure will make sure to install it automatically when enabled. A meta package was added to the plugins already in order for this to work just in case there are questions about what it is supposed to be doing… apart from providing dependencies it does not do anything at the moment. ;)

進一步值得注意的是，Squid Web 代理程式將被移至版本 24.1 的插件中，但對於每個使用它的人來說，升級過程將確保在啟用時自動安裝它。一個元包已經添加到插件中，以便它能夠工作，以防萬一對其應該做什麼有疑問……除了提供依賴項之外，它目前不執行任何操作。 ;)

Last but not least, we have been successfully testing and ironing out OpenSSL 3 ports builds in the past week and inclusion in 24.1 seems very likely at this point. The effort continues and we will also be looking into backport material from FreeBSD 13 stable branches for further preparation.

最後但並非最不重要的一點是，我們在過去一周已經成功測試和解決了 OpenSSL 3 端口構建，目前看來很有可能包含在 24.1 中。我們的努力仍在繼續，我們還將研究 FreeBSD 13 穩定分支的向後移植材料，以進行進一步的準備。

##### 23.7.8 (November 09, 2023)｜23.7.8（2023 年 11 月 9 日）

The configuration restore GUI has been improved in a number of ways due to recent demand and Squid was updated to the new major release version 6.

由於最近的需求，配置恢復GUI在許多方面得到了改進，並且 Squid 已更新到新的主要發布版本 6。

A number of reliability improvements were also added to the WireGuard kernel plugin which from our perspective is now ready for core inclusion. The documentation is being updated accordingly, but will take a bit more time to ensure consistency following up on the GUI changes it received.

WireGuard 核心外掛程式還添加了許多可靠性改進，從我們的角度來看，該外掛程式現在已準備好納入核心。文件正在相應更新，但需要更多時間來確保跟進收到的 GUI 更改的一致性。

This update also includes FreeBSD security advisories and assorted fixes. We are aware of OpenSSL 1.1.1 CVE-2023-5678 and we are already testing builds based on OpenSSL 3 which can be available in 24.1 when it does not negatively impact overall operation. We also expect fixes for version 1 to be available sooner, but without OpenSSL providing such fixes directly the roundtrip time is likely going to increase for them.

此更新還包括 FreeBSD 安全建議和各種修復。我們了解 OpenSSL 1.1.1 CVE-2023-5678，並且我們已經在測試基於 OpenSSL 3 的構建，當它不會對整體操作產生負面影響時，可以在 24.1 中使用它。我們也期望版本 1 的修復程序能夠更快地提供，但如果 OpenSSL 不直接提供此類修復程序，那麼它們的往返時間可能會增加。

##### 23.7.7 (October 25, 2023)｜23.7.7 （2023年10月25日）

The user experience of several pages has been improved. And this update is also shipping several FreeBSD-based changes for further reliability as well as core fixes and improvements as they came up on GitHub or the forum in the last weeks.

多個頁面的使用者體驗已提升。此外，本次更新還包含多項基於 FreeBSD 的更改，旨在進一步提高系統穩定性，並修復和改進了過去幾週在 GitHub 或論壇上提出的核心問題。

A word of caution for third party repository users. FreeBSD currently changes a number of things in their ecosystem. The first change is the move of the “openssl” package to “openssl111” since the former is now based on version 3. This can and likely will disrupt updates of third party packages not having followed this change. While we want to use OpenSSL 3 eventually being in the middle of a stable run is not the time and place to do it. Secondly, FreeBSD makes its port stop relying on ca\_root\_nss package trust store provided by Mozilla which introduces technical barriers for integration of our own trust store. This update changes curl to not use the old bundle files, but then also ensures that the base system will register all CA certificates brought in by our trust store as well. The biggest caveat at the moment is that this process is slower than before and may end up untrusting user CAs if they happen to be on the FreeBSD-provided untrusted list. During upgrades you will see when it writes the trust files and bundles and if any errors occur.

提醒第三方軟體倉庫使用者註意：FreeBSD 目前對其生態系統進行了一些更改。首先，由於「openssl」軟體套件現在基於 OpenSSL 3 版本，因此已將其遷移至「openssl111」。這可能會影響尚未更新的第三方軟體包的更新。雖然我們最終希望使用 OpenSSL 3，但在穩定版系統運行期間進行此操作並不合適。其次，FreeBSD 的連接埠不再依賴 Mozilla 提供的 ca_root_nss 軟體包信任函式庫，這為我們整合自己的信任庫帶來了技術障礙。此次更新使 curl 不再使用舊的 bundle 文件，但同時也確保基礎系統能夠註冊我們信任庫引入的所有CA憑證。目前最大的問題是，此過程比以前更慢，如果使用者的 CA 恰好在 FreeBSD 提供的不受信任清單中，則可能會導致這些 CA 不受信任。升級過程中，您將看到它何時寫入信任檔案和捆綁包，以及是否發生任何錯誤。

In both instances we feel nothing can be gained in postponing these changes so we are carrying them out swiftly after ensuring they do the right thing for our user base and voicing our reservations where it matters.

我們認為，在這兩種情況下，推遲這些變更都沒有任何好處，因此，在確保這些變更對我們的使用者群體有利，並在重要的地方表達我們的保留意見之後，我們將迅速實施這些變更。

You can also find and follow us on Bluesky now:

現在您也可以在Bluesky上找到並關注我們：

[https://bsky.app/profile/opnsense.org](https://bsky.app/profile/opnsense.org)

##### 23.7.6 (October 11, 2023)｜23.7.6 （2023年10月11日）

This update is a maintenance release improving the DS-Lite use via separate GIF tunnels on top of IPv6-only connectivity. We are still continuing the efforts to provide better MVC integration for the gateways abstraction as well as working towards better MVC model consistency.

本次更新為維護版本，旨在改善基於GIF連接的獨立隧道，從而提升DS -Lite 的使用體驗。我們仍在努力改進網關抽象層的MVC集成，並致力於提升MVC模型的一致性。

We would like to thank GitHub user Monviech for his special contributions in the documentation on the subject of reflection and hairpin NAT [\[1\]](#p-136) .

我們要感謝 GitHub 使用者 Monviech 對反射和髮夾NAT [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/nat_reflection.html ) 主題的文檔做出的特殊貢獻。

##### 23.7.5 (September 26, 2023)｜23.7.5 （2023年9月26日）

Today introduces a change in MTU handling for parent interfaces mostly noticed by PPPoE use where the respective MTU values need to fit the parent plus the additional header of the VLAN or PPPoE. Should the MTU already be misconfigured to a smaller value it will be used as configured so check your configuration and clear the MTU value if you want the system to decide about the effective parent MTU size.

今天對父介面的MTU處理方式進行了更改，這主要影響PPPoE用戶。此時，對應的MTU值需要與父介面加上PPPoE的VLAN附加頭部相符。如果MTU的值已錯誤配置為較小的值，則系統將依配置使用。因此，請檢查您的配置，如果您希望系統自動確定有效的父介面MTU大小，請清除MTU值。

Another change in far gateway handling is also included which prevents a monitoring failure if that particular gateway was not being designated as default during boot which made the routing table miss the essential interface route and monitoring would always report it as down. Now the interface route is ensured but not only when applying the default gateway so that it works all the time.

另一項針對遠端網關處理的變更也已完成，它可以防止在啟動過程中未將該網關指定為預設網關時出現監控故障。先前，由於路由表會遺漏必要的介面路由，導致監控始終報告該介面處於關閉狀態。現在，介面路由不僅在套用預設閘道時有效，而且始終保持正常運作。

Also fixed was the problematic migration of the Unbound interfaces settings which now clears the possibly unknown interfaces in order to proceed and have Unbound up and running post update which was not the case for some users previously.

此外，還修復了 Unbound 介面設定遷移的問題，現在可以清除可能未知的接口，以便在更新後繼續運行 Unbound，而之前某些用戶無法做到這一點。

Other reliability improvements and third party security updates are included as well. We also continue our effort to clean up the interface handling code and audit the MVC model files for consistency. A missing change for out of the box DS-Lite support is also being tested on the development version now and will likely hit in 23.7.6.

此外，還包括其他可靠性改進和第三方安全性更新。我們也持續努力清理介面處理程式碼，並審核MVC模型檔案的一致性。目前，我們正在開發版本中測試一項缺失的更改，即開箱即用的DS -Lite 支持，該更改可能會在23.7.6中發布。

##### 23.7.3 (August 30, 2023)｜23.7.3 （2023年8月30日）

Recently we improved the workflow for bringing language updates to the release so here we are with an updated translation package including added support for Korean. Thanks a lot to all contributors for keeping this going strong!

最近我們改進了語言更新的發布流程，現在我們帶來了更新的翻譯包，其中新增了對韓語的支援。非常感謝所有貢獻者，你們的付出讓這項工作得以順利進行！

If you would like to help with translations you can sign up via:

如果您想幫忙翻譯，可以透過以下方式註冊：

[https://poeditor.com/projects/view?id=179921](https://poeditor.com/projects/view?id=179921)

Of note is also the largely rewritten backend for the WireGuard kernel module plugin which offers separate services for each instance much like OpenVPN offers it. The requirement of the wireguard-tools and bash packages were removed. This also means the plugin will be moved to the core for 24.1 along with Wireguard go plugin being removed completely since on FreeBSD 13.2 no external package is needed to enjoy WireGuard and the permanent existence of a kernel module renders the Go fallback defunct through wireguard-tools/wg-quick implementation quirks.

值得注意的是，WireGuard 核心模組插件的後端也進行了大幅重寫，它像 OpenVPN 一樣，為每個執行個體提供獨立的服務。對 wireguard-tools 和 bash 軟體包的依賴已被移除。這也意味著該插件將被移至核心24.1 ，同時 WireGuard Go 插件將被完全移除，因為在 FreeBSD 13.2上無需任何外部軟體包即可使用 WireGuard，而且內核模組的永久存在會因 wireguard-tools/wg-quick 實現上的無效方案。

##### 23.7.2 (August 23, 2023)｜23.7.2 （2023年8月23日）

Assorted improvements are being shipped with this release. Of special note is the proper monitoring of down gateways which allows the new gateway watcher to see the gateway come back online when plugging a cable. A Wazuh agent plugin was added and the ddclient plugin received new protocol support including AWS Route53 amongst others.

此版本包含多項改進。尤其值得一提的是，新增了故障閘道的監控功能，使得新的閘道監控器能夠在插入網路線後偵測到閘道恢復線上狀態。此外，還新增了 Wazuh 代理插件，並且 ddclient 插件也獲得了新的協定支持，包括AWS Route53 等。

##### 23.7.1 (August 08, 2023)｜23.7.1 （2023年8月8日）

23.7 looks pretty good so far but no reason not to make it better. The MVC changes for DHCP, firewall groups, OpenVPN and Unbound receive several required fixes and the latest FreeBSD security advisories were added as well.

23.7 到目前為止看起來還不錯，但沒有理由不讓它變得更好。 MVC 對 DHCP 的更改、防火牆組、OpenVPN 和 Unbound 收到了一些必需的修復，並且還添加了最新的 FreeBSD 安全建議。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: close boot file after probing to avoid lock inheritance  
    系統：探測完成後關閉啟動檔以避免鎖定繼承
    
-   system: fix lock() inheriting the lock state  
    系統：修復 lock() 繼承鎖定狀態的問題
    
-   system: give more context in process kill error case since we operate PID numbers only  
    系統：由於我們僅處理PID編號，因此請在進程終止錯誤情況下提供更多上下文資訊。
    
-   firewall: groups were not correctly parsed for menu post-migration  
    防火牆：遷移後選單中的群組未正確解析
    
-   firewall: hide row command buttons for internal groups  
    防火牆：隱藏內部群組的行命令按鈕
    
-   firewall: add “ipv6-icmp” to protocol list in shaper  
    防火牆：將「ipv6-icmp」加入整形器的協定清單中
    
-   firewall: fix PHP warnings on the rules pages  
    防火牆：修復規則頁面上的PHP警告
    
-   dhcp: check if manufacturer exists for IPv4 lease page to prevent error  
    DHCP：檢查 IPv4 租約頁是否有製造商資訊以防止錯誤
    
-   dhcp: use base16 for iaid\_duid decode for IPv6 lease page to prevent error  
    DHCP：對 IPv6 租約頁的 iaid_duid 解碼使用 base16 編碼，以防止錯誤。
    
-   dhcp: fix validation for static entry requirement  
    DHCP：修復靜態條目要求的驗證
    
-   firmware: revoke 23.1 fingerprint  
    韌體：撤銷23.1指紋
    
-   network time: support pool directive and maxclock (contributed by Kevin Fason)  
    網路時間：支援 pool 指令和 maxclock（由 Kevin Fason 提供）
    
-   openvpn: fix static key delete  
    openvpn：修復靜態金鑰刪除問題
    
-   openvpn: fix “mode” typo and push auth “digest” into export config  
    openvpn：修正「mode」拼字錯誤，並將驗證「digest」推送到匯出設定中
    
-   openvpn: fix race condition when using CRLs in instances  
    openvpn：修正在實例中使用 CRL 時出現的競態條件
    
-   openvpn: remove arbitrary upper bounds on some integer values in instances  
    openvpn：移除實例中某些整數值的任意上限
    
-   unbound: migration of empty nodes failed from 23.1.11 to 23.7  
    未綁定：從23.1.11到23.7的空節點遷移失敗
    
-   unbound: fix regression when disabling first domain override  
    unbound：修正停用第一個網域覆蓋時出現的迴歸問題
    
-   mvc: fix empty item selection issue in BaseListField  
    MVC：修正 BaseListField 中空項選擇的問題
    
-   plugins: os-ddclient 1.14 [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/23.7/dns/ddclient/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-ddclient 1.14 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/23.7/dns/ddclient/pkg-descr )
    
-   plugins: os-acme-client 3.19 [\[2\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/23.7/security/acme-client/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-acme-client 3.19 [\[2\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/23.7/security/acme-client/pkg-descr )
    
-   src: bhyve: fully reset the fwctl state machine if the guest requests a reset [\[3\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-23:07.bhyve.asc)  
    src: bhyve: 如果客戶端要求重置，則完全重置 fwctl 狀態機 [\[3\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-23:07.bhyve.asc )
    
-   src: frag6: avoid a possible integer overflow in fragment handling [\[4\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-23:06.ipv6.asc)  
    src: frag6: 避免片段處理中可能發生的整數溢位 [\[4\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-23:06.ipv6.asc )
    
-   src: amdtemp: Fix missing 49 degree offset on current EPYC CPUs  
    src: amdtemp: 修復目前EPYC CPU 上缺少的 49 度偏移
    
-   src: libpfctl: ensure the initial allocation is large enough  
    src：libpfctl：確保初始分配的記憶體夠大
    
-   src: pf: handle multiple IPv6 fragment headers  
    src: pf: 處理多個 IPv6 分片頭
    
-   ports: curl 8.2.1 [\[5\]](https://curl.se/changes.html#8_2_1)  
    ports: curl 8.2.1 [\[5\]]( https://curl.se/changes.html#8_2_1 )
    
-   ports: dnspython 2.4.1  
    埠：dnspython 2.4.1
    
-   ports: nss 3.92 [\[6\]](https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/security/nss/releases/nss_3_92.html)  
    埠：nss 3.92 [\[6\]]( https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/security/nss/releases/nss_3_92.html )
    
-   ports: openssl 1.1.1v [\[7\]](https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/openssl-3.0/CHANGES.md)  
    ports: openssl 1.1 .1v [\[7\]]( https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/openssl-3.0/CHANGES.md )
    
-   ports: perl 5.34.1 [\[8\]](https://perldoc.perl.org/5.34.1/perldelta)  
    ports: perl 5.34.1 [\[8\]]( https://perldoc.perl.org/5.34.1/perldelta )
    
-   ports: strongswan 5.9.11 [\[9\]](https://github.com/strongswan/strongswan/releases/tag/5.9.11)  
    端口：strongswan 5.9.11 [\[9\]]( https://github.com/strongswan/strongswan/releases/tag/5.9.11 )
    
-   ports: syslog-ng 4.3.1 [\[10\]](https://github.com/syslog-ng/syslog-ng/releases/tag/syslog-ng-4.3.1)  
    埠：syslog-ng 4.3.1 [\[10\]]( https://github.com/syslog-ng/syslog-ng/releases/tag/syslog-ng-4.3.1 )

##### 23.7 (July 31, 2023)｜23.7 （2023年7月31日）

For more than 8 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

八年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

23.7, nicknamed “Restless Roadrunner”（不安分的走鵑）, features numerous MVC/API conversions including the new OpenVPN “instances” configuration option, OpenVPN group alias support, deferred authentication for OpenVPN, FreeBSD 13.2, PHP 8.2 plus much more.

23.7 ，暱稱“Restless Roadrunner”（不安分的走鵑） ，具有眾多MVC/API轉換，包括新的OpenVPN「實例」設定選項、Open組別名支援、OpenVPN延遲驗證、FreeBSD 13.2, PHP 8.2等。

Here are the full patch notes against 23.1.11:

以下是23.1.11完整補丁說明：

-   system: use parse\_url() to validate if the provided login redirect string is actually parseable to prevent redirect  
    系統：使用 parse_url() 函數驗證提供的登入重定向字串是否可解析，以防止重定向。
    
-   system: fix assorted PHP 8.2 deprecation notes  
    系統：修復各種PHP 8.2棄用說明
    
-   system: fix assorted permission-after-write problems  
    系統：修復各種寫後權限問題
    
-   system: introduce a gateway watcher service and fix issue with unhandled “loss” trigger when “delay” is also reported  
    系統：引入網關監視器服務，並修復當同時報告「延遲」時未處理的「丟包」觸發器問題
    
-   system: enabled web GUI compression (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：已啟用 Web GUI壓縮（由 kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   system: disable PHP deprecation notes due to Phalcon emitting such messages breaking the API responses  
    系統：停用PHP棄用說明，因為 Phalcon 會發出此類訊息，從而破壞API回應。
    
-   system: allow “.” DNS search domain override  
    系統：允許「.」 DNS搜尋域覆蓋
    
-   system: on boot let template generation wait for configd socket for up to 10 seconds  
    系統：啟動時，範本產生等待 configd 套接字最多 10 秒。
    
-   system: do not allow state modification on GET for power off and reboot actions  
    系統：不允許對GET進行斷電和重啟操作的狀態修改
    
-   system: better validation and escaping for cron commands  
    系統：改進了 cron 指令的驗證和轉義
    
-   system: better validation for logging user input  
    系統：改進使用者輸入日誌記錄的驗證
    
-   system: improve configuration import when interfaces or console settings do not match  
    系統：改進介面或控制台設定不符時的配置導入
    
-   system: name unknown tunables as “environment” as they could still be supported by e.g. the boot loader  
    系統：將未知可調參數命名為“環境”，因為它們可能仍然受到例如引導程式的支援。
    
-   system: sanitize $act parameter in trust pages  
    系統：清理信任頁面中的 $act 參數
    
-   system: add severity filter in system log widget (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：在系統日誌小工具中加入嚴重性篩選器（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: mute openssl errors pushed to stderr  
    系統：禁止將 openssl 錯誤推送至 stderr
    
-   system: add opnsense-crypt utility to encrypt/decrypt a config.xml  
    系統：新增 opnsense-crypt 工具以加密/解密 config.xml 檔案。
    
-   system: call opnsense-crypt from opnsense-import to deal with encrypted imports  
    系統：從 opnsense-import 呼叫 opnsense-crypt 處理加密導入
    
-   interfaces: extend/modify IPv6 primary address behaviour  
    介面：擴充/修改 IPv6 主位址行為
    
-   interfaces: fix bug with reported number of flapping LAGG ports (contributed by Neil Greatorex)  
    介面：修復報告的抖動LAGG連接埠數量的錯誤（由Neil Greatorex貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: introduce a lock and DAD timer into newwanip for IPv6  
    介面：在 newwanip 中為 IPv6 引入鎖定和DAD定時器
    
-   interfaces: rewrite LAGG pages via MVC/API  
    介面：透過MVC/API重寫LAGG頁面
    
-   interfaces: allow manual protocol selection for VLANs  
    介面：允許手動選擇 VLAN 協議
    
-   interfaces: remove null\_service toggle as empty service name in PPPoE works fine  
    介面：移除 null\_service 開關，因為 PPPoE 中空服務名稱可以正常運作。
    
-   interfaces: on forceful IPv6 reload do not lose the event handling  
    介面：強制重新載入 IPv6 時，不要遺失事件處理
    
-   interfaces: allow primary address function to emit device used  
    介面：允許主位址功能發出設備所使用的位址
    
-   firewall: move all automatic rules for interface connectivity to priority 1  
    防火牆：將所有介面連線的自動規則優先權設為 1

    防火牆：使用MVC/API重寫了群組處理

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   The Unbound ACL now defaults to accept all traffic and no longer generates automatic entries. This was done to avoid connectivity issues on dynamic address setups – especially with VPN interfaces. If this is undesirable you can set it to default to block instead and add your manual entries to pass.  
    Unbound ACL現在預設接受所有流量，不再自動產生條目。這樣做是為了避免動態位址配置（尤其是VPN介面）出現連線問題。如果您不希望這樣，可以將其預設為阻止，並手動新增允許的條目。
    
-   Dpinger no longer triggers alarms on its own as its mechanism is too simplistic for loss and delay detection as provided by apinger a long time ago. Delay and loss triggers have been fixed and logging was improved. The rc.syshook facility “monitor” still exists but is only provided for compatibility reasons with existing user scripts.  
    Dpinger 不再自行觸發警報，因為它的機制太簡單，無法像 Apinger 那樣偵測丟包和延遲。延遲和丟包觸發機制已修復，日誌記錄也得到了改進。 rc.syshook 中的「monitor」功能仍然存在，但僅出於與現有使用者腳本的兼容性考慮而提供。
    
-   IPsec “tunnel settings” GUI is now deprecated and manual migration to the “connections” GUI is recommended. An appropriate EoL announcement will be made next year.  
    IPsec「隧道設定」 GUI現已棄用，建議手動遷移至「連接」 GUI 。相關終止支援公告將於明年發布。
    
-   The new OpenVPN instances pages and API create an independent set of instances more closely following the upstream documentation of OpenVPN. Legacy client/server settings cannot be managed from the API and are not migrated, but will continue to work independently.  
    新的 OpenVPN 實例頁面和API創建了一組獨立的實例，這些實例更嚴格地遵循 OpenVPN 的上游文件。舊版客戶端/伺服器設定無法透過API進行管理，也不會遷移，但將繼續獨立運作。
    
-   The old DynDNS plugin was removed in favor of the newer MVC/API plugin for ddclient. We are aware of the EoL state of ddclient which was unfortunately announced only one year after we started working on the new plugin. We will try to add upstream fixes that have not been released yet and already offer our own ddclient-less Python backend in the same plugin as an alternative.  
    舊的 DynDNS 插件已被移除，取而代之的是適用於 ddclient 的更新的MVC/API插件。我們已知悉 ddclient 已停止維護，遺憾的是，在我們開始開發新插件僅一年後，ddclient 的停止維護公告便發布了。我們將嘗試添加尚未發布的上游修復程序，並在同一插件中提供我們自己的、不依賴 ddclient 的 Python 後端作為替代方案。

##### 23.7.r1 (July 20, 2023)｜23.7 .r1（2023年7月20日）

For more than 8 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

八年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you. <3

我們感謝大家幫助測試、塑造該專案並為該專案做出貢獻！我們知道如果沒有你，一切都會不一樣。 <3

Here are the full patch notes against 23.1.11:

以下是23.1.11完整更新說明：

-   system: use parse\_url() to validate if the provided login redirect string is actually parseable to prevent redirect  
    系統：使用 parse_url() 函數驗證提供的登入重定向字串是否可解析，以防止重定向。
    
-   system: fix assorted PHP 8.2 deprecation notes  
    系統：修復各種PHP 8.2棄用說明
    
-   system: fix assorted permission-after-write problems  
    系統：修復各種寫後權限問題
    
-   system: introduce a gateway watcher service and fix issue with unhandled “loss” trigger when “delay” is also reported  
    系統：引入網關監視器服務，並修復當同時報告「延遲」時未處理的「丟包」觸發器問題
    
-   system: enabled web GUI compression (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：已啟用 Web GUI壓縮（由 kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   system: disable PHP deprecation notes due to Phalcon emitting such messages breaking the API responses  
    系統：停用PHP棄用說明，因為 Phalcon 會發出此類訊息，從而破壞API回應。
    
-   system: allow “.” DNS search domain override  
    系統：允許「.」 DNS搜尋域覆蓋
    
-   system: on boot let template generation wait for configd socket for up to 10 seconds  
    系統：啟動時，範本產生等待 configd 套接字最多 10 秒。
    
-   system: do not allow state modification on GET for power off and reboot actions  
    系統：不允許對GET進行關機和重啟操作的狀態修改
    
-   system: better validation and escaping for cron commands  
    系統：改進了 cron 指令的驗證和轉義
    
-   system: better validation for logging user input  
    系統：改進使用者輸入日誌記錄的驗證
    
-   system: improve configuration import when interfaces or console settings do not match  
    系統：改進介面或控制台設定不符時的配置導入
    
-   system: name unknown tunables as “environment” as they could still be supported by e.g. the boot loader  
    系統：將未知可調參數命名為“環境”，因為它們可能仍然受到例如引導程式的支援。
    
-   system: sanitize $act parameter in trust pages  
    系統：清理信任頁面中的 $act 參數
    
-   system: add severity filter in system log widget (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：在系統日誌小工具中加入嚴重性篩選器（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: extend/modify IPv6 primary address behaviour  
    介面：擴充/修改 IPv6 主位址行為
    
-   interfaces: fix bug with reported number of flapping LAGG ports (contributed by Neil Greatorex)  
    介面：修復報告的抖動LAGG連接埠數量錯誤（由Neil Greatorex貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: introduce a lock and DAD timer into newwanip for IPv6  
    介面：在 newwanip 中為 IPv6 引入鎖定和DAD定時器
    
-   firewall: move all automatic rules for interface connectivity to priority 1  
    防火牆：將所有介面連線的自動規則優先權設為 1
    
-   firewall: rewrote group handling using MVC/API  
    防火牆：使用MVC/API重寫了群組處理
    
-   firewall: clean up AliasField to use new getStaticChildren()  
    防火牆：清理 AliasField 以使用新的 getStaticChildren()
    
-   firewall: “kill states in selection” button was hidden when selecting only a rule for state search  
    防火牆：僅選擇規則進行狀態搜尋時，「終止所選狀態」按鈕會隱藏
    
-   firewall: cleanup port forward page and only show the associated filter rule for this entry  
    防火牆：清理連接埠轉送頁面，僅顯示此項目的關聯過濾規則
    
-   captive portal: safeguard template overlay distribution  
    強制門戶：保護模板疊加分發
    
-   dhcp: rewrote both IPv4 and IPv6 lease pages using MVC/API  
    DHCP：使用MVC/API重寫了 IPv4 和 IPv6 租約頁
    
-   dhcp: allow underscores in DNS names from DHCP leases in Dnsmasq and Unbound watchers (contributed by bugfixin)  
    dhcp：允許 Dnsmasq 和 Unbound 監視器中來自DHCP租約的DNS名稱使用下劃線（由 bu​​gfixin 貢獻）
    
-   dhcp: align router advertisements VIP code and exclude /128

-   firmware: properly escape crash reports shown

-   ipsec: add missing config section for HA sync

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   The Unbound ACL now defaults to accept all traffic and no longer generates automatic entries. This was done to avoid connectivity issues on dynamic address setups – especially with VPN interfaces. If this is undesirable you can set it to default to block instead and add your manual entries to pass.  
    Unbound ACL現在預設接受所有流量，不再自動產生條目。這樣做是為了避免動態位址配置（尤其是VPN介面）出現連線問題。如果您不希望這樣，可以將其預設為阻止，並手動新增允許的條目。
    
-   Dpinger no longer triggers alarms on its own as its mechanism is too simplistic for loss and delay detection as provided by apinger a long time ago. Delay and loss triggers have been fixed and logging was improved. The rc.syshook facility “monitor” still exists but is only provided for compatibility reasons with existing user scripts.  
    Dpinger 不再自行觸發警報，因為它的機制太簡單，無法像 Apinger 那樣偵測丟包和延遲。延遲和丟包觸發機制已修復，日誌記錄也得到了改進。 rc.syshook 中的「monitor」功能仍然存在，但僅出於與現有使用者腳本的兼容性考慮而提供。
    
-   IPsec “tunnel settings” GUI is now deprecated and manual migration to the “connections” GUI is recommended. An appropriate EoL announcement will be made next year.  
    IPsec「隧道設定」 GUI現已棄用，建議手動遷移至「連線」 GUI 。相關終止支援公告將於明年發布。
    
-   The new OpenVPN instances pages and API create an independent set of instances more closely following the upstream documentation of OpenVPN. Legacy client/server settings cannot be managed from the API and are not migrated, but will continue to work independently.  
    新的 OpenVPN 實例頁面和API創建了一組獨立的實例，這些實例更嚴格地遵循 OpenVPN 的上游文件。舊版客戶端/伺服器設定無法透過API進行管理，也不會被遷移，但將繼續獨立運作。
    
-   The old DynDNS plugin was removed in favor of the newer MVC/API plugin for ddclient. We are aware of the EoL state of ddclient which was unfortunately announced only one year after we started working on the new plugin. We will try to add upstream fixes that have not been released yet and already offer our own ddclient-less Python backend in the same plugin as an alternative.  
    舊的 DynDNS 插件已被移除，取而代之的是適用於 ddclient 的更新的MVC/API插件。我們已知悉 ddclient 已停止維護，遺憾的是，在我們開始開發新插件僅一年後，ddclient 的停止維護公告便發布了。我們將嘗試添加尚未發布的上游修復程序，並在同一插件中提供我們自己的、不依賴 ddclient 的 Python 後端作為替代方案。

#### 23.1 “Quintessential Quail”（典型的鵪鶉） Series｜23.1 “Quintessential Quail”（典型的鵪鶉）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_23.1.html>

For more than 8 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

8 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

23.1, nicknamed “Quintessential Quail”（典型的鵪鶉）, features Unbound DNS statistics with a blocklist rewrite in Python, improved WAN SLAAC operability, firewall alias BGP ASN type support, PHP 8.1, assorted FreeBSD networking updates, MVC/API pages for packet capture/virtual IPs/IPsec connection management, IPsec configuration file migration to swanctl.conf, new sslh plugin, ddclient custom backend support (including Azure), WireGuard kernel module plugin variant as the new default plus much more.

23.1，綽號 “Quintessential Quail”（典型的鵪鶉）具有 Unbound 特性 DNS 使用 Python 中的區塊列表重寫進行統計分析，並進行了改進。 WAN SLAAC 可操作性，防火牆別名 BGP ASN 類型支持， PHP 8.1各種 FreeBSD 網路更新， MVC/API 頁面用於封包擷取/虛擬 IP/IPsec 連接管理、IPsec 設定檔遷移到 swanctl.conf、新的 sslh 外掛程式、ddclient 自訂後端支援（包括 Azure）、WireGuard 核心模組外掛程式變體作為新的預設值等等。

##### 23.1.11 (June 28, 2023)｜23.1.11（2023 年 6 月 28 日）

So this is the end of life release for the 23.1 series which includes the recent FreeBSD advisories as well as plugin support for Zabbix 6.4.

因此，這是 23.1 系列的生命週期結束版本，其中包括最近的 FreeBSD 建議以及對 Zabbix 6.4 的插件支援。

We have finished the OpenVPN MVC “instances” for anyone who is interested in a preview using the current development release. FreeBSD 13.2 side looks ready so we will be releasing 23.7-RC1 some time in the second half of July. The final 23.7 release is scheduled for July 31. The upgrade path from 23.1 will be enabled shortly after the new major release, but can take up to 24 hours due to testing and mirror propagation. Please do not despair. ;)

我们已经为任何有兴趣使用当前开发版本进行预览的人完成了 OpenVPN MVC“实例”。 FreeBSD 13.2 方面看起来已准备就绪，因此我们将在 7 月下半月的某个时间发布 23.7-RC1。最终的 23.7 版本计划于 7 月 31 日发布。 23.1 的升級路徑將在新的主要版本發布後不久啟用，但由於測試和鏡像傳播，可能需要長達 24 小時的時間。請不要絕望。 ;)

##### 23.1.10 (June 22, 2023)｜23.1.10（2023 年 6 月 22 日）

As summer is approaching we release this minor update in preparation for the upcoming 23.7 series. We are planning the upgrade to FreeBSD 13.2 as well as offering an MVC variant of the OpenVPN integration amongst many other improvements some of which already shipped in previous 23.1.x releases.

隨著夏天的臨近，我們發布了這個小更新，為即將推出的23.7系列做準備。我們計劃升級到 FreeBSD 13.2 並提供 OpenVPN 整合的 MVC 變體以及許多其他改進，其中一些改進已在先前的 23.1.x 版本中提供。

There may be another kernel update before the final 23.7 arrives but that is for next week to decide. For now enjoy the sun and stay hydrated!

在最終的 23.7 到來之前可能會有另一個核心更新，但這要等到下週才能決定。現在享受陽光並保持水分！

##### 23.1.9 (May 31, 2023)｜23.1.9（2023 年 5 月 31 日）

A small update to improve stability with multiple delegated prefixes from DHCPv6 connectivity as well as proper “no binding” handling in the DHCPv6 client itself. Internally, the backend service has been refactored to allow for future additions, but no visible functionality changes have been done.

一個小更新，旨在透過 DHCPv6 連接的多個委派前綴以及 DHCPv6 用戶端本身中的正確「無綁定」處理來提高穩定性。在內部，後端服務已被重構以允許將來添加，但沒有進行任何可見的功能變更。

Still pretty happy with the IPsec connections MVC pages introduced in 23.1 so we would like to apply the same approach to OpenVPN for 23.7 and it is going to land in the next development version most likely for a sneak preview.

對 23.1 中引入的 IPsec 連接 MVC 頁面仍然非常滿意，因此我們希望對 23.7 的 OpenVPN 應用相同的方法，並且它將在下一個開發版本中登陸，最有可能進行預覽。

Here are the full patch notes:

    系統：修復MVC服務頁面，使用基於ID的重新加載，如OpenVPN

    系統：修復遠端網關靜態路由的路由新增指令問題（由 Daniel Mason 貢獻）
    
-   system: improve static routes error handling  
    系統：改進靜態路由錯誤處理

    系統：修復拼字錯誤並調整網關編輯頁面中的「屬性」使用
    
-   system: pluginctl: service mode can now batch-reload services when existing ID is omitted  
    system:pluginctl:當現有的ID被省略時，服務模式現在可以批次重新載入服務
    
-   firewall: simplify rule edit layout slightly and fix unused element ID  
    防火牆：稍微簡化規則編輯佈局並修復未使用的元素ID

##### 23.1.8 (May 25, 2023)｜23.1.8（2023 年 5 月 25 日）

This update improves IPv6 connectivity, extends module support for the axgbe network driver and fixes a panic with IPv6 refragmentation over policy-based routes amongst others.

此更新改進了 IPv6 連接性，擴展了對 axgbe 網路驅動程式的模組支持，並修復了基於策略的路由上的 IPv6 重新碎片問題。

We are currently testing FreeBSD 13.2 for the upcoming OPNsense 23.7 and it looks promising. Watch out for roadmap updates over the next few weeks as more MVC page conversions are being carried out.

我們目前正在為即將推出的 OPNsense 23.7 測試 FreeBSD 13.2，它看起來很有前途。隨著更多MVC頁面轉換的進行，請留意未來幾週的路線圖更新。

##### 23.1.7 (May 04, 2023)｜23.1.7（2023 年 5 月 4 日）

Today we switch to OpenVPN 2.6 including deferred authentication which we know some people have been waiting for. The routing subsystem received a refactor to integrate default gateway switching into the actual routing code.

今天我們切換到 O​​penVPN 2.6其中包括一些用戶期待已久的延遲認證功能。路由子系統也進行了重構，將預設網關切換整合到實際的路由代碼中。

Suricata was finally updated to a newer release since the Netmap (IPS) stall bug inside their code had been found and fixed while we were still using an older code base that did not have the error.

由於 Suricata 程式碼中的 Netmap ( IPS ) 停滯錯誤已被發現並修復，而我們當時仍在使用沒有該錯誤的舊程式碼庫，因此 Suricata 終於更新到了新版本。

Please also note that OpenVPN does no longer support the XOR feature due to FreeBSD ports blocking these types of out-of-project contributions and OpenVPN itself was never interested in supporting it natively. We have been keeping this alive since 2015, but several alternatives exist now that were not available back then.

另請注意，由於 FreeBSD 連接埠限制了此類外部貢獻，OpenVPN 已不再支援XOR功能，而且 OpenVPN 本身也從未打算原生支援該功能。我們自 2015 年以來一直在維護此功能，但現在已經出現了一些當時尚不存在的替代方案。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: restructure routing to carry out default gateway switching and address family specific reconfig  
    系統：重構路由以執行預設閘道切換和位址族特定重配置
    
-   system: prevent PHP session garbage collection from running early (contributed by lin-xianming)  
    系統：防止PHP會話垃圾回收提前運作（由 lin-xianming 貢獻）
    
-   system: finish simplifying plugins\_run()  
    系統：完成插件簡化\_run()

    防火牆：在別名使用的依賴項檢查中新增缺少的清理規則

-   interfaces: ensure single PPP netgraph node has the proper name  
    介面：確保單一PPP網路圖節點具有正確的名稱

    介面：拒絕VLAN父介面中的無效自賦值

    介面：從 PPPoEv6 協商中排除部分情況

    報告：修復 NetFlow 初始化中錯誤的介面索引（由 Nicolas Thumann 提供）

    dhcp：配置更改後重啟 radvd，否則保留SIGHUP

##### 23.1.6 (April 20, 2023)｜23.1.6 （2023年4月20日）

Two major improvements being shipped today are standalone core DNS support for Bind and Dnscrypt-Proxy plugins as well as OpenVPN group firewall alias type. The latter makes it easier to manage distinct policies for connected VPN users. For more details please refer to the documentation listed below.

今天發布的兩項主要改進是：獨立核心DNS對 Bind 和 Dnscrypt-Proxy 插件的支持，以及 OpenVPN 組防火牆別名類型。後者讓管理已連線VPN用戶的不同策略更加便利。更多詳情請參閱下方列出的文件。

The other honorable mention is the netmap work we have been doing with Zenarmor and Klara on the FreeBSD kernel side which brings bridge device support as well as a considerable improvement to the emulated mode where several packet stalls and mbuf leaks have been identified and subsequently fixed. This should have an operational impact on Suricata (IPS mode) and Zenarmor. The state is much better now but please do not hesitate to contact us about issues that you might still be having with netmap-based packet flows as the topic is a rather complex one.

另一個值得一提的成果是我們在 FreeBSD 核心端與 Zenarmor 和 Klara 合作的 netmap 工作，這項工作不僅帶來了橋接設備支持，還顯著改進了模擬模式，修復了多個資料包停滯和 mbuf 洩漏問題。這應該會對 Suricata（ IPS模式）和 Zenarmor 的運作產生影響。目前情況已大為改善，但如果您在使用基於 netmap 的封包流時仍然遇到問題，請隨時與我們聯繫，因為該主題相當複雜。

Orange FR users be aware that your ISP now requires strict VLAN PCP on all DHCPv4 requests so please now set ‘Use VLAN priority’ interface setting for both DHCPv4 and DHCPv6. The ‘Option Modifiers’ override for “vlan-pcp” in DHCPv4 can be removed.

Orange FR用戶請注意，您的ISP現在要求所有 DHCPv4 請求都必須嚴格執行VLAN PCP ，因此請為 DHCPv4 和 DHCPv6 都設定「使用VLAN優先權」介面設定。 DHCPv4 中「vlan-pcp」的「選項修飾符」覆蓋可以移除。

##### 23.1.5 (March 29, 2023)｜23.1.5 （2023年3月29日）

This moves MVC/API migration a bit further and fixes the radvd restart behaviour using SIGHUP which caused issues with the initial 23.1.4. Unbound gained wildcard domain blocking and its backend was further refactored and improved upon.

這使得MVC/API遷移工作向前推進了一步，並修復了使用SIGHUP時導致的radvd重啟行為問題（該問題最初由23.1.4引起）。 Unbound新增了通配符網域屏蔽功能，後端也得到了進一步的重構與改進。

##### 23.1.4 (March 21, 2023)｜23.1.4 （2023年3月21日）

Another stable update to fix a StrongSwan regression and two OpenVPN incompatibilities introduced prior. We have also improved the service handling code in multiple areas, fixed issues like the VIP migration problem with IP alias on a CARP VIP and improved/simplified the firmware settings now that cryptography flavours no longer exist.

本次穩定更新修復了 StrongSwan 的一個回歸問題以及先前引入的兩個 OpenVPN 不相容問題。此外，我們還改進了多個方面的服務處理代碼，修復了諸如CARP VIP上VIP別名與IP別名之間的遷移問題，並改進/簡化了固件設置，因為現在不再存在加密變體。

這次更新並非事先計劃好的，但 FreeBSD ports 中的 Sqlite 編譯更改需要重新編譯，因此我們沒有發布熱修復程序，而是發布了這個小的穩定更新。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 23.1.2 (March 07, 2023)｜23.1.2 （2023年3月7日）

This is mainly a reliability update with fixes in assorted subsystems. Of note is the OpenVPN authentication framework rewrite in order to take advantage of the upcoming OpenVPN 2.6 deferred authentication feature and the fix for DHCP renew behaviour that was reported on 23.1.

本次更新主要針對可靠性問題，並修復了多個子系統中的問題。值得注意的是，為了利用即將推出的 OpenVPN 2.6延遲認證功能，對 OpenVPN 認證框架進行了重寫；此外，還修復了23.1中報告的DHCP續訂行為問題。

The roadmap for 23.7 was published, but at this point mainly consists of MVC/API porting efforts for existing static pages. While the rewrite is not strictly necessary from a user perspective it will move us a lot closer to our mission goal to introduce privilege separation and to provide an API for all components.

23.7的路線圖已經發布，但目前主要包括對現有靜態頁面進行MVC/API移植工作。雖然從使用者角度來看，重寫並非絕對必要，但它將使我們更接近實現引入權限分離並為所有元件提供API目標。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: use singleton boot detection everywhere  
    系統：所有地方都使用單例啟動偵測
    
-   system: protect against more stray scripts on boot  
    系統：防止啟動時出現更多無關腳本
    
-   system: several shell\_safe() conversions  
    系統：多個 shell\_safe() 轉換
    
-   system: when applying auto-far default route make sure the local address is not empty  
    系統提示：套用自動遠距離預設路由時，請確保本機位址不為空。
    
-   system: refactor system\_default\_route() to prevent empty $gateway  
    系統：重構 system\_default\_route() 以防止 $gateway 為空

    系統：建立 system\_resolver\_configure() 和 cron 作業支持

    系統：新增簡單腳本和 configd 操作以列出目前群組成員（configctl auth list groups）

##### 23.1.1 (February 15, 2023)｜23.1.1 （2023年2月15日）

Apart from security updates for operating system and third party software this mainly fixes issues with the initial 23.1 release. IPsec and Unbound components in particular receive a number of improvements being the more prominent areas of work for this series. Unbound also gained a SafeSearch option and the new reporting database CPU usage should be much lower and easier to use.

除了作業系統和第三方軟體的安全性更新外，本次更新主要修復了初始版本23.1中的問題。 IPsec和Unbound組件尤其得到了多項改進，是本次更新系列的主要工作領域。 Unbound也新增了安全搜尋選項，新的報告資料庫CPU的使用量應該會大幅降低，並且更容易使用。

Overall we are happy with how the major release turned out and look forward to further fixes in e.g. Netmap framework including Suricata changes for multi-threading support which has been in the works for a long time. OpenVPN 2.6 update and related changes are also pending at the moment.

總體而言，我們對此次主要版本的發布結果感到滿意，並期待後續的修復工作，例如 Netmap 框架的修復，包括 Suricata 的多線程支援變更（這項工作已籌備許久）。 OpenVPN 2.6更新及相關變更目前也正在等待中。

The roadmap for 23.7 will be published soon and will again include a number of MVC/API conversions for static components. Statistics do indicate that we are over 60% done with converting the code base to a modern framework as compared to early 2015 which is now already over 8 years ago!

23.7的路線圖即將發布，其中將再次包含一些靜態組件的MVC/API轉換。統計數據顯示，與 2015 年初相比（距今已超過 8 年），我們已完成超過 60% 的程式碼庫向現代框架的轉換！

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: replace single exec\_command() with new shell\_safe() wrapper  
    系統：將單一 exec\_command() 替換為新的 shell\_safe() 包裝器
    
-   system: fix assorted PHP 8.1 deprecation notes  
    系統：修復各種PHP 8.1棄用說明
    
-   system: remove overreaching “Reconfigure a plugin facility” cron job and backend command that has no visible users  
    系統：移除權限過大的「重新設定插件功能」定時任務和後端指令，此指令沒有可見使用者。
    
-   interfaces: fix VLAN rename after protocol addition in 23.1  
    介面：修正VLAN在23.1新增協定後重新命名的問題

    介面：修復VLAN刪除時缺少配置鎖定

A hotfix release was issued as 23.1.1\_2:

已發布熱修復版本23.1.1 \_2:

-   captive portal: remove mod\_evasion use which was discontinued by lighttpd  
    強制傳送門：移除 mod\_evasion 的使用，該功能已被 lighttpd 停止使用。
    
-   unbound: wait for pipe in logger (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    unbound：等待日誌記錄器中的管道（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    

Rate limiting was removed from the captive portal which was set to 250 connections by the same IP to the captive portal itself. This can be easily replaced by a manual firewall rule with advanced options set, e.g. “Max established” set to 250 with destination “This Firewall”（此防火牆）.

已移除強制門戶的速率限制，此限制先前由相同規則IP設定為 250 個連線。這可以透過手動設定防火牆規則輕鬆替代，例如將「最大建立連線數」設定為 250，目標位址為“This Firewall”（此防火牆） 。

##### 23.1 (January 26, 2023)｜23.1 （2023年1月26日）

For more than 8 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

8 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

23.1, nicknamed “Quintessential Quail”（典型的鵪鶉）, features Unbound DNS statistics with a blocklist rewrite in Python, improved WAN SLAAC operability, firewall alias BGP ASN type support, PHP 8.1, assorted FreeBSD networking updates, MVC/API pages for packet capture/virtual IPs/IPsec connection management, IPsec configuration file migration to swanctl.conf, new sslh plugin, ddclient custom backend support (including Azure), WireGuard kernel module plugin variant as the new default plus much more.

23.1 ，暱稱“Quintessential Quail”（典型的鵪鶉） ，具有 Unbound DNS統計信息，使用 Python 重寫了阻止列表，改進了WAN SLAAC可操作性，防火牆別名BGP ASN可操作性，防火牆別名PHP 8.1 Free ⦧P 612，FSD MVC/API封包擷取/虛擬 IP/IPsec 連接管理頁面，IPsec 設定檔遷移到 swanctl.conf，新的 sslh 外掛程式，ddclient 自訂後端支援（包括 Azure），WireGuard 核心模組外掛程式作為新的預設值等等。

Here are the full patch notes against 22.7.11:

以下是22.7.11完整更新說明：

-   system: replaced log\_error() use with log\_msg() and adjusted logging levels accordingly  
    系統：已將 log\_error() 的使用替換為 log\_msg()，並相應地調整了日誌等級。
    
-   system: introduced a service boot log  
    系統：引入了服務啟動日誌
    
-   system: the LibreSSL flavour has been discontinued  
    系統：LibreSSL 版本已停止開發。
    
-   system: simplify gateway monitoring setup code  
    系統：簡化網關監控設定代碼
    
-   system: add option to skip gateway monitor host route  
    系統：新增跳過網關監控主機路由的選項
    
-   system: populate /etc/hosts file with IPv6 addresses too  
    系統：也請用 IPv6 位址填入 /etc/hosts 文件
    
-   system: simplify and guard host route creation  
    系統：簡化和保護主機路由創建
    
-   system: merge system\_staticroutes\_configure() into system\_routing\_configure()  
    系統：將 system\_staticroutes\_configure() 合併到 system\_routing\_configure() 中
    
-   system: do not yield process after calling shutdown command  
    系統：呼叫關閉指令後不要放棄進程
    
-   system: apply tunables during late boot in case a module was loaded depending on them to be set to a specific value  
    系統：在啟動後期應用可調參數，以防某個模組載入時依賴這些參數被設定為特定值。
    
-   system: show size of ZFS ARC (adaptive replacement cache) in system widget  
    系統：在系統控制中顯示ZFS ARC （自適應替換快取）的大小
    
-   system: introduce support tier annotations for core and plugins [\[2\]](#p-379)  
    系統：為核心和插件引入支持層註解 [\[2\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/support.html )
    
-   system: add cron tasks for scrubbing and trimming ZFS pools (contributed by Iain Henderson)  
    系統：新增用於清理和修剪ZFS池的 cron 任務（由 Iain Henderson 提供）
    
-   system: fix 6rd/6to4 gateway interface detection (contributed by Frans J Elliott)  
    系統：修復 6rd/6to4 網關介面偵測問題（由 Frans J Elliott 提供）
    
-   reporting: add Unbound DNS statistics frontend including client drill-down  
    報告：新增 Unbound DNS統計前端，包含客戶端向下鑽取
    
-   interfaces: heavy cleanup of the wireless device integration  
    介面：對無線設備整合進行大量清理
    
-   interfaces: use 802.1ad protocol for stacked VLAN parent (QinQ)  
    介面：對堆疊的VLAN父設備 (QinQ) 使用 802.1ad 協議
    
-   interfaces: GIF and GRE now support subnet-based IPv6 configurations instead of always falling back to a point-to-point (/128) setup  
    介面： GIF和GRE現在支援基於子網路的 IPv6 配置，而不是始終回退到點對點 (/128) 配置。
    
-   interfaces: GIF and GRE now disable IPv6 on IPv4 tunnels (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面： GIF和GRE現在禁用 IPv4 隧道上的 IPv6（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   interfaces: add isolated PPPoEv6 mode to selectively enable IPv6 CP negotiation and turn it off when no IPv6 mode is set  
    介面：新增隔離的 PPPoEv6 模式，以便選擇性地啟用 IPv6 CP協商，並在未設定 IPv6 模式時將其關閉。
    
-   interfaces: add support for SLAAC WAN interfaces without DHCPv6 (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面：新增對不含 DHCPv6 的SLAAC WAN介面的支援（由 Maurice Walker 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: register LAGG, PPP, VLAN and wireless devices as plugins  
    接口：將LAGG, PPP, VLAN和無線設備註冊為插件
    
-   interfaces: simplified get\_real\_interface() function  
    介面：簡化的 get_real_interface() 函數
    
-   interfaces: removed obsolete “defaultgw” files  
    介面：已移除過時的“defaultgw”文件
    
-   interfaces: simplified rc.linkup script  
    介面：簡化的 rc.linkup 腳本
    
-   interfaces: improve IP address cache behaviour in rc.newwanip(v6) scripts  
    介面：改進 rc.newwanip(v6) 腳本中IP位址快取行為
    
-   interfaces: converted virtual IPs to MVC/API  
    介面：將虛擬 IP 轉換為MVC/API
    
-   interfaces: add MAC filtering to packet capture  
    介面：在資料包擷取中加入MAC過濾
    
-   interfaces: convert ARP/NDP pages to server-side searchable variant  
    介面：將ARP/NDP頁面轉換為伺服器端可搜尋版本
    
-   interfaces: create null route for DHCPv6 delegated prefix  
    介面：為 DHCPv6 委派前綴建立空路由
    
-   interfaces: tighten the concept of hardware interfaces and pull supported plugin devices into assignments page automatically  
    介面：完善硬體介面的概念，並將支援的插件設備自動加入到分配頁面。
    
-   firewall: remove deprecated “Dynamic state reset” mechanic  
    防火牆：移除已棄用的「動態狀態重置」機制
    
-   firewall: invalidate port forward rule entry when no target is specified  
    防火牆：未指定目標時，使連接埠轉送規則條目失效。
    
-   firewall: hide deprecated source OS rule setting under advanced  
    防火牆：在進階設定中隱藏已棄用的來源OS規則設定
    
-   firewall: add group option to prevent grouping in interfaces menu  
    防火牆：在介面選單中新增群組選項以防止分組
    
-   firewall: safeguard against missing name from the alias API call  
    防火牆：防止別名API呼叫中缺少名稱
    
-   intrusion detection: keep grid to prevent widgets being removed  
    入侵偵測：保持網格佈局以防止元件被移除
    
-   intrusion detection: reload grid after log drop (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    入侵偵測：日誌遺失後重新載入網格（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   intrusion detection: add verbose logging mode selector  
    入侵偵測：新增詳細日誌記錄模式選擇器
    
-   ipsec: disable charon.install\_routes completely in case upstream would implement it for FreeBSD later on  
    ipsec：完全停用 charon.install\_routes，以防上游將來在 FreeBSD 上實現它。
    
-   ipsec: move user PSK (pre-shared key) and static PSK items to new MVC/API implementation  
    IPsec：將使用者PSK （預先共用金鑰）與靜態PSK項遷移到新的MVC/API實現
    
-   ipsec: migrate existing configuration from ipsec.conf to swanctl.conf  
    IPsec：將現有設定從 ipsec.conf 遷移到 swanctl.conf
    
-   ipsec: add a new independent connections MVC/API component to manage IPsec in a layout matching swanctl.conf syntax more closely  
    ipsec：新增一個新的獨立連接元件MVC/API ，以更緊密地匹配 swanctl.conf 語法來管理 IPsec。
    
-   ipsec: rewrote lease status page in MVC/API  
    ipsec：重寫了MVC/API中的租約狀態頁面
    
-   ipsec: add configurable “unique” setting to phase 1  
    IPsec：在第一階段新增可設定的「唯一」設置
    
-   ipsec: missing correct phase 1 to collect “Network List”（網路列表） option  
    ipsec：缺少正確的階段 1 以收集“Network List”（網路列表）選項
    
-   monit: support start timeout setting (contributed by spoutin)  
    monit：支援啟動超時設定（由 spoutin 貢獻）
    
-   openvpn: add unique daemon name to each instance  
    openvpn：為每個執行個體新增唯一的守護程式名稱
    
-   unbound: add statistics database backend  
    unbound：新增統計資料庫後端
    
-   unbound: add exact domain blocking  
    unbound：新增精確的網域屏蔽
    
-   mvc: call plugins\_interfaces() optionally on service reconfigure  
    mvc：服務重新配置時可選擇呼叫 plugins\_interfaces()

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   LibreSSL flavour has been discontinued. Switch to OpenSSL flavour to proceed with the upgrade.  
    LibreSSL 版本已停止維護。請切換到 O​​penSSL 版本以繼續升級。
    
-   StrongSwan IPsec configuration now uses the preferred swanctl.conf instead of the deprecated ipsec.conf which could lead to connectivity issues in ambiguous cases. Subtle bugs cannot be ruled out as well so please raise an issue on GitHub to be able to investigate each case.  
    StrongSwan IPsec 設定現在使用首選的 swanctl.conf 文件，而不是已棄用的 ipsec.conf 文件，這可能會導致某些情況下出現連線問題。此外，也不能排除存在一些不易察覺的錯誤，因此請在 GitHub 上提交 issue，以便我們調查每個案例。
    
-   The new IPsec connections pages and API create an independent set of connections following the design of swanctl.conf. Legacy tunnel settings cannot be managed from the API and are not migrated.  
    新的 IPsec 連線頁面和API依照 swanctl.conf 的設計建立了一組獨立的連線。傳統的隧道設定無法透過API進行管理，也不會被遷移。

##### 23.1.r1 (January 13, 2023)｜23.1 .r1（2023年1月13日）

For more than 8 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

8 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you. <3

我們感謝大家幫助測試、塑造該專案並為該專案做出貢獻！我們知道如果沒有你，一切都會不一樣。 <3

Here are the full patch notes against 22.7.10:

以下是22.7.10完整更新說明：

-   system: replaced log\_error() use with log\_msg() and adjusted logging levels accordingly  
    系統：已將 log\_error() 的使用替換為 log\_msg()，並相應地調整了日誌等級。
    
-   system: introduced a service boot log  
    系統：引入了服務啟動日誌
    
-   system: the LibreSSL flavour has been discontinued  
    系統：LibreSSL 版本已停止開發。
    
-   system: simplify gateway monitoring setup code  
    系統：簡化網關監控設定代碼
    
-   system: add option to skip gateway monitor host route  
    系統：新增跳過網關監控主機路由的選項
    
-   system: populate /etc/hosts file with IPv6 addresses too  
    系統：也請用 IPv6 位址填入 /etc/hosts 文件
    
-   system: simplify host route creation  
    系統：簡化主機路由創建
    
-   system: merge system\_staticroutes\_configure() into system\_routing\_configure()  
    系統：將 system\_staticroutes\_configure() 合併到 system\_routing\_configure() 中
    
-   system: do not yield process after calling shutdown command  
    系統：呼叫關閉指令後不要放棄進程
    
-   system: apply tunables during late boot in case a module was loaded depending on them to be set to a specific value  
    系統：在啟動後期應用可調參數，以防某個模組載入時依賴這些參數被設定為特定值。
    
-   system: show size of ZFS ARC (adaptive replacement cache) in system widget  
    系統：在系統控制中顯示ZFS ARC （自適應替換快取）的大小
    
-   interfaces: heavy cleanup of the wireless device integration  
    介面：對無線設備整合進行大量清理
    
-   interfaces: use 802.1ad protocol for stacked VLAN parent (QinQ)  
    介面：對堆疊的VLAN父設備 (QinQ) 使用 802.1ad 協定
    
-   interfaces: GIF and GRE now support subnet-based IPv6 configurations instead of always falling back to a point-to-point (/128) setup  
    介面： GIF和GRE現在支援基於子網路的 IPv6 配置，而不是始終回退到點對點 (/128) 配置。
    
-   interfaces: GIF and GRE now disable IPv6 on IPv4 tunnels (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面： GIF和GRE現在禁用 IPv4 隧道上的 IPv6（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   interfaces: add PPPoEv6 mode to prevent IPv6 CP negotiation over PPPoE in other IPv6 modes  
    介面：新增 PPPoEv6 模式，以防止在其他 IPv6 模式下透過 PPPoE 進行 IPv6 CP協商
    
-   interfaces: add support for SLAAC WAN interfaces without DHCPv6 (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面：新增對不含 DHCPv6 的SLAAC WAN介面的支援（由 Maurice Walker 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: register LAGG, PPP, VLAN and wireless devices as plugins  
    接口：將LAGG, PPP, VLAN和無線設備註冊為插件
    
-   interfaces: simplified get\_real\_interface() function  
    介面：簡化的 get_real_interface() 函數
    
-   interfaces: removed obsolete “defaultgw” files  
    介面：已移除過時的“defaultgw”文件
    
-   interfaces: simplified rc.linkup script  
    介面：簡化的 rc.linkup 腳本
    
-   interfaces: improve IP address cache behaviour in rc.newwanip(v6) scripts  
    介面：改進 rc.newwanip(v6) 腳本中的IP位址快取行為
    
-   interfaces: converted virtual IPs to MVC/API  
    介面：將虛擬 IP 轉換為MVC/API
    
-   interfaces: add MAC filtering to packet capture  
    介面：在資料包擷取中加入MAC過濾
    
-   interfaces: convert ARP/NDP pages to server-side searchable variant  
    介面：將ARP/NDP頁面轉換為伺服器端可搜尋版本
    
-   interfaces: create null route for DHCPv6 delegated prefix  
    介面：為 DHCPv6 委派前綴建立空路由
    
-   interfaces: tighten the concept of hardware interfaces and pull supported plugin devices into assignments page automatically  
    介面：完善硬體介面的概念，並將支援的插件設備自動加入到分配頁面。
    
-   firewall: remove deprecated “Dynamic state reset” mechanic  
    防火牆：移除已棄用的「動態狀態重置」機制
    
-   firewall: invalidate port forward rule entry when no target is specified  
    防火牆：未指定目標時，使連接埠轉送規則條目失效。
    
-   firewall: show automated “port 0” rule as actual port “0” on PHP 8  
    防火牆：將自動「連接埠 0」規則顯示為PHP 8 上的實際連接埠「0」。
    
-   firewall: hide deprecated source OS rule setting under advanced  
    防火牆：在進階設定中隱藏已棄用的來源OS規則設定
    
-   reporting: fix incompatible regex syntax in FreeBSD 13.1 for firewall state health statistics  
    報告：修復 FreeBSD 13.1中防火牆狀態健康統計資訊的不相容正規表示式語法
    
-   intrusion detection: keep grid to prevent widgets being removed  
    入侵偵測：保持網格佈局以防止元件被移除
    
-   intrusion detection: reload grid after log drop (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    入侵偵測：日誌遺失後重新載入網格（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   ipsec: disable charon.install\_routes completely in case upstream would implement it for FreeBSD later on  
    ipsec：完全停用 charon.install\_routes，以防上游將來在 FreeBSD 上實現它。
    
-   ipsec: move user PSK (pre-shared key) and static PSK items to new MVC/API implementation  
    IPsec：將使用者PSK （預先共用金鑰）與靜態PSK項遷移到新的MVC/API實現
    
-   ipsec: migrate existing configuration from ipsec.conf to swanctl.conf  
    IPsec：將現有設定從 ipsec.conf 遷移到 swanctl.conf
    
-   ipsec: add a new independent connections MVC/API component to manage IPsec in a layout matching swanctl.conf syntax more closely  
    ipsec：新增一個新的獨立連接元件MVC/API ，以更緊密地匹配 swanctl.conf 語法來管理 IPsec。
    
-   ipsec: rewrote lease status page in MVC/API  
    ipsec：重寫了MVC/API中的租約狀態頁面
    
-   ipsec: add configurable “unique” setting to phase 1  
    IPsec：在第一階段新增可設定的「唯一」設置
    
-   monit: support start timeout setting (contributed by spoutin)  
    monit：支援啟動超時設定（由 spoutin 貢獻）
    
-   openvpn: add unique daemon name to each instance  
    openvpn：為每個執行個體新增唯一的守護程式名稱
    
-   unbound: add DNS statistics collector and reporting frontend  
    unbound：新增DNS統計資訊收集器和報告前端
    
-   unbound: safeguard retrieval of blocklist shortcode  
    未綁定：保障黑名單短代碼的檢索
    
-   unbound: add exact domain blocking  
    unbound：新增精確的網域屏蔽
    
-   mvc: call plugins\_interfaces() optionally on service reconfigure  
    mvc：服務重新配置時可選擇呼叫 plugins\_interfaces()
    
-   mvc: match UUID for multiple values (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    mvc：匹配UUID多個值（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   mvc: convert setBase() to an upsert operation  
    mvc：將 setBase() 轉換為 upsert 操作
    
-   mvc: change default sorting to case-insensitive  
    MVC：將預設排序方式變更為不區分大小寫。
    
-   mvc: fix IntegerField minimum value (contributed by xbb)  
    mvc：修復 IntegerField 的最小值（由 xbb 提供）
    
-   mvc: add TextField tests (contributed by agh1467)  
    MVC：新增文字欄位測試（由 agh1467 貢獻）
    
-   ui: assorted improvements in bootgrid and form controls  
    使用者介面：BootGrid 和表單控制項的各種改進
    
-   ui: switch to pure JSON data in bootgrids  
    ui：在引導網格中切換到純JSON數據
    
-   plugins: os-acme-client 3.15 [\[2\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/23.1/security/acme-client/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-acme-client 3.15 [\[2\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/23.1/security/acme-client/pkg-descr )

    插件：os-bind 1.25 [\[3\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/23.1/dns/bind/pkg-descr )

    插件：os-ddclient 1.11 [\[4\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/23.1/dns/ddclient/pkg-descr )

    外掛程式：os-dyndns 生命週期結束說明已移至23.7

#### 22.7 “Powerful Panther”（強大的黑豹） Series｜22.7 “Powerful Panther”（強大的黑豹）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_22.7.html>

For more than 7 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

7 年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

22.7, nicknamed “Powerful Panther”（強大的黑豹）, features the upgrade to FreeBSD 13.1, PHP 8.0, Phalcon 5, stacked VLAN and Intel QuickAssist (QAT) support, DDoS protection using syncookies, MVC/API pages for IPsec status and Unbound overrides, new APCUPSD and CrowdSec plugins plus much more.

22.7，綽號 “Powerful Panther”（強大的黑豹），並升級到 FreeBSD 13.1, PHP 8.0，Phalcon 5，堆疊 VLAN 以及 Intel QuickAssist（QAT支援使用 syncookies 進行 DDoS 防護， MVC/API IPsec 狀態和 Unbound 涵蓋的頁面，新增 APCUPSD 以及 CrowdSec 插件等等。

LibreSSL flavour is scheduled for removal at the end of this series and will likely receive no further maintenance. Software failing to work properly starting with Tor will have its plugin removed from the flavour from now on to be able to keep updating the software to their latest versions in the OpenSSL flavour. The next major upgrade will automatically transition to the OpenSSL flavour, but we would encourage everyone to switch between 22.7.x for the least amount of possible impact.

LibreSSL 版本計劃在本系列更新結束後移除，並且可能不會再進行維護。從現在開始，所有無法正常運作的軟體（包括 Tor）的插件都將從 LibreSSL 版本中移除，以便能夠將軟體更新到 OpenSSL 版本的最新版本。下一次主要升級將自動過渡到 OpenSSL 版本，但我們建議所有使用者在22.7 .x 版本之間進行切換，以盡可能減少影響。

##### 22.7.11 (January 18, 2023)｜22.7.11 （2023年1月18日）

This will be the end of life release for the 22.7 series with only a small number of reliability updates. Upgrades to 23.1-RC1 are possible from the development version of this release. We do expect an online update for RC2 next week.

這將是22.7系列產品的最終版本，僅提供少量可靠性更新。使用者可以從此版本的開發版升級到23.1-RC1 。我們預計下週將發布RC2的線上更新。

The final 23.1 release will be on January 26. As always the upgrade path from the community version will be added as a hotfix shortly after the final release announcement is published. However, this time around LibreSSL will no longer update and must be switched to the OpenSSL flavour prior to the upgrade.

最終版23.1將於 1 月 26 日發售。與以往一樣，社群版的升級路徑將在最終版發佈公告發布後不久以熱修復補丁的形式添加。但是，此次 LibreSSL 將不再自動更新，必須在升級前切換至 OpenSSL 版本。

##### 22.7.8 (November 17, 2022)｜22.7.8 （2022年11月17日）

This is a small maintenance and security update. You will notice that LibreSSL no longer works with FreeRADIUS software due to hiding library internals that are used by the software. Your current install will continue to work, but we would recommend switching to OpenSSL to receive FreeRADIUS updates as they become available.

這是一個小型維護和安全更新。您會注意到，由於 LibreSSL 隱藏了 FreeRADIUS 軟體使用的部分庫內部程式碼，它不再與 FreeRADIUS 軟體相容。您目前的 LibreSSL 安裝將繼續運行，但我們建議您切換到 O​​penSSL，以便在 FreeRADIUS 更新可用時及時收到更新。

Also, the infamous log\_error() message is being phased out in the development version to end the questions of “Why is this log message an error?” and so with log\_msg() each log line receives a more appropriate log level between error, warning and notice.

此外，臭名昭著的 log\_error() 訊息正在開發版本中逐步淘汰，以結束「為什麼這條日誌訊息是錯誤？」的問題，因此，使用 log\_msg()，每個日誌行都會獲得更合適的日誌級別，介於錯誤、警告和通知之間。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 22.7.7 (November 03, 2022)｜22.7.7 （2022年11月3日）

We replaced the packet capture tool with a MVC/API rewrite and updated most plugins to use the new setup script facility when doing a start/restart/reload through the RC system.

我們將資料包擷取工具替換為MVC/API重寫版，並更新了大多數插件，以便在透過RC系統進行啟動/重啟/重新載入時使用新的設定腳本功能。

A number of FreeBSD kernel improvements have been included as well.

此外，也納入了一些 FreeBSD 內核的改進。

Although OpenSSL is being updated keep in mind that the current popular vulnerability only exists in version 3 and we still use 1.1.1.

儘管 OpenSSL 正在更新，但請記住，目前流行的漏洞僅存在於版本 3 中，我們仍然使用1.1.1 。

##### 22.7.6 (October 12, 2022)｜22.7.6 （2022年10月12日）

This update fixes CRL code handling with third party software and sandboxes the code to avoid dealing with boot-time issues ever again. However, due to the nature of the sandboxing no automatic fix can be made for the following case:

此更新修復了CRL程式碼處理與第三方軟體的相容性問題，並對程式碼進行沙盒隔離，以避免再次出現啟動時問題。但是，由於沙盒隔離的特性，以下情況無法自動修復：

Creating and using an empty CRL in OpenVPN broke in 22.7.5 due to an ancient bug not populating the empty CRL in binary format: the side effect “correcting” this at runtime was removed. 22.7.6 will now correctly populate the binary format of the empty CRL upon creation in the config.xml as originally intended.

在 OpenVPN 中建立和使用空的 CRL 會破壞 22.7.5，因為一個古老的錯誤沒有以二進位格式填充空的 CRL：刪除了運行時「修正」此問題的副作用。 22.7.6 現在將按照最初的預期在 config.xml 中建立時正確填入空 CRL 的二進位格式。

The options to manually fix existing empty CRLs are as follows:

手動修復現有空 CRL 的選項如下：

-   Remove the CRL from OpenVPN as it is unused anyway, or  
    從 OpenVPN 中移除CRL ，因為它本來就沒用到，或者
    
-   Add a dummy certificate to it to populate the CRL properly, or  
    新增一個虛擬憑證以正確填充CRL ，或者
    
-   Add and remove a random existing certificate to populate an empty CRL.  
    新增和刪除一個隨機的現有證書，以填滿一個空的CRL 。
    

These fixes can be carried out on older installation without a problem as well prior to upgrading to avoid OpenVPN from not working post-upgrade.

在升級之前，也可以在舊版本上執行這些修復程序，以避免升級後 OpenVPN 無法正常運作。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: fix inconsistent is\_crl\_internal() implementation  
    系統：修正 is\_crl\_internal() 實作不一致的問題
    
-   system: make sure we always generate a CRL when saved  
    系統：確保每次儲存時都產生CRL
    
-   system: sandbox code handling CRL manipulation in the CRL manager page  
    系統：沙盒程式碼處理CRL在CRL管理器頁面中的操作
    
-   system: wrap global product information handling into a singleton  
    系統：將全域產品資訊處理封裝到單例模式中
    
-   system: move get\_nameservers() to ifctl use  
    系統：將 get\_nameservers() 移至 ifctl use
    
-   reporting: traffic graph polling interval selection and UX tweaks  
    報告：流量圖輪詢間隔選擇和UX調整
    
-   interfaces: port 6RD/6to4 to ifctl use  
    介面：連接埠 6RD/6to4 到 ifctl 使用
    
-   interfaces: optionally use reverse DNS resolution for ARP table hostnames (contributed by soif)  
    介面：可選擇使用反向DNS解析ARP表主機名稱（由 soif 提供）
    
-   interfaces: allow user-configurable VLAN device names with certain restrictions [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues/6038)  
    介面：允許使用者設定VLAN設備名稱，但需滿足某些限制 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues/6038 )
    
-   interfaces: small cleanup on get\_real\_interface()

##### 22.7.5 (October 05, 2022)｜22.7.5 （2022年10月5日）

Today we are fixing a security issue involving the “installer” user and kernel-based TCP panics that some have been fighting with since FreeBSD 13. Some ports and plugins have also been updated now that the holiday season is coming to its inevitable end.

今天，我們修復了一個與「installer」用戶和基於核心的TCP panic相關的安全問題，這個問題自FreeBSD 13以來就一直困擾著一些用戶。隨著假期即將結束，一些連接埠和插件也進行了更新。

The security issue arises on fresh 22.7 installs only due to a boot-time optimization of user account handling since 22.1.8. Users are not reset on each boot anymore which improved boot times with many users but also made the “installer” user stick with the default password in this situation. Physical access to the console with this user was possible under these conditions even after installation and updates were completed. SSH access was also possible when both not restricting login to keys and allowing root login manually. The mandatory reboot after the update to 22.7.5 or higher remedies this problem.

此安全問題僅在全新安裝的22.7系統中出現，原因是自22.1.8起，系統啟動時對用戶帳戶的處理進行了最佳化。使用者帳戶不再在每次啟動時重置，這雖然提高了多用戶系統的啟動速度，但也導致「安裝程式」用戶在這種情況下仍然使用預設密碼。即使安裝更新完成後，仍可使用此使用者實際存取主機。當不限制使用金鑰登入並允許 root 使用者手動登入時，也存在SSH存取問題。更新到22.7.5或更高版本後強制重啟可以解決此問題。

In a default install the issue could only be exploited by manual console access. In general we want to advise users not to yield shell/console access to non-administrators, restrict physical access if applicable, and not offer SSH access based on user accounts, especially when SSH is accessible from the WAN side without a VPN.

在預設安裝中，該問題只能透過手動控制台存取來利用。一般來說，我們建議使用者不要向非管理員授予 shell/控制台訪問權限，如果適用，限制物理訪問，並且不要基於用戶帳戶提供SSH訪問權限，尤其是在無需SSH即可從WAN端訪問VPN的情況下。

In any case we recommend all users of 22.7.x to update immediately or take the necessary precautions to avoid the “installer” user from being accessed in an unauthorized fashion.

總之，我們建議所有22.7 .x 使用者立即更新，或採取必要的預防措施，以避免「安裝程式」使用者被未經授權存取。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 22.7.4 (September 07, 2022)｜22.7.4 （2022年9月7日）

This update addresses more issues with the somewhat unfortunate phpseclib 3 migration. WAN IPv6 SLAAC mode now works more reliably and TLS 1.3 web GUI configurations will enforce the expectations by software clients regarding interoperability.

此更新解決了一些不幸的 phpseclib 3 遷移的更多問題。 WAN IPv6 SLAAC 模式現在工作更加可靠，TLS 1.3 Web GUI 配置將增強軟體用戶端對互通性的期望。

Last but not least the “assign VLAN parent and enable” migration note from 22.1 is no longer required as the boot will attempt to configure all existing hardware devices once with the selected defaults.

最後但同樣重要的是，不再需要從22.1遷移“分配VLAN父設備並啟用”的說明，因為啟動程序將嘗試使用選定的預設值配置所有現有的硬體設備一次。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: enforce RFC 8446 by requiring TLS\_AES\_128\_GCM\_SHA256 for TLS 1.3  
    系統：強制執行RFC 8446，要求TLS使用TLS 1.3 \_AES\_128\_GCM\_SHA256 加密
    
-   system: consider CRL end dates after 2050 as “lifetime” in GeneralizedTime format  
    系統：將 2050 年之後的CRL結束日期視為通用時間格式中的「生命週期」。
    
-   system: revert the default CRL hashing back to what it was in phpseclib 2  
    系統：將預設的CRL哈希演算法恢復到 phpseclib 2 中的設定。
    
-   system: match TLS cipher suites and commands in web GUI settings (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：符合 web GUI設定中的TLS密碼套件和指令（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: improve error message of CRL validation failure (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：改進CRL驗證失敗的錯誤訊息（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: fix phpseclib 3 use for CSR parsing on certificates page  
    系統：修復憑證頁面上CSR解析中 phpseclib 3 的使用問題
    
-   system: add the default “-c” option to backend pluginctl invokes for consistency  
    系統：為保持一致性，在後端插件ctl呼叫中加入預設的“-c”選項
    
-   system: rework console port assignment regarding wireless handling  
    系統：重新設計無線處理相關的控制台連接埠分配

    介面：配置現有設備的所有硬體功能

    介面：手動啟動 IPv6 設備，因為SLAAC不會自動執行此操作。

##### 22.7.3 (September 01, 2022)｜22.7.3 （2022年9月1日）

Pick up the new FreeBSD security advisories while also introducing assorted reliability improvements. CRL now works again for elliptic curve with the adoption of version 3 of phpseclib. Wireless handling was improved due to PHP 8 errors and coding style issues. It is also the subject of further work for 23.1.

取得新的 FreeBSD 安全建議，同時引入各種可靠性改進。透過採用 phpseclib 版本 3，CRL 現在再次適用於橢圓曲線。由於 PHP 8 個錯誤和編碼風格問題，無線處理得到了改進。這也是23.1進一步工作的主題。

Here are the full patch notes:

    系統：將CRL處理遷移到 phpseclib 3

    系統：擴展名稱伺服器腳本返回以用於偵錯目的，例如“configctl system list nameservers debug”

    系統：lighttpd 已棄用伺服器清單指令，預設為停用

    系統：在顯示之前解碼儲存的CRL資料（kulikov-a 貢獻）

    介面： PPP是一個例外，僅在介面配置後建立。

##### 22.7.2 (August 17, 2022)｜22.7.2 （2022年8月17日）

This update comes a little earlier than expected due to FreeBSD security advisories. Of special interest is the new firewall alias BGP ASN type and notices system which can also be implemented from plugins in the future.

由於 FreeBSD 發布了安全公告，此次更新比預期提前了一些。特別值得關注的是新增的防火牆別名BGP ASN類型和通知系統，未來也可透過插件實現。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

    系統：將靜態通知系統替換為基於MVC/API代碼的共享系統
    
-   system: use new \_setup script feature where setup.sh exists  
    系統：使用新的 \_setup 腳本功能，其中 setup.sh 已存在

    系統： PHP 8 當 ldap\_get\_entries() 回傳 false 時出現問題

    介面：修復22.7.1中的無線克隆分配回歸問題

    介面：將 ifctl 工具更新到最新版本

##### 22.7.1 (August 09, 2022)｜22.7.1 （2022年8月9日）

This update first and foremost addresses reported regressions with the initial version and the required security update for Unbound. Expect follow-up releases to be a bit more noisy as we are going to introduce the new notification system and further IPv6 improvements plus new roadmap items to be announced in the upcoming weeks.

本次更新首先解決了初始版本中報告的迴歸問題，並包含了 Unbound 所需的安全性更新。後續版本可能會出現更多變動，因為我們將推出新的通知系統，進一步改進 IPv6，並在未來幾週內公佈新的路線圖專案。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: fix regression in config backup due to timestamp key rename  
    系統：修復由於時間戳鍵重命名而導致的配置備份回歸問題
    
-   system: fix assorted warnings generated by PHP 8  
    系統：修復由PHP 8 產生的各種警告
    
-   system: do not reload Unbound/Dnsmasq hosts configuration by default  
    系統：預設不重新載入 Unbound/Dnsmasq 主機配置

    系統：使用正確的CRL id-ce-cRLReasons 擴充關鍵字“unspecified”

    系統：正確清理 Monit 儀表板小工具中的使用者輸入
    
-   system: remove dead code from login form  
    系統：從登入表單中移除無效代碼
    
-   interfaces: fix get\_interface\_mac() not returning a cached MAC address  
    介面：修正 get\_interface\_mac() 不回傳快取的MAC位址的問題

    介面：隱藏無線編輯頁面上不存在的MAC訊息

    interfaces：當沒有進行任何更改時，停止DHCP呼叫 rc.newwanip

##### 22.7 (July 28, 2022)｜22.7 （2022年7月28日）

For more than 7 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

7 年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

22.7, nicknamed “Powerful Panther”（強大的黑豹）, features the upgrade to FreeBSD 13.1, PHP 8.0, Phalcon 5, stacked VLAN and Intel QuickAssist (QAT) support, DDoS protection using syncookies, MVC/API pages for IPsec status and Unbound overrides, new APCUPSD and CrowdSec plugins plus much more.

22.7，昵称“Powerful Panther”（強大的黑豹），具有升级到 FreeBSD 13.1, PHP 8.0、Phalcon 5、堆叠VLAN 和 Intel QuickAssist (QAT) 支持、使用 syncookies 的 DDoS 保护、MVC/API IPsec 状态页面和 Unbound覆蓋、新功能APCUPSD 和 CrowdSec 插件以及更多。

LibreSSL flavour is scheduled for removal at the end of this series and will likely receive no further maintenance. Software failing to work properly starting with Tor will have its plugin removed from the flavour from now on to be able to keep updating the software to their latest versions in the OpenSSL flavour. The next major upgrade will automatically transition to the OpenSSL flavour, but we would encourage everyone to switch between 22.7.x for the least amount of possible impact.

LibreSSL 版本計劃在本系列更新結束後移除，並且可能不會再進行維護。從現在開始，所有無法正常運作的軟體（包括 Tor）的插件都將從 LibreSSL 版本中移除，以便能夠將軟體更新到 OpenSSL 版本的最新版本。下一次主要升級將自動過渡到 OpenSSL 版本，但我們建議所有使用者在22.7 .x 版本之間進行切換，以盡可能減少影響。
