Here are the full patch notes against 22.1.10:

以下是22.1.10完整補丁說明：

-   system: changed certificate revocation to use the phpseclib library  
    系統：已將憑證撤銷機制變更為使用 phpseclib 函式庫
    
-   system: performance improvement for set\_single\_sysctl()  
    系統：改進了 set\_single\_sysctl() 的效能
    
-   system: restart syslog fully and only once after all services have been started  
    系統：在所有服務啟動後，完全重啟 syslog 服務，且僅重啟一次。
    
-   system: new setting for deployment mode to control PHP error flow  
    系統：新增部署模式設置，用於控制PHP錯誤流
    
-   system: /tmp MFS now uses a maximum of 50% of RAM by default and can be adjusted  
    系統：/tmp MFS現在預設最多使用RAM的 50%，並且可以調整
    
-   system: /var MFS becomes /var/log MFS and uses a maximum of 50% of RAM by default and can be adjusted  
    系統：/var MFS變為 /var/log MFS ，預設情況下最多使用RAM的 50%，可以進行調整。
    
-   system: previous special /var MFS content is now permanently stored under /var to ensure full operability  
    系統：先前的特殊 /var MFS內容現在永久儲存在 /var 目錄下，以確保完全可操作性。
    
-   system: flush all core Python pyc files on updates  
    系統：更新時刷新所有核心 Python pyc 文件
    
-   system: protect syslog-ng against out of memory kills  
    系統：保護 syslog-ng 免受記憶體不足導致的終止
    
-   system: add filter to system log widget (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：為系統日誌小工具新增過濾器（由 kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: disable RRD and NetFlow shutdown backups by default  
    系統：預設為停用RRD和 NetFlow 關閉備份
    
-   system: render interfaces in convert\_config()  
    系統：在 convert\_config() 中渲染介面
    
-   system: apply default firewall policy before interface configuration  
    系統：在介面配置之前套用預設防火牆策略
    
-   system: move remote backup script to proper file system location  
    系統：將遠端備份腳本移至正確的檔案系統位置
    
-   system: disable flag was not removing static route  
    系統：禁用標誌未移除靜態路由
    
-   system: Net\_IPv6::compress() should not compress “::” to “”  
    系統：Net\_IPv6::compress() 不應將“::”壓縮為“”。
    
-   system: fix RADIUS config validation for port requirement (contributed by Josh Soref)  
    系統：修復RADIUS埠要求配置驗證（由 Josh Soref 貢獻）
    
-   system: remove last bits of circular logging (CLOG) support  
    系統：移除循環日誌記錄的最後部分（ CLOG ）支持
    
-   system: removed legacy Diffie-Hellman parameter handling  
    系統：移除了舊版 Diffie-Hellman 參數處理
    
-   interfaces: refactored LAGG, wireless and static ARP handling  
    介面：重構了LAGG 、無線與靜態ARP處理
    
-   interfaces: provide automatic startup of Loopback, IPsec, OpenVPN, VXLAN devices  
    介面：提供 Loopback、IPsec、OpenVPN、 VXLAN設備的自動啟動
    
-   interfaces: removed the side effect reliance on /var/run/booting file  
    介面：移除了對 /var/run/booting 檔案的副作用依賴
    
-   interfaces: add dynamic reload of required devices  
    介面：新增所需設備的動態重新載入功能
    
-   interfaces: add WPA enterprise configuration for infrastructure mode (contributed by Manuel Faux)  
    介面：新增WPA企業基礎架構模式配置（由 Manuel Faux 提供）
    
-   interfaces: fix “Allow service binding” for multiple aliases per interface (contributed by Adam Dawidowski)  
    介面：修正「允許服務綁定」中每個介面多個別名的問題（由 Adam Dawidowski 提供）
    
-   interfaces: auto-detect far gateway requirement for default route  
    介面：自動偵測預設路由的遠端網關要求
    
-   interfaces: switch to MVC/API variant for DNS lookup page  
    介面：切換到MVC/API變體以存取DNS查詢頁面
    
-   interfaces: refactor DHCP and PPPoE scripts to use ifctl exclusively  
    介面：重構DHCP和 PPPoE 腳本，使其僅使用 ifctl。
    
-   interfaces: prevent the removal of default routes in dhclient-script  
    介面：防止 dhclient-script 移除預設路由
    
-   interfaces: fix inconsistencies in wireless handling  
    介面：修復無線處理方面的不一致之處
    
-   interfaces: fix unable to bring up multiple loopback (contributed Johnny S. Lee)  
    介面：修正無法建立多個環回介面的問題（Johnny S. Lee 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: fix unable to bring up multiple VXLAN  
    介面：修復無法啟動多個VXLAN問題
    
-   interfaces: check if int before passing to convert\_seconds\_to\_hms()  
    介面：在傳遞給 convert\_seconds\_to\_hms() 之前，檢查其是否為 int 型別
    
-   interfaces: disable IPv6 inside 4in6 and 4in4 GIF tunnels (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面：停用 4in6 和 4in4 GIF隧道內的 IPv6（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   interfaces: ping diagnostics tool must explicitly set IP version (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面：ping 診斷工具必須明確設定IP版本（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   interfaces: remove other inconsistencies regarding ping utility changes in FreeBSD 13  
    介面：移除 FreeBSD 13 中關於 ping 工具變更的其他不一致之處
    
-   interfaces: correct regex validation for dhcp6c expire statement (contributed by Josh Soref)  
    介面：修正 dhcp6c expire 語句的正規表示式驗證（由 Josh Soref 提供）
    
-   interfaces: add missing scope to link-local GIF host route  
    介面：為連結本地GIF主機路由新增缺少的作用域
    
-   interfaces: add iwlwiwi(4) to wireless devices  
    介面：將 iwlwiwi(4) 新增至無線設備
    
-   firewall: improved port alias performance  
    防火牆：改進了連接埠別名效能
    
-   firewall: obsoleted notices inside the synchronization code  
    防火牆：同步程式碼中已過時的通知
    
-   firewall: support logging in NPT rules  
    防火牆：支援登入NPT規則
    
-   firewall: append missing link-local to inet6 :network selector  
    防火牆：將缺少的 link-local 加入 inet6 :network 選擇器
    
-   firewall: move inspect action into its own async API action to prevent long page loads  
    防火牆：將檢查操作移至單獨的非同步API操作中，以防止頁面載入時間過長。
    
-   firewall: internal aliases cannot be disabled  
    防火牆：無法停用內部別名
    
-   firewall: performance improvement for reading live log  
    防火牆：提升讀取即時日誌的效能
    
-   firewall: ignore age/expire when not provided or empty in sessions page  
    防火牆：如果會話頁面中未提供或為空，則忽略年齡/過期時間設定。
    
-   firewall: add general firewall log for alias and filter system log messages  
    防火牆：新增別名和過濾系統日誌訊息的通用防火牆日誌
    
-   dhcp: no longer automatically add a link-local address to bridges if IPv6 service is running on it  
    DHCP：如果網橋上執行 IPv6 服務，則不再自動為其新增連結本機位址。
    
-   dhcp: allow running relay service on bridges  
    DHCP：允許在網橋上運行中繼服務
    
-   dhcp: clean up IPv6 prefixes script  
    dhcp：清理 IPv6 前綴腳本
    
-   dhcp: include ddns-hostname and other cleanups (contributed by Sascha Buxhofer)  
    dhcp：包含 ddns-hostname 和其他清理工作（由 Sascha Buxhofer 提供）
    
-   dhcp: remove duplicated ddnsupdate static mapping switch  
    DHCP：刪除重複的 DDNS 更新靜態映射開關
    
-   dhcp: remove print\_content\_box() use  
    dhcp：移除 print\_content\_box() 使用
    
-   dhcp: switch to shell-based DHCPv6 lease watcher  
    dhcp：切換到基於 shell 的 DHCPv6 租約監視器
    
-   dhcp: rewrite prefix merge for dynamic IPv6 tracking to support bitwise selection  
    DHCP：重寫前綴合併以實現動態 IPv6 跟踪，以支援位元選擇
    
-   dnsmasq: switch to a Python-based DHCP lease watcher  
    dnsmasq：切換到基於 Python 的DHCP租約監視器
    
-   firmware: console script can now show changelog using “less” before update  
    韌體：控制台腳本現在可以在更新前使用「less」命令顯示變更日誌。
    
-   firmware: disable crash reporter in development deployment mode  
    韌體：在開發部署模式下停用崩潰報告器
    
-   firmware: limit changelog-based update check on dashboard to release version  
    韌體：將儀錶板上基於變更日誌的更新檢查限制為發布版本
    
-   firmware: provide an upgrade log audit  
    韌體：提供升級日誌審計
    
-   intrusion detection: remove dead link to McAfee rule references  
    入侵偵測：移除指向 McAfee 規則引用的失效鏈接
    
-   ipsec: add “IPv4+6” protocol for mobile phase 1 entries (contributed by vnxme)  
    ipsec：為移動階段 1 條目新增“IPv4+6”協定（由 vnxme 提供）
    
-   ipsec: mobile property boolean duplication in phase 2  
    IPsec：第二階段移動屬性布林值重複
    
-   ipsec: remember phase 1 setting for next action  
    IPsec：記住第一階段設定以進行下一步操作

    IPsec：切換到MVC/API的SPD, SAD變體和連接頁面
    
-   ipsec: small UX tweaks in status page  
    ipsec：狀態頁面中的一些小調整UX
    
-   openvpn: pinned Diffie-Hellman parameter to RFC 7919 4096 bit key  
    openvpn：已將 Diffie-Hellman 參數固定為RFC 7919 4096 位元金鑰
    
-   unbound: prevent crash of DHCP lease watcher due to unhandled CalledProcessError exception  
    unbound：防止因未處理的 CalledProcessError 異常導致DHCP租約監視器崩潰
    
-   lang: bring back Italian and update all languages to latest available translations  
    lang：恢復義大利語譯文，並將所有語言更新為最新可用譯文。
    
-   mvc: bugfix search and sort issues for searchRecordsetBase()  
    mvc：修正 searchRecordsetBase() 的搜尋和排序問題
    
-   mvc: add support for non-persistent (memory) models  
    MVC：增加對非持久（記憶體）模型的支持
    
-   mvc: throw when no mount found in model (contributed by agh1467)  
    mvc：當模型中未找到掛載點時拋出異常（由 agh1467 貢獻）
    
-   mvc: fix rowCount when all is selected in searchRecordsetBase()  
    mvc：修正 searchRecordsetBase() 選取全部時 rowCount 的問題
    
-   mvc: fix two regressions in BaseField for Phalcon 5  
    mvc：修正 Phalcon 5 的 BaseField 中的兩個迴歸錯誤
    
-   mvc: store configuration changes only when actual changes exist  
    MVC：僅當實際存在更改時才儲存配置更改
    
-   ui: removed Internet Explorer support  
    使用者介面：已移除對 Internet Explorer 的支持
    
-   ui: boostrap-select ignored header height  
    ui：bootstrap-select 忽略了頭部高度

    ui：在 SimpleActionButton 中加入捕捉 undefined TypeError 的機制（由 agh1467 貢獻）

    ui：修復程式碼庫中的各種拼字錯誤（由 Josh Soref 貢獻）
    
-   ui: handle HTTP 500 error gracefully in MVC pages  
    ui：在MVC頁中優雅地處理HTTP 500 錯誤
    
-   plugins: os-apcupsd 1.0 [\[2\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.7/sysutils/apcupsd/pkg-descr) (contributed by David Berry, Dan Lundqvist and Nicola Pellegrini)

A hotfix release was issued as 22.7\_4:

已發布熱修復版本22.7 \_4:

-   system: IXR\_Library using incorrect constructor format for PHP 8  
    系統： IXR \_函式庫使用了錯誤的建構子格式，用於PHP 8
    
-   interfaces: fix issues with PPP uptime display in PHP 8  
    介面：修正PHP 8 中PPP正常運作時間顯示的問題
    
-   firewall: do not emit link-local address on IPv6 network outbound NAT  
    防火牆：禁止在 IPv6 網路出站時發送鏈路本地位址NAT
    
-   mvc: remove stray error\_reporting(E\_ALL) calls  
    mvc：移除多餘的 error\_reporting(E\_ALL) 呼叫
    

Known issues and limitations:

已知問題和限制：

-   The DH parameter is no longer available in OpenVPN server configuration and now fixed to the RFC 7919 4096 bit key. The only downside may be lower performance on older machines.  
    OpenVPN 伺服器設定中已不再使用DH參數，現在已固定為RFC 7919 4096 位元金鑰。唯一的缺點可能是老舊機器的性能會降低。
    
-   The infamous /var MFS feature was reduced to the /var/log scope in order to avoid future issues with plugins requiring persistent storage under /var. In practice people who used /var MFS had no benefit over it with software that required persistent storage under /var to operate in the first place. Periodic configuration file writes to /var are negligible on SSD-based systems.  
    臭名昭著的 /var MFS功能已被限制在 /var/log 範圍內，以避免未來插件需要將資料持久儲存在 /var 目錄下時出現問題。實際上，對於那些本身就需要將資料持久儲存在 /var 目錄下的軟體而言，使用 /var MFS並沒有任何優勢。在基於SSD的系統中，定期寫入 /var 目錄的設定檔可以忽略不計。
    
-   The os-dyndns plugin is still available due to the fact that ddclient did not release a non-development release so far since we started os-ddclient. Availability thereof might change later in 22.7.x.  
    由於自從我們啟動 os-ddclient 以來，ddclient 尚未發布非開發版本，因此 os-dyndns 外掛程式仍然可用。其可用性可能會在22.7 .x 版本中發生變化。
    
-   The console firmware update will now display text-based changelogs for the update to be installed if available. Use the arrow keys to scroll the changelog and type “q” to resume the update process.  
    主機韌體更新程式現在會以文字顯示待安裝更新的變更日誌（如有）。使用方向鍵捲動查看變更日誌，然後輸入“q”繼續更新過程。
    
-   The manual DHCPv6 tracking mode now requires a proper prefix range given like its counterpart with a static address. If a previous prefix ID type input is detected only setting the lower 64 bits of an IPv6 address, a warning is emitted and the ID is treated as the upper 64 bits of an IPv6 address instead. If your DHCPv6 server does not start please properly fix the given range.  
    手動 DHCPv6 追蹤模式現在需要像靜態位址追蹤模式一樣，提供正確的位址前綴範圍。如果偵測到先前輸入的前綴ID類型僅設定了 IPv6 位址的低 64 位元，則會發出警告，並將ID視為 IPv6 位址的高 64 位元。如果您的 DHCPv6 伺服器無法啟動，請正確設定位址範圍。

##### 22.7.r2 (July 20, 2022)｜22.7 .r2（2022年7月20日）

Quick update on the release candidate series with assorted improvements.

關於發布候選版本系列的簡短更新，其中包含各種改進。

All relevant tickets have been closed and roadmap items completed. There are no visible blockers for 22.7 next week at the moment so we will still be targeting July 28 as the release date.

所有相關工單已關閉，路線圖工程也已完成。目前來看， 22.7下週的發布沒有明顯障礙，因此我們仍將7月28日定為發布日期。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: apply default firewall policy before interface configuration  
    系統：在介面配置之前套用預設防火牆策略
    
-   system: move remote backup script to proper file system location  
    系統：將遠端備份腳本移至正確的檔案系統位置
    
-   system: remove support for displaying legacy logs in the GUI  
    系統：移除對在GUI中顯示舊版日誌的支援
    
-   system: disable flag was not removing static route  
    系統：禁用標誌未移除靜態路由
    
-   system: Net\_IPv6::compress() should not compress “::” to “”  
    系統：Net\_IPv6::compress() 不應將“::”壓縮為“”。
    
-   system: fix RADIUS config validation for port requirement (contributed by Josh Soref)  
    系統：修復RADIUS埠要求配置驗證（由 Josh Soref 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: disable IPv6 inside 4in6 and 4in4 GIF tunnels (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面：停用 4in6 和 4in4 GIF隧道內的 IPv6（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   interfaces: ping diagnostics tool must explicitly set IP version (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面：ping 診斷工具必須明確設定IP版本（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   interfaces: remove other inconsistencies regarding ping utility changes in FreeBSD 13  
    介面：移除 FreeBSD 13 中關於 ping 工具變更的其他不一致之處
    
-   interfaces: correct regex validation for dhcp6c expire statement (contributed by Josh Soref)  
    介面：修正 dhcp6c expire 語句的正規表示式驗證（由 Josh Soref 提供）
    
-   interfaces: add missing scope to link-local GIF host route  
    介面：為連結本地GIF主機路由新增缺少的作用域
    
-   dhcp: remove print\_content\_box() use  
    dhcp：移除 print\_content\_box() 使用
    
-   dnsmasq: switch to a Python-based DHCP lease watcher  
    dnsmasq：切換到基於 Python 的DHCP租約監視器
    
-   firmware: limit changelog-based update check on dashboard to release version  
    韌體：將儀錶板上基於變更日誌的更新檢查限制為發布版本
    
-   firmware: provide an upgrade log audit  
    韌體：提供升級日誌審計
    
-   intrusion detection: remove dead link to McAfee rule references  
    入侵偵測：移除指向 McAfee 規則引用的失效鏈接
    
-   unbound: prevent crash of DHCP lease watcher due to unhandled CalledProcessError exception  
    unbound：防止因未處理的 CalledProcessError 異常導致DHCP租約監視器崩潰
    
-   mvc: fix two regressions in BaseField for Phalcon 5  
    mvc：修正 Phalcon 5 的 BaseField 中的兩個迴歸錯誤
    
-   mvc: store configuration changes only when actual changes exist  
    MVC：僅當實際存在更改時才儲存配置更改
    
-   ui: fix assorted typos in the code base (contributed by Josh Soref)  
    ui：修復程式碼庫中的各種拼字錯誤（由 Josh Soref 貢獻）
    
-   ui: handle HTTP 500 error gracefully in MVC pages  
    ui：在MVC頁中優雅地處理HTTP 500 錯誤
    

Stay safe, Your OPNsense team

請注意安全，OPNsense團隊敬上

##### 22.7.r1 (July 13, 2022)｜22.7 .r1（2022年7月13日）

For more than 7 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

7 年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you. <3

我們感謝大家幫助測試、塑造該專案並為該專案做出貢獻！我們知道如果沒有你，一切都會不一樣。 <3

Here are the full patch notes against 22.1.10:

以下是22.1.10完整更新說明：

-   system: removed legacy Diffie-Hellman parameter handling  
    系統：移除了舊版 Diffie-Hellman 參數處理
    
-   system: changed certificate revocation to use the phpseclib library  
    系統：已將憑證撤銷機制變更為使用 phpseclib 函式庫
    
-   system: performance improvement for set\_single\_sysctl()  
    系統：改進了 set\_single\_sysctl() 的效能
    
-   system: restart syslog fully and only once after all services have been started  
    系統：在所有服務啟動後，完全重啟 syslog 服務，且僅重啟一次。
    
-   system: new setting for deployment mode to control PHP error flow  
    系統：新增部署模式設置，用於控制PHP錯誤流
    
-   system: /tmp MFS now uses a maximum of 50% of RAM by default and can be adjusted  
    系統：/tmp MFS現在預設最多使用RAM的 50%，並且可以調整
    
-   system: /var MFS becomes /var/log MFS and uses a maximum of 50% of RAM by default and can be adjusted  
    系統：/var MFS變為 /var/log MFS ，預設情況下最多使用RAM的 50%，可以進行調整。
    
-   system: previous special /var MFS content is now permanently stored under /var to ensure full operability  
    系統：先前特殊的 /var MFS內容現在永久儲存在 /var 目錄下，以確保完全可操作性。
    
-   system: flush all core Python pyc files on updates  
    系統：更新時刷新所有核心 Python pyc 文件
    
-   system: protect syslog-ng against out of memory kills  
    系統：保護 syslog-ng 免受記憶體不足導致的終止
    
-   system: add filter to system log widget (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：為系統日誌小工具新增過濾器（由 kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: refactored LAGG, wireless and static ARP handling  
    介面：重構了LAGG 、無線與靜態ARP處理
    
-   interfaces: provide automatic startup of Loopback, IPsec, OpenVPN, VXLAN devices  
    介面：提供 Loopback、IPsec、OpenVPN、 VXLAN設備的自動啟動
    
-   interfaces: removed the side effect reliance on /var/run/booting file  
    介面：移除了對 /var/run/booting 檔案的副作用依賴
    
-   interfaces: add dynamic reload of required devices  
    介面：新增所需設備的動態重新載入功能
    
-   interfaces: add WPA enterprise configuration for infrastructure mode (contributed by Manuel Faux)  
    介面：新增WPA基礎架構模式的企業配置（由 Manuel Faux 提供）
    
-   interfaces: fix “Allow service binding” for multiple aliases per interface (contributed by Adam Dawidowski)  
    介面：修正「允許服務綁定」中每個介面多個別名的問題（由 Adam Dawidowski 提供）
    
-   interfaces: auto-detect far gateway requirement for default route  
    介面：自動偵測預設路由的遠端網關要求
    
-   interfaces: switch to MVC/API variant for DNS lookup page  
    介面：切換到MVC/API變體以存取DNS查詢頁面
    
-   interfaces: refactor DHCP and PPPoE scripts to use ifctl exclusively  
    介面：重構DHCP和 PPPoE 腳本，使其完全使用 ifctl。
    
-   interfaces: prevent the removal of default routes in dhclient-script  
    介面：防止 dhclient-script 移除預設路由
    
-   interfaces: fix inconsistencies in wireless handling  
    介面：修復無線處理方面的不一致之處
    
-   firewall: improved port alias performance  
    防火牆：改進了連接埠別名效能
    
-   firewall: obsoleted notices inside the synchronization code  
    防火牆：同步程式碼中已過時的通知
    
-   firewall: support logging in NPT rules  
    防火牆：支援登入NPT規則
    
-   firewall: append missing link-local to inet6 :network selector  
    防火牆：將缺少的 link-local 加入 inet6 :network 選擇器
    
-   firewall: move inspect action into its own async API action to prevent long page loads  
    防火牆：將檢查操作移至單獨的非同步API操作中，以防止頁面載入時間過長
    
-   firewall: internal aliases cannot be disabled  
    防火牆：無法停用內部別名
    
-   firewall: performance improvement for reading live log  
    防火牆：提升讀取即時日誌的效能
    
-   dhcp: no longer automatically add a link-local address to bridges if IPv6 service is running on it  
    DHCP：如果網橋上執行 IPv6 服務，則不再自動為其新增連結本機位址。
    
-   dhcp: allow running relay service on bridges  
    DHCP：允許在網橋上運行中繼服務
    
-   dhcp: clean up IPv6 prefixes script  
    dhcp：清理 IPv6 前綴腳本
    
-   dhcp: include ddns-hostname and other cleanups (contributed by Sascha Buxhofer)  
    dhcp：包含 ddns-hostname 和其他清理工作（由 Sascha Buxhofer 提供）
    
-   dhcp: remove duplicated ddnsupdate static mapping switch  
    DHCP：刪除重複的 DDNS 更新靜態映射開關
    
-   firmware: added 22.7 series fingerprint  
    韌體：新增22.7系列指紋識別
    
-   firmware: console script can now show changelog using “less” before update  
    韌體：控制台腳本現在可以在更新前使用「less」命令顯示變更日誌。
    
-   firmware: disable crash reporter in development and debug deployments  
    韌體：在開發和調試部署中停用崩潰報告器
    
-   ipsec: add “IPv4+6” protocol for mobile phase 1 entries (contributed by vnxme)  
    ipsec：為移動階段 1 條目新增“IPv4+6”協定（由 vnxme 提供）
    
-   ipsec: mobile property boolean duplication in phase 2  
    IPsec：第二階段移動屬性布林值重複
    
-   ipsec: remember phase 1 setting for next action  
    IPsec：記住第一階段設定以進行下一步操作
    
-   ipsec: switch to MVC/API variants of SPD, SAD and connection pages  
    IPsec：切換到MVC/API的SPD, SAD變體和連接頁面
    
-   openvpn: pinned Diffie-Hellman parameter to RFC 7919 4096 bit key  
    openvpn：已將 Diffie-Hellman 參數固定為RFC 7919 4096 位元金鑰
    
-   lang: bring back Italian and update all languages to latest available translations  
    lang：恢復義大利語譯文，並將所有語言更新為最新可用譯文。
    
-   mvc: bugfix search and sort issues for searchRecordsetBase()  
    mvc：修正 searchRecordsetBase() 的搜尋和排序問題
    
-   mvc: add support for non-persistent (memory) models  
    MVC：增加對非持久（記憶體）模型的支持
    
-   mvc: throw when no mount found in model (contributed by agh1467)  
    mvc：當模型中未找到掛載點時拋出異常（由 agh1467 貢獻）
    
-   ui: removed Internet Explorer support  
    使用者介面：已移除對 Internet Explorer 的支持
    
-   ui: boostrap-select ignored header height  
    ui：bootstrap-select 忽略了頭部高度
    
-   ui: merge option objects instead of replacing them in bootgrid (contributed by agh1467)  
    ui：在 bootgrid 中合併選項物件而不是替換它們（由 agh1467 貢獻）
    
-   ui: correct required API for command-info in bootgrid (contributed by agh1467)  
    ui：bootgrid 中 command-info 的必填項API正確（由 agh1467 提供）
    
-   ui: add catch undefined TypeError in SimpleActionButton (contributed by agh1467)  
    ui：在 SimpleActionButton 中加入捕捉 undefined TypeError 的機制（由 agh1467 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-apcupsd 1.0 [\[2\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.7/sysutils/apcupsd/pkg-descr) (contributed by David Berry, Dan Lundqvist and Nicola Pellegrini)  
    插件：os-apcupsd 1.0 [\[2\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.7/sysutils/apcupsd/pkg-descr )（由 David Berry、Dan Lundqvist 和 Nicola Pellegrini 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-boot-delay is no longer available [\[3\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/b31bcb92106/sysutils/boot-delay/Makefile#L6)  
    插件：os-boot-delay 已不再可用 [\[3\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/b31bcb92106/sysutils/boot-delay/Makefile#L6 )
    
-   plugins: os-tayga 1.2 [\[4\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.7/net/tayga/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-tayga 1.2 [\[4\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.7/net/tayga/pkg-descr )
    
-   plugins: os-tor no longer available on LibreSSL due to incompatibilities with newer Tor versions  
    外掛程式：由於與較新版本的 Tor 不相容，LibreSSL 上已不再提供 os-tor 外掛程式。
    
-   plugins: os-web-proxy-useracl is no longer available, no updates since 2017  
    外掛：os-web-proxy-useracl 已不再可用，自 2017 年以來未更新。
    
-   src: FreeBSD 13.1-RELEASE [\[5\]](https://www.freebsd.org/releases/13.1R/relnotes/)  
    來源：FreeBSD 13.1-RELEASE [\[5\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/releases/13.1R/relnotes/ )
    
-   ports: php 8.0.20 [\[6\]](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-8.php#8.0.20)  
    埠：php 8.0.20 [\[6\]]( https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-8.php#8.0.20 )
    
-   ports: sqlite 3.39.0 [\[7\]](https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_39_0.html)  
    連接埠：sqlite 3.39.0 [\[7\]]( https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_39_0.html )
    

A hotfix release was issued as 22.7.r1\_8:

已發布熱修復版本22.7 .r1\_8:

-   system: disable RRD and NetFlow shutdown backups by default  
    系統：預設為停用RRD和 NetFlow 關閉備份
    
-   system: render interfaces in convert\_config()  
    系統：在 convert\_config() 中渲染介面
    
-   interfaces: fix unable to bring up multiple loopback (contributed Johnny S. Lee)  
    介面：修正無法建立多個環回介面的問題（Johnny S. Lee 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: fix unable to bring up multiple VXLAN  
    介面：修復無法啟動多個VXLAN問題
    
-   interfaces: check if int before passing to convert\_seconds\_to\_hms()  
    介面：在傳遞給 convert\_seconds\_to\_hms() 之前，檢查其是否為 int 型別
    
-   ipsec: small UX tweaks in status page  
    ipsec：狀態頁面中的一些小調整UX
    
-   mvc: fix rowCount when all is selected in searchRecordsetBase()  
    mvc：修正 searchRecordsetBase() 選取全部時 rowCount 的問題
    
-   plugins: os-nginx fix for missing DH parameter file  
    外掛程式：os-nginx 修正缺少DH參數檔的問題
    
-   plugins: os-postfix fix for missing DH parameter file  
    插件：os-postfix 修復缺少的DH參數文件
    

Known issues and limitations:

已知問題和限制：

-   The DH parameter is no longer available in OpenVPN server configuration and now fixed to the RFC 7919 4096 bit key. The only downside may be lower performance on older machines.  
    OpenVPN 伺服器設定中已不再使用DH參數，該參數現已固定為RFC 7919 4096 位元金鑰。唯一的缺點可能是老舊機器的性能會降低。
    
-   The infamous /var MFS feature was reduced to the /var/log scope in order to avoid future issues with plugins requiring persistent storage under /var. In practice people who used /var MFS had no benefit over it with software that required persistent storage under /var to operate in the first place. Periodic configuration file writes to /var are negligible on SSD-based systems.  
    臭名昭著的 /var MFS功能已被限制在 /var/log 範圍內，以避免未來插件需要 /var 下的持久存儲時出現問題。實際上，對於那些本身就需要 /var 下持久存儲才能運行的軟體而言，使用 /var MFS並沒有帶來任何好處。在基於SSD的系統中，定期寫入 /var 的設定檔可以忽略不計。

#### 22.1 “Observant Owl”（觀察力敏銳的貓頭鷹） Series｜22.1 “Observant Owl”（觀察力敏銳的貓頭鷹）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_22.1.html>

For more than 7 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

7 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

22.1, nicknamed “Observant Owl”（觀察力敏銳的貓頭鷹）, features the upgrade to FreeBSD 13, switch to logging supporting RFC 5424 with severity filtering, improved tunable sysctl value integration, faster boot sequence and interface initiation and dynamic IPv6 host alias support amongst others.

22.1 ，又稱“Observant Owl”（觀察力敏銳的貓頭鷹） ，其特點包括升級到 FreeBSD 13，切換到支援RFC 5424 的日誌記錄（具有嚴重性過濾功能），改進了可調 sysctl 值集成，加快了啟動順序和接口初始化，以及動態 IPv6 主機名別支援6 主機名別支持

On the flip side major operating system changes bear risk for regression and feature removal, e.g. no longer supporting insecure cryptography in the kernel for IPsec and switching the Realtek vendor driver back to its FreeBSD counterpart which does not yet support the newer 2.5G models. Circular logging support has also been removed. Make sure to read the known issues and limitations below before attempting to upgrade.

另一方面，作業系統的重大變更會帶來功能回歸和移除的風險，例如核心不再支援不安全的 IPsec 加密，以及將 Realtek 廠商驅動程式切換回其 FreeBSD 版本，而該版本尚未支援較新的 2.5G 型號。循環日誌記錄支援也已移除。請務必在嘗試升級之前閱讀以下已知問題和限制。

##### 22.1.10 (July 07, 2022)｜22.1.10 （2022年7月7日）

Today we are shipping small reliability improvements and a few security updates for bundled packages. Of special note is the upgrade of Phalcon 5, Python 3.9 and move of the StrongSwan vici library into a separate package.

今天我們發布了一些可靠性改進和捆綁軟體包的安全性更新。特別值得注意的是 Phalcon 5 和 Python 3.9的升級，以及將 StrongSwan vici 函式庫移至單獨的軟體包中。

This release will be the last of the 22.1 series. The release candidate for 22.7 will be available next week and the release date for the final version is July 28. Users wishing to try the release candidate can reach it from the development version or reinstall from the provided images.

此版本將是22.1系列的最後一個版本。 22.7 的候選版本將於下週發布，最終版本的發布日期為 7 月 28 日。希望嘗試候選版本的用戶可以從開發版本存取它或從提供的映像重新安裝。

A hotfix will be issued on the 28th to enable the upgrade path, but depending on testing and mirror availability this might be up to 24 hours after the initial image release of 22.7.

將於 28 日發布熱修復程序以啟用升級路徑，但根據測試和鏡像可用性，這可能在22.7的初始鏡像發布後最多 24 小時。

##### 22.1.9 (June 23, 2022)｜22.1.9 （2022年6月23日）

Today we are addressing kernel memory leaks that occur when reading firewall rule information from the system. It seems that these leaks even slipped into the FreeBSD 13.1 release so we are happy to see them fixed now.

今天我們要解決的是從系統讀取防火牆規則資訊時出現的核心記憶體洩漏問題。這些洩漏似乎甚至已經存在於 FreeBSD 13.1版本中，所以我們很高興看到它們現在得到了修復。

22.7 is very much on track. Our final target is getting ready for the PHP 8 upgrade but the timing is unclear as we wait for an official Phalcon 5 release version that supports it.

22.7專案進展順利。我們的最終目標是為PHP 8 升級做好準備，但由於我們需要等待官方發布的支援該升級的 Phalcon 5 版本，因此具體時間尚不確定。

Other than that please enjoy the summer and hydrate responsibly.

除此之外，請盡情享受夏日時光，並注意適量飲水。

##### 22.1.8 (May 25, 2022)｜22.1.8 （2022年5月25日）

Small reliability update which also includes a rework for firewall alias handling and performance.

小型可靠性更新，其中還包括對防火牆別名處理和效能的重新設計。

Later today we will also publish a call for testing for the upcoming 22.7 operating system base using FreeBSD 13.1. It is going to be compatible with this 22.1.x series and existing feedback about it is promising so far.

今天晚些時候，我們還將發布一份關於即將推出的基於 FreeBSD 13.1的22.7作業系統基礎的測試邀請。它將與22.1 .x 系列相容，目前收到的回饋令人鼓舞。

##### 22.1.6 (April 13, 2022)｜22.1.6 （2022年4月13日）

Since the Unbound migration for overrides surfaced a number of issues in the new code this is a follow-up release to ensure interoperability. Thank you for the honest feedback, bug reports and code submissions.

由於 Unbound 的覆蓋遷移在新程式碼中暴露出一些問題，因此我們發布了後續版本以確保互通性。感謝您提供的寶貴回饋、錯誤報告和程式碼提交。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: obsolete plugins calling missing functions shall not produce fatal errors  
    系統：過時的外掛程式呼叫缺少的函數不應產生致命錯誤

    防火牆：修復會話頁面ACL

##### 22.1.5 (April 07, 2022)｜22.1.5 （2022年4月7日）

Due to popular demand the user experience for the revamped VLAN handling was improved in several areas. Also included are a larger Unbound MVC rework and DNS system route apply changes from one single spot. Last but not least the zlib vulnerability was fixed in FreeBSD amongst others.

應廣大使用者的要求，我們對改進後的VLAN處理流程進行了多項使用者體驗最佳化。此外，我們也對Unbound的MVC進行了大規模重構，並實現了DNS系統路由變更的集中式應用。最後，我們也修復了FreeBSD中的zlib漏洞等問題。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: set up all DNS system routes from system\_resolvconf\_generate()  
    系統：從 system\_resolvconf\_generate() 設定所有DNS系統路由
    
-   system: properly clear legacy files when clearing log files  
    系統：清除日誌檔案時，正確清除遺留文件
    
-   reporting: add ACPI and ARM temperature support to health data  
    報告：在健康數據中加入ACPI和ARM溫度支持
    
-   interfaces: do not assume exclusive use of router file in IPv6 PPPoE case  
    介面：在 IPv6 PPPoE 場景下，不要假定路由器檔案是獨佔使用。
    
-   interfaces: for symmetry with PPPoE do not reload WAN when address disappears  
    介面：為了與 PPPoE 保持一致，當位址消失時不要重新載入WAN
    
-   interfaces: VLAN UX changes include better tag and parent visibility and handling  
    介面： VLAN UX變更包括更好的標籤和父級可見度和處理
    
-   interfaces: improve VLAN parent selection for batch changes to allow for a single apply  
    介面：改進VLAN批量變更的父級選擇，以允許單次應用
    
-   interfaces: hint at missing apply when trying to add a new interface in assignment page  
    介面：嘗試在分配頁面中新增介面時，提示缺少 apply 屬性
    
-   captive portal: prevent cleansing password field  
    強制門戶：阻止清除密碼字段
    
-   dhcp: give a hint on why an interface was ignored in radvd  
    dhcp：請提示為什麼 radvd 忽略了某個介面。
    
-   firmware: exclude revision matching from latest changelog version check  
    韌體：從最新變更日誌版本檢查中排除版本匹配項
    
-   unbound: add custom forwarding and overrides MVC pages  
    未綁定：新增自訂轉送和覆蓋MVC頁面
    
-   ui: omit total entries display for log grids  
    使用者介面：省略日誌網格中的條目總數顯示

##### 22.1.4 (March 24, 2022)｜22.1.4 （2022年3月24日）

QinQ support based on the FreeBSD 13 VLAN base functionality is finally here! To make the best use of it a MVC conversion of the GUI pages was carried out meaning these are now fully API-enabled as well. Two bugs in the previous GIF/GRE rework have also been reported and fixed.

基於 FreeBSD 13 VLAN基礎功能的 QinQ 支援終於上線了！為了充分利用它， GUI MVC進行了轉換，這意味著這些頁面現在也完全支援API功能。此外，我們也報告並修復了先前GIF/GRE重構中的兩個錯誤。

Note while this does fix CVE-2022-0778 even for LibreSSL the security audit database by FreeBSD will falsely flag the 3.3.6 release as vulnerable when in fact it is not. Since build issues arise on LibreSSL 3.4 that involve plugin dependencies in all likelihood we will be refraining from updating to version 3.4 altogether and do not have much hope for the upcoming 3.5 either.

請注意，雖然此方法確實修復了 LibreSSL 的CVE -2022-0778 漏洞，但 FreeBSD 的安全審計資料庫會錯誤地將3.3.6版本標記為存在漏洞，而實際上它並不存在漏洞。由於 LibreSSL 3.4版本存在涉及插件依賴項的建置問題，我們很可能不會升級到3.4版本，並且對即將發布的3.5版本也不抱太大希望。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: prefer configured IP address family use earlier on boot  
    系統：優先在啟動時儘早使用已設定的IP位址族
    
-   system: allow boot to perform generic UFS/ZFS grow using the /.probe.for.growfs marker file  
    系統：允許啟動程式使用 /.probe.for.growfs 標記檔案執行通用UFS/ZFS生長
    
-   system: import ZFS pools before mounting ZFS datasets  
    系統：在掛載ZFS資料集之前導入ZFS池
    
-   reporting: use asynchronous DNS resolver for reverse lookups on traffic page  
    報表：在流量頁面上使用非同步DNS解析器進行反向查找
    
-   interfaces: loopback “lo0” exists for VIPs  
    介面：VIP 存在環回介面“lo0”。
    
-   interfaces: only strip addresses on configured IP types  
    介面：僅剝離已配置的IP類型的位址
    
-   interfaces: use new ifctl utility for DHCPv6 IP type and add manual page  
    介面：使用新的 ifctl 工具進行 DHCPv6 IP類型設定並新增手冊頁
    
-   interfaces: adjust MTU configuration when parent also requires MTU changes  
    介面：當父級也需要更改MTU時，調整MTU配置
    
-   interfaces: VLAN MVC conversion with API and QinQ support  
    介面： VLAN MVC轉換，支援API和 QinQ
    
-   interfaces: cleanup surrounding LAGG function use  
    介面：清理周圍LAGG函數使用

##### 22.1.2 (March 01, 2022)｜22.1.2 （2022年3月1日）

This release adds GUI support for Intel QuickAssist Technology (QAT) and syncookies as per virtue of the FreeBSD 13 operating system. The work to modernise the interfaces subsystem and improve the new ddclient dynamic DNS plugin are also progressing.

此版本新增了對 Intel QuickAssist 技術 ( GUI ) 和 Syncookie 的支持，這是 FreeBSD 13 作業系統的固有特性。此外，介面子系統的現代化改造以及對新的 ddclient 動態插件DNS QAT改進工作也在穩步推進中。

Due to signs of decay in the build infrastructure, license nitpicking in FreeBSD ports and the upcoming OpenSSL 3 release (which will complicate things most likely) we have decided to discontinue LibreSSL at the end of this year meaning there will be no more LibreSSL flavour starting with version 23.1. Non-essential software will no longer be manually fixed and provided as binary packages if broken by upstream from this point on.

由於建置基礎設施出現衰退跡象、FreeBSD 連接埠中對許可證的吹毛求疵以及即將發布的 OpenSSL 3（這很可能會使情況更加複雜），我們決定在今年年底停止 LibreSSL 的開發，這意味著從23.1版本開始，將不再有任何 LibreSSL 版本。從現在開始，如果上游出現問題，我們將不再手動修復非必要軟體，也不會再以二進位套件的形式提供。

Since 2015 we have been working on functional LibreSSL support with steady means, but 7 years later and OpenSSL making an effort through numerous ways we are sad to give up this alternative since we do not see LibreSSL being used and properly integrated in software projects as often anymore. It has been a slow but steady decline for the past 2 years that also has to do with a LibreSSL release cycle tailored for OpenBSD in particular and OpenSSL library integration quality, which is almost impossible to improve upon in complex third-party software projects. We simply cannot afford the time for it any longer.

自 2015 年以來，我們一直在穩步推進 LibreSSL 的功能性支持，但七年過去了，OpenSSL 也通過多種方式做出了努力，我們不得不遺憾地放棄這一替代方案，因為我們不再像以前那樣頻繁地看到 LibreSSL 在軟體專案中被使用和正確集成。過去兩年，LibreSSL 的使用率持續緩慢下降，這與 LibreSSL 專門針對 OpenBSD 的發布週期以及 OpenSSL 庫的整合品質密切相關，後者在複雜的第三方軟體專案中幾乎無法改進。我們實在沒有時間再繼續投入精力了。

All users are able to update to the OpenSSL flavour without issues now or at any later given point.

所有用戶現在或將來任何時候都可以毫無問題地升級到 OpenSSL 版本。

##### 22.1.1 (February 16, 2022)｜22.1.1 （2022年2月16日）

The first stable release brings in minor fixes from FreeBSD and instant log file visibility for files without severity written which can happen for individual plugins.

第一個穩定版本修復了 FreeBSD 的一些小問題，並實現了未寫入嚴重級別的檔案的即時日誌檔案可見性，這種情況可能會發生在單一插件中。

We have also gone ahead to restructure the interface code further to resolve dependencies between configured devices and interfaces automatically and the bundled development version is worth a try for everyone having issues with GIF/GRE not coming up after boot.

我們也進一步重構了介面程式碼，以自動解決已配置設備和介面之間的依賴關係，對於所有遇到GIF/GRE在啟動後無法啟動問題的用戶，捆綁的開發版本都值得一試。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: changing interface gateway was ignored during route reconfiguration  
    系統：路由重配置期間忽略了更改介面網關的操作
    
-   system: allow to configure SSH setting PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms (contributed by Manuel Faux)  
    系統：允許配置SSH設定 PubkeyAcceptedAlgorithms（由 Manuel Faux 提供）
    
-   system: add backward compatibility for reading logs without severity by default (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：預設情況下新增向後相容性，允許讀取不帶嚴重等級的日誌（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: fix typo causing PHP warning on IPv6 login (contributed by ppascher)  
    系統：修正導致 IPv6 登入時出現PHP警告的拼字錯誤（ppascher 提供）
    
-   system: cron command drop down size was extending below screen  
    系統：cron 指令下拉選單的大小超出了螢幕下方
    
-   system: add a sysctl cache to improve tuneable overview load time  
    系統：新增 sysctl 快取以改善可調概覽載入時間
    
-   system: replace obsolete find\_interface\_network\*() use in GUI  
    系統：取代已過時的 find\_interface\_network\*() 函數，請參考GUI
    
-   system: allow severity levels in PHP log messages and mark authentication success messages as notice  
    系統：允許在PHP日誌訊息中使用嚴重級別，並將身份驗證成功訊息標記為通知
    
-   interfaces: fix default handling for VIP nobind option  
    介面：修復VIP nobind 選項的預設處理
    
-   interfaces: allow VIP nobind feature on CARP addresses  
    介面：允許在CARP位址上使用VIP nobind 功能
    
-   interfaces: stop MPD process before starting  
    介面：啟動前停止MPD進程

##### 22.1 (January 27, 2022)｜22.1 （2022年1月27日）

For more than 7 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

7 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

22.1, nicknamed “Observant Owl”（觀察力敏銳的貓頭鷹）, features the upgrade to FreeBSD 13, switch to logging supporting RFC 5424 with severity filtering, improved tunable sysctl value integration, faster boot sequence and interface initiation and dynamic IPv6 host alias support amongst others.

22.1 ，又稱為“Observant Owl”（觀察力敏銳的貓頭鷹） ，其特點包括升級到 FreeBSD 13，切換到支援RFC 5424 的日誌記錄（具有嚴重性過濾功能），改進了可調 sysctl 值集成，加快了啟動順序和接口初始化，以及動態 IPv6 主機名別支援6 主機名別支援6 主機標位等。

On the flip side major operating system changes bear risk for regression and feature removal, e.g. no longer supporting insecure cryptography in the kernel for IPsec and switching the Realtek vendor driver back to its FreeBSD counterpart which does not yet support the newer 2.5G models. Circular logging support has also been removed. Make sure to read the known issues and limitations below before attempting to upgrade.

另一方面，作業系統的重大變更會帶來功能回歸和移除的風險，例如核心不再支援不安全的 IPsec 加密，以及將 Realtek 廠商驅動程式切換回其 FreeBSD 版本，而該版本尚未支援較新的 2.5G 型號。循環日誌記錄支援也已移除。請務必在嘗試升級之前閱讀以下已知問題和限制。

Here are the full patch notes against version 21.7.7:

以下是針對版本21.7.7完整更新說明：

-   system: improved visibility and flexibility of tunables  
    系統：提高了可調參數的可見度和靈活性
    
-   system: move multiple sysctl manipulations to tunables framework to allow overriding them  
    系統：將多個 sysctl 操作移至可調參數框架，以便可以覆寫它們。
    
-   system: prevent more than one default route by default  
    系統：預設情況下防止存在多個預設路由
    
-   system: sync recovery utility contents with FreeBSD 13  
    系統：將復原實用程式內容與 FreeBSD 13 同步
    
-   system: prevent syslog-ng from crashing after update due to “syslog-ng-ctl reload” use  
    系統：防止 syslog-ng 在更新後因「syslog-ng-ctl reload」指令而崩潰
    
-   system: add severity to syslog output and allow to filter for it  
    系統：在系統日誌輸出中新增嚴重性級別，並允許對其進行篩選。
    
-   system: create latest.log links for easier log consumption  
    系統：建立 latest.log 連結以便於日誌讀取
    
-   system: added opnsense-log utility to inspect logs on the console  
    系統：新增了 opnsense-log 實用程序，用於檢查控制台上的日誌。
    
-   system: removed circular logging support  
    系統：已移除循環日誌記錄支持
    
-   system: background all cron backend command invokes  
    系統：後台所有 cron 後端指令調用
    
-   system: unified cron start between legacy and MVC components  
    系統：統一傳統組件和MVC組件之間的 cron 啟動
    
-   system: improve the fallback after failing to look up specific IPv4 address match for dpinger  
    系統：改進 dpinger 在尋找特定 IPv4 位址匹配失敗時的回退機制
    
-   system: use correct IPv6 interface for dpinger gateway monitoring when using 6RD  
    系統：使用 6RD 時，請使用正確的 IPv6 介面進行 dpinger 閘道監控。
    
-   system: default net.inet6.ip6.intr\_queue\_maxlen to 1000 like its IPv4 counterpart  
    系統：預設值 net.inet6.ip6.intr\_queue\_maxlen 為 1000，與其 IPv4 對應項相同。
    
-   system: default net.inet6.ip6.redirect to off like its IPv4 counterpart  
    系統：預設 net.inet6.ip6.redirect 設定為關閉，與 IPv4 對應項相同
    
-   system: fix potential issues with “search” syntax in resolv.conf  
    系統：修正 resolv.conf 中「search」語法可能存在的問題
    
-   system: fix general settings PHP warnings that only appear when validation fails  
    系統：修復常規設定PHP僅在驗證失敗時出現的警告
    
-   system: allow additional search domain (Pierre Fevre)  
    系統：允許新增其他搜尋網域（皮埃爾·費弗爾）
    
-   system: make /var MFS work when /var directories are mount points, e.g. on ZFS  
    系統：當 /var 目錄是掛載點時，例如在ZFS上，使 /var MFS正常工作
    
-   system: optionally disconnect PPP interfaces when going into CARP backup mode  
    系統：進入CARP備援模式時，可選擇斷開PPP接口
    
-   system: fix new PPP CARP hook function call (contributed by Markus Reiter)  
    系統：修復新的PPP CARP hook 函數呼叫（由 Markus Reiter 提供）
    
-   system: separate core and thread count in information widget  
    系統：資訊小工具中分別顯示核心數和執行緒數
    
-   system: MSDOS file system awareness in information widget for new /boot/efi partition  
    系統： MSDOS資訊小工具中關於新 /boot/efi 分區的檔案系統感知
    
-   system: no longer display duplicated mounted partitions on the dashboard  
    系統：不再在控制台上顯示重複的已掛載分割區。
    
-   system: remove spurious XML validation that cannot cope with attributes from backup restore  
    系統：移除無法處理備份復原屬性的虛假XML驗證
    
-   system: refactor GUI rebind protection and remove its os-dyndns/os-rfc2136 references  
    系統：重構GUI重新綁定保護並移除其 os-dyndns/os-rfc2136 引用
    
-   reporting: fix display of total in/out traffic values  
    報告：修復總進出流量值的顯示問題
    
-   interfaces: LAGG support in console port assignment (contributed by sarthurdev)  
    介面： LAGG支援控制台連接埠分配（由 sarthurdev 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: improve LAGG/VLAN assignments via console option  
    介面：透過控制台選項改進LAGG/VLAN分配
    
-   interfaces: repair get\_interface\_list() for console use  
    介面：修復控制台使用的 get\_interface\_list() 函數
    
-   interfaces: aligned the name and use of special /tmp files for internal interface handling  
    介面：統一了用於內部介面處理的特殊 /tmp 檔案的名稱和使用方式
    
-   interfaces: correctly write nameserverv6 and searchdomainv6 information on dhcp6c lease acquire  
    介面：在 dhcp6c 租約取得過程中正確寫入 nameserverv6 和 searchdomainv6 訊息
    
-   interfaces: make cache IP files exclusive to rc.newwan and rc.newwanv6 scripts to avoid missing IP changes  
    介面：將快取IP檔案限定為 rc.newwan 和 rc.newwanv6 腳本專用，以避免遺漏IP更改
    
-   interfaces: refactored linkup event handler to avoid unnecessary recursion in the code  
    介面：重構了 linkup 事件處理程序，以避免程式碼中不必要的遞歸。
    
-   interfaces: removed opportunistic functions find\_interface\_ip(), find\_interface\_ipv6() and find\_interface\_ipv6\_ll()  
    介面：移除了機會主義函數 find\_interface\_ip()、find\_interface\_ipv6() 和 find\_interface\_ipv6\_ll()
    
-   interfaces: get\_interface\_ip() and get\_interface\_ipv6() now return a valid IP address if one was given to support VIP aliases  
    介面：如果提供了位址，get\_interface\_ip() 和 get\_interface\_ipv6() 現在會傳回有效的IP位址，以支援VIP別名。
    
-   interfaces: interfaces\_addresses() can now map a configuration interface to returned addresses to track its origin  
    interfaces: interfaces\_addresses() 現在可以將設定介面對應到傳回的位址，以追蹤其來源
    
-   interfaces: VIPs now support the “no bind” option to exclude them from automatic service use when configured  
    介面：VIP 現在支援「不綁定」選項，以便在配置時將其從自動服務使用中排除。
    
-   interfaces: interfaces\_primary\_address() is now being used like its IPv6 equivalent throughout the code  
    interfaces: interfaces\_primary\_address() 現在在整個程式碼中都像其 IPv6 等效項一樣使用。
    
-   interfaces: interfaces\_primary\_address6() is now considering addresses from tracking interfaces when needed  
    介面：interfaces\_primary\_address6() 現在會在需要時考慮來自追蹤介面的位址。
    
-   interfaces: interfaces\_scoped\_address6() is now being used throughout the code  
    interfaces: interfaces\_scoped\_address6() 現在在整個程式碼中被使用
    
-   interfaces: “tentative” state now leads to the address being ignored during configuration like “deprecated”  
    介面：「暫定」狀態現在會導致設定期間忽略該位址，就像「已棄用」狀態一樣。
    
-   interfaces: removed unmaintained 3G statistics gathering for Huawei modems that could lock up other modems  
    介面：移除了華為數據機已停止維護的 3G 統計資料收集功能，該功能可能會導致其他數據機卡死。
    
-   interfaces: reworked interface creation on boot up  
    介面：重新設計了啟動時的介面創建
    
-   interfaces: spoof MAC now only applies to actual interface and not all of its VLAN siblings or parent  
    接口：欺騙MAC現在僅適用於實際接口，而不適用於其所有VLAN同級接口或父接口
    
-   interfaces: added permanent promiscuous mode setting  
    介面：新增永久混雜模式設置
    
-   interfaces: add the interface description via ifconfig to its respective device  
    介面：透過 ifconfig 將介面描述加入到對應的設備中。
    
-   interfaces: stop special treatment of bridge interfaces on linkup  
    介面：停止對連結連接中的橋接介面進行特殊處理
    
-   interfaces: improve validations and fix defaults for bridges  
    介面：改進驗證並修復橋接器的預設值
    
-   interfaces: allow bridges to attach to VXLAN on boot  
    介面：允許網橋在啟動時連接到VXLAN
    
-   interfaces: background all interface reconfiguration script hooks  
    介面：後台所有介面重配置腳本鉤子
    
-   interfaces: no longer allow and apply media configuration for non-parent devices  
    介面：不再允許並套用非父設備的媒體配置
    
-   interfaces: removed restriction from interfaces without configuration to not being able to hold VIPs  
    介面：取消了未設定介面無法持有 VIP 的限制
    
-   interfaces: remove defunct link support for GRE  
    介面：移除對GRE失效連結支援
    
-   interfaces: align GIF configuration with base system options  
    介面：使GIF配置與基本系統選項保持一致
    
-   firewall: properly kill all connections from and to a WAN IPv4 on an address change  
    防火牆：在位址變更時正確終止所有來自和去往WAN IPv4 的連接
    
-   firewall: skip rule ID for NAT type log entries (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：跳過規則ID ，用於NAT類型的日誌條目（由 kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   firewall: display interface descriptions on normalisation rules (contributed by vnxme)  
    防火牆：在規範化規則中顯示介面描述（由 vnxme 提供）
    
-   firewall: dynamic IPv6 host alias support (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    防火牆：動態 IPv6 主機別名支援（由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: removed obsolete kill states option on gateway failure  
    防火牆：移除網關故障時已過時的終止狀態選項

    防火牆：已移除 $aliastable 快取

    防火牆：普通日誌預設日誌嚴重性選擇現在為“資訊性”

Known issues and limitations:

已知問題和限制：

-   This release contains a new major operating system version and should be carried out with the necessary care. Despite extended test coverage changes made by FreeBSD may still affect operation without our knowledge. Except for ZFS boot environments rollbacks between major operating system versions are extremely fragile and a reinstall of an older version should be attempted in the worst case. For more information please consult the FreeBSD 13.0 release notes [\[28\]](https://www.freebsd.org/releases/13.0R/relnotes/) .  
    此版本包含一個新的主要作業系統版本，因此應謹慎操作。儘管進行了擴展測試，FreeBSD 所做的更改仍可能在我們不知情的情況下影響系統運行。除ZFS啟動環境外，主要作業系統版本之間的回溯極度不穩定，最壞情況下應嘗試重新安裝舊版。更多資訊請參閱 FreeBSD 13.0發行說明 [\[28\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/releases/13.0R/relnotes/ )。
    
-   IPsec hash and cipher removals in FreeBSD 13 can affect existing setups as insecure cryptographic options have been removed upstream. If you are using MD5, Blowfish, DES, 3DES, or CAST128 in your phase 2 please move to more secure settings prior to the upgrade. Note that phase 1 settings are unaffected, but insecure settings should still be avoided. For more information see the FreeBSD commit in question [\[29\]](https://github.com/opnsense/src/commit/16aabb761c0a) .  
    FreeBSD 13 中 IPsec 雜湊和加密演算法的移除可能會影響現有配置，因為上游已移除不安全的加密選項。如果您在第二階段配置中使用了MD5 、Blowfish、 DES 、3DES 或CAST128 ，請在升級前遷移到更安全的配置。請注意，第一階段配置不受影響，但仍應避免使用不安全的配置。更多資訊請參閱相關的 FreeBSD 提交 [\[29\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/src/commit/16aabb761c0a )。
    
-   The Realtek vendor driver is no longer bundled with the updated FreeBSD kernel. If unsure whether FreeBSD 13 supports your Realtek NIC please install the os-realtek-re plugin prior to upgrading to retain operability of your NICs.  
    更新後的 FreeBSD 核心不再包含 Realtek 廠商驅動程式。如果您不確定 FreeBSD 13 是否支援您的 Realtek NIC網卡，請在升級前安裝 os-realtek-re 插件，以確保網路卡的正常運作。
    
-   MAC spoofing now only pertains to the configured interface and not the VLAN siblings or parent interface. This can introduce unwanted configuration due to previous side effects in the code. Make sure to assign and set the spoofed MAC for all interfaces that require a spoofed MAC or simply spoof the MAC on the parent and leave the VLAN sibling settings empty to let them follow the parent MAC automatically. If in doubt the parent interface can be set into promiscuous mode now to allow for mixed MAC address use across VLANs too.  
    MAC欺騙現在僅適用於已配置的接口，而不適用於VLAN同級接口或父接口。由於先前程式碼中的副作用，這可能會引入不必要的配置。請確保為所有需要欺騙MAC的介面分配並設定欺騙的MAC位址，或直接在父介面上欺騙MAC位址，並將同級介面的VLAN設定留空，使其自動跟隨父介面MAC的設定。如有疑問，現在可以將父介面設定為混雜模式，以允許跨 VLAN 混合使用MAC位址。
    
-   Media and hardware offload settings are no longer shown for non-parent interfaces and need to be set individually on the parent interface to take effect. This can introduce unwanted configuration due to previous side effects in the code. If the parent interface was not previously assigned please assign it to reapply the required settings.  
    媒體和硬體卸載設定不再顯示在非父介面上，需要單獨在父介面上設定才能生效。由於先前程式碼中的副作用，這可能會導致不必要的配置。如果之前未指派父接口，請先指派以重新套用所需的設定。
    
-   NTPD defaults changed to exclude the “iburst” option by default. “limited” setting was detached from “kod” option. In both cases configuration adjustments can achieve previous behaviour if required.  
    NTPD預設設定已更改，預設不包含「iburst」選項。 “limited”設定已從“kod”選項中分離。如有需要，可透過配置調整恢復之前的行為。
    
-   Rebind checks through os-dyndns or os-rfc2136 will no longer work due to the deprecation of both plugins. Please add your rebind hosts manually or disable rebind protection prior to the upgrade.  
    由於 os-dyndns 和 os-rfc2136 插件已被棄用，透過這兩個插件進行的重新綁定檢查將不再有效。請手動新增您的重新綁定主機，或在升級前停用重新綁定保護。
    
-   GRE link1 support has been removed and needs a static route to function now.  
    GRE link1 支援已移除，現在需要靜態路由才能正常運作。
    
-   Circular logging support has been removed. No user interaction is required.  
    循環日誌記錄支援已被移除。無需用戶互動。
    

The public key for the 22.1 series is:

22.1系列的公鑰為：

##### 22.1.r2 (January 20, 2022)｜22.1 .r2（2022年1月20日）

Quick update on the 22.1 front includes feedback from the RC1 release, a FreeBSD package tool fix for its static binary failing to validate certain TLS certificates and a number of small improvements that do not fit into the former categories.

22.1方面的快速更新包括來自RC1版本的回饋、FreeBSD 軟體包工具的靜態二進位檔案無法驗證某些TLS憑證的修復，以及一些不屬於上述類別的小改進。

The 22.1 release is scheduled for January 27 which is next week already. ;)

22.1發布日期定於 1 月 27 日，也就是下週。 ;)

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: use correct IPv6 interface for dpinger gateway monitoring when using 6RD  
    系統：使用 6RD 時，請使用正確的 IPv6 介面進行 dpinger 閘道監控。
    
-   system: remove spurious XML validation that cannot cope with attributes from backup restore  
    系統：移除無法處理備份復原屬性的虛假XML驗證
    
-   system: sync recovery utility contents with FreeBSD 13  
    系統：將復原實用程式內容與 FreeBSD 13 同步
    
-   system: fix new PPP CARP hook function call (contributed by Markus Reiter)  
    系統：修復新的PPP CARP hook 函數呼叫（由 Markus Reiter 提供）
    
-   system: allow additional search domain (Pierre Fevre)  
    系統：允許新增其他搜尋網域（皮埃爾·費弗爾）
    
-   system: fix general settings PHP warnings that only appear when validation fails  
    系統：修復常規設定PHP僅在驗證失敗時出現的警告
    
-   system: move multiple sysctl manipulations to tunables framework to allow overriding them  
    系統：將多個 sysctl 操作移至可調參數框架，以便可以覆寫它們。
    
-   system: prevent more than one default route by default  
    系統：預設情況下防止存在多個預設路由
    
-   system: prevent syslog-ng from crashing after update due to “syslog-ng-ctl reload” use  
    系統：防止 syslog-ng 在更新後因「syslog-ng-ctl reload」指令而崩潰
    
-   system: MSDOS file system awareness in information widget for new /boot/efi partition  
    系統： MSDOS資訊小工具中關於新建 /boot/efi 分割區的檔案系統感知
    
-   system: separate core and thread count in information widget  
    系統：資訊小工具中分別顯示核心數和執行緒數
    
-   system: refactor GUI rebind protection and remove its os-dyndns/os-rfc2136 references  
    系統：重構GUI重新綁定保護並移除其 os-dyndns/os-rfc2136 引用
    
-   reporting: fix display of total in/out traffic values  
    報告：修復總進出流量值的顯示問題
    
-   interfaces: improve validations and fix defaults for bridges  
    介面：改進驗證並修復橋接器的預設值
    
-   interfaces: remove defunct link support for GRE  
    介面：移除對GRE失效連結支援
    
-   interfaces: align GIF configuration with base system options  
    介面：使GIF配置與基本系統選項保持一致
    
-   interfaces: allow bridges to attach to VXLAN on boot  
    介面：允許網橋在啟動時連接到VXLAN
    
-   interfaces: repair get\_interface\_list() for console use  
    介面：修復控制台使用的 get\_interface\_list() 函數
    
-   interfaces: improve LAGG/VLAN assignments via console option  
    介面：透過控制台選項改進LAGG/VLAN分配
    
-   firewall: plain log default logging severity selection is now “informational”  
    防火牆：普通日誌預設日誌嚴重性選擇現在為“資訊性”
    
-   firewall: improve maximum shaper value validation and add Gbit/s support  
    防火牆：改進最大整形值驗證並增加 Gbit/s 支持
    
-   dhcp: rework router advertisement “static” mode flags to separate advanced options  
    DHCP：重新設計路由器通告「靜態」模式標誌，以分離進階選項
    
-   dnsmasq: no-hosts option (contributed by agh1467)  
    dnsmasq：no-hosts 選項（由 agh1467 貢獻）
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update: exclude /boot/efi permission reset from base set extract  
    韌體：opnsense-update：從基本集提取中排除 /boot/efi 權限重置
    
-   intrusion detection: prevent config migration from crashing  
    入侵偵測：防止配置遷移崩潰
    
-   intrusion detection: update to ET-Open to version 6  
    入侵偵測：更新至ET - 開放至版本 6
    
-   network time: detach “limited” from “kod” option (contributed by Zsolt Zsiros)  
    網路時間：從“kod”選項中分離“limited”（由 Zsolt Zsiros 提供）
    
-   network time: remove PID file use as it can be unreliable  
    網路時間：移除PID文件，因為它可能不可靠。
    
-   mvc: fix logging of configd errors  
    mvc：修復 configd 錯誤日誌記錄問題
    
-   mvc: add BlankDesc to ModelRelationField (contributed by agh1467)  
    MVC：在 ModelRelationField 中加入 BlankDesc（由 agh1467 貢獻）
    
-   ui: move storing jQuery Bootgrid settings in browser from core to bootgrid (contributed by Manuel Faux)  
    ui：將 jQuery Bootgrid 設定從瀏覽器核心移至 Bootgrid（由 Manuel Faux 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-ddclient 1.0 as an eventual replacement for os-dyndns  
    插件：os-ddclient 1.0作為 os-dyndns 的最終替代品
    
-   plugins: os-dyndns adds local copy of get\_dyndns\_ip()  
    外掛程式：os-dyndns 新增了 get\_dyndns\_ip() 的本機副本
    
-   plugins: os-freeradius 1.9.18 [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.1/net/freeradius/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-freeradius 1.9.18 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.1/net/freeradius/pkg-descr )
    
-   plugins: os-nginx 1.26 [\[2\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.1/www/nginx/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-nginx 1.26 [\[2\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.1/www/nginx/pkg-descr )
    
-   plugins: os-rfc2136 adds local copy of get\_dyndns\_ip()  
    外掛程式：os-rfc2136 新增了 get\_dyndns\_ip() 的本機副本
    
-   plugins: os-wol adds cron support for wake action (contributed by digitalshow)  
    插件：os-wol 為喚醒操作添加了 cron 支援（由 digitalshow 貢獻）
    
-   src: revert upstream permission change for /root directory  
    src：撤銷上游對 /root 目錄的權限更改
    
-   src: fix kernel build creating wrong linkers.hint file  
    src：修正核心建置過程中建立錯誤 linkers.hint 檔案的問題
    
-   ports: hostapd 2.10 [\[3\]](https://w1.fi/cgit/hostap/plain/hostapd/ChangeLog)  
    ports: hostapd 2.10 [\[3\]]( https://w1.fi/cgit/hostap/plain/hostapd/ChangeLog )
    
-   ports: nss 3.74 [\[4\]](https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/security/nss/releases/nss_3_74.html)  
    埠：nss 3.74 [\[4\]]( https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/security/nss/releases/nss_3_74.html )
    
-   ports: pecl-psr 1.2.0 [\[5\]](https://pecl.php.net/package-changelog.php?package=psr&release=1.2.0)  
    埠：pecl-psr 1.2.0 [\[5\]]( https://pecl.php.net/package-changelog.php?package=psr&release=1.2.0 )
    
-   ports: pkg fixes validation failures on HTTPS fetch in static binary [\[6\]](https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-ports/commit/08342c9812d)  
    ports: pkg 修正了靜態二進位檔中HTTPS取得時的驗證失敗 [\[6\]]( https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-ports/commit/08342c9812d )
    
-   ports: sqlite 3.37.2 [\[7\]](https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_37_2.html)  
    連接埠：sqlite 3.37.2 [\[7\]]( https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_37_2.html )

    埠：wpa\_supplicant 2.10 [\[9\]]( https://w1.fi/cgit/hostap/plain/wpa_supplicant/ChangeLog )
    

##### 22.1.r1 (January 12, 2022)｜22.1 .r1（2022年1月12日）

For more than 7 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

7 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you. <3

我們感謝大家幫助測試、塑造該專案並為該專案做出貢獻！我們知道如果沒有你，一切都會不一樣。 <3

Here are the full patch notes against 21.7.7:

以下是21.7.7完整更新說明：

-   system: improved visibility and flexibility of tunables  
    系統：提高了可調參數的可見度和靈活性
    
-   system: create latest.log links for easier log consumption  
    系統：建立 latest.log 連結以便於日誌讀取
    
-   system: added opnsense-log utility to inspect logs on the console  
    系統：新增了 opnsense-log 實用程序，用於檢查控制台上的日誌。
    
-   system: removed circular logging support  
    系統：已移除循環日誌記錄支持
    
-   system: background all cron backend command invokes  
    系統：後台所有 cron 後端指令調用
    
-   system: unified cron start between legacy and MVC components  
    系統：統一傳統組件和MVC組件之間的 cron 啟動
    
-   system: improve the fallback after failing to look up specific IPv4 address match for dpinger  
    系統：改進 dpinger 在尋找特定 IPv4 位址匹配失敗時的回退機制
    
-   system: default net.inet6.ip6.intr\_queue\_maxlen to 1000 like its IPv4 counterpart  
    系統：預設值 net.inet6.ip6.intr\_queue\_maxlen 為 1000，與其 IPv4 對應項相同。
    
-   system: default net.inet6.ip6.redirect to off like its IPv4 counterpart  
    系統：預設 net.inet6.ip6.redirect 設定為關閉，與 IPv4 對應項相同
    
-   system: fix potential issues with “search” syntax in resolv.conf  
    系統：修正 resolv.conf 中「search」語法可能存在的問題
    
-   system: make /var MFS work when /var directories are mount points, e.g. on ZFS  
    系統：使 /var MFS在 /var 目錄為掛載點時（例如在ZFS上）正常運作
    
-   system: optionally disconnect PPP interfaces when going into CARP backup mode  
    系統：進入CARP備援模式時，可選擇斷開PPP接口
    
-   system: add severity to syslog output and allow to filter for it  
    系統：在系統日誌輸出中新增嚴重性級別，並允許對其進行篩選。
    
-   system: no longer display duplicated mounted partitions on the dashboard  
    系統：不再在控制台上顯示重複的已掛載分割區。
    
-   interfaces: LAGG support in console port assignment (contributed by sarthurdev)  
    介面： LAGG支援控制台連接埠分配（由 sarthurdev 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: aligned the name and use of special /tmp files for internal interface handling  
    介面：統一了用於內部介面處理的特殊 /tmp 檔案的名稱和使用方式
    
-   interfaces: removed opportunistic functions find\_interface\_ip(), find\_interface\_ipv6() and find\_interface\_ipv6\_ll()  
    介面：移除了機會主義函數 find\_interface\_ip()、find\_interface\_ipv6() 和 find\_interface\_ipv6\_ll()
    
-   interfaces: get\_interface\_ip() and get\_interface\_ipv6() now return a valid IP address if one was given to support VIP aliases  
    介面：如果提供了位址，get\_interface\_ip() 和 get\_interface\_ipv6() 現在會傳回有效的IP位址，以支援VIP別名。
    
-   interfaces: interfaces\_addresses() can now map a configuration interface to returned addresses to track its origin  
    interfaces: interfaces\_addresses() 現在可以將設定介面對應到傳回的位址，以追蹤其來源
    
-   interfaces: VIPs now support the “no bind” option to exclude them from automatic service use when configured  
    介面：VIP 現在支援「不綁定」選項，以便在配置時將其從自動服務使用中排除。
    
-   interfaces: interfaces\_primary\_address() is now being used like its IPv6 equivalent throughout the code  
    interfaces: interfaces\_primary\_address() 現在在整個程式碼中都像其 IPv6 等效項一樣使用。
    
-   interfaces: interfaces\_primary\_address6() is now considering addresses from tracking interfaces when needed  
    介面：interfaces\_primary\_address6() 現在會在需要時考慮來自追蹤介面的位址。
    
-   interfaces: interfaces\_scoped\_address6() is now being used throughout the code  
    interfaces: interfaces\_scoped\_address6() 現在在整個程式碼中被使用
    
-   interfaces: “tentative” state now leads to the address being ignored during configuration like “deprecated”  
    介面：「暫定」狀態現在會導致設定期間忽略該位址，就像「已棄用」狀態一樣。
    
-   interfaces: removed unmaintained 3G statistics gathering for Huawei modems that could lock up other modems  
    介面：移除了華為數據機已停止維護的 3G 統計資料收集功能，該功能可能會導致其他數據機卡死。
    
-   interfaces: reworked interface creation on boot up  
    介面：重新設計了啟動時的介面創建
    
-   interfaces: spoof MAC now only applies to actual interface and not all of its VLAN siblings or parent  
    接口：欺騙MAC現在僅適用於實際接口，而不適用於其所有VLAN同級接口或父接口
    
-   interfaces: added permanent promiscuous mode setting  
    介面：新增永久混雜模式設置
    
-   interfaces: add the interface description via ifconfig to its respective device  
    介面：透過 ifconfig 將介面描述加入到對應的設備中。
    
-   interfaces: stop special treatment of bridge interfaces on linkup  
    介面：停止對連結連接中的橋接介面進行特殊處理
    
-   interfaces: correctly write nameserverv6 and searchdomainv6 information on dhcp6c lease acquire  
    介面：在 dhcp6c 租約取得過程中正確寫入 nameserverv6 和 searchdomainv6 訊息
    
-   interfaces: background all interface reconfiguration script hooks  
    介面：後台所有介面重配置腳本鉤子
    
-   interfaces: refactored linkup event handler to avoid unnecessary recursion in the code  
    介面：重構了 linkup 事件處理程序，以避免程式碼中不必要的遞歸。
    
-   interfaces: make cache IP files exclusive to rc.newwan and rc.newwanv6 scripts to avoid missing IP changes  
    介面：將快取IP檔案限定為 rc.newwan 和 rc.newwanv6 腳本專用，以避免遺漏IP更改
    
-   interfaces: no longer allow and apply media configuration for non-parent devices  
    介面：不再允許並套用非父設備的媒體配置
    
-   interfaces: removed restriction from interfaces without configuration to not being able to hold VIPs  
    介面：取消了未設定介面無法持有 VIP 的限制
    
-   firewall: properly kill all connections from and to a WAN IPv4 on an address change  
    防火牆：在位址變更時正確終止所有與WAN IPv4 的連接
    
-   firewall: skip rule ID for NAT type log entries (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：跳過規則ID ，用於NAT類型的日誌條目（由 kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   firewall: display interface descriptions on normalisation rules (contributed by vnxme)  
    防火牆：在規範化規則中顯示介面描述（由 vnxme 提供）
    
-   firewall: dynamic IPv6 host alias support (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    防火牆：動態 IPv6 主機別名支援（由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: removed obsolete kill states option on gateway failure  
    防火牆：移除網關故障時已過時的終止狀態選項
    
-   firewall: removed the $aliastable cache  
    防火牆：已移除 $aliastable 快取
    
-   dhcp: allow for ARM architectures in network boot options (contributed by Keith Cirkel)  
    dhcp：允許在網路啟動選項中使用ARM架構（Keith Cirkel 貢獻）
    
-   dhcp: allow router advertisements to use a specific link-local VIP alias  
    DHCP：允許路由器通告使用特定的連結本地VIP別名
    
-   dhcp: refactor the IPv4 and IPv6 configuration pages and add minimal subnet size requirement hints  
    DHCP：重構 IPv4 和 IPv6 設定頁面，並新增最小子網路大小需求提示
    
-   dnsmasq: fix all-server overwriting strict-order configuration directive (contributed by Christian Tramnitz)  
    dnsmasq：修復所有伺服器覆蓋嚴格順序配置指令的問題（由 Christian Tramnitz 貢獻）
    
-   firmware: add a “status\_reboot” variable to API return data to make clear it belongs to the offered minor update or major upgrade  
    韌體：在API返回資料中新增「status\_reboot」變量，以明確表明它屬於所提供的次要更新還是主要升級。
    
-   firmware: add random delays to existing firmware cron jobs to avoid update server load spikes  
    韌體：在現有韌體定時任務中新增隨機延遲，以避免更新伺服器負載峰值。
    
-   firmware: added an automatic cron job to fetch changelog daily to use it as a lightweight check for updates on the dashboard  
    韌體：新增了一個自動定時任務，每日取得更新日誌，以便在控制面板上進行輕量級的更新檢查。
    
-   firmware: return product info for status endpoint even when no firmware check was done  
    韌體：即使未進行韌體檢查，也應傳回狀態端點的產品資訊。
    
-   firmware: removed obsolete business repository fingerprints and added 22.1 fingerprint  
    韌體：移除過時的業務儲存庫指紋並新增22.1指紋
    
-   firmware: implement cross-ABI reinstall of all packages for future use  
    韌體：實現交叉安裝所有軟體包以備將來使用ABI
    
-   installer: fix installation of rc.conf keymap setting selected earlier during installation  
    安裝程式：修正安裝過程中先前選擇的 rc.conf 鍵盤映射設定的安裝問題
    
-   installer: improve disk and ZFS pool scan and display  
    安裝程式：改進磁碟和ZFS池掃描和顯示
    
-   installer: increase EFI partition size to 260 MB  
    安裝程式：將EFI分割區大小增加到 260 MB
    
-   installer: add EFI partition as a default mount point  
    安裝程式：將EFI分割區加入為預設掛載點
    
-   ipsec: update security of default settings when creating new phase 1 and 2  
    IPsec：建立新的第 1 階段和第 2 階段時，更新預設設定的安全性屬性。
    
-   ipsec: remove hashes and algorithms no longer supported by FreeBSD 13  
    IPsec：移除 FreeBSD 13 不再支援的雜湊和演算法
    
-   ipsec: migrated tunnel settings page to MVC  
    IPsec：隧道設定頁面已遷移至MVC
    
-   lang: update translations for Chinese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Norwegian, Spanish, and Turkish  
    語言：更新中文、法語、德語、義大利語、日語、挪威語、西班牙語和土耳其語的翻譯
    
-   lang: demote Italian to development-only language due to lowered translation ratio  
    lang：由於翻譯比例降低，將義大利語降級為僅用於開發的語言
    
-   monit: move logging to own target  
    監控：將日誌記錄移至自身目標
    
-   network time: add iburst option and stop using it by default (contributed by Patrick M. Hausen)  
    網路時間：新增 iburst 選項並停止預設使用它（由 Patrick M. Hausen 提供）
    
-   openvpn: kill by common name when kill by address does not work  
    openvpn：當按位址終止程式無法正常運作時，以通用名稱終止程式會失效
    
-   unbound: disable do-not-query-localhost on local address server use  
    unbound：停用本機位址伺服器的「請勿查詢 localhost」功能
    
-   unbound: update DNS with hostname-only static entries (contributed by Gareth Owen)  
    unbound：更新DNS ，新增僅包含主機名稱的靜態條目（由 Gareth Owen 提供）
    
-   update: opnsense-bootstrap: -z snapshot mode  
    更新：opnsense-bootstrap：-z 快照模式
    
-   update: opnsense-bootstrap: improved type detection  
    更新：opnsense-bootstrap：改進了類型檢測
    
-   update: opnsense-code: -r for repository removal  
    更新：opnsense-code：-r 用於移除儲存庫
    
-   update: opnsense-fetch: emit error message of failed download  
    更新：opnsense-fetch：發出下載失敗的錯誤訊息
    
-   update: opnsense-update: handle kernel debug directory like /boot/kernel  
    更新：opnsense-update：處理核心偵錯目錄，例如 /boot/kernel
    
-   update: opnsense-update: removed “firmware-upgrade” file support  
    更新：opnsense-update：移除了「firmware-upgrade」檔案支持
    
-   update: opnsense-verify: synced shared code with FreeBSD 13  
    更新：opnsense-verify：已與 FreeBSD 13 同步共享程式碼
    
-   backend: unify use of configctl utility  
    後端：統一使用 configctl 工具
    
-   images: removed deprecated os-dyndns plugin from default installation

    mvc：模擬版本控制，用於舊版配置部分的空節點

    mvc：向介面API加入getInterfaceConfig端點（由Paolo Asperti貢獻）

Known issues and limitations:

已知問題和限制：

-   This release contains a new major operating system version and should be carried out with the necessary care. Despite extended test coverage changes made by FreeBSD may still affect operation without our knowledge.  
    此版本包含一個新的主要作業系統版本，因此請務必謹慎操作。儘管進行了擴展測試，但 FreeBSD 所做的更改仍可能在我們不知情的情況下影響系統運行。
    
-   MAC spoofing now only pertains to the configured interface and not the VLAN siblings or parent interface. This can introduces unwanted configuration due to previous side effects in the code. Make sure to assign and set the spoofed MAC for all interfaces that require a spoofed MAC.  
    MAC欺騙現在僅適用於已配置的接口，而不適用於VLAN同級接口或父接口。由於程式碼中先前存在的副作用，這可能會引入不必要的配置。請確保為所有需要欺騙MAC的介面分配並設定欺騙MAC 。
    
-   Media settings are no longer shown for non-parent interfaces and need to be set individually to take effect. This can introduce unwanted configuration due to previous side effects in the code. If the parent interface was not previously assigned please assign it to reapply the required media settings.  
    非父介面的媒體設定不再顯示，需要單獨設定才能生效。這可能會導致程式碼中先前存在的副作用，從而引入不必要的配置。如果之前未指派父接口，請先指派父接口以重新應用所需的媒體設定。
    
-   Router advertisement static mode option is still subject to change in this release candidate series.  
    在此候選版本系列中，路由器通告靜態模式選項仍有可能變更。
    
-   IPsec hash and cipher removals in FreeBSD 13 can affect existing setups as insecure cryptographic options have been removed upstream. For more information see the FreeBSD commit in question [\[21\]](https://github.com/opnsense/src/commit/16aabb761c0a) . We will be adding an explicit configuration check to 21.7 before its end of life.  
    FreeBSD 13 中 IPsec 雜湊和加密演算法的移除可能會影響現有配置，因為上游已移除不安全的加密選項。更多資訊請參閱相關的 FreeBSD 提交 [\[21\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/src/commit/16aabb761c0a )。我們將在21.7終止維護之前為其新增明確設定檢查。
    
-   Circular logging support has been removed. No user interaction is required.  
    循環日誌記錄支援已被移除。無需用戶互動。
    
-   The migration notes are subject to change and will be extended as needed in the upcoming weeks.  
    遷移說明可能會有所更改，並將在未來幾週內根據需要進行更新。

<a id="p-016"></a>

#### 21.7 “Noble Nightingale”（高貴的南丁格爾） Series｜21.7 “Noble Nightingale”（高貴的南丁格爾）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_21.7.html>

For more than 6 and a half years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

六年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

21.7, nicknamed “Noble Nightingale”（高貴的南丁格爾）, is one of the largest iterations of code changes in our recent history. It will also be the last release on HardenedBSD 12.1. We are planning to start the work on FreeBSD 13 as soon as next week for the 22.1 series.

21.7 ，又稱“Noble Nightingale”（高貴的南丁格爾） ，是我們近期史上程式碼改動最大的版本之一。它也將是HardenedBSD 12.1上的最後一個版本。我們計劃最早於下週開始在FreeBSD 13上開發22.1系列。

The installer was replaced to offer native ZFS installations and prevent glitches in virtual machines using UEFI. Firmware updates were partially redesigned and the UI layout consolidated between static and MVC pages. The live log now contains the actual rule ID to avoid mismatches after adjusting your ruleset and the firewall aliases now also support wildcard netmasks. For a complete list of changes see below.

安裝程式已更新，以提供原生安裝ZFS ，並防止虛擬機器在使用UEFI時發生故障。韌體更新部分重新設計，靜態頁面和MVC頁面之間的佈局也進行了整合UI ）。即時日誌現在包含實際規則ID ，以避免在調整規則集後出現不符的情況，防火牆別名現在也支援通配符子網路遮罩。有關完整的更改列表，請參見下文。

##### 21.7.8 (January 27, 2022)｜21.7.8 （2022年1月27日）

To improve migration to the next version we are releasing this update back to back with 22.1. There is no immediate need to upgrade so plenty of time to read and prepare.

為了方便用戶遷移到下一版本，我們將此次更新與22.1緊接著發布。目前無需立即升級，因此您有充足的時間閱讀和準備。

Suffice to say this will be the last update of the 21.7 series. Thank you and see you on the other side. :)

總之，這將是21.7系列的最後一次更新。感謝大家，我們後會有期。 :)

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: remove spurious XML validation that cannot cope with attributes from backup restore  
    系統：移除無法處理備份復原屬性的虛假XML驗證
    
-   system: prevent syslog-ng from crashing after update due to “syslog-ng-ctl reload” use  
    系統：防止 syslog-ng 在更新後因「syslog-ng-ctl reload」指令而崩潰
    
-   reporting: fix display of total in/out traffic values  
    報告：修復總進出流量值的顯示問題
    
-   firewall: removed the $aliastable cache  
    防火牆：已移除 $aliastable 快取
    
-   firewall: correctly handle IPv6 NAT in states view  
    防火牆：在狀態視圖中正確處理 IPv6 NAT
    
-   firewall: skip rule ID for NAT type log entries (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：跳過規則ID ，用於NAT類型的日誌條目（由 kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   firewall: support “no scrub” option in normalisation rules  
    防火牆：支援規範化規則中的「no scrub」選項
    
-   network time: remove PID file use as it can be unreliable  
    網路時間：移除PID文件，因為它可能不可靠。
    
-   intrusion detection: update to ET-Open to version 6  
    入侵偵測：更新至ET - 開放至版本 6
    
-   intrusion detection: prevent config migration from crashing

##### 21.7.7 (December 15, 2021)｜21.7.7 （2021年12月15日）

End-of-the-year security and reliability update coming right up!

年末安全性和可靠性更新即將發布！

Due to inconclusive reports we are disabling the Netmap API version 14 support in Suricata to get a better understanding of the situation. The plan still is to keep it for the 22.1 upgrade and it has in fact been enabled on the development versions since September without any obvious issues.

由於收到的報告尚無定論，我們暫時在 Suricata 中停用 Netmap API版本 14 的支持，以便更好地了解情況。我們仍計劃在22.1升級時保留該支持，事實上，自 9 月以來，該支持已在開發版本中啟用，且未出現任何明顯問題。

The upgrade to 22.1-BETA3 is also included in the bundled development version.

22.1-BETA3的升級也包含在捆綁的開發版本中。

##### 21.7.6 (November 25, 2021)｜21.7.6 （2021年11月25日）

This smallish update introduces Suricata 5-based versions for Emerging Threats rulesets as well as shipping the latest Suricata 6.0.4 with an additional change for the Netmap API version 14. Please do let us know how that impacts your IPS performance numbers via the forum if you notice anything.

這次小更新引入了基於 Suricata 5 的新興威脅規則集版本，並發布了最新的 Suricata 6.0.4 ，同時對 Netmap API版本 14 進行了額外更改。如果您發現任何影響，請透過論壇告知我們IPS的性能數據。

The upgrade to 22.1-BETA2 is also included in the bundled development version.

22.1-BETA2的升級也包含在捆綁的開發版本中。

##### 21.7.5 (November 11, 2021)｜21.7.5 （2021年11月11日）

FreeBSD security advisories and an issue with Intel-based ixgbe driver with “ifconfig -v” stalls keep this release rolling. Also note that OpenSSH was updated to version 8.8 which deprecates ssh-rsa usage which is mainly an issue for client access from the OPNsense system to the outside and can be amended as per the suggestions in the respective release notes.

FreeBSD 安全性公告以及基於 Intel 的 ixgbe 驅動程式在使用「ifconfig -v」命令時出現的問題導致此版本發布延遲。另請注意，OpenSSH 已更新至8.8版本，該版本棄用了 ssh-rsa 的使用，這主要影響 OPNsense 系統客戶端對外部網路的訪問，您可以根據相應版本說明中的建議進行修改。

And as promised the development version includes the upgrade path to the 22.1-BETA1 release. This will be an online-beta with a few iterations over the FreeBSD 13 stable branch and eventually move to FreeBSD 13.1 release as that becomes available.

正如承諾的那樣，開發版本包含了升級到22.1-BETA1版本的路徑。這將是一個線上測試版，基於FreeBSD 13穩定分支進行幾次迭代，最終將在FreeBSD 13.1版本發布後遷移到該版本。

Highlights for 22.1 already include:

22.1的亮點包括：

-   Suricata Netmap version 14 support for multi-gigabit speed in IPS mode with RSS enabled  
    Suricata Netmap 版本 14 支援在啟用RSS的情況下， IPS模式下的多千兆速度。
    
-   Separate VLAN MAC spoofing and permanent promiscuous mode setting  
    單獨的VLAN MAC欺騙和永久混雜模式設置
    
-   Tunable analytics provide automatic descriptions and type  
    可調分析提供自動描述和類型
    
-   IPsec tunnel overview ported to MVC with pagination  
    IPsec隧道概覽已移植到MVC ，並附有分頁功能
    
-   Proofpoint Emerging Threats rules for Suricata 5.0  
    Proofpoint Emerging Threats 針對 Suricata 的規則5.0
    
-   Removed opportunistic interface address read functions  
    移除了機會主義介面位址讀取功能
    
-   Console-based LAGG configuration support  
    基於控制台的LAGG配置支持
    
-   Removed state killing on gateway failure feature  
    移除了網關故障時終止狀態的功能
    
-   Improved firmware update capabilities  
    改進的韌體更新功能
    
-   No-bind service awareness for virtual IPs  
    虛擬IP的無綁定服務感知
    
-   FreeBSD 13 stable branch  
    FreeBSD 13 穩定分支
    
-   RFC 5424 and severity support in logs  
    RFC 5424 和日誌中的嚴重性支持
    
-   Clog support has been removed  
    堵塞支撐已被移除
    
-   And more…  
    還有更多…
    

Please note that the beta version will always be available for upgrade when switching to the development version. At this point no stable packages are provided and this includes plugins. These will become available as the release candidate is released in early January 2022.

請注意，切換到開發版本時，您始終可以升級到測試版。目前，尚未提供任何穩定軟體包，包括插件。這些軟體包將在 2022 年 1 月初發布候選版本時提供。

All feedback is welcome but keep in mind that there are still a number of moving parts ahead. Upgrade responsibly.

歡迎所有回饋，但請記住，後續還有許多環節需要調整。請謹慎升級。

Here are the full patch notes for version 21.7.5:

    系統：正確提取密鑰 ID 字串（kulikov-a 貢獻）

##### 21.7.4 (October 27, 2021)｜21.7.4 （2021年10月27日）

This update features three new major things: optional receive side scaling (RSS) support in the kernel, asynchronous DNS resolving for aliases and configuration support for advanced LAGG settings.

本次更新包含三個主要新功能：核心中可選的接收端縮放（ RSS ）支援、別名的非同步DNS解析以及對進階LAGG設定的設定支援。

RSS is disabled by default but may be switched on by adding a tunable “net.inet.rss.enabled” with value “1” and rebooting the system. While RSS can improve performance for certain hardware it should be used with care at this point and is not generally recommended yet! The Suricata version bundled with the development release offers the upcoming API bindings to take advantage of the RSS-based multithreading. Also please note that PPPoE cannot take advantage of RSS.

RSS 預設情況下處於停用狀態，但可以透過新增值為「1」的可調式「net.inet.rss.enabled」並重新啟動系統來開啟。雖然 RSS 可以提高某些硬體的性能，但此時應謹慎使用，並且一般不建議使用！與開發版本捆綁在一起的 Suricata 版本提供即將推出的 API 綁定，以利用基於 RSS 的多線程。另請注意，PPPoE 無法利用RSS。

On the side we are almost ready for our 22.1-BETA preview with rolling releases for the development release type which is something new to look forward to also.

另一方面，我們的22.1-BETA預覽版也即將推出，開發版本類型將採用滾動發布的方式，這也是一個值得期待的新功能。

##### 21.7.3 (September 22, 2021)｜21.7.3 （2021年9月22日）

This release finally brings in Suricata version 6 as well as OpenVPN tls-crypt support, automatic user creation on LDAP-based logins and more.

此版本最終引入了 Suricata 版本 6，以及 OpenVPN tls-crypt 支援、基於LDAP的登入自動建立使用者等功能。

As a general note the Realtek vendor driver currently bundled with the base system will be moved to a plugin-based kernel module in version 22.1 and the original re(4) driver inside FreeBSD 13 will be restored. To ease migration and because the version maintained in FreeBSD ports actually offers additional fixes we have included the new plugin into this build.

需要說明的是，目前與基礎系統捆綁的 Realtek 廠商驅動程式將在22.1版本中遷移到基於插件的核心模組，而 FreeBSD 13 中原有的 re(4) 驅動程式將會恢復。為了簡化遷移，並且由於 FreeBSD ports 中維護的版本實際上提供了額外的修復，我們已將新外掛程式包含在此版本中。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: allow automatic user creation on LDAP-based logins  
    系統：允許基於LDAP登入自動建立用戶
    
-   interfaces: add and use unified function is\_interface\_assigned() to prevent deleting assigned interfaces  
    介面：新增並使用統一函數 is\_interface\_assigned() 以防止刪除已指派的介面
    
-   interfaces: sync firewall groups after internal create/destroy operations  
    介面：在內部建立/刪除操作後同步防火牆組
    
-   interfaces: add netstat tree search and improve page layout  
    介面：新增 netstat 樹搜尋並改進頁面佈局
    
-   interfaces: replace opportunistic diagnostics IP address lookups with more robust variants  
    介面：用更強大的變體取代機會性診斷IP位址查找

##### 21.7.2 (September 07, 2021)｜21.7.2 （2021年9月7日）

Today the following CVEs are being addressed:

今天正在處理以下 CVE：

CVE-2021-3711, CVE-2021-3712, CVE-2021-23840, CVE-2021-23841

Please note that the Let’s Encrypt client plugin is now called ACME client since acme.sh version 3 does support multiple providers.

請注意，由於 acme.sh 版本 3 支援多個提供者，因此 Let's Encrypt 用戶端插件現在稱為ACME客戶端。

Apart from the usual batch of fixes the work on RSS (receive side scaling) is progressing and groundwork has already made it to the kernel along with the libnetmap library for allowing better scaling in netmap mode along with it. At this point, however, RSS is not yet enabled and there is no impact on existing setups. That will likely change with one of the next stable versions in this series.

除了常規的修復之外， RSS （接收端縮放）的工作也在穩步推進，相關的基礎工作已經合併到內核中，libnetmap 庫也隨之合併，從而實現了 netmap 模式下更好的縮放效果。然而，目前RSS尚未啟用，對現有配置沒有影響。這種情況可能會在本系列的下一個穩定版本中改變。

On the other hand, the work for FreeBSD 13 migration in 22.1 is ongoing as well to be able to test this rather sooner than later. In this iteration we will take the time to look at shared forwarding edge cases and have already upstreamed a number of patches that have been accumulated over the last couple of years to keep our code base light and tidy.

另一方面， 22.1中針對 FreeBSD 13 的遷移工作也在進行中，以便盡快進行測試。在這個版本中，我們將花時間研究共享轉發的極端情況，並且已經將過去幾年累積的多個補丁提交到上游，以保持程式碼庫的輕量級和整潔。
