##### 21.7.1 (August 04, 2021)｜21.7.1 （2021年8月4日）

After some initial trouble with particular Intel network card instability and two installer shortcomings this brings the first round of stable updates, general improvements and even new features.

在經歷了英特爾網卡穩定性問題和兩個安裝程序缺陷等最初一些問題之後，此次更新帶來了第一輪穩定更新、整體改進，甚至還有一些新功能。

The OpenVPN integration required a few more changes for the 2.5 series and Unbound would stall when the new cache restore feature was caching an empty response.

OpenVPN 整合需要對2.5系列進行一些更改，當新的快取復原功能快取空響應時，Unbound 會停止運作。

Images have been reissued based on this version as well.

基於此版本，圖片也已重新發布。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 21.7 (July 28, 2021)｜21.7 （2021年7月28日）

For more than 6 and a half years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

六年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

21.7, nicknamed “Noble Nightingale”（高貴的南丁格爾）, is one of the largest iterations of code changes in our recent history. It will also be the last release on HardenedBSD 12.1. We are planning to start the work on FreeBSD 13 as soon as next week for the 22.1 series.

21.7 ，又稱“Noble Nightingale”（高貴的南丁格爾） ，是我們近期歷史上程式碼改動最大的版本之一。它也將是 HardenedBSD 12.1的最後一個版本。我們計劃最早於下週開始 FreeBSD 13 的22.1系列的開發工作。

The installer was replaced to offer native ZFS installations and prevent glitches in virtual machines using UEFI. Firmware updates were partially redesigned and the UI layout consolidated between static and MVC pages. The live log now contains the actual rule ID to avoid mismatches after adjusting your ruleset and the firewall aliases now also support wildcard netmasks. For a complete list of changes see below.

安裝程式已更新，以提供原生安裝ZFS ，並防止虛擬機器在使用UEFI時發生故障。韌體更新部分重新設計，靜態頁面和MVC頁面之間的佈局也進行了整合UI ）。即時日誌現在包含實際規則ID ，以避免在調整規則集後出現不符的情況，防火牆別名現在也支援通配符子網路遮罩。有關完整的更改列表，請參見下文。

Download links, an installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

-   system: raised PHP memory limit to 1G

-   system: raised encryption standard for encrypted config.xml export

##### 21.7.r2 (July 14, 2021)｜21.7 .r2（2021年7月14日）

For more than 6 and a half years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

六年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you. <3

我們感謝大家幫助測試、塑造該專案並為該專案做出貢獻！我們知道如果沒有你，一切都會不一樣。 <3

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: prevent use of client certificates in web GUI  
    系統：阻止在 Web 中使用客戶端憑證GUI
    
-   system: hide far gateway option for IPv6  
    系統：隱藏 IPv6 的遠端閘道選項
    
-   system: isvalidpid() is not required for a single killbypid()  
    系統：對於單一 killbypid() 操作，不需要 isvalidpid() 函數。
    
-   system: fix PHP 7.4 deprecated warning in IPv6 library  
    系統：修正 IPv6 函式庫中已棄用的警告PHP 7.4
    
-   system: do not split XMLRPC password into multiple pieces  
    系統提示：請勿將XMLRPC密碼拆分成多個部分
    
-   system: enable group sync for LDAP servers that do not return memberOf (contributed by rdd2)  
    系統：為不傳回 memberOf 的LDAP伺服器啟用群組同步（由 rdd2 提供）
    
-   interfaces: deprecate SLAAC addresses on linkdown  
    介面：連結斷開時棄用SLAAC位址
    
-   firewall: possibility to filter nat/rdr action in live log  
    防火牆：可在即時日誌中過濾 NAT/RDR 操作
    
-   firewall: use permanent promiscuous mode for pflog0  
    防火牆：對 pflog0 使用永久混雜模式
    
-   dhcp: assorted improvements surrounding dhcpd\_staticmap() for real world operation  
    dhcp：圍繞 dhcpd\_staticmap() 的各種改進，以適應實際運作。
    
-   firmware: static template for firmware upgrade message  
    韌體：韌體升級訊息的靜態模板
    
-   installer: assorted wording improvements  
    安裝程序：各種措詞改進
    
-   shell: fix IPv4 /31 assignment

-   unbound: add “unbound check” backend action  
    unbound：新增「unbound 檢查」後端操作
    
-   unbound: allow to retain cache on service reload  
    未綁定：允許在服務重新載入時保留快取
    
-   unbound: fix /var MFS dilemma for DNSBL after boot  
    unbound：修復啟動後 /var MFS與DNSBL之間的衝突
    
-   unbound: remove deprecated custom options setting  
    unbound：移除已棄用的自訂選項設置

    rc：opnsense-beep 旋律資料庫目錄

Here are the full patch notes against 21.1.7:

以下是21.1.7完整更新說明：

-   system: Norwegian translation (contributed by Stein-Aksel Basma)  
    系統：挪威文翻譯（由 Stein-Aksel Basma 提供）
    
-   system: correctly enforce “Disable writing log files to the local disk” when circular logs are not used  
    系統：當不使用循環日誌時，正確強制執行「停用將日誌檔案寫入本機磁碟」。
    
-   system: allow to edit gateway entries with non-conforming names  
    系統：允許編輯名稱不符合規範的網關條目
    
-   system: add HA sync entry for live log templates  
    系統：為即時日誌範本新增HA同步條目
    
-   system: lock config writes during HA merges  
    系統：在HA合併期間鎖定配置寫入
    
-   system: raised PHP memory limit to 1G  
    系統：將PHP記憶體限制提升至 1G
    
-   system: raised encryption standard for encrypted config.xml export  
    系統：提高了加密 config.xml 匯出檔案的加密標準
    
-   system: removed NextCloud backup from core functionality  
    系統：已從核心功能移除 NextCloud 備份
    
-   system: allow more characters in the certificate/authority organization fields (contributed by Jan De Luyck)  
    系統：允許在證書/頒發機構組織欄位中使用更多字元（由 Jan De Luyck 提供）
    
-   system: default gateway failure state killing is now disabled by default  
    系統：預設網關故障狀態終止功能現已預設為停用
    
-   system: circular logs are now disabled by default  
    系統：循環日誌現已預設為停用。
    
-   system: removed unused traffic API dashboard feed  
    系統：已移除未使用的流量API儀錶板饋送
    
-   interfaces: improve GRE/GIF configuration handling and dynamic reload behaviour  
    介面：改進GRE/GIF配置處理與動態重載行為
    
-   interfaces: remove duplicated handling of PPP IPv6 interface detection  
    介面：移除對PPP IPv6介面偵測的重複處理
    
-   interfaces: refactored address removal into interfaces\_addresses\_flush()  
    介面：將位址移除重構到 interfaces\_addresses\_flush() 中
    
-   interfaces: flush IPv6 addresses on the correct IPv6 interface when it differs from the IPv4 interface  
    介面：當 IPv6 位址與 IPv4 位址不同時，在正確的 IPv6 介面上刷新 IPv6 位址。
    
-   interfaces: do not check for existing CARP interfaces midstream  
    接口：不要在中途檢查現有的CARP接口
    
-   interfaces: remove non-tunnel restriction from address collection  
    介面：從位址集合中移除非隧道限制
    
-   interfaces: set tunnel flag for IPv4 tunnel plus cleanups  
    介面：設定 IPv4 隧道標誌並進行清理
    
-   interfaces: allow interface-based overrides of hardware checksum settings  
    介面：允許基於介面覆蓋硬體校驗和設定
    
-   interfaces: refactor DNS lookup and add PTR to output (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面：重構DNS查找並新增PTR到輸出（由 Maurice Walker 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: set label for obsolete rule in live log (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：為即時日誌中已過時的規則設定標籤（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: MVC rewrite of the states diagnostics pages under “States”（各州）  
    防火牆： MVC重寫“States”（各州）下的狀態診斷頁面
    
-   firewall: renamed “pfTables” diagnostics to “Aliases”（別名）  
    防火牆：將「pfTables」診斷程式重新命名為“Aliases”（別名）
    
-   firewall: add quick link to states counter from firewall rule inspection  
    防火牆：在防火牆規則檢查中新增指向狀態計數器的快速鏈接
    
-   firewall: add manual reply-to configuration to rules  
    防火牆：為規則新增手動回覆配置
    
-   firewall: delete related rules when an interface group is removed  
    防火牆：移除介面群組時刪除相關規則
    
-   firewall: rename source/destination networks when group name changes  
    防火牆：當群組名稱更改時重新命名來源/目標網絡
    
-   dhcp: remove ::/0 route from router advertisements (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    dhcp：從路由器通告中移除 ::/0 路由（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   dhcp: always deprecate prefixes in automatic router advertisements  
    DHCP：始終棄用自動路由器通告中的前綴
    
-   dhcp: fix table header sorting in lease pages (contributed by vnxme)  
    DHCP：修復租約頁面中的表頭排序問題（由 vnxme 提供）
    
-   dhcp: lock access to settings pages when interface is not suitable for running a DHCP server  
    DHCP：當介面不適合運行DHCP伺服器時，鎖定對設定頁面的訪問
    
-   firmware: introduced connectivity check  
    韌體：新增連接性檢查
    
-   firmware: confirm plugin removal dialog  
    韌體：確認插件移除對話框
    
-   intrusion detection: fix alert reads from eve.json  
    入侵偵測：修復從 eve.json 讀取警報的問題
    
-   ipsec: adhere to system defaults for route-to and reply-to when creating automatic VPN rules  
    IPsec：建立自動VPN規則時，路由位址和回覆位址應遵循系統預設值。
    
-   ipsec: switched to explicit type selection for identities  
    IPsec：已切換至身分的明確類型選擇
    
-   network time: added NTPD client mode  
    網路時間：已新增NTPD客戶端模式
    
-   openvpn: offer the ability to export a user without a certificate  
    OpenVPN：提供無需憑證即可匯出使用者的功能
    
-   openvpn: increase consistency between export types  
    openvpn：提高導出類型之間的一致性
    
-   unbound: fix domain overrides for private address reverse lookup zones (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    unbound：修正私有位址反向查找區域的網域覆蓋問題（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   mvc: reduce differentials in config.xml when saving models

#### 21.1 “Marvelous Meerkat”（奇妙的狐狸獴） Series｜21.1 “Marvelous Meerkat”（奇妙的狐狸獴）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_21.1.html>

For more than 6 years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

6 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

21.1, nicknamed “Marvelous Meerkat”（奇妙的狐狸獴）, is the relentless continuation of open source dedication. The last 6 years were not always easy, but we are happy to be where we are now and have the community to thank for it.

21.1 ，又稱“Marvelous Meerkat”（奇妙的狐狸獴） ，是對開源奉獻精神的不懈延續。過去的六年並非一帆風順，但我們很高興能取得今天的成就，並衷心感謝社區的支持。

New and improved are the firewall rules and NAT categories, the traffic graphs supporting IPv6 along with a visual refresh, intrusion detection rule management by policies, an alias for MAC addresses and NAT over IPsec with all phase 2 you could ever want. Last but not least, the serial image now supports UEFI as well.

新增和改進的功能包括防火牆規則和NAT類別、支援IPv6的流量圖表（並進行了視覺刷新）、基於策略的入侵檢測規則管理、 MAC地址別名以及支援所有您可能需要的基於IPsec的NAT第二階段功能。最後，串行鏡像現在也支援UEFI 。

For those wondering, the WireGuard plugin has been available since 2019 and receives continuous improvements by its maintainer and various users alike. And that is unlikely to change in the future. ;)

如果你好奇的話，WireGuard 外掛自 2019 年發布以來，一直由其維護者和眾多用戶持續改進。而且這種情況在未來不太可能改變。 ;)

As we continue to deprecate custom configuration inputs for a number of reasons, Dnsmasq has been switched to a pluggable file-based approach [\[1\]](#p-194) with Unbound to follow in the upcoming 21.7 series.

由於多種原因，我們繼續棄用自訂設定輸入，Dnsmasq 已切換到可插拔的基於文件的方法 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/dnsmasq.html )，Unbound 將在即將到來的21.7系列中跟進。

##### 21.1.7 (June 16, 2021)｜21.1.7 （2021年6月16日）

Today we move to Phalcon version 4 along with new FreeBSD security advisories and fixes for firewall live log as well as new features such as shell timeout and TLS remote syslog.

今天，我們將升級到 Phalcon 版本 4，同時也發布了新的 FreeBSD 安全公告，修復了防火牆即時日誌問題，並新增了 shell 逾時和TLS遠端系統日誌等功能。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: add shell inactivity timeout feature for csh/tcsh  
    系統：為 csh/tcsh 新增 shell 非活動逾時功能
    
-   system: add Syslog-ng TLS transport options  
    系統：新增 Syslog-ng TLS傳輸選項
    
-   system: remove unrelated service restarts from filter\_configure\_xmlrpc()  
    系統：從 filter\_configure\_xmlrpc() 中移除無關的服務重新啟動
    
-   system: rotate interface statistics widget (contributed by FingerlessGloves)  
    系統：旋轉介面統計小工具（由 FingerlessGloves 提供）
    
-   system: delete previous route when changed  
    系統：更改時刪除先前的路由
    
-   system: make web GUI restart action usable in cron jobs (contributed by Frank Wall)  
    系統：使 web GUI重啟操作可在 cron 作業中使用（由 Frank Wall 提供）
    
-   interfaces: interface\_configure() checks for enabled already  
    介面：interface\_configure() 檢查是否已啟用
    
-   interfaces: system match for primary address only works with compressed IPv6  
    介面：系統比對主位址僅適用於壓縮 IPv6
    
-   interfaces: disable legacy CSRF output buffering when downloading a packet capture  
    介面：下載資料包擷取時停用舊版CSRF輸出緩衝
    
-   interfaces: execute OpenVPN device creation earlier during boot  
    介面：在啟動過程中更早執行 OpenVPN 設備創建
    
-   firewall: change live log address/port group matcher to correctly flip logic  
    防火牆：變更即時日誌位址/連接埠組匹配器，以正確切換邏輯
    
-   firewall: explicit default for filter rule association in NAT port forwards  
    防火牆： NAT連接埠轉送中過濾規則關聯的明確預設值
    
-   firewall: prevent controls overlap in live log (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：防止即時日誌中的控制重疊（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: let live log use the newly provided rule log label instead of guessing it  
    防火牆：允許即時日誌使用新提供的規則日誌標籤，而不是猜測。
    
-   firewall: calculate wildcard netmasks in aliases

-   captive portal: fix GUI drop session issue

    韌體：在系統小工具中顯示待更新提示
    
-   firmware: allow manual development override on business subscription  
    韌體：允許手動開發覆蓋企業訂閱
    
-   intrusion detection: add YAML tag to custom.yaml.sample  
    入侵偵測：在 custom.yaml.sample 檔案中加入YAML標籤
    
-   openvpn: return “result” instead of “status” in export  
    openvpn：匯出時回傳「result」而不是「status」。
    
-   unbound: honour space as “domainsearchlist” separator  
    unbound：將空格作為「domainsearchlist」分隔符
    
-   lang: updated available translations

-   mvc: migrated framework to Phalcon 4  
    MVC：已將框架遷移到 Phalcon 4

    mvc：如果適用，則在 ApiMutableModelControllerBase::validateAndSave() 中傳回UUID

    rc：在 rc.syshook 啟動設施時無條件設定路由

##### 21.1.6 (May 27, 2021)｜21.1.6 （2021年5月27日）

With a bit of delay we bring to you the usual mix of security and reliability updates. It is of note that the OpenVPN advisory tracked as CVE-2020-15078 does not affect the provided version 2.4.11, but the security audit will falsely flag it as vulnerable because the source of the audit is FreeBSD where OpenVPN was migrated to 2.5 series already.

我們稍有延遲地為您帶來常規的安全性和可靠性更新。需要注意的是，編號為CVE -2020-15078的OpenVPN安全公告並不影響所提供的2.4.11版本，但由於該安全審計的來源是FreeBSD，而OpenVPN在FreeBSD上已經遷移到了2.5系列存在於該版本。

Plans for upcoming 21.1.x versions include a swift Phalcon 4 migration as well as Python 3.8 and PHP 7.4 updates.

即將推出的21.1 .x 版本計劃包括快速遷移 Phalcon 4 以及 Python 3.8和PHP 7.4更新。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 21.1.5 (April 21, 2021)｜21.1.5 （2021年4月21日）

This is mainly a security and reliablility update. There are several FreeBSD security advisories and updates for third party tools such as curl.

本次更新主要涉及安全性和可靠性。 FreeBSD 發布了多項安全公告，並更新了 curl 等第三方工具。

The historic bsdinstaller has been replaced by a scriptable alternative based on the readily available bsdinstall bundled with the base system. And, yes, this brings ZFS installer support into the upcoming 21.7 release.

傳統的 bsdinstaller 已被基於基礎系統自帶的 bsdinstall 的可腳本化替代方案所取代。而且，即將發布的21.7版本也將支援ZFS安裝程式。

On the development side the migration to Phalcon 4 framework is now underway and brings improved UI/API responsiveness. One of the remaining road map goals is the migration to PHP 7.4 which can be carried out after said framework update is complete and released.

在開發方面，向 Phalcon 4 框架的遷移工作正在進行中，這將帶來更佳的UI/API響應速度。路線圖上的剩餘目標之一是向PHP 7.4遷移，這將在該框架更新完成並發布後進行。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 21.1.4 (March 30, 2021)｜21.1.4 （2021年3月30日）

The third party crypto libraries need patching so here we go! The number of user contributions and interaction regarding stability fixes and improvements from the OPNsense side seems to be picking up as well and that is great to see.

第三方加密庫需要打補丁，所以讓我們開始吧！ OPNsense 方面關於穩定性修復和改進的用戶貢獻和互動數量似乎也在增加，這真是個好消息。

The development version includes an update of Suricata to version 6.0.2 in case any of you want to try it out. Also, improvements in the DHCP static mapping can now deal with IPv6 prefix merge for such deployments using Unbound and Dnsmasq host registration.

開發版本包含 Suricata 的更新，版本號碼為6.0.2供有興趣的使用者試用。此外， DHCP靜態映射的改進現在可以處理使用 Unbound 和 Dnsmasq 主機註冊的部署中的 IPv6 前綴合併問題。

In the past 3 months we have also been working on a business edition relaunch and now feel obligated to quickly present the results of these efforts:

過去三個月，我們一直在進行企業版產品的重新發布工作，現在有義務盡快向大家展示這些努力的成果：

The upcoming release of the business edition will be versioned as 21.4 in order to decouple it from the community release cycle. To that end–and to stay true to open source–we have published the release engineering core branch for said business release [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/commits/stable/21.4) .

即將發布的商業版版本號將為21.4 ，以便與社區發布週期解耦。為此，為了秉持開源精神，我們發布了這個商業版的發布工程核心分支[\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/core/commits/stable/21.4 )。

You will see more distinction between “community” and “business” in communication, but the basic approach of a more conservative release cycle in volume and timing for the business edition remains the same. On top of this, the business edition also offers additional plugins, e.g. for central management tasks.

在溝通方面，您會看到「社群版」和「企業版」之間更明顯的區分，但企業版在發布數量和時間安排上採取更為保守的發布週期這一基本原則保持不變。此外，企業版還提供額外的插件，例如用於集中管理任務的插件。

##### 21.1.3 (March 10, 2021)｜21.1.3 （2021年3月10日）

Today we move ahead with the firmware UI and API rework as we are happy with the new user experience. You will also notice the new plugin conflict dialog which will report that plugins have been installed previously but not registered in the configuration. This can be easily amended by resetting the local conflicts, which essentially accepts the current plugin configuration as the new default. This necessary change introduces API incompatibilities with existing external tools.

今天，我們將繼續推進韌體UI和API的重構工作，因為我們對新的用戶體驗感到滿意。您還會注意到新增的插件衝突對話框，該對話框會提示某些插件之前已安裝但未在配置中註冊。您可以透過重設本機衝突輕鬆解決此問題，此操作會將目前的外掛程式配置設定為新的預設值。這項必要的變更會導致API與現有外部工具不相容。

The HAProxy plugin was updated to version 3.0. This release marks the switch to the HAProxy 2.2 release series, which may result in incompatible changes for some users. Many new features were also added, including the possibility to update SSL certificates in runtime. These features should be considered experimental. We encourage everyone to install this version in a test environment before using it in production. As usual, please have a look at the plugin changes [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/21.1/net/haproxy/pkg-descr) and report bugs on GitHub.

HAProxy 插件已更新至3.0版本。此版本標誌著 HAProxy 向2.2系列版本過渡，部分用戶可能會遇到相容性問題。此外，也新增了許多功能，包括運行時更新SSL憑證的功能。這些功能目前仍處於實驗階段。我們建議所有使用者在生產環境中使用此版本之前，先在測試環境中進行測試。與往常一樣，請查看插件變更 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/21.1/net/haproxy/pkg-descr ) 並在 GitHub 上提交錯誤報告。

##### 21.1.2 (February 23, 2021)｜21.1.2 （2021年2月23日）

Please do enjoy this round of timely crypto library updates and other reliability fixes.

請盡情享受本次及時的加密庫更新和其他可靠性修復。

Work has so far been focused on the firmware update process to ensure its safety around edge cases and recovery methods for the worst case. To that end 21.1.3 will likely receive the full revamp including API and GUI changes for a swift transition after thorough testing of the changes now available in the development package of this release.

目前的工作重點是韌體更新流程，以確保其在極端情況下的安全性以及最壞情況下的恢復方法。為此， 21.1.3可能會進行全面改進，包括API和GUI的更改，以便在對當前版本開發包中提供的更改進行徹底測試後，實現快速過渡。

##### 21.1 (January 28, 2021)｜21.1 （2021年1月28日）

For more than 6 years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

6 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

21.1, nicknamed “Marvelous Meerkat”（奇妙的狐狸獴）, is the relentless continuation of open source dedication. The last 6 years were not always easy, but we are happy to be where we are now and have the community to thank for it.

21.1 ，又稱“Marvelous Meerkat”（奇妙的狐狸獴） ，是對開源奉獻精神的不懈延續。過去的六年並非一帆風順，但我們很高興能取得今天的成就，並衷心感謝社區的支持。

New and improved are the firewall rules and NAT categories, the traffic graphs supporting IPv6 along with a visual refresh, intrusion detection rule management by policies, an alias for MAC addresses and NAT over IPsec with all phase 2 you could ever want. Last but not least, the serial image now supports UEFI as well.

新增和改進的功能包括防火牆規則和NAT類別、支援IPv6的流量圖表（並進行了視覺刷新）、基於策略的入侵檢測規則管理、 MAC地址別名以及支援所有您可能需要的IPsec第二階段NAT 。最後，串行鏡像現在也支援UEFI 。

For those wondering, the WireGuard plugin has been available since 2019 and receives continuous improvements by its maintainer and various users alike. And that is unlikely to change in the future. ;)

如果你好奇的話，WireGuard 外掛自 2019 年發布以來，一直由其維護者和眾多用戶持續改進。而且這種情況在未來不太可能改變。 ;)

As we continue to deprecate custom configuration inputs for a number of reasons, Dnsmasq has been switched to a pluggable file-based approach [\[1\]](#p-194) with Unbound to follow in the upcoming 21.7 series.

由於多種原因，我們繼續棄用自訂設定輸入，Dnsmasq 已切換到可插拔的基於文件的方法 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/dnsmasq.html )，Unbound 將在即將到來的21.7系列中跟進。

Download links, an installation guide [\[2\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

##### 21.1.r1 (January 13, 2021)｜21.1 .r1（2021年1月13日）

For more than 6 years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

6 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you. <3

我們感謝大家幫助測試、塑造該專案並為該專案做出貢獻！我們知道如果沒有你，一切都會不一樣。 <3

Here are the full patch notes against 20.7.7\_1:

以下是20.7.7 \_1的完整補丁說明：

-   system: use authentication factory for web GUI login  
    系統：使用認證工廠進行 Web 登入GUI
    
-   system: allow case-insensitive matching for LDAP user authentication  
    系統：允許對LDAP用戶身份驗證進行不區分大小寫的匹配
    
-   system: removed unused gateway API dashboard feed  
    系統：已移除未使用的閘道API儀錶板饋送
    
-   system: removed spurious comma from certificate subject print and unified underlying code  
    系統：從憑證主題列印中移除多餘的逗號，並統一底層程式碼
    
-   system: harden web GUI defaults to TLS 1.2 minimum and strong ciphers  
    系統：增強 Web GUI預設使用TLS 1.2最低限度的強密碼
    
-   system: generate a better self-signed certificate for web GUI default  
    系統：為 Web GUI預設產生更好的自簽名憑證
    
-   system: allow self-signed renew for web GUI default (using “configctl webgui restart renew”)  
    系統：允許 web GUI預設進行自簽名續訂（使用「configctl webgui restart renew」）
    
-   system: allow subdirectories in NextCloud backup (contributed by Lorenzo Milesi)  
    系統：允許在 NextCloud 備份中使用子目錄（由 Lorenzo Milesi 提供）
    
-   system: optionally allow TOTP users to regenerate a token from the password page  
    系統：可選地允許TOTP用戶從密碼頁面重新產生令牌
    
-   system: set default certificate lifetime to 397 days  
    系統：將預設憑證有效期限設定為 397 天
    
-   system: relax gateway name validation  
    系統：放寬網關名稱驗證
    
-   system: display destination port number in firewall log widget (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    系統：在防火牆日誌小工具中顯示目標連接埠號碼（由 Team Rebellion 提供）
    
-   system: allow to recover from bad TLS certificate and/or bad settings in console interface assign  
    系統：允許從錯誤的TLS憑證和/或控制台介面指派中的錯誤設定中恢復
    
-   interfaces: defer IPv6 disable in interface code to ensure PPP interfaces do exist  
    介面：延遲在介面程式碼中停用 IPv6，以確保PPP確實存在。
    
-   interfaces: no longer assume configuration-less interfaces can reach static setup code  
    介面：不再假設無配置介面可以存取靜態設定代碼
    
-   interfaces: fix PPP links not linking to linked advanced configuration  
    介面：修復PPP連結未連結到連結的進階配置
    
-   firewall: add live log “host”, “port” and “not” filters  
    防火牆：新增即時日誌「主機」、「連接埠」和「非」過濾器
    
-   firewall: add manual refresh button to live log  
    防火牆：在即時日誌中新增手動刷新按鈕
    
-   firewall: create an appropriate max-mss scrub rule for IPv6  
    防火牆：為 IPv6 建立適當的 max-mss 清理規則
    
-   firewall: fix anti-spoof option for separate bridge interfaces  
    防火牆：修復獨立橋接介面的防騙選項
    
-   firewall: relax schedule name validation  
    防火牆：放寬計畫名稱驗證
    
-   firewall: fix typo in ICMPv6 validation  
    防火牆：修復 ICMPv6 驗證中的拼字錯誤
    
-   firewall: add type 128 to outgoing IPv6 RFC4890 requirements  
    防火牆：將類型 128 新增至出站 IPv6 RFC4890要求
    
-   firewall: fix minor regression in maintaining target alias file  
    防火牆：修復維護目標別名檔案時出現的小問題
    
-   firewall: category selector missing caption  
    防火牆：類別選擇器缺少標題
    
-   firewall: fix all state value in pfTop (contributed by Lucas Held)  
    防火牆：修復 pfTop 中的所有狀態值（由 Lucas Held 提供）
    
-   firewall: remove duplicated destination field in live log  
    防火牆：刪除即時日誌中重複的目標字段
    
-   firewall: add read-only actions to aliases permission (contributed by Manuel Faux)  
    防火牆：為別名權限新增唯讀操作（由 Manuel Faux 提供）
    
-   reporting: add top talkers to revamped traffic graphs page  
    報告：將熱門話題者加入改版後的流量圖表頁面
    
-   dhcp: hostname validation now includes domain  
    DHCP：主機名稱驗證現在包含域名
    
-   dhcp: correct DHCPv6 custom options unsigned integer field (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    dhcp：正確的 DHCPv6 自訂選項無符號整數欄位（由 Team Rebellion 提供）
    
-   dhcp: removed the need for a static IPv4 being outside of the pool (contributed by Gauss23)  
    dhcp：不再需要靜態 IPv4 位址位於位址池之外（由 Gauss23 貢獻）
    
-   dhcp: add min-secs option for each subnet (contributed by vnxme)  
    DHCP：為每個子網路新增 min-secs 選項（由 vnxme 貢獻）
    
-   dhcp: fix sorting of IPv6 static mappings (contributed by vnxme)  
    DHCP：修正 IPv6 靜態映射的排序問題（由 vnxme 貢獻）
    
-   dnsmasq: remove advanced configuration in favour of plugin directory  
    dnsmasq：移除進階配置，改用外掛目錄
    
-   dnsmasq: use domain override for static hosts  
    dnsmasq：對靜態主機使用網域覆蓋
    
-   firmware: opnsense-code now updates the current directory if nothing was specified  
    韌體：opnsense-code 現在會在未指定任何目錄的情況下更新目前目錄。
    
-   firmware: opnsense-code now uses flexible make.conf target from tools.git  
    韌體：opnsense-code 現在使用 tools.git 中的靈活 make.conf 目標
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update now supports snapshot access via -z option  
    韌體：opnsense-update 現在支援透過 -z 選項存取快照
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update now fixes missing dependencies on the fly  
    韌體：opnsense-update 現在可以動態修復缺少的依賴項
    
-   firmware: repair display of removed packages during release type transition  
    韌體：修復版本類型轉換期間已移除軟體包的顯示問題
    
-   firmware: fix some issues with missing repository on server  
    韌體：修復伺服器上缺少儲存庫的一些問題
    
-   firmware: add version output and date to audit logs  
    韌體：在審計日誌中新增版本輸出和日期
    
-   intrusion detection: replace file-based policy changes with detailed filters  
    入侵偵測：用詳細過濾器取代基於檔案的策略更改
    
-   ipsec: NAT with multiple phase 2 (sponsored by m.a.x. it)  
    IPsec： NAT具有多個第二階段（由 Max It 贊助）
    
-   ipsec: prevent VTI interface to hit spurious 32768 limit  
    ipsec：防止VTI介面觸發虛假的 32768 限制
    
-   ipsec: allow mixed IPv4/IPv6 for VTI  
    ipsec：允許混合使用 IPv4/IPv6 進行VTI
    
-   ipsec: display remote host in status overview (contributed by garlic17)  
    ipsec：在狀態概覽中顯示遠端主機（由 garlic17 貢獻）
    
-   openssh: honour MAX\_LISTEN\_SOCKS to prevent startup failure  
    openssh：遵循MAX \_LISTEN\_SOCKS 指令以防止啟動失敗
    
-   openvpn: added toggle for block-outside-dns (contributed by Julio Camargo)  
    openvpn：新增封鎖外部 DNS 的開關（由 Julio Camargo 貢獻）
    
-   openvpn: hide “openvpn\_add\_dhcpopts” fields when not parsed via the backend  
    openvpn：當未透過後端解析時，隱藏「openvpn\_add\_dhcpopts」字段
    
-   openvpn: set default certificate lifetime to 397 days in wizard  
    OpenVPN：在精靈中將預設憑證有效期設定為 397 天
    
-   unbound: default to SO\_REUSEPORT  
    未綁定：預設為SO \_REUSEPORT
    
-   web proxy: add GSuite and YouTube filtering (contributed by Julio Camargo)  
    網路代理：新增 G Suite 和 YouTube 過濾功能（由 Julio Camargo 提供）
    
-   web proxy: lock ACL download to prevent duplicate execution  
    網路代理：鎖定ACL下載以防止重複執行
    
-   mvc: make sure isArraySequential() is only true on array input  
    MVC：確保 isArraySequential() 僅在陣列輸入時為 true
    
-   mvc: speed up processing time when over 2000 users are selected in a group  
    MVC：當一組使用者中選取超過 2000 位使用者時，加快處理速度
    
-   mvc: allow underscore in filter string (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    mvc：允許在過濾器字串中使用下劃線（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   images: use UFS2 as the default for nano, serial and vga  
    圖片：使用UFS2作為 nano、串列埠和 VGA 的預設設置
    
-   images: support UEFI boot in serial image  
    鏡像：支援UEFI串行啟動鏡像
    
-   ui: add tooltips for service control widget  
    使用者介面：為服務控制小工具新增工具提示
    
-   ui: move sidebar stage from session to local storage  
    ui：將側邊欄舞台從會話移至本機存儲
    
-   plugins: os-bind 1.15 [\[2\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/21.1/dns/bind/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-bind 1.15 [\[2\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/21.1/dns/bind/pkg-descr )
    
-   plugins: os-frr 1.21 [\[3\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/21.1/net/frr/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-frr 1.21 [\[3\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/21.1/net/frr/pkg-descr )
    
-   src: fix OpenSSL NULL pointer de-reference [\[4\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-20:33.openssl.asc)  
    src: 修正 OpenSSL NULL指標解引用 [\[4\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-20:33.openssl.asc )
    
-   src: fix AES-CCM requests with an AAD size smaller than a single block  
    src：修復AES-CCM請求，其大小AAD小於單一區塊
    
-   src: introduce HARDEN\_KLD to ensure DTrace functionality  
    src：引入HARDEN \_KLD 以確保 DTrace 功能
    
-   src: fix partial scrub of multicast packages  
    src：修復多播包的部分清理問題
    
-   src: refine pf\_route\* behaviour in PF\_DUPTO case for shared forwarding  
    src：改進PF \_DUPTO 案例中 pf\_route\* 的行為，以實現共享轉發
    
-   src: assorted upstream fixes for ipfw, iflib, multicast processing and pf  
    來源：針對 ipfw、iflib、多播處理和 pf 的各種上游修復
    
-   ports: libressl 3.2.3 [\[5\]](https://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/LibreSSL/libressl-3.2.2-relnotes.txt) [\[6\]](https://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/LibreSSL/libressl-3.2.3-relnotes.txt)

    ports：透過開啟根檔案描述子修復 shell 關鍵字的 pkg 問題
    
-   ports: radvd 2.19 [\[7\]](https://radvd.litech.org/)

#### 20.7 “Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子） Series｜20.7 “Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_20.7.html>

For five and a half years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

五年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

20.7, nicknamed “Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子）, is a major operating system jump forward on a sustainable firewall experience. This release adds DHCPv6 multi-WAN, custom error pages for the web proxy, Suricata 5, HardenedBSD 12.1, netstat tree view, basic firewall API support (via plugin) and extended live log filtering amongst others.

20.7 ，又稱“Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子） ，是作業系統在永續防火牆體驗方面的重大飛躍。此版本新增了對 DHCPv6 多埠WAN 、Web 代理程式自訂錯誤頁面、Suricata 5 和12.1 、netstat 樹狀視圖、基本防火牆API支援（透過外掛程式）以及擴展的即時日誌過濾等功能。

##### 20.7.8 (January 19, 2021)｜20.7.8 （2021年1月19日）

The particular volume of this stable update foreshadows the end of the 20.7 series in less than two weeks.

此次穩定版更新的特殊規模預示著20.7系列將在不到兩週的時間內結束。

One longstanding issue with radvd on FreeBSD 12.1 has been resolved according to multiple user feedback.

根據多位用戶的回饋，FreeBSD 12.1上 radvd 的一個長期存在的問題已經解決。

The mailing lists have been archived and will no longer be used.

郵件清單已存檔，將不再使用。

And before there are questions: yes, consumers of the development version are now able to upgrade to 21.1-RC1.

在提出問題之前：是的，開發版本的消費者現在可以升級到21.1-RC1 。

##### 20.7.6 (December 08, 2020)｜20.7.6 （2020年12月8日）

This update brings the usual mix of reliability fixes, plugin and third party software updates: FreeBSD, HardenedBSD, PHP, OpenSSH, StrongSwan, Suricata and Syslog-ng amongst others.

本次更新帶來了常見的可靠性修復、插件和第三方軟體更新：FreeBSD、HardenedBSD、 PHP 、OpenSSH、StrongSwan、Suricata 和 Syslog-ng 等。

Please note that Let’s Encrypt users need to reissue their certificates manually after upgrading to this version to fix the embedded certificate chain issue with the current signing CA switch going on.

請注意，Let's Encrypt 用戶升級到此版本後需要手動重新頒發證書，以修復當前簽名CA開關導致的嵌入式證書鏈問題。

The mail backup plugin is currently not available pending a response from the maintainer. Users are advised to avoid using it for the moment.

郵件備份插件目前暫時無法使用，正在等待維護者的回覆。建議用戶暫時不要使用該插件。

Here are the full patch notes:

    系統：不再強制網關使用別名

##### 20.7.4 (October 22, 2020)｜20.7.4 （2020年10月22日）

This release finally wraps up the recent Netmap kernel changes and tests. The Realtek vendor driver was updated as well as third party software cURL, libxml, OpenSSL, PHP, Suricata, Syslog-ng and Unbound just to name a couple of them.

本次版本更新最終完成了近期 Netmap 核心的變更和測試。 Realtek 廠商驅動程式以及第三方軟體（例如 cURL、libxml、OpenSSL、 PHP 、Suricata、Syslog-ng 和 Unbound 等）也更新了。

We would like to thank Sunny Valley Networks for their relentless efforts to bring said Netmap fixes and improvements into FreeBSD.

我們要感謝 Sunny Valley Networks 為將上述 Netmap 修復和改進引入 FreeBSD 所做的不懈努力。

If you are having trouble with a stuck update try the command sequence below from the root shell or simply reboot from the GUI and rerun the update in case it was not fully carried out yet.

如果更新卡住，請嘗試從 root shell 執行以下命令序列，或直接從GUI重新啟動並重新運行更新，以防更新尚未完全完成。

```
# pkill syslog-ng
# service syslog-ng restart
```

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: switch web GUI address selection to avoid server.bind in IPv6 first case  
    系統：切換 web GUI位址選擇，以避免 IPv6 第一種情況下的 server.bind
    
-   system: fix defunct “use default” button on web GUI listen interfaces  
    系統：修正網頁上失效的「使用預設值」按鈕GUI監聽接口
    
-   system: signal “auth user changed” when a user is modified via web GUI  
    系統：當使用者透過 Web 修改時發出「auth user changed」訊號GUI
    
-   system: replace gateway widget and add proper API endpoint for it  
    系統：替換網關小工具並為其添加正確的API端點
    
-   system: fix reading displayName attribute on LDAP search (contributed by ServiusHack)  
    系統：修正LDAP搜尋中讀取 displayName 屬性的問題（由 ServiusHack 提供）
    
-   interfaces: change maximum MTU value to 65535 in accordance with RFC 791  
    接口：根據RFC 791 將MTU最大值改為 65535
    
-   interfaces: update wireless device detection prefixes  
    介面：更新無線設備偵測前綴
    
-   interfaces: lexical sort interface keys for assignments  
    介面：用於賦值的詞法排序介面鍵
    
-   firewall: add support for network exclusions in network alias type  
    防火牆：在網路別名類型中新增對網路排除項目的支持
    
-   firewall: add NAT information to pfInfo page (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：在 pfInfo 頁面新增NAT資訊（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: associated NAT rules missed state keyword  
    防火牆：關聯的NAT規則缺少狀態關鍵字
    
-   firewall: allow “or” conditions in live log  
    防火牆：允許即時日誌中的“或”條件
    
-   firewall: use pfctl for alias IP check (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：使用 pfctl 檢查別名IP （kulikov-a 貢獻）

##### 20.7.2 (September 02, 2020)｜20.7.2 （2020年9月2日）

While we are still looking closer at netmap/iflib performance on 12.1 we are rolling out a kernel with Intel em/igb updates that should avoid bad packet counts in the default installation. Syslog-ng received a workaround for the diagnosed startup issue and alias now supports MAC address content similar to how host content works.

雖然我們仍在深入研究12.1上的netmap/iflib性能，但我們正在推出一個包含Intel em/igb更新的內核，這應該可以避免預設安裝中出現錯誤的套件計數。 Syslog-ng已針對已診斷的啟動問題找到了解決方法，而別名現在支援MAC位址內容，其運作方式與主機內容類似。

Here are the full patch notes:

    系統：在環境中設定REQUESTS \_CA\_BUNDLE

##### 20.7.1 (August 13, 2020)｜20.7.1 （2020年8月13日）

Small update here with security advisories, multicast fixes and logging reliability patches amongst others.

本次更新內容不多，包括安全性公告、多重播放修復和日誌可靠性修補程式等。

Overall, the jump to HardenedBSD 12.1 is looking promising from our end. From the reported issues we still have more logging quirks to investigate and especially Netmap support (used in IPS and Sensei) is lacking in some areas that were previously working. Patches are being worked on already so we shall get there soon enough. Stay tuned.

整體而言，從我們的角度來看，升級到 HardenedBSD 12.1的進展令人鼓舞。根據已報告的問題，我們仍需調查一些日誌記錄方面的小問題，尤其是 Netmap 支援（ IPS和 Sensei 中使用的）在某些方面存在不足，而這些方面之前是可以正常工作的。我們已經在著手開發補丁，相信很快就能解決問題。敬請期待。

##### 20.7 (July 30, 2020)｜20.7 （2020年7月30日）

For five and a half years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

五年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

20.7, nicknamed “Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子）, is a major operating system jump forward on a sustainable firewall experience. This release adds DHCPv6 multi-WAN, custom error pages for the web proxy, Suricata 5, HardenedBSD 12.1, netstat tree view, basic firewall API support (via plugin) and extended live log filtering amongst others.

20.7 ，又稱“Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子） ，是作業系統在永續防火牆體驗方面的重大飛躍。此版本新增了對 DHCPv6 多WAN的支援、Web 代理程式的自訂錯誤頁面、Suricata 5 和 HardenedBSD 12.1的支援、netstat 樹狀視圖、基本防火牆API支援（透過外掛程式實現）以及擴充功能的即時外掛程式實現）以及擴充功能的即時插件支援（透過外掛程式實現）以及擴充功能的即時裝置。

Download links, an installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

##### 20.7.r1 (July 21, 2020)｜20.7 .r1（2020年7月21日）

For five and a half years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

五年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you. <3

#### 20.1 “Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥） Series｜20.1 “Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_20.1.html>

For over 5 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

5 多年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

20.1, nicknamed “Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥）, is a subtle improvement on sustainable firewall experience. This release adds VXLAN and additional loopback device support, IPsec public key authentication and elliptic curve TLS certificate creation amongst others. Third party software has been updated to their latest versions. The logging frontend was rewritten for MVC with seamless API support. On the far side the documentation increased in quality as well as quantity and now presents itself in a familiar menu layout.

20.1 （又稱“Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥） ）是對永續防火牆體驗的細微改進。此版本新增了VXLAN和額外的環回裝置支援、IPsec公鑰認證以及橢圓曲線TLS憑證建立等功能。第三方軟體已更新至最新版本。日誌前端已重寫，以支援MVC ，並無縫相容API 。此外，文件的品質和數量均有所提升，並採用熟悉的選單佈局。

##### 20.1.9 (July 23, 2020)｜20.1.9 （2020年7月23日）

20.7-RC1 is already available and the final release of 20.7 is scheduled for July 30. A hotfix release for 20.1.9 will enable the upgrade path some hours after the initial 20.7 announcement is out, but please note that updated 32-bit builds (also known as i386) will no longer be available from this day forward.

20.7-RC1 已經可用，20.7 的最終版本計劃於 7 月 30 日發布。 20.1.9 的修補程式版本將在最初的 20.7 公告發布後幾個小時啟用升級路徑，但請注意，從今天起，更新的 32 位元版本（也稱為 i386）將不再可用。

##### 20.1.8 (July 02, 2020)｜20.1.8 （2020年7月2日）

Sorry about the delay while we chased a race condition in the updates back to an issue with the latest FreeBSD package manager updates. For now we reverted to our current version but all relevant third party packages have been updated as updates became available over the last weeks, e.g. cURL and Python, and hostapd / wpa\_supplicant amongst others.

很抱歉，由於我們一直在排查更新中的競態條件問題，導致更新延遲，該問題源自於最新的 FreeBSD 軟體套件管理器更新。目前我們已回滾到當前版本，但所有相關的第三方軟體包都已在過去幾週內隨著更新的發布而更新，例如 cURL、Python 以及 hostapd/wpa_supplicant 等。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

    系統：簡化 IPv4 續訂中 get\_interface\_ip() 的使用
    
-   system: allow HA sync of network time settings  
    系統：允許HA同步網路時間設定
    
-   system: download all filtered items in log export  
    系統：下載日誌匯出中所有已篩選的項目

    系統：在 Nextcloud 備份中新增對上游LDAP帳號的支援（由 Fabian Franz 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: fix stateless DHCPv6 for track6 interfaces (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面：修復 track6 介面的無狀態 DHCPv6 問題（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   firewall: fix missing address filter error by moving NAT targets to runtime resolve  
    防火牆：透過將NAT目標移至運行時解析來修復位址過濾器缺失錯誤

##### 20.1.7 (May 20, 2020)｜20.1.7 （2020年5月20日）

Today we move to PHP 7.3 in order to be able to complete testing for the 20.7-BETA online upgrades. Also included is a patch for the packet filter kernel code which could crash with shared forwarding when interfaces disappeared due to use after free in the default network stack path.

今天我們升級到PHP 7.3 ，以便完成20.7-BETA線上升級的測試。此外，還包含一個針對資料包過濾器核心程式碼的補丁，該補丁修復了在預設網路協定堆疊路徑中，由於釋放後使用導致介面消失時，共用轉送功能可能會崩潰的問題。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: default net.inet.icmp.reply\_from\_interface to 1  
    系統：預設 net.inet.icmp.reply\_from\_interface 為 1
    
-   system: fix static gateway wizard handing  
    系統：修復靜態網關精靈處理
    
-   firewall: allow outbound NAT source and destination port ranges  
    防火牆：允許出站NAT源埠與目標埠範圍
    
-   interfaces: use interfaces\_primary\_address6() inside get\_interface\_ipv6()  
    介面：在 get_interface_ipv6() 中使用 interfaces_primary_address6()
    
-   dhcp: add AdvLinkMTU to router advertisements settings (contributed by Ilteris Eroglu)  
    DHCP：將 AdvLinkMTU 新增至路由器通告設定（由 Ilteris Eroglu 提供）
    
-   unbound: prevent wildcard domains for the local system domain  
    unbound：阻止本機系統域使用通配符域
    
-   backend: suppress inconsequential IDNA warnings for aliases  
    後端：抑制別名的無關緊要的IDNA警告
    
-   backend: add option to return a key value list for TLS ciphers  
    後端：新增返回TLS密碼鍵值清單的選項
    
-   mvc: reference constraint pointing validation results to the wrong field  
    MVC：引用約束將驗證結果指向錯誤的字段
    
-   plugins: os-acme-client 1.32 adds Acmeproxy DNS support (contributed by Maarten den Braber)  
    插件：os-acme-client 1.32新增了 Acmeproxy DNS支援（由 Maarten den Braber 貢獻）
    
-   src: added Novatel Wireless MiFi 8800/8000 support (contributed by rootless4real)  
    資料來源：新增對 Novatel Wireless MiFi 8800/8000 的支援（由 rootless4real 貢獻）
    
-   src: fix pf shared forwarding on non-existing interfaces  
    src：修正不存在的介面上的 PF 共享轉送問題
    
-   src: patch in tty 3wire autologin support  
    src：tty 3wire 自動登入支援的補丁

##### 20.1.5 (April 23, 2020)｜20.1.5 （2020年4月23日）

Today ships the first release version of the supplemental firewall rule API via plugin, a new firewall shaper statistics GUI and API and the usual number of improvements and third party updates.

今天發布了第一個透過插件提供的補充防火牆規則API版本、​​新的防火牆整形統計資訊GUI和API ，以及通常數量的改進和第三方更新。

Note that this version does not ship OpenSSL 1.1.1g as at this point our release decision would have been to push 20.1.5 to next week or do a smaller 20.1.6 next week on top.

請注意，此版本不包含 OpenSSL 1.1 .1g，因為此時我們的發布決定是將20.1.5推遲到下週，或者在下週在此基礎上發布一個更小的20.1.6 。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: support configuration for SSH HostKeyAlgorithms, KexAlgorithms, Ciphers and MACs  
    系統：支援對SSH主機金鑰演算法、金鑰交換演算法、密碼和MAC的配置
    
-   system: simplify validations in gateway monitor settings  
    系統：簡化網關監控設定中的驗證
    
-   interfaces: mark VXLAN and loopback devices as configurable  
    介面：將VXLAN和環回設備標記為可設定

    介面：驗證錯誤導致無法傳遞無法傳遞的目標
    
-   interfaces: netstat tree view GUI and API  
    介面：netstat 樹狀視圖GUI和API
    
-   interfaces: use libxo to extract ARP data  
    介面：使用 libxo 擷取ARP數據
    
-   firewall: checkbox selection ignores visibility setting  
    防火牆：選取複選框會忽略可見性設置
    
-   firewall: add network group type to combine aliases cleanly  
    防火牆：新增網路群組類型以清楚合併別名
    
-   firewall: IPv6 essential icmpv6 allow for  
    防火牆：IPv6 基本 icmpv6 允許
    
-   firewall: new shaper statistics GUI and API  
    防火牆：新的整形器統計資訊GUI和API
    
-   firewall: support filter log messages with PID  
    防火牆：支援使用PID過濾日誌訊息
    
-   reporting: when flow times are not returned stick to receive timestamp  
    報告：未返回流程時間時，堅持接收時間戳

    openvpn：在選擇「任意」介面時使用多宿主UDP

##### 20.1 (January 30, 2020)｜20.1 （2020年1月30日）

For over 5 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

5 多年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

20.1, nicknamed “Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥）, is a subtle improvement on sustainable firewall experience. This release adds VXLAN and additional loopback device support, IPsec public key authentication and elliptic curve TLS certificate creation amongst others. Third party software has been updated to their latest versions. The logging frontend was rewritten for MVC with seamless API support. On the far side the documentation increased in quality as well as quantity and now presents itself in a familiar menu layout.

20.1 （又稱“Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥） ）是對永續防火牆體驗的細微改進。此版本新增了VXLAN和額外的環回裝置支援、IPsec公鑰認證以及橢圓曲線TLS憑證建立等功能。第三方軟體已更新至最新版本。日誌前端已重寫，以支援MVC ，並無縫相容API 。此外，文件的品質和數量均有所提升，並採用熟悉的選單佈局。

    支援方向和非快速介面規則
    
-   Logging frontend migrated to MVC / API  
    日誌前端已移轉至MVC / API
    
-   PSR 12 coding style  
    PSR 12 編碼風格

<a id="p-020"></a>

#### 19.7 “Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹） Series｜19.7 “Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_19.7.html>

For four and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

四年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

19.7, nicknamed “Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹）, embodies an iteration of what should be considered enjoyable user experience for firewalls in general: improved statistics and visibility of rules, reliable and consistent live logging and alias utility improvements. Apart from the usual upgrades of third party software to up-to-date releases, OPNsense now also offers built-in remote system logging through Syslog-ng, route-based IPsec, updated translations with Spanish as a brand new and already fully translated language and newer Netmap code with VirtIO, VLAN child and vmxnet support.

19.7 （又稱“Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹） ）體現了防火牆使用者體驗的全新迭代：改進了規則的統計資訊和可見性，增強了即時日誌記錄的可靠性和一致性，並改進了別名工具。除了將第三方軟體升級到最新版本外，OPNsense 現在還提供透過 Syslog-ng 實現的內建遠端系統日誌記錄、基於路由的 IPsec、更新的翻譯（新增西班牙語，且已完成翻譯）以及支援 VirtIO、 VLAN子節點和 vmxnet 的更新版 Netmap 程式碼。

Last but not least we would like to thank m.a.x. it for their sponsorship of the default gateway priority switching feature and their continued work of writing and maintaining plenty of community plugins. This time around, Maltrail, Netdata and WireGuard VPN have been freshly added to the mix.

最後，我們要感謝 Max It 對預設閘道優先權切換功能的贊助，以及他們持續編寫和維護大量社群插件的工作。此次，Maltrail、Netdata 和 WireGuard VPN也加入了支援行列。

隨著週四臨近， 20.1的最後準備工作正在進行中。作為一項快速的緩解措施，我們發布了19.7系列的生命週期結束版本，其中包含少量更新。

Remember that when 20.1 is available it will take up to a day before we release the hotfix with the major upgrade path enabled. Please be patient as we simply want to ensure that upgrades will not be bumpy affair. :)

##### 19.7.7 (November 21, 2019)｜19.7.7 （2019年11月21日）

Lots of small improvements. Of note are Eve JSON payload syslog export now works for 4 kb payload blobs. The outdated Google API PHP client was replaced. LibreSSL is now at version 3.0.2. Plus another Intel SA advisory via FreeBSD.

許多小改進。值得注意的是，Eve JSON有效載荷 syslog 導出功能現在可以支援 4 KB 的有效載荷 blob。過時的 Google API PHP客戶端已被取代。 LibreSSL 版本已更新至3.0.2 。此外，還有另一項透過 FreeBSD 發布的 Intel SA安全公告。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 19.7.6 (November 01, 2019)｜19.7.6 （2019年11月1日）

As we are experiencing the Suricata community first hand in Amsterdam we though to release this version a bit earlier than planned. Included is the latest Suricata 5.0.0 release in the development version. That means later this November we will releasing version 5 to the production version as we finish up tweaking the integration and maybe pick up 5.0.1 as it becomes available.

由於我們在阿姆斯特丹親身感受到了 Suricata 社群的活力，我們決定提前發布此版本。開發版本中已包含最新的 Suricata 5.0.0版本。這意味著今年 11 月下旬，我們將發布版本 5 至正式版，屆時我們將完成整合方面的調整，並可能在5.0.1版本發布後將其納入其中。

LDAP TLS connectivity is now integrated into the system trust store, which ensures that all required root and intermediate certificates will be seen by the connection setup when they have been added to the authorities section. The same is true for trusting self-signed certificates. On top of this, IPsec now supports public key authentication as contributed by Pascal Mathis.

LDAP TLS連線現已整合到系統信任儲存中，這確保了所有必需的根憑證和中間憑證在新增至授權機構部分後，都能被連線建立流程識別。信任自簽名憑證也是如此。此外，IPsec 現在支援由 Pascal Mathis 貢獻的公鑰認證。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: hook LDAP TLS support into system-wide trust file  
    系統：將LDAP TLS支援加入到系統層級信任檔案中
    
-   system: fix dpinger custom parameters not being honoured  
    系統：修復 dpinger 自訂參數不生效的問題
    
-   system: fix PHP core loop fail in tunables overview  
    系統：修復PHP可調參數概覽中的核心循環故障
    
-   system: only allow P12 export if password confirmation matches  
    系統：僅當密碼確認匹配時才允許匯出 P12 文件
    
-   interfaces: change PCAP download to binary file stream  
    介面：將PCAP下載更改為二進位檔案流
    
-   firewall: store reference to outbound NAT address instead of literal address  
    防火牆：儲存出站NAT位址的引用，而不是字面位址。
    
-   firewall: add log message for scheduled firewall reload  
    防火牆：新增計劃防火牆重啟的日誌訊息
    
-   firmware: tie pkg dependency to core  
    韌體：將軟體包依賴項與核心綁定

    ipsec：允許使用EC金鑰進行基於憑證的金鑰加密（由 Martin Strigl 提供）
    
-   ipsec: add support for public key authentication (contributed by Pascal Mathis)  
    IPsec：新增對公鑰認證的支援（由 Pascal Mathis 貢獻）

    openvpn：伺服器精靈已存在CA使用和伺服器憑證檢查（由 johnaheadley 提供）

##### 19.7.3 (August 28, 2019)｜19.7.3 （2019年8月28日）

Please enjoy this release with improved CARP utility and a number of smaller fixes and updates for the operating system and third party tools. You can now also toggle logging directly from the rule overview to make debugging easier.

此版本改進了CARP實用程序，並修復和更新了作業系統和第三方工具的一些小問題，敬請體驗。現在您也可以直接從規則概覽中切換日誌記錄，從而簡化偵錯過程。

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   system: try all backups for automatic revert when config.xml is damaged  
    系統：嘗試所有備份以實現 config.xml 檔案損壞時的自動復原。
    
-   system: do a system reset if all config.xml files are damaged  
    系統：如果所有 config.xml 檔案都已損壞，則執行系統重設。
    
-   system: only show tunables reboot hint when applying tunables (contributed by Northguy)  
    系統：僅在應用可調參數時顯示可調參數重啟提示（由 Northguy 提供）
    
-   system: use FQDN in system log remote messages  
    系統：在系統日誌遠端訊息中使用FQDN
    
-   system: add defunct gateways to GUI in disabled state  
    系統：將失效網關新增至處於停用狀態的GUI
    
-   interfaces: only allow VLAN parents that will work as VLAN parents  
    介面：僅允許能夠作為VLAN父級工作的VLAN父級
    
-   interfaces: optionally promote/demote CARP on service status  
    介面：可依服務狀態選擇性地提升/降級CARP
    
-   interfaces: CARP status page report with demotion level to avoid ambiguity  
    介面： CARP狀態頁面報告，具有降級等級以避免歧義
    
-   firewall: revert problematic 19.7.2 change “unhide automatic interface-based output rules”  
    防火牆：恢復有問題的19.7.2更改“取消隱藏基於介面的自動輸出規則”
    
-   firewall: restore automatic outbound NAT pre-19.7 behaviour which excludes gateways not configured and not dynamic  
    防火牆：恢復自動出站NAT預19.7行為，此行為排除未設定和非動態閘道。
    
-   firewall: add logging toggle to rules overview (contributed by johnaheadley)  
    防火牆：在規則概覽中新增日誌記錄開關（由 johnaheadley 提供）
    
-   firewall: DHCPv6 relay would generate rules even if not enabled  
    防火牆：即使未啟用 DHCPv6 中繼，也會產生規則。
    
-   firmware: only do single-repository fingerprint verify defaulting to our OPNsense repository  
    韌體：僅進行單一倉庫指紋驗證，預設使用我們的 OPNsense 倉庫。
    
-   firmware: fix base and kernel package listing  
    韌體：修復基礎軟體包和內核軟體包列表
    
-   intrusion detection: show change message after toggle or save  
    入侵偵測：切換或儲存後顯示變更訊息
    
-   intrusion detection: rule download fix  
    入侵偵測：規則下載修復
    
-   monit: add parent devices to interface list (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    monit：將父設備新增至介面清單（由 Frank Brendel 提供）
    
-   monit: fix standard configuration migration (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    monit：修復標準配置遷移問題（由 Frank Brendel 貢獻）
    
-   reporting: skip illegal NetFlow records in flow parser  
    報表：跳過流解析器中的非法 NetFlow 記錄
    
-   opendns: migrate update hook from DynDNS plugin to core to make it fully automatic  
    opendns：將更新鉤子從 DynDNS 插件遷移到核心，使其完全自動化
    
-   backend: fix exception message string handling in Python 3  
    後端：修正 Python 3 中的異常訊息字串處理問題
    
-   backend: add help to pluginctl utility  
    後端：為 pluginctl 工具添加幫助訊息
    
-   backend: configctl event handler support  
    後端：configctl 事件處理程序支持
    
-   mvc: log API key when authentication failed  
    mvc：當身分驗證失敗時記錄API金鑰

##### 19.7.2 (August 05, 2019)｜19.7.2 （2019年8月5日）

This update ships the latest FreeBSD security advisories along with several smaller improvements and fixes. Sunny Valley Networks is the first vendor to introduce additional software to the plugin framework in the form of the Sensei plugin.

本次更新包含了最新的 FreeBSD 安全公告以及一些較小的改進和修復。 Sunny Valley Networks 是首家以 Sensei 插件的形式向插件框架引入額外軟體的供應商。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: missing “<PRI>” in legacy output via Syslog-ng  
    系統：透過 Syslog-ng 輸出的舊版日誌中缺少「 <PRI> 」。
    
-   system: fix writing gateway information for DNS servers  
    系統：修復DNS伺服器的網關資訊寫入問題
    
-   system: allow gateway to work in DHCPv6 WAN when no router solicitation is available  
    系統：允許網關在沒有路由器請求時以 DHCPv6 WAN模式工作
    
-   firewall: unhide automatic interface-based output rules  
    防火牆：取消隱藏基於介面的自動輸出規則
    
-   firewall: unhide automatic non-interface-based floating rules  
    防火牆：取消隱藏自動非介面浮動規則
    
-   firewall: lift length restriction in NAT rule description  
    防火牆： NAT規則描述中的提升長度限制
    
-   firewall: avoid newlines in rule descriptions  
    防火牆：規則描述中避免使用換行符
    
-   firewall: only show usable addresses in NAT outbound rules  
    防火牆：僅在NAT出站規則中顯示可用位址
    
-   interfaces: fix extended CARP output when parsing interface information  
    介面：修復解析介面資訊時擴充的CARP輸出問題
    
-   interfaces: add more outputs to overview page to increase usefulness  
    介面：在概覽頁面中新增更多輸出以提高實用性
    
-   interfaces: use shared DHCP lease reader for ARP list  
    介面：使用共享的DHCP租約讀取器進行ARP列表
    
-   captive portal: fix binary read issue in Python 3  
    強制門戶：修復 Python 3 中的二進位讀取問題
    
-   dhcp: fix DHCPv4 relay interface selection (contributed by jayantsahtoe)  
    DHCP：修復 DHCPv4 中繼介面選擇問題（由 jayantsahtoe 提供）
    
-   firmware: handle file signature verify correctly with multiple fingerprint repositories  
    韌體：正確處理多個指紋庫中的檔案簽章驗證
    
-   firmware: Aivian mirror is no longer active  
    韌體：Aivian鏡像已停止運作
    
-   firmware: Cloudfence mirror in Brazil added

##### 19.7.1 (July 25, 2019)｜19.7.1 （2019年7月25日）

We do not wish to keep you from enjoying your summer time, but this is a recommended security update enriched with reliability fixes for the new 19.7 series. Of special note are performance improvements as well as a fix for a longstanding NAT before IPsec limitation.

我們不想影響您享受夏日時光，但本次更新旨在為新款19.7系列產品提供安全保障，並修復了可靠性問題。尤其值得一提的是，本次更新也提升了效能，並修復了長期存在的NAT IPsec 連線限制問題。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: do not create automatic copies of existing gateways  
    系統：不要自動複製現有網關
    
-   system: do not translate empty tunables descriptions  
    系統：不要翻譯空的可調參數描述
    
-   system: remove unwanted form action tags  
    系統：移除不需要的表單操作標籤
    
-   system: do not include Syslog-ng in rc.freebsd handler  
    系統：不要在 rc.freebsd 處理程序中包含 Syslog-ng。
    
-   system: fix manual system log stop/start/restart  
    系統：修復手動系統日誌停止/啟動/重新啟動問題
    
-   system: scoped IPv6 “%” could confuse mwexecf(), use plain mwexec() instead  
    系統提示：作用域 IPv6 “%” 可能會導致 mwexecf() 函式出錯，請改用普通的 mwexec() 函式。
    
-   system: allow curl-based downloads to use both trusted and local authorities  
    系統：允許基於 curl 的下載同時使用受信任的和本地的授權機構。
    
-   system: fix group privilege print and correctly redirect after edit  
    系統：修復群組權限列印和編輯後正確重定向的問題
    
-   system: use cached address list in referrer check  
    系統：在引用檢查中使用快取的位址列表
    
-   system: fix Syslog-ng search stats  
    系統：修復 Syslog-ng 搜尋統計信息
    
-   firewall: HTML-escape dynamic entries to display aliases  
    防火牆： HTML -轉義動態條目以顯示別名
    
-   firewall: display correct IP version in automatic rules  
    防火牆：在自動規則中顯示正確的IP版本
    
-   firewall: fix a warning while reading empty outbound rules configuration  
    防火牆：修正讀取空出站規則配置時出現的警告
    
-   firewall: skip illegal log lines in live log  
    防火牆：跳過即時日誌中的非法日誌行
    
-   interfaces: performance improvements for configurations with hundreds of interfaces  
    介面：針對包含數百個介面的配置，效能有所提升
    
-   reporting: performance improvements for Python 3 NetFlow aggregator rewrite  
    報表：Python 3 NetFlow 聚合器重寫後的效能改進
    
-   dhcp: move advanced router advertisement options to correct config section  
    DHCP：將進階路由器通告選項移至正確的設定部分
    
-   ipsec: replace global array access with function to ensure side-effect free boot  
    IPsec：用函數替換全域數組訪問，以確保無副作用啟動
    
-   ipsec: change DPD action on start to “dpdaction = restart”  
    ipsec：將DPD啟動時的操作更改為“dpdaction = restart”
    
-   ipsec: remove already default “dpdaction = none” if not set  
    ipsec：如果未設置，則移除已存在的預設值「dpdaction = none」。
    
-   ipsec: use interface IP address in local ID when doing NAT before IPsec  
    IPsec：在執行NAT之前，使用本機介面IP中的ID位址
    
-   web proxy: fix database reset for Squid 4 by replacing use of ssl\_crtd with security\_file\_certgen  
    Web代理：修正Squid 4的資料庫重設問題，方法是將ssl\_crtd替換為security\_file\_certgen。
    
-   plugins: os-acme-client 1.24 [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/pull/1399)  
    插件：os-acme-client 1.24 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/pull/1399 )

    插件：os-bind 1.6 [\[2\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/dns/bind/pkg-descr )

    插件：os-frr 現在限製字元BGP前綴列表和路由映射 [\[4\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/net/frr/pkg-descr )

##### 19.7 (July 17, 2019)｜19.7 （2019年7月17日）

For four and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

四年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

19.7, nicknamed “Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹）, embodies an iteration of what should be considered enjoyable user experience for firewalls in general: improved statistics and visibility of rules, reliable and consistent live logging and alias utility improvements. Apart from the usual upgrades of third party software to up-to-date releases, OPNsense now also offers built-in remote system logging through Syslog-ng, route-based IPsec, updated translations with Spanish as a brand new and already fully translated language and newer Netmap code with VirtIO, VLAN child and vmxnet support.

19.7 （暱稱“Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹） ）體現了防火牆使用者體驗的全新方向：改進了規則的統計資訊和可見性，增強了即時日誌記錄的可靠性和一致性，並改進了別名工具。除了將第三方軟體升級到最新版本外，OPNsense 現在還提供透過 Syslog-ng 實現的內建遠端系統日誌記錄、基於路由的 IPsec、更新的翻譯（新增西班牙語，且已完成翻譯）以及支援 VirtIO、 VLAN子節點和 vmxnet 的更新版 Netmap 程式碼。

Last but not least we would like to thank m.a.x. it for their sponsorship of the default gateway priority switching feature and their continued work of writing and maintaining plenty of community plugins. This time around, Maltrail, Netdata and WireGuard VPN have been freshly added to the mix.

最後，我們要感謝 Max It 對預設閘道優先權切換功能的贊助，以及他們持續編寫和維護大量社群插件的工作。此次，Maltrail、Netdata 和 WireGuard VPN也加入了支援行列。

Known issues and limitations:

已知問題和限制：

-   Web proxy squid update from version 3 to 4 breaks the cache database. To repair go to “Services: Web Proxy: Administration” tab “Support”（支援） and click “Reset”（重置）.  
    Web 代理程式 Squid 從版本 3 更新到版本 4 會破壞快取資料庫。若要修復此問題，請前往「服務：Web 代理程式：管理」標籤“Support”（支援）並按一下“Reset”（重置） 。
    
-   Web proxy login privilege is no longer available. Access may be restricted by a group selector instead.  
    Web代理登入權限已不再可用。存取權限可能改為透過群組選擇器進行限制。
    
-   Nano images require a reinstall using the latest image to avoid inode shortage which makes the system appear to run out of space during recent 19.1.x updates.  
    Nano 鏡像需要使用最新鏡像重新安裝，以避免 inode 短缺導致系統在最近的19.1 .x 更新期間出現空間不足的情況。
    
-   OpenVPN no longer supports listening on gateway groups. Use localhost paired with port forwards instead.  
    OpenVPN 已不再支援監聽網關群組。請改用 localhost 並配合連接埠轉送。

##### 19.7.r1 (July 09, 2019)｜19.7 .r1（2019年7月9日）

For four and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

四年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you.

感謝大家參與測試、完善和貢獻這個專案！我們知道，沒有你們，這個計畫就不會是現在的樣子。

Here are the full changes against version 19.1.10:

以下是與版本19.1.10相比的全部變更：

-   system: new remote syslog setup via Syslog-ng  
    系統：透過 Syslog-ng 設定新的遠端 syslog
    
-   system: gateway handling rewrite  
    系統：網關處理重寫
    
-   system: default gateway switching priority control [\[2\]](https://www.max-it.de/) (sponsored by m.a.x. it)  
    系統：預設閘道切換優先權控制 [\[2\]]( https://www.max-it.de/ ) (由 max it 贊助)
    
-   system: dpinger ported to plugin framework  
    系統：dpinger 已移植到插件框架
    
-   system: bring back PHP warning log level  
    系統：恢復PHP警告日誌級別
    
-   system: use authentication factory for user import  
    系統：使用身份驗證工廠進行使用者導入
    
-   interfaces: VLAN, bridge, LAGG, GRE, GIF setup refactor  
    介面： VLAN ，橋接， LAGG, GRE, GIF設定重構
    
-   interfaces: improve load sequence to allow DHCPv6 on bridges  
    介面：改進負載順序以允許在網橋上使用 DHCPv6
    
-   interfaces: GIF, GRE, IPsec and OpenVPN will no longer accept IP configuration  
    介面： GIF, GRE 、IPsec 和 OpenVPN 將不再接受IP配置
    
-   interfaces: speed up get\_real\_interface() by assuming interfaces exist  
    介面：透過假設介面存在來加速 get\_real\_interface() 函數。
    
-   interfaces: sort interface groups and require rules apply if necessary (contributed by Robin Schneider)  
    介面：對介面組進行排序，並根據需要應用規則（由 Robin Schneider 提供）
    
-   interfaces: background PPPoE connect and disconnect  
    介面：後台 PPPoE 連線和斷開
    
-   interfaces: only IP-address allowed in PPP gateway (contributed by Smart-Soft)  
    介面：僅允許IP位址進入PPP網關（由 Smart-Soft 提供）
    
-   interfaces: simplified linking VIPs to interfaces  
    介面：簡化 VIP 與介面的連接
    
-   interfaces: removed interface\_has\_gateway()  
    介面：已移除 interface\_has\_gateway()
    
-   interfaces: removed interface\_has\_gatewayv6()  
    介面：已移除 interface\_has\_gatewayv6()
    
-   interfaces: removed get\_failover\_interface()  
    介面：已移除 get\_failover\_interface()
    
-   interfaces: removed rc.kill\_states  
    介面：已移除 rc.kill\_states
    
-   firewall: ability to view automatic rules  
    防火牆：能夠查看自動規則
    
-   firewall: rule origin locator in live log and automatic rules listing  
    防火牆：即時日誌中的規則來源定位器和自動規則列表
    
-   firewall: show statistics for all active rules including automatic ones  
    防火牆：顯示所有活動規則（包括自動規則）的統計訊息
    
-   firewall: optional statistics for alias tables  
    防火牆：別名表的可選統計信息
    
-   firewall: fix translation of shaper mask “none” value  
    防火牆：修復整形器遮罩「無」值的轉換
    
-   firewall: add ipv6-icmp type selection  
    防火牆：新增 IPv6-ICMP 類型選擇
    
-   firewall: rule listing layout update  
    防火牆：規則清單佈局更新
    
-   reporting: new NetFlow reader in Python 3  
    報告：Python 3 中新增 NetFlow 讀取器
    
-   reporting: validate that NetFlow WAN interfaces are also added to listening interfaces  
    報告：驗證 NetFlow WAN介面是否也已新增至監聽介面。
    
-   dhcp: ported to plugin framework  
    DHCP：已移植到插件框架
    
-   dhcp: added failover split to DHCPv4 (contributed by Wolfgang Pedot)  
    DHCP：為 DHCPv4 新增了故障轉移分割（由 Wolfgang Pedot 貢獻）
    
-   dhcp: fix ddnsdomainprimary setting validation  
    DHCP：修復 ddnsdomainprimary 設定驗證
    
-   dhcp: added advanced options for router advertisements  
    DHCP：為路由器通告新增了進階選項
    
-   dhcp: removed remove rasend/ranosend checkbox  
    DHCP：已移除移除 rasend/ranosend 複選框
    
-   dhcp: simplify DHCPv4 interface lookup on lease page  
    DHCP：簡化租約頁面上的 DHCPv4 介面查找
    
-   dhcp: use AdvDefaultLifetime 0 when default route shall not be advertised  
    DHCP：當預設路由不應被通告時，使用 AdvDefaultLifetime 0。
    
-   firmware: support reading package repository and origin  
    韌體：支援讀取軟體包倉庫和來源
    
-   firmware: warn on third party package installation  
    韌體：警告第三方軟體包安裝
    
-   firmware: synchronise update checks to avoid “not responding” errors  
    韌體：同步更新檢查以避免「無響應」錯誤
    
-   firmware: fix empty update list on release type change  
    韌體：修復發布類型變更時更新清單為空的問題
    
-   images: nano image now supports future-proof number of inodes  
    圖像：nano 圖像現在支援面向未來的 inode 數量
    
-   installer: support password reset in opnsense-importer  
    安裝程式：支援在 opnsense-importer 中重設密碼
    
-   intrusion detection: allow rule action bulk changes  
    入侵偵測：允許規則操作批次更改
    
-   intrusion detection: minor usability improvements  
    入侵偵測：可用性略有改進
    
-   intrusion detection: support eve system log output  
    入侵偵測：支援 EVE 系統日誌輸出
    
-   openvpn: removed gateway group listening support  
    openvpn：已移除網關群組監聽支持
    
-   openvpn: no longer restart servers on CARP events  
    openvpn：不再因CARP事件重啟伺服器
    
-   openvpn: reduced complexity in service handling  
    OpenVPN：降低服務處理的複雜性
    
-   web proxy: replace proxy login privilege “user-proxy-auth” with group selector  
    Web代理：將代理登入權限「user-proxy-auth」替換為群組選擇器
    
-   backend: ported remaining scripts to Python 3  
    後端：已將剩餘腳本移植到 Python 3。
    
-   backend: add helpers.glob() to enable template traversal  
    後端：新增 helpers.glob() 以啟用範本遍歷
    
-   backend: new “monitor” hook for rc.syshook  
    後端：為 rc.syshook 新增「監控」鉤子
    
-   mvc: do not add “none” in AuthGroupField if multiple select  
    MVC：如果選擇多個選項，請勿在 AuthGroupField 中新增「none」。
    
-   mvc: allow sorting JsonKeyValueStoreField by value  
    mvc：允許依數值對 JsonKeyValueStoreField 進行排序
    
-   ui: remember previous selected columns and row count on several MVC pages  
    使用者介面：記住多個MVC頁面上先前選擇的列和行數
    
-   ui: apply alert reminders for several MVC pages  
    ui：為多個MVC頁面套用提醒
    
-   ui: add failed callback to saveFormToEndpoint()  
    ui：向 saveFormToEndpoint() 新增失敗回調
    
-   ui: core theme color update  
    使用者介面：核心主題顏色更新
    
-   ui: fix file size suffix (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    ui：修復檔案大小後綴（由 Fabian Franz 提供）
    
-   ui: add useRequestHandlerOnGet option  
    ui：新增 useRequestHandlerOnGet 選項
    
-   ui: bootstrap 3.4.1 [\[3\]](https://blog.getbootstrap.com/2019/02/13/bootstrap-4-3-1-and-3-4-1/)  
    ui: bootstrap 3.4.1 [\[3\]]( https://blog.getbootstrap.com/2019/02/13/bootstrap-4-3-1-and-3-4-1/ )
    
-   src: netmap VirtIO, VLAN child and vmxnet support  
    src：netmap VirtIO、 VLAN子進程和 vmxnet 支持
    
-   src: fix races in tun(4)/tap(4) drivers  
    src：修正 tun(4)/tap(4) 驅動程式中的競爭問題
    
-   ports: squid 4.7 [\[4\]](http://squid.mirror.colo-serv.net/archive/4/squid-4.0.7-RELEASENOTES.html)  
    埠：squid 4.7 [\[4\]]( http://squid.mirror.colo-serv.net/archive/4/squid-4.0.7-RELEASENOTES.html )
    
-   ports: syslog-ng 3.21.1 [\[5\]](https://github.com/syslog-ng/syslog-ng/releases/tag/syslog-ng-3.21.1)  
    埠：syslog-ng 3.21.1 [\[5\]]( https://github.com/syslog-ng/syslog-ng/releases/tag/syslog-ng-3.21.1 )

<a id="p-021"></a>

#### 19.1 “Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥） Series｜19.1 “Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_19.1.html>

For more than four years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

四年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

The 19.1 release, nicknamed “Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥）, consists of a total of 620 individual changes since 18.7 came out 6 months ago, spread out over 12 intermediate releases including the recent release candidates. That is the average of 2 stable releases per month, security updates and important bug fixes included! If we had to pick a few highlights it would be: The firewall alias API is finally in place. The migration to HardenedBSD 11.2 has been completed. 2FA now works with a remote LDAP / local TOTP combination. And the OpenVPN client export was rewritten for full API support as well.

19.1版本（暱稱“Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥） ）自 6 個月前18.7發布以來，共包含 620 項變更，這些變更分佈在 12 個中間版本中，包括最近的候選版本。這意味著平均每月發布 2 個穩定版本，其中包含安全性更新和重要的錯誤修復！如果要列舉一些亮點，那就是：防火牆別名API終於上線。向 HardenedBSD 11.2的遷移已完成。雙重認證 (2FA) 現在支援遠端LDAP / 本地TOTP組合。此外，OpenVPN 用戶端匯出也已重寫，以完全支援API 。

##### 19.1.8 (May 20, 2019)｜19.1.8 （2019年5月20日）

This update addresses several privilege escalation issues in the access control implementation and new memory disclosure issues in Intel CPUs. We would like to thank Arnaud Cordier and Bill Marquette for the top-notch reports and coordination.

本次更新解決了存取控制實作中的多個權限提升問題以及英特爾 CPU 中新增的記憶體外洩問題。我們衷心感謝 Arnaud Cordier 和 Bill Marquette 提供的出色報告和協調工作。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: address CVE-2019-11816 privilege escalation bugs [\[1\]](https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2019-11816) (reported by Arnaud Cordier)  
    系統：位址CVE -2019-11816 權限提升漏洞 [\[1\]]( https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2019-11816 )（由 Arnaud Cordier 報告）
    
-   system: /etc/hosts generation without interface\_has\_gateway()  
    系統：/etc/hosts 生成時未包含 interface\_has\_gateway()

    系統：在配置復原保存訊息中顯示正確的時間戳記（由 nhirokinet 提供）
    
-   system: list the commands for the pluginctl utility when no argument is given  
    系統：列出pluginctl實用程式在不提供參數時的指令

    系統：引進並使用 userIsAdmin() 輔助函數，而不是直接檢查「page-all」權限。

    系統：在控制項 ACL 中使用絕對路徑（Netgate 報表）

##### 19.1.7 (May 02, 2019)｜19.1.7 （2019年5月2日）

This update features a number of improvements such as link-local support for bridges, HA sync consolidation, adding local CAs to the trusted SSL certificates for most of the system download capabilities, plugin-based PAM authentication rework for IPsec and the web proxy as well as third party fixes for hostapd / wpa\_supplicant 2.8 and Suricata 4.1.4.

本次更新包含多項改進，例如橋接的鏈路本地支援、 HA同步整合、為大多數系統下載功能將本地 CA 新增至受信任的SSL憑證中、針對 IPsec 和 Web 代理程式的基於插件的PAM 2.8 4.1.4的第三方修復。

Python 3 migration is also underway now which requires to pull in both Python versions which may be heavy on embedded Nano installs, but we cannot see another way for this tedious task which will probably stretch into 19.7 to be fully carried out in 20.1.

Python 3 遷移目前也在進行中，這需要引入兩個 Python 版本，這可能會對嵌入式 Nano 安裝造成很大負擔，但我們看不到其他方法可以在20.1中完全完成這項繁瑣的任務，該任務可能會持續到19.7 。

And speaking of 20.1: This is the first of many reminders that 20.1 will discontinue the i386 (Intel 32 Bit) franchise as discussed a number of times within the community over the years. Our hope is that ARM64 will make a viable replacement. But that is for another time.

說到20.1 ：這是多次提醒， 20.1將終止i386（Intel 32位元）系列，這一點多年來社區內已多次討論過。我們希望ARM64能夠成為一個可行的替代方案。但這又是另一個話題了。

As you may have noticed the project has not been delivering releases every other week and there are a number of reasons for it:

您可能已經注意到，該專案並沒有像之前那樣每隔一周發布一次版本，這其中有許多原因：

Security-wise we have not had a lot of necessary third-party software updates. Feature-wise we are sitting on a number of improvements for the upcoming 19.7 series that will trickle into 19.1.x now, but that have also required larger preparations and testing in the meantime. On the community side of the spectrum, sponsored by our partner m.a.x. it, we have started to work on better default gateway switching which led to an overall gateway integration rework and then quickly to interface handling restructuring, which in turn led to improving plugin capabilities of core services (OpenVPN, IPsec, Unbound, Dnsmasq, DHCPD, Dpinger). Looking at it now it has been the largest rework so far on code established many years ago and only occasionally patched. We hope this shows our dedication to the code base even when things are not always 100% bug free. If you feel like pitching in now is a good time to try the development version and let us know about how it performs.

在安全性方面，我們並沒有太多必要的第三方軟體更新。在功能方面，我們正在為即將推出的19.7系列開發一系列改進，這些改進將逐步整合到19.1版本中，但同時，我們也需要進行更多的準備和測試。在社群方面，在合作夥伴max it的贊助下，我們開始著手改進預設閘道切換功能，這導致了網關整合的整體重構，並迅速轉向介面處理重構，進而提升了核心服務（OpenVPN、IPsec、Unbound、Dnsmasq、 DHCPD 、Dpinger）的插件功能。現在看來，這是迄今為止對多年前創建且僅偶爾打補丁的程式碼進行的最大規模重構。我們希望這能展現我們對程式碼庫的投入，即使程式碼並非總是100%無bug。如果您有興趣參與，現在正是試用開發版本並向我們回饋其效能的好時機。

##### 19.1.6 (April 11, 2019)｜19.1.6 （2019年4月11日）

This update brings a smaller number of fixes and improvements as well as the latest PHP version update.

本次更新帶來了一些修復和改進，以及最新的PHP版本更新。

With a heavy heart we disable E\_WARNING messages in the PHP error reporting. It has been implemented in 2015 to improve code quality and it did just that, but with the latest PHP 7.2 jump in 19.1.5 it causes problems around the newly added count() usage warning messages. We plan to bring back E\_WARNING usage in 19.7.

我們懷著沉重的心情宣布，將在PHP錯誤報告中禁用E_WARNING訊息。該訊息於2015年啟用，旨在提高程式碼質量，並且確實達到了預期效果。然而，隨著19.1.5版本中最新的PHP 7.2更新，它導致新增的count()使用警告訊息出現問題。我們計劃在19.7中恢復E_WARNING訊息的使用。

##### 19.1.4 (March 12, 2019)｜19.1.4 （2019年3月12日）

An UEFI boot panic scenario was debugged last week with the help of the community. This update includes a fix that will allow the ones affected by this 19.1 issue to upgrade or install (and boot of course) correctly. We are also including the IPsec VTI support and the latest Suricata 4.1.3 with stability and compatibility fixes.

上週，在社群的幫助下，我們調試了一個UEFI啟動崩潰問題。本次更新包含一個修復程序，將使受19.1問題影響的使用者能夠正確升級或安裝（當然也能正常啟動）。此外，我們還加入了對VTI的支持，以及最新的4.1.3 ，並修復了穩定性和相容性問題。

Due to the severity of the UEFI boot panic 19.1.4 will be the new initial release for all upgrades from 18.7 within a day or two depending on additional testing and confirmation. Last but not least there will be new images some time next week to put this fully behind us. Thank you for your patience and understanding. :)

由於UEFI啟動崩潰問題的嚴重性， 19.1.4將作為新的初始版本，用於所有從18.7升級的用戶，具體發佈時間取決於後續的測試和確認。下週某個時候，我們將發布新的鏡像，徹底解決這個問題。感謝您的耐心與理解。 :)

Special thanks go to the team of Synacktiv for reporting a packet filter IPv6 vulnerability for which a patch was included as well.

特別感謝 Synacktiv 團隊報告了一個 IPv6 封包過濾器漏洞，該漏洞也已發布了修補程式。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   firewall: fix validation regression in outbound NAT introduced in 19.1.3  
    防火牆：修正出站驗證迴歸問題NAT由19.1.3引進）

##### 19.1.3 (March 07, 2019)｜19.1.3 （2019年3月7日）

This is a smaller stable update consisting of LDAPS authentication server improvements, Unbound host overrides alias support, OpenSSL 1.0.2r security update and the recent PAM rework for better privilege separation.

這是一個較小的穩定更新，包括LDAPS身份驗證伺服器改進、Unbound 主機覆蓋別名支援、OpenSSL 1.0 .2r 安全性更新以及最近PAM為更好地進行權限分離而進行的重構。

We are currently focusing on IPsec VTI, third-party service PAM integration and investigating kernel boot crashes. In the latter case we are aware of the update issues some people are having and recommend running 18.7 until this is taken care of. Above all, please be patient. New images and seamless upgrade paths will be provided as soon as the problems have been pinned down.

我們目前正專注於 IPsec VTI 、第三方服務PAM整合以及核心啟動崩潰問題的調查。對於核心啟動崩潰問題，我們已註意到部分使用者遇到的更新問題，建議在問題解決之前執行18.7 。請耐心等待。一旦問題解決，我們將立即提供新的鏡像和無縫升級方案。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: improve LDAPS mode and related authentication cleanups  
    系統：改良LDAPS模式及相關認證清理
    
-   system: move enable checkbox to the top in remote logging settings  
    系統：將遠端日誌記錄設定中的「啟用」複選框移至頂部
    
-   system: allow reset of tunables to to factory defaults  
    系統：允許將可調參數重設為出廠預設值
    
-   system: new tunables factory default to prevent ICMP redirects being sent (net.inet.icmp.drop\_redirect=1)  
    系統：新的可調參數出廠預設值，以防止發送ICMP重定向（net.inet.icmp.drop\_redirect=1）
    
-   firewall: allow explicitly setting source hash key in outbound NAT (Fredrik Ronnvall)  
    防火牆：允許在出站NAT中明確設定來源雜湊鍵（Fredrik Ronnvall）
    
-   interfaces: probe media before applying new settings

##### 19.1.2 (February 28, 2019)｜19.1.2 （2019年2月28日）

This update is the sum of a few weeks of intense testing and debugging in areas such as WAN DHCP with very short lease times, Suricata IPS not working as expected, stacked 6RD setups that have overly long device names amongst others.

本次更新是經過數週密集測試和調試後的結果，測試和調試領域包括：租期非常短的WAN DHCP 、Suricata IPS無法按預期工作、設備名稱過長的堆疊式 6RD 設定等等。

The update may be a bit bumpy this time since the web GUI session directory will be moved to a safer location. You will be logged out during the update and the system will reboot due to the included operating system update. As soon as it is back you will be able to log in as usual.

這次更新可能會有些不順利，因為 Web GUI會話目錄將會被移轉到更安全的位置。更新期間您將被強制登出，並且系統會因作業系統更新而重新啟動。系統重新啟動後，您就可以像往常一樣登入了。

LibreSSL received a major upgrade from 2.7 to 2.8. If you are using LibreSSL and see any issues please do let us know because it sadly looks like third party projects such as OpenVPN, Squid, StrongSwan and NTP leave the use of LibreSSL to the few users who are able to fix the source code builds on their own and we want to ideally avoid having to patch third party software.

LibreSSL 已從2.7升級到2.8 。如果您在使用 LibreSSL 時遇到任何問題，請務必告知我們，因為令人遺憾的是，OpenVPN、Squid、StrongSwan 和NTP等第三方專案似乎將 LibreSSL 的使用權留給了少數能夠自行修復原始程式碼建置問題的用戶，而我們希望盡可能避免為第三方軟體修補程式。

##### 19.1.1 (February 05, 2019)｜19.1.1 （2019年2月5日）

This is a security and reliability release: WAN DHCP will no longer trust the server MTU given. Uncoordinated cross site scripting issues have been fixed. And the Python request library was patched due to CVE 2018-18074.

這是一個安全性和可靠性版本更新： WAN DHCP將不再信任指定的伺服器MTU 。已修復非協調跨站腳本攻擊問題。此外，由於CVE 2018-18074，Python request 函式庫也已打上修補程式。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

    系統：位址XSS -容易出現轉義問題 [\[1\]]( https://packetstormsecurity.com/files/151381/OPNsense-18.7-Cross-Site-Scripting.html )
    
-   firewall: add port range validation to shaper inputs  
    防火牆：在整形器輸入中新增連接埠範圍驗證

    防火牆：刪除描述驗證約束

    介面：在自訂數據機上正確配置SIM PIN
    
-   reporting: prevent cleanup from deleting current data when future data exists  
    報告：防止清理操作在存在未來資料時刪除目前資料。

    openvpn：修正了多客戶端匯出問題
