##### 19.1 (January 31, 2019)｜19.1 （2019年1月31日）

For more than four years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

四年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

The 19.1 release, nicknamed “Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥）, consists of a total of 620 individual changes since 18.7 came out 6 months ago, spread out over 12 intermediate releases including the recent release candidates. That is the average of 2 stable releases per month, security updates and important bug fixes included! If we had to pick a few highlights it would be: The firewall alias API is finally in place. The migration to HardenedBSD 11.2 has been completed. 2FA now works with a remote LDAP / local TOTP combination. And the OpenVPN client export was rewritten for full API support as well.

19.1版本，暱稱“Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥） ，自 6 個月前18.7發布以來，共包含 620 項更改，這些更改分佈在 12 個中間版本中，包括最近的候選版本。這意味著平均每月發布 2 個穩定版本，其中包含安全性更新和重要的錯誤修復！如果要列舉幾個亮點，那就是：防火牆別名API終於上線了。向 HardenedBSD 11.2的遷移已完成。雙重認證 (2FA) 現在支援遠端LDAP / 本地TOTP組合。此外，OpenVPN 用戶端匯出也已重寫，以完全支援API 。

    monit：組件改進和錯誤修復（由 Frank Brendel 貢獻）
    
-   ui: fix regression in single host or network subnet select in static pages  
    ui：修正靜態頁面中單一主機或網路子網路選擇時的迴歸問題
    
-   plugins: os-frr 1.7 updates OSPF outbound rules (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    插件：os-frr 1.7更新OSPF出站規則（由 Fabian Franz 提供）
    
-   plugins: os-telegraf 1.7.4 fixes packet filter input  
    插件：os-telegraf 1.7.4修復資料包過濾器輸入
    
-   plugins: os-theme-rebellion 1.8.2 adds image colour invert  
    插件：os-theme-rebellion 1.8.2新增圖像顏色反轉
    
-   plugins: os-vnstat 1.1 [\[3\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/net/vnstat/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-vnstat 1.1 [\[3\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/net/vnstat/pkg-descr )
    
-   plugins: os-zabbix-agent now uses Zabbix version 4.0  
    外掛：os-zabbix-agent 現在使用 Zabbix 版本4.0
    
-   src: revert mmc\_calculate\_clock() as HS200/HS400 support breaks legacy support  
    src：還原 mmc\_calculate\_clock()，因為HS200/HS400支援會破壞舊版支持
    
-   src: update sqlite3-3.20.0 to sqlite3-3.26.0 [\[4\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-19:03.sqlite.asc)  
    src: 更新 sqlite3- 3.20.0為 sqlite3- 3.26.0 [\[4\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-19:03.sqlite.asc )
    
-   src: import tzdata 2018h, 2018i [\[5\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-19:04.tzdata.asc)  
    src: import tzdata 2018h, 2018i [\[5\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-19:04.tzdata.asc )
    
-   src: avoid unsynchronized updates to kn\_status [\[6\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-19:05.kqueue.asc)  
    src：避免對 kn\_status 進行不同步的更新 [\[6\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-19:05.kqueue.asc )
    
-   ports: ca\_root\_nss 3.42  
    埠：ca\_root\_nss 3.42
    
-   ports: dhcp6c 20190128 prevent rawops double-free (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    ports: dhcp6c 20190128 防止 rawops 雙重釋放（由 Team Rebellion 提供）
    
-   ports: sudo patch to fix listpw=never [\[7\]](https://bugzilla.sudo.ws/show_bug.cgi?id=869)  
    ports: sudo patch to fix listpw=never [\[7\]]( https://bugzilla.sudo.ws/show_bug.cgi?id=869 )
    

Migration notes and minor incompatibilities to look out for:

遷移注意事項和需要注意的細微不相容性：

-   Gateway health graphs may need a manual reset due to the Apinger to Dpinger migration. Apinger is no longer available.  
    由於從 Apinger 遷移到 Dpinger，網關健康圖表可能需要手動重設。 Apinger 已不再可用。
    
-   Intrusion detection GeoIP rules are automatically deactivated and need to be manually migrated to firewall alias GeoIP.  
    入侵偵測 GeoIP 規則已自動停用，需要手動遷移到防火牆別名 GeoIP。
    
-   Quagga plugin has been superseded by FRR plugin. A binary quagga package has been conserved for the time being.  
    Quagga 插件已被FRR插件取代。目前已暫時保留了 quagga 二進位軟體包。
    
-   Please read the FRR documentation with regard to the required system tunables [\[8\]](#p-210) .  
    請閱讀FRR文檔，以了解有關所需系統可調參數的資訊 [\[8\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/dynamic_routing.html )。
    
-   Bhyve VM boot may fail as a guest. Use the “-w” parameter [\[9\]](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=11492.0) to boot.  
    Bhyve VM作為虛擬機器啟動可能會失敗。請使用“-w”參數 [\[9\]]( https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=11492.0 ) 啟動。
    
-   Boot may fail due to Meltdown/Spectre mitigation. A workaround [\[10\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues/3177) exists.  
    由於 Meltdown/Spectre 緩解措施，啟動可能會失敗。存在一種解決方法 [\[10\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues/3177 )。
    
-   SNMP plugin has been superseded by Net-SNMP plugin.  
    SNMP插件已被 Net- SNMP插件取代。

##### 19.1.r2 (January 23, 2019)｜19.1 .r2（2019年1月23日）

Small online update issued to fix known and subsequently patched issues. If you use Insight and flowd\_aggregate service refuses to start go to System: Firmware: Packages and reinstall the “flowd” package.

本次線上更新旨在修復已知問題，這些問題已透過後續修補程式修復。如果您使用 Insight 且 flowd_aggregate 服務無法啟動，請前往“系統”>“韌體”>“軟體包”，然後重新安裝“flowd”軟體包。

These are the changes in detail:

以下是詳細變更內容：

-   firmware: fix invisible error in health check  
    韌體：修復健康檢查中的隱性錯誤
    
-   intrusion detection: avoid spurious migration error on factor reset  
    入侵偵測：避免因重置而導致的虛假遷移錯誤
    
-   monit: fix dashboard widget display and general settings save  
    監控：修復儀錶板小工具顯示和常規設定保存問題
    
-   plugins: os-telegraf fixes checkbox for CPU time collect (contributed by chaispaquichui)  
    插件：os-telegraf 修復了CPU時間收集的複選框（由 chaispaquichui 貢獻）
    
-   ports: flowd Python bindings runtime fix  
    ports: flowd Python 綁定運行時修復
    

Stay safe, Your OPNsense team

請注意安全，OPNsense團隊敬上

##### 19.1.r1 (January 21, 2019)｜19.1 .r1（2019年1月21日）

For almost four years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

近四年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you.

感謝大家參與測試、完善和貢獻這個專案！我們知道，沒有你們，這個計畫就不會是現在的樣子。

Here are the full changes against version 18.7.10:

以下是與18.7.10版本相比的全部變更：

-   system: console port assignment can now assign OPT without LAN  
    系統：控制台連接埠分配現在可以分配OPT而無需LAN
    
-   system: anti-lockout will use OPT1 if LAN is not present  
    系統：如果LAN不存在，防鎖定功能將使用OPT1
    
-   system: allow creation of combined client/server SSL certificate  
    系統：允許建立組合客戶端/伺服器SSL憑證
    
-   system: gateway monitoring switches to Dpinger with Apinger removed  
    系統：網關監控切換到 Dpinger，移除 Apinger。
    
-   system: detect unassigned gateways in static address setups  
    系統：偵測靜態位址配置中未指派的網關
    
-   system: more advanced gateway monitoring options for Dpinger (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    系統：Dpinger 的更進階網關監控選項（由 Team Rebellion 提供）
    
-   system: removal of the old notification system in favour of Monit  
    系統：移除舊的通知系統，改用 Monit 系統。
    
-   system: only allow syslog remote binding to assigned interfaces  
    系統：僅允許 syslog 遠端綁定到指定的接口
    
-   system: disable IP aliases configured with VHID on temporary disable  
    系統：暫時停用已配置為VHID別名的IP
    
-   system: remove AHCI MSI disable workaround used in FreeBSD 11.1  
    系統：移除AHCI MSI FreeBSD 11.1中所使用的停用變通方案
    
-   system: default gateway switching moves back to general settings  
    系統：預設網關切換已移回常規設定
    
-   system: beep sound notification setting moves to misc. settings  
    系統：蜂鳴聲通知設定移至其他設置
    
-   system: limit log line length in log widget  
    系統：限制日誌控制項中的日誌行長度
    
-   interfaces: change 6RD/6to4 interface prefix from internal name to physical device  
    介面：將 6RD/6to4 介面前綴從內部名稱變更為實體設備
    
-   interfaces: prohibit tracking on 6RD with /64 upstream prefix  
    介面：禁止在 6RD 上使用 /64 上游前綴進行追蹤
    
-   interfaces: remove unneeded use of potentially clashing fe80::1:1 addresses for IPv6 tracking  
    介面：移除不必要的、可能衝突的 fe80::1:1 位址，用於 IPv6 追蹤
    
-   interfaces: clear an apparently faulty system DUID when no manual DUID is set  
    介面：清除明顯故障的系統錯誤DUID當未手動設定DUID時）
    
-   interfaces: updated custom dhclient-script used for DHCPv4  
    介面：已更新用於 DHCPv4 的自訂 dhclient 腳本
    
-   interfaces: VIP support for GRE devices  
    介面： VIP支援GRE設備
    
-   interfaces: simplify find\_interface\_ip\* functions  
    介面：簡化 find_interface_ip* 函數
    
-   interfaces: remove get\_interface\_subnet\* functions  
    介面：移除 get\_interface\_subnet\* 函數
    
-   interfaces: remove unused get\_possible\_listen\_ips function  
    介面：移除未使用的 get_possible_listen_ips 函數
    
-   interfaces: link status indicator on assignments page  
    介面：任務頁面上的連結狀態指示器
    
-   interfaces: unify interface removal code  
    介面：統一介面移除程式碼
    
-   firewall: switch GeoIP database download to HTTPS  
    防火牆：將 GeoIP 資料庫下載切換至HTTPS
    
-   firewall: find IP reference tool for aliases  
    防火牆：找出別名的IP參考工具
    
-   firewall: improve alias page responsiveness with large number of addresses  
    防火牆：提高別名頁面在大量位址下的回應速度
    
-   firewall: show system errors when reloading aliases  
    防火牆：重新載入別名時顯示系統錯誤
    
-   firewall: NAT port forward logging option and live view support  
    防火牆： NAT連接埠轉送日誌記錄選項和即時查看支援
    
-   firewall: optionally resolve all host names in live view  
    防火牆：可選擇在即時視圖中解析所有主機名
    
-   firewall: not all states could be removed in diagnostics page  
    防火牆：並非所有狀態都可以在診斷頁面中移除
    
-   firewall: clean up unused NAT rule association code  
    防火牆：清理未使用的NAT規則關聯代碼
    
-   reporting: improve handling of empty Insight datasets  
    報告：改進對空 Insight 資料集的處理
    
-   reporting: prepare for Python 3 conversion  
    報告：準備 Python 3 轉換
    
-   firmware: switch default mirror location to HTTPS  
    韌體：將預設鏡像位置切換至HTTPS
    
-   firmware: health check for base and kernel files including version check  
    韌體：對基礎檔案和核心檔案進行健康檢查，包括版本檢查
    
-   firmware: support base and kernel file size in packages overview  
    韌體：軟體包中對基礎檔案和內核檔案大小的支援概述
    
-   firmware: /var MFS compatibility on base installation when reboot is deferred  
    韌體：/var MFS基本安裝時延遲重啟的兼容性
    
-   firmware: command line core lock feature prevents package upgrades  
    韌體：命令列核心鎖定功能可阻止軟體包升級。
    
-   firmware: internally remember plugins installed or removed in the GUI  
    韌體：內部記住在GUI中安裝或移除的插件
    
-   firmware: show last known update log on page open  
    韌體：在頁面開啟時顯示上次已知更新日誌
    
-   firmware: show untrusted repository error in GUI  
    韌體： GUI中顯示不受信任的儲存庫錯誤
    
-   firmware: separate chanelogs tab for clarity  
    韌體：為了清晰起見，單獨列出通道日誌標籤頁
    
-   dhcp: refuse setup of instances that have no associated IP address  
    DHCP：拒絕設定沒有關聯IP位址的實例
    
-   dhcp: fix lease time local vs. UTC display in IPv6 leases  
    DHCP：修正 IPv6 租約中本地租約時間與UTC顯示的問題
    
-   installer: change communication from TCP to named pipes  
    安裝人員：將通訊方式從TCP更改為命名管道
    
-   installer: fix sporadic segmentation faults in frontend code  
    安裝程式：修復前端程式碼中零星出現的段錯誤
    
-   installer: allow config import from ZFS pools  
    安裝程式：允許從ZFS池匯入配置
    
-   installer: allow password reset on ZFS pools  
    安裝程序：允許在ZFS池上重設密碼
    
-   installer: removed a number of unused modules  
    安裝程式：移除了一些未使用的模組
    
-   ipsec: generate correct config for “Hybrid-RSA + XAuth” (contributed by Max Weller)  
    ipsec：為「混合RSA + XAuth」產生正確的配置（由 Max Weller 提供）
    
-   ipsec: reworked strongswan.conf generation  
    ipsec：重新設計了 strongswan.conf 的生成
    
-   ipsec: use new interface subnet retrieval code  
    IPsec：使用新的介面子網路檢索程式碼
    
-   monit: support declaring dependencies (contributed by Alexander Werner)  
    monit：支持聲明依賴項（由 Alexander Werner 貢獻）
    
-   monit: add Service/Test type relation (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    monit：新增服務/測試類型關係（由 Frank Brendel 貢獻）
    
-   monit: add CARP status to standard services  
    monit：將CARP狀態加入到標準服務
    
-   monit: add gateway alerts to standard services  
    監控：為標準服務新增網關警報
    
-   monit: backend rework to simplify the service  
    monit：後端重構以簡化服務
    
-   intrusion detection: support base ruleset overlays and improve logging  
    入侵偵測：支援基礎規則集疊加並改善日誌記錄
    
-   intrusion detection: GeoIP feature in user-defined rules has been removed  
    入侵偵測：使用者自訂規則中的 GeoIP 功能已移除
    
-   intrusion detection: obey Content-Disposition header  
    入侵偵測：遵守 Content-Disposition 標頭
    
-   openvpn: client export rewrite, new export option for The Green Bow  
    openvpn：客戶端匯出重寫，為 The Green Bow 新增匯出選項
    
-   unbound: reworked slab calculation  
    未綁定：重新計算的板計算
    
-   unbound: added statistics page  
    unbound：新增統計頁面
    
-   unbound: only bind to interfaces or OpenVPN instances, always bind to loopback  
    unbound：僅綁定到介面或 OpenVPN 實例，始終綁定到環回接口
    
-   unbound: fix ACL subnet calculation for OpenVPN instances  
    unbound：修復 OpenVPN 實例的子網路運算ACL
    
-   unbound: do not generate host entries for OpenVPN instances  
    unbound：不為 OpenVPN 實例產生主機條目
    
-   unbound: improve help text wording and general settings layout  
    未綁定：改進幫助文字措詞和常規設定佈局
    
-   web proxy: parent proxy support (contributed by Michael Muenz)  
    Web代理：父代理支援（由Michael Muenz貢獻）
    
-   wizard: fix checkbox label styling  
    精靈：修復複選框標籤樣式
    
-   mvc: converted reboot, halt and license page to MVC  
    mvc：已將重新啟動、停止和許可證頁面轉換為MVC
    
-   mvc: compared-to-field constraint (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    mvc：與字段進行比較的約束（由 Fabian Franz 提供）
    
-   mvc: external clients which set Authorization header now receive raw JSON responses  
    mvc：設定了 Authorization 標頭的外部客戶端現在可以接收原始的JSON回應
    
-   mvc: fix empty value check in grid (contributed by Smart-Soft)  
    MVC：修復網格中的空值檢查（由 Smart-Soft 提供）
    
-   mvc: globally lock config when multiple items are deleted at once  
    MVC：當一次刪除多個項目時，全域鎖定配置

#### 18.7 “Happy Hippo”（快樂河馬） Series｜18.7 “Happy Hippo”（快樂河馬）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_18.7.html>

For 3 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

三年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

Another 6 months passed by ever so quickly! The main goal for 18.7, nicknamed “Happy Hippo”（快樂河馬）, is stability so we have not yet begun to adopt FreeBSD 11.2, but there are several of its Intel NIC driver updates included to bridge the gap until 19.1 comes out. The upgrade also includes a tremendous amount of IPv6 improvements including 6RD support as well as authentication and backup framework consolidation. Please also take note that QinQ is no longer included in this release.

又過了六個月，時間過得很快！ 18.7 （暱稱“Happy Hippo”（快樂河馬） ）的主要目標是穩定性，因此我們尚未開始採用FreeBSD 11.2 ，但其中包含了一些Intel NIC驅動程式更新，以彌補19.1 。此次升級還包含大量IPv6改進，包括6RD支援以及身份驗證和備份框架的整合。另請注意，此版本不再包含QinQ。

These are the most prominent changes since version 18.1:

以下是自18.1版本以來最顯著的變化：

-   improved WAN DHCPv6 and SLAAC connectivity and tracking  
    改進了WAN DHCPv6 和SLAAC連接性和追蹤功能
    
-   functional IPv6 Rapid Deployment (6RD) support  
    功能性 IPv6 快速部署 (6RD) 支持
    
-   improved default route handling and gateway switching  
    改進的預設路由處理和網關交換
    
-   OpenVPN default setup improvements for IPv6 and RADIUS attribute support  
    OpenVPN 預設設定改進，支援 IPv6 和RADIUS屬性
    
-   Dpinger gateway monitoring integration  
    Dpinger網關監控集成
    
-   password policies for local authentication and coupled TOTP  
    用於本地身份驗證和耦合TOTP的密碼策略
    
-   Monit core integration to eventually replace the legacy notifications  
    監控核心整合最終將取代舊式通知
    
-   OpenSSH access via group and shell selection instead of privilege  
    透過群組和 shell 選擇而非權限存取 OpenSSH
    
-   pluggable backup framework with new Nextcloud option  
    帶有全新 Nextcloud 選項的可插拔備份框架
    
-   system tunables are now also used as loader tunables  
    系統可調參數現在也用作載入器可調參數。
    
-   unrestricted VLAN usage for e.g. Xen  
    不受限制的VLAN用途，例如 Xen
    
-   QinQ interface removal  
    QinQ介面移除
    
-   firmware GUI speedup, improved error parsing and console reboot hint  
    韌體GUI速度提升、改進的錯誤解析和控制台重啟提示
    
-   ZFS on root boot support (installer support is pending, but opnsense-bootstrap works)  
    ZFS關於根啟動支援（安裝程式支援正在等待中，但 opnsense-bootstrap 可以正常運作）
    
-   ZFS and MSDOS config import support  
    ZFS和MSDOS配置導入支持
    
-   ISC DHCP version moves from 4.3 to 4.4  
    ISC DHCP版本從4.3升級到4.4
    
-   RRDtool version moves from 1.2 to 1.7  
    RRDtool 版本從1.2升等到1.7
    
-   rework rc.syshook facility to use drop-in directories instead of suffixes  
    重構 rc.syshook 功能，使其使用直接插入的目錄而不是後綴。
    
-   backports of FreeBSD 11.2 Intel NIC drivers  
    FreeBSD 11.2 Intel NIC驅動程式的向後移植
    
-   stand-alone frontend UI development tools  
    獨立前端UI開發工具
    
-   language updates for Czech, French, German, Portuguese (Brazil)  
    捷克語、法語、德語、葡萄牙語（巴西）的語言更新
    
-   UI header security and SSL cipher hardening  
    UI報頭安全性和SSL密碼強化
    
-   extensive UI cleanups and menu consolidation  
    大量UI清理和菜單整合
    
-   new and rewritten plugins: os-cache, os-lcdproc-sdeclcd, os-net-snmp, os-nut, os-openconnect, os-relayd 2.0, os-shadowsocks, os-theme-cicada, os-theme-rebellion, os-theme-tukan, os-wol 2.0  
    新的和重寫的插件： os-cache, os-lcdproc-sdeclcd, os-net-snmp, os-nut, os-openconnect, os-relayd 2.0 , os-shadowsocks, os-theme-cicada, os-theme-the-me-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the-the 2.0
    

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you.

感謝大家參與測試、完善和貢獻這個專案！我們知道，沒有你們，這個計畫就不會是現在的樣子。

##### 18.7.10 (January 07, 2019)｜18.7.10 （2019年1月7日）

2019 means 19.1 is almost here. In the meantime accept this small incremental update with goodies such as Suricata 4.1, custom passwords for P12 certificate export as well as fresh fixes in the FreeBSD base.

2019 年意味著19.1即將發布。在此期間，請接受這個小幅增量更新，其中包含一些實用功能，例如 Suricata 4.1 、P12 憑證匯出的自訂密碼以及 FreeBSD 基礎中的一些最新修復。

A lot of cleanups went into this update to make sure there will be a smooth transition to 19.1-RC for you early birds. We expect RC1 in 1-2 weeks and the final 19.1 on January 31.

為了確保各位早期使用者能夠順利過渡到19.1-RC ，本次更新進行了大量清理工作。我們預計RC1將在1-2週內上線，最終的19.1版本將於1月31日上線。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: P12 certificate export now allows to specify a password  
    系統：P12 憑證匯出現在允許指定密碼
    
-   system: allow plain IPv6 for LDAP and RADIUS host  
    系統：允許主機使用純 IPv6 協議，主機為LDAP和RADIUS
    
-   system: properly sort columns with size units in activity page  
    系統：在活動頁面中正確依大小單位對列進行排序
    
-   system: remove references to “automatic” in HA help texts  
    系統：刪除HA幫助文本中所有關於「自動」的引用
    
-   system: add option to only show temperature of one core in widget  
    系統：新增選項，允許在小部件中僅顯示一個核心的溫度。
    
-   system: speed up isArraySequential()  
    系統：加快 isArraySequential() 的速度
    
-   system: introduce configdp\_run() variant  
    系統：引入 configdp\_run() 變體
    
-   system: assorted code cleanups  
    系統：各種程式碼清理
    
-   interfaces: only show name servers offered by individual link in status page  
    介面：僅在狀態頁面中顯示各個連結提供的名稱伺服器
    
-   interfaces: DUID-LL generator fix (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    介面： DUID-LL生成器修復（由 Team Rebellion 提供）
    
-   interfaces: show disabled and virtual interfaces in groups  
    介面：顯示群組中已停用和虛擬介面
    
-   interfaces: change wireless page interface iterators  
    介面：更改無線頁面介面迭代器
    
-   interfaces: change LAGG page interface iterators  
    介面：更改LAGG頁面介面迭代器
    
-   interfaces: remove unused get\_dns\_servers()  
    介面：移除未使用的 get\_dns\_servers()
    
-   interfaces: assorted code cleanups  
    接口：各種程式碼清理
    
-   firewall: fix an exception error in alias config read  
    防火牆：修正別名設定讀取中的異常錯誤
    
-   firewall: fix typo in outbound NAT destination help text  
    防火牆：修復出站NAT目標幫助文字中的拼字錯誤
    
-   firewall: rename “Localhost”（本機） to “Loopback”（環回） for clarity in virtual IP pages  
    防火牆：為了在虛擬IP頁面中更清晰地命名，請將“Localhost”（本機）重新命名為“Loopback”（環回）
    
-   firewall: unify anti-lockout behaviour to match rules and GUI display  
    防火牆：統一防鎖定行為以符合規則和GUI顯示
    
-   firewall: switch to tokenizer for shaper source and destination fields  
    防火牆：切換到分詞器來處理整形器的來源字段和目標字段
    
-   firewall: fix alias utility issue when adding into empty alias  
    防火牆：修正向空別名新增別名時別名實用程式的問題
    
-   firewall: correct alias name limit to 31 characters  
    防火牆：將別名名稱限制更正為 31 個字符
    
-   firewall: bring back auto-complete for nested aliases  
    防火牆：恢復巢狀別名的自動補全功能
    
-   firewall: NAT rules on reflection for port forwards only when address exists on interface  
    防火牆： NAT僅當介面上存在位址時，才對連接埠轉送規則進行反射。
    
-   firewall: lower bogon download retry attempts to 3  
    防火牆：將 Bogon 下載重試次數減少至 3 次
    
-   firewall: schedule JS code update  
    防火牆：計畫JS代碼更新
    
-   captive portal: add setting to always send accounting requests  
    強制門戶：新增始終發送計費請求的設置

##### 18.7.9 (December 12, 2018)｜18.7.9 （2018年12月12日）

To keep it snappy: enclosed are assorted updates and fixes, a new dnscrypt-proxy plugin as well as security updates from FreeBSD and third parties. Happy patch day!

為了保持系統運作流暢：本次更新包含各種更新和修復程式、新的 dnscrypt-proxy 插件，以及 FreeBSD 和第三方的安全性更新。祝您補丁日快樂！

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: allow setting alternative names on CSR  
    系統：允許在CSR上設定備用名稱
    
-   system: add link-local routes with correct scope  
    系統：新增具有正確作用域的鏈路本地路由
    
-   system: fix LDAP import button for Firefox  
    系統：修復 Firefox 的LDAP導入按鈕
    
-   system: assorted cleanups in HTML and PHP code  
    系統：對HTML和PHP代碼進行各種清理
    
-   interfaces: add note about CGN addresses included in private range  
    介面：新增關於私有範圍內包含的CGN位址的說明
    
-   interfaces: fix checksum disable for IPv6 TX / RX flags  
    介面：修復 IPv6 TX / RX標誌的校驗和停用問題
    
-   interfaces: multiple type DUID support (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    介面：多種類型DUID支援（由 Team Rebellion 提供）
    
-   interfaces: properly read and write dhcp6c DUID binary file  
    介面：正確讀取和寫入 dhcp6c DUID二進位文件
    
-   interfaces: do not read VLAN capabilities from nonexistent interfaces  
    接口：不要從不存在的介面讀取VLAN功能
    
-   interfaces: removal of PEAR.inc from IPv6 address library  
    介面：從 IPv6 位址庫移除PEAR .inc

    接口：對HTML和PHP程式碼進行各種清理

-   firewall: default alias protocol to both IPv4 and IPv6  
    防火牆：IPv4 和 IPv6 的預設別名協議
    
-   firewall: fix validation of outbound NAT destination alias  
    防火牆：修復出站NAT目標別名的驗證

##### 18.7.8 (November 22, 2018)｜18.7.8 （2018年11月22日）

This stable update finally brings you the promised LDAP+TOTP authentication, but also renewed language translations and several third party software updates for software such as OpenSSL, OpenSSH and Sudo. A reboot is not required, but recommended.

這次穩定版更新終於帶來了承諾的LDAP+TOTP身份驗證功能，同時也更新了語言翻譯，並針對OpenSSL、OpenSSH和Sudo等第三方軟體進行了多項更新。無需重啟，但建議重啟。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

    系統：顯示 NextCloud 備份約束的實際驗證訊息
    
-   system: LDAP import button primary colour and prevent default page submit  
    系統： LDAP匯入按鈕主色並阻止預設頁面提交
    
-   system: add LDAP+TOTP authentication variant (2FA)  
    系統：新增LDAP+TOTP身份驗證變體（雙重認證）
    
-   system: avoid silent fatal error when LDAP OUs could not be retrieved  
    系統：避免在無法擷取LDAP OU 時出現靜默致命錯誤
    
-   system: avoid duplicated cookies on login page by not closing session  
    系統：避免登入頁面上出現重複的 cookie，方法是不要關閉會話。
    
-   system: allow to fully disable misc. reboot failsafe backups

##### 18.7.7 (November 08, 2018)｜18.7.7 （2018年11月8日）

Today we are addressing CVE-2018-18958 regarding an unenforced “deny config write” privilege. The issue was reported by brainrecursion this Monday and subsequently fixed along with several related issues. The “deny config write” privilege coupled with admin or user and group manager rights are affected combinations. It is an uncommon way to configure access as the “deny config write” privilege is commonly used for role-based access to non-system services, e.g. captive portals.

今天我們討論的是編號為CVE -2018-18958的問題，該問題涉及未強制執行的「拒絕配置寫入」權限。 brainrecursion於本週一報告了此問題，隨後已修復，同時修復的還有幾個相關問題。 「拒絕配置寫入」權限與管理員或使用者/群組管理員權限的組合會受到影響。這種配置存取權限的方式並不常見，因為「拒絕配置寫入」權限通常用於基於角色的非系統服務存取控制，例如強制入口網站。

As we cannot be sure that no further issues of this sort exist please refrain from using the “deny config write” privilege or at least stop giving access to system services or full admin rights to these users or groups. In the midterm we will be looking for replacements of the current privilege for something that is more generic and robust in enforcement.

由於我們無法確定是否有其他類似問題，請避免使用「拒絕配置寫入」權限，或至少停止向這些使用者或群組授予系統服務存取權限或完整的管理員權限。中期，我們將尋找更通用、更強大的權限替代方案來取代目前的權限。

Additionally, the update to Suricata 4.0.6 addresses the SMTP crash vulnerability CVE-2018-18956. Since the update does not reboot without an operating system update please manually restart the intrusion detection service.

此外，Suricata 4.0.6的更新修復了SMTP崩潰漏洞CVE -2018-18956。由於此更新不會在不更新作業系統的情況下重啟，請手動重新啟動入侵偵測服務。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 18.7.6 (October 25, 2018)｜18.7.6 （2018年10月25日）

We are back for new features, updates and reliability fixes. Noteworthy are the addition of the PIE shaper option and firewall alias API. Both Unbound and Dnsmasq have been updated to their latest version.

我們帶來了新功能、更新和穩定性修復。值得注意的是，新增了PIE流量整形選項和API防火牆別名。 Unbound和Dnsmasq均已更新至最新版本。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

    防火牆：解析核心中用於連接埠轉送的介面位址“:0”

    防火牆：列出操作修正（由 Thomas Bandixen 提供）

    防火牆：新增對PIE整形器的支援（由 Michael Muenz 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: migrate to new alias API including a new failsafe  
    防火牆：遷移到新別名API ，包含新的故障保護機制
    
-   firewall: repair log widget for plugin themes  
    防火牆：修復外掛主題的日誌小工具

##### 18.7.5 (October 17, 2018)｜18.7.5 （2018年10月17日）

While the HardenedBSD 11.2 adoption is almost finished behind the scenes, this release merely revolves around minor corrections and additions that make your life easier. We are also confident that 18.7.6 finally ships the firewall alias API.

雖然 HardenedBSD 11.2的採用工作已基本完成，但此版本僅包含一些小的修正和新增功能，旨在簡化您的使用體驗。我們也確信18.7.6最終將包含防火牆別名API 。

Of worthy mention are also the IPsec phase 1 changes that allow multiple DH groups and hashes to be selected simultaneously to tackle interoperability between different mobile client requirements. Also check out the Nginx plugin which has again extended its utility belt to include limiting, permanent bans, caching and more.

值得一提的是，IPsec 第一階段的變更允許同時選擇多個DH組和哈希值，以解決不同行動客戶端之間的互通性問題。此外，Nginx 外掛程式也再次擴展了其功能，新增了限制、永久封鎖、快取等功能。

##### 18.7.4 (September 27, 2018)｜18.7.4 （2018年9月27日）

This update reboots into the latest and greatest Realtek driver version 1.95. Also included is a web proxy implementation of the WPAD protocol. Furthermore LibreSSL was moved from version 2.6 to 2.7.

本次更新將系統重新啟動至最新的 Realtek 驅動程式版本1.95 。此外，還包含WPAD協定的 Web 代理實作。同時，LibreSSL 也從版本2.6升級至2.7 。

Originally planned was the release of the firewall alias API, but this will have to way a while longer. Thank you for your understanding and support!

原計劃發布防火牆別名API ，但還需要一段時間。感謝您的理解與支持！

##### 18.7.3 (September 18, 2018)｜18.7.3 （2018年9月18日）

Long-term IPv6 efforts continue in the form of further 6RD feature comfort and a few edge-case fixes in IPv6 interface selection. Please note there is a reboot necessary due to a security advisory amendment and errata patch.

IPv6 的長期改進工作仍在繼續，包括進一步完善 6RD 功能以及修復 IPv6 介面選擇中的一些特殊情況。請注意，由於安全公告的修訂和勘誤補丁，需要重新啟動系統。

Progress was made on the importer that blocked further efforts in ZFS installation originally planned for 18.7. You can now list available ZFS pool and import from any of those if you so wish. Props to Smart-Soft for the contribution.

先前阻礙ZFS安裝的導入程序已取得進展，該安裝原計劃在18.7中進行。現在您可以列出可用的ZFS池，並根據需要從中匯入資料。感謝 Smart-Soft 的貢獻。

On the plugin side development for the upcoming WireGuard VPN, ntopng and vnStat plugins continues. Check the forum for further updates.

針對即將推出的 WireGuard VPN 、ntopng 和 vnStat 外掛程式的開發工作仍在繼續。請關注論壇以獲取更多更新資訊。

##### 18.7.2 (September 06, 2018)｜18.7.2 （2018年9月6日）

Lots of third party security updates, plugin updates and minor enhancements in overall system reliability.

包含大量第三方安全性更新、插件更新以及系統整體可靠性的細微改進。

In other news the firewall alias API has been finished in the development version. If you use the development version you cannot go back to the production version until the API has been released there as well, which is probably 18.7.3 so not too far away. We are happy about all reports of the new alias pages and API usability.

其他訊息中，防火牆別名API已在開發版本中完成。如果您使用開發版本，則在API也發布之前無法返回到生產版本，這可能是18.7.3，所以距離不遠了。我們對新別名頁面和API可用性的所有報告感到高興。

We will soon begin the migration work for FreeBSD 11.2 for 19.1, but please keep in mind that we will be issuing security advisories to 11.1 when they arise even beyond the original end of life policy.

我們很快就會開始將 FreeBSD 11.2遷移到19.1 ，但請記住，即使超出最初的生命週期結束政策，我們仍會在出現安全問題時向11.1發布安全公告。

##### 18.7.1 (August 14, 2018)｜18.7.1 （2018年8月14日）

This is the first stable update and includes security updates for several third party software and FreeBSD. A Bind plugin was released with DNSBL support and the reported problems with the HAProxy plugin have been sorted out thanks to enthusiastic reporters and testers.

這是首個穩定版更新，包含多個第三方軟體和 FreeBSD 的安全性更新。 Bind 插件已發布，支援DNSBL ，並且感謝熱心的報告者和測試人員，HAProxy 插件的已知問題也已解決。

##### 18.7 (July 31, 2018)｜18.7 （2018年7月31日）

For 3 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

三年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

Another 6 months passed by ever so quickly! The main goal for 18.7, nicknamed “Happy Hippo”（快樂河馬）, is stability so we have not yet begun to adopt FreeBSD 11.2, but there are several of its Intel NIC driver updates included to bridge the gap until 19.1 comes out. The upgrade also includes a tremendous amount of IPv6 improvements including 6RD support as well as authentication and backup framework consolidation. Please also take note that QinQ is no longer included in this release.

又過了六個月，時間過得很快！ 18.7 （暱稱“Happy Hippo”（快樂河馬） ）的主要目標是穩定性，因此我們尚未開始採用FreeBSD 11.2 ，但其中包含了一些Intel NIC驅動程式更新，以彌補19.1期。此次升級還包含大量IPv6改進，包括6RD支援以及身份驗證和備份框架的整合。另請注意，此版本不再包含QinQ。

These are the most prominent changes since version 18.1:

以下是自18.1版本以來最顯著的變化：

-   improved WAN DHCPv6 and SLAAC connectivity and tracking  
    改進了WAN DHCPv6 和SLAAC連接性和跟踪
    
-   functional IPv6 Rapid Deployment (6RD) support  
    功能性 IPv6 快速部署 (6RD) 支持
    
-   improved default route handling and gateway switching  
    改進的預設路由處理和網關交換
    
-   OpenVPN default setup improvements for IPv6 and RADIUS attribute support  
    OpenVPN 預設設定改進，支援 IPv6 和RADIUS屬性
    
-   Dpinger gateway monitoring integration  
    Dpinger網關監控集成
    
-   password policies for local authentication and coupled TOTP  
    本地身份驗證和耦合密碼策略TOTP
    
-   Monit core integration to eventually replace the legacy notifications  
    監控核心整合最終將取代舊式通知
    
-   OpenSSH access via group and shell selection instead of privilege  
    透過群組和 shell 選擇而非權限存取 OpenSSH
    
-   pluggable backup framework with new Nextcloud option  
    帶有全新 Nextcloud 選項的可插拔備份框架
    
-   system tunables are now also used as loader tunables  
    系統可調參數現在也用作載入器可調參數。
    
-   unrestricted VLAN usage for e.g. Xen  
    不受限制的VLAN用途，例如 Xen
    
-   QinQ interface removal  
    QinQ介面移除
    
-   firmware GUI speedup, improved error parsing and console reboot hint  
    韌體GUI速度提升、改進的錯誤解析和控制台重啟提示
    
-   ZFS on root boot support (installer support is pending, but opnsense-bootstrap works)  
    ZFS關於根啟動支援（安裝程式支援正在等待中，但 opnsense-bootstrap 可以正常運作）
    
-   ZFS and MSDOS config import support  
    ZFS和MSDOS配置導入支持
    
-   ISC DHCP version moves from 4.3 to 4.4  
    ISC DHCP版本從4.3升級到4.4
    
-   RRDtool version moves from 1.2 to 1.7  
    RRDtool 版本從1.2升等到1.7
    
-   rework rc.syshook facility to use drop-in directories instead of suffixes  
    重構 rc.syshook 功能，使其使用直接插入的目錄而不是後綴。
    
-   backports of FreeBSD 11.2 Intel NIC drivers  
    FreeBSD 11.2 Intel NIC驅動程式的向後移植
    
-   stand-alone frontend UI development tools  
    獨立前端UI開發工具
    
-   language updates for Czech, French, German, Portuguese (Brazil)  
    捷克語、法語、德語、葡萄牙語（巴西）的語言更新
    
-   UI header security and SSL cipher hardening  
    UI報頭安全性和SSL密碼強化
    
-   extensive UI cleanups and menu consolidation  
    大範圍的UI清理和選單整合
    
-   new and rewritten plugins: os-cache, os-lcdproc-sdeclcd, os-net-snmp, os-nut, os-openconnect, os-relayd 2.0, os-shadowsocks, os-theme-cicada, os-theme-rebellion, os-theme-tukan, os-wol 2.0  
    新的和重寫的插件：os-cache、os-lcdproc-sdeclcd、os-net-snmp、os-nut、os-openconnect、os-relayd 2.0 、os-shadowsocks、os-theme-cicada、os-theme-rebellion、os-shadowsocks、os-theme-cicada、os-theme-rebellion、os-theme 2.0 le
    

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you.

感謝大家參與測試、完善和貢獻這個專案！我們知道，沒有你們，這個計畫就不會是現在的樣子。

Here are the full changes against version 18.7-RC2:

以下是與版本18.7-RC2相比的全部變更：

-   system: clarify help for preventing local nameserver usage in general settings  
    系統：澄清有關在常規設定中阻止使用本地名稱伺服器的幫助訊息
    
-   system: deal with ACL trailing slash wildcards due to its removal from menu links  
    系統：由於選單連結中已移除，請處理ACL尾部斜杠通配符
    
-   system: allow LDAP user import even when multiple authentications servers are set  
    系統：即使設定了多個身份驗證伺服器，也允許LDAP用戶匯入
    
-   system: merge duplicated encrypt() and decrypt() config backup implementations  
    系統：合併重複的 encrypt() 和 decrypt() 配置備份實現
    
-   system: extend encrypt() and decrypt() with optional header, footer and attribute usage  
    系統：擴展 encrypt() 和 decrypt() 函數，使其支援可選的頭部、尾部和屬性用法
    
-   system: optional encryption of Nextcloud backup through user-specified password (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    系統：可透過使用者指定的密碼對 Nextcloud 備份進行可選加密（由 Fabian Franz 提供）
    
-   interfaces: do not yield IPv6 tunnel addresses via legacy\_getall\_interface\_addresses()  
    interfaces: 不透過 legacy\_getall\_interface\_addresses() 取得 IPv6 隧道位址
    
-   firewall: rules alias preview on hover when no description was provided  
    防火牆：未提供描述時，滑鼠懸停時顯示規則別名預覽
    
-   firewall: transitional code for upcoming alias API usage  
    防火牆：即將使用的別名API的過渡代碼
    
-   firewall: remove alias types urltable\_ports and url\_ports  
    防火牆：移除別名類型 urltable\_ports 和 url\_ports
    
-   firewall: revert only binding to first interface address due to ambiguity in IPv6 local-link setups  
    防火牆：由於 IPv6 本地鏈路配置存在歧義，因此僅恢復綁定到第一個介面位址。
    
-   dnsmasq: unconditionally listen on loopback device but avoid binding more than 127.0.0.1 in IPv4  
    dnsmasq：無條件監聽回環設備，但避免綁定超過 IPv4 中的127.0.0.1個端口
    
-   installer: properly accept cancel on guided install  
    安裝程式：正確接受引導安裝中的取消操作
    
-   installer: removed unused mail log feature  
    安裝程式：移除了未使用的郵件日誌功能
    
-   ipsec: remove validation to support for IPv6 over IPv4 tunnel and vice versa  
    IPsec：移除支援 IPv6 over IPv4 隧道以及反向 IPv6 隧道的驗證
    
-   web proxy: more elaborate fix of IDNA encode with leading dots  
    網路代理：更精細地修復了IDNA編碼，並添加了前導點。
    
-   mvc: always use std\_bootgrid\_reload() for bootgrid reloads  
    mvc：一律使用 std\_bootgrid\_reload() 進行引導網格重新加載
    
-   ui: sidebar menu support for optional themes (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    ui：側邊欄選單支援選用主題（由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-dyndns 1.8 fixes Eurodns support  
    插件：os-dyndns 1.8修復 Eurodns 支持
    
-   plugins: os-theme-rebellion 1.3 (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    插件：os-theme-rebellion 1.3 （由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-relayd 2.2 (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    插件：os-relayd 2.2 （由 Frank Brendel 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-siproxd 1.3 (contributed by Michael Muenz)  
    插件：os-siproxd 1.3 （由 Michael Muenz 貢獻）
    
-   ports: dhcp6c 20180720 with fix for raw support (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    埠：dhcp6c 20180720，修正了原始支援問題（由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）
    
-   ports: php 7.1.20 [\[2\]](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-7.php#7.1.20)  
    埠：php 7.1.20 [\[2\]]( https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-7.php#7.1.20 )
    

Migration notes and minor incomatibilities to look out for:

移民注意事項和需要注意的細微不相容之處：

-   SSH access is now bound to the “wheel” group which is automatically added to “admins” group, which “root” is a member of. “root” is the only user that has a default shell, namely opnsense-shell, which is the root console menu.  
    SSH存取權限現在綁定到「wheel」群組，該群組會自動新增至「admins」群組，「root」是該群組的成員。 「root」是唯一擁有預設 shell 的用戶，即 opnsense-shell，它是 root 控制台選單。
    
-   SSH access can be set for an arbitrary group as well under System: Administration for non-members of “admins” group. However, in both cases only SCP works due to a request in the forum to be more proactive regarding yielding of shell access rights. If you want a user to gain true SSH access you need to change their shell from “nologin” to an installed shell in their respective settings.  
    SSH權限也可以在「系統」>「管理」中為非「admins」群組成員的任意群組設定。但是，由於論壇上有人要求更主動地授予 shell 存取權限，因此在這兩種情況下，只有SCP有效。如果您希望使用者獲得真正的SSH存取權限，則需要在其各自的設定中將 shell 從「nologin」變更為已安裝的 shell。
    
-   Web GUI HTTPS ciphers have been hardened. To gain access please use a recent browser.  
    Web GUI HTTPS加密已加強。請使用最新版本的瀏覽器存取。
    
-   The authentication fallback for the GUI/system has been removed in favour of selecting multiple authentication servers at once. Reassign your fallback as a primary authentication method or now use more than two methods.  
    GUI /system 的身份驗證備用方案已被移除，取而代之的是可以同時選擇多個身份驗證伺服器。請將備用方案重新指定為主身份驗證方法，或現在可以使用兩種以上的身份驗證方法。
    
-   It has been found that although WAN interfaces require gateways to function, they do not necessarily have to be assigned in single-WAN scenarios to avoid interfering with WAN reply behaviour. The “none” selection was therefore changed to “auto-detect” to reflect this and now is the recommended setting unless multi-WAN is used.  
    經研究發現，雖然WAN介面需要網關才能正常運作，但在單WAN場景下，並非必須分配網關，以免干擾WAN的回應行為。因此，“無”選項已更改為“自動檢測”以反映這一點，並且現在建議使用此設置，除非使用多WAN場景。
    
-   In preparation for the firewall alias API the per-item descriptions have been removed along with support for the deprecated types urltable\_ports and url\_ports.  
    為了準備防火牆別名API每個項目的描述已被刪除，同時也刪除了對已棄用類型urltable\_ports和url\_ports的支援。
    
-   OpenVPN /31 tunnel network calculation changed to use the first and last address as network address and broadcast address do not exist. If you are affected, adjust your clients or export their configuration again which includes the configuration fix. Additionally, /32 tunnel networks are now prohibited.  
    OpenVPN /31 隧道網路的計算方式已更改，現在使用第一個和最後一個位址作為網路位址，因為廣播位址不存在。如果您受到影響，請調整用戶端設定或重新匯出包含此組態修復的配置。此外，/32 隧道網路現已停用。
    

All images are provided with SHA-256 signatures, which can be verified against the distributed public key:

所有圖像均帶有SHA -256 簽名，可使用已分發的公鑰進行驗證：

```
# openssl base64 -d -in image.bz2.sig -out /tmp/image.sig
# openssl dgst -sha256 -verify rsa.pub -signature /tmp/image.sig image.bz2
```

##### 18.7.r2 (July 19, 2018)｜18.7 .r2（2018年7月19日）

So far so good. Here is another batch of changes for the upcoming 18.7 release from assorted areas. Also included is the latest Suricata 4.0.5.

目前一切順利。以下是即將發布的18.7版本來自各個領域的另一批更改。此外，還包括最新的4.0.5版本。

We have bundled the firewall alias API progress under the hood, but it looks like we will miss our initial 18.7 target. Sorry about that. Though it should be worth the wait. :)

我們已經在後台整合了防火牆別名API的進展，但看來我們將無法實現最初的18.7目標。對此我們深表歉意。不過，相信等待是值得的。 :)

Here is the full list of changes against version 18.7-RC1:

以下是相對於版本18.7-RC1的完整變更清單：

-   system: show fingerprint in certificate details (contributed by Robin Schneider)  
    系統：在證書詳情中顯示指紋（由 Robin Schneider 提供）
    
-   system: fix Nextcloud file name format (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    系統：修復 Nextcloud 檔案名稱格式（由 Fabian Franz 提供）
    
-   system: allow remote backup via cron command  
    系統：允許透過 cron 指令進行遠端備份
    
-   system: clarify interface labels for NetFlow generator  
    系統：明確 NetFlow 產生器的介面標籤
    
-   system: restart syslog when interface bind addresses may have changed  
    系統：當介面綁定位址可能已變更時，請重新啟動 syslog 日誌記錄。
    
-   system: do not use forced down gateways for default gateway switching  
    系統：不要使用強制關閉的網關進行預設網關切換。
    
-   system: allow USB-based serial ports  
    系統：允許基於USB的串口
    
-   interfaces: allow /0 to /32 in 6rd and align prefix length calculation with effective prefix used  
    介面：允許使用 /0 到 /32 的前綴，並將前綴長度計算與實際使用的前綴對齊。
    
-   interfaces: 6rd validation and avoid listing on assignment page  
    介面：第六次驗證並避免列入分配頁面
    
-   firewall: remove virtual IP network address restrictions for IPv6  
    防火牆：移除 IPv6 的虛擬IP網路位址限制
    
-   firewall: ignore namelookup when no nameservers are configured  
    防火牆：當未配置名稱伺服器時，忽略名稱查找。
    
-   firewall: drop detail description field in preparation for alias API  
    防火牆：刪除詳細描述字段，為別名API做準備
    
-   firewall: do not emit reflection rules for the wrong address family  
    防火牆：不要為錯誤的位址族發出反射規則
    
-   firewall: properly handle 6rd / 6to4 tunnel device in rule generation  
    防火牆：在規則產生中正確處理 6rd / 6to4 隧道設備
    
-   firewall: allow to select external aliases  
    防火牆：允許選擇外部別名
    
-   dashboard: add a 6 widget columns option  
    儀表板：新增 6 列小工具選項
    
-   firmware: slightly improve remote probing of kernel and base set  
    韌體：略微改進內核和基本集的遠端探測
    
-   firmware: hide upgrade banner when update is done  
    韌體：更新完成後隱藏升級橫幅
    
-   installer: give basic tip that GUI IP can be set in console (contributed by stilez)  
    安裝程式：提供基本提示， GUI IP可以在控制台中設定（由 stilez 提供）
    
-   intrusion detection: clean up previously installed rules  
    入侵偵測：清理先前安裝的規則
    
-   ipsec: add mutual RSA and EAP-MSCHAPv2 support  
    ipsec：新增相互的RSA和EAP -MSCHAPv2 支持
    
-   monit: fix UI issues (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    monit：修復UI問題（由 Frank Brendel 提供）
    
-   ntp: typo in SiRF selection  
    ntp：SiRF 選擇中的拼字錯誤
    
-   openvpn: change IP calculation of /31 tunnel networks (contributed by Daniil Baturin)  
    openvpn：更改IP /31 隧道網路的計算（由 Daniil Baturin 提供）
    
-   openvpn: move generation of client connect / disconnect directives to server mode block  
    openvpn：將客戶端連接/斷開連接指令的產生移至伺服器模式區塊

    插件：os-theme-rebellion 1.2 （由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）

    插件：os-theme-tukan 1.1 （由 Team Rebellion 提供）
    
-   plugins: os-openconnect 1.1 (contributed by Michael Muenz)  
    插件：os-openconnect 1.1 （由 Michael Muenz 貢獻）

    插件：os-net-snmp 1.0修復監聽字段（由 Michael Muenz 貢獻）

    外掛程式：os-web-proxy-sso 2.2 UI修復（由 Smart-Soft 提供）

As always with our pre-releases, only OpenSSL is provided at this point, but can be switched for LibreSSL as soon as the release is available. This release candidate does update directly into the 18.7 stable track and subsequent release candidates. Please let us know about your experience!

與以往的預發布版本一樣，目前僅提供 OpenSSL，但正式版發布後即可切換到 LibreSSL。此候選版本將直接更新至18.7穩定版及後續候選版本。歡迎分享您的使用體驗！

##### 18.7.r1 (July 11, 2018)｜18.7 .r1（2018年7月11日）

For 3 and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

三年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

Another 6 months passed by ever so quickly! The main goal for 18.7 is stability so we have not yet begun to adopt FreeBSD 11.2, but there are several Intel NIC driver updates included to bridge the gap until 19.1 comes out. The upgrade also includes a tremendous amount of IPv6 improvements and authentication framework consolidation. Please also take note that QinQ is no longer included in this release.

又過了六個月，時間過得很快！ 18.7的主要目標是穩定性，因此我們尚未開始採用 FreeBSD 11.2 ，但其中包含了一些 Intel NIC驅動程式更新，以彌補19.1發布前的這段時間。此次升級還包括大量 IPv6 改進和身份驗證框架整合。另請注意，此版本不再包含 QinQ。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you.

感謝大家參與測試、完善和貢獻這個專案！我們知道，沒有你們，這個計畫就不會是現在的樣子。

Here are the full changes against version 18.1.11:

以下是與版本18.1.11相比的全部變更：

-   system: improve local account expire cron job to also flush passwords and SSH keys  
    系統：改進本機帳號過期定時任務，使其同時刷新密碼和SSH金鑰
    
-   system: do not account-lock root user to avoid meddling with cron  
    系統提示：請勿鎖定 root 使用者帳戶，以免干擾 cron 任務。
    
-   system: only write authorized SSH keys for login-capable users  
    系統：僅允許具有登入權限的使用者寫入授權的SSH金鑰
    
-   system: Diffie-Helman parameter selection: auto, cron-based, RFC 7919  
    系統：Diffie-Helman 參數選擇：自動、基於 cron、 RFC 7919
    
-   system: avoid use of expired nsCertType attribute in certificate purpose test (contributed by Justin Coffman)  
    系統：避免在憑證用途測試中使用已過期的nsCertType屬性（由Justin Coffman貢獻）
    
-   system: steer SSH shell access via group to separate system-wide admins from SCP-only users  
    系統：透過群組來引導SSH shell 存取權限，以將系統級管理員與SCP僅限使用者分開
    
-   system: web GUI cipher hardening and optional HSTS use  
    系統：web GUI密碼強化與可選HSTS使用
    
-   system: administration settings now include session timeout and authentication server selection  
    系統：管理設定現在包括會話逾時和身份驗證伺服器選擇。
    
-   system: remove authentication fallback in favour of allowing to select multiple servers at once  
    系統：移除身份驗證回退機制，改為允許一次選擇多個伺服器。
    
-   system: local password policies are now found via local database server edit  
    系統：現在可以透過本機資料庫伺服器編輯來尋找本機密碼原則。
    
-   system: removed spurious LDAP user test page  
    系統：已移除虛假的LDAP用戶測試頁面
    
-   system: allow to select a shell per user  
    系統：允許每個使用者選擇一個 shell
    
-   system: unlimited sessions are no longer allowed  
    系統提示：不再允許無限會話。
    
-   system: remote syslog support for intrusion detection  
    系統：支援遠端 syslog 以進行入侵偵測
    
-   system: allow full validation on gateways added via interfaces configuration page  
    系統：允許對透過介面設定頁面新增的網關進行完整驗證
    
-   system: use red color on all administrator users and superuser groups in access lists  
    系統：在存取清單中，所有管理員使用者和超級使用者群組均使用紅色。
    
-   system: removed average tooltip indication from both CPU usage graphs on dashboard (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    系統：從儀表板上的兩個CPU使用情況圖表中移除平均值工具提示（由Team Rebellion貢獻）
    
-   system: large CPU usage widget now shows the time and date for each data point  
    系統：大型CPU使用情況小工具現在顯示每個資料點的日期和時間
    
-   interfaces: allow tracking mode for SLAAC (ISP 018.net.il)  
    介面：允許SLAAC ( ISP 018.net.il) 的追蹤模式
    
-   interfaces: rework IPv6 interface detection logic on PPP links  
    介面：重構PPP鏈路上的IPv6介面偵測邏輯
    
-   interfaces: optionally allow manual router advertisements and DHCPv6 for tracking (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    介面：可選擇性地允許手動路由器通告和 DHCPv6 用於追蹤（由 Team Rebellion 提供）
    
-   interfaces: merged CARP BACKUP / MASTER handlers into rc.syshook  
    介面：將CARP BACKUP / MASTER處理程序合併到 rc.syshook 中
    
-   interfaces: optionally offer multi-wan and far gateway options for static interface configuration when adding a new gateway  
    介面：新增網關時，可選擇為靜態介面配置提供多WAN和遠網關選項。
    
-   interfaces: allow full interface reload cycle in overview page instead of split release/renew  
    介面：允許在概覽頁面中完成完整的介面重新載入週期，而不是分割發布/續訂。
    
-   interfaces: removed QinQ functionality  
    介面：移除 QinQ 功能
    
-   firewall: improved feedback and reading of filter reload errors  
    防火牆：改進了過濾器重載錯誤的回饋和讀取
    
-   firewall: do not trigger rules scheduling if scheduled rule is disabled  
    防火牆：如果計劃規則已停用，則不要觸發規則計劃。
    
-   firewall: do not automatically port-forward attached VIPs of an interface  
    防火牆：不要自動轉送介面附加的虛擬 IP 位址
    
-   dhcp: remove legacy wake on lan support from leases page  
    DHCP：從租約頁面移除舊版網路喚醒支持
    
-   dnsmasq: listen on all interface addresses for selected interfaces  
    dnsmasq：監聽所選介面的所有介面位址
    
-   firmware: dedicated error for when package manager keeps running in background  
    韌體：當軟體包管理器持續在背景運行時出現的專用錯誤
    
-   firmware: new mirror Aalborg University (Aalborg, DK)  
    韌體：新鏡像奧爾堡大學（奧爾堡， DK ）
    
-   firmware: new mirror Dataroute (Dusseldorf, DE)  
    韌體：新鏡像 Dataroute（杜塞爾多夫， DE ）
    
-   importer: keep asking for a partition if the selected partition is not supported by the importer  
    導入器：如果導入器不支援所選分區，則繼續請求分區。
    
-   installer: use opnsense-importer on configuration import to avoid code duplication  
    安裝程式：在匯入配置時使用 opnsense-importer 以避免程式碼重複
    
-   installer: password recovery option only works for 18.7 onwards  
    安裝程序：密碼恢復選項僅適用於18.7及更高版本。
    
-   installer: simplify GEOM mirror setup questions and resulting mirror name  
    安裝程式：簡化GEOM鏡像設定問題和產生的鏡像名稱
    
-   intrusion detection: add support for rule version checks  
    入侵偵測：增加對規則版本檢查的支持
    
-   ipsec: support mutual RSA with EAP-MSCHAPv2  
    IPsec：支援與EAP相互RSA -MSCHAPv2
    
-   monit: former plugin imported into core and brand new dashboard widget (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    monit：原始插件已匯入核心，並新增了儀表板小工具（由 Frank Brendel 貢獻）
    
-   openvpn: client-specific overrides rework to support RADIUS attributes Framed-IP-Address, Framed-IP-Address, Framed-Route  
    openvpn：客戶端特定覆寫重做以支援RADIUS屬性 Framed- IP -Address、Framed- IP -Address、Framed-Route
    
-   openvpn: destroy device nodes when deleting servers or clients  
    openvpn：刪除伺服器或客戶端時銷毀設備節點
    
-   unbound: create ACL entries for all interface addresses of selected interfaces  
    未綁定：為所選介面的所有介面位址建立ACL條目
    
-   unbound: support ACL modes deny\_non\_local and refuse\_non\_local (contributed by DJFelix)  
    unbound：支援ACL模式 deny\_non\_local 和 reject\_non\_local（由 DJFelix 提供）
    
-   wizard: added a dedicated Diffie-Helman parameter selector  
    精靈：新增了專用的 Diffie-Helman 參數選擇器
    
-   mvc: dynamic urls regardless if you have a trailing slash or not (contributed by Max Orelus)  
    mvc：動態 URL，不論 URL 末端是否有斜線（由 Max Orelus 貢獻）
    
-   mvc: switch from the default $\_GET\[“\_url”\] to $\_SERVER\[“REQUEST\_URI”\] and let Phalcon handle the routing  
    mvc：將預設的 $\_GET\[“\_url”\] 替換為 $\_SERVER\[“ REQUEST \_URI”\]，並請 Phalcon 處理路由。
    
-   mvc: add support for application-specific field types  
    MVC：新增對應用程式特定欄位類型的支持
    
-   mvc: IDNA encode fails when input starts with a dot  
    mvc：當輸入以點號開頭時， IDNA編碼失敗
    
-   rc: unset rcvar before evaluation (contributed by Nicholas de Jong)  
    rc：在評估之前取消設定 rcvar（由 Nicholas de Jong 提供）
    
-   rc: redesigned rc.initial as opnsense-shell utility with command line support and improved RC system interoperability  
    rc：重新設計了 rc.initial，使其成為具有命令列支援的 opnsense-shell 實用程序，並改進了RC系統互通性。
    
-   ui: top level menu item link pivots and security improvements (contributed by Max Orelus)  
    使用者介面：頂級選單項目連結的調整和安全性改進（由 Max Orelus 貢獻）
    
-   ui: assorted style updates and minor fixes in static pages to improve overall visual representation  
    使用者介面：對靜態頁面進行了各種樣式更新和細微修復，以改善整體視覺效果。
    
-   ui: content security policy hardening (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    使用者介面：內容安全策略強化（由 Fabian Franz 提供）
    
-   ui: switch remaining use of Glyphicons to Font-Awesome in static pages  
    使用者介面：將靜態頁面中剩餘的 Glyphicons 圖示切換為 Font-Awesome 圖標
    
-   ui: when JQuery Bootgrid rowselect is enabled the click event is triggered twice  
    使用者介面：啟用 jQuery Bootgrid 的行選擇功能後，點擊事件會觸發兩次。
    
-   ui: order menu alphabetically in a number of places  
    使用者介面：在多個地方按字母順序排列選單
    
-   ui: replaced JQuery Tokenize with Tokenize2  
    ui：已將 jQuery Tokenize 替換為 Tokenize2
    
-   plugins: os-net-snmp 1.0 supports use of Net-SNMP (contributed by Michael Muenz)  
    插件：os-net-snmp 1.0支援使用 Net- SNMP （由 Michael Muenz 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-wol 2.0.d is a MVC rewrite of the wake on LAN plugin (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    插件：os-wol 2.0 .d 是MVC LAN插件的重寫版本（由 Fabian Franz 貢獻）
    
-   src: keep the CARP data structure when an address is not being removed  
    src：當位址未移除時，保留CARP資料結構
    
-   src merge pfSense stf(4) / 6RD additions not in FreeBSD  
    src 合併 pfSense stf(4) / 6RD 新增內容，這些內容不在 FreeBSD 中
    

The list of currently known issues with 18.7-RC1:

18.7-RC1目前已知的問題清單：

-   Boot may fail on Intel Denverton attached storage  
    連接 Intel Denverton 儲存裝置時，啟動可能會失敗
    
-   6RD prefix calculation is not always correct  
    6RD前綴的計算並非總是正確的。
    
-   Monit UI glitch in multi-select fields  
    Monit UI多選字段故障
    
-   Apollo Lake errata patch pending  
    阿波羅湖勘誤補丁待定
    
-   ZFS installer support is missing  
    ZFS安裝程序支援缺失
    

All images are provided with SHA-256 signatures, which can be verified against the distributed public key:

所有圖像均帶有SHA -256 簽名，可使用已分發的公鑰進行驗證：

```
# openssl base64 -d -in image.bz2.sig -out /tmp/image.sig
# openssl dgst -sha256 -verify rsa.pub -signature /tmp/image.sig image.bz2
```

#### 18.1 “Groovy Gecko”（絕妙壁虎） Series｜18.1 “Groovy Gecko”（絕妙壁虎）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_18.1.html>

For more than 3 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

3 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We humbly present to you the sum of another major iteration of the OPNsense firewall. Over the second half of 2017 well over 500 changes have made it into this release, nicknamed “Groovy Gecko”（絕妙壁虎）. Most notably, the firewall NAT rules have been reworked to be more flexible and usable via plugins, which is going to pave the way for subsequent API works on the core firewall functionality. For more details please find the attached list of changes below.

我們很榮幸地向您呈現 OPNsense 防火牆的另一個重大迭代更新。在 2017 年下半年，我們對此版本（代號“Groovy Gecko”（絕妙壁虎） ）進行了超過 500 項更改。其中最值得一提的是，防火牆規則NAT經過重新設計，使其更加靈活，並可透過插件使用，這將為後續API版本對防火牆核心功能的改進奠定基礎。更多詳情請參閱下方附件中的變更清單。

The upgrade track from 17.7 will be available later today. Please be patient. :)

從17.7升級的路線將於今天晚些時候開放。請耐心等待。 :)

Meltdown and Spectre patches are currently being worked on in FreeBSD [\[1\]](https://lists.freebsd.org/pipermail/freebsd-security/2018-January/009719.html) , but there is no reliable timeline. We will keep you up to date through the usual channels as more news become available. Hang in there!

FreeBSD 目前正在開發 Meltdown 和 Spectre 的補丁 [\[1\]]( https://lists.freebsd.org/pipermail/freebsd-security/2018-January/009719.html )，但尚無可靠的時間表。一旦有更多消息，我們將透過常用管道及時通知您。請耐心等待！

These are the most prominent changes since version 17.7:

以下是自17.7版本以來最顯著的變化：

-   FreeBSD 11.1, PHP 7.1 and jQuery 3 migration  
    FreeBSD 11.1, PHP 7.1和 jQuery 3 遷移
    
-   Realtek vendor NIC driver version 1.94  
    Realtek 廠商NIC驅動版1.94
    
-   Portable NAT before IPsec support  
    便攜式NAT支援 IPsec 之前
    
-   Local group restriction feature in OpenVPN and IPsec  
    OpenVPN 和 IPsec 中的本機群組限制功能
    
-   OpenVPN multi-remote support for clients  
    OpenVPN 多遠端客戶端支援
    
-   Strict interface binding for SSH and web GUI  
    SSH和 web GUI的嚴格介面綁定
    
-   Improved MVC tabs and general page layout  
    改進了MVC標籤頁和整體頁面佈局
    
-   Shared forwarding now works on IPv6, in conjunction with “try-forwarding” and improved reply-to multi-WAN behaviour  
    共用轉送現在可在 IPv6 上執行，並結合「嘗試轉送」和改進的回覆多WAN行為
    
-   Easy-to-use update cache support for Linux and Windows in web proxy  
    Web代理程式中對Linux和Windows的易於使用的更新快取支持
    
-   Intrusion detection alert improvements and plugin support for new rulesets (ET Pro, Snort VRT)  
    入侵偵測警報改進和對新規則集的插件支援（ ET Pro，Snort VRT ）
    
-   Revamped HAProxy plugin with introduction pages  
    經過改良的 HAProxy 插件，新增了介紹頁面
    
-   Moved interface selection to menu and quick search for firewall rules, DHCP and wireless status  
    將介面選擇移至選單，並可快速搜尋防火牆規則、 DHCP和無線狀態
    
-   Alias backend rewrite for future extensibility  
    為了便於未來擴展，對別名後端進行了重寫
    
-   Plugin-capable firewall NAT rules  
    支援插件的防火牆NAT規則
    
-   Migration of system routes UI and backend to MVC (also available via API)  
    系統路由UI和後端遷移至MVC （也可透過API存取）
    
-   Reverse DNS support for insight reporting (also available via API)  
    反向DNS支持洞察報告（也可透過API取得）
    
-   Fully rewritten firewall live log in MVC (also available via API)  
    防火牆即時登入已完全重寫MVC （也可透過API取得）
    
-   New plugins: zerotier, mdns-repeater, collectd, telegraf, clamav, c-icap, tor, siproxd, web-proxy-sso, web-proxy-useracl, postfix, rspamd, redis, iperf, arp-scan, zabbix-proxy, frr, node\_exporter  
    新增插件：zerotier、mdns-repeater、collectd、telegraf、clamav、c-icap、tor、siproxd、web-proxy-sso、web-proxy-useracl、postfix、rspamd、redis、iperf、arp-scan、zabbix-proxy、fporter、noproxy

##### 18.1.13 (July 24, 2018)｜18.1.13 （2018年7月24日）

It is that time of the year again: this update is the last one in the 18.1 series and 18.7, nicknamed “Happy Hippo”（快樂河馬）, will be released next week!

又到了一年一度的更新時間：本次更新是18.1系列的最後一次更新，而18.7 （暱稱“Happy Hippo”（快樂河馬） ）將於下週發布！

The transition will be seamless when heeding the upgrade notes to be published with the 18.7 images on July 31. All 18.7-RC users will be able to upgrade right away. After a number of hours we will enable the upgrade path with a small hotfix to 18.1.13. This process may take up to 24 hours so please do not be alarmed about delays.

只要按照7月31日隨18.7鏡像一同發布的升級說明進行操作，過渡過程將非常順暢。所有18.7-RC用戶都可以立即升級。幾個小時後，我們將透過一個小型熱修復程序啟用18.1.13的升級路徑。此過程可能需要長達24小時，因此請不要擔心延遲。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: restart syslog when interface bind addresses may have changed  
    系統：當介面綁定位址可能已變更時，請重新啟動 syslog 日誌記錄。
    
-   system: remove unused action\_disable setting in gateway monitoring  
    系統：移除網關監控中未使用的 action_disable 設定
    
-   firmware: new mirror Dataroute (Dusseldorf, DE)  
    韌體：新的鏡像 Dataroute（杜塞爾多夫， DE ）
    
-   ntp: typo in SiRF selection  
    ntp：SiRF 選擇中的拼字錯誤
    
-   openvpn: translate validated field names  
    openvpn：翻譯已驗證的欄位名稱
    
-   rc: unset rcvar before evaluation (contributed by Nicholas de Jong)  
    rc：在評估之前取消設定 rcvar（由 Nicholas de Jong 提供）
    
-   installer: give basic tip that GUI IP can be set in console after install (contributed by stilez)  
    安裝程式：提供基本提示，即安裝後可以在控制台中設定GUI IP （由stilez提供）
    
-   plugins: os-theme-cicada 1.2 (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    插件：os-theme-cicada 1.2 （由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-theme-rebellion 1.2 (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    插件：os-theme-rebellion 1.2 （由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-theme-tukan 1.1 (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    插件：os-theme-tukan 1.1 （由 Team Rebellion 貢獻）
    
-   ports: suricata 4.0.5 [\[1\]](https://suricata-ids.org/2018/07/18/suricata-4-0-5-available/)  
    埠：suricata 4.0.5 [\[1\]]( https://suricata-ids.org/2018/07/18/suricata-4-0-5-available/ )

已發布熱修復版本18.1.13 \_1:

##### 18.1.12 (July 13, 2018)｜18.1.12 （2018年7月13日）

This update ships a few minor bug fixes and several feature tweaks that were either wished for or contributed by the community. That is why we wholeheartedly love our community. <3

本次更新修復了一些小bug，並根據社群的回饋或建議進行了多項功能調整。這就是我們如此熱愛我們社區的原因。 <3

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   system: improve local account expire cron job to also flush passwords and SSH keys  
    系統：改進本機帳號過期定時任務，使其同時刷新密碼和SSH金鑰
    
-   system: show fingerprint in certificate details (contributed by Robin Schneider)  
    系統：在證書詳情中顯示指紋（由 Robin Schneider 提供）
    
-   system: fix Nextcloud file name format (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    系統：修復 Nextcloud 檔案名稱格式（由 Fabian Franz 提供）
    
-   system: allow remote backup via cron command  
    系統：允許透過 cron 指令進行遠端備份
    
-   interfaces: allow /0 to /32 in 6rd and align prefix length calculation with effective prefix used  
    介面：允許使用 /0 到 /32 的前綴，並將前綴長度計算與實際使用的前綴對齊。
    
-   firewall: do not trigger rules scheduling if scheduled rule is disabled  
    防火牆：如果計劃規則已停用，則不要觸發規則計劃。
    
-   firewall: allow to select external aliases  
    防火牆：允許選擇外部別名
    
-   firewall: ignore namelookup when no nameservers are configured  
    防火牆：當未配置名稱伺服器時，忽略名稱查找。
    
-   dashboard: remove tooltips from CPU widgets (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    儀錶板：移除CPU小工具的工具提示（由 Team Rebellion 提供）
    
-   dashboard: add date to large CPU widget data  
    儀表板：為大型CPU小部件資料新增日期
    
-   firmware: add Aalborg University mirror  
    韌體：添加奧爾堡大學鏡像
    
-   intrusion detection: add missing classification category  
    入侵偵測：新增缺少的分類類別
    
-   ipsec: add mutual RSA and EAP-MSCHAPv2 support  
    ipsec：新增相互的RSA和EAP -MSCHAPv2 支持
    
-   wizard: make clear that “admin password” means “root password”  
    精靈：請明確「管理者密碼」指的是「root密碼」。
    
-   ui: when JQuery Bootgrid rowselect is enabled the click event is triggered twice  
    使用者介面：啟用 jQuery Bootgrid 的行選擇功能後，點擊事件會觸發兩次。
    
-   mvc: switch from the default $\_GET\[“\_url”\] to $\_SERVER\[“REQUEST\_URI”\] and let Phalcon handle the routing  
    mvc：將預設的 $\_GET\[“\_url”\] 替換為 $\_SERVER\[“ REQUEST \_URI”\]，並請 Phalcon 處理路由。
    
-   mvc: dynamic urls regardless if you have a trailing slash or not (contributed by Max Orelus)  
    mvc：動態 URL，不論 URL 末端是否有斜線（由 Max Orelus 貢獻）
    
-   mvc: multiselect may allow empty option, no need to give blank item too  
    MVC：多選框可允許空選項，無需提供空白項。
    
-   mvc: add support for application-specific field types  
    MVC：新增對應用程式特定欄位類型的支持
    
-   ui: top level menu item link pivots and security improvements (contributed by Max Orelus)  
    使用者介面：頂級選單項目連結的調整和安全性改進（由 Max Orelus 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-net-snmp 1.0 (contributed by Michael Muenz)  
    插件：os-net-snmp 1.0 （由 Michael Muenz 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-openconnect 1.1 (contributed by Michael Muenz)  
    插件：os-openconnect 1.1 （由 Michael Muenz 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-web-proxy-sso UI fixes (contributed by Smart-Soft)  
    外掛程式：os-web-proxy-sso UI修復（由 Smart-Soft 提供）
    

Stay safe, Your OPNsense team

請注意安全，OPNsense團隊敬上

##### 18.1.11 (July 02, 2018)｜18.1.11 （2018年7月2日）

A small update ships several improvements and preparations for the upcoming version 18.7. We are also bundling a patch for the lazy FPU state restore information disclosure.

本次小更新包含多項改進，並為即將發布的版本18.7做好了準備。我們還捆綁了一個補丁，用於修復FPU狀態恢復資訊外洩延遲的問題。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: enforce full password policy check for local passwords including TOTP  
    系統：強制執行對本地密碼（包括TOTP的完整密碼策略檢查
    
-   system: add RFC 7919 DH parameter files for upcoming 18.7 feature  
    系統：即將推出的18.7功能新增RFC 7919 DH參數文件
    
-   system: add 3072-bit RSA key length options to certificates (contributed by Justin Coffman)  
    系統：向憑證新增 3072 位元RSA金鑰長度選項（由 Justin Coffman 提供）
    
-   system: move auto-cron jobs to plugin files  
    系統：將自動定時任務移至插件文件
    
-   interfaces: refactor reload handling around interfaces\_configure()  
    介面：重構 interfaces\_configure() 周圍的重新載入處理
    
-   interfaces: allow private addresses in 6RD  
    介面：允許在 6RD 中使用私有位址
    
-   interfaces: check existence of “status” (contributed by Tian Yunhao)  
    介面：檢查「狀態」是否存在（由田雲浩貢獻）
    
-   reporting: add NetFlow/Insight database force repair function  
    報告：新增 NetFlow/Insight 資料庫強制修復功能
    
-   dhcp: update from ISC version 4.3 to 4.4  
    DHCP：從ISC版本4.3更新到4.4
    
-   importer: allow ZFS import for upcoming 18.7 ZFS installer feature  
    導入器：允許即將推出的18.7 ZFS安裝程式功能導入ZFS
    
-   importer: allow import from simple MSDOS USB drives  
    導入器：允許從簡單的MSDOS USB驅動器匯入
    
-   intrusion detection: add app detect rules (contributed by Michael Muenz)  
    入侵偵測：新增應用程式偵測規則（由 Michael Muenz 提供）
    
-   rc: suppress message of service not enabled on NetFlow backup  
    rc：抑制 NetFlow 備份中服務未啟用的訊息
    
-   rc: use exec in /etc/rc and /etc/rc.shutdown hooks  
    rc：在 /etc/rc 和 /etc/rc.shutdown 鉤子中使用 exec
    
-   rc: rework rc.syshook facility to be driven by directories and not suffixes  
    rc：重構 rc.syshook 功能，使其由目錄而非後綴驅動。
    
-   unbound: remove defunct unbound\_statistics() function  
    unbound：移除已失效的 unbound\_statistics() 函數
    
-   plugins: os-postfix 1.4 advanced force recipient check (contributed by Michael Muenz)  
    插件：os-postfix 1.4高級強制收件人檢查（由 Michael Muenz 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: service start corrections for accompanying rc.syshook changes  
    外掛程式：針對 rc.syshook 更改的服務啟動修正
    
-   src: incorrect TLB shootdown for Xen-based guests [\[1\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-18:07.pmap.asc)  
    src: 不正確TLB擊落基於 Xen 的訪客 [\[1\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-18:07.pmap.asc )
    
-   src: lazy FPU state restore information disclosure [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-18:07.lazyfpu.asc)  
    src: lazy FPU狀態恢復資訊揭露 [\[2\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-18:07.lazyfpu.asc )
    
-   src: enable usage of locate(1) utility  
    src：啟用 locate(1) 工具的使用

    埠：isc-dhcp 4.4.1 [\[3\]]( https://deepthought.isc.org/article/AA-01571 )

    埠：未綁定1.7.3 [\[5\]]( https://nlnetlabs.nl/projects/unbound/download/ )

##### 18.1.9 (May 31, 2018)｜18.1.9 （2018年5月31日）

This update is going forward with a larger batch of firmware update improvements that are important for 18.7 and beyond, addressing the former lack of error handling, check for update speed and API check capabilities for major upgrades.

本次更新將帶來更大批量的韌體更新改進，這些改進對於18.7及以後的版本非常重要，解決了之前缺少錯誤處理、更新速度檢查以及API主要升級檢查功能的問題。

Intrusion detection syslog behaviour changes slightly after a number of good discussions, meaning that now syslog is always on, but fast log alert info is steered by the former syslog option making the option the best of both worlds and enabling future syslog export, which is now also available in the development version.

經過多次有益的討論，入侵偵測 syslog 的行為略有改變，這意味著現在 syslog 始終處於開啟狀態，但快速日誌警報資訊由先前的 syslog 選項控制，這使得該選項兼具兩者的優點，並支援未來的 syslog 匯出，該功能現在在開發版本中也可用。

Last but not least we want to mention the work done on allowing detached UI development which is now included in the release. For more information check out the UI development tools [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/ui_devtools) that have been released alongside.

最後，我們想提及已完成的允許獨立進行UI開發的工作，該功能現已包含在本次發布版本中。更多信息，請查看同時發布的UI開發工具 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/ui_devtools )。

There is more preparation underway for 18.7, but that info will have to wait as it eludes the context of this announcement. Feel free to frequently check the milestone progress in the forums [\[2\]](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=8597.0) in the meantime.

18.7的更多準備工作正在進行中，但由於與本公告內容無關，相關資訊暫時無法透露。在此期間，歡迎您隨時在論壇 [\[2\]]( https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=8597.0 ) 查看里程碑進度。

Here is the full list of changes:

##### 18.1.8 (May 17, 2018)｜18.1.8 （2018年5月17日）

This update to 18.1.8 contains several improvements, kernel security patches and third-party software updates.

本次更新至18.1.8包含多項改良、核心安全性修補程式和第三方軟體更新。

Highlights include boot support on an otherwise installed ZFS. The default route handling was improved to minimise issues with unstable links. A NUT plugin is now available as well as a second optional theme.

亮點包括：支援在其他已安裝ZFS的情況下啟動。改進了預設路由處理，最大限度地減少了不穩定連結的問題。現在也提供NUT外掛以及第二個可選主題。

##### 18.1.7 (May 03, 2018)｜18.1.7 （2018年5月3日）

It has been a while and judging by the extensive list of changes below one can easily see why. The impact footprint of this update, however, is relatively small. With this update we are also moving into the 18.7-BETA phase where avid users are invited to flip their release version from production to development in the firmware GUI settings.

距離上次更新已經有一段時間了，從下面列出的眾多變更內容來看，不難理解原因。不過，本次更新的影響相對較小。此次更新也標誌著我們進入了18.7-BETA階段，屆時我們將邀請資深用戶在韌體GUI設定中將版本從生產模式切換到開發模式。

Extensive work has been done for DHCPv6 connectivity by the wonderful folks of Team Rebellion, e.g. fixing the stale daemon issues that prevented connectivity after reconfiguration. OpenVPN was updated to version 2.4.6 and received a substantial server setup rejuventation to allow out of the box IPv6 usage. LibreSSL received a bump in order to correctly speed up AESNI, something that was not working since its update to version 2.6.

Team Rebellion 的各位成員為 DHCPv6 連線做了大量工作，例如修正了重新配置後導致連線中斷的過時守護程式問題。 OpenVPN 已更新至2.4.6版本，並進行了大量的伺服器設定更新，從而實現了開箱即用的 IPv6 功能。 LibreSSL 也得到了升級，以正確提升AESNI速度，此前自2.6版本更新以來，速度提升一直存在問題。

Users of the web proxy with IDNA domains must take note that the previous implementation was removed in favour of a less intrusive approach that does not require encoding and decoding domain names in the configuration. All domains are now stored verbatim and are only encoded during web proxy runtime setup. Formerly created and thus now wrongly encoded domains need to be deleted and added back. We are sorry for any inconvenience caused.

使用IDNA網域的Web代理使用者請注意，先前的實作方式已被移除，取而代之的是一種侵入性較小的方案，無需在配置中對網域進行編碼和解碼。所有網域現在都以原樣存儲，僅在Web代理運行時設定期間進行編碼。之前創建的、因此現在編碼錯誤的網域需要刪除並重新新增。由此造成的不便，我們深表歉意。

##### 18.1.6 (April 09, 2018)｜18.1.6 （2018年4月9日）

With Meltdown and Spectre just behind us here comes another round of security advisories and assorted changes.

隨著 Meltdown 和 Spectre 漏洞的出現，新一輪安全公告和各種變更也隨之而來。

Three mentionable changes are included: We are switching back to single-source automatic outbound NAT on the primary IP instead of using all additional VIPs on the interface as was the case with OPNsense 17.7 and earlier. The hardware-assisted VLAN capability check was removed from the system enabling e.g. XEN users to create VLANs. And the multi-WAN traffic shaping experience has been corrected for non-default interfaces within the scope of shared forwarding.

此次更新包含三項值得一提的變更：我們已將主介面IP上的單源自動出站NAT切換回原先17.7及更早版本中所有附加VIP介面。系統已移除硬體輔助的VLAN功能檢查，從而使XEN用戶能夠建立VLAN。此外，我們也修正了共享轉送範圍內非預設介面的多WAN流量整形問題。

Expected is an image release based on this version some time within the next week for completeness.

為了完善版本，預計將在下週某個時候發布基於此版本的鏡像檔案。

We are also happy to announce the immediate availability of the renewed OPNsense 18.1 images based on version 18.1.6. Apart from the numerous improvements since the initial release, the images contain three relevant fixes:

-   Fix Unbound DNS parameter underflow on systems with higher number of CPUs  
    修正 CPU 數量較多的系統上 Unbound DNS參數下溢問題
    
-   Disable Health Reporting (RRD) by default on Nano images to reduce write cycles  
    預設情況下，Nano 鏡像上的健康報告功能 ( RRD ) 已停用，以減少寫入次數。
    
-   Disable TRIM by default on Nano images to prevent corruptions of the file system  
    預設情況下，Nano 鏡像中會停用TRIM以防止檔案系統損壞

##### 18.1.5 (March 21, 2018)｜18.1.5 （2018年3月21日）

Today ships Meltdown and Spectre V2 mitigation for amd64, the latter only effective with the corresponding microcode update. However, the combating of speculative execution security issues remains an ongoing quest for the unforeseeable future. To avoid surprises HardenedBSD has enabled Meltdown mitigation (PTI) by default even for AMD CPUs who have not yet been found vulnerable. Performance impact is luckily minimal here, although the Spectre V2 mitigation (IBRS) can slow down CPUs with the respective microcode updates in place.

今天發布的版本針對 amd64 架構提供了 Meltdown 和 Spectre V2 漏洞緩解措施，其中 Spectre V2 漏洞緩解措施僅在更新相應的微程式碼後才有效。然而，應對推測執行安全問題仍然是一項持續且難以預料的挑戰。為了避免意外情況，HardenedBSD 預設啟用了 Meltdown 漏洞緩解措施（ PTI ），即使對於尚未發現漏洞的 CPU（ AMD ）也是如此。幸運的是，效能影響微乎其微，但 Spectre V2 漏洞緩解措施（ IBRS ）在更新對應的微程式碼後可能會降低 CPU 的運作速度。

To opt out of one or both features, the following values can now be persistently set under System: Settings: Tunables:

若要選擇退出其中一項或兩項功能，現在可以在「系統」>「設定」>「可調參數」下永久設定下列值：

-   Disable PTI via “vm.pmap.pti” to “0” and a reboot, and  
    將「vm.pmap.pti」的值設為「0」並重啟，即可停用PTI
    
-   Disable IBRS via “hw.ibrs\_disable” to “1” with a simple “Apply”（申請）.  
    透過簡單的“Apply”（申請）將IBRS禁用，方法是將「hw.ibrs\_disable」設定為「1」。
    

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 18.1 (January 29, 2018)｜18.1 （2018年1月29日）

For more than 3 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

3 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We humbly present to you the sum of another major iteration of the OPNsense firewall. Over the second half of 2017 well over 500 changes have made it into this release, nicknamed “Groovy Gecko”（絕妙壁虎）. Most notably, the firewall NAT rules have been reworked to be more flexible and usable via plugins, which is going to pave the way for subsequent API works on the core firewall functionality. For more details please find the attached list of changes below.

我們很榮幸地向您呈現 OPNsense 防火牆的另一個重大迭代更新。在 2017 年下半年，我們對此版本（代號“Groovy Gecko”（絕妙壁虎） ）進行了超過 500 項更改。其中最值得一提的是，防火牆規則NAT經過重新設計，使其更加靈活，並可透過插件使用，這將為後續API的核心防火牆功能改進奠定基礎。更多詳情請參閱下方附件中的變更清單。

The upgrade track from 17.7 will be available later today. Please be patient. :)

從17.7升級的路線將於今天晚些時候開放。請耐心等待。 :)

Meltdown and Spectre patches are currently being worked on in FreeBSD [\[1\]](https://lists.freebsd.org/pipermail/freebsd-security/2018-January/009719.html) , but there is no reliable timeline. We will keep you up to date through the usual channels as more news become available. Hang in there!

FreeBSD 目前正在開發 Meltdown 和 Spectre 的補丁 [\[1\]]( https://lists.freebsd.org/pipermail/freebsd-security/2018-January/009719.html )，但尚無可靠的時間表。一旦有更多消息，我們將透過常用管道及時通知您。請耐心等待！

These are the most prominent changes since version 17.7:

以下是自17.7版本以來最顯著的變化：

-   FreeBSD 11.1, PHP 7.1 and jQuery 3 migration  
    FreeBSD 11.1, PHP 7.1和 jQuery 3 遷移
    
-   Realtek vendor NIC driver version 1.94  
    Realtek 廠商NIC驅動程式版本1.94
    
-   Portable NAT before IPsec support  
    便攜式NAT支援 IPsec 之前
    
-   Local group restriction feature in OpenVPN and IPsec  
    OpenVPN 和 IPsec 中的本機群組限制功能
    
-   OpenVPN multi-remote support for clients  
    OpenVPN 多遠端客戶端支援
    
-   Strict interface binding for SSH and web GUI  
    SSH和 web GUI的嚴格介面綁定
    
-   Improved MVC tabs and general page layout  
    改進了MVC標籤頁和整體頁面佈局
    
-   Shared forwarding now works on IPv6, in conjunction with “try-forwarding” and improved reply-to multi-WAN behaviour  
    共用轉送現在可在 IPv6 上執行，並結合「嘗試轉送」和改進的回覆多WAN行為
    
-   Easy-to-use update cache support for Linux and Windows in web proxy  
    Web代理程式中對Linux和Windows的易於使用的更新快取支持
    
-   Intrusion detection alert improvements and plugin support for new rulesets (ET Pro, Snort VRT)  
    入侵偵測警報改進和對新規則集的插件支援（ ET Pro，Snort VRT ）
    
-   Revamped HAProxy plugin with introduction pages  
    經過改良的 HAProxy 插件，新增了介紹頁面
    
-   Moved interface selection to menu and quick search for firewall rules, DHCP and wireless status  
    將介面選擇移至選單，並可快速搜尋防火牆規則、 DHCP和無線狀態
    
-   Alias backend rewrite for future extensibility  
    為了便於未來擴展，對別名後端進行了重寫
    
-   Plugin-capable firewall NAT rules  
    支援插件的防火牆NAT規則
    
-   Migration of system routes UI and backend to MVC (also available via API)  
    系統路由UI和後端遷移至MVC （也可透過API存取）
    
-   Reverse DNS support for insight reporting (also available via API)  
    反向DNS支持洞察報告（也可透過API取得）
    
-   Fully rewritten firewall live log in MVC (also available via API)  
    防火牆即時登入已完全重寫MVC （也可透過API取得）
    
-   New plugins: zerotier, mdns-repeater, collectd, telegraf, clamav, c-icap, tor, siproxd, web-proxy-sso, web-proxy-useracl, postfix, rspamd, redis, iperf, arp-scan, zabbix-proxy, frr, node\_exporter  
    新增插件：zerotier、mdns-repeater、collectd、telegraf、clamav、c-icap、tor、siproxd、web-proxy-sso、web-proxy-useracl、postfix、rspamd、redis、iperf、arp-scan、zabbix-proxy、fporter、noproxy

##### 18.1.r2 (January 15, 2018)｜18.1 .r2（2018年1月15日）

Long story short: we thank all early testers of 18.1-RC1! You guys have made it possible to push this online update of 18.1-RC2 sooner than anticipated.

長話短說：感謝所有早期測試18.1-RC1的用戶！正是因為有了你們，我們才能比預期更早推出18.1-RC2的線上更新。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: add workaround for new 32 bit mmap disallow default (requires reboot)  
    系統：新增針對新的 32 位元 mmap 停用預設值的變通方案（需要重新啟動）
    
-   system: modify the boot sequence to improve initial IP assignment for PPPoE  
    系統：修改啟動順序以改進 PPPoE 的初始IP分配
    
-   system: support additional RADIUS attributes and show them in the authentication tester  
    系統：支援額外的RADIUS屬性並在身份驗證測試器中顯示它們
    
-   system: only zap non-directories in /var/run on boot  
    系統：啟動時僅刪除 /var/run 目錄下的非目錄文件
    
-   system: remove mocked version string in high availability synchronisation  
    系統：移除高可用性同步中的模擬版本字串
    
-   system: added mail facility remote logging  
    系統：新增郵件設施遠端日誌記錄
    
-   firewall: optional hash identifier for rules makes them easier to find in system file  
    防火牆：規則的可選哈希標識符使其更容易在系統檔案中找到。
    
-   firewall: support IPv4 + IPv6 selection for port forwards  
    防火牆：支援 IPv4 和 IPv6 連接埠轉送。
    
-   firewall: add VIP gateway option for PPPoE interfaces  
    防火牆：為 PPPoE 介面新增VIP網關選項
    
-   firewall: rename NPT to NPTv6 for clarity  
    防火牆：為了清晰起見，將NPT重新命名為 NPTv6
    
-   firewall: race condition in creating alias directory  
    防火牆：建立別名目錄時存在競爭條件
    
-   firewall: make NAT reflection enable less ambiguous  
    防火牆：使NAT反射啟用更清晰

##### 18.1.r1 (January 11, 2018)｜18.1 .r1（2018年1月11日）

For more than 3 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

3 年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We humbly present to you the sum of another major iteration of the OPNsense firewall. Over the second half of 2017 well over 500 changes have made it into this first release candidate. Most notably, the firewall NAT rules have been reworked to be more flexible and usable via plugins, which is going to pave the way for subsequent API works on the core firewall functionality. For more details please find the attached list of changes below.

我們很榮幸地向您呈現 OPNsense 防火牆的另一個重大迭代更新。在 2017 年下半年，我們對首個候選版本進行了超過 500 項變更。其中最值得一提的是，我們對防火牆NAT規則進行了重新設計，使其更加靈活，並可透過插件進行擴展，這將為後續API核心防火牆功能的改進奠定基礎。更多詳情請參閱下方附件中的變更清單。

Meltdown and Spectre patches are currently being worked on in FreeBSD [\[1\]](https://lists.freebsd.org/pipermail/freebsd-security/2018-January/009719.html) , but there is no reliable timeline. We will keep you up to date through the usual channels as more news become available. Hang in there!

FreeBSD 目前正在開發 Meltdown 和 Spectre 的補丁 [\[1\]]( https://lists.freebsd.org/pipermail/freebsd-security/2018-January/009719.html )，但尚無可靠的時間表。一旦有更多消息，我們將透過常用管道及時通知您。請耐心等待！

All images are provided with SHA-256 signatures, which can be verified against the distributed public key:

```
# openssl base64 -d -in image.bz2.sig -out /tmp/image.sig
# openssl dgst -sha256 -verify rsa.pub -signature /tmp/image.sig image.bz2
```
