#### 17.7 “Free Fox”（自由狐狸） Series｜17.7 “Free Fox”（自由狐狸）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_17.7.html>

For more than two and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

兩年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We are writing to you today to announce the final release of version 17.7, nicknamed “Free Fox”（自由狐狸）, which, over the course of the last 6 months, includes highlights such as SafeStack application hardening, the Realtek re(4) driver for better network stability, a Quagga plugin with broad routing protocol support and the Unbound resolver as the new default. Additionally, translations for Czech, Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese and German have been completed for the first time during this development cycle.

我們今天致函您，宣布正式發布版本17.7 （暱稱“Free Fox”（自由狐狸） ）。在過去的六個月中，該版本進行了多項改進，亮點包括：SafeStack 應用強化、用於提升網路穩定性的 Realtek re(4) 驅動程式、支援廣泛路由協定的 Quagga 插件，以及將 Unbound 解析器設為新的預設解析器。此外，捷克語、中文、日文、葡萄牙文和德文的翻譯工作也首次在本開發週期內完成。

Focus in OPNsense has shifted to improving and streamlining its various systems and providing continuous updates, which amounts to over 300 individual changes made since 17.1 so far. The plugin infrastructure is growing as well thanks to our awesome contributors Frank Wall, Frank Brendel, Fabian Franz and Michael Muenz. And we, last but not least, have been working more closely than ever with HardenedBSD by unifying our ports infrastructure.

OPNsense 的工作重點已轉向改進和簡化其各種系統，並提供持續更新，自17.1以來，已進行了 300 多項更改。插件基礎設施也不斷發展壯大，這要感謝我們傑出的貢獻者 Frank Wall、Frank Brendel、Fabian Franz 和 Michael Muenz。最後，我們與 HardenedBSD 的合作也比以往任何時候都更加緊密，我們統一了連接埠基礎設施。

##### 17.7.12 (January 18, 2018)｜17.7.12 （2018年1月18日）

As 18.1 is drawing near this stable update for the 17.7 series could be the last one. So whether there will be a hotfix to enable the update path or a full 17.7.13 remains to be seen, but we will keep you informed either way. The targeted release date for 18.1 is January 29.

隨著 18.1 的臨近，17.7 系列的穩定更新可能是最後一次。因此，是否會有修補程式來啟用更新路徑或完整的17.7.13還有待觀察，但我們會隨時通知您。 18.1的預定發售日期是1月29日。

For now we refrain from letting users upgrade directly to the release candidates, but suffice to say that with the development version accompanying this update it is possible from the console. And again thank you to all early adopters which have made the release candidates a thoroughly enjoyable experience.

目前我們暫不允許使用者直接升級到候選版本，但需要說明的是，使用者可以透過控制台使用本次更新附帶的開發版本進行升級。再次感謝所有早期用戶，正是你們的參與讓候選版本體驗如此愉快。

##### 17.7.10 (December 14, 2017)｜17.7.10 （2017年12月14日）

A regression sneaked into 17.7.9 that updated Lighttpd web server which made the captive portal incompatible with the newer version. We are also bundling OpenSSL updates for both the ports and source. Last but not least, Suricata and Hyperscan have been bumped to their latest versions.

17.7.9版本中出現了一個迴歸錯誤，該錯誤導致 Lighttpd Web 伺服器更新後，強制入口網站與新版本不相容。我們還捆綁了 OpenSSL 的連接埠和原始碼更新。最後，Suricata 和 Hyperscan 也升級到最新版本。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: allow user-based language setting through Lobby: Password

##### 17.7.9 (December 07, 2017)｜17.7.9 （2017年12月7日）

Today a XSS vulnerability in the certificate manager is being fixed that is based on a crafted certificate being imported into the system. PHP was finally updated from 7.0 to 7.1 which should make things a bit faster. Last but not least, the HAProxy plugin by Frank Wall receives a major update for improved usability, several new features and two bug fixes.

今天，憑證管理員中的一個漏洞XSS正在修復，該漏洞利用了使用者將精心建構的憑證匯入系統的情況。此外， PHP也已從7.0更新至7.1 ，這應該會提升一些速度。最後，Frank Wall 開發的 HAProxy 外掛也迎來了重大更新，不僅提升了易用性，還新增了多項功能並修復了兩個漏洞。

##### 17.7.7 (October 26, 2017)｜17.7.7 （2017年10月26日）

OpenSSH is being updated to version 7.6, which means this change breaks compatibility with SSH protocol version 1 and refuses RSA keys smaller than 1024 bits. Ideally, none of this should matter in a security-aware deployment, but it is safer to double-check before the upgrade.

OpenSSH 正在更新至7.6版本，這意味著此次更新將破壞與SSH協定版本 1 的兼容性，並拒絕小於 1024 位元的RSA金鑰。理想情況下，在註重安全性的部署中，這些都不會造成任何問題，但為了安全起見，升級前最好還是仔細檢查一下。

A new plugin for the Telegraf agent was released and we have reworked the GeoIP alias configuration to be less cumbersome. We would like to thank everyone for the steady stream of ideas and constructive discussion and ask for more!

我們發布了 Telegraf 代理程式的新插件，並改進了 GeoIP 別名配置，使其更加簡單。感謝大家源源不絕的寶貴意見與建設性討論，也期待大家繼續提出寶貴建議！

The 18.1-BETA call for testing will be out in the next 24 hours as well for all enthusiasts who want to test-drive the change from FreeBSD 11.0 to 11.1. It has been an unconventional development cycle and this time around there will be no images until 18.1-RC in late December or January.

18.1-BETA測試邀請將在未來 24 小時內發布，供所有想要體驗 FreeBSD 從11.0到11.1升級的用戶參與。這是一個非同尋常的開發週期，這次要等到 12 月底或 1 月份的18.1-RC才會發布鏡像。

##### 17.7.6 (October 20, 2017)｜17.7.6 （2017年10月20日）

What a KRACKing week it has been! In order to move past the WPA2 attacks we have updated hostapd and wpa\_supplicant to their latest version 2.6 including the released security fixes. If you use wireless devices you are advised to reboot to properly reload all wireless services.

這真是令人抓狂的一週！為了應對WPA2攻擊，我們已將hostapd和wpa_supplicant更新至最新版本2.6其中包含已發布的安全修復程序。如果您使用無線設備，建議您重新啟動系統以正確重新載入所有無線服務。

In more positive news, plugins for Web Proxy SSO support and Siproxd have been publicly released with this version. Additionally, multi-remote OpenVPN client configurations are now easily possible via the GUI. We also thank Fabian Abplanalp and HiHo.ch for providing a mirror in Switzerland.

更令人振奮的是，此版本已公開發布了支援 Web 代理程式SSO和 Siproxd 的插件。此外，現在可以透過GUI輕鬆設定多個遠端 OpenVPN 用戶端。我們也要感謝 Fabian Abplanalp 和 HiHo.ch 在瑞士提供的鏡像遺址。

##### 17.7.5 (October 05, 2017)｜17.7.5 （2017年10月5日）

This update includes a larger number of security-related updates in third party software recently published. We do recommend a reboot to ensure all services are restarted correctly.

We also are happy to announce the immediate availability of the renewed OPNsense 17.7 images based on version 17.7.5. Apart from the numerous improvements since the initial release, the images contain an addition for single interfaces SSH installer scenarios as well as an PPPoE multi-AP kernel patch. And due to popular demand the dynamic DNS plugin now comes preinstalled, something we missed in the original 17.7 plugin conversion process.

我們也很高興地宣布立即推出基於版本 17.7.5 的更新版 OPNsense 17.7 影像。除了自初始版本以來的眾多改進之外，這些映像還包含單一介面SSH安裝程式場景的附加內容以及PPPoE多AP核心修補程式。由於大眾的需求，現在預先安裝了動態 DNS 插件，這是我們在原始 17.7 插件轉換過程中錯過的東西。

For almost 3 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the code base, quick and reliable firmware upgrades, multi- language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

近三年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化程式碼庫、快速可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

##### 17.7.4 (September 27, 2017)｜17.7.4（2017 年 9 月 27 日）

Another week, another update. Most notably, the Tor plugin has been officially released.

又一周，又更新了。最值得注意的是，Tor 插件已正式發布。

New images finally follow in 17.7.5 and we are happy to report that the shared forwarding additions are already up and running on the FreeBSD 11.1 kernel with two major improvements: IPv6 support and tryforward compatibility! That means 18.1-BETA and an associated public call for testing are not too far out at this point.

新鏡像最終出現在 17.7.5 中，我們很高興地報告共享轉發功能已經在 FreeBSD 11.1 核心上啟動並運行，並有兩項重大改進：IPv6 支援和 tryforward 相容性！這意味著 18.1-BETA 以及相關的公開測試呼籲目前並不遙遠。

And here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   system: remove revoked certificates from list of certificates to revoke  
    系統：從要撤銷的憑證清單中刪除已撤銷的憑證
    
-   firewall: add advanced setting to disable interface gateway rules  
    防火牆：新增進階設定以停用介面網關規則

    防火牆：忽略網關權重為零
    
-   firewall: add reply-to specific gateway in pluggable rules  
    防火牆：在可插入規則中新增對特定網關的回复
    
-   firewall: support anchor quick keyword in pluggable rules

##### 17.7.1 (August 31, 2017)｜17.7.1（2017 年 8 月 31 日）

Our first stable round of version 17.7 brings a number of improvements, fixes and software updates for third party services. Special attention goes to the major bump of LibreSSL from 2.4 to 2.5. NAT before IPsec is now also neatly integrated and there are new plugins for fast Collectd and Zerotier setup.

我們的第一輪穩定版本17.7為第三方服務帶來了許多改進、修復和軟體更新。特别要注意的是 LibreSSL 从 2.4 到 2.5. NAT 的重大转变，之后 IPsec 现在也被整齐地集成，并且有用于快速 Collectd 和 Zerotier 设置的新插件。

We would also like to use this opportunity to remind everyone that OPNsense is and always will be free software. All of its source code and associated build tools can be found here:

我們也要藉此機會提醒大家，OPNsense 現在是、將來也永遠是自由軟體。它的所有原始程式碼和相關建置工具都可以在這裡找到：

[https://github.com/opnsense](https://github.com/opnsense)

Over the course of the coming weeks, we will be focusing on releasing the roadmap for version 18.1, ClamAV integration, PHP 7.1 and going back to a more frequent update schedule.

在接下來的幾週內，我們將重點介紹版本18.1、ClamAV 整合、PHP 7.1 的路線圖，並恢復更頻繁的更新計畫。

Here are the hotfixes issued with 17.7.1\_2:

以下是17.7.1\_2 發布的修補程式：

-   system: ensure vital /var directories exist when not using /var MFS  
    系統：確保不使用 /var 時重要的 /var 目錄存在MFS
    
-   firewall: fix root-based cross-site scripting in pfInfo diagnostics  
    防火牆：修復 pfInfo 診斷中基於根的跨站點腳本
    

Here are the full patch notes of the initial 17.7.1:

##### 17.7 (July 31, 2017)｜17.7（2017 年 7 月 31 日）

For more than two and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

兩年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、HardenedBSD 安全性、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

We are writing to you today to announce the final release of version 17.7, nicknamed “Free Fox”（自由狐狸）, which, over the course of the last 6 months, includes highlights such as SafeStack application hardening, the Realtek re(4) driver for better network stability, a Quagga plugin with broad routing protocol support and the Unbound resolver as the new default. Additionally, translations for Czech, Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese and German have been completed for the first time during this development cycle.

我們今天寫信給您，宣布版本17.7（暱稱“Free Fox”（自由狐狸））的最終版本，在過去 6 個月的時間裡，包括 SafeStack 應用程式強化、用於提高網路穩定性的 Realtek re(4) 驅動程式、具有廣泛路由協議支援的 Quagga 插件以及作為新預設值的 Unbound 解析器等亮點。此外，在此開發週期中首次完成了捷克語、中文、日文、葡萄牙語和德語的翻譯。

Focus in OPNsense has shifted to improving and streamlining its various systems and providing continuous updates, which amounts to over 300 individual changes made since 17.1 so far. The plugin infrastructure is growing as well thanks to our awesome contributors Frank Wall, Frank Brendel, Fabian Franz and Michael Muenz. And we, last but not least, have been working more closely than ever with HardenedBSD by unifying our ports infrastructure.

OPNsense 的重點已轉向改進和簡化其各種系統並提供持續更新，自 17.1 至今已進行了 300 多項單獨更改。感謝我們出色的貢獻者 Frank Wall、Frank Brendel、Fabian Franz 和 Michael Muenz，插件基礎設施也在不斷發展。最後但並非最不重要的一點是，我們透過統一我們的連接埠基礎設施，與 HardenedBSD 進行了比以往更加密切的合作。

##### 17.7.r2 (July 21, 2017)｜17.7.r2（2017 年 7 月 21 日）

For more than two and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

兩年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、HardenedBSD 安全性、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

We are writing to you today to announce the second release candidate for version 17.7, which, over the course of the last 5 months, includes highlights such as SafeStack application hardening, the Realtek re(4) driver for network stability, a Quagga plugin with broad routing protocol support and the Unbound resolver as the new default. Additionally, translations for Czech, Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese and German have been completed during this iteration.

我們今天寫信給您，宣布 17.7 的第二個候選版本，在過去 5 個月的時間裡，其中包括 SafeStack 應用程式強化、用於網路穩定性的 Realtek re(4) 驅動程式、具有廣泛路由協議支援的 Quagga 插件以及作為新預設值的 Unbound 解析器等亮點。此外，捷克語、中文、日文、葡萄牙語和德語的翻譯也在本次迭代中完成。

Focus in OPNsense has shifted to improving and streamlining its various systems and providing continuous updates, which amounts to over 300 individual changes made since 17.1 so far. The plugin infrastructure is growing as well thanks to our awesome contributors Frank Wall, Frank Brendel, Fabian Franz and Michael Muenz. And we, last but not least, have been working more closely than ever with HardenedBSD by unifying our ports infrastructure. Although this is only the beginning, let us not skip ahead.

OPNsense 的重點已轉向改進和簡化其各種系統並提供持續更新，自 17.1 至今已進行了 300 多項單獨更改。感謝我們出色的貢獻者 Frank Wall、Frank Brendel、Fabian Franz 和 Michael Muenz，插件基礎設施也在不斷發展。最後但並非最不重要的一點是，我們透過統一我們的連接埠基礎設施，與 HardenedBSD 進行了比以往更加密切的合作。雖然這只是開始，但我們不要跳過。

    系統：透過刪除 TLS\_RSA\_WITH\_3DES\_EDE\_CBC\_SHA 來強化GUI

    系統：透過改進安全屬性cookie的使用來強化GUI

    系統：使用DH-4096參數強化GUI

    系統：允許在TOTP身份驗證中反轉密碼/令牌順序

    系統：新增主要GUI韌體升級代碼

The list of currently known issues with 17.7-RC2:

17.7-RC2 目前已知問題清單：

-   LAGG device destroy may cause a kernel panic. A fix is scheduled for 17.7.  
    LAGG 設備損壞可能會導致核心崩潰。計劃針對 17.7 進行修復。
    
-   IPsec inbound packet filtering does not work under NAT-T. A fix is scheduled for 17.7.  
    IPsec 入站資料包過濾在NAT-T 下不起作用。計劃針對 17.7 進行修復。
    
-   PPPoE Host-Uniq is still in the test phase and may not be fully operational.  
    PPPoE Host-Uniq 仍處於測試階段，可能無法完全運作。
    
-   Configuration handling of static PHP is not always compatible with PHP 7.1 at this point. We are downgrading to 7.0 for the release of 17.7 to ensure integrity.  
    目前，靜態PHP的配置處理並不總是與PHP 7.1相容。我們將降級至7.0以發布17.7以確保完整性。
    

Users of 17.7-RC1 can upgrade to RC2 via the usual online updates. Images are not provided with this particular release. As always with our pre- releases, only OpenSSL is provided at this point, but can be switched for LibreSSL as soon as the release is available. This release candidate does update directly into the 17.7 stable track and subsequent release candidates. Please let us know about your experience!

##### 17.7.r1 (July 14, 2017)｜17.7.r1（2017 年 7 月 14 日）

For more than two and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

兩年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、HardenedBSD 安全性、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

We are writing to you today to announce the first release candidate for version 17.7, which, over the course of the last 5 months, includes highlights such as SafeStack application hardening, the Realtek re(4) driver for network stability, a Quagga plugin with broad routing protocol support and the Unbound resolver as the new default. Additionally, translations for Czech, Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese and German have been completed during this iteration.

我們今天寫信給您，宣布 17.7 的第一個候選版本，在過去 5 個月的時間裡，其中包括 SafeStack 應用程式強化、用於網路穩定性的 Realtek re(4) 驅動程式、具有廣泛路由協議支援的 Quagga 插件以及作為新預設值的 Unbound 解析器等亮點。此外，捷克語、中文、日文、葡萄牙語和德語的翻譯也在本次迭代中完成。

Focus in OPNsense has shifted to improving and streamlining its various systems and providing continuous updates, which amounts to over 300 individual changes made since 17.1 so far. The plugin infrastructure is growing as well thanks to our awesome contributors Frank Wall, Frank Brendel, Fabian Franz and Michael Muenz. And we, last but not least, have been working more closely than ever with HardenedBSD by unifying our ports infrastructure. Although this is only the beginning, let us not skip ahead.

OPNsense 的重點已轉向改進和簡化其各種系統並提供持續更新，自 17.1 至今已進行了 300 多項單獨更改。感謝我們出色的貢獻者 Frank Wall、Frank Brendel、Fabian Franz 和 Michael Muenz，插件基礎設施也在不斷發展。最後但並非最不重要的一點是，我們透過統一我們的連接埠基礎設施，與 HardenedBSD 進行了比以往更加密切的合作。雖然這只是開始，但我們不要跳過。

#### 17.1 “Eclectic Eagle”（折衷鷹） Series｜17.1 “Eclectic Eagle”（折衷鷹）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_17.1.html>

The OPNsense team is proud to announce the final availability of version 17.1, nicknamed “Eclectic Eagle”（折衷鷹）. This major release features FreeBSD 11.0, the SSH remote installer, new languages Italian / Czech / Portuguese, state-of-the-art HardenedBSD security features, PHP 7.0, new plugins for FTP Proxy / Tinc VPN / Let’s Encrypt, native PAM authentication against e.g. 2FA (TOTP), as well a rewritten Nano-style card images that adapt to media size to name only a few.

OPNsense 團隊很榮幸地宣布版本的最終可用性 17.1，綽號 “Eclectic Eagle”（折衷鷹）。這個主要版本包含 FreeBSD 11.0, 的 SSH 遠端安裝程式、新語言義大利語/捷克語/葡萄牙語、最先進的 HardenedBSD 安全功能、 PHP 7.0，新插件 FTP 代理/Tinc VPN / 讓我們加密，原生 PAM 針對例如身份驗證2FA（TOTP），以及重寫的奈米風格卡片圖像，可適應介質尺寸，僅舉幾例。

We would like to encourage everyone to supervise this major upgrade physically. As such, it cannot be performed from the GUI. Instead, go to the root console menu, choose option 12 and type “17.1” at the prompt. The process will download a full set of updates and reboot multiple times. All operating system files and packages will be reinstalled as a consequence. This process can also be remotely triggered via SSH.

我們鼓勵大家親自監督這項重大升級。因此，無法從 GUI 執行該操作。相反，請前往根控制台選單，選擇選項 12 並在提示字元處輸入「17.1」。該過程將下載全套更新並重新啟動多次。所有作業系統檔案和軟體包都將因此重新安裝。該過程也可以透過SSH遠端觸發。

For fresh installations images are provided with OpenSSL for 32 and 64 bit Intel architectures. The new SSH installer feature will be listening on the LAN port 192.168.1.1, give out DHCP leases to clients and can connect using the user “root” (console menu) or “installer” (the installer, of course) with the default password “opnsense”. The respective checksums for the images can be found below this announcement and the direct download links from our capable mirror providers are as follows:

對於全新安裝，映像隨 OpenSSL 一起提供，適用於 32 位元和 64 位元 Intel 架構。新的SSH安裝程式功能將偵聽LAN連接埠192.168.1.1，向客戶端提供DHCP租用，並可使用使用者「root」（控制台選單）或「安裝程式」（當然是安裝程式）和預設密碼「opnsense」進行連線。鏡像各自的校驗和可以在本公告下方找到，來自我們有能力的鏡像提供者的直接下載連結如下：

##### 17.1.11 (July 25, 2017)｜17.1.11（2017 年 7 月 25 日）

An IPv6 problem has finally been fixed which could prevent reclaiming address leases during an interface reload, especially when OpenVPN was running. Thanks to everyone involved in tracking this down! Also, the last bits for the new GUI major upgrade feature are now in place. The 17.7 upgrade path will be unlocked on July 31, which will require installing one tiny final update.

IPv6 問題終於得到解決，該問題可能會阻止在介面重新載入期間回收位址租約，尤其是在 OpenVPN 執行時。感謝所有參與追蹤此事的人！此外，新的GUI主要升級功能的最後部分現已到位。 17.7 升級路徑將於 7 月 31 日解鎖，這將需要安裝一個微小的最終更新。

##### 17.1.8 (June 01, 2017)｜17.1.8（2017 年 6 月 1 日）

It is with pleasure that we announce the availability of SafeStack in the OPNsense ports tree as our latest addition via our valued HardenendBSD friendship. While SafeStack is already deployed for the base operating system, it had not previously been applied to the ports tree.

我們很高興地宣布，透過我們寶貴的 HardenendBSD 友誼，OPNsense 端口樹中的 SafeStack 已成為我們的最新成員。雖然 SafeStack 已經部署在基本作業系統中，但之前並未套用於連接埠樹。

SafeStack is an exploit mitigation developed by clang/llvm. It helps mitigate stack-based buffer overflows. SafeStack depends on Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) in order to be effective. OPNsense fulfils that dependency by including the HardenedBSD ASLR implementation, which follows the original PaX design. Without ASLR, SafeStack is ineffective as an attacker would know where the SafeStack lies in memory and could use that information to her advantage.

SafeStack 是由 clang/llvm 開發的漏洞緩解措施。它有助於減輕基於堆疊的緩衝區溢位。 SafeStack 依賴位址空間佈局隨機化 (ASLR) 才能發揮作用。 OPNsense 透過包含 HardenedBSD ASLR 實作來滿足這種依賴性，該實作遵循原始 PaX 設計。如果沒有ASLR，SafeStack 就無效，因為攻擊者會知道 SafeStack 位於記憶體中的位置，並可以利用該資訊來獲得優勢。

It is still rather quiet security-wise. Despite updating OpenSSL, it does not contain any security updates this time.

從安全角度來看，它仍然相當安靜。儘管更新了 OpenSSL，但這次不包含任何安全性更新。

##### 17.1.7 (May 18, 2017)｜17.1.7（2017 年 5 月 18 日）

OpenVPN released version 2.4.2 and also 2.3.15 which come with two high profile fixes addressing CVE-2017-7479 and CVE-2017-7478. While we still aim for OpenVPN 2.4 adoption during the 17.1 series, we have deferred updating the release version from 2.3 to 2.4 at this point to be able to respond more quickly.

OpenVPN 发布了版本 2.4.2 和 2.3.15，其中包含两个备受瞩目的修复程序，地址为 CVE-2017-7479 和 CVE-2017-7478。虽然我们的目标仍然是在 17.1 系列期间采用 OpenVPN 2.4，但我们此时已推迟将发布版本从 2.3 更新到 2.4，以便能够更快地做出响应。

##### 17.1.6 (May 04, 2017)｜17.1.6（2017 年 5 月 4 日）

Other than the usual bulk of improvements, the Quagga plugin gained BGP support and the Phalcon framework is now able to run smoothly on PHP 7.1, which we are targeting for 17.7. The next bit of planned work in the 17.1 series is switching OpenVPN to version 2.4. It can already be previewed in the development version.

Enjoy the security-silence this time around. :)

##### 17.1.5 (April 24, 2017)｜17.1.5（2017 年 4 月 24 日）

After a brief timeout due to a super happy image release, 17.1.5 brings to you several longterm improvements for the firewall handling, dynamic DNS and several plugin updates, with Quagga and Monit as two brand new additions to the pool. As an especially longterm improvement, the German translation finally hit 100% completed thanks to the many contributors over the last two years.

由於超級快樂的圖像發布而短暫暫停後，17.1.5為您帶來了防火牆處理的多項長期改進、動態DNS和多個插件更新，其中Quagga和Monit作為池中的兩個全新添加。作為一項特別長期的改進，在過去兩年的眾多貢獻者的努力下，德語翻譯終於達到了 100% 完成。

We are currently working on extending SafeStack support to mission-critical third-party packages, testing the move to PHP 7.1 and finishing the associated roadmap for the upcoming 17.7 release. Stay tuned for more.

我們目前正在努力將 SafeStack 支援擴展到關鍵任務第三方軟體包，測試向PHP 7.1的遷移，並完成即將發布的17.7版本的相關路線圖。請繼續關注更多內容。

##### 17.1.4 (March 29, 2017)｜17.1.4（2017 年 3 月 29 日）

The update finally addresses one of the larger issues with IPsec in 17.1 where traffic was not properly tracked by the packet filter and therefore causing spurious connection drops in TCP sessions. Another cool addition is the merge of the HardenedBSD SafeStack work to further harden our operating system application binaries.

該更新最終解決了 17.1 中 IPsec 的較大問題之一，其中資料包過濾器未正確追蹤流量，因此導致 TCP 會話中出現虛假連接遺失。另一個很酷的補充是合併 HardenedBSD SafeStack 工作，以進一步強化我們的作業系統應用程式二進位。

Last but not least, the switch to the new virtual terminal driver is now fully functional and we intend to release new images based on 17.1.4 on Monday next week. Note this does not affect running installations.

最後但並非最不重要的一點是，切換到新的虛擬終端驅動程式現已完全正常運行，我們打算在下週一發布基於 17.1.4 的新映像。請注意，這不會影響正在運行的安裝。

Upgrading from a physical console may abort the firmware update due to an incompatible switch in the TTY settings. Simply log in again and restart the update to continue. Note this does not affect upgrades via GUI or SSH. Should problems arise, force a reinstall of the core package from the shell with the following command:

從實體控制台升級可能會因為 TTY 設定中的開關不相容而中止韌體更新。只需重新登入並重新啟動更新即可繼續。請注意，這不會影響透過GUI或SSH升級。如果出現問題，請使用下列命令從 shell 強制重新安裝核心包：

```
# # opnsense-revert opnsense
```

We are also happy to announce the availability of the renewed OPNsense 17.1 images based on this version. Apart from the numerous improvements since the initial release, the images have been switched to use the virtual console driver vt(4) as a default to address boot issues. They also feature a new config importer and fix the serial console display of the installer.

我們也很高興地宣布推出基於此版本的更新版 OPNsense 17.1 映像。除了初始版本以來的眾多改進之外，這些映像已切換為預設使用虛擬控制台驅動程式 vt(4) 以解決啟動問題。它們還具有新的配置導入器，並修復了安裝程式的串行控制台顯示。

For more than two years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the code base, quick and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

兩年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化程式碼庫、快速可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

##### 17.1.3 (March 16, 2017)｜17.1.3（2017 年 3 月 16 日）

A dozen bug fixes meet several dozen new features and enhancements, literally! This update is about making OPNsense more flexible with the tools that everybody knows: firewall management, DNS services and Let’s Encrypt.

從字面上看，十幾個錯誤修復滿足了幾十個新功能和增強功能！此更新旨在透過大家都知道的工具讓 OPNsense 更加靈活：防火牆管理、DNS 服務和 Let’s Encrypt。

This is also the stepping stone for providing new images based on 17.1 because the Hyper-V disk disappearance was now fixed upstream: a big thank you to Microsoft and FreeBSD for providing updates! The vt(4) console driver migration is still underway, as well as applying SafeStack for the amd64 architecture and chasing down an IPsec regression with FreeBSD 11.0. More on this next time, stay tuned.

這也是提供基於17.1的新映像的墊腳石，因為 Hyper-V 磁碟消失現已在上游修復：非常感謝 Microsoft 和 FreeBSD 提供更新！ vt(4) 控制台驅動程式遷移仍在進行中，並將 SafeStack 應用於 amd64 架構，並使用 FreeBSD 11.0 追尋 IPsec 回歸。下次會詳細介紹，敬請期待。

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   system: allow up to 32 characters in user and group names  
    系統：使用者名稱和群組名稱最多允許 32 個字符
    
-   system: mute cron job output to prevent spurious system mails  
    系統：靜音 cron 作業輸出以防止虛假的系統郵件
    
-   system: fix scrambled password option on user add  
    系統：修復使用者新增時的亂碼密碼選項
    
-   system: add captive portal session backup  
    系統：新增強制入口網站會話備份
    
-   system: fix CRL certificate count display  
    系統：修復CRL證書數量顯示
    
-   firmware: add mirror via Universidad Pontificia Bolivariana [\[1\]](https://www.upb.edu.co/) (Medellin, CO)

##### 17.1.2 (February 22, 2017)｜17.1.2（2017 年 2 月 22 日）

This update addresses a longstanding issue with the overall reliability of Realtek NICs by replacing the FreeBSD driver with its latest vendor driver equivalent. The results including inline intrusion prevention have been promising to say the least. We thank Realtek for its recent release of version 1.93 and our users for pursuing the unthinkable with us. :)

此更新透過將 FreeBSD 驅動程式替換為其最新的供應商驅動程式等效項，解決了 Realtek NIC 整體可靠性方面長期存在的問題。至少可以說，包括內聯入侵防禦在內的結果是有希望的。我們感謝瑞昱最近發布的1.93版本，感謝我們的用戶與我們一起追求不可思議的事情。 :)

Speaking of intrusion prevention, Suricata and Hyperscan have been updated to their latest versions which will now prevent crashes with older 64 bit CPUs that do not have the SSSE3 instruction set.

說到入侵防禦，Suricata 和 Hyperscan 已更新到最新版本，現在可以防止不具有 SSSE3 指令集的舊 64 位元 CPU 發生崩潰。

Language updates have been plenty, with a new and very busy contributor for Chinese. Xie xie!

語言更新很多，有一個新的、非常忙碌的中文貢獻者。謝謝！

Furthermore, the shared forwarding between both packet filters introduced in OPNsense 17.1 has now been disabled by default and can be manually re-enabled from the GUI on Firewall: Settings: Advanced.

此外，OPNsense 17.1 中引入的兩個封包過濾器之間的共享轉發現已預設為停用，可以從防火牆：設定：進階中的 GUI 手動重新啟用。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 17.1.1 (February 09, 2017)｜17.1.1（2017 年 2 月 9 日）

This week we are introducing a number of reliability fixes especially with regard to our move to FreeBSD 11.0 and PHP 7.0; most prominently a NAT fix for the shared filter forwarding and repairing the CRL generation. You will also find a few interesting IPsec additions. ;)

本週我們將引入一些可靠性修復，特別是與我們遷移到 FreeBSD 11.0 和 PHP 7.0 相關的修復；最突出的是NAT修復共享過濾器轉發和修復CRL一代。您還會發現一些有趣的 IPsec 添加內容。 ;)

In case the shared forwarding is still giving you trouble on 17.1.1, run the following command to use the old behaviour and report back to us:

如果共享轉發在 17.1.1 上仍然給您帶來麻煩，請執行以下命令以使用舊行為並向我們報告：

```
# sysctl net.pf.share_forward=0
```

##### 17.1 (January 31, 2017)｜17.1（2017 年 1 月 31 日）

The OPNsense team is proud to announce the final availability of version 17.1, nicknamed “Eclectic Eagle”（折衷鷹）. This major release features FreeBSD 11.0, the SSH remote installer, new languages Italian / Czech / Portuguese, state-of-the-art HardenedBSD security features, PHP 7.0, new plugins for FTP Proxy / Tinc VPN / Let’s Encrypt, native PAM authentication against e.g. 2FA (TOTP), as well a rewritten Nano-style card images that adapt to media size to name only a few.

OPNsense 團隊很榮幸地宣布版本的最終可用性 17.1，綽號 “Eclectic Eagle”（折衷鷹）。這個主要版本包含 FreeBSD 11.0, 的 SSH 遠端安裝程式、新語言義大利語/捷克語/葡萄牙語、最先進的 HardenedBSD 安全功能、 PHP 7.0，新插件 FTP 代理/Tinc VPN / 讓我們加密，原生 PAM 針對例如身份驗證2FA（TOTP），以及重寫的奈米風格卡片圖像，可適應介質尺寸，僅舉幾例。

We would like to encourage everyone to supervise this major upgrade physically. As such, it cannot be performed from the GUI. Instead, go to the root console menu, choose option 12 and type “17.1” at the prompt. The process will download a full set of updates and reboot multiple times. All operating system files and packages will be reinstalled as a consequence. This process can also be remotely triggered via SSH.

我們鼓勵大家親自監督這項重大升級。因此，無法從 GUI 執行該操作。相反，請前往根控制台選單，選擇選項 12 並在提示字元處輸入「17.1」。該過程將下載全套更新並重新啟動多次。所有作業系統檔案和軟體包都將因此重新安裝。該過程也可以透過SSH遠端觸發。

For fresh installations images are provided with OpenSSL for 32 and 64 bit Intel architectures. The new SSH installer feature will be listening on the LAN port 192.168.1.1, give out DHCP leases to clients and can connect using the user “root” (console menu) or “installer” (the installer, of course) with the default password “opnsense”. The respective checksums for the images can be found below this announcement and the direct download links from our capable mirror providers are as follows:

對於全新安裝，映像隨 OpenSSL 一起提供，適用於 32 位元和 64 位元 Intel 架構。新的SSH安裝程式功能將偵聽LAN連接埠192.168.1.1，向客戶端提供DHCP租用，並可使用使用者「root」（控制台選單）或「安裝程式」（當然是安裝程式）和預設密碼「opnsense」進行連線。鏡像各自的校驗和可以在本公告下方找到，來自我們有能力的鏡像提供者的直接下載連結如下：

Here is the list of major features that have been worked on since 16.7 was released 6 months ago:

以下是自 6 個月前發布 16.7 以來所開發的主要功能清單：

-   cooperative firewall forwarding to allow traffic shaper/captive portal with multi-WAN  
    協作防火牆轉發，允許具有多個WAN的流量整形器/強制門戶
    
-   install media now boots up with SSH for headless remote installation  
    安裝媒體現在使用 SSH 啟動，以進行無頭遠端安裝
    
-   HardenedBSD ASLR and PIE compilation for most binaries  
    大多數二進位檔案的 HardenedBSD ASLR 和 PIE 編譯
    
-   HardenedBSD SEGVGUARD to prevent ASLR brute force attacks  
    HardenedBSD SEGVGUARD 可防止 ASLR 暴力攻擊
    
-   PHP 7.0 compatibility and general GUI speed improvements  
    PHP 7.0 相容性與一般 GUI 速度改進
    
-   replaced the CSRF implementation in the non-MVC pages  
    取代了非MVC頁面中的CSRF實現
    
-   integrated authentication using PAM to allow e.g. 2FA (TOTP) over SSH  
    使用PAM進行整合式身份驗證，以允許例如2FA (TOTP) 超過 SSH
    
-   system secondary console support with new EFI and Mute options  
    系統輔助控制台支援新的EFI和靜音選項
    
-   Portuguese/Portugal as a release language (contributed by Carlos Meireles)  
    葡萄牙語/葡萄牙作為發布語言（由 Carlos Meireles 貢獻）
    
-   Portuguese/Brazil as a release language (contributed by Thiago Basilio)  
    葡萄牙語/巴西作為發布語言（由 Thiago Basilio 貢獻）
    
-   Italian as a release language (contributed by Antonio Prado)  
    義大利語作為發布語言（由 Antonio Prado 貢獻）
    
-   Czech as a release language (contributed by Pavel Borecki)  
    捷克語作為發布語言（由 Pavel Borecki 貢獻）
    
-   improved password security (contributed by OSnet)  
    改進的密碼安全性（由 OSnet 貢獻）
    
-   FTP proxy plugin (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    FTP 代理插件（由 Frank Brendel 貢獻）
    
-   Let’s Encrypt Plugin [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/pull/66) (contributed by Frank Wall)  
    Let’s Encrypt 外掛程式 [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/pull/66)（由 Frank Wall 貢獻）
    
-   Tinc VPN Plugin  
    Tinc VPN 插件
    
-   IPsec tunnel isolation mode for interoperability  
    IPsec 隧道隔離模式以實現互通性
    
-   micro versioning/migrations for config items  
    配置項目的微版本控制/遷移
    
-   constraint support for config items  
    配置項的約束支持
    
-   rewritten Nano images with growfs(8) support  
    使用 Growthfs(8) 支援重寫 Nano 影像
    
-   authentication methods are now fully pluggable  
    身份驗證方法現在是完全可插入的
    
-   firewall rules are now fully pluggable  
    防火牆規則現在完全可插入
    
-   FreeBSD 11.0 including additional reliability fixes  
    FreeBSD 11.0 包括額外的可靠性修復

自 16.7.14/17.1.r1 以來進行的細微更改：

-   system: always restore native /var layout on boot  
    系統：啟動時始終恢復本機 /var 佈局
    
-   system: make vt/sc configurable  
    系統：使 vt/sc 可配置
    
-   web proxy: improve validation for SSL bump URL input (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    Web 代理：改進對 SSL 碰撞 URL 輸入的驗證（由 Fabian Franz 貢獻）
    
-   web proxy: add plugin-capable pre/post authentication directories (contributed by Evgeny Bevz)

    mvc：在缺失元素中使用空字串而不是「##Unlinked」（由 Frank Wall 貢獻）

    www：替換靜態PHP頁面的CSRF實現

    src：將 hash\_packet6() 的結果轉換為主機位元組順序

    src：在 pflog 中正確初始化 subrulenr

    埠：openssl 1.0.2k [\[2\]](https://www.openssl.org/news/secadv/20170126.txt)

    埠：php 7.0.15 [\[3\]](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-7.php#7.0.15)
    

Additionally, these migration caveats should be heeded before upgrading:

此外，在升級之前應注意以下遷移注意事項：

-   The integrated authentication framework is now used as a system-wide default including login(1), su(1) and sudo(8). This means that e.g. when 2FA is enabled for the GUI it will be used for low-level password prompts as well and plain passwords are disabled by default. If this behaviour is undesired, set the “Disable integrated authentication” option under System: Settings: Administration.  
    整合式身分驗證框架現在用作系統範圍的預設設置，包括 login(1)、su(1) 和 sudo(8)。這意味著例如當GUI啟用2FA時，它也將用於低階密碼提示，並且預設會停用明文密碼。如果不希望出現此行為，請在系統：設定：管理下設定「停用整合驗證」選項。
    
-   Disabled Gateway entries are now always honoured instead of being set up as a default gateway.  
    禁用的網關條目現在始終受到尊重，而不是被設定為預設網關。
    
-   The console settings received a non-backwards compatible change. If the VGA console is not working, simply reconfigure it from System: Settings: Administration as it was likely set to “Serial”（序列） due to a wrong GUI default.  
    控制台設定收到了非向後相容的變更。如果VGA控制台無法工作，只需從系統：設定：管理中重新配置它，因為它可能由於錯誤的GUI預設設定而設定為“Serial”（序列）。
    
-   FreeBSD 11.0 switched to the vt(4) console driver, but we are keeping sc(4) as the default. You can change this after installation by enabling the virtual terminal driver under System: Settings: Administration.  
    FreeBSD 11.0 切換到 vt(4) 控制台驅動程序，但我們保留 sc(4) 作為預設值。您可以在安裝後透過啟用系統：設定：管理下的虛擬終端驅動程式來變更此設定。
    
-   EFI boots may not yield a console anymore, the setting for VGA is wrong now and should be switched to “EFI”（電噴） under System: Settings: Administration.  
    EFI啟動可能不再產生控制台，VGA的設定現在是錯誤的，應該在系統：設定：管理下切換到“EFI”（電噴）。
    
-   The access privileges for “Lobby: Login / Logout / Dashboard” and “Diagnostics: Backup / Restore” have been remapped internally and need to be reapplied when they have been assigned explicitly.  
    「大廳：登入/登出/儀表板」和「診斷：備份/復原」的存取權限已在內部重新映射，並且在明確分配後需要重新套用。
    
-   The inherited 6rd kernel patches are not included in standard FreeBSD 11.0. The state of 6rd is possibly broken. We ask for volunteers to pick up the work if 6rd is still a requirement, as we do not have access to such setups.  
    繼承的第 6 個核心補丁不包含在標準 FreeBSD 11.0 中。 6號的狀態可能已經被打破了。如果仍然需要第六次，我們會要求志工來接手這項工作，因為我們無法訪問此類設定。
    
-   Fundamental WiFi stack changes in FreeBSD 11.0 could still affect overall operability. Please let us know about these right away.  
    FreeBSD 11.0 中的基本 WiFi 堆疊變更仍可能影響整體可操作性。請立即告知我們這些資訊。
    
-   The following services moved to individual plugins and need to be reinstalled in order to be used: SNMP, Load Balancer, Wake on LAN, Universal Plug and Play, IGMP Proxy. Their respective configurations will be preserved by the system even if these plugins are not installed.  
    以下服務已移至單獨的插件，需要重新安裝才能使用：SNMP、負載平衡器、LAN 喚醒、通用即插即用、IGMP 代理。即使未安裝這些插件，系統也會保留它們各自的配置。
    
-   The Intel e1000 driver plugin has been removed due to an incompatibility with FreeBSD 11.0. All previously known bugs of the FreeBSD 11.0 e1000 driver have been fixed in OPNsense 17.1 and reported to FreeBSD.  
    由於與 FreeBSD 11.0 不相容，Intel e1000 驅動程式外掛程式已被刪除。 FreeBSD 11.0 e1000 驅動程式先前已知的所有錯誤均已在 OPNsense 17.1 中修復，並向 FreeBSD 報告。

##### 17.1.r1 (January 20, 2017)｜17.1.r1（2017 年 1 月 20 日）

The wish list for our kernel improvements has been emptied just a week ago, which makes 17.1-RC1 look like the final 17.1 for all intents and purposes and already includes the stable upgrade path. Several features have been moved from the core to the plugins and may need to be reinstalled, namely Load Balancer, Wake on LAN, SNMP, IGMP Proxy and Universal Plug and Play. More details are listed below.

我們的核心改進願望清單在一週前就被清空了，這使得17.1-RC1看起來像是最終的17.1，並且已經包含了穩定的升級路徑。多個功能已從核心移至插件，可能需要重新安裝，即負載平衡器、LAN, SNMP, IGMP 代理喚醒和通用即插即用。下面列出了更多詳細資訊。

A special thank you goes to Carlos Meireles and Thiago Basilio, who brought to you Portuguese as a language choice (Portugal and Brazil, respectively). Awesome work!

特別感謝 Carlos Meireles 和 Thiago Basilio，他們為您帶來了葡萄牙語作為語言選擇（分別是葡萄牙和巴西）。太棒了！

Here is the full list of changes since 17.1-BETA:

以下是自 17.1-BETA 以來的完整更改清單：

-   core: default to integrated authentication (PAM) for su, login et al  
    核心：預設為 su、login 等整合式身分驗證（PAM）
    
-   core: lock down UNIX accounts for active integrated authentication  
    核心：鎖定UNIX帳戶進行主動整合認證
    
-   core: console option 11 now reloads all instead of only the web GUI  
    核心：控制台選項 11 現在重新載入所有內容，而不僅僅是網頁 GUI
    
-   core: removed unused translations from console features  
    核心：從控制台功能中刪除了未使用的翻譯
    
-   core: load AESNI by default  
    核心：預設載入AESNI
    
-   core: remove restrictions to not run DNS resolver and forwarder in parallel  
    核心：刪除不並行運行DNS解析器和轉發器的限制
    
-   core: use the sc console driver instead of vt  
    核心：使用sc控制台驅動程式而不是vt
    
-   core: consolidate anti-lockout behaviour  
    核心：鞏固防鎖定行為
    
-   core: optionally limit ciphers for web GUI  
    核心：可選地限製網路密碼GUI
    
-   core: move individual XMLRPC sync options to their respective services  
    核心：將各個XMLRPC同步選項移至各自的服務
    
-   core: use rc.shutdown hook for graceful ACPI shutdown  
    核心：使用 rc.shutdown 鉤子優雅地關閉 ACPI
    
-   core: fix locale setting in MVC (contributed by Alexander Shursha)  
    核心：修復 MVC 中的區域設定（由 Alexander Shursha 貢獻）
    
-   core: add translations to the wizard (contributed by Alexander Shursha)  
    核心：嚮導加入翻譯（由 Alexander Shursha 貢獻）
    
-   core: fix several crash reports  
    核心：修復多個崩潰報告
    
-   core: use the ddb.conf that FreeBSD already provides  
    核心：使用FreeBSD已經提供的ddb.conf
    
-   core: configure ddb even if no dump device was found  
    核心：即使沒有找到轉儲設備，也配置 ddb
    
-   core: move bogon rules to fix DHCPv6 WAN scenarios  
    核心：移動 bogon 規則以修復 DHCPv6 WAN 場景
    
-   web proxy: allow to disable caching by zeroing cache\_mem  
    Web 代理程式：允許透過清零快取\_mem 來停用快取
    
-   plugins: the os-intel-em driver has been removed  
    插件：os-intel-em 驅動程式已被刪除
    
-   plugins: configuration additions for os-tinc  
    插件：os-tinc 的配置添加
    
-   plugins: exported several base features to plugins (os-snmp, os-igmp-proxy, os-wol, os-upnp, os-relayd)  
    插件：將幾個基本功能匯出到插件（os-snmp、os-igmp-proxy、os-wol、os-upnp、os-relayd）
    
-   lang: added Portuguese/Portugal (contributed by Carlos Meireles)  
    lang：加入了葡萄牙語/葡萄牙語（由 Carlos Meireles 貢獻）
    
-   lang: added Portuguese/Brazil (contributed by Thiago Basilio)  
    lang：新增了葡萄牙語/巴西（由 Thiago Basilio 貢獻）
    
-   src: wireless firmware now only available via kernel modules  
    src：無線韌體現在只能透過核心模組使用
    
-   src: the EM\_MULTIQUEUE kernel option has been removed  
    src：EM\_MULTIQUEUE 核心選項已被刪除
    
-   src: HardenedBSD SEGVGUARD improvements  
    src：HardenedBSD SEGVGUARD 改進
    
-   src: HardenedBSD force -fPIC when building PIEs  
    src：建構 PIE 時 HardenedBSD 強制使用 -fPIC
    
-   src: do not initialize the adapter on MTU change when ix status is down  
    src：當 ix 狀態關閉時，請勿在MTU變更上初始化適配器
    
-   src fix panic during lagg destruction with simultaneous status check  
    src 修復滯後破壞期間的恐慌並同時進行狀態檢查
    
-   src: restore link state probing for e1000 82574 chipsets  
    src：恢復 e1000 82574 晶片組的連結狀態偵測
    
-   src: IP cooperative forwarding rework, fixes IPv4 in pf  
    src: IP 協作轉送返工，修正 pf 中的 IPv4
    
-   src: avoid deadlocks during lagg configuration  
    src：避免 lagg 配置期間出現死鎖
    
-   src: multiple fixes for netmap to repair emulation panics  
    src：對 netmap 進行了多項修復以修復模擬恐慌
    

Known issues in this version:

此版本中的已知問題：

-   The inherited 6rd kernel patches are not included in standard FreeBSD 11.0. The impact on 6rd setups is currently unknown.  
    繼承的第 6 個核心補丁不包含在標準 FreeBSD 11.0 中。目前尚不清楚對第六設定的影響。
    
-   Fundamental WiFi stack changes in FreeBDS 11.0 could still affect operability.  
    FreeBDS 11.0 中的基本 WiFi 堆疊變更仍可能影響可操作性。
    
-   Insight and Health statistics import from the early installer may not work.  
    從早期安裝程式匯入的 Insight 和 Health 統計資料可能無法正常運作。
    
-   Due to a Python 2.7.13 incompatibility the NetFlow connector may not work. A workaround is to revert to the Python 2.7.12 release. See the forum for details [\[1\]](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=4235.0) .  
    由於 Python 2.7.13 不相容，NetFlow 連接器可能無法運作。解決方法是恢復到 Python 2.7.12 版本。詳情請參閱論壇[\[1\]](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=4235.0) 。
    
-   The LibreSSL version will not be available until the final release.  
    LibreSSL 版本要等到最終版本才可使用。
    
-   The console settings received a non-backwards compatible change. If the VGA console is not working, simply reconfigure it from System: Settings: Administration as it was likely set to Serial due to a wrong GUI default.  
    控制台設定收到了非向後相容的變更。如果VGA控制台無法工作，只需從系統：設定：管理中重新配置它，因為它可能由於錯誤的GUI預設設定而設定為序列。

##### 17.1.b (December 16, 2016)｜17.1.b（2016 年 12 月 16 日）

With the best wishes for the holiday season attached we hereby humbly present our 17.1-BETA images and thank everyone for their early input, valid questions and generally keeping us on our toes throughout the past months. The next major release features FreeBSD 11.0, the SSH remote installer, new languages Italian and Czech, state-of-the-art HardenedBSD security features, PHP 7.0, native PAM authentication against e.g. 2FA (TOTP), as well a rewritten Nano-style card images that adapt to the media size to name only a few.

帶著對假期的最美好的祝愿，我們在此謙虛地展示我們的17.1-BETA圖像，並感謝大家的早期投入、有效的問題以及在過去幾個月中始終保持警惕的大家。下一個主要版本具有 FreeBSD 11.0、SSH 遠端安裝程式、新語言義大利語和捷克語、最先進的 HardenedBSD 安全功能、PHP 7.0、原生 PAM 身份驗證（例如）。 2FA (TOTP)，以及重寫的 Nano 風格卡片圖像，可適應介質尺寸等等。

These will be the only beta images. They are not suitable for production environments. Release candidate builds will start in January in order to provide production-ready images. Checksums can be found below this announcement. Direct download links from our capable mirror providers are as follows:

這些將是唯一的測試版圖像。它們不適合生產環境。候選版本建置將於一月份開始，以提供可用於生產的映像。校驗和可以在本公告下方找到。來自我們有能力的鏡像提供者的直接下載連結如下：

Here is a list of hand-picked major features that were worked on since 16.7:

以下是自16.7以來精心挑選的主要功能清單：

-   system secondary console support with new EFI and Mute options  
    系統輔助控制台支援新的EFI和靜音選項
    
-   installer now boots up with SSH for headless remote installation  
    安裝程式現在使用 SSH 啟動，以進行無頭遠端安裝
    
-   Italian as a release language (contributed by Antonio Prado)  
    義大利語作為發布語言（由 Antonio Prado 貢獻）
    
-   Czech as a release language (contributed by Pavel Borecki)  
    捷克語作為發布語言（由 Pavel Borecki 貢獻）
    
-   HardenedBSD ASLR and PIE compilation for most binaries  
    大多數二進位檔案的 HardenedBSD ASLR 和 PIE 編譯
    
-   HardenedBSD SEGVGUARD to prevent ASLR brute force attacks  
    HardenedBSD SEGVGUARD 可防止 ASLR 暴力攻擊
    
-   PHP 7.0 compatibility and general GUI speed improvements  
    PHP 7.0 相容性與常規 GUI 速度改進
    
-   improved password security (contributed by OSnet)  
    改進的密碼安全性（由 OSnet 貢獻）
    
-   FTP proxy plugin (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    FTP 代理插件（由 Frank Brendel 貢獻）
    
-   PAM authentication module, e.g. 2FA on SSH  
    PAM 認證模組，例如SSH 的 2FA
    
-   IPsec tunnel isolation mode for interoperability  
    IPsec 隧道隔離模式以實現互通性
    
-   Intel em(4) driver version 7.6.2 as a plugin  
    Intel em(4) 驅動程式版本 7.6.2 作為插件
    
-   micro versioning/migrations for config items  
    配置項目的微版本控制/遷移
    
-   constraint support for config items  
    配置項的約束支持
    
-   rewritten Nano images with growfs(8) support  
    使用 Growthfs(8) 支援重寫 Nano 影像
    
-   authentication methods are now fully pluggable  
    身份驗證方法現在是完全可插入的
    
-   firewall rules are now fully pluggable  
    防火牆規則現在完全可插入
    
-   Tinc VPN Plugin  
    Tinc VPN 插件
    
-   FreeBSD 11.0
    

Known issues in this version:

此版本中的已知問題：

-   The inherited 6rd kernel patches are not included in standard FreeBSD 11.0. The impact on 6rd setups is currently unknown.  
    繼承的第 6 個核心補丁不包含在標準 FreeBSD 11.0 中。目前尚不清楚對第六設定的影響。
    
-   The installer character set is not entirely correct due to the default console switch to vt(4).  
    由於預設控制台切換到 vt(4)，安裝程式字元集並不完全正確。
    
-   Fundamental WiFi stack changes in FreeBDS 11.0 may still affect overall operability.  
    FreeBDS 11.0 中的基本 WiFi 堆疊變更可能仍會影響整體可操作性。
    
-   Insight and Health statistics import from the early installer do not work.  
    從早期安裝程式匯入的 Insight 和 Health 統計資料不起作用。
    
-   The LibreSSL version will not be available until the final release.  
    LibreSSL 版本要等到最終版本才可使用。
    

Any help in making 17.1 the best it could possibly be for its final release at the end of January 2017 is highly appreciated. Please do not hesitate to contact us through any of the known channels:

#### 16.7 “Dancing Dolphin”（跳舞的海豚） Series｜16.7 “Dancing Dolphin”（跳舞的海豚）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_16.7.html>

It is time for the next major iteration in open-source security! After 6 months and 20 minor releases we hereby declare the general availability of OPNsense 16.7, nicknamed “Dancing Dolphin”（跳舞的海豚）. The highlights of this major release include:

現在是開源安全領域下一次重大迭代的時候了！經過 6 個月和 20 個小版本發布，我們特此宣布 OPNsense 16.7（暱稱 “Dancing Dolphin”（跳舞的海豚））全面可用。此主要版本的亮點包括：

-   Suricata 3.1.1 with Intel Hyperscan support  
    Suricata 3.1.1 具有 Intel Hyperscan 支援
    
-   NetFlow-based reporting and export  
    基於 NetFlow 的報告和匯出
    
-   Traffic shaping using CoDel / FQ-CoDel  
    使用 CoDel / FQ-CoDel 進行流量整形
    
-   Two-factor authentication based on RFC 6238 (TOTP)  
    基於RFC6238（TOTP）的雙重認證
    
-   HTTPS and ICAP support in the proxy server  
    代理伺服器中的HTTPS和ICAP支持
    
-   FreeBSD 10.3 with full integration of HardenedBSD ASLR  
    FreeBSD 10.3 完全整合 HardenedBSD ASLR
    
-   UEFI boot and installation modes  
    UEFI 啟動及安裝模式
    
-   Substantial updates to our language packs: Japanese, Russian, German, French, Chinese  
    我們的語言包大幅更新：日語、俄語、德語、法語、中文
    

We thank all contributors, testers and users for their relentless support and invaluable feedback. The release candidate phase has been the most fun we have had so far. :)

我們感謝所有貢獻者、測試人員和用戶的不懈支持和寶貴的回饋。候選版本階段是迄今為止我們經歷過的最有趣的階段。 :)

Attention: An incompatibility in Chrome may prevent the firmware update from running. Try a different browser to upgrade to 16.7 where a workaround has been added to avoid the problem in the future.

注意：Chrome 中的不相容可能會阻止韌體更新運行。嘗試使用其他瀏覽器升級到16.7，其中添加了解決方法以避免將來出現問題。

All images can be found on the mirrors below with checksums attached to the end of this announcement:

所有圖像都可以在下面的鏡像中找到，校驗和附在本公告的末尾：

[https://opnsense.org/download/](https://opnsense.org/download/)

##### 16.7.14 (January 25, 2017)｜16.7.14（2017 年 1 月 25 日）

We are back for one last update of the 16.7 series with a small number of fixes and security-related package updates. Do not forget that 17.1 is scheduled for next week: the update instructions will be delivered via the usual firmware update path.

我們回來了16.7系列的最後一次更新，其中包含少量修復和與安全相關的軟體包更新。不要忘記17.1定於下週發布：更新說明將透過通常的韌體更新路徑傳遞。

Until then, here are the full patch notes:

在此之前，以下是完整的補丁說明：

-   traffic shaper: order rules numerically by sequence number  
    流量整形器：依序號對規則進行數字排序
    
-   firmware: added opnsense-revert tool for release-based package revert  
    韌體：新增了 opnsense-revert 工具，用於基於版本的套件恢復
    
-   captive portal: fix downloading files in Chrome  
    強制入口網站：修復在 Chrome 中下載檔案的問題
    
-   insight: fix downloading files in Chrome  
    洞察：修復在 Chrome 中下載檔案的問題
    
-   mvc: consistently set locale (contributed by Alexander Shursha)  
    mvc：一致設定的語言環境（由 Alexander Shursha 貢獻）
    
-   mvc: do not deliver content twice on API calls  
    mvc：不要在 API 呼叫中傳遞內容兩次
    
-   python: downgraded to 2.7.12 in order to fix segmentation faults within insight reporting  
    python：降級到2.7.12以修復洞察報告中的分段錯誤
    
-   libressl: avoid possible side-channel leak of ECDSA private keys when signing [\[1\]](https://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/patches/6.0/common/016_libcrypto.patch.sig)  
    libressl：在簽署 [\[1\]](https://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/patches/6.0/common/016_libcrypto.patch.sig) 時避免可能出現的 ECDSA 私鑰洩漏
    
-   ports: bind 9.10.4-P5 [\[2\]](https://deepthought.isc.org/article/AA-01447/0/BIND-9.10.4-P5-Release-Notes.html)  
    連接埠：綁定 9.10.4-P5 [\[2\]](https://deepthought.isc.org/article/AA-01447/0/BIND-9.10.4-P5-Release-Notes.html)

    連接埠：sqlite 3.16.2 [\[4\]](https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_16_2.html)

    連接埠：openssh 7.4p1 [\[5\]](https://www.openssh.com/txt/release-7.4)

    埠： sudo 1.8.19p2 [\[6\]](https://www.sudo.ws/releases/legacy/#1.8.19p2)

    埠：lighttpd 1.4.45 [\[7\]](https://www.lighttpd.net/2017/1/14/1.4.45/)

    埠：php 5.6.30 [\[8\]](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-5.php#5.6.30)
    

##### 16.7.13 (January 06, 2017)｜16.7.13（2017 年 1 月 6 日）

This update ships with the latest version of Squid, an enhanced version of the HAProxy plugin and other assorted reliability improvements.

此更新附帶最新版本的 Squid、HAProxy 插件的增強版本以及其他各種可靠性改進。

As 17.1 inevitably approaches, we have set the release date to January 31. If all goes well, the upcoming 16.7.14 will be the EOL release for the 16.7 series.

##### 16.7.11 (December 14, 2016)｜16.7.11（2016 年 12 月 14 日）

The builds for 17.1-BETA are rolling as we write this and we are mighty proud of having come so far! Almost two years ago we started with a simple vision and have been staying true to our goal of providing stable licensing, swift updates and modern features. But that story is not for today. :)

在我們撰寫本文時，17.1-BETA 的構建正在滾動，我們為到目前為止的進展感到非常自豪！大約兩年前，我們從一個簡單的願景開始，並堅持我們的目標，即提供穩定的許可、快速更新和現代功能。但這個故事不是今天講的。 :)

In the meantime, this 16.7.11 update receives newer versions of OpenVPN and Suricata, improved password hashing and two DNS forwarder fixes. Furthermore, the firmware feature received an extensive user experience boost, including, but not limited to, being able to read pending release notes.

同時，此16.7.11更新接收了新版本的OpenVPN和Suricata，改進的密碼雜湊和兩個DNS轉發器修復。此外，韌體功能還獲得了廣泛的用戶體驗提升，包括但不限於能夠閱讀待發布的發行說明。

Here is the full list of changes:

    系統：新增了靜音控制台支援並改進了 tty 重新配置

    系統：恢復了 powerd 的「正常」電源狀態配置選項（由 Tikimotel 提供）

##### 16.7.8 (November 16, 2016)｜16.7.8（2016 年 11 月 16 日）

Today we present to you the latest stable iteration of the 16.7 series focusing on improved reliability and security in all areas and major feature upgrades.

今天我們向您展示16.7系列的最新穩定迭代，重點是在所有領域提高可靠性和安全性以及主要功能升級。

Big news this week are the inclusion of two new fully-featured plugins for Tinc VPN and FTP proxying, the latter being kindly sponsored by EURO-LOG AG [\[1\]](http://www.eurolog.com/) . Together with the community we are continuing the trend towards a comprehensive plugins environment based on top of our distinctive MVC GUI framework, with more plugins already in direct development.

本週的大新聞是 Tinc VPN 和 FTP 代理的兩個新的全功能插件，後者由 EURO-LOG AG [\[1\]](http://www.eurolog.com/) 慷慨贊助。我們與社區一起繼續發展基於我們獨特的MVC GUI框架的綜合插件環境的趨勢，更多插件已經在直接開發中。

Speaking of such, the MVC framework received fine-grained versioning and constraint support as well as a completely revamped API error handling and plugin-compatible authentication handling.

說到這裡，MVC框架獲得了細粒度的版本控制和約束支持，以及完全改進的API錯誤處理和插件相容的身份驗證處理。

Last but not least, enclosed within are third-party software updates, most importantly the latest versions of LibreSSL, Bind, Sudo, OpenVPN, Suricata, PHP and Curl.

最後但並非最不重要的一點是，其中包含第三方軟體更新，最重要的是 LibreSSL、Bind、Sudo、OpenVPN、Suricata、PHP 和 Curl 的最新版本。

A reboot is not strictly necessary, but recommended.

重新啟動並不是絕對必要的，但建議這樣做。

##### 16.7.7 (October 27, 2016)｜16.7.7（2016 年 10 月 27 日）

This update brings several reliability and security improvements as usual. Our LibreSSL fans will notice the version 2.3 has finally been replaced with 2.4 and we switched to position independent executables in our base system to make good use of HardenedBSD ASLR.

與往常一樣，此更新帶來了多項可靠性和安全性改進。我們的 LibreSSL 粉絲會注意到版本 2.3 最終被 2.4 取代，並且我們切換到在基本系統中放置獨立的可執行文件，以充分利用 HardenedBSD ASLR。

Another hot topic is the addition of a Czech translation into the release. Many thanks to pavelb for making that happen!

另一個熱門話題是在版本中添加了捷克語翻譯。非常感謝帕維爾布讓這一切發生！

Overall progress towards OPNsense 17.1 is steady: native PAM support is through the testing phase and major FreeBSD upgrade support is already enclosed within this very update. Our next step is the release of beta images some time during November.

Seamless upgrades from any major release to the next is our mission. :)

##### 16.7.5 (September 28, 2016)｜16.7.5（2016 年 9 月 28 日）

Now that we got the chance to ship not one, but two OpenSSL bumps at the same time we barely missed the LibreSSL updates. That is life. But we still have a few great things to offer this week.

現在我們有機會同時發布兩個而不是一個 OpenSSL 版本，我們幾乎沒有錯過 LibreSSL 更新。這就是生活。但本週我們仍然有一些很棒的東西可以提供。

First and foremost, users noted that the captive portal did not work with the transparent proxy. This lead to internal investigation into the operating system kernel itself, where a number of issues with using several packet filters in a row can lead to shortcuts in packet paths through the networking stack.

首先，使用者指出強制門戶無法與透明代理一起使用。這導致了對作業系統核心本身的內部調查，其中連續使用多個資料包過濾器的許多問題可能會導致通過網路堆疊的資料包路徑出現捷徑。

This circled back to a simple fix for the captive portal: you can now edit each zone to enable the proxy for HTTP (port 3128) or HTTPS (port 3129) for captive portal use without requiring the firewall redirect. You only have to make sure you actually have your captive portal interface set up as an interface in the proxy.

這又回到了強制入口網站的簡單修復：您現在可以編輯每個區域以啟用 HTTP（連接埠 3128）或 HTTPS（連接埠 3129）的代理程式以供強制入口網站使用，而無需防火牆重定向。您只需確保您確實將強制門戶介面設定為代理程式中的介面即可。

We will continue to look into the remaining kernel issues and give updates and calls for testing when we reach new milestones.

我們將繼續研究剩餘的核心問題，並在達到新的里程碑時提供更新和測試呼籲。

In other news, both OpenVPN and IPsec received several improvements for interoperability and the occasional bug with the missing firewall rules tab for their respective interfaces.

在其他訊息中，OpenVPN 和 IPsec 都在互通性方面得到了多項改進，並且偶爾出現缺少各自介面的防火牆規則標籤的錯誤。

##### 16.7.4 (September 22, 2016)｜16.7.4（2016 年 9 月 22 日）

We are deliberately skipping waiting for OpenSSL to announce their new version today as the roundtrip time for incorporating patches and updates into FreeBSD and maybe also LibreSSL will likely delay an update to next week. We will simply do a 16.7.5 next week as well and let 16.7.4 stand on its own feet.

我們故意跳過今天等待 OpenSSL 宣布其新版本的時間，因為將補丁和更新合併到 FreeBSD 中的往返時間，也許 LibreSSL 也可能將更新推遲到下週。下週我們也會乾脆做一個16.7.5，讓16.7.4自立。

The prominent theme of this update is CARP. We have identified a number of issues with the way it was being set up and reverted the process back to what BSD standards recommend. We have a shiny new test lab to preview and scrutinise these changes in a larger environment. The tests were promising. Let us know what you think!

本次更新的突出主題是CARP。我們發現了其設定方式中的許多問題，並將流程恢復為BSD標準建議的方式。我們有一個閃亮的新測試實驗室，可以在更大的環境中預覽和審查這些變化。測試結果很有希望。讓我們知道您的想法！

Another thing is the introduction of the Intel Gigabit driver plugin based on the stock driver code version 7.6.2 as multiple reports popped up regarding driver reliability. If you are having trouble with CARP or intrusion detection IPS mode with your em(4) driver, try installing the new plugin and reboot to activate.

另一件事是基於庫存驅動程式代碼版本7.6.2引入了英特爾千兆位元驅動程式插件，因為有關驅動程式可靠性的多個報告彈出。如果您的 em(4) 驅動程式在使用 CARP 或入侵偵測 IPS 模式時遇到問題，請嘗試安裝新外掛程式並重新啟動以啟動。

##### 16.7.3 (August 31, 2016)｜16.7.3（2016 年 8 月 31 日）

Brand new is the general availability of the Italian translation thanks to the work of Antonio Prado. The work is still ongoing and all help is highly appreciated. Also, the web font has been updated to enhance display of Cyrillic letters. We just love fostering the translations!

##### 16.7.2 (August 18, 2016)｜16.7.2（2016 年 8 月 18 日）

The release schedule is being stretched bit by bit to see how long we can go without an update. Well, we did not want wait any longer to share with you the following bits… so here they are. ;)

發佈時間表正在一點一點地延長，看看我們能堅持多久而不更新。好吧，我們不想再等了，想與您分享以下內容……所以它們就在這裡。 ;)

FreeBSD incorporated several reliability fixes for Hyper-V and we had to back out an ICMP stable commit that was not fully working for trace route output over the network. There are several important ports updates, namely Lighttpd, StrongSwan and OpenSSH all brought to their latest versions.

FreeBSD 包含了針對 Hyper-V 的多個可靠性修復程序，我們不得不取消一個 ICMP 穩定提交，該提交不能完全用於網路上的追蹤路由輸出。有幾個重要的 ports 更新，即 Lighttpd、StrongSwan 和 OpenSSH 都已達到最新版本。

On our side, multi-point VPN plugins have been corrected to properly group to their respective firewall rule interface. For anyone waiting to migrate their VPNs from 16.1.20 to 16.7, now is the time to do so! Also, the stale OpenVPN windows binaries have been removed. Note that we gracefully support configuration file export in several formats.

在我們這邊，多點 VPN 插件已被更正，以正確分組到各自的防火牆規則介面。對於任何等待將 VPN 從 16.1.20 遷移到 16.7 的人來說，現在就是這樣做的時候了！此外，過時的 OpenVPN Windows 二進位檔案已被刪除。請注意，我們很好地支援多種格式的配置檔案匯出。

##### 16.7.1 (August 02, 2016)｜16.7.1（2016 年 8 月 2 日）

Thanks again for the warm welcome of the 16.7 series! The feedback has been overwhelming, quite positively so. It was partly addressed in to be released code, shall be weaved into the upcoming roadmap or will be further discussed in our forums. Every wee bit counts on our way to 17.1. :)

再次感謝16.7系列的熱烈歡迎！回饋非常熱烈，而且非常正面。它已在即將發布的程式碼中得到部分解決，將被納入即將發布的路線圖或將在我們的論壇中進一步討論。在通往 17.1 的道路上，每一點都很重要。 :)

This release addresses a pressing issue with the Intel e1000 driver in conjunction with IPS mode. For now, a piece of code that went into FreeBSD 10.3 has been reverted to bring back stability, but we are working with the author on a more permanent solution.

此版本解決了 Intel e1000 驅動程式與 IPS 模式結合使用的迫切問題。目前，進入 FreeBSD 10.3 的一段程式碼已被恢復以恢復穩定性，但我們正在與作者合作尋找更永久的解決方案。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: default config now disables hardware offloading features  
    系統：預設配置現在禁用硬體卸載功能
    
-   system: prevent carp demotion on sender and pfsync failures  
    系統：防止 carp 在發送方和 pfsync 失敗時降級
    
-   firewall: removed obsolete reflection timeout value  
    防火牆：刪除了過時的反射逾時值
    
-   firewall: added logging option for outbound NAT  
    防火牆：新增了出站日誌記錄選項NAT
    
-   firewall: fix interface address IPv6 outbound NAT  
    防火牆：修復介面位址 IPv6 出站NAT
    
-   firewall: fix one-to-one copy feature  
    防火牆：修復一對一複製功能
    
-   firewall: execute custom scrub rules before auto-generated rules  
    防火牆：在自動產生的規則之前執行自訂清理規則
    
-   firmware: fixed race on base / kernel fetch  
    韌體：修復了基礎/內核獲取的競爭
    
-   firmware: revoke the obsoleted 16.1 update fingerprint  
    韌體：撤銷已廢棄的16.1更新指紋
    
-   interfaces: allow default route on multi-WAN PPPoE  
    介面：允許多WAN PPPoE 上的預設路由
    
-   interfaces: allow to set txpower for WiFi adapters  
    介面：允許設定 WiFi 適配器的 txpower
    
-   interfaces: allow backwards-compatible interface enable  
    介面：允許向後相容介面啟用
    
-   vpn: fix faulty IPSec authenticator selection in phase 1  
    VPN：修正第一階段中錯誤的 IPSec 驗證器選擇
    
-   mvc: add missing CRL type in certificates cache  
    mvc：在憑證快取中新增缺少的 CRL 類型
    
-   mvc: set robots meta to nofollow, noindex  
    mvc：將機器人元設定為 nofollow、noindex
    
-   mvc: always show logout button in menu  
    mvc：始終在選單中顯示註銷按鈕
    
-   src: fix bspatch heap overflow vulnerability [\[1\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-16:25.bspatch.asc)  
    src: 修正bspatch堆溢位漏洞[\[1\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-16:25.bspatch.asc)
    
-   src: fix ICMP translation in pf  
    src：修正 pf 中的 ICMP 翻譯
    
-   src: revert extended descriptor format for em(4) [\[2\]](https://github.com/opnsense/src/commit/b0f7ff3)  
    src: 恢復 em(4) [\[2\]](https://github.com/opnsense/src/commit/b0f7ff3) 的擴充描述符格式
    
-   src: lower spurious log notice to debug in rtsold  
    src：減少在 rtsold 中調試的虛假日誌通知
    
-   plugins: os-haproxy 1.4 (contributed by Frank Wall)  
    插件：os-haproxy 1.4（由 Frank Wall 貢獻）
    
-   ports: libressl 2.3.7 [\[3\]](https://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/LibreSSL/libressl-2.3.7-relnotes.txt)  
    埠： libressl 2.3.7 [\[3\]](https://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/LibreSSL/libressl-2.3.7-relnotes.txt)
    

##### 16.7 (July 28, 2016)｜16.7（2016 年 7 月 28 日）

It is time for the next major iteration in open-source security! After 6 months and 20 minor releases we hereby declare the general availability of OPNsense 16.7, nicknamed “Dancing Dolphin”（跳舞的海豚）. The highlights of this major release include:

現在是開源安全領域下一次重大迭代的時候了！經過 6 個月和 20 個小版本發布，我們特此宣布 OPNsense 16.7（暱稱 “Dancing Dolphin”（跳舞的海豚））全面可用。此主要版本的亮點包括：

-   Suricata 3.1.1 with Intel Hyperscan support  
    Suricata 3.1.1 具有 Intel Hyperscan 支援
    
-   NetFlow-based reporting and export  
    基於 NetFlow 的報告和匯出
    
-   Traffic shaping using CoDel / FQ-CoDel  
    使用 CoDel / FQ-CoDel 進行流量整形
    
-   Two-factor authentication based on RFC 6238 (TOTP)  
    基於RFC6238（TOTP）的雙重認證
    
-   HTTPS and ICAP support in the proxy server  
    代理伺服器中的HTTPS和ICAP支持
    
-   FreeBSD 10.3 with full integration of HardenedBSD ASLR  
    FreeBSD 10.3 完全整合 HardenedBSD ASLR
    
-   UEFI boot and installation modes  
    UEFI 啟動與安裝模式
    
-   Substantial updates to our language packs: Japanese, Russian, German, French, Chinese  
    我們的語言包大幅更新：日語、俄語、德語、法語、中文
    

We thank all contributors, testers and users for their relentless support and invaluable feedback. The release candidate phase has been the most fun we have had so far. :)

我們感謝所有貢獻者、測試人員和用戶的不懈支持和寶貴的回饋。候選版本階段是迄今為止我們經歷過的最有趣的階段。 :)

Attention: An incompatibility in Chrome may prevent the firmware update from running. Try a different browser to upgrade to 16.7 where a workaround has been added to avoid the problem in the future.

注意：Chrome 中的不相容可能會阻止韌體更新運行。嘗試使用其他瀏覽器升級到16.7，其中添加了解決方法以避免將來出現問題。

All images can be found on the mirrors below with checksums attached to the end of this announcement:

所有圖像都可以在下面的鏡像中找到，校驗和附在本公告的末尾：

[https://opnsense.org/download/](https://opnsense.org/download/)

Please stay in touch, tell us what you think about OPNsense and how we can improve it further! You can find us in any of these popular locations:

請保持聯繫，告訴我們您對 OPNsense 的看法以及我們如何進一步改進它！您可以在以下任何一個熱門地點找到我們：

-   Twitter: [https://twitter.com/opnsense](https://twitter.com/opnsense)  
    推特：[https://twitter.com/opnsense](https://twitter.com/opnsense)
    
-   Forum: [https://forum.opnsense.org/](https://forum.opnsense.org/)  
    論壇：[https://forum.opnsense.org/](https://forum.opnsense.org/)
    
-   GitHub: [https://github.com/opnsense](https://github.com/opnsense)  
    GitHub：[https://github.com/opnsense](https://github.com/opnsense)

##### 16.7.r2 (July 14, 2016)｜16.7.r2（2016 年 7 月 14 日）

16.7-RC2 is here and brings major additions to amd64 architectures: Intel Hyperscan library to speed up Suricata rule matching and UEFI boot support! It also brings language packs to their correct 16.7 state, with Japanese already having been completed by the amazing Chie Taguchi.

16.7-RC2 現已推出，為 amd64 架構帶來了重大補充：英特爾 Hyperscan 庫可加速 Suricata 規則匹配和 UEFI 啟動支援！它還將語言包帶到正確的16.7狀態，日語已經由令人驚嘆的 Chie Taguchi 完成。

The mirrors have been expanded to allow trackers of -stable or -devel packages to upgrade to the release candidate. Users of LibreSSL wanting to upgrade can now switch to OpenSSL instead of seeing upgrade errors until LibreSSL becomes available again and their systems move back to LibreSSL automatically.

鏡像已擴展為允許 -stable 或 -devel 軟體包的追蹤器升級到候選版本。想要升級的 LibreSSL 用戶現在可以切換到 O​​penSSL，而不會看到升級錯誤，直到 LibreSSL 再次可用並且他們的系統自動移回 LibreSSL。

Otherwise, only minor issues have been reported and fixed. This likely means there will not be another release candidate.

否則，僅報告並修復了小問題。這可能意味著不會有另一個候選版本。

New images are available from all known mirrors, checksums are found below:

新鏡像可從所有已知鏡像中獲取，校驗和如下：

[https://opnsense.org/download/](https://opnsense.org/download/)

##### 16.7.r1 (July 04, 2016)｜16.7.r1（2016 年 7 月 4 日）

It has been 5 months since 16.1 came out. Since then, over 1500 commits and 18 stable releases have continuously improved and enhanced the project. Since then, thousands of new users have joined. And, since then, our new documentation has been extended and tweaked with numerous guides, explanations and answers to your questions.

距離16.1問世已經5個月了。從那時起，超過 1500 次提交和 18 個穩定版本不斷改進和增強了該專案。從那時起，已有數千名新用戶加入。從那時起，我們的新文件得到了擴展和調整，提供了大量指南、解釋和問題解答。

The cumulation of these efforts is this announcement of the first release candidate for 16.7. Images are being provided to encourage to try these in a fresh setting, but the config import in the installer and the GUI work as usual so that migration is simple. Checksums for the images can be found below. VGA images have been omitted to permit work on the UEFI variant in the meantime.

這些努力的累積就是16.7的第一個候選版本的發布。提供圖像是為了鼓勵在新的設定中嘗試這些，但安裝程式中的配置導入和GUI照常工作，因此遷移很簡單。圖像的校驗和可以在下面找到。 VGA 影像已被省略，以允許同時處理 UEFI 變體。

[https://opnsense.org/download/](https://opnsense.org/download/)

The RC cycle will end in a month with the actual 16.7 release so that early birds will not have to reinstall afterwards. Remember: feedback is key in this phase, feel free to contact us in any way you like and let us make 16.7 grand together.

RC 週期將在一個月後隨著 16.7 的實際發布而結束，這樣早起的鳥兒就不必在之後重新安裝。請記住：回饋是這一階段的關鍵，請隨時以任何您喜歡的方式聯繫我們，讓我們一起讓16.7變得更加輝煌。

Here is our list of major features that were worked on since 16.1:

以下是我們自 16.1 以來開發的主要功能清單：

-   SSL fingerprinting / blacklisting in the IDS/IPS  
    SSL IDS/IPS 中的指紋/黑名單
    
-   Firewall rules category tags for easy filtering  
    防火牆規則類別標籤，方便過濾

    自訂鏡像支援韌體升級
    
-   OpenVPN client-specific overrides can now be bound to selected servers  
    OpenVPN 用戶端特定覆蓋現在可以綁定到選定的伺服器
    
-   Added RFC 4638 support (MTU > 1492 in PPPoE)  
    新增了 RFC 4638 支援（MTU > PPPoE 中的 1492）
    
-   NTP can now be disabled if required  
    如果需要，現在可以停用NTP
    
-   New category-based remote ACL support in proxy server  
    代理伺服器中新的基於類別的遠端ACL支持
    
-   ICAP configuration added to proxy server  
    ICAP 新增到代理伺服器的配置
    
-   Pluggable service infrastructure  
    可插拔的服務基礎設施
    
-   Pluggable syslog infrastructure  
    可插拔的系統日誌基礎設施
    
-   Finished a full sweep of visible GUI pages for improved look and feel  
    完成了對可見GUI頁面的全面掃描，以改善外觀和感覺
    
-   HTTPS proxy support  
    HTTPS 代理支持
    
-   Russian translations 100% completed  
    俄文翻譯 100% 完成
    
-   NetFlow export to multiple remote destinations  
    NetFlow 匯出到多個遠端目標
    
-   NetFlow local reporting frontend  
    NetFlow 本機報告前端
    
-   PPTP, L2TP and PPPoE Servers ported to MPD version 5  
    PPTP, L2TP 和 PPPoE 伺服器移植到 MPD 版本 5
    
-   HAProxy plugin  
    HAProxy 插件
    
-   Traffic shaping with CoDel / FQ-CoDel  
    使用 CoDel / FQ-CoDel 進行流量整形
    
-   Firewall alias geolocation support  
    防火牆別名地理定位支持
    
-   Cron GUI and API  
    計畫任務 GUI 和 API
    
-   Japanese translations 100% completed  
    日文翻譯100%完成
    
-   Dashboard revamp with multi-column support, drag and drop and mini API  
    儀表板改造，支援多列、拖放和迷你API
    
-   RFC 6238 (TOTP) support for two-factor authentication  
    RFC 6238 (TOTP) 支援雙重認證
    
-   HardenedBSD ASLR implementation  
    HardenedBSD ASLR 實施
    
-   High availability page for remote service status and start/stop/restart  
    用於遠端服務狀態和啟動/停止/重新啟動的高可用性頁面
    
-   API commands for remote reboot and power off  
    API 遠端重啟與關機指令
    
-   Firmware page resume support and cron-based “nightly” updates  
    韌體頁面恢復支援和基於 cron 的“夜間”更新
    
-   opnsense-patch, the tremendously nifty patching tool  
    opnsense-patch，非常漂亮的修補工具
    
-   Traffic graphs frontend has been replaced by a modern alternative  
    流量圖前端已被現代替代方案取代
    
-   PPTP, L2TP and PPPoE Servers are now individual plugins no longer found in the default installation  
    PPTP, L2TP 和 PPPoE 伺服器現在是單獨的插件，在預設安裝中不再找到
    
-   Pluggable interface infrastructure  
    可插拔介面基礎設施
    
-   New firewall GUI page for custom scrubbing rules (normalisation)  
    用於自訂清理規則的新防火牆GUI頁面（規範化）
    
-   Removal of proxy-based NAT reflection  
    刪除基於代理的NAT反射
    
-   No more custom PHP modules  
    不再需要客製化PHP模組
    
-   FreeBSD 10.3
    
-   Suricata 3.1  
    蘇利卡塔3.1

#### 16.1 “Crafty Coyote”（狡猾的郊狼） Series｜16.1 “Crafty Coyote”（狡猾的郊狼）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_16.1.html>

No, we would not say it was easy getting here, but booting into 16.1 for the first time sure is as relieving (and exciting) as it could get for our project growing beyond what we had ever imagined. It has been more than a year since OPNsense first came out. Back then it was FreeBSD 10.0. Not even two months after, 10.1 was introduced along with the opnsense-update utility. Today is the day for FreeBSD 10.2, the latest and greatest release currently available for broader driver support and stability improvements.

不，我們不會說到達這裡很容易，但是第一次啟動16.1肯定是令人放鬆（並且令人興奮）的，因為我們的項目發展超出了我們的想像。自 OPNsense 首次問世以來已經一年多了。那時是 FreeBSD 10.0。不到兩個月後，10.1 與 opnsense-update 實用程式一起推出。今天是 FreeBSD 10.2 的日子，它是目前可用於更廣泛的驅動程式支援和穩定性改進的最新、最強大的版本。

16.1 is nicknamed “Crafty Coyote”（狡猾的郊狼） in honour of our beloved childhood TV sessions. It is the accumulation of 6 months of work, having had our focus on reengineering the captive portal, native intrusion prevention, plugin support, and transforming the reporting frontend into something more modern and flexible just to name a few [\[1\]](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/) . Apart from the recently published security advisories (see patch notes below), we have included a quick navigation feature which can be activated by pressing (TAB) followed by search keywords and hitting (ENTER) to go to the desired page. Last but not least, a larger batch of improvements and fixes went into assorted sections of the GUI that certainly help to get your work done without ending up dazed and confused.

16.1 被暱稱為 “Crafty Coyote”（狡猾的郊狼），以紀念我們摯愛的童年 TV 課程。這是 6 個月工作的積累，我們的重點是重新設計強制門戶、本機入侵防護、插件支持，並將報告前端轉變為更現代、更靈活的東西，僅舉幾例 [\[1\]](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/)。除了最近發布的安全公告（請參閱下面的補丁說明）之外，我們還提供了快速導航功能，可以透過按（TAB）然後搜尋關鍵字並點擊（ENTER）來啟動該功能以前往所需的頁面。最後但並非最不重要的一點是，對GUI的各個部分進行了大量的改進和修復，這肯定有助於您完成工作，而不會感到頭暈和困惑。

Speaking of clearing things up, there is more… While Ad, Franco and a couple of amazing external contributors have been busy writing and reviewing code, Jos worked in the shadows to bring to you a fully revised set of project documentation in the form of an online handbook [\[2\]](https://docs.opnsense.org/) . More content will follow as we slow down development speed a bit in order to catch up. We will have to see how that works out. ;)

說到清理工作，還有更多…當 Ad、Franco 和一些出色的外部貢獻者一直忙於編寫和審查程式碼時，Jos 在幕後工作，以線上手冊 [\[2\]](https://docs.opnsense.org/) 的形式為您帶來一套經過全面修訂的專案文件。隨著我們稍微放慢開發速度以趕上，更多內容將會隨之而來。我們必須看看結果如何。 ;)

Another thing we have noticed is that translations are hard! We have planned to finish a translation for this iteration, but the sheer amount of work overwhelmed even the sizeable German translation team. The German translation is now at 77% percent completed with Japanese, Chinese and French chasing tails. If you want to help drop us a line at [project@opnsense.org](mailto:project%40opnsense.org) for details on how to contribute.

我們注意到的另一件事是翻譯很困難！我們計劃完成這次迭代的翻譯，但龐大的工作量甚至讓規模龐大的德語翻譯團隊不堪重負。德文翻譯目前已完成 77%，日文、中文和法文正在緊追不捨。如果您想提供協助，請發送電子郵件至 [project@opnsense.org](mailto:project%40opnsense.org)，以了解有關如何貢獻的詳細資訊。

All images have been pushed as well, although may take a bit more time to reach a mirror near you. You can find the checksums attached at the end of this announcement.

所有圖像也已推送，儘管可能需要更多時間才能到達您附近的鏡子。您可以在本公告末尾找到所附的校驗和。

[https://opnsense.org/download/](https://opnsense.org/download/)

##### 16.1.20 (July 22, 2016)｜16.1.20（2016 年 7 月 22 日）

We are pushing out 16.1.20 a little earlier than expected to fix a GUI regression that can affect users with IPv6. Sorry about that.

我們比預期早一點推出 16.1.20，以修復可能影響 IPv6 用戶的 GUI 回歸。對此感到抱歉。

Since this is the last 16.1 series release, the firmware page offers an overview of migration hints for the 16.7 series. We are expecting to be right on schedule, namely July 28. Oh, and by the way, the next release will be called “Dancing Dolphin”（跳舞的海豚）.

由於這是最後一個16.1系列版本，因此韌體頁面提供了16.7系列的遷移提示概述。我們預計會如期進行，即 7 月 28 日。哦，順便說一句，下一個版本將被稱為 “Dancing Dolphin”（跳舞的海豚）。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   firmware: end-of-life announcement and preparation for 16.7 upgrade  
    韌體：生命週期結束公告和16.7升級準備
    
-   services: fix a missing dependency for the DHCPv6 service probing  
    服務：修復 DHCPv6 服務探測缺失的依賴項
    

Stay safe, Your OPNsense team

請注意安全，OPNsense團隊敬上

##### 16.1.19 (July 21, 2016)｜16.1.19（2016 年 7 月 21 日）

It is time for a last full stable release before we offer our 16.1.20 end-of-life version, which then can be used to upgrade to the 16.7 series.

在我們提供 16.1.20 生命週期終止版本之前，是時候發布最後一個完整穩定版本了，然後可以使用該版本升級到 16.7 系列。

Most changes presented today were either long-running development additions for 16.7 or small reports that came up during the 16.7-RC testing period. Another prominent fix addresses an issue with sporadic premature captive portal authentication timeouts that one of our awesome forum members helped to debug.

今天提出的大多數變化要么是16.7的長期開發添加，要么是16.7-RC測試期間出現的小報告。另一個突出的修復解決了零星的過早強制門戶身份驗證超時問題，我們的一位出色的論壇成員幫助調試了這個問題。

    端口：蘇利卡塔 3.0.2 [\[1\]](https://suricata-ids.org/2016/06/20/suricata-3-0-2-released/), 魷魚 3.5.20 [\[1\]](https://suricata-ids.org/2016/06/20/suricata-3-0-2-released/），外籍人士 2.2.0 [\[3\]](http://expat.sourceforge.net/), 代理 1.6.7 [\[4\]](http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.6/src/CHANGELOG)，綁定 9.10.4-P2 [\[5\]](https://kb.isc.org/article/AA-01396/81/BIND-9.10.4-P2-Release-Notes.html)

Before we get on with the release candidate for 16.7, we are proudly presenting the latest and greatest stable addition to the 16.1 series.

##### 16.1.17 (June 15, 2016)｜16.1.17（2016 年 6 月 15 日）

Today we offer complementary improvements and fixes to your swinging installation in the hopes that they will make your daily experience even better, rounded off with a pinch of SSL crypto updates.

今天，我們為您的擺動安裝提供補充性改進和修復，希望它們能讓您的日常體驗變得更好，並透過一些SSL加密更新來完善。

In other news, we are getting ready for a first 16.7 release candidate after having finished the full work on the FreeBSD 10.3 base system including the addition of HardenedBSD’s ASLR. More on this next week.

在其他訊息中，在完成 FreeBSD 10.3 基礎系統（包括添加 HardenedBSD 的 ASLR）的全部工作後，我們正在為第一個 16.7 候選版本做好準備。下週將詳細介紹這一點。

##### 16.1.16 (June 06, 2016)｜16.1.16（2016 年 6 月 6 日）

It has been a long journey for HardenedBSD and OPNsense, and finally the paths start to merge as the splendid and battle- proven ASLR implementation gets incorporated into the default installation! It is just the beginning as we will start to leverage the extra security by enabling position independent execution in 16.7 and merge more security-related features. We thank again the HardenedBSD team for their continued efforts on making this world a safer place.

對於 HardenedBSD 和 OPNsense 來說，這是一個漫長的旅程，隨著出色且久經考驗的 ASLR 實現被納入預設安裝，最終路徑開始合併！這只是一個開始，我們將開始透過在 16.7 中啟用位置獨立執行來利用額外的安全性，並合併更多與安全相關的功能。我們再次感謝 HardenedBSD 團隊為讓這個世界更安全所做的持續努力。

In other news, there is a thoroughly revamped dashboard for you to enjoy and a handful of security fixes in FreeBSD and the ports ecosystem. LibreSSL has been updated to the latest production release and the BETA version is progressing nicely as we change our working mode from “rework all the things” to “polish all the things”. A release candidate is coming up soon.

在其他新聞中，FreeBSD 和 ports 生態系統中有一個徹底改版的儀表板供您使用，以及一些安全修復程序。 LibreSSL 已更新到最新的生產版本，隨著我們將工作模式從“返工所有事物”更改為“拋光所有事物”，BETA 版本進展順利。候選版本即將推出。

##### 16.1.13 (May 04, 2016)｜16.1.13（2016 年 5 月 4 日）

Ever so swiftly we are adopting the OpenSSL and LibreSSL updates and welcome the cooperation between both projects on this one. Way to go guys!

我們正在迅速採用 OpenSSL 和 LibreSSL 更新，並歡迎兩個專案之間在這一方面的合作。幹得好夥計們！

In other news, NTP and Bind were updated to their latest versions. The gateway monitoring tool Apinger can now properly handle NTP taking over time from time to time. Er, anyway, language packs will become pluggable in the long run and the MVC work for the HAProxy plugin is now completely bundled with the release. Plugin release is currently scheduled for 16.1.14.

其他消息中，NTP和Bind已更新至最新版本。網關監控工具Apinger現在可以正確處理NTP不時接管的情況。呃，無論如何，從長遠來看，語言包將變得可插入，HAProxy 插件的 MVC 工作現在完全與版本捆綁在一起。插件目前預定於16.1.14發布。

##### 16.1.12 (April 27, 2016)｜16.1.12（2016 年 4 月 27 日）

How are you doing? We have been doing fine, trying new things, moving on further… The progress for our upcoming version 16.7 now accumulates to 3 full months. To that end we are making the transition from ALPHA toi BETA on the 16.7 development series. And since we have been asked to incorporate development change logs as well, look no further (well, look below).

你好嗎？我們一直做得很好，嘗試新事物，繼續前進……我們即將推出的版本16.7的進度現在已經累計到了整整3個月。為此，我們正在 16.7 開發系列上從ALPHA過渡到BETA。由於我們還被要求合併開發變更日誌，所以不用再猶豫了（好吧，請看下面）。

Anyway, 16.1.12 brings a handful of anticipated additions like FreeBSD’s package manager version 1.7.2 and the ability to use CoDel / FQ-Codel in the traffic shaper. We have also started to move services to the plugin framework instead of having them in the base installation. And, maybe as a last point, initial work for fixing the trusty apinger utility for gateway monitoring has surfaced.

不管怎樣，16.1.12帶來了一些預期的新增功能，例如 FreeBSD 的套件管理器版本1.7.2以及在流量整形器中使用 CoDel / FQ-Codel 的能力。我們也開始將服務移至插件框架，而不是將它們放在基本安裝中。並且，也許作為最後一點，修復用於網關監控的可信 apinger 實用程式的初步工作已經浮出水面。

##### 16.1.11 (April 18, 2016)｜16.1.11（2016 年 4 月 18 日）

We are skipping a bit ahead with 16.1.11 to address a CSRF vulnerability, which outlines the path we have been on since we started [\[1\]](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=2837.0) and we will surely continue this security-aware trend.

我們將跳過 16.1.11 來解決 CSRF 漏洞，該漏洞概述了我們自開始 [\[1\]](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=2837.0) 以來所走的道路，我們肯定會繼續這種安全意識趨勢。

In other news, this update includes native GeoIP alias support, captive portal voucher customisations requested by many and the last batch of Russian, effectively bringing it to 100% completed. Wow!

在其他訊息中，此更新包括本地 GeoIP 別名支援、許多人要求的強制門戶憑證定制以及最後一批俄語，有效地使其 100% 完成。哇！

##### 16.1.9 (April 08, 2016)｜16.1.9（2016 年 4 月 8 日）

We expect all of you are doing well? It has been a longer while since the last update so 16.1.9 has got a bit of everything to keep the spirits high. :)

我們希望你們都做得很好？自從上次更新以來已經有一段時間了，所以16.1.9已經有了一些可以保持高昂情緒的東西。 :)

There is tremendous progress in the translations. It just so happens that we now have a comprehensive Russian translation as well which is going to be completed in the upcoming weeks. Many thanks to Smart-Soft for making this happen. The contender is Japanese through the work of Chie Taguchi, who did most of the translation that we have had for a year. It is going to be a close race to the finish line for both languages. Then again, the whole translation team is doing an amazing job.

翻譯工作有了巨大的進步。碰巧的是，我們現在也有了全面的俄語翻譯，並將在未來幾週內完成。非常感謝 Smart-Soft 讓這一切成為現實。競爭者是田口千惠（Chie Taguchi）的日文作品，我們一年來的大部分翻譯工作都是由他完成的。對於兩種語言來說，這將是一場勢均力敵的競賽。話又說回來，整個翻譯團隊都做得非常好。

As polarising as it may be, we have added HTTPS support in the proxy server. Another noteworthy item is StrongSwan 5.4.0, which helps to address IPSec status page hangs that some have observed with complex setups. We are looking for feedback for these items, please do write in.

儘管可能存在兩極分化，但我們在代理伺服器中新增了 HTTPS 支援。另一個值得注意的項目是 StrongSwan 5.4.0，它有助於解決某些人在複雜設定中觀察到的 IPSec 狀態頁面掛起問題。我們正在尋找對這些項目的回饋，請寫信。
