##### 16.1.8 (May 23, 2016)｜16.1.8（2016 年 5 月 23 日）

This quick 16.1.8 is not a big update, but it means a lot. We have finished our full sweep of the GUI to update the look and feel of all pages and made the code ready for what is to come now: new features that are on our roadmap for 16.7. The first one will be the HTTPS proxy, but there is also NetFlow and improved statistics / reporting on the shortlist.

這個快速的16.1.8並不是一個大的更新，但是意義重大。我們已經完成了對 GUI 的全面掃描，以更新所有頁面的外觀和風格，並為接下來的內容做好程式碼準備：16.7 路線圖上的新功能。第一個是HTTPS代理，但入圍名單上還有 NetFlow 和改進的統計/報告。

A day after 16.1.7 was out last week, FreeBSD 10.2-RELEASE-p14 was announced. Of the four patches enclosed, the two Hyper-V patches we have already brought to OPNsense over a month ago, the OpenSSH patch does not apply since we only use the port and already had it up-to-date. That leaves us with only one patch that we are shipping now to complete the experience.

上週 16.1.7 發布的第二天，FreeBSD 10.2-RELEASE-p14 發布了。在所附的四個補丁中，我們一個多月前已經將兩個 Hyper-V 補丁帶到 OPNsense，OpenSSH 補丁不適用，因為我們只使用該連接埠並且已經將其更新為最新。這樣我們現在就只剩下一個補丁來完成體驗了。

Attention to everyone using OpenVPN + cryptodev acceleration: the cryptodev module along with older crypto drivers has been removed from the kernel itself, which means that if you need to keep using it, go to System: Settings: Misc and reconfigure your crypto hardware including an enable of cryptodev usage.

使用 OpenVPN + cryptodev 加速的每個人請注意：cryptodev 模組以及較舊的加密驅動程式已從內核本身中刪除，這意味著如果您需要繼續使用它，請轉到系統：設定：雜項並重新配置您的加密硬件，包括啟用 cryptodev 使用。

The refreshed images for 16.1 (based on 16.1.8) have been pushed to the mirrors. You can find the checksums attached at the end of this announcement.

16.1（基於16.1.8）的刷新鏡像已推送至鏡像。您可以在本公告末尾找到所附的校驗和。

[https://opnsense.org/download/](https://opnsense.org/download/)

##### 16.1.7 (March 16, 2016)｜16.1.7 （2016年3月16日）

Time for a quick update! We are still polishing our non-MVC GUI pages to match the modern style of the MVC equivalents and fix a few minor bugs along the way. In these matters, we ask for your participation in critically reviewing the changes below in order to catch remaining issues as soon as possible. We expect to finish our full code sweep next week. After that we will shift focus to work on new features.

是時候快速更新一下了！我們仍在完善非MVC GUI頁面，使其與MVC頁面保持現代風格，並在此過程中修復一些小錯誤。為此，我們懇請您參與以下更改的審核，以便盡快發現剩餘問題。我們預計下週完成全面的程式碼審查。之後，我們將把工作重心轉移到新功能的開發。

The upgrades from 15.7.25 to 16.1.x briefly stalled with 16.1.6 due to a dormant incompatibility in the FreeBSD package management tool after flipping from 10.1 to 10.2, so we went ahead and made it all better. More precaution in our own update tools will hopefully prevent such unwanted breakage in the future, but we understand that these things can slip through. :)

從15.7.25到16.1 .x 的升級在16.1.6處短暫停滯，這是由於 FreeBSD 軟體包管理工具在從10.1切換到10.2後存在一個潛在的兼容性問題，因此我們已著手修復此問題。希望我們自身的更新工具能夠更加謹慎，從而避免未來出現此類意外故障，但我們也理解此類問題有時難以避免。 :)

New images are on the way shortly after 16.1.8. We are also introducing the new “opnsense-stable” firmware path and some cool upgrade features for our brave testers. More explanations will follow soon.

新鏡像將在16.1.8發布後不久推出。我們還將推出全新的「opnsense-stable」韌體路徑，並為勇敢的測試人員帶來一些很棒的升級功能。更多詳情稍後公佈。

##### 16.1.6 (March 09, 2016)｜16.1.6 （2016年3月9日）

It is update time! This time around, DHCP and DNS have been freshened up thoroughly, removing both potential and real problems from the GUI and underneath. Additionally, the proxy server gained ICAP support and a category-based remote block list selection.

更新時間到！本次更新對DHCP和DNS進行了全面升級，修復了GUI及其底層版本中存在的潛在和實際問題。此外，代理伺服器還新增了對ICAP支持，以及基於類別的遠端封鎖清單選擇功能。

Our firmware mirror support has finally been extended so that it is now possible to pull all updates from a single mirror, which will very soon make it possible to run a local mirror for your internal installations. We are also shipping the original FreeBSD OpenSSL patch, although the security issues cannot not surface on OPNsense. We just like to be thorough.

我們的韌體鏡像支援功能終於擴展完畢，現在可以從單一鏡像來源拉取所有更新，不久之後，您就可以為內部安裝運行本地鏡像了。我們還提供了原始的 FreeBSD OpenSSL 補丁，儘管這些安全性問題在 OPNsense 上不會出現。我們只是想做到萬無一失。

Here are the full patch notes:

##### 16.1.5 (March 02, 2016)｜16.1.5 （2016年3月2日）

It pleases us to say that although we ship the latest OpenSSL 1.0.2g today, we have had both SSv2 and SSv3 support disabled in our installation for a long while, so older installations are also not affected by yesterday’s announcement. On a slightly related note, LibreSSL was not affected at all.

我們很高興地宣布，雖然我們今天發布的是最新的 OpenSSL 1.0 .2g 版本，但我們的安裝版本早已禁用 SSv2 和 SSv3 支持，因此舊版本安裝也不會受到昨天公告的影響。另外，LibreSSL 也完全不受影響。

With that out of the way, we also happily let you know that we are shipping RFC 4638 support with this stable release. We also push a fix for an upstream bug in Unbound and update Squid to the latest version… again. ;)

除此之外，我們很高興地宣布，本次穩定版本將支援RFC 4638。同時，我們也修復了Unbound上游的一個bug，並將Squid再次更新到最新版本。 ;)

We have also announced the roadmap for 16.7. Take a look at our upcoming milestones:

我們也公佈了16.7的路線圖。請查看我們即將實現的里程碑：

[https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/)

##### 16.1.4 (February 24, 2016)｜16.1.4 （2016年2月24日）

We pop in for a short stable update, namely 16.1.4. Squid has been updated to 3.5.14 and received a GUI entry for maximum\_object\_size to define since the default has been reported as a wee bit too small.

我們帶來一個簡短的穩定更新，即16.1.4已更新至3.5.14 ，並收到一個GUI條目，用於定義 maximum\_object\_size，因為據報告預設值略小。

In other news, the final roadmap for 16.7 will be unveiled later this week after much internal discussion. Our main goals are to finish a full code audit, further alignment with FreeBSD and a few tiny surprises. Stay tuned for those. :)

另外，經過多次內部討論， 16.7的最終路線圖將於本週稍後公佈。我們的主要目標是完成全面的程式碼審計，進一步與 FreeBSD 保持一致，以及一些小小的驚喜。敬請期待！ :)

##### 16.1.3 (February 17, 2016)｜16.1.3 （2016年2月17日）

It is time for a smaller update to 16.1.3. There is another fix for our Hyper-V users, the health section finally received its CPU temperature graph and a few ports have been updated to their latest version. Nothing of particular interest happened, no issues with glibc from our side today. :)

16.1.3版本進行了一次小更新。本次更新修復了 Hyper-V 用戶遇到的另一個問題，健康狀態部分終於添加了CPU溫度圖表，並且部分端口已更新至最新版本。今天沒有發生任何特別值得關注的事情，glibc 也未有任何問題。 :)

A number of assorted issues have been flushed from the code thanks to good use of the crash reporter. A special thank you goes to those of you who submit email addresses and a brief description along with the report. For us it is tremendously useful to get as many details as possible and to verify that our fixed work reliably in a particular use cases before shipping them.

由於崩潰報告工具的合理使用，程式碼中許多不同的問題都已解決。特別感謝那些提交電子郵件地址和簡要描述以及崩潰報告的用戶。對我們來說，盡可能多地了解問題細節至關重要，這有助於我們在發布修復程序之前，驗證其在特定用例中的可靠性。

##### 16.1.2 (February 05, 2016)｜16.1.2 （2016年2月5日）

It is time for a swift update for our dear Hyper-V users. There is a packet forwarding regression in FreeBSD 10.2 that has not been added as errata yet so we had to pin it down with the help of three brave testers. If you happen to want to run Hyper-V without going through the issue, install from an older 15.7 image and upgrade directly to avoid the bad version.

親愛的 Hyper-V 用戶們，是時候進行快速更新了。 FreeBSD 10.2中存在一個資料包轉送迴歸問題，該問題尚未被列入勘誤表，因此我們不得不藉助三位勇敢的測試人員的力量來找出它。如果您想在不遇到此問題的情況下運行 Hyper-V，請使用較舊的15.7鏡像進行安裝，然後直接升級，以避免使用存在問題的版本。

To improve upon Suricata 3.0 and the SSL fingerprint lists we are now enabling users to add user-defined rules for adding and enforcing their own fingerprints. But wait, that is not all. On top of that the IP geolocation feature was added as well while at it. :)

為了改進 Suricata 3.0和SSL指紋列表，我們現在允許用戶添加自訂規則，以便添加和強制執行他們自己的指紋。等等，這還不是全部。除此之外，我們還順便增加了IP地理定位功能。 :)

Otherwise, only smaller bugs have been addressed to make 16.1 look even shinier. The FreeBSD security advisory for OpenSSL got integrated too, but is not of much concern since we consistently use the ports version for our components. The important fixes have been shipped with version 16.1.1 back on Monday.

除此之外，我們只修復了一些較小的錯誤，讓16.1看起來更加完美。 FreeBSD 關於 OpenSSL 的安全公告也已集成，但由於我們的元件一直使用 ports 版本，因此無需過多關注。重要的修復程序已於週一隨16.1.1版本發布。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   src: OpenSSL SSLv2 ciphersuite downgrade vulnerability [\[1\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-16:11.openssl.asc)  
    來源：OpenSSL SSLv2 密碼套件降級漏洞 [\[1\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-16:11.openssl.asc )
    
-   src: Fix packet forwarding in Hyper-V netvsc driver [\[2\]](https://bugs.freebsd.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=203630)  
    src：修正 Hyper-V netvsc 驅動程式中的封包轉送 [\[2\]]( https://bugs.freebsd.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=203630 )
    
-   src: Honour disabled pf(4) log flag on dropped packets with IP options [\[3\]](https://reviews.freebsd.org/D3222)

-   ports: curl 7.47.0 [\[4\]](https://curl.haxx.se/changes.html) , nettle 3.2 [\[5\]](https://fossies.org/diffs/nettle/3.1.1_vs_3.2/ChangeLog-diff.html)  
    ports: curl 7.47.0 [\[4\]]( https://curl.haxx.se/changes.html ) , nettle 3.2 [\[5\]]( https://fossies.org/diffs/nettle/3.1.1_vs_3.2/ChangeLog-diff.html )

    精靈：修復 OpenVPN 的憑證產生問題

    防火牆：修正浮動規則中 POST 請求的介面選擇問題

    防火牆：不要從網關選擇中隱藏網關

    防火牆：已將空路由新增至網關選擇中

-   dns resolver: fix $numprocs setting in config according to manual

    DNS 解析器：不要為空的 IPv6 位址產生非法輸出

-   search: resize box on focus and also propagate proxy server tabs

-   intrusion detection: can now add user rules based on SSL fingerprints and IP geolocation  
    入侵偵測：現在可以基於SSL指紋和IP地理位置新增使用者規則
    

##### 16.1.1 (February 02, 2016)｜16.1.1 （2016年2月2日）

Today we are following up on the OpenSSL advisories. LibreSSL was not affected (surprise, surprise), but received a tiny fix to sync up with the deprecation of the high-severity SSL\_OP\_SINGLE\_DH\_USE option of its sibling.

今天我們跟進 OpenSSL 的安全公告。 LibreSSL 沒有受到影響（不出所料），但得到了一個小的修復，以與 OpenSSL 的高危險SSL \_OP\_SINGLE\_DH\_USE 選項的棄用保持同步。

In other news, we are shipping a few minor fixes along with all-new SSL-centric rulesets for the intrusion prevention courtesy of abuse.ch. Protect your assets, they are worth it!

另外，我們正在發布一些小修復程序，以及由 abuse.ch 提供的全新以SSL為中心的入侵防禦規則集。保護您的資產，它們值得您這樣做！

##### 16.1 (January 28, 2016)｜16.1 （2016年1月28日）

No, we would not say it was easy getting here, but booting into 16.1 for the first time sure is as relieving (and exciting) as it could get for our project growing beyond what we had ever imagined. It has been more than a year since OPNsense first came out. Back then it was FreeBSD 10.0. Not even two months after, 10.1 was introduced along with the opnsense-update utility. Today is the day for FreeBSD 10.2, the latest and greatest release currently available for broader driver support and stability improvements.

不，我們不會說走到今天這一步很容易，但第一次啟動16.1確實令人如釋重負（也激動不已），我們的專案發展速度遠遠超出了我們的想像。 OPNsense 首次發布至今已超過一年。當時的版本是 FreeBSD 10.0 。不到兩個月後， 10.1和 opnsense-update 工具一同發布。今天，FreeBSD 10.2正式發布，這是目前最新、最強大的版本，旨在提供更廣泛的驅動程式支援並提升穩定性。

16.1 is nicknamed “Crafty Coyote”（狡猾的郊狼） in honour of our beloved childhood TV sessions. It is the accumulation of 6 months of work, having had our focus on reengineering the captive portal, native intrusion prevention, plugin support, and transforming the reporting frontend into something more modern and flexible just to name a few [\[1\]](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/) . Apart from the recently published security advisories (see patch notes below), we have included a quick navigation feature which can be activated by pressing (TAB) followed by search keywords and hitting (ENTER) to go to the desired page. Last but not least, a larger batch of improvements and fixes went into assorted sections of the GUI that certainly help to get your work done without ending up dazed and confused.

16.1暱稱是“Crafty Coyote”（狡猾的郊狼）以此紀念我們摯愛的童年時光TV 。它是我們歷時六個月努力的成果，期間我們專注於重構強制門戶、原生入侵防禦、插件支持，並將報告前端改造得更加現代化和靈活，等等[\[1\]]( https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/ )。除了最近發布的安全公告（請參閱下方修補程式說明）之外，我們還新增了快速導航功能，只需按下 ( TAB )，然後輸入搜尋關鍵字，再按下 ( ENTER ) 即可跳到所需頁面。最後， GUI中的各個部分也進行了大量改進和修復，這些改進和修復無疑將幫助您更有效率地完成工作，避免感到困惑和不知所措。

Speaking of clearing things up, there is more… While Ad, Franco and a couple of amazing external contributors have been busy writing and reviewing code, Jos worked in the shadows to bring to you a fully revised set of project documentation in the form of an online handbook [\[2\]](https://docs.opnsense.org/) . More content will follow as we slow down development speed a bit in order to catch up. We will have to see how that works out. ;)

說到澄清一些事情，還有更多……在 Ad、Franco 和幾位優秀的外部貢獻者忙於編寫和審查代碼的同時，Jos 則在幕後默默工作，為大家帶來了一套全面修訂的項目文檔，以在線手冊的形式呈現 [\[2\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/ )。為了趕上進度，我們會稍微放慢開發速度，之後會陸續發布更多內容。讓我們拭目以待吧。 ;)

Another thing we have noticed is that translations are hard! We have planned to finish a translation for this iteration, but the sheer amount of work overwhelmed even the sizeable German translation team. The German translation is now at 77% percent completed with Japanese, Chinese and French chasing tails. If you want to help drop us a line at [project@opnsense.org](mailto:project%40opnsense.org) for details on how to contribute.

我們也注意到，翻譯工作非常困難！我們原本計劃完成本版本的所有翻譯工作，但工作量之大，即使是規模龐大的德語翻譯團隊也難以應付。目前德文翻譯已完成 77%，而日文、中文和法文翻譯則進展緩慢。如果您想提供協助，請發送電子郵件至 [project@opnsense.org](mailto:project%40opnsense.org)以了解具體貢獻方式。

All images have been pushed as well, although may take a bit more time to reach a mirror near you. You can find the checksums attached at the end of this announcement.

所有圖片均已上傳，但可能需要一些時間才能到達您附近的鏡像來源。您可以在本公告末尾找到校驗和。

[https://opnsense.org/download/](https://opnsense.org/download/)

#### 15.7 “Brave Badger”（勇敢的獾） Series｜15.7 “Brave Badger”（勇敢的獾）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_15.7.html>

While the summer is hot, we push forward to what now is 15.7 – nicknamed ‘Brave Badger’ – right in front of you. A lot of effort went into this project during the past 6 months, and we dare say it has been worth all of it. We would like to thank our followers and friends and feedback givers and forum lurkers and contributors and doubters and supporters that helped to make 15.7 what it is. We wouldn’t be here without any of you. Thank you.

雖然盛夏酷暑，我們依然奮力前行，最終呈現出了現在呈現在您眼前的15.7暱稱“勇敢的獾”。過去六個月裡，我們為這個計畫投入了大量心血，我們敢說，一切付出都是值得的。我們衷心感謝所有追蹤者、朋友、回饋者、論壇潛水員、貢獻者、質疑者和支持者，是你們的幫助成就了今天的15.7 。沒有你們，就沒有今天的我們。謝謝！

In itself, 15.7 is a simple upgrade from 15.1.12 which we recommend to everyone. What changes is that development will move to a different branch so that from now on regressions are less likely and therefore stability will increase further. The provided images may also be the only ones for the next 6 months as we are confident in their longevity and the online upgrade path. We have also bumped the LibreSSL flavour to a production-ready state and encourage everyone to try it out. The installer’s import configuration tool coupled with a quick and easy installation can help you move from OpenSSL to LibreSSL and back seamlessly.

就其本身而言，15.7是我們推薦給大家的15.1.12的簡單升級。變化在於，開發將轉移到不同的分支，因此從現在開始回歸的可能性較小，因此穩定性將進一步提高。所提供的圖像也可能是未來 6 個月內唯一的圖像，因為我們對其壽命和線上升級路徑充滿信心。我們還將 LibreSSL 風格提升至生產就緒狀態，並鼓勵每個人都嘗試一下。安裝程式的導入配置工具加上快速簡便的安裝可以幫助您無縫地從 OpenSSL 遷移到 LibreSSL 並返回。

The biggest addition is the intrusion detection integration (suricata) as well as new local and remote blacklists options for the proxy server (squid). Security-wise, it has been rather quiet with only a few CVEs in third-party tools. Please see the full patch notes for details and references:

此次更新最大的新增功能是入侵偵測整合（Suricata）以及代理伺服器（Squid）新增的本地和遠端黑名單選項。安全性方面，此次更新相對平靜，僅在第三方工具中發現了少量 CVE 漏洞。詳情及參考資料請參閱完整的更新日誌：

-   kernel: borrowed a dummynet / ipnat patch from m0n0wall to enable symmetric traffic shaping when NAT is involved  
    核心：從 m0n0wall 借用了一個虛擬網路/ipnat 補丁，以便在涉及NAT時啟用對稱流量整形。
    
-   kernel: fix recurse lock panic for tmpfs in conjunction with unionfs  
    核心：修復 tmpfs 與 unionfs 結合使用時出現的遞迴鎖恐慌問題
    
-   kernel: applied two stable patches that prevent squid from crashing [\[1\]](https://bugs.freebsd.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=195802)  
    內核：應用了兩個穩定補丁，防止 Squid 崩潰 [\[1\]]( https://bugs.freebsd.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=195802 )
    
-   kernel: retired ALTQ support  
    核心：已停用ALTQ支持
    
-   base: sendmail TLS/DH Interoperability Improvement [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:08.sendmail.asc)  
    基礎：sendmail TLS/DH互通性改進 [\[2\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:08.sendmail.asc )
    
-   base: improved iconv(3) UTF-7 support [\[3\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:10.iconv.asc)  
    基礎：改良的 iconv(3) UTF -7 支援 [\[3\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:10.iconv.asc )
    
-   base: inconsistency between locale and rune locale states [\[4\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:09.xlocale.asc)  
    基礎：區域設定和符文區域設定狀態不一致 [\[4\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:09.xlocale.asc )
    
-   notable ports updates: phalcon 2.0.3 [\[5\]](https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/phalcon-v2.0.3) , curl 7.43.0\_2 [\[6\]](https://curl.haxx.se/changes.html) , openssh 6.8p1\_8, python 2.7.10 [\[7\]](https://hg.python.org/cpython/raw-file/15c95b7d81dc/Misc/NEWS) , perl 5.20.2\_5 [\[8\]](https://perldoc.perl.org/5.20.2/perldelta) , ntp 4.2.8p3 [\[9\]](http://www.eecis.udel.edu/~ntp/ntp_spool/ntp4/ChangeLog-stable) , libxml 2.9.2\_3 [\[10\]](https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=CVE-2015-1819) , openldap 2.4.41 [\[11\]](https://www.openldap.org/software/release/changes_lts.html)  
    值得關注的連接埠更新：phalcon 2.0.3 [\[5\]]( https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/phalcon-v2.0.3 ) , curl 7.43.0 \_2 [\[6\]]( https://curl.haxx.se/changes.html ) , openssh 2.7.10 [\[7\]]( https://hg.python.org/cpython/raw-file/15c95b7d81dc/Misc/NEWS ) , perl 5.20.2 \_5 [\[8\]]( https://perldoc.perl.org/5.20.2/perldelta ) , ntp 4.2 2.9.2 [\[9\lib http://www.eecis.udel.edu/~ntp/ntp_spool/ntp4/ChangeLog-stable [\[10\]]( https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=CVE-2015-1819 ) , openldap 2.4.41 [\[11\]]( https://www.openldap.org/software/release/changes_lts.html )
    
-   opnsense-update: will no longer try to reinstall the installed version after a fresh installation  
    opnsense-update：全新安裝後將不再嘗試重新安裝已安裝的版本
    
-   bsdinstaller: bring back cpdup to error out on low memory installation (you need 1 GB of RAM, or work around installation using the nano image)  
    bsdinstaller：恢復 cpdup 在記憶體不足時報錯的安裝功能（你需要 1 個GB或RAM ，或使用 nano 鏡像進行安裝）
    
-   traffic shaper: removed legacy queues support in favour of the new traffic shaper functionality  
    流量整形器：已移除對舊式佇列的支持，轉而使用新的流量整形器功能。
    
-   traffic shaper: allow direct enable/disable toggle  
    流量整形器：允許直接啟用/停用切換
    
-   proxy: fix the initial daemon start on bootup  
    代理：修復啟動時初始守護程式啟動問題
    
-   proxy: added LAN as the default interface configuration  
    代理：已新增LAN作為預設介面配置
    
-   proxy: local and remote blacklists with regex support  
    代理：支援正規表示式的本地和遠端黑名單
    
-   intrusion detection: initial release of our IDS GUI based on suricata  
    入侵偵測：我們基於 Suricata 的IDS GUI的初始版本發布
    
-   gateways: monitoring mode gained IPv6 support  
    網關：監控模式新增 IPv6 支持
    
-   captive portal: fix idle timeout bug  
    強制門戶：修復空閒逾時錯誤
    
-   captive portal: do not delete the wrong zone when having multiple configurations  
    強制門戶：存在多個配置時，請勿刪除錯誤的區域
    
-   captive portal: removed include files from exposed web directory  
    強制入口網站：已從公開的 Web 目錄中移除包含文件
    
-   backend: always regenerate users and groups to avoid corruption after an unclean shutdown  
    後端：始終重新產生使用者和群組，以避免在非正常關機後出現資料損壞。
    
-   backend: wait for configd socket to come up to address a startup race issue  
    後端：等待 configd 套接字啟動，解決啟動競爭問題
    
-   backend: clean up configd socket on exit  
    後端：退出時清理 configd 套接字
    
-   backend: fixed regression that prevented user scripts from being started via /etc/rc.conf  
    後端：修正了導致使用者腳本無法透過 /etc/rc.conf 啟動的回歸問題。
    
-   gateways: only show apinger in services when monitoring is enabled for a gateway  
    網關：僅當為網關啟用監控時，才會在服務中顯示 apinger
    
-   languages: brought Simplified Chinese to 49% completed, German to 30% completed  
    語言：簡體中文完成度達 49%，德文完成度達 30%。
    
-   universal plug and play: make page invoke static to remove exploitability of the legacy packages framework  
    通用即插即用：將頁面呼叫設為靜態，以消除舊版軟體包框架的漏洞利用風險
    
-   crash reporter: finally enabled the send button and provides human-readable feedback whether the submission was complete  
    崩潰報告器：終於啟用了發送按鈕，並提供易於理解的回饋，告知提交是否完成。
    
-   shell: added non-interactive interface assignment for headless deployments  
    shell：為無頭部署新增了非互動式介面分配
    
-   ssh: disable password authentication on factory reset to align with the standard configuration  
    SSH：恢復出廠設定時停用密碼驗證，以與標準設定保持一致。
    
-   diagnostics: avoid duplicated calls of gethostbyaddr() in NDP table view  
    診斷：避免在NDP表格檢視中重複呼叫 gethostbyaddr()
    
-   users: prompt for old password on password change to prevent account hijacking  
    使用者：更改密碼時提示輸入舊密碼，以防止帳號被盜用
    
-   users: stripped the impossible scponly user privileges since said utility has never been part of our ecosystem  
    使用者：由於該實用程式從未成為我們生態系統的一部分，因此已剝奪了不可能的 scponly 使用者權限。
    

Images can be found on any of our mirrors, but they may take a few hours to sync. The checksums are attached at the end of this announcement for convenience.

圖片可以在我們所有的鏡像伺服器上找到，但同步可能需要幾個小時。為了方便起見，校驗和附在本公告末。

[https://opnsense.org/download/](https://opnsense.org/download/)

##### 15.7.25 (January 18, 2016)｜15.7.25 （2016年1月18日）

This is good-bye. 6 months have passed and 15.7 has served us well. In only 10 days 16.1 will be out and it is looking shiny. Please study the end of life announcement on the firmware page before attempting to upgrade to the next version.

這是告別。 6 個月過去了， 15.7為我們提供了良好的服務。再過 10 天， 16.1即將發布，它看起來非常棒。在嘗試升級到下一個版本之前，請務必仔細閱讀韌體頁面上的生命週期結束公告。

As such, we have incorporated all of the outstanding security issues of last week, mostly related to FreeBSD and OpenSSH. Patches for the GUI are light; all pending improvements go directly into the next major release.

因此，我們整合了上週所有突出的安全問題，主要與 FreeBSD 和 OpenSSH 有關。 GUI 的補丁很輕；所有待定的改進都會直接進入下一個主要版本。

##### 15.7.24 (January 11, 2016)｜15.7.24 （2016年1月11日）

We’re back, and we have a lot of neat changes and security updates for you. Most notably, the firewall pages received a lot of subtle tweaks to improve user experience. Secondly, the firmware pages gained the plugins management feature. And last but not least, the kernel and base upgrade gained better signature support [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/update#opnsense-sign--opnsense-verify) that ties right into FreeBSD’s pkg verification mechanism, how cool is that!

我們回來了，並帶來了許多令人驚喜的改動和安全更新。最值得一提的是，防火牆頁面進行了許多細微的調整，以提升使用者體驗。其次，韌體頁面新增了外掛程式管理功能。最後，核心和基礎升級獲得了更完善的簽名支援 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/update#opnsense-sign--opnsense-verify )，這與 FreeBSD 的軟體包驗證機製完美契合，是不是很棒！

We’d like to use this opportunity to thank four of our regular contributors who’ve helped us to advance further than we could have dreamed. A big thank you to Manuel Faux, Fabian Franz, Frank Wall and Andreas Martin! And no, we do not make these up as we go. ;)

我們想藉此機會感謝四位長期捐款者，他們的幫助使我們取得了遠超預期的成就。非常感謝 Manuel Faux、Fabian Franz、Frank Wall 和 Andreas Martin！而且，我們可不是隨口編造的哦 ;)

##### 15.7.23 (December 23, 2015)｜15.7.23 （2015 年 12 月 23 日）

As the end of the year 2015 is nearing, we push one last update. And it’s been a hell of a year! This is actually the 49th official update we’re releasing, so that gives you the idea of how serious we were about “once a week”. The major upgrade 16.1 is around the corner as well, although major is a bit of a stretch: the main reason for calling it 16.1 are the all new captive portal and FreeBSD 10.2. But that’s not the point. Here it is…

2015 年即將結束，我們發布了最後一個更新。這一年真是精彩！這實際上是我們發布的第 49 個正式更新，由此可見我們對「每週一次」的承諾有多麼認真。重大升級16.1也即將到來，雖然稱之為重大升級有點誇張：之所以稱之為16.1 ，主要是因為全新的強制門戶和 FreeBSD 10.2 。但這並非重點。以下是更新內容…

We would like to thank everyone for their resounding support through good and bad times, for lively discussions, outside contributions and all the encouragement we’ve received. We’ve set a reasonable pace for progress within our project and we will certainly keep it up for 2016. That’s the least we can do for you. After all, we do like to think we’ve built a little family.

我們衷心感謝大家在順境和逆境中給予的鼎力支持，感謝大家的熱烈討論、外部捐助以及所有鼓勵。我們為專案設定了合理的進展速度，並保證在2016年繼續維持。這是我們能為大家做的最起碼的事。畢竟，我們很樂意把大家看成是一個大家庭。

##### 15.7.22 (December 09, 2015)｜15.7.22 （2015年12月9日）

So here are OpenSSL 1.0.2e and LibreSSL 2.2.5, finally! 15.7.22 itself is only tweaks and minor fixes. We take it as a good sign that there were no “oh no what did you do to the menu” complaints in the past week. Nobody missed the RRD graphs either. You guys are really cool.

最後是 OpenSSL 1.0.2e 和 LibreSSL 2.2.5！ 15.7.22本身只是調整和小修復。我們認為這是一個好兆頭，過去一周沒有出現“哦，不，你對菜單做了什麼”的投訴。也沒有人錯過RRD圖表。你們真的很酷。

The root cause for the filter reload timeout reports that some of you encountered in 15.7.19 has finally been found. The function filter\_generate\_optcfg\_array() could be called hundreds of times in a single filter reload while only providing static interface data to the callers that did not change over the runtime of the reload. At some point it must have gotten so slow that a caching mechanism was added around the function, which caused the function’s output to get stuck, causing the initial bug report. Now it’s as fast as ever and glitch-free.

之前在15.7.19中提到的過濾器重載逾時問題的根本原因終於找到了。函數 `filter_generate_optcfg_array()` 在一次過濾器重載過程中可能會被呼叫數百次，而它只向呼叫者提供靜態介面數據，這些數據在重載運行時不會發生變化。在某個時間點，該函數的運行速度可能變得非常緩慢，因此在函數周圍添加了快取機制，導致函數的輸出卡住，從而引發了最初的錯誤報告。現在，該函數已經恢復到先前的速度，並且沒有任何故障。

##### 15.7.21 (December 04, 2015)｜15.7.21 （2015年12月4日）

Back in September we’ve started out to work on the excessive GUI padding and dispersed menu structure in order to get to a slick and clean page layout. We’ve transformed tab navigation into submenu items, pulling similar items together into one single category, adding distinctive icons as a highlight and anchor point. We’ve come to like it so much that we can’t wait for 16.1 to merge it in so here it is for everyone to enjoy. Work in this area will continue in tiny pieces as we go along. Send us feedback, let us know what we can push even further.

早在九月份，我們就開始著手解決頁面內過多的GUI邊距和分散的選單結構問題，力求打造簡潔流暢的頁面佈局。我們將標籤導航改為子選單，並將相似的項目歸入同一類別，同時添加了醒目的圖示作為亮點和連結點。我們對最終效果非常滿意，迫不及待地想在16.1中將其整合到系統中，現在就分享給大家。我們會持續推進這方面的工作，逐步完善。歡迎大家提供回饋，告訴我們還有哪些方面可以進一步改進。

15.7.21 brings updates to some of the most important ports and RRD frontend pages have been completely removed. Unfortunately, we couldn’t squeeze in OpenSSL and LibreSSL at this point, but will follow up as soon as both of them are available.

##### 15.7.19 (November 13, 2015)｜15.7.19 （2015年11月13日）

Time for the weekly update. :)

又到了每週更新時間。 :)

15.7.19 is a smaller maintenance release with a backend switch for IPsec reporting and a couple of minor fixes. With the help of the community, we’re also improving the consistency of the GUI translation with more commits already in the works.

15.7.19是一個較小的維護版本，包含一個用於 IPsec 報告的後端切換以及一些小的修復。在社區的幫助下，我們也在改進GUI翻譯的一致性，更多提交正在進行中。

Notable from a development version perspective are the API authentication and the revived voucher support for our new captive portal. This means two more roadmap items already finished for 16.1.

##### 15.7.18 (November 04, 2015)｜15.7.18 （2015年11月4日）

It took a while to track down a NTP regression with FreeBSD that turned out to be a flaw in the kernel itself. That’s now fixed for all FreeBSD versions. Thanks everyone for helping out here again. :)

花了好長時間才找到 FreeBSD 的NTP迴歸問題，結果發現是核心本身的缺陷。現在所有 FreeBSD 版本都已修復。再次感謝大家的幫忙！ :)

This update brings quite a few fixes, especially with regard to VMware and Xen virtualisation plugins. If you are in need of such plugins for seamless guest support the installation is quite painless:

本次更新修復了不少問題，尤其是在 VMware 和 Xen 虛擬化插件方面。如果您需要此類插件以實現無縫的客戶機支持，安裝過程非常簡單：

```
# pkg install os-vmware
# pkg install os-xen
```

In case of VMware, the masterplan is that vmx network devices will be persistent after reboot so that such devices can be embedded into the config.xml. Let us know how that works for you guys. Needless to say, we’ll keep working on making plugins accessible through the GUI with our next major version that is 16.1.

對於 VMware，總體規劃是讓 vmx 網路設備在重新啟動後保持持久化，以便將這些設備嵌入到 config.xml 檔案中。請告訴我們這對你們來說效果如何。當然，我們將繼續努力，在下一個主要版本16.1中實現透過GUI存取插件。

We’ve also been working on ironing out further IPsec hiccups and adding more features to the captive portal in the development version. Oh, and this: fresh images based on 15.7.18 will be available a couple of days after this release.

我們也一直在努力解決 IPsec 的一些小問題，並在開發版本中為強制門戶添加更多功能。另外，基於15.7.18的全新鏡像將在本次發布後的幾天內提供。

##### 15.7.17 (October 20, 2015)｜15.7.17 （2015年10月20日）

So this is 15.7.17 with a couple of neat things under the hood: AES-NI is now supported by both LibreSSL and OpenSSL. Other than that only minor fixes went in along with the latest version bumps for cURL, Squid, Unbound and (of course) LibreSSL.

所以這是15.7.17版本，其中包含一些巧妙的改進： AES-NI現在同時支援 LibreSSL 和 OpenSSL。除此之外，只進行了一些小的修復，並更新了 cURL、Squid、Unbound 以及（當然還有）LibreSSL 的最新版本。

The development version has more things happening: we’ve reorganised the menu to get rid of the “Status”（地位） and “Diagnostics”（診斷） section, updating layouts and minimising padding of the bootstrap theme. And that’s not all, because we’re also replacing the old captive portal! The new captive portal can already be tested and will receive more features as we near version 16.1. Let us know what you think.

開發版本新增了更多功能：我們重新組織了選單，移除了“Status”（地位）和“Diagnostics”（診斷）部分，更新了佈局並減少了 Bootstrap 主題的內邊距。不僅如此，我們還替換了舊的強制門戶！新的強制入口網站現已開放測試，並且隨著16.1版本的發布，我們將添加更多功能。歡迎您提出寶貴意見。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

    連接埠：LibreSSL 和 OpenSSL 現在都支援AES-NI加速
    
-   ports: curl 7.45 [\[1\]](https://curl.haxx.se/changes.html) , squid 3.5.10 [\[2\]](http://ftp.meisei-u.ac.jp/mirror/squid/squid-3.5-ChangeLog.txt) , unbound 1.5.5 [\[3\]](https://nlnetlabs.nl/projects/unbound/download/) , libressl 2.2.4 [\[4\]](http://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/patches/5.8/common/007_obj2txt.patch.sig)  
    連接埠：捲曲 7.45 [\[1\]](https://curl.haxx.se/changes.html), 魷魚 3.5.10 [\[2\]](http://ftp.meisei-u.ac.jp/mirror/squid/squid-3.5-ChangeLog.txt），無界 1.5.5 [\[3\]](https://nlnetlabs.nl/projects/unbound/download/），libressl 2.2.4 [\[4\]](http://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/patches/5.8/common/007_obj2txt.patch.sig)
    
-   layout: bumped font awesome to 4.4  
    版面：字體 Awesome 升級至4.4
    
-   dhcp: dhcpd leases did not always reload dhcpleases daemon  
    dhcp：dhcpd 租約並非總是重新載入 dhcpleases 守護程式。

    openvpn：修正嚴格使用者/ CN匹配複選框行為
    
-   ipsec: fix tunnel identification when using NAT  
    ipsec：修復使用NAT時的隧道標識
    
-   dns filter: add OpenDNS IPv6 servers  
    DNS 過濾器：新增 OpenDNS IPv6 伺服器
    
-   dns resolver: fix apply glitch that would blank the settings temporarily  
    DNS解析器：修復應用程式故障導致設定暫時失效的問題。
    
-   log files: search is now case-insensitive  
    日誌檔案：搜尋現在不區分大小寫。

-   crash reporter: improved wording as reports without contact info may be hard to fix  
    崩潰報告：改進措辭，因為缺少聯絡資訊的報告可能難以修復。

    虛擬 IP：修復新版VIP可能存在的應用故障

    同步：目標宕機時不要報錯，而是記錄日誌。

    語言：法語已完成 35%，德語已完成 65%。
    
-   development: the captive portal has been replaced with a newly implemented variant based on our MVC standards – if you still want to use the old one please use the release package instead (although any feedback for the new captive portal is greatly appreciated)

##### 15.7.16 (October 10, 2015)｜15.7.16 （2015年10月10日）

We’ve spent three great days in Nuremberg at it-sa, thanks for everybody who dropped by.

我們在紐倫堡的 it-sa 度過了美好的三天，感謝每位前來參觀的朋友。

Originally we wanted to push out 15.7.16 earlier, but faced an interesting challenge with the latest FreeBSD package manager version update. To that end, we are probably going to release new images for 15.7.17 with the new package manager included just to make sure we can retain a clean and flat upgrade process even for the images. But fear not, online upgrades are still working as expected.

我們原本計劃更早發布15.7.16 ，但由於 FreeBSD 最新軟體包管理器版本更新，遇到了一些挑戰。因此，我們可能會發布包含新軟體包管理器的15.7.17新鏡像，以確保即使是鏡像也能保持流暢的升級流程。不過請放心，線上升級仍然正常運作。

Speaking of releases and images, we’ve had recent feedback about what we call releases that do not necessarily offer images. We do this because in a weekly update cycle it is far too complicated to bundle verified images. The versioning scheme does not reflect this at the moment, but we’ve had similar intentions when we moved away from the old 15.1 scheme. Long story short, we will try to make this more clear in the future. The preferred method of installation is via the latest available image that should be upgraded immediately after installation.

說到版本發布和鏡像，我們最近收到了一些回饋，指出有些版本發布並不一定包含鏡像。我們這樣做是因為在每週更新的周期內，打包已驗證的鏡像過於複雜。目前的版本控制方案尚未體現這一點，但我們當初放棄舊的15.1方案時，也是出於類似的考慮。簡而言之，我們將在未來對此進行更清晰的說明。建議的安裝方法是使用最新的可用鏡像，並在安裝後立即進行升級。

Since the build tools are open, it’s not a particular problem to build a newer version yourself or if you require one that comes directly from us just let us know so we can help your specific use case. Last but not least, here are the full patch notes:

由於建置工具是開源的，因此自行建立新版本並不是什麼大問題；如果您需要我們直接提供的版本，請告知我們，以便我們能夠幫助您解決具體問題。最後，以下是完整的更新說明：

-   ports: phalcon 2.0.8 [\[1\]](https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/phalcon-v2.0.8) , php 5.6.14\[3\]

##### 15.7.15 (September 30, 2015)｜15.7.15 （2015年9月30日）

We hope you guys are having a good week? Because if not we have a treat for you: the wait for System Health [\[1\]](https://opnsense.org/system-health-whats-next/) is finally over and the best part is that it’ll just work with your previously collected RRD data. :) We kindly ask you to provide feedback via the usual channels in order to make it even better. There’s still a lot of time till 16.1 hits the shelves, so to speak.

希望大家這週過得愉快！如果不是，我們有個好消息要告訴大家：備受期待的系統健康 [\[1\]]( https://opnsense.org/system-health-whats-next/ ) 終於發布了，最棒的是它可以直接使用您之前收集的RRD數據。 :) 為了進一步改進，我們懇請您透過常用管道提供回饋。距離16.1正式發表還有一段時間。

This is a rather small maintenance release with a handful of fixes. The things that pop out are StrongSwan 5.3.3 [\[2\]](https://wiki.strongswan.org/projects/strongswan/wiki/Changelog53) as well as the menu now being correctly translated when selecting a different language. And, BTW, behind the scenes we’re just now opening up our translation server that’ll make it even easier to contribute to language translations in the future.

這是一個規模較小的維護版本，修復了一些問題。其中最引人注目的是 StrongSwan 5.3.3 [\[2\]]( https://wiki.strongswan.org/projects/strongswan/wiki/Changelog53 ) 以及選擇不同語言時選單翻譯的正確性。此外， BTW我們也開放了翻譯伺服器，這將使未來參與語言翻譯更加便利。

##### 15.7.12 (September 12, 2015)｜15.7.12 （2015年9月12日）

The vacation time is over for most of us, and so we do roll on into what is going to be a busy autumn. As we haven’t had a release in 2 weeks a longer list of changes has accumulated. Most prominently, we have a security advisory for FreeBSD that may allow privilege escalation on amd64 architectures. More security-related updates are available for LibreSSL, Bind and PHP.

大多數人的假期已經結束，我們即將迎來一個忙碌的秋天。由於我們已經兩週沒有發布新版本，因此積壓了大量變更。其中最引人注目的是針對 FreeBSD 的安全公告，該公告指出在 amd64 架構上可能存在權限提升漏洞。此外，LibreSSL、Bind 和PHP也發布了更多安全相關的更新。

We’ve also been able to iron out the few IPsec configuration problems left related to the page rewrite thanks to relentless testing by Frank Wall and others. We appreciate any help in doing the same for the new Firewall pages we have staged in our development version [\[12\]](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=1305.0) . 感謝 Frank Wall 和其他人的不懈測試，我們已經解決了與頁面重寫相關的剩餘幾個 IPsec 設定問題。我們也感謝大家協助我們測試開發版本 [\[12\]]( https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=1305.0 ) 中新部署的防火牆頁。以下是完整的變更清單：

##### 15.7.10 (August 25, 2015)｜15.7.10 （2015年8月25日）

15.7.10 is here with a larger number of third party updates as well as a security advisory for FreeBSD. Otherwise it’s relatively silent as we are still busy reworking the firewall section pages like we did with OpenVPN and IPSec recently.

15.7.10已發布，其中包含大量第三方更新以及針對 FreeBSD 的安全公告。除此之外，我們目前相對平靜，因為我們仍在忙於重構防火牆部分頁面，就像我們最近對 OpenVPN 和 IPSec 所做的那樣。

We’ve also bumped the crash reporter into the system section as a tool to generate custom reports, delivering the shortest possible path to get in touch with us regarding bugs or other quirks that do not automatically generate a report. We are totally happy with the way you guys have already embraced the reporter and wish to see even more usage of it. It has helped us to identify issues and ship fixes a lot quicker.

我們已將崩潰報告工具移至系統部分，作為產生自訂報告的工具，方便使用者以最快捷的方式聯絡我們，回​​饋那些不會自動產生報告的錯誤或其他問題。我們很高興看到大家對報告工具的積極使用，並期待看到更多人使用它。它幫助我們更快地發現問題並發布修復。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   src: Multiple integer overflows in expat XML parser [\[1\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:20.expat.asc)  
    src：expat XML解析器中出現多個整數溢位 [\[1\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:20.expat.asc )
    
-   src: bumped tzdata to 2015f [\[2\]](http://mm.icann.org/pipermail/tz-announce/2015-August/000033.html)

##### 15.7.9 (August 19, 2015)｜15.7.9 （2015年8月19日）

What’s up! We are about to release new images to put a stake in the ground following roughly 500 commits since 15.7 was released in early July. FreeBSD 10.2 is around the corner, which makes this all the more important. First tests look promising, but it’ll have to wait a few more weeks to hopefully get rid of more custom patches and thorough testing. We’ve also made progress with nano-style images to improve interoperability between different media types. Images are scheduled to be released shortly after 15.7.10 for said release.

大家好！自 7 月初發布15.7以來，我們進行了大約 500 次提交，現在我們即將發布新的鏡像，以鞏固現有成果。 FreeBSD 10.2也即將發布，這使得此次發布更加重要。初步測試結果令人鼓舞，但還需要幾週時間才能完成，希望能夠移除更多自訂修補程式並進行更全面的測試。此外，我們在 nano 風格的鏡像方面也取得了進展，以提高不同介質類型之間的互通性。這些鏡像計劃在15.7.10發布後不久發布。

With that in mind, 15.7.9 is a maintenance release which only addresses our code before we make a bigger leap forward. Focus has been to improve firmware upgrades and crash reporter, all OpenVPN and IPSec configuration pages and a fix for recent LibreSSL flavours not wanting to generate certificates.

有鑑於此， 15.7.9是一個維護版本，僅針對我們程式碼進行一些調整，為後續的重大更新做準備。本次更新的重點是改進韌體升級和崩潰報告功能，優化所有 OpenVPN 和 IPSec 設定頁面，並修復了最新 LibreSSL 版本無法產生憑證的問題。

##### 15.7.6 (July 31, 2015)｜15.7.6 （2015年7月31日）

This is 15.7.6 due to several security advisories for FreeBSD as well as OpenSSH and Bind problems. Reference links are provided for external issues as always. More crash reports came in for issues that date back to as much as a few years long before we started OPNsense. We are very happy for the chance to finally flush them out of the code base.

由於 FreeBSD 發布了多項安全公告，以及 OpenSSH 和 Bind 存在問題，本次更新編號為15.7.6 。像往常一樣，我們提供了外部問題的參考連結。此外，我們還收到了更多崩潰報告，這些問題甚至可以追溯到幾年前，遠在我們啟動 OPNsense 專案之前。我們非常高興終於有機會將這些問題從程式碼庫中徹底清除。

The update requires a reboot. Here are the full patch notes:

    ports: pkg 1.5.5 [\[2\]]( https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-ports/commit/1eb51efa2 )

    埠：ca\_root\_nss 3.19.2

    端口: phalcon 2.0.5 [\[3\]]( https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/phalcon-v2.0.5 )

    埠：isc-dhcp42-server 4.2.8 \_1 [\[4\]]( https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-ports/commit/3de9ed7a87 )

    備份：修復介面不匹配導致的無限重啟循環

##### 15.7.2 (July 10, 2015)｜15.7.2 （2015年7月10日）

It’s us. Again. Following the recent OpenSSL announcement of CVE-2015-1793 we are pushing out 15.7.2 earlier than expected. It is notable that FreeBSD 10.1 as well as LibreSSL are not affected. However, if you are running OPNsense with OpenSSL you should upgrade immediately. Services are not restarted automatically, so a reboot is advised but not mandatory. Please take a responsible course of action.

又是我們。繼 OpenSSL 近期發布的CVE更新之後，我們將提前推送15.7.2更新。值得注意的是，FreeBSD 10.1以及 LibreSSL 不受影響。但是，如果您正在使用 OpenSSL 運行 OPNsense，則應立即升級。服務不會自動重啟，因此建議重新啟動系統，但並非強制要求。請謹慎操作。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   opnsense-update: can now switch from/to LibreSSL/OpenSSL on the fly (needs root shell for now)  
    opnsense-update：現在可以動態切換 LibreSSL 和 OpenSSL（目前需要 root shell）
    
-   ssh: work around a shutdown bug that prevents other users from logging in (requires a reboot if used)  
    SSH：用於繞過一個導致其他使用者無法登入的關機漏洞（如果使用，需要重新啟動）。
    
-   shell: allow the root menu to run one-shot shell commands too  
    shell：允許根選單也執行一次性 shell 指令。
    
-   shell: clean up the version advertisement in the banner  
    shell：清理橫幅中的版本廣告
    
-   dashboard: colour hostap wifi as green when up  
    儀錶板：當 hostap wifi 連線正常時，顏色顯示為綠色
    
-   backup: do not redirect on interface mismatch, reboot right away instead  
    備份：介面不匹配時不要重定向，而是立即重啟
    
-   system: migrated /var and /tmp memory disks to tmpfs (requires a reboot if used)  
    系統：已將 /var 和 /tmp 記憶體磁碟遷移到 tmpfs（如果使用，需要重新啟動）
    
-   proxy: fix the startup when used on a /var memory disk (requires a manual start after boot)  
    代理：修復在 /var 記憶體磁碟上使用時的啟動問題（啟動後需要手動啟動）
    
-   intrusion detection: fix the startup when used on a /var memory disk (requires a manual start after boot)  
    入侵偵測：修復在 /var 記憶體磁碟上使用時的啟動問題（需要在啟動後手動啟動）
    
-   intrusion detection: enable the uricontent keyword for the ET ruleset  
    入侵偵測：為ET規則集啟用 uricontent 關鍵字
    
-   ports: libressl 2.2.1 [\[1\]](https://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/LibreSSL/libressl-2.2.1-relnotes.txt)  
    連接埠：libressl 2.2.1 [\[1\]]( https://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/LibreSSL/libressl-2.2.1-relnotes.txt )
    
-   ports: openssl 1.0.2d [\[2\]](https://www.openssl.org/news/secadv_20150709.txt)  
    ports: openssl 1.0 .2d [\[2\]]( https://www.openssl.org/news/secadv_20150709.txt )
    
-   ports: phalcon 2.0.4 [\[3\]](https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/phalcon-v2.0.4)  
    埠：phalcon 2.0.4 [\[3\]]( https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/phalcon-v2.0.4 )
    

##### 15.7.1 (July 08, 2015)｜15.7.1 （2015年7月8日）

We hope you guys are doing well. We are certainly happy with our first production release out in the open. :) Now that that’s taken care of, we have the opportunity to introduce stable braches for 15.7.x, with this week’s 15.7.1 as the first of many.

希望大家一切都好。我們非常高興首個正式版已經發布。 :) 現在正式版發布完畢，我們有機會推出15.7 .x 的穩定分支，本週發布的15.7.1只是眾多分支中的第一個。

Squid and Bind have CVE-related fixes. Otherwise, only minor fixes and improvements went into this release. If you are being affected by the DHCP server startup issue reboots are necessary in order to fix the root cause. Please follow these steps:

Squid 和 Bind 已修復與CVE相關的問題。除此之外，本次版本僅包含一些小的修復和改進。如果您遇到DHCP伺服器啟動問題，則需要重新啟動伺服器才能解決根本原因。請依照以下步驟操作：

1.  Upgrade to 15.7.1 using your preferred method.  
    使用您喜歡的方式升級到15.7.1 。
    
2.  Disable RAM disks in “System: Settings: Misc.” and reboot.  
    在「系統：設定：其他」中停用RAM磁碟並重新啟動。
    
3.  Enable RAM disks in “System: Settings: Misc.” and reboot.  
    在「系統：設定：其他」中啟用RAM磁碟，然後重新啟動。
    
4.  The DHCP server will now startup correctly.  
    DHCP伺服器現在可以正常啟動了。
    

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   overall: introducing stable updates for 15.7.x  
    整體而言：為15.7 .x 引入穩定更新
    
-   ports: bind910 9.10.2-P2 [\[1\]](https://kb.isc.org/article/AA-01269/81/BIND-9.10.2-P2-Release-Notes.html) , freetype2 2.6 [\[2\]](https://sourceforge.net/projects/freetype/files/freetype2/2.6/) , squid 3.5.6 [\[3\]](http://ftp.meisei-u.ac.jp/mirror/squid/squid-3.5-ChangeLog.txt)  
    ports: bind910 9.10.2-P2 [\[1\]]( https://kb.isc.org/article/AA-01269/81/BIND-9.10.2-P2-Release-Notes.html ) , freetype2 2.6 [\[2\]]( https://sourceforge.net/projects/freetype/files/freetype2/2.6/ ) , squid 3.5.6 \P3332\332)[ http://ftp.meisei-u.ac.jp/mirror/squid/squid-3.5-ChangeLog.txt ]。
    
-   crash reporter: fixed the upload of additional files  
    崩潰報告器：修正了上傳附加檔案的問題
    
-   system: always have a symlink available for /var/db/pkg  
    系統：始終為 /var/db/pkg 建立一個符號鏈接
    
-   system: protect sshd against OOM kills  
    系統：保護 sshd 免受OOM攻擊
    
-   system: can now properly select time zones which have a sub-sub-category  
    系統：現在可以正確選擇具有子子類別的時區
    
-   intrusion detection: switch default interface to WAN  
    入侵偵測：將預設介面切換至WAN
    
-   menu: added awareness for further routing tabs  
    選單：增加了對其他路由選項卡的提示
    
-   login: switch off “autocapitalize” and “autocorrect” for username field  
    登入：關閉使用者名字段的「自動大寫」和「自動修正」功能
    
-   status: do not scale RRD graphs over 100% of their actual size  
    狀態：請勿將RRD圖表縮放超過其實際尺寸的 100%
    
-   languages: minor tweaks for the German translation  
    語言：對德語翻譯進行了一些細微調整
    

##### 15.7 (July 02, 2015)｜15.7 （2015年7月2日）

While the summer is hot, we push forward to what now is 15.7 – nicknamed ‘Brave Badger’ – right in front of you. A lot of effort went into this project during the past 6 months, and we dare say it has been worth all of it. We would like to thank our followers and friends and feedback givers and forum lurkers and contributors and doubters and supporters that helped to make 15.7 what it is. We wouldn’t be here without any of you. Thank you.

雖然盛夏酷暑，我們依然奮力前行，最終呈現出了現在呈現在您眼前的15.7暱稱“勇敢的獾”。過去六個月裡，我們為這個計畫投入了大量心血，我們敢說，一切付出都是值得的。我們衷心感謝所有追蹤者、朋友、回饋者、論壇潛水員、貢獻者、質疑者和支持者，是你們的幫助成就了今天的15.7 。沒有你們，就沒有今天的我們。謝謝！

In itself, 15.7 is a simple upgrade from 15.1.12 which we recommend to everyone. What changes is that development will move to a different branch so that from now on regressions are less likely and therefore stability will increase further. The provided images may also be the only ones for the next 6 months as we are confident in their longevity and the online upgrade path. We have also bumped the LibreSSL flavour to a production-ready state and encourage everyone to try it out. The installer’s import configuration tool coupled with a quick and easy installation can help you move from OpenSSL to LibreSSL and back seamlessly.

就其本身而言，15.7是我們推薦給大家的15.1.12的簡單升級。變化在於，開發將轉移到不同的分支，因此從現在開始回歸的可能性較小，因此穩定性將進一步提高。所提供的圖像也可能是未來 6 個月內唯一的圖像，因為我們對其壽命和線上升級路徑充滿信心。我們還將 LibreSSL 風格提升至生產就緒狀態，並鼓勵每個人都嘗試一下。安裝程式的導入配置工具加上快速簡便的安裝可以幫助您無縫地從 OpenSSL 遷移到 LibreSSL 並返回。

The biggest addition is the intrusion detection integration (suricata) as well as new local and remote blacklists options for the proxy server (squid). Security-wise, it has been rather quiet with only a few CVEs in third-party tools. Please see the full patch notes for details and references:

此次更新最大的新增功能是入侵偵測整合（Suricata）以及代理伺服器（Squid）新增的本地和遠端黑名單選項。安全性方面，此次更新相對平靜，僅在第三方工具中發現了少量 CVE 漏洞。詳情及參考資料請參閱完整的更新日誌：

-   kernel: borrowed a dummynet / ipnat patch from m0n0wall to enable symmetric traffic shaping when NAT is involved  
    核心：從 m0n0wall 借用了一個虛擬網路/ipnat 補丁，以便在涉及NAT時啟用對稱流量整形。
    
-   kernel: fix recurse lock panic for tmpfs in conjunction with unionfs  
    核心：修復 tmpfs 與 unionfs 結合使用時出現的遞迴鎖恐慌問題
    
-   kernel: applied two stable patches that prevent squid from crashing [\[1\]](https://bugs.freebsd.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=195802)  
    內核：應用了兩個穩定補丁，防止 Squid 崩潰 [\[1\]]( https://bugs.freebsd.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=195802 )
    
-   kernel: retired ALTQ support  
    內核：已棄用ALTQ支持
    
-   base: sendmail TLS/DH Interoperability Improvement [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:08.sendmail.asc)  
    基礎：sendmail TLS/DH互通性改進 [\[2\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:08.sendmail.asc )
    
-   base: improved iconv(3) UTF-7 support [\[3\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:10.iconv.asc)  
    基礎：改良的 iconv(3) UTF -7 支援 [\[3\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:10.iconv.asc )
    
-   base: inconsistency between locale and rune locale states [\[4\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:09.xlocale.asc)  
    基礎：區域設定和符文區域設定狀態不一致 [\[4\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:09.xlocale.asc )
    
-   notable ports updates: phalcon 2.0.3 [\[5\]](https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/phalcon-v2.0.3) , curl 7.43.0\_2 [\[6\]](https://curl.haxx.se/changes.html) , openssh 6.8p1\_8, python 2.7.10 [\[7\]](https://hg.python.org/cpython/raw-file/15c95b7d81dc/Misc/NEWS) , perl 5.20.2\_5 [\[8\]](https://perldoc.perl.org/5.20.2/perldelta) , ntp 4.2.8p3 [\[9\]](http://www.eecis.udel.edu/~ntp/ntp_spool/ntp4/ChangeLog-stable) , libxml 2.9.2\_3 [\[10\]](https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=CVE-2015-1819) , openldap 2.4.41 [\[11\]](https://www.openldap.org/software/release/changes_lts.html)  
    值得關注的連接埠更新：phalcon 2.0.3 [\[5\]]( https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/phalcon-v2.0.3 ) , curl 7.43.0 \_2 [\[6\]]( https://curl.haxx.se/changes.html ) , openssh 6.8p 2.7.10 [\[7\]]( https://hg.python.org/cpython/raw-file/15c95b7d81dc/Misc/NEWS ) , perl 5.20.2 \_5 [\[8\]]( https://perldoc.perl.org/5.20.2/perldelta ) , ntp 4.2 .8p3 [\[ http://www.eecis.udel.edu/~ntp/ntp_spool/ntp4/ChangeLog-stable 2.9.2 \_3 [\[10\]]( https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=CVE-2015-1819 ) , openldap 2.4.41 [\[11\]]( https://www.openldap.org/software/release/changes_lts.html )
    
-   opnsense-update: will no longer try to reinstall the installed version after a fresh installation  
    opnsense-update：全新安裝後將不再嘗試重新安裝已安裝的版本
    
-   bsdinstaller: bring back cpdup to error out on low memory installation (you need 1 GB of RAM, or work around installation using the nano image)  
    bsdinstaller：恢復 cpdup 在記憶體不足時報錯的安裝功能（你需要 1 個GB或RAM ，或使用 nano 鏡像進行安裝）
    
-   traffic shaper: removed legacy queues support in favour of the new traffic shaper functionality  
    流量整形器：已移除對舊式佇列的支持，轉而使用新的流量整形器功能。
    
-   traffic shaper: allow direct enable/disable toggle  
    流量整形器：允許直接啟用/停用切換
    
-   proxy: fix the initial daemon start on bootup  
    代理：修復啟動時初始守護程式啟動問題
    
-   proxy: added LAN as the default interface configuration  
    代理：已新增LAN作為預設介面配置
    
-   proxy: local and remote blacklists with regex support  
    代理：支援正規表示式的本地和遠端黑名單
    
-   intrusion detection: initial release of our IDS GUI based on suricata  
    入侵偵測：我們基於 Suricata 的IDS GUI的初始版本發布
    
-   gateways: monitoring mode gained IPv6 support  
    網關：監控模式新增 IPv6 支持
    
-   captive portal: fix idle timeout bug  
    強制門戶：修復空閒逾時錯誤
    
-   captive portal: do not delete the wrong zone when having multiple configurations  
    強制門戶：存在多個配置時，請勿刪除錯誤的區域
    
-   captive portal: removed include files from exposed web directory  
    強制入口網站：已從公開的 Web 目錄中移除包含文件
    
-   backend: always regenerate users and groups to avoid corruption after an unclean shutdown  
    後端：始終重新產生使用者和群組，以避免在非正常關機後出現資料損壞。
    
-   backend: wait for configd socket to come up to address a startup race issue  
    後端：等待 configd 套接字啟動，解決啟動競爭問題
    
-   backend: clean up configd socket on exit  
    後端：退出時清理 configd 套接字
    
-   backend: fixed regression that prevented user scripts from being started via /etc/rc.conf  
    後端：修正了導致使用者腳本無法透過 /etc/rc.conf 啟動的回歸問題。
    
-   gateways: only show apinger in services when monitoring is enabled for a gateway  
    網關：僅當為網關啟用監控時，才會在服務中顯示 apinger
    
-   languages: brought Simplified Chinese to 49% completed, German to 30% completed  
    語言：簡體中文完成度達 49%，德文完成度達 30%。
    
-   universal plug and play: make page invoke static to remove exploitability of the legacy packages framework  
    通用即插即用：將頁面呼叫設為靜態，以消除舊版軟體包框架的漏洞利用風險
    
-   crash reporter: finally enabled the send button and provides human-readable feedback whether the submission was complete  
    崩潰報告器：終於啟用了發送按鈕，並提供易於理解的回饋，告知提交是否完成。
    
-   shell: added non-interactive interface assignment for headless deployments  
    shell：為無頭部署新增了非互動式介面分配
    
-   ssh: disable password authentication on factory reset to align with the standard configuration  
    SSH：恢復出廠設定時停用密碼驗證，以與標準設定保持一致。
    
-   diagnostics: avoid duplicated calls of gethostbyaddr() in NDP table view  
    診斷：避免在NDP表格檢視中重複呼叫 gethostbyaddr()
    
-   users: prompt for old password on password change to prevent account hijacking  
    使用者：更改密碼時提示輸入舊密碼，以防止帳號被盜用
    
-   users: stripped the impossible scponly user privileges since said utility has never been part of our ecosystem  
    使用者：由於該實用程式從未成為我們生態系統的一部分，因此已剝奪了不可能的 scponly 使用者權限。
    

Images can be found on any of our mirrors, but they may take a few hours to sync. The checksums are attached at the end of this announcement for convenience.

#### 15.1 “Ascending Albatross”（上升的信天翁） Series｜15.1 “Ascending Albatross”（上升的信天翁）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/CE_15.1.html>

The OPNsense core team is proud to announce that it has released its 15.1 version, nicknamed “Ascending Albatross”（上升的信天翁）, of the open source OPNsense firewall software.

OPNsense 核心團隊很榮幸地宣布，其開源 OPNsense 防火牆軟體的15.1版本（暱稱“Ascending Albatross”（上升的信天翁） ）已經發布。

This is the first release by the OPNsense project. Download [\[1\]](http://opnsense.org/download/) and try it now! Be sure to visit the project website [\[2\]](http://www.opnsense.org/) and learn more about us and the project. The project wants to be a friendly place for users, developers and partners.

這是 OPNsense 專案的首個版本。立即下載 [\[1\]]( http://opnsense.org/download/ ) 並體驗吧！請務必造訪專案網站 [\[2\]]( http://www.opnsense.org/ )，以了解更多關於我們和專案的資訊。我們致力於打造一個對使用者、開發者和合作夥伴都友善的平台。

We believe that an open source project should keep its sources and build tools available for all. OPNsense uses the simple 2-clause BSD license.

我們認為，開源專案應該向所有人開放其原始碼和建置工具。 OPNsense 使用簡單的 2 條款BSD許可證。

Users benefit from the polished installer, rich feature set and modern user interface. Developers are invited to check out our easy-to-use build tools. Commercial Support assists in keeping networks fast and secure. The project welcomes partners to be successful together.

使用者可受惠於完善的安裝程式、豐富的功能集和現代化的使用者介面。我們誠摯邀請開發者體驗我們易於使用的建置工具。商業支援服務可確保網路快速安全。本計畫歡迎合作夥伴攜手共進，共創輝煌。

OPNsense(r) is based on FreeBSD 10 and is a fork of pfSense(r) which in its turn is a fork of m0n0wall(r).

OPNsense(r) 是基於 FreeBSD 10，是 pfSense(r) 的一個分支，而 pfSense(r) 又是 m0n0wall(r) 的一個分支。

The next major release is 15.7 and is to be released on July 1st 2015. Bug fixes and security patches will be released when available.

下一個主要版本是15.7 ，將於2015年7月1日發布。錯誤修復和安全補丁將在可用時發布。

We are looking forward to welcome you in the OPNsense community.

我們期待您的加入，歡迎您加入 OPNsense 社群。

Because Open makes Sense!

因為開放才是明智之舉！

The OPNsense core team

OPNsense核心團隊

##### 15.1.12 (June 17, 2015)｜15.1.12 （2015年6月17日）

It’s sad but true: 15.1.12 may very well be the last of its kind. 6 months are almost over and 15.7 is around the corner with a number of changes e.g. how we do version numbers, release engineering branches and upcoming versions such as 16.1. As nothing is set in stone, we ask you to participate in the discussion on the forums:

令人遺憾的是， 15.1.12很可能是該系列的最後一個版本。六個月即將過去， 15.7也即將發布，屆時將帶來諸多變化，例如版本號的命名方式、發布工程分支以及即將推出的版本（例如16.1 。由於一切尚未最終確定，我們誠摯邀請您參與論壇上的討論：

[https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=705.0](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=705.0)

The aftermath of the recent OpenSSL release(s) finally settled so now we are shipping FreeBSD’s security advisory along with the latest releases of OpenSSL 1.0.2c and LibreSSL 2.2.0. Upgrading PHP 5.6.10 seemed like another sensible thing to do.

最近 OpenSSL 版本發布帶來的影響終於平息下來，因此我們現在將 FreeBSD 的安全公告與最新版本的 OpenSSL 1.0 .2c 和 LibreSSL 2.2.0一起發布。升級PHP 5.6.10似乎也是明智之舉。

The firmware update side of things received another minor batch of changes and is now at a point we’re satisfied with. Should you find anything odd or unusual, please let us know.

韌體更新方面又進行了一些小幅改動，目前我們對此感到滿意。如果您發現任何異常或不尋常之處，請告知我們。

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   src: fix OpenSSL multiple vulnerabilities [\[1\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:10.openssl.asc)  
    src：修正 OpenSSL 多個漏洞 [\[1\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:10.openssl.asc )
    
-   src: update base system file(1) to 5.22 [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:07.zfs.asc)  
    src: 更新基本系統檔案(1)至5.22 [\[2\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:07.zfs.asc )
    
-   src: improve reliability of ZFS [\[3\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:06.file.asc)  
    src：提升ZFS [\[3\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:06.file.asc ) 的可靠性
    
-   src: updated to tzdata2015e [\[4\]](http://mm.icann.org/pipermail/tz-announce/2015-June/000032.html)  
    src：已更新至 tzdata2015e [\[4\]]( http://mm.icann.org/pipermail/tz-announce/2015-June/000032.html )
    
-   ports: openssl 1.0.2c [\[5\]](https://www.openssl.org/news/openssl-1.0.2-notes.html) , libressl 2.2.0 [\[6\]](https://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/LibreSSL/libressl-2.2.0-relnotes.txt) , php 5.6.10 [\[7\]](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-5.php#5.6.10) , dnsmasq 2.73 [\[8\]](https://www.thekelleys.org.uk/dnsmasq/CHANGELOG) , smartmontools 6.4 [\[9\]](https://www.smartmontools.org/browser/tags/RELEASE_6_4/smartmontools/NEWS)  
    ports: openssl 1.0 .2c [\[5\]]( https://www.openssl.org/news/openssl-1.0.2-notes.html ) , libressl 2.2.0 [\[6\]]( https://ftp.openbsd.org/pub/OpenBSD/LibreSSL/libressl-2.2.0-relnotes.txt ) , php 5.6.10 https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-5.php#5.6.10 , 57\ dnsmasq 2.73 [\[8\]]( https://www.thekelleys.org.uk/dnsmasq/CHANGELOG ) , smartmontools 6.4 [\[9\]]( https://www.smartmontools.org/browser/tags/RELEASE_6_4/smartmontools/NEWS )
    
-   syslogd: disable unmaintained and unused ZMQ patches  
    syslogd：停用未維護和未使用的ZMQ補丁
    
-   opnsense-update: gained independent awareness of kernel and base system version  
    opnsense-update：獨立感知核心和基礎系統版本
    
-   opnsense-update: improved the manual page to include all recent changes  
    opnsense-update：改進了手冊頁面，使其包含所有最新更改
    
-   firmware: bring back /etc/shells support to avoid the unknown shell warning on bootup  
    韌體：恢復對 /etc/shells 的支持，以避免啟動時出現未知 shell 警告
    
-   firmware: always schedule next poll while upgrade is running to accommodate for web server restart delay  
    韌體：始終在升級運行時安排下一次輪詢，以應對 Web 伺服器重新啟動延遲。
    
-   logs: fix DHCP reverse ordering and update layout  
    日誌：修復DHCP反向排序並更新佈局
    
-   wizard: remove false statement about using “dhcp” for LAN setup  
    精靈：刪除關於使用「dhcp」進行LAN設定的錯誤說明
    
-   menu: order interfaces by name  
    選單：按名稱對介面進行排序
    
-   captive portal: fix database creation query by avoiding SQL injection syntax that broke due to a recent upstream hardening of the database adapter underneath

##### 15.1.11.4 (June 12, 2015)｜15.1.11.4 （2015年6月12日）

Coincidentally, we scheduled 15.1.11.4 for today and have found ourselves in the middle of an OpenSSL/LibreSSL update. FreeBSD has been really quick and provided ports updates for both of them. OpenSSL base updates, however, won’t be shipped today. That isn’t so bad, because we build all ports against the newer version by default. The base update will follow next week.

巧合的是，我們今天安排了15.1.11.4更新，結果發現自己正忙於OpenSSL/LibreSSL的更新。 FreeBSD反應非常迅速，並且已經提供了這兩個軟體的連接埠更新。不過，OpenSSL的基礎更新今天不會發布。這倒也無妨，因為我們預設會基於新版本來建立所有連接埠。基礎更新將在下週發布。

There have been quite a few things happening apart from \*SSL, see the notes and links to individual updates. Another round of stabilisation for the firmware GUI will make upgrading a bit more consistent in the future. And, ironically, if you encounter the update freezing up in the GUI, simply refresh the page and look for new updates.

除了 \*SSL 之外，還發生了很多事情，請參閱註釋和各個更新的連結。韌體GUI的另一輪穩定將使未來的升級更加一致。而且，諷刺的是，如果您在GUI中遇到更新凍結，只需刷新頁面並查找新的更新即可。

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   opnsense-update: has gained the ability to do package updates as well  
    opnsense-update：也獲得了執行軟體包更新的功能。
    
-   core: removed unused ssh\_tunnel\_shell and 3gstats utilities, added sudo to the default utilities  
    核心：移除了未使用的 ssh_tunnel_shell 和 3gstats 工具，並將 sudo 新增至預設工具。
    
-   captiveportal/traffic shaper: better fix for localhost skip  
    強制門戶/流量整形器：更好地修復本機主機跳過問題
    
-   traffic shaper: added ICMP, IGMP, ESP, AH and GRE protocols to selectable protocols  
    流量整形器：已將ICMP, IGMP, ESP, AH和GRE協定新增至可選協定中
    
-   core: fixed a bug that prevented our API from working properly with Phalcon 2.0.1 and above  
    核心修復：修復了一個導致我們的API無法與 Phalcon 2.0.1及更高版本正常工作的錯誤。
    
-   backend: added configctl command utility launcher and improved its logging capabilities  
    後端：新增了 configctl 命令實用程式啟動器，並改進了其日誌記錄功能
    
-   backend: worked around a performance degradation bug in Python 2.7 on FreeBSD  
    後端：解決了 FreeBSD 系統上 Python 2.7的一個效能下降 bug。
    
-   gateways: monitoring via `apinger` is now turned off by default for all new gateways created (opt-out flipped to opt-in for privacy reasons)  
    網關：所有新建立的網關現在預設關閉透過`apinger`進行的監控（出於隱私原因，選擇退出已改為選擇加入）。
    
-   firmware: refactored firmware code to use opnsense-update’s new capabilities  
    韌體：重構了韌體程式碼以使用 opnsense-update 的新功能
    
-   firmware: fix parsing of packages to be upgraded in fringe cases  
    韌體：修復在特殊情況下解析待升級軟體包的問題
    
-   firmware: fix overzealous caching of available package upgrades  
    韌體：修復過度快取可用軟體包升級的問題
    
-   users: user with group admins now have `wheel` group associated with them, allowing them to use `su` or `sudo` (if configured)  
    使用者：擁有管理員群組的使用者現在已關聯到`wheel`群組，允許他們使用`su`或`sudo` （如果已配置）
    
-   users: do not copy root’s hidden files while creating a new user home directory  
    使用者：建立新使用者主目錄時，請勿複製 root 使用者的隱藏文件
    
-   ports: pcre 8.37\_1 [\[1\]](https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-ports/commit/030adcf1d)  
    埠：pcre 8.37 \_1 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-ports/commit/030adcf1d )
    
-   ports: phalcon 2.0.2 [\[2\]](https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/phalcon-v2.0.2)  
    埠：phalcon 2.0.2 [\[2\]]( https://github.com/phalcon/cphalcon/releases/tag/phalcon-v2.0.2 )
    
-   ports: strongswan 5.3.2 [\[3\]](https://wiki.strongswan.org/projects/strongswan/wiki/Changelog53)  
    端口：strongswan 5.3.2 [\[3\]]( https://wiki.strongswan.org/projects/strongswan/wiki/Changelog53 )

    連接埠：sqlite 3.8.10.2 [\[4\]]( https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_8_10_2.html )

##### 15.1.11.3 (June 05, 2015)｜15.1.11.3 （2015年6月5日）

A tiny batch of fixes comes bundled with today’s 15.1.11.3 mainly to increase stability during WiFi USB attach/detach. It is a work in progress so please let us know how your experience changes.

今天的15.1.11.3版本包含少量修復程序，主要目的是提高USB連接/斷開時的穩定性。目前仍在完善中，請告知我們您的使用體驗變化。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   config: improved the deletion of backups  
    配置：改進了備份刪除功能
    
-   wifi: do not launch FreeBSD’s rc scripts on 802.11 attach/detach  
    wifi：請勿在802.11連線/分離時執行 FreeBSD 的 rc 腳本
    
-   ipfw: always forward traffic coming from localhost  
    ipfw：始終轉送來自本機的流量
    
-   system: apply PSR2 coding style to GUI pages  
    系統：將PSR2編碼風格應用於GUI頁面
    
-   captive portal: apply PSR2 coding style to GUI pages  
    強制入口網站：將PSR2程式設計風格應用於GUI頁面
    

Stay safe, Your OPNsense team

請注意安全，OPNsense團隊敬上

##### 15.1.11.2 (June 03, 2015)｜15.1.11.2 （2015年6月3日）

Today’s update includes a shiny new rewrite of the traffic shaper functionality for dummynet, another completed chapter in the ongoing quest for standardisation towards FreeBSD. The other gem is the first batch of translations for Simplified Chinese kindly provided by two of our enthusiastic users from China. We ask for you to try both features and let us know about limitations and issues through any of the usual channels. We appreciate likes and don’t-likes alike. :)

現今的更新包括對 dummynet 流量整形功能的全新重寫，這是我們持續推進 FreeBSD 標準化進程中的另一個重要里程碑。另一個亮點是，我們兩位來自中國的熱情用戶慷慨地提供了第一批簡體中文翻譯。我們懇請您試用這兩個功能，並透過常用管道告知我們您遇到的任何限製或問題。我們歡迎您的回饋，無論好壞。 :)

Security-wise, it has been rather quiet. Enjoy it while it lasts. Here are the full patch notes:

安全方面，目前為止風平浪靜。好好享受這段平靜時光吧。以下是完整的更新說明：

-   notable ports upgrades: pcre 8.37, pkg 1.5.3, ca\_root\_nss 3.19.1  
    值得注意的連接埠升級：pcre 8.37 、pkg 1.5.3 、ca\_root\_nss 3.19.1
    
-   aliases: fix javascript error that prevented aliases from woking  
    別名：修正導致別名無法正常運作的 JavaScript 錯誤
    
-   traffic shaper: rewrote the feature using standard components on top of the new MVC framework/API (see Firewall: Traffic Shaper)  
    流量整形器：使用基於新MVC框架/ API的標準組件重寫了此功能（請參閱防火牆：流量整形器）
    
-   system: enabled first few hundred translations of Simplified Chinese to help the community to progress and review said translation (see System: Settings: General)  
    系統：啟用最初數百個簡體中文翻譯，以幫助社群推進和審核這些翻譯（請參閱系統：設定：常規）
    
-   vpn: all GUI files underwent a thorough coding style refresh  
    VPN：所有GUI檔案都進行了徹底的編碼風格更新。
    
-   firmware: prevent spurious “Module already loaded” errors while upgrading PHP packages  
    韌體：防止在升級PHP軟體包時出現虛假的「模組已載入」錯誤
    

The packages for OpenSSL and LibreSSL are up and can be applied via the GUI or console firmware upgrade.

OpenSSL 和 LibreSSL 的軟體包已準備就緒，可透過GUI或控制台韌體升級進行應用。

Stay safe, Your OPNsense team

請注意安全，OPNsense團隊敬上

##### 15.1.11.1 (May 23, 2015)｜15.1.11.1 （2015年5月23日）

Today it’s time for 15.1.11.1 which includes two tweaks for the recent Logjam vulnerability as well as the images for OPNsense on top of OpenSSL. The reason for not providing LibreSSL images is that we are going to make the flavour selectable via the GUI since pkgng does such a great job of tracking and resolving all the provided and required dependencies.

今天發布的是15.1.11.1 ，其中包含針對最近Logjam漏洞的兩項調整，以及基於OpenSSL的OPNsense鏡像。之所以沒有提供LibreSSL鏡像，是因為我們將透過GUI來允許使用者選擇鏡像版本，而pkgng在追蹤和解析所有提供的和必需的依賴項方面做得非常出色。

-   crypto: regenerate DH parameters for 1024, 2048 and 4096 bit

-   crypto: tweak the web server config to harden against Logjam  
    加密：調整 Web 伺服器配置以增強其對 Logjam 的防禦能力
