##### 15.1.11 (May 22, 2015)｜15.1.11 （2015年5月22日）

As we are nearing the finish line for version 15.7 in July, we sat down on a single table in the Netherlands this week to review the changes that we’ve made over the past 5 months and we saw that only one road map [\[1\]](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/) item is still open: the frequently requested IDS package! We’ve come a long way since the initial 15.1 and have seen stability increase, functionality expand and timely updates being sustained on an almost weekly basis. Certainly achievements we want to keep whilst going forward.

隨著我們即將於七月完成15.7版本的發布，本週我們在荷蘭的一張桌子旁坐下來，回顧了過去五個月所做的改進。我們發現，路線圖[\[1\]]( https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/ )中僅剩一項尚未完成：那就是呼聲很高的IDS軟體包！自最初的15.1版本以來，我們取得了長足的進步，穩定性顯著提升，功能不斷擴展，幾乎每週都能及時更新。這些都是我們希望在未來繼續維持的成果。

The initial release of 15.1.11 has been postponed since Tuesday due to a framework update we’ve had to exclude as well as polishing the new GUI firmware feature to finally revive the base system update. If you are updating from the GUI to this release, you will still have to run the Console Firmware (Option 12) upgrade to bring your base system up to date (FreeBSD 10.1-RELEASE-p10). This is the last time, we promise. A reboot is mandatory.

由於我們不得不排除一項框架更新，以及完善新的GUI韌體功能以最終恢復基礎系統更新， 15.1.11的初始版本自周二起已推遲發布。如果您是從GUI更新到此版本，您仍然需要執行控制台韌體（選項 12）升級程式來更新您的基礎系統（FreeBSD 10.1-RELEASE -p10）。我們保證這是最後一次。更新後必須重新啟動系統。

We ship PHP 5.6.9 ahead of FreeBSD, removed numerous unused packages and two more custom kernel patches bringing us down to 5 custom patches from previously more than 40. We also have plans for further pruning, probably running without custom patches when FreeBSD 10.2 hits the shelves, metaphorically speaking.

我們提前發布了PHP 5.6.9 ，比 FreeBSD 更早，移除了許多未使用的軟體包和兩個自訂內核補丁，使我們的自訂補丁數量從之前的 40 多個減少到 5 個。我們也計劃進一步精簡，或許在 FreeBSD 10.2正式發佈時，不會再使用任何自訂補丁。

We haven’t forgotten the recent Logjam Attack [\[2\]](https://weakdh.org/) , but wanted not to postpone the current release any further. With that being said, 15.1.11.1 is coming out tomorrow including wary tweaks related to Logjam.

我們並未忘記最近的 Logjam 攻擊 [\[2\]]( https://weakdh.org/ )，但不想進一步推遲目前版本的發布。因此， 15.1.11.1將於明日發布，其中包含針對 Logjam 的一些謹慎調整。

Here is the full list of changes for 15.1.11:

以下是15.1.11的完整變更清單：

-   core: removed unused package dependencies b42-fwcutter, bwi-firmware-kmod, dmidecode, ifstated, pecl-ssh2  
    核心：移除未使用的軟體包相依性 b42-fwcutter、bwi-firmware-kmod、dmidecode、ifstated、pecl-ssh2
    
-   core: switched back from bind-tools to the latest full bind 9.10 package due to various requests  
    核心：由於各種請求，已從 bind-tools 切換回最新的完整 bind 9.10軟體包。
    
-   src: fix panic in pf(4) in conjunction with ALTQ [\[3\]](https://bugs.freebsd.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=200222)  
    src：修正 pf(4) 與ALTQ [\[3\]]( https://bugs.freebsd.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=200222 ) 結合使用時發生的 panic
    
-   src: updated to FreeBSD 10.0-RELEASE-p10 [\[4\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:04.freebsd-update.asc) [\[5\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:05.ufs.asc)  
    src：已更新至 FreeBSD 10.0-RELEASE -p10 [\[4\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:04.freebsd-update.asc ) [\[5\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:05.ufs.asc )
    
-   src: reverted two more custom patches to align with FreeBSD  
    src：撤銷了另外兩個自訂補丁，以與 FreeBSD 保持一致。
    
-   ports: updated to ca\_root\_nss 3.19, sqlite 3.8.10.1, php 5.6.9 [\[6\]](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-5.php#5.6.9) , openssh 6.8p1\_7 [\[7\]](http://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2015/05/16/3)  
    連接埠：已更新至 ca\_root\_nss 3.19 、sqlite 3.8.10.1 、php 5.6.9 [\[6\]]( https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-5.php#5.6.9 )、openssh 6.8p1\ http://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2015/05/16/3 \
    
-   opnsense-update: exclude /etc/tty from the upgrade  
    opnsense-update：從升級中排除 /etc/tty
    
-   bsdinstaller: reworked the internals to align to modern port standards  
    bsdinstaller：重構了內部結構以符合現代端口標準
    
-   captive portal: switched rules generation to new template engine  
    強制門戶：規則產生已切換到新的範本引擎
    
-   firmware: reimplement the GUI firmware update using MVC code  
    韌體：使用MVC程式碼重新實作GUI韌體更新
    
-   menu: remove collapse/expand inconsistencies  
    選單：移除折疊/展開不一致之處
    
-   dashboard: fix disabled widgets dialog  
    儀表板：修復已停用的小工具對話框
    
-   nat: fixed delete of multiple item  
    nat：修正了刪除多個項目的問題
    
-   nat: fix display of disabled rules  
    nat：修正已停用規則的顯示問題
    
-   queues: the legacy ALTQ traffic shaper is now found under “Firewall: Queues” to make room for the upcoming traffic shaper reimplementation based on IPFW/dummynet  
    佇列：舊版ALTQ流量整形器現已移至「防火牆：佇列」下，以便為即將基於IPFW /dummynet 的流量整形器重新實作騰出空間。
    
-   core: fix faulty read of /var/log/dmesg.boot  
    核心：修正讀取 /var/log/dmesg.boot 檔案時發生錯誤的問題
    

The live upgrades are up for both LibreSSL and OpenSSL. Images will follow in a later announcement as the testing backlog has gotten larger with more images and flavours. We are working on a Continuous Integration platform, but for now we’re still doing things manually.

LibreSSL 和 OpenSSL 的即時升級已經上線。由於測試任務繁多，鏡像和版本也越來越多，我們將在稍後發布鏡像更新公告。我們正在開發持續整合平台，但目前仍需手動操作。

##### 15.1.10.2 (May 13, 2015)｜15.1.10.2 （2015年5月13日）

We are happy to announce OPNsense 15.1.10.2 today following a rather exciting firmware upgrade bug that prevented the release yesterday. We are back to normal now thanks to the wonderful people of pkgng, and, boy, do we have news to share.

我們很高興地宣布 OPNsense 15.1.10.2正式發布！在此之前，由於一個相當棘手的韌體升級漏洞，我們昨天的發布計畫被迫取消。感謝 pkgng 團隊的鼎力相助，現在一切恢復正常。而且，我們確實有很多好消息可以跟大家分享。

First and foremost, it’s time to reveal to all of you the Proxy Server (based on squid) work we’ve done under the hood for a few months now. The new MVC framework has been plugged seamlessly into the GUI and can be inspected under “Services: Proxy Server”. This is a sneak preview of things to come and any help in testing and commenting on the feature is going to be a huge help as we go forward.

首先，是時候向大家展示我們幾個月來在底層開發的基於 Squid 的代理伺服器了。全新的MVC框架已無縫整合到GUI中，您可以在「服務：代理伺服器」下查看。這只是未來功能的預覽，任何對測試和回饋的幫助都將對我們未來的發展大有裨益。

The translation project has been kickstarted for Japanese [\[1\]](http://dotike.github.io/opnsense.core.ja_JP.UTF8/) and Chinese, although the translations are not yet available in the GUI due to their incompleteness. We do, however, think this is a good opportunity to ask for contributions to the translations and welcome efforts for other languages as well.

日文[\[1\]]( http://dotike.github.io/opnsense.core.ja_JP.UTF8/ )和中文的翻譯專案已經啟動，但由於翻譯尚不完整GUI版本尚未發布。不過，我們認為這是一個好機會，可以徵集大家對翻譯的貢獻，也歡迎大家為其他語言貢獻力量。

Last but not least HardenedBSD’s work [\[2\]](https://hardenedbsd.org/article/shawn-webb/2015-05-08/hardenedbsd-teams-opnsense) to build OPNsense on top of their code has been a quick success story and will eventually bring features like ASLR into the project. The cooperation also sparked a number of build tools improvements that will make maintaining the project easier in the future. Changes also help to unify the OpenSSL/LibreSSL release handling so that with this announcement you will be enjoying your timely LibreSSL firmware upgrade. ;)

最後，HardenedBSD 基於其程式碼建構 OPNsense 的工作[\[2\]]( https://hardenedbsd.org/article/shawn-webb/2015-05-08/hardenedbsd-teams-opnsense )取得了快速成功，最終將把ASLR等功能引入到專案中。此次合作也促成了多項建置工具的改進，這將使未來的專案維護更加便利。此外，這些改進還有助於統一 OpenSSL/LibreSSL 的發布流程，因此，隨著此次公告的發布，您將及時享受到 LibreSSL 韌體升級帶來的便利。 ;)

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   proxy: basic proxy features on top of our new and shiny MVC framework under “Services: Proxy Server”  
    代理：基於我們全新且酷炫的MVC框架的基本代理功能，位於「服務：代理伺服器」下
    
-   proxy: smart tokens for item lists (copy/paste CSV list into them and watch the magic happen)  
    代理：用於項目列表的智慧型令牌（複製/貼上CSV列表到其中，然後見證奇蹟發生）
    
-   proxy: help on/off per item or full page  
    代理：開啟/關閉每個項目或整頁的幫助
    
-   proxy: hide advanced options and include sane defaults  
    代理：隱藏進階選項並包含合理的預設值
    
-   proxy: FTP proxy included with same ACL controls as HTTP  
    代理： FTP代理包含與ACL相同的控件，與HTTP相同
    
-   proxy: simple authentication using built-in user database  
    代理：使用內建使用者資料庫的簡單身份驗證
    
-   openvpn: added Tunnelblick’s version of the OpenVPN XOR feature for protocol obfuscation [\[3\]](https://code.google.com/p/tunnelblick/wiki/cOpenvpn_xorpatch)  
    openvpn：新增了 Tunnelblick 版本的 OpenVPN XOR功能，用於協定混淆 [\[3\]]( https://code.google.com/p/tunnelblick/wiki/cOpenvpn_xorpatch )
    
-   core: fixed config.xml section import regression  
    核心：修復了 config.xml 部分導入迴歸問題
    
-   core: stripped numerous dynamic strings from gettext() invokes  
    核心：從 gettext() 呼叫中剝離了大量動態字串
    
-   ports: added FreeBSD’s 10.1 ifinfo tool to probe for interface statistics to replace legacy PHP module code  
    連接埠：新增了 FreeBSD 的10.1 ifinfo 工具來探測介面統計信息，以取代舊的PHP模組程式碼。
    
-   ports: bsdinstaller 2.3 no longer uses cpdup utility, plus log collection and SONAME fixes  
    連接埠：bsdinstaller 2.3不再使用 cpdup 工具，以及日誌收集和SONAME修復
    
-   ports: updated to pkg 1.5.2, phalcon 2.0.0, dnsmasq 2.72\_1 [\[4\]](https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2015-3294)  
    連接埠：已更新至 pkg 1.5.2 、phalcon 2.0.0 、dnsmasq 2.72 \_1 [\[4\]]( https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2015-3294 )
    
-   ports: Perl is now installed by default (5.18)  
    ports: Perl 現在預設安裝 ( 5.18 )
    
-   development: OpenSSL and LibreSSL branches have been merged for a simpler build experience and smaller release times  
    開發進度：OpenSSL 和 LibreSSL 分支已合併，以簡化建置流程並縮短發佈時間。
    
-   development: the package sets are now always kept as a single archive that can be reused and recompiled (even selectively)  
    開發：軟體包集現在始終保存為可重複使用和重新編譯（甚至是選擇性地重新編譯）的單一歸檔檔案。
    
-   development: stable translation template file is available now [\[5\]](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opnsense/core/master/src/share/locale/en_US/LC_MESSAGES/OPNsense.pot)  
    開發：穩定的翻譯範本文件現已可用 [\[5\]]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opnsense/core/master/src/share/locale/en_US/LC_MESSAGES/OPNsense.pot )
    
-   development: kickstarted Japanese and Chinese translations  
    開發：啟動了日文和中文翻譯工作
    
-   development: language translation files are now automatically compiled into the core package  
    開發：語言翻譯檔案現在會自動編譯到核心套件。
    
-   development: added a persistent build config file for setting the version, crypto flavour and release version tag (if applicable)  
    開發：新增了一個持久的建置設定文件，用於設定版本、加密風格和發布版本標籤（如果適用）。
    

The update is available via the firmware upgrade feature only.

此更新僅可透過韌體升級功能進行取得。

##### 15.1.10.1 (May 06, 2015)｜15.1.10.1 （2015年5月6日）

Here comes a quick hotfix for a pressing VLAN regression we’ve been hearing about today plus 3 more minor additions. These are the patch notes:

今天我們聽到了很多關於VLAN回歸問題的回饋，這裡發布一個緊急修復補丁，並新增了3項小功能。以下是補丁說明：

-   interfaces: fix interface rename regression that prevented VLANs from being set up  
    介面：修正了介面重命名回歸問題，該問題導致無法設定 VLAN。
    
-   firmware: clean up downloaded packages after installation  
    韌體：安裝後清理下載的軟體包
    
-   logging: prevent spurious pgrep-related messages from being logged  
    日誌記錄：防止記錄與 pgrep 相關的無關訊息
    
-   config: fix Google Drive backup accounting off-by-two  
    設定：修正 Google 雲端硬碟備份統計誤差為 2 的問題
    

The update available via the GUI or console firmware upgrade. No restarts necessary, except for those being affected by the VLAN regression. Let us know whether this brings you back to normal.

可透過GUI或主機韌體升級進行更新。除受VLAN回歸問題影響的用戶外，無需重新啟動。請告知我們更新後是否恢復正常。

Both LibreSSL and OpenSSL are available as of now!

LibreSSL 和 OpenSSL 目前皆可使用！

Stay safe, Your OPNsense team

請注意安全，OPNsense團隊敬上

##### 15.1.10 (May 04, 2015)｜15.1.10 （2015年5月4日）

The new release is finally here! Yet before we begin, we’d like to stress this part: please read the notes enclosed; they are important for the future of OPNsense.

新版本終於來了！但在開始之前，我們想強調一點：請閱讀隨附的說明；它們對 OPNsense 的未來發展至關重要。

We are now about two thirds into what is going to be 15.7. On this path, we’ve always released cutting edge snapshot releases and 15.1.10 is no different. However, what is different is the fact that this release marks a larger departure from what is considered a mere fork: we are leaving behind numerous kernel patches and two major features to better align with FreeBSD’s code base and to rebuild these features on more maintainable fundament. In this case we’re talking about the layer 7 shaper and FAIRQ/CODEL support.

我們現在已經完成了15.7計畫的三分之二。一直以來，我們都發布最前沿的快照版本， 15.1.10也不例外。然而，不同之處在於，這個版本標誌著我們與通常意義上的分支有了更大的區別：我們放棄了大量的核心補丁和兩個主要功能，以便更好地與 FreeBSD 的程式碼庫保持一致，並在更易於維護的基礎之上重建這些功能。這裡我們指的是第 7 層流量整形器和FAIRQ/CODEL支援。

But we not only delete all the things. No, we have added NanoBSD images to the release bundle. Reengineered the process to keep completely in sync with the FreeBSD ports collection. Replaced the GUI menu and ACL with MVC-based rewrites. We’ve switched on the fingerprint verification to finally enforce the (previously introduced) package repository signing.

但我們並非只是刪除了所有內容。不，我們還在發布包中添加了 NanoBSD 鏡像。我們重新設計了流程，使其與 FreeBSD ports 集合完全同步。我們用基於MVC的重寫替換了GUI選單和ACL 。我們啟用了指紋驗證，最終強制執行了（先前引入的）軟體包倉庫簽章。

It’s very likely that most of these additions and removals are not visible from a usage perspective and we do believe that is a good thing. For some these changes will spark criticism, but then again they are a chance to better distinguish between projects and individual requirements. We believe in choice. We believe in the choices we make for the benefit of our users. And we intend to keep it that way for a long time. Talk to us and let us know what we can achieve together. :)

這些新增和移除的功能很可能大部分在使用過程中都難以察覺，我們認為這是一件好事。對於某些用戶來說，這些改變可能會引發批評，但反過來，這也是一個更好地區分專案和具體需求的機會。我們相信選擇的權利。我們相信我們所做的選擇都是為了使用者的利益。而且我們打算長期堅持這一點。請與我們聯繫，讓我們知道我們可以攜手實現什麼目標。 :)

Important notes on the live upgrade:

關於即時升級的重要說明：

The recommended way to upgrade is the root shell menu option “12”. The box will require an immediate reboot. No further steps will be necessary.

建議的升級方法是使用 root shell 選單選項「12」。系統將立即重新啟動。無需其他步驟。

The GUI firmware upgrade has never been perfect due to wanting to upgrade itself through running the update. The GUI update is still safe to run, but it will not let you know when it is finished. The update window will go blank, which is your queue to refresh the page. The login window will reappear. After login, the GUI update will already be finished. To wrap up the full upgrade cycle, drop to the root shell and type:

由於想要透過運行更新來升級自身，GUI的韌體升級一直不完美。 GUI更新仍然可以安全運行，但它不會讓您知道它何時完成。更新視窗將變為空白，這是您刷新頁面的佇列。將重新出現登入視窗。登入後，GUI更新已完成。要結束整個升級週期，請前往 root shell 並輸入：

```
# # opnsense-update && reboot
```

But then again, simply use the root shell menu option “12”. It works seamlessly via SSH, too.

不過，您也可以直接使用 root shell 選單選項「12」。它也可以透過SSH無縫運行。

The full change log of 15.1.10 is as follows:

15.1.10的完整變更日誌如下：

-   kernel: cleaned up the custom legacy patches to move the underlying FreeBSD back to more standard behaviour  
    核心：清理了自訂的遺留補丁，使底層 FreeBSD 恢復到更標準的行為。
    
-   kernel: removed dysfunctional dummynet patches and traffic shaper / limiter GUI feature (ETA for a replacement is 15.7)  
    核心：移除了功能異常的虛擬網路修補程式和流量整形/限制器GUI功能（ ETA的替代方案是15.7 ）
    
-   kernel: stripped FAIRQ and CODELQ disciplines as they are no longer supported by FreeBSD  
    核心：已移除FAIRQ和CODELQ規則，因為 FreeBSD 已不再支援它們。
    
-   kernel: isolated MPD (Multi-link PPP daemon) alteration patches (will be dropped in a future release)  
    核心：隔離的MPD （多鏈路PPP守護進程）修改補丁（將在未來的版本中移除）
    
-   kernel: fixed IPSec dropping connections in some scenarios  
    核心：修正了某些情況下 IPSec 連線斷開的問題
    
-   images: a new NanoBSD-based image has been added to the release bundle (directly written to SD or HD)  
    鏡像：發布包中新增了一個基於 NanoBSD 的鏡像（直接寫入SD或HD ）。
    
-   notable ports updates: curl 7.42.1, ca\_root\_nss 3.18.1  
    值得注意的連接埠更新：curl 7.42.1 ，ca\_root\_nss 3.18.1
    
-   installer: omit swap and add noatime to root partition in quick/easy install when available space is under 30GB, fixed faulty exit on importer cancel  
    安裝程式：當可用空間小於 30GB 時，快速/簡易安裝會省略交換分割區並將 noatime 新增至根分割區；修正了匯入程式取消作業時的錯誤退出問題。
    
-   development: the ports tree is now kept fully in sync with FreeBSD  
    更新：連接埠樹現在與 FreeBSD 完全同步。
    
-   development: improved the ports build script in terms of error reporting and rebuilding speed  
    開發：改進了連接埠建置腳本，提高了錯誤報告速度和重建速度。
    
-   development: simplified file system path handling in most files to make the code easier to maintain  
    開發：簡化了大多數文件的檔案系統路徑處理，使程式碼更易於維護。
    
-   development: fixed a bug that prevented extracting our packages on ZFS  
    開發：修正了阻止在ZFS上提取軟體包的錯誤
    
-   core: replaced most of the legacy PHP module usage with more portable (and maintainable) scripting code  
    核心功能：以更便攜（且更易於維護）的腳本程式碼取代了大部分舊版PHP模組的使用。
    
-   dashboard: fixed the main link to always land on the dashboard to not confuse a restricted ACL setup  
    儀錶板：修復了主鏈接，使其始終跳到儀表板，以免與受限的ACL設定混淆。
    
-   traffic shaper: layer 7 filter removed as the project has been abandoned (ETA for a replacement is 16.1)  
    交通整形器：由於項目已放棄，已移除第 7 層過濾器（ ETA的替代方案為16.1 ）。
    
-   system/settings: added an FTP proxy feature for clients trying to do active transfers  
    系統/設定：為嘗試進行主動轉帳的客戶端新增了FTP代理功能
    
-   menu: replaced the old one with the new MVC equivalent plus assorted improvements  
    選單：用新的MVC版本取代了舊版本，並進行了多項改進。
    
-   ACL: replaced the old one with the new MVC equivalent  
    ACL ：用新的MVC等效件取代了舊的。
    
-   login: polished the login screen behaviour  
    登入：優化了登入介面的行為
    
-   backend: don’t try to send a signal to non-existing process  
    後端：不要嘗試向不存在的進程發送訊號。
    
-   user: can now change the password via “User: Change Password” from the menu  
    用戶現在可以透過選單中的「用戶：更改密碼」來更改密碼。
    
-   firmware: enforce signed packages on upgrade for our mirrors  
    韌體：強制鏡像站點在升級時安裝簽名軟體包。
    
-   rrd: fixed directory create-after-use  
    rrd：修正了使用後建立目錄的問題

##### 15.1.9.2 (April 22, 2015)｜15.1.9.2 （2015年4月22日）

Another week, another stable release. :) While we are busy working on extensive kernel cleanups to bring OPNsense closer to FreeBSD, we decided to ship a minor update today with a number of third-party software refreshes and assorted fixes across the board before we make the leap to 15.1.10.

又一周，又一個穩定版本發布。 :) 雖然我們正在忙於進行廣泛的內核清理工作，以使 OPNsense 更接近 FreeBSD，但我們決定在今天發布一個小更新，其中包含一些第三方軟體更新和各種修復，然後再過渡到15.1.10 。

We’d like to mention the extensive translation groundwork being done by Isaac Levy, which will enable others to start working on specific language support now that there’s an official English translation in the system. A Japanese translation is being discussed already – if you’d like to contribute other language translations let us know through the usual channels. We’d be more than happy to include them into a future release.

我們想特別提及 Isaac Levy 所做的卓有成效的翻譯基礎工作，這使得其他人能夠在系統已有官方英文翻譯的情況下，著手開發特定語言的支援。目前日文翻譯也正在討論中－如果您有意貢獻其他語言的翻譯，請透過常用管道告知我們。我們非常樂意將它們納入未來的版本。

Here is the full change log of 15.1.9.2:

以下是15.1.9.2的完整變更日誌：

-   captive portal: fixed rule generation on empty IP  
    強制門戶：固定規則產生於空IP
    
-   gui: print current user in upper right corner along with the hostname  
    GUI：在右上角顯示目前使用者和主機名稱。
    
-   user manager: fixed empty password error when creating a new user  
    使用者管理員：修正了建立新使用者時密碼為空的錯誤。

    高可用性：未配置時不觸發同步
    
-   interfaces: added the hn(4) interfaces as ALTQ capable  
    接口：新增了 hn(4) 接口，使其支援ALTQ
    
-   configuration: do not overwrite the default configuration on firmware updates  
    配置：韌體更新時請勿覆蓋預設配置
    
-   ipsec: fixed road warrior authentication  
    IPsec：固定遠端戰士身份驗證

    openvpn：修復客戶端編輯鏈接

    連接埠：sqlite 3.8.9 [\[1\]]( https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_8_9.html )

    埠： PHP 5.6.8 [\[2\]]( https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-5.php#5.6.8 )

    ports: pkg 1.5.1 [\[3\]]( https://lists.freebsd.org/pipermail/freebsd-stable/2015-April/082234.html )
    
-   development: kickstarted language support via English translation (.pot file)

##### 15.1.9.1 (April 16, 2015)｜15.1.9.1 （2015年4月16日）

Today we present you a quiet stable update with a hand full of assorted features, tweaks and bug fixes. Most notably, we’ve integrated DNS filtering via OpenDNS and tested / reworked the IPSec reporting.

今天我們為您帶來一個穩定可靠的更新，其中包含一系列功能、調整和錯誤修復。最值得一提的是，我們透過 OpenDNS 整合了DNS過濾功能，並測試/改進了 IPSec 報告功能。

As far as we know there have been no security-related fixes of bundled third-party software since 15.1.9.

據我們所知，自15.1.9以來，捆綁的第三方軟體還沒有出現任何與安全相關的修復。

Update through the GUI via “System: Firmware” or the root console option “12) Upgrade from console”. A reboot is not strictly required, but recommended to trigger the automatic enable of soft updates and TRIM (if applicable to your disk).

透過「系統：韌體」或根控制台選項「12) 從控制台升級」進行GUI更新。雖然並非絕對需要重啟，但建議重新啟動以觸發自動啟用軟更新和TRIM （如果您的磁碟適用）。

Here is the full change log of 15.1.9.1:

以下是15.1.9.1的完整變更日誌：

-   firmware: show a warning on pending system updates that need to be executed from the console  
    韌體：顯示有關需要從控制台執行的待處理系統更新的警告
    
-   system: “General Setup”（常規設定） and “Advanced”（先進的） items have been merged into “Settings”（設定）  
    系統： “General Setup”（常規設定）和“Advanced”（先進的）專案已合併至“Settings”（設定）中
    
-   system: “Certificate Manager”（證書管理器） is now known as “Certificates”（證書）, default tab changed as well  
    系統： “Certificate Manager”（證書管理器）現已更名為“Certificates”（證書） ，預設標籤頁也已更改。
    
-   services: introduce OpenDNS-based DNS filtering  
    服務：引入基於 OpenDNS 的DNS過濾
    
-   services: fixed start button layout when service is offline  
    服務：修正了服務離線時的啟動按鈕佈局
    
-   ports: fixed StrongSwan SMP socket bind on FreeBSD  
    連接埠：修復了 FreeBSD 上的 StrongSwan SMP套接字綁定問題
    
-   ipsec: brought back tunnel status reporting  
    IPsec：恢復了隧道狀態報告
    
-   ipsec: fixed “Do not install LAN SPD” setting  
    ipsec：修復了「請勿安裝LAN SPD 」設置
    
-   user manager: fixed group permission and privilege read bugs  
    使用者管理員：修復了群組權限和特權讀取錯誤

    網路喚醒：修復了「無法建立指向/來自字串偏移量或重載物件的參考」錯誤
    
-   openvpn: fixed server restart regression  
    openvpn：修正了伺服器重新啟動回歸問題
    
-   core: automatically enable TRIM on boot if available  
    核心：如果可用，則在啟動時自動啟用TRIM

##### 15.1.9 (April 10, 2015)｜15.1.9 （2015年4月10日）

Although we have already released 15.1.8.4 early this week, we’re pushing out 15.1.9 for two important reasons: security updates, kernel panic fixes and clean images as we’ve had a couple of things that needed addressing following the configuration system rewrite in 15.1.8. That’s three important reasons really. ;)

雖然我們本周初已經發布了15.1.8.4 ，但我們推出15.1.9主要有兩個原因：安全更新、內核崩潰修復以及乾淨的鏡像，因為在15.1.8中重寫配置系統後，我們遇到了一些需要解決的問題。其實是三個重要的原因。 ;)

The recommended upgrade method is the root console option 12 to properly update both the packages and the base system to the latest available releases. Please verify that the system information widget on the dashboard presents you with the following and new version information (will show “i386” as opposed to “amd64” if you use the 32 bit version):

建議的升級方法是使用根控制台選項 12，以便將軟體包和基礎系統正確更新到最新版本。請確認儀表板上的系統資訊小工具顯示以下新版本資訊（如果您使用的是 32 位元版本，則會顯示「i386」而不是「amd64」）：

```
# OPNsense 15.1.9-amd64
# FreeBSD 10.1-RELEASE-p9
# OpenSSL 1.0.1m 19 Mar 2015
```

Alternatively, you can choose to boot a fresh install media and do a clean config import followed by an immediate installation to retain your full setup.

或者，您可以選擇使用全新的安裝媒體啟動，然後進行乾淨的配置匯入，然後立即進行安裝，以保留您的完整設定。

As always, back up your configuration to an external location prior to upgrading.

與往常一樣，升級前請將設定備份到外部位置。

LibreSSL images and updates are expected later today. Please watch out for the announcement on Twitter, IRC, the forum or elsewhere. LibreSSL is still an experimental release despite the fact we keep it up to date and mix LibreSSL updates into the shared patch notes.

LibreSSL 鏡像和更新預計將於今天晚些時候發布。請留意 Twitter、 IRC 、論壇或其他管道的公告。儘管我們會持續更新 LibreSSL 並將更新內容整合到共享的修補程式說明中，但它目前仍處於實驗階段。

Here is the change log for 15.1.9:

以下是15.1.9的變更日誌：

-   tools: install media live images now use the more flexible tmpfs(5)  
    工具：安裝媒體即時鏡像，現在使用更靈活的 tmpfs(5)
    
-   tools: cxgbe(4) is now compiled into the kernel  
    工具：cxgbe(4) 現在已編譯到核心中
    
-   ports: strongswan 5.3.0 [\[1\]](https://www.strongswan.org/blog/2015/03/30/strongswan-5.3.0-released.html) , openssh 6.8p1 [\[2\]](https://www.openssh.com/txt/release-6.8) , ntp 4.2.8p2 [\[3\]](http://support.ntp.org/bin/view/Main/SecurityNotice#Recent_Vulnerabilities)  
    埠：strongswan 5.3.0 [\[1\]]( https://www.strongswan.org/blog/2015/03/30/strongswan-5.3.0-released.html ) , openssh 6.8p1 [\[2\]]( https://www.openssh.com/txt/release-6.8 ) , ntp 4.2 http://support.ntp.org/bin/view/Main/SecurityNotice#Recent_Vulnerabilities [38.
    
-   src: reverted inconsistent carp(4) and pfsync(4) patches to retain standard FreeBSD behaviour  
    src：回滾了不一致的 carp(4) 和 pfsync(4) 補丁，以保持標準的 FreeBSD 行為
    
-   src: fix multiple vulnerabilities of ntp [\[4\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:07.ntp.asc)  
    src：修正ntp的多個漏洞[\[4\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:07.ntp.asc )
    
-   src: fix denial of service with IPv6 router advertisements [\[5\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:09.ipv6.asc)  
    src：修正 IPv6 路由器通告的拒絕服務攻擊 [\[5\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:09.ipv6.asc )
    
-   core: console upgrade now also triggers the unused package removal  
    核心：控制台升級現在也會觸發未使用軟體包的刪除
    
-   core: fix regression that caused a faulty config.xml when applying limiter settings  
    核心修復：修復了應用限制器設定時導致 config.xml 檔案錯誤的回歸問題
    
-   core: refactored the configd command structure for clarity  
    核心：重構了 configd 指令結構，使其更清晰易懂。
    
-   core: fix for SMTP notifications that broke due to PHP 5.6’s new default SSL behaviour  
    核心：修正了由於PHP 5.6的新預設SSL行為而導致的SMTP通知失效問題。
    
-   core: thorough unused java script purge under the hood  
    核心功能：徹底清除底層未使用的 Java 腳本。
    
-   upnp: fix redeclaration error on main page shortcut click  
    upnp：修復主頁快捷方式點擊時的重新聲明錯誤
    
-   user manager: consolidated the labels of all privileges, especially OpenVPN  
    使用者管理員：整合了所有權限的標籤，特別是 OpenVPN 權限的標籤。
    
-   development: opnsense-update can selectively upgrade base/kernel for testing

##### 15.1.8.4 (April 07, 2015)｜15.1.8.4 （2015年4月7日）

We hereby proudly announce our latest and greatest stable update 15.1.8.4. This is almost completely GUI-oriented (frontend and backend) due to numerous cleanups we’ve done in pursuit of the 15.1.8 release and its new config subsystem. A huge thank you goes to everybody who submitted bugs over the course of the last week.

我們在此榮幸地宣布最新、最強大的穩定版本更新15.1.8.4 。由於我們在發布15.1.8及其全新配置子系統的過程中進行了大量清理工作，因此本次更新幾乎完全基於GUI （前端和後端）。衷心感謝過去一周提交錯誤報告的所有用戶。

The firmware upgrade is online-only, so either go through the GUI or the console. A bit of bumpiness may be present in the GUI upgrade. After PHP packages have been removed you can safely steer away from the page and recheck for firmware updates to make sure the firmware has been upgraded correctly.

韌體升級僅在線上進行，因此可以透過GUI或控制台進行。 GUI 升級中可能會出現一些顛簸。刪除PHP軟體包後，您可以安全地離開該頁面並重新檢查韌體更新，以確保韌體已正確升級。

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   core: removed numerous unused function from the code base  
    核心部分：從程式碼庫中移除了大量未使用的函數。
    
-   core: fixed numerous `Illegal string offset` warnings  
    核心：修復了大量`Illegal string offset`警告
    
-   core: fixed numerous `Cannot create references to/from string offsets nor overloaded objects` errors related to 15.1.8’s config system switch  
    核心：修正了與15.1.8的配置系統開關相關的多個`Cannot create references to/from string offsets nor overloaded objects`錯誤
    
-   captive portal: properly redirect to original page after entering a valid voucher  
    強制入口網站：輸入有效優惠券後正確重定向到原始頁面
    
-   xmlrcp: replaced the whole legacy implementation due to issues with the latest PHP version to unbreak the feature  
    xmlrcp：由於最新PHP版本存在問題，因此已替換整個舊版實作以修復功能。
    
-   core: fixed an ancient background execution bug that prevented the spawned process from fully detaching from its parent  
    核心修復：修復了一個長期存在的後台執行錯誤，該錯誤會導致生成的進程無法完全脫離其父進程。
    
-   firmware: completely detached the firmware upgrade from the GUI to make it more reliable and hide empty update tables  
    韌體：將韌體升級與GUI完全分離，以提高其可靠性並隱藏空的更新表。
    
-   dashboard: polish the version information print and also show OpenSSL/LibreSSL version for better awareness  
    儀錶板：最佳化版本資訊列印，並顯示 OpenSSL/LibreSSL 版本，以提高使用者認知度。
    
-   xmlrpc: removed dangerous PHP and shell execution hooks  
    xmlrpc：已移除危險的PHP和shell執行鉤子
    
-   core: removed the backwards compatibility code for base OpenSSL as we don’t want to use it anymore  
    核心程式碼：已移除基礎 OpenSSL 的向後相容程式碼，因為我們不再需要使用它。
    
-   core: fixed unstable GUI and console factory reset  
    核心修復：不穩定的GUI和主機恢復出廠設置
    
-   system settings: finally flipped the SSH key only checkbox to properly align with the underlying settings name of `PasswordAuthentication`  
    系統設定：終於將SSH鍵專用」複選框切換為與底層設定名稱`PasswordAuthentication`正確對齊。
    
-   core: removed usage of numerous legacy PHP plugins in favour of more portable approaches  
    核心功能：移除了大量舊版PHP插件，轉而採用更具可攜性的方法。
    
-   logs: captive portal logs now have the proper layout  
    日誌：強制門戶日誌現在有正確的佈局。
    
-   logs: fixed firewall log parsing to unhide log entries for IP protocols that were not TCP/UDP/ICMP  
    日誌：修正了防火牆日誌解析，取消隱藏非TCP/UDP/ICMP協定的IP日誌條目
    
-   crash reporter: revamp the crash report layout and add appropriate feedback messages (note that the send button isn’t enabled but we’ll get there)  
    崩潰報告器：改進崩潰報告佈局並添加適當的回饋訊息（請注意，發送按鈕尚未啟用，但我們會盡快實現）。
    
-   interfaces: fixed WAN PPPOE edit  
    接口：固定WAN PPPOE編輯
    
-   configd: do not emit an error on shutdown  
    configd：關閉時不發出錯誤
    
-   configd: gained a background execution feature  
    configd：新增後台執行功能
    
-   development: added hooks for running custom rc scripts  
    開發：新增了運行自訂 rc 腳本的鉤子
    
-   development: enable PHP warnings for core.git mount  
    開發：啟用 core.git 掛載的PHP警告
    

If you do not possess a running installation, the images for 15.1.8 are available through at least one of our shiny new our mirrors. Make sure you upgrade to 15.8.1.4 as soon as you installed 15.1.8 to avoid all unnecessary hiccups:

如果您沒有正在運行的安裝，則可以透過至少一個我們閃亮的新鏡像來獲得15.1.8的圖像。確保在安裝15.1.8後立即升級到15.8.1.4，以避免所有不必要的問題：

[https://opnsense.org/download/](https://opnsense.org/download/)

Stay safe, Your OPNsense team

請注意安全，OPNsense團隊敬上

##### 15.1.8.3 (March 30, 2015)｜15.1.8.3 （2015年3月30日）

The new config system had a number of issues, but thanks to your help we’ve ironed them out in the two days following the release. The trend continues with this small stable update fixing the last batch of visible issues while also pulling in PHP 5.6.7, which isn’t currently available in FreeBSD ports.

新的配置系統存在一些問題，但多虧了大家的幫助，我們在發布後的兩天內就解決了這些問題。此次小幅穩定更新延續了這一趨勢，修復了最後一批已知的問題，同時也引入了 FreeBSD ports 中目前尚未提供的PHP 5.6.7 。

Here is the full change log:

這是完整的更改日誌：

-   ports: PHP was updated to 5.6.7 addressing CVE-2015-0231, CVE-2015-2305, etc. [\[1\]](https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-5.php#5.6.7)  
    埠： PHP已更新為5.6.7位址分別為CVE -2015-0231、 CVE -2015-2305 等。 [\[1\]]( https://www.php.net/ChangeLog-5.php#5.6.7 )
    
-   captive portal: service now restarts correctly when triggered from the GUI  
    強制門戶：現在從GUI觸發時，服務可以正確重啟。
    
-   ipsec: multiple config system replacement regression fixes  
    IPsec：多種設定係統替換回歸修復
    
-   dhcp: fixed the flushing of v6 settings while applying them  
    DHCP：修正了應用 DHCP 設定時 v6 設定被清除的問題
    
-   user manager: fixed a bug that would remove groups  
    使用者管理員：修復了會刪除使用者群組的錯誤。
    
-   firewall rules: prevent delete rule from deleting all rules  
    防火牆規則：防止刪除規則刪除所有規則
    
-   core: ignore empty tags in configs generated by frontend code  
    核心：忽略前端程式碼產生的配置中的空標籤
    

The update is available for both of the crypto flavours OpenSSL and LibreSSL through the System/Firmware section of the GUI. If you are upgrading from pre-15.1.7.1 don’t forget to run “opnsense-update && reboot” on a root shell to bring in the latest base fixes afterwards as well. Installations of 15.1.7.1 and higher can use the console firmware upgrade option 12 to run an adaptive update cycle (depending on how much needs to be updated the system may reboot).

此更新可透過 GUI 的系統/韌體部分適用於 OpenSSL 和 LibreSSL 兩種加密貨幣。如果您從 15.1.7.1 之前的版本升級，請不要忘記在 root shell 上運行“opnsense-update && restart”，以便隨後引入最新的基本修復。 15.1.7.1 及更高版本的安裝可以使用控制台韌體升級選項 12 來運行自適應更新周期（取決於系統可能重新啟動的需要更新的程度）。

As always, please back up your config and let us know if you run into any trouble. :)

和往常一樣，請備份您的配置，如果遇到任何問題，請告知我們。 :)

[https://opnsense.org/support-overview/mailing-list](https://opnsense.org/support-overview/mailing-list) [https://twitter.com/opnsense](https://twitter.com/opnsense) [https://github.com/opnsense](https://github.com/opnsense) [https://forum.opnsense.org](https://forum.opnsense.org/)

##### 15.1.8.2 (March 25, 2015)｜15.1.8.2 （2015年3月25日）

After an extended low profile period we are back in business with the latest and greatest 15.1.8. You’ll notice that we have incorporated the recent OpenSSL security advisories along with a larger number of fixes and cleanups. But there’s more. We have pushed the bulk load of our new configuration handling code which is intended to bridge the gap between the old and the new front-end code. And since we don’t like to stop there just yet, we’ve also added support for backing up your configs on your private Google Drive.

經過一段時間的低調更新，我們帶著最新最強大的15.1.8版本強勢回歸。您會注意到，我們不僅整合了最新的OpenSSL安全公告，還進行了大量的修復和清理工作。不僅如此，我們還推送了全新的配置處理程式碼，旨在彌合新舊前端程式碼之間的差距。而且，我們並未止步於此，也新增了將設定備份到您私有Google雲端硬碟的功能。

We encourage our users running 15.1.7.1 or later to try the root console menu option “12” for a fully automatic system upgrade. Otherwise, it’s either installing from scratch using install media and the installer’s config import feature, or running the GUI firmware update and dropping to a root shell to run `opnsense-update && reboot` to fully benefit from the base system security updates. Please let us know about your upgrade experience. We are still adding and tweaking code to complement and simplify the upgrade process.

我們鼓勵運行15.1.7.1或更高版本的使用者嘗試使用 root 控制台選單選項「12」進行全自動系統升級。否則，您可以選擇使用安裝媒體和安裝程序的配置導入功能全新安裝系統，或者運行GUI固件更新程序，然後進入 root shell 運行`opnsense-update && reboot`以充分利用基礎系統安全更新。請告知我們您的升級體驗。我們仍在不斷添加和調整程式碼，以完善和簡化升級流程。

Users of the install media are encouraged to update their firmware via the GUI from 15.1.8 to 15.1.8.2 as soon as possible due to a few important config system hotfixes.

由於一些重要的配置系統熱修復，建議安裝媒體的使用者盡快透過GUI將韌體從15.1.8更新到15.1.8.2 。

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   src: applied FreeBSD-SA-15:06.openssl [\[1\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:06.openssl.asc)  
    src: applied FreeBSD- SA -15:06.openssl [\[1\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:06.openssl.asc )
    
-   src: updated to tzdata2015b [\[2\]](http://mm.icann.org/pipermail/tz-announce/2015-March/000029.html)  
    src：已更新至 tzdata2015b [\[2\]]( http://mm.icann.org/pipermail/tz-announce/2015-March/000029.html )
    
-   src: add missing max-packets parsing for pf(4)  
    src：為 pf(4) 新增缺少的最大資料包解析
    
-   src: OPNsense branding for boot loader  
    來源：OPNsense 引導程式品牌標識
    
-   bsdinstaller: speed up SD card writes using async mode and assorted cleanups  
    bsdinstaller：使用非同步模式和各種清理操作加快SD卡寫入速度
    
-   opnsense-update: don’t trigger a spurious update after a fresh install when invoked for the first time  
    opnsense-update：首次呼叫時，不要在全新安裝後觸發不必要的更新
    
-   notable port updates: isc-dhcp42 4.2.8, libressl 2.1.6 (hopefully builds will be available on Friday), openssl 1.0.1m, ca\_root\_nss 3.18  
    值得關注的連接埠更新：isc-dhcp42 4.2.8 、libressl 2.1.6 （預計週五即可發佈建置版本）、openssl 1.0 .1m、ca\_root\_nss 3.18
    
-   core: removed obsolete conf\_mount\_ro() and conf\_mount\_rw() usage  
    核心：移除了過時的 conf\_mount\_ro() 和 conf\_mount\_rw() 用法
    
-   core: removed platform awareness with a more appropriate probe for install media  
    核心功能：移除了平台感知功能，轉而使用更合適的安裝介質探測方法
    
-   core: removed all remnants of the old firmware update code  
    核心：已移除所有舊韌體更新程式碼的殘留部分
    
-   core: completely rewrote the config.xml handling to unify old and new GUI components  
    核心：完全重寫了 config.xml 的處理方式，以統一新舊GUI元件。
    
-   core: added support for config backup to Google Drive [\[3\]](https://wiki.opnsense.org/index.php/Manual:Backup_to_Google_Drive)  
    核心：新增對設定備份到 Google 雲端硬碟的支援 [\[3\]]( https://wiki.opnsense.org/index.php/Manual:Backup_to_Google_Drive )
    
-   core: fixed a few config handling issues with the new system via 15.1.8.1  
    核心：透過15.1.8.1修復了新系統中的一些配置處理問題
    
-   core: fixed missing aliases in new config system via 15.1.8.2  
    核心：透過15.1.8.2修復了新配置系統中缺少的別名
    
-   core: removed php-fpm remnants that would e.g. prevent automatic IP assignment in DHCP mode via 15.1.8.2  
    核心：移除了 php-fpm 的殘留項，這些殘留項會阻止透過IP在DHCP模式下自動分配15.1.8.2
    
-   packages: removed the legacy package system  
    軟體包：已移除舊版軟體包系統

    upnp：將預裝軟體包轉換為標準功能

    openvpn：已將客戶端匯出套件新增為標準功能

    dyndns：Duck DNS支持的一些後續工作

    防火牆日誌：修正了導致過濾器無法正常運作的錯誤。

    igmpproxy：修正了守護程式啟動問題

##### 15.1.7.2 (March 13, 2015)｜15.1.7.2 （2015年3月13日）

This week has been really quiet just like last week so we give you another tiny stable update in the style of “click-click-click-done”. Most notably, we’ve tracked down two issues with the package database being unavailable, resulting in “no updates available” situations. Thanks again to everyone who helped to debug and test this with us!

本週和上週一樣平靜，所以我們又以「點擊點擊完成」的方式發布了一個小型穩定更新。最值得一提的是，我們找到了兩個軟體包資料庫不可用的問題，這些問題導致了「無可用更新」的提示。再次感謝所有幫助我們調試和測試的朋友！

We are not aware of any security issues at this point. Our LibreSSL efforts continue with 15.1.7.2-LibreSSL later today and it seems to be an extended work in progress as we uncover just how deep OpenSSL is tied into the FreeBSD ecosystem. Needless to say it shouldn’t be this way, but we’re getting there step by step.

目前我們尚未發現任何安全問題。我們將繼續推進 LibreSSL 的開發工作，並將於今天稍晚發布15.1.7.2 -LibreSSL。由於我們仍在不斷探索 OpenSSL 與 FreeBSD 生態系統的緊密聯繫，這項工作似乎仍將持續進行。毋庸置疑，這種情況不應該發生，但我們正在一步步地前進。

For everybody running 15.1.7.1 that might be a good opportunity to try the root console menu option 12 to update in one single go (including available base updates). It can also be invoked via SSH if you are into that sort of headless/remote workflow.

對於所有運行15.1.7.1的用戶來說，這或許是一個嘗試使用根控制台選單選項 12 進行一次性更新（包括所有可用的基礎更新）的好機會。如果您喜歡無頭/遠端工作流程，也可以透過SSH呼叫此功能。

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   bsdinstaller: fixed the package database wipe on custom install  
    bsdinstaller：修正了自訂安裝時軟體包資料庫被清除的問題
    
-   bsdinstaller: install progress bar is now more responsive with regard to individual directories in /usr  
    bsdinstaller：安裝進度條現在對 /usr 目錄下的各個目錄反應更靈敏。
    
-   firmware: removed obsoleted upgrade code and tools following our pkgng/opnsense-update approach  
    韌體：根據我們的 pkgng/opnsense-update 方法，移除了過時的升級程式碼和工具。
    
-   miniupnpd: now properly links to the OpenSSL/LibreSSL port  
    miniupnpd：現在可以正確連結到 OpenSSL/LibreSSL 連接埠
    
-   ipmitool: now properly links to the OpenSSL/LibreSSL port  
    ipmitool：現在可以正確連結到 OpenSSL/LibreSSL 連接埠
    
-   core: extensive cleanups for PHP shebang usage, wiped numerous unused scripts and unreachable web pages, removed PBI remnants, removed ‘tmp\_path’ softcoding to improve readability and git-grep(1) experience, removed stale debug statement that were only marginally useful while bumping the statements to default that indicate real errors  
    核心：對PHP shebang 的使用進行了全面清理，清除了大量未使用的腳本和無法訪問的網頁，移除了PBI殘留項，移除了 'tmp\_path' 的軟編碼以提高代碼可讀性和 git-grep(1) 的使用短語真正指示了僅有用的句子，並將略微指向錯誤（1) 的使用語句的錯誤指示和句子，並將略微指向錯誤。
    
-   shell: fixed halt script permissions and switched to synchronous mode  
    shell：修復了停止腳本權限並切換到同步模式
    
-   sysctl: added net.inet6.ip6.rfc6204w3 to improve the DHCPv6 experience  
    sysctl：新增了 net.inet6.ip6.rfc6204w3 以改善 DHCPv6 體驗
    
-   nat: remove target IP hardcoding in automatic rules (props to pfSense for pointing that out to us)  
    nat：移除自動規則中硬編碼的目標IP （感謝pfSense指出這一點）
    
-   rc: fixed missing package database when using the MFS option for /var  
    rc：修正了使用 /var 的MFS選項時缺少軟體包資料庫的問題
    
-   configd: added a standard rc.d script for easy daemon control  
    configd：新增了一個標準的 rc.d 腳本，方便守護程式控制。
    
-   mvc: a lot of new code to support general infrastructure for upcoming porting of features, e.g. proxy feature  
    MVC：大量新程式碼用於支援即將移植的功能（例如代理功能）的通用基礎架構。
    
-   help: adjusted links in the help menu to use HTTPS and improved targeting  
    幫助：調整了幫助選單中的鏈接，使用HTTPS並改進了目標定位。

##### 15.1.7.1 (March 07, 2015)｜15.1.7.1 （2015年3月7日）

As things mature and confidence grows we are trying something new today: a lightweight and online-only stable update that addresses numerous GUI bugs uncovered by our users. We hope to continue this trend and thus keep asking for all kinds of feedback through the usual communication channels. Let’s build a better OPNsense together.

隨著系統日趨成熟，信心不斷增強，我們今天嘗試一種新的方案：一個輕量級的、僅在線推送的穩定版更新，旨在修復用戶反饋的眾多GUI漏洞。我們希望延續這一趨勢，並繼續透過常用的溝通管道收集各種回饋意見。讓我們攜手共建更美好的OPNsense。

There are no security issues we are aware of. The LibreSSL version will likely be available tomorrow.

我們目前尚未發現任何安全問題。 LibreSSL 版本預計將於明日發布。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   bsdinstaller: work towards embedded installations, e.g. Quick/Easy disk selection  
    bsdinstaller：致力於嵌入式安裝，例如快速/簡易磁碟選擇。
    
-   opnsense-update: added command line switches and a manual page for usability’s sake  
    opnsense-update：為了提高易用性，增加了命令列開關和手冊頁。
    
-   opnsense-update: will now remember that the base system is up to date  
    opnsense-update：現在會記住基礎系統已是最新版本。
    
-   ports: updated to LibreSSL 2.1.4 (for our experimental LibreSSL flavour only)  
    連接埠：已更新至 LibreSSL 2.1.4 （僅適用於我們的實驗性 LibreSSL 版本）
    
-   directory layout: collapsed the /conf -> /cf/conf magic into a simple /conf directory (needs a reboot to take effect)  
    目錄佈局：將 /conf -> /cf/conf 合併為一個簡單的 /conf 目錄（需要重新啟動才能生效）
    
-   certificates: consistently lowered the default lifetime to 1 year  
    證書：始終將預設有效期縮短至 1 年。
    
-   captive portal: fixed an issue that prevented traffic forwarding in some cases  
    強制門戶：修正了某些情況下阻止流量轉送的問題
    
-   nat: do not resolve aliases on display to stay consistent with rules page  
    nat：為了與規則頁面保持一致，請勿在顯示時解析別名。
    
-   console menu: rebuilt the firmware upgrade option 12 to work on top of our new pkgng/opnsense-update system  
    控制台選單：重新建構了韌體升級選項 12，使其能夠與我們新的 pkgng/opnsense-update 系統相容。
    
-   crash reporter: can now be found under Diagnostics and was extended to show all parsing errors. The send button is currently disabled but feel free to copy+paste the messages to push them through the usual channels.  
    崩潰報告器：現在可以在「診斷」標籤下找到，並且已擴展，可以顯示所有解析錯誤。發送按鈕目前已停用，但您可以複製貼上訊息，並透過常用管道發送。
    
-   rc: fixed numerous parse errors in files previously missed by the regression test  
    rc：修復了回歸測試之前遺漏的檔案中的大量解析錯誤
    
-   rc: DHCP lease and RRD graph persistency after reboot, halt and config import (reinstall)  
    rc： DHCP租約和RRD圖形在重啟、停止和配置導入（重新安裝）後的持久性
    
-   upnp: the shortcuts menu has been reintroduced

-   login: redirect after login now brings up the previously selected page

##### 15.1.7 (February 28, 2015)｜15.1.7 （2015年2月28日）

We are saddened by the news of Leonard Nimoy passing away. He has been an inspiration for many of us ever since Star Trek first flickered over the TV screens and all the years thereafter. What a strange world we’d live in if it weren’t for him? Thank you, Leonard, 15.1.7 is being released in your honour.

我們對倫納德·尼莫伊的離世深感悲痛。自從《星際迷航》首次在TV螢幕上播放以來，他一直是許多人的靈感源泉，並在之後的歲月裡激勵著我們。如果沒有他，我們的世界將會多麼不同？謝謝你，倫納德， 15.1.7發行正是為了紀念你。

As we move forward, we’ve found that 15.1.6.1’s new tool opnsense-update works really well for everybody and thus we are very happy with the new live upgrade path. To show you that we are super serious we are shipping the latest FreeBSD 10.1 release engineering and security advisories and encourage you to try it out. We also have numerous tweaks with regard to tightening security in Bind, OpenSSL, StrongSwan, OpenSSH as well as needed GUI fixes thanks to the steady stream of incoming reports. If you encounter an issue or even a slight hiccup, please let us know through any of the available channels.

隨著工作的推進，我們發現15.1.6.1的新工具 opnsense-update 對所有使用者都非常有效，因此我們對新的線上升級路徑感到非常滿意。為了表明我們的高度重視，我們發布了最新的 FreeBSD 10.1版本工程和安全公告，並鼓勵您進行試用。此外，由於不斷收到用戶回饋，我們也針對 Bind、OpenSSL、StrongSwan 和 OpenSSH 的安全性進行了多項調整，並修復了GUI中存在的問題。如果您遇到任何問題或即使是輕微的故障，請透過任何可用管道告知我們。

The images can be found here:

圖片可以在這裡找到：

[https://sourceforge.net/projects/opnsense/files/15.1.7/](https://sourceforge.net/projects/opnsense/files/15.1.7/)

How to upgrade:

如何升級：

Always backup your config. Do not try to go from the LibreSSL snapshot to OpenSSL. The parallel LibreSSL snapshot will be out by tomorrow.

務必備份您的配置。不要嘗試從 LibreSSL 快照版本切換到 O​​penSSL。 LibreSSL 的平行快照版本將於明天發布。

Do a clean install using the desired install media. You can always import the old configuration from the installer if you already have an older installation.

使用所需的安裝媒體進行全新安裝。如果您已有舊版本，可以隨時從安裝程式匯入舊配置。

Alternatively and experimentally, upgrade using the firmware update, then drop to a root shell and issue the following commands.

或者，您可以嘗試使用韌體更新進行升級，然後進入 root shell 並發出以下命令。

```
# # opnsense-update && reboot
```

At this point, using any of the two methods, you should be on OPNsense 15.1.7-78bdb9aef FreeBSD 10.1-RELEASE-p6.

此時，使用這兩種方法中的任何一種，您都應該在 OPNsense 15.1.7-78bdb9aef FreeBSD 10.1-RELEASE -p6 上。

This is the official change log:

這是官方變更日誌：

-   Fix integer overflow in IGMP protocol [\[1\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:04.igmp.asc)  
    修正IGMP協定中的整數溢位問題 [\[1\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-15:04.igmp.asc )
    
-   Fix vt(4) crash with improper ioctl parameters [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:01.vt.asc)  
    修正 vt(4) 因 ioctl 參數不正確而導致的崩潰 [\[2\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:01.vt.asc )
    
-   Updated base system OpenSSL to 1.0.1l [\[3\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:02.openssl.asc)  
    已將基礎系統 OpenSSL 更新至1.0 .1l [\[3\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:02.openssl.asc )
    
-   Fix freebsd-update libraries update ordering issue [\[4\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:03.freebsd-update.asc)  
    修正 freebsd-update 函式庫更新順序問題 [\[4\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-15:03.freebsd-update.asc )
    
-   Disabled OpenSSH’s High Performance SSH/SCP and None-Cipher extensions to follow up on several security-related discussions.  
    已停用 OpenSSH 的高效能SSH/SCP和無密碼擴展，以跟進幾個與安全相關的討論。
    
-   Switched from a heavy Bind installation to a lightweight one to reduce attack surface.  
    為了減少攻擊面，將原本笨重的 Bind 安裝方式換成了輕量級的安裝方式。
    
-   Removed and replaced the legacy `check_reload_status` daemon with a Python-based rewrite.  
    移除並取代了舊版`check_reload_status`守護進程，改用基於 Python 的重寫版本。
    
-   Fixed the auto-login console lockout regression introduced in 15.1.6.1.  
    修正了15.1.6.1中引入的自動登入控制台鎖定回歸問題。
    
-   Fixed a problem associated with OpenVPN not being able to read passwords from files.  
    修正了 OpenVPN 無法從檔案讀取密碼的問題。
    
-   Notable ports upgrades: bind-tools 9.10.2, strongswan 5.2.2\_1, curl 7.41 plus our LibreSSL fixes for mpd/libpdel.  
    值得注意的連接埠升級：bind-tools 9.10.2 、strongswan 5.2.2 \_1、curl 7.41以及我們針對 mpd/libpdel 的 LibreSSL 修復。
    
-   Removed PHP-FPM remnants from IPv6 and OpenVPN scripts.  
    從 IPv6 和 OpenVPN 腳本中移除PHP-FPM殘留資訊。
    
-   Fixed several OpenSSL invokes to use the latest port version as opposed to the base version.  
    修復了多個 OpenSSL 調用，使其使用最新連接埠版本而不是基本版本。
    
-   Improved memory/disc/swap usage on the dashboard.  
    改進了儀錶板上的記憶體/磁碟/交換空間使用情況。
    
-   Properly set DNS Resolver Advanced defaults.  
    正確設定DNS解析器進階預設值。
    
-   Fixed append of custom Unbound scripts.  
    修正了自訂 Unbound 腳本的追加問題。
    
-   Modified the root menu shell to pass through to a real shell when arguments are given.  
    修改了根選單 shell，使其在提供參數時能夠傳遞到真正的 shell。
    
-   Zapped the spurious “Array”（大批） prefix in user-defined aliases.  
    刪除了用戶自訂別名中錯誤的“Array”（大批）前綴。
    
-   Moved the bogons files fetch location to a local mirror.  
    已將 bogons 檔案取得位置移至本機鏡像。
    
-   The core.git development boot hook has been improved to properly include /usr/local/etc/rc changes.  
    core.git 開發啟動鉤子已改進，可以正確地包含 /usr/local/etc/rc 的變更。
    
-   All of our packages are now annotated as coming from our mirror as well as additional safeguards potentially allowing you to use additional FreeBSD packages on top of OPNsense.  
    我們所有的軟體包現在都標註為來自我們的鏡像，並且增加了額外的安全措施，可能允許您在 OPNsense 之上使用額外的 FreeBSD 軟體包。
    

##### 15.1.6.1 (February 21, 2015)｜15.1.6.1 （2015年2月21日）

QUICK UPDATE: A regression sneaked into the release that renders the console unusable when “System: Advanced: Admin Access: Console menu protection” is being disabled. As far as we can see, this does not effect anything but the console login so you should be able to log back in and recheck the option to get it back (even though you will have to type the username/password).

QUICK UPDATE ：本次發布版本中出現了一個回歸錯誤，當「系統：進階：管理員存取：控制台選單保護」選項被停用時，控制台將無法使用。據我們觀察，此錯誤僅影響控制台登錄，因此您應該可以重新登入並重新勾選該選項以恢復其功能（即使您需要手動輸入使用者名稱/密碼）。

What an intense week. The m0n0wall EoL announcement [\[1\]](http://m0n0.ch/wall/end_announcement.php) leaves us with a long TODO list that goes as far as realigning the project, especially in terms of lowering hardware requirements. We’re slowly getting there, but it has only been a week for us compared to m0n0wall’s 12 year track record. We ask for a little more time and for you to keep discussing challenges and opportunities through the available communication channels.

真是忙碌的一周。 m0n0wall 的生命週期結束公告 [\[1\]]( http://m0n0.ch/wall/end_announcement.php ) 給我們留下了一份長長的清單TODO ，其中甚至包括對項目進行重新調整，尤其是在降低硬體要求方面。我們正在逐步推進，但與 m0n0wall 長達 12 年的發展歷程相比，這只是一周的時間。我們懇請您再給我們一些時間，並繼續透過現有的溝通管道與我們討論挑戰和機會。

Speaking of track records, today we bring you 15.1.6.1, the extra one meaning we’ve caught 3 issues during the release process tests and had to essentially redo the whole thing. No idea if we keep this numbering trick or not, consider it a little experiment.

說到版本記錄，今天我們帶來的是15.1.6.1 ，多出來的那個「1」意味著我們在發布測試過程中發現了3個問題，不得不基本上重做整個版本。我們還沒決定是否繼續沿用這種編號方式，就當做個小實驗吧。

The highlights (TL;DR): We now run FreeBSD 10.1 with lots of driver updates and security patches on top, addressed two CVEs, introduce our base upgrade tool opnsense-update, new naming scheme for install images and IKEv1 for IPsec.

亮點（ TL;DR ）：我們現在運行 FreeBSD 10.1 ，並在此基礎上進行了大量驅動程式更新和安全補丁，解決了兩個 CVE，引入了我們的基礎升級工具 opnsense-update，新的安裝鏡像命名方案以及用於 IPsec 的 IKEv1。

Acquiring the release:

取得發行版：

[https://sourceforge.net/projects/opnsense/files/15.1.6.1/](https://sourceforge.net/projects/opnsense/files/15.1.6.1/)

Explaining the naming scheme:

解釋命名規則：

-   cdrom: ISO installer image with live system capabilities running in VGA-only mode  
    光碟： ISO安裝程式映像，具有即時系統功能，以VGA僅模式運行
    
-   vga: USB installer image with live system capabilities running in VGA-only mode  
    vga： USB安裝程式映像，具有即時系統功能，以VGA僅模式運行
    
-   serial: USB installer image with live system capabilities running in serial console (115200) mode with secondary VGA support (no kernel messages there though)  
    序號： USB安裝程式映像，具有即時系統功能，以串行控制台 (115200) 模式運行，並支援輔助VGA （但那裡沒有核心訊息）
    

Explaining (experimental) base upgrades:

解釋（實驗性）基地升級：

The preferred method for upgrades is still booting install media, importing the config through the installer and reinstalling as it is a clean fallback. Nevertheless, we’ve pushed a new tool that can be invoked manually on the command line after the firmware upgrade to 15.1.6.1 has been completed.

升級的首選方法仍然是使用安裝媒體啟動，透過安裝程式匯入配置並重新安裝，因為這是乾淨的回退方案。不過，我們也推出了一款新工具，可以在韌體升級到15.1.6.1完成後，透過命令列手動呼叫該工具。

To upgrade the base system, as root type

若要升級基礎系統，請以 root 使用者身分輸入

```
# # opnsense-update && reboot
```

The immediate reboot is mandatory, but you are in charge. Again, this is still experimental, so please report any bugs or strange behaviour running an older release that has been upgraded in this way. If all hell breaks loose, the config can still be recovered using the preferred upgrade method even when the system is broken during the upgrade. And you should always keep a backup of your config somewhere else…

立即重啟是強制性的，但您可以自行決定。再次強調，這仍處於實驗階段，因此如果您在使用這種方式升級的舊版本時遇到任何錯誤或異常行為，請及時報告。如果升級過程中系統發生故障，您仍然可以使用首選的升級方法來恢復配置。此外，您應該始終在其他位置備份您的配置。

##### 15.1.5 (February 10, 2015)｜15.1.5 （2015年2月10日）

We shifted the release back a couple of days to discuss current progress and the feedback we’ve gotten and directly review the release process – it seems to be “clean enough”. ;)

We’ve updated the bug trackers, added a couple of wiki pages and related articles with more on roadmap refinement on the way in a day or two. Thank you for all the responses and kind mentions.

This is a typical maintenance release with ports stable updates and various core fixes. On the other hand, we are putting a new MVC-based framework in place to slowly replace the current front end scripting (yep, this is a request for comments). Here is the full list of changes:

    修正了防火牆規則和系統頁面中的幾個小錯誤GUI 。
    
-   Grab the correct OpenSSL from the system for encrypting/decrypting the configuration files.  
    從系統中取得正確的 OpenSSL，用於加密/解密設定檔。
    
-   Message of the day now shows the correct system version.  
    每日訊息現在顯示正確的系統版本。
    
-   Fixed sorting and button for deleting selected rules in NAT pages.  
    修正了NAT頁面中排序和刪除選定規則的按鈕。

We proudly announce our next stable cut: It has been quite calm on the ports side of things, but there have been many commits in the core adding up to an incentive to upgrade as soon as possible. ##### 15.1 (January 02, 2015)｜15.1 （2015年1月2日）

The OPNsense core team is proud to announce that it has released its 15.1 version, nicknamed “Ascending Albatross”（上升的信天翁）, of the open source OPNsense firewall software.

OPNsense 核心團隊很榮幸地宣布，其開源 OPNsense 防火牆軟體的15.1版本（暱稱“Ascending Albatross”（上升的信天翁） ）已經發布。

This is the first release by the OPNsense project. Download [\[1\]](http://opnsense.org/download/) and try it now! Be sure to visit the project website [\[2\]](http://www.opnsense.org/) and learn more about us and the project. The project wants to be a friendly place for users, developers and partners.

這是 OPNsense 專案的首個版本。立即下載 [\[1\]]( http://opnsense.org/download/ ) 並體驗吧！請務必造訪專案網站 [\[2\]]( http://www.opnsense.org/ )，以了解更多關於我們和專案的資訊。該專案致力於打造一個對用戶、開發者和合作夥伴都友善的平台。

We believe that an open source project should keep its sources and build tools available for all. OPNsense uses the simple 2-clause BSD license.

我們認為，開源專案應該向所有人開放其原始碼和建置工具。 OPNsense 使用簡單的 2 條款BSD許可證。

Users benefit from the polished installer, rich feature set and modern user interface. Developers are invited to check out our easy-to-use build tools. Commercial Support assists in keeping networks fast and secure. The project welcomes partners to be successful together.

使用者可受惠於完善的安裝程式、豐富的功能集和現代化的使用者介面。我們誠摯邀請開發者體驗我們易於使用的建置工具。商業支援服務可確保網路快速安全。本計畫歡迎合作夥伴攜手共進，共創輝煌。

OPNsense(r) is based on FreeBSD 10 and is a fork of pfSense(r) which in its turn is a fork of m0n0wall(r).

OPNsense(r) 是基於 FreeBSD 10，是 pfSense(r) 的一個分支，而 pfSense(r) 又是 m0n0wall(r) 的一個分支。

The next major release is 15.7 and is to be released on July 1st 2015. Bug fixes and security patches will be released when available.

下一個主要版本是15.7 ，將於2015年7月1日發布。錯誤修復和安全補丁將在可用時發布。

##### 26.4.2 (August 14, 2026)｜26.4.2 （2026年8月14日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 26.1.11 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 26.1.11社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Please note that this release offers source NAT as a tentative replacement for outbound NAT. Feature parity is a work in progress for the 26.10 series. For now, please be aware that source NAT continues to work as before, but the GUI will not allow you to edit the source NAT rules unless you choose hybrid or manual mode in the settings. This aligns with how the outbound NAT page is working. Starting with 26.10, the hybrid or manual mode will be required to render source NAT rules into the firewall.

請注意，此版本提供的來源NAT暫定替代出站NAT系列的功能對等性仍在開發中。目前，請注意來源NAT仍​​可正常運作，但除非您在設定中選擇混合模式或手動模式，否則GUI將不允許您編輯來源NAT 26.10規則。這與出站NAT頁面的工作方式一致。從26.10開始，必須使用混合模式或手動模式才能將來源NAT規則渲染到防火牆中。

Here are the full patch notes for the initial release:

以下是初始版本的完整更新說明：

-   system: improve the log\_archive script to also work on log subdirectories  
    系統：改進 log\_archive 腳本，使其也能處理日誌子目錄
    
-   system: routing: changed “disable” option to “enable”  
    系統：路由：將“停用”選項變更為“啟用”
    
-   system: add “local\_uri” type in SanitizeFilter() and use it to avoid hardcoding  
    系統：在 SanitizeFilter() 中新增「local\_uri」類型，並使用它來避免硬編碼。
    
-   system: several compatible adjustments for upcoming PHP 8.5  
    系統：針對即將推出的PHP 8.5進行了多項相容調整
    
-   system: enhance live log widget (contributed by Greelan)  
    系統：增強即時日誌小工具（由 Greelan 提供）
    
-   system: support 7680 bit RSA type for certificates and authorities  
    系統：支援 7680 位元RSA類型的證書和授權機構
    
-   reporting: improve parsing in NetFlow for overlapping flow timestamps and use UTC for cleanups  
    報告：改進 NetFlow 中重疊流時間戳的解析，並使用UTC進行清理
    
-   reporting: stop NetFlow service before reloading configuration  
    報表：在重新載入設定之前停止 NetFlow 服務
    
-   interfaces: properly format API times to ISO format and convert timezone for display in automatic discovery  
    介面：正確格式化API時間至ISO格式，並轉換時區以便在自動發現中顯示。
    
-   interfaces: fix typos in GIF reconfiguration script  
    介面：修復GIF重配置腳本中的拼字錯誤
    
-   interfaces: improve VIP page save when no subnet was posted  
    介面：改進VIP頁面保存（當未發布子網路時）
    
-   firewall: use htmlSafe() on action search value in live log [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-9h93-hhcx-957c) (reported by call-AX)  
    防火牆：在即時日誌中對操作搜尋值使用 htmlSafe() [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-9h93-hhcx-957c )（由 call- AX報告）
    
-   firewall: always show automatic and legacy rules in new rules GUI  
    防火牆：在新規則中始終顯示自動規則和舊版規則GUI
    
-   firewall: add the same new rules GUI design to the MVC NAT pages  
    防火牆：將相同的新規則GUI設計加入到MVC NAT頁面
    
-   firewall: add CSV download/upload to MVC NAT pages  
    防火牆：將CSV下載/上傳新增至MVC NAT頁面
    
-   firewall: add migration for outbound NAT into source NAT page  
    防火牆：新增出站NAT到來源NAT頁面的遷移
    
-   firewall: destination NAT: display effective port when local-port is omitted  
    防火牆：目標NAT ：省略本機埠時顯示有效埠
    
-   firewall: source NAT: allow empty target which means the interface address  
    防火牆：來源NAT ：允許空目標，即介面位址
    
-   firewall: source NAT: skip rendering rules when mode is not advanced/manual or hybrid  
    防火牆：來源NAT ：當模式不是進階/手動或混合模式時，跳過渲染規則
    
-   firewall: improve performance on MVC pages using virtualDOM  
    防火牆：使用虛擬 DOM 提升MVC頁面的效能
    
-   firewall: allow WAN as “associated interface” for NPTv6 when prefix ID is set  
    防火牆：當設定前綴ID時，允許WAN作為 NPTv6 的「關聯介面」。
    
-   firewall: fix TypeError on alias getItem() with unknown UUID (contributed by haxorton)  
    防火牆：修正別名 getItem() 出現未知型別錯誤UUID （由 haxorton 提供）
    
-   firewall: show rule counts that can be exported and hide tab if no rules exist  
    防火牆：顯示可匯出的規則數量，如果沒有規則則隱藏選項卡。
    
-   firewall: improve interface filter logic to include floating rules with multiple interfaces when they overlap with at least one interface in the interface filter request  
    防火牆：改善介面過濾邏輯，以便在浮動規則與介面過濾請求中的至少一個介面重疊時，也能包含這些浮動規則。
    
-   firewall: add validations for “No RDR”（無 RDR） option to prevent target and local-port being set  
    防火牆：新增對“No RDR”（無 RDR）選項的驗證，以防止設定目標和本地端口

Here are the full patch notes for patch release 1:

以下是補丁版本 1 的完整更新說明：

-   system: configuration line injection via multiple GUI text fields [\[40\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-57154) (reported by lujiefsi)  
    系統：透過多個GUI文字欄位注入設定行 [\[40\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-57154 )（由 lujiefsi 報告）
    
-   system: add missing legacy\_html\_escape\_form\_data() for $a\_cert on administration settings [\[41\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58394) (reported by Jonas Ampferl of Hacking Cult)  
    系統：在管理設定中為 $a\_cert 新增缺少的 legacy\_html\_escape\_form\_data() [\[41\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58394 )（由 Hacking Cult 的 Jonas Ampferl 報告）
    
-   system: lockout: address newline injection and correct IP parsing [\[42\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-57155) (reported by lujiefsi)  
    系統：鎖定：解決換行符注入問題並修正IP解析 [\[42\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-57155 )（由 lujiefsi 報告）
    
-   system: hasPrivilege() not merging user privs correctly [\[43\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-p9pr-782r-w2xw) (reported by iys8)  
    系統：hasPrivilege() 未正確合併使用者權限 [\[43\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-p9pr-782r-w2xw ) (由 iys8 報告)
    
-   system: fix ACL pattern for carp\_status action (contributed by Etienne Girault)  
    系統：修復ACL carp\_status 操作模式（由 Etienne Girault 提供）
    
-   interfaces: prohibit the use of advanced DHCP option settings by non-administrators  
    介面：禁止非管理員使用進階DHCP選項設定
    
-   firewall: safeguard ISO country codes in alias download [\[44\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58394) (reported by Jonas Ampferl of Hacking Cult)  
    防火牆：保護別名下載中的國家代碼ISO [\[44\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58394 )（由 Hacking Cult 的 Jonas Ampferl 報告）
    
-   firewall: escape user-controlled values in tooltip attributes [\[45\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-2v2x-m4j7-76pv) (reported by Jonas Ampferl of Hacking Cult)  
    防火牆：轉義工具提示屬性中的使用者控制值 [\[45\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-2v2x-m4j7-76pv ) （由 Hacking Cult 的 Jonas Ampferl 報告）
    
-   firewall: unify group names of OpenVPN, WireGuard and IPsec encapsulation  
    防火牆：統一 OpenVPN、WireGuard 和 IPsec 封裝的群組名稱
    
-   firewall: skip alias on new rules GUI apply  
    防火牆：跳過新規則的別名GUI應用
    
-   captive portal: pass in ip\_address as a set for accounting  
    強制入口網站：傳入 ip_address 作為計費集合。
    
-   firmware: fix small glitch that re-prompts for showing community plugins  
    韌體：修正了重新提示顯示社群插件的小故障
    
-   network time: fix stored XSS in GPS init string display [\[46\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58392) (reported by Jonas Ampferl of Hacking Cult)  
    網路時間：修復儲存在GPS中的XSS初始化字串顯示 [\[46\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58392 )（由 Hacking Cult 的 Jonas Ampferl 報告）
    
-   openvpn: prevent path traversal in “common\_name” attribute [\[47\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58393) (reported by lujiefsi)  
    openvpn：阻止「common\_name」屬性中的路徑遍歷 [\[47\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58393 ) (lujiefsi 報告)
    
-   openvpn: escape client common\_name in connection-status views [\[48\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58390) (reported by Jan Kahmen of turningpoint and lujiefsi)  
    openvpn：在連線狀態檢視中轉義客戶端 common\_name [\[48\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58390 )（由 turnpoint 的 Jan Kahmen 和 lujiefsi 報告）
    
-   mvc: checkAndThrowValueInUse validate input token which may only contain alphanum and dashes [\[49\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-58395) (reported by Jonas Ampferl of Hacking Cult)

-   system: DTLSv1.1 is forcefully rejected by OpenSSL 3.5, migrate to DTLSv1.2

    系統：對CRL使用 serialNumberHex，以避免丟棄高位序號（由 chrstnth 提供）
    
-   system: lower max-request-size to roughly max post size in lighttpd configs [\[63\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-h4qj-j2x9-q553) (reported by lujiefsi)  
    系統：將 lighttpd 配置中的 max-request-size 降低到接近最大 post 大小 [\[63\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-h4qj-j2x9-q553 ) （由 lujiefsi 報告）
    
-   system: do not let the components selectpicker grow indefinitely in defaults page  
    系統：不要讓預設頁面中的元件選擇器無限增長
    
-   system: dashboard widget does not know about patch release syntax  
    系統：儀表板小工具不了解補丁發布語法
    
-   system: make LDAP auth adhere to bad login penalty as well (contributed by Matt Andreko)  
    系統：使LDAP身份驗證也遵循不良登入懲罰（由 Matt Andreko 提供）
    
-   reporting: do not show disabled interfaces in traffic graphs (contributed by Konstantinos Spartalis)  
    報告：流量圖中不應顯示已停用的介面（由 Konstantinos Spartalis 提供）
    
-   firewall: use “urgent” as empty default for firewall debug messages  
    防火牆：防火牆偵錯訊息的預設值為空，使用“緊急”
    
-   firewall: invalidate rule stats cache for firewall utilities API endpoint  
    防火牆：使防火牆實用程式的規則統計快取失效API端點
    
-   captive portal: automatic block rule should be evaluated after the anti-lockout rule  
    強制門戶：自動阻止規則應在防鎖定規則之後進行評估。
    
-   firmware: remove overzealous cleansing in output\_cmd to unhide individual character progress  
    韌體：移除 output\_cmd 中過度清理以顯示單一字元進度
    
-   monit: use throwNotFullAdmin() to restrict monit GUI write access to full admins due to intended system wide execution rights

-   monit: fix mail-format and poll-time validation

-   openvpn: client export can export private keys for unlisted certificate references [\[64\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-rw63-4hw9-p4v7) (reported by iys8 and lujiefsi)

-   unbound: missing NetMaskAllowed=N on override address

    mvc：針對自訂操作缺少 throwReadOnly() 操作的情況，保護某些寫入操作 [\[65\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/core/security/advisories/GHSA-vw8q-pqq7-2q7v ) (lujiefsi 報告)

##### 26.4 (April 15, 2026)｜26.4 （2026年4月15日）

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 26.4 release including full MVC/API experience as automation rules have been promoted to the new rules GUI, Suricata with a new inline inspection mode using “divert”, assorted IPv6 reliability and feature improvements, router advertisements MVC/API, full code shell command escaping revamp, default IPv6 mode now using Dnsmsaq for client connectivity, Unbound blocklist source selection, an automatic host discovery service, captive portal IPv6 support plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此26.4 MVC/API ，包括完整的MVC/API體驗，自動化規則已升級到新規則GUI ，Suricata 具有使用「divert」的新內聯檢查模式，各種 IPv6 可靠性和功能改進，路由器通訊Dnsmsaq 進行用戶端連接，Unbound 黑名單來源選擇，自動主機發現服務，強制入口網站 IPv6 支援等等。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 26.1.6 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 26.1.6社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

A hotfix release was issued as 26.4\_14:

已發布熱修復版本26.4 \_14:

-   system: properly escape username in sync\_user.php command invoke [\[52\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-44194) (contributed by Konstantinos Spartalis)  
    系統：在 sync\_user.php 指令中正確轉義使用者名稱 invoke [\[52\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-44194 )（由 Konstantinos Spartalis 提供）
    
-   system: fix XMLRPC sync with VIP and “nosync” option  
    系統：修復XMLRPC與VIP同步問題以及「nosync」選項
    
-   interfaces: safeguard DHCPv4 settings against arbitrary command injection [\[53\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-45158) (reported by Kchigo)  
    介面：保護 DHCPv4 設定免受任意指令注入 [\[53\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2026-45158 ) (Kchigo 報告)
    
-   captive portal: re-introduce hash lookup for accounting purposes  
    強制門戶：重新引入用於會計目的的哈希查找
    
-   captive portal: reload IPFW on captive portal reconfigure too  
    強制門戶：重新載入IPFW也重新配置強制門戶
    
-   dnsmasq: ignore DHCP names for “wpad” to fix CERT Vulnerability VU#598349  
    dnsmasq：忽略「 DHCP 」的名稱以修復CERT # VU

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   ISC-DHCP moves to a plugin. It will be automatically installed during upgrades. It is not installed on new installations because it is not being used, but you can still install and keep using it.  
    ISC-DHCP已移至插件。升級時將自動安裝。新安裝時不會安裝，因為它未使用，但您仍然可以安裝並繼續使用它。
    
-   To accommodate the change away from ISC-DCHP defaults the “Track interface” IPv6 mode now has a sibling called “Identity Association”（身分關聯） which does the same except it is not automatically starting ISC-DHCPv6 and Radvd router advertisements to allow better interoperability with Kea and Dnsmasq setups.  
    為了適應從ISC-DCHP預設值「追蹤介面」IPv6 模式的改變，現在有一個名為“Identity Association”（身分關聯）的同級模式，它執行相同的操作，只是不會自動啟動ISC -DHCPv6 和 Radvd 路由器通告，從而更好地與 Kea 和 Dnsmasq 設定操作。
    
-   Dnsmasq is now the default for DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 as well as RA out of the box. One thing that the upstream software cannot cover is prefix delegation so that is no longer offered by default. Use another DHCPv6 server in this case.  
    Dnsmasq 現在是 DHCPv4、DHCPv6 和RA的預設 DHCP 服務。但上游軟體無法支援前綴委派，因此預設不再提供此功能。在這種情況下，請使用其他 DHCPv6 伺服器。
    
-   Due to command line execution safety concerns the historic functions mwexec\_bg() and mwexec() were removed. Make sure your custom code is not using them and use mwexecf(), mwexecfb() and mwexecfm() instead.  
    出於命令列執行安全性的考慮，已移除歷史函數 mwexec\_bg() 和 mwexec()。請確保您的自訂程式碼未使用它們，並改用 mwexecf()、mwexecfb() 和 mwexecfm()。
    
-   The function sessionClose() has also been removed from the MVC code and is no longer needed. Make sure to remove it from your custom code.  
    sessionClose() 函數已從MVC程式碼移除，不再需要。請確保從您的自訂程式碼中也移除它。
    
-   The custom.yaml support has been removed from intrusion detection. Please migrate to the newer /usr/local/etc/suricata/conf.d override directory.  
    入侵偵測功能已移除對 custom.yaml 的支援。請遷移到更新的 /usr/local/etc/suricata/conf.d 覆蓋目錄。
    
-   The new host discovery service “hostwatch” is enabled by default. You can always turn it off under Interfaces: Neighbors: Automatic Discovery if you so choose.  
    新的主機發現服務“hostwatch”預設為啟用。您可以隨時在“介面”>“鄰居”>“自動發現”中將其關閉。
    
-   The firewall migration page is not something you need to jump into right away. Please make yourself familiar with the new rules GUI first and check the documentation for incompatibilities. Single interface from the floating interface will not be considered “floating” in priorities.  
    您無需立即造訪防火牆遷移頁面。請先熟悉新規則GUI ，並查閱文件以了解是否存在不相容性。來自浮動介面的單一介面在優先權方面將不被視為“浮動”。
    
-   Firewall: NAT: Port Forwarding is now called “Destination NAT”（目標 NAT）. Firewall rule associations are no longer supported, but the old associated firewall rules remain in place with their last known configuration and can now be edited to suit future needs.  
    防火牆： NAT ：連接埠轉送現在稱為“Destination NAT”（目標 NAT） 。不再支援防火牆規則關聯，但舊的關聯防火牆規則及其最後已知的配置仍然保留，現在可以對其進行編輯以滿足未來的需求。
    
-   Firewall: NAT: Source NAT is from the set of pages formerly known as automation, but Outbound NAT is still the main page for these types of rules.  
    防火牆： NAT ：來源NAT來自以前稱為自動化的頁面集，但出站NAT仍然是這些類型規則的主要頁面。
    
-   Unbound blocklists are now the same between business and community version. This requires a manual reapply of the blocklists in order to use the new shared format.  
    企業版和社群版之間的非綁定黑名單現在保持一致。這意味著需要手動重新套用黑名單才能使用新的共享格式。

#### 25.10 Series｜25.10系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_25.10.html>

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 25.10 release including revamped frontend grid UI, experimental privilege separation for the GUI, a new and improved firewall automation GUI, performance enhancements especially for numerous aliases being used at once, OpenID Connect integration, captive portal backend rewrite, Greek as a new language, FreeBSD 14.3 plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此25.10版本，包括改進的前端網格UI、GUI的實驗性權限分離、新的和改進的防火牆自動化GUI、性能增強（特別是針對同時使用的多個人名14.3 還有更多。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

##### 25.10.2 (February 09, 2026)｜25.10.2 （2026年2月9日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 25.7.10 community version with additional reliability improvements, but without revamped Unbound blocklists for the time being.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 25.7.10社群版本，並增加了可靠性改進，但目前尚未改進 Unbound 封鎖清單。

Here are the full patch notes:

-   system: gateway monitor Shell class use et al

-   system: no longer back up DUID but add compatibility glue to opnsense-importer  
    系統：不再備份DUID ，但為 opnsense-importer 添加相容性粘合
    
-   system: replace exec() in config encrypt/decrypt  
    系統：在配置加密/解密中取代 exec()
    
-   system: replace history diff exec() with shell\_safe()  
    系統：將 history diff exec() 替換為 shell\_safe()
    
-   system: safe execution tweaks in rc.routing\_configure  
    系統：rc.routing_configure 中的安全執行調整
    
-   system: fix log keyword search regression introduced in 25.7.7  
    系統：修正25.7.7中引入的日誌關鍵字搜尋迴歸問題

    系統：清理並規範化範例 config.xml 文件

    系統：將網關程式碼中的“realif”變數替換為“device”變數

    系統：在即時橫幅中取代 exec() SSH探針

##### 25.10.1 (December 10, 2025)｜25.10.1 （2025年12月10日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 25.7.8 community version with additional reliability improvements, but without revamped Unbound blocklists for the time being.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 25.7.8社群版本，並增加了可靠性改進，但目前尚未改進 Unbound 封鎖清單。

Please be aware that during the update check the new package manager will be installed, but will fail to report the update status like it always had before and so you will end up with an error that will require checking for updates again. The fix is in this update, but impossible to install without upgrading the package manager first. We hope this will only be a minor inconvenience during the process.

請注意，在更新檢查過程中，新的軟體包管理器將被安裝，但它將無法像以前那樣報告更新狀態，因此您最終會遇到錯誤，需要再次檢查更新。此更新已修復此問題，但如果不先升級軟體套件管理器，則無法安裝此更新。我們希望這只會給您帶來一些小小的麻煩。

Also, Python has reported security issues of which a DoS in http.client could potentially affect existing installations given that an HTTP server sends a malicious response which “can consume a large amount of memory and CPU time and cause swapping”. Python has not released an update for version 3.11 at this point in time.

此外，Python 還報告了一些安全性問題，其中 http.client 中的HTTP服務攻擊 (DoS) 可能會影響現有安裝，因為伺服器會發送惡意回應，該回應「會消耗大量記憶體和時間CPU並導致交換」。截至目前，Python 尚未發布針對版本3.11更新。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: use new file\_safe() in two instances  
    系統：在兩個實例中使用 new file\_safe()
    
-   system: improve the HA VIP sync code  
    系統：改進HA VIP同步程式碼
    
-   system: simplify RRD backup code and remove exec() usage [\[1\]](https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2025-13698) (reported by Alex Williams from Pellera Technologies working with Trend Zero Day Initiative)  
    系統：簡化RRD備份程式碼並移除 exec() 使用 [\[1\]]( https://www.cve.org/cverecord?id=CVE-2025-13698 ) （由 Pellera Technologies 的 Alex Williams 與 Trend Zero Day Initiative 合作報告）
    
-   system: move valid\_from search criteria to log\_matcher for faster end of search  
    系統：將有效值從搜尋條件移至日誌匹配器，以加快搜尋結束速度。
    
-   system: use file\_safe() in gateway monitor watcher  
    系統：在網關監視器中使用 file\_safe()
    
-   system: refactor factory reset page to MVC and add a reset per component operating on models  
    系統：重構恢復出廠設定頁面至MVC ，並為每個運行於不同型號的組件新增重設選項。
    
-   system: fix a HA sync regression introduced in 25.7.6 that prevented a sync from succeeding in an edge case  
    系統：修正25.7.6中引入的HA同步迴歸問題，此問題導致在特定情況下同步無法成功。
    
-   system: defaults: properly delete empty model containers in the configuration  
    系統：預設值：正確刪除配置中的空模型容器
    
-   system: switch int/bool to string in gateway properties  
    系統：在網關屬性中將整數/布林值切換為字串
    
-   system: ignore TypeErrors when parsing log lines in the backend  
    系統：解析後端日誌行時忽略類型錯誤
    
-   system: replace various raw exec(), system(), passthru() and shell\_exec() calls with safer variants  
    系統：將各種原始的 exec()、system()、passthru() 和 shell\_exec() 呼叫替換為更安全的變體
