##### 25.10 (October 15, 2025)｜25.10 （2025年10月15日）

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 25.10 release including revamped frontend grid UI, experimental privilege separation for the GUI, a new and improved firewall automation GUI, performance enhancements especially for numerous aliases being used at once, OpenID Connect integration, captive portal backend rewrite, Greek as a new language, FreeBSD 14.3 plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此25.10版本，包括改進的前端網格UI 、實驗性的權限分離GUI 、全新改進的防火牆自動化GUI 、性能增強（尤其是在同時使用多個人名14.3等等。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 25.7.5 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 25.7.5社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: the setup wizard was rewritten using MVC/API  
    系統：設定精靈已使用MVC/API重寫。
    
-   system: change default DHCP use from ISC to Dnsmasq for factory reset and console port and address assignments  
    系統：將預設的DHCP用法從ISC更改為 Dnsmasq，用於恢復出廠設定以及控制台連接埠和位址分配。
    
-   system: numerous permission, ownership and directory alignments for web GUI privilege separation  
    系統：針對 Web GUI權限分離，提供了多種權限、所有權和目錄對齊方式
    
-   system: allow experimental feature to run web GUI privilege separated as “wwwonly” user  
    系統：允許實驗性功能以「wwwonly」使用者身分運行，web GUI權限已隔離
    
-   system: add a banner when trying to revert the privilege separated GUI back to root at run time  
    系統：嘗試在執行時間將權限GUI還原為 root 時新增橫幅
    
-   system: consistently use empty() checks on “blockbogons”, “blockpriv”, “dnsallowoverride” and “dnsallowoverride\_exclude”  
    系統：總是對「blockbogons」、「blockpriv」、「dnsallowoverride」和「dnsallowoverride\_exclude」使用 empty() 檢查
    
-   system: change default system domain to “internal” (contributed by Self-Hosting-Group)  
    系統：將預設系統網域變更為「internal」（由 Self-Hosting-Group 提供）
    
-   system: remove the “optional” notion of tunables known to the system  
    系統：移除系統中已知的可調參數的「可選」概念
    
-   system: enable kernel timestamps by default  
    系統：預設啟用核心時間戳
    
-   system: allow CSR to be downloaded from System/Trust/Certificates (contributed by Gavin Chappell)  
    系統：允許從 System/Trust/Certificates 下載CSR （由 Gavin Chappell 提供）
    
-   system: HTML decode entities when generating new QR code for user  
    系統： HTML在為使用者產生新程式碼時解碼實體QR
    
-   system: add missing timestamp formatter in snapshots  
    系統：在快照中新增缺少的時間戳格式化程序
    
-   system: prevent misconfigurations with the automatic user creation option  
    系統：透過自動建立使用者選項來防止配置錯誤
    
-   system: add pluginctl hook for cache\_flush  
    系統：新增用於快取刷新的 pluginctl 鉤子
    
-   system: rewrite wwwonly bootstrap procedure  
    系統：重寫 wwwonly 引導程序
    
-   system: allow authentication events from wwwonly user  
    系統：允許來自 wwwonly 使用者的身份驗證事件
    
-   system: fix two regressions due to stream output path safety addition  
    系統：修正因流輸出路徑安全新增而導致的兩個迴歸問題
    
-   system: fix reconfigure control on HA status page for small viewports  
    系統：修正小視窗下HA狀態頁面上的重新設定控件
    
-   system: add pluginctl -m and -v options for model migrations and validations calls  
    系統：為模型遷移和驗證呼叫新增 pluginctl -m 和 -v 選項
    
-   system: add “power off” backend action to GUI cron options  
    系統：將「關機」後端操作新增至GUI cron 選項
    
-   system: add the pfsync “defer” option to high availability  
    系統：為高可用性系統新增 pfsync 的「defer」選項
    
-   system: return both interfaces in a single call for get\_nameservers()  
    系統：在一次呼叫 get\_nameservers() 時傳回兩個介面
    
-   system: safeguard legacy local\_sync\_accounts() against malformed user entries  
    系統：保護舊版 local\_sync\_accounts() 免受格式錯誤的使用者條目的影響
    
-   system: change atrun interval to every minute  
    系統：將運行間隔變更為每分鐘
    
-   reporting: removed the unused second argument in getSystemHealthAction()  
    報表：已移除 getSystemHealthAction() 函數中未使用的第二個參數
    
-   reporting: renamed getRRDlistAction() to getRrdListAction()  
    報表：將 getRRDlistAction() 重新命名為 getRrdListAction()
    
-   reporting: fixed internal parameter names in insight graphs  
    報告：修復了洞察圖表中的內部參數名稱。
    
-   interfaces: fix media settings write issue since 24.7 as it would not apply when “autoselect” result already matched  
    介面：修正媒體設定寫入問題（自24.7起），因為當「自動選擇」結果已符合時，寫入作業將無法生效。
    
-   interfaces: removed defunct SLAAC tracking functionality (SLAAC on WAN still works fine)

-   interfaces: no longer fix improper WLAN clone naming at run time as it should be ensured by code for a long time now  
    介面：不再在運行時修復不正確的WLAN克隆命名，因為程式碼早已確保這一點。

    介面：移除函數 get\_configured\_carp\_interface\_list() 和 get\_configured\_ip\_aliases\_list()

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   The captive portal implementation moves from IPFW to PF. Check the technical details first, especially regarding the new ruleset behaviours. [\[45\]](#p-200)  
    強制門戶的實作從IPFW遷移到PF 。請先查看技術細節，特別是關於新規則集行為的部分。 [\[45\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/captiveportal.html )
    
-   Deprecated Google Drive backups due to upstream policy changes and moved to plugins for existing users.  
    由於上游政策變更，Google 雲端硬碟備份功能已棄用，現有用戶已將其遷移至插件。
    
-   API URLs registered in the default ACLs have been switched from “camelCase” to “snake\_case”.  
    API預設 ACL 中註冊的 URL 已從「駝峰式」切換為「蛇形式」。
    
-   API grid return values now offer “%field” for a value description when available. “field” will now always be the literal value from the configuration. The API previously returned a display value for some field types, but not all.  
    API 網格傳回值現在提供「%field」作為值描述（如果可用）。 「field」現在將始終是配置中的文字值。 API 之前傳回了某些欄位類型的顯示值，但不是全部。
    
-   Reverted tunables “hw.ibrs\_disable” and “vm.pmap.pti” to FreeBSD defaults when no explicit values have been set in tunables.  
    當未在可調參數中設定任何明確值時，將可調參數「hw.ibrs\_disable」和「vm.pmap.pti」還原為 FreeBSD 預設值。
    
-   Moved OpenVPN legacy to plugins as a first step to deprecation.  
    將 OpenVPN 的舊版本遷移到插件中，這是棄用的第一步。
    
-   Moved IPsec legacy to plugins as a first step to deprecation.  
    將 IPsec 傳統功能遷移到外掛程式中，作為棄用的第一步。

#### 25.4 Series｜25.4系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_25.4.html>

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 25.4 release including numerous MVC/API conversions, a new user self-service portal, user CSV import/export, improved security zones support and documentation, a new UI look with a light and dark theme, PHP 8.3, FreeBSD 14.2 plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此25.4版本，包括眾多MVC/API轉換、新的用戶自助服務入口網站、用戶CSV導入/匯出、改進的安全區域支援和文件、具有淺色和深色主題的新UI外觀14.2 PHP 8.3

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

##### 25.4.3 (September 03, 2025)｜25.4.3 （2025年9月3日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 25.4.2 business version with additional reliability improvements and adds Dnsmasq DHCP support.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 25.4.2商業版，並增加了可靠性改進和對 Dnsmasq DHCP支援。

A new US-based business mirror has been added. To accommodate upcoming certificate renewals our behaviour of libfetch CRL checking was slightly changed to omit a missing CRL warning on leaf certificates that certificate vendors do not typically offer in the first place. When certificates are going to be replaced on the business mirrors in October due to pending renewal all versions prior to 25.4.3 will print the spurious warning that no CRL was provided for the leaf certificate but CRL checking will still be carried out as usual and the warning will still be printed when a signing CA certificate does not publicly provide its CRL to check against.

新增了一個基於US的企業鏡像。為了適應即將到來的憑證續期，我們對 libfetch CRL檢查的行為進行了微調，不再針對憑證供應商通常不提供的葉子憑證發出缺少的CRL警告。由於證書即將續期，企業鏡像上的證書將於 10 月進行更換。在此之前的所有版本25.4.3都會列印一條虛假警告，提示葉子證書未提供CRL ，但CRL檢查仍將照常執行，並且當簽名CA證書未公開提供其CRL 。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: increase log file download timeout to prevent exit before data has returned  
    系統：增加日誌檔案下載逾時時間，以防止在資料返回之前退出
    
-   system: prevent misconfigurations with the “Automatic user creation” authentication option  
    系統：透過「自動建立使用者」身份驗證選項防止配置錯誤
    
-   system: prevent the root user from changing its name  
    系統：阻止 root 使用者更改其名稱
    
-   interfaces: capture netmap ring when listening on interfaces in netmap mode  
    介面：在 netmap 模式下監聽介面時捕捉 netmap 環
    
-   dnsmasq: add full DHCP/RA support  
    dnsmasq：新增完整的DHCP/RA支持
    
-   firmware: abort on what appear to be partial updates due to obscure file errors  
    韌體：由於疑似檔案錯誤，中止看似不完整的更新。
    
-   firmware: add US east coast mirror for business edition  
    韌體：新增US東海岸鏡像（商業版）
    
-   ipsec: passthrough networks setting missed “allow new” flag  
    IPsec：直通網路設定缺少「允許新」標誌
    
-   kea-dhcp: ignore encoding errors in lease parser  
    kea-dhcp：忽略租約解析器中的編碼錯誤
    
-   src: libfetch: ignore leaf certificates missing CRL which in practice is not offered by most authorities  
    src: libfetch: 忽略缺少的葉子證書CRL ，實際上大多數機構並不提供此證書。
    
-   src: libarchive: update to 3.8.1 to fix integer overflow leading to double free [\[1\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-25:07.libarchive.asc)  
    src: libarchive: 更新至3.8.1以修復整數溢位導致的雙重釋放 [\[1\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-25:07.libarchive.asc )
    
-   src: route: fix “route -n monitor” when its output is redirected [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-25:14.route.asc)  
    src: 路由: 修正「route -n monitor」在輸出重定向時的問題 [\[2\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-25:14.route.asc )

##### 25.4.2 (August 06, 2025)｜25.4.2 （2025年8月6日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 25.1.12 community version with additional reliability improvements, but without Dnsmasq DHCP support and without the captive portal backend switch.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 25.1.12社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進，但沒有 Dnsmasq DHCP支持，也沒有強制門戶後端切換。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: safeguard local\_group\_set() since users may not exist for valid reasons  
    系統：保護 local\_group\_set()，因為使用者可能由於正當理由而不存在。
    
-   system: fix regression in setGroupMembership()  
    系統：修正 setGroupMembership() 中的迴歸問題
    
-   system: add “Source Networks”（來源網路） option to groups to restrict connectivity to web GUI  
    系統：為群組新增“Source Networks”（來源網路）選項，以限制對 Web 的連線GUI
    
-   system: remove defunct “sshlogingroup” OpenSSH option because non-admins are no longer permitted shell access  
    系統：移除已失效的 OpenSSH 選項“sshlogingroup”，因為非管理者使用者不再被允許存取 shell。
    
-   system: reduce font size in thermal sensors widget tooltip (contributed by indeed-a-genius)  
    系統：減小熱感應器小工具工具提示中的字體大小（由 indeed-a-genius 提供）
    
-   system: allow access to cached watcher gateway status  
    系統：允許存取快取的監視網關狀態
    
-   system: implement “force\_down” failover support  
    系統：實現“強制關閉”故障轉移支持
    
-   system: implement base\_bootgrid\_table in user, group and priv templates  
    系統：在使用者、群組和權限範本中實作 base\_bootgrid\_table
    
-   system: balance fastcgi servers a bit better  
    系統：稍微平衡一下 FastCGI 伺服器
    
-   system: check private key matches provided certificate data  
    系統：檢查私鑰是否與提供的憑證資料匹配
    
-   system: introduce a “wwwonly” user and group and related privilege separation preparations  
    系統：引進「僅限www使用者」和使用者群組，並做好相關的權限分離準備
    
-   system: add minimalistic interface to support SSO authentication  
    系統：新增極簡介面以支援SSO身份驗證
    
-   system: refactor a couple of existing empty() tests to isEmpty()  
    系統：將幾個現有的 empty() 測試重構為 isEmpty()
    
-   system: refactor cache flush into system\_cache\_flush()  
    系統：將快取刷新重構為 system\_cache\_flush()
    
-   system: add backend call for returning timezones  
    系統：新增後端呼叫以返回時區訊息
    
-   system: fix “weight” default fallback causing non-string return in gateway status  
    系統：修正「weight」預設回退機制導致網關狀態回傳非字串的問題
    
-   system: fix route status removal buttons  
    系統：修復路線狀態移除按鈕
    
-   system: fix passing “arguments” as parameters for cron jobs  
    系統：修正將「參數」作為 cron 作業的參數傳遞的問題
    
-   system: add banner to HA sync and firmware page when proxy environment override is used  
    系統：當使用代理環境覆蓋時，請在HA同步和韌體頁面中新增橫幅
    
-   system: fix audit message strings  
    系統：修復審計訊息字串
    
-   system: add missing “kernel” application for remote logging  
    系統：新增缺少的「核心」應用程式以進行遠端日誌記錄

    介面：清理與VIP存取相關的冗餘函數

    介面：考慮重新載入時追蹤的介面和連結設備

    介面：將橋接配置轉換為MVC/API

    介面：重構 newwanip IPv4/v6 腳本以減少它們之間的差異
    
-   interfaces: do not call a description a “dmesg”  
    介面：不要將描述命名為“dmesg”。

    介面：放寬 dmesg 探測的正規表達式，以無縫支援 dmesg 時間戳

    介面：向 ifctl 新增更新模式

##### 25.4.1 (May 22, 2025)｜25.4.1 （2025年5月22日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 25.1.6 community version with additional reliability improvements, but without Dnsmasq DHCP support and the recent captive portal backend switch.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 25.1.6社區版本，並進行了額外的可靠性改進，但沒有 Dnsmasq DHCP支援和最近的強制門戶後端切換。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: extend XMLRPC “nosync” support to keep backup items for new cases  
    系統：擴充XMLRPC “nosync” 支持，以便為新案例保留備份項目
    
-   system: use RADIUS Message Authenticator by default  
    系統：預設使用RADIUS訊息驗證器
    
-   system: prevent recursion loop when CAs are cross-referencing each other  
    系統：防止 CA 之間相互引用時出現遞歸循環
    
-   system: fix off by one error due to line ending at the end of a log file  
    系統：修復了由於日誌檔案末尾的行結尾導致的差一錯誤
    
-   system: offer config directory to store locations for external certificates and support it in the certificates widget  
    系統：提供設定目錄以儲存外部憑證的位置，並在憑證小工具中支援該目錄。
    
-   system: allow multiple manual DNS search domains  
    系統：允許多個手動搜尋域DNS
    
-   system: fix gateway watcher backoff  
    系統：修復網關監視器退避
    
-   system: minor code cleanups in auth.inc  
    系統：對 auth.inc 中的程式碼進行了少量清理。
    
-   system: kill gateways states for failback scenario when a higher priority gateway goes back online  
    系統：當優先權較高的網關恢復上線時，終止故障復原場景下的網關狀態
    
-   system: update to latest tzdata content for time zones and ISO 3166 definitions  
    系統：將時區和ISO 3166 定義更新到最新的 tzdata 內容
    
-   system: clean up a number of unused functions  
    系統：清理一些未使用的功能
    
-   system: refactor a VIP access in auth.inc  
    系統：重構 auth.inc 中的VIP訪問
    
-   system: add field “boottime” to api/system/systemTime (contributed by eopo)  
    系統：在 api/system/systemTime 中新增欄位「boottime」（由 eopo 貢獻）
    
-   reporting: move NetFlow backend single\_pass to command line parameters for easier debugging  
    報表：將 NetFlow 後端單次傳遞移至命令列參數，以便於偵錯
    
-   reporting: use client time in traffic dashboard widget  
    報告：在流量儀錶板小工具中使用客戶端時間
    
-   reporting: replace insights totals chart with ChartJS variant  
    報告：將 Insights 總計圖表替換為 ChartJS 變體
    
-   reporting: minor style fixes and cleanups in health graphs  
    報告：對健康圖表進行了一些細微的樣式修正和清理。
    
-   interfaces: refactor bridge configuration backend  
    介面：重構橋接配置後端
    
-   interfaces: refactor wireless device assignment  
    介面：重構無線設備分配
    
-   interfaces: allow literal comma by escape sequence in DHCP advanced option modifiers  
    介面：允許在DHCP高階選項修飾符中使用轉義序列來表示字面逗號
    
-   interfaces: fix refresh button in ARP page  
    介面：修復ARP頁面中的刷新按鈕

##### 25.4 (April 09, 2025)｜25.4 （2025年4月9日）

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 25.4 release including numerous MVC/API conversions, a new user self-service portal, user CSV import/export, improved security zones support and documentation, a new UI look with a light and dark theme, PHP 8.3, FreeBSD 14.2 plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此25.4版本，包括眾多MVC/API轉換、新的用戶自助服務入口網站、用戶CSV導入/導出、改進的安全區域支援和文件、具有淺色和深色主題的新UI外觀、 PHP 8.3及14.2 。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 25.1.4 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 25.1.4社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: migrate user, group and privilege management to MVC/API  
    系統：將使用者、群組和權限管理遷移到MVC/API
    
-   system: remove the “disable integrated authentication” feature  
    系統：移除「停用整合驗證」功能
    
-   system: add “Default groups” option to add standard groups when a LDAP/RADIUS user logs in  
    系統：新增「預設群組」選項，以便在LDAP/RADIUS用戶登入時新增標準群組
    
-   system: remove the old manual LDAP importer  
    系統：移除舊的手動LDAP導入器
    
-   system: migrate HA status page to MVC/API  
    系統：將HA狀態頁面移轉到MVC/API
    
-   system: allow custom additions to sshd\_config (contributed by Neil Greatorex)  
    系統：允許向 sshd_config 新增自訂配置（由 Neil Greatorex 貢獻）
    
-   system: increase max-request-field-size for web GUI  
    系統：增加 Web 請求欄位的最大大小GUI
    
-   system: set tunable default for checksum offloading of the vtnet(4) driver to disabled (contributed by Patrick M. Hausen)  
    系統：將 vtnet(4) 驅動程式的校驗和卸載的可調預設值設為停用（由 Patrick M. Hausen 提供）
    
-   system: add support for RFC 5549 routes and refactor static route creation code  
    系統：新增對RFC 5549路由的支援並重構靜態路由建立程式碼
    
-   system: improve notification support to also allow persistent notifications and static banners  
    系統：改進通知支持，使其支援常駐通知和靜態橫幅廣告
    
-   system: add notifications for low disk space and OpenSSH file override use  
    系統：新增磁碟空間不足和 OpenSSH 檔案覆蓋使用情況的通知
    
-   system: migrate tunables page to MVC/API  
    系統：將可調參數頁面遷移到MVC/API
    
-   system: switch to temperature sensor caching  
    系統：切換到溫度感測器緩存
    
-   system: add certificate widget to track expiration dates and allow quick renewal  
    系統：新增證書小工具以追蹤到期日並允許快速續訂
    
-   system: remove deprecated “page-getserviceprovider”, “page-dashboard-all” and “page-system-groupmanager-addprivs” privileges  
    系統：移除已棄用的「page-getserviceprovider」、「page-dashboard-all」和「page-system-groupmanager-addprivs」權限
    
-   system: replace file\_get\_contents() with curl implementation in XMLRPC sync and add verifypeer option  
    系統：將XMLRPC同步中的 file\_get\_contents() 替換為 curl 實現，並新增 verifypeer 選項
    
-   system: add item edit links to several dashboard widgets  
    系統：在多個儀錶板小部件中新增項目編輯鏈接
    
-   system: prioritize index page and prevent redirection to a /api page on login  
    系統：優先顯示首頁，並防止登入時重定向到 /api 頁面
    
-   system: mute disk space status in case of live install media  
    系統：在即時安裝媒體的情況下，靜音磁碟空間狀態
    
-   system: optimize system status collection  
    系統：優化系統狀態擷取
    
-   system: exclude pchtherm thresholds temperature thresholds  
    系統：排除 pchtherm 閾值溫度閾值
    
-   system: update button wording on new HA status page  
    系統：更新新HA狀態頁面上的按鈕文字
    
-   system: adjust gateway widget to use the intended caching mechanism  
    系統：調整網關小工具以使用預期的快取機制
    
-   system: thermal sensors widget can now select individual sensors to display plus UX changes  
    系統：熱感應器小工具現在可以選擇要顯示的各個感測器，以及UX變化
    
-   system: handle dev.pchtherm temperatures in the thermal dashboard widget (contributed by Joe Roback)  
    系統：處理熱力儀錶板小部件中的 dev.pchtherm 溫度（由 Joe Roback 提供）
    
-   system: use new apply button partial in tunables page  
    系統：在可調參數頁面中使用新的應用程式按鈕局部視圖
    
-   system: move high availability option “disable preempt” to advanced mode  
    系統：將高可用性選項「停用搶佔」移至進階模式

    系統：理順 syslog-ng rc.d 腳本

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   The access management was rewritten in MVC and contains behavioural changes including not rendering UNIX accounts for non-shell users. The integrated authentication via PAM has been the default for a long time so the option to disable it has been removed. The manual LDAP importer is no longer available since LDAP/RADIUS authenticators support on-demand creation and default group setup option. The “page-system-groupmanager-addprivs” privilege was removed since the page does not exist anymore. A multi-purpose privilege editor has been added under the existing “page-system-usermanager-addprivs” instead.  
    存取管理功能已在MVC中重寫，並包含一些行為變更，例如不再為非 shell 使用者渲染UNIX帳戶。透過PAM集成的身份驗證長期以來一直是預設設置，因此已移除禁用選項。由於LDAP/RADIUS身份驗證器支援按需建立和預設群組設定選項，因此不再提供手動LDAP導入器。 「page-system-groupmanager-addprivs」權限已移除，因為該頁面已不存在。取而代之的是，在現有的「page-system-usermanager-addprivs」下新增了一個多用途權限編輯器。
    
-   PPP devices can no longer be configured on the interface settings page. To edit the device settings use the native PPP device edit page instead.  
    PPP設備無法再透過介面設定頁面進行設定。若要編輯設備設置，請改用PPP設備原生編輯頁面。

<a id="p-034"></a>

#### 24.10 Series｜24.10系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_24.10.html>

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 24.10 release including ZFS snapshot support via GUI/API, rewritten dashboard, system trust MVC/API support, GRE and GIF MVC/API support, NAT 1-to-1 MVC/API support, WireGuard QR code generator, dynamic IPsec VTI tunnel support, experimental OpenVPN DCO support, FreeBSD 14.1, Python 3.11 plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此版本。 24.10 發布包括 ZFS 透過快照支持 GUI/API重寫的儀表板，系統信任 MVC/API 支持， GRE 和 GIF MVC/API 支持， NAT 一對一 MVC/API 支援 WireGuard QR 代碼產生器，動態 IPsec VTI 支援隧道，實驗性 OpenVPN DCO 支援 FreeBSD 14.1， Python 3.11 還有更多。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

##### 24.10.2 (February 04, 2025)｜24.10.2 （2025年2月4日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 24.7.12 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 24.7.12社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: add a “time-loop” around authentication for failed attempts  
    系統：為失敗的身份驗證嘗試新增「時間循環」。
    
-   system: remove the SSL bundles in default locations  
    系統：移除預設位置的SSL捆綁包
    
-   system: prevent JS crashing out when dashboard widget title is not set  
    系統：防止儀表板小工具標題未設定時JS崩潰
    
-   system: use system instead of sample defaults when reverting tunables  
    系統：還原可調參數時，使用系統預設值而不是範例預設值。
    
-   system: report actual LAN address being used after factory reset  
    系統：報告恢復出廠設定後實際使用的LAN地址
    
-   system: fix TOTP regression when used with LDAP  
    系統：修正與LDAP一起使用時的TOTP迴歸問題
    
-   system: show multiple SAN entries when supplied by the certificate  
    系統：當憑證提供多個SAN條目時，顯示這些條目
    
-   system: traffic dashboard widget should persist interface identifiers  
    系統：交通儀錶板小工具應持久化介面識別碼。
    
-   system: reset dashboard widget options to the default if none of the options match  
    系統：如果沒有任何選項匹配，則將儀表板小部件選項重設為預設值
    
-   system: mismatch in returned “change” attribute for route toggle  
    系統：路由切換回傳的「change」屬性不匹配
    
-   system: suppress XML parse errors in announcement widget when forum is unreachable  
    系統：當論壇無法存取時，抑制公告小工具中的XML解析錯誤
    
-   system: catch PHP errors for Google Drive backups  
    系統：擷取 Google 雲端硬碟備份的PHP錯誤
    
-   system: ignore plugins\_interfaces() errors in write\_config()  
    系統：忽略 write_config() 中的 plugins_interfaces() 錯誤
    
-   system: fix snapshot ACL  
    系統：修復快照ACL
    
-   system: re-enable support for subjectAltName when creating CSRs  
    系統：重新啟用建立 CSR 時對 subjectAltName 的支持
    
-   system: remove spurious backup() during config revert  
    系統：在設定還原期間移除多餘的備份()
    
-   reporting: add daemon -f parameter to close file descriptors for NetFlow local capture (contributed by Ben Smithurst)  
    報告：為 NetFlow 本機擷取新增 daemon -f 參數以關閉檔案描述符（由 Ben Smithurst 提供）
    
-   interfaces: use Autoconf class to avoid raw ifctl file access  
    介面：使用 Autoconf 類別來避免直接存取 ifctl 文件
    
-   interfaces: remove ancient MAC address trickery to unbreak hostapd  
    介面：移除古老的MAC位址欺騙手段以修復 hostapd
    
-   interfaces: add missing neighbor and DNS lookup page ACL entries  
    介面：新增缺少的鄰居和DNS查找頁ACL條目
    
-   interfaces: PPP device page ACL missed getserviceproviders.php  
    介面： PPP設備頁面ACL缺少 getserviceproviders.php
    
-   interfaces: reload GUI in the background  
    介面：在背景重新載入GUI
    
-   dhcp: allow radvd to use /128 CARP VIP as source  
    dhcp：允許 radvd 使用 /128 CARP VIP作為源
    
-   firewall: remove faulty PPP exclusion in scrubbing rule creation  
    防火牆：移除清理規則建立過程中錯誤的PPP排除項
    
-   firmware: improved output helpers and associated cleanup in audit scripts  
    韌體：改進了審計腳本中的輸出輔助函數和相關清理工作
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update: add support for regression tests set  
    韌體：opnsense-update：新增對回歸測試集的支持
    
-   firmware: add “configctl firmware changelog current” backend command  
    韌體：新增“configctl firmware changelog current”後端命令
    
-   firmware: refactor lock/unlock scripts using new output helpers  
    韌體：使用新的輸出輔助函數重構鎖定/解鎖腳本
    
-   firmware: opnsense-code: support for origin selection during upgrade mode  
    韌體：opnsense-code：支援在升級模式下選擇來源
    
-   firmware: opnsense-patch: improve patch behaviour for non-default account/repositories combinations  
    韌體：opnsense-patch：改進非預設帳戶/儲存庫組合的補丁行為
    
-   firmware: fix the return value handling in the firmware option of the console menu  
    韌體：修復控制台選單韌體選項中的返回值處理問題
    
-   firmware: use output\_cmd/output\_txt helpers in remaining scripts  
    韌體：在其餘腳本中使用 output\_cmd/output\_txt 輔助函數。
    
-   firmware: disable duckdb migration for stable transition again  
    韌體：再次停用 DuckDB 遷移以實現穩定過渡
    
-   intrusion detection: limit stats.log logging (contributed by doktornotor)  
    入侵偵測：限制 stats.log 日誌記錄（由 doktornotor 提供）
    
-   ipsec: remove hashing algorithm from null cipher  
    IPsec：從空密碼中移除雜湊演算法
    
-   ipsec: fix mobile clients reload missing system.inc  
    ipsec：修正行動用戶端重新載入缺少的 system.inc 檔案的問題
    
-   isc-dhcp: IPv6 prefixes script can fail to restart (contributed by Ben Smithurst)  
    isc-dhcp：IPv6 前綴腳本可能無法重新啟動（由 Ben Smithurst 提供）
    
-   kea-dhcp: add dhcp-socket-type option (contributed by Till Niederauer)  
    kea-dhcp：新增 dhcp-socket-type 選項（由 Till Niederauer 貢獻）
    
-   kea-dhcp: add MAC formatter to leases page (contributed by cpalv)  
    kea-dhcp：在租約頁面中新增MAC格式化程序（由 cpalv 貢獻）
    
-   kea-dhcp: align hostname validation with manual host entries  
    kea-dhcp：使主機名稱驗證與手動主機條目保持一致
    
-   kea-dhcp: add “match-client-id” in subnet definitions  
    kea-dhcp：在子網路定義中加入“match-client-id”

##### 24.10.1 (November 27, 2024)｜24.10.1 （2024年11月27日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 24.7.9 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 24.7.9社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

We subsequently republished the images as 24.10.1 due to CRL verification issues in the initial 24.10 version which were quickly hotfixed, but could not easily be fixed in the existing images.

由於初始版本24.10中存在CRL驗證問題，我們隨後將這些圖像重新發佈為24.10.1 ，這些問題已迅速得到熱修復，但無法在現有圖像中輕易修復。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: remove obsolete banners from static pages  
    系統：從靜態頁面中移除過時的橫幅廣告
    
-   system: address CRL/cert subject hash mismatch during trust store rehash  
    系統：位址CRL /憑證主題哈希值在信任庫重新哈希期間不匹配
    
-   system: add missing MinProtocol in OpenSSL config template from trust settings  
    系統：在 OpenSSL 設定模板的信任設定中加入缺少的 MinProtocol
    
-   system: add SignatureAlgorithms option and fix minor form glitch in trust settings  
    系統：新增 SignatureAlgorithms 選項並修復信任設定中的小表單故障
    
-   system: sync certctl to FreeBSD 14.1 base code et al  
    系統：將 certctl 同步到 FreeBSD 14.1基本程式碼等
    
-   system: migrate authoritative bundle location to /usr/local/etc/ssl/cert.pem  
    系統：將權威憑證包位置移轉到 /usr/local/etc/ssl/cert.pem
    
-   system: flush the global OpenSSL configuration to /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf as well  
    系統：同時將全域 OpenSSL 設定刷新到 /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf
    
-   system: ignore gateway monitor status on boot when setting up routes  
    系統：啟動時設定路由時忽略網關監控狀態
    
-   system: fix IP address validation not being displayed in the gateway form  
    系統：修正IP位址驗證未顯示在網關表單中的問題
    
-   reporting: refactor existing RRD backend code  
    報告：重構現有RRD後端程式碼
    
-   reporting: isset() vs. empty() on RRD enable  
    報告： RRD啟用狀態下的 isset() 與 empty() 對比
    
-   reporting: fix regression in RRD temperature readings  
    報告：修復RRD溫度讀數中的回歸問題
    
-   reporting: ISO dates and logical ranges in health graphs (contributed by Roy Orbitson)  
    報告： ISO健康圖表中的日期和邏輯範圍（由 Roy Orbitson 提供）
    
-   interfaces: fix VXLAN interface being busy when vxlanlocal or vxlanremote is changed  
    介面：修正VXLAN當 vxlanlocal 或 vxlanremote 變更時介面繁忙的問題
    
-   interfaces: 6RD/6to4 route creation should be limited to IPv6  
    介面：6RD/6to4 路由建立應僅限於 IPv6
    
-   interfaces: parse part of SFP module information in legacy\_interfaces\_details()  
    interfaces: 解析 legacy\_interfaces\_details() 中SFP模組資訊的一部分
    
-   interfaces: kill defunct route-to states with the stale gateway IP  
    介面：使用過時的網關終止失效的路由狀態IP
    
-   firewall: add a note about stateless TCP during syncookie use  
    防火牆：新增關於 syncookie 使用期間無狀態TCP的說明
    
-   firewall: enhance validation that group name can not start or end with a digit  
    防火牆：增強驗證，確保群組名稱不能以數字開頭或結尾。
    
-   firewall: make loopback traffic stateful again to fix its use with syncookie option  
    防火牆：重新啟用環回流量狀態機制，以修復其與 syncookie 選項的相容性問題
    
-   firewall: add “Action”（行動） property to list of retrieved rules  
    防火牆：將“Action”（行動）屬性加入到已擷取規則清單中

    防火牆：使用 UUID 作為規則標籤以簡化跟踪

-   firmware: introduce config.sh and use it in launcher.sh and connection.sh  
    韌體：引入 config.sh 文件，並在 launcher.sh 和 connection.sh 文件中使用它。

##### 24.10 (October 17, 2024)｜24.10 （2024年10月17日）

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 24.10 release including ZFS snapshot support via GUI/API, rewritten dashboard, system trust MVC/API support, GRE and GIF MVC/API support, NAT 1-to-1 MVC/API support, WireGuard QR code generator, dynamic IPsec VTI tunnel support, experimental OpenVPN DCO support, FreeBSD 14.1, Python 3.11 plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此版本。 24.10 發布包括 ZFS 透過快照支持 GUI/API重寫的儀表板，系統信任 MVC/API 支持， GRE 和 GIF MVC/API 支持， NAT 一對一 MVC/API 支援 WireGuard QR 代碼產生器，動態 IPsec VTI 支援隧道，實驗性 OpenVPN DCO 支援 FreeBSD 14.1， Python 3.11 還有更多。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 24.7.6 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 24.7.6社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   The dashboard has been replaced. Widgets from the old format are no longer supported and need to be rewritten by the respective authors.  
    儀錶板已更換。舊格式的小部件不再受支持，需要由相應的作者重寫。
    
-   ISC DHCP will no longer reload DNS services on static mapping edits. This is for feature parity with Kea DHCP and avoiding cross-service complications. If you expect your static mappings to show up in a particular DNS service please restart this service manually.  
    ISC DHCP將不再在靜態映射編輯時重新載入DNS服務。這是為了與 Kea DHCP的功能保持一致，並避免跨服務衝突。如果您希望靜態映射顯示在特定的DNS服務中，請手動重新啟動該服務。

<a id="p-035"></a>

#### 24.4 Series｜24.4系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_24.4.html>

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 24.4 release including ports-based OpenSSL 3, Suricata 7, several MVC/API conversions, a new neighbor configuration feature for ARP/NDP, core inclusion of the os-firewall and os-wireguard plugins, CARP VHID tracking for OpenVPN and WireGuard, functional Kea DHCPv4 server with HA support plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此24.4版本，包括基於端口的 OpenSSL 3、Suricata 7、多個MVC/API轉換、 ARP/NDP的新鄰居配置功能、核心包含 os-firewall 和 os-wireguard 插件、 CARP VHID Open14 431追蹤、支援HA的功能性 Kea DHCPv4 伺服器等等。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

##### 24.4.3 (September 17, 2024)｜24.4.3 （2024年9月17日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 24.4.2 business version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 24.4.2商業版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: add snapshots (boot environments) support via MVC/API (contributed by Sheridan Computers)  
    系統：透過MVC/API新增快照（啟動環境）支援（由 Sheridan Computers 提供）
    
-   system: recover stuck monitors and offer a cron job  
    系統：恢復卡住的顯示器並提供定時任務
    
-   isc-dhcp: allow to disable a DHCPv6 server with faulty settings  
    isc-dhcp：允許停用設定錯誤的 DHCPv6 伺服器
    
-   openvpn: add close-on-exec flag to service lock file  
    openvpn：為服務鎖定檔案新增 close-on-exec 標誌
    
-   openvpn: add username field to the status page  
    openvpn：在狀態頁面新增使用者名字段
    
-   wireguard: add close-on-exec flag to service lock file  
    WireGuard：向服務鎖定檔案新增 close-on-exec 標誌
    
-   mvc: improve container field cloning  
    MVC：改進容器欄位克隆
    
-   ui: allow style tag on headers  
    ui：允許在標題上新增樣式標籤
    
-   ports: openssl 3.0.15 [\[1\]](https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/openssl-3.0/CHANGES.md)  
    ports: openssl 3.0.15 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/openssl-3.0/CHANGES.md )

##### 24.4.1 (June 20, 2024)｜24.4.1 （2024年6月20日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 24.1.8 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 24.1.8社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: fix maximum log file size being ignored when there is only one file  
    系統：修復只有一個日誌檔案時忽略最大日誌檔案大小的問題
    
-   system: make log rotate action available to Cron  
    系統：使日誌輪替操作可供 Cron 使用
    
-   system: remove get\_current\_theme() and improve static page templating  
    系統：移除 get\_current\_theme() 並改進靜態頁面模板
    
-   system: move radvd and rtsold to system log where they belong  
    系統：將 radvd 和 rtsold 移到它們所屬的系統日誌。
    
-   system: deny access to .core files from web GUI and disable core dumps by default  
    系統：禁止從 Web 存取 .core 檔案GUI並預設停用核心轉儲
    
-   system: move net.inet.icmp.drop\_redirect sysctl to automatic mode  
    系統：將 net.inet.icmp.drop\_redirect sysctl 設定為自動模式
    
-   system: add Google Drive configuration as an XMLRPC sync target  
    系統：將 Google 雲端硬碟配置新增為XMLRPC同步目標
    
-   system: do not create an interface route without an address  
    系統：請勿建立沒有位址的介面路由。
    
-   firewall: use the new $.replaceInputWithSelector() for source/destination networks in MVC filter pages  
    防火牆：在MVC過濾器頁面中使用新的 $.replaceInputWithSelector() 來取代來源/目標網絡
    
-   firewall: fix empty rule label rendered as “null” on sessions page  
    防火牆：修正會話頁面上空規則標籤顯示為「null」的問題
    
-   interfaces: give DAD another second of delay to finish for the IPv6 renew  
    介面：再給DAD再延遲一秒鐘，以便完成 IPv6 續約
    
-   interfaces: reword the gateway selector default and help text to describe its function more accurately  
    介面：重新措詞網關選擇器的預設值和幫助文本，以更準確地描述其功能。
    
-   interfaces: detect and ignore “detached” state for IPv6  
    介面：偵測並忽略 IPv6 的「分離」狀態
    
-   interfaces: remove unused imports from sockstat list  
    介面：從 sockstat 清單中移除未使用的導入
    
-   interfaces: in SLAAC tracking prevent accepting our own radvd configuration  
    介面：在SLAAC追蹤中阻止接受我們自己的 radvd 配置
    
-   firmware: change default fetch of changelog to 30 seconds  
    韌體：將預設取得變更日誌的時間變更為 30 秒
    
-   firmware: dump TLS information for firmware server(s) in use  
    韌體：轉儲正在使用的韌體伺服器的TLS訊息
    
-   ipsec: fix faulty “-” usage in URIs  
    IPsec：修正URI中「-」的錯誤用法
    
-   kea-dhcp: simplified the controller code  
    kea-dhcp：簡化了控制器程式碼
    
-   kea-dhcp: generate JSON payload from model  
    kea-dhcp：從模型產生JSON有效載荷
    
-   kea-dhcp: fix field separator for subnet domain search (contributed by KitKat31337)  
    kea-dhcp：修復子網域搜尋的字段分隔符號（由 KitKat31337 貢獻）
    
-   isc-dhcp: make private consumers actually private where it matters  
    isc-dhcp：在關鍵時刻真正保障私人用戶的隱私
    
-   isc-dhcp: take into account that multiple ia-pd can be delegated  
    isc-dhcp：請注意可以委派多個 ia-pd
    
-   openvpn: fix “attempt to read property…” in status page  
    openvpn：修正狀態頁面中的「嘗試讀取屬性…」問題
    
-   openvpn: safeguard config access in updown\_event.py  
    openvpn：保護 updown\_event.py 中的設定訪問
    
-   wireguard: pass endpoint to validator to avoid invalid QR code errors on mobile app  
    WireGuard：將端點傳遞給驗證器，以避免行動應用程式出現無效的QR程式碼錯誤
    
-   wireguard: add MTU when set on the instance  
    WireGuard：在實例上設定時加入MTU
    
-   wireguard: move validation to correct spot when no instance address and peer address was provided  
    WireGuard：當未提供實例位址和對等位址時，將驗證移至正確位置。
    
-   wireguard: also validate hostnames correctly in peer generator endpoint  
    WireGuard：也要正確驗證對等產生器端點中的主機名
    
-   unbound: change blocklist processing in \_blocklist\_reader()  
    未綁定：更改 \_blocklist\_reader() 中的封鎖清單處理
    
-   unbound: allow RFC 2181 compatible names in query forwarding  
    unbound：允許在查詢轉發中使用RFC 2181 相容名稱
    
-   backend: allow to query multiple sysctl queries at once  
    後端：允許同時查詢多個 sysctl 查詢
    
-   backend: resolve deprecation warnings for sre\_constants (contributed by MaxXor)  
    後端：解決 sre\_constants 的棄用警告（由 MaxXor 貢獻）
    
-   mvc: pass isFieldChanged() to children in ContainerField  
    mvc：將 isFieldChanged() 傳遞給 ContainerField 中的子項
    
-   mvc: replace PhalconFilterValidationException with OPNsenseBaseValidationException wrapper  
    mvc：將 PhalconFilterValidationException 替換為 OPNsenseBaseValidationException 包裝器
    
-   mvc: extend model implementation to ease legacy migrations  
    MVC：擴展模型實作以簡化舊版本遷移
    
-   mvc: change exception handling in runMigrations() to avoid mismatches in attributes being silently ignored  
    MVC：修改 runMigrations() 中的例外處理，避免屬性不符的情況被靜默忽略
    
-   mvc: refactor grid search to fetch descriptive values from the model instead of trying to reconstruct them  
    MVC：重構網格搜索，使其從模型中獲取描述性值，而不是嘗試重建這些值。
    
-   mvc: replace array\_map+strval for loop with cast to preserve execution time in BaseListField  
    mvc：將 BaseListField 中的 array\_map+strval for 迴圈替換為強制型別轉換，以節省執行時間
    
-   mvc: silence spurious validation message when explicitly asked to ignore them  
    MVC：明確要求忽略時，靜默顯示虛假驗證訊息
    
-   ui: fix bootgrid parsing of timestamp  
    ui：修正 bootgrid 對時間戳記的解析問題
    
-   ui: improve tokenizer paste behaviour  
    使用者介面：改進分詞器貼上行為
    
-   ui: prevent vertical modal overflows and instead present a scrollbar  
    使用者介面：防止垂直模態框溢出，而是顯示捲軸。
    
-   ui: add $.replaceInputWithSelector() action  
    ui：新增 $.replaceInputWithSelector() 操作
    
-   ui: handle static page CSRF without Phalcon  
    ui：處理靜態頁CSRF無需 Phalcon
    
-   ui: prevent word break for top level menu items  
    使用者介面：防止頂級選單項目換行

##### 24.4 (April 30, 2024)｜24.4 （2024年4月30日）

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 24.4 release including ports-based OpenSSL 3, Suricata 7, several MVC/API conversions, a new neighbor configuration feature for ARP/NDP, core inclusion of the os-firewall and os-wireguard plugins, CARP VHID tracking for OpenVPN and WireGuard, functional Kea DHCPv4 server with HA support plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此24.4版本，包括基於連接埠的 OpenSSL 3、Suricata 7、多個MVC/API轉換、 ARP/NDP的新鄰居設定功能、核心包含 os-firewall 和 os-wireguard Guard Guard CARP VHID 、P832追蹤、支援HA的功能性 Kea DHCPv4 伺服器等等。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 24.1.6 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 24.1.6社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   Audits and certifications are requiring us to restrict system accounts for non-administrators (without wheel group in particular). It will no longer be possible to use non-adminstrator accounts with shell access and permissions for sensitive files have been tightened to not be world-readable. This may cause custom tooling to stop working, but can easily be fixed by giving these required accounts the full administration rights.  
    稽核和認證要求我們限制非管理員使用者（特別是非 wheel 使用者群組）的系統帳戶。非管理員帳戶將無法再擁有 shell 存取權限，敏感檔案的權限也已收緊，不再對外公開。這可能會導致一些自訂工具無法正常運作，但可以透過賦予這些必要的帳戶完整的管理權限輕鬆解決。
    
-   ISC DHCP functionality is slowly being deprecated with the introduction of Kea as an alternative. The work to replace the tooling of ISC DHCP is ongoing, but feature sets will likely differ for a long time therefore. ISC DHCP Relay has been replaced with an OpenBSD-based code alternative and is now found under “DHCRelay”.  
    隨著 Kea 作為替代方案的引入，ISC DHCP 功能正在慢慢被棄用。替換ISC DHCP工具的工作正在進行中，但功能集可能會在很長一段時間內有所不同。 ISC DHCP Relay 已替換為基於 OpenBSD 的程式碼替代方案，現在可以在 “DHCRelay” 下找到。
    
-   The move to the FreeBSD ports version of OpenSSL 3.0 is included and may disrupt third party repository use until those have been fixed and rebuilt accordingly. Please note that we do not vet third party repositories and do not have control over them so their response time may vary.  
    遷移到 FreeBSD ports 版本的 OpenSSL 3.0已包含在內，這可能會導致第三方倉庫的使用受到影響，直到相關問題修復並重新建置為止。請注意，我們不審核第三方倉庫，也無法控制它們，因此它們的回應時間可能會有所不同。
    
-   The Squid web proxy functionality moves to a plugin and will no longer be installed by default for new installations. However, if you have Squid enabled the plugin will automatically be installed during the upgrade. There is no code difference in the implementation and integration of the plugin compared to the core version. The OPNProxy plugin is still available, but also moved to the community plugins due to this.  
    Squid Web代理功能已移至插件，新安裝的系統將不再預設安裝該功能。但是，如果您已啟用Squid，則升級過程中會自動安裝該外掛程式。該插件的實現和整合與核心版本在程式碼上沒有任何區別。 OPNProxy插件仍然可用，但由於上述原因也已移至社群插件。

#### 23.10 Series｜23.10系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_23.10.html>

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 23.10 release including numerous MVC/API conversions, the new OpenVPN “instances” configuration option, OpenVPN group alias support, deferred authentication for OpenVPN, FreeBSD 13.2, PHP 8.2, rewritten WireGuard kernel plugin plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此23.10版本，包括許多MVC/API轉換、新的 OpenVPN「實例」設定選項、OpenVPN 群組別名支援、OpenVPN 的延遲驗證、FreeBSD 13.2, PHP 8.2 、重寫的 WireGuard 核心外掛等等。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

##### 23.10.3 (March 28, 2024)｜23.10.3 （2024年3月28日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 23.7.12 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 23.7.12社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: fix handling of empty “serialusb” node set during import  
    系統：修正導入過程中處理空的「serialusb」節點集的問題
    
-   system: fix assorted PHP deprecation warnings  
    系統：修復各種PHP棄用警告
    
-   system: add issuer and logo to OTP link  
    系統：將發行商和徽標添加到OTP鏈接
    
-   system: prevent empty “user” node to crash during boot  
    系統：防止空的「用戶」節點在啟動過程中崩潰
    
-   system: allow 0 length voucher passwords in authentication server  
    系統：允許身分驗證伺服器中使用長度為 0 的憑證密碼
    
-   reporting: update traffic graph colors to be contrast and consistent (contributed by brotherla)  
    報告：更新交通圖表顏色，使其對比度更高且更一致（由 brotherla 提供）
    
-   interfaces: add missing ACL entries for ARP/NDP tables  
    介面：為ARP/NDP表新增缺少的ACL條目
    
-   interfaces: prevent modal x-axis overflow on packet capture page  
    介面：防止封包擷取頁面上的模態 x 軸溢出
    
-   firewall: add optional advanced property “State policy” to influence state creation on a per rule base  
    防火牆：新增可選的進階屬性“狀態策略”，以根據規則庫影響狀態建立
    
-   firewall: change default traffic normalization behavior and choose “in” as standard direction for manual rules  
    防火牆：變更預設流量規範化行為，並將手動規則的標準方向選擇為「入」。
    
-   firewall: refactor schedule matching and fix an end-of-the-month bug  
    防火牆：重構計畫匹配機制並修復月底漏洞
    
-   firewall: fix incorrect packet counters statistics collection  
    防火牆：修復資料包計數器統計資訊收集錯誤的問題
    
-   firewall: fix virtual IP API use with subnet/subnet\_bits usage  
    防火牆：修復虛擬IP API與子網路/子網路位元使用的問題
    
-   firewall: fix floating rule display (contributed by lin-xianming)  
    防火牆：修復浮動規則顯示問題（由 lin-xianming 提供）
    
-   firewall: fix display of ICMP tooltip (contributed by lin-xianming)  
    防火牆：修復ICMP工具提示的顯示問題（由 lin-xianming 提供）
    
-   firewall: make select width more consistent on alias diagnostics table selection  
    防火牆：讓別名診斷表選擇中的選擇寬度更加一致
    
-   ipsec: show EAP-RADIUS settings only when legacy tunnels are being used  
    ipsec：僅當使用傳統隧道時才顯示EAP-RADIUS設置
    
-   unbound: prevent os.write() on None when another thread closed the pipe in Python module  
    unbound：防止在另一個執行緒關閉管道時，對 Python 模組中的 None 物件執行 os.write() 操作
    
-   unbound: make atomic copies of root.hints file to hopefully appease Unbound startup problems  
    Unbound：建立 root.hints 檔案的原子副本，以期解決 Unbound 啟動問題。
    
-   unbound: fix missing /lib nullfs mount in chroot  
    unbound：修正 chroot 環境中缺少 /lib nullfs 掛載的問題。
    
-   unbound: add aggressive-nsec option toggle (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    unbound：新增 aggressive-nsec 選項切換（由 kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   mvc: fix PHP\_FLOAT\_MIN being unreliable  
    mvc：修復PHP \_FLOAT\_MIN 不可靠
    
-   ui: replace all &gt; and &lt; occurrences in treeview (contributed by lin-xianming)  
    ui：取代樹狀視圖中所有 &gt; 和 &lt; 出現的位置（由 lin-xianming 提供）
    
-   ui: fix epoch support as number in bootgrid  
    ui：修復 bootgrid 中對 epoch 作為數字的支持
    
-   plugins: os-OPNProxy 1.0.4 removes ident support  
    插件：os-OPNProxy 1.0.4移除 ident 支援
    
-   plugins: os-OPNWAF 1.3 adds SSLVerifyDepth  
    外掛：os- OPNWAF 1.3新增 SSLVerifyDepth
    
-   ports: curl 8.6.0 [\[1\]](https://curl.se/changes.html#8_6_0)  
    ports: curl 8.6.0 [\[1\]]( https://curl.se/changes.html#8_6_0 )
    
-   ports: suricata 6.0.17 [\[2\]](https://suricata.io/2024/03/19/suricata-7-0-4-and-6-0-17-released/)  
    埠：suricata 6.0.17 [\[2\]]( https://suricata.io/2024/03/19/suricata-7-0-4-and-6-0-17-released/ )
    
-   ports: unbound 1.19.3 [\[3\]](https://nlnetlabs.nl/projects/unbound/download/#unbound-1-19-3)  
    埠：未綁定1.19.3 [\[3\]]( https://nlnetlabs.nl/projects/unbound/download/#unbound-1-19-3 )
    

A hotfix release was issued as 23.10.3\_1:

已發布熱修復版本23.10.3 \_1:

-   firmware: add fingerprint, migration notes and upgrade hint for 24.4  
    韌體：為24.4添加指紋、遷移說明和升級提示
    

##### 23.10.2 (February 02, 2024)｜23.10.2 （2024年2月2日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 23.7.12 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 23.7.12社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: add an optional random delay before executing remote backups  
    系統：在執行遠端備份之前會新增可選的隨機延遲。
    
-   system: fix regression in log viewer level selector  
    系統：修正日誌檢視器等級選擇器中的迴歸問題
    
-   system: implement relevant certctl tool functionality in Python to increase performance  
    系統：用 Python 實現相關的 certctl 工具功能以提高效能
    
-   system: fix log severity selector (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：修正日誌嚴重性選擇器（由 kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: include IPv6 link-local interface addresses for web GUI and OpenSSH (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    系統：包含 Web GUI和 OpenSSH 的 IPv6 連結本地介面位址（由 Maurice Walker 貢獻）
    
-   system: update cron and gateways model  
    系統：更新 cron 和網關模型
    
-   system: change ZFS transaction group defaults to avoid excessive disk wear [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/commit/269b9fbaf)  
    系統：更改ZFS事務組預設值以避免過度磁碟磨損 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/core/commit/269b9fbaf )
    
-   system: handle case insensitivity while reading groups  
    系統：處理讀取組時的大小寫不敏感問題
    
-   system: shuffle authentication templates to the end of login configuration  
    系統：將身份驗證範本移至登入設定的末尾
    
-   system: add “maxfilesize” option to enforce a log rotate when files exceed their limit  
    系統：新增“maxfilesize”選項，以便在檔案大小超過限制時強制執行日誌輪替。
    
-   reporting: OpenVPN server instances were missing from respective health graph  
    報告：OpenVPN 伺服器實例在對應的健康圖表中缺失。
    
-   reporting: assorted tweaks for the firmware upgrade script handling Unbound DNS database migration  
    報告：對韌體升級腳本處理 Unbound DNS資料庫遷移進行各種調整
    
-   interfaces: add new backend jobs and extend with optional parameter  
    介面：新增新的後端作業並擴展可選參數
    
-   interfaces: obey menu group sequence when specified  
    介面：依指定順序執行選單組順序
    
-   firewall: improve alias write behaviour by checking for changes beforehand  
    防火牆：透過預先檢查變更來改善別名寫入行為
    
-   firewall: fix preg\_replace() to avoid truncated network display in rules listing  
    防火牆：修正 preg\_replace() 函數，以避免規則清單中網路顯示被截斷
    
-   firewall: validate if GeoIP and BGP ASN targets contain at least 1 kb of data before assuming timestamp is correct  
    防火牆：在假定時間戳記正確之前，請先驗證 GeoIP 和BGP ASN目標是否包含至少 1 KB 的資料。
    
-   firewall: align GeoIP file check with documentation  
    防火牆：使 GeoIP 文件檢查與文件保持一致
    
-   firewall: add an ifconfig.debug file  
    防火牆：新增 ifconfig.debug 文件
    
-   captive portal: fix integer validation in vouchers  
    強制門戶：修復憑證中的整數驗證
    
-   dhcp: cache backend action “interface list macdb” to increase responsiveness  
    DHCP：快取後端操作「interface list macdb」以提高回應速度
    
-   dhcp: allow saving with invalid range when IPv4 server is disabled  
    DHCP：允許在 IPv4 伺服器停用時保存無效範圍的位址
    
-   dhcp: do not clobber $range\_to / $range\_from with the legacy test for lower 64 bit only input  
    dhcp：不要用僅針對低 64 位元輸入的舊版測試覆蓋 $range\_to / $range\_from
    
-   dhcp: improve the parsing code of IPv6 leases  
    DHCP：改進 IPv6 租約的解析程式碼
    
-   firmware: switch bogons/changelog set base URL to portable “opnsense-update -X” call  
    韌體：將 bogons/changelog set base URL切換為便攜式“opnsense-update -X”調用
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update: avoid rewriting .cshrc and .profile files on base set updates  
    韌體：opnsense-update：避免在基本集更新時重寫 .cshrc 和 .profile 文件
    
-   firmware: add audit messages for relevant API actions  
    韌體：為相關的API操作新增審核訊息
    
-   firmware: implement “always reboot” option  
    韌體：實現「始終重啟」選項
    
-   firmware: add unlocked mode to launcher script  
    韌體：在啟動器腳本中新增解鎖模式
    
-   firmware: use pluggable package repository scripts  
    韌體：使用可插拔軟體包倉庫腳本
    
-   firmware: automatically install os-squid plugin install when web proxy is enabled before major upgrade  
    韌體：在大版本升級前啟用 Web 代理程式時，自動安裝 os-squid 插件
    
-   firmware: refactor export and scrub Unbound DNS database before major upgrade  
    韌體：在大升級前重構導出並清理 Unbound DNS資料庫
    
-   firmware: disallow TLS lower than 1.3 on business mirror  
    韌體：禁止商業鏡像上的TLS低於1.3
    
-   intrusion detection: show rule origin in rule adjustments grid  
    入侵偵測：在規則調整網格中顯示規則來源
    
-   ipsec: add support for RADIUS class groups in instances  
    IPsec：在實例中加入對RADIUS類組的支持
    
-   ipsec: extend connection proposals tooltip to children and fix tooltip style issue  
    IPsec：將連線提議工具提示擴展到子項目並修復工具提示樣式問題
    
-   lang: assorted language updates  
    語言：各種語言更新
    
-   network time: prevent the service from listening on a wildcard when selecting specific interfaces (contributed by doktornotor)  
    網路時間：阻止服務在選擇特定介面時監聽通配符（由 doktornotor 提供）
    
-   openvpn: add virtual IPv6 address to widget and status page (contributed by cs-1)  
    openvpn：為小工具和狀態頁面新增虛擬 IPv6 位址（由 cs-1 貢獻）
    
-   openvpn: consider clients missing CARP VHID as disabled  
    openvpn：將缺少CARP VHID的客戶端視為已停用
    
-   openvpn: add validation for netmask greater than 29 exactly as specified in the OpenVPN source code  
    openvpn：新增大於 29 的子網路遮罩的驗證，完全按照 OpenVPN 原始碼中的定義進行操作。
    
-   openvpn: add workaround for net30/p2p smaller than /29 networks  
    OpenVPN：新增針對小於 /29 網路的 net30/p2p 網路的變通方案
    
-   unbound: use tls-system-cert instead of tls-cert-bundle  
    unbound：請使用 tls-system-cert 代替 tls-cert-bundle
    
-   unbound: replace JustDomains with Firebog blocklists (contributed by Amy Nagle)  
    unbound：將 JustDomains 替換為 Firebog 屏蔽清單（由 Amy Nagle 提供）
    
-   unbound: update root hints  
    unbound：更新根提示
    
-   backend: support streaming output using the “stream\_output” handler  
    後端：支援使用“stream\_output”處理程序進行串流輸出
    
-   backend: implement optional trust model and add extended logging  
    後端：實作可選的信任模型並新增擴充日誌記錄
    
-   backend: support optional configd configuration files  
    後端：支援可選的 configd 設定檔
    
-   backend: only parse stream results when configd socket could be opened  
    後端：僅當 configd 套接字可以開啟時才解析流結果
    
-   mvc: add an IPPortField type  
    mvc：新增 IPPortField 類型
    
-   mvc: split configdRun() in order to return a resource which the controller can stream with minimal memory consumption  
    MVC：拆分 configdRun() 函數，以便傳回控制器可以以最小記憶體消耗進行串流傳輸的資源。
    
-   ui: fix the missing dialog padding in some modals  
    使用者介面：修正某些模態方塊中對話方塊缺少內邊距的問題
    
-   ui: set a default data-size for increased readability in selectpickers  
    ui：設定預設資料大小，以提高選擇器的可讀性
    
-   ui: show tooltip when grid td content does not fit  
    使用者介面：當網格 td 內容超出範圍時顯示工具提示
    
-   ui: add double click event to tree view to render a grid dialog  
    使用者介面：向樹狀視圖新增雙擊事件，以渲染網格對話框
    
-   ui: upgrade jqTree to version 1.7.5  
    ui：將 jqTree 升級到版本1.7.5
    
-   plugins: os-OPNBEcore 1.3 adds “any interface” floating rule support  
    插件：os-OPNBEcore 1.3新增了「任意介面」浮動規則支援
    
-   plugins: os-OPNcentral 1.9 adds “any interface” floating rule support and fixes memory consumption with downloads  
    插件：os-OPNcentral 1.9添加了“任意界面”浮動規則支持，並修復了下載時的內存消耗問題。

##### 23.10.1 (December 13, 2023)｜23.10.1 （2023年12月13日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 23.7.9 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 23.7.9社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: rewrite trust integration for certctl use

##### 23.10 (October 17, 2023)｜23.10 （2023年10月17日）

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 23.10 release including numerous MVC/API conversions, the new OpenVPN “instances” configuration option, OpenVPN group alias support, deferred authentication for OpenVPN, FreeBSD 13.2, PHP 8.2, rewritten WireGuard kernel plugin plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此23.10版本，包括許多MVC/API轉換、新的 OpenVPN「實例」設定選項、OpenVPN 群組別名支援、OpenVPN 的延遲驗證、FreeBSD 13.2, PHP 8.2 、重寫的 WireGuard 核心外掛等等。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 23.7.6 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 23.7.6社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: introduce a gateway watcher service and fix issue with unhandled “loss” trigger when “delay” is also reported  
    系統：引入網關監視器服務，並修復當同時報告「延遲」時未處理的「丟包」觸發器問題
    
-   system: disable PHP deprecation notes due to Phalcon emitting such messages breaking the API responses  
    系統：停用PHP棄用說明，因為 Phalcon 會發出此類訊息，從而破壞API回應。
    
-   system: allow “.” DNS search domain override  
    系統：允許「.」 DNS搜尋域覆蓋
    
-   system: on boot let template generation wait for configd socket for up to 10 seconds  
    系統：啟動時，範本產生等待 configd 套接字最多 10 秒。
    
-   system: improve configuration import when interfaces or console settings do not match  
    系統：改進介面或控制台設定不符時的配置導入
    
-   system: add severity filter in system log widget (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：在系統日誌小工具中加入嚴重性篩選器（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: enabled web GUI compression (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：已啟用 Web GUI壓縮（由 kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   system: close boot file after probing to avoid lock inheritance  
    系統：探測完成後關閉啟動檔以避免鎖定繼承
    
-   system: fix lock() inheriting the lock state  
    系統：修復 lock() 繼承鎖定狀態的問題
    
-   system: give more context in process kill error case since we operate PID numbers only  
    系統：由於我們僅操作PID編號，因此請在進程終止錯誤情況下提供更多上下文資訊。
    
-   system: improve monitoring of down gateways  
    系統：改進故障網關的監控
    
-   system: clear all /var/run directories on bootup  
    系統：啟動時清除所有 /var/run 目錄
    
-   system: fix missing config save when RRD data is supplied during backup import  
    系統：修正在備份導入期間提供RRD資料時配置保存缺失的問題
    
-   system: defer config reload to SIGHUP in gateway watcher  
    系統：將設定重新載入延遲到網關監視器中的SIGHUP
    
-   system: handle “force\_down” state correctly in gateway watcher  
    系統：正確處理網關監視器中的「force\_down」狀態
    
-   system: make Gateways class argument optional  
    系統：將 Gateways 類別參數設為可選
    
-   system: correctly set RFC 5424 on remote TLS system logging  
    系統：已正確設定遠端RFC 5424 TLS系統日誌記錄
    
-   system: remove hasGateways() and write DHCP router option unconditionally  
    系統：移除 hasGateways() 並無條件寫入DHCP路由器選項
    
-   system: avoid plugin system for gateways monitor status fetch  
    系統：避免使用網關監控狀態取得的插件系統

    系統：移除在靜態頁面上向 Gateways 類別傳遞未使用的 ifconfig 數據

    系統：移除傳遞給網關類別的剩餘冗餘 ifconfig 數據

A hotfix release was issued as 23.10\_2:

已發布熱修復版本23.10 \_2:

-   system: detect a on/off password shift when syncing user accounts  
    系統：偵測使用者帳號同步時的密碼切換（開啟/關閉）
    
-   firewall: when migrating aliases make sure that nesting does not fail  
    防火牆：遷移別名時，請確保巢狀不會失敗
    
-   plugins: os-OPNWAF now requires a description for virtual servers  
    插件：os- OPNWAF現在需要虛擬伺服器的描述
    
-   plugins: os-radsecproxy fixes for stale rc script / pidfile issues  
    外掛程式：os-radsecproxy 修正了過期的 rc 腳本/pid 檔案問題
    

Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   The Unbound ACL now defaults to accept all traffic and no longer generates automatic entries. This was done to avoid connectivity issues on dynamic address setups – especially with VPN interfaces. If this is undesirable you can set it to default to block instead and add your manual entries to pass.  
    Unbound ACL現在預設接受所有流量，不再自動產生條目。這樣做是為了避免動態位址配置（尤其是VPN介面）出現連線問題。如果您不希望這樣，可以將其預設為阻止，並手動新增允許的條目。
    
-   Dpinger no longer triggers alarms on its own as its mechanism is too simplistic for loss and delay detection as provided by apinger a long time ago. Delay and loss triggers have been fixed and logging was improved. The rc.syshook facility “monitor” still exists but is only provided for compatibility reasons with existing user scripts.  
    Dpinger 不再自行觸發警報，因為它的機制太簡單，無法像 Apinger 那樣偵測丟包和延遲。延遲和丟包觸發機制已修復，日誌記錄也得到了改進。 rc.syshook 中的「monitor」功能仍然存在，但僅出於與現有使用者腳本的兼容性考慮而提供。
    
-   IPsec “tunnel settings” GUI is now deprecated and manual migration to the “connections” GUI is possible. There are currently no plans to remove the deprecated legacy component so it can be used without restriction.  
    IPsec「隧道設定」 GUI現已棄用，可手動遷移至「連線」 GUI 。目前沒有計劃移除已棄用的舊組件，因此可以不受限制地使用。
    
-   The new OpenVPN instances pages and API create an independent set of instances more closely following the upstream documentation of OpenVPN. Legacy client/server settings cannot be managed from the API and are not migrated, but will continue to work independently.  
    新的 OpenVPN 實例頁面和API創建了一組獨立的實例，這些實例更嚴格地遵循 OpenVPN 的上游文件。舊版客戶端/伺服器設定無法透過API進行管理，也不會被遷移，但將繼續獨立運作。
    
-   The old DynDNS plugin was removed in favor of the newer MVC/API plugin for ddclient. Ddclient used to be EoL for a few months this year but currently a new release is being prepared. We have since maintained a copy of the software and fixed bugs and shipped upstream patches as they became available in the development version. Also, a native Python backend is available in the same plugin which covers the Dyndns2 protocol, AWS Route 53, Azure, Cloudflare and DuckDNS.  
    舊的 DynDNS 插件已被移除，取而代之的是適用於 ddclient 的更新的MVC/API插件。 ddclient 今年曾一度停止維護數月，但目前正在準備發布新版本。我們一直維護著該軟體的副本，並在開發版本中修復了錯誤，並在有新補丁時將其提交到上游。此外，該插件還提供了一個原生 Python 後端，支援 Dyndns2 協定、 AWS Route 53、Azure、Cloudflare 和 DuckDNS。

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 23.4 release including Unbound DNS statistics, PHP 8.1, assorted FreeBSD networking updates, further MVC/API conversions, WireGuard kernel module plugin plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此23.4版本，包括 Unbound DNS統計資訊、 PHP 8.1各種 FreeBSD 網路更新、進一步的MVC/API轉換、WireGuard 核心模組外掛程式等等。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

##### 23.4.2 (August 04, 2023)｜23.4.2 （2023年8月4日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 23.1.11 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 23.1.11社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: improve RRD collector PID/service handling  
    系統：改良RRD收集器PID /服務處理
    
-   system: do not touch /var/run/booting if it exists (contributed by William Desportes)  
    系統：如果 /var/run/booting 存在，請勿修改（由 William Desportes 提供）
    
-   system: do a full transition on gateway group apply  
    系統：對網關群組應用執行完整轉換
    
-   system: automatically create core dump with installed debug kernel  
    系統：使用已安裝的調試核心自動建立核心轉儲
    
-   system: add RADIUS authentication support for MSCHAPv2 using Crypt\_CHAP\_MSv2()  
    系統：新增使用 Crypt\_CHAP\_MSv2() 對 MSCHAPv2 的RADIUS身份驗證支持
    
-   system: propagate error in rc.syshook scripts  
    系統：在 rc.syshook 腳本中傳播錯誤
    
-   system: use parse\_url() to validate if the provided login redirect string is actually parseable to prevent redirect  
    系統：使用 parse_url() 函數驗證提供的登入重定向字串是否可解析，以防止重定向。
    
-   system: fix assorted permission-after-write problems  
    系統：修復各種寫後權限問題
    
-   system: add opnsense-crypt utility to encrypt/decrypt a config.xml  
    系統：新增 opnsense-crypt 工具以加密/解密 config.xml 檔案。
    
-   system: call opnsense-crypt from opnsense-import to deal with encrypted imports  
    系統：從 opnsense-import 呼叫 opnsense-crypt 處理加密導入
    
-   system: do not allow state modification on GET for power off and reboot actions  
    系統：不允許對GET進行關機和重啟操作的狀態修改
    
-   system: better validation and escaping for cron commands  
    系統：改進了 cron 指令的驗證和轉義
    
-   system: better validation for logging user input  
    系統：改進使用者輸入日誌記錄的驗證
    
-   system: mute openssl errors pushed to stderr  
    系統：禁止將 openssl 錯誤推送至 stderr
    
-   system: name unknown tunables as “environment” as they could still be supported by e.g. the boot loader  
    系統：將未知可調參數命名為“環境”，因為它們可能仍然受到例如引導程式的支援。
    
-   system: sanitize $act parameter in trust pages  
    系統：清理信任頁面中的 $act 參數
    
-   interfaces: minor fixes in IP address status read  
    介面：修正了IP位址狀態讀取中的一些小問題
    
-   interfaces: additions for legacy\_interface\_stats()  
    interfaces: 為 legacy\_interface\_stats() 新增功能
    
-   interfaces: use interfaces\_primary\_address() during IPv4 renewal  
    介面：在 IPv4 續約期間使用 interfaces\_primary\_address()
    
-   interfaces: allow manual protocol selection for VLANs  
    介面：允許手動選擇 VLAN 協議
    
-   interfaces: remove null\_service toggle as empty service name in PPPoE works fine  
    介面：移除 null\_service 開關，因為 PPPoE 中空服務名稱可以正常運作。
    
-   interfaces: fix bug with reported number of flapping LAGG ports (contributed by Neil Greatorex)  
    介面：修復報告的抖動LAGG連接埠數量錯誤（由Neil Greatorex貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: introduce a lock and DAD timer into newwanip for IPv6  
    介面：在 newwanip 中為 IPv6 引入鎖定和DAD定時器
    
-   firewall: remove duplicate table definitions  
    防火牆：刪除重複的表格定義
    
-   firewall: prevent VIP address adding /32 on IPv6 rule selection  
    防火牆：阻止在 IPv6 規則選擇中新增VIP位址 /32
    
-   firewall: align rule validation with port forward validation  
    防火牆：將規則驗證與連接埠轉送驗證對齊
    
-   firewall: move all automatic rules for interface connectivity to priority 1  
    防火牆：將所有介面連線的自動規則優先權設為 1
    
-   firewall: “kill states in selection” button was hidden when selecting only a rule for state search  
    防火牆：僅選擇規則進行狀態搜尋時，「終止所選狀態」按鈕會隱藏
    
-   captive portal: safeguard template overlay distribution  
    強制門戶：保護模板疊加分發
    
-   dhcp: fix IPv6 lease page undefined vars and other issues  
    DHCP：修正 IPv6 租約頁未定義變數及其他問題
    
-   dhcp: share DUID parsing code via dhcpd\_parse\_duid()  
    dhcp：透過 dhcpd\_parse\_duid() 共享DUID解析程式碼
    
-   dhcp: revamp the prefix route handling also adding support for statically mapped downstream routers  
    DHCP：改進前綴路由處理，並增加對靜態映射下游路由器的支持
    
-   dhcp: validate client hostnames in Dnsmasq/Unbound lease watchers  
    dhcp：在 Dnsmasq/Unbound 租約監視器中驗證用戶端主機名
    
-   dhcp: fix validation for static entry requirement  
    DHCP：修復靜態條目要求的驗證
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update: move -K option to -x  
    韌體：opnsense-update：將 -K 選項移至 -x
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update: support deferred kernel set install  
    韌體：opnsense-update：支援延遲內核集安裝
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update: use -w option with -a option in fetch(1)  
    韌體：opnsense-update：在 fetch(1) 中使用 -w 選項和 -a 選項
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update: ensure kernel directory consistency  
    韌體：opnsense-update：確保內核目錄一致性
    
-   firmware: shift subscription key extract to “-x” option  
    韌體：將訂閱金鑰提取到“-x”選項
    
-   firmware: use post-upgrade hook and stage kernel as well for clean abort  
    韌體：使用升級後鉤子和暫存核心以實現乾淨的中止操作
    
-   firmware: sort plugins before store  
    韌體：在儲存前對插件進行排序
    
-   firmware: automatic kernel upgrade after reboot like base and package stages  
    韌體：重啟後自動核心升級，類似基礎階段和軟體包階段
    
-   firmware: sticky advanced mode if flavour is set to non-default  
    韌體：如果風味設定為非默認，則啟用高級模式。
    
-   firmware: properly escape crash reports shown  
    韌體：正確轉義崩潰報告
    
-   firmware: fix a faulty JSON construction during partial upgrade check  
    韌體：修復部分升級檢查期間出現的JSON構造錯誤
    
-   intrusion detection: add missing typecast in getAlertLogsAction()  
    入侵偵測：在 getAlertLogsAction() 中加入缺少的類型轉換
    
-   ipsec: add missing config section for HA sync  
    ipsec：為HA同步新增缺少的配置部分
    
-   ipsec: add passthrough networks when specified to prevent overlapping “connections” missing them  
    IPsec：在指定時新增直通網絡，以防止重疊的「連線」遺失。
    
-   ipsec: add RADIUS server selection for “Connections”（連接） when RADIUS is not defined in legacy tunnel configuration  
    ipsec：當傳統隧道配置中未定義RADIUS時，為“Connections”（連接）新增RADIUS伺服器選擇
    
-   ipsec: fix RSA key pair generation with size other than 2048  
    ipsec：修復RSA金鑰對產生問題，金鑰長度不能為 2048
    
-   openvpn: fix typo in widget for client timestamp display  
    openvpn：修正客戶端時間戳顯示小工具中的拼字錯誤
    
-   unbound: move unbound-blocklists.conf to configuration location  
    unbound：將 unbound-blocklists.conf 移到設定位置
    
-   backend: minor regression in deeper nested command structures in configd  
    後端：configd 中更深層嵌套的命令結構有輕微迴歸問題
    
-   mvc: fix locking regression that caused bulk changes to not being rendered correctly  
    MVC：修正了鎖定迴歸問題，該問題導致批次變更無法正確渲染。
    
-   mvc: properly support multi clause search phrases  
    MVC：正確支援多子句搜尋片語

    mvc：在 searchRecordsetBase() 排序時填入缺少的鍵

-   ui: remove noodp and noydir from HTML meta robots tag (contributed by William Desportes)

##### 23.4.1 (June 14, 2023)｜23.4.1 （2023年6月14日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 23.1.9 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 23.1.9社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: register DNS service ports for unified use across core and plugins  
    系統：註冊DNS服務端口，以便在核心和插件之間統一使用
    
-   system: serialize deferred requests for web GUI restart  
    系統：序列化 Web 延遲請求GUI重啟
    
-   system: relocate API messages to backend log target as they currently end up in captive portal logs  
    系統：將API訊息遷移到後端日誌目標，因為它們目前最終會出現在強制門戶日誌中。
    
-   system: allow non-system group delete after faulty PHP 8 warning fix (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：允許非系統群組在故障的PHP 8 警告後進行刪除（由 kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: restructure routing to carry out default gateway switching and address family specific reconfig  
    系統：重構路由以執行預設閘道切換和位址族特定重配置
    
-   system: prevent PHP session garbage collection from running early (contributed by lin-xianming)  
    系統：防止PHP會話垃圾回收提前運作（由 lin-xianming 貢獻）
    
-   system: finish simplifying plugins\_run()  
    系統：完成插件簡化\_run()
    
-   system: calling return\_down\_gateways() depends on default gateway switch setting  
    系統：呼叫 return_down_gateways() 取決於預設網關交換器設定
    
-   system: open new session if missing to prevent spurious CRSF errors in static pages  
    系統：如果會話缺失，則開啟新會話，以防止靜態頁面中出現虛假的CRSF錯誤
    
-   system: add device hint to empty interface address message in case of mismatch during default route attempt  
    系統：在預設路由嘗試期間出現不符情況時，向空介面位址訊息新增設備提示
    
-   system: add kernel messages to the general system log  
    系統：將核心訊息新增至通用系統日誌
    
-   system: make sure routing log messages all use “ROUTING:” prefix  
    系統：確保所有路由日誌訊息都使用“ ROUTING :”前綴
    
-   system: print warning for duplicated gateway name  
    系統：列印網關名稱重複的警告
    
-   system: prefix API key filename with FQDN of this host  
    系統：將此主機的API加入到FQDN金鑰檔案名稱前綴中
    
-   system: fix MVC service page with ID-based reload like OpenVPN  
    系統：修復MVC服務頁面，使其像 OpenVPN 一樣基於ID重新載入。
    
-   system: fix issue with route add command for far gateway static route (contributed by Daniel Mason)  
    系統：修正遠網關靜態路由的 route add 指令問題（由 Daniel Mason 提供）
    
-   system: improve static routes error handling  
    系統：改進靜態路由錯誤處理
    
-   system: fix a typo and align “attribute” use in gateway edit page  
    系統：修正網關編輯頁面中的拼字錯誤並調整「屬性」的使用方式
    
-   system: pluginctl: service mode can now batch-reload services when existing ID is omitted  
    系統：pluginctl：當省略現有ID時，服務模式現在可以批次重新載入服務
    
-   system: do not delete dpinger PID file  
    系統：請勿刪除 dpinger PID文件
    
-   reporting: sort interfaces by description in health graphs  
    報告：在健康圖表中按描述對介面進行排序
    
-   reporting: fix incorrect interface index in NetFlow init (contributed by Nicolas Thumann)  
    報告：修復 NetFlow 初始化中錯誤的介面索引（由 Nicolas Thumann 提供）
    
-   interfaces: ping diagnostic tool was rewritten using MVC/API  
    介面：ping 診斷工具已使用MVC/API重寫
    
-   interfaces: ensure single PPP netgraph node has the proper name  
    介面：確保單一PPP網路圖節點具有正確的名稱
    
-   interfaces: reject invalid self-assignments in VLAN parent  
    介面：拒絕VLAN父介面中的無效自賦值
    
-   interfaces: migrate trace route page to MVC/API  
    介面：將追蹤路由頁面遷移到MVC/API
    
-   interfaces: migrate port probe page to MVC/API  
    介面：將連接埠探測頁面遷移到MVC/API
    
-   interfaces: remove indirection in PPP ports handling  
    介面：移除PPP埠處理中的間接性
    
-   interfaces: exclude a few cases from PPPoEv6 negotiation  
    介面：從 PPPoEv6 協商中排除部分情況
    
-   interfaces: deal with “prefixv6” as an array  
    介面：將“prefixv6”作為數組處理
    
-   interfaces: improve address cleanup when handling VIP modifications  
    介面：改進處理VIP修改時的位址清理
    
-   interfaces: explicitly report current IP address during renewal avoidance  
    介面：在避免續約期間明確報告目前IP位址
    
-   interfaces: patch in appropriate rebind/renew DHCPv6 handling  
    介面：新增適當的 DHCPv6 重新綁定/續訂處理補丁
    
-   interfaces: for static “Use IPv4 connectivity” on PPPoE bring up IPv6 routes as well  
    介面：對於 PPPoE 上的靜態“使用 IPv4 連接”，也啟用 IPv6 路由。
    
-   interfaces: ifctl: fix typo causing content to be printed while adding it  
    介面：ifctl：修正了新增內容時導致列印內容的拼字錯誤
    
-   interfaces: ifctl: avoid null route on fragile /64 prefix delegation  
    介面：ifctl：避免在脆弱的 /64 前綴委託上出現空路由
    
-   interfaces: ifctl: do not flush name server routes  
    介面：ifctl：不要刷新名稱伺服器路由
    
-   interfaces: deal with RENEW and REBIND only reporting partial PDINFO  
    接口：僅處理RENEW和REBIND並報告部分PDINFO
    
-   firewall: allow to create aliases for logged-in OpenVPN users [\[1\]](#p-132)  
    防火牆：允許為已登入的 OpenVPN 使用者建立別名 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/aliases.html )
    
-   firewall: leave out fractional seconds from timestamps in aliases  
    防火牆：別名中的時間戳記省略小數秒
    
-   firewall: add missing scrub rules in dependency check for alias use  
    防火牆：在別名使用的依賴項檢查中新增缺少的清理規則
    
-   firewall: usability improvements and cleanups in scheduler pages (contributed by kuya1284)  
    防火牆：改善調度程序頁面的可用性並進行清理（kuya1284 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: add “set debug” and “set keepcounters” options to advanced options  
    防火牆：在進階選項中新增「set debug」和「set keepcounters」選項
    
-   firewall: simplify rule edit layout slightly and fix unused element ID  
    防火牆：略微簡化規則編輯佈局並修復未使用的元素ID
    
-   dhcp: fix too many addresses issue in radvd RDNSS setting  
    DHCP：修正 radvd RDNSS設定中的位址過多問題
    
-   dhcp: restart radvd on config changes, otherwise keep SIGHUP  
    dhcp：配置更改後重啟 radvd，否則保留SIGHUP
    
-   dhcp: when cleaning up static leases do not remove entries where only a MAC address is set  
    DHCP：清理靜態租約時，不要刪除僅設定了MAC位址的條目。
    
-   dhcp: provide run task “static\_mapping” to avoid polluting unrelated plugins  
    dhcp：提供運行任務“static\_mapping”，以避免污染無關外掛。
    
-   dhcp: remove ::/64 magic as it uses AdvRouterAddr yes  
    dhcp：移除 ::/64 魔法，因為它使用了 AdvRouterAddr 是
    
-   dnsmasq: use new run task “static\_mapping” to collect static mappings from DHCP  
    dnsmasq：使用新的運行任務「static\_mapping」從DHCP收集靜態映射
    
-   firmware: now that we have a full data model do not overdo cleanup during plugin registration  
    韌體：既然我們已經有了完整的資料模型，插件註冊期間就不要過度清理。
    
-   firmware: remove flavouring support from update tools  
    韌體：從更新工具中移除風味支持
    
-   firmware: update size requirements for major upgrades from command line  
    韌體：透過命令列進行主要升級的更新大小要求
    
-   firmware: embed build metadata into package annotations for use in runtime remote queries  
    韌體：將建置元資料嵌入到軟體包註解中，以便在執行時間遠端查詢中使用。
    
-   firmware: fix execution of version queries when not possible  
    韌體：修復版本查詢無法執行時的問題
    
-   firmware: revoke 22.10 fingerprint  
    韌體：撤銷22.10指紋

    入侵偵測：解析規則元資料時效能略有提升

##### 23.4 (April 25, 2023)｜23.4 （2023年4月25日）

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 23.4 release including Unbound DNS statistics, PHP 8.1, assorted FreeBSD networking updates, further MVC/API conversions, WireGuard kernel module plugin plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此23.4版本，包括 Unbound DNS統計資訊、 PHP 8.1各種 FreeBSD 網路更新、進一步的MVC/API轉換、WireGuard 核心模組外掛程式等等。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 23.1.5 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 23.1.5社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: replaced log\_error() use with log\_msg() and adjusted logging levels accordingly  
    系統：已將 log\_error() 的使用替換為 log\_msg()，並相應地調整了日誌等級。
    
-   system: introduced a service boot log  
    系統：引入了服務啟動日誌
    
-   system: simplify gateway monitoring setup code  
    系統：簡化網關監控設定代碼
    
-   system: add option to skip gateway monitor host route  
    系統：新增跳過網關監控主機路由的選項
    
-   system: populate /etc/hosts file with IPv6 addresses too  
    系統：也請用 IPv6 位址填入 /etc/hosts 文件
    
-   system: simplify and guard host route creation  
    系統：簡化和保護主機路由創建
    
-   system: merge system\_staticroutes\_configure() into system\_routing\_configure()  
    系統：將 system\_staticroutes\_configure() 合併到 system\_routing\_configure() 中
    
-   system: do not yield process after calling shutdown command  
    系統：呼叫關閉指令後不要放棄進程
    
-   system: apply tunables during late boot in case a module was loaded depending on them to be set to a specific value  
    系統：在啟動後期應用可調參數，以防某個模組載入時依賴這些參數被設定為特定值。
    
-   system: show size of ZFS ARC (adaptive replacement cache) in system widget  
    系統：在系統控制項中顯示ZFS ARC （自適應替換快取）的大小
    
-   system: introduce support tier annotations for core and plugins [\[2\]](#p-379)  
    系統：為核心和插件引入支持層註解 [\[2\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/support.html )
    
-   system: add cron tasks for scrubbing and trimming ZFS pools (contributed by Iain Henderson)  
    系統：新增用於清理和修剪ZFS池的 cron 任務（由 Iain Henderson 提供）
    
-   system: fix 6rd/6to4 gateway interface detection (contributed by Frans J Elliott)  
    系統：修復 6rd/6to4 網關介面偵測問題（由 Frans J Elliott 提供）
    
-   system: incorrect link to CARP status page on dashboard widget  
    系統：儀表板小工具上的CARP狀態頁面連結錯誤
    
-   system: replace single exec\_command() with new shell\_safe() wrapper  
    系統：將單一 exec\_command() 替換為新的 shell\_safe() 包裝器
    
-   system: fix assorted PHP 8.1 deprecation notes  
    系統：修復各種PHP 8.1棄用說明
    
-   system: remove overreaching “Reconfigure a plugin facility” cron job and backend command that has no visible users  
    系統：移除權限過大的「重新設定插件功能」定時任務和後端指令，此指令沒有可見使用者。
    
-   system: use singleton boot detection everywhere  
    系統：所有地方都使用單例啟動偵測
    
-   system: protect against more stray scripts on boot  
    系統：防止啟動時出現更多無關腳本
    
-   system: several shell\_safe() conversions  
    系統：多個 shell\_safe() 轉換
    
-   system: when applying auto-far default route make sure the local address is not empty  
    系統提示：套用自動遠距離預設路由時，請確保本機位址不為空。
    
-   system: refactor system\_default\_route() to prevent empty $gateway  
    系統：重構 system\_default\_route() 以防止 $gateway 為空
    
-   system: create system\_resolver\_configure() and cron job support  
    系統：建立 system\_resolver\_configure() 和 cron 作業支持
    
-   system: add simple script and configd action to list current group membership (configctl auth list groups)  
    系統：新增簡單腳本和 configd 操作以列出目前群組成員（configctl auth list groups）
    
-   system: prevent alias reload in routing reconfiguration like we do in rc.syshook monitor reload  
    系統：防止路由重新配置時像在 rc.syshook 監控重新載入中那樣重新載入別名。
    
-   system: address a number of web GUI startup problems  
    系統：解決一系列 Web GUI啟動問題
    
-   system: service handling refactor, tweaks and improvements  
    系統：服務處理重構、調整與改進
    
-   system: rework killbypid()/killbyname() behaviour  
    系統：重寫 killbypid()/killbyname() 的行為
    
-   system: use system\_resolver\_configure() everywhere  
    系統：所有地方都使用 system\_resolver\_configure()
    
-   system: timezone parsing issue for zones west of UTC using “-“  
    系統：使用「-」解析UTC以西區域的時區時區時出現問題
    
-   system: migrate services page and widget to MVC/API  
    系統：將服務頁面和小工具遷移到MVC/API
    
-   system: move web GUI service definition to correct file  
    系統：將 Web GUI服務定義移至正確的文件
    
-   system: add service\_by\_filter() service search extension  
    系統：新增 service\_by\_filter() 服務搜尋擴充
    
-   system: pin down the auto-far gateway selection and routing log adjustments  
    系統：確定自動遠距離網關選擇和路由日誌調整
    
-   system: prevent applying tunables which are already set  
    系統：阻止套用已設定的可調參數
    
-   system: use data attribute to find existing rows in service widget to avoid special character issues (contributed by Alexander O’Mara)  
    系統：使用資料屬性在服務小工具中尋找現有行，以避免特殊字元問題（Alexander O'Mara 貢獻）
    
-   system: handle empty DNS server gateway (contributed by Nicolas Thumann)  
    系統：處理空的DNS伺服器閘道（由Nicolas Thumann提供）

-   reporting: simplify state collection for system-states.rrd  
    報告：簡化 system-states.rrd 的狀態收集

    報告：轉換 NetFlow/Netgraph 使用的無效介面名稱字符

    介面：對無線設備整合進行大量清理
