Migration notes, known issues and limitations:

遷移說明、已知問題與限制：

-   StrongSwan IPsec configuration now uses the preferred swanctl.conf instead of the deprecated ipsec.conf which could lead to connectivity issues in ambiguous cases.  
    StrongSwan IPsec 設定現在使用首選的 swanctl.conf 而不是已棄用的 ipsec.conf，這可能會導致在不明確的情況下出現連線問題。
    
-   The new IPsec connections pages and API create an independent set of connections following the design of swanctl.conf. Legacy tunnel settings cannot be managed from the API and are not migrated.  
    新的 IPsec 連線頁面和API依照 swanctl.conf 的設計建立了一組獨立的連線。傳統的隧道設定無法透過API進行管理，也不會被遷移。
    
-   Rate limiting was removed from the captive portal which was set to 250 connections by the same IP to the captive portal itself. This can be easily replaced by a manual firewall rule with advanced options set, e.g. “Max established” set to 250 with destination “This Firewall”（此防火牆）.  
    已移除強制門戶的速率限制，此限制先前由相同規則IP設定為 250 個連線。這可以透過手動設定防火牆規則輕鬆替代，例如將「最大建立連線數」設定為 250，目標位址為“This Firewall”（此防火牆）並設定進階選項。

<a id="p-038"></a>

#### 22.10 Series｜22.10系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_22.10.html>

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 22.10 release including the upgrade to FreeBSD 13.1, PHP 8.0, Phalcon 5, MVC/API conversions for IPsec, Unbound and notifications, firewall alias support for BGP ASN, new APCUPSD and CrowdSec plugins plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此版本。 22.10 此次發布包括升級到 FreeBSD。 13.1, PHP 8.0獵鷹5號 MVC/API 支援 IPsec、Unbound 和通知的轉換，以及防火牆別名。 BGP ASN， 新的 APCUPSD 以及 CrowdSec 插件等等。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

##### 22.10.2 (February 20, 2023)｜22.10.2 （2023年2月20日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 22.7.11 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 22.7.11社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   interfaces: fix VLAN missing a config lock on delete  
    介面：修復VLAN刪除時缺少設定鎖定
    
-   firewall: do not switch gateway on bootup  
    防火牆：啟動時不要切換網關
    
-   intrusion detection: properly reset metadata response when no metadata is found  
    入侵偵測：當未發現元資料時，正確重置元資料響應。
    
-   unbound: missing global so that cache is never flushed when requested  
    未綁定：缺少全域變量，因此請求時快取永遠不會刷新。
    
-   mvc: cleanse $record input in searchRecordsetBase() before usage  
    mvc：使用前清理 searchRecordsetBase() 中的 $record 輸入
    
-   src: fix multiple OpenSSL vulnerabilities [\[1\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-23:03.openssl.asc)  
    src：修正多個 OpenSSL 漏洞 [\[1\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-23:03.openssl.asc )
    
-   src: geli: split the initialization of HMAC [\[2\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-23:01.geli.asc)  
    src: geli: 拆分HMAC [\[2\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-SA-23:01.geli.asc ) 的初始化
    
-   src: fix ena driver crash after reset in 7th gen AWS instance types [\[3\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-23:03.ena.asc)  
    src：修正第七代AWS實例類型 [\[3\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-23:03.ena.asc ) 重設後 ena 驅動程式崩潰的問題
    
-   src: fix sdhci broken write-protect settings [\[4\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-23:02.sdhci.asc)  
    src：修正 sdhci 損壞的寫入保護設定 [\[4\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-23:02.sdhci.asc )
    
-   src: import tzdata 2022g [\[5\]](https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-23:01.tzdata.asc)  
    src: import tzdata 2022g [\[5\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-23:01.tzdata.asc )
    
-   src: x86: ignore stepping for APL30 errata  
    src: x86: 忽略APL30勘誤表的單步執行
    
-   ports: openssl 1.1.1t [\[6\]](https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/openssl-3.0/CHANGES.md)  
    ports: openssl 1.1 .1t [\[6\]]( https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/openssl-3.0/CHANGES.md )
    

A hotfix release was issued as 22.10.2\_1:

已發布熱修復版本22.10.2 \_1:

-   firmware: added 23.4 series fingerprint  
    韌體：新增23.4系列指紋識別
    

##### 22.10.1 (February 01, 2023)｜22.10.1 （2023年2月1日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 22.7.11 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 22.7.11社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: fix getOID() call for phpseclib 3 while processing CSR  
    系統：修復處理CSR時 phpseclib 3 的 getOID() 呼叫
    
-   system: avoid error on installer user creation  
    系統：避免安裝程式使用者建立時出錯
    
-   system: show booting banner on dashboard  
    系統：在儀表板上顯示啟動橫幅
    
-   system: add statistics tree view containing vmstat memory characteristics  
    系統：新增包含 vmstat 記憶體特徵的統計資訊樹視圖
    
-   system: explicitly reopen main log file in case another log file was used and closed  
    系統：如果另一個日誌檔案被使用並關閉，則明確地重新開啟主日誌檔案。
    
-   system: tweak log\_msg() to prepare log level adjustments migration away from log\_error()  
    系統：調整 log\_msg() 函數，以便為日誌等級調整遷移（從 log\_error() 函數遷移）做準備。
    
-   system: enforce config reload to fetch group membership in authentication tester  
    系統：強制重新載入配置以取得身份驗證測試器中的群組成員身份
    
-   system: separate interface type icon from name column in interface widget  
    系統：在介面控制項中，將介面類型圖示與名稱列分開
    
-   system: change system log default to “Notice”（注意）  
    系統：將系統日誌預設值變更為“Notice”（注意）
    
-   system: UX tweaks on activity page  
    系統： UX活動頁面調整
    
-   system: revised backend daemon startup delay  
    系統：修改後端守護程式啟動延遲
    
-   system: drop empty plugins\_run() result  
    系統：刪除空的 plugins\_run() 結果
    
-   system: fix internal CRL check (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：修復內部CRL檢查（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: add group (class) sync and user creation for RADIUS authentication  
    系統：為RADIUS身份驗證新增群組（類別）同步與使用者建立功能
    
-   system: show and search ACL endpoints in privilege selector  
    系統：顯示與搜尋權限選擇器中的ACL端點
    
-   system: replace a number of log\_error() calls with log\_msg() equivalent  
    系統：將多個 log\_error() 呼叫替換為等效的 log\_msg() 呼叫
    
-   system: improve SSH lockout behaviour  
    系統：改進SSH鎖定行為
    
-   system: fix a few minor Coverity Scan reports in PHP and Python [\[1\]](https://scan.coverity.com/projects/opnsense-core)  
    系統：修正PHP和 Python 中的一些 Coverity 掃描報告的次要問題 [\[1\]]( https://scan.coverity.com/projects/opnsense-core )
    
-   interfaces: show attached interface for VLAN device in overview  
    介面：在概覽中顯示VLAN設備的已連接介面
    
-   interfaces: packet capture MVC/API replacement  
    介面：資料包擷取MVC/API替換
    
-   interfaces: fix ARP table name resolve backend issue (contributed by soif)  
    介面：修復ARP表名解析後端問題（由 soif 提供）
    
-   interfaces: migrate main clearing of interface data to ifctl  
    介面：將介面資料的主要清除功能移轉到 ifctl
    
-   interfaces: fix display of special HTML characters in packet capture  
    介面：修正封包擷取中特殊字元HTML的顯示問題
    
-   interfaces: retain existing PPP settings on saving interface settings  
    介面：儲存介面設定時保留現有的PPP設定
    
-   interfaces: delete the correct lock of PPP device  
    介面：刪除PPP設備的正確鎖定
    
-   interfaces: fix variable use in interface\_proxyarp\_configure()  
    介面：修正 interface\_proxyarp\_configure() 中的變數使用問題
    
-   interfaces: use get\_interface\_list() to identify hardware devices  
    介面：使用 get_interface_list() 來識別硬體設備
    
-   interfaces: fix single ACL use for MVC/API interface pages  
    介面：修復單一ACL用於MVC/API介面頁面的問題
    
-   firewall: off-by-one in regex for target port range parse  
    防火牆：正規表示式中目標連接埠範圍解析出現差一錯誤
    
-   firewall: support Maxmind unclassified “EU”（歐盟） as selectable country  
    防火牆：支援 Maxmind 未分類“EU”（歐盟）作為可選國家/地區
    
-   firewall: fix possible race condition when changing limit in live log  
    防火牆：修復在即時日誌中更改限制時可能出現的競爭條件
    
-   firewall: fix sorting bug in aliases list  
    防火牆：修正別名清單中的排序錯誤
    
-   firewall: allow the use of “dynamic” interface types in shaper, e.g. IPsec devices  
    防火牆：允許在流量整形器中使用「動態」介面類型，例如 IPsec 設備
    
-   firewall: wrap user rule registration in new function filter\_core\_rules\_user()  
    防火牆：將使用者規則註冊封裝在新函數 filter\_core\_rules\_user() 中
    
-   firewall: simplify rule lookup by using filter\_core\_rules\_user()  
    防火牆：使用 filter\_core\_rules\_user() 簡化規則查找
    
-   firewall: allow external dynamic address in NPT  
    防火牆：允許外部動態位址進入NPT
    
-   firewall: remove extended VIP expansion from NAT rules  
    防火牆：從NAT規則移除擴充的VIP擴展
    
-   firewall: fix live view hostname lookup may result in HTTP 431 error  
    防火牆：修正即時查看主機名稱查找可能導致HTTP 431 錯誤的問題
    
-   firewall: add category selection to aliases  
    防火牆：新增類別選擇
    
-   firewall: states page performance improvements and better address parsing in search  
    防火牆：改善頁面效能並優化搜尋中的位址解析
    
-   firewall: reuse “hostid” on filter reload events  
    防火牆：在過濾器重新載入事件中重複使用“hostid”
    
-   firewall: show automated “port 0” rule as actual port “0” on PHP 8  
    防火牆：將自動「連接埠 0」規則顯示為PHP 8 上的實際連接埠「0」。
    
-   reporting: fix incompatible regex syntax in FreeBSD 13.1 for firewall state health statistics  
    報告：修復 FreeBSD 13.1中防火牆狀態健康統計資訊的不相容正規表示式語法
    
-   reporting: bail DNS resolve in traffic graphs when resolver is not configured

-   captive portal: for static MAC assignments make sure that the IP address actually changed before updating it  
    強制入口網站：對於靜態MAC位址分配，請確保在更新IP位址之前，該位址已實際變更。
    
-   dnsmasq: remove expired root trust anchor (contributed by Johnny S. Lee)  
    dnsmasq：移除過期的根信任錨（由 Johnny S. Lee 提供）
    
-   firmware: always fetch the signature file to avoid signature issues after upgrades  
    韌體：升級後務必取得簽名文件，以避免簽名問題。
    
-   firmware: use effective ABI in changelog fetch  
    韌體：在更新日誌取得中使用有效的ABI
    
-   firmware: ignore automatic business plugin and license hint  
    韌體：忽略自動業務外掛程式和許可證提示
    
-   ipsec: missing return in controller

-   ipsec: remove side effect host route removal from Phase 1 page

-   ipsec: default log should be set to “basic” but PHP 8 disagreed

-   openvpn: use ifctl in link up/down scripts

##### 22.10 (October 26, 2022)｜22.10 （2022年10月26日）

The OPNsense business edition transitions to this 22.10 release including the upgrade to FreeBSD 13.1, PHP 8.0, Phalcon 5, MVC/API conversions for IPsec, Unbound and notifications, firewall alias support for BGP ASN, new APCUPSD and CrowdSec plugins plus much more.

OPNsense 商業版過渡到此版本。 22.10 此次發布包括升級到 FreeBSD。 13.1, PHP 8.0獵鷹5號 MVC/API 支援 IPsec、Unbound 和通知的轉換，以及防火牆別名。 BGP ASN， 新的 APCUPSD 以及 CrowdSec 插件等等。

Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

升級前請務必閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 22.7.6 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 22.7.6社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: changed certificate revocation to use the phpseclib library  
    系統：已將憑證撤銷機制變更為使用 phpseclib 函式庫
    
-   system: performance improvement for set\_single\_sysctl()  
    系統：改進了 set\_single\_sysctl() 的效能
    
-   system: restart syslog fully and only once after all services have been started  
    系統：在所有服務啟動後，完全重啟 syslog 服務，且僅重啟一次。
    
-   system: new setting for deployment mode to control PHP error flow  
    系統：新增部署模式設置，用於控制PHP錯誤流
    
-   system: /tmp MFS now uses a maximum of 50% of RAM by default and can be adjusted  
    系統：/tmp MFS現在預設最多使用RAM的 50%，並且可以調整
    
-   system: /var MFS becomes /var/log MFS and uses a maximum of 50% of RAM by default and can be adjusted  
    系統：/var MFS變為 /var/log MFS ，預設情況下最多使用RAM的 50%，此設定可調整。
    
-   system: previous special /var MFS content is now permanently stored under /var to ensure full operability  
    系統：先前的特殊 /var MFS內容現在永久儲存在 /var 目錄下，以確保完全可操作性。
    
-   system: protect syslog-ng against out of memory kills  
    系統：保護 syslog-ng 免受記憶體不足導致的終止
    
-   system: add filter to system log widget (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：為系統日誌小工具新增過濾器（由 kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: disable RRD and NetFlow shutdown backups by default  
    系統：預設為停用RRD和 NetFlow 關閉備份
    
-   system: render interfaces in convert\_config()  
    系統：在 convert\_config() 中渲染介面
    
-   system: move remote backup script to proper file system location  
    系統：將遠端備份腳本移至正確的檔案系統位置
    
-   system: Net\_IPv6::compress() should not compress “::” to “”  
    系統：Net\_IPv6::compress() 不應將“::”壓縮為“”。
    
-   system: remove last bits of circular logging (CLOG) support  
    系統：移除循環日誌記錄的最後部分（ CLOG ）支持
    
-   system: removed legacy Diffie-Hellman parameter handling  
    系統：移除了舊版 Diffie-Hellman 參數處理
    
-   system: IXR\_Library using incorrect constructor format for PHP 8  
    系統： IXR \_函式庫使用了錯誤的建構子格式，用於PHP 8
    
-   system: fix regression in config backup due to timestamp key rename  
    系統：修復由於時間戳鍵重命名而導致的配置備份回歸問題
    
-   system: fix assorted warnings generated by PHP 8  
    系統：修復由PHP 8 產生的各種警告
    
-   system: do not reload Unbound/Dnsmasq hosts configuration by default  
    系統：預設不重新載入 Unbound/Dnsmasq 主機配置
    
-   system: use proper CRL id-ce-cRLReasons extension keyword “unspecified”  
    系統：使用正確的CRL id-ce-cRLReasons 擴充關鍵字“unspecified”
    
-   system: remove dead code from login form  
    系統：從登入表單中移除無效代碼
    
-   system: replace static notices system with a shared one based on MVC/API code  
    系統：將靜態通知系統替換為基於MVC/API代碼的共享系統
    
-   system: use new \_setup script feature where setup.sh exists  
    系統：使用新的 \_setup 腳本功能，其中 setup.sh 已存在
    
-   system: PHP 8 issue when ldap\_get\_entries() returns false  
    系統： PHP ldap\_get\_entries() 回傳 false 時出現 8 個問題
    
-   system: wrong variable in scope addition on manual DNS server via link-local gateway  
    系統：手動透過連結本地網關在伺服器上新增作用域時，變數錯誤DNS
    
-   system: “passwordarea” support for sensitive backup values  
    系統：「密碼區域」支援敏感備份值
    
-   system: migrate CRL handling to phpseclib 3  
    系統：將CRL處理遷移到 phpseclib 3
    
-   system: run monitor reload inside system\_routing\_configure()  
    系統：在 system\_routing\_configure() 內部執行 monitor reload 函數
    
-   system: fix IPv6 link-local HTTP\_REFERER check (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    系統：修復 IPv6 連結本地HTTP \_REFERER 檢查（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   system: fix assorted PHP 8 warnings in the codebase  
    系統：修復程式碼庫中各種PHP 8 個警告

    系統：擴展名稱伺服器腳本返回以用於偵錯目的，例如“configctl system list nameservers debug”

    系統：將 get\_searchdomains() 移至 ifctl 使用並允許FQDN

    系統：為 rc.resolv\_conf\_generate 腳本新增替換鉤子

    系統：將“dns reload”後端呼叫替換為可移植的替代方案

Known issues and limitations:

已知問題和限制：

-   The DH parameter is no longer available in OpenVPN server configuration and now fixed to the RFC 7919 4096 bit key. The only downside may be lower performance on older machines.  
    OpenVPN 伺服器設定中已不再使用DH參數，該參數現已固定為RFC 7919 4096 位元金鑰。唯一的缺點可能是老舊機器的性能會降低。
    
-   The infamous /var MFS feature was reduced to the /var/log scope in order to avoid future issues with plugins requiring persistent storage under /var. In practice people who used /var MFS had no benefit over it with software that required persistent storage under /var to operate in the first place. Periodic configuration file writes to /var are negligible on SSD-based systems.  
    臭名昭著的 /var MFS功能被限制在 /var/log 範圍內，以避免未來插件需要 /var 下的持久存儲時出現問題。實際上，對於那些本身就需要 /var 下持久存儲才能運行的軟體而言，使用 /var MFS並沒有帶來任何好處。在基於SSD的系統中，定期寫入 /var 的設定檔可以忽略不計。
    
-   The os-dyndns plugin is still available due to the fact that ddclient did not release a non-development release so far since we started os-ddclient. Availability thereof might change later in 22.7.x.  
    由於自從我們啟動 os-ddclient 以來，ddclient 尚未發布非開發版本，因此 os-dyndns 外掛程式仍然可用。其可用性可能會在22.7 .x 版本中發生變化。
    
-   The console firmware update will now display text-based changelogs for the update to be installed if available. Use the arrow keys to scroll the changelog and type “q” to resume the update process.  
    主機韌體更新程式現在會以文字顯示待安裝更新的變更日誌（如有）。使用方向鍵捲動查看變更日誌，然後輸入“q”繼續更新過程。
    
-   The manual DHCPv6 tracking mode now requires a proper prefix range given like its counterpart with a static address. If a previous prefix ID type input is detected only setting the lower 64 bits of an IPv6 address, a warning is emitted and the ID is treated as the upper 64 bits of an IPv6 address instead. If your DHCPv6 server does not start please properly fix the given range.  
    手動 DHCPv6 追蹤模式現在需要像靜態位址追蹤模式一樣，提供正確的位址前綴範圍。如果偵測到先前輸入的前綴ID類型僅設定了 IPv6 位址的低 64 位元，則會發出警告，並將ID視為 IPv6 位址的高 64 位元。如果您的 DHCPv6 伺服器無法啟動，請正確設定位址範圍。
    
-   Empty CRLs (System: Trust: Revocation) created prior to this version were not stored correctly. This leads to non-working OpenVPN servers when these CLRs are used starting with this version. To fix this prior to upgrading remove the empty CRL from OpenVPN, or add a dummy certificate to it to populate the CRL properly, or add and remove a random existing certificate to correct the empty CRL.  
    在此版本之前建立的空 CRL（系統：信任：吊銷）未正確儲存。這會導致從此版本開始使用這些 CRL 時 OpenVPN 伺服器無法正常運作。若要在升級之前解決此問題，請從 OpenVPN 中刪除空的CRL ，或向其中新增虛擬憑證以正確填入CRL ，或新增並刪除一個隨機的現有憑證以更正空的CRL 。

The OPNsense business edition successfully transitions to this 22.4 release with a new API-capable VLAN interface including QinQ support, FreeBSD 13 and many other improvements. Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

##### 22.4.3 (August 04, 2022)｜22.4.3 （2022年8月4日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 22.1.10 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 22.1.10社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: properly shut down removed interfaces in console port assignment  
    系統：已正確關閉控制台連接埠指派中已移除的介面
    
-   system: log hard limit results in 9999 entries for grid output  
    系統：日誌硬限制導致網格輸出出現 9999 筆記錄
    
-   system: move add\_user script out of shell scripts  
    系統：將 add\_user 腳本從 shell 腳本中移出
    
-   system: disable flag was not removing static route  
    系統：禁用標誌未移除靜態路由
    
-   system: fix RADIUS config validation for port requirement (contributed by Josh Soref)  
    系統：修復RADIUS埠要求配置驗證（由 Josh Soref 貢獻）
    
-   system: properly cleanse user input in Monit dashboard widget  
    系統：正確清理 Monit 儀表板小工具中的使用者輸入
    
-   system: flush all core Python pyc files on updates  
    系統：更新時刷新所有核心 Python pyc 文件
    
-   system: apply default firewall policy before interface configuration  
    系統：在介面配置之前套用預設防火牆策略
    
-   interfaces: move lo0 interface registration to loopback  
    介面：將 lo0 介面註冊移至環回接口
    
-   interfaces: simplify bridge destroy on deletion  
    介面：簡化刪除時橋接銷毀
    
-   interfaces: add missing scope to link-local GIF host route  
    介面：為連結本地GIF主機路由新增缺少的作用域
    
-   interfaces: fix “Allow service binding” for multiple aliases per interface (contributed by Adam Dawidowski)  
    介面：修正「允許服務綁定」中每個介面多個別名的問題（由 Adam Dawidowski 提供）
    
-   firewall: ignore age/expire when not provided or empty in sessions page  
    防火牆：如果會話頁面中未提供或為空，則忽略年齡/過期時間設定。
    
-   firewall: internal aliases cannot be disabled  
    防火牆：無法停用內部別名
    
-   firmware: update repository silently on remote list if needed  
    韌體：如有需要，靜默更新遠端清單中的儲存庫
    
-   intrusion detection: remove dead link to McAfee rule references  
    入侵偵測：移除指向 McAfee 規則引用的失效鏈接
    
-   ipsec: move vici library from core to ports  
    IPsec：將 vici 庫從核心庫移至連接埠庫
    
-   unbound: prevent crash of DHCP lease watcher due to unhandled CalledProcessError exception  
    unbound：防止因未處理的 CalledProcessError 異常導致DHCP租約監視器崩潰
    
-   backend: except configparser read (contributed by agh1467)  
    後端：除了 configparser 讀取（由 agh1467 貢獻）
    
-   mvc: AutoNumberField: set minimum value to 1  
    mvc：自動編號欄位：設定最小值為 1
    
-   mvc: IntegerFieldType: fix for negative numbers (contributed by xbb)  
    mvc：IntegerFieldType：修復負數問題（由 xbb 提供）
    
-   mvc: fix two regressions in BaseField for Phalcon 5  
    mvc：修正 Phalcon 5 的 BaseField 中的兩個迴歸錯誤
    
-   mvc: fix rowCount when all is selected in searchRecordsetBase()  
    mvc：修正 searchRecordsetBase() 選取全部時 rowCount 的問題
    
-   plugins: os-ddclient 1.8 [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.1/dns/ddclient/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-ddclient 1.8 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/stable/22.1/dns/ddclient/pkg-descr )

##### 22.4.2 (July 07, 2022)｜22.4.2 （2022年7月7日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 22.1.9 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 22.1.9社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: support plugin device reconfiguration in pluginctl utility  
    系統：支援在 pluginctl 工具中重新配置插件設備
    
-   system: use password\_verify() in authenticators (contributed by oittaa)  
    系統：在驗證器中使用 password\_verify()（由 oittaa 提供）
    
-   system: hide password from command line during config encryption  
    系統：在設定加密期間隱藏命令列密碼
    
-   system: improve gateway subnet validation to fix IPv6 edge cases  
    系統：改進網關子網路驗證以修復 IPv6 邊緣問題
    
-   system: dpinger support for IPv6 aliases  
    系統：dpinger 對 IPv6 別名的支持
    
-   system: support 1500000 baudrate selection for ARM  
    系統：支援ARM的 1500000 波特率選擇
    
-   system: non-functional cleanups for upcoming move to PHP 8  
    系統：為即將遷移到PHP 8 進行非功能性清理
    
-   system: fix firmware command shortcut in opnsense-shell utility  
    系統：修正 opnsense-shell 實用程式中的韌體命令捷徑
    
-   system: if no temperature sysctls are exposed do nothing  
    系統：如果沒有暴露溫度系統控制指令，則不執行任何操作。
    
-   interfaces: add unique constraint for tag+if on VLANs  
    介面：為 VLAN 上的 tag+if 新增唯一約束
    
-   firewall: bring back missing toggle button in aliases  
    防火牆：在別名中恢復缺少的切換按鈕

-   firewall: various usability and visibility improvements for aliases  
    防火牆：針對別名進行了多項可用性和可見性改進
    
-   firewall: performance improvement for large numbers of port type aliases  
    防火牆：針對大量連接埠類型別名進行效能改進
    
-   firewall: simplify sort and add natural sorting in alias diagnostics  
    防火牆：簡化別名診斷中的排序並加入自然排序
    
-   captive portal: add extendedPreAuthData for MAC address retrieval during authentication

##### 22.4.1 (June 07, 2022)｜22.4.1 （2022年6月7日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 22.1.7 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 22.1.7社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: set up all DNS system routes from system\_resolvconf\_generate()  
    系統：從 system\_resolvconf\_generate() 設定所有DNS系統路由
    
-   system: tunables without hierarchy are just “environment” variables  
    系統：沒有層級結構的調參只是「環境」變數。
    
-   system: use PHP random\_bytes() builtin (contributed by oittaa)  
    系統：使用PHP random\_bytes() 內建函數（由 oittaa 貢獻）
    
-   system: support cd9660 file system in opnsense-importer  
    系統：opnsense-importer 支援 cd9660 檔案系統
    
-   system: prevent gateway monitoring from entering a “filter reload” loop  
    系統：防止網關監控進入「過濾器重新載入」循環
    
-   system: only restore missing or zero size ACL files  
    系統：僅恢復缺失或大小為零的ACL文件
    
-   reporting: add ACPI and ARM temperature support to health data  
    報告：在健康數據中加入ACPI和ARM溫度支持
    
-   reporting: do not rely on /var/run/booting test in system health backend code  
    報告：不要依賴系統健康後端程式碼中的 /var/run/booting 測試。
    
-   reporting: fix validation in NetFlow settings  
    報告：修復 NetFlow 設定中的驗證
    
-   interfaces: interface\_ppps\_configure() remove boot-time side effect  
    介面：interface\_ppps\_configure() 移除啟動時副作用

    介面：DHCPv6 進階配置有一個不同的標誌可以停用NA
    
-   interfaces: add technical interface ID display to assignments page  
    介面：在任務頁面新增技術介面ID顯示

    防火牆：讓規則解析更一致，因為 x:any 和 any:y 都是有效的連接埠選項

    韌體：在插件/軟體包中搜尋小寫字母

##### 22.4 (April 26, 2022)｜22.4 （2022年4月26日）

The OPNsense business edition successfully transitions to this 22.4 release with a new API-capable VLAN interface including QinQ support, FreeBSD 13 and many other improvements. Please make sure to read the migration notes before upgrading.

OPNsense 商業版已成功升級至22.4版本，並新增了支援API和VLAN的介面，包括 QinQ 支援、FreeBSD 13 相容性以及其他諸多改進。請務必在升級前閱讀遷移說明。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 22.1.4 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 22.1.4社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: improved visibility and flexibility of tunables  
    系統：提高了可調參數的可見度和靈活性
    
-   system: move multiple sysctl manipulations to tunables framework to allow overriding them

Known issues and limitations:

已知問題和限制：

-   This release contains a new major operating system version and should be carried out with the necessary care. Despite extended test coverage changes made by FreeBSD may still affect operation without our knowledge. Except for ZFS boot environments rollbacks between major operating system versions are extremely fragile and a reinstall of an older version should be attempted in the worst case. For more information please consult the FreeBSD 13.0 release notes [\[43\]](https://www.freebsd.org/releases/13.0R/relnotes/) .  
    此版本包含一個新的主要作業系統版本，因此應謹慎操作。儘管測試覆蓋範圍已擴大，但 FreeBSD 所做的更改仍可能在我們不知情的情況下影響系統運作。除ZFS啟動環境外，主要作業系統版本之間的回溯極度不穩定，最壞情況下應嘗試重新安裝舊版。更多資訊請參閱 FreeBSD 13.0發行說明 [\[43\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/releases/13.0R/relnotes/ )。
    
-   IPsec hash and cipher removals in FreeBSD 13 can affect existing setups as insecure cryptographic options have been removed upstream. If you are using MD5, Blowfish, DES, 3DES, or CAST128 in your phase 2 please move to more secure settings prior to the upgrade. Note that phase 1 settings are unaffected, but insecure settings should still be avoided. For more information see the FreeBSD commit in question [\[44\]](https://github.com/opnsense/src/commit/16aabb761c0a) .  
    FreeBSD 13 中 IPsec 雜湊和加密演算法的移除可能會影響現有配置，因為上游已移除不安全的加密選項。如果您在第二階段使用了MD5 、Blowfish、 DES 、3DES 或CAST128 ，請在升級前遷移到更安全的設定。請注意，第一階段的設定不受影響，但仍應避免使用不安全的設定。更多資訊請參閱相關的 FreeBSD 提交 [\[44\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/src/commit/16aabb761c0a )。
    
-   The Realtek vendor driver is no longer bundled with the updated FreeBSD kernel. If unsure whether FreeBSD 13 supports your Realtek NIC please install the os-realtek-re plugin prior to upgrading to retain operability of your NICs.  
    更新後的 FreeBSD 核心不再包含 Realtek 廠商驅動程式。如果您不確定 FreeBSD 13 是否支援您的 Realtek NIC網卡，請在升級前安裝 os-realtek-re 插件，以確保網路卡的正常運作。
    
-   MAC spoofing now only pertains to the configured interface and not the VLAN siblings or parent interface. This can introduce unwanted configuration due to previous side effects in the code. Make sure to assign and set the spoofed MAC for all interfaces that require a spoofed MAC or simply spoof the MAC on the parent and leave the VLAN sibling settings empty to let them follow the parent MAC automatically. If in doubt the parent interface can be set into promiscuous mode now to allow for mixed MAC address use across VLANs too.  
    MAC欺騙現在僅適用於已配置的接口，而不適用於VLAN同級接口或父接口。由於先前程式碼中的副作用，這可能會引入不必要的配置。請確保為所有需要欺騙MAC的介面分配並設定欺騙的MAC位址，或直接在父介面上欺騙MAC位址，並將同級介面的VLAN設定留空，使其自動跟隨父介面MAC位址。如有疑問，現在可以將父介面設定為混雜模式，以允許跨 VLAN 混合使用MAC位址。
    
-   Media and hardware offload settings are no longer shown for non-parent interfaces and need to be set individually on the parent interface to take effect. This can introduce unwanted configuration due to previous side effects in the code. If the parent interface was not previously assigned please assign it to reapply the required settings.  
    媒體和硬體卸載設定不再顯示在非父介面上，需要單獨在父介面上設定才能生效。由於先前程式碼中的副作用，這可能會導致不必要的配置。如果之前未指派父接口，請先指派以重新套用所需的設定。
    
-   NTPD defaults changed to exclude the “iburst” option by default. “limited” setting was detached from “kod” option. In both cases configuration adjustments can achieve previous behaviour if required.  
    NTPD預設設定已更改，預設不包含「iburst」選項。 “limited”設定已從“kod”選項中分離。如有需要，可透過配置調整恢復之前的行為。
    
-   Rebind checks through os-dyndns or os-rfc2136 will no longer work due to the deprecation of both plugins. Please add your rebind hosts manually or disable rebind protection prior to the upgrade.  
    由於 os-dyndns 和 os-rfc2136 插件已被棄用，透過這兩個插件進行的重新綁定檢查將不再有效。請手動新增您的重新綁定主機，或在升級前停用重新綁定保護。
    
-   GRE link1 support has been removed and needs a static route to function now.  
    GRE link1 支援已移除，現在需要靜態路由才能正常運作。
    
-   Circular logging support has been removed. No user interaction is required.  
    循環日誌記錄支援已被移除。無需用戶互動。

##### 21.10.3 (February 10, 2022)｜21.10.3 （2022年2月10日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 21.7.8 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 21.7.8社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: remove spurious XML validation that cannot cope with attributes from backup restore  
    系統：移除無法處理備份復原屬性的虛假XML驗證
    
-   system: prevent syslog-ng from crashing after update due to “syslog-ng-ctl reload” use  
    系統：防止 syslog-ng 在更新後因「syslog-ng-ctl reload」指令而崩潰
    
-   system: changing interface gateway was ignored during route reconfiguration  
    系統：路由重配置期間忽略了更改介面網關的操作
    
-   system: cron command drop down size was extending below screen  
    系統：cron 指令下拉選單的大小超出了螢幕下方
    
-   reporting: fix display of total in/out traffic values  
    報告：修復總進出流量值的顯示問題
    
-   firewall: removed the $aliastable cache  
    防火牆：已移除 $aliastable 快取
    
-   firewall: correctly handle IPv6 NAT in states view  
    防火牆：在狀態視圖中正確處理 IPv6 NAT
    
-   firewall: skip rule ID for NAT type log entries (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：跳過規則ID ，用於NAT類型的日誌條目（由 kulikov-a 提供）

##### 21.10.2 (January 13, 2022)｜21.10.2 （2022年1月13日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 21.7.7 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 21.7.7社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

A new plugin called OPNWAF [\[1\]](#p-049) is being added to this release to offer Apache web server for simple setup of load balancing and reverse proxy scenarios. It also offers ACME protocol support for Let’s Encrypt with a single click.

此版本新增了一個名為OPNWAF [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/vendor/deciso/opnwaf.html ) 的插件，用於為負載平衡和反向代理場景提供 Apache Web 伺服器的簡易設定。此外，它還支援 Let's Encrypt 的ACME協議，只需單擊即可啟用。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: move logging remnants of Relayd/HAProxy to plugin code  
    系統：將 Relayd/HAProxy 的日誌記錄殘留程式碼移至外掛程式碼
    
-   system: support XMLRPC authentication using API keys  
    系統：支援使用API金鑰進行XMLRPC身份驗證

    系統：系統日誌小工具自動刷新（由 kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: fix /etc/ssl/cert.pem permission on backend call  
    系統：修復後端呼叫中 /etc/ssl/cert.pem 的權限
    
-   interfaces: make is\_linklocal() properly detect all link-local addresses (contributed by Per von Zweigbergk)  
    interfaces：使 is\_linklocal() 能夠正確偵測所有連結本地位址（由 Per von Zweigbergk 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: properly translate “any” port to upper or lower port bound  
    防火牆：正確將「任意」連接埠轉換為上限或下限連接埠。
    
-   firewall: support any-to-X ranges for rules port input (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：支援規則連接埠輸入的任意到 X 範圍（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: drop policy based routing validation on interface rules  
    防火牆：刪除基於策略的介面規則路由驗證
    
-   firewall: typo in direction for session diagnostics (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：會話診斷方向有拼字錯誤（kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   firewall: fix address direction for states diagnostics (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：修復狀態診斷的位址方向（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firmware: added generic configuration support via opnsense-update.conf  
    韌體：新增透過 opnsense-update.conf 進行通用配置的支持

    韌體：修改啟動器以支援 -r 和 -s 選項

-   captive portal: “connected since” malformed due to datetime already being converted  
    強制門戶：「connected since」格式錯誤，因為日期時間已被轉換。
    
-   dhcp: add current IPv4 address to static lease creation (contributed by Taneli Leppa)  
    DHCP：將目前 IPv4 位址新增至靜態租約建立（由 Taneli Leppa 提供）
    
-   intrusion detection: switch to ET-Open Suricata 5 rulesets  
    入侵偵測：切換到ET - 開啟 Suricata 5 規則集
    
-   intrusion detection: support multiple policy property in metadata  
    入侵偵測：支援元資料中的多個策略屬性
    
-   intrusion detection: update severity of ruleset download skipped log message (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    入侵偵測：更新規則集下載嚴重性跳過日誌訊息（由 kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   intrusion detection: update embedded classification.config

-   ipsec: inline only caller of get\_configured\_vips\_list()  
    ipsec：僅限內聯呼叫 get\_configured\_vips\_list()
    
-   ipsec: avoid VTI device recreation when using hostnames  
    ipsec：使用主機名稱時避免VTI設備重建
    
-   backend: add configctl “-d” and “-q” options for future use  
    後端：新增 configctl “-d” 和 “-q” 選項以供將來使用
    
-   backend: configd profiler call fix  
    後端：configd 分析器呼叫修復
    
-   ui: prevent browser auto-fill for username/password (contributed by NOYB)

##### 21.10.1 (December 02, 2021)｜21.10.1 （2021年12月2日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 21.7.5 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 21.7.5社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Please note that OpenSSH was updated to version 8.8 which deprecates ssh-rsa usage which is mainly an issue for client access from the OPNsense system to the outside and can be amended as per the suggestions in the respective release notes.

請注意，OpenSSH 已更新至8.8版本，該版本棄用了 ssh-rsa 的使用，這主要是 OPNsense 系統用戶端存取外部網路時的問題，可以根據相應發行說明中的建議進行修改。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: prevent expired or intermediate CA certificates from being added to trust store by default  
    系統：預設情況下阻止將過期或中間的CA憑證新增至信任庫中
    
-   system: prevent XSS in LDAP attribute return in authentication tester (reported by Orange CERT-CC)  
    系統：防止驗證測試器中XSS在LDAP屬性回傳（由 Orange CERT-CC報告）
    
-   system: add product title to auth pages  
    系統：在身分驗證頁面中新增產品標題
    
-   system: fix log search ignoring first character  
    系統：修復日誌搜尋忽略首字符的問題
    
-   system: add xc0 entry video console entry if node exists  
    系統：如果節點存在，則新增 xc0 視訊控制台條目
    
-   system: add automatic outbound NAT logging option  
    系統：新增自動出站NAT日誌記錄選項
    
-   system: remove support for obsolete “local” syslog socket plugin request  
    系統：移除對過時的「本地」syslog套接字插件請求的支持
    
-   system: prevent setup wizard error in WAN-only configuration  
    系統：防止在WAN僅限配置中出現設定精靈錯誤
    
-   system: properly extract keyid string (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：正確提取密鑰 ID 字串（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: show all threads and correct WCPU in activity (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：顯示所有執行緒並修正WCPU活動（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: fix display and sorting in activity (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：修復活動中的顯示和排序問題（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: escape shell parameters in cron jobs  
    系統：在 cron 作業中轉義 shell 參數
    
-   interfaces: remove obsolete link\_interface\_to\_vlans() function  
    介面：移除過時的 link_interface_to_vlans() 函數
    
-   interfaces: inline legacy\_interface\_rename() function  
    介面：內聯 legacy\_interface\_rename() 函數
    
-   interfaces: verbose output on test port (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    介面：測試連接埠的詳細輸出（由 kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   interfaces: let guess\_interface\_from\_ip() find the best match on overlapping subnets (contributed by Jason Crowley)  
    interfaces: let guess\_interface\_from\_ip() find best match on overlaped subnets (provided by Jason Crowley)
    
-   interfaces: improve configurability with LAGG devices  
    介面：透過LAGG設備提高可配置性
    
-   firewall: fix non-sticky rule association in port forward  
    防火牆：修復連接埠轉送中的非黏性規則關聯
    
-   firewall: switch failover peer address acquire away from deprecated function  
    防火牆：切換故障轉移對等位址取得方式，不再使用已棄用的功能
    
-   firewall: specify overload table on maximum new connections  
    防火牆：指定最大新增連線數的過載表
    
-   firewall: add loaded item count and last update to aliases page  
    防火牆：在別名頁面新增已載入項目計數和上次更新時間
    
-   firewall: refactor getInterfaceGateway() to eliminate edge cases with IPsec route-to behaviour  
    防火牆：重構 getInterfaceGateway() 函數，以消除 IPsec 路由行為的極端情況
    
-   firewall: allow alias to skip entry on EmptyLabel (contributed by James Golovich)  
    防火牆：允許別名跳過 EmptyLabel 條目（由 James Golovich 提供）
    
-   firewall: improve resolve performance by implementing asynchronous DNS lookups  
    防火牆：透過實作非同步DNS查找來提升解析效能
    
-   firewall: add live view templates page to respective ACL (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：將即時視圖範本頁面新增至對應的ACL （kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: replace pfInfo with statistics page  
    防火牆：將 pfInfo 替換為統計資訊頁面
    
-   firewall: add rules to statistics page (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：為統計頁面新增規則（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: remove defunct “block carp from self” CARP rule  
    防火牆：移除已失效的「阻止鯉魚訪問自身」 CARP規則
    
-   dhcp: automatically set AdvRASrcAddress for link-local CARP address  
    DHCP：自動為鏈路本地CARP位址設定AdvRASrcAddress
    
-   dhcp: exclude link-local subnet router advertisements  
    DHCP：排除連結本地子網路路由器通告
    
-   dhcp: show static leases without IP address assignments in the lease pages  
    dhcp：在租約頁面中顯示沒有IP位址分配的靜態租約
    
-   firmware: do not remove obsolete base files on major upgrades  
    韌體：大版本升級時請勿刪除過時的基礎文件
    
-   firmware: opnsense-code utility fix for “-d” option (contributed by Patrick M. Hausen)  
    韌體：opnsense-code 實用程式修復了“-d”選項（由 Patrick M. Hausen 提供）

    韌體：opnsense-update 工具現在能夠在「-d」模式下引導其自身配置。

    韌體：opnsense-update 工具不再預設使用「-bkp」參數

    韌體：opnsense-update 實用程式各種清理

    韌體：opnsense-update：將 -A 替換為 -M，並獨立處理單一目錄的 -M 操作

    韌體：opnsense-verify：停用無簽名儲存庫的驗證

    韌體：opnsense-version：支援 -x 有效ABI探測
    
-   firmware: support ABI hints in the file “firmware-upgrade”  
    韌體：支援「firmware-upgrade」檔案中的ABI提示
    
-   ipsec: add charon.max\_ikev1\_exchanges parameter  
    ipsec：新增 charon.max_ikev1_exchanges 參數
    
-   ipsec: add closeaction parameter (contributed by Patrick M. Hausen)  
    ipsec：新增 closeaction 參數（由 Patrick M. Hausen 提供）

    ipsec：新增 sha256\_96 標誌（由 Patrick M. Hausen 貢獻）
    
-   ipsec: rewrite netmask calculation for VTI tunnel setup  
    IPsec：重寫VTI隧道建立的子網路遮罩計算

    monit：將連結事件新增至警報設定（由 Frank Brendel 提供）

    monit：在服務設定中新增 polltime（由 Frank Brendel 提供）
    
-   openvpn: remove obsolete remnants of tun-ipv6  
    openvpn：刪除 tun-ipv6 的過時殘餘

##### 21.10 (October 14, 2021)｜21.10 （2021年10月14日）

The OPNsense business edition successfully transitions to this 21.10 release with a new installer including ZFS support, improved central management and Intel network driver updates amongst others.

OPNsense 商業版已成功過渡到此21.10版本，新安裝程式包含ZFS支援、改進的中央管理以及 Intel 網路驅動程式更新等。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 21.7.3 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 21.7.3社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: allow automatic user creation on LDAP-based logins  
    系統：允許基於LDAP登入自動建立用戶
    
-   system: circular logs are now disabled by default  
    系統：循環日誌現已預設為停用。
    
-   system: default gateway failure state killing is now disabled by default  
    系統：預設網關故障狀態終止功能現已預設為停用
    
-   system: allow cron-based restarts of all “restart” action providers  
    系統：允許基於 cron 的所有「重啟」操作提供者重啟
    
-   system: allow more characters in the certificate/authority organization fields (contributed by Jan De Luyck)  
    系統：允許在證書/頒發機構組織欄位中使用更多字元（由 Jan De Luyck 提供）
    
-   system: default RSS widget feed to forum announcements  
    系統：預設RSS小工具資訊流至論壇公告
    
-   system: prevent use of client certificates in web GUI  
    系統：阻止在 Web 中使用客戶端憑證GUI
    
-   system: raised encryption standard for encrypted config.xml export  
    系統：提高了加密 config.xml 匯出檔案的加密標準
    
-   system: reload FreeBSD services when reloading all services from console  
    系統：從控制台重新載入所有服務時，也需要重新載入 FreeBSD 服務
    
-   system: add missing ACL for Syslog targets page  
    系統：為 Syslog 目標頁面新增缺少的ACL
    
-   system: removed NextCloud backup from core functionality  
    系統：已從核心功能移除 NextCloud 備份
    
-   system: removed unused traffic API dashboard feed  
    系統：已移除未使用的流量API儀錶板饋送
    
-   interfaces: add and use unified function is\_interface\_assigned() to prevent deleting assigned interfaces  
    介面：新增並使用統一函數 is\_interface\_assigned() 以防止刪除已指派的介面
    
-   interfaces: add netstat tree search and improve page layout  
    介面：新增 netstat 樹搜尋並改進頁面佈局
    
-   interfaces: allow interface-based overrides of hardware checksum settings  
    介面：允許基於介面覆蓋硬體校驗和設定
    
-   interfaces: correct indent in dhclient configuration  
    介面：dhclient 配置中的縮排是否正確
    
-   interfaces: clear PPPoE SLAAC addresses on linkdown  
    介面：連結斷開時清除 PPPoE SLAAC位址
    
-   interfaces: flush IPv6 addresses on the correct IPv6 interface when it differs from the IPv4 interface  
    介面：當 IPv6 位址與 IPv4 位址不同時，在正確的 IPv6 介面上刷新 IPv6 位址。
    
-   interfaces: improve GRE/GIF configuration handling and dynamic reload behaviour  
    介面：改進GRE/GIF配置處理與動態重載行為
    
-   interfaces: packet capture quick select for all interfaces  
    介面：所有介面的資料包擷取快速選擇
    
-   interfaces: refactor DNS lookup and add PTR to output (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面：重構DNS查找並新增PTR到輸出（由 Maurice Walker 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: refactored address removal into interfaces\_addresses\_flush()  
    介面：將位址移除重構到 interfaces\_addresses\_flush() 中
    
-   interfaces: remove duplicated handling of PPP IPv6 interface detection  
    介面：移除對PPP IPv6介面偵測的重複處理
    
-   interfaces: replace opportunistic diagnostics IP address lookups with more robust variants  
    介面：用更強大的變體取代機會性診斷IP位址查找
    
-   interfaces: sync firewall groups after internal create/destroy operations  
    介面：在內部建立/刪除操作後同步防火牆組
    
-   interfaces: use -M option in rtsold invoke in preparation for 22.1  
    介面：在 rtsold 呼叫中使用 -M 選項，為22.1做準備
    
-   firewall: MVC rewrite of the pfTop diagnostics pages under “Sessions”（會議）  
    防火牆： MVC重寫“Sessions”（會議）下的 pfTop 診斷頁面
    
-   firewall: MVC rewrite of the states diagnostics pages under “States”（各州）  
    防火牆： MVC重寫“States”（各州）下的狀態診斷頁面
    
-   firewall: add manual reply-to configuration to rules  
    防火牆：為規則新增手動回覆配置
    
-   firewall: add quick link to states counter from firewall rule inspection  
    防火牆：在防火牆規則檢查中新增指向狀態計數器的快速鏈接
    
-   firewall: aliases maximum entries progress bar  
    防火牆：別名最大條目數進度條
    
-   firewall: allow to specify port ranges for outgoing NAT (contributed by Nikolay Denev)  
    防火牆：允許指定出站連接埠範圍NAT （由 Nikolay Denev 提供）
    
-   firewall: clarify match/set priority in rules  
    防火牆：明確符合項目/設定規則中的優先權
    
-   firewall: delete related rules when an interface group is removed  
    防火牆：移除介面群組時刪除相關規則
    
-   firewall: improve alias description/preview  
    防火牆：改進別名描述/預覽
    
-   firewall: make sure net.pf.request\_maxcount and table-entries are always aligned  
    防火牆：確保 net.pf.request\_maxcount 和表格項目始終保持一致。
    
-   firewall: only set state options on rules when state is being tracked  
    防火牆：僅當需要追蹤狀態時才設定規則的狀態選項。
    
-   firewall: rename source/destination networks when group name changes  
    防火牆：當群組名稱更改時重新命名來源/目標網絡
    
-   firewall: renamed “pfTables” diagnostics to “Aliases”（別名）  
    防火牆：將「pfTables」診斷程式重新命名為“Aliases”（別名）
    
-   firewall: use permanent promiscuous mode for pflog0  
    防火牆：對 pflog0 使用永久混雜模式
    
-   dhcp: add shared dhcpd\_leases() reader and use it in both lease pages  
    DHCP：新增共用的 dhcpd\_leases() 讀取器，並在兩個租約頁面中使用它。
    
-   dhcp: always deprecate prefixes in automatic router advertisements  
    DHCP：始終棄用自動路由器通告中的前綴
    
-   dhcp: assorted improvements surrounding dhcpd\_staticmap() for real world operation  
    dhcp：圍繞 dhcpd\_staticmap() 的各種改進，以適應實際運作。
    
-   dhcp: fix table header sorting in lease pages (contributed by vnxme)

    DHCP：當介面不適合運行DHCP伺服器時，鎖定對設定頁面的訪問
    
-   dhcp: remove ::/0 route from router advertisements (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    dhcp：從路由器通告中移除 ::/0 路由（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   firmware: also check plugins sync for up to date core package  
    韌體：請同時檢查插件同步，確保核心軟體包已更新至最新版本。
    
-   firmware: backend now supports reinstall like opnsense-bootstrap -q  
    韌體：後端現在支援使用 opnsense-bootstrap -q 進行重新安裝
    
-   firmware: confirm plugin removal dialog  
    韌體：確認插件移除對話框
    
-   firmware: introduced connectivity check  
    韌體：新增連接性檢查
    
-   firmware: opnsense-patch can now patch installer and updater files  
    韌體：opnsense-patch 現在可以修補安裝程式和更新程式文件
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update -c option now honours the -f option  
    韌體：opnsense-update -c 選項現在支援 -f 選項
    
-   firmware: opnsense-update improvements for mirror manipulation options  
    韌體：opnsense-update 改進了鏡像操作選項
    
-   firmware: replace php version\_compare() call with pkg-version shell command  
    韌體：將 php version\_compare() 呼叫替換為 pkg-version shell 指令
    
-   firmware: revoke 21.4 fingerprint  
    韌體：撤銷21.4指紋

    韌體：韌體升級訊息的靜態模板
    
-   firmware: sync plugins in console update  
    韌體：同步控制台更新中的插件
    
-   ipsec: add auto type for identities  
    IPsec：為身分新增自動類型
    
-   ipsec: adhere to system defaults for route-to and reply-to when creating automatic VPN rules  
    IPsec：建立自動VPN規則時，路由位址和回覆位址應遵循系統預設值。
    
-   ipsec: fix a regression in VTI handling  
    ipsec：修復VTI處理中的迴歸問題
    
-   ipsec: fix a regression in rightsubnets for non-mobile phase 2

    IPsec：使用「#」字元對ASN1DN和FQDN類型進行身份引用

    openvpn： CARP狀態讀取清理（由 vnxme 提供）

    openvpn：不要建立空的路由器文件

    openvpn：驗證隧道前綴以避免 OpenVPN 2.5啟動錯誤（kulikov-a 貢獻）

<a id="p-041"></a>

#### 21.4 Series｜21.4系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_21.4.html>

The OPNsense business edition moves into a new era with this 21.4 release. Note that the version numbers are now diverging from the community edition to make it easier to distinguish between the two. The next major update will be 21.10 in October.

OPNsense 商業版透過此次21.4版本邁入新時代。請注意，版本號碼已與社群版有所不同，以便於區分兩者。下一次重大更新將於 10 月發布，版本編號為21.10 。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

##### 21.4.3 (August 11, 2021)｜21.4.3 （2021年8月11日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 21.1.8 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 21.1.8社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

The OpenVPN advisory tracked as CVE-2020-15078 does not affect the provided version 2.4.11, but the security audit will falsely flag it as vulnerable because the source of the audit is FreeBSD where OpenVPN was migrated to 2.5 series already.

OpenVPN 安全公告CVE -2020-15078 不會影響提供的版本2.4.11 ，但安全審計會錯誤地將其標記為易受攻擊，因為審計的來源是 FreeBSD，而 OpenVPN 已經遷移到2.5系列。

API errors during the update can appear but are a harmless side effect of the MVC framework major version transition to Phalcon 4. The system will reboot as normal. Make sure to clear your browser cache if the check for updates does not seem to work afterwards and/or double-check with a different browser.

更新過程中可能會出現API錯誤，但這是MVC框架主版本過渡到Phalcon 4時的無害副作用。系統將正常重新啟動。如果之後檢查更新似乎不起作用，請務必清除瀏覽器緩存，和/或使用其他瀏覽器再次檢查。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: use ifinfo counters instead of pfctl in interface widget  
    系統：在介面控制項中使用 ifinfo 計數器取代 pfctl
    
-   system: prevent excessive config writes on LDAP import  
    系統：防止對LDAP導入進行過多的配置寫入
    
-   system: do not split XMLRPC password into multiple pieces  
    系統提示：請勿將XMLRPC密碼拆分成多個部分
    
-   system: fix IPv4 /31 assignment address assignment in shell  
    系統：修正 shell 中的 IPv4 /31 位址分配問題
    
-   system: raised PHP memory limit to 1G  
    系統：將PHP記憶體限制提升至 1G
    
-   system: enable group sync for LDAP servers that do not return memberOf (contributed by rdd2)  
    系統：為不傳回 memberOf 的LDAP伺服器啟用群組同步（由 rdd2 提供）
    
-   system: isvalidpid() is not required for a single killbypid()  
    系統：對於單一 killbypid() 操作，不需要 isvalidpid() 函數。
    
-   system: hide far gateway option for IPv6  
    系統：隱藏 IPv6 的遠端閘道選項
    
-   system: Norwegian translation (contributed by Stein-Aksel Basma)  
    系統：挪威文翻譯（由 Stein-Aksel Basma 提供）
    
-   system: add HA sync entry for live log templates  
    系統：為即時日誌範本新增HA同步條目
    
-   system: add shell inactivity timeout feature for csh/tcsh  
    系統：為 csh/tcsh 新增 shell 非活動逾時功能
    
-   system: add Syslog-ng TLS transport options  
    系統：新增 Syslog-ng TLS傳輸選項
    
-   system: remove unrelated service restarts from filter\_configure\_xmlrpc()  
    系統：從 filter\_configure\_xmlrpc() 中移除無關的服務重新啟動
    
-   system: rotate interface statistics widget (contributed by FingerlessGloves)  
    系統：旋轉介面統計小工具（由 FingerlessGloves 提供）
    
-   interfaces: clear PPPoE SLAAC addresses on linkdown  
    介面：連結斷開時清除 PPPoE SLAAC位址
    
-   interfaces: do not check for existing CARP interfaces midstream  
    接口：不要在中途檢查現有的CARP接口
    
-   interfaces: refactor IP address removal on configure  
    介面：重構IP配置時移除位址
    
-   interfaces: set tunnel flag for IPv4 tunnel plus cleanups  
    介面：設定 IPv4 隧道標誌並進行清理
    
-   interfaces: interface\_configure() checks for enabled already  
    介面：interface\_configure() 檢查是否已啟用
    
-   firewall: make sure net.pf.request\_maxcount and table-entries are always aligned  
    防火牆：確保 net.pf.request\_maxcount 和表格項目始終保持一致。
    
-   firewall: add live log support for new filterlog format  
    防火牆：新增對新 filterlog 格式的即時日誌支持
    
-   firewall: set label for obsolete rule in live log (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：為即時日誌中已過時的規則設定標籤（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: let live log use the newly provided rule log label instead of guessing it  
    防火牆：允許即時日誌使用新提供的規則日誌標籤，而不是猜測。
    
-   firewall: calculate wildcard netmasks in aliases  
    防火牆：計算別名中的通配符子網路遮罩
    
-   dhcp: fix processing domain search list on static IPv6  
    DHCP：修正靜態 IPv6 上網域搜尋清單的處理問題
    
-   dhcp: support ignore-client-uids in DHCPv4 (contributed by Kacper Why)  
    DHCP：支援在 DHCPv4 中忽略客戶端 UID（由 Kacper Why 貢獻）
    
-   firmware: mask subscription in GUI output  
    韌體： GUI輸出中的遮罩訂閱
    
-   firmware: add version/date header into check script as well  
    韌體：在檢查腳本中新增版本/日期標頭
    
-   firmware: show update pending hint in system widget  
    韌體：在系統小工具中顯示待更新提示
    
-   firmware: add “-q” option for in-place opnsense-bootstrap run  
    韌體：新增“-q”選項以進行原地 opnsense-bootstrap 運行
    
-   firmware: fix grep call on FreeBSD 13 (contributed by Mariusz Zaborski)  
    韌體：修復 FreeBSD 13 上的 grep 呼叫（由 Mariusz Zaborski 貢獻）
    
-   firmware: correct return code on type change in opnsense-update  
    韌體：更正 opnsense-update 中類型變更時的回傳碼
    
-   firmware: fix opnsense-code pull when ABI configuration is no longer there  
    韌體：修復當ABI配置不再存在時 opnsense-code 拉取錯誤
    
-   firmware: fix upgrade with multiple repositories enabled  
    韌體：修復啟用多個儲存庫時的升級問題
    
-   installer: assorted wording improvements  
    安裝程序：各種措詞改進
    
-   openvpn: fix invalid rules generated by wizard (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    openvpn：修正精靈產生的無效規則（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   openvpn: return empty list when /api/openvpn/export/accounts/ is called without parameters  
    openvpn：當呼叫 /api/openvpn/export/accounts/ 時未傳遞參數，則傳回空列表。
    
-   mvc: catch all errors including syntax and class not found errors  
    MVC：捕捉所有錯誤，包括語法錯誤和類別未找到錯誤。
    
-   mvc: bring back bind\_textdomain\_codeset() to fix possible faulty page rendering  
    MVC：恢復 bind_textdomain_codeset() 函數以修復可能出現的頁面渲染錯誤
    
-   mvc: migrated framework to Phalcon 4  
    MVC：已將框架遷移到 Phalcon 4
    
-   mvc: return UUID in ApiMutableModelControllerBase::validateAndSave() if applicable  
    mvc：如果適用，則在 ApiMutableModelControllerBase::validateAndSave() 中傳回UUID
    
-   shell: throw error when opnsense-importer encounters an encrypted config.xml  
    shell：當 opnsense-importer 遇到加密的 config.xml 檔案時拋出錯誤
    
-   plugins: added variants support to share plugin code over different third-party software versions  
    插件：新增變體支持，以便在不同的第三方軟體版本之間共享插件程式碼
    
-   plugins: added NO\_ABI marker to themes  
    外掛：已將NO \_ABI 標記新增至主題
    
-   plugins: remove the use of $main\_buttons in relevant code  
    外掛程式：移除相關程式碼中對 $main\_buttons 的使用
    
-   plugins: compatibility fixes with Phalcon 4

##### 21.4.2 (July 09, 2021)｜21.4.2 （2021年7月9日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 21.1.6 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 21.1.6社區版本，並增加了可靠性改進。

The OpenVPN advisory tracked as CVE-2020-15078 does not affect the provided version 2.4.11, but the security audit will falsely flag it as vulnerable because the source of the audit is FreeBSD where OpenVPN was migrated to 2.5 series already.

OpenVPN 安全公告CVE -2020-15078 不影響提供的版本2.4.11 ，但安全審計會錯誤地將其標記為易受攻擊，因為審計的來源是 FreeBSD，而 OpenVPN 已經遷移到2.5系列。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: add audit log target and move related syslog messages there  
    系統：新增稽核日誌目標並將相關的系統日誌訊息移至該目標位置。
    
-   system: allow to edit gateway entries with non-conforming names  
    系統：允許編輯名稱不符合規範的網關條目
    
-   system: correctly enforce “Disable writing log files to the local disk” when circular logs are not used  
    系統：當不使用循環日誌時，正確強制執行「停用將日誌檔案寫入本機磁碟」。
    
-   system: delete previous route when changed  
    系統：更改時刪除先前的路由
    
-   system: fix PHP 7.4 deprecated warning in IPv6 library  
    系統：修正 IPv6 函式庫中已棄用的警告PHP 7.4
    
-   system: lock config writes during HA merges  
    系統：在HA合併期間鎖定配置寫入
    
-   system: make web GUI restart action usable in cron jobs (contributed by Frank Wall)  
    系統：使 web GUI重啟操作可在 cron 作業中使用（由 Frank Wall 提供）
    
-   system: set HSTS max-age to 1 year (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    系統：設定HSTS最大年齡為 1 年（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   interfaces: add policy-based routing support for “dynamic” interface gateways  
    介面：為「動態」介面網關新增基於策略的路由支援
    
-   interfaces: disable legacy CSRF output buffering when downloading a packet capture  
    介面：下載資料包擷取時停用舊版CSRF輸出緩衝
    
-   interfaces: execute OpenVPN device creation earlier during boot  
    介面：在啟動過程中更早執行 OpenVPN 設備創建
    
-   interfaces: remove non-tunnel restriction from address collection  
    介面：從位址集合中移除非隧道限制
    
-   interfaces: return scoped link-local in get\_configured\_ip\_addresses()  
    interfaces：在 get\_configured\_ip\_addresses() 中傳回作用域連結本機位址
    
-   interfaces: revise approach to clear states when WAN address changes  
    介面：修改在WAN位址更改時清除狀態的方法
    
-   interfaces: system match for primary address only works with compressed IPv6  
    介面：系統比對主位址僅適用於壓縮 IPv6
    
-   firewall: NPTv6 configuration clean-up (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    防火牆：NPTv6 配置清理（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   firewall: add live log filter templates feature (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：新增即時日誌過濾器範本功能（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: change live log address/port group matcher to correctly flip logic  
    防火牆：變更即時日誌位址/連接埠組匹配器，以正確切換邏輯
    
-   firewall: explicit default for filter rule association in NAT port forwards  
    防火牆： NAT連接埠轉送中過濾規則關聯的明確預設值
    
-   firewall: live log widget multiple interfaces and inspect feature (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：即時日誌小工具多介面和檢查功能（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: possibility to filter nat/rdr action in live log  
    防火牆：可在即時日誌中過濾 NAT/RDR 操作
    
-   firewall: prevent controls overlap in live log (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：防止即時日誌中的控制重疊（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: remove redundant NPTv6 binat rule (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    防火牆：刪除冗餘的 NPTv6 binat 規則（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   captive portal: fix GUI drop session issue  
    強制入口網站：修復GUI會話遺失問題
    
-   dhcp: compress expanded IPv6 lease addresses for clean match with system  
    DHCP：壓縮擴充的 IPv6 租約位址，以便與系統完全相符。
    
-   dhcp: on the GUI pages avoid the use of dhcpd\_dhcp\_configure()  
    DHCP：在GUI頁面上，避免使用dhcpd\_dhcp\_configure()
    
-   dnsmasq: use dhcpd\_staticmap() for lease registration  
    dnsmasq：使用 dhcpd\_staticmap() 進行租約註冊
    
-   firmware: allow manual development override on business subscription  
    韌體：允許手動開發覆蓋企業訂閱
    
-   firmware: push automatic flags to firmware frontend  
    韌體：將自動標誌推送至韌體前端
    
-   intrusion detection: add YAML tag to custom.yaml.sample  
    入侵偵測：在 custom.yaml.sample 檔案中加入YAML標籤
    
-   intrusion detection: fix alert reads from eve.json  
    入侵偵測：修復從 eve.json 讀取警報的問題
    
-   ipsec: add “keyingtries” phase 1 configuration option  
    IPsec：新增「keyingtries」階段 1 設定選項
    
-   lang: updated available translations  
    語言：已更新可用翻譯
    
-   openvpn: remove now defunct OpenSSL engine support  
    openvpn：移除已失效的 OpenSSL 引擎支持
    
-   openvpn: return “result” instead of “status” in export  
    openvpn：匯出時回傳「result」而不是「status」。
    
-   unbound: cleanse blacklist domain input  
    unbound：清除黑名單域輸入
    
-   unbound: honour space as “domainsearchlist” separator  
    unbound：將空格作為「domainsearchlist」分隔符
    
-   unbound: match whole entry in blacklists (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    unbound：匹配黑名單中的完整條目（由 kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   unbound: use dhcpd\_staticmap() for lease registration  
    unbound：使用 dhcpd\_staticmap() 進行租約登記
    
-   rc: unconditionally configure routing on rc.syshook start facility  
    rc：在 rc.syshook 啟動設施時無條件設定路由
    
-   ui: change service restart icons to fa-repeat  
    ui：將服務重啟圖示改為 fa-repeat

    ui：按組對介面進行排序

    ui：防止翻譯換行符號斷開JS

    使用者介面：切換防火牆類別圖示以提高清晰度

    ui：將 chartjs-plugin-streaming 更新至1.9.0

##### 21.4.1 (June 02, 2021)｜21.4.1 （2021年6月2日）

This business release is based on the OPNsense 21.1.5 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 21.1.5社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

The OpenVPN advisory tracked as CVE-2020-15078 does not affect the provided version 2.4.11, but the security audit will falsely flag it as vulnerable because the source of the audit is FreeBSD where OpenVPN was migrated to 2.5 series already.

OpenVPN 安全公告CVE -2020-15078 不影響提供的版本2.4.11 ，但安全審計會錯誤地將其標記為易受攻擊，因為審計的來源是 FreeBSD，而 OpenVPN 已經遷移到2.5系列。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: lighttpd include directory for configuration (contributed by Greelan)

    防火牆：在整形器中使用位址表來避免因位址過多而導致 IPFW 崩潰。
    
-   firewall: clarify help text for firewall rules traffic direction (contributed by Greelan)

##### 21.4 (April 08, 2021)｜21.4 （2021年4月8日）

The OPNsense business edition moves into a new era with this 21.4 release. Note that the version numbers are now diverging from the community edition to make it easier to distinguish between the two. The next major update will be 21.10 in October.

OPNsense 商業版透過此次21.4版本邁入新時代。請注意，版本號碼已與社群版有所不同，以便於區分兩者。下一次重大更新將於 10 月發布，版本編號為21.10 。

Download link is as follows. An installation guide [\[1\]](#p-055) and the checksums for the images can be found below as well.

下載連結如下。安裝指南 [\[1\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/install.html ) 和映像校驗和也如下所示。

[https://downloads.opnsense.com/](https://downloads.opnsense.com/)

This business release is based on the OPNsense 21.1.4 community version with additional reliability improvements.

此商業版本基於 OPNsense 21.1.4社群版，並增加了可靠性改進。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: use authentication factory for web GUI login  
    系統：使用認證工廠進行 Web 登入GUI
    
-   system: allow case-insensitive matching for LDAP user authentication  
    系統：允許對LDAP用戶身份驗證進行不區分大小寫的匹配
    
-   system: removed unused gateway API dashboard feed  
    系統：已移除未使用的閘道API儀錶板饋送
    
-   system: removed spurious comma from certificate subject print and unified underlying code  
    系統：從憑證主題列印中移除多餘的逗號，並統一底層程式碼
    
-   system: harden web GUI defaults to TLS 1.2 minimum and strong ciphers  
    系統：強化網路GUI預設使用TLS 1.2最小且強的密碼
    
-   system: generate a better self-signed certificate for web GUI default  
    系統：為 Web GUI預設產生更好的自簽名憑證
    
-   system: allow self-signed renew for web GUI default (using “configctl webgui restart renew”)  
    系統：允許 web GUI預設進行自簽名續訂（使用「configctl webgui restart renew」）
    
-   system: allow subdirectories in NextCloud backup (contributed by Lorenzo Milesi)  
    系統：允許在 NextCloud 備份中使用子目錄（由 Lorenzo Milesi 提供）
    
-   system: first backup is same as current so ignore it on GUI and console  
    系統：第一次備份與目前備份相同，因此請忽略GUI和控制台上的備份。
    
-   system: optionally allow TOTP users to regenerate a token from the password page  
    系統：允許TOTP用戶從密碼頁面重新產生令牌（可選）
    
-   system: set hw.uart.console appropriately  
    系統：正確設定 hw.uart.console
    
-   system: reconfigure routes on bootup  
    系統：啟動時重新設定路由
    
-   system: relax gateway name validation  
    系統：放寬網關名稱驗證
    
-   system: ignore disabled gateways in dpinger services  
    系統：忽略 dpinger 服務中已停用的網關
    
-   system: choose a better bind candidate for IPv4 in dpinger  
    系統：在 dpinger 中為 IPv4 選擇更佳的綁定候選位址
    
-   system: do not trim string fields in upstream XMLRPC library  
    系統：不要修剪上游XMLRPC庫中的字串字段
    
-   system: fix export API keys reload issue on Safari  
    系統：修復 Safari 瀏覽器匯出API鍵重新載入問題
    
-   system: retain index after tunables sorting in 21.1.1  
    系統：在21.1.1中對可調參數進行排序後保留索引
    
-   system: fix firewall log widget update on small fixed number of entries  
    系統：修正防火牆日誌小工具在少量固定條目更新時出現的問題
    
-   system: replace traffic graphs in widget using chart.js  
    系統：使用 chart.js 取代小工具中的交通圖表
    
-   system: make StartTLS work when retrieving LDAP authentication containers (contributed by Christian Brueffer)  
    系統：使 StartTLS 在檢索LDAP身份驗證容器時正常運作（由 Christian Brueffer 提供）
    
-   system: fix IPv6 route deletion on status page  
    系統：修正狀態頁面上的 IPv6 路由刪除問題
    
-   system: prevent duplicate dashboard traffic pollers mangling with the graphs  
    系統：防止重複的儀錶板流量輪詢器幹擾圖表。
    
-   system: added cron job “HA update and reconfigure backup”  
    系統：新增了 cron 作業“ HA更新和重新配置備份”
    
-   system: unify HA sync sections and remove legacy blocks  
    系統：統一HA同步部分並移除舊版塊
    
-   system: adapt lighttpd ssl.privkey approach  
    系統：採用 lighttpd ssl.privkey 方法
    
-   system: correctly remove routing entries directly connected to an interface  
    系統：正確刪除直接連接到介面的路由條目
    
-   system: fix dashboard traffic widget load behaviour (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：修正儀錶板交通小工具載入行為（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   system: fix dashboard widget title regression  
    系統：修復儀錶板小工具標題回歸問題

    系統：新增各種缺少的配置部分以實現高可用性同步

    系統：延遲重新啟動 Web 服務GUI以防止會話斷開

<a id="p-042"></a>

#### 20.7 “Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子） Series｜20.7 “Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_20.7.html>

For five and a half years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

五年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

20.7, nicknamed “Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子）, is a major operating system jump forward on a sustainable firewall experience. This release adds DHCPv6 multi-WAN, custom error pages for the web proxy, Suricata 5, HardenedBSD 12.1, netstat tree view, basic firewall API support (via plugin) and extended live log filtering amongst others.

20.7 ，又稱“Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子） ，是作業系統在永續防火牆體驗方面的重大飛躍。此版本新增了對 DHCPv6 多埠WAN 、Web 代理程式自訂錯誤頁面、Suricata 5 和12.1 、netstat 樹狀視圖、基本防火牆API支援（透過外掛程式）以及擴展的即時日誌過濾等功能。

##### 20.7.8 (January 19, 2021)｜20.7.8 （2021年1月19日）

The particular volume of this stable update foreshadows the end of the 20.7 series in less than two weeks.

此次穩定版更新的特殊規模預示著20.7系列將在不到兩週的時間內結束。

One longstanding issue with radvd on FreeBSD 12.1 has been resolved according to multiple user feedback.

根據多位用戶的回饋，FreeBSD 12.1上 radvd 的一個長期存在的問題已經解決。

The mailing lists have been archived and will no longer be used.

郵件清單已存檔，將不再使用。

And before there are questions: yes, consumers of the development version are now able to upgrade to 21.1-RC1.

在提出問題之前：是的，開發版本的消費者現在可以升級到21.1-RC1 。

Here are the full patch notes:

-   system: allow to recover from bad TLS certificate and/or bad settings in console interface assign  
    系統：允許從錯誤的TLS憑證和/或控制台介面指派中的錯誤設定中恢復

    系統：保持與TLS 1 相容的 Web 預設設定GUI在20.7系列上

    系統：將預設憑證有效期限設定為 397 天

    防火牆：將類型 128 新增至出站 IPv6 RFC4890要求

    防火牆：在即時日誌中新增手動刷新按鈕

    防火牆：修復 ICMPv6 驗證中的拼字錯誤

##### 20.7.6 (December 08, 2020)｜20.7.6 （2020年12月8日）

This update brings the usual mix of reliability fixes, plugin and third party software updates: FreeBSD, HardenedBSD, PHP, OpenSSH, StrongSwan, Suricata and Syslog-ng amongst others.

本次更新帶來了常見的可靠性修復、插件和第三方軟體更新：FreeBSD、HardenedBSD、 PHP 、OpenSSH、StrongSwan、Suricata 和 Syslog-ng 等。

Please note that Let’s Encrypt users need to reissue their certificates manually after upgrading to this version to fix the embedded certificate chain issue with the current signing CA switch going on.

請注意，Let's Encrypt 用戶升級到此版本後需要手動重新頒發證書，以修復當前簽名CA開關導致的嵌入式證書鏈問題。

The mail backup plugin is currently not available pending a response from the maintainer. Users are advised to avoid using it for the moment.

郵件備份插件目前暫時無法使用，正在等待維護者的回覆。建議用戶暫時不要使用該插件。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: no longer enforce alias names in gateways  
    系統：不再強制網關使用別名
    
-   system: add “step into” icon on log lines when filtering  
    系統：在篩選日誌行時新增「進入」圖標
    
-   system: add current CPU load progress bar (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    系統：新增目前CPU載入進度條（由 kulikov-a 提供）
    
-   firewall: allow larger selection in live log  
    防火牆：允許在即時日誌中選擇更多選項
    
-   firewall: correctly select current IPv6 field in getInterfaceGateway()  
    防火牆：在 getInterfaceGateway() 中正確選擇目前 IPv6 字段
    
-   firewall: add validation for ipv6-icmp combined with inet  
    防火牆：新增對 IPv6 ICMP 與 INET 組合的驗證
    
-   reporting: traffic graph replacement using iftop  
    報告：使用 iftop 取代流量圖
    
-   openvpn: calculate first network address as gateway address when only ifconfig\_local is given  
    openvpn：只有在提供 ifconfig\_local 時，將第一個網路位址計算為網關位址
    
-   web proxy: throw startup error to user  
    Web代理程式：向使用者拋出啟動錯誤

    外掛：由於安全問題尚未解決，os-mail-backup 不可用。

##### 20.7.4 (October 22, 2020)｜20.7.4 （2020年10月22日）

This release finally wraps up the recent Netmap kernel changes and tests. The Realtek vendor driver was updated as well as third party software cURL, libxml, OpenSSL, PHP, Suricata, Syslog-ng and Unbound just to name a couple of them.

本次版本更新最終完成了近期 Netmap 核心的變更和測試。 Realtek 廠商驅動程式以及第三方軟體（例如 cURL、libxml、OpenSSL、 PHP 、Suricata、Syslog-ng 和 Unbound 等）也更新了。

We would like to thank Sunny Valley Networks for their relentless efforts to bring said Netmap fixes and improvements into FreeBSD.

我們要感謝 Sunny Valley Networks 為將上述 Netmap 修復和改進引入 FreeBSD 所做的不懈努力。

If you are having trouble with a stuck update try the command sequence below from the root shell or simply reboot from the GUI and rerun the update in case it was not fully carried out yet.

如果更新卡住，請嘗試從 root shell 執行以下命令序列，或直接從GUI重新啟動並重新運行更新，以防更新尚未完全完成。

```
# pkill syslog-ng
# service syslog-ng restart
```

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: switch web GUI address selection to avoid server.bind in IPv6 first case  
    系統：切換 web GUI位址選擇，以避免 IPv6 第一種情況下的 server.bind
    
-   system: fix defunct “use default” button on web GUI listen interfaces  
    系統：修正網頁上失效的「使用預設值」按鈕GUI監聽接口
    
-   system: signal “auth user changed” when a user is modified via web GUI  
    系統：當使用者透過 Web 修改時發出「auth user changed」訊號GUI
    
-   system: replace gateway widget and add proper API endpoint for it  
    系統：替換網關小工具並為其添加正確的API端點
    
-   system: fix reading displayName attribute on LDAP search (contributed by ServiusHack)  
    系統：修正LDAP搜尋中讀取 displayName 屬性的問題（由 ServiusHack 提供）
    
-   interfaces: change maximum MTU value to 65535 in accordance with RFC 791  
    接口：根據RFC 791 將MTU最大值改為 65535
    
-   interfaces: update wireless device detection prefixes  
    介面：更新無線設備偵測前綴
    
-   interfaces: lexical sort interface keys for assignments  
    介面：用於賦值的詞法排序介面鍵
    
-   firewall: add support for network exclusions in network alias type  
    防火牆：在網路別名類型中新增對網路排除項目的支持
    
-   firewall: add NAT information to pfInfo page (contributed by kulikov-a)  
    防火牆：在 pfInfo 頁面新增NAT資訊（kulikov-a 貢獻）
    
-   firewall: associated NAT rules missed state keyword  
    防火牆：關聯的NAT規則缺少狀態關鍵字
    
-   firewall: allow “or” conditions in live log  
    防火牆：允許即時日誌中的“或”條件

##### 20.7.3 (September 24, 2020)｜20.7.3 （2020年9月24日）

Today is the day for a number of FreeBSD security advisories and a few reliability fixes.

今天將發布多份 FreeBSD 安全公告和一些可靠性修復。

We are still testing a batch of Netmap improvement patches with a separate kernel. This and the Realtek vendor driver update will likely follow in the next kernel update. All feedback is welcome.

我們仍在用單獨的核心測試一批 Netmap 改進補丁。這些補丁以及 Realtek 廠商驅動程式的更新很可能會在下一次核心更新中發布。歡迎提供任何回饋意見。

##### 20.7.2 (September 02, 2020)｜20.7.2 （2020年9月2日）

While we are still looking closer at netmap/iflib performance on 12.1 we are rolling out a kernel with Intel em/igb updates that should avoid bad packet counts in the default installation. Syslog-ng received a workaround for the diagnosed startup issue and alias now supports MAC address content similar to how host content works.

雖然我們仍在深入研究12.1上的netmap/iflib性能，但我們正在推出一個包含Intel em/igb更新的內核，這應該可以避免預設安裝中出現錯誤的套件計數。 Syslog-ng已針對已診斷的啟動問題找到了解決方法，而別名現在支援MAC位址內容，其運作方式與主機內容類似。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: set REQUESTS\_CA\_BUNDLE in environments  
    系統：在環境中設定REQUESTS \_CA\_BUNDLE
    
-   system: improve parsing for temperature sensors  
    系統：改進溫度感測器的解析

    系統：在 Chrome 登入表單中新增「新密碼」提示

    系統：重新命名 syslog 服務描述，並在未啟用時隱藏舊版模式

    系統：啟動序列後強制 syslog-ng 重啟
    
-   system: properly read new style logging directories  
    系統：正確讀取新式日誌目錄

    報告：在 flowd_aggregate 中向 syslog 發送回溯訊息時替換行尾符

##### 20.7.1 (August 13, 2020)｜20.7.1 （2020年8月13日）

Small update here with security advisories, multicast fixes and logging reliability patches amongst others.

本次更新內容不多，包括安全性公告、多重播放修復和日誌可靠性修補程式等。

Overall, the jump to HardenedBSD 12.1 is looking promising from our end. From the reported issues we still have more logging quirks to investigate and especially Netmap support (used in IPS and Sensei) is lacking in some areas that were previously working. Patches are being worked on already so we shall get there soon enough. Stay tuned.

整體而言，從我們的角度來看，升級到 HardenedBSD 12.1的進展令人鼓舞。根據已報告的問題，我們仍需調查一些日誌記錄方面的小問題，尤其是 Netmap 支援（ IPS和 Sensei 中使用的）在某些方面存在不足，而這些方面之前是可以正常工作的。我們已經在著手開發補丁，相信很快就能解決問題。敬請期待。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

    系統：將日誌進程名稱拆分到單獨的欄位中

    系統：相應地過濾新樣式的日誌目錄

    系統：增加延遲以改善 syslog-ng 啟動速度

    系統：已正確將登入頁面切換到最新 jQuery 版本3.5.1

    韌體：請忽略健康輸出中的 mandoc.db 文件，因為系統每週都會重新產生它們。

##### 20.7 (July 30, 2020)｜20.7 （2020年7月30日）

For five and a half years, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

五年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

20.7, nicknamed “Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子）, is a major operating system jump forward on a sustainable firewall experience. This release adds DHCPv6 multi-WAN, custom error pages for the web proxy, Suricata 5, HardenedBSD 12.1, netstat tree view, basic firewall API support (via plugin) and extended live log filtering amongst others.

20.7 ，又稱“Legendary Lion”（傳奇獅子） ，是作業系統在永續防火牆體驗方面的重大飛躍。此版本新增了對 DHCPv6 多WAN的支援、Web 代理程式的自訂錯誤頁面、Suricata 5 和 HardenedBSD 12.1的支援、netstat 樹狀視圖、基本防火牆API支援（透過外掛程式實現）以及擴充功能的即時外掛程式實現）以及擴充功能的即時插件支援（透過外掛程式實現）以及擴充功能的即時裝置。

    介面：改進了VLAN處理和預設值，以便在12.1上更穩定地使用 netmap。

    介面：DHCPv4 no-release 和 debug 選項已移至全域介面設置
    
-   interfaces: automatically register loopback device lo0  
    介面：自動註冊環回設備 lo0
    
-   firewall: handle new net.pf.request\_maxcount system limit accordingly  
    防火牆：相應地處理新的 net.pf.request\_maxcount 系統限制
    
-   firewall: properly evaluate and execute gateway monitoring kill states feature  
    防火牆：正確評估並執行網關監控終止狀態功能
    
-   firewall: add the iplen option to shaper rules (contributed by Maxfield Allison)  
    防火牆：在整形規則中新增 iplen 選項（由 Maxfield Allison 提供）
    
-   firewall: show partial alias content in tooltip  
    防火牆：在工具提示中顯示部分別名內容
    
-   firewall: translated static log overview page to MVC  
    防火牆：已將靜態日誌概覽頁面翻譯為MVC
    
-   firewall: aliases now show internal aliases  
    防火牆：別名現在顯示內部別名
    
-   firewall: validate if NAT destination contains a port  
    防火牆：驗證NAT目標是否包含端口
    
-   firewall: prevent config\_read\_array() from adding an empty lo0  
    防火牆：阻止 config\_read\_array() 新增空的 lo0
    
-   firmware: added fingerprint for 20.7 series  
    韌體：新增20.7系列指紋辨識功能
    
-   firmware: hint at missing plugins and request to install or dismiss  
    韌體：提示缺少插件並請求安裝或關閉
    
-   intrusion detection: extend rule search with metadata and show results on rule info  
    入侵偵測：擴展規則搜尋範圍，新增元數據，並在規則資訊中顯示結果

#### 20.1 “Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥） Series｜20.1 “Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_20.1.html>

For over 5 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

5 多年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

20.1, nicknamed “Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥）, is a subtle improvement on sustainable firewall experience. This release adds VXLAN and additional loopback device support, IPsec public key authentication and elliptic curve TLS certificate creation amongst others. Third party software has been updated to their latest versions. The logging frontend was rewritten for MVC with seamless API support. On the far side the documentation increased in quality as well as quantity and now presents itself in a familiar menu layout.

20.1 （又稱“Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥） ）是對永續防火牆體驗的細微改進。此版本新增了VXLAN和額外的環回裝置支援、IPsec公鑰認證以及橢圓曲線TLS憑證建立等功能。第三方軟體已更新至最新版本。日誌前端已重寫，以支援MVC ，並無縫相容API 。此外，文件的品質和數量均有所提升，並採用熟悉的選單佈局。

##### 20.1.8 (July 02, 2020)｜20.1.8 （2020年7月2日）

Sorry about the delay while we chased a race condition in the updates back to an issue with the latest FreeBSD package manager updates. For now we reverted to our current version but all relevant third party packages have been updated as updates became available over the last weeks, e.g. cURL and Python, and hostapd / wpa\_supplicant amongst others.

很抱歉，由於我們一直在排查更新中的競態條件問題，導致更新延遲，該問題源自於最新的 FreeBSD 軟體套件管理器更新。目前我們已回滾到當前版本，但所有相關的第三方軟體包都已在過去幾週內隨著更新的發布而更新，例如 cURL、Python 以及 hostapd/wpa_supplicant 等。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: simpler get\_interface\_ip() usage in IPv4 renewal  
    系統：簡化 IPv4 續訂中 get\_interface\_ip() 的使用
    
-   system: allow HA sync of network time settings  
    系統：允許HA同步網路時間設定
    
-   system: download all filtered items in log export  
    系統：下載日誌匯出中所有已篩選的項目
    
-   system: add support for upstream LDAP accounts in Nextcloud backup (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    系統：在 Nextcloud 備份中新增對上游LDAP帳號的支援（由 Fabian Franz 貢獻）
    
-   interfaces: fix stateless DHCPv6 for track6 interfaces (contributed by Maurice Walker)  
    介面：修復 track6 介面的無狀態 DHCPv6 問題（由 Maurice Walker 提供）
    
-   firewall: fix missing address filter error by moving NAT targets to runtime resolve  
    防火牆：透過將NAT目標移至運行時解析來修復位址過濾器缺失錯誤

    防火牆：防止網關協定不符導致規則集失效

    防火牆：解決最新 jQuery 函式庫的類別自動補全問題

    防火牆：改善別名說明文字（由 Team Rebellion 提供）

##### 20.1.7 (May 20, 2020)｜20.1.7 （2020年5月20日）

Today we move to PHP 7.3 in order to be able to complete testing for the 20.7-BETA online upgrades. Also included is a patch for the packet filter kernel code which could crash with shared forwarding when interfaces disappeared due to use after free in the default network stack path.

今天我們升級到PHP 7.3 ，以便完成20.7-BETA線上升級的測試。此外，還包含一個針對資料包過濾器核心程式碼的補丁，該補丁修復了在預設網路協定堆疊路徑中，由於釋放後使用導致介面消失時，共用轉送功能可能會崩潰的問題。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: default net.inet.icmp.reply\_from\_interface to 1  
    系統：預設 net.inet.icmp.reply\_from\_interface 為 1
    
-   system: fix static gateway wizard handing  
    系統：修復靜態網關精靈處理
    
-   firewall: allow outbound NAT source and destination port ranges  
    防火牆：允許出站NAT源埠與目標埠範圍
    
-   interfaces: use interfaces\_primary\_address6() inside get\_interface\_ipv6()  
    介面：在 get_interface_ipv6() 中使用 interfaces_primary_address6()
    
-   dhcp: add AdvLinkMTU to router advertisements settings (contributed by Ilteris Eroglu)  
    DHCP：將 AdvLinkMTU 新增至路由器通告設定（由 Ilteris Eroglu 提供）
    
-   unbound: prevent wildcard domains for the local system domain  
    unbound：阻止本機系統域使用通配符域
    
-   backend: suppress inconsequential IDNA warnings for aliases  
    後端：抑制別名的無關緊要的IDNA警告
    
-   backend: add option to return a key value list for TLS ciphers  
    後端：新增返回TLS密碼鍵值清單的選項
    
-   mvc: reference constraint pointing validation results to the wrong field  
    MVC：引用約束將驗證結果指向錯誤的字段
    
-   plugins: os-acme-client 1.32 adds Acmeproxy DNS support (contributed by Maarten den Braber)  
    插件：os-acme-client 1.32新增了 Acmeproxy DNS支援（由 Maarten den Braber 貢獻）
    
-   src: added Novatel Wireless MiFi 8800/8000 support (contributed by rootless4real)  
    資料來源：新增對 Novatel Wireless MiFi 8800/8000 的支援（由 rootless4real 貢獻）
    
-   src: fix pf shared forwarding on non-existing interfaces  
    src：修正不存在的介面上的 PF 共享轉送問題
    
-   src: patch in tty 3wire autologin support
