##### 20.1.5 (April 23, 2020)｜20.1.5 （2020年4月23日）

Today ships the first release version of the supplemental firewall rule API via plugin, a new firewall shaper statistics GUI and API and the usual number of improvements and third party updates.

今天發布了第一個透過插件提供的補充防火牆規則API版本、​​新的防火牆整形統計資訊GUI和API ，以及通常數量的改進和第三方更新。

Note that this version does not ship OpenSSL 1.1.1g as at this point our release decision would have been to push 20.1.5 to next week or do a smaller 20.1.6 next week on top.

請注意，此版本不包含 OpenSSL 1.1 .1g，因為此時我們的發布決定是將20.1.5推遲到下週，或者在下週在此基礎上發布一個更小的20.1.6 。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: support configuration for SSH HostKeyAlgorithms, KexAlgorithms, Ciphers and MACs  
    系統：支援對SSH主機金鑰演算法、金鑰交換演算法、密碼和MAC的配置
    
-   system: simplify validations in gateway monitor settings  
    系統：簡化網關監控設定中的驗證
    
-   interfaces: mark VXLAN and loopback devices as configurable  
    介面：將VXLAN和環回設備標記為可設定
    
-   interfaces: validation typo caused failure to communicate unassignable targets  
    介面：驗證錯誤導致無法傳遞無法傳遞的目標
    
-   interfaces: netstat tree view GUI and API  
    介面：netstat 樹狀視圖GUI和API
    
-   interfaces: use libxo to extract ARP data  
    介面：使用 libxo 擷取ARP數據
    
-   firewall: checkbox selection ignores visibility setting  
    防火牆：選取複選框會忽略可見性設置
    
-   firewall: add network group type to combine aliases cleanly  
    防火牆：新增網路群組類型以清楚合併別名
    
-   firewall: IPv6 essential icmpv6 allow for  
    防火牆：IPv6 基本 icmpv6 允許
    
-   firewall: new shaper statistics GUI and API  
    防火牆：新的整形器統計資訊GUI和API
    
-   firewall: support filter log messages with PID  
    防火牆：支援使用PID過濾日誌訊息
    
-   reporting: when flow times are not returned stick to receive timestamp  
    報告：未返回流程時間時，堅持接收時間戳
    
-   openvpn: use multihome when selecting “any” interface with UDP  
    openvpn：在選擇「任意」介面時使用多宿主UDP
    
-   unbound: create shared startup script for background task  
    unbound：為背景任務建立共享啟動腳本
    
-   mvc: also store “” field value as initial state to prevent empty fields as being marked as changed  
    MVC：同時將空白欄位值儲存為初始狀態，以防止將空白欄位標記為已變更。
    
-   mvc: firewall source NAT ranges support in plugins  
    mvc：外掛程式中支援防火牆源NAT範圍
    
-   mvc: keep options in static set for PortField

    mvc：跳過空的閘道工件

##### 20.1 (January 30, 2020)｜20.1 （2020年1月30日）

For over 5 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

5 多年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

20.1, nicknamed “Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥）, is a subtle improvement on sustainable firewall experience. This release adds VXLAN and additional loopback device support, IPsec public key authentication and elliptic curve TLS certificate creation amongst others. Third party software has been updated to their latest versions. The logging frontend was rewritten for MVC with seamless API support. On the far side the documentation increased in quality as well as quantity and now presents itself in a familiar menu layout.

20.1 （又稱“Keen Kingfisher”（翠鳥） ）是對永續防火牆體驗的細微改進。此版本新增了VXLAN和額外的環回裝置支援、IPsec公鑰認證以及橢圓曲線TLS憑證建立等功能。第三方軟體已更新至最新版本。日誌前端已重寫，以支援MVC ，並無縫相容API 。此外，文件的品質和數量均有所提升，並採用熟悉的選單佈局。

##### 20.1.r1 (January 24, 2020)｜20.1 .r1（2020年1月24日）

For over 5 years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

5 多年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you.

感謝大家參與測試、完善和貢獻這個專案！我們知道，沒有你們，這個計畫就不會是現在的樣子。

#### 19.7 “Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹） Series｜19.7 “Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_19.7.html>

For four and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

四年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

19.7, nicknamed “Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹）, embodies an iteration of what should be considered enjoyable user experience for firewalls in general: improved statistics and visibility of rules, reliable and consistent live logging and alias utility improvements. Apart from the usual upgrades of third party software to up-to-date releases, OPNsense now also offers built-in remote system logging through Syslog-ng, route-based IPsec, updated translations with Spanish as a brand new and already fully translated language and newer Netmap code with VirtIO, VLAN child and vmxnet support.

19.7 （又稱“Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹） ）體現了防火牆使用者體驗的全新迭代：改進了規則的統計資訊和可見性，增強了即時日誌記錄的可靠性和一致性，並改進了別名工具。除了將第三方軟體升級到最新版本外，OPNsense 現在還提供透過 Syslog-ng 實現的內建遠端系統日誌記錄、基於路由的 IPsec、更新的翻譯（新增西班牙語，且已完成翻譯）以及支援 VirtIO、 VLAN子節點和 vmxnet 的更新版 Netmap 程式碼。

Last but not least we would like to thank m.a.x. it for their sponsorship of the default gateway priority switching feature and their continued work of writing and maintaining plenty of community plugins. This time around, Maltrail, Netdata and WireGuard VPN have been freshly added to the mix.

最後，我們要感謝 Max It 對預設閘道優先權切換功能的贊助，以及他們持續編寫和維護大量社群插件的工作。此次，Maltrail、Netdata 和 WireGuard VPN也加入了支援行列。

##### 19.7.10 (January 27, 2020)｜19.7.10 （2020年1月27日）

As Thursday nears the last preparations for 20.1 are underway. As a quick relief here is the End-Of-Life release of the 19.7 series with a tiny number of updates.

隨著週四臨近， 20.1的最後準備工作正在進行中。作為一項快速的緩解措施，我們發布了19.7系列的生命週期結束版本，其中包含少量更新。

Remember that when 20.1 is available it will take up to a day before we release the hotfix with the major upgrade path enabled. Please be patient as we simply want to ensure that upgrades will not be bumpy affair. :)

請注意，當20.1可用時，我們最多需要一天時間才會發布啟用主要升級路徑的熱修復補丁。請耐心等待，我們只想確保升級過程順利無阻。 :)

##### 19.7.6 (November 01, 2019)｜19.7.6 （2019年11月1日）

As we are experiencing the Suricata community first hand in Amsterdam we though to release this version a bit earlier than planned. Included is the latest Suricata 5.0.0 release in the development version. That means later this November we will releasing version 5 to the production version as we finish up tweaking the integration and maybe pick up 5.0.1 as it becomes available.

由於我們在阿姆斯特丹親身感受到了 Suricata 社群的活力，我們決定提前發布此版本。開發版本中已包含最新的 Suricata 5.0.0版本。這意味著今年 11 月下旬，我們將發布版本 5 至正式版，屆時我們將完成整合方面的調整，並可能在5.0.1版本發布後將其納入其中。

LDAP TLS connectivity is now integrated into the system trust store, which ensures that all required root and intermediate certificates will be seen by the connection setup when they have been added to the authorities section. The same is true for trusting self-signed certificates. On top of this, IPsec now supports public key authentication as contributed by Pascal Mathis.

LDAP TLS連線現已整合到系統信任儲存中，這確保了所有必需的根憑證和中間憑證在新增至授權機構部分後，都能被連線建立流程識別。信任自簽名憑證也是如此。此外，IPsec 現在支援由 Pascal Mathis 貢獻的公鑰認證。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: hook LDAP TLS support into system-wide trust file  
    系統：將LDAP TLS支援加入到系統層級信任檔案中
    
-   system: fix dpinger custom parameters not being honoured  
    系統：修復 dpinger 自訂參數不生效的問題
    
-   system: fix PHP core loop fail in tunables overview

-   system: only allow P12 export if password confirmation matches  
    系統：僅當密碼確認匹配時才允許匯出 P12 文件
    
-   interfaces: change PCAP download to binary file stream  
    介面：將PCAP下載更改為二進位檔案流

##### 19.7.3 (August 28, 2019)｜19.7.3 （2019年8月28日）

Please enjoy this release with improved CARP utility and a number of smaller fixes and updates for the operating system and third party tools. You can now also toggle logging directly from the rule overview to make debugging easier.

此版本改進了CARP實用程序，並修復和更新了作業系統和第三方工具的一些小問題，敬請體驗。現在您也可以直接從規則概覽中切換日誌記錄，從而簡化偵錯過程。

Here is the full list of changes:

以下是全部變更內容：

-   system: try all backups for automatic revert when config.xml is damaged  
    系統：嘗試所有備份以實現 config.xml 檔案損壞時的自動復原。
    
-   system: do a system reset if all config.xml files are damaged  
    系統：如果所有 config.xml 檔案都已損壞，則執行系統重設。
    
-   system: only show tunables reboot hint when applying tunables (contributed by Northguy)  
    系統：僅在應用可調參數時顯示可調參數重啟提示（由 Northguy 提供）
    
-   system: use FQDN in system log remote messages  
    系統：在系統日誌遠端訊息中使用FQDN
    
-   system: add defunct gateways to GUI in disabled state  
    系統：將失效網關新增至處於停用狀態的GUI
    
-   interfaces: only allow VLAN parents that will work as VLAN parents  
    介面：僅允許能夠作為VLAN父級工作的VLAN父級
    
-   interfaces: optionally promote/demote CARP on service status  
    介面：可依服務狀態選擇性地提升/降級CARP
    
-   interfaces: CARP status page report with demotion level to avoid ambiguity  
    介面： CARP狀態頁面報告，具有降級等級以避免歧義
    
-   firewall: revert problematic 19.7.2 change “unhide automatic interface-based output rules”  
    防火牆：恢復有問題的19.7.2更改“取消隱藏基於介面的自動輸出規則”
    
-   firewall: restore automatic outbound NAT pre-19.7 behaviour which excludes gateways not configured and not dynamic  
    防火牆：恢復自動出站NAT預19.7行為，此行為排除未設定和非動態閘道。
    
-   firewall: add logging toggle to rules overview (contributed by johnaheadley)  
    防火牆：在規則概覽中新增日誌記錄開關（由 johnaheadley 提供）
    
-   firewall: DHCPv6 relay would generate rules even if not enabled  
    防火牆：即使未啟用 DHCPv6 中繼，也會產生規則。
    
-   firmware: only do single-repository fingerprint verify defaulting to our OPNsense repository  
    韌體：僅進行單一倉庫指紋驗證，預設使用我們的 OPNsense 倉庫。
    
-   firmware: fix base and kernel package listing  
    韌體：修復基礎軟體包和內核軟體包列表
    
-   intrusion detection: show change message after toggle or save  
    入侵偵測：切換或儲存後顯示變更訊息
    
-   intrusion detection: rule download fix  
    入侵偵測：規則下載修復
    
-   monit: add parent devices to interface list (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    monit：將父設備新增至介面清單（由 Frank Brendel 提供）
    
-   monit: fix standard configuration migration (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    monit：修復標準配置遷移問題（由 Frank Brendel 貢獻）
    
-   reporting: skip illegal NetFlow records in flow parser  
    報表：跳過流解析器中的非法 NetFlow 記錄

##### 19.7.2 (August 05, 2019)｜19.7.2 （2019年8月5日）

This update ships the latest FreeBSD security advisories along with several smaller improvements and fixes. Sunny Valley Networks is the first vendor to introduce additional software to the plugin framework in the form of the Sensei plugin.

本次更新包含了最新的 FreeBSD 安全公告以及一些較小的改進和修復。 Sunny Valley Networks 是首家以 Sensei 插件的形式向插件框架引入額外軟體的供應商。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: missing “<PRI>” in legacy output via Syslog-ng  
    系統：透過 Syslog-ng 輸出的舊版日誌中缺少「 <PRI> 」。
    
-   system: fix writing gateway information for DNS servers  
    系統：修復DNS伺服器的網關資訊寫入問題
    
-   system: allow gateway to work in DHCPv6 WAN when no router solicitation is available  
    系統：允許網關在沒有路由器請求時以 DHCPv6 WAN模式工作
    
-   firewall: unhide automatic interface-based output rules  
    防火牆：取消隱藏基於介面的自動輸出規則
    
-   firewall: unhide automatic non-interface-based floating rules  
    防火牆：取消隱藏自動非介面浮動規則
    
-   firewall: lift length restriction in NAT rule description  
    防火牆： NAT規則描述中的提升長度限制
    
-   firewall: avoid newlines in rule descriptions  
    防火牆：規則描述中避免使用換行符
    
-   firewall: only show usable addresses in NAT outbound rules  
    防火牆：僅在NAT出站規則中顯示可用位址
    
-   interfaces: fix extended CARP output when parsing interface information  
    介面：修復解析介面資訊時擴充的CARP輸出問題
    
-   interfaces: add more outputs to overview page to increase usefulness  
    介面：在概覽頁面中新增更多輸出以提高實用性
    
-   interfaces: use shared DHCP lease reader for ARP list  
    介面：使用共享的DHCP租約讀取器進行ARP列表
    
-   captive portal: fix binary read issue in Python 3  
    強制門戶：修復 Python 3 中的二進位讀取問題

    DHCP：修復 DHCPv4 中繼介面選擇問題（由 jayantsahtoe 提供）

##### 19.7.1 (July 25, 2019)｜19.7.1 （2019年7月25日）

We do not wish to keep you from enjoying your summer time, but this is a recommended security update enriched with reliability fixes for the new 19.7 series. Of special note are performance improvements as well as a fix for a longstanding NAT before IPsec limitation.

我們不想影響您享受夏日時光，但本次更新旨在為新款19.7系列產品提供安全保障，並修復了可靠性問題。尤其值得一提的是，本次更新也提升了效能，並修復了長期存在的NAT IPsec 連線限制問題。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: do not create automatic copies of existing gateways  
    系統：不要自動複製現有網關
    
-   system: do not translate empty tunables descriptions  
    系統：不要翻譯空的可調參數描述
    
-   system: remove unwanted form action tags  
    系統：移除不需要的表單操作標籤
    
-   system: do not include Syslog-ng in rc.freebsd handler  
    系統：不要在 rc.freebsd 處理程序中包含 Syslog-ng。
    
-   system: fix manual system log stop/start/restart  
    系統：修復手動系統日誌停止/啟動/重新啟動問題
    
-   system: scoped IPv6 “%” could confuse mwexecf(), use plain mwexec() instead  
    系統提示：作用域 IPv6 “%” 可能會導致 mwexecf() 函式出錯，請改用普通的 mwexec() 函式。
    
-   system: allow curl-based downloads to use both trusted and local authorities  
    系統：允許基於 curl 的下載同時使用受信任的和本地的授權機構。
    
-   system: fix group privilege print and correctly redirect after edit  
    系統：修復群組權限列印和編輯後正確重定向的問題
    
-   system: use cached address list in referrer check  
    系統：在引用檢查中使用快取的位址列表
    
-   system: fix Syslog-ng search stats  
    系統：修復 Syslog-ng 搜尋統計信息
    
-   firewall: HTML-escape dynamic entries to display aliases  
    防火牆： HTML -轉義動態條目以顯示別名
    
-   firewall: display correct IP version in automatic rules  
    防火牆：在自動規則中顯示正確的IP版本
    
-   firewall: fix a warning while reading empty outbound rules configuration  
    防火牆：修正讀取空出站規則配置時出現的警告
    
-   firewall: skip illegal log lines in live log  
    防火牆：跳過即時日誌中的非法日誌行
    
-   interfaces: performance improvements for configurations with hundreds of interfaces  
    介面：針對包含數百個介面的配置，效能有所提升
    
-   reporting: performance improvements for Python 3 NetFlow aggregator rewrite  
    報表：Python 3 NetFlow 聚合器重寫後的效能改進
    
-   dhcp: move advanced router advertisement options to correct config section  
    DHCP：將進階路由器通告選項移至正確的設定部分
    
-   ipsec: replace global array access with function to ensure side-effect free boot  
    IPsec：用函數替換全域數組訪問，以確保無副作用啟動
    
-   ipsec: change DPD action on start to “dpdaction = restart”  
    ipsec：將DPD啟動時的操作更改為“dpdaction = restart”
    
-   ipsec: remove already default “dpdaction = none” if not set  
    ipsec：如果未設置，則移除已存在的預設值「dpdaction = none」。
    
-   ipsec: use interface IP address in local ID when doing NAT before IPsec  
    IPsec：在執行NAT之前，使用本機介面IP中的ID位址
    
-   web proxy: fix database reset for Squid 4 by replacing use of ssl\_crtd with security\_file\_certgen  
    Web代理：修正Squid 4的資料庫重設問題，方法是將ssl\_crtd替換為security\_file\_certgen。

##### 19.7 (July 17, 2019)｜19.7 （2019年7月17日）

For four and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

四年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆來推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

19.7, nicknamed “Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹）, embodies an iteration of what should be considered enjoyable user experience for firewalls in general: improved statistics and visibility of rules, reliable and consistent live logging and alias utility improvements. Apart from the usual upgrades of third party software to up-to-date releases, OPNsense now also offers built-in remote system logging through Syslog-ng, route-based IPsec, updated translations with Spanish as a brand new and already fully translated language and newer Netmap code with VirtIO, VLAN child and vmxnet support.

19.7 （暱稱“Jazzy Jaguar”（爵士捷豹） ）體現了防火牆使用者體驗的全新方向：改進了規則的統計資訊和可見性，增強了即時日誌記錄的可靠性和一致性，並改進了別名工具。除了將第三方軟體升級到最新版本外，OPNsense 現在還提供透過 Syslog-ng 實現的內建遠端系統日誌記錄、基於路由的 IPsec、更新的翻譯（新增西班牙語，且已完成翻譯）以及支援 VirtIO、 VLAN子節點和 vmxnet 的更新版 Netmap 程式碼。

Last but not least we would like to thank m.a.x. it for their sponsorship of the default gateway priority switching feature and their continued work of writing and maintaining plenty of community plugins. This time around, Maltrail, Netdata and WireGuard VPN have been freshly added to the mix.

最後，我們要感謝 Max It 對預設閘道優先權切換功能的贊助，以及他們持續編寫和維護大量社群插件的工作。此次，Maltrail、Netdata 和 WireGuard VPN也加入了支援行列。

These are the most prominent changes since version 19.1:

以下是自19.1版本以來最顯著的變化：

-   List automatic firewall rules  
    列出自動防火牆規則
    
-   Statistics for all firewall rules  
    所有防火牆規則的統計訊息
    
-   Alias JSON import / export  
    別名JSON導入/導出
    
-   Optional statistics for aliases  
    別名的可選統計信息
    
-   Firewall rule locator for live log and automatic rules  
    即時日誌和自動規則的防火牆規則定位器
    
-   Rewritten gateway handling and switching  
    重寫了網關處理和交換機制
    
-   Remote logging via Syslog-ng  
    透過 Syslog 進行遠端日誌記錄
    
-   LDAP group sync support  
    LDAP群組同步支持
    
-   Support certificate signing requests  
    支援證書簽署請求
    
-   Route-based IPsec support (VTI)  
    基於路由的 IPsec 支援 ( VTI )
    
-   XMLRPC sync support for alias, VHID, widgets  
    XMLRPC別名同步支持， VHID小部件
    
-   Unbound host overrides alias support  
    未綁定主機覆蓋別名支持
    
-   Web proxy and IPsec authentication using PAM  
    使用PAM Web 代理程式和 IPsec 驗證
    
-   Parent web proxy support  
    父級 Web 代理程式支援
    
-   Web proxy login privilege via group  
    透過群組存取 Web 代理登入權限
    
-   Improved reliability and utility of opnsense-patch  
    改進了 opnsense-patch 的可靠性和實用性
    
-   Dpinger and DHCP servers ported to plugin framework  
    Dpinger 和DHCP伺服器已移植到插件框架
    
-   Language updates for Chinese, Czech, Japanese, German, French, Russian and Portuguese  
    語言更新：中文、捷克語、日語、德語、法語、俄語和葡萄牙語
    
-   Spanish as a new language  
    西班牙語作為一門新語言
    
-   Netdata, WireGuard, Maltrail and Mail-Backup (PGP) plugin  
    Netdata、WireGuard、Maltrail 和 Mail-Backup ( PGP ) 插件
    
-   Netmap update for VirtIO, VLAN child and vmxnet support  
    針對 VirtIO、 VLAN子項和 vmxnet 的網路映射更新支援
    
-   Bootstrap 3.4, LibreSSL 2.9, Unbound 1.9, PHP 7.2, Python 3.7, Squid 4  
    Bootstrap 3.4 、LibreSSL 2.9 、Unbound 1.9, PHP 7.2 、Python 3.7 、Squid 4

    src:恢復IPV6 \_NEXTHOP選項支持

Known issues and limitations:

已知問題和限制：

-   Web proxy squid update from version 3 to 4 breaks the cache database. To repair go to “Services: Web Proxy: Administration” tab “Support”（支援） and click “Reset”（重置）.  
    Web 代理程式 Squid 從版本 3 更新到版本 4 會破壞快取資料庫。若要修復此問題，請前往「服務：Web 代理程式：管理」標籤“Support”（支援）並按一下“Reset”（重置） 。
    
-   Web proxy login privilege is no longer available. Access may be restricted by a group selector instead.  
    Web代理登入權限已不再可用。存取權限可能改為透過群組選擇器進行限制。
    
-   Nano images require a reinstall using the latest image to avoid inode shortage which makes the system appear to run out of space during recent 19.1.x updates.  
    Nano 鏡像需要使用最新鏡像重新安裝，以避免 inode 短缺導致系統在最近的19.1 .x 更新期間出現空間不足的情況。
    
-   OpenVPN no longer supports listening on gateway groups. Use localhost paired with port forwards instead.  
    OpenVPN 已不再支援監聽網關群組。請改用 localhost 並配合連接埠轉送。

##### 19.7.r1 (July 09, 2019)｜19.7 .r1（2019年7月9日）

For four and a half years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

四年半以來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

We thank all of you for helping test, shape and contribute to the project! We know it would not be the same without you.

感謝大家參與測試、完善和貢獻這個專案！我們知道，沒有你們，這個計畫就不會是現在的樣子。

Here are the full changes against version 19.1.10:

以下是與版本19.1.10相比的全部變更：

-   system: new remote syslog setup via Syslog-ng  
    系統：透過 Syslog-ng 設定新的遠端 syslog
    
-   system: gateway handling rewrite  
    系統：網關處理重寫
    
-   system: default gateway switching priority control [\[2\]](https://www.max-it.de/) (sponsored by m.a.x. it)  
    系統：預設閘道切換優先權控制 [\[2\]]( https://www.max-it.de/ ) (由 max it 贊助)
    
-   system: dpinger ported to plugin framework  
    系統：dpinger 已移植到插件框架
    
-   system: bring back PHP warning log level  
    系統：恢復PHP警告日誌級別
    
-   system: use authentication factory for user import  
    系統：使用身份驗證工廠進行使用者導入
    
-   interfaces: VLAN, bridge, LAGG, GRE, GIF setup refactor  
    介面： VLAN ，橋接， LAGG, GRE, GIF設定重構
    
-   interfaces: improve load sequence to allow DHCPv6 on bridges  
    介面：改進負載順序以允許在網橋上使用 DHCPv6
    
-   interfaces: GIF, GRE, IPsec and OpenVPN will no longer accept IP configuration  
    介面： GIF, GRE 、IPsec 和 OpenVPN 將不再接受IP配置
    
-   interfaces: speed up get\_real\_interface() by assuming interfaces exist  
    介面：透過假設介面存在來加速 get\_real\_interface() 函數。
    
-   interfaces: sort interface groups and require rules apply if necessary (contributed by Robin Schneider)  
    介面：對介面組進行排序，並根據需要應用規則（由 Robin Schneider 提供）
    
-   interfaces: background PPPoE connect and disconnect  
    介面：後台PPPoE連線與斷開
    
-   interfaces: only IP-address allowed in PPP gateway (contributed by Smart-Soft)  
    介面：PPP網關中僅允許IP位址（由Smart-Soft提供）
    
-   interfaces: simplified linking VIPs to interfaces  
    介面：簡化 VIP 與介面的鏈接
    
-   interfaces: removed interface\_has\_gateway()  
    介面：刪除了interface\_has\_gateway()
    
-   interfaces: removed interface\_has\_gatewayv6()  
    介面：刪除了介面\_has\_gatewayv6()
    
-   interfaces: removed get\_failover\_interface()  
    介面：刪除了 get\_failover\_interface()
    
-   interfaces: removed rc.kill\_states  
    介面：刪除了 rc.kill\_states
    
-   firewall: ability to view automatic rules  
    防火牆：查看自動規則的能力
    
-   firewall: rule origin locator in live log and automatic rules listing  
    防火牆：即時日誌中的規則來源定位器和自動規則列表
    
-   firewall: show statistics for all active rules including automatic ones  
    防火牆：顯示所有活動規則（包括自動規則）的統計訊息
    
-   firewall: optional statistics for alias tables  
    防火牆：別名表的可選統計信息
    
-   firewall: fix translation of shaper mask “none” value  
    防火牆：修復整形器遮罩「無」值的翻譯
    
-   firewall: add ipv6-icmp type selection  
    防火牆：新增ipv6-icmp類型選擇
    
-   firewall: rule listing layout update  
    防火牆：規則清單佈局更新
    
-   reporting: new NetFlow reader in Python 3  
    報告：Python 3 中的新 NetFlow 讀取器
    
-   reporting: validate that NetFlow WAN interfaces are also added to listening interfaces  
    報告：驗證 NetFlow WAN 介面也已新增至偵聽接口
    
-   dhcp: ported to plugin framework  
    dhcp：移植到插件框架
    
-   dhcp: added failover split to DHCPv4 (contributed by Wolfgang Pedot)  
    dhcp：在 DHCPv4 中加入了故障轉移拆分（由 Wolfgang Pedot 貢獻）
    
-   dhcp: fix ddnsdomainprimary setting validation  
    dhcp：修復 ddnsdomainprimary 設定驗證
    
-   dhcp: added advanced options for router advertisements  
    dhcp：新增了路由器通告的進階選項
    
-   dhcp: removed remove rasend/ranosend checkbox  
    dhcp：刪除了刪除 rasend/ranosend 複選框
    
-   dhcp: simplify DHCPv4 interface lookup on lease page  
    dhcp：簡化租約頁面上的 DHCPv4 介面查找
    
-   dhcp: use AdvDefaultLifetime 0 when default route shall not be advertised  
    dhcp：當預設路由不被通告時使用 AdvDefaultLifetime 0
    
-   firmware: support reading package repository and origin  
    韌體：支援讀取包倉庫和origin
    
-   firmware: warn on third party package installation  
    韌體：警告第三方軟體包安裝
    
-   firmware: synchronise update checks to avoid “not responding” errors  
    韌體：同步更新檢查以避免「無響應」錯誤
    
-   firmware: fix empty update list on release type change  
    韌體：修復發布類型變更時的空更新列表
    
-   images: nano image now supports future-proof number of inodes  
    圖像：nano 圖像現在支援面向未來的 inode 數量
    
-   installer: support password reset in opnsense-importer  
    安裝程式：支援在 opnsense-importer 中重設密碼
    
-   intrusion detection: allow rule action bulk changes  
    入侵偵測：允許規則操作批次更改
    
-   intrusion detection: minor usability improvements  
    入侵偵測：可用性的微小改進
    
-   intrusion detection: support eve system log output  
    入侵偵測：支援eve系統日誌輸出
    
-   openvpn: removed gateway group listening support  
    openvpn：刪除了網關群組偵聽支持
    
-   openvpn: no longer restart servers on CARP events  
    openvpn：不再在 CARP 事件上重新啟動伺服器
    
-   openvpn: reduced complexity in service handling  
    openvpn：降低服務處理的複雜性
    
-   web proxy: replace proxy login privilege “user-proxy-auth” with group selector  
    Web 代理程式：以群組選擇器取代代理程式登入權限“user-proxy-auth”
    
-   backend: ported remaining scripts to Python 3  
    後端：將剩餘腳本移植到 Python 3
    
-   backend: add helpers.glob() to enable template traversal  
    後端：新增helpers.glob()以啟用範本遍歷
    
-   backend: new “monitor” hook for rc.syshook  
    後端：rc.syshook 的新「監視器」掛鉤
    
-   mvc: do not add “none” in AuthGroupField if multiple select  
    mvc：如果多重選擇，請不要在 AuthGroupField 中新增“none”
    
-   mvc: allow sorting JsonKeyValueStoreField by value  
    mvc：允許按值排序 JsonKeyValueStoreField
    
-   ui: remember previous selected columns and row count on several MVC pages  
    ui：記住幾個MVC頁面上先前選擇的列和行數
    
-   ui: apply alert reminders for several MVC pages  
    ui：為多個MVC頁面應用警報提醒
    
-   ui: add failed callback to saveFormToEndpoint()  
    ui：向 saveFormToEndpoint() 新增失敗回調
    
-   ui: core theme color update  
    ui：核心主題顏色更新
    
-   ui: fix file size suffix (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    ui：修復檔案大小後綴（由 Fabian Franz 貢獻）
    
-   ui: add useRequestHandlerOnGet option  
    ui：新增 useRequestHandlerOnGet 選項
    
-   ui: bootstrap 3.4.1 [\[3\]](https://blog.getbootstrap.com/2019/02/13/bootstrap-4-3-1-and-3-4-1/)  
    ui: 引導程式 3.4.1 [\[3\]](https://blog.getbootstrap.com/2019/02/13/bootstrap-4-3-1-and-3-4-1/)
    
-   src: netmap VirtIO, VLAN child and vmxnet support  
    src：網路映射 VirtIO、VLAN 子級和 vmxnet 支持
    
-   src: fix races in tun(4)/tap(4) drivers  
    src：修復 tun(4)/tap(4) 驅動程式中的比賽
    
-   ports: squid 4.7 [\[4\]](http://squid.mirror.colo-serv.net/archive/4/squid-4.0.7-RELEASENOTES.html)  
    端口：魷魚4.7 [\[4\]](http://squid.mirror.colo-serv.net/archive/4/squid-4.0.7-RELEASENOTES.html)
    
-   ports: syslog-ng 3.21.1 [\[5\]](https://github.com/syslog-ng/syslog-ng/releases/tag/syslog-ng-3.21.1)  
    端口：syslog-ng 3.21.1 [\[5\]](https://github.com/syslog-ng/syslog-ng/releases/tag/syslog-ng-3.21.1)
    

Known issues and limitations:

已知問題和限制：

-   Filterlog spamming console due to new Syslog-ng integration. Temporary workaround is stopping filterlog via “pkill filterlog”.  
    由於新的 Syslog-ng 集成，過濾日誌垃圾郵件控制台。臨時解決方法是透過「pkill filterlog」停止filterlog。
    
-   OpenVPN no longer supports listening on gateway groups. Use localhost paired with port forwards instead.  
    OpenVPN 不再支援偵聽網關群組。請使用與連接埠轉送配對的 localhost。
    
-   The web proxy login privilege is no longer available. Access may be restricted by a group selector instead.  
    Web 代理登入權限不再可用。相反，存取可能會受到群組選擇器的限制。
    
-   Web proxy squid update from version 3 to 4 breaks the cache database. To repair go to “Services: Web Proxy: Administration” tab “Support”（支援） and click “Reset”（重置）.  
    Web 代理魷魚從版本 3 更新到版本 4 會破壞快取資料庫。要修复，请转到“服务：Web 代理：管理”选项卡“Support”（支援），然后单击“Reset”（重置）。
    
-   Nano images require a reinstall using the latest image to avoid inode shortage which makes the system appear to run out of space during recent 19.1.x updates.  
    Nano 映像需要使用最新映像重新安裝，以避免 inode 短缺，從而導致系統在最近的 19.1.x 更新期間出現空間不足的情況。

#### 19.1 “Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥） Series｜19.1 “Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥）系列

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/releases/BE_19.1.html>

For more than four years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

四年來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆，推動創新，提供簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、強化的 BSD 安全性、快速採用上游軟體更新以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD許可。

The 19.1 release, nicknamed “Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥）, consists of a total of 620 individual changes since 18.7 came out 6 months ago, spread out over 12 intermediate releases including the recent release candidates. That is the average of 2 stable releases per month, security updates and important bug fixes included! If we had to pick a few highlights it would be: The firewall alias API is finally in place. The migration to HardenedBSD 11.2 has been completed. 2FA now works with a remote LDAP / local TOTP combination. And the OpenVPN client export was rewritten for full API support as well.

19.1版本（暱稱“Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥） ）自 6 個月前18.7發布以來，共包含 620 項變更，這些變更分佈在 12 個中間版本中，包括最近的候選版本。這意味著平均每月發布 2 個穩定版本，其中包含安全性更新和重要的錯誤修復！如果要列舉一些亮點，那就是：防火牆別名API終於上線。向 HardenedBSD 11.2的遷移已完成。雙重認證 (2FA) 現在支援遠端LDAP / 本地TOTP組合。此外，OpenVPN 用戶端匯出也已重寫，以完全支援API 。

##### 19.1.9 (June 06, 2019)｜19.1.9 （2019年6月6日）

Small 19.1 series update mainly focusing on LDAP group synchronisation and assorted OpenVPN improvements. Two regressions of previous versions have been fixed as well.

本次19.1系列更新規模較小，主要針對LDAP群組同步及各項OpenVPN改進。同時修復了先前版本中的兩個回歸問題。

    系統：允許任意組使用 sudo 進行類似 SSH 登入

##### 19.1.8 (May 20, 2019)｜19.1.8 （2019年5月20日）

This update addresses several privilege escalation issues in the access control implementation and new memory disclosure issues in Intel CPUs. We would like to thank Arnaud Cordier and Bill Marquette for the top-notch reports and coordination.

本次更新解決了存取控制實作中的多個權限提升問題以及英特爾 CPU 中新增的記憶體外洩問題。我們衷心感謝 Arnaud Cordier 和 Bill Marquette 提供的出色報告和協調工作。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: address CVE-2019-11816 privilege escalation bugs [\[1\]](https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2019-11816) (reported by Arnaud Cordier)  
    系統：位址CVE -2019-11816 權限提升漏洞 [\[1\]]( https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2019-11816 )（由 Arnaud Cordier 報告）
    
-   system: /etc/hosts generation without interface\_has\_gateway()  
    系統：/etc/hosts 生成時未包含 interface\_has\_gateway()
    
-   system: show correct timestamp in config restore save message (contributed by nhirokinet)  
    系統：在配置復原保存訊息中顯示正確的時間戳記（由 nhirokinet 提供）
    
-   system: list the commands for the pluginctl utility when no argument is given  
    系統：列出pluginctl實用程式在不提供參數時的指令
    
-   system: introduce and use userIsAdmin() helper function instead of checking for “page-all” privilege directly  
    系統：引進並使用 userIsAdmin() 輔助函數，而不是直接檢查「page-all」權限。
    
-   system: use absolute path in widget ACLs (reported by Netgate)  
    系統：在控制項 ACL 中使用絕對路徑（Netgate 報表）
    
-   system: RRD-related cleanups for less code exposure  
    系統： RRD相關清理，以減少程式碼暴露
    
-   interfaces: add EN DUID Generation using OPNsense PEN (contributed by Team Rebellion)  
    介面：新增EN DUID使用 OPNsense 產生PEN （由 Team Rebellion 提供）
    
-   interfaces: replace legacy\_getall\_interface\_addresses() usage  
    介面：取代 legacy\_getall\_interface\_addresses() 用法
    
-   firewall: fix port validation in aliases with leading / trailing spaces  
    防火牆：修正別名中帶前導/尾隨空格的連接埠驗證問題
    
-   firewall: fix outbound NAT translation display in overview page  
    防火牆：修復概覽頁面中的出站NAT翻譯顯示
    
-   firewall: prevent CARP outgoing packets from using the configured gateway  
    防火牆：阻止CARP出站封包使用已設定的網關
    
-   firewall: use CARP net.inet.carp.demotion to control current demotion in status page  
    防火牆：使用CARP net.inet.carp.demotion 控制狀態頁中的目前降級
    
-   firewall: stop live log poller on error result  
    防火牆：出錯時停止即時日誌輪詢
    
-   dhcp: change rule priority to 1 to avoid IPv6 bogon clash  
    DHCP：將規則優先權變更為 1 以避免 IPv6 衝突
    
-   dnsmasq: only admins may edit custom options field  
    dnsmasq：只有管理員才能編輯自訂選項字段
    
-   firmware: use insecure mode for base and kernel sets when package fingerprints are disabled  
    韌體：停用軟體包指紋時，對基本集和核心集使用不安全模式。
    
-   firmware: add optional device support for base and kernel sets  
    韌體：為基本集和內核集添加可選設備支持
    
-   firmware: add Hostcentral mirror (HTTP, Melbourne, Australia)  
    韌體：新增 Hostcentral 鏡像（ HTTP ，澳洲墨爾本）
    
-   ipsec: always reset rightallowany to default when writing configuration  
    ipsec：寫入配置時始終將 rightallowany 重設為預設值
    
-   lang: say “hola” to Spanish as the newest available GUI language  
    語言：用西班牙語說“hola”，這是最新可用的GUI語言
    
-   lang: updates for Chinese, Czech, Japanese, German, French, Russian and Portuguese  
    語言：中文、捷克語、日語、德語、法語、俄語和葡萄牙語的更新
    
-   network time: only admins may edit custom options field  
    網路時間：只有管理員才能編輯自訂選項字段
    
-   openvpn: call openvpn\_refresh\_crls() indirectly via plugin\_configure() for less code exposure  
    openvpn：透過 plugin_configure() 間接呼叫 openvpn_refresh_crls()，以減少程式碼暴露

    插件：os-theme-tukan 1.17 （由 Team Rebellion 提供）

    src: 時區資料庫資訊更新 [\[3\]]( https://www.freebsd.org/security/advisories/FreeBSD-EN-19:08.tzdata.asc )

##### 19.1.7 (May 02, 2019)｜19.1.7 （2019年5月2日）

This update features a number of improvements such as link-local support for bridges, HA sync consolidation, adding local CAs to the trusted SSL certificates for most of the system download capabilities, plugin-based PAM authentication rework for IPsec and the web proxy as well as third party fixes for hostapd / wpa\_supplicant 2.8 and Suricata 4.1.4.

本次更新包含多項改進，例如橋接的鏈路本地支援、 HA同步整合、為大多數系統下載功能將本地 CA 新增至受信任的SSL憑證中、針對 IPsec 和 Web 代理程式的基於插件的PAM 2.8 4.1.4的第三方修復。

Python 3 migration is also underway now which requires to pull in both Python versions which may be heavy on embedded Nano installs, but we cannot see another way for this tedious task which will probably stretch into 19.7 to be fully carried out in 20.1.

Python 3 遷移目前也在進行中，這需要引入兩個 Python 版本，這可能會對嵌入式 Nano 安裝造成很大負擔，但我們看不到其他方法可以在20.1中完全完成這項繁瑣的任務，該任務可能會持續到19.7 。

And speaking of 20.1: This is the first of many reminders that 20.1 will discontinue the i386 (Intel 32 Bit) franchise as discussed a number of times within the community over the years. Our hope is that ARM64 will make a viable replacement. But that is for another time.

說到20.1 ：這是多次提醒， 20.1將終止i386（Intel 32位元）系列，這一點多年來社區內已多次討論過。我們希望ARM64能夠成為一個可行的替代方案。但這又是另一個話題了。

As you may have noticed the project has not been delivering releases every other week and there are a number of reasons for it:

您可能已經注意到，該專案並沒有像之前那樣每隔一周發布一次版本，這其中有許多原因：

Security-wise we have not had a lot of necessary third-party software updates. Feature-wise we are sitting on a number of improvements for the upcoming 19.7 series that will trickle into 19.1.x now, but that have also required larger preparations and testing in the meantime. On the community side of the spectrum, sponsored by our partner m.a.x. it, we have started to work on better default gateway switching which led to an overall gateway integration rework and then quickly to interface handling restructuring, which in turn led to improving plugin capabilities of core services (OpenVPN, IPsec, Unbound, Dnsmasq, DHCPD, Dpinger). Looking at it now it has been the largest rework so far on code established many years ago and only occasionally patched. We hope this shows our dedication to the code base even when things are not always 100% bug free. If you feel like pitching in now is a good time to try the development version and let us know about how it performs.

在安全性方面，我們並沒有太多必要的第三方軟體更新。在功能方面，我們正在為即將推出的19.7系列開發一系列改進，這些改進將逐步整合到19.1版本中，但同時，我們也需要進行更多的準備和測試。在社群方面，在合作夥伴max it的贊助下，我們開始著手改進預設閘道切換功能，這導致了網關整合的整體重構，並迅速轉向介面處理重構，進而提升了核心服務（OpenVPN、IPsec、Unbound、Dnsmasq、 DHCPD 、Dpinger）的插件功能。現在看來，這是迄今為止對多年前創建且僅偶爾打補丁的程式碼進行的最大規模重構。我們希望這能展現我們對程式碼庫的投入，即使程式碼並非總是100%無bug。如果您有興趣參與，現在正是試用開發版本並向我們回饋其效能的好時機。

Without further ado, here are the full patch notes:

##### 19.1.6 (April 11, 2019)｜19.1.6 （2019年4月11日）

This update brings a smaller number of fixes and improvements as well as the latest PHP version update.

本次更新帶來了一些修復和改進，以及最新的PHP版本更新。

With a heavy heart we disable E\_WARNING messages in the PHP error reporting. It has been implemented in 2015 to improve code quality and it did just that, but with the latest PHP 7.2 jump in 19.1.5 it causes problems around the newly added count() usage warning messages. We plan to bring back E\_WARNING usage in 19.7.

我們懷著沉重的心情宣布，將在PHP錯誤報告中禁用E_WARNING訊息。該訊息於2015年啟用，旨在提高程式碼質量，並且確實達到了預期效果。然而，隨著19.1.5版本中最新的PHP 7.2更新，它導致新增的count()使用警告訊息出現問題。我們計劃在19.7中恢復E_WARNING訊息的使用。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

    系統：僅允許儀錶板接受其自身的POST請求
    
-   system: remove obsolete symlink to opnsense-auth  
    系統：移除指向 opnsense-auth 的過時符號鏈接
    
-   system: skip PHP E\_WARNING log level until 19.7  
    系統：跳過PHP E_WARNING 日誌級別，直到19.7
    
-   system: numerous PHP 7.2 warning fixes  
    系統：修復了大量PHP 7.2警告
    
-   dhcp: DHCPD server check in relay only if interface is active  
    DHCP： DHCPD僅當介面處於活動狀態時才在中繼中檢查伺服器
    
-   dnsmasq: skip empty custom options  
    dnsmasq：跳過空的自訂選項

    入侵防禦：不要丟棄 flowbits:noalert 規則

    unbound：預設新增 OpenVPN 的ACL條目

##### 19.1.5 (April 05, 2019)｜19.1.5 （2019年4月5日）

After a longer pause we are back with considerable upgrades for IPsec, a new CSR feature for local CAs, PHP 7.2 migration and a number of other considerable third party updates.

經過一段較長的停頓，我們帶著 IPsec 的重大升級、本地 CA 的全新CSR功能、 PHP 7.2遷移以及許多其他重要的第三方更新回歸。

These are the full patch notes:

-   system: improve gateway status return when monitoring is off

    系統：警告使用者「user-config-readonly」權限即將棄用

    系統：使帶有尾部斜線的 Nextcloud URL無效（由 Fabian Franz 提供）

##### 19.1.4 (March 12, 2019)｜19.1.4 （2019年3月12日）

An UEFI boot panic scenario was debugged last week with the help of the community. This update includes a fix that will allow the ones affected by this 19.1 issue to upgrade or install (and boot of course) correctly. We are also including the IPsec VTI support and the latest Suricata 4.1.3 with stability and compatibility fixes.

上週，在社群的幫助下，我們調試了一個UEFI啟動崩潰問題。本次更新包含一個修復程序，將使受19.1問題影響的使用者能夠正確升級或安裝（當然也能正常啟動）。此外，我們還加入了對VTI的支持，以及最新的4.1.3 ，並修復了穩定性和相容性問題。

Due to the severity of the UEFI boot panic 19.1.4 will be the new initial release for all upgrades from 18.7 within a day or two depending on additional testing and confirmation. Last but not least there will be new images some time next week to put this fully behind us. Thank you for your patience and understanding. :)

由於UEFI啟動崩潰問題的嚴重性， 19.1.4將作為新的初始版本，用於所有從18.7升級的用戶，具體發佈時間取決於後續的測試和確認。下週某個時候，我們將發布新的鏡像，徹底解決這個問題。感謝您的耐心與理解。 :)

Special thanks go to the team of Synacktiv for reporting a packet filter IPv6 vulnerability for which a patch was included as well.

特別感謝 Synacktiv 團隊報告了一個 IPv6 封包過濾器漏洞，該漏洞也已發布了修補程式。

Here are the full patch notes:

-   firewall: fix validation regression in outbound NAT introduced in 19.1.3  
    防火牆：修正出站驗證迴歸問題NAT由19.1.3引進）

    安裝程式：恢復使用網路連線以允許CTRL +C 並恢復

##### 19.1.3 (March 07, 2019)｜19.1.3 （2019年3月7日）

This is a smaller stable update consisting of LDAPS authentication server improvements, Unbound host overrides alias support, OpenSSL 1.0.2r security update and the recent PAM rework for better privilege separation.

這是一個較小的穩定更新，包括LDAPS身份驗證伺服器改進、Unbound 主機覆蓋別名支援、OpenSSL 1.0 .2r 安全性更新以及最近PAM為更好地進行權限分離而進行的重構。

We are currently focusing on IPsec VTI, third-party service PAM integration and investigating kernel boot crashes. In the latter case we are aware of the update issues some people are having and recommend running 18.7 until this is taken care of. Above all, please be patient. New images and seamless upgrade paths will be provided as soon as the problems have been pinned down.

我們目前正專注於 IPsec VTI 、第三方服務PAM整合以及核心啟動崩潰問題的調查。對於核心啟動崩潰問題，我們已註意到部分使用者遇到的更新問題，建議在問題解決之前執行18.7 。請耐心等待。一旦問題解決，我們將立即提供新的鏡像和無縫升級方案。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: improve LDAPS mode and related authentication cleanups  
    系統：改良LDAPS模式及相關認證清理
    
-   system: move enable checkbox to the top in remote logging settings  
    系統：將遠端日誌記錄設定中的「啟用」複選框移至頂部
    
-   system: allow reset of tunables to to factory defaults  
    系統：允許將可調參數重設為出廠預設值
    
-   system: new tunables factory default to prevent ICMP redirects being sent (net.inet.icmp.drop\_redirect=1)  
    系統：新的可調參數出廠預設值，以防止發送ICMP重定向（net.inet.icmp.drop\_redirect=1）
    
-   firewall: allow explicitly setting source hash key in outbound NAT (Fredrik Ronnvall)  
    防火牆：允許在出站NAT中明確設定來源雜湊鍵（Fredrik Ronnvall）
    
-   interfaces: probe media before applying new settings  
    介面：在應用新設定前探測介質
    
-   interfaces: correctly compare MAC addresses  
    介面：正確比較MAC位址
    
-   dhcp: added TFTP bootfile-name (contributed by Bjorn Kalkbrenner)  
    dhcp：已新增TFTP啟動檔名（由 Bjorn Kalkbrenner 提供）
    
-   firmware: move duty to return the correct set name / ID to opnsense-version  
    韌體：移動職責以傳回正確的集名稱 / ID到 opnsense-version
    
-   firmware: finally revoke 18.7 fingerprint  
    韌體：最終撤銷18.7指紋
    
-   intrusion detection: minor template cleanups using helpers.empty()  
    入侵偵測：使用 helpers.empty() 進行少量範本清理
    
-   ipsec: peer identifier can now fall back to remote-gateway in manual SPD entries  
    ipsec：在手動SPD條目中，對等標識符現在可以回退到遠端網關。
    
-   ipsec: allow easier override of colours in widget (contributed by Fabian Franz)  
    IPsec：允許更輕鬆地覆蓋小部件中的顏色（由 Fabian Franz 貢獻）
    
-   monit: add validation for test type (contributed by Frank Brendel)  
    monit：新增測試類型驗證（由 Frank Brendel 貢獻）
    
-   openvpn: add auth-nocache option in exporter  
    openvpn：在匯出器中新增 auth-nocache 選項
    
-   openvpn: validate certificate type for servers  
    openvpn：驗證伺服器憑證類型
    
-   unbound: add host overrides alias support  
    unbound：新增主機覆蓋別名支持
    
-   web proxy: add auth to parent proxy (contributed by Michael Muenz)  
    Web代理程式：為父代理程式新增身份驗證（Michael Muenz 貢獻）
    
-   backend: add helpers.empty() in configd  
    後端：在 configd 中加入 helpers.empty()
    
-   mvc: simplify save / close / cancel button labels  
    MVC：簡化儲存/關閉/取消按鈕標籤
    
-   mvc: add sorting for field list types  
    MVC：為欄位清單類型新增排序功能
    
-   rc: move all template generation to early stage  
    rc：將所有範本產生移至早期階段
    
-   ui: improve escaping of displayed data in static pages  
    使用者介面：改進靜態頁面中顯示資料的轉義
    
-   ui: escape button values in static pages  
    ui：靜態頁面中的轉義按鈕值
    
-   ui: avoid short PHP tags  
    ui：避免使用過短的PHP標籤
    
-   plugins: os-dnscrypt-proxy 1.3 [\[1\]](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/dns/dnscrypt-proxy/pkg-descr)  
    插件：os-dnscrypt-proxy 1.3 [\[1\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/dns/dnscrypt-proxy/pkg-descr )

-   plugins: os-postfix log file ACL and wrapper mode typo fix (contributed by Michael Muenz)  
    外掛程式：os-postfix 日誌檔案ACL和包裝模式拼字錯誤修復（由 Michael Muenz 貢獻）
    
-   plugins: os-theme-cicada IPsec widget colour fix (contributed by Team Rebellion)

    插件： os-vnstat /var MFS修復 [\[3\]]( https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/net/vnstat/pkg-descr )

    插件：os-zabbix4-proxy 1.0 （由 Michael Muenz 貢獻）

    ports: openssl 1.0 .2r [\[4\]]( https://www.openssl.org/news/secadv/20190226.txt )

##### 19.1.2 (February 28, 2019)｜19.1.2 （2019年2月28日）

This update is the sum of a few weeks of intense testing and debugging in areas such as WAN DHCP with very short lease times, Suricata IPS not working as expected, stacked 6RD setups that have overly long device names amongst others.

本次更新是經過數週密集測試和調試後的結果，測試和調試領域包括：租期非常短的WAN DHCP 、Suricata IPS無法按預期工作、設備名稱過長的堆疊式 6RD 設定等等。

The update may be a bit bumpy this time since the web GUI session directory will be moved to a safer location. You will be logged out during the update and the system will reboot due to the included operating system update. As soon as it is back you will be able to log in as usual.

這次更新可能會有些不順利，因為 Web GUI會話目錄將會被移轉到更安全的位置。更新期間您將被強制登出，並且系統會因作業系統更新而重新啟動。系統重新啟動後，您就可以像往常一樣登入了。

LibreSSL received a major upgrade from 2.7 to 2.8. If you are using LibreSSL and see any issues please do let us know because it sadly looks like third party projects such as OpenVPN, Squid, StrongSwan and NTP leave the use of LibreSSL to the few users who are able to fix the source code builds on their own and we want to ideally avoid having to patch third party software.

LibreSSL 已從2.7升級到2.8 。如果您在使用 LibreSSL 時遇到任何問題，請務必告知我們，因為令人遺憾的是，OpenVPN、Squid、StrongSwan 和NTP等第三方專案似乎將 LibreSSL 的使用權留給了少數能夠自行修復原始程式碼建置問題的用戶，而我們希望盡可能避免為第三方軟體修補程式。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: move session files into their own directory (forces the current sessions to expire)  
    系統：將會話檔案移至單獨的目錄中（強制當前會話過期）
    
-   system: add validation check for time period for Dpinger (contributed by Team Rebellion)

-   system: move opnsense-auth to libexec, but keep a symlink in sbin directory

##### 19.1.1 (February 05, 2019)｜19.1.1 （2019年2月5日）

This is a security and reliability release: WAN DHCP will no longer trust the server MTU given. Uncoordinated cross site scripting issues have been fixed. And the Python request library was patched due to CVE 2018-18074.

這是一個安全性和可靠性版本更新： WAN DHCP將不再信任指定的伺服器MTU 。已修復非協調跨站腳本攻擊問題。此外，由於CVE 2018-18074，Python request 函式庫也已打上修補程式。

Here are the full patch notes:

以下是完整的更新說明：

-   system: address XSS-prone escaping issues [\[1\]](https://packetstormsecurity.com/files/151381/OPNsense-18.7-Cross-Site-Scripting.html)  
    系統：位址XSS -容易出現轉義問題 [\[1\]]( https://packetstormsecurity.com/files/151381/OPNsense-18.7-Cross-Site-Scripting.html )

##### 19.1 (January 31, 2019)｜19.1（2019 年 1 月 31 日）

For more than four years now, OPNsense is driving innovation through modularising and hardening the open source firewall, with simple and reliable firmware upgrades, multi-language support, HardenedBSD security, fast adoption of upstream software updates as well as clear and stable 2-Clause BSD licensing.

四年多來，OPNsense 透過模組化和強化開源防火牆、簡單可靠的韌體升級、多語言支援、HardenedBSD 安全性、上游軟體更新的快速採用以及清晰穩定的 2 條款BSD 許可來推動創新。

The 19.1 release, nicknamed “Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥）, consists of a total of 620 individual changes since 18.7 came out 6 months ago, spread out over 12 intermediate releases including the recent release candidates. That is the average of 2 stable releases per month, security updates and important bug fixes included! If we had to pick a few highlights it would be: The firewall alias API is finally in place. The migration to HardenedBSD 11.2 has been completed. 2FA now works with a remote LDAP / local TOTP combination. And the OpenVPN client export was rewritten for full API support as well.

19.1 版本，綽號為 “Inspiring Iguana”（鼓舞人心的鬣蜥），自 6 個月前 18.7 發布以來，總共包含 620 個單獨更改，分佈在超過 12 個中間版本中，包括最近的候選版本。這是平均每月 2 個穩定版本，包括安全性更新和重要錯誤修復！如果我們必須選擇幾個亮點的話，那就是： 防火牆別名 API 終於到位了。到 HardenedBSD 11.2 的遷移已完成。 2FA 現在可與遠端 LDAP / 本地 TOTP 組合搭配使用。 OpenVPN 用戶端匯出也被重寫以獲得完整的 API 支援。

Migration notes and minor incompatibilities to look out for:

需要注意的遷移說明和輕微不相容性：

-   Gateway health graphs may need a manual reset due to the Apinger to Dpinger migration. Apinger is no longer available.  
    由於 Apinger 到 Dpinger 的遷移，網關運行狀況圖可能需要手動重設。阿平格不再可用。
    
-   Intrusion detection GeoIP rules are automatically deactivated and need to be manually migrated to firewall alias GeoIP.  
    入侵偵測 GeoIP 規則會自動停用，需要手動遷移到防火牆別名 GeoIP。
    
-   Quagga plugin has been superseded by FRR plugin. A binary quagga package has been conserved for the time being.  
    Quagga 外掛程式已被 FRR 外掛程式取代。暫時保存了一個二進位 quagga 包。
    
-   Please read the FRR documentation with regard to the required system tunables [\[8\]](#p-210) .  
    請閱讀有關所需系統可調參數 [\[8\]](#p-210) 的 FRR 文件。
    
-   Bhyve VM boot may fail as a guest. Use the “-w” parameter [\[9\]](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=11492.0) to boot.  
    Bhyve VM 作為訪客啟動可能會失敗。使用“-w”參數[\[9\]](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?topic=11492.0)啟動。
    
-   Boot may fail due to Meltdown/Spectre mitigation. A workaround [\[10\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues/3177) exists.  
    由於 Meltdown/Spectre 緩解措施，啟動可能會失敗。存在解決方法 [\[10\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues/3177)。
    
-   SNMP plugin has been superseded by Net-SNMP plugin.  
    SNMP 插件已被 Net-SNMP 插件取代。

Small online update issued to fix known and subsequently patched issues. If you use Insight and flowd\_aggregate service refuses to start go to System: Firmware: Packages and reinstall the “flowd” package.

發布小型線上更新以修復已知和隨後修補的問題。如果您使用 Insight 並且 flowd\_aggregate 服務拒絕啟動，請前往系統：韌體：軟體包並重新安裝「flowd」軟體包。

-   firmware: fix invisible error in health check  
    韌體：修復健康檢查中的隱形錯誤
    
-   intrusion detection: avoid spurious migration error on factor reset  
    入侵偵測：避免因子重置時出現虛假遷移錯誤
    
-   monit: fix dashboard widget display and general settings save

    插件：os-telegraf 修復了 CPU 時間收集的複選框（由 chaispaquichui 貢獻）
    
-   ports: flowd Python bindings runtime fix  
    ports：flowd Python 綁定運行時修復

您的 OPNsense 團隊請保持安全

Known issues and limitations:

已知問題和限制：

-   Gateway health graphs may need a manual reset due to the Apinger to Dpinger migration.  
    由於 Apinger 到 Dpinger 的遷移，網關運行狀況圖可能需要手動重設。
    
-   Intrusion detection GeoIP rules are automatically deactivated and need to be manually migrated to firewall alias GeoIP.  
    入侵偵測 GeoIP 規則會自動停用，需要手動遷移到防火牆別名 GeoIP。
    
-   Monit general settings do not save. A patch exists [\[11\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/commit/a2899594) to remedy this problem: opnsense-patch a2899594  
    監控常規設定不儲存。存在一個補丁 [\[11\]](https://github.com/opnsense/core/commit/a2899594) 來解決此問題：opnsense-patch a2899594
    
-   Issue with IDS migration code creating a spurious crash report. Patch already done for the final 19.1.  
    IDS 遷移程式碼存在建立虛假崩潰報告的問題。最終19.1的補丁已經完成。
    
-   Quagga plugin has been superseded by FRR plugin. A binary quagga package has been conserved for the time being.  
    Quagga 外掛程式已被 FRR 外掛程式取代。暫時保存了一個二進位 quagga 包。
    
-   Please read the FRR documentation with regard to the required system tunables [\[12\]](#p-210) .  
    請閱讀 FRR 文檔，以了解所需的系統可調參數 [\[12\]](#p-210) 。
    
-   SNMP plugin has been superseded by Net-SNMP plugin.  
    SNMP 插件已被 Net-SNMP 插件取代。
    
-   ZFS guided installation pending.  
    ZFS 指導安裝待定。

## Business Edition

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-046"></a>

### Business Edition｜商業版

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/be.html>

[![_images/pexels-field-engineer-442152.jpg](<../images/476f7179-pexels-field-engineer-442152.jpg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/pexels-field-engineer-442152.jpg)

A mission critical version of the well-known OPNsense firewall.

著名的 OPNsense 防火牆的關鍵任務版本。

The Business Edition offers additional safeguards where functional changes are being included in a more conservative manner and feedback has been collected from development and community.

商業版提供了額外的保護措施，其中以更保守的方式包含功能更改，並從開發和社群收集回饋。

Offering specific business-oriented features and third party security verification. Currently, the only open source LINCE compliant firewall.

提供特定的面向業務的功能和第三方安全驗證。目前，唯一符合開源LINCE標準的防火牆。

-   Mission critical  
    關鍵任務
    
-   LINCE compliant (security verification by trained third party independent professionals)  
    LINCE 相容（由受過訓練的第三方獨立專業人員進行安全驗證）
    
-   Commercial firmware repository  
    商業韌體儲存庫
    
-   Free GeoIP database  
    免費的 GeoIP 資料庫
    
-   Official OPNsense Open Virtualisation Image  
    官方 OPNsense 開放虛擬化鏡像
    
-   Central Management, including easy one click remote host access, provisioning and monitoring.  
    集中管理，包括輕鬆的一鍵式遠端主機存取、配置和監控。
    
-   Web Application Firewall  
    網路應用防火牆
    
-   Authoritative DNS server  
    權威DNS伺服器
    
-   Free E-Book (English & German)  
    免費電子書（英語和德語）
    

More information:

更多資訊：

-   [Central Management](#p-047)

#### [Central Management](#p-047)｜[中央管理](#p-047)

As part of the OPNsense Business Edition, Deciso offers a plugin to keep all your firewalls up to date and have an easy entry point to manage them.

作為 OPNsense 商業版的一部分，Deciso 提供了一個插件，可以讓您的所有防火牆保持最新狀態，並有一個簡單的入口點來管理它們。

#### [Installation](#p-047)｜[安裝](#p-047)

After acquiring a license, you can switch to the commercial software repository containing OPNcentral. In order to install, just go to System->Firmware->Plugins and search for `os-OPNcentral`.

獲得許可證後，您可以切換到包含 OPNcentral 的商業軟體儲存庫。要安裝，只需進入系統->韌體->插件並蒐索`os-OPNcentral`。

#### [Register new hosts](#p-047)｜[註冊新主機](#p-047)

Before adding a host, you need to generate an API key and secret from the machine you will grant access to. API keys are managed in the user manager (system\_usermanager.php), go to the user manager page and select a user. Somewhere down the page you will find the API section for this user.

在新增主機之前，您需要從要授予存取權限的電腦產生 API 金鑰和機密。 API 金鑰在使用者管理員（system\_usermanager.php）中管理，進入使用者管理員頁面並選擇使用者。在頁面下方的某個位置，您會找到該使用者的 API 部分。

Click on the + sign to add a new key. When the key is created, you will receive a (single download) with the credentials in one text file (ini formatted). The contents of this file look like this:

點選+號新增密鑰。建立金鑰後，您將收到一份（單一下載），其中包含一個文字檔案（ini 格式）中的憑證。該文件的內容如下所示：

```
key=w86XNZob/8Oq8aC5r0kbNarNtdpoQU781fyoeaOBQsBwkXUt
secret=XeD26XVrJ5ilAc/EmglCRC+0j2e57tRsjHwFepOseySWLM53pJASeTA3
```

Next go to the Hosts section of the management menu in Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration and add a new host, copy the url from the machine and the API key and secret generated above.

接下來前往 Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration 中管理選單的 Hosts 部分並新增主機，複製機器中的 url 以及上面產生的 API 金鑰和密碼。

Note

注意事項

You can disable certificate validation if your using a self-signed certificate, although we advise to generate proper certificates for the machines.

如果您使用自簽名證書，您可以停用證書驗證，但我們建議為電腦產生正確的證書。

[![../../_images/OPNcentral_hosts.png](<../images/e24d62a6-OPNcentral_hosts.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNcentral_hosts.png) **Icons**

[![../../_images/OPNcentral_hosts.png](<../images/e24d62a6-OPNcentral_hosts.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNcentral_hosts.png) **圖示**  
Group membership

團體會員  
Download configuration (or all as a zip file)

下載配置（或全部作為 zip 檔案）  
Edit host configuration

編輯主機配置  
Clone host configuration

克隆主機配置  
Delete host configuration

刪除主機配置  
  

##### [Central WebGui certificate management](#p-047)｜[中央WebGui憑證管理](#p-047)

The host configuration offers an option to link a central certificate to the managed host, in which case the certificate will be distributed to the host (if `WebGui` is being provisioned).

主機配置提供了將中央憑證連結到託管主機的選項，在這種情況下，憑證將分發到主機（如果正在設定`WebGui`）。

Using this feature, you’re able to centrally manage certificates (manually or using ACME) easily.

使用此功能，您可以輕鬆地集中管理證書（手動或使用ACME）。

Tip

提示

Add `OPNcentral - provision / reconfigure remote hosts` in System ‣ Settings ‣ Cron with a daily schedule to automatically provision all attached firewalls on a daily basis.

在系統 ‣ 設定 ‣ Cron 中新增 `OPNcentral - provision / reconfigure remote hosts` 以及每日規劃，以每天自動設定所有連接的防火牆。

Attention

注意力

Do not synchronize `Certificates` and `WebGUI` at the same time. [Provisioning classes WebGUI](#p-047)

請勿同時同步`Certificates`和`WebGUI`。 [設定類別WebGUI](#p-047)

##### [Alter generic host settings](#p-047)｜[更改通用主機設定](#p-047)

The second tab in the screen contains the setting page which configures defaults for all hosts where applicable.

螢幕中的第二個標籤包含設定頁面，該頁面為所有適用的主機配置預設值。

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Interfaces<br>接口 | Select the interfaces of the central node that would be used when merging settings on the remote firewall, only applicable on part of the configuration sections (such as the firewall). See the provisioning section for more details.<br>選擇合併遠端防火牆上的設定時將使用的中心節點的接口，僅適用於部分配置部分（例如防火牆）。有關更多詳細信息，請參閱配置部分。 |
| Enable backups<br>啟用備份 | Enable centralized backups.<br>啟用集中備份。 |
| Backups:<br>備份： |  |
| • Sequential count<br>• 順序計數 | Number of sequential backups to preserve from remote host (per host), copy of local history to a maximum of X per host.<br>從遠端主機（每台主機）保留的順序備份數，本地歷史記錄的副本最多為每台主機 X 個。 |
| • Interval type<br>• 間隔類型 | When an interval is provided, this option determines the period for the interval. e.g. when weekly is specified, each last record of the week is preserved to a maximum of the number of intervals<br>當提供間隔時，此選項決定間隔的時間段。例如當指定weekly時，該週的每個最後記錄將保留到最大間隔數 |
| • Interval count<br>• 間隔計數 | Non sequential number of backups to keep, last backup of specified interval type is preserved for the number of items specified here.<br>要保留的非連續備份數，指定間隔類型的最後一個備份將保留此處指定的項目數。 |

#### [Centralized backups](#p-047)｜[集中備份](#p-047)

When “Enable backups” is checked in the generic host settings tab OPNcentral will perform a nighly backup of all configured hosts. The host overview (Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration) shows the number of backups with their related size and last modification date for each host.

當在通用主機設定標籤中選取「啟用備份」時，OPNcentral 將每晚對所有已配置的主機執行備份。主機概述（管理 ‣ 主機 ‣ 設定）顯示每個主機的備份數量及其相關大小和上次修改日期。

Note

注意事項

The modification date defines the last time the remote host was changed, so if a host hasn’t been changed for a longer period of time this value would show an older date.

修改日期定義了遠端主機上次更改的時間，因此如果主機在較長時間內沒有更改，則該值將顯示較舊的日期。

Tip

提示

It is possible to execute the backup manually from the gui. In order to do that, go to Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration and press the `Execute backup` button.

可以從 GUI 手動執行備份。為此，請前往 Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration 並按 `Execute backup` 按鈕。

Tip

提示

If more frequent backups are desired, just add a cron job in System‣Settings‣Cron for the task `OPNcentral - backup remote hosts`.

如果需要更頻繁的備份，只需在系統‣設定‣Cron 中為任務`OPNcentral - backup remote hosts` 新增一個 cron 作業即可。

#### [Multi tenancy using host groups](#p-047)｜[使用主機群組的多租戶](#p-047)

Hosts can be organised in groups using the Management ‣ Host ‣ Groups menu option. By default hosts are accessible by all users having access to the specified OPNcentral menu options. You can change that behaviour by linking a host into one or more groups, where you can constrain access.

可以使用 Management ‣ Host ‣ Groups 選單選項將主機組織成群組。預設情況下，所有有權存取指定 OPNcentral 選單選項的使用者都可以存取主機。您可以透過將主機連結到一個或多個群組來更改該行為，您可以在其中限制存取。

[![](<../images/13388a63-blockdiag-92b1f550c721b0d0baefd967cdfb81.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/blockdiag-92b1f550c721b0d0baefd967cdfb81ac849a4b6e.png)

Warning

警告

When attaching a host to multiple host groups and want to constraint access, make sure you limit all host groups to avoid accidental access for all OPNcentral users.

將主機附加到多個主機群組並想要限制存取時，請確保限制所有主機群組，以避免所有 OPNcentral 使用者意外存取。

#### [Connect to managed machine](#p-047)｜[連接被管理機器](#p-047)

On various management pages there are direct links available to login to the firewall in question. Usually connected nodes are shown with a link which opens in a new tab when clicking.

在各種管理頁面上，都有可用於登入相關防火牆的直接連結。通常連接的節點會顯示一個鏈接，單擊時會在新選項卡中打開。

The example below shows a link in the firmware status page which will open `https://node1.opnsense.local`.

下面的範例顯示了韌體狀態頁面中的一個鏈接，該鏈接將打開`https://node1.opnsense.local`。

[![../../_images/OPNcentral_status_uptodate.png](<../images/aec75ea6-OPNcentral_status_uptodate.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNcentral_status_uptodate.png)

When the management server is allowed to access the OPNcentral components on the connected node it will automatically login after the link is clicked with the proper credentials assigned to the api token user.

當允許管理伺服器存取連接節點上的 OPNcentral 元件時，它將在點擊連結後使用分配給 api 令牌使用者的正確憑證自動登入。

If the latests Business Edition is installed on the managed machine, but access prohibits automatic logins, you will be redirected to the login page.

如果受管電腦上安裝了最新的商業版，但存取禁止自動登錄，您將被重新導向到登錄頁面。

When the connected machine is not using the business edition, it’s not possible to use the link, a message such as the following will be presented to the user:

當連接的機器不是使用商業版時，無法使用該鏈接，將向用戶顯示如下訊息：

[![../../_images/OPNcentral_auto_login_unavailable.png](<../images/ce17c2d9-OPNcentral_auto_login_unavailable.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNcentral_auto_login_unavailable.png)

Note

注意事項

Make sure your browser trusts the remote node otherwise the browser can’t access the machine and will signal an issue with the software version.

確保您的瀏覽器信任遠端節點，否則瀏覽器將無法存取電腦並會發出軟體版本問題的訊號。

#### [Machine firmware status / upgrade](#p-047)｜[機器韌體狀態/升級](#p-047)

All connected and enabled machines can be contacted using the Management ‣ Status ‣ Firmware page, when visiting the page all connected machines will automatically be contacted to report their status and installed version.

可以使用 Management ‣ Status ‣ Firmware 頁面聯繫所有已連接和已啟用的計算機，訪問該頁面時將自動聯繫所有已連接的計算機以報告其狀態和安裝的版本。

[![../../_images/OPNcentral_status_toupdate.png](<../images/bba5741e-OPNcentral_status_toupdate.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNcentral_status_toupdate.png)

When an update is available, it will be shown in the list, including if this upgrade requires a reboot. The upgrade button starts the upgrade procedure, but will only upgrade machines that will require a reboot if **Enable reboot** is checked.

當有可用更新時，它將顯示在清單中，包括此升級是否需要重新啟動。升級按鈕會啟動升級過程，但如果選取 **啟用重新啟動**，則只會升級需要重新啟動的電腦。

Tip

提示

Use the refresh button to request status again.

使用刷新按鈕再次請求狀態。

The upgrade wheel starts spinning when an upgrade was requested, since the upgrade itself can consume some time, you can revisit the status page later (or press refresh) to show the new status.

當請求升級時，升級輪開始旋轉，因為升級本身可能會消耗一些時間，您可以稍後重新訪問狀態頁面（或按刷新）以顯示新狀態。

#### [Machine service status and control](#p-047)｜[機器使用狀態及控制](#p-047)

The service status and control page provides an overview on all managed OPNsense firewalls connected to OPNcentral and offers the ability to restart services when needed.

服務狀態和控制頁面提供了連接到 OPNcentral 的所有託管 OPNsense 防火牆的概述，並提供了在需要時重新啟動服務的功能。

[![../../_images/OPNcentral_service_status_overview.png](<../images/bb394d3d-OPNcentral_service_status_overview.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNcentral_service_status_overview.png)

In the screenshot above there are 7 machines managed by OPNcentral, for every configured service there’s an icon reflecting the status of the service.

在上面的螢幕截圖中，OPNcentral 管理著 7 台機器，對於每個配置的服務，都有一個反映服務狀態的圖示。

Stopped (inactive, but configured)

已停止（不活動，但已配置）  
Running (active)

跑步（主動）  
Host unreachable or misconfigured

主機無法存取或配置錯誤  
  

When you click one of the service icons, the icon changes into a checkbox which can be used to restart the selected services with the button below the table.

當您按一下其中一個服務圖示時，該圖示會變成一個複選框，可用於透過表格下方的按鈕重新啟動所選服務。

Tip

提示

The link in the host column brings you directly into the service control page of the selected firewall.

主機列中的連結將直接帶您進入所選防火牆的服務控制頁面。

#### [Machine resource status](#p-047)｜[機器資源狀態](#p-047)

In order to gain insights into the managed machines there is a resource page available which queries all connected firewalls and reports aggregated status about them.

為了深入了解受管理的計算機，可以使用一個資源頁面來查詢所有連接的防火牆並報告有關它們的匯總狀態。

While collecting data for a machine there’s a spinner visible, as soon as information is collected you can view relevant information per node.

在收集機器資料時，會出現一個可見的旋轉器，一旦收集到信息，您就可以查看每個節點的相關資訊。

[![../../_images/OPNcentral_resources_host.png](<../images/1f96b0e1-OPNcentral_resources_host.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNcentral_resources_host.png)

From left to right the following information is available:

從左到右，提供以下資訊：

-   Host information  
    主機資訊
    
    -   Host name (description)  
        主機名稱（描述）
        
    -   Version installed  
        安裝版本
        
    -   Processor type  
        處理器類型
        
    -   Most recent configuration change (tooltip uncovers who made the change and from which module)  
        最近的配置變更（工具提示揭示了誰進行了更改以及來自哪個模組）
        
-   General statistics  
    一般統計
    
    -   Current cpu usage (total percentage)  
        目前CPU使用率（總百分比）
        
    -   Total memory usage  
        總記憶體使用量
        
    -   Swap file usage  
        交換文件使用
        
    -   Total interfaces configured (up/down)  
        配置的介面總數（上行/下行）
        
    -   Aggregated HA status (when configured), MASTER when all interfaces are, BACKUP when at least one is demoted to BACKUP  
        聚合 HA 狀態（配置後），MASTER（當所有介面皆處於）時，BACKUP（當至少一個介面降級為 BACKUP）
        
    -   Root file system usage  
        根檔案系統使用情況
        
    -   Gateway status including maximum delay  
        網關狀態，包括最大延遲
        
-   Firewall  
    防火牆
    
    -   State table usage  
        狀態表使用情況
        
    -   Alias usage (when over 100% the requested entries don’t fir in memory)  
        別名使用（當超過 100% 的請求條目不在記憶體中時）
        
    -   Source tracking table usage  
        來源追蹤表使用情況
        
    -   Current traffic in/out, tooltip the piechart to show protocol name (or number) with current rate  
        目前流量輸入/輸出，圓餅圖工具提示以顯示目前速率的協定名稱（或編號）
        

Tip

提示

When headings are underlined, a click brings you to the relevant module of the firewall in question.

當標題帶有下劃線時，點擊即可進入相關防火牆的相關模組。

#### [Provisioning / sharing settings](#p-047)｜[配置/共享設定](#p-047)

The provisioning tool offers the ability to configure some settings in a more centralised manner. Inspired by the functionality that is offered for high-availability setups, you can distribute global settings among all connected firewalls for various configuration options. The central host acts as a template in this case.

配置工具提供了以更集中的方式配置某些設定的能力。受到高可用性設定功能的啟發，您可以在所有連接的防火牆之間分發全域設定以實現各種設定選項。在這種情況下，中央主機充當模板。

In order to configure the settings that should be shared, you can configure the “classes” to synchronize in the host settings Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration.

為了配置應共用的設置，您可以在主機設定 Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration 中配置要同步的「類別」。

[![../../_images/OPNcentral_provisioning_host_classes_setup.png](<../images/9f781828-OPNcentral_provisioning_host_classes_set.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNcentral_provisioning_host_classes_setup.png)

Here you will find the same options as are available under System->High Availability->Settings. After configuring the desired parameters, you can use the Provisioning page (Management ‣ Provisioning) to inspect status and push options to the attached firewalls.

在這裡，您將找到與“系統”->“高可用性”->“設定”下可用的選項相同的選項。配置所需參數後，您可以使用設定頁面（管理 ‣ 設定）檢查狀態並將選項推送到連接的防火牆。

Warning

警告

Be **very** careful pushing settings to your connected firewall which may disconnect your session, such as firewall and routing related options. The central management host can’t predict if settings you plan to make lead to an inaccessible firewall.

**非常**小心地將設定推送到連接的防火牆，這可能會斷開您的會話，例如防火牆和路由相關選項。中央管理主機無法預測您計劃進行的設定是否會導致防火牆無法存取。

Tip

提示

Add `OPNcentral - provision / reconfigure remote hosts` in System ‣ Settings ‣ Cron with a daily schedule to automatically provision all attached firewalls on a daily basis.

在系統 ‣ 設定 ‣ Cron 中新增 `OPNcentral - provision / reconfigure remote hosts` 以及每日規劃，以每天自動設定所有連接的防火牆。

All provisioning classes known by the management machine will be shown in the table, combined with the status of each section. OPNcentral calculates if settings are equal, keeps track of changes and restarts related services when needed.

管理電腦已知的所有設定類別將與每個部分的狀態一起顯示在表中。 OPNcentral 計算設定是否相等、追蹤變更並在需要時重新啟動相關服務。

[![../../_images/OPNcentral_provisioning_status.png](<../images/66a28abd-OPNcentral_provisioning_status.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNcentral_provisioning_status.png)

You can either selectlively reconfigure specific hosts with the checkbox or reconfigure all at once on command.

您可以使用複選框選擇性地重新配置特定主機，也可以根據命令一次重新配置所有主機。

Collecting status

收藏狀態  
Class equals this machine (nothing todo)

等級等於這台機器（沒什麼好做的）  
Changes ready to commit

準備提交的更改  
Unknown yet configured class

未知但已配置的類  
Unable to connect

無法連接  
  

#### [Provisioning classes](#p-047)｜[配置類別](#p-047)

By default merging configuration items from the central firewall overwrites the settings on the target machine, but in some cases we need a more practical approach to deal with local modifications.

預設情況下，合併來自中央防火牆的設定項會覆蓋目標電腦上的設置，但在某些情況下，我們需要更實用的方法來處理本機修改。

In this chapter we are going to describe how classes with special implementations are being treated on synchronisation and how to utilise this behaviour to ease management.

在本章中，我們將描述如何在同步時處理具有特殊實作的類別以及如何利用此行為來簡化管理。

##### [Users & Groups](#p-047)｜[用戶與群組](#p-047)

When users and groups are synchronized, the existing api key+secret is merged into the user with the same name to prevent access issues after reconfigure. To avoid issues, make sure there’s a unique username with proper credentials before using the synchronization.

當使用者和群組同步時，現有的 api key+secret 會合併到同名使用者中，以防止重新配置後出現存取問題。為了避免問題，請在使用同步之前確保有一個具有正確憑證的唯一使用者名稱。

Note

注意事項

Although quite some setups will likely use external authentication options available in OPNsense, sometimes it’s practical to share the same user database among different firewalls. This option allows for sharing, without the need to sue the same key+secret on all connected firewalls.

儘管相當多的設定可能會使用 OPNsense 中提供的外部身份驗證選項，但有時在不同防火牆之間共用相同的使用者資料庫是實用的。此選項允許共享，無需在所有連接的防火牆上使用相同的密鑰+秘密。

##### [Aliases (Firewall)](#p-047)｜[別名（防火牆）](#p-047)

Since various firewall sections depend on aliases, OPNcentral checks if aliases are used before removing local aliases from the remote firewall.

由於各個防火牆部分依賴別名，因此 OPNcentral 在從遠端防火牆刪除本地別名之前會檢查是否使用了別名。

Due to this powerful feature, after synchronisation of the central aliases you can also use nesting to combine remote aliases into new local ones.

由於這個強大的功能，在同步中央別名後，您還可以使用巢狀將遠端別名組合到新的本機別名中。

For example, when the local machine has `local_alias_1` and the central location offers `central_alias_1` when both are combined into `local_alias_2` and `local_alias_2` is used in firewall/nat rules it will automatically merge central changes after a reconfigure action from the dashboard.

例如，當本機電腦具有 `local_alias_1` 並且中央位置提供 `central_alias_1` 時，當兩者合併為 `local_alias_2` 並且在防火牆/nat 規則中使用 `local_alias_2` 時，它將在從儀表板執行重新配置操作後自動合併中央變更。

![](<../images/cfd7a1a5-blockdiag-7e939dcbc0c5968ff2810b8363f2c8.png>)

Note

注意事項

As long as `local_alias_2` is used, both `local_alias_1` and `local_alias_2` will be preserved after provisioning.

只要使用`local_alias_2`，`local_alias_1`和`local_alias_2`都會在配置後保留。

##### [Firewall rules](#p-047)｜[防火牆規則](#p-047)

Merging the firewall rules will keep the interfaces unaltered which don’t exists on the central node as these are being provided to the target firewall. In case you want to exclude some interfaces (for all remote firewalls), you can easily override the known interfaces in Management -> Host configuration on the General settings tab.

合併防火牆規則將使中心節點上不存在的介面保持不變，因為這些介面被提供給目標防火牆。如果您想要排除某些介面（對於所有遠端防火牆），您可以在「常規設定」標籤上的「管理」->「主機設定」中輕鬆覆蓋已知介面。

Since there’s an explicit order in which different types of rules are being handled, you can choose if you want to prefer central rules being matched first or last depending on the type of “interface” to use.

由於處理不同類型的規則有明確的順序，因此您可以根據要使用的「介面」類型來選擇是先符合中心規則還是最後符合中心規則。

![](<../images/21c7e41a-blockdiag-ec0d5aaf9b949b5a5e296533bff3fe.png>)

Tip

提示

When forcing interface groups to the backup node, these will precede interface rules such as LAN and WAN, when only sending over interface groups the remote firewall is able to allow traffic which would otherwise be rejected.

當強制介面群組到備份節點時，這些將優先於LAN和WAN等介面規則，當僅透過介面群組發送時，遠端防火牆能夠允許否則將被拒絕的流量。

Note

注意事項

When multiple interfaces are attached to a (floating) rule, these will be removed by the provisioning algorithm as the intend isn’t fully clear in these matters.

當多個介面附加到（浮動）規則時，這些介面將被配置演算法刪除，因為這些問題的意圖並不完全清楚。

Note

筆記

Rules on the central node which do apply to all interfaces or a selection of interfaces are always being send to the remote firewall. When this isn’t intentional, best not use these options in the “floating” rules.

中央節點上適用於所有介面或選擇的介面的規則始終傳送到遠端防火牆。如果這不是故意的，最好不要在「浮動」規則中使用這些選項。

##### [NAT (Firewall)](#p-047)｜[NAT（防火牆）](#p-047)

Merging the nat rules will keep the interfaces unaltered which don’t exists on the central node as these are being provided to the target firewall. In case you want to exclude some interfaces (for all remote firewalls), you can easily override the known interfaces in Management -> Host configuration on the General settings tab.

合併 nat 規則將使中心節點上不存在的介面保持不變，因為這些介面被提供給目標防火牆。如果您想要排除某些介面（對於所有遠端防火牆），您可以在「常規設定」標籤上的「管理」->「主機設定」中輕鬆覆蓋已知介面。

Note

注意事項

All NAT type rules (`Port Forward`, `One-to-One`, `Source NAT (Outbound)`, `NPTv6`) are treated similar.

所有 NAT 類型規則 (`Port Forward`, `One-to-One`, `Source NAT (Outbound)`, `NPTv6`) 的處理方式類似。

Note

注意事項

When multiple interfaces are attached to a rule, which is possible for port forwards. These will be removed by the provisioning algorithm.

當多個介面附加到一條規則時，可以進行連接埠轉送。這些將被配置演算法刪除。

Note

注意事項

Port forwarding rules on the central node which do apply on a selection of interfaces are always being send to the remote firewall. When this isn’t intentional, best prevent the usage of these forwards.

中央節點上適用於所選介面的連接埠轉送規則始終傳送到遠端防火牆。如果這不是故意的，最好阻止使用這些轉發。

##### [Firewall categories](#p-047)｜[防火牆類](#p-047)

Merging categories will preserve the ones that are currently used on the remote firewall.

合併類別將保留遠端防火牆上目前使用的類別。

##### [WebGui (Administration)](#p-047)｜[WebGui（管理）](#p-047)

To prevent breakage after synchronisation, the certificate used by the webgui will be preserved after synchronisation (or the one provided in the host configuration will be shipped).

為了防止同步後損壞，同步後將保留 webgui 使用的憑證（或將發送主機配置中提供的憑證）。

Attention

注意

Currently it’s not possible to merge certificates and webgui admin settings, as the certificate store will potentially be overwritten in that case.

目前無法合併憑證和 webgui 管理設置，因為在這種情況下憑證儲存可能會被覆寫。

#### [Configuration Tutorials](#p-047)｜[配置教學](#p-047)

In this section we will show example configurations of some of the features that OPNcentral Central Management offers.

在本節中，我們將展示 OPNcentral 中央管理提供的一些功能的範例配置。

##### [Automatic WebGUI Login](#p-047)｜[WebGUI自動登入](#p-047)

For the automatic login feature to work, the following infrastructure is required:

為了使自動登入功能發揮作用，需要以下基礎設施：

-   One OPNsense with Business Edition and OPNcentral installed, which will be used as the Central Host for configuration. Using this OPNsense for no other tasks than configuration and administration is recommended.  
    一台安裝了 Business Edition 和 OPNcentral 的 OPNsense，將用作配置的中央主機。建議將此 OPNsense 用於配置和管理以外的其他任務。
    
-   One or several other OPNsense with Business Edition and OPNcentral installed, which will be managed by the Central Host.  
    安裝了商業版和 OPNcentral 的一個或多個其他 OPNsense，將由中央主機管理。
    
-   Either your own PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) or using the OPNsense provided one in System ‣ Trust  
    您自己的PKI（公鑰基礎設施）或使用系統‣信任中提供的 OPNsense
    
-   A DNS infrastructure or public DNS provider, that manages the FQDNs (Full Qualified Domain Names) of each OPNsense  
    管理每個 OPNsense 的 FQDN（完全限定網域名稱）的 DNS 基礎設施或公共 DNS 供應商
    

We assume that we have this example infrastructure:

我們假設我們有這個範例基礎設施：

| FQDN | IP Address<br>IP 地址 | Task<br>任務 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `central-host.opnsense.local` | 203.0.113.1 | Central Host for administration<br>中央管理主機 |
| `node-a1.opnsense.local` | 198.51.100.1 | Firewall Node site A<br>防火牆節點站點 A |
| `node-b1.opnsense.local` | 192.0.2.1 | Firewall Node site B<br>防火牆節點站點 B |

###### 1\. Add Firewall Nodes to the Central Host｜1\.將防火牆節點新增至中心主機

-   Go to Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration.  
    轉至管理 ‣ 主機 ‣ 設定。
    
-   Follow the steps described here [Register new hosts](#p-047).  
    請按照此處所述的步驟[註冊新主機](#p-047)。
    
-   If there are connection problems, check if the Central Host can resolve the FQDNs of the Firewall Nodes. They have to be added via their FQDN and *not* via IP address. Otherwise the SAN of the certificates will not match the FQDN.  
    如果有連線問題，請檢查中央主機是否可以解析防火牆節點的 FQDN。它們必須透過其 FQDN 添加，*不能*透過 IP 位址添加。否則證書的SAN將與FQDN不符。
    

Tip

提示

When using a custom WebGUI port, specify the socket like this: `https://node-a1.opnsense.local:8443`

使用自訂 WebGUI 連接埠時，請像這樣指定套接字：`https://node-a1.opnsense.local:8443`

Note

注意事項

Only add the Firewall Nodes to the Central Host. Do not add the Central Host to itself to prevent configuration loops.

僅將防火牆節點新增至中央主機。請勿將中央主機新增至其自身，以防止配置循環。

###### 2\. Create a PKI on the Central Host｜2\.在中央主機上建立PKI

For more information read [Setup Self-Signed Certificate Chains](#p-104)

有關更多信息，請閱讀[設定自簽名憑證鏈](#p-104)

-   Go to System ‣ Trust ‣ Authorities and press *+* to Create an internal Certificate Authority.  
    前往 System ‣ Trust ‣ Authority 並按 *+* 建立內部憑證授權單位。
    
-   Leave all the populated fields on their default values.  
    將所有填滿欄位保留為預設值。
    
-   As State, City, Organization and Email Address, add your own.  
    新增您自己的州、城市、組織和電子郵件地址。
    
-   As Descriptive name and Common Name, use `opncentral-ca`.  
    作為描述性名稱和通用名稱，請使用 `opncentral-ca`。
    
-   Press *Save*.  
    按*儲存*。
    

Note

注意事項

Export the CA certificate, and import it into the Trusted Root Certificate Store of each client that should use the automatic WebGUI login. It will only work if the Browser trusts the connection.

匯出 CA 證書，並將其匯入至應使用自動 WebGUI 登入的每個用戶端的受信任根證書儲存空間。只有當瀏覽器信任該連接時它才會起作用。

###### 3\. Create Server Certificates for all Hosts｜3\.為所有主機建立伺服器憑證

-   Go to System ‣ Trust ‣ Certificates and press *+* to Create an internal Certificate.  
    前往 System ‣ Trust ‣ Certificates 並按 *+* 建立內部憑證。
    
-   Leave all the populated fields on their default values.  
    將所有填滿欄位保留為預設值。
    
-   As Type choose Server Certificate.  
    作為類型，選擇伺服器憑證。
    
-   As Common Name and Alternative Names Type DNS (SAN) choose the FQDNs of the Firewall; e.g., `central-host.opnsense.local`  
    作為通用名稱和備用名稱類型DNS (SAN)，選擇防火牆的 FQDN；例如，`central-host.opnsense.local`
    
-   Press *Save* and repeat this until there are certificates for the Central Host and the Firewall Nodes.  
    按*儲存*並重複此操作，直到有中央主機和防火牆節點的憑證。
    

###### 4\. Change WebGUI certificate of Central Host｜4\.更改中央主機的WebGUI證書

-   Go to System ‣ Settings ‣ Administration.  
    前往系統 ‣ 設定 ‣ 管理。
    
-   Make sure the Protocol is HTTPS and choose the certificate with the FQDN of the Central Host; e.g., `central-host.opnsense.local`  
    確保協定為HTTPS，並選擇中心主機為FQDN的憑證；例如，`central-host.opnsense.local`
    
-   Press *Save* and press the link that appears, which will redirect the session to a new browser tab.  
    按*儲存*並按出現的鏈接，這會將會話重定向到新的瀏覽器標籤。
    

Note

注意事項

The browser should automatically trust the connection to the Central Host now. If not, make sure the `opncentral-ca` certificate has been imported as described in Step 2. It is mandatory that the browser trust is established before continuing.

瀏覽器現在應該會自動信任與中央主機的連線。如果沒有，請確保已依照步驟 2 中所述匯入`opncentral-ca` 憑證。在繼續之前必須建立瀏覽器信任。

###### 5\. Provision Certificates and WebGUI to Firewall Nodes｜5\.向防火牆節點提供憑證和 WebGUI

-   Go to Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration.  
    轉至管理 ‣ 主機 ‣ 設定。
    
-   Select a Firewall Node, e.g., `node-a1.opnsense.local` and edit it.  
    選擇一個防火牆節點，例如`node-a1.opnsense.local`並進行編輯。
    
-   Make sure that Validate SSL is not selected right now.  
    確保現在未選擇驗證SSL。
    
-   Select the correct certificate in Push WebUI certificate, in this case `node-a1.opnsense.local`  
    在 Push WebUI 證書中選擇正確的證書，本例為`node-a1.opnsense.local`
    
-   In Provision classes, select `Web GUI`. Please be careful *not* to select `Certificates`, only `Web GUI` is needed as Provision classes.  
    在供應類別中，選擇`Web GUI`。注意*不要*選擇`Certificates`，只有`Web GUI`需要作為Provision類別。
    
-   Press *Save* and repeat the same for all other Firewall Nodes.  
    按“儲存”並對所有其他防火牆節點重複相同的操作。
    
-   Go to Management ‣ Provisioning and select all Hosts, then press Reconfigure.  
    前往 Management ‣ Provisioning 並選擇所有主機，然後按 Reconfigure。
    
-   After the provisioning has succeeded, go back to Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration and enable Validate SSL for all Firewall Nodes.  
    配置成功後，返回 Management ‣ Host ‣ Configuration 並為所有防火牆節點啟用 Validate SSL。
    

###### 6\. Test the Automatic Login｜6\.測試自動登入

-   Go to Management ‣ Provisioning and click on any of the Host links. An additional browser tab will open with the selected Firewall Node and the session is automatically logged in.  
    前往 Management ‣ Provisioning 並點選任意主機連結。將開啟一個附加瀏覽器選項卡，其中包含所選的防火牆節點，並且會話將自動登入。
    

Tip

提示

This feature is especially useful for Network Administrators that centrally manage a large amount of OPNsense Firewalls.

此功能對於集中管理大量 OPNsense 防火牆的網路管理員特別有用。
