As part of the OPNsense Business Edition, Deciso offers a plugin for advanced DNS infrastructure requirements.

作為 OPNsense 商業版的一部分，Deciso 提供了一個滿足高級 DNS 基礎設施要求的插件。

OPNDNS is based on [PowerDNS Authoritative](https://doc.powerdns.com/authoritative/) and hosts DNS zones on OPNsense. It can manage static internal zones, reverse lookup zones, and dynamic DNS updates from services such as [KEA DHCP](#p-196) using RFC2136.

OPNDNS 基於 [PowerDNS 權威](https://doc.powerdns.com/authoritative/) 並在 OPNsense 上託管 DNS 區域。它可以管理靜態內部區域、反向查找區域以及使用 RFC2136 的 [KEA DHCP](#p-196) 等服務的動態 DNS 更新。

It supports record types that are usually outside the scope of a recursive resolver, such as `MX`, `SRV` and `TXT`.

它支援通常超出遞歸解析器範圍的記錄類型，例如`MX`, `SRV`和`TXT`。

In a common setup, [Unbound DNS](#p-199) remains the recursive resolver for clients and forwards selected internal zones to this service.

在常見設定中，[Unbound DNS](#p-199) 仍然是客戶端的遞歸解析器，並將選定的內部區域轉送到此服務。

#### [Considerations before deployment](#p-048)｜[部署前註意事項](#p-048)

##### [DNS role](#p-048)｜[DNS角色](#p-048)

This service is not a recursive resolver. It only answers for zones configured locally.

此服務不是遞歸解析器。它僅回答本地配置的區域。

It is intended primarily for internal authoritative DNS use cases, such as infrastructure zones, reverse lookup zones and DHCP-driven dynamic updates. It is not meant to replace a dedicated public DNS setup for internet-facing domains.

它主要用於內部權威的DNS用例，例如基礎設施區域、反向查找區域和DHCP驅動的動態更新。它並不意味著取代面向互聯網域的專用公共DNS設定。

It should normally not replace [Unbound DNS](#p-199) as the DNS server for clients. Instead, keep Unbound on port `53` and forward selected internal zones to this service on another port, for example `53053`.

它通常不應取代[Unbound DNS](#p-199)作為客戶端的DNS伺服器。相反，請在連接埠 `53` 上保持 Unbound，並將選定的內部區域轉送到另一個連接埠（例如 `53053`）上的此服務。

Note

筆記

Unbound resolves arbitrary DNS names for clients. This service only answers for zones it is authoritative for.

Unbound 為客戶端解析任意 DNS 名稱。該服務僅回答其權威的區域。

##### [Records and RRsets](#p-048)｜[記錄與RR集](#p-048)

The GUI uses the term **record** for simplicity.

為簡單起見，GUI 使用術語「**記錄**」。

Technically, each record entry represents an RRset. An RRset is the combination of:

從技術上講，每個記錄條目代表一個 RRset。 RRset 是以下各項的組合：

-   one record name  
    一個記錄名稱
    
-   one record type  
    一種記錄類型
    
-   one TTL  
    一TTL
    
-   one or more values  
    一個或多個值
    

For example, two IPv4 addresses for the same host are stored as one `A` RRset with two values:

例如，同一台主機的兩個 IPv4 位址儲存為一個具有兩個值的 `A` RRset：

```
host1.internal 300 IN A 192.168.1.10
host1.internal 300 IN A 192.168.1.11
```

In the GUI, this is entered as one record with `host1` as name, `A` as type, `300` as TTL, and both IP addresses as separate values.

在 GUI 中，這是作為一條記錄輸入的，`host1` 作為名稱，`A` 作為類型，`300` 作為 TTL，並且兩個 IP 地址作為單獨的值。

##### [Zone types](#p-048)｜[區域類型](#p-048)

There are two zone types:

有兩種區域類型：

-   `static` zones contain records managed through the GUI.  
    `static` 區域包含透過GUI 管理的記錄。
    
-   `allowupdate` zones allow RFC2136 updates.  
    `allowupdate` 區域允許 RFC2136 更新。
    

Static zones are intended for manually configured records, such as nameservers, infrastructure hosts, service records and reverse lookup records.

靜態區域適用於手動設定的記錄，例如名稱伺服器、基礎架構主機、服務記錄和反向查找記錄。

Dynamic zones are intended for automatic updates, for example from [KEA DHCP](#p-196).

動態區域用於自動更新，例如來自 [KEA DHCP](#p-196)。

Attention

注意力

Do not create manual records in dynamic zones unless you know exactly why they are needed. These zones are expected to be owned by RFC2136 update clients.

不要在動態區域中建立手動記錄，除非您確切知道為什麼需要它們。這些區域預計由 RFC2136 更新客戶端擁有。

##### [High availability](#p-048)｜[高可用性](#p-048)

A global role controls how the service behaves:

全域角色控制服務的行為方式：

-   `Primary` creates and manages zones and records.  
    `Primary` 建立和管理區域和記錄。
    
-   `Secondary` creates secondary zones and retrieves their contents from the configured peer.  
    `Secondary` 建立輔助區域並從配置的對等方擷取其內容。
    

The primary can allow one configured peer to transfer zones and can notify it when a zone changes.

主節點可以允許一個已配置的對等方傳輸區域，並且可以在區域更改時通知它。

Note

筆記

The HA design is intentionally simple. A single peer is configured globally and used for zone transfers and notifications.

HA 設計故意簡單。單一對等點在全域進行配置並用於區域傳輸和通知。

Using this service as a secondary for public DNS infrastructure is not recommended, even if it is technically possible.

不建議將此服務用作公共DNS基礎設施的輔助服務，即使技術上可行。

#### [General settings](#p-048)｜[常規設定](#p-048)

Most settings are straightforward. Enable the service, choose the role, configure the listen port, and optionally configure the HA peer.

大多數設定都很簡單。啟用服務，選擇角色，配置偵聽端口，並可選擇配置HA對等點。

**General**

**一般**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Enable**<br>**啟用** | Enable the service.<br>啟用該服務。 |
| **Listen Port**<br>**監聽埠** | Port used for DNS queries.<br>用於DNS查詢的埠。 |
| **Role**<br>**角色** | Choose whether this firewall acts as `Primary` or `Secondary`.<br>選擇此防火牆是否充當`Primary`或`Secondary`。 |
| **Peer**<br>**同行** | IP address and port of the peer DNS server. On a primary, this is used for zone transfers and notifications. On a secondary, this is the primary server.<br>IP對端DNS伺服器的位址與連接埠。在主節點上，這用於區域傳輸和通知。在輔助伺服器上，這是主伺服器。 |
| **Disable HA sync**<br>**停用HA同步** | Prevent general settings from being synchronized between HA peers.<br>防止常規設定在HA對等點之間同步。 |

Tip

提示

When Unbound listens on port `53`, configure this service on a different port such as `53053` and forward the relevant zones from Unbound.

當 Unbound 偵聽連接埠 `53` 時，請在不同連接埠（例如 `53053`）上設定此服務，並從 Unbound 轉送相關區域。

**SOA**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Primary nameserver**<br>**主網域伺服器** | Primary nameserver used in the SOA record, for example `ns1.internal`.<br>SOA 記錄中使用的主名稱伺服器，例如 `ns1.internal`。 |
| **Responsible Mailbox**<br>**負責的信箱** | Responsible mailbox encoded as DNS name, for example `hostmaster.internal`.<br>責任信箱編碼為DNS名稱，例如`hostmaster.internal`。 |
| **Refresh**<br>**刷新** | Time in seconds after which a secondary checks the primary for zone updates.<br>輔助節點檢查主節點是否有區域更新的時間（以秒為單位）。 |
| **Retry**<br>**重試** | Time in seconds after which a secondary retries a failed refresh.<br>輔助設備重試失敗刷新之前的時間（以秒為單位）。 |
| **Expire**<br>**過期** | Time in seconds after which a secondary stops serving the zone if the primary cannot be reached.<br>如果無法到達主資料庫，則輔助資料庫將停止為該區域提供服務的時間（以秒為單位）。 |
| **Minimum TTL**<br>**最低TTL** | Minimum TTL used in the SOA record.<br>SOA 記錄中使用的最小TTL。 |

Note

筆記

SOA records are generated automatically. They do not need to be created manually.

SOA 記錄自動產生。它們不需要手動建立。

If these settings are changed, existing zones must be deleted and recreated to receive updated SOA content. The serial is updated automatically on configuration changes and is used by secondary servers to detect updates.

如果變更這些設置，則必須刪除並重新建立現有區域才能接收更新的 SOA 內容。此序號會在配置變更時自動更新，並由輔助伺服器用來偵測更新。

**Log**

**日誌**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Log Level** | Higher values log more details. Use high values only while debugging. Values can be between 1 to 9. |

| **日誌等級** |值越高，記錄的細節越多。僅在調試時使用高值。值可以介於 1 到 9 之間。
| **Log DNS Queries**<br>**記錄DNS查詢** | Log incoming DNS queries. This can generate large amounts of log data.<br>記錄傳入的DNS查詢。這會產生大量日誌資料。 |
| **Log DNS Details**<br>**日誌DNS詳細資料** | Log additional DNS packet details for debugging. This can be noisy.<br>記錄額外的DNS封包詳細資料以進行偵錯。這可能會很吵。 |

#### [Zone settings](#p-048)｜[區域設定](#p-048)

Zones are configured in Services ‣ Authoritative DNS ‣ Zones.

區域在服務‣權威DNS‣區域中配置。

**Zones**

**區域**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Zone Name**<br>**區域名稱** | Name of the zone, for example `internal` or `1.168.192.in-addr.arpa`.<br>區域的名稱，例如 `internal` 或 `1.168.192.in-addr.arpa`。 |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | `static` for GUI-managed zones, `allowupdate` for RFC2136 updates.<br>`static` 適用於 GUI 管理區域，`allowupdate` 適用於 RFC2136 更新。 |
| **Allow Updates From**<br>**允許更新自** | Network allowed to send RFC2136 updates. Only used with `allowupdate` zones.<br>網路允許發送RFC2136更新。僅與`allowupdate`區域一起使用。 |
| **Default TTL**<br>**預設TTL** | Default time-to-live for records in this zone.<br>該區域中記錄的預設生存時間。 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | Optional description for your reference.<br>可選描述供您參考。 |

**Records**

**記錄**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Zone**<br>**專區** | Zone this record belongs to.<br>該記錄所屬的區域。 |
| **Record Name**<br>**記錄名稱** | Record name. All names must be fully qualified in the zone.<br>記錄姓名。該區域中的所有名稱都必須完全限定。 |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | DNS record type, for example `A`, `AAAA`, `NS`, `MX`, `PTR` or `TXT`.<br>DNS 記錄類型，例如`A`, `AAAA`, `NS`, `MX`, `PTR` 或`TXT`。 |
| **TTL** | Optional record-specific TTL. If empty, the zone default is used.<br>可選的特定記錄TTL。如果為空，則使用區域預設值。 |
| **Values**<br>**價值觀** | One or more record values. Use one value per line.<br>一個或多個記錄值。每行使用一個值。 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | Optional description for your reference.<br>可選描述供您參考。 |

##### [Forwarding from Unbound](#p-048)｜[來自未綁定的轉發](#p-048)

Clients should normally query [Unbound DNS](#p-199) on port `53`. Unbound can then forward only the locally hosted zones.

客戶端通常應在連接埠 `53` 上查詢 [Unbound DNS](#p-199)。然後，Unbound 只能轉送本機託管區域。

This keeps the client setup simple while separating recursive and authoritative DNS duties.

這使得客戶端設定變得簡單，同時分離了遞歸和權威 DNS 職責。

Go to Services ‣ Unbound DNS ‣ General and set:

進入服務‣解除綁定DNS‣常規並設定：

| **Listen Port**<br>**監聽埠** | `53` |

Press **Apply**.

按**應用**。

Go to Services ‣ Unbound DNS ‣ Query Forwarding and add forwarding entries for the zones.

**Forward zone**

**前進區**

| Option<br>選項 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Domain**<br>**域名** | `internal` |
| **Server IP**<br>**伺服器IP** | `127.0.0.1` |
| **Server Port**<br>**伺服器連接埠** | `53053` |

Press **Save** and add the next entry.

按 **儲存** 並新增下一個項目。

| Option<br>選項 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |

| **Server IP**<br>**伺服器IP** | `127.0.0.1` |

Press **Save** and **Apply**.

按**儲存**並**應用**。

When a client queries Unbound for `ns1.internal`, the request is forwarded to `127.0.0.1:53053`. The local service answers for the zone and Unbound returns the response to the client.

當客戶端查詢Unbound `ns1.internal`時，請求將轉送至`127.0.0.1:53053`。本地服務對該區域進行應答，Unbound 將回應傳回給客戶端。

Note

筆記

Forwarding only applies to the configured domains. Internet DNS resolution continues to be handled by Unbound normally.

轉送僅適用於配置的網域。互聯網DNS解析繼續由Unbound正常處理。

##### [Dynamic DNS with KEA DHCP (RFC2136)](#p-048)｜[動態DNS與KEA DHCP(RFC2136)](#p-048)

[KEA DHCP](#p-196) can register client FQDNs through dynamic DNS updates using RFC2136.

[KEA DHCP](#p-196) 可以使用 RFC2136 透過動態 DNS 更新來註冊客戶端 FQDN。

This example registers DHCP clients in forward and reverse zones.

此範例在正向和反向區域中註冊 DHCP 用戶端。

The example uses:

此範例使用：

-   Parent zone: `internal`  
    父區：`internal`
    
-   Forward zone: `dhcp.internal`  
    前鋒區：`dhcp.internal`
    
-   Reverse zone: `1.168.192.in-addr.arpa`  
    反向區：`1.168.192.in-addr.arpa`
    
-   Nameservers: `ns1.internal` and `ns2.internal`  
    名稱伺服器：`ns1.internal` 和 `ns2.internal`
    
-   DHCP subnet: `192.168.1.0/24`  
    DHCP子網：`192.168.1.0/24`
    
-   DHCP pool: `192.168.1.100 - 192.168.1.199`  
    DHCP池：`192.168.1.100 - 192.168.1.199`
    
-   DNS server: `127.0.0.1`  
    DNS伺服器：`127.0.0.1`
    
-   DNS server port: `53053`  
    DNS 伺服器連接埠：`53053`
    

Go to Services ‣ Authoritative DNS ‣ Zones and add:

轉到服務 ‣ 權威 DNS ‣ 區域並新增：

| Option<br>選項 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Name**<br>**姓名** | `dhcp.internal` |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | `allowupdate` |
| **Allow Updates From**<br>**允許更新自** | `127.0.0.1/32` `192.168.1.3/32` |

Press **Save**.

按**儲存**。

Note

筆記

The IP address `192.168.1.3` represents the secondary DNS server in an HA setup. You can omit this address when HA is not used.

IP 位址 `192.168.1.3` 代表 HA 設定中的輔助 DNS 伺服器。當不使用HA時，可以省略該位址。

By default, PowerDNS forwards RFC2136 updates received by a secondary zone to the configured primary server. Allowing the secondary DNS server here lets the primary accept those forwarded updates.

預設情況下，PowerDNS 將輔助區域收到的RFC2136 更新轉送到已設定的主伺服器。此處允許輔助 DNS 伺服器可以讓主伺服器接受那些轉送的更新。

This is useful when Kea is active on the backup OPNsense node. Kea sends its updates to the local secondary server, which then forwards them to the primary server where the update is applied.

當 Kea 在備份 OPNsense 節點上處於活動狀態時，這非常有用。 Kea 將其更新傳送到本地輔助伺服器，然後本地輔助伺服器將其轉送到應用程式更新的主伺服器。

Then add an NS record for the zone. If you do not use HA, you can skip the second nameserver value.

然後為該區域新增 NS 記錄。如果您不使用HA，則可以跳過第二個名稱伺服器值。

| Option<br>選項 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Zone**<br>**專區** | `dhcp.internal` |
| **Name**<br>**姓名** | `dhcp.internal` |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | `NS` |
| **TTL** | `300` |
| **Values**<br>**價值觀** | `ns1.internal`<br>`ns2.internal` |

Press **Save**.

按**儲存**。

Note

筆記

This example reuses the nameservers from the already configured `internal` zone.

此範例重複使用已設定的 `internal` 區域中的名稱伺服器。

The nameserver host records, such as `ns1.internal.` and `ns2.internal.`, are defined in the parent zone. The dynamic `dhcp.internal` zone only references them with its own NS record.

名稱伺服器主機記錄（例如 `ns1.internal.` 和 `ns2.internal.`）在父區域中定義。動態`dhcp.internal`區域僅使用其自己的NS記錄來引用它們。

Go to Services ‣ Authoritative DNS ‣ Zones and add a new reverse zone. If you already created the reverse zone earlier just change it accordingly.

前往 Services ‣ Authoritative DNS ‣ Zones 並新增新的反向區域。如果您之前已經建立了反向區域，只需相應地更改它即可。

| Option<br>選項 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Name**<br>**姓名** | `1.168.192.in-addr.arpa` |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | `allowupdate` |
| **Allow Updates From**<br>**允許更新自** | `127.0.0.1/32` `192.168.1.3/32` |

Press **Save**.

按**儲存**。

Then add an NS record for the reverse zone if they do not already exist. If you do not use HA, you can skip the second nameserver value.

然後新增反向區域的 NS 記錄（如果它們尚不存在）。如果您不使用HA，則可以跳過第二個名稱伺服器值。

| Option<br>選項 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Zone**<br>**專區** | `1.168.192.in-addr.arpa` |
| **Name**<br>**姓名** | `1.168.192.in-addr.arpa` |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | `NS` |
| **TTL** | `300` |
| **Values**<br>**價值觀** | `ns1.internal`<br>`ns2.internal` |

Press **Save** and **Apply**.

按**儲存**並**應用**。

Note

筆記

The reverse zone also uses the same nameservers.

反向區域也使用相同的名稱伺服器。

The PTR records themselves are created dynamically by KEA through RFC2136 updates. The NS record only defines which nameservers are responsible for the reverse zone.

PTR 記錄本身是由KEA 透過RFC2136 更新動態建立的。 NS 記錄僅定義哪些名稱伺服器負責反向區域。

Attention

注意力

Do not forget to add forwards from Unbound for these zones.

不要忘記為這些區域添加來自 Unbound 的轉發。

Go to Services ‣ KEA DHCP ‣ KEA DHCPv4, select a subnet and enable advanced mode.

進入服務‣KEA DHCP‣KEADHCPv4，選擇子網路並啟用進階模式。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Value**<br>**價值** |
| --- | --- |
| Subnet<br>子網 | `192.168.1.0/24` |
| Pools<br>泳池 | `192.168.1.100 - 192.168.1.199` |
| **DHCP option data**<br>**DHCP 選項資料** |  |
| Auto collect option data<br>自動收集選項資料 | Unchecked<br>未選取 |
| Routers<br>路由器 | `192.168.1.1` |
| DNS servers<br>DNS 伺服器 | `192.168.1.1` |
| Domain name<br>網域 | `dhcp.internal` |
| **Dynamic DNS**<br>**動態DNS** |  |
| DNS forward zone<br>DNS 前進區 | `dhcp.internal.` |
| DNS reverse zone<br>DNS 反向區 | `1.168.192.in-addr.arpa.` |
| DNS qualifying suffix<br>DNS 資格字尾 | `dhcp.internal.` |
| DNS server<br>DNS伺服器 | `127.0.0.1` |
| DNS server port<br>DNS 伺服器連接埠 | `53053` |
| Override no update<br>覆蓋不更新 | `X` |
| Override client update<br>覆蓋客戶端更新 | `X` |
| Update on renew<br>更新更新 | `X` |
| Conflict resolution mode<br>衝突解決模式 | `no-check-with-dhcid` |

Attention

注意力

In KEA the zones and qualifying suffix must end with a trailing dot.

在 KEA 中，區域和資格後綴必須以尾隨點結尾。

If certain hosts should get registered with custom hostnames, create a host reservation for them.

如果某些主機應使用自訂主機名稱註冊，請為它們建立主機預留。

Go to Services ‣ KEA DHCP ‣ DDNS Agent and set:

前往服務 ‣ KEA DHCP ‣ DDNS 代理並設定：

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Value**<br>**價值** |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | `X` |
| Bind address<br>綁定位址 | `127.0.0.1` |
| Bind port<br>綁定埠 | `53001` |

Press **Apply**.

按**應用**。

Note

筆記

This example does not use a TSIG key. The communication is local and `Allow Updates From` restricts which clients can update the zone.

此範例不使用 TSIG 金鑰。通訊是本地的，`Allow Updates From` 限制哪些客戶端可以更新區域。

For a general DHCP setup, see [KEA DHCP](#p-196).

有關常規 DHCP 設置，請參閱 [KEA DHCP](#p-196)。

##### [High availability setup](#p-048)｜[高可用性設定](#p-048)

This example uses two OPNsense firewalls:

此範例使用兩個 OPNsense 防火牆：

-   Primary: `192.168.1.2`  
    主要：`192.168.1.2`
    
-   Secondary: `192.168.1.3`  
    中學：`192.168.1.3`
    

The primary manages the zones and allows the secondary to transfer them.

主節點管理區域並允許輔助節點傳輸它們。

###### [Primary](#p-048)｜[小學](#p-048)

Go to Services ‣ Authoritative DNS ‣ Settings ‣ General on the primary and set:

轉到主伺服器上的 Services ‣ Authoritative DNS ‣ Settings ‣ General 並設定：

| Option<br>選項 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enable**<br>**啟用** | `X` |
| **Listen Port**<br>**監聽埠** | `53053` |
| **Role**<br>**角色** | `Primary` |
| **Peer**<br>**同行** | `192.168.1.3:53053` |
| **Disable HA sync**<br>**禁用HA同步** | `X` |

Press **Apply**.

按**應用**。

Create static and dynamic zones on the primary as usual. It manages the records and increases the zone serial on each **Apply** or when an RFC2136 client updates a record.

照常在主伺服器上建立靜態和動態區域。它管理記錄並在每次 **Apply** 或當 RFC2136 用戶端更新記錄時增加區域序列。

###### [Secondary](#p-048)｜[中學](#p-048)

Go to Services ‣ Authoritative DNS ‣ Settings ‣ General on the secondary and set:

前往輔助伺服器上的 Services ‣ Authoritative DNS ‣ Settings ‣ General 並設定：

| Option<br>選項 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enable**<br>**啟用** | `X` |
| **Listen Port**<br>**監聽埠** | `53053` |
| **Role**<br>**角色** | `Secondary` |
| **Peer**<br>**同行** | `192.168.1.2:53053` |
| **Disable HA sync**<br>**停用 HA 同步** | `X` |

Press **Apply**.

按**應用**。

For a secondary server, records are not managed locally. The zone contents are received from the primary through zone transfer.

對於輔助伺服器，記錄不在本機管理。區域內容是透過區域傳輸從主設備接收的。

Add `Authoritative DNS` to System ‣ High Availability ‣ Settings ‣ Services to synchronize. The zones on the secondary are created when HA synchronization is triggered in System ‣ High Availability ‣ Status.

將`Authoritative DNS`加入系統‣高可用性‣設定‣服務中進行同步。當在 System ‣ High Availability ‣ Status 中觸發HA 同步時，會建立輔助節點上的區域。

After the first sync, the secondary performs an AXFR zone transfer. Further changes are announced through NOTIFY messages.

第一次同步後，輔助設備執行AXFR區域傳輸。進一步的更改將透過NOTIFY訊息宣布。

It is recommended to transfer zones over the same link used for HA sync. TCP must be allowed between both nodes on the configured listen port.

建議透過用於 HA 同步的相同連結傳輸區域。 TCP 必須允許在配置的偵聽連接埠上的兩個節點之間使用。

Attention

注意力

The secondary is read-only. Records sync automatically via standard DNS zone transfers, you do not need any cron jobs for the HA sync.

輔助是唯讀的。透過標準 DNS 區域傳輸自動記錄同步，您不需要任何 cron 作業來進行 HA 同步。

RFC2136 updates must be sent to the primary. During failover, the secondary continues to serve the latest transferred zone state.

RFC2136 更新必須傳送到主伺服器。在故障轉移期間，輔助節點繼續提供最新傳輸的區域狀態。

#### [Good to know](#p-048)｜[很高興知道](#p-048)

##### [SOA records](#p-048)｜[SOA記錄](#p-048)

An SOA record defines basic authority and timing information for a zone. It contains the primary nameserver, responsible mailbox, zone serial and refresh timers used by secondary servers.

SOA 記錄定義區域的基本權限和計時資訊。它包含主名稱伺服器、負責的郵箱、區域序列和輔助伺服器使用的刷新計時器。

SOA records are generated automatically from the SOA settings.

SOA 記錄是根據SOA 設定自動產生的。

They cannot be created manually as records in the GUI. To regenerate SOA content, delete and recreate the zone.

它們無法手動建立為GUI 中的記錄。若要重新產生 SOA 內容，請刪除並重新建立該區域。

##### [NS records](#p-048)｜[NS記錄](#p-048)

NS records define which nameservers are responsible for a zone.

NS 記錄定義哪些名稱伺服器負責一個區域。

Configure NS records explicitly for every zone.

為每個區域明確配置NS記錄。

For a zone named `internal`, a simple setup could use:

對於名為 `internal` 的區域，可以使用以下簡單設定：

```
internal 300 IN NS ns1.internal
internal 300 IN NS ns2.internal
```

Additional zones can use the same nameservers.

其他區域可以使用相同的名稱伺服器。

Nameservers should also have matching address records. For reverse lookups, create corresponding PTR records as well.

名稱伺服器也應該有匹配的位址記錄。對於反向查找，也建立對應的PTR記錄。

##### [Serial handling](#p-048)｜[串行處理](#p-048)

When static zone content changes, the zone serial is increased so that secondary servers can detect updates.

當靜態區域內容發生變更時，區域序號會增加，以便輔助伺服器可以偵測到更新。

Secondary systems should not manage records directly.

輔助系統不應直接管理記錄。

##### [DHCP search domain](#p-048)｜[DHCP搜尋網域名稱](#p-048)

Clients can resolve short hostnames when DHCP provides a search domain.

當DHCP提供搜尋域時，客戶端可以解析短主機名稱。

For example, if [KEA DHCP](#p-196) sends `dhcp.internal` as the domain name, a client may resolve `host1` as `host1.dhcp.internal`.

例如，如果 [KEA DHCP](#p-196) 發送 `dhcp.internal` 作為域名，則客戶端可以將 `host1` 解析為 `host1.dhcp.internal`。

Note

筆記

Short name resolution depends on the client resolver behavior and the DHCP options it receives.

短名稱解析取決於客戶端解析器行為及其接收的 DHCP 選項。

DNS itself still stores and answers for fully qualified names. The search domain is only applied by the client.

DNS 本身仍然儲存和回答完全限定名稱。搜尋域僅由客戶端套用。

##### [Firewall rules](#p-048)｜[防火牆規則](#p-048)

If clients or peers query the service directly, allow TCP and UDP traffic to the configured listen port.

如果用戶端或對等方直接查詢服務，請允許 TCP 和 UDP 流量流向配置的偵聽連接埠。

For zone transfers, TCP must be allowed between primary and secondary.

對於區域傳輸，必須允許在主要和次要之間進行TCP。

Tip

提示

DNS queries commonly use UDP. Zone transfers require TCP.

DNS 查詢通常使用UDP。區域轉移需要TCP。

##### [Testing](#p-048)｜[測試](#p-048)

Test direct queries before configuring Unbound forwarding.

在配置 Unbound 轉送之前測試直接查詢。

```
drill -p 53053 @127.0.0.1 internal SOA
drill -p 53053 @127.0.0.1 internal NS
drill -p 53053 @127.0.0.1 ns1.internal A
drill -p 53053 @127.0.0.1 -x 192.168.1.2
```

If direct queries work but client queries fail, check the Unbound forwarding configuration first.

如果直接查詢有效，但用戶端查詢失敗，請先檢查未綁定轉送配置。

##### [Log and diagnostics](#p-048)｜[日誌與診斷](#p-048)

If queries do not return the expected result, check:

如果查詢未傳回預期結果，請檢查：

-   service status  
    服務狀態
    
-   listen port  
    監聽埠
    
-   Unbound forwarding entries  
    未綁定轉送項
    
-   firewall rules  
    防火牆規則
    
-   zone existence  
    區域存在
    
-   expected records  
    預期記錄
    
-   relative record names  
    相關記錄名稱
    
-   trailing dots in record values where required  
    如果需要，請記錄值中的尾隨點
    

Attention

注意力

A query for `host.internal` only reaches the local zone when Unbound has a forwarding entry for `internal`.

只有當 Unbound 具有 `internal` 的轉發表項時，`host.internal` 的查詢才會到達本地區域。

Without forwarding, Unbound tries to resolve the name normally and does not automatically know about the locally hosted zone.

如果沒有轉發，Unbound 會嘗試正常解析名稱，並且不會自動了解本機託管區域。

As part of the OPNsense Business Edition, Deciso offers a plugin to easily protect webservices against all sort of injection attacks and provides encryption for traffic to and from the outside world.

作為 OPNsense 商業版的一部分，Deciso 提供了一個插件，可以輕鬆保護 Web 服務免受各種注入攻擊，並為進出外部世界的流量提供加密。

Our Web Application Firewall plugin offers some functionality which can also be found in community plugins available, but in a more user friendly manner. It combines the features most commonly used in [reverse proxies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reverse_proxy), such as TLS offloading and load balancing.

我們的 Web 應用程式防火牆插件提供了一些功能，這些功能也可以在可用的社群插件中找到，但以更用戶友好的方式提供。它結合了[反向代理](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reverse_proxy)中最常用的功能，例如TLS卸載和負載平衡。

To ease maintenance the `OPNWAF` plugin offers usage of both internal certificates or newly generated using the ACME protocol via [Let’s Encrypt](https://letsencrypt.org/) with a single click.

為了簡化維護，`OPNWAF`插件提供內部證書的使用或透過[Let’s Encrypt](https://letsencrypt.org/)使用ACME協議新產生的證書，只需單擊即可。

#### [Prerequisites](#p-049)｜[前提條件](#p-049)

Before using this plugin in combination with Let’s Encrypt, make sure port 443 isn’t being used for the web gui of this firewall (System->Settings->Administration).

在將此插件與 Let’s Encrypt 結合使用之前，請確保連接埠 443 未用於此防火牆的 Web GUI（系統 -> 設定 -> 管理）。

Note

注意事項

When using Let’s Encrypt, The Web Application Firewall uses the tls-alpn-01 challenge type for easy domain verification, this requires the virtual server to listen on port 443. Make sure the firewall allows incoming HTTPS connections on port 443. If the client connects via a custom port, you can forward these requests to port 443, and configure the virtual server to forward these requests to the correct internal port.

使用 Let’s Encrypt 時，Web 應用程式防火牆使用 tls-alpn-01 質詢類型來輕鬆進行網域驗證，這要求虛擬伺服器偵聽連接埠 443。確保防火牆允許連接埠 443 上的傳入 HTTPS 連線。如果用戶端透過自訂連接埠連接，您可以將這些請求轉送至連接埠 443，並設定虛擬伺服器將這些請求轉送至正確的內部連接埠。

#### [Installation](#p-049)｜[安裝](#p-049)

To install this plugin, go to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins and search for **os-OPNWAF**, the \[+\] button downloads and installs the software.

要安裝此插件，請前往系統 ‣ 韌體 ‣ 插件並搜尋 **os-OPNWAF**，\[+\] 按鈕下載並安裝軟體。

Next go to Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Settings to enable it.

接下來前往 Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Settings 來啟用它。

#### [General](#p-049)｜[一般](#p-049)

Before deep diving into the settings pages, we will explain the most important terminology used in this module.

在深入研究設定頁面之前，我們將解釋本模組中使用的最重要的術語。

##### [Virtual servers](#p-049)｜[虛擬伺服器](#p-049)

A virtual server (also known as a virtual host) is a a concept which allows the use of multiple domains on a single webserver using the same port. In our case it offers the possibility to host various webservers inside your network and forward traffic to them in a secure fashion.

虛擬伺服器（也稱為虛擬主機）是一個允許使用相同連接埠在單一網路伺服器上使用多個網域的概念。在我們的例子中，它提供了在網路內託管各種網站伺服器並以安全的方式將流量轉發給它們的可能性。

##### [Locations](#p-049)｜[地點](#p-049)

Locations reside in virtual servers and describe on a path level how requests are being handled, if for example one would like to forward only a subdirectory (like `/api`) to a server in the network, the location is where to configure this.

位置駐留在虛擬伺服器中，並在路徑層級描述如何處理請求，例如，如果只想將子目錄（如`/api`）轉送到網路中的伺服器，則位置是配置它的位置。

##### [Web protection](#p-049)｜[網頁保護](#p-049)

The web protection options offer easy access to the [OWASP ModSecurity ruleset](https://owasp.org/www-project-modsecurity-core-rule-set/) , which offers a set of generic attack detection rules against a wide range attacks including the [OWASP Top Ten](https://owasp.org/www-project-top-ten/).

Web 保護選項可以輕鬆存取 [OWASP ModSecurity 規則集](https://owasp.org/www-project-modsecurity-core-rule-set/)，它提供了一組針對廣泛攻擊的通用攻擊偵測規則，包括 [OWASP 十大](https://owasp.org/www-project-top-ten/)。

#### [Setup](#p-049)｜[設定](#p-049)

Before configuring virtual servers, let’s take a look at the general settings pages (Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Settings). After installation, the module itself should be enabled by default.

在設定虛擬伺服器之前，我們先來看看常規設定頁面（防火牆 ‣ Web 應用程式 ‣ 設定）。安裝後，模組本身應預設為啟用。

In order to use the integrated ACME client (for Let’s Encrypt), the ACME enable checkbox needs to be set, the certificate agreement needs to be accepted (next checkbox) and contact email needs to be specified.

為了使用整合的ACME客戶端（用於Let’s Encrypt），需要設定ACME啟用複選框，需要接受憑證協定（下一個複選框）並需要指定聯絡電子郵件。

Optionally a permanent redirect from HTTP to HTTPS can be enabled for all virtual servers. The HTTP port can be customized if necessary by enabling the advanced mode. Do not forget to create an additional firewall rule to allow access to the HTTP Port. When it is non standard, a port forward is necessary (e.g., listen on 8080, forward 80 to 8080).

（可選）可以為所有虛擬伺服器啟用從 HTTP 到 HTTPS 的永久重定向。如有必要，可以透過啟用進階模式來自訂HTTP連接埠。不要忘記建立額外的防火牆規則以允許存取 HTTP 連接埠。當它是非標準時，需要連接埠轉送（例如，偵聽 8080，將 80 轉送到 8080）。

[![../../_images/OPNWAF_settings.png](<../images/5867ae21-OPNWAF_settings.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNWAF_settings.png)

Web protection is not enabled by default, but you can enable it in the Web protection tab. This is also the place to configure the module and settings which apply for all virtual hosts.

預設未啟用 Web 保護，但您可以在「Web 保護」標籤中啟用它。這也是配置適用於所有虛擬主機的模組和設定的地方。

To optionally configure a default catch-all virtual server, select a certificate for Strict SNI Check in Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Settings. The certificate can be self-signed and match the CN of the the default server name. Any invalid SNI will now be served an error document. If a wildcard A-Record is defined for a base domain (e.g., `*.example.com in A 203.0.113.1`), each subdomain would be answered by the first configured virtual server otherwise, even if the SNI does not match it.

若要選擇配置預設的包羅萬象的虛擬伺服器，請在防火牆 ‣ Web 應用程式 ‣ 設定中選擇嚴格SNI 檢查的憑證。此憑證可以是自簽章的並與預設伺服器名稱的CN相符。現在將向任何無效的SNI提供錯誤文檔。如果為基域定義了通配符 A 記錄（例如，`*.example.com in A 203.0.113.1`），則每個子域都將由第一個配置的虛擬伺服器應答，即使SNI 與其不符。

##### [Web Protection](#p-049)｜[網頁保護](#p-049)

It is recommended to enable the web protection, but not change the default values of individual options without reason. The defaults are tuned for high security while also maintaining good performance and compatibility.

建議啟用網頁保護，但不要無故更改個別選項的預設值。預設值經過調整以實現高安全性，同時保持良好的效能和相容性。

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Enable<br>啟用 | Enable content protection to prevent against different types of (injection) attacks<br>啟用內容保護以防止不同類型的（注入）攻擊 |
| Paranoia Level<br>偏執程度 | A paranoia level of 1 is default. In this level, most core rules are enabled. PL1 is advised for beginners, installations covering many different sites and applications, and for setups with standard security requirements. A higher level will increase sensitivity at the cost of more false positives.<br>預設偏執等級為 1。在此層級中，啟用了大多數核心規則。建議初學者、覆蓋許多不同網站和應用程式的安裝以及具有標準安全要求的設定使用PL1。較高的水平會提高靈敏度，但會出現更多的誤報。 |
| Allowed HTTP Verbs<br>允許的 HTTP 動詞 | Leave empty to use the default HTTP Verbs. Choosing one or more items here will overwrite the default globally. If there are WebDAV servers, adjusting these Verbs can be mandatory with methods like PROPPATCH or PROPFIND.<br>留空以使用預設的 HTTP 動詞。此處選擇一項或多項將覆寫全域預設值。如果有 WebDAV 伺服器，則可以使用 PROPPATCH 或 PROPFIND 等方法強制調整這些動詞。 |
| Request Body Limit Action<br>請求身體限制行動 | What to do if the request body size is above the configured limit. The default is Reject. Keep in mind that this setting will automatically be set to ProcessPartial when using DetectionOnly mode.<br>如果請求正文大小超出配置的限制該怎麼辦。預設為拒絕。請記住，使用DetectionOnly 模式時，此設定將自動設定為ProcessPartial。 |
| Request Body Limit<br>請求正文限制 | Maximum request body size in bytes we will accept for buffering. If you support file uploads then the value given has to be as large as the largest file you are willing to accept. The hard limit is 1GB.<br>我們接受緩衝的最大請求正文大小（以位元組為單位）。如果您支援文件上傳，則給定的值必須與您願意接受的最大文件一樣大。硬限制為 1GB。 |
| Request Body No Files Limit<br>請求正文無檔案限制 | Maximum request body size in bytes we will accept for buffering with files excluded. You want to keep this value as low as practical. The hard limit is 1GB.<br>我們可接受的緩衝（排除檔案）的最大請求正文大小（以位元組為單位）。您希望將該值保持在盡可能低的水平。硬限制為 1GB。 |
| Request Body In Memory Limit | Store the request body data in memory. When the multipartparser reaches this limit, it will start using your hard disk for storage. That is slow, but unavoidable. The hard limit is 1GB. |

|記憶體限制中的請求正文將請求主體資料儲存在記憶體中。當 multipartparser 達到此限制時，它將開始使用您的硬碟進行儲存。這是緩慢的，但卻是不可避免的。硬限制為 1GB。 |
| Response Body Limit Action<br>回應身體極限行動 | What happens when we encounter a response body larger than the configured limit? By default, we process what we have and let the rest through with the Process Partial option. That is somewhat less secure, but does not break any legitimate pages.<br>當我們遇到大於配置限制的回應正文時會發生什麼？預設情況下，我們會處理現有的內容，並使用「處理部分」選項讓其餘部分完成。這有點不太安全，但不會破壞任何合法頁面。 |
| Response Body Limit<br>響應身體限制 | Maximum response body size (in bytes) we will accept for buffering. The hard limit is 1GB.<br>我們接受緩衝的最大響應主體大小（以位元組為單位）。硬限制為 1GB。 |
| Regex Match Limit<br>正規表示式比對限制 | Maximum regex matching length in security rules. If set too high, could cause performance issues or DoS.<br>安全性規則中的最大正規表示式符合長度。如果設定得太高，可能會導致效能問題或 DoS。 |
| Regex Match Limit Recursion<br>正規表示式比對限制遞歸 | Maximum regex recursion matching length in security rules. If set too high, could cause performance issues or DoS.<br>安全規則中的最大正規表示式遞迴符合長度。如果設定得太高，可能會導致效能問題或 DoS。 |

##### [Configure virtual servers](#p-049)｜[設定虛擬伺服器](#p-049)

With the general settings in place, we can start adding virtual servers to offload traffic to machines in our network. First go to Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Virtual Servers and click on the \[+\] in the top section of the screen, which defines the virtual servers.

常規設定就位後，我們可以開始新增虛擬伺服器以將流量卸載到網路中的電腦。首先前往 Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Virtual Servers 並點擊螢幕頂部的 \[+\]，它定義了虛擬伺服器。

| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | Enable this virtual server.<br>啟用此虛擬伺服器。 |
| LogLevel<br>日誌等級 | (advanced mode) Log verbosity level<br>（進階模式）日誌詳細等級 |
| ServerName<br>伺服器名稱 | Fully qualified hostname for this server.<br>該伺服器的完全限定主機名稱。 |
| Port<br>港口 | Port number this vhost will listen on, can easily be combined with firewall nat rules to map traffic to non standard ports when origination from remote destinations. (e.g., listen on 8443, forward 443 to 8443).<br>此虛擬主機將偵聽的連接埠號，可輕鬆地與防火牆 nat 規則結合使用，以在源自遠端目標時將流量對應至非標準連接埠。 （例如，收聽 8443，將 443 轉送到 8443）。 |
| Error Document<br>錯誤文檔 | Choose error documents to use for common issues, like page not found.<br>選擇用於常見問題的錯誤文檔，例如找不到頁面。 |
| Description<br>描述 | User friendly description for this vhost (optional).<br>該虛擬主機的使用者友好描述（可選）。 |
| **Trust**<br>**信任** |  |
| Enable ACME<br>啟用ACME | Enable the ACME protocol to automatically provision certificates using Let’s Encrypt, when set will ignore the selected certificate (and enable SSL on this virtual server).<br>啟用 ACME 協定以使用 Let’s Encrypt 自動提供證書，設定後將忽略所選證書（並在此虛擬伺服器上啟用 SSL）。 |
| Certificate<br>憑證 | When using a certificate available in the system trust store, select it here.<br>當使用系統信任儲存中可用的憑證時，請在此處選擇它。 |
| SSL Proxy check peer<br>SSL 代理檢查對等點 | This directive configures host name checking for server certificates when mod\_ssl is acting as an SSL client. The check will succeed if the host name from the request URI matches one of the CN attribute(s) of the certificate’s subject, or matches the subjectAltName extension. If the check fails, the SSL request is aborted and a 502 status code (Bad Gateway) is returned.<br>當 mod\_ssl 充當 SSL 用戶端時，此指令配置伺服器憑證的主機名稱檢查。如果請求 URI 中的主機名稱與憑證主題的 CN 屬性之一匹配，或與 subjectAltName 擴充功能匹配，則檢查將成功。如果檢查失敗，SSL請求將中止並傳回 502 狀態代碼（Bad Gateway）。 |
| **Client Auth**<br>**客戶端身份驗證** |  |
| CA for client auth<br>CA 用於用戶端驗證 | Require a client certificate signed by the provided authority before allowing a connection.<br>在允許連線之前，需要由所提供的機構簽署的用戶端憑證。 |
| CRL for client auth<br>CRL 用於用戶端驗證 | Attach the (first) found certificate revocation list for the selected CA to this virtual host. Please note when no CRL is offered all clients are rejected.<br>將所選CA的（第一個）找到的憑證撤銷清單附加到該虛擬主機。請注意，如果沒有提供CRL，所有客戶都會被拒絕。 |
| Verify depth for client auth<br>驗證客戶端身份驗證的深度 | The depth actually is the maximum number of intermediate certificate issuers, i.e. the number of CA certificates which are max allowed to be followed while verifying the client certificate.<br>深度實際上是中間證書頒發者的最大數量，即驗證客戶端證書時最大允許遵循的CA證書的數量。 |
| **OpenID Connect**<br>**OpenID 連線** |  |

Leave empty to use the provided default.<br>此 OpenID Connect 用戶端的重定向\_uri；這是一種虛榮心 URL 那必須 ONLY 指向伺服器上受此模組保護的路徑，但它必須 NOT 指向需要提供的任何實際內容。留空以使用提供的預設值。 |

| **Security**<br>**安全** |  |
| Header Security<br>標頭安全 | Header security, by default several privacy and security related headers are set, in some cases (old applications for example) you might want to disable sending default headers to clients. HSTS can be disabled here if necessary.<br>標頭安全性，預設設定了幾個與隱私和安全相關的標頭，在某些情況下（例如舊應用程式）您可能想要停用向客戶端發送預設標頭。如有必要，可在此處停用HSTS。 |
| TLS Security profile<br>TLS 安全性簡介 | TLS security profile as documented by [Mozilla](https://wiki.mozilla.org/Security/Server_Side_TLS)<br>[Mozilla](https://wiki.mozilla.org/Security/Server_Side_TLS) 記錄的TLS 安全設定檔 |
| Disable Security Rules by ID<br>透過ID停用安全規則 | Select one or multiple Web Protection rules to disable via their IDs. This can help to selectively disable rules that cause false positives, without disabling the Web Protection completely.<br>選擇一個或多個要透過其 ID 停用的 Web 保護規則。這有助於選擇性地停用導致誤報的規則，而無需完全停用 Web 保護。 |
| Web Protection<br>網路保護 | When Web Protection is enabled for the host you may disable it for specific destinations here, or set it to detection only for logging purposes.<br>當為主機啟用 Web 保護時，您可以在此處針對特定目標停用它，或將其設定為僅出於日誌記錄目的進行偵測。 |

The section above defines the port the virtual server will listen on. Remember, in order to use ACME (Let’s encrypt) this should either be 443 or the traffic should be forwarded from port 443 to the port defined here.

上面的部分定義了虛擬伺服器將偵聽的連接埠。請記住，為了使用ACME（讓我們加密），這應該是 443，或者流量應從連接埠 443 轉送到此處定義的連接埠。

Note

注意事項

Port numbers can be reused. Multiple virtual servers can share the same port. Hostnames must be unique. They are used to identify the virtual server via SNI (Server Name Indication).

連接埠號碼可以重複使用。多個虛擬伺服器可以共用相同連接埠。主機名稱必須是唯一的。它們用於透過SNI（伺服器名稱指示）來識別虛擬伺服器。

Warning

警告

The ALPN protocol (the challenge type used by Let’s Encrypt) will resolve the FQDNs specified in the virtual host entry to the IP address of the firewall. If your DNS records point to both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, IPv6 will be preferred by the challenge, so make sure your firewall is reachable via IPv6 as well if this is the case.

ALPN 協定（Let’s Encrypt 使用的質詢類型）會將虛擬主機條目中指定的 FQDN 解析為防火牆的 IP 位址。如果您的 DNS 記錄同時指向 IPv4 和 IPv6 位址，則挑戰將首選 IPv6，因此如果是這種情況，請確保您的防火牆也可透過 IPv6 存取。

When supplying a certificate manually via the system trust store you can assign it in this dialog as well.

透過系統信任儲存手動提供憑證時，您也可以在此對話方塊中指派它。

##### [Configure locations](#p-049)｜[配置位置](#p-049)

The virtual server itself doesn’t provide much content to the user other than offering a page telling access is prohibited, so the next step is to map directories to external locations. These can be defined in the Locations grid underneath the Virtual servers.

除了提供禁止存取的頁面之外，虛擬伺服器本身不會向使用者提供太多內容，因此下一步是將目錄對應到外部位置。這些可以在虛擬伺服器下方的位置網格中定義。

There are different types of locations:

有不同類型的位置：

1.  Proxy Pass, which Reverse Proxies the HTTP traffic  
    代理通行證，反向代理HTTP流量
    
2.  Proxy Pass Match, which Reverse Proxies the HTTP traffic but has regex support  
    代理傳遞匹配，反向代理 HTTP 流量，但具有正規表示式支援
    
3.  Redirect, which creates a HTTP redirect  
    重定向，建立 HTTP 重定向
    
4.  Redirect Match, which creates a HTTP redirect but has regex support  
    重定向匹配，建立 HTTP 重定向，但具有正規表示式支持
    
5.  Exchange Server, a template for Microsoft Exchange servers  
    Exchange Server，Microsoft Exchange 伺服器的模板
    

###### [Proxy Pass](#p-049)｜[代理通行證](#p-049)

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | Enable this location<br>啟用此位置 |
| VirtualServer<br>虛擬伺服器 | The server this location belongs to<br>該位置所屬的伺服器 |
| Local path<br>本機路徑 | Local path of the HTTP request to match (e.g. `/` for all paths). You can also create multiple location entries, each with their own specific path (e.g. `/docs`). They will be processed in the order of their creation.<br>HTTP 請求符合的本機路徑（例如，`/` 適用於所有路徑）。您也可以建立多個位置條目，每個條目都有自己的特定路徑（例如`/docs`）。它們將按照創建的順序進行處理。 |
| Type<br>類型 | ProxyPass<br>代理通行證 |
| Remote destinations<br>遠端目的地 | Locations to forward requests to, when more than one is provided, requests will be loadbalanced in a round robin fashion. Supports `http`, `https`, `ws` `wss`, `h2` and `h2c` destinations. When your webapp uses websockets and https requests, use `wss://`<br>將請求轉送到的位置，當提供多個位置時，請求將以循環方式進行負載平衡。支援`http`, `https`, `ws` `wss`, `h2`和`h2c`目的地。當您的 web 應用程式使用 websockets 和 https 請求時，請使用 `wss://` |
| Access control<br>存取控制 | List of networks allowed to access this path (empty means any)<br>允許存取此路徑的網路清單（空表示任意） |
| Overlay error pages<br>覆寫錯誤頁面 | Overlay common error pages with the ones specified in the virtual server.<br>將常見錯誤頁面與虛擬伺服器中指定的頁面重疊。 |
| Description<br>描述 | User friendly description for this location<br>此位置的用戶友好描述 |
| **Proxy Options**<br>**代理選項** |  |
| OIDC Auth Required<br>OIDC 需要授權 | Require OpenID Connect authentication for this location if a provider has been selected in the virtual server.<br>如果已在虛擬伺服器中選擇了供應商，則需要對此位置進行 OpenID Connect 驗證。 |
| OIDC Claims<br>OIDC 索賠 | Select claims that must match for authorization. Multiple claims will be evaluated via OR operator. The default “valid-user” will allow access for any authenticated user in your OIDC scope.<br>選擇必須符合授權的聲明。多項索賠將透過OR操作員進行評估。預設的「有效用戶」將允許 OIDC 範圍內的任何經過身份驗證的用戶進行存取。 |
| **Proxy Options**<br>**代理選項** |  |
| TLS header passthrough<br>TLS 標頭直通 | Select which headers to passthrough to the client, all headers will be prefixed with X- to distinct them more easily from the applications perspective. The original headers use underscores (\_) these will be replaced for minus (-) signs to prevent applications dropping them.<br>選擇要傳遞到客戶端的標頭，所有標頭都將以 X- 為前綴，以便從應用程式的角度更輕鬆地區分它們。原始標頭使用下劃線 (\_)，這些標頭將被減號 (-) 替換，以防止應用程式丟棄它們。 |
| Request Headers<br>請求標頭 | Select how headers should be processed in the request from this location to the destination<br>選擇從該位置到目標的請求中應如何處理標頭 |
| Preserve Host<br>保留主機 | When enabled, this option will pass the Host: line from the incoming request to the proxied host, instead of the hostname specified in the location. This option should normally be turned Off. It is mostly useful in special configurations like proxied mass name-based virtual hosting, where the original Host header needs to be evaluated by the backend server.<br>啟用後，此選項會將 Host: 行從傳入請求傳遞到代理主機，而不是在位置中指定的主機名稱。通常應關閉此選項。它在特殊配置中最有用，例如基於代理品質名稱的虛擬主機，其中原始主機標頭需要由後端伺服器進行評估。 |
| Connection timeout<br>連線逾時 | Connect timeout in seconds. The number of seconds the server waits for the creation of a connection to the backend to complete.<br>連線逾時（以秒為單位）。伺服器等待與後端的連線建立完成的秒數。 |
| timeout<br>超時 | Socket timeout in seconds. The number of seconds the server waits for data sent by / to the backend.<br>套接字逾時（以秒為單位）。伺服器等待 / 發送到後端的資料的秒數。 |
| Response field size<br>回應欄位大小 | Adjust the size of the proxy response field buffer. The buffer size should be at least the size of the largest expected header size from a proxied response.<br>調整代理回應欄位緩衝區的大小。緩衝區大小應至少是代理回應中最大預期標頭大小的大小。 |
| nocanon<br>諾卡農 | Normally, mod\_proxy will canonicalise ProxyPassed URLs. But this may be incompatible with some backends, particularly those that make use of PATH\_INFO. The optional nocanon keyword suppresses this and passes the URL path raw to the backend. Note that this keyword may affect the security of your backend, as it removes the normal limited protection against URL-based attacks provided by the proxy.<br>通常，mod\_proxy 會將 ProxyPassed URL 規範化。但這可能與某些後端不相容，特別是那些使用PATH\_INFO 的後端。可選的 nocanon 關鍵字可以抑制這種情況，並將 URL 路徑原始傳遞到後端。請注意，此關鍵字可能會影響後端的安全性，因為它消除了代理提供的針對基於URL的攻擊的正常有限保護。 |

The options here are quite simple, first you define a path on your end (`/` in our example), next you define one or more destinations this path should map to (for example you could point to a public server here, like [https://opnsense.org](https://opnsense.org/)).

這裡的選項非常簡單，首先您定義一條路徑（在我們的範例中為`/`），接下來您定義該路徑應映射到的一個或多個目的地（例如您可以指向此處的公共伺服器，如[https://opnsense.org](https://opnsense.org/)）。

Note

注意事項

When more than one destination is provided, the load will be balanced automatically.

當提供多個目的地時，負載將自動平衡。

Tip

提示

Constraining access to allow only specific networks or hosts can be arranged using the `Access control` input.

可以使用 `Access control` 輸入來限制存取以僅允許特定網路或主機。

###### [Proxy Pass Match](#p-049)｜[代理通行證匹配](#p-049)

The Proxy Pass Match type is the advanced alternative to Proxy Pass.

代理傳遞匹配類型是代理傳遞的高級替代方案。

Choosing it will turn the Local path field into Location Match, and the new Remote path field into Proxy Pass Match.

選擇它將本機路徑欄位轉變為位置匹配，並將新的遠端路徑欄位轉變為代理通道匹配。

These types allow you to match requests based on a regular expression pattern instead of just a literal path.

這些類型可讓您根據正規表示式模式（而不僅僅是文字路徑）來匹配請求。

The match is entered into Local path and the substitution groups can be set in Remote path.

匹配被輸入到本機路徑中，並且可以在遠端路徑中設定替換組。

Here is an example how this can look like:

下面是一個範例：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Local path<br>本地路徑 | `^/manual/(.*)$` |
| Remote path<br>遠端路徑 | `/$1` |

Tip

提示

-   `^`: Match start of the URL path  
    `^`：匹配URL路徑的開始
    
-   `/manual/`: Match the literal string /manual/  
    `/manual/`：匹配文字字串/manual/
    
-   `(.*)`: Capture any characters (zero or more) after /manual/ — this is group 1  
    `(.*)`：捕捉 /manual/ 之後的任何字元（零個或多個）－這是群組 1
    
-   `$`: Match end of the string  
    `$`：匹配字串末尾
    
-   `$1`: Reference the captured group from the local path. In this example it strips /manual/ from the URL path internally.  
    `$1`：從本地路徑引用捕獲的群組。在此範例中，它在內部從 URL 路徑中剝離 /manual/。
    

Attention

注意

This is an advanced feature for edge cases like stripping paths from requests to form a new base path, or anchoring a path precisely. It can also be used to prevent trailing slashes being attached which break some URL parameter schemes. In most cases using the plain Proxy Pass will give you the desired result automatically.

這是針對邊緣情況的高級功能，例如從請求中剝離路徑以形成新的基本路徑，或精確錨定路徑。它還可用於防止附加尾部斜杠，這會破壞某些 URL 參數方案。在大多數情況下，使用普通的代理通行證將自動為您提供所需的結果。

###### [Redirect](#p-049)｜[重定向](#p-049)

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | Enable this location<br>啟用此位置 |
| VirtualServer<br>虛擬伺服器 | The server this location belongs to<br>該位置所屬的伺服器 |
| Local path<br>本機路徑 | Local path of the HTTP request to match (e.g. `/` for all paths). You can also create multiple location entries, each with their own specific path (e.g. `/docs`). They will be processed in the order of their creation.<br>HTTP 請求符合的本機路徑（例如，`/` 適用於所有路徑）。您也可以建立多個位置條目，每個條目都有自己的特定路徑（例如`/docs`）。它們將按照創建的順序進行處理。 |
| Type<br>類型 | Redirect<br>重定向 |
| HTTP redirection message<br>HTTP 重定向訊息 | Choose the HTTP redirection message. The default is 307, but others like 301 and 308 are also available.<br>選擇HTTP重定向訊息。預設值為 307，但也可以使用 301 和 308 等其他連接埠。 |
| Remote destinations<br>遠端目的地 | Locations to redirect requests to, only one is allowed per location per redirect<br>將請求重定向到的位置，每個重定向每個位置僅允許一個 |
| Access control<br>存取控制 | List of networks allowed to access this path (empty means any)<br>允許存取此路徑的網路清單（空表示任意） |
| Description<br>描述 | User friendly description for this location<br>此位置的用戶友好描述 |

When setting up a redirect, it will also match HTTP if Redirect HTTP to HTTPS in General Settings has been enabled. If not, only HTTPS is matched.

設定重定向時，如果在常規設定中啟用了重定向 HTTP 到 HTTPS，它也會匹配 HTTP。如果沒有，則僅符合HTTPS。

Note

注意事項

When a `/` location with a Redirect has been created, there can’t be any additional ProxyPass locations that match the same `/` location, nor a more specific `/docs` location. The redirect will match first, since it will catch and redirect all traffic of the virtual server location. What is possible though, is that there is a `/docs` location that redirects, and an additional `/html` location that proxies traffic, in the scope of the same virtual server.

建立具有重定向的 `/` 位置後，不能有任何其他 ProxyPass 位置與相同的 `/` 位置匹配，也不能有更具體的 `/docs` 位置。重定向將首先匹配，因為它將捕獲並重定向虛擬伺服器位置的所有流量。但可能的是，在同一台虛擬伺服器的範圍內，有一個用於重定向的 `/docs` 位置，以及一個用於代理流量的附加 `/html` 位置。

###### [Redirect Match](#p-049)｜[重定向匹配](#p-049)

The Redirect Match type is the advanced alternative to Redirect.

重定向匹配類型是重定向的高級替代類型。

Choosing it will turn the Local path field into Location Match, and the Remote destinations field into Redirect Match.

選擇它將本機路徑欄位轉變為位置匹配，將遠端目標欄位轉變為重定向匹配。

Wrapping Redirect into a Location behaves slightly differently than doing the same with Proxy Pass, as regular expression groups cannot be passed into the location.

將重定向包裝到某個位置的行為與使用代理傳遞執行的操作略有不同，因為正規表示式群組無法傳遞到該位置。

The intended way is using environment variables. See [mod\_alias](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/current/mod/mod_alias.html) for more information.

預期的方法是使用環境變數。請參閱 [mod\_alias](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/current/mod/mod_alias.html) 以了解更多資訊。

Here is an example how this can look like:

下面是一個範例：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Local path<br>本地路徑 | `/error/(?<NUMBER>[0-9]+)` |
| Remote destinations<br>遠程目的地 | `http://example.com/errors/%{env:MATCH_NUMBER}.html` |

Tip

提示

When using the normal Redirect, a common trap is redirects that are infinite due to the apache trailing slash issue. This can be solved via Redirect Match by setting Local path as `^/?$` which force a match from the start of the first found slash.

使用普通重定向時，一個常見的陷阱是由於 apache 尾部斜杠問題而導致無限重定向。這可以透過重定向匹配來解決，方法是將本地路徑設定為`^/?$`，強制從第一個找到的斜杠的開頭進行匹配。

Attention

注意

In most cases using the plain Redirect will give you the desired result automatically.

在大多數情況下，使用普通重定向將自動為您提供所需的結果。

###### [Exchange Server](#p-049)｜[交換伺服器](#p-049)

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | Enable this location<br>啟用此位置 |
| VirtualServer<br>虛擬伺服器 | The server this location belongs to<br>該位置所屬的伺服器 |
| Type<br>類型 | Exchange Server<br>交換伺服器 |
| Remote destinations<br>遠端目的地 | Locations to redirect requests to, only one is allowed per location per redirect<br>將請求重定向到的位置，每個重定向每個位置僅允許一個 |
| Restrict Exchange Paths<br>限制交換路徑 | Restrict Exchange Server specific paths to networks provided in the Access control field. If paths are selected, exactly these paths will have the Access control attached. Access to path / is filtered per default with a redirect to /owa. All non-selected paths will be allowed from all networks.<br>限制存取控製欄位中提供的網路的 Exchange Server 特定路徑。如果選擇路徑，則這些路徑將附加存取控制。預設情況下，透過重定向到 /owa 來過濾對路徑 / 的存取。所有網路都將允許所有未選擇的路徑。 |
| Access control<br>存取控制 | Constrain access to networks provided in this list, when not provided no constraints apply. When type is Exchange Server, it will restrict access to paths selected in Restrict Exchange Paths.<br>限制對此清單中提供的網路的訪問，如果未提供，則不適用任何限制。當類型為 Exchange Server 時，它將限制對「限制 Exchange 路徑」中選擇的路徑的存取。 |
| Description<br>描述 | User friendly description for this location<br>此位置的用戶友好描述 |

**[Prerequisites](#p-049)｜[前提條件](#p-049)**

To successfully reverse proxy an Exchange Server, a few conditions must be met:

要成功反向代理程式 Exchange Server，必須滿足一些條件：

-   The communication between Apache and the Exchange Server must happen via HTTPS.  
    Apache 和 Exchange Server 之間的通訊必須透過 HTTPS 進行。
    
-   The Exchange Server must have its internal and external URLs set correctly, preferably to the same hostnames that will be set as virtual servers.  
    Exchange Server 必須正確設定其內部和外部 URL，最好設定為將設定為虛擬伺服器的相同主機名稱。
    

Common hostname/path combinations are:

常見的主機名稱/路徑組合有：

| VirtualDirectory<br>虛擬目錄 | Internal and external URL of Exchange Server<br>Exchange Server 的內部與外部URL |
| --- | --- |
| OwaVirtualDirectory<br>Owa 虛擬目錄 | `mail.example.com/owa` |
| EcpVirtualDirectory<br>Ecp 虛擬目錄 | `mail.example.com/ecp` |
| WebServicesVirtualDirectory<br>Web 服務虛擬目錄 | `mail.example.com/EWS/Exchange.asmx` |
| ActiveSyncVirtualDirectory<br>ActiveSync 虛擬目錄 | `mail.example.com/Microsoft-Server-ActiveSync` |
| OabVirtualDirectory<br>Oab 虛擬目錄 | `mail.example.com/OAB` |
| MapiVirtualDirectory<br>Mapi虛擬目錄 | `mail.example.com/mapi` |
| OutlookAnywhere | `mail.example.com/rpc` - ExternalClientAuthenticationMethod set to Negotiate<br>`mail.example.com/rpc` -ExternalClientAuthenticationMethod 設定為「協商」 |
| ClientAccessService<br>客戶存取服務 | `autodiscover.example.com/Autodiscover/Autodiscover.xml` |

When using a self-signed certificate, the authority for the certificate must be imported into System->Trust->Authorities. The certificate must include `mail.example.com` and `autodiscover.example.com` in its SAN. Without trust established between the OPNsense and the Exchange Server, the connection will fail since only encrypted connections are allowed to an Exchange Server.

使用自簽名憑證時，必須在「系統」->「信任」->「權限」中匯入該憑證的權限。證書的 SAN 中必須包含 `mail.example.com` 和 `autodiscover.example.com`。如果 OPNsense 和 Exchange Server 之間沒有建立信任，連線將會失敗，因為只允許與 Exchange Server 進行加密連線。

Attention

注意

Exchange Servers use a feature called “Extended Protection”（擴充保護） which requires the same certificate to be used by the web application firewall and the Exchange Server itself.

Exchange Server 使用名為 “Extended Protection”（擴充保護） 的功能，該功能要求 Web 應用程式防火牆和 Exchange Server 本身使用相同的憑證。

Attention

注意

Outlook passthrough via either RCP/HTTP or MAPI/HTTP is getting more challenging due to the deprecation of the NTML protocol. If authentication popups happen, it can help to set the “Multi Processing Modules”（多處理模組） to “mpm-prefork”. Mitigating all authentication issues might not be possible anymore, since the required NTLM replacement protocol OAuth is only available for Exchange Online.

由於 NTML 協定的棄用，透過 RCP/HTTP 或 MAPI/HTTP 的 Outlook 直通變得更具挑戰性。如果出現身份驗證彈出窗口，將 “Multi Processing Modules”（多處理模組） 設定為「mpm-prefork」會有所幫助。緩解所有驗證問題可能不再可能，因為所需的 NTLM 替代協定 OAuth 僅適用於 Exchange Online。

**[Setup](#p-049)｜[設定](#p-049)**

Create two virtual servers with the hostnames of the Exchange Server, e.g., `autodiscover.example.com` and `mail.example.com`. Select Enable ACME or use your own certificate, set Header Security to `Off / compatibility mode`, set Web Protection to `Detection Only`. Adjust these later once the Exchange Server works correctly through the reverse proxy.

使用 Exchange Server 的主機名稱建立兩個虛擬伺服器，例如 `autodiscover.example.com` 和 `mail.example.com`。選擇啟用ACME或使用您自己的證書，將標頭安全設定為`Off / compatibility mode`，將Web保護設定為`Detection Only`。一旦 Exchange Server 透過反向代理程式正常運作，請稍後調整這些內容。

Create a Location with the Type `Exchange Server` for each of these virtual servers. As Remote destinations use the internal IP address of the Exchange Server, e.g., `https://192.168.10.10`. If the virtual servers use the same hostnames as the Exchange Server, trust is automatically established with host header passthrough.

為每個虛擬伺服器建立類型為 `Exchange Server` 的位置。由於遠端目標使用 Exchange Server 的內部 IP 位址，例如 `https://192.168.10.10`。如果虛擬伺服器使用與 Exchange Server 相同的主機名，則會透過主機標頭直通自動建立信任。

These new Locations will create all virtual directories the Exchange Server requires automatically. With the options Restrict Exchange Paths and Access control, access to specific paths can be restricted. This is recommended for the `/ecp` path.

這些新位置將自動建立 Exchange Server 所需的所有虛擬目錄。使用限制交換路徑和存取控制選項，可以限制對特定路徑的存取。建議用於 `/ecp` 路徑。

The finished configuration should look like this:

完成的配置應如下所示：

**Virtual Servers**

**虛擬伺服器**

**mail.example.com**

**Virtual Server**

**虛擬伺服器**

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | `X` |
| ServerName<br>伺服器名稱 | `mail.example.com` |
| **Trust**<br>**信任** |  |
| Enable ACME<br>啟用ACME | `X` |
| SSL Proxy check peer<br>SSL 代理檢查對等點 | `X` |
| **Security**<br>**安全** |  |
| Header Security<br>標頭安全 | Off / compatibility mode<br>關閉/相容模式 |
| TLS Security profile<br>TLS 安全簡介 | Intermediate<br>中級 |
| Web Protection<br>網路保護 | Detection Only<br>僅偵測 |

**Location**

**地點**

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | `X` |
| VirtualServer<br>虛擬伺服器 | `mail.example.com` |
| Type<br>類型 | Exchange Server<br>交換伺服器 |
| Remote destinations<br>遠端目的地 | `https://192.168.10.10` |
| Restrict Exchange Paths<br>限制交換路徑 | `/ecp` |
| Access control<br>存取控制 | `192.168.0.0/16 172.16.0.0/12 10.0.0.0/8` |

**autodiscover.example.com**

**Virtual Server**

**虛擬伺服器**

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | `X` |
| ServerName<br>伺服器名稱 | `autodiscover.example.com` |
| **Trust**<br>**信任** |  |
| Enable ACME<br>啟用ACME | `X` |
| SSL Proxy check peer<br>SSL 代理檢查對等點 | `X` |
| **Security**<br>**安全** |  |
| Header Security<br>標頭安全 | Off / compatibility mode<br>關閉/相容模式 |
| TLS Security profile<br>TLS 安全簡介 | Intermediate<br>中級 |
| Web Protection<br>網路保護 | Detection Only<br>僅偵測 |

**Location**

**地點**

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | `X` |
| VirtualServer<br>虛擬伺服器 | `autodiscover.example.com` |
| Type<br>類型 | Exchange Server<br>交換伺服器 |
| Remote destinations<br>遠端目的地 | `https://192.168.10.10` |
| Restrict Exchange Paths<br>限制交換路徑 | `/ecp` |
| Access control<br>存取控制 | `192.168.0.0/16 172.16.0.0/12 10.0.0.0/8` |

Note

注意事項

In case an internal hostname is used in Remote destinations, ensure this name is in the SAN and common name of the self-signed certificate of the Exchange Server. This hostname must be resolvable from the OPNsense. Do not use the same hostname for Virtual servers and Remote destinations to avoid creating a reverse proxy loop.

如果在遠端目標中使用內部主機名，請確保名稱位於 Exchange Server 自簽章憑證的 SAN 和公用名稱中。此主機名稱必須可從 OPNsense 解析。不要對虛擬伺服器和遠端目標使用相同的主機名，以避免建立反向代理循環。

##### [Test web protection](#p-049)｜[測試網頁防護](#p-049)

When web protection was enabled, we always advise to test if it’s actually functional. Luckily this is quite easy to test using a webbrowser. For this example we will try to inject some sql code in the url, which should be blocked when properly configured:

啟用網路保護後，我們始終建議測試它是否真正起作用。幸運的是，使用網頁瀏覽器進行測試非常容易。對於這個例子，我們將嘗試在 url 中註入一些 sql 程式碼，正確配置後應該會阻止這些程式碼：

`https://your.example.domain/?id=100 or 'x'='y'`

This should show a page similar to the one below:

這應該會顯示類似於以下頁面的頁面：

[![../../_images/OPNWAF_forbidden.png](<../images/cab04b47-OPNWAF_forbidden.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNWAF_forbidden.png)

When deploying web protection for virtual servers, start with the Detection Only setting that can be set per virtual server. This way, you can evaluate the Web Security log file, and look for rules that match.

為虛擬伺服器部署 Web 保護時，請從可為每個虛擬伺服器設定的「僅偵測」設定開始。這樣，您可以評估網路安全日誌文件，並尋找符合的規則。

This will reveal if the web application might be outdated and needs patching, because several web protection rules match and would block connections.

這將揭示 Web 應用程式是否可能已過時並需要修補，因為多個 Web 保護規則匹配並會阻止連線。

If they are false positives, the rule IDs can be set as exemptions with the option Disable Security Rules by ID. Search the rules in the dropdown, and select multiple ones you want to exclude.

如果是誤報，則可以使用ID選項停用安全規則將規則 ID 設定為豁免。在下拉清單中搜尋規則，然後選擇要排除的多個規則。

After this configuration, set the Web Protection to On (default) to enable it. The web application should now be configured for production. If there are still errors, repeat the above steps.

完成此配置後，將 Web 保護設為開啟（預設）以啟用它。現在應該配置 Web 應用程式以用於生產。如果仍然有錯誤，請重複上述步驟。

Attention

注意

Do not exclude too many rules. These matches could be a potential misconfiguration of the web application behind the WAF. Only exclude rules that totally break the functionality of the web application.

不要排除太多規則。這些匹配可能是 WAF 背後的 Web 應用程式的潛在配置錯誤。僅排除完全破壞 Web 應用程式功能的規則。

##### [Secure WebDav and HTTP File Servers](#p-049)｜[安全 WebDav 與 HTTP 檔案伺服器](#p-049)

These servers have specific requirements to work through a WAF. They need an extended set of HTTP Verbs, and higher thresholds for the Request and Response Body.

這些伺服器有透過WAF工作的特定要求。他們需要一組擴展的 HTTP 動詞，以及更高的請求和回應正文閾值。

A popular example for a WebDAV Server is Nextcloud or Owncloud.

WebDAV 伺服器的一個流行範例是 Nextcloud 或 Owncloud。

Go to the Web Protection Settings, and set the Allowed HTTP Verbs to:

前往 Web 保護設置，並將允許的 HTTP 動詞設為：

COPY, DELETE, GET, HEAD, LOCK, MKCOL, MOVE, OPTIONS, POST, PROPFIND, PROPPATCH, PUT, TRACE, UNLOCK.

To allow large file uploads, set Request Body Limit Action to Process Partial. If you want to process as much content of the file as possible, enable the advanced mode and set custom values for the Request Body and Response Body limits.

若要允許大檔案上傳，請將請求正文限制操作設定為處理部分。如果要處理盡可能多的文件內容，請啟用進階模式並為請求正文和回應正文限制設定自訂值。

If the file is larger than the configured limits, it will only be processed partially. This means, the whole file will be uploaded, but only a portion of the file is analyzed by the web application parser. Rejecting can improve security, yet will make large files fail completely if they exceed the configured hard limits.

如果檔案大於配置的限制，則只會部分處理。這意味著，整個文件將被上傳，但 Web 應用程式解析器僅分析文件的一部分。拒絕可以提高安全性，但如果大檔案超出配置的硬限制，則會導致大檔案完全失敗。

Note

注意事項

Increasing the Body limits will increase the log file sizes, and will eventually use the disk of the OPNsense to write files upon inspection. For this, the Request Body in Memory Limit can be increased to 1GB to focus on RAM usage. If you want to use the least resources, logging and disk I/O, leave all settings on default, and set Request Body Limit Action to Process Partial.

增加 Body 限制會增加日誌檔案大小，最終會在檢查時使用 OPNsense 的磁碟來寫入檔案。為此，記憶體限制中的請求主體可以增加到 1GB，以專注於RAM的使用。如果您想使用最少的資源、日誌記錄和磁碟 I/O，請將所有設定保留為預設值，並將「請求正文限制操作」設為「處理部分」。

Tip

提示

If many different file extensions are hosted on the WebDAV server, some of these will be blocked by default rules. In that case, disable the rule: `920440 (URL file extension is restricted by policy)`

如果 WebDAV 伺服器上託管許多不同的檔案副檔名，則預設規則將阻止其中一些檔案副檔名。在這種情況下，禁用規則：`920440 (URL file extension is restricted by policy)`

##### [Request Headers](#p-049)｜[請求標頭](#p-049)

In some cases it is a requirement to manipulate request headers. The Request Header Directive can add, merge, change or remove HTTP request headers.

在某些情況下，需要操作請求標頭。請求標頭指令可以新增、合併、變更或刪除 HTTP 請求標頭。

In our example, we unset the `Accept-Encoding` header to potentially prevent BREACH attacks.

在我们的示例中，我们取消设置 `Accept-Encoding` 标头以潜在地防止 BREACH 攻击。

Go to Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Request Headers and create a new header:

前往 Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Request Headers 並建立一個新標頭：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Type<br>類型 | `Unset` |
| Header<br>標題 | `Accept-Encoding` |
| Value<br>價值 | (leave this empty)<br>（將此留空） |

Afterwards, go to an existing location in Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Virtual Servers and select it in (Proxy Options) Request Headers.

然後，前往 Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Virtual Servers 中的現有位置，並在（代理選項）請求標頭中選擇它。

After applying the configuration, the header will be unset from all requests of this location to the Remote destinations.

套用配置後，該位置到遠端目標的所有請求的標頭都將被取消設定。

Tip

提示

More information about the available request header types can be found here: [https://httpd.apache.org/docs/current/mod/mod\_headers.html#requestheader](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/current/mod/mod_headers.html#requestheader)

有關可用請求標頭類型的更多資訊可以在此處找到：[https://httpd.apache.org/docs/current/mod/mod\_headers.html#requestheader](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/current/mod/mod_headers.html#requestheader)

##### [Protect a local server with certificates](#p-049)｜[使用憑證保護本機伺服器](#p-049)

In the above virtual host configuration are a couple of parameters related to client authentication. The advantage of using these is that you can prevent unauthorized access to services using certificates signed by a (local) certificate authority.

在上面的虛擬主機配置中有幾個與客戶端身份驗證相關的參數。使用這些的優點是，您可以使用（本地）憑證授權單位簽署的憑證來防止對服務進行未經授權的存取。

To use this functionality, first make sure you have a certificate authority defined in System ‣ Trust ‣ Authorities which you are going to use to create certificates for your clients.

要使用此功能，首先確保您在 System ‣ Trust ‣ Authorities 中定義了一個憑證授權單位，您將使用它為客戶端建立憑證。

Next step is to add a VirtualServer which contains at least the following information:

下一步是新增一個 VirtualServer，其中至少包含以下資訊：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| ServerName<br>伺服器名稱 | The fully qualified domain name this host listens to<br>該主機偵聽的完全限定網域名稱 |
| Port<br>港口 | Port number to bind to, you can use [Port forwarding](#p-135) to redirect traffic from standard ports to non standard ones when needed<br>綁定的連接埠號碼，需要時可以使用[連接埠轉送](#p-135)將流量從標準連接埠重定向到非標準連接埠 |
| Certificate / Enable ACME<br>证书/启用ACME | Either use an ACME certificate or define one yourself, this one should be trusted by the browser connecting to this host<br>使用 ACME 证书或自己定义一个证书，连接到该主机的浏览器应该信任该证书 |
| CA for client auth<br>CA 用于客户端身份验证 | select the Authority created earlier<br>选择之前创建的权限 |

Followed by a location, which maybe as simple as binding path `/` to a local machine without certificate at `http://10.0.0.1`.

後面是一個位置，可能就像將路徑 `/` 綁定到沒有憑證的本機電腦`http://10.0.0.1` 一樣簡單。

Tip

提示

You can use revocation lists to pull back access rights for selected clients, just make sure to restart the service in order to make the changes effective.

您可以使用撤銷清單來收回所選用戶端的存取權限，只需確保重新啟動服務以使變更生效。

After this step, clients should not be able to access the virtual host, next you can create a certificate for the client and import it in the trust store. Usually browsers automatically pick these up when allowed by the client.

完成此步驟後，用戶端應該無法存取虛擬主機，接下來您可以為用戶端建立憑證並將其匯入信任儲存區。通常，當客戶端允許時，瀏覽器會自動選取這些。

##### [Protect a location with OpenID Connect](#p-049)｜[使用 OpenID Connect 保護位置](#p-049)

In the above virtual host and location configuration are a couple of parameters related to OpenID Connect. The advantage of using these is that you can prevent unauthenticated and unauthorized access to services using an identity provider.

在上面的虛擬主機和位置配置中有幾個與 OpenID Connect 相關的參數。使用這些的優點是，您可以防止使用身分提供者對服務進行未經身份驗證和未經授權的存取。

First, add an identity provider for service OPNWAF in System ‣ Access ‣ OpenID Connect.

首先，在 System ‣ Access ‣ OpenID Connect 中为服务OPNWAF 添加身份提供商。

For more information refer to the [OpenID Connect manual](#p-050).

更多資訊請參閱[OpenID Connect 手冊](#p-050)。

Next, add it to a virtual server in Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Virtual Servers:

接下來，將其新增至防火牆 ‣ Web 應用程式 ‣ 閘道 ‣ 虛擬伺服器中的虛擬伺服器：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **OpenID Connect**<br>**OpenID 連線** |  |
| OIDC Provider<br>OIDC 提供者 | Choose the identity provider created in System ‣ Access ‣ OpenID Connect<br>選擇在 System ‣ Access ‣ OpenID Connect |
| OIDC Redirect URI<br>OIDC 重定向URI | Leave default, this will create a URI that must be set with your identity provider. If the virtual server is example.com it will become `https://example.com/oidc/callback` if not specified otherwise. This location will be automatically removed from proxying. If you cannot use the default, choose an URI that does not collide with any path of your backend application.<br>保留預設值，這將建立一個必須透過您的身分提供者進行設定的 URI。如果虛擬伺服器是 example.com，如果沒有另外指定，它將變成`https://example.com/oidc/callback`。該位置將自動從代理中刪除。如果您無法使用預設值，請選擇不與後端應用程式的任何路徑衝突的URI。 |

As final step, ensure the following is set in each ProxyPass location of this virtual server:

最後一步，確保在此虛擬伺服器的每個 ProxyPass 位置中設定以下內容：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **OpenID Connect**<br>**OpenID 連線** |  |
| OIDC Auth Required<br>OIDC 需要授權 | Select to enforce OIDC authentication with the below claim.<br>選擇使用以下聲明強制執行 OIDC 身份驗證。 |
| OIDC Claims<br>OIDC 索賠 | Leave on default to allow any authenticated user in the OIDC scope access to the location.<br>保留預設值以允許OIDC範圍內的任何經過身份驗證的使用者存取該位置。 |

After applying, the location will need authentication (user must log in).

申請後，該位置需要身份驗證（用戶必須登入）。

##### [OpenID Connect claims](#p-049)｜[OpenID Connect 聲明](#p-049)

A claim is a piece of information that can be used to identify a user. This means you can create a stricter policy which user has access to the location, not only enforcing authentication but also authorization.

聲明是可用於識別使用者身分的一條訊息。這意味著您可以建立更嚴格的使用者有權存取該位置的策略，不僅強制執行身份驗證，還強制執行授權。

As example, we only want to grant access to a location for all users with the first name `John`.

例如，我們只想向所有名字為 `John` 的使用者授予對某個位置的存取權。

First, we add a claim in Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ OIDC Claims:

首先，我們在 Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ OIDC Claims 中新增一個聲明：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **OpenID Connect**<br>**OpenID 連線** |  |
| Claim type<br>索賠類型 | Most claim types are standardized via the OIDC spec. Some provider specific options are also offered (group). For our example case we choose `name`.<br>大多數索賠類型都透過 OIDC 規範進行標準化。也提供了一些提供者特定的選項（群組）。對於我們的範例案例，我們選擇`name`。 |
| Claim value<br>索賠價值 | `John` |

Next, we add the claim to an OpenID Connect enabled location in Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Virtual Servers:

接下來，我們將聲明新增至 Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Virtual Servers 中啟用 OpenID Connect 的位置：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **OpenID Connect**<br>**OpenID 連線** |  |
| OIDC Auth Required<br>OIDC 需要授權 | Select to enforce OIDC authentication with the below claim.<br>選擇使用以下聲明強制執行 OIDC 身份驗證。 |
| OIDC Claims<br>OIDC 索賠 | `name John` |

After applying, the location will need authentication (user must log in) and authorization (user must be John).

申請後，該位置將需要身份驗證（用戶必須登入）和授權（用戶必須是John）。

Note

注意事項

Multiple claims can be selected, they will be combined via `or` operator.

可以選擇多個索賠，它們將透過`or`運算符合併。

Tip

提示

Authorizing unique users can be done with the `preferred_username` claim, which is the name a user authenticates with. Some identity providers can send groups (non-standard) in their OIDC scope which simplifies authorization when you have a large amount of users.

可以使用 `preferred_username` 聲明來授權唯一用戶，這是用戶進行身份驗證時使用的名稱。一些身分提供者可以在其 OIDC 範圍內發送群組（非標準），這可以在您擁有大量使用者時簡化授權。

##### [Error Documents](#p-049)｜[錯誤文檔](#p-049)

By default, generic Apache documents will be served for HTTP response status codes. The most common client error responses can be styled OPNsense themed, or be branded with your own style.

預設情況下，將為 HTTP 回應狀態程式碼提供通用 Apache 文件。最常見的客戶端錯誤回應可以採用 OPNsense 主題樣式，也可以採用您自己的風格進行品牌化。

To download the default error document templates, go to Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Error Documents.

若要下載預設錯誤文件模板，請前往防火牆 ‣ Web 應用程式 ‣ 錯誤文件。

Select the Download command in the `Default` row. Afterwards you can unzip the archive, and change the individual error documents.

選擇`Default`行中的下載指令。之後，您可以解壓縮存檔，並更改個別錯誤文件。

When you are done, select **+** to open the upload dialogue:

完成後，選擇 **++** 開啟上傳對話方塊：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Name<br>名稱 | Name for this template, e.g. `MyErrorDocuments`<br>該範本的名稱，例如`MyErrorDocuments` |
| Uri<br>烏裡 | Uri used to serve error pages, when unspecified, /\_\_waf\_errors\_\_/ will be used. Best to use the offered default.<br>用於提供錯誤頁面的 Uri，如果未指定，將使用 /\_\_waf\_errors\_\_/。最好使用提供的預設值。 |
| Content<br>內容 | Select the zip archive with the altered error documents.<br>選擇包含已變更錯誤文件的 zip 檔案。 |

After saving, the error documents can be added in Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Virtual Servers:

儲存後，可以在 Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Gateways ‣ Virtual Servers 中新增錯誤文件：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Error Document<br>錯誤文檔 | `MyErrorDocuments` will use your new template. `Default` will use the OPNsense styled template. `None` will use the unaltered default Apache documents.<br>`MyErrorDocuments` 將使用您的新範本。 `Default` 將使用 OPNsense 風格的模板。 `None` 將使用未更改的預設 Apache 文件。 |

To optionally overlay any error with only the template provided ones, you can set the following in a location:

若要選擇性地僅使用範本提供的錯誤覆蓋任何錯誤，您可以在某個位置設定以下內容：

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Overlay error pages<br>覆寫錯誤頁面 | Overlay common error pages with the ones specified in the virtual server. This means that all HTTP response status codes received from the `Remote destinations` will be stripped, and only matching HTTP response codes in the current selected error document template will be served.<br>將常見錯誤頁面與虛擬伺服器中指定的頁面重疊。這意味著從 `Remote destinations` 收到的所有 HTTP 響應狀態代碼都會被剝離，並且僅提供當前所選錯誤文檔模板中匹配的 HTTP 響應代碼。 |

Tip

提示

When using OpenID Connect, it is a good idea to either use the `Default` or custom error documents, to ensure the `Unauthorized` error pages have a more cohesive and user friendly style.

使用 OpenID Connect 時，最好使用 `Default` 或自訂錯誤文檔，以確保 `Unauthorized` 錯誤頁面具有更具凝聚力和使用者友好的風格。

#### [Server Status](#p-049)｜[伺服器狀態](#p-049)

The server exposes metrics that can be revealed in Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Status.

伺服器公開可在 Firewall ‣ Web Application ‣ Status 中顯示的指標。

You can find tabs with general information, workers, current requests and ACME certificates.

您可以找到包含一般信息、工人、当前请求和ACME证书的选项卡。

If the server behaves unexpected, checking the current requests and server load can reveal potential issues:

如果伺服器表現異常，檢查目前請求和伺服器負載可以揭示潛在問題：

-   **Detect backend connectivity issues**  
    **檢測後端連線問題**
    
    Requests that remain open for unusually long periods or repeatedly fail may indicate that an upstream service is slow or unreachable. Inspecting the active request list can help determine whether the issue originates from the reverse proxy or the backend application.

    請求保持開啟的時間異常長或反覆失敗可能表示上游服務速度緩慢或無法存取。檢查活動請求清單可以幫助確定問題是源自反向代理還是後端應用程式。
    
-   **Validate configuration changes in real time**  
    **即時驗證配置變更**
    
    After modifying the configuration, the status page can be used to verify that requests are handled as expected. Observing request paths and worker activity allows administrators to confirm that traffic reaches the intended backend services.

    修改配置後，狀態頁面可用於驗證請求是否如預期處理。透過觀察請求路徑和工作執行緒活動，管理員可以確認流量是否到達了預期的後端服務。
    
-   **Find malicious clients**  
    **尋找惡意客戶端**
    
    Malicious clients could DoS the hosted websites if the CPU load is very high and the number of concurrent requests is unexpected.

    如果 CPU 负载非常高并且并发请求数量超出预期，恶意客户端可能会对托管网站进行 DoS。
    

Tip

提示

Server statistics are API enabled, meaning you could export them to an external monitoring system. Since they are not stored on disk, persistence requires external polling.

服务器统计数据已启用API，这意味着您可以将它们导出到外部监控系统。由於它們不會儲存在磁碟上，因此持久性需要外部輪詢。
