<a id="p-050"></a>

### OpenID Connect｜OpenID 連接

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/vendor/deciso/oidc.html>

OpenID Connect (OIDC) is an identity layer built on top of the OAuth 2.0 protocol that allows applications to verify a user’s identity and obtain basic profile information in a secure way. While OAuth 2.0 is mainly used for authorization (granting access to resources), OIDC adds authentication by introducing an ID Token, which is a digitally signed piece of information about the user. This makes it possible for applications (called “relying parties”) to confirm who the user is, without having to manage passwords directly. OIDC is widely used in single sign-on (SSO) scenarios, enabling users to log in with trusted identity providers like Google, Microsoft, or enterprise systems, while keeping the process standardized and secure.

OpenID Connect (OIDC) 是建構在 OAuth 2.0 協定之上的身分層，允許應用程式驗證使用者身分並以安全的方式取得基本設定檔資訊。 OAuth 2.0 主要用於授權（授予對資源的存取權限），而 OIDC 透過引入 ID 令牌來新增身份驗證，令牌是有關使用者的數位簽署資訊。這使得應用程式（稱為「依賴方」）可以確認使用者是誰，而無需直接管理密碼。 OIDC廣泛應用於單一登入（SSO）場景，使用戶能夠使用受信任的身份提供者（如Google、Microsoft或企業系統）登錄，同時保持流程標準化和安全。

The business edition includes OpenID Connect support for some parts of the system, these will be further detailed in this document

商業版包括對系統某些部分的 OpenID Connect 支持，這些將在本文檔中進一步詳細介紹

#### Basic workflow｜基本工作流程

In an OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication flow, the application (client) redirects the user to an Identity Provider (IdP), where the user logs in. After successful authentication, the IdP sends back an authorization code (or token) to the client, which it exchanges for an ID Token (and optionally access/refresh tokens). The ID Token contains the user’s identity information, allowing the client to verify who the user is.

在 OpenID Connect (OIDC) 驗證流程中，應用程式（用戶端）將使用者重新導向至身分提供者 (IdP)，使用者將在其中登入。成功驗證後，IdP 將授權代碼（或令牌）傳回客戶端，用戶端將其交換為 ID 令牌（以及可選的存取/刷新令牌）。 IDToken包含使用者的身份訊息，允許客戶端驗證使用者是誰。

Multiple identity providers do support OIDC, the information offered for the relying party (in this case OPNsense), usually consists of the following items:

多個身分提供者確實支援OIDC，即為依賴方（在本例中為 OPNsense）提供的信息，通常包含以下項目：

-   Client ID (an id identifying this client)  
    客戶端ID（標識該客戶端的 ID）
    
-   Secret this client should use  
    該客戶應該使用的秘密
    
-   Uri to locate the `.well-known/openid-configuration` file  
    用於定位 `.well-known/openid-configuration` 檔案的 Uri
    
-   Authentication method used (for example `POST`)  
    使用的身份驗證方法（例如`POST`）
    

Usually the provider needs the return path configured as well, often these are called *“Redirect URIs”（重定向 URI）*, when our location is not in the list, it’s not allowed to return the token to the requested path.

通常提供者也需要配置返迴路徑，通常這些稱為*“Redirect URIs”（重定向 URI）*，當我們的位置不在清單中時，不允許將令牌返回到請求的路徑。

#### Adding OpenID Providers｜新增 OpenID 供應商

OpenID providers can be configured via System ‣ Access ‣ OpenID Connect, the table below describes all available options and their purpose. The service type determines which ones are available.

OpenID 提供者可以透過 System ‣ Access ‣ OpenID Connect 進行配置，下表描述了所有可用選項及其用途。服務類型決定哪些服務可用。

**Local settings**

**本地設定**

Configures the service type and identification at OPNsense.

在 OPNsense 上設定服務類型和識別。

| **Fieldname**<br>**欄位名稱** | **Purpose**<br>**目的** |
| --- | --- |
| Application code<br>申請代碼 | Application code used on our end to identify this provider, this text will be used on our end as part of the oidc endpoints. Needs to be unique in order to identify the proper IdP.<br>我們端用於識別此提供者的應用程式代碼，此文字將在我們端用作 oidc 端點的一部分。需要唯一才能識別正確的 IdP。 |
| Service<br>服務 | For which type of service may this provider be used, see services section<br>該提供者可以使用哪種類型的服務，請參閱服務部分 |
| Extensive log (debug)<br>豐富的日誌（調試） | Log detailed audit messages<br>記錄詳細的審核訊息 |
| Description<br>描述 | Description of this provider<br>該提供者的描述 |

**OpenID Connect provider**

**OpenID Connect 提供者**

This part of the configuration contains

這部分配置包含

| **Fieldname**<br>**欄位名稱** | **Purpose**<br>**目的** |
| --- | --- |
| Provider URL<br>供應商URL | Location of the OpenID connect provider, e.g. [https://id.provider.com](https://id.provider.com/), the path “.well-known/openid-configuration” will be suffixed to find the configuration of this OP<br>OpenID 連線供應商的位置，例如[https://id.provider.com](https://id.provider.com/)，路徑後綴為「.well-known/openid-configuration」即可找到此OP的設定 |
| Client ID<br>客戶ID | The client identifier of the RP (requesting party) at the OP (OpenID provider).<br>RP（請求方）在OP（OpenID 提供者）的客戶端標識符。 |
| Client Secret<br>客戶秘密 | The client secret of the RP (requesting party) at the OP (OpenID provider).<br>RP（請求方）在OP（OpenID 提供者）的客戶端金鑰。 |
| Authentication method<br>認證方式 | Authentication method to use, eiher POST, BASIC or use what’s offered by the provider.<br>所使用的身份驗證方法，POST, BASIC 或使用提供者提供的方法。 |
| Additional scopes<br>附加範圍 | Select additional scopes to request, by default only oidc is requested.<br>選擇要要求的其他範圍，預設僅請求 oidc。 |

**Local database**

**本地資料庫**

This section offers control on how to process authenticated users locally, independent of the type of service being used.

本節提供如何在本地處理經過驗證的使用者的控制，與所使用的服務類型無關。

| **Fieldname**<br>**欄位名稱** | **Purpose**<br>**目的** |
| --- | --- |
| User identification field<br>使用者識別欄位 | Fieldname from the UserInfo response to use.<br>要使用的 UserInfo 回應中的欄位名稱。 |
| Create user<br>建立使用者 | On successful login, create or update the user (including groups when selected)<br>成功登入後，建立或更新使用者（包括選擇的群組） |
| Group attribute<br>群組屬性 | The attribute name in UserInfo object which contains the groups this user belongs to.<br>UserInfo 物件中的屬性名稱，包含該使用者所屬的群組。 |
| Default groups<br>預設群組 | When created locally, always assign these groups.<br>在本機建立時，請務必指派這些群組。 |
| Limit groups<br>限制群組 | When created locally, only allow these groups to be offered via the provider.<br>在本機建立時，僅允許透過提供者提供這些群組。 |

#### Services｜服務

When using OIDC on OPNsense, the service decides the endpoint used on the firewall to initiate the login sequence. As each authentication flow could use its own implementation, we need some stepping stone which guides the browser to the proper login provider.

在 OPNsense 上使用 OIDC 時，此服務決定防火牆上使用的端點來啟動登入序列。由於每個身份驗證流程都可以使用自己的實現，因此我們需要一些墊腳石來引導瀏覽器到正確的登入提供者。

As these endpoints are usually also the return paths for the openid provider, we will describe the relevant paths per service type.

由於這些端點通常也是 openid 提供者的返迴路徑，因此我們將描述每種服務類型的相關路徑。

##### WebGui / Admin｜WebGUI / 管理

When the `WebGui / Admin` service is selected, the OPNsense login screen will show the option below the user/password fields.

選擇 `WebGui / Admin` 服務時，OPNsense 登入畫面將在使用者/密碼欄位下方顯示選項。

These options do not need to be selected in the System ‣ Settings ‣ Administration page under authentication server, as there is only one WebGui to choose from.

這些選項不需要在認證伺服器下的 System ‣ Settings ‣ Administration 頁面中選擇，因為只有一個 WebGui 可供選擇。

The following endpoints are available for this service type:

以下端點可用於此服務類型：

| uri<br>烏裡 | Purpose<br>目的 |
| --- | --- |
| /api/oidc/rp/login/<<appcode>> | Login, locates the provider uri and initiates the flow<br>登錄，找到提供者 uri 並啟動流程 |
| /api/oidc/rp/finalize/<<appcode>> | After login, the openid provider forwards to here and a session is created with the proper privileges set.<br>登入後，openid 提供者轉送到此處，並使用適當的權限集建立會話。 |

##### Captive Portal｜強制門戶

A captive portal provider needs to be selected in the authentication option inside the zone configuration as these can be used in different zones.

需要在區域配置內的身份驗證選項中選擇強制門戶提供者，因為它們可以在不同的區域中使用。

The following endpoints are available for this service type:

以下端點可用於此服務類型：

| uri<br>烏裡 | Purpose<br>目的 |
| --- | --- |
| /api/captiveportal/access\_oidc/login/\[<<appcode>>\] | Login, when there is only one oidc provider attached to the zone, the appcode may be omitted. In which case the controller locates the appcode and requests the proper finalize path from the OP.<br>登錄，當該區域只有一個 oidc 提供者時，appcode 可以省略。在這種情況下，控制器找到應用程式程式碼並從 OP 請求正確的最終路徑。 |
| /api/captiveportal/access\_oidc/finalize/<<appcode>> | After login, the openid provider forwards to here and a captive portal session is created.<br>登入後，openid 提供者轉送到此處並建立強制入口網站會話。 |
| /api/captiveportal/access\_oidc/logout/\[<<appcode>>\] | End captive portal session<br>結束強制入口網站會話 |

After configuring the captive portal zone to use the OIDC provider, we need to deploy a custom template as well. The html example below explains the relevant sections to implement in order to use OIDC.

將強制門戶區域配置為使用OIDC提供者後，我們還需要部署自訂範本。下面的 html 範例解釋了使用 OIDC 時要實現的相關部分。

```
....
<script>
    $( document ).ready(function() {
        let addr = new URL(window.location);
        /* the status parameter is used to easily determine which action is requested  */
        switch (addr.searchParams.get('status')) {
            case null:
                /* When not set, request client status via the standard controller */
                $.ajax({url: "/api/captiveportal/access/status/", dataType:"json"}).done(function(data) {
                    if (data['clientState'] == 'AUTHORIZED') {
                        /* already logged in */
                        $(".status-logged-in").show();
                    } else {
                        /* unhide "loader" text and redirect to trampoline */
                        $(".status-empty").show();
                        window.location = '/api/captiveportal/access_oidc/login/';
                    }
                });
                break;
            case 'logged-in':
            case 'logged-out':
            case 'login-failed':
                /* show status <div/> */
                $(".status-" + addr.searchParams.get('status')).show();
                break;
        }
    });
</script>
....
<section class="content-row">
    <article class="wrapper">
        <div class="content status-logged-in" style="display: none;">
            <h1>Session logged in </h1><br/>
            <h1><a href="/api/captiveportal/access_oidc/logout/">Logout</a></h1>
        </div>
        <div class="content status-logged-out" style="display: none;">
            <h1>Session logged out </h1><br/>
            <h1><a href="/api/captiveportal/access_oidc/login/">Login</a></h1>
        </div>
        <div class="content status-login-failed" style="display: none;">
            <h1>Login failed </h1>
        </div>
        <div class="content status-empty" style="display: none;">
            <h1>Redirecting to login...</h1>
        </div>
    </article>
</section>
....
```

:[`Download full example`](https://docs.opnsense.org/_downloads/29602629f868898a9c07e34f66d5524d/cp_template.zip)

The full example zip is an easy to use template package which can be uploaded via Services ‣ Captive Portal ‣ Administration in the templates tab.

完整的範例 zip 是一個易於使用的範本包，可以透過範本標籤中的 Services ‣ Captive Portal ‣ Administration 上傳。

Note

注意事項

When offering a single OIDC provider for a captive portal zone, we can generalize the template as no app code needs to be offered. In case multiple options need to be available, a custom template need to be created offering the user a choice between options when no session exists yet. (e.g. :code:\` window.location\` can’t be used to forward to the provider)

當為強制門戶區域提供單一OIDC提供者時，我們可以通用模板，因為不需要提供應用程式程式碼。如果需要多個選項可用，則需要建立自訂模板，以便在尚不存在會話時為使用者提供選項之間的選擇。 （例如：code:\` window.location\`不能用於轉發給提供者）

Since users need to be able to access the oidc provider (which is usually not in the same network), the ip address (or group of addresses) should be excluded from entering the portal. In most cases these aren’t just static addresses, in which case you need to use custom firewall rules to allow traffic to the provider (such as Microsoft Entra ID). The [captive portal documentation](#p-200) explains how to define custom rules for these case.

由於使用者需要能夠存取 oidc 提供者（通常不在同一網路中），因此應排除該 IP 位址（或位址群組）進入入口網站。在大多數情況下，這些不僅僅是靜態位址，在這種情況下，您需要使用自訂防火牆規則來允許流量到達提供者（例如 Microsoft Entra ID）。 [強制入口網站文件](#p-200) 說明如何為這些情況定義自訂規則。

Tip

提示

When your provider is hosted in a rather dynamic environment (such as Microsoft Entra ID), you probably want to put the associated domains in an allow list. The included Dnsmasq service can be of great help there as explained in the [IPset](#p-194) feature documentation.

當您的提供者託管在相當動態的環境中（例如 Microsoft Entra ID）時，您可能會想要將關聯的網域放入允許清單中。正如 [IPset](#p-194) 功能文件中所述，隨附的 Dnsmasq 服務可以提供很大幫助。

##### OPNWAF (Web application firewall / reverse proxy)｜OPNWAF（Web應用防火牆/反向代理）

The reverse proxy defines one endpoint specifically to be used by oidc when an “OIDC Provider”（OIDC 提供者） is selected in the virtual server configuration:

當在虛擬伺服器配置中選擇“OIDC Provider”（OIDC 提供者）時，反向代理定義了一個專門供 oidc 使用的端點：

| uri<br>烏裡 | Purpose<br>目的 |
| --- | --- |
| /oidc/callback<br>/oidc/回呼 | predefined vanity url that can not be used in the application as location. It can be optionally changed via the `OIDC Redirect URI` setting in a virtual server.<br>預先定義的虛榮 url 不能在應用程式中用作位置。它可以透過虛擬伺服器中的`OIDC Redirect URI`設定進行選擇性更改。 |

Below a collection of useful links how to setup OpenID at various providers:

以下是如何在不同提供者設定 OpenID 的有用連結集合：

-   Authentic ([https://docs.goauthentik.io/add-secure-apps/providers/oauth2/](https://docs.goauthentik.io/add-secure-apps/providers/oauth2/))  
    正品（[https://docs.goauthentik.io/add-secure-apps/providers/oauth2/](https://docs.goauthentik.io/add-secure-apps/providers/oauth2/)）
    
-   Jumpcloud ([https://jumpcloud.com/support/sso-with-oidc](https://jumpcloud.com/support/sso-with-oidc))  
    跳雲 ([https://jumpcloud.com/support/sso-with-oidc](https://jumpcloud.com/support/sso-with-oidc))

#### [General](#p-051)｜[一般](#p-051)

[![../../_images/user_portal.png](<../images/4669beee-user_portal.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/user_portal.png)

The portal replaces the simple user password menu, which can be found at Lobby ‣ Password and offers additional functionality for self-service support.

此入口網站取代了簡單的使用者密碼選單（可在大廳 ‣ 密碼中找到），並提供自助服務支援的附加功能。

根據配置，使用者可以在此處更改密碼和語言、下載並重新產生一次性密碼令牌以及存取他們有權存取的實例的 OpenVPN 設定檔。

#### [Administration](#p-051)｜[管理](#p-051)

Under System ‣ Settings ‣ Portal Admin you will find the administration part of the portal, this includes generic account settings and OpenVPN instance access.

在 System ‣ Settings ‣ Portal Admin 下，您將找到入口網站的管理部分，其中包括通用帳戶設定和 OpenVPN 執行個體存取。

##### [Settings](#p-051)｜[設定](#p-051)

Here you will find the basic settings for the portal

在這裡您可以找到門戶的基本設置

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Allow OTP token creation<br>允許創建OTP代幣 | Select which group a user should be a member of to manage it’s own token<br>選擇用戶應屬於哪個群組來管理自己的令牌 |
| User portal welcome message<br>使用者入口網站歡迎資訊 | Welcome message (first tab content), may include html formatted text.<br>歡迎訊息（第一個選項卡內容），可能包括 html 格式的文字。 |

##### [OpenVPN](#p-051)

The OpenVPN tab shows a grid where you can add instances which a user should have access to, it contains most of the settings also available in the standard OpenVPN export module.

OpenVPN 標籤顯示一個網格，您可以在其中新增使用者應有權存取的實例，它包含標準 OpenVPN 匯出模組中也提供的大部分設定。

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Member of<br>會員 | Select which group a user should be a member of to download a profile<br>選擇使用者應屬於哪個群組來下載設定檔 |
| Server instance<br>伺服器實例 | The instance we grant access to<br>我們授予存取權限的實例 |
| Certificate lifetime (days)<br>憑證有效期限（天） | Lifetime of a certificate, after expiry the user can not login anymore<br>憑證的有效期限，過期後使用者將無法再登入 |
| Certificate Key type<br>憑證金鑰類型 | Type of certificate to include in the profile<br>要包含在設定檔中的憑證類型 |
| Certificate Digest Algorithm<br>證書摘要演算法 | Digest algorithm used to generate the certificate<br>用於產生證書的摘要演算法 |
| Export template<br>匯出範本 | Type of file the user will download<br>使用者將下載的文件類型 |
| Hostname<br>主機名稱 | The hostname or ip address used to contact this firewall<br>用於聯絡此防火牆的主機名稱或 IP 位址 |
| Enable static challenge (OTP)<br>啟用靜態挑戰（OTP） | Ask the user for its one time password token separately (instead of as part the password).<br>單獨向使用者詢問其一次性密碼令牌（而非作為密碼的一部分）。 |
| Custom config<br>自訂配置 | Custom configuration, which will be returned in the output file without modifications.<br>自訂配置，將在輸出檔案中傳回而不進行修改。 |
| Description<br>描述 | Description shown to the user for this instance download<br>向使用者顯示此實例下載的描述 |

Tip

提示

If a user should be allowed to download multiple file formats for the same service, you can duplicate the entry. Simply use different descriptions per entry.

如果應允許使用者為相同服務下載多種檔案格式，您可以複製該條目。只需對每個條目使用不同的描述即可。

#### [Configuration example](#p-051)｜[設定範例](#p-051)

The following configuration outlines a pretty common business case with the following requirements:

以下配置概述了一個非常常見的業務案例，具有以下要求：

Users should get:

用戶應該得到：

> -   an OpenVPN profile with user certificate  
      帶有使用者憑證的 OpenVPN 設定文件
>     
> -   Two-Factor authentication with TOTP  
      使用TOTP進行雙重認證
>     
> -   access to a self-service portal to manage their password, OTP token and OpenVPN profile  
      存取自助服務入口網站來管理其密碼、OTP 令牌和 OpenVPN 設定文件
>     

##### [1\. Configure default groups](#p-051)｜[1\.配置預設群組](#p-051)

We will create three groups that control access to the user portal, OTP token and OpenVPN profile.

我們將建立三個群組來控制對使用者入口網站、OTP 令牌和 OpenVPN 設定檔的存取。

Go to System ‣ Access ‣ Groups and add the following groups:

前往 System ‣ Access ‣ Groups 並新增以下群組：

**user\_default\_priv**

**使用者\_default\_priv**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Group name**<br>**群組名稱** | `user_default_priv` |
| **Privileges**<br>**特權** | `Lobby: Password` |

-   Press **Save** and add next  
    按**儲存**並新增下一個
    

Note

注意事項

This allows members to access the user portal and manage their passwords.

這允許成員訪問用戶門戶並管理他們的密碼。

**user\_otp\_priv**

**使用者\_otp\_priv**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Group name**<br>**群組名稱** | `user_otp_priv` |

-   Press **Save** and add next  
    按**儲存**並新增下一個
    

Note

注意事項

This group does not need any privileges, we will use it for the user portal configuration in a later step to allow members access to the OTP tokens.

該群組不需要任何權限，我們將在後面的步驟中將其用於使用者入口網站配置，以允許成員存取OTP令牌。

**user\_ovpn\_priv**

**使用者\_ovpn\_priv**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Group name**<br>**群組名稱** | `user_ovpn_priv` |

-   Press **Save** and add next  
    按**儲存**並新增下一個
    

Note

注意事項

This group does not need any privileges, we will use it for the user portal configuration in a later step to allow members access to the OpenVPN instance.

該群組不需要任何權限，我們將在後面的步驟中將其用於使用者入口網站配置，以允許成員存取 OpenVPN 實例。

Tip

提示

You can create multiple groups here, e.g., `user_ovpn_priv_sales`, `user_ovpn_priv_admin` so you can control access to multiple OpenVPN instances.

您可以在此處建立多個群組，例如`user_ovpn_priv_sales`, `user_ovpn_priv_admin`，以便您可以控制對多個 OpenVPN 執行個體的存取。

##### [2\. Configure a user (Onboarding)](#p-051)｜[2\.配置用戶（入職）](#p-051)

Now we need a user that will become a member of the groups we created.

現在我們需要一個將成為我們創建的群組的成員的使用者。

Go to System ‣ Access ‣ User and add the following user:

前往 System ‣ Access ‣ User 並新增以下使用者：

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Username**<br>**使用者名稱** | `john` |
| **Password**<br>**密碼** | Set a password<br>設定密碼 |
| **Group Membership**<br>**團體會員** | `user_default_priv, user_otp_priv, user_ovpn_priv` |

-   Press **Save**  
    按**儲存**
    

Note

注意事項

Creating a user certificate is not necessary, the user portal will automagically create one for the user when they download an OpenVPN configuration. Same goes for the OTP token which the user can create themselves.

不需要建立使用者證書，使用者入口網站將在使用者下載 OpenVPN 設定時自動為使用者建立證書。使用者可以自己建立的OTP令牌也是如此。

Tip

提示

When using an LDAP authentication server, creating users manually is not needed. Go to System ‣ Access ‣ Servers and enable Automatic user creation. For Default groups, choose `user_default_priv`. Add the groups `user_otp_priv` and `user_ovpn_priv` to users on the LDAP server. Please note that all groups must be created manually and share the same name between System ‣ Access ‣ Groups and the LDAP server.

使用LDAP認證伺服器時，不需要手動建立使用者。前往 System ‣ Access ‣ Servers 並啟用自動使用者建立。對於預設組，選擇 `user_default_priv`。將群組`user_otp_priv`和`user_ovpn_priv`加入到LDAP伺服器上的使用者。請注意，所有群組必須手動創建，並在系統 ‣ 存取 ‣ 群組和 LDAP 伺服器之間共用相同的名稱。

##### [3\. Configure Authentication Servers](#p-051)｜[3\.設定驗證伺服器](#p-051)

We require two server types:

我們需要兩種伺服器類型：

> -   The default server `Local Database` will allow users to authenticate with the user portal.  
      預設伺服器`Local Database`將允許使用者透過使用者入口網站進行身份驗證。
>     
> -   The additional server `Local Database + TOTP` will be used for OpenVPN.  
      額外的伺服器`Local Database + TOTP`將用於OpenVPN。
>     

Go to System ‣ Access ‣ Servers and add the following additional server:

前往 System ‣ Access ‣ Servers 並新增以下附加伺服器：

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Descriptive name**<br>**描述性名稱** | `Local Database + TOTP` |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | `Local + Timebased One Time Password` |

-   Press **Save**  
    按**儲存**
    

Attention

注意

If you set the authentication server in System ‣ Settings ‣ Administration to the `Local Database + TOTP` option, users cannot manage their own OTP tokens in the user portal without prior help from an administrator; because they need an OTP token for authentication and might not have one yet. Especially if you choose an LDAP variant and have a big userbase, take this into consideration if everything should be fully automated. This is why we suggest using two authentication server types so users will be able to authenticate to the user portal without using TOTP.

如果您在系統 ‣ 設定 ‣ 管理 中將驗證伺服器設定為 `Local Database + TOTP` 選項，則在沒有管理員事先協助的情況下，使用者無法在使用者入口網站中管理自己的 OTP 令牌；因為他們需要一個 OTP 令牌進行驗證，但可能還沒有。特別是如果您選擇 LDAP 變體並擁有龐大的用戶群，如果一切都應該完全自動化，請考慮這一點。這就是為什麼我們建議使用兩種身份驗證伺服器類型，以便使用者能夠在不使用TOTP的情況下向使用者入口網站進行身份驗證。

##### [4\. Configure OpenVPN Instance](#p-051)｜[4\.設定OpenVPN實例](#p-051)

Go to VPN ‣ OpenVPN ‣ Instances and add a new instance.

前往 VPN ‣ OpenVPN ‣ 實例並新增實例。

You can use the following section as guidance: [Setup SSL VPN Road Warrior](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/sslvpn_instance_roadwarrior.html)

您可以使用以下部分作為指導：[設定SSL VPN Road Warrior](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/sslvpn_instance_roadwarrior.html)

Here are the adjustments to make in the instance configuration when following that guide:

以下是遵循該指南時要在實例配置中進行的調整：

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | `user_ovpn_priv` |
| **Authentication**<br>**驗證** | `Local Database + TOTP` |

Note

注意事項

Setting the description of the instance as the prior created group name makes administration in the user portal simpler.

將實例的描述設定為先前建立的群組名稱可以使使用者入口網站中的管理更加簡單。

##### [5\. Configure User Portal](#p-051)｜[5\.設定使用者入口網站](#p-051)

Go to System ‣ Settings ‣ Portal Admin and set the following options:

進入 System ‣ Settings ‣ Portal Admin 並設定以下選項：

**Settings**

**設定**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Allow OTP token creation**<br>**允許創建OTP代幣** | `user_otp_priv` |

-   Press **Apply** and go to next tab  
    按 **應用** 並轉到下一個選項卡
    

Note

注意事項

This allows any user in the `user_otp_priv` group to access the OTP self-service in the user portal.

這允許`user_otp_priv`群組中的任何使用者存取使用者入口網站中的OTP自助服務。

**OpenVPN**

**開放VPN**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Member of**<br>**成員** | `user_ovpn_priv` |
| **Server instance**<br>**伺服器實例** | `[Server] user_ovpn_priv` |
| **Export template**<br>**匯出模板** | `Archive` |
| **Static Challenge**<br>**靜態挑戰** | `X` |
| **Hostname**<br>**主機名稱** | The FQDN of your firewall with A-Record in the public DNS<br>您的防火牆的FQDN公開有A記錄DNS |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | `user_ovpn_priv_archive` |

Press **Save** and add another choice if you want to offer e.g., Viscosity as alternative download option

如果您想提供例如黏度作為替代下載選項，請按**儲存**並新增另一個選擇

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Member of**<br>**成員** | `user_ovpn_priv` |
| **Server instance**<br>**伺服器實例** | `[Server] user_ovpn_priv` |
| **Export template**<br>**匯出模板** | `Viscosity (visc)` |
| **Static Challenge**<br>**靜態挑戰** | `X` |
| **Hostname**<br>**主機名稱** | The FQDN of your firewall with A-Record in the public DNS<br>您的防火牆的FQDN公開有A記錄DNS |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | `user_ovpn_priv_viscosity` |

-   Press **Save** and **Apply**  
    按**儲存**並**應用**
    

Tip

提示

Enabling Static Challenge will create a pop up that asks for the OTP token so that users do not have to merge it with their user password manually.

啟用靜態挑戰將建立一個彈出窗口，要求提供 OTP 令牌，以便使用者不必手動將其與使用者密碼合併。

Note

注意事項

You can create multiple instances and choose which group can download which configuration.

您可以建立多個實例並選擇哪個群組可以下載哪個配置。

Attention

注意

Keep the Certificate lifetime in mind. The user cannot renew their own certificate, an administrator must do it for them. Alternatively, choose a very high lifetime here that is in the range of the CA you created before. E.g., if the CA is valid for 10 years, you can set the certificate lifetime to 5 years. The long lifetime should be fine if you deploy additional user authentication with one time password as outlined in this guide.

請牢記證書的有效期限。使用者無法更新自己的證書，管理員必須為他們執行此操作。或者，在此處選擇非常高的壽命，該壽命在您之前創建的 CA 範圍內。例如，如果CA的有效期為10年，則可以將證書有效期設定為5年。如果您按照本指南所述使用一次性密碼部署額外的使用者身份驗證，那麼較長的生命週期應該沒問題。

##### [6\. Test User Portal](#p-051)｜[6\.測試使用者入口](#p-051)

Now that the initial configuration is complete, test the user portal.

現在初始配置已完成，測試使用者入口網站。

Check in System ‣ Settings ‣ Administration that the `Listen Interfaces` are either on any, or include the interface your users will use for accessing the user portal. Do not forget to create a firewall rule that allows access to the WebGUI from this network.

檢查系統 ‣ 設定 ‣ 管理 `Listen Interfaces` 是否位於任何一個上，或包含您的使用者將用於存取使用者入口網站的介面。不要忘記建立允許從此網路存取 WebGUI 的防火牆規則。

Attention

注意

It is not advised to allow access to the WebGUI from public networks without restriction.

不建議無限制地允許從公共網路存取WebGUI。

If you are corrently logged into the WebGUI admin, open a different browser or an incognito tab. Open the same URL you would use to log in as administrator, but instead log in with the user you created earlier (john).

如果您已正確登入 WebGUI 管理員，請開啟其他瀏覽器或隱身標籤。開啟您用於以管理員身分登入的同一個URL，但使用您先前建立的使用者 (john) 登入。

You will now see the user portal as landing page. Here, the configurations you created in the prior steps will show their results.

現在您將看到使用者入口網站作為登入頁面。在這裡，您在前面的步驟中建立的配置將顯示其結果。

The user will be able to change their password, generate their own OTP token, and download the OpenVPN configuration files; which also automagically generates their user certificate.

使用者將能夠更改密碼，產生自己的OTP令牌，並下載OpenVPN設定檔；它也會自動產生他們的使用者憑證。

Tip

提示

Additional users can be created by repeating the onboarding step.

可以透過重複入職步驟來建立其他使用者。

##### [7\. Remove Access (Offboarding)](#p-051)｜[7\.刪除存取權限（Offboarding）](#p-051)

The prior steps outlined most of the onboarding process. Though, what should happen if the user access must be removed?

前面的步驟概述了大部分入職流程。但是，如果必須刪除使用者存取權限該怎麼辦？

Go to System ‣ Access ‣ User and remove all `Group memberships` and `Privileges`, regenerate the `OTP seed` and set the `Disabled` flag. After saving, the users rights will be nullified, and even if it will be re-enabled, the user will not be able to elevate their rights as they cannot log into the user portal, or use their OTP token to establish an OpenVPN connection.

進入系統‣訪問‣用戶並刪除所有`Group memberships`和`Privileges`，重新產生`OTP seed`並設定`Disabled`標誌。儲存後，使用者權限將被取消，即使重新啟用，使用者也無法提升權限，因為他們無法登入使用者門戶，也無法使用OTP令牌建立OpenVPN連線。

Attention

注意

If you use an LDAP authentication server, you must deactivate the user on that server. Keep the group memberships in mind, also the current default groups you might have set.

如果您使用 LDAP 驗證伺服器，則必須在該伺服器上停用使用者。請記住群組成員身份，以及您可能設定的目前預設群組。

As further step, invalidate the user certificate.

進一步，使用戶證書失效。

Go to System ‣ Trust ‣ Revocation and edit the CA you created for the OpenVPN instance. If there is no CRL yet, create one by setting a Description and pressing **Apply**.

前往 System ‣ Trust ‣ Replication 並編輯您為 OpenVPN 實例建立的 CA。如果還沒有 CRL，請透過設定描述並按 **套用** 來建立一個。

Afterwards, edit the CA again, and select a `Revocation per type`, e.g., `Unspecified` where you choose the created user certificate. After applying, this certificate will no longer be valid.

然後，再編輯CA，選擇一個`Revocation per type`，例如`Unspecified`，在這裡選擇建立的使用者憑證。申請後，該證書將不再有效。

Attention

注意

Deleting a certificate from the GUI will not invalidate it. You must use the revocation component to publish the revocation to the OpenVPN instance.

從GUI刪除憑證不會使其失效。您必須使用吊銷元件將撤銷發佈到 OpenVPN 執行個體。

<a id="p-052"></a>

### Scheduled jobs｜預定職位

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/vendor/deciso/scheduled_jobs.html>

Similar to the [cron](#p-098) service, scheduled jobs can execute certain predefined commands. The difference is cron is used for periodic schedules, jobs handles one time planned events.

與 [cron](#p-098) 服務類似，計畫作業可以執行某些預先定義的指令。差別在於 cron 用於定期規劃，作業處理一次性規劃事件。

This feature is practical to plan automatic updates during maintenance slots or to shutdown the system if we know electrical engineers are going to cut the power at a specific time.

此功能對於在維護時段計劃自動更新或在我們知道電氣工程師將在特定時間切斷電源時關閉系統非常實用。

A list of example commands can be found at the cron section of the manual.

範例命令清單可以在手冊的 cron 部分找到。

| **Fieldname**<br>**欄位名稱** | **Purpose**<br>**目的** |
| --- | --- |
| Time<br>時間 | Date and time the action should be performed<br>應執行操作的日期和時間 |
| Until (s)<br>直到（s） | When scheduled, counts down to the moment of execution<br>安排好後，倒數至執行時刻 |
| Command<br>指令 | Configd command to execute<br>要執行的 Configd 指令 |
| Parameters<br>參數 | Optional parameters<br>可選參數 |
| Description<br>描述 | Description to use for the job.<br>用於作業的描述。 |

### Hardware sizing & setup｜硬體尺寸和設置

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/hardware.html>

The **hardware setup** requires a careful preparation and selection of the standard PC hardware components for the intended installation of OPNsense.

**硬體設定**需要仔細準備和選擇標準PC硬體組件，以實現 OPNsense 的預期安裝。

⚠ Computer hardware with the open source security software OPNsense® pre-installed can be purchased directly from various (online) stores.

⚠ 預先安裝開源安全軟體 OPNsense® 的電腦硬體可以直接從各種（線上）商店購買。

Tip

提示

The OPNsense development team encourages everyone looking for a turn-key solution to buy from [Deciso](https://www.deciso.com/) or one of the other partners listed on our partner page. **Listed partners make significant contributions back to the project.**

OPNsense 開發團隊鼓勵每個尋求交鑰匙解決方案的人從 [Deciso](https://www.deciso.com/) 或我們合作夥伴頁面上列出的其他合作夥伴之一購買。 **列出的合作夥伴為該專案做出了重大貢獻。**

#### Supported hardware architectures｜支援的硬體架構

OPNsense® is available for [x86-64](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X86-64) (amd64) bit microprocessor architectures. Full installs on [SD memory cards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Secure_Digital), [solid-state disks (SSD)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solid-state_drive) or [hard disk drives (HDD)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hard_disk_drive) are intended for OPNsense.

OPNsense® 適用於 [x86-64](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X86-64) (amd64) 位元微處理器架構。 [SD 記憶卡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Secure_Digital)、[固態磁碟 (SSD)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solid-state_drive) 或 [硬碟 (HDD)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hard_disk_drive) 上的完整安裝適用於 OPNsense。

While supported devices range from embedded systems to rack-mounted servers, the hardware must be capable of running 64-bit [operating systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/operating_system).

雖然支援的設備範圍從嵌入式系統到機架式伺服器，但硬體必須能夠運行 64 位元[作業系統](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/operating_system)。

#### Hardware requirements｜硬體需求

For substantially narrowed OPNsense® functionality there is the basic specification. For full functionality there are minimum, reasonable and recommended specifications.

對於大幅縮減的 OPNsense® 功能，有基本規範。為了實現完整的功能，有最低、合理和推薦的規格。

Minimum

最低

This is the minimum specification to run all OPNsense standard features that do not need disk writes. It means that you can run all standard features, except for the ones that require disk writes, e.g. a caching proxy (cache) or intrusion detection and prevention (alert database).

這是運行所有不需要磁碟寫入的 OPNsense 標準功能的最低規格。這表示您可以運行所有標準功能，但需要磁碟寫入的功能除外，例如快取代理（快取）或入侵偵測和預防（警報資料庫）。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Processor<br>處理器 | 1 GHz dual-core CPU<br>1 GHz 雙核心CPU |
| RAM | 3 GB |
| Install method<br>安裝方法 | Serial console or video (VGA)<br>序列控制台或視訊 (VGA) |
| Install target<br>安裝目標 | SD or CF card with a minimum of 4 GB, use nano images for installation.<br>SD或CF卡且至少有4個GB，使用nano鏡像進行安裝。 |

表：*最低硬體需求*

Reasonable

合理

This is the reasonable specification to run all OPNsense standard features. It means that every feature is functional, but perhaps not with a lot of users or high loads.

這是運行所有 OPNsense 標準功能的合理規範。這意味著每個功能都是可用的，但可能不適用於大量使用者或高負載。

| --- | --- |

表：*合理的硬體需求*

Recommended

推薦

This is the recommended specification to run all OPNsense standard features. It means that every feature is functional and fits most use cases.

這是運行所有 OPNsense 標準功能的建議規格。這意味著每個功能都是實用的並且適合大多數用例。

Hardware guide

硬體指南

The hardware required for your local OPNsense will be determined by the intended minimum [throughput](#p-054) and feature set.

本地 OPNsense 所需的硬體將由預期的最小[吞吐量](#p-054) 和功能集決定。

#### Impact of Feature set｜功能集的影響

While most features do not affect hardware dimensioning, a few features have a massive impact on it. These include:

雖然大多數功能不會影響硬體尺寸，但少數功能會對硬體尺寸產生巨大影響。這些包括：

[Squid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Squid_\(software\))

[魷魚](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Squid_\(software\))

A caching web proxy which can be used for web-content control. These packages rely strongly on CPU load and disk-cache writes.

可用於 Web 內容控制的快取 Web 代理。這些包強烈依賴於CPU載入和磁碟快取寫入。

[Captive portal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Captive_portal)

[強制門戶](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Captive_portal)

Settings with hundreds of simultaneously served captive portal users will require more CPU power in all the hardware specifications displayed below.

在下面顯示的所有硬體規格中，具有數百個同時服務的強制門戶用戶的設定將需要更多的 CPU 功率。

[State transition tables](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_transition_table)

[狀態轉換表](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_transition_table)

It is a known fact that each state table entry requires about 1 kB (kilobytes) of RAM. The average state table, filled with 1000 entries, will occupy about 1 MB (megabytes) of [RAM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Random-access_memory). OPNsense usage settings with hundreds of thousands of connections will require memory accordingly.

眾所周知，每個狀態表條目需要大約 1 kB（千位元組）的RAM。平均狀態表填入 1000 個條目，將佔用約 1 MB（兆位元組）的 [RAM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Random-access_memory)。具有數十萬個連接的 OPNsense 使用設定將相應地需要記憶體。

  

#### Throughput｜吞吐量

The main hardware factors of the OPNsense setup involved are CPU, RAM, mass storage (disc), the number and quality of network interfaces.

OPNsense 設定涉及的主要硬體因素是CPU, RAM、大容量儲存（磁碟）、網路介面的數量和品質。

Network interface cards

網路介面卡

As the FreeBSD hardware-lists and -recommendations say, Intel® network interface cards (NIC) for [LAN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_area_network) connections are reliable, fast and not error-prone. Intel chipset NICs deliver higher throughput at a reduced [CPU load](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Load_\(computing\)).

如 FreeBSD 硬體清單和建議所述，用於 [LAN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_area_network) 連接的英特爾® 網路介面卡 (NIC) 可靠、快速且不易出錯。 Intel 晶片組 NIC 以減少的 [CPU 負載](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Load_\(computing\)) 提供更高的吞吐量。

Supported hardware

支援的硬體

FreeBSD is the base of OPNsense. All FreeBSD drivers are included in the OPNsense kernel, and the hardware compatibility is the same.

FreeBSD 是 OPNsense 的基礎。所有FreeBSD驅動程式都包含在OPNsense核心中，且硬體相容性是相同的。

#### [Architecture](#p-055)｜[建築](#p-055)

The **software setup** and installation of OPNsense® is available for the [x86-64](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X86-64) microprocessor architecture only.

OPNsense® 的 **軟體設定** 和安裝僅適用於 [x86-64](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/X86-64) 微處理器架構。

#### [Embedded vs Full](#p-055)｜[嵌入式與完整](#p-055)

OPNsense offers two Image types with all major releases: embedded and full images. The Embedded Image is intended for environments where preinstalling the storage media is required due to a lack of local resources on the firewall like storage, and/or console access (VGA/Serial). The image is tailored to reduce write cycles as well, but the image can be used anywhere. Another reason for the Embedded Image is to eliminate the need for local console access for installing OPNsense. Installation is managed by prewriting the image to a storage device, installing the storage device, and booting the system.

OPNsense 為所有主要版本提供兩種影像類型：嵌入式影像和完整影像。嵌入式映像適用於由於防火牆上缺乏儲存和/或控制台存取（VGA/序列）等本機資源而需要預先安裝儲存媒體的環境。該映像也經過定制，可以減少寫入週期，但該映像可以在任何地方使用。使用嵌入式映像的另一個原因是無需本地控制台存取即可安裝 OPNsense。透過將映像預先寫入儲存裝置、安裝儲存裝置並引導系統來管理安裝。

Full Images provide installation tools like OPNsense Importer, Live Environment, and Installer. Full Images are released to support different console/hardware installation requirements.

完整映像檔提供 OPNsense Importer、Live Environment 和 Installer 等安裝工具。發布完整映像以支援不同的控制台/硬體安裝要求。

Both image types can be installed and run from virtual disks (VM), [SD memory cards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Secure_Digital), USB disks, [solid-state disks (SSD)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solid-state_drive), or [hard disk drives (HDD)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hard_disk_drive).

兩種映像類型都可以從虛擬磁碟 (VM)、[SD 記憶卡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Secure_Digital), USB 磁碟、[固態磁碟 (SSD)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Solid-state_drive) 或 [硬碟 (HDD)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hard_disk_drive) 安裝和運行。

The main differences between embedded and full images are:

嵌入圖像和完整圖像之間的主要區別是：

| Embedded<br>嵌入式 | Full<br>完整 |
| --- | --- |
| Writes to RAM disk<br>寫入RAM磁碟 | Writes to local disk<br>寫入本機磁碟 |
| No log data retention after reboot<br>重啟後無日誌資料保留 | Log data retention after reboot<br>重啟後日誌資料保留 |
| Not intended for local disk writes<br>不適用於本機磁碟寫入 | Suitable for disk writes.<br>適合磁碟寫入。 |
| Embedded only use, SWAP file is optional<br>僅限嵌入式使用，SWAP 檔案可選 | Can enable RAM disk for embedded mode.<br>可以啟用RAM磁碟為嵌入式模式。 |

The embedded image stores logging and cache data in memory only, while full versions will keep the data stored on the local drive. A full version can mimic the behavior of an embedded version by enabling RAM disks, which is especially useful for SD memory card installations.

嵌入式映像僅將日誌記錄和快取資料儲存在記憶體中，而完整版本會將資料儲存在本機磁碟機上。完整版本可以透過啟用RAM磁碟來模仿嵌入式版本的行為，這對於SD記憶卡安裝特別有用。

Warning

警告

See the chapter [Hardware Sizing & Setup](#p-054) for further information on hardware requirements prior to an install.

有關安裝前硬體要求的更多信息，請參閱[硬體調整和設定](#p-054)一章。

#### [Installation Images](#p-055)｜[安裝圖](#p-055)

Depending on your hardware and use case, different installation options are available:

根據您的硬體和使用案例，可以使用不同的安裝選項：

| Type<br>類型 | Description<br>描述 | Image Type<br>圖像類型 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dvd<br>DVD | ISO image boots into a live environment in VGA-only mode with UEFI support<br>ISO 映像在VGA-only 模式下啟動到即時環境，並支援 UEFI | Full<br>完整 |
| vga<br>顯示卡 | USB image boots into a live environment in VGA-only mode with UEFI support<br>USB 映像在 VGA-only 模式下啟動到即時環境，並支援 UEFI | Full<br>完整 |
| serial<br>連續劇 | USB image boots into live environment running in serial console (115200) mode only with UEFI support<br>僅在 UEFI 支援的情況下，USB 映像才能啟動到以串行控制台 (115200) 模式運行的實時環境 | Full<br>完整 |
| nano<br>奈米 | Image for preinstalling onto >=4 GB USB drives, SD, or CF cards for use with embedded devices running in serial console (115200) mode with secondary VGA support (no kernel messages though)<br>用於預先安裝到 >=4 GB USB 驅動器、SD 或 CF 卡上的映像，用於在串行控制台 (115200) 模式下運行並具有輔助 VGA 支援的嵌入式設備（儘管沒有內核訊息） | Embedded<br>嵌入式 |

Note

注意事項

All Full Image types can run both [OPNsense Importer](#p-055) before booting into the Live environment and also run [Installer](#p-055) once booted into the Live environment.

所有完整映像類型都可以在啟動到 Live 環境之前運行 [OPNsense Importer](#p-055)，並且在啟動到 Live 環境後也可以運行 [Installer](#p-055)。

Warning

警告

Flash memory cards will only tolerate a limited number of writes and re-writes. For the Nano image, **/var/log** and **/tmp** are memory disks by default to prolong the lifetimes of CF/SD cards and SSDs in special cases.

閃存卡只能承受有限次數的寫入和重新寫入。對於Nano鏡像，**/var/log**和**/tmp**預設為內存盤，以延長特殊情況下CF/SD卡和SSD的使用壽命。

To enable non-embedded versions: Go to System ‣ Settings ‣ Miscellaneous ‣ Disk / Memory Settings, change the setting, then reboot. Consider enabling an external syslog server as well.

若要啟用非嵌入式版本：前往 System ‣ Settings ‣ Miscellaneous ‣ Disk / Memory Settings，變更設置，然後重新啟動。也可以考慮啟用外部系統日誌伺服器。

![](<../images/686ed6d3-blockdiag-005efed8b20c25c636d400ea7793a6.png>)

Note

注意事項

**Please** be aware that the latest installation media does not always correspond with the latest released version available. OPNsense installation images are provided on a scheduled basis with major release versions in January and July. More information on our release schedule is available from our package repository, see [README](https://pkg.opnsense.org/releases/mirror/README). We are encouraged to update OPNsense after installation to be on the latest release available, see [Update Page](#p-057).

**請** 請注意，最新的安裝媒體並不總是與最新發布的可用版本相對應。 OPNsense 安裝映像按計劃提供，主要發布版本為 1 月和 7 月。有關我們的發布計劃的更多信息，請參閱我們的軟體包存儲庫，請參閱 [README](https://pkg.opnsense.org/releases/mirror/README)。我們鼓勵您在安裝後將 OPNsense 更新為可用的最新版本，請參閱[更新頁面](#p-057)。

#### [Download and Verification](#p-055)｜[下載並驗證](#p-055)

The OPNsense distribution can be [downloaded](https://opnsense.org/download) from one of our [mirrors](https://opnsense.org/download).

OPNsense 發行版可以從我們的 [鏡像](https://opnsense.org/download) 之一[下載](https://opnsense.org/download)。

OpenSSL is used for image file verification. 4 files are needed for verification process:

OpenSSL 用於映像檔驗證。驗證過程需要4個文件：

-   The SHA-256 checksum file (<filename>.sha256)  
    SHA-256 校驗與文件 (<filename>.sha256)
    
-   The bzip-compressed image file (<filename>.<image>.bz2)  
    bzip 壓縮的圖片檔案 (<filename>.<image>.bz2)
    
-   The signature file for the uncompressed image file (<filename>.<image>.sig)  
    未壓縮圖片檔案的簽名檔（<filename>.<image>.sig）
    
-   The OpenSSL public key (<filename>.pub)  
    OpenSSL 公鑰 (<filename>.pub)
    

Use one of the OPNsense mirrors to download these files:

使用 OPNsense 鏡像之一下載這些檔案：

1.  Go to the bottom of OPNsense [download](https://opnsense.org/download) page.  
    前往 OPNsense [下載](https://opnsense.org/download) 頁面底部。
    
2.  Click one of the available mirrors closest to your location.  
    點擊距離您所在位置最近的可用鏡子之一。
    
3.  Download one of each file mentioned above for your Image type.  
    根據您的圖像類型下載上述每個檔案之一。
    

The OpenSSL public key (.pub) is required to verify against. Although the file is available on the mirror’s repository, you should not trust the copy there. Download it, open it up, and verify the public key matches the one from other sources. If it does not, the mirror may have been hacked, or you may be the victim of a man-in-the-middle attack. Some other sources to get the public key from include:

需要 OpenSSL 公鑰 (.pub) 進行驗證。儘管該文件在鏡像存儲庫中可用，但您不應信任那裡的副本。下載它，打開它，並驗證公鑰與其他來源的公鑰是否匹配。如果沒有，鏡像可能已被駭客入侵，或者您可能是中間人攻擊的受害者。獲取公鑰的其他一些來源包括：

-   [https://pkg.opnsense.org/releases/mirror/README](https://pkg.opnsense.org/releases/mirror/README)
    
-   [https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?board=11.0](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?board=11.0)
    
-   [https://opnsense.org/blog/](https://opnsense.org/blog/)
    
-   [https://github.com/opnsense/changelog/tree/master/community](https://github.com/opnsense/changelog/tree/master/community)
    
-   [https://pkg.opnsense.org](https://pkg.opnsense.org/) (/<FreeBSD:<version>:<architecture>/<release version>/sets/changelog.txz)
    

Note

注意事項

Only major release announcements for images contain the public key, and update release announcements will not. i.e. 22.1 will have a copy of the public key in the release announcement, but 22.1.9 will not.

只有鏡像的主要發佈公告包含公鑰，更新發佈公告則不會。即22.1將在發佈公告中擁有公鑰副本，但22.1.9不會。

Once you download all the required files and verify that the public key matches the public key found in one of the alternate sources listed above, you can be relatively confident that the key has not been tampered with. To verify the downloaded image, run the following commands (substituting the filenames in brackets for the files you downloaded):

下載所有必需的文件並驗證公鑰是否與上面列出的備用來源之一中找到的公鑰匹配後，您可以相對確信該密鑰沒有被篡改。若要驗證下載的映像，請執行以下命令（用括號中的檔案名稱取代您下載的檔案）：

```
openssl sha256 OPNsense-<filename>.bz2
```

Match the checksum command output with the checksum values in the file `OPNsense-<version>-OpenSSL-checksums-amd64.sha256`. If the checksums don’t match, redownload your image file.

將 checksum 指令輸出與檔案 `OPNsense-<version>-OpenSSL-checksums-amd64.sha256` 中的校驗和值進行比對。如果校驗和不匹配，請重新下載映像檔。

If the checksums match, continue with the verification commands.

如果校驗和匹配，則繼續執行驗證命令。

```
openssl base64 -d -in OPNsense-<filename>.<image>.sig -out /tmp/image.sig
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify OPNsense-<filename>.pub -signature /tmp/image.sig OPNsense-<filename>.<image>
```

Warning

警告

Make sure to unpack the image using `bunzip2` before verifying. Our signatures are generated before compressing them (as of OPNsense version 24.1)

確保在驗證之前使用`bunzip2`解壓鏡像。我們的簽名是在壓縮之前產生的（從 OPNsense 版本 24.1 開始）

If the output of the second command is “**Verified OK**”, your image file was verified successfully, and it is safe to install from it. Any other outputs, and you may need to check your commands for errors, or the image file may have been compromised.

如果第二個指令的輸出是“**Verified OK**”，則您的映像檔已成功驗證，可以安全地從中進行安裝。任何其他輸出，您可能需要檢查命令是否有錯誤，或者圖像檔案可能已洩露。

#### [Installation Media](#p-055)｜[安裝媒體](#p-055)

Now that you have downloaded and verified the installation image from above, you must unpack the image file before you can write the image to disk. For Unix-like OSes use the following command:

現在您已經從上面下載並驗證了安裝映像，您必須先解壓縮映像文件，然後才能將映像寫入磁碟。對於類別 Unix 作業系統，請使用下列命令：

```
bzip2 -d OPNsense-<filename>.bz2
```

For Windows use an application like [7zip](https://www.7-zip.org/download.html). The `.bz2` will be removed from the end of the filename after command/application completes.

對於 Windows，請使用 [7zip](https://www.7-zip.org/download.html) 等應用程式。命令/應用程式完成後，`.bz2`將從檔案名稱末尾刪除。

After unpacking the image you can create the installation media. The easiest method to install OPNsense is to use the USB “[vga](#p-055)” Image. If your target platform has a serial console interface choose the “[serial](#p-055)” image. If you need to know more about using the serial console interface, consult the [serial access how-to](#p-060).

解壓縮映像後，您可以建立安裝媒體。安裝 OPNsense 最簡單的方法是使用 USB “[vga](#p-055)” 映像。如果您的目標平台有序列控制台接口，請選擇「[serial](#p-055)」映像。如果您需要了解有關使用串行控制台介面的更多信息，請參閱[串行存取操作方法](#p-060)。

Write the image to a USB flash drive (>=1 GB) or hard disk, using either dd for Unix-like OSes or, for Windows, physdiskwrite, [Etcher](https://www.balena.io/etcher#download-etcher), or [Rufus](https://rufus.ie/).

將映像寫入 USB 隨身碟 (>=1 GB) 或硬碟，對於類 Unix 作業系統使用 dd，對於 Windows，使用 physdiskwrite、[Etcher](https://www.balena.io/etcher#download-etcher) 或 [Rufus](https://rufus.ie/)。

**FreeBSD**

**免費BSD**

```
dd if=OPNsense-##.#.##-[Type]-[Architecture].img of=/dev/daX bs=16k
```

Where X = the device number of your USB flash drive (check `dmesg`)

其中 X = USB 快閃磁碟機的裝置編號（檢查`dmesg`）

**OpenBSD**

**開放BSD**

```
dd if=OPNsense-##.#.##-[Type]-[Architecture].img of=/dev/rsd6c bs=16k
```

The device must be the ENTIRE device (in Windows/DOS language: the ‘C’ partition), and a raw I/O device (the ‘r’ in front of the device “sd6”), not a block mode device.

該裝置必須是 ENTIRE 裝置（在 Windows/DOS 語言中：「C」分割區）和原始 I/O 裝置（裝置「sd6」前方的「r」），而不是區塊模式裝置。

**Linux**

```bash
sudo dd if=OPNsense-##.#.##-[Type]-[Architecture].img of=/dev/sdX bs=16k
```

where X = the IDE device name of your USB flash drive (check with hdparm -i /dev/sdX) (ignore the warning about trailing garbage - it’s because of the digital signature)

其中 X = USB 快閃磁碟機的 IDE 裝置名稱（使用 hdparm -i /dev/sdX 檢查）（忽略有關尾隨垃圾的警告 - 這是因為數位簽章）

**macOS**

```bash
sudo dd if=OPNsense-##.#.##-[Type]-[Architecture].img of=/dev/rdiskX bs=64k
```

where r = raw device, and where X = the disk device number of your CF card (check Disk Utility) (ignore the warning about trailing garbage - it’s because of the digital signature)

其中 r = 原始設備，X = CF 卡的磁碟設備號碼（檢查「磁碟工具」）（忽略有關尾隨垃圾的警告 - 這是因為數位簽章）

**Windows**

```
physdiskwrite -u OPNsense-##.#.##-[Type]-[Architecture].img
```

(use v0.3 or later!)

（使用v0.3或更高版本！）

#### [System Boot Preparation](#p-055)｜[系統啟動準備](#p-055)

After preparing the installation media, we need to make sure we can access the console (either via keyboard and \[virtual\]monitor or [serial connectivity](#p-060)). Next we need to know how to access the boot menu or the system BIOS (UEFI) to boot from the installation media. In most cases, it will be a function (F#), Del, or ESC key that needs to pressed immediately after powering on (or rebooting) the system. Usually within the first 2 to 3 seconds from powering up.

準備好安裝媒體後，我們需要確保可以存取控制台（透過鍵盤和\[虛擬\]顯示器或[序列連接](#p-060)）。接下來我們需要知道如何存取啟動選單或系統BIOS（UEFI）以從安裝媒體啟動。在大多數情況下，它是一個功能鍵 (F#)、Del 或 ESC 鍵，需要在開啟（或重新引導）系統後立即按下。通常在通電後的前 2 至 3 秒內。

Tip

提示

OPNsense devices from the [OPNsense shop](https://shop.opnsense.com/) use `<ESC>` to enter the BIOS and boot selection options.

[OPNsense 商店](https://shop.opnsense.com/) 的 OPNsense 設備使用 `<ESC>` 進入BIOS 和啟動選擇選項。

Note

注意事項

Serial connectivity settings for DECXXXX devices can be found [here](#p-067)

DECXXXX 設備的串列連接設定可以在[此處](#p-067) 找到

#### [Installation Instructions](#p-055)｜[安裝說明](#p-055)

Install Instructions

安裝說明

OPNsense installation boot process allows us to run several optional configuration steps. The boot process was designed to always boot into the live environment, allowing us to access the GUI or even SSH directly. If a timeout was missed, restart the boot procedure.

OPNsense 安裝引導程序可讓我們執行幾個可選的設定步驟。啟動過程被設計為始終啟動到實時環境，允許我們直接訪問GUI甚至SSH。如果逾時，請重新啟動啟動程序。

##### [OPNsense Importer](#p-055)｜[OPNsense 導入器](#p-055)

All Full Images have the OPNsense Importer feature that offers flexibility in recovering failed firewalls, testing new releases without overwriting the current installation by running the new version in memory with the existing configuration or migrating configurations to new hardware installations. Using Importer is slightly different between previous installs with existing configurations on disk vs new installations/migrations.

所有完整映像都具有 OPNsense 導入器功能，可靈活恢復失敗的防火牆、透過在記憶體中使用現有配置運行新版本或將配置遷移到新硬體安裝來測試新版本，而無需覆蓋當前安裝。使用導入器在磁碟上現有配置的先前安裝與新安裝/遷移之間略有不同。

For systems that have OPNsense installed and the configuration intact, here is the process:

對於已安裝 OPNsense 且配置完好的系統，流程如下：

1.  Boot the system with installation media  
    使用安裝媒體引導系統
    
2.  Press any key when you see **“Press any key to start the configuration importer”**.  
    當您看到 **「按任意鍵啟動配置導入程式」** 時，請按任意鍵。
    
    1.  If you see the login prompt, you have passed the importer and will need to reboot.  
        如果您看到登入提示，則表示您已通過匯入程序，需要重新啟動。
        
3.  Type the device name of the existing drive that contains the configuration and press enter.  
    輸入包含配置的現有磁碟機的裝置名稱，然後按 Enter 鍵。
    
4.  If Importer is successful, the boot process will continue into the live environment using the stored configuration on disk.  
    如果導入程式成功，引導程序將使用磁碟上儲存的配置繼續進入即時環境。
    
5.  If Importer was unsuccessful, we will be returned to the device selection prompt. Confirm the device name is correct and try again. Otherwise, there may be possible disk corruption and restoring from backup.  
    如果導入程式不成功，我們將返回到設備選擇提示。確認設備名稱正確並重試。否則，可能會出現磁碟損壞並從備份還原的情況。
    

At this point, the system will boot up with a fully functional firewall in live environment using existing configuration but will not overwrite the previous installation. Use this feature for safely previewing or testing upgrades.

此時，系統將使用現有配置在即時環境中啟動功能齊全的防火牆，但不會覆蓋先前的安裝。使用此功能可以安全地預覽或測試升級。

For new installations or migrations, follow this process:

對於新安裝或遷移，請遵循以下流程：

1.  We must have a 2nd USB drive formatted with FAT or FAT32 File system.  
    我們必須有一個使用 FAT 或 FAT32 檔案系統格式化的第二個 USB 驅動器。
    
    1.  Preferable non-bootable USB drive.  
        首選不可啟動的USB驅動器。
        
2.  Create a **conf** directory on the root of the USB drive  
    在 USB 磁碟機的根目錄下建立 **conf** 目錄
    
3.  Place an *unencrypted* <downloaded backup>.xml into /conf and rename the file to **config.xml** (`/conf/config.xml`)  
    將 *未加密的* <downloaded backup>.xml 放入 /conf 並將檔案重新命名為 **config.xml** (`/conf/config.xml`)
    
4.  Put both the Installation media and the 2nd USB drive into the system and power up / reboot.  
    將安裝媒體和第二個USB驅動器放入系統中並啟動/重新啟動。
    
5.  Boot the system from the OPNsense Installation media via Boot Menu or BIOS (UEFI).  
    透過啟動選單或BIOS (UEFI) 從 OPNsense 安裝媒體啟動系統。
    
6.  Press any key when you see: **“Press any key to start the configuration importer”**  
    當您看到：**「按任一鍵啟動配置導入程式」時，請按任一鍵**
    
7.  Type the device name of the 2nd USB Drive, e.g. da0 or nvd0 , and press Enter.  
    輸入第二個USB驅動器的裝置名稱，例如da0 或 nvd0 ，然後按 Enter。
    
    1.  If Importer is successful, the boot process will continue into the Live environment using the configuration stored on the USB drive.  
        如果導入程式成功，引導程序將使用儲存在USB磁碟機上的設定繼續進入即時環境。
        
    2.  If unsuccessful, the importer will error and return to the device selection prompt. In this case, repeat steps 1-3 again.  
        如果不成功，導入器將出錯並返回到裝置選擇提示。在這種情況下，請再次重複步驟 1-3。
        

##### [Live Environment](#p-055)｜[生活環境](#p-055)

![../_images/opnsense_liveenv.png](<../images/5531e393-opnsense_liveenv.png>)

After booting with an OPNsense Full Image (DVD, VGA, Serial), the firewall will be in the Live environment with and without the use of OPNsense Importer. We can interact with the Live environment via Local Console, GUI (HTTPS), or SSH.

使用 OPNsense 完整映像（DVD, VGA、序列）啟動後，無論是否使用 OPNsense 導入器，防火牆都會處於即時環境中。我們可以透過本地控制台、GUI（HTTPS）或SSH與Live環境互動。

By default, we can log into the shell using the user `root` with the password `opnsense` to operate the live environment via the local console.

預設情況下，我們可以使用使用者`root`和密碼`opnsense`登入shell，透過本機控制台操作即時環境。

The GUI is accessible at [https://192.168.1.1/](https://192.168.1.1/) using Username: `root` Password: `opnsense` by default (unless a previous configuration was imported).

預設情況下，可以使用使用者名稱：`root`密碼：`opnsense`在[https://192.168.1.1/](https://192.168.1.1/)訪問GUI（除非匯入了先前的設定）。

Using SSH we can access the firewall at IP **192.168.1.1** . Both the **root** and **installer** users are available with the password specified above.

使用 SSH 我們可以存取位於 IP **192.168.1.1**的防火牆。**root**和**installer** 使用者都可以使用上面指定的密碼。

Note

注意事項

The installation media is read-only, which means your current live configuration will be lost after reboot.

安裝媒體是唯讀的，這表示您目前的即時配置將在重新啟動後遺失。

Continue to [OPNsense Installer](#p-055) to install OPNsense to the local storage device.

繼續 [OPNsense 安裝程序](#p-055) 將 OPNsense 安裝到本機儲存裝置。

##### [OPNsense Installer](#p-055)｜[OPNsense 安裝程序](#p-055)

Note

注意事項

To invoke the installer, log in with user **installer** and password **opnsense**

若要呼叫安裝程序，請使用使用者 **installer**和密碼**opnsense** 登入

After successfully booting up with the OPNsense Full Image (DVD, VGA, Serial), the firewall will be at the Live Environment’s login: prompt. To start the installation process, login with the user `installer` and password `opnsense`. If Importer was used to import an existing configuration, the installer and root user password will be the root password from the imported configuration.

使用 OPNsense 完整映像（DVD, VGA，串列）成功啟動後，防火牆將出現在即時環境的登入：提示字元處。若要開始安裝流程，請使用使用者`installer`和密碼`opnsense`登入。如果使用導入程式導入現有配置，則安裝者和 root 使用者密碼將是導入配置中的 root 密碼。

If the installer user does not work, log in as user root and select: `8) Shell` from the menu and type `opnsense-installer`. The `opnsense-importer` can also be run this way should you need to rerun the import.

如果安裝程式使用者不起作用，請以 root 使用者身分登錄，然後從選單中選擇：`8) Shell`，然後輸入`opnsense-installer`。如果您需要重新執行匯入，也可以透過這種方式執行 `opnsense-importer`。

The installer can always be run to clone an existing system, even for Nano images. This can be useful for creating live backups for later recovery.

始終可以運行安裝程式來克隆現有系統，甚至對於 Nano 映像也是如此。這對於建立即時備份以供以後恢復非常有用。

Tip

提示

The installer can also be started from an internal host using SSH. The default IP address is `192.168.1.1`

也可以使用 SSH 從內部主機啟動安裝程式。預設IP位址為`192.168.1.1`

Attention

注意

When installing an appliance with SD or MMC flash card storage, ensure you select the UFS filesystem and choose `mmcsd0` in the Disk Selection. Do not choose `da0` as that is the USB drive. As an example, this is applicable to the DEC677 Desktop Security Appliance.

安裝具有 SD 或 MMC 快閃記憶體卡儲存的裝置時，請確保選擇 UFS 檔案系統，並在磁碟選擇中選擇 `mmcsd0`。不要選擇`da0`，因為它是USB 驅動器。例如，這適用於DEC677桌面安全設備。

The installation process involves the following steps:

安裝過程包括以下步驟：

1.  Keymap selection - The default configuration should be fine for most occasions.  
    鍵映射選擇 - 預設配置應該適合大多數情況。
    
2.  Install (UFS|ZFS) - Choose UFS or ZFS filesystem. ZFS is in most cases the best option as it is the most reliable option, but it does require enough capacity (a couple of gigabytes at least).  
    安裝 (UFS|ZFS) - 選擇 UFS 或 ZFS 檔案系統。 ZFS 在大多數情況下是最好的選擇，因為它是最可靠的選擇，但它確實需要足夠的容量（至少幾千兆位元組）。
    
3.  Partitioning (ZFS) - Choose a device type. The default option (stripe) is usually acceptable when using a single disk.  
    分區 (ZFS) - 選擇設備類型。使用單一磁碟時，預設選項（條帶）通常是可以接受的。
    
4.  Disk Selection (ZFS) - Select the Storage device e.g. `da0` or `nvd0`  
    磁碟選擇 (ZFS) - 選擇儲存設備，例如`da0` 或 `nvd0`
    
5.  Last Chance! - Select Yes to continue with partitioning and to format the disk. However, doing so will **destroy** the contents of the disk.  
    最後的機會！ - 選擇「是」繼續分割區並格式化磁碟。但是，這樣做會**破壞**磁碟的內容。
    
6.  Continue with recommended swap (UFS) - Yes is usually fine here unless the install target is very small (< 16GB)  
    繼續使用建議的交換 (UFS) - 此處「是」通常沒問題，除非安裝目標非常小（< 16GB）
    
7.  Select Root Password - Change and confirm the new root password  
    選擇 Root 密碼 - 更改並確認新的 root 密碼
    
8.  Select Complete Install - Exits the installer and reboots the machine. The system is now installed and ready for initial configuration.  
    選擇完整安裝 - 退出安裝程式並重新啟動電腦。系統現已安裝並準備好進行初始設定。
    

Warning

警告

You will lose all files on the installation disk. If another disk is to be used then choose a Custom installation instead of the Quick/Easy Install.

您將會遺失安裝盤上的所有檔案。如果要使用另一個磁碟，則選擇自訂安裝而不是快速/輕鬆安裝。

##### [Nano Image](#p-055)｜[奈米影像](#p-055)

To use the nano image follow this process:

要使用奈米圖像，請遵循以下過程：

1.  Create the system disk by using the Nano image. See [Installation Media](#p-055) how to write the nano image to disk.  
    使用Nano鏡像建立系統磁碟。請參閱[安裝媒體](#p-055)如何將nano鏡像寫入磁碟。
    
2.  Install the system disk drive into the system.  
    將系統磁碟機安裝到系統中。
    
3.  Configure the system (BIOS) to boot from this disk.  
    將系統 (BIOS) 配置為從此磁碟啟動。
    
4.  After the system boots, the firewall is ready to be configured.  
    系統啟動後，防火牆就可以進行設定了。
    

Using the nano image for embedded systems, your firewall is already up and running. The configuration settings to enable Memory Disks (RAM disks) that minimize write cycles to relevant partitions by mounting these partitions in system memory and reporting features are disabled by default.

使用嵌入式系統的奈米映像，您的防火牆已經啟動並運行。預設情況下，停用記憶體磁碟（RAM 磁碟）的配置設置，透過將這些分割區掛載到系統記憶體中來最小化相關分割區的寫入週期，並且報告功能處於停用狀態。

#### [Initial Configuration](#p-055)｜[初始配置](#p-055)

After installation, the system will prompt you for the interface assignment. If you ignore this, then the default settings will be applied. Installation ends with the login prompt.

安裝完成後，系統會提示您進行介面分配。如果您忽略這一點，則將套用預設設定。安裝以登入提示結束。

By default you have to log in to enter the console.

預設情況下，您必須登入才能進入控制台。

**Welcome message**

**歡迎留言**

```yaml
* * * Welcome to OPNsense [OPNsense 15.7.25 (amd64/OpenSSL) on OPNsense * * *

WAN (em1)     -> v4/DHCP4: 192.168.2.100/24
LAN (em0)     -> v4: 192.168.1.1/24

FreeBSD/10.1 (OPNsense.localdomain) (ttyv0)

login:
```

Tip

提示

A user can login to the console menu with his credentials. The default credentials after a fresh install are username “root” and password “opnsense”.

使用者可以使用其憑證登入控制台選單。全新安裝後的預設憑證是使用者名稱「root」和密碼「opnsense」。

VLANs and assigning interfaces

VLAN 和分配介面

If you choose to do manual interface assignment or when no config file can be found then you are asked to assign Interfaces and VLANs. VLANs are optional. If you do not need VLANs then choose **no**. You can always configure VLANs at a later time.

如果您選擇手動指派介面或找不到設定文件，系統會要求您指派介面和 VLAN。 VLAN 是選購的。如果您不需要 VLAN，則選擇**否**。您始終可以稍後配置 VLAN。

LAN, WAN and optional interfaces

LAN, WAN及可選接口

The first interface is the LAN interface. Type the appropriate interface name, for example “em0”. The second interface is the WAN interface. Type the appropriate interface name, e.g. “em1” . Possible additional interfaces can be assigned as OPT interfaces. If you assigned all your interfaces you can press \[ENTER\] and confirm the settings. OPNsense will configure your system and present the login prompt when finished.

第一個接口是LAN接口。鍵入適當的介面名稱，例如“em0”。第二個接口是WAN接口。輸入適當的介面名稱，例如“em1”。可能的附加介面可指派為OPT 介面。如果您指派了所有接口，您可以按\[ENTER\]並確認設定。 OPNsense 將設定您的系統並在完成後顯示登入提示。

Minimum installation actions

最少的安裝操作

In case of a minimum install setup (i.e. on CF cards), OPNsense can be run with all standard features, except for the ones that require disk writes, e.g. a caching proxy like Squid. Do not create a swap slice, but a RAM Disk instead. In the GUI enable System ‣ Settings ‣ Miscellaneous ‣ RAM Disk Settings and set the size to 100-128 MB or more, depending on your available RAM. Afterwards reboot.

如果是最低安裝設定（即在CF卡上），OPNsense 可以使用所有標準功能運行，但需要磁碟寫入的功能除外，例如像 Squid 這樣的快取代理。不要建立交換片，而是建立 RAM 磁碟。在GUI中啟用系統‣設定‣雜項‣RAM磁碟設定並將大小設為100-128MB或更大，取決於您可用的RAM。之後重新啟動。

**Enable RAM disk manually**

**手動啟用RAM磁碟**

[![../_images/Screenshot_Use_RAMdisks.png](<../images/adf8cae3-Screenshot_Use_RAMdisks.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/Screenshot_Use_RAMdisks.png)

Then via console, check your /etc/fstab and make sure your primary partition has **rw,noatime** instead of just **rw**.

然後透過控制台，檢查您的 /etc/fstab 並確保您的主分區有 **rw,noatime**而不是只有**rw**。

Console

安慰

The console menu shows 13 options.

控制台選單顯示 13 個選項。

```
0)     Logout                              7)      Ping host
1)     Assign interfaces                   8)      Shell
2)     Set interface(s) IP address         9)      pfTop
3)     Reset the root password             10)     Filter logs
4)     Reset to factory defaults           11)     Restart web interface
5)     Reboot system                       12)     Upgrade from console
6)     Halt system                         13)     Restore a configuration
```

Table: *The console menu*

表：*控制台選單*

opnsense-update

opsense-更新

OPNsense features a command line interface (CLI) tool “opnsense-update”. Via menu option **8) Shell**, the user can get to the shell and use opnsense-update.

OPNsense 具有命令列介面 (CLI) 工具「opnsense-update」。透過選單選項 **8) Shell**，使用者可以存取 shell 並使用 opnsense-update。

For help, type *man opnsense-update* and press \[Enter\].

如需協助，請輸入 *man opnsense-update* 並按 \[Enter\]。

Upgrade from console

從控制台升級

The other method to upgrade the system is via console option **12) Upgrade from console**

升級系統的另一種方法是透過控制台選項 **12) 從控制台升級**

GUI

An update can be done through the GUI via System ‣ Firmware ‣ Updates.

可透過系統‣韌體‣更新透過GUI完成更新。

[![../_images/firmware-update.png](<../images/892d702d-firmware-update.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/firmware-update.png)

---

<a id="p-056"></a>

### Virtual & Cloud-Based Installation｜虛擬和基於雲端的安裝

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/virtuals.html>

#### Local/Server｜本地/伺服器

Installing OPNsense on a virtual machine can be done by using the DVD ISO image. Full instructions are available in chapter [Initial Installation & Configuration](#p-055).

可使用 DVD ISO 映像在虛擬機器上安裝 OPNsense。完整說明可在[初始安裝和設定](#p-055)一章中找到。

##### General tips｜一般提示

For optimal performance and compatibility, consider the following guidelines:

為了獲得最佳效能和相容性，請考慮以下準則：

-   Minimum required RAM is 3 GB  
    最少需要 RAM 為 3 GB
    
-   Minimum recommended virtual disk size of 8 GB  
    建議的最小虛擬磁碟大小為 8 GB
    
-   Disable all hardware off-loading settings in Interfaces ‣ Settings  
    在 Interfaces ‣ Settings 中停用所有硬體卸載設定
    

![../_images/disableoffloading.png](<../images/566c4c4b-disableoffloading.png>)

##### VMware ESXi

VMware offers full instructions for installing FreeBSD, which can be found [here](https://partnerweb.vmware.com/GOSIG/FreeBSD_14x.html).

VMware 提供了安裝 FreeBSD 的完整說明，可以在[此處](https://partnerweb.vmware.com/GOSIG/FreeBSD_14x.html) 找到。

To install VMware Tools, go to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins and install **os-vmware** by clicking on the **+** sign next to it.

若要安裝 VMware Tools，請前往 System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins，然後按一下旁邊的 **+**符號來安裝**os-vmware**。

![../_images/os-vmware.png](<../images/4cb52ee1-os-vmware.png>)

Note

注意事項

While other network setups may work fine, it is recommended to use VMXNET3 according to VMware’s Compatibility Guide.

雖然其他網路設定可能運作正常，但建議根據 VMware 相容性指南使用VMXNET3。

##### Xen

To install Xen tools, go to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins (tick **Show (Tier 3) community plugins**) and install **os-xen** by clicking on the **+** sign next to it.

若要安裝 Xen 工具，請前往 System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins（勾選 **顯示（第 3 層）社群外掛程式**）並透過點擊旁邊的**+**符號來安裝**os-xen**。

![../_images/os-xen.png](<../images/0915b8f6-os-xen.png>)

##### Hyper-V｜超V

Both Hyper-V Generation 1 and 2 virtual machines are supported out of the box with no additional drivers or tools needed.

Hyper-V 第 1 代和第 2 代虛擬機均受開箱即用支持，無需額外的驅動程式或工具。

Note

注意事項

Secure Boot must be disabled in the Hardware > Security section of the VM.

必須在 VM 的硬體 > 安全性部分停用安全啟動。

##### KVM

To install QEMU Guest Agent, go to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins (tick **Show (Tier 3) community plugins**) and install **os-qemu-guest-agent** by clicking on the **+** sign next to it.

若要安裝 QEMU Guest Agent，請前往系統 ‣ 韌體 ‣ 外掛程式（勾選 **顯示（第 3 層）社群外掛程式**）並透過點擊旁邊的**+**符號來安裝**os-qemu-guest-agent**。

**KVM chipsets** OPNsense (based on FreeBSD) supports running under both the legacy i440FX machine type and the newer Q35 chipset.

**KVM 晶片組** OPNsense（基於 FreeBSD）支援在舊版 i440FX 機器類型和較新的 Q35 晶片組下運作。

##### Others｜其他

OPNsense can be installed on all hypervisors that support FreeBSD (such as Bhyve or VirtualBox).

OPNsense 可以安裝在所有支援 FreeBSD 的虛擬機器管理程式（例如 Bhyve 或 VirtualBox）上。

Note: to install VirtualBox Guest Additions, go to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins (tick **Show (Tier 3) community plugins**) and install **os-virtualbox** by clicking on the **+** sign next to it.

注意：要安裝 VirtualBox Guest Additions，請前往 System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins（勾選 **顯示（第 3 層）社群外掛程式**）並透過點擊旁邊的**+**符號來安裝**os-virtualbox**。

##### Hosted｜主辦

For hosted installations where you cannot install using the DVD ISO, an alternative approach is available in the form of **opnsense-bootstrap**.

對於無法使用 DVD ISO 安裝的託管安裝，可以使用 **opnsense-bootstrap** 形式的替代方法。

##### opnsense-bootstrap｜opsense-引導程序

opnsense-bootstrap(8) is a tool that can completely reinstall a running system in place for a thorough factory reset or to restore consistency of all the OPNsense files. It can also wipe the configuration directory, but won’t do that by default.

opnsense-bootstrap(8) 是一個工具，可以完全重新安裝正在運行的系統，以實現徹底的出廠重置或恢復所有 OPNsense 檔案的一致性。它還可以擦除配置目錄​​，但預設不會這樣做。

It will automatically pick up the latest available version and build a chain of trust by using current package fingerprints -> CA root certificates -> HTTPS -> OPNsense package fingerprints.

它將自動選擇最新的可用版本，並使用當前包指紋 -> CA 根證書 -> HTTPS -> OPNsense 包指紋構建信任鏈。

What it will also do is turn a supported stock FreeBSD release into an OPNsense installation. Both UFS and ZFS installations are supported.

它還將要做的是將受支援的 FreeBSD 庫存版本轉換為 OPNsense 安裝。支援UFS和ZFS安裝。

opnsense-bootstrap is available at our [GitHub source repository](https://github.com/opnsense/update)

opnsense-bootstrap 可在我們的 [GitHub 來源儲存庫](https://github.com/opnsense/update) 取得

#### Amazon AWS EC2 Cloud｜亞馬遜AWS EC2雲

[![../_images/amazon-web-services.png](<../images/84fe639e-amazon-web-services.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/amazon-web-services.png)

Installing OPNsense in Amazon Web Services can be a daunting task as no console is offered. Luckily, an easy-to-install AMI is available in the AWS Marketplace.

在 Amazon Web Services 中安裝 OPNsense 可能是一項艱鉅的任務，因為不提供控制台。幸運的是，AWS Marketplace 中提供了易於安裝的AMI。

See our how-to for [Installing OPNsense AWS image](#p-061).

請參閱我們的[安裝 OPNsense AWS 圖像](#p-061) 的操作方法。

#### Microsoft Azure｜微軟Azure

[![../_images/Azure.png](<../images/097b738f-Azure.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/Azure.png)

OPNsense is available in the Microsoft Azure Marketplace as an easily installable virtual appliance.

OPNsense 在 Microsoft Azure Marketplace 中作為易於安裝的虛擬設備提供。

See our how-to for [OPNsense Azure Virtual Appliance](#p-063).

請參閱我們的 [OPNsense Azure 虛擬設備](#p-063) 操作方法。

#### Common Issues｜常見問題

Some common issues have been reported for different virtual environments. You can find known solutions to these problems below.

針對不同的虛擬環境報告了一些常見問題。您可以在下面找到這些問題的已知解決方案。

If your problem is not listed, always try the General tips mentioned in this article first.

如果您的問題未列出，請務必先嘗試本文中提到的一般提示。

##### File copy failed during installation｜安裝期間檔案複製失敗

This issue is most likely caused by a low memory setting. Make sure your virtual OPNsense installation has a minimum of 3 GB of RAM.

此問題很可能是由記憶體設定較低引起的。確保您的虛擬 OPNsense 安裝至少有 3 個 GB 或 RAM。

##### Disk Errors on VMware｜VMware 上的磁碟錯誤

This issue can be caused by a defective drive. Changing the drive mode to IDE has been reported to help for certain ESXi versions.

此問題可能是由有缺陷的驅動器引起的。根據報告，將磁碟機模式變更為 IDE 對某些 ESXi 版本有幫助。

##### NAT / performance issues on XenServer/XCP-NG｜NAT / XenServer 上的效能問題/XCP-NG

This issue has been reported to be solved by disabling TX checksum offloading on Vifs (only there, not also in OPNsense DomU) - for details see this [documentation](https://docs.xcp-ng.org/guides/pfsense/#3-disable-tx-checksum-offload).

據報道，此問題可透過在 Vifs 上停用 TX 校驗和卸載來解決（僅在 Vifs 上，不在 OPNsense DomU 中） - 有關詳細信息，請參閱此 [文件](https://docs.xcp-ng.org/guides/pfsense/#3-disable-tx-checksum-offload)。

##### Traffic Shaper does not work on VMware｜流量整形器不適用於 VMware

If you are using the VMXNET3 driver, try switching to E1000 instead.

如果您使用的是 VMXNET3 驅動程序，請嘗試切換到 E1000。

---

<a id="p-057"></a>

### Updates｜更新

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/updates.html>

The OPNsense update schedule consists of two major releases each year, which receive minor updates about every two weeks. The major release version number consists of the year and month of release (e.g. 25.1 for the January 2025 release), with the fortnightly minor updates adding a third number (e.g. 25.1.3 for the third update to 25.1).

OPNsense 更新計劃每年包括兩個主要版本，大約每兩週收到一次小更新。主要版本號由發布年份和月份組成（例如 25.1 表示 2025 年 1 月版本），每兩週一次的次要更新添加了第三個數字（例如 25.1.3 表示 25.1 的第三次更新）。

#### Update settings｜更新設定

By navigating to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Settings, you can influence the firmware update settings:

透過導覽至 System ‣ Firmware ‣ Settings，您可以影響韌體更新設定：

-   **Firmware Mirror:** this influences where OPNsense tries to get its updates from. If you have trouble updating or searching for updates, or if your current mirror is running slowly, you can change it here.  
    **韌體鏡像：** 這會影響 OPNsense 嘗試從中取得更新的位置。如果您在更新或搜尋更新時遇到問題，或者當前的鏡像運行緩慢，您可以在此處進行更改。
    
-   **Release Type:** this switches between the regular fortnightly schedule of tested releases (Production) or the newest, not fully tested code (Development). **Please leave this setting on “Production”（生產）, unless you fully understand the implications of switching.**  
    **發布類型：**這在每兩週定期的測試版本（生產）或最新的、未完全測試的程式碼（開發）之間切換。**請將此設定保留為“Production”（生產），除非您完全理解切換的含義。 **
    

Tip

提示

The settings page is also the place where you can run audits which help in debugging common connectivity issues. Just press “Run an audit” and choose “Connectivity”（連接性） from the list if you encounter issues with the remote server.

設定頁面也是您可以運行審核的地方，這有助於調試常見的連接問題。如果您遇到遠端伺服器問題，只需按下「執行審核」並從清單中選擇“Connectivity”（連接性）即可。

#### Minor updates｜小更新

Updates can be installed from the web interface by going to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Status. On this page, you can click **Check for updates** to search for updates. If they are available, a button will appear asking to install them.

可以透過 Web 介面安裝更新，方法是前往 System ‣ Firmware ‣ Status。在此頁面上，您可以點擊「**檢查更新**」來搜尋更新。如果它們可用，則會出現一個按鈕，要求安裝它們。

#### Major Upgrades｜主要升級

Major upgrades are recommended to be done via a VGA display or serial console so you can see what is going on.

建議透過VGA顯示器或序列控制台完成主要升級，以便您可以看到正在發生的情況。

Note

注意事項

You can find documentation about serial access under [Serial Access](#p-060)

您可以在[串行訪問](#p-060)下找到有關串行訪問的文檔

Warning

警告

Major updates are installed offline. This means no web or SSH server is running for you to monitor the upgrade. If something fails, you will need a secondary connection or direct access to revert to a snapshot or repair the installation.

主要更新是離線安裝的。這意味著沒有運行網路或SSH伺服器來監控升級。如果發生故障，您將需要輔助連線或直接存取來恢復快照或修復安裝。

If you choose option 12 on the console menu on latest release, you are asked if you want to upgrade to the newest version or to the next major release. Type in the major release number (for example “19.1”) and press enter. OPNsense will download all release files for an offline upgrade (kernel, packages etc.) and reboot afterwards.

如果您在最新版本的控制台選單上選擇選項 12，系統會詢問您是否要升級到最新版本或下一個主要版本。輸入主要版本號（例如“19.1”）並按 Enter 鍵。 OPNsense 將下載所有版本檔案以進行離線升級（核心、軟體包等），然後重新啟動。

After the reboot, it will install all updates and when it is done, it will reboot again. You should then be on the desired release.

重新啟動後，它將安裝所有更新，完成後，它將再次重新啟動。然後您應該就可以使用所需的版本了。

---

<a id="p-058"></a>

### Included software｜附軟體

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/software_included.html>

OPNsense® comes with a lot of features included in the base system, for some situations you may need additional software, which is either provided via a plugin or only as a binary package (without user interface).

OPNsense® 的基本系統中包含許多功能，在某些情況下，您可能需要額外的軟體，這些軟體要么透過插件提供，要么僅作為二進位套件（沒有使用者介面）提供。

This chapter aims to provide some details on the components included in the system, where to find them and how to install them when not installed by default.

本章旨在提供有關係統中包含的組件的一些詳細資訊、在哪裡可以找到它們以及默認情況下未安裝它們時如何安裝它們。

#### The operating system｜作業系統

The basic ([FreeBSD](https://www.freebsd.org/)) system contains a kernel and a base package, which provide the bare essentials for the system to be able to boot and do its work.

基本（[FreeBSD](https://www.freebsd.org/)）系統包含一個核心和一個基礎包，它們為系統提供了啟動和工作的基本要素。

Both components are updated using `opnsense-update`, which is explained in more detail [here](#p-075).

這兩個組件均使用`opnsense-update`進行更新，[此處](#p-075)對此進行了更詳細的解釋。

#### Plugins｜外掛

Plugins are packages offered by OPNsense®, which can be installed directly via the user interface and often come with setup options accessible for the end-user.

插件是 OPNsense® 提供的軟體包，可直接透過使用者介面安裝，並且通常附帶最終用戶可以存取的設定選項。

Since OPNsense® is a community-driven project, the amount of (community/commercial) support available on these plugins can be different.

由於 OPNsense® 是一個由社區驅動的項目，因此這些插件提供的（社區/商業）支援量可能有所不同。

Note

注意事項

The plugin repository is maintained by the project, when plugins are not kept up to date by its maintainer, they will be removed at some point in time. (a good example for such a plugin would be if one requires python 2 and we stop shipping it due to upstream deprecation)

插件儲存庫由專案維護，當插件未由其維護者保持最新時，它們將在某個時間點被刪除。 （此類插件的一個很好的例子是，如果需要 python 2，但我們由於上游棄用而停止交付它）

#### Packages (pkg)｜包裝（包包）

Binary software is installed using pkg, which uses our software repository (available via multiple mirrors). All installed software can be found via the user interface System -> Firmware ->Packages, but in some situations people want to install additional software via the command line of the machine itself.

二進位軟體使用 pkg 安裝，它使用我們的軟體儲存庫（可透過多個鏡像取得）。所有已安裝的軟體都可以透過使用者介面「系統」->「韌體」->「軟體包」找到，但在某些情況下，人們希望透過機器本身的命令列安裝其他軟體。

To find a full list of all software available, you can use the following command:

要查找所有可用軟體的完整列表，您可以使用以下命令：

```
pkg rquery '%n (%v)'
```

For example, if you would like to install the gnu [nano](https://www.nano-editor.org/) editor, you can do so using the following command:

例如，如果您想安裝 gnu [nano](https://www.nano-editor.org/) 編輯器，可以使用下列命令來安裝：

```
pkg install nano
```

Note

注意事項

OPNsense® is a firewall distribution, we aim to keep our footprint as small as possible. This means that we don’t build all the software available in the world. If you need a specific package for your use-case, you could always ask via a support ticket on [GitHub](https://github.com/opnsense/tools/issues), but note that packages not used by our core system or a supported plugin would not be guaranteed in the future (build contents may change over time).

OPNsense® 是一個防火牆發行版，我們的目標是讓我們的足跡盡可能小。這意味著我們不會建構世界上所有可用的軟體。如果您需要適合您的用例的特定包，您可以隨時透過 [GitHub](https://github.com/opnsense/tools/issues) 上的支援票詢問，但請注意，我們的核心系統或支援的插件未使用的套件將來不會得到保證（建置內容可能會隨著時間的推移而改變）。

Warning

警告

Adding (FreeBSD, ..) repositories in `/usr/local/etc/pkg/repos/` manually is not supported and usually lead to unexpected issues. Before reporting any type of issue with such setups, we kindly ask you to revert to a standard setup first.

不支援在`/usr/local/etc/pkg/repos/`中手動新增（FreeBSD，..）儲存庫，並且通常會導致意外問題。在報告此類設定的任何類型問題之前，我們懇請您先恢復到標準設定。

#### The ports tree｜連接埠樹

In case you are using software which is not supplied by us, you can always build these packages yourself. It’s best to use our build system to facilitate this, you can do so using the following commands

如果您使用的軟體不是我們提供的，您始終可以自己建立這些軟體包。最好使用我們的建置系統來促進這一點，您可以使用以下命令來完成此操作

```bash
opnsense-code ports
cd /usr/ports/your/port
make install
```

To update a package, the following command can be used instead:

若要更新軟體包，可以使用以下命令：

```bash
opnsense-code ports
cd /usr/ports/your/port
make reinstall
```

It might be necessary for some ports to also install the source tree:

某些連接埠可能還需要安裝來源樹：

```
opnsense-code src
```

Note

注意事項

There are a lot of resources available about building ports packages, such as [https://www.freebsd.org/ports/](https://www.freebsd.org/ports/) and the pointers in our documentation and tools. We consider building custom software a feature not usable for beginners, before creating support tickets, make sure you have the necessary skillsets needed to perform such tasks.

有許多關於建立 ports 套件的資源，例如 [https://www.freebsd.org/ports/](https://www.freebsd.org/ports/) 以及我們文件和工具中的指標。我們認為建立自訂軟體是初學者無法使用的功能，在創建支援票證之前，請確保您擁有執行此類任務所需的必要技能。
