<a id="p-059"></a>

#### Changelogs｜變更日誌

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/changelog.html>

OPNsense core offers a changelog of the core and the plugins may offer their own changelog, if they are growing rapidly so the changelog does not fit into core anymore.

OPNsense 核心提供核心的變更日誌，且外掛程式可能會提供自己的變更日誌，如果它們成長迅速，則變更日誌不再適合核心。

##### Core｜核心

Core offers a changelog section in the area System ‣ Firmware as an own menu or the dialog will automatically open in case of an available update.

Core 在系統 ‣ 韌體區域中提供了一個變更日誌部分作為自己的選單，或在有可用更新的情況下對話方塊將自動開啟。

To open a changelog manually, you can open the Changelog tab, and click the book:

若要手動開啟變更日誌，您可以開啟「變更日誌」選項卡，然後按一下該書：

![../../_images/changelog_book_icon.png](<../images/bb44745e-changelog_book_icon.png>)

After opening the changelog, you will get an entry like this one:

打開變更日誌後，您將看到以下條目：

![../../_images/changelog_entry.png](<../images/16dda685-changelog_entry.png>)

The changelog entries can be found at different places:

變更日誌條目可以在不同的地方找到：

-   Forum: [https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?board=11.0](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?board=11.0)  
    論壇：[https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?board=11.0](https://forum.opnsense.org/index.php?board=11.0)
    
-   GitHub: [https://github.com/opnsense/changelog/tree/master/community](https://github.com/opnsense/changelog/tree/master/community)  
    GitHub：[https://github.com/opnsense/changelog/tree/master/community](https://github.com/opnsense/changelog/tree/master/community)
    
-   Blog: [https://opnsense.org/blog/](https://opnsense.org/blog/)  
    部落格：[https://opnsense.org/blog/](https://opnsense.org/blog/)
    

##### Plugins｜外掛

The plugins changelogs can be found in the plugins section after clicking the info button of the plugin (Plugins tab in Firmware).

點擊插件的資訊按鈕（韌體中的插件標籤）後，可以在插件部分找到插件更改日誌。

![../../_images/changelog_plugins_info_nginx.png](<../images/7d336ccf-changelog_plugins_info_nginx.png>)

After the description of the software behind the plugin or the plugin itself, the changelog follows.

在描述插件背後的軟體或插件本身之後，更改日誌如下。

<a id="p-060"></a>

#### Serial Access｜序列存取

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/serial_access.html>

![../../_images/serial_bootloader.png](<../images/3fe95326-serial_bootloader.png>)

Besides the web frontend, SSH and a locally connected monitor (if your device supports it), OPNsense can also be controlled via serial. Accessing OPNsense via serial is similar to accessing via SSH, but unlike SSH, the system can be accessed at any time, even when OPNsense is not accessible over the network. This makes it especially useful for installing OPNsense, for emergency troubleshooting when you accidentally cut off internet access as well as for major system upgrades.

除了網頁前端、 SSH和本地連接的顯示器（如果您的裝置支援）之外，OPNsense 還可以透過串列埠進行控制。透過串列埠存取 OPNsense 與透過SSH存取，但與SSH不同的是，即使 OPNsense 無法透過網路存取，您也可以隨時存取該系統。這使得它特別適用於安裝 OPNsense、在意外斷開網路連接時進行緊急故障排除以及進行重大系統升級。

##### Requirements｜要求

-   OPNsense installation must provide a serial interface (virtual or hardware)  
    OPNsense 安裝必須提供序列介面（虛擬或硬體）。
    
-   Software which can be used to access the serial interface (screen, minicom, PuTTY etc.)  
    可用於存取序列介面的軟體（screen、minicom、PuTTY 等）
    

For a bare metal installation, you also need the following (unless provided though a management interface differently, please refer your server manual):

對於裸機安裝，您還需要以下元件（除非透過管理介面以其他方式提供，請參閱您的伺服器手冊）：

-   a null modem cable  
    零調製解調器電纜
    
-   if you don’t have an RS232 port on your computer, you need an USB to RS232 converter  
    如果您的電腦上沒有RS232端口，則需要一個USB轉RS232轉換器。
    

##### Connecting to the serial console｜連接到串列埠控制台

If you already installed OPNsense via a non-serial installer, serial access needs to be turned on. To do this, open the web interface, navigate to System ‣ Settings ‣ Administration, scroll down to ‘Console’ and set the primary or secondary console to ‘Serial console’. Note: this is **only** necessary if you already installed OPNsense, and did not use the serial installer to do so. In all other cases (accessing BIOS, running the serial installer, connecting to an installation that was done via serial), serial access is already available.

如果您已透過非串列式安裝程式安裝了 OPNsense，則需要啟用串列存取。為此，請開啟 Web 介面，導覽至“系統”‣“設定”‣“管理”，向下捲動至“控制台”，並將主控制台或輔助控制台設定為“串列埠控制台”。注意：僅當您已安裝 OPNsense 但未使用串列埠安裝程式時才需要執行此操作。在所有其他情況下（訪問串口）， BIOS（運行串行安裝程序，連接到透過串行完成的安裝），串行存取已可用。

On Unix-like systems, you can connect to the serial console using the `screen` program, with a baud rate of 115200. The device name can differ per system and per serial device. Examples of names are:

在類 Unix 系統中，您可以使用`screen`程式連接到串列埠控制台，波特率為 115200。設備名稱可能因係統和串列設備而異。名稱範例：

-   /dev/ttyS0 (serial port, Linux)  
    /dev/ttyS0（串口，Linux）
    
-   /dev/ttyUSB0 (usb-to-serial, Linux)  
    /dev/ttyUSB0（USB 轉串口，Linux）
    
-   /dev/cuau0 (serial port, FreeBSD)  
    /dev/cuau0（串口，FreeBSD）
    
-   /dev/cuaU0 (usb-to-serial, FreeBSD)  
    /dev/cuaU0（USB 轉串口，FreeBSD）
    
-   /dev/tty.usbmodem1112421 (usb-to-serial, macOS)  
    /dev/tty.usbmodem1112421（USB 轉串口，macOS）
    
-   COM1, COM2, … (Windows)  
    COM1, COM2 ，…（Windows）
    

Note

注意事項

If you have multiple devices of the same type like shown here:

如果您有多個相同類型的設備，如下圖所示：

> `# ls /dev/ttyUSB*`
> 
> `/dev/ttyUSB0  /dev/ttyUSB1`

You can disconnect one of them to see which one is left or you can read the `dmesg` log to get the vendor information for the device node. You can search for a message containing “now attached to ttyUSB1” to find out which device it is. Afterwards you can compare the previous output to the output of a tool like `lsusb`.

您可以斷開其中一個設備，看看還剩下哪一個，或者您可以讀取`dmesg`日誌來取得設備節點的供應商資訊。您可以搜尋包含「now attached to ttyUSB1」的訊息，以找出是哪個裝置。之後，您可以將先前的輸出與`lsusb`等工具的輸出進行比較。

For example, on the Deciso DEC630, accessed from macOS, the device is named `/dev/tty.usbmodem1112421`. Entering the serial console thus involves opening a terminal and executing the following instruction:

例如，在 macOS 系統下存取 Deciso DEC630時，裝置名稱為`/dev/tty.usbmodem1112421` 。因此，進入串列埠控制台需要開啟終端機並執行下列指令：

```
screen /dev/tty.usbmodem1112421 115200
# or
minicom -b 115200 -D /dev/tty.usbmodem1112421
```

Note

注意事項

Access to the device is likely to be access restricted. You should run the command as root because running it as a user may lead to an access denied error on Linux / BSD.

對該設備的存取可能受到限制。您應該以 root 使用者身分執行該命令，因為以普通使用者身分執行可能會導致 Linux 系統上出現存取被拒絕的錯誤 / BSD 。

If OPNsense is running, you will now be asked for your username and password if authentication is enabled. Otherwise the menu is displayed (at least after pressing enter). The credentials are the same as those used for SSH.

如果 OPNsense 正在運行，並且啟用了身份驗證，系統會要求您輸入使用者名稱和密碼。否則，將顯示選單（至少在按下回車鍵後會顯示）。憑證與SSH所使用的憑證相同。

A thing to note is that the screen won’t always auto-update. If you connect and see no output, try pressing Enter first before checking the other (more complex) possibilities. Another thing is that, when connecting via `screen`, you might not be able to scroll (but you can still pipe the output through a pager like `more` or `less`).

需要注意的是，螢幕並非總是自動更新。如果您連接後沒有看到任何輸出，請先嘗試按 Enter 鍵，然後再嘗試其他（更複雜的）方法。另外，透過`screen`連接時，您可能無法捲動螢幕（但您仍可將輸出透過分頁器（例如`more`或`less` ）進行串流）。

<a id="p-061"></a>

#### Installing OPNsense AWS image｜安裝 OPNsense AWS鏡像

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/installaws.html>

[![../../_images/amazon-web-services.png](<../images/84fe639e-amazon-web-services.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/amazon-web-services.png)

Our EC2 image is available in the [aws marketplace](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-lu5v2tokic3py).

我們的EC2鏡像可在 [aws marketplace](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-lu5v2tokic3py)中找到。

##### Step 1 - New Instance｜步驟 1 - 新建實例

To start a new instance go to “instances”, followed by “launch instance” in your EC2 view.

若要啟動新實例，請在EC2視圖中前往“實例”，然後選擇“啟動實例”。

Next go to “AWS Marketplace” and search “OPNsense”. Our official image is sold via Deciso Sales B.V..

接下來前往“AWS Marketplace”並搜尋“OPNsense” 。我們的官方圖片由Deciso Sales BV銷售。

[![../../_images/aws_step1_choose_ami.png](<../images/8793be5d-aws_step1_choose_ami.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/aws_step1_choose_ami.png)

##### Step 2 - Select Type｜步驟 2 - 選擇類型

Choose an instance type

選擇實例類型

[![../../_images/aws_launch_new_image.png](<../images/2102c960-aws_launch_new_image.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/aws_launch_new_image.png)

##### Step 3 - Configure Instance Details｜步驟 3 - 設定實例詳細信息

Here you can configure your network details, by default a network is assigned which is accessible from an external IPv4 address.

您可以在此處設定網路詳細信息，預設會指派一個可透過外部 IPv4 位址存取的網路。

At the bottom of the page you can also supply “User data” in the “Advanced Details”（高級詳情） section, you can use this to set an initial password for the ec2-user.

在頁面底部的“Advanced Details”（高級詳情）部分，您還可以提供“用戶資料”，您可以使用此資料為 ec2 用戶設定初始密碼。

Note

注意事項

When a password is omitted, one will be automatically generated for you and displayed on the console (get system log).

如果省略密碼，系統將自動為您產生密碼並顯示在控制台上（取得系統日誌）。

##### Step 4 - Add Storage｜步驟 4 - 新增儲存空間

Here you can change the initial storage size and type of volume to use.

您可以在此處變更初始儲存大小和要使用的磁碟區類型。

##### Step 5 - Add Tags｜步驟 5 - 新增標籤

Optionally you may add tags to the instance, it’s safe to leave this empty.

您可以選擇性地在執行個體中新增標籤，也可以將其留空。

##### Step 6 - Configure security group｜步驟 6 - 設定安全群組

To configure security group, make sure you allow HTTPS access from your own network. Since SSH is also enabled by default on these images, you may enable port 22 (SSH) too from your network.

若要設定安全群組，請確保允許從您自己的網路存取HTTPS 。由於這些鏡像預設也啟用了SSH ，您也可以從您的網路啟用連接埠 22 ( SSH )。

[![../../_images/aws_configure_security_group.png](<../images/9fbaf50b-aws_configure_security_group.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/aws_configure_security_group.png)

##### Step 7 - Review your settings｜步驟 7 - 檢查您的設置

[![../../_images/aws_review_settings.png](<../images/4e14feda-aws_review_settings.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/aws_review_settings.png)

##### Step 8 - SSH keypair｜步驟 8 - SSH金鑰對

Select ssh keypair or skip, the selected ssh key is attached to the ec2-user, you can change this afterwards from the usermanager. (System -> Access -> Users).

選擇 SSH 金鑰對或跳過，所選 SSH 金鑰將附加到 ec2 用戶，之後您可以從用戶管理員變更此設定。 （系統 -> 存取 -> 使用者）

[![../../_images/aws_ssh_keypair.png](<../images/c79fabbc-aws_ssh_keypair.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/aws_ssh_keypair.png)

##### Step 9 - Review status page｜步驟 9 - 查看狀態頁面

[![../../_images/aws_status.png](<../images/eb6e26ba-aws_status.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/aws_status.png)

##### Step 10 - AWS instances｜步驟 10 - AWS實例

Go to your AWS instances

前往您的AWS實例

[![../../_images/aws_instances.png](<../images/6512c276-aws_instances.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/aws_instances.png)

Select the image, go to “image settings” then “get system log” to obtain the initial password for the ec2-user (if not specified in the user data) and the initial root password.

選擇鏡像，進入“鏡像設定”，然後“取得系統日誌”以取得 ec2-user 的初始密碼（如果使用者資料中未指定）和初始 root 密碼。

Note

注意事項

Sometimes it can take a bit of time before the console settings appear in the “system log”, in our experience the output is available when the Status check reports it’s finished.

根據我們的經驗，有時控制台設定可能需要一段時間才會出現在「系統日誌」中，當狀態檢查報告完成後，輸出才會可用。

##### Step 11 - Initial root password｜步驟 11 - 初始 root 密碼

Copy your initial root password (line \*\* set initial….)

複製你的初始root密碼（行 \** set initial….）

```yaml
.....
Configuring system logging...done.
>>> Invoking start script 'aws'
**********************************************************************************************************
*** set initial ec2-user password to : J4heQUAaRWJFGkXrfUKssjQ9jyFiBmaRgqaBiYRK7iiL2lUtvG
*** !!! remember to change this immediately
*** openssh-key provided, set to ec2-user
*** set initial root password to : SNFpd2lcefYXXjyRezPrloTWTF3LjhgZPV3zLuDxEdVkiBGWxn

 WAN (xn0)       -> v4/DHCP4: 172.31.27.130/20

 HTTPS: SHA256 52 87 3F 28 48 59 A3 7D 59 66 26 36 01 2C 77 61
               FB 8E 78 C8 C4 C4 80 2C 97 C6 67 AA CB 28 48 60

FreeBSD/amd64 (OPNsense.localdomain) (ttyu0)

```

Tip

提示

When the ec2 console doesn’t show the initial password you can also use the configured ssh shell to reset the root password using `sudo /usr/local/sbin/opnsense-shell` and option `3` in the menu.

當 ec2 控制台未顯示初始密碼時，您也可以使用已設定的 ssh shell，透過選單中的`sudo /usr/local/sbin/opnsense-shell`和選項`3`來重設 root 密碼。

##### Step 11 - Search current address and login｜第 11 步 - 搜尋目前地址並登入

[![../../_images/aws_search_current_ip.png](<../images/865f24ec-aws_search_current_ip.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/aws_search_current_ip.png)

Login to OPNsense using the address provided.

使用提供的地址登入 OPNsense。

<a id="p-062"></a>

#### Installing OPNsense OVA image｜安裝 OPNsense OVA鏡像

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/installova.html>

OPNsense is available as an Open Virtual Appliance (OVA) package, which can be deployed in various virtualization products (e.g. VMWare, Virtualbox).

OPNsense 以開放虛擬設備 ( OVA ) 軟體包的形式提供，可部署在各種虛擬化產品（例如 VMWare、Virtualbox）中。

The image is not provided as a community free download, but can be acquired from Deciso.

該圖片並非作為社區免費下載提供，但可以從 Deciso 獲取。

In this document we describe the simple steps when deploying in VirtualBox, other supported platforms function quite similar.

本文檔介紹了在 VirtualBox 中部署的簡單步驟，其他受支援的平台的操作也十分類似。

##### Step 1 - Import appliance｜步驟 1 - 導入電器

In the top menu, choose File ‣ Import appliance and select the image you downloaded, it should show a dialog like the following.

在頂部選單中，選擇“檔案”‣“匯入裝置”，然後選擇您下載的映像，應該會顯示下列對話方塊。

[![../../_images/ova_import_dialog_1.png](<../images/9ff85f81-ova_import_dialog_1.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/ova_import_dialog_1.png)

Just click import, accept the license and the image should be transferred to your machine.

點擊匯入，接受許可協議，圖像就會傳輸到您的電腦。

##### Step 2 - Network setup｜步驟 2 - 網路設置

The OVA template comes with two interfaces configured by default (you can add more later if needed). Always choose the right type of network before using OPNsense, the imported adapters might not be assigned to a type after import.

OVA範本預設配置了兩個介面（如有需要，您可以稍後新增更多介面）。使用 OPNsense 前，請務必選擇正確的網路類型，匯入的適配器在匯入後可能不會自動分配類型。

Note

注意事項

Please be aware that the order of the network cards in the virtualization product may differ from how they are presented to the operating system. In VirtualBox “Adapter 1”（適配器 1） seems to connect to WAN (em1)

請注意，虛擬化產品中網路卡的順序可能與作業系統中顯示的順序不同。在 VirtualBox 中“Adapter 1”（適配器 1）似乎連接到WAN (em1)。

##### Step 3 - Initial configuration｜步驟 3 - 初始配置

The virtual machine is operational now, initial configuration is performed similar to other setups, as described in [Initial Installation & Configuration](#p-055).

虛擬機器現在可以運行了，初始配置與其他設定類似，如[初始安裝和配置](#p-055)中所述。

<a id="p-063"></a>

#### OPNsense Azure Virtual Appliance｜OPNsense Azure虛擬設備

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/installazure.html>

OPNsense is a fully featured security platform that secures your network with high-end features such as inline intrusion prevention, virtual private networking, two factor authentication, captive portal and filtering web proxy. The optional high availability setup ensures stable network performance with automatic failover and synchronised states, minimising disruption. Keep your network secure and the good packets flowing.

OPNsense 是一款功能齊全的安全平台，它利用內聯入侵防禦、虛擬專用網路 (VPN)、雙重認證、強制入口網站和過濾式 Web 代理程式等高階功能，為您的網路提供全方位保護。選購的高可用性配置可確保網路效能穩定，實現自動故障轉移和狀態同步，最大限度地減少中斷。保障您的網路安全，確保資料包暢通無阻。

The Virtual Appliance is available on the Microsoft Azure Marketplace ([here](https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/en-en/marketplace/apps/decisosalesbv.opnsense?tab=Overview)).

虛擬裝置可在 Microsoft Azure Marketplace 上購買（[此處](https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/en-en/marketplace/apps/decisosalesbv.opnsense?tab=Overview) ）。

[![../../_images/azure_offer.png](<../images/18ab8746-azure_offer.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/azure_offer.png)

Our installation manual will guide you through a simple installation scenario using 1 network interface, for more advanced network setups you best checkout the Azure [documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-en/azure/virtual-machines/linux/multiple-nics).

我們的安裝手冊將引導您完成使用 1 個網路介面的簡單安裝場景，對於更進階的網路設置，您最好查看 Azure [文件](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-en/azure/virtual-machines/linux/multiple-nics) 。

##### Setup : Basic settings｜設定：基本設定

The Marketplace create button guides you to the initial virtual machine setup, choose your subscription and system preferences here and name your virtual machine.

Marketplace 建立按鈕會引導您完成初始虛擬機器設置，在這裡選擇您的訂閱和系統首選項，並為您的虛擬機器命名。

[![../../_images/azure_deploy_basics.png](<../images/7e70f8c3-azure_deploy_basics.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/azure_deploy_basics.png)

Next make sure you create an initial administrative user, since some names are reserved (like admin and root), you need to choose another one here. In our example we choose `adm001` here.

接下來，請確保建立初始管理員用戶，因為某些名稱已保留（例如 admin 和 root），所以您需要選擇另一個名稱。在我們的範例中，我們選擇`adm001` 。

Note

注意事項

You can enable the root user after installation, the setup user can access the system using ssh or https after installation todo so.

安裝完成後，您可以啟用 root 用戶，安裝完成後，設定用戶可以使用 ssh 或 https 存取系統來執行此操作。

[![../../_images/azure_deploy_basics_user.png](<../images/71a9a1a1-azure_deploy_basics_user.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/azure_deploy_basics_user.png)

##### Setup : Disks｜安裝：磁碟

Next you can choose a disk type to use, **standard SSD** is fast enough for most workloads.

接下來您可以選擇要使用的磁碟類型，**標準SSD** 對於大多數工作負載來說速度足夠快。

[![../../_images/azure_deploy_disks.png](<../images/10af82e8-azure_deploy_disks.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/azure_deploy_disks.png)

##### Setup : Network｜設定：網路

For our example, we kept our settings simple using a **private IP** which is accessible over port **443 (https)** after bootup. Most settings can be changed after deployment.

對於我們的範例，我們使用 **私有 IP**來保持設定簡單，啟動後可透過連接埠**443 (https)** 存取。大多數設定可以在部署後更改。

[![../../_images/azure_deploy_network.png](<../images/0c3b8dc8-azure_deploy_network.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/azure_deploy_network.png)

Note

注意事項

Microsoft has quite some information available about different networking settings and options [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-en/azure/virtual-machines/windows/network-overview)

微軟提供了大量關於不同網路設定和選項的資訊[此處](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-en/azure/virtual-machines/windows/network-overview)

##### Create｜創造

Proceed to **Review + create** to finalize the deployment.

接下來執行**審核+建立**以完成部署。

##### Login to your instance｜登入您的實例

When the virtual machine is created and booted for the first time, you can login using the assigned user (`adm001`), now you can enable the root user if you like in System -> Access -> Users

虛擬機器建立並首次啟動後，您可以使用指派的使用者（ `adm001` ）登入。現在，您可以根據需要啟用 root 用戶，方法是：系統 -> 存取 -> 用戶

[![../../_images/azure_startup_users.png](<../images/20071c86-azure_startup_users.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/azure_startup_users.png)

Note

注意事項

Our Azure virtual appliance has ssh enabled by default, you can change these settings in System -> Settings -> Administration

我們的 Azure 虛擬設備預設啟用 SSH，您可以在「系統」->「設定」->「管理」中變更這些設定。

<a id="p-065"></a>

### Quickstart getting started｜快速入門

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/hardware/quickstart.html>

#### Quickstart / getting started｜快速入門/開始

#### Intro｜引言

After opening the box of your just delivered appliance, there should be a quickstart included. Your OPNsense® appliance has been pre-installed with the OPNsense® Business Edition software

打開剛送達的設備的包裝盒後，裡面應該會有快速入門指南。您的 OPNsense® 裝置已預先安裝 OPNsense® 商業版軟體。

This quickstart applies to all of the devices acquired from the OPNsense® Shop ([https://shop.opnsense.com/](https://shop.opnsense.com/)), which includes the following series:

本快速入門指南適用於從 OPNsense® 商店 ([https://shop.opnsense.com/](https://shop.opnsense.com/) ) 購買的所有設備，包括以下系列：

| Series<br>系列 | Formfactor<br>外形尺寸 | Range<br>範圍 | Network driver(s)<br>網路驅動程式 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DEC6XX | Desktop<br>桌上型電腦 | Entry level<br>入門級 | igb |
| DEC7XX | Desktop<br>桌上型電腦 | Midrange<br>中階 | igb, ax<br>igb，ax |
| DEC8XX | Desktop<br>桌面 | Enterprise<br>企業 | igb, ax |
| DEC26XX | Rack<br>機架式 | Entry level<br>入門級 | igb |
| DEC27XX | Rack<br>機架式 | Midrange<br>中階 | igb, ax<br>igb，ax |
| DEC38XX | Rack<br>機架式 | Enterprise<br>企業級 | igb, ax<br>igb，ax |
| DEC40XX | Rack<br>機架 | Enterprise / Datacenter<br>企業/資料中心 | igb, ax, \[ice\]<br>igb、ax、[ice] |

#### Port assignments｜連接埠分配

The Ethernet ports of the appliance are assigned as follows:

該設備的乙太網路連接埠分配如下：

Port **0** is assigned to LAN with IP address `192.168.1.1` and has a DHCP Server running with IP range from `192.168.1.100` to `192.168.1.199`.

連接埠 **0** 分配給LAN `192.168.1.100`位址為IP `192.168.1.1`並且有一個DHCP伺服器正在運行，範圍從IP到`192.168.1.199` 。

Port **1** is assigned to WAN and uses DHCP Client to obtain an IP-address.

連接埠 **1** 分配給WAN ，並使用DHCP客戶端取得IP位址。

Additional ports available on the device are left unconfigured, you can assign them later using Interfaces->Assignments.

設備上的其他可用連接埠尚未配置，您可以稍後使用“介面”->“分配”進行指派。

Note

注意事項

Ports on the devices are all numbered, 0-**X** (e.g. 0,1,2) for all 1 gbps standard ethernet ports, X0-X**X** for SFP+ ports (e.g. X0, X1), XXV0-XXV**X** for SFP28 ports (e.g. XXV0, XXV1). The numbering corresponds with the driver numbering, e.g. port **0** is usually `igb0`, see the product range for drivers used in the different models

設備上的所有連接埠均已編號，0-**X**（例如 0、1、2）代表所有 1 Gbps 標準乙太網路端口，X0-X**X** 代表其他連接埠。 SFP+ 連接埠（例如 X0、X1）， XXV0-XXV**X** 代表 SFP28 連接埠（例如） XXV0, XXV1編號與驅動程式編號相對應，例如連接埠 **0** 通常是 `igb0`請查看不同型號所使用的驅動程式產品系列。

#### Console connectivity｜控制台連接

The supplied USB-cable can be used to gain console access (settings are: 115200 8N1). Console access is restricted with a login. Use the following credentials:

可使用隨附的USB線存取控制台（設定：115200 8N1）。控制台存取需要登入。請使用以下憑證：

-   user : **root**  
    使用者：**root**
    
-   password : **opnsense**  
    密碼：**opnsense**
    

#### Web interface｜網頁介面

To gain access to the web interface (default IP: `192.168.1.1`) use the following credentials:

若要存取 Web 介面（預設IP: `192.168.1.1` ），請使用下列憑證：

-   user : **root**  
    使用者：**root**
    
-   password : **opnsense**  
    密碼：**opnsense**
    

#### Next steps｜下一步

After performing basic setup, apply your OPNsense Business Edition license token and then update your system or change to community when not planning to use the supplied license. (The firmware update module is located at System>Firmware>Settings)

完成基本設定後，請套用您的 OPNsense 商業版許可證令牌，然後更新您的系統；如果您不打算使用提供的許可證，請切換到社群版。 （韌體更新模組位於「系統」>「韌體」>「設定」）

**Option 1**: use Business Edition license

**選項 1**：使用商業版許可證

[![../_images/quickstart_be.png](<../images/03c11faf-quickstart_be.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/quickstart_be.png)

**Option 2**: use Community Edition

**選項 2**：使用社群版

[![../_images/quickstart_community.png](<../images/b4bfde5d-quickstart_community.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/quickstart_community.png)

Note

注意事項

The OPNsense Business Edition license token is sent by email including instructions on how to apply.

OPNsense 商業版許可證令牌將透過電子郵件發送，其中包含如何申請的說明。

Tip

提示

Always update your device after gaining access to the internet, updates are usually available once the device reaches your destination. Just go to the status tab in the firmware section, press “check for updates” and install the pending updates.

請務必在連接互聯網後更新設備。通常情況下，設備到達目的地後即可獲得更新。只需前往韌體部分的「狀態」選項卡，點擊「檢查更新」並安裝待更新的韌體即可。

<a id="p-067"></a>

### Serial Console connectivity｜串行控制台連接

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/hardware/serial_connectivity.html>

The following device families offer a mini-usb connection which can be used for serial communication:

以下設備系列提供可用於串列通訊的迷你 USB 介面：

| Series<br>系列 | Formfactor<br>外形尺寸 | Range<br>範圍 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DEC6XX | Desktop<br>桌上型電腦 | Entry level<br>入門級 |
| DEC7XX | Desktop<br>桌上型電腦 | Midrange<br>中階機 |
| DEC8XX | Desktop<br>桌面 | Enterprise<br>企業 |
| DEC26XX | Rack<br>機架 | Entry level<br>入門級 |
| DEC27XX | Rack<br>機架式 | Midrange<br>中音 |
| DEC38XX | Rack<br>機架式 | Enterprise<br>企業級 |
| DEC40XX | Rack<br>機架 | Enterprise / Datacenter<br>企業/資料中心 |

Supplied with the firewall is a mini-usb to usb cable, use this to connect the to your PC (Windows, Linux, Mac) next start your terminal program (Putty, screen, etc).

防火牆附帶一條 mini-usb 轉 usb 電纜，用它將防火牆連接到您的PC （Windows、Linux、Mac），然後啟動您的終端程式（Putty、screen 等）。

The baudrate should be set to `115200,8N1`, more information about how to use the serial console is available in our [serial access guide](#p-060)

波特率應設定為`115200,8N1` ，有關如何使用串口控制台的更多信息，請參閱我們的[串口訪問指南](#p-060)

Note

注意事項

The default configured settings in OPNsense for proper serial connectivity in System->Settings->Administration are as followed:

OPNsense 中用於正確建立串行連接的預設組態設定（位於「系統」->「設定」->「管理」）如下：

| setting<br>設定 | value<br>值 |
| --- | --- |
| Primary Console<br>主控制台 | Serial Console<br>串行控制台 |
| Secondary Console<br>輔助控制台 | None<br>無 |
| Serial Speed<br>串列速度 | 115200 |
| USB-based serial<br>USB序號 | (unchecked)<br>（未檢查） |
| Console menu<br>控制台選單 | (checked)<br>（已勾選） |

Windows Tip

Windows 小技巧

On windows a COM port would be assigned after connecting the unit to usb, to find which one (COM1, COM2, .,) to use, keep the windows key pressed and hit `R` (Windows+R) and execute the following command `devmgmt.msc` to open the device manager.

在 Windows 系統中，將裝置連接到 USB 後會分配一個COM連接埠。若要尋找要使用的連接埠（ COM1, COM2 , .,），請按住 Windows 鍵並按下`R` (Windows+R)，然後執行下列指令`devmgmt.msc`開啟裝置管理員。

In the device manager all available ports are visible under the “Ports (COM & LPT)” section.

在裝置管理員中，「連接埠 ( COM & LPT )」部分下方可以看到所有可用的連接埠。

#### **Legacy UART vs. UEFI serial**｜**舊款UART與UEFI序號對比**

Starting from OPNsense 22.1 (22.4 for the business edition) and the change to FreeBSD 13-STABLE, support for EFI serial has changed, which requires EFI based systems to disable legacy support to prevent confusing the operating system. Should you connect your Deciso appliance with a serial line and get limited output / no output from the point of handover to the OS, it is important your BIOS settings are updated to disable legacy UART.

從 OPNsense 22.1 （商業版為22.4 ）以及 FreeBSD 13- STABLE開始，對EFI串口的支援發生了變化，這要求基於EFI的系統禁用舊版支援，以避免作業系統出現混亂。如果您使用串口線連接 Deciso 設備，並且在切換點到OS後出現輸出受限或無輸出的情況，則務必更新您的BIOS設定以停用舊版UART 。

While in the BIOS, go to Setup Utility –> AMD CBS –> FCH Common Options –> UART Configuration Options –> UART 0 Legacy Options. and make sure this setting is set to **Disabled**.

在BIOS中，前往「設定實用程式」-> AMD CBS -> FCH常用選項 -> UART設定選項 -> UART 0 舊版選項，並確保此設定設定為 **停用**。

#### [**Installation instructions**](#p-068)｜[**安裝說明**](#p-068)

Updating the UEFI firmware requires writing a bootable image to a USB drive on a separate machine. Make sure you have an empty or unused USB drive before starting this procedure. Also make sure the USB drive is FAT32 formatted.

更新UEFI韌體需要將可啟動映像寫入另一台電腦上的USB驅動器。在開始此過程之前，請確保您有一個空的或未使用的USB驅動器。同時，請確保USB驅動器已FAT32格式化。

Warning

警告

As a general warning, following this procedure is at your own risk.

需要提醒的是，依照此方法操作風險自負。

**Step 1**

**第一步**

Download the latest BIOS archive file for your platform from the downloads section above.

從上面的下載部分下載適用於您平台的最新BIOS存檔檔案。

**Step 2**

**第二步**

Verify the SHA256 checksum.

驗證SHA256校驗和。

**Step 3**

**步驟 3**

Insert the USB drive into your computer and extract the archive to the USB drive. Make sure the file structure is as follows:

將USB驅動器插入電腦，並將壓縮包解壓到USB驅動器。請確保文件結構如下：

```
USB drive:/
├── LATEST.FD
├── startup.nsh
├── H2OFFT-Sx64.efi
├── efi/
│   ├── boot/
│   │   ├── Bootx64.efi
```

**Step 4**

**步驟4**

Safely remove the USB drive from the computer and plug it into the appliance.

安全地從電腦中取出USB驅動器，然後將其插入裝置。

**Step 5**

**步驟5**

Connect to the appliance using a [Serial Console connectivity](#p-067) connection. Open a terminal to the relevant COM port.

使用 [序列控制台連接](#p-067)連接連接到設備。打開終端並連接到相關的COM埠。

**Step 6**

**步驟6**

Boot the appliance and enter the BIOS by pressing Escape. The current BIOS version (suffix) should show up. Make note of it so you can compare it to the new version to verify everything went well.

啟動設備，然後按 Esc 鍵輸入BIOS 。此時應該會顯示目前的BIOS版本（後綴）。記下該版本號，以便與新版本進行比較，驗證一切是否正常。

**Step 7**

**步驟7**

Go to Setup Utility –> AMD CBS –> FCH Common Options –> UART Configuration Options –> UART 0 Legacy Options. Make sure this setting is set to **Disabled**. This is explained in [Legacy UART vs. UEFI serial](#p-067).

前往設定實用程式 –> AMD CBS –> FCH 常用選項 –> UART 設定選項 –> UART 0 舊選項。確保此設定設定為 **停用**。這在[舊版UART與UEFI系列](#p-067)中進行了解釋。

Note

注意事項

Should your serial terminal highlight a BIOS option selection in such a way that it is unreadable, for the A20 appliance it’s the very first option in the UART Configuration Options menu screen.

如果您的序列終端突出顯示BIOS選項選擇，以至於無法讀取，則對於 A20 設備，它是UART配置選項選單畫面中的第一個選項。

**Step 8**

**步驟 8**

Select **Boot manager** and boot the USB drive. The UEFI shell will take over and execute the necessary BIOS update. If the update is complete, the machine will power off. **Do NOT do anything until the machine has shutdown.**

選擇 **啟動管理器**並啟動 USB 驅動器。 UEFI shell 將接管並執行必要的 BIOS 更新。如果更新完成，機器將關閉。**執行NOT 執行任何操作，直到機器關閉。 **

Note

注意事項

Should the USB drive not show up, something went wrong during writing. The newly created FAT32 partition should be the very first block on the drive. Inspect the drive on a different machine to check the layout.

如果USB分區未顯示，則表示寫入過程中出現問題。新建的FAT32分區應該是硬碟上的第一個區塊。請在另一台電腦上檢查該硬碟，確認其佈局。

**Step 9**

**步驟 9**

Reboot the machine and check the new BIOS version in either the boot log or the BIOS itself.

重新啟動機器，並在啟動日誌或BIOS本身中檢查新的BIOS版本。

#### [**Hyper threading**](#p-068)｜[**超線程**](#p-068)

Selected models do support hyper threading, but as effectiveness depends on workload, we tend to disable it by default. If you do want to enable it when supported, enter the setup utility and search for the following menu item:

部分機型支援超執行緒技術，但由於其效能取決於工作負載，我們通常會預設為停用該功能。如果您希望在支援的機型上啟用超線程，請進入設定程式並尋找以下選單項目：

> AMD CBS -> Zen Common Options -> Core/Thread Enablement -> SMTEN
>
> AMD CBS -> Zen 通用選項 -> 核心/線程啟用 -> SMTEN

Select `Auto` here to enable the feature.

選擇`Auto`以啟用該功能。

#### [**Microcode updates**](#p-068)｜[**微程式碼更新**](#p-068)

Microcode patches are distributed in our EFI firmware updates. If a Microcode update is required to address specific issues which are deemed important enough by AMD/Intel, you can install the microcode update yourself in a timely manner by using the [CPU Microcode updates \[AMD/Intel\]](#p-178) plugin.

微代碼補丁包含在我們的EFI韌體更新中。如果需要微程式碼更新來解決AMD /Intel 認為足夠重要的特定問題，您可以使用 [ CPU微程式碼更新 \[ AMD /Intel\]]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/cpu-microcode.html ) 外掛程式自行安裝微程式碼更新。

<a id="p-069"></a>

### SFP(+) Compatibility｜SFP (+) 相容性

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/hardware/sfp_compatibility.html>

Most OPNsense® appliances feature 10 Gigabit SFP+ cages powered by AMD® axgbe to allow for flexible connectivity. Different SFP(+) transceiver modules can be used to connect to different types of media (e.g. copper or fiber) depending on your needs.

大多數 OPNsense® 設備都配備由AMD供電的 10 千兆SFP + 網籠，以實現靈活的連接。根據您的需求，可以使用不同的SFP (+) 收發器模組連接到不同類型的介質（例如銅纜或光纖）。

Our enterprise & datacenter OPNsense® appliances may also feature 25 Gigabit capable SFP28 cages powered by Intel® ice.

我們的企業和資料中心 OPNsense® 設備還可以配備由 Intel® ice 提供支援的 25 千兆級SFP28機箱。

Below you can find some general information as well as a list of tested SFP(+)/SFP28 transceiver modules that are verified to work with OPNsense® appliances.

下面您可以找到一些一般信息，以及經過測試並驗證可與 OPNsense® 設備配合使用的SFP (+)/ SFP28收發器模組列表。

Tip

提示

If you are using an SFP(+)/SFP28 module on one of the OPNsense® appliances that is not listed below but is working properly, consider submitting a Pull Request to [our documentation](https://github.com/opnsense/docs) to extend the list. Any contribution is welcome!

如果您在某個未在下方列出的 OPNsense® 裝置上使用SFP (+)/ SFP28模組，且該模組運作正常，請考慮向 [我們的文件](https://github.com/opnsense/docs)提交 Pull Request 以擴充清單。歡迎任何貢獻！

#### [**General Information**](#p-069)｜[**一般資訊**](#p-069)

There are a lot of transceiver modules available on the market and they are usually one of the following types:

市面上有許多收發器模組，它們通常是以下幾種類型之一：

-   Copper RJ45  
    銅RJ45
    

Often used for connectivity up to a distance of 100 meters maximum and are relatively inexpensive.

通常用於最大距離為 100 公尺的連接，而且價格相對便宜。

Warning

警告

RJ45 SFP+ modules (10GBASE-T) can run at high operating temperatures in comparison to Fiber or DAC modules. Only the datacenter level OPNsense® appliances are equipped with passive cooling for the SFP+ cages. If the ambient temperature does not exceed 50°C, RJ45 SFP+ modules can be used in all OPNsense® appliances without issue.

與光纖或DAC模組相比， RJ45 SFP +模組（10GBASE-T）可在更高的工作溫度下運作。只有資料中心級OPNsense®設備才配備用於SFP +機櫃的被動散熱裝置。若環境溫度不超過50°C，則所有OPNsense®設備均可安全使用RJ45 SFP +模組。

-   Single-mode optical fiber (SMF)  
    單模光纖（ SMF ）
    

Often used for communication across large distances (100+km) and usually connected with either Simplex-LC or Duplex-LC OS2 patch cords. It can potentially carry more bandwidth than Multi-mode fiber, but the equipment needed to use SMF is often more expensive in comparison to MMF.

通常用於遠距離（100+公里）通信，通常與單工-LC或雙工-LC OS2跳線連接。它可能比多模光纖承載更多的頻寬，但使用SMF所需的設備通常比MMF更昂貴。

-   Multi-mode optical fiber (MMF)  
    多模光纖（ MMF ）
    

Multi-mode fiber is the alternative for SMF (up to 550M for 10Gb/s), often used for backbone applications in buildings and usually connected with OM3 Duplex-LC patch cords.

多模光纖是SMF的替代方案（10Gb/s 時可達 550M），常用於建築物內的骨幹應用，通常與OM3雙工- LC跳線連接。

-   Direct-Attach Copper (DAC)  
    直連銅（ DAC ）
    

For short ranges (up to 10M), often a popular choice due to low cost and low latency.

對於短距離（10公尺以內）應用，由於成本低、延遲低，通常是熱門選擇。

-   Active Optical Cable (AOC)  
    有源光纜（ AOC ）
    

An alternative to DAC with lower latency, longer reach, electromagnetic interference (EMI) immunity and smaller, more manageable cable. An economical option compared to using MMF patch cable and network interface modules.

它是一種替代DAC的方案，具有更低的延遲、更遠的傳輸距離、抗電磁幹擾( EMI )以及更小巧、更易於管理的線纜。與使用MMF跳線和網路介面模組相比，它是一種更經濟的選擇。

Attention

注意

Most transceiver modules are available for purchase with a variety of different programming options for compatibility with different vendors. Unless specified otherwise, all modules are assumed to have the generic / MSA standard default programming.

大多數收發器模組都提供多種不同的程式選項，以相容於不同廠商的產品。除非另有說明，所有模組均預設採用通用/ MSA標準編程。

#### [**Axgbe**](#p-069)｜[**Axgbe**](#p-069)

Note

注意事項

10 Mbit/s is currently not supported by Axgbe.

Axgbe 目前不支援 10 Mbit/s。

Note

注意事項

When using SFP+Modules, do not mix 2.5/5Gbps and 10Gbps link-speed as the hardware does not support mixing these due to different frequencies.

使用SFP +模組時，請勿混合使用2.5 /5Gbps 和 10Gbps 鏈路速度，因為硬體不支援由於頻率不同而混合使用這些鏈路速度。

<a id="p-070"></a>

### Support｜支援

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/hardware/support.html>

Firewalls can be complex devices, in which case it helps to have some pointers when running into issues. When official hardware is used, a free year of OPNsense Business Edition is offered with the product.

防火牆可能非常複雜，因此遇到問題時，掌握一些指導原則會很有幫助。使用官方硬體時，產品會附贈一年的 OPNsense 商業版軟體。

In case a problem emerges, we need to establish if this is related to either hardware or software. Over the years we have seen quite some different challenges people run into, which we would like to highlight in this chapter, including feedback our engineers need to assess if an issue is hardware related. To assist with installation and/or configuration challenges, we can always offer support when subscribed to our business support service.

如果出現問題，我們需要確定問題出在硬體還是軟體上。多年來，我們遇到過各種各樣的挑戰，本章將重點介紹這些挑戰，以及我們的工程師需要哪些回饋來評估問題是否與硬體相關。如果您訂閱了我們的企業支援服務，我們將隨時為您提供安裝和/或設定方面的協助。

Tip

提示

Always make sure to backup your configuration before doing any debugging.

在進行任何調試之前，請務必備份您的配置。

Note

注意事項

To start an RMA procedure, always contact our sales team (sales at opnsense dot com) first, make sure to let us know which device serial number it relates to.

要啟動RMA程序，請務必先聯絡我們的銷售團隊（sales at opnsense dot com），並確保告知我們它與哪個設備序號相關。

Note

注意事項

When redacting output for security reasons, always make sure networks are replaced with similar numbers (specifically using the same subnets), for example when using `192.168.1.1/24` on the firewall and not wanting to share that information, just replace it with something like `x1.x1.x1.1/24` so we know there is a `/24` network for which we use the .1 address.

出於安全原因編輯輸出時，務必確保網路被替換為類似的數字（特別是使用相同的子網），例如，當在防火牆上使用`192.168.1.1/24`並且不想共享該資訊時，只需將其替換為類似`x1.x1.x1.1/24`的內容，這樣我們就知道存在一個`/24`網絡，我們為其使用 .1 位址。

When sharing information with our team, you often need to collect some data from the machine, you can either arrange that via [serial connectivity](#p-067) or a [secure shell](#p-098).

在與我們的團隊共享資訊時，您經常需要從機器收集一些數據，您可以透過 [串行連接](#p-067)或 [安全外殼](#p-098)來安排。

#### Network connectivity issues｜網路連線問題

When there’s no or limited network connectivity, we need to establish if there is a physical connectivity issue first. Always make sure to use well shielded network cables and check connectivity on the same switch port using a laptop or other device to rule out issues with the other end of the connection.

當網路連線中斷或受限時，我們需要先確定是否有實體連線問題。務必使用屏蔽良好的網路線，並使用筆記型電腦或其他裝置連接到同一交換器連接埠進行連接測試，以排除連接另一端的問題。

Knowing both cable and switch (or modem) connectivity is fine, we can start investigating if the issue is caused by a specific port or if its a more generic issue. We can use Interfaces ‣ Assignments to switch ports around, so for example if `igc0` is having issues, try to move the function to another port and see if the issue persists after a clean reboot.

確認網路線和交換器（或數據機）連接正常後，我們可以開始調查問題是出在特定連接埠還是更普遍的問題上。我們可以使用「接口」‣「分配」來切換端口，例如，如果`igc0`出現問題，可以嘗試將其功能移至另一個端口，然後重啟系統，看看問題是否仍然存在。

If the issue seems to be isolated to a single (specific) port, when contacting our office, please share the status of the lights for both working and non working ports and via a console collect the output of the following commands after a clean reboot:

如果問題似乎僅限於單一（特定）端口，請在聯繫我們辦公室時，提供正常工作端口和不正常工作端口的指示燈狀態，並在乾淨重啟後透過控制台收集以下命令的輸出：

```
dmesg
ifconfig -m -v
ifinfo
```

In cases where the issue seems to persist when chosing another port, the easiest option to rule out hardware issues is to reinstall the device and retest with our default settings.

如果選擇其他連接埠後問題仍然存在，排除硬體問題的最簡單方法是重新安裝設備並使用預設設定重新測試。

#### Boot issues / drive issues｜啟動問題/驅動器問題

In order to debug, we need to establish console connectivity first using the (serial) console port. When powering up the machine, after a while, there’s usually some output from the bios of the machine.

為了進行調試，我們需要先透過（串列埠）控制台連接埠建立連線。機器啟動後，過一段時間，通常會從機器的BIOS輸出一些資訊。

You can use the `<ESC>` key to select a boot device, with this you can boot from a usb stick to reinstall if you’re not able to boot into OPNsense at all.

您可以使用`<ESC>`鍵選擇啟動設備，這樣您就可以從 USB 隨身碟啟動以重新安裝，如果您完全無法啟動到 OPNsense。

In some cases, even with a zfs filesystem, it happens that the filesystem gets corrupted, if that’s the case, it’s usually best to reinstall the device (see reinstalling).

在某些情況下，即使使用 zfs 檔案系統，檔案系統也可能損壞。如果發生這種情況，通常最好重新安裝設備（請參閱重新安裝）。

Most of our devices use NVME storage, if your device contains one and you wish to reinstall as clean as possible (which is advisable in some situations), boot into the installer, login using `root` with the password `opnsense` next choose 8 for console and execute the following command:

我們的大多數設備都使用NVME存儲，如果您的設備包含一個存儲並且您希望盡可能乾淨地重新安裝（在某些情況下建議這樣做），請啟動安裝程序，使用`root`和密碼`opnsense`登錄，然後選擇8作為控制台並執行以下命令：

```
nvmecontrol format nvme0
```

Then exit to login prompt (type exit and select 0) And try re-installing (using `installer` with password `opnsense`).

然後退出到登入提示字元（輸入 exit 並選擇 0），然後嘗試重新安裝（使用`installer`和密碼`opnsense` ）。

#### Random crashes or reboots｜隨機崩潰或重啟

When the machine crashes with a “kernel” crash, there’s often a crash report in System ‣ Firmware ‣ Reporter, you can upload that via the reporter to us adding your email address (to help us find it) or you can copy any relevant information that is reported there and send it to our team.

當機器發生「核心」崩潰時，通常會在「系統」‣「韌體」‣「報告器」中產生崩潰報告。您可以透過報告器上傳該報告，並附上您的電子郵件地址（以便我們可以找到），或者您可以複製其中報告的任何相關資訊並將其發送給我們的團隊。

In most cases, to exclude hardware issues, it’s best to reinstall the machine and test it without any additional plugins installed. If the machine remains unstable in that case, please share the crash reporter output and the output of the following commands so we can assess next steps on our end:

大多數情況下，為了排除硬體問題，最好重新安裝系統並在不安裝任何額外插件的情況下進行測試。如果系統仍然不穩定，請提供崩潰報告的輸出以及以下命令的輸出，以便我們評估後續步驟：

```
dmesg
cat /var/log/system/latest.log
```

#### Reinstalling the Business Edition｜重新安裝商業版

Using your license number, you can always download the latest software installers from our servers, these are located at [https://opnsense-update.deciso.com/\[license\_number\]/Installers](https://opnsense-update.deciso.com/).

使用您的許可證號，您可以隨時從我們的伺服器下載最新的軟體安裝程序，這些程序位於 [ https://opnsense-update.deciso.com/\[license\_number\ ]/Installers]( https://opnsense-update.deciso.com/ )。

The filenames are similar to the ones used for the community edition, these are explained [here](#p-055), just continue reading in that section of the manual to learn how to verify the files, create a bootable usb stick and run the installer. Both versions are similar when it comes to installation.

檔案名稱與社群版使用的檔案名稱類似，具體說明請參閱[此處](#p-055) ，請繼續閱讀手冊的相應章節，以了解如何驗證檔案、建立啟動USB以及運行安裝程式。兩個版本的安裝過程基本上相同。

Note

注意事項

For installs on our hardware, you will need the `serial` type.

要在我們的硬體上進行安裝，您需要`serial`類型。

---

### Lobby｜大廳

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

[![_images/architecture-building-ceiling-lamp-260931.jpg](<../images/1c622abb-architecture-building-ceiling-lamp-26093.jpg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/architecture-building-ceiling-lamp-260931.jpg)

The lobby is the entrance to your (virtual) security appliance, where you can find your dashboard, change your password and end your session. After initial installation, this is the first place you will visit.

大廳是您（虛擬）安全設備的入口，您可以在這裡找到控制台、更改密碼和結束會話。首次安裝後，這是您首先會訪問的地方。

<a id="p-072"></a>

### General User Interface｜通用使用者介面

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/gui.html>

This article explains the basics of the OPNsense Graphical User Interface or GUI for short.

本文介紹了 OPNsense 圖形使用者介面（簡稱GUI的基本原理。

#### User Login｜使用者登入

Before we can take a look at the GUI options we need to login. The default user is root and the password is opnsense.

在查看GUI選項之前，我們需要登入。預設使用者名稱是root，密碼是opnsense。

[![../_images/login.png](<../images/f87894f1-login.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/login.png)

#### GUI Layout & Main Components｜GUI佈局和主要組件

The GUI consists out of the following main components:

GUI由以下主要部件組成：

[![../_images/gui_layout.png](<../images/31e5c380-gui_layout.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/gui_layout.png)

##### Logo & Link to Lobby｜標誌和通往大廳的鏈接

Click on the OPNsense logo wherever you are in the interface and you will be directed to the lobby and dashboard.

無論你在介面的哪個位置，點擊 OPNsense 徽標，即可進入大廳和儀表板。

In the Lobby you can:

在大廳您可以：

-   Look at the dashboard with widgets  
    查看具有小部件的儀表板
    
-   View the 2-clause BSD license  
    查看 2 條款BSD許可證
    
-   Change your password  
    更改密碼
    
-   Logout  
    註銷
    

##### Menu Area｜選單區域

The Menu area holds all the primary menus and submenus. Here you can select what part of the system you want to watch or change.

選單區域包含所有主選單和子選單。您可以在這裡選擇要查看或變更的系統部分。

You can see the layering on the menu. There are three levels:

您可以從選單上看出層次結構。共有三個層次：

1.  Category level  
    類別層級
    
2.  Function level  
    職能層級
    
3.  Configuration level *(may not exist if the function is simple)*  
    配置等級*（如果功能簡單則可能不存在）*
    

In the following sample you see a screenshot of the Category **System**, with:

以下範例展示了類別**系統**的螢幕截圖，其中包含：

-   Function: **Settings**  
    功能：**設定**
    
-   Selected Configuration item: **General**  
    已選取配置項目：**常規**
    

![../_images/submenu.png](<../images/6f534001-submenu.png>)

##### Favorites｜收藏夾

Frequently used menu items can be added to a Favorites menu. This applies to Configuration level items, or Function level items if the Configuration level does not exist.

常用選單項目可以加入到收藏夾選單。這適用於配置層級的選單項，如果配置層級不存在，則也適用於功能層級的選單項目。

To add or remove a Favorites menu item, hover over the page title with your mouse or tap it on a touch device. A favorite (star) icon will appear. Click or tap this icon to toggle the menu item as a favorite.

若要新增或移除收藏選單項，請將滑鼠停留在頁面標題上，或在觸控裝置上點擊頁面標題。此時會出現一個收藏（星形）圖示。點擊或輕觸此圖示即可將該選單項目切換為收藏。

Favorites are shown in the Favorites menu item at the top of the menu area, where they can be selected for quick access.

收藏夾顯示在選單區域頂部的「收藏夾」選單項目中，可以從中選擇以便快速存取。

[![../_images/favorites.png](<../images/6d489981-favorites.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/favorites.png)

##### Search Navigation｜搜尋導航

Another way to navigate through the GUI is by using the search box on the upper right corner of the screen. Either click on it or hit tab to select it.

瀏覽GUI的另一種方法是使用螢幕右上角的搜尋框。您可以點選它，也可以按Tab鍵選擇它。

The search field is a type-ahead field, meaning that it will guess what you are looking for and fill up while typing. Hit Enter or click on an option to select and navigate directly to the right page.

搜尋框是自動補全的，也就是說它會根據你的輸入自動猜測你要找的內容並填滿。按下回車鍵或點擊選項即可選擇並直接跳到對應的頁面。

![../_images/quick-navigation.png](<../images/ba4fd67a-quick-navigation.png>)

##### System Status｜系統狀態

In the upper right corner of the screen is also a small indication of the system status. In a normal situation this will be greyed out, but it will display a color if something is wrong. You can click on it to review any of the pending messages, if any:

螢幕右上角還有一個系統狀態指示器。正常情況下，它會顯示為灰色；但如果出現問題，它會顯示不同的顏色。您可以點擊它來查看是否有待處理的消息：

![../_images/gui_system_status.png](<../images/f840f6e0-gui_system_status.png>)

The colors indicate the severity of the issue. They are:

顏色代表問題的嚴重程度。它們分別是：

-   Red. Indicates that an error has occurred during system operation. Click it to go to the relevant page. In most cases this will be the crash reporter, which you can use to send us information about the crash.  
    紅色。表示系統運作過程中發生錯誤。點擊即可跳轉至相關頁面。大多數情況下，這將是崩潰報告頁面，您可以使用它向我們發送有關崩潰的信息。
    

![../_images/gui_system_status_error.png](<../images/8d68d43d-gui_system_status_error.png>)

-   Yellow. Indicates a warning.  
    黃色。表示警告。
    
-   Blue. Indicates an informational message.  
    藍色。表示訊息提示。
    
-   Grey. Everything is working as normal.  
    灰色。一切正常。
    

##### User & Local domain｜使用者和本地網域

In the right corner just to the left of the system status you will see your username and the full domain name the firewall is configured with (to change firewall name, go to System ‣ Setting ‣ General).

在系統狀態的右側角落，您將看到您的使用者名稱和防火牆配置的完整網域名稱（要變更防火牆名稱，請前往「系統」‣「設定」‣「常規」）。

##### Content Area｜內容區域

The content area is used to display:

內容區域用於顯示：

-   Input forms  
    輸入表單
    
-   Popup Forms  
    彈出式表單
    
-   Buttons  
    按鈕
    
-   General forms of data output graphical and text based  
    資料輸出的一般形式包括圖形和文字。
    

#### Form View｜表單視圖

Let’s take a look at how an advanced form may look like:

讓我們來看看高級表單可能會是什麼樣子：

![../_images/proxy_form.png](<../images/c8ef76d1-proxy_form.png>)

##### Full Help｜全面幫助

Many forms are equipped with built-in help. In the upper right corner of the form you can select to view all help messages at once. The toggle will color green when enabled and show the help messages beneath the input items.

許多表單都內建了幫助功能。在表單的右上角，您可以選擇一次查看所有幫助資訊。啟用後，該開關會顯示為綠色，並在輸入項目下方顯示幫助資訊。

![../_images/help_msg.png](<../images/101ab207-help_msg.png>)

##### Advanced Mode｜高級模式

Some forms have hidden advanced features, to view them toggle the **advanced mode** in the left corner of the form. Doing so will reveal all advanced options.

某些表單隱藏著一些進階功能，要查看這些功能，請切換到表單左上角的**進階模式**。切換後將顯示所有進階選項。

![../_images/advanced.png](<../images/ff7347e4-advanced.png>)

##### Single Item Help｜單項幫助

Show a single line help by pressing the **(i)** left of a form item. Like this:

按下表單項目左側的 **(i)** 鍵，即可顯示單行幫助資訊。例如：

![../_images/info.png](<../images/c548f01a-info.png>)

##### Standard Tabs｜標準標籤

A standard tab can be clicked upon to open the corresponding form.

點擊標準標籤即可開啟對應的表單。

A sample can be seen here:

這裡可以看到一個範例：

![../_images/tab.png](<../images/5525fb1f-tab.png>)

##### Dropdown Tabs｜下拉標籤

A dropdown tab can be clicked upon to open the first menu item or you can click on the arrow next to it to show all options, like so:

您可以點選下拉選單標籤開啟第一個選單項，或點選旁邊的箭頭顯示所有選項，如下所示：

![../_images/dropdown_tab.png](<../images/2feeb5cb-dropdown_tab.png>)

#### Data grids｜資料網格

Many components within OPNsense use grid views to navigate through content, below is an example of a simple table view supporting the most relevant actions.

OPNsense 中的許多元件都使用網格視圖來瀏覽內容，以下是一個簡單的表格視圖範例，支援最相關的操作。

![../_images/gui_grid.png](<../images/6bc8e452-gui_grid.png>)

##### Fields｜田野

The available fields vary between components, the icon can be used to select which fields should be visible or hidden.

不同組件的可用欄位各不相同，可以使用圖示來選擇哪些欄位應該可見或隱藏。  
  

##### Filter and limit｜過濾和限制

The top area of the grid contains a search input combined with a reload button and a selection for the number of rows to show at once on a page. Often the search input will be instantly applied, but in some cases a reload is needed if the action can't be processed fast enough.

網格頂部區域包含一個搜尋框、一個刷新按鈕以及一個用於選擇每頁同時顯示的行數的選項。通常情況下，搜尋操作會立即生效，但如果操作處理速度不夠快，則需要重新整理頁面。  
  
When using the filter in log files, you will find a **Go to page** action behind every record. This will jump to the corresponding page and show you all surrounding records so you can see the context of a log message.

在日誌檔案中使用過濾器時，您會發現每個記錄後面都有一個**轉到頁面**操作。這將跳到相應的頁面並顯示所有周圍的記錄，以便您可以查看日誌訊息的上下文。  
  

The search input tokenizes space-delimited words, causing the filter to return records matching all of the clauses included in the search phrase.

搜尋輸入會將空格分隔的單字進行分詞，從而使篩選器傳回與搜尋短語中包含的所有子句相符的記錄。

##### Actions｜行動

Different actions could be supported on a (set of) records:

可以對（一組）記錄執行不同的操作：

-   / Enable / disable a record  
    啟用/停用記錄
-   Edit a record  
    編輯記錄
-   Copy a record and edit  
    複製記錄並編輯
-   Delete a record, usually this will ask for a confirmation  
    刪除記錄時，通常會要求確認。
-   Add a new record and open edit dialog  
    新增記錄並開啟編輯對話框

  
  

##### Page Navigation｜頁面導航

The navigation buttons `« ‹ [1,2,..] › »` help scroll through the different pages that are available for the selected data.

導航按鈕`« ‹ [1,2,..] › »`可協助捲動所選資料的不同頁面。

Note

注意事項

Although the page numbers and last page button (`»`) are always visible, they can only be used when the size of the dataset is known upfront. In case of large datasets, such as intrusion alerts and log views the number of records is not known upfront, since there’s no relation between the size of the underlying data and the number of records.

雖然頁碼和最後一頁按鈕（ `»` ）始終可見，但只有在預先知道資料集大小的情況下才能使用它們。對於大型資料集，例如入侵警報和日誌視圖，記錄數無法預先得知，因為底層資料的大小與記錄數之間沒有關聯。

The record count in these cases is more or less a guestimate based on the number of records already shown.

這些情況下的記錄數或多或少是根據已顯示的記錄數所做的估計。

---

<a id="p-073"></a>

### Dashboard｜儀表板

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/dashboard.html>

The Dashboard is the first page you will see after you log into OPNsense. Additionally, it can be accessed via Lobby ‣ Dashboard. The Dashboard provides an overview of your system status.

登入 OPNsense 後，您首先看到的頁面是「儀表板」。此外，您還可以透過「大廳」‣「儀表板」存取它。 “儀錶板”提供系統狀態概覽。

#### Configuration｜配置

What is shown on the Dashboard can be configured by adding and removing widgets. Some widgets also allow further configuration.

儀表板上顯示的內容可以透過新增和移除小工具進行配置。某些小部件還允許進行更高級的配置。

By default, the following widgets are present:

預設情況下，會顯示以下組件：

-   **System Information** Shows information about the installed OPNsense version, updates etc.  
    **系統資訊** 顯示有關已安裝的 OPNsense 版本、更新等資訊。
    
-   **Memory** Shows memory usage.  
    **記憶體** 顯示記憶體使用量。
    
-   **Disk** Shows disk usage.  
    **磁碟** 顯示磁碟使用情況。
    
-   **CPU** Shows CPU usage.  
    **CPU** 顯示CPU使用情況。
    
-   **Announcements** Shows the latest announcements from the OPNsense project.  
    **公告** 顯示 OPNsense 專案的最新公告。
    
-   **Gateways** Shows used gateways.  
    **網關** 顯示已使用的網關。
    
-   **Interface Statistics** Shows the number of packets, bytes and errors handled by each interface.  
    **介面統計資料** 顯示每個介面處理的資料包數量、位元組數和錯誤數量。
    
-   **Firewall** Collects logged events from the moment the dashboard has loaded to represent a snapshot of what the firewall is currently seeing. Can be expanded to show a live log.  
    **防火牆** 從儀表板載入完畢後開始收集日誌事件，以呈現防火牆目前監控狀態的快照。可以展開查看即時日誌。
    
-   **Traffic Graph** Shows traffic passing through the system.  
    **流量圖** 顯示通過系統的流量。
    
-   **Services** Shows the configured services as well as the options to start/restart/stop them.  
    **服務** 顯示已設定的服務以及啟動/重新啟動/停止這些服務的選項。
    

In the upper right corner of the page, you can find the following buttons:

在頁面右上角，您可以找到以下按鈕：

-   **Edit dashboard (pencil icon)** Enter edit mode. Unlocks the dashboard temporarily so you can move, resize, remove, or configure widgets.  
    **編輯儀錶板（鉛筆圖示）** 進入編輯模式。暫時解鎖儀錶板，以便您可以移動、調整大小、刪除或配置小工具。
    
-   **Add widget (plus icon)** Opens a dialog window with a list of widgets that can be added to the Dashboard. Simply click on an entry in the list to add it to the Dashboard.  
    **新增小工具（加號圖示）** 打開一個對話框窗口，其中列出了可以新增到儀表板的小工具。只需單擊清單中的條目即可將其新增至儀表板。
    
-   **Restore default layout (widgets icon)** Restores the dashboard to its default configuration discarding all your modifications.  
    **恢復預設佈局（小部件圖示）** 將儀表板恢復到預設配置，丟棄您的所有修改。
    
-   **Save** After editing the dashboard, you can make all changes persistent by clicking this button. Otherwise the changes will be discarded as soon as you reload the page.  
    **儲存** 編輯完儀錶板後，您可以點擊此按鈕儲存所有變更。否則，頁面重新載入後，變更將會遺失。
    

If the dashboard is in edit mode, the following buttons are available in the upper right corner of every widget:

如果儀錶板處於編輯模式，則每個小部件的右上角都會顯示以下按鈕：

-   **Edit (pencil icon)** Click this to modify the widget settings. This button is only present if the widget is configurable.  
    **編輯（鉛筆圖示）** 點擊此按鈕修改小工具設定。僅當小工具可配置時，此按鈕才會顯示。
    
-   **Remove (cross icon)** Removes the widget from the Dashboard.  
    **移除（叉號圖示）** 從儀錶板移除小工具。
    

If the widget is not in edit mode, you can find a link in the upper right corner of each widget if applicable, which will take you to the relevant configuration page.

如果小部件未處於編輯模式，您可以在每個小部件的右上角找到連結（如有），點擊該連結即可進入相關的設定頁面。

All widgets can be resized by dragging on one of the corners of the widget.

所有控制都可以透過拖曳控制項的角落來調整大小。

Note

注意事項

The dashboard configuration is saved per user. This means that each user can have their own dashboard layout. Therefore, use the “Users and Groups”（使用者和群組） high availability option to synchronize the dashboard configuration.

儀表板配置是按使用者儲存的。這意味著每個使用者都可以擁有自己的儀錶板佈局。因此，請使用“Users and Groups”（使用者和群組）高可用性選項來同步儀錶板配置。

---

<a id="p-074"></a>

### Password｜密碼

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/lobby_password.html>

The password page in the lobby offers the user the ability to change his or hers password and default settings.

大廳中的密碼頁面允許使用者更改密碼和預設設定。

When The option `User OTP seed` is enabled in the System->Settings->Administration page, one could also acquire a new OTP seed here.

當在系統->設定->管理頁面中啟用選項`User OTP seed`時，也可以在這裡取得新的OTP種子。

Warning

警告

Changing an OTP seed automatically invalidates the previous one, so only request a new one when you are able to scan the new one using your mobile phone.

更改OTP種子會自動使先前的種子失效，因此只有當您能夠使用手機掃描新種子時，才要求新的種子。

---

<a id="p-075"></a>

### OPNsense Tools｜OPNsense 工具

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/opnsense_tools.html>

The OPNsense project offers a number of tools to instantly patch the system, revert a package to a previous (older version) state or revert the whole kernel.

OPNsense 專案提供了許多工具，可以立即修補系統、將軟體包恢復到先前的（舊版本）狀態或恢復整個核心。

#### opnsense-update｜opsense-更新

The opnsense-update utility offers combined kernel and base system upgrades using remotely fetched binary sets, as well as package upgrades via pkg. For a complete list of options look at the manpage on the system.

opnsense-update 工具提供核心和基礎系統組合升級，可透過遠端取得二進位檔案集進行升級，也可透過 pkg 進行軟體套件升級。有關完整選項列表，請參閱系統手冊頁。

##### Example:｜範例：

A minor update also updated the kernel and you experience some driver issues with your NIC. Open your browser and go to

一次小更新也更新了內核，導致您的NIC出現一些驅動程式問題。打開瀏覽器並訪問

[https://pkg.opnsense.org/FreeBSD:11:amd64/18.1/sets/](https://pkg.opnsense.org/FreeBSD:11:amd64/18.1/sets/)

Here you can see all the kernels for version 18.1. Be aware to change the version if you are on a newer version. As an example you updated from 18.1.4 to 18.1.5 you have now installed kernel-18.1.5. To revert back to the last stable you can see kernel-18.1 so the syntax would be:

這裡可以看到版本18.1的所有核心。如果您使用的是更新的版本，請注意更改版本號。例如，如果您從18.1.4更新到18.1.5則現在安裝的是核心18.1.5 。要恢復到上一個穩定版本，您可以查看內核18.1語法如下：

\# opnsense-update -kr 18.1

\# opnsense-shell reboot

#### opnsense-shell 重啟

Where -k only touches the kernel and -r takes the version number.

其中 -k 只修改內核，-r 指定版本號。

To switch back to the current kernel just use

要切換回當前內核，只需使用

\# opnsense-update -k

#### opnsense-update -k

\# opnsense-shell reboot

#### opnsense-shell 重啟

Warning

警告

Before reverting a kernel please consult the forums or open an issue via Github. You should only revert kernels on test machines or when qualified team members advise you to do so!

在回滾核心版本之前，請先查閱論壇或透過 GitHub 提交 issue。您只能在測試機器上回滾內核，或在合格的團隊成員建議下進行回滾！

#### opnsense-revert

The opnsense-revert utility offers to securely install previous versions of packages found in an OPNsense release as long as the selected mirror caches said release. For a complete list of options look at the manpage on the system.

opnsense-revert 工具可以安全地安裝 OPNsense 版本中包含的軟體包的先前版本，前提是所選鏡像快取了該版本。有關完整選項列表，請參閱系統上的手冊頁。

##### Example 1:｜例1：

The latest update of OPNsense to version 18.1.5 did a minor jump for the IPSec package “strongswan”. From this moment your VPNs are unstable and only a restart helps.

OPNsense 最新更新至18.1.5版本後，IPSec 軟體套件「strongswan」的版本號略有變化。從現在開始，您的 VPN 連線將不穩定，只有重新啟動才能解決問題。

To check if the update of the package is the reason you can easily revert the package to its previous state while running the latest OPNsense version itself.

要檢查軟體包更新是否是原因，您可以在運行最新 OPNsense 版本的同時，輕鬆地將軟體包恢復到先前的狀態。

\# opnsense-revert -r 18.1.4 strongswan

#### opnsense-revert -r 18.1.4 strongswan

With this command you can, for example, run OPNsense 18.1.5 while using the 18.1.4 version of strongswan. If you want to go back to the current release version just do

例如，您可以使用此指令在執行 StrongSwan 的18.1.4版本時執行 OPNsense 18.1.5 。如果您想返回目前版本，只需執行以下操作即可。

\# opnsense-revert strongswan

#### opnsense-revert strongswan

##### Example 2:｜例2：

The previous revert of strongswan was not the solution you expected so you try to completely revert to the previous OPNsense version:

先前對 strongswan 的回滾操作並沒有達到預期效果，因此您嘗試完全回滾到先前的 OPNsense 版本：

\# opnsense-revert -r 18.1.4 opnsense

#### opnsense-revert -r 18.1.4 opnsense

Be aware to also check if there were kernel updates like above to also downgrade the kernel if needed!

請注意，也要檢查是否有類似上述的核心更新，以便在需要時降級核心！

#### opnsense-patch

The opnsense-patch utility treats all arguments as upstream git repository commit hashes, downloads them and finally applies them in order. Patches can also be reversed by reapplying them, but multiple patches must be given in reverse order to succeed. For a complete list of options look at the manpage on the system.

opnsense-patch 工具會將所有參數視為上游 Git 倉庫的提交雜湊值，下載這些雜湊值，然後按順序套用它們。也可以透過重新套用補丁來撤銷已套用的補丁，但要成功套用多個補丁，必須按相反的順序輸入。有關完整的選項列表，請參閱系統上的手冊頁。

##### Example 1:｜例1：

In the Traffic Shaper a newly introduced typo prevents the system from setting the correct ipfw ruleset. You were asked by the developer to test a fresh patch 63cfe0a at URL [https://github.com/opnsense/core/commit/63cfe0a96c83eee0e8aea0caa841f4fc7b92a8d0](https://github.com/opnsense/core/commit/63cfe0a96c83eee0e8aea0caa841f4fc7b92a8d0) At the end of the page there’s the short version 63cfe0a so the command would be:

流量整形器中新引入的一個拼字錯誤導致系統無法設定正確的 ipfw 規則集。開發人員要求您在URL [https://github.com/opnsense/core/commit/63cfe0a96c83eee0e8aea0caa841f4fc7b92a8d0](https://github.com/opnsense/core/commit/63cfe0a96c83eee0e8aea0caa841f4fc7b92a8d0)處測試新修補程式 63cfe0a。頁面末尾顯示的是簡寫版本 63cfe0a，因此命令應為：

\# opnsense-patch 63cfe0a

#### opnsense-patch 63cfe0a

If it doesn’t fix your issue or makes it even worse, you can just reapply the command to revert it.

如果這樣做沒有解決您的問題，或者使問題變得更糟，您可以重新執行該命令以撤銷操作。

##### Example 2:｜例2：

You need a special feature for a plugin and ask in Github for it. A developer adds it and ask you to install the patch 699f1f2 for testing. The full link to it would be [https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/commit/699f1f28a33ce0122fa0e2f5e6e1f48eb3c4f074](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/commit/699f1f28a33ce0122fa0e2f5e6e1f48eb3c4f074)

你需要插件的一個特殊功能，並在 GitHub 上提出請求。開發者添加了該功能，並要求你安裝補丁 699f1f2 進行測試。完整的連結是 [https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/commit/699f1f28a33ce0122fa0e2f5e6e1f48eb3c4f074](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/commit/699f1f28a33ce0122fa0e2f5e6e1f48eb3c4f074)

\# opnsense-patch -c plugins 699f1f2

#### opnsense-patch -c plugins 699f1f2

The -c changes the default core to plugin repo and adds the patch to the system.

-c 參數將預設核心變更為插件倉庫，並將補丁新增至系統。

It is also possible to add patches from different users, just add -a githubusername before -c

也可以新增來自不同使用者的補丁，只需在 -c 前新增 -a githubusername 即可。

Your firewall collects quite some information about its health and workload, the reporting section will provide insights into these.

您的防火牆會收集有關其運行狀況和工作負載的大量信息，報告部分將提供有關這些信息的見解。

<a id="p-077"></a>

### System Health & Round Robin Data｜系統健康狀況和輪詢數據

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/systemhealth.html>

[![../_images/systemhealth_sample.png](<../images/93be3cb2-systemhealth_sample.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/systemhealth_sample.png)

System Health is a dynamic view on RRD data gathered by the system. It can be accessed via Reporting ‣ Health. It allows you to dive into different statistics that show the overall health and performance of the system over time.

系統健康狀況是系統收集的RRD資料的動態視圖。您可以透過「報告」‣「健康狀況」來存取它。它允許您深入了解各種統計信息，這些信息顯示了系統隨時間推移的整體健康狀況和性能。

The system health module will enable you to track down issues faster and easier than traditional static RRD graphs and it allows you to zoom in.

系統健康模組使您能夠比傳統的靜態RRD圖表更快、更容易地追蹤問題，並且允許您放大。

#### Data collectors｜數據收集器

System Health has the following primary data collectors:

系統健康狀況的主要資料收集器如下：

Packets

數據包

Packets show the number of packets per second traveling to and from a certain interface.

資料包顯示每秒進出特定介面的資料包數量。

Quality

品質

Quality show latency and packet loss of the monitored gateways (ip).

品質顯示被監控網關（ip）的延遲和丟包率。

System

系統

The system section is used for sensor data regarding the system utilization, such as memory usage, mbufs, states, processes and (when available) cpu temperature.

系統部分用於有關係統利用率的感測器數據，例如記憶體使用情況、mbuf、狀態、進程以及（如果可用）CPU 溫度。

Traffic

交通

Shows traffic graphs for each interface including vpn (ipsec).

顯示每個介面（包括 VPN (ipsec)）的流量圖。

Depending on the features in use there may be more or less graphs available.

根據所使用的功能，可用的圖表數量可能會有所不同。

#### GUI Features Overview｜GUI功能概述

Please see the screenshot below for all element of the system health module. Each element will be explained in the next chapters.

請查看下方螢幕截圖，以了解系統健康模組的所有組成部分。每個組成部分將在後續章節中進行解釋。

[![../_images/systemhealth_gui.png](<../images/21f28919-systemhealth_gui.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/systemhealth_gui.png)

##### Toggle menu collapse｜切換菜單折疊

This feature will show or hide the top menu.

此功能可顯示或隱藏頂部選單。

##### Category Selection｜類別選擇

The category items are tabs with drop down menu’s. Click on one of the categories and select the graph you like to dive into.

類別選項以標籤頁的形式呈現，每個標籤頁都配有下拉式選單。點擊其中一個類別，然後選擇您想要查看的圖表。

##### Graph Selection｜圖表選擇

Part of the drop down menu, where you can select the graph to view.

下拉式選單的一部分，您可以在其中選擇要查看的圖表。

##### Select primary dataset｜選擇主資料集

Select the RRD dataset you want to use. The more to the left the lower the maximum resolution. By default the graphs are opened with the highest available RRD resolution.

選擇要使用的RRD資料集。越靠左，最大解析度越低。預設情況下，圖表以可用的最高RRD解析度開啟。

##### Inverse｜逆

By selecting **Inverse** each odd dataset is reversed in direction (times minus one), this is especially useful for traffic flows where you can plot ingoing and outgoing flows in different directions.

透過選擇**反向**，每個奇數資料集的方向都會反轉（乘以-1），這對於交通流量尤其有用，因為您可以繪製不同方向的流入和流出流量。

[![../_images/systemhealth_inverse.png](<../images/e4c01b76-systemhealth_inverse.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/systemhealth_inverse.png)

##### Resolution｜解決

The resolution determines the maximum number of datapoints that will be shown in the graph and therefore indirectly influences the scale of the calculated averages.

解析度決定了圖表中顯示的最大資料點數，因此間接影響計算出的平均值的尺度。

##### Hide/show table data｜隱藏/顯示表格數據

By default the table data is hidden, you can show it by toggling the **Show Tables** to **On**.

預設情況下，表資料是隱藏的，您可以透過將**顯示表**切換為**開啟**來顯示它。

The table data area consists of the min/max/average and detailed table data area.

表格資料區由最小值/最大值/平均值和詳細表格資料區組成。

##### Name of the graph｜圖表名稱

Shows the name of the selected graph.

顯示所選圖表的名稱。

##### Current Detail Level｜目前詳細程度

Since the data is dynamically rendered it will automatically calculate the averages and show you the current detail level in this area.

由於資料是動態渲染的，它會自動計算平均值並向您顯示該區域的當前詳細程度。

##### Label filter｜標籤過濾器

[![../_images/systemhealth_labelfilter.png](<../images/2027de32-systemhealth_labelfilter.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/systemhealth_labelfilter.png)

The label filter can be used to filer out data you do not want to see. Click once to disable or double click to select only this set.

標籤篩選器可用於篩選掉您不想看到的資料。按一下可停用，雙擊可僅選擇此群組。

A nice sample can be seen here, where the *processes* obscure all other data.

這裡可以看到一個很好的例子，其中*進程*掩蓋了所有其他資料。

[![../_images/systemhealth_obscureddata.png](<../images/be5cc0ed-systemhealth_obscureddata.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/systemhealth_obscureddata.png)

Just click once on *processes* to hide this data set, notice that the scales will adapt as well.

只需點擊一次 *processes* 即可隱藏此資料集，請注意，比例尺也會隨之調整。

[![../_images/systemhealth_filtered.png](<../images/3d6b8ffb-systemhealth_filtered.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/systemhealth_filtered.png)

##### Main graph area｜主圖區域

The main graph area show the full graph or just the part you selected in the zoom area with more detail.

主圖表區域顯示完整圖表，或僅顯示您在縮放區域中選擇的部分，並提供更多詳細資訊。

##### Zoom Area｜縮放區域

The zoom area can be used to select and zoom in on one part of the graph, the scales are adapted automatically and any tables will be updated as well.

可以使用縮放區域選擇並放大圖表的某一部分，刻度會自動調整，表格也會隨之更新。

This feature is very useful to zoom in on issues or for showing just part of the graph.

此功能對於放大檢視問題或僅顯示圖表的一部分非常有用。

To use, click on it and hold while moving your pointer to another part of the zoom area, on mouse up (release mouse click) the main graph area will be updated accordingly. The zoom area will also be updated with more detailed data - when available - for the selected area.

使用方法：點擊並按住該按鈕，同時將指標移到縮放區域的其他位置。滑鼠放開（釋放滑鼠點擊）後，主圖表區域將會相應更新。縮放區域也會更新，顯示所選區域的更詳細資料（如有）。

A sample selection:

部分範例：

[![../_images/systemhealt_selection.png](<../images/40476424-systemhealt_selection.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/systemhealt_selection.png)

And the result:

結果如下：

[![../_images/systemhealth_zoomed.png](<../images/91ddd326-systemhealth_zoomed.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/systemhealth_zoomed.png)

##### Min/max/average table｜最小值/最大值/平均值表

If **Show Tables** is on then this area will show: \* Minimum value of each dataset \* Maximum value of each dataset \* Average value of each dataset

如果開啟**顯示表格**，則此區域將顯示：\* 每個資料集的最小值 \* 每個資料集的最大值 \* 每個資料集的平均值

##### Detailed table｜詳細表格

If **Show Tables** is on then this area will show each value that is plotted in the graph. You can toggle the time and date view from timestamp to human readable values and export the data to as comma separated file (.CSV).

如果開啟**顯示表格**，則該區域將顯示圖表中繪製的每個值。您可以將時間和日期視圖從時間戳切換為人類可讀值，並將資料匯出為逗號分隔檔案 (.CSV)。

The exported dataset can be used for your own reporting.

匯出的資料集可用於您自己的報告。

[![../_images/systemhealth_excel.png](<../images/8bd0db81-systemhealth_excel.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/systemhealth_excel.png)

---

<a id="p-078"></a>

### Using Insight - Netflow Analyzer｜使用 Insight - Netflow 分析器

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/insight.html>

OPNsense is equipped with a flexible and fast Netflow Analyzer called Insight. To use Insight, one needs to configure the Netflow exporter for local capturing of Netflow data. To do so take a look at [Configure Netflow Exporter](#p-083).

OPNsense 配備了一個名為 Insight 的靈活快速的 Netflow 分析器。若要使用 Insight，需要設定 Netflow 匯出器以在本機擷取 Netflow 資料。為此，請參閱 [設定 Netflow 導出器](#p-083) 。

#### User Interface｜使用者介面

Insight is a fully integrated part of OPNsense. Its User Interface is simple yet powerful. It can be accessed via Reporting ‣ Insight.

Insight 是 OPNsense 的一個完全整合部分。它的用戶介面簡潔而強大。可以透過「報告」‣「Insight」來存取它。

[![../../_images/insight_gui.png](<../images/65a29dcc-insight_gui.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/insight_gui.png)

Insight offers a full set of analysis tools, ranging from a graphical overview to a csv exporter for further analysis with your favorite spreadsheet.

Insight 提供了一整套分析工具，從圖形概覽到 csv 匯出器，方便您使用自己喜歡的電子表格進行進一步分析。

#### Graphs & Totals｜圖表與總計

The default view of Insight is the Top users and Graphical Overview. This view allows for quick examination of current and past flows, showing a graph for in and out going traffic for each configured interface.

Insight 的預設視圖是「熱門使用者和圖形概覽」。此視圖可以快速查看目前和歷史流量，並以圖表形式顯示每個已配置介面的入站和出站流量。

##### Select Range & Resolution｜選擇範圍和分辨率

In the top right corner a selection can be made for the date range and accuracy (resolution) of the collected traffic flows.

在右上角可以選擇收集的交通流量的日期範圍和精確度（解析度）。

##### View Type｜視圖類型

One can show the traffic flows in a stacked manner (default), as a stream or expanded to compare usage with different interfaces.

可以將流量以堆疊方式（預設）、串流或展開方式顯示，以便與不同介面的使用情況進行比較。

**Stacked**

**堆疊**

[![../../_images/stacked_view.png](<../images/5092703d-stacked_view.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/stacked_view.png)

**Stream**

**溪流**

[![../../_images/stream_view.png](<../images/f0b0f1b4-stream_view.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/stream_view.png)

**Expanded**

**擴充版**

[![../../_images/expanded_view.png](<../images/898a609f-expanded_view.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/expanded_view.png)

##### Interfaces｜介面

Clicking on an interface disables or enables the graph view, double clicking select only that interface.

按一下介面可停用或啟用圖形視圖，雙擊僅選擇該介面。

##### Top Users｜熱門用戶

The top 25 users are shown for a selected interface, both for ports and ips within the previously selected date range.

針對選定的接口，顯示先前選定日期範圍內端口和 IP 位址使用次數排名前 25 的用戶。

##### Interface Top｜介面頂部

Select the interface to see the top 25 users.

選擇介面查看排名前 25 名的用戶。

##### Port Pie Chart｜港口圓餅圖

The port pie chart shows the percentage per port/application. One can change the view by clicking or double clicking on one of the shown port names/numbers.

連接埠餅圖顯示了每個連接埠/應用程式的百分比。按一下或雙擊顯示的連接埠名稱/編號即可變更視圖。

Clicking on a piece of the pie will open a detailed view for further analysis.

點擊圓餅圖中的某一部分，即可開啟詳細視圖進行進一步分析。

[![../../_images/pie_piece.png](<../images/adee58d7-pie_piece.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/pie_piece.png) [![../../_images/pie_details.png](<../images/2c4cfc7b-pie_details.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/pie_details.png)

##### IP Addresses Pie Chart｜IP地址餅圖

The IP addresses pie chart works the same as the ports pie chart and shows the percentage per IP number. One can change the view by clicking or double clicking on one of the shown IP numbers.

地址餅圖IP的工作方式與連接埠餅圖相同，顯示每個位址IP的百分比。點選或雙擊顯示的位址IP即可變更視圖。

Clicking on a piece of the pie will open a detailed view for further analysis.

點擊圓餅圖中的某一部分，即可開啟詳細視圖進行進一步分析。

##### Interface Totals｜介面總計

Not shown in the screenshot but latest version also includes a Total for the selected interface, shown are Packets (In, Out, Total) and Bytes (In, Out, Total).

截圖中未顯示，但最新版本還包含所選介面的總計，顯示資料包（入、出、總計）和位元組（入、出、總計）。

#### Details View｜詳細資訊

One can open the details view by clicking on one of the pieces of a pie chart or click on the tab **Details**.

您可以透過點擊餅圖的某一部分或點擊「**詳細資料**」標籤來開啟詳細資料視圖。

When opening the details view by clicking on the tab one can make a new query.

點選標籤開啟詳細資料檢視後，即可建立新查詢。

[![../../_images/insight_details_view.png](<../images/a441d589-insight_details_view.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/insight_details_view.png)

After selecting a valid date range (form/to) and interface one can further limit the output by filtering on port or IP address. Select the refresh icon to update the detailed output. Leave Port and Address empty for a full detailed listing.

選擇有效的日期範圍（起始日期/結束日期）和介面後，也可以透過按連接埠或IP位址篩選來進一步縮小輸出範圍。點擊刷新圖示即可更新詳細輸出。如果要查看完整詳細列表，請將連接埠和位址留空。

[![../../_images/insight_full_details.png](<../images/df772907-insight_full_details.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/insight_full_details.png)

#### Export View｜匯出視圖

The **Export** view allows you to export the data for further analysis in your favorite spreadsheet or other data analysis application.

透過**匯出**視圖，您可以將資料匯出到您喜歡的電子表格或其他資料分析應用程式中進行進一步分析。

[![../../_images/insight_export_view.png](<../images/d0f0cca9-insight_export_view.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/insight_export_view.png)

To export data, select a **Collection** :

若要匯出數據，請選擇一個**集合**：

-   FlowSourceAddrTotals - Totals per source address  
    FlowSourceAddrTotals - 每個來源位址的總計
    
-   FlowInterfaceTotals - Totals per interface  
    FlowInterfaceTotals - 每個介面的總計
    
-   FlowDstPortTotals - Totals per destination port  
    FlowDstPortTotals - 每個目標連接埠的總計
    
-   FlowSourceAddrDetails - Full details per source address  
    FlowSourceAddrDetails - 每個來源位址的完整詳細信息
    

Select the **Resolution** in seconds (300,3600,86400)

選擇**解析度**（以秒為單位）（300,3600,86400）

Then select a date range (from/to) and click the **export** button.

然後選擇日期範圍（從/到），並點擊**匯出**按鈕。

[![../../_images/insight_export.png](<../images/9b12b991-insight_export.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/insight_export.png)

<a id="p-079"></a>

### Netflow Export & Analyses｜Netflow 匯出與分析

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/netflow.html>

[![../_images/netflow_analyzer_insight.png](<../images/37faa6bb-netflow_analyzer_insight.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/netflow_analyzer_insight.png)

Netflow is a monitoring feature, invented by Cisco, it is implemented in the FreeBSD kernel with ng\_netflow (Netgraph). Since Netgraph is a kernel implementation it is very fast with little overhead compared to softflowd or pfflowd.

Netflow 是 Cisco 發明的監控功能，它在 FreeBSD 核心中透過 ng_netflow（Netgraph）實現。由於 Netgraph 是核心級實現，因此與 softflowd 或 pfflowd 相比，它速度非常快，而且開銷也很小。

While many monitoring solutions such as Nagios, Cacti and vnstat only capture traffic statistics, Netflow captures complete packet flows including source, destination IP and port number.

雖然許多監控解決方案（如 Nagios、Cacti 和 vnstat）僅捕獲流量統計信息，但 Netflow 可以捕獲完整的包流，包括來源、目標IP和端口號。

OPNsense offers full support for exporting Netflow data to external collectors as well as a comprehensive Analyzer for on-the-box analysis and live monitoring.

OPNsense 提供將 Netflow 資料匯出到外部收集器的全面支持，以及用於機上分析和即時監控的綜合分析器。

OPNsense is the only open source solution with a built-in Netflow analyzer integrated into its Graphical User Interface. It can be accessed via Reporting ‣ Netflow.

OPNsense是唯一將內建Netflow分析器整合到圖形使用者介面中的開源解決方案。可透過「報告」‣「Netflow」存取。

#### Supported Versions｜支援的版本

OPNsense support both Netflow version 5 (IPv4) and version 9 (IPv4 & IPv6).

OPNsense 同時支援 Netflow 版本 5 (IPv4) 和版本 9 (IPv4 和 IPv6)。

#### Netflow Basics｜Netflow基礎知識

For analyzing the flow data it is important to understand the difference between ingress and egress traffic.

要分析流量數據，了解流入流量和流出流量之間的差異非常重要。

##### Ingress

Traffic to or coming from the firewall.

進出防火牆的流量。

##### Egress｜出口

Traffic passing through the firewall.

通過防火牆的流量。

##### Ingress + Egress = Double flow count｜入口流量 + 出口流量 = 雙倍流量

When enabling both ingress and egress, traffic gets counted double due to Network Address Translation as all packets going to the WAN coming from the LAN pass the Network translation of the firewall therefore also creating an ingress flow.

當同時啟用入口和出口時，由於網路位址轉換，流量會被計算兩次，因為所有發送到WAN LAN都會經過防火牆的網路位址轉換，因此也會產生一個入口流量。

If you are not interested in ingress traffic then OPNsense offers the option to filter this traffic. When utilizing a proxy on the same device its important to capture the ingress flows as well, otherwise all proxy traffic won’t be visible. Downside is of course that all traffic not passing the proxy will be counted twice due to the mentioned NAT effect.

如果您對入站流量不感興趣，OPNsense 提供了過濾該流量的選項。在同一裝置上使用代理程式時，請務必擷取入站流量，否則所有代理流量將不可見。缺點是，由於前面提到的NAT效應，所有未經過代理的流量都會重複計數。

#### Netflow Exporter｜Netflow 匯出器

OPNsense Netflow Exporter supports multiple interfaces, filtering of ingress flows and multiple destinations including local capture for analysis by Insight (OPNsense Netflow Analyzer).

OPNsense Netflow Exporter 支援多個介面、入口流過濾和多個目標，包括本地捕獲以供 Insight（OPNsense Netflow Analyzer）分析。

[![../_images/netflow_exporter1.png](<../images/40d7f9fc-netflow_exporter1.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/netflow_exporter1.png)

#### Netflow Analyzer - Insight｜Netflow 分析器 - 洞察

OPNsense offers a full Netflow Analyzer with the following features:

OPNsense 提供功能齊全的 Netflow 分析器，具有以下功能：

-   Captures 5 detail levels  
    捕捉 5 個細節層次
    
    > -   Last 2 hours, 30 second average  
          過去2小時30秒平均值
    >     
    > -   Last 8 hours, 5 minute average  
          過去 8 小時 5 分鐘平均值
    >     
    > -   Last week, 1 hour average  
          上週，平均每小時 1 小時
    >     
    > -   Last month, 24 hour average  
          上個月，24小時平均值
    >     
    > -   Last year, 24 hour average  
          去年，24小時平均值
    >     
    
-   Graphical representation of flows (stacked, stream and expanded)  
    流程的圖形表示（堆疊式、串流式和展開式）
    
-   Top usage per interface, both ips and ports.  
    每個介面的使用率最高值，包括 IP 位址和連接埠。
    
-   Full in/out traffic in packets and bytes  
    資料包和位元組的完整入/出流量
    
-   Detailed view with date selection and port/ip filter (up to 2 months)  
    查看詳細視圖，可選擇日期和連接埠/IP位址（最多2個月）
    
-   Data export to csv for offline analysis  
    資料匯出為 CSV 檔案以進行離線分析
    
    > -   Selectable Detail Level  
          可選細節級別
    >     
    > -   Selectable Resolution  
          可選解析度
    >     
    > -   Selectable Dat range  
          可選資料範圍
    >     
    

![../_images/netflow_insight_details.png](<../images/9ca292b5-netflow_insight_details.png>)

#### Configuration｜配置

##### Setup Netflow Exporter｜設定 Netflow 導出器

See [Configure Netflow Exporter](#p-083)

請參閱[設定 Netflow 導出器](#p-083)

##### Setup Insight｜設定洞察

See [Using Insight - Netflow Analyzer](#p-078)

請參閱[使用 Insight - Netflow 分析器](#p-078)
