###### [Configure Load Balancing](#p-095)｜[配置負載平衡](#p-095)

To setup load balancing follow the same configuration procedure as for Failover, but in step 2 choose same **Tier** for both Gateways.

若要設定負載平衡，請依照與故障轉移相同的設定步驟進行操作，但在步驟 2 中，為兩個閘道選擇相同的**層級**。

This will change the behavior from failover to equal balancing between the two gateways.

這將改變網關之間的負載平衡機制，從故障轉移變成兩個網關之間的負載平衡。

Note

注意事項

When using multiple Gateways with the same Tier, you need to disable shared forwarding in Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced.

當使用多個具有相同層級的閘道時，需要在防火牆‣設定‣進階中停用共用轉送。

**[Sticky Connection](#p-095)｜[黏性連接](#p-095)**

Some web sites don’t like changing request IPs for the same session, this may lead to unexpected behavior. To solve this you can use the option **Sticky Connections**, this will make sure each subsequent request from the same user to the same website is send through the same gateway.

有些網站不喜歡更改相同會話的請求 IP，這可能會導致意外行為。要解決此問題，您可以使用選項**黏性連線**，這將確保同一使用者到同一網站的每個後續請求都透過相同網關傳送。

To set this option can be set under Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced.

此選項可在「防火牆」‣「設定」‣「進階」中進行設定。

**[Unequal Balancing (Weight)](#p-095)｜[不等重平衡](#p-095)**

If you have a non symmetric setup with one ISP having a much higher bandwidth than the other then you can set a weight on each gateway to change the load balance. For instance if you have one line of 10 Mbps and one of 20 Mbps then set the weight of the first one to 1 and the second one to 2. This way the second gateway will get twice as many traffic to handle than the first.

如果您的配置不對稱，其中一個ISP頻寬遠高於另一個，您可以為每個網關設定權重來調整負載平衡。例如，如果您有一條線路的頻寬為10 Mbps，另一條線路的頻寬為20 Mbps，則將前者的權重設為1，將後者的權重設為2。這樣，第二個網關將處理比第一個網關多一倍的流量。

To do so, go to System ‣ Gateways ‣ Configuration and press the pencil icon next to the Gateway you want to update. The weight is defined under the advanced section.

為此，請前往“系統”‣“網關”‣“配置”，然後按一下要更新的網關旁的鉛筆圖示。權重在高級設定部分中定義。

###### [Combining Balancing & Failover](#p-095)｜[均衡與故障轉移結合](#p-095)

To combine Load Balancing with Failover you will have 2 or more WAN connections for Balancing purposes and 1 or more for Failover. OPNsense offers 5 tiers (Failover groups) each tier can hold multiple ISPs/WAN gateways.

要將負載平衡與故障轉移結合使用，您需要至少 2 個用於負載平衡的WAN連接，以及至少 1 個用於故障轉移的連接。 OPNsense 提供 5 個層級（故障轉移群組），每個層級可容納多個 ISP/ WAN閘道。

###### [Failover and Failback States](#p-095)｜[故障轉移與故障復原狀態](#p-095)

In some multi-WAN setups it may be necessary to directly influence firewall states. The most common example is the combination of a main ISP with a failover metered ISP (mobile network with data consumption limits).

在某些多WAN配置中，可能需要直接影響防火牆狀態。最常見的例子是主ISP與故障轉移計量ISP （具有資料使用量限制的行動網路）的組合。

In case of a main ISP failure, all states should failover quickly to the metered ISP. When the main ISP reconnects, all states should just as quickly fail back. This prevents sticky states on the metered ISP to continue data consumption which could be expensive depending on the contract.

若主交換器ISP發生故障，所有狀態應快速故障轉移至計量交換器ISP 。當主交換器ISP重新連接後，所有狀態應同樣快速地恢復。這可以防止計量交換器ISP上的狀態持續消耗數據，從而避免因合約條款而產生的高昂費用。

This setup is configured globally via System ‣ Gateways ‣ Configuration, there cannot be a distinction for different gateway groups.

此設定透過「系統」‣「網關」‣「配置」進行全域配置，無法區分不同的網關組。

**[Configuration](#p-095)｜[配置](#p-095)**

For a minimal working failover configuration, we need two gateways with different priorities.

為了實現最基本的故障轉移配置，我們需要兩個優先順序不同的網關。

Go to System ‣ Gateways ‣ Configuration

轉到“系統”‣“網關”‣“配置”。

Note

注意事項

We assume both the main and metered gateways already exist due to DHCP configuration.

我們假設由於DHCP配置，主網關和計量網關都已經存在。

**Main ISP Gateway (e.g., DSL/Cable/Fibre)**

**主網關（例如， ISP / DSL /光纖）**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Name**<br>**姓名** | `WAN_DHCP` |
| **Upstream Gateway**<br>**上游網關** | `X` |
| **Failover States**<br>**故障轉移狀態** | `X` |
| **Priority**<br>**優先權** | `253` |

Note

注意事項

The **Priority** must be a lower number than the metered ISP gateway. This will mark this gateway as preferred. Checking **Failover States** will kill all firewall states if a failover happens. This means you must enable gateway monitoring, otherwise there cannot be a failover.

**優先權**的數字必須低於計量的ISP網關。這會將此網關標記為首選。若發生故障轉移，檢查**故障轉移狀態**將終止所有防火牆狀態。這表示您必須啟用網關監控，否則無法進行故障轉移。

**Metered ISP Gateway (e.g. LTE/5G)**

**按流量計費的ISP網關（例如LTE /5G）**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Name**<br>**姓名** | `LTE_DHCP` |
| **Upstream Gateway**<br>**上游網關** | `X` |
| **Failback States**<br>**故障恢復狀態** | `X` |
| **Priority**<br>**優先權** | `254` |

Note

注意事項

The **Priority** must be a higher number than the main ISP gateway. Checking **Failback States** will kill all firewall states if our main gateway comes back online.

**優先權**必須高於主網關ISP優先權。檢查**故障復原狀態**會在主閘道恢復上線時終止所有防火牆狀態。

Go to System ‣ Settings ‣ General and enable the following:

進入“系統”‣“設定”‣“常規”，啟用以下選項：

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Gateway switching**<br>**網關切換** | `X` |

This will allow the default gateway of this firewall to change when a failover happens. It is necessary for the failover and failback of states to trigger correctly.

這樣，當發生故障轉移時，防火牆的預設閘道就會改變。這是確保故障轉移和故障恢復狀態正確觸發所必需的。

**[Verification](#p-095)｜[驗證](#p-095)**

To verify if the failover and failback kill firewall states as expected, the simplest test is unplugging the main ISP and wait for the gateway monitor to trigger the failover to the metered ISP.

為了驗證故障轉移和故障復原是否如預期終止防火牆狀態，最簡單的測試是拔掉主ISP的電源，並等待網關監視器觸發故障轉移到計量ISP 。

Any client with a session to the internet will be forced to re-establish it. A good test would be a SSH or RDP session.

任何已連接到網際網路的用戶端都將被強制重新建立連線。一個好的測試方法是使用SSH或RDP會話。

Afterwards, reconnect the main ISP and wait for the failback to happen. The same scenario with the sessions being forced to re-establish should repeat.

之後，重新連接主ISP並等待故障恢復完成。會話強制重新建立的過程應該會重複進行。

If there are issues, verify default gateway switching, gateway priorities, and if the correct failover and failback states options have been set.

如果出現問題，請檢查預設網關切換、網關優先級，以及是否已設定正確的故障轉移和故障復原狀態選項。

For further diagnostics, use Firewall ‣ Diagnostics ‣ States.

如需進一步診斷，請使用防火牆‣診斷‣狀態。

<a id="p-096"></a>

### High Availability｜高可用性

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/hacarp.html>

OPNsense utilizes the Common Address Redundancy Protocol or CARP for hardware failover. Two or more firewalls can be configured as a failover group. If one interface fails on the primary or the primary goes offline entirely, the secondary becomes active.

OPNsense 使用通用位址冗餘協定 (CARP) 或CARP實現硬體故障轉移。可以將兩個或多個防火牆配置為故障轉移群組。如果主防火牆上的一個介面發生故障或主防火牆完全離線，則備用防火牆將自動啟動。

Utilizing this powerful feature of OPNsense creates a fully redundant firewall with automatic and seamless fail-over. While switching to the backup network connections will stay active with minimal interruption for the users.

利用 OPNsense 的這項強大功能，可以創建完全冗餘的防火牆，並實現自動無縫故障轉移。切換到備用網路連線時，網路連線將保持活動狀態，對使用者的影響降至最低。

[![../_images/light_bulbs.png](<../images/986ada2f-light_bulbs.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/light_bulbs.png)

#### Workflow｜工作流程

Although its not required to synchronize the configuration from the master machine to the backup, a lot of people would like to keep both systems (partially) the same.

雖然不需要將主機器的配置同步到備份機器，但許多人希望保持兩個系統（部分）相同。

To prevent issues spreading over both machines at the same time, we choose to only update on command (see the status page).

為防止問題同時蔓延到兩台機器上，我們選擇僅在接到命令時才進行更新（請參閱狀態頁面）。

Our workflow looks like this:

我們的工作流程如下：

![](<../images/21ab2e1c-blockdiag-84bfcf7e20ab9eb991e715ad02162f.png>)

First commit all changes to the master, then update the backup while knowing the master is still properly configured.

首先將所有變更提交到主分支，然後在確認主分支配置正確的情況下更新備份。

Note

注意事項

In case of an emergency, you should still be able to switch to the backup node when changes cause issues, since the backup machine is left in a known good state during the whole process.

如果發生緊急情況，當變更導致問題時，您仍然應該能夠切換到備份節點，因為備份機器在整個過程中都保持已知良好的狀態。

#### Automatic replication｜自動複製

Although we advise to make sure to keep the backup machine intact during maintenance, some people prefer to keep the backup in sync on periodic intervals. For this reason we added a cron action which you can schedule yourself in System -> Settings -> Cron on the primary node.

雖然我們建議在維護期間確保備份機器完好無損，但有些人喜歡定期同步備份。為此，我們新增了一個定時任務，您可以在主節點的「系統」->「設定」->「定時任務」中自行安排該任務的執行。

To use this feature, add a new cron job containing the `HA update and reconfigure backup` command and a proper schedule, once a day outside office hours is usually a safe option.

要使用此功能，請新增一個新的 cron 作業，其中包含`HA update and reconfigure backup`命令和適當的計劃，每天在辦公時間之外執行一次通常是一個安全的選擇。

Note

注意事項

To prevent a non functional primary machine updating the active master, the `HA update and reconfigure backup` will only execute if all carp interfaces are in `MASTER` mode.

為防止非功能性主機器更新活動主機器， `HA update and reconfigure backup`僅在所有 carp 介面處於`MASTER`模式時才會執行。

#### Settings｜設定

##### Automatic failover｜自動故障轉移

Although not really a setting on the high availability setup page, it’s a crucial part of high available setups. Using CARP type virtual addresses, the secondary firewall will take over without user intervention and minimal interruption when the primary becomes unavailable.

雖然這並非高可​​用性設定頁面上的選項，但它是高可用性設定的關鍵組成部分。透過使用CARP類型的虛擬位址，當主防火牆不可用時，備用防火牆無需用戶幹預即可接管，並將中斷降至最低。

Virtual IPs of the type CARP ([Virtual IPs](#p-111)) are required for this feature.

此功能需要類型為CARP ([虛擬 IP](#p-111) ) 的虛擬 IP。

##### Disable preempt｜禁用搶佔

By default this option is deselected, which is the advised scenario for most common HA setups. The preempt option make sure that multiple carp interfaces will act as a group (all `backup` or `master`) at the same time, assuming no technical issues exist between both.

預設情況下，此選項處於未選取狀態，這是大多數常見HA設定的建議做法。啟用「優先」選項可確保多個鯉魚介面同時作為一個群組運作（全部為`backup`或`master` ），前提是它們之間不存在任何技術問題。

##### Disconnect dialup interfaces｜斷開撥號介面

When this device is configured as CARP backup it will disconnect all PPP type interfaces and try to reconnect them when becoming master again.

當此設備配置為CARP備份時，它將斷開所有PPP類型的接口，並在再次成為主設備時嘗試重新連接它們。

##### Synchronize all states via｜透過以下方式同步所有狀態

The firewall state table can replicated to all failover configured firewalls. This means the existing connections will be maintained in case of a failure, which is important to prevent network disruptions.

防火牆狀態表可以複製到所有已設定故障轉移的防火牆。這意味著即使發生故障，現有連線也能得以維持，這對於防止網路中斷至關重要。

To enable the feature, select an interface for state table communication. Best choose a dedicated interface for this type of communication to prevent manipulation of states causing security issues or intermittent state loss in traffic congestion scenarios.

若要啟用此功能，請選擇一個用於狀態表通訊的介面。最好為此類通訊選擇專用接口，以防止狀態篡改導致安全問題或在流量擁塞情況下出現間歇性狀態遺失。

Note

注意事項

As of OPNsense version 24.7 a “Sync compatibility” selector is offered in the high availability settings page. Make sure both nodes use the same version to prevent state synchronization issues.

從 OPNsense 版本24.7開始，高可用性設定頁面中新增了「同步相容性」選擇器。請確保兩個節點使用相同的版本，以避免狀態同步問題。

##### Configuration synchronization｜配置同步

OPNsense includes configuration synchronization capabilities. Configuration changes made on the primary system are synchronized on demand to the secondary firewall.

OPNsense 具備設定同步功能。主系統上所做的配置變更會根據需要同步到輔助防火牆。

A backup node should never contain settings for Configuration synchronization in System ‣ High Availability ‣ Settings. If this is the case an administrator can accidentally synchronize the backup with the master, causing all kinds of configuration errors.

備份節點絕不應在「系統」‣「高可用性」‣「設定」中包含設定同步設定。否則，管理員可能會意外地將備份節點與主節點同步，從而導致各種配置錯誤。

Tip

提示

Configure the master node in a different theme (e.g. dark theme) to differentiate the two machines.

將主節點配置為不同的主題（例如深色主題），以區分兩台機器。

##### Configure HA CARP｜配置HA CARP

For detailed setup guide see: [Configure CARP](#p-148)

詳細設定指南請參考：[配置CARP](#p-148)

#### Status｜地位

The status page connects to the backup host configured earlier and show all services running on the backup server. With this page you can update the backup machine and restart services if needed.

狀態頁面連接到先前設定的備份主機，並顯示備份伺服器上正在執行的所有服務。您可以透過此頁面更新備份伺服器，並在需要時重新啟動服務。

Tip

提示

Use the refresh button to update the backup node and restart all services at once.

使用刷新按鈕更新備份節點並一次重啟所有服務。

---

<a id="p-097"></a>

### Routes｜路線

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/routes.html>

Routing is one of the core features of your firewall, which is responsible for forwarding packets over the network based on (predefined) paths.

路由是防火牆的核心功能之一，它負責根據（預先定義的）路徑在網路上轉送封包。

Within the routing section of your firewall you can keep track of configured routes and define static routes yourself to teach your firewall which path it should take when forwarding packets to a specific network.

在防火牆的路由部分，您可以追蹤已設定的路由，並自行定義靜態路由，以告訴防火牆在將封包轉送到特定網路時應該走哪條路徑。

![](<../images/8dcb45dc-blockdiag-9a911defa1c48c439fade06078ae34.png>)

When a client sends a packet to the firewall for a network not directly attached to it, the firewall would normally check its routing table to determine to which gateway (see [Gateways](#p-093)) it should be send.

當客戶端向防火牆發送封包，目標網路並非直接連接到該防火牆時，防火牆通常會檢查其路由表，以確定應該將封包傳送至哪個網關（請參閱[網關](#p-093) ）。

Tip

提示

Use traceroute (Interfaces ‣ Diagnostics ‣ Trace Route) to verify which path traffic would follow to reach its destination.

使用 traceroute（介面 ‣ 診斷 ‣ 路由追蹤）來驗證流量到達目的地所遵循的路徑。

#### Configuration｜配置

This is where you can setup static routes, looking at the diagram in the previous chapter, here you would define how `[1]` would access `[2]` using router `[3]`.

在這裡你可以設定靜態路由，參考上一章的圖表，在這裡你可以定義`[1]`如何使用路由器`[3]`訪問`[2]` 。

The number of settings are obviously limited, we need to know the gateway and the target network.

設定項的數量顯然是有限的，我們需要知道網關和目標網路。

---

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Disabled<br>已停用 | (temporary) disable this item<br>（暫時）停用此項目 |
| Network Address<br>網路位址 | Destination network to reach<br>要到達的目標網路 |
| Gateway<br>網關 | The gateway to use.<br>要使用的網關。 |
| Description<br>描述 | Optional description for this item<br>此物品的可選描述 |

Note

注意事項

Some services are known to update the routing table themselves, in which case you shouldn’t add static routes manually (OpenVPN manages its own routes for example).

已知有些服務會自行更新路由表，在這種情況下，您不應該手動新增靜態路由（例如，OpenVPN 會管理自己的路由）。

#### Status｜地位

The status page shows the current active content of the routing table.

狀態頁面顯示路由表的目前活動內容。

---

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Proto<br>原型 | Protocol (IPv4 or IPv6)<br>協定（IPv4 或 IPv6） |
| Destination<br>目的地 | Destination network<br>目的地網路 |
| Gateway<br>閘道 | Where to send the packet for this destination network<br>傳送至此目標網路的封包的位址 |
| Flags<br>旗幟 | Routes have associated flags which influence operation of the protocols when sending to destinations matched by the routes. See the **Flags** table below for details.<br>路由具有關聯的標誌，這些標誌在發送到與路由匹配的目的地時影響協定的操作。有關詳細信息，請參閱下面的 **標誌** 表。 |
| Use<br>用途 | Counts the number of packets sent via this route<br>統計透過此路由傳送的資料包數量 |
| MTU | The MTU set for this route<br>此路線的MTU設定 |
| Netif | Interface to use for this route<br>此路由使用的介面 |
| Netif (name)<br>Netif（名稱） | Name of the interface if found<br>如果找到接口，則填寫接口名稱 |
| Expire<br>過期 | The time at which this route should expire, or zero if it should never expire. It is the responsibility of individual protocol suites to ensure that routes are actually deleted once they expire.<br>此路由應過期的時間，若永不過期則為零。各個協定套件有責任確保路由在過期後被實際刪除。 |

##### Flags｜旗幟

The following flags are supported by the kernel.

內核支援以下標誌。

| Letter / Flag<br>字母/旗幟 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| 1 \[RTF\_PROTO1\]<br>1 \[ RTF \_PROTO1\] | Protocol specific routing flag<br>協定特定路由標誌 |
| 2 \[RTF\_PROTO2\]<br>2 \[ RTF \_PROTO2\] | Protocol specific routing flag<br>協定特定路由標誌 |
| 3 \[RTF\_PROTO3\]<br>3 \[ RTF \_PROTO3\] | Protocol specific routing flag<br>協定特定路由標誌 |
| B \[RTF\_BLACKHOLE\]<br>B \[ RTF \_BLACKHOLE\] | Just discard pkts (during updates)<br>（更新期間）丟棄封包 |
| b \[RTF\_BROADCAST\]<br>b \[ RTF \_BROADCAST\] | The route represents a broadcast address<br>此路由表示廣播位址 |
| C \[RTF\_CLONING\]<br>C \[ RTF \_克隆\] | Generate new routes on use<br>使用時產生新路由 |
| c \[RTF\_PRCLONING\]<br>c \[ RTF \_PRCLONING\] | Protocol-specified generate new routes on use<br>協定指定的在使用時產生新路由 |
| D \[RTF\_DYNAMIC\]<br>D \[ RTF \_DYNAMIC\] | Created dynamically (by redirect)<br>動態建立（透過重定向） |
| d \[RTF\_DONE\]<br>d \[ RTF \_完成\] | Message confirmed<br>訊息已確認 |
| G \[RTF\_GATEWAY\]<br>G \[ RTF \_GATEWAY\] | Destination is a gateway<br>目的地是個網關 |
| H \[RTF\_HOST\]<br>H \[ RTF \_HOST\] | Host entry (net otherwise)<br>主機條目（否則為網路） |
| L \[RTF\_LLINFO\]<br>L \[ RTF \_LLINFO\] | Valid protocol to link address translation<br>有效的協定到連結位址轉換 |
| M \[RTF\_MODIFIED\]<br>M \[ RTF \_MODIFIED\] | Modified dynamically (by redirect)<br>動態修改（透過重定向） |
| R \[RTF\_REJECT\]<br>R \[ RTF \_REJECT\] | Host or net unreachable<br>主機或網路不可達 |
| S \[RTF\_STATIC\]<br>S \[ RTF \_STATIC\] | Manually added<br>手動新增 |
| U \[RTF\_UP\]<br>U \[ RTF \_UP\] | Route usable<br>可用路線 |
| X \[RTF\_XRESOLVE\]<br>X \[ RTF \_XRESOLVE\] | External daemon resolves name<br>外部守護程式解析名稱 |

#### Logs｜紀錄

Route related logging, like `radvd` and `rtsold` for IPv6 write messages to this logging section which can be used for debugging purposes.

路由相關的日誌記錄，例如 IPv6 的`radvd`和`rtsold`會將訊息寫入此日誌部分，這些訊息可用於偵錯目的。

<a id="p-098"></a>

### Settings｜設定

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/settingsmenu.html>

Besides the configuration options that every component has, OPNsense also contains a lot of general settings that you can tweak. This page contains an overview of them.

除了每個組件都具備的配置選項外，OPNsense 還包含許多可調整的通用設定。本頁面概述了這些設定。

#### Administration｜行政

The settings on this page concerns logging into OPNsense. The “Secure Shell”（安全外殼） settings are described under [Creating Users & Groups](#p-086).

此頁面上的設定涉及登入 OPNsense。 “Secure Shell”（安全外殼） 設定在[建立使用者和群組](#p-086) 下描述。

##### Listen interfaces｜監聽介面

Warning

警告

Before considering the use of manual selected interfaces, make sure to read this chapter so you are aware of the pitfalls upfront. Misconfigurations likely lead to a non-accessible web interface and/or missing ssh access.

在考慮使用手動選擇的介面之前，請務必閱讀本章，以便提前了解可能的問題。設定錯誤很可能導致 Web 介面無法存取和/或 SSH 存取失敗。

Both the WebUI and the Secure Shell server support the option to only listen on specific interfaces, the use of this option however comes with clear warnings which you do need to be aware of before deciding to use this option.

WebUI 和 Secure Shell 伺服器都支援僅監聽特定介面的選項，但是使用此選項會有一些明顯的警告，您在決定使用此選項之前需要了解這些警告。

By default (our recommended settings), these services listen on all addresses (interfaces).

預設情況下（我們建議的設定），這些服務監聽所有位址（介面）。

If for whatever reason, you do need to listen only on specific interfaces, the following rules apply:

如果出於某種原因，您確實需要僅監聽特定接口，則適用以下規則：

-   The interface must always be available, so do not try to bind to vpn instances of any kind (OpenVPN, Wireguard, …)  
    介面必須始終可用，因此請勿嘗試綁定到任何類型的 VPN 實例（OpenVPN、Wireguard 等）。
    
-   The addressing must be fully static, so no IPv6 tracking configured for example  
    位址必須完全靜態，例如，不能配置 IPv6 追蹤。
    

As the webgui is not able to predict with 100% certainty that these rules do apply, it is possible to select interfaces that don’t support binding for these services.

由於 Web 管理介面無法 100% 確定這些規則是否適用，因此可以選擇不支援這些服務綁定的介面。

Note

注意事項

When facing issues with the webgui (and/or ssh) and the above rules are not met, please do not bother to open a ticket as these are unsupported scenario’s.

如果在使用 webgui（和/或 ssh）時遇到問題，且不符合上述規則，請不要費心提交工單，因為這些是不受支援的情況。

Tip

提示

In case (**for any service**) one would like to prevent binding on all interfaces, it is possible to add a loopback interface (Interfaces ‣ Devices ‣ Loopback), assign an ip address and bind to that.

如果（**對於任何服務**）想要阻止在所有介面上進行綁定，可以新增一個環回介面（介面 ‣ 設備 ‣ 環回），請指派一個 IP 位址並綁定到該介面。

When traffic is routed through the firewall, the “loopback ip” (some private address, not in the loopback range) should be directly accessible from the network behind it. For example use an address like `192.168.130.1/32` to access the web interface while your own network is using `192.168.1.0/24`.

當流量通過防火牆路由時，「環回 IP」（某個私人位址，不在環回位址範圍內）應該能夠從其後面的網路直接存取。例如，可以使用類似`192.168.130.1/32`的位址存取 Web 介面，而您自己的網路則使用`192.168.1.0/24` 。

Technologies like Network Address Translation (NAT) can also be combined if the other end is not aware of the route to this single address.

如果另一端不知道到達該單一位址的路由，也可以結合使用網路位址轉換（ NAT ）等技術。

##### Web GUI｜網頁GUI

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Protocol<br>協議 | It is strongly recommended to leave this on “HTTPS”<br>強烈建議保持此設定開啟“HTTPS” |
| SSL Certificate<br>SSL憑證 | By default, a self-signed certificate is used. Certificates can be added via System ‣ Trust ‣ Certificates.<br>預設使用自簽名憑證。可透過「系統」‣「信任」‣「憑證」新增憑證。 |
| SSL Ciphers<br>SSL密碼 | Can be used to limit SSL cipher selection in case the system defaults are undesired. Note that restrictive use may lead to an inaccessible web GUI.<br>可用來限制SSL密碼選擇，以防系統預設設定不理想。請注意，限制性使用可能會導致網頁無法存取GUI 。 |
| HTTP Strict Transport Security<br>HTTP嚴格傳輸安全 | Enforces loading the web GUI over HTTPS, even when the connection is hijacked (man-in-the-middle attack), and do not allow the user to trust an invalid certificate for the web GUI.<br>強制要求通過GUI而非HTTPS加載 Web，即使連接被劫持（中間人攻擊），並且不允許用戶信任無效的 Web 證書GUI 。 |
| TCP port<br>TCP埠 | Can be useful if there are other services that are reachable via port 80/443 of the external IP, for example.<br>例如，如果其他服務可以透過外部IP的 80/443 連接埠訪問，則此連接埠可能很有用。 |
| HTTP Redirect<br>HTTP重定向 | If you change the port, a redirect rule from port 80/443 will be created. Check this option to disable the creation this automatic redirect rule.<br>如果您變更端口，系統將建立一條從端口 80/443 重定向的規則。選取此選項可停用此自動重定向規則的建立。 |
| Login Messages<br>登入訊息 | If checked, disable the successful login messages in the web GUI.<br>如果選中，則停用網頁上的成功登入訊息GUI 。 |
| Session Timeout<br>會話逾時 | Time in minutes to expire idle management sessions.<br>空閒管理會話的過期時間（分鐘）。 |
| DNS Rebind Check<br>DNS重綁定檢查 | OPNsense contains protection against [DNS rebinding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DNS_rebinding) by filtering out DNS replies with local IPs. Check this box to disable this protection if it interferes with web GUI access or name resolution in your environment.<br>OPNsense 包含針對 [DNS重綁定](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DNS_rebinding)的保護機制，透過過濾掉DNS包含本地 IP 位址的回復來防止重綁定。如果此保護機制幹擾您環境中的 Web GUI存取或名稱解析，請勾選此方塊以停用它。 |
| Alternate Hostnames<br>備用主機名稱 | Alternate, valid hostnames (to avoid false positives in referrer/DNS rebinding protection).<br>備用的有效主機名稱（以避免引用頁/ DNS重新綁定保護中出現誤報）。 |
| HTTP Compression<br>HTTP壓縮 | Reduces size of transfer, at the cost of slightly higher CPU usage.<br>減少傳輸檔案大小，但會略微增加CPU的使用量。 |
| Access log<br>訪問日誌 | Log all access to the Web GUI for debugging/analysis.<br>記錄所有對 Web GUI的訪問，以便進行調試/分析。 |
| Server Log<br>伺服器日誌 | Display all web GUI errors in the main system log.<br>在主系統日誌中顯示所有 Web GUI錯誤。 |
| Listen interfaces<br>監聽介面 | Can be used to limit interfaces on which the Web GUI can be accessed. This allows freeing the interface for other services, such as HAProxy.<br>可用來限制可存取 Web GUI的介面。這樣可以釋放介面供其他服務（例如 HAProxy）使用。 |
| HTTP\_REFERER enforcement check<br>HTTP _REFERER 強制檢查 | The origins of requests are checked in order to provide some protection against CSRF. You can turn this off if it interferes with external scripts that interact with the Web GUI.<br>會檢查請求的來源，以提供一些保護，防止CSRF攻擊。如果此功能幹擾與 Web 互動的外部腳本GUI ，您可以將其關閉。 |

##### Deployment settings｜部署設定

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Deployment type<br>部署類型 | Influences error feedback to the user<br>影響提供給使用者的錯誤回饋 |
| Strict security<br>嚴格安全 | Prevent the webgui from running as root, some legacy components may not be compatible with this feature. Disabling the feature again requires console access.<br>防止 webgui 以 root 身份運行，而某些舊組件可能與此功能不相容。再次停用該功能需要控制台存取權限。 |

##### Secure Shell｜安全外殼

User accounts can be used for logging in to the web frontend, as well as for logging in to the console (via VGA, serial or SSH). The latter will only work if the user shell is not set to `/sbin/nologin`.

使用者帳戶可用於登入 Web 前端，也可用於登入控制台（透過VGA 、串列埠或SSH ）。後者僅在用戶 shell 未設定為`/sbin/nologin`時才有效。

In order to access OPNsense via SSH, SSH access will need to be configured via System ‣ Settings ‣ Administration. Under the “Secure Shell”（安全外殼） heading, the following options are available:

要透過SSH, SSH存取OPNsense，需要透過「系統」‣「設定」‣「管理」進行配置。在“Secure Shell”（安全外殼）標題下，可以使用以下選項：

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Secure Shell Server<br>安全性外殼伺服器 | Enable a secure shell service<br>啟用安全性 shell 服務 |
| Permit Root Login<br>允許 root 登入 | Root login is generally discouraged. It is advised to log in via another user and switch to root afterwards.<br>通常不鼓勵 root 登入。建議透過其他使用者登錄，然後切換到root。 |
| Permit password login<br>允許密碼登入 | When disabled, authorized keys need to be configured for each User that has been granted secure shell access.<br>如果停用此功能，則需要為每個已取得安全性外殼存取權限的使用者設定授權金鑰。 |
| SSH port<br>SSH端口 | Port to listen on, default is 22<br>要監聽的端口，預設為 22 |
| Listen Interfaces<br>監聽介面 | Only accept connections from the selected interfaces. Leave empty to listen globally. Use with extreme care.<br>僅接受來自選定介面的連線。留空則監聽全域介面。請謹慎使用。 |
| Key exchange algorithms<br>金鑰交換演算法 | The key exchange methods that are used to generate per-connection keys<br>用於產生每個連線金鑰的金鑰交換方法 |
| Ciphers<br>密碼 | The ciphers to encrypt the connection<br>用於加密連線的密碼 |
| MACs<br>MAC（訊息認證碼） | The message authentication codes used to detect traffic modification<br>用於偵測流量竄改的訊息認證碼 |
| Host key algorithms<br>主機金鑰演算法 | Specifies the host key algorithms that the server offers<br>指定伺服器提供的主機金鑰演算法 |
| Public key signature algorithms<br>公鑰簽章演算法 | The signature algorithms that are used for public key authentication<br>用於公鑰認證的簽章演算法 |

##### Secure Shell - Advanced Settings｜安全殼 - 進階設置

To configure options that are not available in the GUI one can add custom configuration files on the firewall itself. Files can be added in `/usr/local/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/` using the `.conf` file extension. When more files are placed inside the directory, they will be included in alphabetical order. The custom configuration files are included first to provide proper overrides to options normally set by the system.

若要設定GUI中未提供的選項，可以在防火牆本身上新增自訂設定檔。可以使用`.conf`檔案副檔名在`/usr/local/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/`中新增檔案。目錄中放置多個檔案時，它們將按字母順序排列。自訂設定檔會優先包含，以便對系統預設設定的選項進行適當的覆寫。

Warning

警告

It is the responsibility of the administrator to ensure that the configuration is valid. No configuration checks will be performed and any errors may prevent you being able to login to the firewall remotely!

管理員有責任確保配置有效。系統不會執行任何設定檢查，任何錯誤都可能導致您無法遠端登入防火牆！

##### Console｜安慰

In case of an emergency, it’s always practical to make sure to configure a console to be able to access the firewall when network connectivity is not possible.

為了應對緊急情況，最好配置一個控制台，以便在網路連線中斷時能夠存取防火牆。

Tip

提示

After initial installation, always make sure to test if the console actually works. When concluding the console is not functional when you need it can be very unpractical.

安裝完成後，請務必測試主機是否正常運作。如果主機在需要時無法使用，會非常不方便。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Use the virtual terminal driver (vt)<br>使用虛擬終端驅動程式 (vt) | When unchecked, OPNsense will use the older sc driver.<br>如果取消選中，OPNsense 將使用舊版 sc 驅動程式。 |
| Primary Console<br>主控制台 | The primary console will show boot script output. All consoles display OS boot messages, console messages, and the console menu.<br>主控制台將顯示啟動腳本輸出。所有控制台均顯示OS啟動資訊、控制台資訊和控制台選單。 |
| Secondary Console<br>輔助控制台 | See above.<br>請參閱上方。 |
| Serial Speed<br>串列速度 | Allows adjusting the baud rate. 115200 is the most common.<br>允許調整波特率。 115200 是最常用的波特率。 |
| Use USB-based serial ports<br>使用基於USB的串口 | Listen on `/dev/ttyU0`, `/dev/ttyU1`, … instead of `/dev/ttyu0`.<br>監聽`/dev/ttyU0`, `/dev/ttyU1`等串口，而不是`/dev/ttyu0`串口。 |
| Password protect the console menu<br>密碼保護控制台選單 | Can be unchecked to allow physical console access without password. This can avoid lock-out, but at the cost of attackers being able to do anything if they gain physical access to your system.<br>可以取消選取以允許無需密碼即可存取實體控制台。這可以避免鎖定，但代價是攻擊者獲得對您系統的實體存取權限後就可以做任何事情。 |

##### Authentication｜驗證

The authentication section of the Administrationm settings offers general security settings for users logging into the firewall.

管理設定的身份驗證部分提供了登入防火牆使用者的常規安全設定。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Server<br>伺服器 | Select one or more authentication servers to validate user credentials against. Multiple servers can make sense with remote authentication methods to provide a fallback during connectivity issues. When nothing is specified the default of “Local Database”（本地資料庫） is used.<br>選擇一個或多個驗證伺服器來驗證使用者憑證。多個伺服器可以使用遠端身份驗證方法來在連線問題期間提供後備服務。當未指定任何內容時，將使用預設值 “Local Database”（本地資料庫）。 |
| Disable integrated authentication<br>停用整合驗證 | When set, console login, SSH, and other system services can only use standard UNIX account authentication.<br>啟用後，控制台登入、 SSH及其他系統服務只能使用標準UNIX帳戶驗證。 |
| Sudo<br>sudo | Permit sudo usage for administrators with shell access.<br>允許具有 shell 存取權限的管理員使用 sudo 指令。 |
| User OTP seed<br>使用者OTP種子 | Select groups which are allowed to generate their own OTP seed on the password page.<br>在密碼頁面選擇允許產生自己OTP種子的群組。 |

#### Cron｜克朗

[Cron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cron) is a service that is used to execute jobs periodically. Cron jobs can be viewed by navigating to System ‣ Settings ‣ Cron. New jobs can be added by click the `+` button in the lower right corner.

[Cron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cron)是一項用來定期執行任務的服務。您可以透過導覽至「系統」‣「設定」‣「Cron」來查看 Cron 任務。您可以透過點擊右下角的`+`按鈕來新增任務。

When adding a new job or modifying an existing one, you will be presented with fields that directly reflect the cron file syntax and that mostly speak for themselves. A job needs a name, a command, command parameters (if applicable), a description (optional, but recommend) and most importantly, a schedule. All time-related fields share the same syntax:

當您新增任務或修改現有任務時，您會看到一些字段，這些字段直接反映了 cron 檔案的語法，而且大多含義顯而易見。一個任務需要包含名稱、命令、命令參數（如果適用）、描述（可選，但建議填寫）以及最重要的規劃任務。所有與時間相關的欄位都使用相同的語法：

-   An asterisk (\*) can be used to mean “any”  
    星號（*）可以用來表示“任意”
    
-   Specifying multiple values is possible using the comma: `1,4,9`  
    可以使用逗號指定多個值： `1,4,9`
    
-   Ranges can be specified using a dash: `4-9`  
    可使用短橫線指定範圍： `4-9`
    

Available cron jobs are registered in the backend to prevent command injection and privilege escalation. These can be found under Command and may use optional Parameters. Restart and reload actions are self-explanatory. They tend to take no parameters and will restart (usually slower stop and start of a process) or reload (usually a faster SIGHUP) the respective service. The availability of restart and reload is subject to their respective services as not all software will support a reload for implementational reasons.

可用的定時任務已在後端註冊，以防止命令注入和權限提升。這些任務可以在“命令”下找到，並可能使用可選參數。重啟和重新載入操作顧名思義，它們通常不接受任何參數，會重啟（通常是進程的停止和啟動，速度較慢）或重新加載（通常是速度較快的SIGHUP ）相應的服務。重新啟動和重新載入的可用性取決於各自的服務，因為出於實現方面的原因，並非所有軟體都支援重新載入。

The most common core commands are as follows:

最常用的核心指令如下：

| Command in GUI<br>GUI中的指令 | Command in shell<br>shell 中的指令 | Supported parameters<br>支援的參數 | Background information<br>背景資訊 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Automatic firmware update<br>自動韌體更新 | configctl firmware auto-update | N/A<br>不適用 | Perform a minor update if applicable.<br>如有必要，請執行小版更新。 |
| Download and reload external proxy ACLs<br>下載並重新載入外部代理程式 ACL | configctl proxy fetchacls | N/A<br>不適用 | Fetch and activate the external ACL files for configured blocklists.<br>取得並啟動已設定黑名單的外部ACL檔。 |
| Firmware changelog update<br>韌體變更日誌更新 | configctl firmware changelog cron | N/A<br>不適用 | Refresh current changelog status from authoritative firmware location to preview changelogs for new versions. Note this utilizes a skew interval of 25 minutes and is also performed by the firmware update check.<br>從權威韌體位置重新整理目前變更日誌狀態，以預覽新版本的變更日誌。請注意，此操作使用 25 分鐘的延遲間隔，並且韌體更新檢查也會執行此操作。 |
| Firmware update check<br>韌體更新檢查 | configctl firmware poll | N/A<br>不適用 | Refresh current update status from firmware mirror for e.g. remote status check via API. Note this utilizes a skew interval of 25 minutes.<br>從韌體映像刷新目前更新狀態，例如透過API進行遠端狀態檢查。請注意，此操作使用 25 分鐘的延遲間隔。 |
| HA update and reconfigure backup<br>HA更新並重新配置備份 | configctl system ha\_reconfigure\_backup | N/A | Synchronize the configuration to the backup firewall and restart its services to apply the changes.<br>將設定同步到備份防火牆並重新啟動其服務以套用變更。 |
| Halt and power off the system<br>停止並關閉系統電源 | configctl system halt | N/A | Perform a power off at the specified time.<br>在指定時間執行關機操作。 |
| Manual gateway switch<br>手動網關開關 | configctl interface routes alarm<br>configctl 介面路由警報 | N/A<br>不適用 | Perform a manual gateway switch if applicable. Malfunctioning gateway monitors will be restarted as well<br>如果適用，請執行手動網關切換。故障的網關監視器也將重新啟動 |
| Periodic interface reset<br>定期重置介面 | configctl interface reconfigure \[identifier\]<br>configctl interface reconfigure \[標識符] | identifier: Internal name of the interface as shown in assignments or overview page, e.g. “lan”, “wan”, “optX”.<br>識別碼：介面的內部名稱，如分配或概覽頁面中所示，例如「lan」、「wan」、「optX」。 | Cycle through an interface reset that removes all connectivity and reactivates it cleanly.<br>循環執行介面重置，該重置會移除所有連接並乾淨地重新啟動介面。 |
| Reboot the system<br>重新啟動系統 | configctl system reboot | N/A | Perform a reboot at the specified time.<br>在指定時間執行重新啟動。 |
| Remote backup<br>遠端備份 | configctl system remote backup | N/A | Trigger the remote backup at the specified time as opposed to its nightly default.<br>在指定時間觸發遠端備份，而不是預設的夜間備份。 |
| Restart OpenVPN instance<br>重新啟動 OpenVPN 實例 | configctl openvpn restart | instance: UUID<br>實例： UUID | Restart the given OpenVPN instance.<br>重新啟動指定的 OpenVPN 實例。 |
| Update and reload firewall aliases<br>更新並重新載入URL別名 | configctl filter refresh\_aliases | N/A<br>不適用 | Updates IP aliases for DNS entries and MAC addresses as well as URL tables.<br>更新IP條目和DNS位址的別名以及MAC表。 |
| Update and reload intrusion detection rules<br>更新並重新載入入侵偵測規則 | configctl ids update | N/A<br>不適用 | Fetches remote rules and reloads the IDS instance to make use of newly fetched rules.<br>取得遠端規則並重新載入IDS實例以使用新取得的規則。 |
| Update Unbound DNSBLs<br>更新 Unbound DNSBL | configctl unbound dnsbl | N/A | Update the the DNS blocklists and apply the changes to Unbound.<br>更新DNS黑名單並將更改套用到 Unbound。 |
| ZFS pool trim<br>ZFS池修剪 | configctl zfs trim \[pool\] | pool: ZFS pool name to perform the action on<br>pool: ZFS要執行操作的池名稱 | Initiates an immediate on-demand TRIM operation for all of the free space in a pool. This operation informs the underlying storage devices of all blocks in the pool which are no longer allocated and allows thinly provisioned devices to reclaim the space.<br>對池中的所有可用空間立即啟動按需TRIM操作。此操作會通知底層儲存設備池中所有不再指派的區塊，並允許精簡配置的設備回收空間。 |
| ZFS pool scrub<br>ZFS池清理 | configctl zfs scrub \[pool\]<br>configctl zfs scrub \[池\] | pool: ZFS pool name to perform the action on<br>池： ZFS要執行操作的池名稱 | Begins a scrub or resumes a paused scrub. The scrub examines all data in the specified pools to verify that it checksums correctly. For replicated (mirror, raidz, or draid) devices, ZFS automatically repairs any damage discovered during the scrub.<br>開始清理或恢復已暫停的清理。清理操作會檢查指定池中的所有數據，以驗證其校驗和是否正確。對於複製（鏡像、RAIDZ 或 DRAID）設備， ZFS會自動修復清理過程中發現的任何損壞。 |

#### Tunables｜可調參數

Tunables are the settings that go into the `loader.conf` and `sysctl.conf` files, which allows tweaking of low-level system settings. They can be set by going to System ‣ Settings ‣ Tunables.

可調參數是指寫入`loader.conf`和`sysctl.conf`檔案的設置，用於調整底層系統設定。可透過「系統」‣「設定」‣「可調參數」進行設定。

Here, the currently active settings can be viewed and new ones can be created. A list of possible values can be obtained by issuing `sysctl -a` on an OPNsense shell. Additional tunables may exist depending on boot loader capabilities and kernel module support.

在這裡，您可以查看當前啟動的設定並建立新的設定。在 OPNsense shell 中執行`sysctl -a`指令可以取得可用值清單。根據引導程式的功能和核心模組支援情況，可能還有其他可調參數。

| Hardware<br>硬體 | Select between No/ACPI thermal sensor driver and processor-specific drivers.<br>選擇是否ACPI熱感應器驅動程式或處理器專用驅動程式。 |
| **Periodic Backups**<br>**定期備份** |  |
| Periodic RRD Backup<br>定期備份RRD | Periodically backup Round Robin Database.<br>定期備份循環資料庫。 |
| Periodic DHCP Leases Backup<br>定期備份DHCP租約 | Periodically backup DHCP leases.<br>定期備份DHCP租約。 |
| Periodic NetFlow Backup<br>定期 NetFlow 備份 | Periodically backup Netflow state.<br>定期備份 NetFlow 狀態。 |
| Periodic Captive Portal Backup<br>定期備份強制門戶 | Periodically backup Captive Portal state.<br>定期備份強制門戶狀態。 |
| **Power Savings**<br>**節能** |  |
| Use PowerD<br>使用 PowerD | PowerD allows tweaking power conservation features. The modes are maximum (high performance), minimum (maximum power saving), adaptive (balanced), hiadaptive (balanced, but with higher performance).<br>PowerD 允許調整節能功能。模式包括最大（高性能）、最小（最大省電）、自適應（平衡）、非自適應（平衡，但具有更高的性能）。 |
| On AC Power Mode<br>開啟AC電源模式 | Set power mode when on AC (on grid). Default option is: hiadaptive.<br>設定開啟AC （併網）時的電源模式。預設選項為：hiadaptive。 |
| On Battery Power Mode<br>電池供電模式 | Set power mode when on battery. Default option is: hiadaptive.<br>設定電池供電時的電源模式。預設選項為：高自適應。 |
| On Normal Power Mode<br>正常電源模式 | Set power mode the power utility can not determine the power state. Default option is: hiadaptive.<br>設定電源模式，此時電源管理工具無法確定電源狀態。預設選項為：高自適應模式。 |
| **Disk / Memory Settings**<br>**磁碟/記憶體設定** |  |
| Swap file<br>交換文件 | Create a 2 GB swap file. This can increase performance, at the cost of increased wear on storage, especially flash.<br>建立一個 2 GB交換文件。這可以提高效能，但會增加儲存損耗，尤其是快閃記憶體損耗。 |
| /var RAM disk<br>/var RAM磁碟 | This can be useful to avoid wearing out flash storage. **Everything in /var, including logs will be lost upon reboot.**<br>這有助於避免快閃記憶體損耗。 **重啟後 /var 中的所有內容，包括日誌，都會遺失。** |
| /tmp RAM disk<br>/tmp RAM磁碟 | See above.<br>見上。 |
| **System Sounds**<br>**系統音效** |  |
| Disable the startup/shutdown beep<br>關閉開機/關機提示音 | Disable beeps via the built-in speaker (“PC Speaker”（電腦音箱）)<br>關閉內建揚聲器提示音 ( “PC Speaker”（電腦音箱） ) |

#### Logging｜日誌記錄

Local log settings can be found at System ‣ Settings ‣ Logging, tab “Local”（當地的）.

本機日誌設定可在「系統」‣「設定」‣「日誌記錄」標籤“Local”（當地的）中找到。

The regular log files will use the following standard pattern on disk `/var/log/<application>/<application>_[YYYYMMDD].log` (one file per day). Our user interface provides an integrated view stitching all collected files together. Available settings may change the appearance on disk depending on space and time constraints for log rotation.

常規日誌檔案將使用以下標準模式儲存在磁碟上`/var/log/<application>/<application>_[YYYYMMDD].log` （每天一個檔案）。我們的使用者介面提供了一個整合視圖，將所有收集的文件拼接在一起。根據空間和日誌輪換的時間限制，可用的設定可能會改變磁碟上的顯示方式。

Many plugins have their own logs. In the UI, they are grouped with the settings of that plugin. They mostly log to /var/log/ in text format, so you can view or follow them with *tail*.

許多插件都有自己的日誌。在UI中，這些日誌與插件的設定一起分組。它們大多以文字格式記錄到 /var/log/ 目錄下，因此您可以使用 *tail* 命令查看或追蹤這些日誌。

An overview of the local settings:

本地設定概覽：

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Enable local logging<br>啟用本機日誌記錄 | Disable to avoid wearing out flash memory when applicable and set up remote logging instead.<br>為避免快閃記憶體損耗，請在適用情況下停用本機日誌記錄，並改用遠端日誌記錄。 |
| Maximum preserved files<br>最大保留檔案數 | Configures the number of days to keep logs or the number of files if “maximum file size” option is used.<br>設定日誌保留的天數，或如果使用了「最大檔案大小」選項，則設定檔保留數量。 |
| Maximum file size<br>最大檔案大小 | Limit the file size of the logs instead of keeping one log per day.<br>限制日誌檔案的大小，而不是每天只保留一個日誌檔案。 |

Tip

提示

When using (very) small file size limits, it is possible to schedule the rotate action more frequently using cron (System ‣ Settings ‣ Cron). Seek for an action named `Rotate log files` in the list in that case.

當使用（非常）小的檔案大小限制時，可以使用 cron（系統 ‣ 設定 ‣ Cron）更頻繁地安排輪換操作。在這種情況下，請在清單中尋找名為`Rotate log files`的操作。

Remote log settings can be found at System ‣ Settings ‣ Logging, tab “Remote”（偏僻的）.

遠端日誌設定可在「系統」‣「設定」‣「日誌記錄」標籤“Remote”（偏僻的）中找到。

*Add* a new *Destination* to set up a remote target destination.

*新增*新的*目的地*以設定遠端目標目的地。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | Master on/off switch.<br>主開關。 |
| Transport<br>交通 | Protocol to use for syslog.<br>用於系統日誌的協議。 |
| Applications<br>應用程式 | Select a list of applications to send to remote syslog. Leave empty for *all*.<br>選擇要傳送到遠端系統日誌的應用程式清單。留空則表示發送*所有*應用程式。 |
| Levels<br>級別 | Choose which levels to include, omit to select all.<br>選擇要包含的級別，省略則選擇全部級別。 |
| Facilities<br>設施 | Choose which facilities to include, omit to select all.<br>選擇要包含的設施，省略則選擇全部設施。 |
| Hostname<br>主機名稱 | Hostname or IP address where to send logs to.<br>日誌傳送到的主機名稱或IP位址。 |
| Port<br>端口 | Port to use, usually 514.<br>要使用的端口，通常為 514。 |
| Certificate<br>憑證 | Client certificate to use (when selecting a tls transport type)<br>要使用的用戶端憑證（選擇 TLS 傳輸類型時） |
| Description<br>描述 | Set a description for you own use.<br>為您自己新增描述。 |

Note

注意事項

When using syslog over TLS, make sure both ends are configured properly (certificates and hostnames), certificate errors are quite common in these type of setups. On OPNsense the general system log usually contains more details. When it comes to tracking syslog-ng messages, [this](https://support.oneidentity.com/kb/263658/common-issues-of-tls-encrypted-message-transfer) is usually a good resource.

使用TLS上的 syslog 時，請確保兩端配置正確（憑證和主機名稱），並且憑證錯誤在此類設定中相當常見。在 OPNsense 上，常規系統日誌通常包含更多詳細資訊。要追蹤 syslog-ng 訊息，[此](https://support.oneidentity.com/kb/263658/common-issues-of-tls-encrypted-message-transfer)通常是一個很好的資源。

A reconfigure doesn’t always apply the new tls settings instantly, if that’s not the case best stop and start syslog in OPNsense (using the gui).

重新配置並不總是能立即應用新的 TLS 設置，如果不是這種情況，最好在 OPNsense 中停止並啟動 syslog（使用圖形使用者介面）。

To activate any changed settings use the “Apply”（申請） button below.

要啟動任何已更改的設置，請使用下面的“Apply”（申請）按鈕。

To clear all the logs on the system use the “Reset Log Files”（重置日誌文件） button.

若要清除系統上的所有日誌，請使用“Reset Log Files”（重置日誌文件）按鈕。

<a id="p-099"></a>

### Snapshots｜快照

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/snapshots.html>

#### [Snapshots](#p-099)｜[快照](#p-099)

Index

索引

-   [Snapshots](#p-099)  
    [快照](#p-099)
    
    -   [Quick Overview](#p-099)  
        [快速概覽](#p-099)
        
    -   [Recommended Workflow](#p-099)  
        [推薦工作流程](#p-099)
        
    -   [Tutorial](#p-099)  
        [教學](#p-099)
        
        -   [Creating a Snapshot](#p-099)  
            [創建快照](#p-099)
            
        -   [Booting a Snapshot](#p-099)  
            [啟動快照](#p-099)
            
        -   [Deleting a Snapshot](#p-099)  
            [刪除快照](#p-099)
            

#### [Quick Overview](#p-099)｜[快速概覽](#p-099)

*Snapshots* capture the base system at a given moment. They’re useful for administration, as they introduce a fallback boot option when more risky operations like major upgrades or experimental configurations fail. If something goes wrong, it is quite simple to roll back to the previous working state.

*快照* 會捕捉系統在特定時刻的基礎狀態。它們對系統管理非常有用，因為當諸如重大升級或實驗性配置等風險較高的操作失敗時，快照可以提供備用啟動選項。如果出現問題，回滾到之前的正常狀態非常簡單。

These *Snapshots* leverage ZFS features, making them space-efficient and easy to manage. During the boot process, the latest and previous saved *Snapshots* can be chosen with *Option 8*, effectively switching between different system states.

這些*快照*利用了ZFS特性，使其既節省空間又易於管理。在啟動過程中，可以使用*選項8*選擇最新和先前儲存的*快照*，從而有效地在不同的系統狀態之間切換。

Attention

注意

**Snapshots require ZFS as filesystem**. UFS will not work since it does not support file system level snapshots.

**快照需要使用ZFS作為檔案系統**。 UFS無法使用，因為它不支援檔案系統層級的快照。

The *Snapshots* are differential. A new *Snapshot* is always the latest current running state. This means, there are no incremental *Snapshot* chains, as seen in other implementations such as Hypervisors.

*快照*是差分式的。新的*快照*始終代表最新的目前運行狀態。這意味著，不存在像其他實作方式（例如虛擬機器管理程式）中那樣的增量式*快照*鏈。

Note

注意事項

Each *Snapshot* can be created and deleted as its own self contained entity with no other dependencies. The size of each *Snapshot* will grow over time as the distance in bytes between the current *active Snapshot* and all stored *non-active Snapshots* grow.

每個快照都可以作為一個獨立的實體建立和刪除，不依賴任何其他元件。隨著目前活動快照與所有已儲存的非活動快照之間的位元組數差距增大，每個快照的大小也會隨之增長。

#### [Recommended Workflow](#p-099)｜[推薦工作流程](#p-099)

1.  Create a new Snapshot with the name `known-good`  
    建立一個名為`known-good`的新快照
    
2.  Do administrative changes (e.g. firmware upgrade)  
    執行管理變更（例如韌體升級）
    
3.  Reboot and test the changes:  
    重新啟動並測試變更：
    

-   OPNsense works as expected:  
    OPNsense 運作正常：
    
    -   Remove the **known-good** *Snapshot* and keep using the **default** *Snapshot*  
        刪除 **已知良好** *快照* 並繼續使用 **預設** *快照*
        
    
-   OPNsense has issues:  
    OPNsense存在一些問題：
    
    -   Activate the **known-good** *Snapshot* either in the WebGUI or the Boot Menu  
        在 Web 圖形使用者介面或啟動選單中啟動**已知良好**的*快照*
        
    -   After rebooting, remove the bad **default** *Snapshot*  
        重新啟動後，刪除壞的**預設** *快照*
        
    -   Rename the **known-good** *Snapshot* back to **default**  
        將**已知良好**的*快照*重新命名回**預設**。
        
    

Tip

提示

*Snapshots* can also be used to safeguard against regressions introduced in configuration changes. Creating a new snapshot and activating it immediately, will make the system roll back automatically to the *last known good configuration* on reboot or power cycle.

*快照*也可以用於防止配置變更引入回歸問題。建立新快照並立即啟動後，系統會在重新啟動或斷電後自動回滾到*上次已知的良好配置*。

#### [Tutorial](#p-099)｜[教學](#p-099)

As an example, there is a major upgrade to a new OPNsense version. To have the option of a quick rollback when things do not turn out as expected, creating a *Snapshot* before doing the changes is the best choice.

例如，OPNsense 進行了一次重大升級，升級到新版本後，為了能夠在出現意外情況時快速回滾，最佳做法是在進行更改之前創建*快照*。

Note

注意事項

This is useful for *Hardware Appliances*. A virtualized OPNsense will have other recovery options that leverage the features of the Hypervisor itself, like creating VM level snapshots.

這對於*硬體設備*非常有用。虛擬化的 OPNsense 將提供其他復原選項，利用虛擬機器管理程式本身的功能，例如建立VM層級的快照。

Snapshots can have the following states:

快照可以有以下幾個狀態：

| Active<br>目前 | Description<br>描述 |
| --- | --- |
| **N** | *Snapshot* is active right now<br>*快照* 目前處於活動狀態 |
| **R** | *Snapshot* will be active after reboot<br>*快照* 將在重新啟動後生效 |
| **NR** | *Snapshot* is active and will be used on reboots<br>*快照* 已啟用，將在重新啟動時使用 |
| **\-** | *Snapshot* is not active<br>*快照* 未啟動 |

##### [Creating a Snapshot](#p-099)｜[創建快照](#p-099)

-   Go to System ‣ Snapshots  
    轉到系統‣快照
    
-   Select **+** to create a new *Snapshot*, use `known-good` as name  
    選擇 **+** 建立新的*快照*，使用`known-good`作為名稱
    

At this point, upgrade the OPNsense to a new version. These changes will all happen in the current active **default** Snapshot, leaving the **known-good** Snapshot as *last known good configuration*.

此時，請將 OPNsense 升級到新版本。所有這些變更都將在目前活動的**預設**快照中進行，而**已知良好**快照將保留為*最後已知的良好配置*。

##### [Booting a Snapshot](#p-099)｜[啟動快照](#p-099)

If the upgrade introduced some issues, the **known-good** *Snapshot* can be activated from the WebGUI.

如果升級引入了一些問題，可以從 WebGUI 啟動**已知良好** *快照*。

-   If the WebGUI is available:  
    如果 WebGUI 可用：
    
    > -   Go to System ‣ Snapshots  
          轉到系統‣快照
    >     
    > -   Select **✓** to activate the **known-good** *Snapshot*  
          選擇 **✓**以啟動**已知良好** *快照*
    >     
    > -   Reboot the OPNsense to roll back to the **known-good** *Snapshot*  
          重新啟動 OPNsense 以回滾到**已知良好**的*快照*。
    >     
    

Note

注意事項

In some cases, if the OPNsense does not boot to the WebGUI due to a software error, the *Boot Menu* can be used to roll back. If a *Hardware Appliance* does not have VGA, using the serial console is the best alternative.

在某些情況下，如果 OPNsense 由於軟體錯誤而無法啟動到 WebGUI，則可以使用*啟動選單*進行回溯。如果*硬體設備*沒有VGA，使用序列控制台是最好的選擇。

-   If the WebGUI is unavailable:  
    如果 WebGUI 不可用：
    
    > -   Boot the OPNsense, at the start of the boot sequence the *Boot Menu* will show up  
          啟動 OPNsense，在啟動順序開始時，將顯示 *啟動選單*
    >     
    > -   Press the *Space Bar* to pause it  
          按*空白鍵*暫停
    >     
    > -   Press `8` to choose `8. Boot Environments` which displays the current *Snapshots*  
          按下`8`選擇`8. Boot Environments` ，即可顯示目前的*快照*
    >     
    > -   Press `2` to select a different *active Snapshot*, it should now display `zfs:zroot/ROOT/known-good`  
          按下`2`選擇另一個*活動快照*，現在應該顯示`zfs:zroot/ROOT/known-good`
    >     
    > -   Press `1` to go back to the *main menu*  
          按`1`返回*主選單*
    >     
    > -   Press `ENTER` to select `1. Boot Multi user [ENTER]`  
          按`ENTER`選擇`1. Boot Multi user [ENTER]`
    >     
    

Tip

提示

If there are more Snapshots, press `2` repeatedly to cycle through them.

如果還有更多快照，請重複按`2`循環瀏覽。

##### [Deleting a Snapshot](#p-099)｜[刪除快照](#p-099)

Now that the OPNsense has booted either the **known-good** *Snapshot* or the **default** *Snapshot*, it is time to clean up to ensure a clear current system state.

現在 OPNsense 已啟動 **已知良好** *快照* 或 **預設** *快照*，是時候進行清理以確保清晰的當前系統狀態了。

-   If the upgrade succeeded and **default** has been booted:  
    如果升級成功且已啟動**預設**系統：
    
    > -   Go to System ‣ Snapshots  
          轉到系統‣快照
    >     
    > -   Check that the **default** *Snapshot* is *Active NR*  
          檢查**預設** *快照* 是否為*活動 NR*
    >     
    > -   Press **🗑** to delete the **known-good** *Snapshot*  
          按 **🗑**刪除**已知良好** *快照*
    >     
    
-   If the upgrade failed and **known-good** has been booted:  
    如果升級失敗且**已知良好**的系統已啟動：
    
    > -   Go to System ‣ Snapshots  
          轉到系統‣快照
    >     
    > -   Check that the **known-good** *Snapshot* is *Active NR*  
          檢查**已知良好**的*快照*是否處於*活動狀態NR *
    >     
    > -   Press **🗑** to delete the **default** *Snapshot*  
          按 **🗑**刪除**預設** *快照*
    >     
    > -   Press **✎** to rename the **known-good** *Snapshot* to **default**  
          按 **✎**將**known-good** *Snapshot* 重新命名為 **default**
    >     
    

At this point, the OPNsense is correctly configured at the *last known good configuration* state.

此時，OPNsense 已正確配置為*最後已知的良好配置*狀態。

Tip

提示

Snapshots can be kept for a while after an upgrade, to have the option to roll back after a few days of testing in production. Please note that all configuration changes in that time will be lost when rolling back, so creating a configuration backup and importing it into the old system state can become a necessity.

升級後可以保留快照一段時間，以便在生產環境測試幾天後選擇回滾。請注意，回滾時這段時間內的所有組態變更都會遺失，因此建立組態備份並將其匯入至舊系統狀態可能成為必要之舉。

Note

注意事項

[Creating a Snapshot](#p-099) can be repeated to retry the major upgrade. Refer to the [Recommended Workflow](#p-099) for a quick overview.

[建立快照](#p-099)可以重複執行以重試主要升級。有關快速概覽，請參閱[推薦工作流程](#p-099) 。

---

<a id="p-100"></a>

### Trust｜相信

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/certificates.html>

In OPNsense, certificates are used for ensuring trust between peers. To make using them easier, OPNsense allows creating certificates from the front-end. In addition to that, it also allows creating certificates for other purposes, avoiding the need to use the `openssl` command line tool. Certificates in OPNsense can be managed from System ‣ Trust ‣ Certificates.

在 OPNsense 中，憑證用於確保對等節點之間的信任。為了方便使用，OPNsense 允許從前端建立憑證。此外，它還允許建立用於其他用途的證書，無需使用`openssl`命令列工具。 OPNsense 中的憑證可以透過「系統」‣「信任」‣「憑證」進行管理。

Examples of OPNsense components that use certificates:

使用憑證的 OPNsense 元件範例：

-   OpenVPN
    
-   IPsec
    
-   Captive Portal  
    強制門戶
    
-   Web Proxy  
    網路代理
    

#### Certificate types｜證書類型

The following types of certificate can be generated in OPNsense:

OPNsense 可以產生以下類型的憑證：

-   Client  
    客戶
    
-   Server  
    伺服器
    
-   Combined Client/Server  
    客戶端/伺服器組合
    
-   Certificate Authority  
    證書頒發機構
    

In addition to this, OPNsense can generate a Certificate Signing Request (CSR). This can be used if you want to create a certificate signed by an external CA.

此外，OPNsense 還可以產生憑證簽署要求 ( CSR )。如果您想建立由外部CA簽署的證書，可以使用此功能。

Warning

警告

Make sure that you select the correct certificate type, as many clients will refuse connection (or at least show errors) if an incorrect certificate type is used. For example, you can use either a server certificate or a combined client/server certificate to secure the connection to the web interface, but not a CA or client certificate.

請務必選擇正確的憑證類型，因為如果使用了錯誤的憑證類型，許多用戶端會拒絕連線（或至少顯示錯誤）。例如，您可以使用伺服器憑證或用戶端/伺服器組合憑證來保護與 Web 介面的連接，但不能使用CA或用戶端憑證。

Warning

警告

“Store intermediate” (System ‣ Trust ‣ Settings) is disabled by default on our setups, which means none of the intermediates is being deployed in our trust store. When inserting a new certificate manually which needs an intermediate to validate, you do have to include the intermediates to prevent validation issues in the gui.

在我們的設定中，「儲存中間憑證」（系統 ‣ 信任 ‣ 設定）預設為停用狀態，這表示我們的信任儲存區中不會部署任何中間憑證。手動插入需要中間證書進行驗證的新證書時，您必須包含中間證書，以避免在圖形使用者介面中出現驗證問題。

#### Settings｜設定

In System ‣ Trust ‣ Settings you can find some advanced options to manage how the system handles trust. For compliance reasons, it is possible to implement certain constraints when a default OpenSSL context is requested.

在「系統」‣「信任」‣「設定」中，您可以找到一些進階選項來管理系統如何處理信任關係。出於合規性考慮，可以在請求預設 OpenSSL 上下文時實施某些限制。

| **Options**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Store intermediate<br>儲存中間體 | Allow local defined intermediate certificate authorities to be used in the local trust store. Be careful with deploying intermediate certificates as cross signed ones may causing breakage when included but expired later in the chain.<br>允許在本地信任儲存中使用本地定義的中間憑證授權單位。部署中間憑證時要小心，因為交叉簽署的憑證在包含但稍後在鏈中過期時可能會導致損壞。 |
| Store CRL’s<br>儲存CRL | Store all configured CRL’s in the default trust store. If the client or service support CRL’s, deploying to the default location eases maintenance.<br>將所有已配置的CRL儲存在預設信任儲存區。如果用戶端或服務支援CRL ，則部署到預設位置可以簡化維護。 |
| Auto fetch CRL’s<br>自動取得CRL | Schedule an hourly job to download CRLs using the defined Distributionpoints in the CAs deployed in our trust store.<br>排程每小時執行一次作業，使用部署在我們信任庫中的 CA 的已定義分發點下載 CRL。 |
| Enable legacy<br>啟用舊版 | Enable Legacy Providers. (Enables ciphers which will be removed in future versions of OpenSSL)<br>啟用舊版提供者。 （啟用將在 OpenSSL 的未來版本中移除的密碼套件） |
| Configuration constraints<br>配置限制 | When enabled, you can set some default ciphers and protocols, be careful with these options as these settings will be used by wuite some applications of the firewall (and might break them).<br>啟用後，您可以設定一些預設密碼和協議，請小心使用這些選項，因為這些設定將被防火牆的某些應用程式使用（並可能會破壞它們）。 |

Note

注意事項

Applications are not forced to use a standard context, depending the application, custom constraints may or may not have any effect.

應用程式並非必須使用標準上下文，根據應用程式的不同，自訂約束可能有效也可能無效。

#### Revoke certificates｜撤銷證書

##### Certificate Revocation Lists｜憑證吊銷列表

A Certificate Revocation Lists (CRL) is a list of certificates that have been revoked by the certificate authority. Some services in OPNsense can use these to validate if a certificate is still valid to use even though it might not be expired.

憑證撤銷清單 ( CRL ) 是憑證授權單位撤銷的憑證清單。 OPNsense 中的某些服務可以使用此清單來驗證憑證是否仍然有效，即使它尚未過期。

Defining a CRL in OPNsense is not very complicated, just go to System ‣ Trust ‣ Revocation and click on the \[+\] sign for your (local) certificate authority to create a new CRL. When a CRL exists, you may edit it and add or remove certificates in it (using the pencil icon).

在 OPNsense 中定義CRL並不復雜，只需轉到“系統”‣“信任”‣“吊銷”，然後單擊本地證書頒發機構旁邊的 [+] 符號即可創建一個新的CRL 。如果CRL已存在，您可以對其進行編輯，並在其中新增或刪除憑證（使用鉛筆圖示）。

Note

注意事項

If you wish to use a CRL for external tools you can download it using the button

如果您想使用CRL作為外部工具，可以使用按鈕下載它。

One of the downsides of a CRL is that they don’t scale very well, each consumer of the list should download the full list in order to know if a certificate can still be trusted. Information often is less accurate as these lists usually are only generated on certain intervals.

CRL的一個缺點是其擴充性不佳，清單的每個使用者都必須下載完整的清單才能確定憑證是否仍然可信。此外，由於這些清單通常僅按特定週期生成，因此資訊的準確性往往較低。

When using a CRL for a local authority on OPNsense itself the scaling part usually isn’t a large issue as the number of certificates is usually limited (for example to the number of employees in your organisation).

當在 OPNsense 上使用CRL作為本地機構時，擴展性通常不是一個大問題，因為證書的數量通常是有限的（例如，受限於您組織中的員工人數）。

To manually verify the created certificates using `openssl` commands, you need the following ingredients:

若要使用`openssl`指令手動驗證已建立的證書，您需要以下工具：

1.  The CA certificate chain which signed the certificates (export “cert” from Authorities menu)  
    用於簽署憑證的CA憑證鏈（從「Authorities」選單匯出「cert」）
    
2.  The CRL created in OPNsense (export “crl” from Revocation menu)  
    在 OPNsense 中建立的CRL （從「​​撤銷」選單中匯出「crl」）
    
3.  A revoked certificate (export “cert” from Certificates menu)  
    已撤銷的憑證（從「憑證」功能表匯出「憑證」）
    
4.  A non expired or revoked certificate  
    未過期或未撤銷的證書
    

First we concatenate both the CA chain and the CRL into a single “chain” file:

首先，我們將CA鍊和CRL鏈連接成一個單獨的「鏈」檔案：

```
# cat ca_chain.crt ca_crl.crl > my_chain.pem
```

Then validate a revoked certificate using the following `openssl` command:

然後使用以下`openssl`指令驗證已撤銷的憑證：

```
# openssl verify -crl_check -CAfile my_chain.pem revoked_cert.crt
C=NL, CN=my_cert
error 23 at 0 depth lookup: certificate revoked
error ocsp_user_cert2.crt: verification failed
```

And a valid certificate:

以及一份有效的證書：

```yaml
# openssl verify -crl_check -CAfile my_chain.pem ok_cert.crt
ocsp_server_cert.crt: OK
```

##### Online Certificate Status Protocol｜線上證書狀態協議

The Online Certificate Status Protocol ([OCSP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Online_Certificate_Status_Protocol)) offers similar functionality as the CRL’s described earlier, but validates certificates “online” and offers a whitelising instead of a blacklisting method. Certificates are checked against an online known set of certificates after which the server responds with ‘good’, ‘revoked’, or ‘unknown’. Only good responses are considered valid.

線上證書狀態協定 ([OCSP](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Online_Certificate_Status_Protocol) ) 提供與先前描述的CRL類似的功能，但它「線上」驗證證書，並採用白名單而非黑名單機制。憑證會與已知的線上憑證集進行比對，之後伺服器會傳回「有效」、「已撤銷」或「未知」的回應。只有「有效」的回應才被視為有效。

In order to explain the client verifying a certificate where to check it’s validity, the `AuthorityInfoAccess` extension should be provided in the certificate authority (The parameter `OCSP uri` adds this to the certificate in OPNsense).

為了向驗證憑證的用戶端解釋在哪裡檢查其有效性，憑證授權單位應提供`AuthorityInfoAccess`擴充（參數`OCSP uri`將其新增至 OPNsense 中的憑證）。

Tip

提示

You can use the button to find the ocsp uri when available.

您可以使用該按鈕尋找可用的 ocsp uri。

The OCSP responder (server) which validates the ‘OCSP request’ needs a special signing certificate, which can be created in OPNsense via System ‣ Trust ‣ Authorities, issued by the same CA which created the user and/or server certificates.

驗證「 OCSP請求」的OCSP響應者（伺服器）需要一個特殊的簽章證書，該證書可以透過 OPNsense 中的「系統」‣「信任」‣「機構」創建，由創建用戶和/或伺服器證書的同一個CA頒發。

OPNsense does not implement an OCSP responder, but to test the concept, we can use the [openssl-ocsp](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man3.0/man1/openssl-ocsp.html) command.

OPNsense 沒有實作OCSP響應器，但為了測試這個概念，我們可以使用 [openssl-ocsp](https://www.openssl.org/docs/man3.0/man1/openssl-ocsp.html)指令。

Note

注意事項

openssl-ocsp is only intended to be used for test and demonstration purposes.

openssl-ocsp 僅供測試和示範之用。

In order to test the concept, we need the following ingredients:

為了驗證這個概念，我們需要以下資料：

1.  The CA certificate chain which signed the certificates (export “cert” from Authorities menu)  
    用於簽署憑證的CA憑證鏈（從「Authorities」選單匯出「cert」）
    
2.  The OCSP signer certificate (export “cert” and “key” from Authorities menu for the signer)  
    OCSP簽署者憑證（從「授權機構」選單中匯出簽署者的「憑證」和「金鑰」）
    
3.  An index file for openssl-ocsp (export index from Revocation menu) as specified in [https://pki-tutorial.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cadb.html](https://pki-tutorial.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cadb.html)  
    openssl-ocsp 的索引檔案（從「撤銷」選單匯出索引），如 [https://pki-tutorial.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cadb.html](https://pki-tutorial.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cadb.html)中所述
    
4.  A serial number of a revoked certificate (use the info button to find the serial number)  
    已撤銷憑證的序號（使用資訊按鈕尋找序號）
    
5.  A serial number of a non expired or revoked certificate  
    未過期或未吊銷憑證的序號
    

First start the server in a console:

首先在控制台中啟動伺服器：

```
# openssl ocsp -index index.txt -port 8081 -rsigner ocsp_signer.crt -rkey ocsp_signer.key -CA ca.crt -ignore_err -text
```

Then verify a known good certificate (with serial number 1):

然後驗證一個已知有效的憑證（序號為 1）：

```yaml
# openssl ocsp -url http://127.0.0.1:8081 -CAfile ca.crt -issuer ca.crt -serial 1
Response verify OK
1: good
        This Update: Jan  6 13:33:59 2024 GMT
```

A revoked one:

已撤銷的：

```yaml
# openssl ocsp -url http://127.0.0.1:8081 -CAfile ca.crt -issuer ca.crt -serial 2
Response verify OK
2: revoked
    This Update: Jan  6 13:34:54 2024 GMT
    Revocation Time: Jan 1 21:31:08 2024 GMT
```

And an unknown certificate

以及一份未知證書

```yaml
# openssl ocsp -url http://127.0.0.1:8081 -CAfile ca.crt -issuer ca.crt -serial 9999
Response verify OK
9999: unknown
    This Update: Jan  6 13:36:51 2024 GMT
```

#### Internal organisation｜內部組織

In this paragraph we would like to explain the organisation of the internal trust store. The certificates and revocation lists that exist are staged into system directories and deployed for usage by a tool called `certctl.py` on our end.

本段將解釋內部信任庫的組織結構。現有的憑證和吊銷清單被暫存在系統目錄中，並部署到我們這邊，供名為`certctl.py`的工具使用。

The source for certificates and revocation lists is collected in the following directories, either shipped with the base system and/or managed from OPNsense:

憑證和撤銷清單的來源檔案收集在以下目錄中，這些目錄要麼隨基本系統一起提供，要麼由 OPNsense 管理：

| **Path**<br>**路徑** | **Topic**<br>**主題** |
| --- | --- |
| /usr/share/certs/trusted | Default system certificates, shipped with the base system<br>預設系統證書，隨基本系統一起提供 |
| /usr/local/share/certs | Application specific certificates and revocation lists<br>應用程式特定憑證和撤銷清單 |
| /usr/share/certs/untrusted | Certificates that are not to be trusted anymore<br>不再受信任的憑證 |

`certctl.py` collects all certificates from the set defined above and creates links to them in the target directories specified below.

`certctl.py`從上面定義的集合中收集所有證書，並在下面指定的目標目錄中建立指向它們的連結。

| **Path**<br>**路徑** | **Topic**<br>**主題** |
| --- | --- |
| /etc/ssl/certs | Directory with links (and files) to certificates named by their hash. (for example `ef954a4e.0` or `ef954a4e.r0` for a CRL) Primary location for the base system.<br>包含指向憑證的連結（和檔案）的目錄，憑證依其雜湊值命名。 （例如， `ef954a4e.0`對應的是CRL或`ef954a4e.r0` ）基本系統的主要位置。 |
| /etc/ssl/untrusted | Same as above, but untrusted (ignored)<br>與上述相同，但設定為 untrusted（忽略） |
| /usr/local/openssl/certs | Same as `/etc/ssl/certs`, default location for applications build from the “ports” tree<br>與`/etc/ssl/certs`相同，是從「ports」樹建構的應用程式的預設位置 |
| /usr/local/etc/ssl/cert.pem | Combined bundle file for applications that require a single file.<br>適用於只需要單一檔案的應用程式的合併軟體包檔案。 |

Each target link (or file) contains a single certificate or revocation list, which OpenSSL can easily locate using the certificate subject.

每個目標連結（或檔案）都包含一個憑證或撤銷列表，OpenSSL 可以使用憑證主題輕鬆找到它。

Note

注意事項

If either `/etc/ssl/cert.pem` and/or `/usr/local/etc/ssl/cert.pem` exists, they will have preference above the hashed links insode the target directories. Staring with OPNsense version 25.1, these files will be removed when they exist.

如果`/etc/ssl/cert.pem`和/或`/usr/local/etc/ssl/cert.pem`存在，則它們優先於目標目錄中的雜湊連結。從 OPNsense 版本25.1開始，這些檔案如果存在將被刪除。

Default settings for OpenSSL are saved into `/usr/local/openssl/openssl.cnf` (ports) and `/etc/ssl/openssl.cnf` (base), both are managed by OPNsense.

OpenSSL 的預設設定保存在`/usr/local/openssl/openssl.cnf` （連接埠）和`/etc/ssl/openssl.cnf` （基本）中，兩者都由 OPNsense 管理。

#### Usage examples｜使用範例

In [Setup Self-Signed Certificate Chains](#p-104) you will find examples of how to setup certificate chains yourself.

在 [設定自簽名憑證鏈](#p-104)中，您可以找到如何自行設定憑證鏈的範例。

### Log Files｜紀錄檔案

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/logging_system.html>

When troubleshooting problems with your firewall, it is very likely you have to check the logs available on your system. In the UI of OPNsense, the log files are generally grouped with the settings of the component they belong to. The log files can be found here:

在排查防火牆問題時，您很可能需要檢查系統上的日誌。在 OPNsense 的UI目錄下，日誌檔案通常會根據其所屬組件的設定進行分組。日誌檔案位於以下位置：

|   |   |   |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **System Log**<br>**系統日誌** | System ‣ Log Files ‣ General<br>系統 ‣ 日誌檔案 ‣ 常規 | *Most of all system related events go here*<br>*大多數系統相關事件都會記錄在這裡* |
| **Backend / config daemon**<br>**後端/設定守護程式** | System ‣ Log Files ‣ Backend<br>系統 ‣ 日誌檔案 ‣ 後端 | *Here you can find logs for config generation of API usage*<br>*此處可找到API使用情況的設定產生日誌* |
| **Web GUI** | System ‣ Log Files ‣ Web GUI<br>系統 ‣ 日誌檔案 ‣ Web GUI | *Lighttpd, the webserver of OPNsense itself, logs here*<br>*OPNsense 自身的 Web 伺服器 Lighttpd 的日誌記錄在此* |
| **Firmware**<br>**韌體** | System ‣ Firmware ‣ Log File<br>系統 ‣ 韌體 ‣ 日誌檔案 | *Updates from the packaging system go here*<br>*來自打包系統的更新將放在這裡* |
| **Gateways**<br>**網關** | System ‣ Gateways ‣ Log File<br>系統 ‣ 網關 ‣ 日誌檔案 | *Lists Dpinger gateway tracking related log messages*<br>*列出 Dpinger 網關追蹤相關的日誌訊息* |
| **Routing**<br>**路由** | System ‣ Routes ‣ Log File<br>系統 ‣ 路由 ‣ 日誌檔案 | *Routing changes or interface events*<br>*路由變更或介面事件* |

### Diagnostics｜診斷

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

#### Activity｜活動

The activity module shows current active processes and their details, you can search within the list of activities, fetch general information (like load averages, number of processes, etc.) using the info button in the footer of the grid.

活動模組顯示當前活動進程及其詳細信息，您可以在活動列表中進行搜索，使用網格底部的 info 按鈕獲取一般信息（如負載平均值、進程數等）。

---

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| PID | The process id of this process<br>此進程的進程 ID |
| USERNAME | Username executed this process<br>執行此進程的使用者名稱 |
| PRI | Current priority of the process<br>目前流程優先級 |
| NICE | NICE is the [nice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nice_\(Unix\)) amount (in the range -20 to 20)<br>NICE是 [nice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nice_\(Unix\) ) 數量（範圍為 -20 到 20） |
| SIZE | Total size of the process (text, data, and stack)<br>進程總大小（文字、資料與堆疊） |
| RES | Current amount of resident memory, RAM currently in use by the process<br>目前駐留內存量， RAM當前進程正在使用 |
| C | is the processor number on which the process is executing (visible only on SMP systems)<br>是進程正在執行的處理器編號（僅在SMP系統上可見） |
| TIME | The number of system and user cpu seconds that the process has used<br>進程已使用的系統與使用者 CPU 秒數 |
| WCPU | Weighted cpu percentage<br>加權 CPU 使用率 |
| COMMAND | Command string<br>指令字串 |

#### Services｜服務

The services page shows the configured services and status, you can stop/start/restart all of them here.

服務頁面顯示已設定的服務及其狀態，您可以在這裡停止/啟動/重新啟動所有服務。

<a id="p-103"></a>

#### Configure 2FA TOTP & Google Authenticator｜配置雙重認證TOTP和 Google Authenticator

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/two_factor.html>

This how-to will show you how to setup a One-time Password 2 Factor Authentication using OPNsense and Google’s Authenticator. All services of OPNsense can be used with this 2FA solution.

本教學將向您展示如何使用 OPNsense 和 Google Authenticator 設定一次性密碼雙重認證。 OPNsense 的所有服務均可與此雙重認證解決方案搭配使用。

[![../../_images/two_factor_authentication.png](<../images/8614e4c5-two_factor_authentication.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/two_factor_authentication.png)

Note

注意事項

To use the same feature with any time based one-time password token just enter the seed into the field in step 3 instead of creating a new seed. The seed needs to be in base32 format.

若要將此功能與任何基於時間的一次性密碼令牌一起使用，只需在步驟 3 中將種子輸入到對應欄位中，而無需建立新種子。種子必須採用 base32 格式。

##### Step 1 - Add New Authentication Server｜步驟 1 - 新增的身份驗證伺服器

To add a TOTP server go to System ‣ Access ‣ Servers and press **Add server** in the top right corner. Then fill in the form as follows:

要新增TOTP伺服器，請前往“系統”‣“存取”‣“伺服器”，然後點擊右上角的**新增伺服器**。接下來，請如下填寫表單：

|   |   |   |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Descriptive name**<br>**描述性名稱** | TOTP Server<br>TOTP伺服器 | *Choose a server name*<br>*選擇伺服器名稱* |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | Local+Timebased One Time Password<br>本地+基於時間的一次性密碼 | *Select the TOTP server Type*<br>*選擇TOTP伺服器類型* |
| **Token length**<br>**令牌長度** | 6 | *6 for Google Authenticator*<br>*Google Authenticator 為 6* |
| **Time window**<br>**時間視窗** |  | *Leave Empty for Google Authenticator*<br>*留空以使用 Google Authenticator* |
| **Grace period**<br>**寬限期** |  | *Leave Empty for Google Authenticator*<br>*留空以使用 Google 驗證器* |

##### Step 2 - Install Google Authenticator｜步驟 2 - 安裝 Google Authenticator

Go to the App Store of your platform and search for Google Authenticator. Install using the normal procedure for your device.

請前往您所用平台的應用程式商店，搜尋「Google Authenticator」。請依照適用於您裝置的正常安裝步驟進行安裝。

##### Step 3 - Add or modify user｜步驟 3 - 新增或修改用戶

For this example we will create a new user, go to System ‣ Access ‣ Users and click on the plus sign in the lower right corner.

在這個例子中，我們將建立一個新用戶，轉到“系統”‣“訪問”‣“用戶”，然後點擊右下角的加號。

Enter a **Username** and **Password** and fill in the other fields just as you would do for any other user. Then select the **Generate new (160bit) secret** under **OTP seed**.

輸入**使用者名稱**和**密碼**，並像填寫其他使用者資訊一樣填寫其他欄位。然後在**OTP種子**下選擇**產生新的（160位元）金鑰**。

When done press **Save**.

完成後，請按**儲存**。

##### Step 4 - Activate Authenticator for this OTP seed｜步驟 4 - 啟動此OTP種子的驗證器

To activate your new OTP seed on the Google Authenticator, first reopen the user you just created by clicking on the pencil icon.

若要啟動 Google Authenticator 上的新OTP種子，請先點選鉛筆圖示重新開啟您剛剛建立的使用者。

[![../../_images/OTP_seed.png](<../images/831dcf85-OTP_seed.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OTP_seed.png)

Now it will show a QR code:

現在會顯示QR程式碼：

[![../../_images/otp_qr_code.png](<../images/f4fd79a3-otp_qr_code.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/otp_qr_code.png)

Warning

警告

Be very careful with the seed or QR code as this is the only thing you need to calculate the token. **KEEP YOUR SEED/QR CODE SAFE !**

請務必妥善保管種子或QR代碼，因為這是計算代幣所需的唯一資訊。 **KEEP YOUR SEED/QR CODE SAFE ！**

Now open your Google Authenticator compatible application and select the option to start the configuration and then scan the QR code or alternatively enter the seed directly.

現在打開您的 Google Authenticator 相容應用程序，選擇開始配置的選項，然後掃描QR代碼，或直接輸入種子。

In case of SailOTP the configuration works like this:

對於 SailOTP，配置方式如下：

[![../../_images/sailotp_menu.jpg](<../images/2201289e-sailotp_menu.jpg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/sailotp_menu.jpg)

Pull down to open the application menu and choose the entry to add a new Token.

下拉開啟應用程式選單，然後選擇新增令牌的條目。

[![../../_images/sailotp_scan_qr.jpg](<../images/9835d174-sailotp_scan_qr.jpg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/sailotp_scan_qr.jpg)

In the next step, you have to scan the previously created QR code by clicking on the screen.

下一步，您需要點擊螢幕掃描之前建立的QR碼。

[![../../_images/sailotp_scanresult.jpg](<../images/26644d39-sailotp_scanresult.jpg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/sailotp_scanresult.jpg)

When the QR code is scanned, a new view will open where you can see the details of the result. This view can be used to check if the generated key and OTP settings of the scan results do match your settings. Confirm if everything is ok by clicking “Add”（添加）.

掃描QR條碼後，將開啟一個新視圖，您可以在其中查看結果詳情。您可以使用此視圖檢查產生的金鑰和OTP設定是否與您的設定相符。點選“Add”（添加）確認一切正常。

After this step, you will be back on the home screen of the app and will get a Token for 30 Seconds.

完成此步驟後，您將返回應用程式的主螢幕，並獲得有效期為 30 秒的令牌。

Please note that there are many apps to generate the token. Some well known are:

請注意，有很多應用程式可以產生令牌。一些比較知名的應用程式包括：

| Name<br>名稱 | Platform<br>平台 | URL |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FreeOTP<br>免費一次性密碼 | Android, iOS<br>安卓、iOS | [https://freeotp.github.io/](https://freeotp.github.io/)<br>[https://freeotp.github.io/](https://freeotp.github.io/) |
| Google Authenticator | Android, iOS | [https://www.google.com/landing/2step/](https://www.google.com/landing/2step/)<br>[https://www.google.com/landing/2step/](https://www.google.com/landing/2step/) |

##### Step 5 - Test the token｜步驟 5 - 測試令牌

For testing the user authentication, OPNsense offers a simple tester. Go to System ‣ Access ‣ Tester

為了測試使用者身份驗證，OPNsense 提供了一個簡單的測試工具。請轉到“系統”‣“訪問”‣“測試工具”。

Select the Authentication server you have configured, and enter the user name. Then enter the **\*token** + **password**, remember the order is token and then password **in the same field**.

選擇您設定的身份驗證伺服器，然後輸入使用者名稱。然後輸入**\*令牌**+**密碼**，記住順序是令牌，然後是密碼**在同一欄位**。

Note

注意事項

Password field should be used to enter both token and your password, like: **Password:** 123456PASSWORD when the default configuration is used. The OTP authentication server can also be configured to have it in the reverse order like PASSWORD123456.

密碼欄位應用於輸入令牌和密碼，例如：**密碼：** 123456PASSWORD（使用預設設定時）。 OTP 身份验证服务器也可以配置为以相反的顺序，如 PASSWORD123456。

Hit the test button and if all goes well you should see *successfully authenticated*.

點擊測試按鈕，如果一切順利，您應該會看到*成功通過身份驗證*。

[![../../_images/system_access_tester.png](<../images/acf16400-system_access_tester.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/system_access_tester.png)

##### Step 6 - Enable authentication server｜步驟 6 - 啟用身份驗證伺服器

Per default the system validates user credentials against the “Local Database”（本地資料庫）. In System ‣ Settings ‣ Administration, section **Authentication** you should change this to your newly added authentication server to make sure no local user can gain access without 2FA.

默认情况下，系统根据 “Local Database”（本地資料庫） 验证用户凭据。在 System ‣ Settings ‣ Administration 的 **Authentication** 部分中，您應該將其變更為新新增的驗證伺服器，以確保本機使用者在沒有 2FA 的情況下無法取得存取權限。

**Note: Make sure you’ve tested your token!**

**注意：請確保您已測試過您的令牌！**

[![../../_images/auth_server.png](<../images/553d6650-auth_server.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/auth_server.png)

##### Step 7 - Using the token｜步驟 7 - 使用令牌

To use the token in any application/service that you have configured, just open the Google Authenticator and add the created token/key **before** your regular password.

要在您配置的任何應用程式/服務中使用該令牌，只需打開 Google Authenticator，並在常規密碼**之前**添加建立的令牌/密鑰即可。

Warning

警告

Remember, you need to enter the token **before** or **after** you password (depending on your configuration)! And the password field should be used to enter both token and your password, like: **Password:** 123456PASSWORD

請記住，您需要在輸入密碼的**之前**或**之後**輸入令牌（取決於您的配置）！密碼欄位應同時輸入令牌和密碼，例如：**密碼：** 123456PASSWORD

The code will change every 30 seconds. Sample code:

代碼每 30 秒更新一次。範例程式碼：

[![../../_images/google_token_sample.png](<../images/0fd40a08-google_token_sample.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/google_token_sample.png)

#### Setup Self-Signed Certificate Chains｜設定自簽名憑證鏈
