<a id="p-131"></a>

### Generic info｜一般資訊

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/firewall_generic.html>

This chapter explains some of the concepts that are used in different modules of our firewall system and therefore don’t belong to a specific section of this topic.

本章解釋了防火牆系統不同模組中使用的一些概念，因此不屬於本主題的特定部分。

#### Address types｜地址類型

When choosing source and/or destination addresses, the user can choose several options depending on the context. To explain what the different options mean when being presented, we will summarize them below:

當選擇來源和/或目標位址時，使用者可以根據上下文選擇多個選項。為了解釋不同選項的含義，我們將其總結如下：

---

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Alias<br>別名 | Flexible type of network or address definition for easy reuse, explained in [aliases](#p-132)<br>靈活的網路類型或位址定義，以便於重複使用，如[別名](#p-132) |
| Single host or network<br>單主機或網路 | Standard host or network in [CIDR notation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Classless_Inter-Domain_Routing)<br>標準主機或網路 [CIDR 表示法](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Classless_Inter-Domain_Routing) |
| any<br>任何 | All IPv4 and/or IPv6 addresses (in the world)<br>所有 IPv4 和/或 IPv6 位址（全球） |
| This Firewall<br>此防火牆 | All IPv4 and/or IPv6 addresses assigned to this firewall<br>指派給此防火牆的所有 IPv4 和/或 IPv6 位址 |
| \[Interface\] Network<br>\[介面\]網路 | All networks assigned to the device, this will also include networks of assigned virtual addresses (\[Interface\] is explained in the [interfaces](#p-106) topic). Normally used to allow traffic from or to clients connected to a specific interface.<br>指派給裝置的所有網絡，這也包括指派的虛擬位址的網路（\[介面\]在[介面](#p-106)主題中進行了解釋）。通常用於允許來自或流向連接到特定介面的客戶端的流量。 |
| \[Interface\] Address<br>\[介面\]位址 | All addresses configured on an interface, this includes all virtual (alias) addresses as well.<br>在介面上設定的所有位址，這也包括所有虛擬（別名）位址。 |
| Virtual IPs<br>虛擬IP | Explicit selection for addresses defined in [Virtual IPs](#p-111)<br>明確選擇[虛擬 IP](#p-111) 中定義的位址 |

---

<a id="p-132"></a>

### Aliases｜別名

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/aliases.html>

Aliases are named lists of networks, hosts or ports that can be used as one entity by selecting the alias name in the various supported sections of the firewall. These aliases are particularly useful to condense firewall rules and minimize changes.

別名是網路、主機或連接埠的命名列表，透過在防火牆的各個支援部分中選擇別名，可以將其用作實體。這些別名對於壓縮防火牆規則和最小化變更特別有用。

Aliases can be added, modified and removed via Firewall ‣ Aliases.

可以透過 Firewall ‣ Aliases 新增、修改和刪除別名。

#### Overview｜概述

The page opens with an overview of the aliases available, including some internal ones available from installed software. At the top of the page you can search for aliases or preselect various types or categories to which they belong.

該頁面開啟後會概述可用的別名，包括已安裝軟體中可用的一些內部別名。在頁面頂部，您可以搜尋別名或預先選擇它們所屬的各種類型或類別。

In order to gain some insights into the current status of the plugins, two additional (meta) fields are being displayed, being:

為了深入了解插件的當前狀態，將顯示兩個附加（元）字段，即：

-   Loaded#  
    已載入#
    
    -   Shows the amount of entries planned to install into the table, in case there’s not enough memory available to load the item in question, one can easily find the alias causing the overflow in table entries (bar at the right top of the page)  
        顯示計劃安裝到表中的條目數量，如果沒有足夠的記憶體來載入相關項目，可以輕鬆找到導致表條目溢出的別名（頁面右上角的欄）
        
-   Last updated  
    最後更新
    
    > -   Shows the last timestamp from the entries saved to disk.  
          顯示儲存到磁碟的條目的最後一個時間戳。
    >     
    

Note

注意事項

The fields above are only used for aliases that contain either networks or hosts, port type aliases are part of the rule and thus not visible in any table.

上面的欄位僅用於包含網路或主機的別名，連接埠類型別名是規則的一部分，因此在任何表中都不可見。

#### Alias Types｜別名類型

OPNsense offers the following alias types:

OPNsense 提供以下別名類型：

| Type<br>類型 | Description<br>描述 |
| --- | --- |
| Hosts<br>主持人 | Single hosts by IP or Fully Qualified Domain Name or host exclusions (starts with “!” sign)<br>透過 IP 或完全限定網域名稱或主機排除（以「！」符號開頭）的單一主機 |
| Networks<br>網 | Entire network p.e. 192.168.1.1/24 or network exclusion eg !192.168.1.0/24<br>全網P.E. 192.168.1.1/24 或網路排除，例如！ 192.168.1.0/24 |
| Ports<br>港口 | Port numbers or a port range like 20:30<br>連接埠號碼或連接埠範圍，例如 20:30 |
| MAC addresses<br>MAC 位址 | MAC address or partial mac addresses like `f4:90:ea`<br>MAC 位址或部分 MAC 位址，例如 `f4:90:ea` |
| URL (IPs)<br>URL（IP） | A table of IP addresses that are fetched once<br>一次取得的IP位址表 |
| URL Tables (IPs)<br>URL 表 (IP) | A table of IP addresses that are fetched on regular intervals.<br>定期取得的IP位址表。 |
| URL Table in JSON format (IPs)<br>URL JSON 格式的表格 (IP) | A table of IP addresses that are fetched on regular intervals. (using a json structure)<br>定期取得的IP位址表。 （使用json結構） |
| GeoIP<br>地理IP | Select countries or whole regions<br>選擇國家或整個地區 |
| Network group<br>網路群 | Combine different network type aliases into one<br>將不同的網路類型別名合併為一個 |
| Dynamic IPv6 Host<br>動態 IPv6 主機 | A Host entry that will auto update on a prefixchange<br>會在前綴更改時自動更新的主機條目 |
| BGP ASN | Maps autonomous system (AS) numbers to networks where they are responsible for.<br>將自治系統 (AS) 編號對應到其負責的網路。 |
| OpenVPN group<br>OpenVPN 群組 | Map user groups to logged in OpenVPN users<br>將使用者群組對應到登入的 OpenVPN 使用者 |
| Internal (automatic)<br>內部（自動） | Internal aliases which are managed by the product<br>由產品管理的內部別名 |
| External (advanced)<br>外部（高級） | Externally managed alias, this only handles the placeholder. Content is set from another source (plugin, api call, etc)<br>外部管理的別名，這只處理佔位符。內容是從其他來源設定的（插件、API 呼叫等） |

##### Hosts｜主辦單位

Hosts can be entered as a single IP address, a range (separated with a minus sign, e.g. `10.0.0.1-10.0.0.10`) or a fully qualified domain name.

主機可以輸入為單一IP位址、範圍（以減號分隔，例如`10.0.0.1-10.0.0.10`）或完全限定的網域名稱。

When using a fully qualified domain name, the name will be resolved periodically (default is each 300 seconds).

使用完全限定域名時，將定期解析該名稱（預設為每 300 秒）。

Sample

樣本

Let’s say we want to create an alias table for **www.youtube.com**

假設我們要為 **www.youtube.com** 建立一個別名表

[![../_images/aliases_host.png](<../images/8363346d-aliases_host.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/aliases_host.png)

**Apply changes** and look at the content of our newly created pf table.

**套用變更**並查看我們新建立的 pf 表的內容。

Go to Firewall ‣ Diagnostics ‣ Aliases and select our newly created youtube table.

前往 Firewall ‣ Diagnostics ‣ Aliases 並選擇我們新建立的 YouTube 表格。

[![../_images/pftable_youtube.png](<../images/f7b204d8-pftable_youtube.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/pftable_youtube.png)

As you can see there are multiple IP addresses for this domain.

如您所看到的，該網域有多個 IP 位址。

Tip

提示

To change the alias domain resolve interval, go to Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced and set **Aliases Resolve Interval** to the number of seconds to refresh.

若要變更別名域解析間隔，請前往 Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced 並將 **Aliases Resolve Interval** 設定為刷新的秒數。

Hosts type Aliases can contain exclusion hosts. Exclusion addresses starts with “!” sign (eg !192.168.0.1) and can be used to exclude hosts from Network Group Aliases.

主機類型別名可以包含排除主機。排除位址以「！」開頭符號（例如！192.168.0.1），可用於從網路群組別名中排除主機。

Warning

警告

Please note that the **Flush** action is not persistent!

請注意，**Flush** 操作不是持久的！

**“flush”** means flush the current contents of the alias, which will be repopulated when it’s not an external type, so flush in most cases isn’t very useful.

**「flush」**表示刷新別名的當前內容，當它不是外部類型時將重新填充別名，因此刷新在大多數情況下不是很有用。

Same behaviour applies to the API call [alias\_util flush](#p-276)

相同的行為適用於 API 呼叫 [alias\_utillush](#p-276)

##### Networks｜網路

Networks are specified in Classless Inter-Domain Routing format (CIDR). Use the the correct CIDR mask for each entry. For instance a /32 specifies a single IPv4 host, or /128 specifies a single IPv6 host, whereas /24 specifies 255.255.255.0 and /64 specifies a normal IPv6 network. Network type Aliases can contain exclusion hosts or networks. Exclusion addresses starts with “!” sign (eg !192.168.0.0/24) and can be used to exclude hosts or networks from current Alias or Network Group Alias

網路以無類別域間路由格式 (CIDR) 指定。為每個條目使用正確的 CIDR 遮罩。例如，/32 指定單一 IPv4 主機，或 /128 指定單一 IPv6 主機，而 /24 指定 255.255.255.0，而 /64 指定普通 IPv6 網路。網路類型別名可以包含排除主機或網路。排除位址以「！」開頭符號（例如！192.168.0.0/24），可用於從目前別名或網路組別別名排除主機或網路

Apart from the CIDR notation, one could also use a [wildcard mask](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wildcard_mask) to match ranges of hosts or networks.

除了CIDR表示法之外，還可以使用[通配符遮罩](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wildcard_mask)來匹配主機或網路的範圍。

Tip

提示

To match all servers ending at .1 in the 192.168.X.1 networks, use a wildcard definition like `192.168.0.1/0.0.255.0`

若要符合 192.168.X.1 網路中以 .1 結尾的所有伺服器，請使用通配符定義，例如 `192.168.0.1/0.0.255.0`

##### Ports｜港口

Ports can be specified as a single number or a range using a colon **:**. For instance to add a range of 20 to 25 one would enter 20:25 in the **Port(s)** section.

連接埠可以指定為單一數字或使用冒號 **:**的範圍。例如，要新增 20 到 25 的範圍，可以在**Port(s)** 部分輸入 20:25。

##### MAC addresses｜MAC 地址

Hardware mac addresses can be specified as a (partial) hex value, such as `F4:90:EA` to match all addresses from Deciso or `f4:90:ea:00:00:01` to match a single item (the input is case insensitive).

硬體 MAC 位址可以指定為（部分）十六進位值，例如 `F4:90:EA` 符合 Deciso 中的所有位址，或 `f4:90:ea:00:00:01` 符合單一項目（輸入不區分大小寫）。

The way these aliases function is approximately the same as hostnames in host type aliases, they are resolved on periodic intervals from the `arp` and `ndp` tables.

這些別名的功能與主機類型別名中的主機名稱大致相同，它們是從 `arp` 和 `ndp` 表中定期解析的。

Warning

警告

Please be aware that hardware addresses can be spoofed ([https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MAC\_spoofing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MAC_spoofing)), which doesn’t make filters on them more secure than ip addresses in any way.

請注意，硬體位址可能會被欺騙（[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MAC\_spoofing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MAC_spoofing)），這並不會使它們上的過濾器比 IP 位址更安全。

Note

注意事項

Since mappings between addresses and mac addresses are resolved periodically the actual situation can differ, you can always check Firewall -> Diagnostics -> Aliases to inspect the current contents of the alias.

由於位址和 MAC 位址之間的對應會定期解析，因此實際情況可能會有所不同，因此您可以隨時檢查防火牆 -> 診斷 -> 別名來檢查別名的當前內容。

##### URL Tables｜URL 桌子

URL tables can be used to fetch a list of IP addresses from a remote server. You can specify a `` Refresh frequency` `` to determine how often this information should be updated.

URL 表可用於從遠端伺服器取得 IP 位址清單。您可以指定 `` Refresh frequency` `` 來決定此資訊的更新頻率。

Note

注意事項

The content of the file being fetched should contain one IPv\[4|6\] address per line, lines that start with a `whitespace` , colon (`,`), semicolon (`;`), pipe (`|`) or hash (`#`) will be ignored.

正在取得的檔案內容每行應包含一個 IPv\[4|6\] 位址，以 `whitespace` 、冒號 (`,`)、分號 (`;`)、豎線 (`|`) 或哈希 (`#`) 開頭的行將被忽略。

##### URL Table in JSON format (IPs)｜URL JSON 格式的表格（IP）

URL tables can be used to fetch a list of IP addresses from a remote server and parse their contents when in [JSON](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JSON) format, similar to our standard (text based) url table.

URL 表可用於從遠端伺服器取得 IP 位址列表，並以 [JSON](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JSON) 格式解析其內容，類似於我們的標準（基於文字）url 表。

You can use a `Path expression` to select data from the container, in some cases, when content is “flat” you just need a single path reference. For example the spamhause [drop](https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/drop_v4.json) list contains a json file per row with a field `cidr`.

您可以使用 `Path expression` 從容器中選擇數據，在某些情況下，當內容是「扁平」時，您只需要一個路徑引用。例如，spamhause [drop](https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/drop_v4.json) 清單每行包含一個 json 文件，其中包含一個欄位 `cidr`。

More advanced scenarios are also possible as our parser supports [jq](https://jqlang.org/), some (simple) examples can be found below in the table below.

更高級的場景也是可能的，因為我們的解析器支援 [jq](https://jqlang.org/)，一些（簡單的）範例可以在下表中找到。

| Content<br>內容 | Path Expression<br>路徑表達式 | Topic<br>主題 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [https://ip-ranges.amazonaws.com/ip-ranges.json](https://ip-ranges.amazonaws.com/ip-ranges.json) | .prefixes\[\]\| select(.region==”us-east-1”) \| select(.service==”EC2”) \| .ip\_prefix<br>.前綴\[\]\| 選擇(.region==”us-east-1”) \| 選擇（.服務==”EC2”) \| .ip\_前綴 | All ip addresses belonging to service EC2 in region us-east-1<br>屬於服務的所有IP位址 EC2 在 us-east-1 地區 |
| [https://api.github.com/meta](https://api.github.com/meta) | .web + .api + .git \| .\[\] | All of GitHubs web, api and git addresses<br>所有 GitHub 的 Web、API 與 git 位址 |
| [https://endpoints.office.com/endpoints/worldwide?clientrequestid=b10c5ed1-bad1-445f-b386-b919946339a7](https://endpoints.office.com/endpoints/worldwide?clientrequestid=b10c5ed1-bad1-445f-b386-b919946339a7) | .\[\]\| select(.serviceArea==”Exchange”) \| select(“.ips”)\| .ips \| .\[\]?<br>.\[\]\| select(.serviceArea==”交換”) \| 選擇（“.ips”）\| .ips \| .\[\]？ | Exchange networks from Microsoft<br>Microsoft 的交換網路 |

Tip

提示

Use [https://play.jqlang.org/](https://play.jqlang.org/) to fiddle with the jq language before pasting content and path expression in an alias.

在將內容和路徑表達式貼到別名之前，請使用 [https://play.jqlang.org/](https://play.jqlang.org/) 擺弄 jq 語言。

##### GeoIP｜地理IP

With GeoIP aliases you can select one or more countries or whole continents to block or allow. Use the *toggle all* checkbox to select all countries within the given region.

使用 GeoIP 別名，您可以選擇一個或多個國家或整個大陸來阻止或允許。使用*切換全部*複選框選擇給定區域內的所有國家。

To use GeoIP, when not using our business edition, you need to configure a source in the Firewall ‣ Aliases -> GeoIP settings tab, our software supports formats offered by IPinfo and MaxMind.

要使用 GeoIP，當不使用我們的商業版時，您需要在 Firewall ‣ Aliases -> GeoIP settings 標籤中配置來源，我們的軟體支援 IPinfo 和 MaxMind 提供的格式。

Note

注意事項

In our experience IPinfo offers a much bigger and more detailed dataset, do make sure you increase Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced : Firewall Maximum Table Entries to a higher number when using different countries from the list. As of this writing, the total size of the list is ~7 million entries.

根據我們的經驗，IPinfo 提供了更大、更詳細的資料集，當使用清單中的不同國家/地區時，請確保將 Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced : Firewall Maximum Table Entries 增加到更高的數量。截至撰寫本文時，清單的總大小約為 700 萬個條目。

Although you’re not obligated to use one of the defined services, the following documents explain how to use the option of your choice:

儘管您沒有義務使用其中一項已定義的服務，但以下文件說明如何使用您選擇的選項：

> -   [IPinfo GeoIP’s Setup](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/ipinfo_geo_ip.html)  
      [IPinfo GeoIP的設定](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/ipinfo_geo_ip.html)
>     
> -   [MaxMind GeoIP’s Setup](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/maxmind_geo_ip.html)  
      [MaxMind GeoIP 的設定](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/maxmind_geo_ip.html)
>     

Tip

提示

When using the Business Edition, you can leave the `Url` field empty so the firewall will download the IPinfo database provided from our mirrors automatically.

使用商業版時，您可以將`Url`欄位留空，這樣防火牆就會自動下載我們的鏡像提供的IPinfo資料庫。

Below you will find a detailed specification our software can detect and process automatically.

下面您將找到我們的軟體可以自動偵測和處理的詳細規格。

**gzip format (IPinfo)**

**gzip 格式（IP 資訊）**

This format is a simple comma separated file containing the following elements in this order:

此格式是一個簡單的逗號分隔文件，依序包含以下元素：

-   network  
    網路
    
-   country  
    國家
    
-   country\_code  
    國家\_代碼
    
-   continent  
    大陸
    
-   continent\_code  
    大陸\_代碼
    
-   asn  
    阿斯尼
    
-   as\_name  
    作為\_name
    
-   as\_domain  
    作為\_domain
    

Our software only uses `network` and `country_code`, these should be mentioned in the header of the csv. The file itself should be compressed using `gzip`

我們的軟體只使用`network`和`country_code`，這些應該在csv的標題中提及。文件本身應該使用 `gzip` 進行壓縮

**zip format (MaxMind)**

**zip 格式 (MaxMind)**

This format requires a \[zip\] file containing the following csv files:

此格式需要包含以下 csv 檔案的 \[zip\] 檔案：

*Title*

*標題*

| Filename<br>檔名 | Purpose<br>目的 | Format<br>格式 | Example<br>範例 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| %prefix%-locations-en.csv | maps geo locations to iso countries<br>將地理位置對應到 ISO 國家 | geoname\_id,,,,country\_iso\_code<br>地理名稱\_id,,,,國家\_iso\_code | 1,,,,NL |
| %prefix%-IPv4.csv<br>%前綴%-IPv4.csv | IPv4 networks<br>IPv4網路 | network,geoname\_id<br>網路、地理名稱\_id | 2.21.241.0/28,1 |
| %prefix%-IPv6.csv<br>%前綴%-IPv6.csv | IPv6 networks<br>IPv6網路 | network,geoname\_id<br>網路、地理名稱\_id | 2001:470:1f15:210::/64,1 |

The `%prefix%` can be used to identify the product and/or vendor, in MaxMind’s case these files are named `GeoLite2-Country-Locations-en.csv`, `GeoLite2-Country-Blocks-IPv4.csv`, `GeoLite2-Country-Blocks-IPv6.csv` for example.

`%prefix%` 可用於識別產品和/或供應商，例如，在 MaxMind 的情況下，這些檔案被命名為 `GeoLite2-Country-Locations-en.csv`, `GeoLite2-Country-Blocks-IPv4.csv`, `GeoLite2-Country-Blocks-IPv6.csv`。

Tip

提示

Geo IP lists can be rather large, especially when using IPv6. When creating rules, always try to minimize the number of addresses needed in your selection. A selection of all countries in the world not being the Netherlands can usually be rewritten as only addresses from the Netherlands for example.

Geo IP 清單可能相當大，特別是使用 IPv6 時。建立規則時，請務必盡量減少選擇中所需的位址數量。例如，通常可以將世界上除荷蘭以外的所有國家/地區的選擇重寫為僅來自荷蘭的地址。

Tip

提示

If the number of items is larger than the allocated alias size, you can assign more memory to aliases. Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced : Firewall Maximum Table Entries

如果項目數量大於分配的別名大小，您可以為別名分配更多記憶體。防火牆 ‣ 設定 ‣ 進階 : 防火牆最大表格條目數

##### Network group｜網路組

Combine different network type aliases into one, this type of alias accepts other host type aliases (networks, hosts, …). Although nesting is possible with other alias types as well, this type only displays valid aliases easing administration, functionally a `Networks` type alias can do the same but uses a different presentation.

將不同的網路類型別名組合為一個，這種類型的別名會接受其他主機類型別名（網路、主機等）。儘管其他別名類型也可以嵌套，但此類型僅顯示有效的別名以方便管理，從功能上講，`Networks` 類型別名可以執行相同的操作，但使用不同的表示形式。

##### Dynamic IPv6 Host｜動態 IPv6 主機

An IPv6 Dynamic Host is used where the system is using a dynamic prefix on the LAN, a tracking interface. When the prefix changes, either due to the ISP changing the prefix at will or the prefix changes when the WAN connection is reset, any alias containing an address of a client such as a server on the LAN would no longer be valid.

IPv6 動態主機用於系統在 LAN（追蹤介面）上使用動態前綴的情況。當前綴發生變化時，無論是由於ISP隨意更改前綴，還是由於WAN連接重置時前綴發生變化，任何包含客戶端位址（例如LAN上的伺服器）的別名將不再有效。

For example, you obtain a prefix 2001:db8:2222:2800::/56. You have a /56 prefix and if the tracking id was set to 0 for your LAN, you would have an address range on your LAN of 2001:db8:2222:2800:: to 2001:db8:2222:2800:FFFF:FFFF:FFFF:FFFF.

例如，您獲得前綴 2001:db8:2222:2800::/56。您有 /56 前綴，如果您的 LAN 的追蹤 ID 設定為 0，則您的 LAN 上的位址範圍為 2001:db8:2222:2800:: 到 2001:db8:2222:2800:FFFF:FFFF:FFFF:FFFF。

You want to run a server on your LAN that is accessible from the WAN so you give it a static address of 2001:db8:2222:2800:1000:1000::1 and create a rule allowing traffic to access the server.

您希望在 LAN 上執行一個可從 WAN 存取的伺服器，因此您為其指定靜態位址 2001:db8:2222:2800:1000:1000::1 並建立一條允許流量存取該伺服器的規則。

When your prefix changes, that static address is no longer valid, so you must use the Dynamic IPv6 Host to create an alias address for the firewall entry that automatically tracks the prefix and changes the rule.

當您的前綴變更時，此靜態位址不再有效，因此您必須使用動態 IPv6 主機為自動追蹤前綴並變更規則的防火牆項目建立別名位址。

The Dynamic Host Alias will always split on the /64 boundary, it will take the upper 64 bits from the interface you select and the lower 64 bits from the address you enter. It does not matter what size your prefix delegation is.

動態主機別名將始終在 /64 邊界上拆分，它將從您選擇的介面中取得高 64 位，並從您輸入的位址中取得低 64 位元。您的前綴委託的大小並不重要。

Create a new IPv6 Dynamic Host alias and enter only the suffix of the address, in this example, we will enter the lower 64 bits of the address, you would enter ::1000:1000:0000:1, note the ‘::’ at the start of the address, you MUST always start the address with a ‘::’. You do not need to enter a size after the address i.e. /128 as that is automatically assumed.

建立一個新的 IPv6 動態主機別名並僅輸入位址的後綴，在本例中，我們將輸入位址的低 64 位，您將輸入 ::1000:1000:0000:1，注意位址開頭的“::”，您MUST始終以“::”開頭位址。您無需在地址後面輸入大小，即 /128，因為這是自動假定的。

Select the interface you wish to use for the source of the upper 64 bits, in this case we will select the LAN interface.

選擇您希望用於高 64 位元來源的接口，在本例中我們將選擇LAN 接口。

When the prefix changes, the alias address will then be updated in the firewall rules, let’s say your prefix changes to 2001:db8:2222:3200::/56 the rule updates and the entry for your server in the firewall would update automatically to be 2001:db8:2222:3200:1000:1000::1

當前綴變更時，別名位址將在防火牆規則中更新，假設您的前綴變更為 2001:db8:2222:3200::/56 規則更新，防火牆中伺服器的項目將自動更新為 2001:db8:2222:3200:1000:1000::1

Let’s take another example, you have a /48 prefix delegation, you have two LAN interfaces and a server on each. You would need to create two separate Dynamic IPv6 Host entries, one for each LAN. For simplicities sake we will use the same address for each server on each interface, you would enter ::aaaa:bbbb:cccc:0001 as the address.

我們再舉個例子，您有一個 /48 前綴委託，有兩個 LAN 接口，每個接口上都有一個伺服器。您需要建立兩個單獨的動態 IPv6 主機條目，每個 LAN 一個。為了簡單起見，我們將為每個介面上的每個伺服器使用相同的位址，您將輸入 ::aaaa:bbbb:cccc:0001 作為位址。

<table>
<tr><th>Upper 64 bits, taken from<br>高64位，取自LAN1 Interface<br>1介面</th><th>Lower 64 bits - Your server address<br>低64位 - 你的伺服器位址</th></tr>
<tr><th>Server 1:<br>伺服器1：2a02:1234:5678:0000</th><th>aaaa:bbbb:cccc:0001</th></tr>
<tr><td colspan="2"><em>Server 1<br>伺服器1GUAaddress is:<br>位址為：2a02:1234:5678:0000:aaaa:bbbb:cccc:0001</em></td></tr>
</table>

<table>
<tr><th>Upper 64 bits, taken from<br>高64位，取自LAN2 Interface<br>2介面</th><th>Lower 64 bits - Your server address<br>低64位 - 你的伺服器位址</th></tr>
<tr><th>Server 2:<br>伺服器2：2a02:1234:5678:0001</th><th>aaaa:bbbb:cccc:0001</th></tr>
<tr><td colspan="2"><em>Server 2<br>伺服器2GUAaddress is:<br>位址為：2a02:1234:5678:0001:aaaa:bbbb:cccc:0001</em></td></tr>
</table>

The prefix changes, in this case we have a /48 prefix, so the new prefix is 2a02:1234:5679/48 our aliases would update to give us the following addresses:

前綴發生變化，在本例中我們有一個 /48 前綴，因此新的前綴是 2a02:1234:5679/48 我們的別名將更新為我們提供以下地址：

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| LAN 1: Server 1 GUA address is:<br>LAN 1：伺服器1 GUA 位址為： | 2a02:1234:5679:0000:aaaa:bbbb:cccc:0001 |
| LAN 2: Server 2 GUA address is:<br>LAN 2：伺服器2 GUA 位址為： | 2a02:1234:5679:0001:aaaa:bbbb:cccc:0001 |

You may enter multiple addresses, for example if you have several servers on the same LAN segment, just add the suffix for each one. In the example below we have three servers.

您可以輸入多個位址，例如，如果您在同一LAN網段上有多個伺服器，只需為每個位址新增後綴即可。在下面的範例中，我們有三台伺服器。

> [![../_images/alias_dynamic_ipv6_host.png](<../images/bc1de689-alias_dynamic_ipv6_host.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/alias_dynamic_ipv6_host.png)

##### BGP ASN

With this alias type you are able to select networks by their responsible parties. Using BGP parties announce the addresses they are responsible for to each other. For example Cloudflare uses AS number `13335`, Microsoft is known to use `8075`.

使用此別名類型，您可以依責任方選擇網路。使用BGP，各方宣布他們彼此負責的地址。例如，Cloudflare 使用 AS 編號 `13335`，已知 Microsoft 使用 `8075`。

More background and how addresses are assigned is explained on [wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Autonomous_system_\(Internet\))

更多背景知識以及如何分配地址在 [wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Autonomous_system_\(Internet\) 上有解釋）

##### External｜外部

The contents for external alias types is not administered via our normal alias service and can be practical in scenarios where you want to push new entries from external programs. Such as specific lockout features or external tools feeding access control to your firewall.

外部別名類型的內容不透過我們的普通別名服務進行管理，並且在您想要從外部程式推送新條目的情況下非常實用。例如特定的鎖定功能或向防火牆提供存取控制的外部工具。

In Firewall ‣ Diagnostics ‣ Aliases you can always inspect the current contents of the external alias and add or remove entries immediately.

在 Firewall ‣ Diagnostics ‣ Aliases 中，您隨時可以檢查外部別名的目前內容並立即新增或刪除條目。

Tip

提示

When changing alias contents which are used on firewall rules with state tracking enabled, you might need to remove the specific state before the new rule turns active. (see Firewall ‣ Diagnostics ‣ States Dump )

當變更啟用狀態追蹤的防火牆規則上使用的別名內容時，您可能需要在新規則變為活動狀態之前刪除特定狀態。 （請參閱防火牆 ‣ 診斷 ‣ 狀態轉儲）

Tip

提示

Since external alias types won’t be touched by OPNsense, you can use `pfctl` directly in scripts to manage its contents. (e.g. `pfctl -t MyAlias -T add 10.0.0.3` to add **10.0.0.3** to **MyAlias**)

由於 OPNsense 不會觸及外部別名類型，因此您可以直接在腳本中使用 `pfctl` 來管理其內容。 （例如 `pfctl -t MyAlias -T add 10.0.0.3` 將 **10.0.0.3**加入到**MyAlias**）

##### OpenVPN group｜OpenVPN群組

This alias type offers the possibility to build firewall policies for logged in OpenVPN users by the group they belong to as configured in System ‣ Access ‣ Groups.

此別名類型提供了根據系統 ‣ 存取 ‣ 群組中配置的所屬群組為登入 OpenVPN 使用者建立防火牆策略的可能性。

The current users that are logged into OpenVPN can be inspected via VPN ‣ OpenVPN ‣ Connection Status, the alias just follows this information and flushes the attached addresses to the item in question.

目前登入 OpenVPN 的使用者可以透過 VPN ‣ OpenVPN ‣ 連線狀態進行檢查，別名只是遵循此資訊並將附加位址刷新到相關項目。

For example, when a user named **fred** which is a member of group **remote\_users** logs into OpenVPN and received a tunnel address of `10.10.10.2`, the alias containing “remote\_users” would include this address as well.

例如，當名為 **fred**的使用者（**remote\_users** 群組的成員）登入 OpenVPN 並收到`10.10.10.2` 的隧道位址時，包含「remote\_users」的別名也會包含此位址。

Note

注意事項

For this mechanism to work, the common-name of the user certificate must match the username exactly, which is the case by default if the certificate has been created from the user manager.

為了使此機制發揮作用，使用者憑證的公用名稱必須與使用者名稱完全匹配，如果憑證是從使用者管理員建立的，則預設情況下就是這種情況。

Tip

提示

When using LDAP (Active directory), you can synchronise group membership to avoid double administration in OPNsense.

使用LDAP（Active Directory）時，您可以同步群組成員資格以避免 OPNsense 中的雙重管理。

##### Internal (automatic)｜內部（自動）

Internal aliases are prefixed with `__` so they are easy to identify and can’t overlap with any user defined ones. These aliases help you to determine what the content is for some internal concepts such as “LAN network”. Using the Firewall->Diagnostics->Aliases menu item you can inspect their contents at any time.

內部別名以`__`為前綴，因此易於識別，並且不能與任何使用者定義的別名重疊。這些別名可協助您確定某些內部概念（例如「LAN網路」）的內容。使用「防火牆」->「診斷」->「別名」選單項，您可以隨時檢查其內容。

#### Using Aliases in Firewall Rules｜在防火牆規則中使用別名

Aliases can be used in firewall rules to ease administration of large lists. For instance we might need a list of remote IP addresses that should have access to certain services, when anything changes we only need to update the list.

可以在防火牆規則中使用別名來簡化大型清單的管理。例如，我們可能需要一個應該有權存取某些服務的遠端IP位址列表，當發生任何變更時，我們只需要更新該列表。

Let’s create a simple alias to allow 3 remote IP addresses access to an ipsec server for a site to site tunnel connection:

讓我們建立一個簡單的別名，以允許 3 個遠端 IP 位址存取 ipsec 伺服器以實現網站到網站隧道連接：

-   192.168.100.1
    
-   192.168.200.2
    
-   192.168.202.2
    

[![../_images/alias_remote_ipsec.png](<../images/44736bc4-alias_remote_ipsec.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/alias_remote_ipsec.png)

We call our list remote\_ipsec and update our firewall rules accordingly.

我們將清單稱為“remote\_ipsec”並相應地更新我們的防火牆規則。

[![../_images/alias_firewall_rules.png](<../images/36283e23-alias_firewall_rules.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/alias_firewall_rules.png)

Note

注意事項

The list icon identifies a rule with an alias.

清單圖示標識帶有別名的規則。

#### Export / Import｜出口/進口

The alias admin page (Firewall ‣ Aliases) contains a download and an upload button in the footer of the table, with this feature you can merge aliases into the configuration and download a `json` formatted list of all aliases in the system.

別名管理頁面（防火牆 ‣ 別名）在表格的頁腳中包含一個下載和上傳按鈕，透過此功能，您可以將別名合併到設定中，並下載系統中所有別名的 `json` 格式清單。

Since data is validated before insertion, it shouldn’t be possible to import defective data (if the import fails, a list of errors is presented).

由於資料在插入之前經過驗證，因此不可能匯入有缺陷的資料（如果匯入失敗，則會顯示錯誤清單）。

Tip

提示

When performing migrations, sometimes its easier to change multiple items at once in a text editor. This feature can easily be used to facilitate that, with limiting risk of a broken configuration (since items are validated equally as single item input would do).

執行遷移時，有時在文字編輯器中一次更改多個項目會更容易。此功能可以輕鬆地用於促進這一點，同時限製配置損壞的風險（因為專案的驗證與單一專案輸入的驗證相同）。

#### Add new entries using our API｜使用我們的 API 新增條目

The endpoints from the alias\_util can easily be used to push new entries into an alias (or remove existing ones). In case of an external alias these items won’t be persistent over reboots, which can be practical in some use-cases (large frequent changing lists for example).

別名\_util 中的端點可輕鬆用於將新條目推送到別名中（或刪除現有條目）。如果使用外部別名，這些項目將不會在重新啟動後保持不變，這在某些用例中非常實用（例如大型頻繁更改的清單）。

The document “[Use the API](#p-370)” contains the steps needed to create an api key and secret, next you can just call the same endpoint the user interface would.

文件「[使用API](#p-370)」包含建立 api 金鑰和秘密所需的步驟，接下來您可以呼叫使用者介面所需的相同端點。

Below you see how to add **10.0.0.2** to an alias named **MyAlias** using an insecure connection (self-signed cert) on the host **opnsense.firewall** with `curl`. The verbose option provides more details about the data exchanged between the two machines.

下面您將看到如何在主機 **opnsense.firewall**上使用 `curl` 使用不安全連線（自簽名憑證）將**10.0.0.2**新增至名為**MyAlias** 的別名。 verbose 選項提供有關兩台電腦之間交換的資料的更多詳細資訊。

```bash
curl \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --basic \
  --user "key:secret" \
  --request POST \
  --insecure \
  --verbose \
  --data  '{"address":"10.0.0.2"}' \
  https://opnsense.firewall/api/firewall/alias_util/add/MyAlias
```

Note

注意事項

Adding aliases using `/api/firewall/alias_util/add/` is only supported for Host, Network and External type aliases

僅主機、網路和外部類型別名支援使用 `/api/firewall/alias_util/add/` 新增別名

#### Exclusions｜排除情況

Pf firewall tables support exceptions (or exclusion) of addresses. This feature can be used in one Alias or in combined (Network group type) Aliases. See ([https://www.freebsd.org/doc/handbook/firewalls-pf.html](https://www.freebsd.org/doc/handbook/firewalls-pf.html) 30.3.2.4).

Pf 防火牆表支援位址例外（或排除）。此功能可在一個別名或組合（網路群組類型）別名中使用。請參閱（[https://www.freebsd.org/doc/handbook/firewalls-pf.html](https://www.freebsd.org/doc/handbook/firewalls-pf.html) 30.3.2.4）。

#### Nesting｜嵌套

For host and network alias types nesting is possibility, this can simplify management a lot since single items can be named properly and grouped into sections for administration.

對於主機和網路別名類型，嵌套是可能的，這可以大大簡化管理，因為可以正確命名單一專案並將其分組到部分中進行管理。

For example, we define 4 servers among 2 critical using different rulesets:

例如，我們使用不同的規則集在 2 個關鍵伺服器中定義 4 個伺服器：

-   server\_a {10.0.1.1}  
    伺服器\_a {10.0.1.1}
    
-   server\_b {10.0.1.2}  
    伺服器\_b {10.0.1.2}
    
-   server\_c {10.0.1.100}  
    伺服器\_c {10.0.1.100}
    
-   server\_d {10.0.1.200}  
    伺服器\_d {10.0.1.200}
    
-   critical\_servers {server\_a , server\_b}  
    關鍵伺服器{伺服器a，伺服器b}
    
-   other\_servers {server\_c , server\_d}  
    其他伺服器 {伺服器\_c , 伺服器\_d}
    
-   servers { critical\_servers , other\_servers}.  
    伺服器{關鍵伺服器，其他伺服器}。
    

The alias `servers` will contain all 4 addresses after configuration.

配置後，別名`servers`將包含所有4個位址。

There is also a possibility to combine different Aliases with Aliases, consisting of exclusions. For example, there is Alias “FireHOL”（火熱） that use extensive externl drop-list and two Aliases that contains subnet and hosts exclusions. It is possible to create Network group (combined) Alias (“FireHOL\_with\_exclusions”):

也可以將不同的別名與別名組合起來，包括排除。例如，有一個別名“FireHOL”（火熱），它使用廣泛的外部下拉列表，以及兩個包含子網路和主機排除的別名。可以建立網路群組（組合）別名（“FireHOL\_with\_exclusions”）：

-   FireHOL {[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/firehol/blocklist-ipsets/master/firehol\_level1.netset](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/firehol/blocklist-ipsets/master/firehol_level1.netset)}
    
-   subnets\_exclusions {!127.0.0.0/8, !0.0.0.0/8}  
    子網\_排除 {!127.0.0.0/8, !0.0.0.0/8}
    
-   hosts\_exclusions {!8.8.8.8}  
    主機\_排除{!8.8.8.8}
    
-   FireHOL\_with\_exclusions {FireHOL, subnets\_exclusions, hosts\_exclusions}  
    FireHOL\_with\_exclusions {FireHOL、子網路\_exclusions、主機\_exclusions}
    

`FireHOL_with_exclusions` Alias will contain all records from FireHOL Alias excluding addresses from exclusions Aliases.

`FireHOL_with_exclusions` 別名將包含 FireHOL 別名中的所有記錄，不包括排除別名中的位址。

It’s always good to check if an address is included in the Alias via Firewall ‣ Diagnostics ‣ pfTable

透過 Firewall ‣ Diagnostics ‣ pfTable 檢查地址是否包含在 Alias 中總是好的

#### Spamhaus｜斯帕姆豪斯

The Spamhaus Don’t Route Or Peer Lists DROP (Don’t Route Or Peer) and DROPv6 are advisory “drop all traffic” lists, consisting of netblocks that are “hijacked” or leased by professional spam or cyber-crime operations (used for dissemination of malware, trojan downloaders, botnet controllers). The DROP and DROPv6 lists are a tiny subset of the SBL, designed for use by firewalls and routing equipment to filter out the malicious traffic from these netblocks.

Spamhaus 不路由或對等列表DROP（不路由或對等）和 DROPv6 是建議性「丟棄所有流量」列表，由專業垃圾郵件或網路犯罪操作「劫持」或租用的網路區塊（用於傳播惡意軟體、木馬下載器、殭屍網路控制器）組成。 DROP 和 DROPv6 清單是 SBL 的一個小子集，設計用於防火牆和路由設備過濾掉來自這些網路區塊的惡意流量。

*Source :* [https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/](https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/)

*來源：* [https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/](https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/)

Downloads

下載

-   [DROP list](https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/drop.txt)  
    [DROP列表](https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/drop.txt)
    
-   [DROPv6 list](https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/dropv6.txt)  
    [刪除v6列表](https://www.spamhaus.org/drop/dropv6.txt)
    

To setup the DROP and DROPv6 lists in combination with the firewall rules, read: [Configure Spamhaus DROP](#p-152)

要結合防火牆規則設定 DROP 和 DROPv6 列表，請閱讀：[配置 Spamhaus DROP](#p-152)

<a id="p-133"></a>

### Categories｜類別

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/firewall_categories.html>

To ease maintenance of larger rulesets, OPNsense includes categories for the firewall. Each rule can contain one or more categories, which can be filtered on top of each firewall rule page.

為了簡化大型規則集的維護，OPNsense 包含防火牆類別。每條規則可以包含一個或多個類別，這些類別可以在每個防火牆規則頁面的頂部進行過濾。

New categories can be created from within the rule or you can use the category editor in Firewall -> Categories to manage them.

可以從規則內建立新類別，也可以使用防火牆 -> 類別中的類別編輯器來管理它們。

There aren’t a lot of properties available on a category, you can optionally set a color and when created from a firewall rule the item can have an “automatic” checkbox, in which case it will be removed automatically when unused.

類別上沒有很多可用的屬性，您可以選擇設定顏色，並且當從防火牆規則建立時，該項目可以有一個「自動」複選框，在這種情況下，它將在不使用時自動刪除。

<a id="p-134"></a>

### [Interface] Groups｜[介面] 群組

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/firewall_groups.html>

#### \[Interface\] Groups｜\[介面\]群組

To simplify rulesets, you can combine interfaces into **Interface Groups** and add policies which will be applied to all interfaces in the group.

為了簡化規則集，您可以將介面組合到**介面組**並新增將套用於群組中所有介面的策略。

Since interface groups are processed before normal interfaces, you should not have issues with overlapping rules in the interface tabs itself. More details about processing order can be found [here](#p-137)

由於介面組是在普通介面之前處理的，因此您不應該遇到介面選項卡本身規則重疊的問題。有關處理訂單的更多詳細信息，請參閱[此處](#p-137)

Note

注意事項

For multiwan setups be careful with groups. Since groups are not bound to a specific interface, they will use the normal routing system to determine the next hop when applied on WAN type interfaces (`reply-to` is not used here).

對於多WAN 設置，請小心群組。由於群組沒有綁定到特定接口，因此當應用於WAN類型接口（此處不使用`reply-to`）時，它們將使用正常的路由系統來確定下一跳。

#### Settings｜設定

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Name<br>名稱 | The technical name of the group. Has some restrictions which also apply to the underlying operating system.<br>該組的技術名稱。有一些限制也適用於底層作業系統。 |
| Description<br>描述 | A user friendly description, informational use only<br>使用者友善的描述，僅供參考 |
| Members<br>會員 | Member interfaces<br>會員介面 |

For a deployment strategy visit [Security Zones](#p-153)

部署策略請造訪[安全區](#p-153)

<a id="c-27"></a>

### Network Address Translation

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-135"></a>

#### Network Address Translation｜網路位址轉換

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/nat.html>

##### [Network Address Translation](#p-135)｜[網路位址轉換](#p-135)

Index

索引

-   [Network Address Translation](#p-135)  
    [網路位址轉換](#p-135)
    
    -   [Some terms explained](#p-135)  
        [部分術語解釋](#p-135)
        
    -   [Destination NAT (Port Forward)](#p-135)  
        [目的地NAT（港口轉送）](#p-135)
        
        -   [Filter rule association](#p-135)  
            [過濾規則關聯](#p-135)
            
    -   [One-to-one](#p-135)  
        [一對一](#p-135)
        
    -   [Source NAT (Outbound)](#p-135)  
        [來源NAT（出站）](#p-135)
        
    -   [NPTv6](#p-135)
        
    -   [How-tos](#p-135)  
        [操作方法](#p-135)
        

Network Address Translation (abbreviated to NAT) is a way to separate external and internal networks (WANs and LANs), and to share an external IP between clients on the internal network. NAT can be used on IPv4 and IPv6.

網路位址轉換（縮寫為NAT）是一種分離外部和內部網路（WAN 和 LAN）並在內部網路上的用戶端之間共用外部IP的方法。 NAT 可在 IPv4 和 IPv6 上使用。

Most of the options below use three different addresses: the source, destination and redirect address. These addresses are used for the following:

下面的大多數選項使用三個不同的位址：來源位址、目標位址和重定向位址。這些地址用於以下用途：

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Source<br>來源 | Where the traffic comes from. This can often be left on “any”.<br>流量從哪裡來。這通常可以保留在“any”上。 |
| Destination<br>目的地 | Where the traffic is headed. For incoming traffic from outside, this is usually your external IP address.<br>交通流向何處。對於來自外部的傳入流量，這通常是您的外部 IP 位址。 |
| Redirect<br>重定向 | Where the traffic should be redirected.<br>流量應該重定向到哪裡。 |

Warning

警告

-   Network Address Translation should not be relied upon as a security measure.  
    不應依賴網路位址轉換作為安全措施。
    
-   Disabling pf will also disable NAT.  
    禁用 pf 也會停用 NAT。
    

##### [Some terms explained](#p-135)｜[部分術語解釋](#p-135)

**BINAT**: NAT generally works in one direction. However, if you have networks of equal size, you can also use BINAT, which is bidirectional. This can simplify your set-up. If you don’t have networks of equal size, you can only use regular NAT.

**BINAT**：NAT一般作用於一個方向。但是，如果您的網路大小相同，您也可以使用BINAT，它是雙向的。這可以簡化您的設定。如果你沒有同等規模的網絡，你只能使用常規的NAT。

**NAT reflection**: When a client on the internal network tries to access another client, but using the *external* IP instead of the internal one (which would the most logical), NAT reflection can rewrite this request so that it uses the internal IP, in order to avoid taking a detour and applying rules meant for actual outside traffic.

**NAT反射**：當內部網路上的客戶端嘗試存取另一個客戶端，但使用*外部*IP而不是內部（這是最合乎邏輯的）時，NAT反射可以重寫此請求，以便它使用內部IP，以避免繞道並應用針對實際外部流量的規則。

Tip

提示

There is a how-to section explaining [NAT Reflection](#p-136) in detail.

有一個操作方法部分詳細解釋了[NAT反射](#p-136)。

Note

注意事項

The NAT rules generated with enabling **NAT reflection** only include networks directly connected to your Firewall. This means if you have a private network separated from your LAN you need to add this with a manual Source NAT (Outbound) rule.

啟用 **NAT 反射** 產生的 NAT 規則僅包含直接連接到您的防火牆的網路。這意味著，如果您有一個與 LAN 分離的專用網絡，則需要使用手動來源 NAT（出站）規則來新增此網路。

**Pool options**: When there are multiple IPs to choose from, this option will allow regulating which IP gets used. The default, Round Robin, will simply distribute packets to one server after the other. If you only have one external IP, this option has no effect.

**池選項**：當有多個 IP 可供選擇時，此選項將允許調整使用哪一個 IP。預設情況下，循環法將簡單地將資料包分發到一台伺服器到另一台伺服器。如果您只有一個外部IP，則此選項無效。

##### [Destination NAT (Port Forward)](#p-135)｜[目的地NAT（港口轉送）](#p-135)

When multiple internal clients share one external IP address, any inbound connection targeting the external IP address will not succeed, since the firewall will not know where to send the traffic. This can be addressed by creating port forwarding rules. For example, for a web server behind the firewall to be accessible, ports 80 and 443 need to be redirected to it.

當多個內部用戶端共用一個外部IP位址時，任何針對外部IP位址的入站連線都不會成功，因為防火牆不知道將流量傳送到哪裡。這可以透過建立連接埠轉送規則來解決。例如，要存取防火牆後面的 Web 伺服器，需要將連接埠 80 和 443 重新導向到該伺服器。

Destination NAT (Port Forward) can be set up by navigating to Firewall ‣ NAT ‣ Destination NAT (Port Forward). Here, you will see an overview of Destination NAT (Port Forward) rules.

可以透過導覽到防火牆‣NAT‣目標NAT（連接埠轉送）來設定目標NAT（連接埠轉送）。在這裡，您將看到目的地NAT（連接埠轉送）規則的概述。

When adding a rule, the following fields are available:

新增規則時，以下欄位可用：

**Organization**

**組織**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Disabled**<br>**已停用** | Disable this rule so it will not be used.<br>停用此規則，使其不會被使用。 |
| **Sequence**<br>**順序** | Rules are evaluated in sequence order.<br>規則依序進行評估。 |
| **Categories**<br>**類別** | Assign categories for rule organization.<br>為規則組織指派類別。 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | Enter a description to identify this rule.<br>輸入描述以標識此規則。 |

**Interface**

**介面**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Interface**<br>**介面** | Choose the interface(s) on which the traffic originates.<br>選擇流量源自的介面。 |
| **Version**<br>**版本** | Select IPv4, IPv6 or both.<br>選擇 IPv4、IPv6 或兩者。 |
| **Protocol**<br>**協議** | Assign categories for rule organization.<br>為規則組織分配類別。 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | Select the protocol this rule should match.<br>選擇此規則應符合的協定。 |

**Source**

**來源**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Invert Source**<br>**反轉來源** | Match everything except the specified source.<br>符合指定來源以外的所有內容。 |
| **Source Address**<br>**來源位址** | Specify the source network or alias to match.<br>指定要符合的來源網路或別名。 |

**Destination**

**目的地**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Invert Destination**<br>**反轉目的地** | Match everything except the specified destination.<br>符合指定目的地以外的所有內容。 |
| **Destination Address**<br>**目的地位址** | Destination address or alias to match.<br>要符合的目標位址或別名。 |
| **Destination Port**<br>**目的港** | Destination port or port range.<br>目標端口或端口範圍。 |

**Translation**

**翻譯**

Tip

提示

This translates the original destination (e.g., the external IP address of the firewall) to a new target (e.g., an internal host).

這會將原始目的地（例如，防火牆的外部IP位址）轉換為新目標（例如，內部主機）。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Redirect Target IP**<br>**重定向目標IP** | The internal IP address to forward traffic to.<br>將流量轉送到的內部IP位址。 |
| **Redirect Target Port**<br>**重定向目標連接埠** | The port on the internal host to forward traffic to.<br>內部主機上要將流量轉送至的連接埠。 |
| **Pool Options**<br>**池選項** | Choose how traffic is distributed when multiple target IPs are used.<br>選擇使用多個目標 IP 時如何指派流量。 |

**Options**

**選項**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **No XMLRPC Sync**<br>**沒有XMLRPC同步** | Exclude this rule from synchronizing to HA peers.<br>將此規則排除在與HA 對等點的同步之外。 |
| **NAT Reflection**<br>**NAT 反思** | Control NAT reflection for this rule.<br>控制此規則的NAT反射。 |
| **Set Tag**<br>**設定標籤** | Assign a tag to packets matching this rule.<br>為符合此規則的封包指派標籤。 |
| **Match Tag**<br>**符合標籤** | Only match packets that have this tag.<br>僅符合具有此標記的資料包。 |
| **Firewall rule**<br>**防火牆規則** | By default, firewall rules need to be created manually, which is also the advised option. Alternatively you can use Pass, which passes traffic on the nat rule (not visible in the rules tab) or generate interface rules which can be overruled via rules with a higher priority. Please keep in mind the destination for the rule should match the target defined in this NAT rule.<br>預設情況下，需要手動建立防火牆規則，這也是建議的選項。或者，您可以使用 Pass，它會在 nat 規則上傳遞流量（在規則標籤中不可見）或產生可以透過具有更高優先權的規則推翻的介面規則。請記住，規則的目標應與此 NAT 規則中定義的目標相符。 |

Note

注意事項

This feature is also used to implement transparent proxies. A connection can to be forwarded to a daemon (listening on localhost), which then tries to get the original destination IP from the /dev/pf device.

此功能也用於實現透明代理。連線可以轉送到守護程式（在本機上偵聽），然後守護程式嘗試從 /dev/pf 裝置取得原始目的地IP。

For example, a transparent proxy that handles HTTP traffic needs a rule that forwards traffic from TCP port 80, IPv4 to 127.0.0.1:3128 (in the default configuration).

例如，處理 HTTP 流量的透明代理需要一條規則，將流量從 TCP 連接埠 80、IPv4 轉送到 127.0.0.1:3128（在預設設定中）。

Attention

注意

You cannot NAT to \[::1\] (the IPv6 localhost) or any other link-local addresses. IPv6 requires routable addresses for NAT, at least an ULA (Unique Local Address) is required as target.

您不能 NAT 到 \[::1\] （IPv6 本機）或任何其他連結本機位址。 IPv6 需要NAT 可路由位址，至少需要一個ULA（唯一本地位址）作為目標。

###### [Filter rule association](#p-135)｜[過濾規則關聯](#p-135)

This option controls the creation of linked filter rules in Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\].

此選項控制在 Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] 中連結過濾規則的建立。

**Manual**

**手冊**

Choose this if you want to create your own Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] manually. No linked filter rule is created.

如果您想手動建立自己的防火牆‣規則\[新\]，請選擇此選項。未建立連結的過濾規則。

Note

注意事項

This option is recommended for more comple setups, like Destination NAT (Port Forward) rules on VPN interfaces. The filter rule can be edited and features like reply-to disabled.

建議更複雜的設定使用此選項，例如 VPN 介面上的目標 NAT（連接埠轉送）規則。可以編輯過濾規則並停用回復等功能。

**Pass**

**透過**

A filter rule will be automatically added and updated. This rule cannot be seen or edited in Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\].

過濾規則將自動新增和更新。在 Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] 中無法檢視或編輯此規則。

Note

注意事項

Recommended choice for most setups.

大多數設定的推薦選擇。

**Register rule**

**註冊規則**

Adds a linked filter rule in Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] that is automatically updated when the NAT rule is updated. The created filter rule cannot be manually edited.

在 Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] 中新增連結的過濾規則，該規則會在 NAT 規則更新時自動更新。建立的過濾規則無法手動編輯。

##### [One-to-one](#p-135)｜[一對一](#p-135)

One-to-one NAT will translate two IPs one-to-one, rather than one-to-many as is most common in other NAT types. In this respect, it is similar to what NPT does for IPv6.

一對一 NAT 會將兩個 IP 一對一轉換，而不是像其他 NAT 類型中最常見的一對多轉換。在這方面，它類似於NPT對IPv6的作用。

One-to-one NAT can be set up by navigating to Firewall ‣ NAT ‣ One-to-one.

一對一 NAT 可透過導覽至防火牆 ‣ NAT ‣ 一對一進行設定。

A BINAT rule specifies a bidirectional mapping between an external and internal network and can be used from both ends, nat only applies in one direction.<br>在這裡選擇BINAT（預設）或NAT，當網路大小相等時，binat通常是最好的選擇。使用NAT我們還可以映射不等大小的網路。 BINAT規則指定外部網路和內部網路之間的雙向映射，並且可以從兩端使用，nat僅適用於一個方向。 |

| --- | --- |

##### [Source NAT (Outbound)](#p-135)｜[來源NAT（出站）](#p-135)

When a client on an internal network makes an outbound request, the gateway will have to change the source IP to the external IP of the gateway, since the outside server will not be able to send an answer back otherwise.

當內部網路上的用戶端發出出站請求時，網關必須將來源IP更改為網關的外部IP，因為否則外部伺服器將無法發送回應。

Source NAT (Outbound), abbreviated to SNAT, can be configured under Firewall ‣ NAT ‣ Source NAT (Outbound).

源NAT（出站），縮寫為SNAT，可在防火牆‣NAT‣源NAT（出站）下配置。

If you only have one external IP, the automatic mode is suitable in most cases. With multiple external addresses, you may want to use hybrid or manual mode and add custom rules.

如果您只有一台外接IP，大多數情況下自動模式就適合。對於多個外部位址，您可能需要使用混合或手動模式並新增自訂規則。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Automatic Source NAT rule generation<br>自動源NAT規則產生 | The default. Follows the behaviour described above, and is suitable for most scenarios.<br>預設。遵循上述行為，適用於大多數場景。 |
| Manual Source NAT rule generation<br>手動源NAT規則生成 | No automatic rules are generated. They can be added manually.<br>不產生自動規則。它們可以手動添加。 |
| Hybrid Source NAT rule generation<br>混合源NAT規則產生 | Automatic rules are generated, and additional manual rules can be added.<br>自動產生規則，並且可以新增其他手動規則。 |
| Disable Source NAT rule generation<br>禁用來源NAT規則產生 | Disables Source NAT. This is used for [transparent bridges](#p-118), for example.<br>禁用來源NAT。例如，這用於[透明橋](#p-118)。 |

##### [NPTv6](#p-135)

Network Prefix Translation, shortened to NPTv6, is used to translate IPv6 addresses. A common usage for this is to translate global (“WAN”（VAN）) IPs to local ones. In this regard, it is similar to NAT, although NPTv6 can only be used to map addresses one-to-one, unlike NAT which typically translates one external IP to several internal ones.

網路前綴轉換，縮寫為 NPTv6，用於轉換 IPv6 位址。常見用法是將全域 (“WAN”（VAN）) IP 轉換為本機 IP。在這方面，它與NAT類似，儘管NPTv6只能用於一對一映射地址，而不像NAT通常將一個外部IP轉換為多個內部地址。

NPTv6 routes are listed at Firewall ‣ NAT ‣ NPTv6.

NPTv6 路由在防火牆 ‣ NAT ‣ NPTv6 中列出。

Leave empty to auto-detect the prefix address using the specified tracking interface instead. The prefix size specified for the internal prefix will also be applied to the external prefix.<br>輸入此網路前綴轉換的外部 IPv6 前綴（目標）。留空以使用指定的追蹤介面自動偵測前綴位址。為內部前綴指定的前綴大小也將套用於外部前綴。 |
| **Track interface**<br>**軌跡介面** | Use prefix defined on the selected interface instead of the interface this rule applies to when target prefix is not provided.<br>當未提供目標前綴時，請使用在所選介面上定義的前綴，而不是套用此規則的介面。 |

**Options**

**選項**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Log**<br>**日誌** | Log packets that are handled by this rule.<br>記錄此規則處理的資料包。 |

###### [Networks used in this How-To section](#p-136)｜[本操作方法部分所使用的網路](#p-136)

| Interface<br>介面 | IPv4 Subnet<br>IPv4 子網路 | Hosts<br>主持人 | Gateway<br>網關 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WAN | `203.0.113.0/24` | `203.0.113.1` - OPNsense | `203.0.113.254` - OPNsense |
| DMZ | `172.16.1.0/24` | `172.16.1.1` - Webserver<br>`172.16.1.1` - 網路伺服器 | `172.16.1.254` - OPNsense |
| LAN | `192.168.1.0/24` | `192.168.1.1` - Client<br>`192.168.1.1` - 客戶 | `192.168.1.254` - OPNsense |

###### [NAT - Quick Overview](#p-136)｜[NAT - 快速概述](#p-136)

Because there are not enough available IPv4 addresses, a workaround called *NAT* (Network Address Translation) was implemented into the IPv4 Standard. It basically enables a router like the OPNsense to translate IPv4 addresses to other IPv4 addresses. Most of the time it is used to translate the limited external IPv4 address space to the shared internal IPv4 address space (RFC 1918, `192.168.0.0/16` - `172.16.0.0/12` - `10.0.0.0/8`) and vice versa.

由於沒有足夠的可用 IPv4 位址，因此 IPv4 標準中實作了一種名為 *NAT*（網路位址轉換）的解決方法。它基本上使 OPNsense 等路由器能夠將 IPv4 位址轉換為其他 IPv4 位址。大多數時候，它用於將有限的外部 IPv4 位址空間轉換為共享的內部 IPv4 位址空間（RFC 1918、`192.168.0.0/16` - `172.16.0.0/12` - `10.0.0.0/8`），反之亦然。

Note

注意事項

SNAT - Source Network Address Translation

SNAT - 來源網路位址轉換

-   Changes the source IP of a packet  
    更改資料包的來源IP
    
-   Firewall –> NAT –> Source NAT (Outbound) using the option *Translate Source IP* in a rule  
    防火牆 –> NAT –> 來源 NAT（出站），使用規則中的選項 *翻譯來源 IP*
    

DNAT - Destination Network Address Translation

DNAT - 目標網路位址轉換

-   Changes the destination IP of a packet  
    更改資料包的目的地IP
    
-   Firewall –> NAT –> Destination NAT (Port Forward) using the option *Redirect target IP* in a rule  
    防火牆 –> NAT –> 目標 NAT（連接埠轉送），使用規則中的選項 *重定向目標 IP*
    

PAT - Port Address Translation

PAT - 埠位址轉換

-   Changes the destination port of a packet  
    更改資料包的目標端口
    
-   Firewall –> NAT –> Destination NAT (Port Forward) using the option *Redirect target port* in a rule  
    防火牆 –> NAT –> 目標 NAT（連接埠轉送）使用規則中的選項 *重定向目標連接埠*
    

If you create a DNAT rule, you enable all clients in the WAN access to an internal IPv4 address. The OPNsense acts like a translator, translating IPv4 addresses between client and server. The OPNsense writes all translations into a file called the NAT table. It knows exactly how traffic should flow back and forth with the translations in place.

如果您建立 DNAT 規則，則允許 WAN 中的所有用戶端存取內部 IPv4 位址。 OPNsense 的作用就像一個轉換器，在客戶端和伺服器之間轉換 IPv4 位址。 OPNsense 將所有翻譯寫入名為 NAT 表的檔案中。它確切地知道流量應如何在翻譯到位後來回流動。

Warning

警告

NAT is not a security feature. It only acts as a translator. If you want security, you need firewall rules in addition.

NAT 不是安全功能。它僅充當翻譯器。如果你想要安全，你還需要防火牆規則。

###### [Introduction to Reflection and Hairpin NAT](#p-136)｜[倒影與髮夾簡介NAT](#p-136)

For example, you have a Webserver `example.com` with the internal IP `172.16.1.1` in your DMZ. It has a public DNS Record of `example.com in A 203.0.113.1`.

例如，您有一個 Web 伺服器 `example.com`，其內部 IP `172.16.1.1` 位於您的 DMZ 中。它有一個公開的DNS記錄`example.com in A 203.0.113.1`。

Your internal client `192.168.1.1` can’t reach the Webserver if it resolves the DNS A-Record `203.0.113.1`. When the OPNsense receives the packet from the client `192.168.1.1` with the destination IP `203.0.113.1`, it chooses **itself** as the target, and **not** `172.16.1.1`. That’s because the external IPv4 address `203.0.113.1` is mapped to the WAN interface of the OPNsense.

您的內部客戶 `192.168.1.1` 如果解決了則無法存取網路伺服器 DNS A記錄 `203.0.113.1`。當 OPNsense 收到客戶端寄來的資料包時 `192.168.1.1` 與目的地 IP `203.0.113.1`，它選擇**自己**作為目標，並且**不** `172.16.1.1`。這是因為外部 IPv4 位址 `203.0.113.1` 被映射到 WAN OPNsense 的介面。

That’s where Reflection NAT comes into play. It creates NAT rules which help your internal client `192.168.1.1` to communicate with your webserver `203.0.113.1`, by using the OPNsense as the “translator” to the actual destination `172.16.1.1`.

這就是反射NAT發揮作用的地方。它創建 NAT 規則，透過使用 OPNsense 作為實際目的地 `172.16.1.1` 的“轉換器”，幫助您的內部客戶端 `192.168.1.1` 與您的網路伺服器 `203.0.113.1` 進行通訊。

Attention

注意

You should choose your preferred Reflection NAT method from the three possible choices presented here. They’re exclusive to each other, picking one method and sticking to it will prevent mistakes.

您應該從此處提供的三種可能的選擇中選擇您首選的 Reflection NAT 方法。它們是互斥的，選擇一種方法並堅持下去可以防止錯誤。

-   [Method 1](#p-136) - Creating **manual** Port-Forward NAT (DNAT), **manual** Source NAT (SNAT), and **automatic** firewall rules  
    [方法 1](#p-136) - 建立**手動**連接埠轉送NAT（DNAT）、**手動**來源NAT（SNAT）和**自動**防火牆規則
    
-   [Method 2](#p-136) - Creating **automatic** Port-Forward NAT (DNAT), **manual** Source NAT (SNAT), and **manual** firewall rules  
    [方法 2](#p-136) - 建立**自動**連接埠轉送NAT（DNAT）、**手動**來源NAT（SNAT）和**手動**防火牆規則
    
-   [Method 3](#p-136) - Creating **automatic** Port-Forward NAT (DNAT), **automatic** Source NAT (SNAT), and **manual** firewall rules  
    [方法 3](#p-136) - 建立**自動**連接埠轉送NAT（DNAT）、**自動**來源NAT（SNAT）和**手動**防火牆規則
    

Note

注意事項

-   **Reflection NAT:** The client and the server are in different subnets (layer 2 broadcast domains) and the OPNsense routes traffic between them. They can’t communicate directly by resolving ARP requests. You only need DNAT.  
    **反思NAT：** 用戶端和伺服器位於不同的子網路（第 2 層廣播域）中，並且 OPNsense 在它們之間路由流量。他們無法透過解析 ARP 請求直接進行通訊。你只需要DNAT。
    
-   **Hairpin NAT:** The client and the server are in the same subnet (layer 2 broadcast domain). They can communicate directly with each other by resolving ARP requests. You need SNAT and DNAT.  
    **髮夾NAT：**客戶端和伺服器在同一子網路（二層廣播網域）。他們可以透過解析 ARP 請求直接相互通訊。您需要SNAT和DNAT。
    

Note

注意事項

When using IPsec, by default NAT only matches on policy based VPN. NAT on VTI (Virtual Tunnel Interfaces) won’t match unless some tunables are set. These tunables change the behavior of firewall filter and NAT on if\_enc and if\_ipsec interfaces. You can read more about the tunables in [IPsec VTI - Route based setup](#p-154)

使用 IPsec 時，預設情況下 NAT 僅與基於策略的 VPN. NAT 匹配，VTI（虛擬隧道介面）不會匹配，除非設定了一些可調參數。這些可調參數變更 if\_enc 和 if\_ipsec 介面上防火牆過濾器和 NAT 的行為。您可以在 [IPsec VTI - 基於路由的設定](#p-154) 中閱讀有關可調參數的更多信息

###### [Best Practice](#p-136)｜[最佳實踐](#p-136)

The best way to do Reflection NAT in the OPNsense is **not** to use the legacy Reflection options in [(Advanced) Settings](#p-146). Creating the NAT rules manually with [Method 1](#p-136) prevents unwanted traffic and makes auditing easy. There will be no hidden rules. All rules will be perfectly visible in the GUI and .xml config exports.

在 OPNsense 中進行反射 NAT 的最佳方法是**不**使用 [（進階）設定](#p-146) 中的舊反射選項。使用[方法 1](#p-136) 手動建立NAT規則可防止不需要的流量並使審核變得容易。不會有任何潛規則。所有規則都將在 GUI 和 .xml 配置導出中完全可見。

###### [Start of the How-To Section:](#p-136)｜[操作方法部分開始：](#p-136)

The goal is to access the Webserver `172.16.1.1` on port `443` with it’s external IP `203.0.113.1` from a client in WAN, LAN and DMZ.

目標是從 WAN, LAN 和 DMZ 中的客戶端透過外部 IP `203.0.113.1` 存取連接埠 `443` 上的 Web 伺服器 `172.16.1.1`。

**[Method 1 - Creating manual Port-Forward NAT (DNAT), manual Source NAT (SNAT), and automatic firewall rules](#p-136)｜[方法 1 - 建立手動連接埠轉送 NAT (DNAT)、手動來源 NAT (SNAT) 和自動防火牆規則](#p-136)**

Go to Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced

前往防火牆 ‣ 設定 ‣ 進階

Disable *Reflection for Destination NAT (Port Forwards)*, *Reflection for 1:1* and *Automatic Source NAT (Outbound) for Reflection*

停用*目的地反射NAT（連接埠轉送）*、*1:1 反射*和*自動來源NAT（出站）反射*

Go to Firewall ‣ NAT ‣ Destination NAT (Port Forward)

前往防火牆 ‣ NAT ‣ 目標NAT（連接埠轉送）

Select **+** to create a new Destination NAT (Port Forward) rule.

選擇 **++** 建立新的目標 NAT（連接埠轉送）規則。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Interface:<br>介面： | Select `WAN`, `DMZ` and `LAN` - Select all interfaces in which clients are that should access the webserver. This will create a linked Firewall rule in Firewall ‣ Rules ‣ Floating which allows the traffic.<br>選擇 `WAN`, `DMZ` 和 `LAN` - 選擇客戶端應存取 Web 伺服器的所有介面。這將在 Firewall ‣ Rules ‣ Floating 中建立允許流量的連結防火牆規則。 |
| Protocol:<br>協議： | Select `TCP`<br>選擇`TCP` |
| Source:<br>來源： | Select `Any`<br>選擇`Any` |
| Source port range:<br>來源埠範圍： | Select `Any`<br>選擇`Any` |
| Destination:<br>目的地: | Input `203.0.113.1` - It’s the external IPv4 address of the webserver.<br>輸入 `203.0.113.1` - 這是網路伺服器的外部 IPv4 位址。 |
| Destination port range:<br>目的連接埠範圍： | Input `443` - Or select the alias `HTTPS`<br>輸入`443` - 或選擇別名`HTTPS` |
| Redirect target IP:<br>重定向目標IP： | Input `172.16.1.1` - It’s the Webserver’s internal IPv4 address in the DMZ.<br>輸入`172.16.1.1` - 這是DMZ中Web伺服器的內部IPv4位址。 |
| Redirect target port:<br>重定向目標埠： | Input `443` - Or select the alias `HTTPS`<br>輸入`443` - 或選擇別名`HTTPS` |
| Description:<br>描述： | Input `Reflection NAT Rule Webserver 443` - Add a description because the linked *Filter rule association* will use that as its name and the Firewall ‣ Rules ‣ Floating rule will have it in the description.<br>輸入 `Reflection NAT Rule Webserver 443` - 新增描述，因為連結的 *過濾器規則關聯* 將使用它作為其名稱，而防火牆 ‣ 規則 ‣ 浮動規則將在描述中包含它。 |
| NAT reflection:<br>NAT 反思： | Use system default<br>使用系統預設 |
| Filter rule association:<br>過濾規則關聯： | Add associated filter rule<br>新增關聯過濾規則 |

Tip

提示

Reading the DNAT rule like a sentence makes it clearer:

像句子一樣閱讀DNAT規則會比較清楚：

If a packet is received by the OPNsense on any of the interfaces `WAN`, `DMZ` and `LAN` with protocol `TCP` from the source IP `ANY` and the source port range `ANY` to destination IP `203.0.113.1` and destination port `443` –> rewrite the destination IP to `172.16.1.1` and the destination port to `443`.

如果 OPNsense 在任何介面上收到封包 `WAN`, `DMZ` 和 `LAN` 有協議 `TCP` 從源頭 IP `ANY` 和來源連接埠範圍 `ANY` 到目的地 IP `203.0.113.1` 和目的港 `443` –> 重寫目的地 IP 到 `172.16.1.1` 以及目的港 `443`.

Note

注意事項

Due to “Add associated filter rule”, the added linked firewall rule in Firewall ‣ Rules ‣ Floating will allow traffic to the destination IP `172.16.1.1` because NAT rules match before Firewall rules. That means the firewall receives the packet and the NAT rule converts the destination from `203.0.113.1` to `172.16.1.1` first, before passing the packet to the firewall filter. You could also set “Filter rule association: Pass”, but then the resulting firewall rule would be invisible.

由於“新增關聯的過濾規則”，在防火牆‣規則‣浮動中新增的連結防火牆規則將允許流量到達目的地IP `172.16.1.1`，因為NAT規則在防火牆規則之前符合。這意味著防火牆接收資料包，並且NAT規則首先將目標從`203.0.113.1`轉換為`172.16.1.1`，然後再將資料包傳遞到防火牆過濾器。您也可以設定“過濾規則關聯：通過”，但產生的防火牆規則將不可見。

Note

注意事項

In some setups (e.g. an external IP address is bound on an additional VPN interface) you need to set “Filter rule association: None” and create your own Firewall rules. One of those firewall rules should match only on the VPN interface, and in “advanced features” of that rule “reply-to” should be your VPN interface. The other firewall rule (without “reply-to”) should match the remaining interfaces.

在某些設定中（例如，外部IP位址綁定在附加VPN介面上），您需要設定「過濾器規則關聯：無」並建立您自己的防火牆規則。這些防火牆規則之一應該僅在VPN接口上匹配，並且在該規則的“高級功能”中，“回复”應該是您的VPN接口。其他防火牆規則（不含「回覆」）應與其餘介面相符。

Attention

注意

Now you have Reflection NAT. The traffic from the internal LAN client `192.168.1.1` and any WAN client reaches the Webserver. But there is a caveat - any DMZ client and the Webserver itself are still unable reach the external IP `203.0.113.1`. For that you need Hairpin NAT, which involves an additional SNAT rule.

現在你有反射了NAT。來自內部LAN客戶端`192.168.1.1`和任何WAN客戶端的流量到達Web伺服器。但有一個警告 - 任何 DMZ 用戶端和 Web 伺服器本身仍然無法到達外部 IP `203.0.113.1`。為此，您需要髮夾NAT，其中涉及額外的SNAT規則。

Go to Firewall ‣ NAT ‣ Source NAT (Outbound)

轉到防火牆 ‣ NAT ‣ 源 NAT（出站）

Select *Hybrid Source NAT rule generation* and save. That way you can have manual Source NAT rules in conjunction with automatic IP-Masquerading rules. You could also choose *Manual Source NAT rule generation*. Please make sure that you create your own IP-Masquerading rules with manual Source NAT enabled.

選擇*混合來源NAT規則產生*並儲存。這樣，您就可以將手動來源 NAT 規則與自動 IP 偽裝規則結合。您也可以選擇*手動來源NAT規則產生*。請確保您建立自己的IP-偽裝規則並啟用手動來源NAT。

Select **+** to create a new Source NAT rule.

選擇 **++** 建立新的來源 NAT 規則。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Interface: | Select `DMZ` - It’s the interface of the subnet the Webserver is in. |

|介面： |選擇 `DMZ` - 它是網路伺服器所在子網路的介面。
| Protocol:<br>協議： | Select `TCP`<br>選擇`TCP` |
| Source Address:<br>原始碼位址： | Select `DMZ net` - It’s the alias for the DMZ Network `172.16.1.0/24`<br>選擇`DMZ net` - 這是DMZ網路`172.16.1.0/24`的別名 |
| Source Port:<br>來源埠： | Select `Any`<br>選擇`Any` |
| Destination Address:<br>目的地位址： | Input `172.16.1.1` - It’s the Webserver’s internal IPv4 address in the DMZ.<br>輸入`172.16.1.1` - 這是DMZ中Web伺服器的內部IPv4位址。 |
| Destination Port:<br>目的港： | Input `443` - Or select the alias `HTTPS`<br>輸入`443` - 或選擇別名`HTTPS` |
| Translation/target:<br>翻譯/目標： | Select `DMZ address` - It’s the alias for the OPNsense Interface IPv4 address `172.16.1.254` in the DMZ Network.<br>選擇 `DMZ address` - 它是 DMZ 網路中 OPNsense 介面 IPv4 位址 `172.16.1.254` 的別名。 |
| Description:<br>描述： | Input `Hairpin NAT Rule Webserver 443`<br>輸入`Hairpin NAT Rule Webserver 443` |

Tip

提示

Reading the SNAT rule like a sentence makes it clearer:

像句子一樣閱讀SNAT規則會比較清楚：

If a packet is received by the OPNsense on the interface `DMZ` with protocol `TCP` from the source net `172.16.1.0/24` and the source port `ANY` to destination IP `172.16.1.1` and destination port `443` –> rewrite the source ip to `172.16.1.254` and answer from the OPNsense `DMZ` interface.

如果介面上的 OPNsense 收到封包 `DMZ` 有協議 `TCP` 來自來源網 `172.16.1.0/24` 和來源埠 `ANY` 到目的地 IP `172.16.1.1` 和目的港 `443` –> 將來源ip重寫為 `172.16.1.254` 以及 OPNsense 的回答 `DMZ` 介面。

Note

注意事項

Now all DMZ clients (and the Webserver itself) can reach the Webserver with its external IP.

現在所有DMZ客戶端（以及Web伺服器本身）都可以透過其外部IP到達Web伺服器。

-   You need this additional SNAT rule to avoid asymmetrical traffic between clients and servers in the same layer 2 broadcast domain. TCP traffic won’t work otherwise.  
    您需要這個額外的 SNAT 規則來避免同一第 2 層廣播網域中的用戶端和伺服器之間的不對稱流量。 TCP 否則交通將無法運作。
    

Repeat [Method 1](#p-136) until all additional servers are reachable.

重複[方法1](#p-136)，直到所有其他伺服器均可存取。

If you encounter any issues, check [Troubleshooting NAT Rules](#p-136) for a few tips.

如果您遇到任何問題，請查看[疑難排解NAT規則](#p-136)以獲得一些提示。

Warning

警告

The following methods are not advised, but are still explained in order to prevent misconfigurations. There is more information in [(Advanced) Settings](#p-146).

不建議使用以下方法，但仍會進行解釋，以防止配置錯誤。更多資訊請參閱[（進階）設定](#p-146)。

依照[方法 1 - 目標 NAT（連接埠轉送）](#p-136) 中的方式建立 NAT 規則，但變更下列內容：

###### [One-to-One NAT Reflection](#p-136)｜[一對一NAT反思](#p-136)

When Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced *Reflection for 1:1* is activated, automatic Reflection NAT rules for all One-to-One NAT rules are generated.

當防火牆 ‣ 設定 ‣ 進階 *1:1 反射* 啟動時，會產生所有一對一 NAT 規則的自動反射 NAT 規則。

If you want to create manual Reflection and Hairpin NAT rules, leave *Reflection for 1:1* disabled and follow the steps in [Method 1](#p-136). The only change is not adding the WAN interface to the Destination NAT (Port Forward) rules you create. The resulting Destination NAT (Port Forward) and Source NAT rules are **in addition** to the existing One-to-One NAT rules.

如果要建立手動反射和髮夾NAT規則，請停用*Reflection for 1:1*並依照[方法1](#p-136)中的步驟操作。唯一的變更是未將 WAN 介面新增至您建立的目標 NAT（連接埠轉送）規則。產生的目標 NAT（連接埠轉送）和來源 NAT 規則是現有一對一 NAT 規則的**補充**。

If your Destination NAT (Port Forward) rule has 1 interface selected (e.g. LAN), the resulting *Filter rule association: Add associated filter rule* will appear in Firewall ‣ Rules ‣ LAN. If you have more than 1 interface selected, it will appear in Firewall –> Rules –> Floating.

如果您的目標NAT（連接埠轉送）規則選擇了 1 個介面（例如LAN），則產生的*過濾器規則關聯：新增關聯的過濾器規則*將出現在防火牆‣規則‣LAN中。如果您選擇了 1 個以上的接口，它將出現在防火牆 –> 規則 –> 浮動中。

    在客戶端、opnsense、服務端使用tcpdump，測試設備之間流量來回是否無誤。尋找 TCP SYN 和 SYN ACK。如果只有SYN，則連線未建立，且您的規則有錯誤。

#### [Overview](#p-137)｜[概述](#p-137)

OPNsense contains a stateful packet filter, which can be used to restrict or allow traffic from and/or to specific networks as well as influence how traffic should be forwarded (see also policy based routing in “[Multi WAN](#p-095)”).

OPNsense 包含一個狀態資料包過濾器，可用於限製或允許來自和/或流向特定網路的流量，以及影響流量的轉送方式（請同時參閱「[Multi WAN](#p-095)」中基於策略的路由）。

The rules section shows all policies that apply on your network, grouped by interface.

規則部分顯示適用於您的網路的所有策略，並按介面分組。

There are two implementations to choose from:

有兩種實現方式可供選擇：

-   **Rules \[new\]**: a modern MVC implementation with API support and improved rule management  
    **規則\[新\]**：具有API支持和改進的規則管理的現代MVC實施
    
-   **Rules**: a static PHP page with no API support  
    **規則**：靜態 PHP 頁面，不支援 API
    

Tip

提示

**Rules \[new\]** will replace **Rules** over time, you can already migrate your existing rules with a helper in Firewall ‣ Rules ‣ Migration assistant.

**規則\[新\]**將隨著時間的推移取代**規則**，您已經可以使用防火牆 ‣ 規則 ‣ 遷移助手中的幫助程序遷移現有規則。

#### [The basics](#p-137)｜[基礎](#p-137)

Before creating rules, it’s good to know about some basics which apply to all rules.

在創建規則之前，最好先了解一些適用於所有規則的基礎知識。

##### [States](#p-137)｜[狀態](#p-137)

By default rules are set to stateful (you can change this, but it has consequences), which means that the state of a connection is saved into a local dictionary which will be resolved when the next packet comes in. The consequence of this is that when a state exists, the firewall doesn’t need to process all its rules again to determine the action to apply, which has huge performance advantages.

預設情況下，規則設定為有狀態（您可以更改它，但會產生後果），這表示連接的狀態已儲存到本機字典中，該字典將在下一個資料包進入時解析。這樣做的結果是，當狀態存在時，防火牆不需要再次處理其所有規則來確定要應用的操作，這具有巨大的效能優勢。

Another advantage of stateful packet filtering is that you only need to allow traffic in one direction to automatically allow related packets for the same flow back in. Below diagram shows a tcp connection from a client to a server for https traffic, when not using stateful rules, both the client should be permitted to send traffic to the server at port 443 as the server back to the client (usually a port >=1024).

有狀態資料包過濾的另一個優點是，您只需要允許一個方向的流量，即可自動允許同一流的相關資料包返回。下圖顯示了從客戶端到伺服器的 https 流量的 tcp 連接，當不使用有狀態規則時，應允許客戶端在連接埠 443 上將流量傳送到伺服器，而伺服器則返回客戶端（通常是連接埠 >=1024）。

![](<../images/1f4ad8bd-blockdiag-dea26ad7c72648ab145bcbdc066abb.png>)

The use of states can also improve security particularly in case of tcp type traffic, since packet sequence numbers and timestamps are also checked in order to pass traffic, it’s much harder to spoof traffic.

使用狀態還可以提高安全性，特別是在 TCP 類型流量的情況下，因為也會檢查封包序號和時間戳以便傳遞流量，因此欺騙流量要困難得多。

Note

注意事項

When changing rules, sometimes its necessary to reset states to assure the new policies are used for existing traffic. You can do this in Firewall ‣ Diagnostics ‣ States.

變更規則時，有時需要重設狀態以確保新策略用於現有流量。您可以在防火牆 ‣ 診斷 ‣ 狀態中執行此操作。

Note

注意事項

In order to keep states, the system need to reserve memory. By default 10% of the system memory is reserved for states, this can be configured in Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Firewall Maximum States. (The help text shows the default number of states on your platform)

為了保持狀態，系統需要預留記憶體。預設情況下，系統記憶體的 10% 保留用於狀態，這可以在 Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Firewall Maximum States 中配置。 （幫助文字顯示您平台上的預設狀態數）

States can also be quite convenient to find the active top users on your firewall at any time, we added an easy to use “session” browser for this purpose. You can find it under Firewall ‣ Diagnostics ‣ Sessions.

狀態也可以非常方便地隨時找到防火牆上的活躍頂級用戶，我們為此添加了一個易於使用的「會話」瀏覽器。您可以在防火牆 ‣ 診斷 ‣ 會話下找到它。

Tip

提示

States also play an important rule into protecting services against (distributed) denial of service attacks (DDOS). Relevant topics available in our documentation are “synproxy” states, connection limits and [syncookies](#p-146)

各国还在保护服务免受（分布式）拒绝服务攻击方面发挥着重要作用（DDOS）。我們文件中提供的相關主題包括「synproxy」狀態、連線限制和 [syncookies](#p-146)

##### [Action](#p-137)｜[行動](#p-137)

Rules can be set to three different action types:

規則可以設定為三種不同的操作類型：

-   Pass –> allow traffic  
    通過 –> 允許交通
    
-   Block –> deny traffic and don’t let the client know it has been dropped (which is usually advisable for untrusted networks)  
    阻止 –> 拒絕流量，並且不要讓客戶端知道它已被丟棄（這對於不受信任的網路通常是可取的）
    
-   Reject –> deny traffic and let the client know about it. (only tcp and udp support rejecting packets, which in case of TCP means a `RST` is returned, for UDP `ICMP UNREACHABLE` is returned).  
    拒絕 –> 拒絕流量並讓客戶端知道。 （只有tcp和udp支持拒绝数据包，在TCP的情况下意味着返回`RST`，对于UDP `ICMP UNREACHABLE`则返回）。
    

For internal networks it can be practical to use reject, so the client does not have to wait for a time-out when access is not allowed. When receiving packets from untrusted networks, you usually don’t want to communicate back if traffic is not allowed.

對於內部網絡，使用拒絕是可行的，因此客戶端不必在不允許存取時等待逾時。當從不受信任的網路接收資料包時，如果流量不允許，您通常不希望進行回應。

##### [Processing order](#p-137)｜[加工訂單](#p-137)

Firewall rules are processed in sequence per section, first evaluating the **Floating** rules section followed by all rules which belong to **interface groups** and finally all **interface** rules.

防火牆規則按每個部分的順序進行處理，首先評估**浮動**規則部分，然後評估屬於**介面組**的所有規則，最後評估所有**介面**規則。

Internal (automatic) rules are usually registered first.

內部（自動）規則通常首先註冊。

![](<../images/21c7e41a-blockdiag-ec0d5aaf9b949b5a5e296533bff3fe.png>)

Rules can either be set to `quick` or not set to quick, the default is to use quick. When set to quick, the rule is handled on “first match” basis, which means that the first rule matching the packet will take precedence over rules following in sequence.

規則可以設定為`quick`，也可以不設定為quick，預設使用quick。當設定為快速時，規則將根據「第一個匹配」進行處理，這意味著與封包匹配的第一個規則將優先於按順序跟隨的規則。

When `quick` is not set, last match wins. This can be useful for rules which define standard behaviour. Our default deny rule uses this property for example (if no rule applies, drop traffic).

當`quick`未設定時，最後一場比賽獲勝。這對於定義標準行為的規則很有用。例如，我們的預設拒絕規則使用此屬性（如果沒有規則適用，則丟棄流量）。

Note

注意事項

Internally rules are registered using a priority, floating uses `200000`, groups use `300000` and interface rules land on `400000` combined with the order in which they appear. Automatic rules are usually registered at a higher priority (lower number).

內部規則使用優先權註冊，浮動使用`200000`，群組使用`300000`，介面規則結合它們出現的順序落在`400000`上。自動規則通常以較高的優先順序（較低的數字）註冊。

Warning

警告

**NAT rules are always processed before filter rules!** So for example, if you define a [NAT : Destination NAT (Port Forwarding) rules](#p-135) *without a associated rule*, i.e. **Filter rule association** set to **Pass**, this has the consequence, that no other rules will apply!

**NAT 規則始終在過濾器規則之前處理！** 因此，例如，如果您定義 [NAT ：目的地 NAT（連接埠轉送）規則](#p-135) *沒有關聯規則*，即 **過濾器規則關聯**設定為**透過**，則結果是，不會套用其他規則！

Tip

提示

The interface should show all rules that are used, when in doubt, you can always inspect the raw output of the ruleset in `/tmp/rules.debug`

介面應該顯示所有使用的規則，當有疑問時，您可以隨時檢查`/tmp/rules.debug`中規則集的原始輸出

Since Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] and Firewall ‣ Rules implementations exist side by side, there are some additional considerations regarding the processing order of rules.

由於 Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] 和 Firewall ‣ Rules 實作並存，因此需要一些關於規則處理順序的額外注意事項。

If a Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] filter rule has:

如果 Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] 過濾規則具有：

> -   a single interface defined, it is an **Interface Rule**  
      定義的單一接口，它是一個**接口規則**
>     
> -   a group interface defined, it is a **Group Rule**  
      定義的群組接口，它是**組規則**
>     
> -   any number of interfaces or one inverted interface defined, it is a **Floating Rule**  
      定義任意數量的接口或一個反向接口，它是一個**浮動規則**
>     

Processing order:

加工順序：

> 1.  System defined rules at the beginning of the ruleset  
      系統定義的規則位於規則集的開頭
>     
> 2.  Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] and Firewall ‣ Rules floating rules  
      防火牆 ‣ 規則 \[新\] 和 防火牆 ‣ 規則浮動規則
>     
> 3.  Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] and Firewall ‣ Rules group rules  
      防火牆 ‣ 規則\[新\] 與防火牆 ‣ 規則群組規則
>     
> 4.  Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] single interface rules  
      防火牆 ‣ 規則\[新\]單一介面規則
>     
> 5.  Firewall ‣ Rules single interface rules  
      防火牆 ‣ 規則單一介面規則
>     
> 6.  System defined rules at the end of the ruleset  
      系統定義的規則位於規則集末尾
>     

##### [Rule sequence](#p-137)｜[規則順序](#p-137)

The sequence in which the rules are displayed and processed can be customized per section:

規則顯示和處理的順序可以按部分自訂：

-   Select a rule with the checkbox on the left side of the rule.  
    透過規則左側的複選框選擇規則。
    
-   Use the arrow button in the action menu on the right side of a rule in order to move selected rules before the rule where the action button is pressed.  
    使用規則右側操作選單中的箭頭按鈕可以將所選規則移至按下操作按鈕的規則之前。
    

While rules in Firewall ‣ Rules are processed implicitly by the order they appear in the configuration file, Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] implement a more explicit **Sort order**.

雖然 Firewall ‣ Rules 中的規則按照它們在設定檔中出現的順序隱式處理，但 Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] 實作了更明確的 **排序順序**。

A **Sort order** will have this structure: `200000.0000250`:

**排序順序**將具有以下結構：`200000.0000250`：

> -   `200000` The **Priority group**, defines the hierarchy the rule belongs to. It can be influenced by the interface in a rule.  
      `200000` **優先權群組**，定義規則所屬的層次結構。它可能會受到規則中介面的影響。
>     
> -   `.0000250` The **Sequence**, it defines the exact spot of the rule in context of the interface hierarchy. It can be influenced with the Sequence field inside a rule, or with the Move rule before this rule button.  
      `.0000250` **序列**，它定義了介面層次結構上下文中規則的確切位置。它可以透過規則內的序列欄位或在此規則之前的移動規則按鈕來影響。
>     

As example, we create a few different rules:

例如，我們建立一些不同的規則：

> -   `200000.0000100` (Floating rule)  
      `200000.0000100`（浮動規則）
>     
> -   `200000.0000200` (Floating rule)  
      `200000.0000200`（浮動規則）
>     
> -   `300000.0000050` (Group rule)  
      `300000.0000050`（團體規則）
>     
> -   `300000.0000060` (Group rule)  
      `300000.0000060`（團體規則）
>     
> -   `400000.0002000` (Interface rule)  
      `400000.0002000`（接口規則）
>     
> -   `400000.0003100` (Interface rule)  
      `400000.0003100`（接口規則）
>     

When applying the filter, the rules will be processed in this **Sort order**. A lower sequence number inside the priority group means the priority is higher.

套用篩選器時，規則將按此**排序順序**進行處理。優先級組內的序號越低意味著優先順序越高。

Note

注意事項

The Sequence does not have to be unique, multiple rules can share the same number. Though what this means is that the filter is not populated as strictly in order as if all rules have a unique sequence.

序列不必是唯一的，多個規則可以共用相同的編號。但這意味著過濾器的填充順序並不嚴格，就好像所有規則都有唯一的序列一樣。

Tip

提示

When adding a new rule, the Sequence will be automatically populated with a unique number. You can either change this number manually to adjust the exact position of the rule, or use the Move rule before this rule button.

新增規則時，序列將自動填入唯一的編號。您可以手動變更此數字以調整規則的確切位置，或使用「在此規則之前移動規則」按鈕。

##### [Direction](#p-137)｜[方向](#p-137)

![](<../images/30557c9a-blockdiag-8fa8f9da13994845cc6c78c64c7b85.png>)

Traffic can be matched on `in[coming]` or `out[going]` direction, our default is to filter on incoming direction. In which case you would set the policy on the interface where the traffic originates from.

流量可以在`in[coming]`或`out[going]`方向進行匹配，我們預設是在傳入方向上進行過濾。在這種情況下，您可以在流量源自的介面上設定策略。

For example, if you want to allow `https` traffic coming from any host on the internet, you would usually set a policy on the WAN interface allowing port `443` to the host in question.

例如，如果您想要允許來自互聯網上任何主機的 `https` 流量，您通常會在 WAN 介面上設定策略，允許連接埠 `443` 到達相關主機。

Note

注意事項

Traffic leaving the firewall is accepted by default (using a non-quick rule), when **Disable force gateway** in Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced is not checked, the connected gateway would be enforced as well.

預設接受離開防火牆的流量（使用非快速規則），當未選取「防火牆 ‣ 設定 ‣ 進階」中的**停用強制網關**時，也會強制執行連線的閘道。

#### [Implementations](#p-137)｜[實作](#p-137)

##### [Rules \[new\]](#p-137)｜[規則\[新\]](#p-137)

*Rules \[new\]* started out as *Firewall Automation* with a limited GUI to offer API support, since the static php implementation of *Rules* lacked automation requirements. Over time, more features have been added, and the GUI has been completely reworked. Long requested features like advanced search functionality, category folders improved performance and better visibility are the result.

*規則\[新\]*最初是作為*防火牆自動化*，具有有限的GUI來提供API支持，因為*規則*的靜態php實現缺乏自動化要求。隨著時間的推移，更多的功能被添加，GUI 也被徹底重新設計。其結果是高級搜尋功能、類別資料夾、改進的效能和更好的可見性等長期需求的功能。

You can find it in Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] or Firewall ‣ Automation ‣ Filter.

您可以在 Firewall ‣ Rules \[new\] 或 Firewall ‣ Automation ‣ Filter 中找到它。

###### [User Interface](#p-137)｜[使用者介面](#p-137)

Our overview shows all the rules that apply to the selected interface, group or floating section. For every rule, some details are provided and when applicable you can perform actions such as move, edit, copy, delete.

我們的概述顯示了適用於所選介面、群組或浮動部分的所有規則。對於每條規則，都提供了一些詳細信息，並且在適用時您可以執行移動、編輯、複製、刪除等操作。

API access is described in more detail in the [firewall](#p-276) API reference manual.

API 訪問在[防火牆](#p-276) API 參考手冊中有更詳細的描述。

[![../_images/firewall_rules_1.png](<../images/06de146a-firewall_rules_1.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/firewall_rules_1.png)

**[Interface filter](#p-137)｜[介面濾鏡](#p-137)**

Choose an interface to filter the current view. Floating, group and single interfaces can be selected.

選擇一個介面來過濾目前視圖。可以選擇浮動、分組和單一介面。

If you choose the “LAN”（和） interface, you will be presented with all floating, group and single interface rules that influence packet decisions of the LAN interface.

如果您選擇“LAN”（和）接口，您將看到影響LAN介面封包決策的所有浮動、群組和單一介面規則。

If you create a new rule while having an interface selected, it will be automatically added to dialog.

如果您在選擇介面時建立新規則，它將自動新增到對話方塊中。

**[Categories filter](#p-137)｜[類別篩選](#p-137)**

Choose one or multiple categories to filter the current view. This combines with the selection of the interface filter.

選擇一個或多個類別來篩選目前視圖。這與介面濾波器的選擇相結合。

Categories can be created in Firewall ‣ Categories and can enable grouping different logic constructs.

可以在 Firewall ‣ Categories 中建立類別，並且可以將不同的邏輯結構分組。

If you create a category for mailservers and tag rules with it, you can simply filter for this tag and only see your mailservers. As with the interface filter, selecting one or multiple tags will add them automatically to a new rule.

如果您為郵件伺服器建立類別並使用它標記規則，則可以簡單地過濾此標記並僅查看您的郵件伺服器。與介面過濾器一樣，選擇一個或多個標籤會將它們自動新增到新規則中。

**[Tree button](#p-137)｜[樹按鈕](#p-137)**

Group all firewall rules in a tree, based on their category. The groups act like folders, but always honor the sort order and sequence. The group folders are not saved inside the configuration, they are an alternative view based on categories.

根據類別將所有防火牆規則分組到樹中。這些組的作用類似於資料夾，但始終遵循排序順序和順序。群組資料夾不保存在配置中，它們是基於類別的替代視圖。

Whenever a rule in sequence changes category, a new folder copying the category of the first rule will be created. To move similiar rules into the same folder, change their sequence and category. But keep in mind that the sequence of rules will always be the same as without the tree view.

每當序列中的規則變更類別時，都會建立一個複製第一條規則的類別的新資料夾。若要將類似規則移至同一資料夾中，請變更其順序和類別。但請記住，規則的順序始終與沒有樹視圖時相同。

**[Inspect button](#p-137)｜[檢查按鈕](#p-137)**

The inspect button will reveal all system defined (automatic) firewall rules and show rule statistics. It can be enabled at any time to get a complete view of the current active ruleset.

檢查按鈕將顯示所有系統定義的（自動）防火牆規則並顯示規則統計資料。可以隨時啟用它以獲得當前活動規則集的完整視圖。

While in inspect mode the search can find IP addresses inside aliases.

在檢查模式下，搜尋可以找到別名內的 IP 位址。

Rule statistics are cached. To pull the latest statistics, press the refresh button in the statistics column.

規則統計資訊被快取。若要提取最新的統計數據，請按下統計資料列中的刷新按鈕。
