If the rule times out the states will be removed and the rule will be skipped. This means, if there is still a matching rule after the scheduled rule that allows the traffic, it will be used instead. Keep this in mind when using scheduled rules, and carefully build the ruleset around them, e.g., with additional block rules.<br>規則也可以安排在特定日期或時間範圍內激活，您可以在防火牆 ‣ 高級 ‣ 計劃中建立計劃並在規則中選擇一個。如果規則逾時，狀態將被刪除，並且規則將被跳過。這意味著，如果在允許流量的預定規則之後仍然存在符合規則，則將使用它。使用計劃規則時請記住這一點，並圍繞它們仔細建立規則集，例如使用附加的阻止規則。 |

**Stateful firewall**

**狀態防火牆**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **State type**<br>**狀態類型** | State tracking mechanism to use, default is full stateful tracking, sloppy ignores sequence numbers, use none for stateless rules.<br>要使用的狀態追蹤機制，預設是完整的狀態跟踪，馬虎會忽略序號，對於無狀態規則使用ne。 |
| **State policy**<br>**國家政策** | Choose how states created by this rule are treated, default (as defined in advanced), floating in which case states are valid on all interfaces or interface bound. Interface bound states are more secure, floating more flexible.<br>選擇如何處理此規則創建的狀態，預設（如高級定義），浮動，在這種情況下狀態在所有介面或介面綁定上都有效。介面綁定狀態更安全，浮動更靈活。 |
| **NO pfsync** | This prevents states created by this rule to be synced with pfsync.<br>這會阻止此規則建立的狀態與 pfsync 同步。 |
| **TCP established**<br>**TCP成立** | State Timeout in seconds (TCP only)<br>狀態超時以秒為單位（僅限TCP） |
| **UDP first**<br>**UDP第一** | The state timeout in seconds after the first UDP packet.<br>第一個 UDP 封包後的狀態逾時（以秒為單位）。 |
| **UDP single**<br>**UDP單** | The state timeout in seconds if both hosts have sent UDP packets.<br>如果兩台主機都發送了 UDP 封包，則狀態逾時（以秒為單位）。 |
| **UDP multiple**<br>**UDP 多個** | The state timeout in seconds if the source host sends more than one UDP packet but the destination host has never sent one back.<br>如果來源主機發送多個UDP封包但目標主機從未傳回一個封包，則狀態逾時（以秒為單位）。 |
| **Adaptive Timeouts \[start\]**<br>**自適應逾時\[開始\]** | When the number of state entries exceeds this value, adaptive scaling begins. All timeout values are scaled linearly with factor (adaptive.end - number of states) / (adaptive.end - adaptive.start).<br>當狀態條目數超過此值時，自適應縮放開始。所有超時值均隨因子 (adaptive.end - 狀態數) / (adaptive.end - adjustment.start) 線性縮放。 |
| **Adaptive Timeouts \[end\]**<br>**自適應逾時\[結束\]** | When reaching this number of state entries, all timeout values become zero, effectively purging all state entries immediately. This value is used to define the scale factor, it should not actually be reached (set a lower state limit).<br>當達到這個狀態條目數時，所有逾時值都會變為零，從而立即有效地清除所有狀態條目。該值用於定義比例因子，實際上不應達到該值（設定狀態下限）。 |
| **Max states**<br>**最大狀態** | Limits the number of concurrent states the rule may create. When this limit is reached, further packets that would create state are dropped until existing states time out.<br>限制規則可以建立的並發狀態的數量。當達到此限制時，將丟棄更多已建立狀態的資料包，直到現有狀態逾時。 |
| **Max source nodes**<br>**最大來源節點** | Limits the maximum number of source addresses which can simultaneously have state table entries.<br>限制可以同時擁有狀態表條目的來源位址的最大數量。 |
| **Max source states**<br>**最大來源狀態** | Limits the maximum number of simultaneous state entries that a single source address can create with this rule.<br>限制單一來源位址可以使用此規則建立的同時狀態條目的最大數量。 |
| **Max source connections**<br>**最大來源連線數** | Limit the maximum number of simultaneous TCP connections which have completed the 3-way handshake that a single host can make.<br>限制單一主機可以完成 3 次握手的同時TCP 連接的最大數量。 |
| **Max new connections \[c\]**<br>**最大新連線數\[c\]** | Maximum new connections per host, measured over time.<br>隨著時間的推移測量的每台主機的最大新連線數。 |
| **Max new connections \[s\]**<br>**最大新連線\[s\]** | Time interval (seconds) to measure the number of connections<br>測量連線數的時間間隔（秒） |
| **Overload table**<br>**過載表** | Overload table used when max new connections per time interval has been reached. The default virusprot table comes with a default block rule in floating rules, alternatively specify your own table here.<br>當達到每個時間間隔的最大新連線數時使用過載表。預設的virusprot表在浮動規則中帶有預設的阻止規則，或在此處指定您自己的表。 |

| **Traffic shaper \[reverse\]**<br>**流量塑造者\[反向\]** | Shape packets using the selected pipe or queue in the reverse rule direction.<br>使用選定的管道或佇列以相反的規則方向對封包進行整形。 |

A specific gateway may be chosen as well here. This setting is only relevant in the context of a state, for stateless rules there is no defined opposite direction.<br>確定封包如何沿相反方向路由回去（回覆），當設定為預設值時，WAN類型介面上的封包回復到該介面上連接的閘道（除非全域停用）。這裡也可以選擇特定網關。此設定僅在狀態上下文中相關，對於無狀態規則，沒有定義的相反方向。 |

| **Set priority**<br>**設定優先權** | Packets matching this rule will be assigned a specific queueing priority. If the packet is transmitted on a vlan(4) interface, the queueing priority will be written as the priority code point in the 802.1Q VLAN header<br>符合此規則的封包將會被指派特定的排隊優先權。如果封包在 vlan(4) 介面上傳輸，排隊優先權將作為優先權代碼點寫入 802.1Q VLAN 標頭 |
| **Set priority \[low-delay\]**<br>**設定優先權\[低延遲\]** | Used in combination with set priority, packets which have a TOS of lowdelay and TCP ACKs with no data payload will be assigned this priority when offered.<br>與設定優先權結合使用，具有低延遲的 TOS 和沒有資料負載的 TCP ACK 的封包在提供時將被指派此優先權。 |
| **Match TOS / DSCP**<br>**匹配TOS / DSCP** | Only match packets which have the given TOS/DSCP marker.<br>僅匹配具有給定 TOS/DSCP 標記的資料包。 |

**Internal tagging**

**內部標記**

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Set local tag**<br>**設定本機標籤** | Packets matching this rule will be tagged with the specified string. The tag acts as an internal marker that can be used to identify these packets later on. This can be used, for example, to provide trust between interfaces and to determine if packets have been processed by translation rules. Tags are “sticky”, meaning that the packet will be tagged even if the rule is not the last matching rule. Further matching rules can replace the tag with a new one but will not remove a previously applied tag. A packet is only ever assigned one tag at a time.<br>符合此規則的封包將使用指定的字串進行標記。此標籤可作為內部標記，可用於稍後識別這些資料包。例如，這可用於在介面之間提供信任並確定資料包是否已由轉換規則處理。標籤是“黏性的”，這意味著即使規則不是最後一個匹配規則，資料包也會被標記。進一步的匹配規則可以用新標籤取代該標籤，但不會刪除先前套用的標籤。一個資料包一次只分配一個標籤。 |
| **Match local tag**<br>**符合本機標籤** | Used to specify that packets must already be tagged with the given tag in order to match the rule.<br>用於指定封包必須已帶有給定標記才能符合規則。 |

###### [Divert-to](#p-137)｜[轉移到](#p-137)

With divert we can integrate additional policy constructs into firewall rules. A rule with “divert-to” can send all packets to a divert socket, on which a service like [Intrusion Prevention System](#p-202) can listen.

透過轉移，我們可以將額外的策略構造整合到防火牆規則中。帶有「divert-to」的規則可以將所有資料包發送到轉移套接字，[入侵防禦系統](#p-202)等服務可以在該套接字上偵聽。

This can provide more fine grained control than intercepting all traffic for inspection. It can improve performance because large flows that do not necessarily need inspection can be excluded.

與攔截所有流量進行檢查相比，這可以提供更細粒度的控制。它可以提高效能，因為可以排除不一定需要檢查的大流量。

As an example, go to Services ‣ Intrusion Detection ‣ Administration and set the “Capture mode” to “Divert (IPS)”.

例如，進入服務‣入侵偵測‣管理並將「捕獲模式」設定為「轉移（IPS）」。

Afterwards, create a firewall rule that matches the traffic that should be inspected and set the “Divert-to”（轉移至） settings in that rule. Matching packets will be diverted to the socket the intrusion detection listens on. After making a decision, the packet will then be forwarded or dropped.

然後，建立與應檢查的流量相符的防火牆規則，並在該規則中設定 “Divert-to”（轉移至） 設定。匹配的資料包將被轉移到入侵偵測偵聽的套接字。做出決定後，資料包將被轉送或丟棄。

Attention

注意

Keep in mind that when the service that listens on the divert socket is stopped, the firewall rule will drop all matching packets.

請記住，當偵聽轉移套接字的服務停止時，防火牆規則將丟棄所有符合的資料包。

##### [Rules](#p-137)｜[規則](#p-137)

*Rules* is the implementation that has been around since day one. Since it consists of static php pages, there is no API support, Over time, it will be replaced by *Rules \[new\]* and a Migration assistant can be found in Firewall ‣ Rules ‣ Migration assistant.

*規則*是從第一天起就已經存在的實施。由於它由靜態php頁面組成，因此沒有API支持，隨著時間的推移，它將被*規則\[新\]*取代，並且可以在防火牆‣規則‣遷移助手中找到遷移助手。

###### [Settings](#p-137)｜[設定](#p-137)

Traffic that is flowing through your firewall can be allowed or denied using rules, which define policies. This section of the documentation describe the different settings, grouped by usage.

可以使用定義策略的規則來允許或拒絕流經防火牆的流量。文件的這一部分描述了按用途分組的不同設定。

**Organisation**

**組織**

Some settings help to identify rules, without influencing traffic flow.

某些設定有助於識別規則，而不影響流量。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Category<br>類別 | The category this rule belongs to, can be used as a filter in the overview<br>此規則所屬的類別，可在概覽 |
| Description<br>描述 | Descriptive text<br>描述性文字 |

**Basic settings**

**基本設定**

Below are the settings most commonly used:

以下是最常用的設定：

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Action<br>行動 | The [action](#p-137) to perform.<br>要執行的[操作](#p-137)。 |
| Disabled<br>已停用 | Disable a rule without removing it, can be practical for testing purposes and to support easy enablement of less frequently used policies.<br>停用規則而不刪除它，對於測試目的非常實用，並支援輕鬆啟用不常用的策略。 |
| Interface<br>介面 | Interface\[s\] this rule applies on. You can easily copy rules between interfaces and change this field to the new target interface. (remember to check the order before applying)<br>此規則適用的介面。您可以輕鬆地在介面之間複製規則，並將該欄位變更為新的目標介面。 （申請前記得檢查訂單） |
| TCP/IP Version<br>TCP/IP版本 | Does this rule apply on IPv4, IPv6 or both.<br>此規則適用於 IPv4、IPv6 或兩者。 |
| Protocol<br>協議 | Protocol to use, most common are TCP and UDP<br>使用的協議，最常見的是TCP和UDP |
| Source<br>來源 | Source network or address, when combining IPv4 and IPv6 in one rule, you can use aliases which contain both address families. You can select multiple sources per rule.<br>來源網路或位址，將 IPv4 和 IPv6 組合在一條規則中時，可以使用包含這兩個位址族的別名。您可以為每個規則選擇多個來源。 |
| Source / Invert<br>來源/反轉 | Invert source selection (for example not 192.168.0.0/24) You can only invert single sources.<br>反轉來源選擇（例如不是192.168.0.0/24） 您只能反轉單一來源。 |
| Destination<br>目的地 | Destination network or address, like source you can use aliases here as well. You can select multiple destinations per rule.<br>目標網路或位址，與來源一樣，您也可以在此使用別名。您可以為每個規則選擇多個目標。 |
| Destination / Invert<br>目的地/反轉 | When the filter should be inverted, you can mark this checkbox. You can only invert single destinations.<br>當需要反轉過濾器時，您可以標記此複選框。您只能反轉單一目的地。 |
| Destination port range<br>目的連接埠範圍 | For TCP and/or UDP you can select a service by name (http, https) or number (range), you can also use aliases here to simplify management.<br>對於TCP和/或UDP，您可以透過名稱（http、https）或編號（範圍）選擇服務，您也可以在此處使用別名來簡化管理。 |
| Log<br>日誌 | Create a log entry when this rule applies, you can use Firewall ‣ Log Files ‣ Live View to monitor if your rule applies.<br>當此規則適用時建立日誌條目，您可以使用防火牆 ‣ 日誌檔案 ‣ 即時檢視來監控您的規則是否適用。 |

Tip

提示

The use of descriptive names help identify traffic in the live log view easily.

使用描述性名稱有助於輕鬆識別即時日誌檢視中的流量。

With the use of the eye button in the right top corner of the screen you can find statistics about the rule in question (number of evaluations, number of active states and traffic counters).

透過使用螢幕右上角的眼睛按鈕，您可以找到有關相關規則的統計資料（評估數量、活動狀態數量和流量計數器）。

Tip

提示

You can select multiple sources or destinations per rule, yet keep in mind that a nested alias might be the better choice. This feature is most useful if you plan to create [security zones](#p-153).

您可以為每個規則選擇多個來源或目標，但請記住，巢狀別名可能是更好的選擇。如果您打算建立[安全區域](#p-153)，此功能最有用。

**Traffic shaping (QoS)**

**流量整形（QoS）**

When a firewall rule needs to be constrained in terms of the number of packets it may process over time, it’s possible to combine the rule with the traffic shaper.

當防火牆規則需要限制其隨時間處理的封包數量時，可以將該規則與流量整形器結合。

The process of shaping is explained in the [Traffic Shaping](#p-138) section of our documentation. Below you will find the relevant properties for the firewall rule.

我們文件的[流量整形](#p-138)部分解釋了整形的過程。您將在下方找到防火牆規則的相關屬性。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Traffic shaping/rule direction<br>流量整形/規則方向 | Force packets being matched by this rule into the configured queue or pipe<br>強制將此規則相符的資料包放入配置的佇列或管道中 |
| Traffic shaping/reverse direction<br>流量整形/反向 | Force packets being matched in the opposite direction into the configured queue or pipe<br>強制封包以相反方向匹配到配置的佇列或管道中 |

Tip

提示

Filter rules are more flexible than the ones specified in the shaper section itself as these can be combined with aliases as well. Although this feature is quite new, it’s certainly worth looking at when in need of a traffic shaper.

過濾規則比整形器部分本身指定的規則更靈活，因為它們也可以與別名組合。儘管此功能相當新，但在需要流量整形器時確實值得一看。

**Less commonly used**

**不太常用**

Some settings are usually best left default, but can also be set in the normal rule configuration.

某些設定通常最好保留預設值，但也可以在正常規則配置中進行設定。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Source port range<br>來源連接埠範圍 | In case of TCP and/or UDP, you can also filter on the source port (range) that is used by the client. Since in most cases you can’t influence the source port, this setting is usually kept default (`any`).<br>如果是TCP和/或UDP，您也可以過濾客戶端使用的來源連接埠（範圍）。由於在大多數情況下您無法影響來源端口，因此此設定通常會保留預設值（`any`）。 |
| Quick<br>快 | If a packet matches a rule specifying quick, the first matching rule wins. When not set to quick the last matching rule wins. When not sure, best use quick rules and interpret the ruleset from top to bottom.<br>如果資料包與指定快速的規則匹配，則第一個匹配的規則獲勝。如果未設定為快速，則最後符合的規則獲勝。不確定時，最好使用快速規則並從上到下解釋規則集。 |
| Direction<br>方向 | Direction of the traffic, see also [Direction](#p-137).<br>交通方向，另見[方向](#p-137)。 |

**High Availability**

**高可用性**

The following options are specifically used for HA setups.

以下選項專門用於 HA 設定。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| No XMLRPC Sync<br>沒有XMLRPC同步 | Disable configuration sync for this rule, when **Firewall Rules** sync is enabled in System ‣ High Availability ‣ Settings<br>在系統 ‣ 高可用性 ‣ 設定 |
| State Type / NO pfsync<br>狀態類型 / NO pfsync | Prevent states created by this rule to be synced to the other node<br>防止此規則所建立的狀態同步到其他節點 |

**Schedule**

**時間表**

Rules can also be scheduled to be active at specific days or time ranges, you can create schedules in Firewall ‣ Advanced ‣ Schedules and select one in the rule.

規則也可以安排在特定日期或時間範圍內激活，您可以在防火牆 ‣ 高級 ‣ 計劃中建立計劃並在規則中選擇一個。

**Policy based routing**

**基於策略的路由**

This feature can be used to forward traffic to another gateway based on more fine grained filters than static routes could ([OSI layer 4 verses OSI layer 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OSI_model)) and can be used to build multi-wan scenario’s using gateway groups.

此功能可用於基於比靜態路由更細緻的過濾器將流量轉送到另一個網關（[OSI第 4 層與OSI第 3 層](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OSI_model)），並且可用於使用網關群組建置多 WAN 場景。

More information about Multi-Wan can be found in the “[Multi WAN](#p-095)” chapter.

有關 Multi-Wan 的更多信息，請參閱“[Multi WAN](#p-095)”章節。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Gateway<br>網關 | When a gateway is specified, packets will use policy based routing using the specified gateway or gateway group. Usually this option is set on the receiving interface (LAN for example), which then chooses the gateway specified here. (This ignores default routing rules). Only packets flowing in the same direction of the rule are affected by this parameter, the opposite direction (replies) are not affected by this option.<br>指定網關後，資料包將使用指定網關或網關群組基於政策的路由。通常此選項會在接收介面上設定（例如LAN），然後接收介面選擇此處指定的網關。 （這會忽略預設路由規則）。只有與規則相同方向的封包才受此參數影響，相反方向（回復）不受此選項影響。 |
| reply-to<br>回覆 | By default traffic is always send to the connected gateway on the interface. If for some reason you don’t want to force traffic to that gateway, you can disable this behaviour or enforce an alternative target here.<br>預設情況下，流量總是會傳送到介面上連接的閘道。如果您因為某些原因不想強制流量到達該網關，您可以停用此行為或在此處強制執行替代目標。 |

Note

注意事項

When using policy based routing, don’t forget to exclude local traffic which shouldn’t be forwarded. You can do so by creating a rule with a higher priority, using a `default` gateway.

使用基於政策的路由時，不要忘記排除不應轉送的本地流量。您可以透過使用 `default` 網關建立具有更高優先順序的規則來實現此目的。

Tip

提示

In our experience the packet capture function (Interfaces ‣ Diagnostics ‣ Packet capture) can be a valuable tool to inspect if traffic is really heading the direction you would expect it to go, just choose a host to monitor and try to exchange some packets. When selecting all interfaces, it’s easy to see where traffic headed.

根據我們的經驗，封包擷取功能（介面‣診斷‣封包擷取）可以是一個有價值的工具，可以檢查流量是否確實朝著您期望的方向發展，只需選擇要監視的主機並嘗試交換一些封包即可。選擇所有介面時，可以輕鬆查看流量的去向。

**Connection limits**

**連線限制**

The advanced options contains some settings to limit the use of a rule or specify specific timeouts for the it. Most generic (default) settings for these options can be found under Firewall ‣ Settings ‣ Advanced

進階選項包含一些限制規則使用或為其指定特定逾時的設定。這些選項的大多數通用（預設）設定可以在防火牆 ‣ 設定 ‣ 進階下找到

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Max states<br>最大狀態 | Limits the number of concurrent states the rule may create. When this limit is reached, further packets that would create state will not match this rule until existing states time out.<br>限制規則可以建立的並發狀態的數量。當達到此限制時，將建立狀態的其他資料包將無法匹配此規則，直到現有狀態逾時。 |
| Max source nodes<br>最大來源節點 | Limits the maximum number of source addresses which can simultaneously have state table entries.<br>限制可以同時擁有狀態表條目的來源位址的最大數量。 |
| Max established<br>麥克斯成立 | Limits the maximum number of simultaneous TCP connections which have completed the 3-way handshake that a single host can make.<br>限制單一主機可以完成 3 次握手的同時TCP 連接的最大數量。 |
| Max source states<br>最大來源狀態 | Limits the maximum number of simultaneous state entries that a single source address can create with this rule.<br>限制單一來源位址可以使用此規則建立的同時狀態條目的最大數量。 |
| Max new connections<br>最大新連線數 | Limit the rate of new connections over a time interval. The connection rate is an approximation calculated as a moving average. (number of connections / seconds) Only applies on TCP connections<br>限制一段時間內新連線的速率。連接率是按移動平均值計算的近似值。 （連接數/秒）僅適用於 TCP 連接 |
| State timeout<br>狀態逾時 | State Timeout in seconds (applies to TCP only)<br>狀態逾時（以秒為單位）（僅適用於TCP） |

**Advanced**

**高級**

Some less common used options are defined below.

下面定義了一些不太常用的選項。

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| Source OS<br>來源OS | Operating systems can be fingerprinted based on some tcp fields from the originating connection. These fingerprints can be used as well to match traffic on. (more detailed information can be found in the [pf.os](https://www.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=pf.os) man page)<br>可以根據原始連線中的一些 TCP 欄位對作業系統進行指紋識別。這些指紋也可用於匹配流量。 （更詳細的資訊可以在[pf.os](https://www.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=pf.os)手冊頁中找到） |
| allow options<br>允許選項 | By default the firewall blocks IPv4 packets with IP options or IPv6 packets with routing extension headers set. If you have an application that requires such packets (such as multicast or IGMP) you can enable this option.<br>預設情況下，防火牆會阻止具有 IP 選項的 IPv4 封包或設定了路由擴充標頭的 IPv6 封包。如果您有需要此類資料包的應用程式（例如多播或IGMP），您可以啟用此選項。 |
| TCP flags<br>TCP 旗幟 | If specific TCP flags need to be set or unset, you can specify those here.<br>如果需要設定或取消設定特定的 TCP 標誌，您可以在此處指定。 |
| Set priority<br>設定優先權 | Packets matching this rule will be assigned a specific queueing priority. If the packet is transmitted on a VLAN interface, the queueing priority will be written as the priority code point in the 802.1Q VLAN header. If two priorities are given, packets which have a TOS of lowdelay and TCP ACKs with no data payload will be assigned to the second one.<br>符合此規則的封包將會被指派特定的排隊優先權。如果資料包在VLAN介面上傳輸，排隊優先權將作為優先權代碼點寫入802.1QVLAN標頭中。如果給出兩個優先級，則具有低延遲的 TOS 和不帶資料負載的 TCP ACK 的封包將分配給第二個優先權。 |
| Match priority<br>匹配優先級 | Only match packets which have the given queueing priority assigned.<br>僅匹配分配給定排隊優先級的資料包。 |
| Set local tag<br>設定本機標籤 | Packets matching this rule will be tagged with the specified string. The tag acts as an internal marker that can be used to identify these packets later on. This can be used, for example, to provide trust between interfaces and to determine if packets have been processed by translation rules. Tags are “sticky”, meaning that the packet will be tagged even if the rule is not the last matching rule. Further matching rules can replace the tag with a new one but will not remove a previously applied tag. A packet is only ever assigned one tag at a time.<br>符合此規則的封包將使用指定的字串進行標記。此標籤可作為內部標記，可用於稍後識別這些資料包。例如，這可用於在介面之間提供信任並確定資料包是否已由轉換規則處理。標籤是“黏性的”，這意味著即使規則不是最後一個匹配規則，資料包也會被標記。進一步的匹配規則可以用新標籤取代該標籤，但不會刪除先前套用的標籤。一個資料包一次只分配一個標籤。 |
| Match local tag<br>符合本機標籤 | Match packets that are tagged earlier (using set local tag)<br>符合先前標記的資料包（使用設定本機標記） |
| State Type<br>狀態類型 | Influence the state tracking mechanism used, the following options are available. When in doubt, it’s usually best to preserve the default `keep state`<br>• Keep state ‣ is used for stateful connection tracking.<br>• Sloppy state ‣ works like keep state, but it does not check sequence numbers. Use it when the firewall does not see all packets.<br>• Synproxy state ‣ proxies incoming TCP connections to help protect servers from spoofed TCP SYN floods. This option includes the functionality of keep state and modulate state combined.<br>• None ‣ Do not use state mechanisms to keep track.<br>影響所使用的狀態追蹤機制，有以下選項可用。如有疑問，通常最好保留預設值 `keep state`<br>• Keep state ‣ 用於有狀態連線追蹤。 <br>• Sloppy state ‣ 與 keep state 類似，但它不檢查序號。當防火牆看不到所有資料包時使用它。 <br>• Synproxy 狀態‣ 代理傳入的TCP 連接，以幫助保護伺服器免受欺騙的TCP SYN 洪水攻擊。此選項包括保持狀態和調變狀態組合的功能。 <br>• 無‣ 不使用狀態機制來追蹤。 |

#### [Troubleshooting](#p-137)｜[故障排除](#p-137)

While building your ruleset things can go wrong, it’s always good to know where to look for signs of an issue. One of the most common mistakes is traffic doesn’t match the rule and/or the order of the rule doesn’t make sense for whatever reason.

在建立規則集時，事情可能會出錯，但了解在哪裡尋找問題跡象總是好的。最常見的錯誤之一是流量與規則不符和/或規則的順序無論出於何種原因都沒有意義。

With the use of the “inspect” button, one can easily see if a rule is being evaluated and traffic did pass using this rule. It’s also possible to jump directly into the attached states to see if your host is in the list as expected.

透過使用「檢查」按鈕，人們可以輕鬆查看是否正在評估規則以及流量是否確實通過了該規則。也可以直接跳到附加狀態以查看您的主機是否按預期位於清單中。

Another valuable tool is the live log viewer, in order to use it, make sure to provide your rule with an easy to read description and enable the “log” option.

另一個有價值的工具是即時日誌檢視器，為了使用它，請確保為您的規則提供易於閱讀的描述並啟用「日誌」選項。

If your using source routing (policy based routing), debugging can sometimes get a bit more complicated. Since the normal system routing table may not apply, it helps to know which flow the traffic actually followed. The packet capture is a useful tool in that case.

如果您使用來源路由（基於策略的路由），偵錯有時會變得有點複雜。由於正常的系統路由表可能不適用，因此有助於了解流量實際遵循哪個流。在這種情況下，資料包擷取是一個有用的工具。

Common issues in this area include return traffic using a different interface than the one it came into, since traffic follows the normal routing table on it’s way out (reply-to issue), or traffic leaving the wrong interface due to overselection (matching internal traffic and forcing a gateway).

這一領域的常見問題包括返回流量使用與其進入的接口不同的接口，因為流量在出去時遵循正常的路由表（回復問題），或者由於過度選擇而離開錯誤的接口（匹配內部流量並強制網關）。

Inspecting used netmasks is also a good idea, intending to match a host but providing a subnet is a mistake easily made (e.g. `192.168.1.1/32` vs `192.168.1.1/24` is in reality all of `192.168.1.x`).

檢查使用的網路遮罩也是一個好主意，打算匹配主機但提供子網是一個很容易犯的錯誤（例如`192.168.1.1/32`與`192.168.1.1/24`實際上是`192.168.1.x`的全部）。

Last but not least, remember rules are matched in order and the default (inbound) policy is `block` if nothing else is specified, since we match traffic on `inbound`, make sure to add rules where traffic originates from (e.g. `lan` for traffic leaving your network, the return should normally be allowed by state).

最後但並非最不重要的一點是，記住規則是按順序匹配的，如果沒有指定其他內容，預設（入站）策略是 `block`，因為我們在 `inbound` 上匹配流量，請確保添加流量源自的規則（例如 `lan` 對於離開網路的流量，返回通常應由州允許）。

<a id="c-29"></a>

### Traffic Shaping

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-138"></a>

#### Traffic Shaping｜流量整形

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/shaping.html>

Traffic shaping (also known as “packet shaping”) is the control of computer network traffic in order to optimize or guarantee performance, lower latency, and/or increase usable bandwidth by delaying packets that meet certain criteria. More specifically, traffic shaping is any action on a set of packets (often called a stream or a flow), which imposes additional delay on those packets such that they conform to some predetermined constraint (a contract or traffic profile).

流量整形（也稱為「資料包整形」）是對電腦網路流量的控制，以便透過延遲滿足特定標準的資料包來優化或保證效能、降低延遲和/或增加可用頻寬。更具體地說，流量整形是對一組資料包（通常稱為流或流）的任何操作，它對這些資料包施加額外的延遲，以便它們符合某些預定的約束（合約或流量配置檔案）。

![../_images/traffic_shaping.png](<../images/f390d338-traffic_shaping.png>)

##### Introduction｜介紹

Traffic shaping within OPNsense is very flexible and is organized around pipes, queues and corresponding rules. The pipes define the allowed bandwidth, the queues can be used to set a weight within the pipe and finally the rules are used to apply the shaping to a certain package flow. The shaping rules are handled independently from the firewall rules and other settings, unless a pipe or queue is assigned in a firewall rule directly.

OPNsense 內的流量整形非常靈活，並圍繞管道、隊列和相應規則進行組織。管道定義允許的頻寬，佇列可用於設定管道內的權重，最後使用規則將整形應用於特定的包流。除非直接在防火牆規則中指派管道或佇列，否則整形規則的處理獨立於防火牆規則和其他設定。

OPNsense traffic shaping is a reliable solution to limit bandwidth or prioritize traffic and can be combined with other functions such as captive portal or high availability (CARP).

OPNsense 流量整形是限制頻寬或確定流量優先順序的可靠解決方案，並且可以與強制入口網站或高可用性 (CARP) 等其他功能結合。

Bandwidth limitations can be defined based upon the interface(s), IP source & destination, direction of traffic (in/out) and port numbers (application).

頻寬限制可以根據介面、IP來源和目的地、流量方向（輸入/輸出）和連接埠號碼（應用程式）來定義。

Available bandwidth can be shared evenly over all users, this allows for optimum performance at all times.

可用頻寬可以在所有用戶之間平均共享，這樣可以始終實現最佳效能。

Traffic can also be prioritized by adding queues and defining weights. Strictly speaking traffic is not really prioritized but applications with a higher weight can consume more bandwidth than others when the total available bandwidth is limited.

還可以透過新增佇列和定義權重來確定流量的優先權。嚴格來說，流量並沒有真正優先考慮，但當總可用頻寬有限時，權重較高的應用程式可能會比其他應用程式消耗更多的頻寬。

The traffic shaper implementation uses IPFW and dummynet to offer a modern, reliable solution with a low cpu footprint.

流量整形器實作使用 IPFW 和 dummynet 來提供現代化、可靠且 CPU 佔用空間低的解決方案。

##### Dummynet & ipfw｜虛擬網路和 ipfw

Dummynet operates by first using the firewall to classify packets and divide them into flows, using any match pattern that can be used in ipfw rules. Depending on local policies, a flow can contain packets for a single TCP connection, or from/to a given host, or entire subnet, or a protocol type, etc.

Dummynet 的運作方式是先使用防火牆對封包進行分類並將其劃分為流，並使用可在 ipfw 規則中使用的任何匹配模式。根據本地策略，流可以包含單一TCP連接的資料包，或來自/到給定主機的資料包，或整個子網，或協定類型等。

Packets belonging to the same flow are then passed to either of two different objects, which implement the traffic regulation:

然後，屬於同一流的資料包被傳遞到兩個不同物件中的任意一個，從而實現流量調節：

pipe

管子

A pipe emulates a link with given bandwidth, propagation delay, queue size and packet loss rate. Packets are queued in front of the pipe as they come out from the classifier, and then transferred to the pipe according to the pipe’s parameters.

管道模擬具有給定頻寬、傳播延遲、佇列大小和丟包率的連結。資料包從分類器出來時在管道前面排隊，然後根據管道的參數傳輸到管道。

queue

佇列

A queue is an abstraction used to implement the WF2Q+ (Worstcase Fair Weighted Fair Queueing) policy, which is an efficient variant of the WFQ policy. The queue associates a weight and a reference pipe to each flow, and then all backlogged (i.e., with packets queued) flows linked to the same pipe share the pipe’s bandwidth proportionally to their weights. Note that weights are not priorities; a flow with a lower weight is still guaranteed to get its fraction of the bandwidth even if a flow with a higher weight is permanently backlogged.

隊列是用於實現WF2Q+（最壞情況公平加權公平排隊）策略的抽象，它是WFQ策略的高效變體。佇列將權重和參考管道與每個流相關聯，然後連結到同一管道的所有積壓（即，資料包排隊）流按與其權重成比例地共享管道的頻寬。請注意，權重不是優先級；而是優先級。即使權重較高的流永久積壓，權重較低的流仍能保證獲得其頻寬的一部分。

In practice, pipes can be used to set hard limits to the bandwidth that a flow can use, whereas queues can be used to determine how different flows share the available bandwidth.

實際上，管道可用於對流可以使用的頻寬設定硬限制，而佇列可用於確定不同流如何共享可用頻寬。

The shaping rules can be defined in the rules section of the traffic shaper.

整形規則可以在流量整形器的規則部分中定義。

Tip

提示

Dummynet recommends the tunable `kern.hz` to be configured with a minimal value of `1000`, when using the shaper on a virtual machine, the default for this setting is usually lower. A higher value increases responsiveness of the shaper.

Dummynet 建議將可調的 `kern.hz` 配置為最小值 `1000`，在虛擬機器上使用整形器時，此設定的預設值通常較低。較高的值可提高整形器的反應能力。

You can add this value in System ‣ Settings ‣ Tunables

您可以在 System ‣ Settings ‣ Tunables 中新增此值

##### Status / statistics｜狀態/統計數據

To check if your shaper is acting like intended, you can use the status page (Firewall -> Shaper -> Status).

若要檢查您的 shaper 是否如預期運作，您可以使用狀態頁面（防火牆 -> Shaper -> 狀態）。

This component will show a breakdown of configured pipes, queues and rules showing the amount of traffic passed through it since the last restart of the service including the timestamp when that happened.

該元件將顯示已配置管道、隊列和規則的詳細信息，顯示自上次服務重新啟動以來通過它的流量，包括發生該事件時的時間戳。

If flows are active, you can show their details using the “Show active flows” checkbox, do remember to refresh your view after changing these settings.

如果流處於活動狀態，您可以使用「顯示活動流」複選框顯示其詳細信息，請記住在更改這些設定後刷新視圖。

The rules are not shown by default, you can use the “Show rules” checkbox to enabled those, this option can help you identifying misconfigurations more easily, since the underlying technology (`ipfw`) keeps track of data on a per rule basis.

預設不顯示規則，您可以使用「顯示規則」複選框來啟用這些規則，此選項可以幫助您更輕鬆地識別錯誤配置，因為底層技術（`ipfw`）會根據每個規則追蹤資料。

Tip

提示

Make sure to use easy to find descriptions, these will ease debugging when traffic isn’t being handled as expected.

確保使用易於查找的描述，當流量未按預期處理時，這些描述將簡化偵錯。

##### Reserve dedicated bandwidth｜預留專用頻寬

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/shaper_dedicated_bw.html>

**Reserve dedicated bandwidth for a realtime traffic such as (hosted) Voice Over IP (VOIP) server.**

**為即時流量預留專用頻寬，例如（託管）Voice Over IP (VOIP) 伺服器。**

In this scenario we will create a pipe dedicated for traffic going to and coming from our realtime application. For the sample we presume a SIP trunk or hosted Voice Over IP (VOIP) server.

在這種情況下，我們將建立一個專用於進出即時應用程式的流量的管道。對於範例，我們假設有一個 SIP 中繼或託管 Voice Over IP (VOIP) 伺服器。

For this example we presume a requirement of 4 uncompressed voice channels of 64 kbps, resulting in a total bandwidth of 256 kbps. The internet connection in this example has 10 Mbps Download and 1 Mbps Upload.

對於此範例，我們假設需要 4 個 64 kbps 的未壓縮語音通道，導致總頻寬為 256 kbps。本範例中的網際網路連線具有 10 Mbps 下載和 1 Mbps 上傳。

[![](<../images/d8a3726a-nwdiag-3418ebe96212e329652ed37ad74bd28dc.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/nwdiag-3418ebe96212e329652ed37ad74bd28dc53d6d4c.png)

Shaping hosted VOIP / SIP trunk sample

塑造託管VOIP / SIP主幹樣本

To start go to Firewall ‣ Shaper ‣ Pipes.

首先前往 Firewall ‣ Shaper ‣ Pipes。

###### Step 1 - Create Upload and Download Pipes｜步驟 1 - 建立上傳和下載管道

On the **Pipes** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit Pipe** screen will popup.

在 **管道**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。將彈出一個空的**編輯管道**螢幕。

Create Pipe For Upload (To our VOIP Server)

建立上傳管道（到我們的VOIP伺服器）

|   |   |   |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **enabled**<br>**啟用** | Checked<br>已檢查 | *Check to enable the pipe*<br>*檢查以啟用管道* |

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/shaper_share_evenly.html>

For this example we presume an internet connection of 10 Mbps Download and 1 Mbps Upload that we want to share evenly between all users.

對於此範例，我們假設網路連線為 10 Mbps 下載和 1 Mbps 上傳，我們希望在所有使用者之間均勻共用。

<a id="p-141"></a>

##### Limit maximum internet bandwidth users can consume｜限制使用者可以消耗的最大網路頻寬

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/shaper_limit_per_user.html>

For this example we will divide the internet Download traffic between the connected users in such manner that each user will receive up to a maximum of 1 Mbps.

在此範例中，我們將在連線的使用者之間指派網路下載流量，使每個使用者最多接收 1 Mbps。

[![](<../images/5edbe2b6-nwdiag-3a3b295df95f5f47b05bd5247ff3374f6.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/nwdiag-3a3b295df95f5f47b05bd5247ff3374f6471bbc9.png)

Simple network diagram

簡單網路圖

To start go to Firewall ‣ Shaper ‣ Pipes.

首先前往 Firewall ‣ Shaper ‣ Pipes。

###### Step 1 - Create download and upload pipes｜步驟 1 - 建立下載和上傳管道

On the **Pipes** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit Pipe** screen will popup.

在 **管道**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。將彈出一個空的**編輯管道**螢幕。

Create Pipe For Download

建立下載管道

|   |   |   |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **enabled**<br>**啟用** | Checked<br>已檢查 | *Check to enable the pipe*<br>*檢查以啟用管道* |
| **bandwidth**<br>**頻寬** | 1 | *Numeric value of the desired bandwidth*<br>*所需頻寬的數值* |
| **bandwidth Metric**<br>**頻寬指標** | Mbit/s<br>兆位元/秒 | *Metric to use with the numeric value*<br>*與數值一起使用的量測* |
| **mask**<br>**面具** | destination<br>目的地 | *Dynamic pipe per downloading client*<br>*每個下載客戶端的動態管道* |
| **description**<br>**描述** | PipeDown-1Mbps | *Free field, enter something descriptive*<br>*自由字段，輸入描述性內容* |

Create Pipe For Upload

建立上傳管道

|   |   |   |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **enabled**<br>**啟用** | Checked<br>已檢查 | *Check to enable the pipe*<br>*檢查以啟用管道* |
| **bandwidth**<br>**頻寬** | 1 | *Numeric value of the desired bandwidth*<br>*所需頻寬的數值* |
| **bandwidth Metric**<br>**頻寬指標** | Mbit/s<br>兆位元/秒 | *Metric to use with the numeric value*<br>*與數值一起使用的量測* |
| **mask**<br>**面具** | source<br>來源 | *Dynamic pipe per uploading client*<br>*每個上傳客戶端的動態管道* |
| **description**<br>**描述** | PipeUp-1Mbps | *Free field, enter something descriptive*<br>*自由字段，輸入描述性內容* |

Note

注意事項

Always create separate pipes for download and upload limiting to avoid undefined behaviour when mixing bidirectional traffic in a single pipe.

始終為下載和上傳限制建立單獨的管道，以避免在單一管道中混合雙向流量時出現未定義的行為。

**Prioritize using Queues｜優先使用隊列**

By utilizing queues we can influence the bandwidth within a pipe and give certain applications more bandwidth than others based on a weighted algorithm.

透過利用佇列，我們可以影響管道內的頻寬，並根據加權演算法為某些應用程式提供比其他應用程式更多的頻寬。

The idea is simple: Let presume we have a pipe of 10 Mbps and 2 applications for instance smtp (email) and http(s). The http(s) traffic will get a weight of 1 and the smtp traffic a weight of 9, then when all capacity of our pipe is in use the email traffic will get 9x more bandwidth than our http(s) traffic, resulting in 1 Mbps for http(s) and 9 Mbps for smtp.

這個想法很簡單：假設我們有一個 10 Mbps 的管道和 2 個應用程序，例如 smtp（電子郵件）和 http(s)。 http(s) 流量的權重為 1，smtp 流量的權重為 9，然後當管道的所有容量都使用時，電子郵件流量將獲得比 http(s) 流量多 9 倍的頻寬，從而導致 http(s) 流量為 1 Mbps，smtp 流量為 9 Mbps。

For our example we only look at download traffic, but the exact same can be done for the upload traffic.

對於我們的範例，我們僅查看下載流量，但可以對上傳流量執行完全相同的操作。

<table>
<tr><th>Application<br>應用</th><th>Weight<br>重量</th><th>Minimum Bandwidth<br>最小頻寬</th></tr>
<tr><td>SMTP(port 25)<br>（埠 25）</td><td>9</td><td>9 Mbps</td></tr>
<tr><td>HTTP (80)</td><td rowspan="2">1</td><td rowspan="2">1 Mbps</td></tr>
<tr><td>HTTPS (443)</td></tr>
</table>

To start go to Firewall ‣ Shaper ‣ Pipes.

首先前往 Firewall ‣ Shaper ‣ Pipes。

在 **管道**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。將彈出一個空的**編輯管道**螢幕。

建立下載管道 (10 Mbps)

| **bandwidth**<br>**頻寬** | 10 | *Numeric value of the desired bandwidth*<br>10 *所需頻寬的數值* |
| **bandwidth Metric**<br>**頻寬指標** | Mbit/s<br>兆位元/秒 | *Metric to use with the numeric value*<br>*與數值一起使用的量測* |
| **mask**<br>**面具** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty*<br>*留空* |
| **description**<br>**描述** | PipeDown-10Mbps | *Free field, enter something descriptive*<br>*自由字段，輸入描述性內容* |

| **target**<br>**目標** | Queue-HTTP<br>隊列-HTTP | *Select the HTTP queue*<br>*選擇HTTP隊列* |
| **description**<br>**描述** | ShapeHTTPDownload<br>ShapeHTTP下載 | *Enter a descriptive name*<br>*輸入描述性名稱* |

Adding an extra rule for HTTPS traffic is simple as we can use the same HTTP queue if we like:

| **target**<br>**目標** | Queue-HTTP<br>隊列-HTTP | *Select the HTTP queue*<br>*選擇HTTP隊列* |

This way HTTP and HTTPS traffic will be treated the same (total max of 1 Mbps).

##### Multi Interface shaping for a GuestNet｜GuestNet 的多重介面整形

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/shaper_guestnet.html>

One of the options with OPNsense’s traffic shaper is its ability to add shaping rules based upon two interfaces. This option allows you to shape traffic differently based on the direction the traffic is moving between interfaces.

OPNsense 流量整形器的選項之一是能夠基於兩個介面新增整形規則。此選項可讓您根據流量在介面之間移動的方向以不同方式調整流量。

For this example we will use this functionality to share a symmetric 10 Mbps internet connection between a primary LAN network and a Guest Network.

在此範例中，我們將使用此功能在主 LAN 網路和訪客網路之間共用對稱 10 Mbps 網路連線。

The LAN network will not be limited, traffic from users on our Guest Network will be limited to a total of 2 Mbps Download and 1 Mbps Upload.

LAN 網路不會受到限制，訪客網路上的使用者流量將限制為總共 2 Mbps 下載和 1 Mbps 上傳。

<a id="p-144"></a>

##### Fighting Bufferbloat with FQ_CoDel｜使用 FQ_CoDel 對抗緩衝區膨脹

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/shaper_bufferbloat.html>

###### Fighting Bufferbloat with FQ\_CoDel｜使用 FQ\_CoDel 對抗緩衝膨脹

Bufferbloat is the undesirable latency that comes from a router or other network equipment buffering too much data. This occurs because the router cannot immediately transmit data through a slow (bottleneck) link, so it “buffers” those packets. New traffic can get stuck behind those buffered packets, resulting in enormous (even multi-second) delays to all traffic. End users see this as lagging in games, stuttering in video & voice calls, or a general sense that “the network is slow”.

緩衝膨脹是由於路由器或其他網路設備緩衝過多資料而產生的不良延遲。發生這種情況是因為路由器無法立即透過慢速（瓶頸）鏈路傳輸數據，因此它會「緩衝」這些資料包。新流量可能會滯留在這些緩衝資料包後面，導致所有流量出現巨大（甚至數秒）延遲。最終用戶將此視為遊戲滯後、視訊和語音通話卡頓或普遍感覺「網路速度慢」。

The AQM/SQM algorithms can eliminate that latency, significantly improving the end-user experience. One AQM is **FQ\_CoDel** e.g. Flow Queueing with Controlled Delay. It ensures that packets from small flows are sent in a timely fashion, while large flows share the bottleneck’s capacity.

AQM/SQM 演算法可以消除這種延遲，從而顯著改善最終用戶體驗。一個 AQM 是 **FQ\_CoDel** 例如具有受控延遲的流排隊。它確保小流量的資料包及時發送，而大流量則共享瓶頸容量。

Here is an overview of the FQ\_CoDel algorithm that performs these tasks in parallel:

以下是並行執行這些任務的 FQ\_CoDel 演算法的概述：

1.  Separate every traffic flow’s arriving packets into their own queue.  
    將每個流量的到達資料包分成各自的佇列。
    
2.  Remove a small batch of packets from a queue, round-robin style, and transmit that batch through the (slow) bottleneck link to the ISP. When each batch has been fully sent, retrieve a batch from the next queue, and so on.  
    以循環方式從佇列中刪除一小批資料包，然後透過（慢速）瓶頸連結將該批次傳輸到ISP。當每個批次完全發送後，從下一個佇列中檢索批次，依此類推。
    
3.  Offer back pressure to flows that are sending “more than their share” of data.  
    向發送「超過其份額」資料的串流提供背壓。
    

This last step is the heart of the FQ\_CoDel algorithm. It measures the time that a packet remains in a queue (its “sojourn time”). That’s how it determines that a flow is using more than its share. If packets have been in a queue “too long” (that is, if their sojourn times exceed the *target* setting for longer than the *interval*), FQ\_CoDel begins to mark or drop some of those packets to cause the sender to slow down.

最後一步是FQ\_CoDel 演算法的核心。它測量資料包在佇列中保留的時間（其“停留時間”）。這就是它確定某個流的使用量超過其份額的方式。如果封包在佇列中「太長」（即，如果它們的停留時間超過*目標*設定的時間超過*間隔*），FQ\_CoDel開始標記或丟棄其中一些封包，以導致傳送者減慢速度。

For more details, see RFC 8290 [https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8290](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8290).

欲了解更多詳情，請參閱RFC 8290 [https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8290](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8290)。

Attention

注意

If you are running IPv6 or any dynamic routing protocol, consider creating a Control plane specific class [Control Plane Shaping](#p-145).

如果您正在執行 IPv6 或任何動態路由協議，請考慮建立控制平面特定類別 [Control Plane Shaping](#p-145)。

###### Parameters of FQ\_CoDel｜FQ\_CoDel 的參數

FQ\_CoDel uses the following parameters in its algorithm.

FQ\_CoDel 在其演算法中使用下列參數。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **target**<br>**目標** | *Maximum time packets should dwell in a queue. (Default: 5ms)*<br>*封包在佇列中停留的最長時間。 （預設值：5 毫秒）* |
| **interval**<br>**間隔** | *When sojourn times exceed the target for more than this interval, drop or mark packets to slow that flow. (Default: 100ms)*<br>*當停留時間超過目標超過此間隔時，丟棄或標記資料包以減慢流量。 （預設值：100 毫秒）* |
| **quantum**<br>**量子** | *Maximum number of bytes to dequeue for transmission at one time. Should be set to the value of Interface MTU. (Default: 1514 bytes, 1500+14B hardware header, max 9000)*<br>*一次出隊傳輸的最大位元組數。應設定為介面MTU的值。 （預設：1514 字節，1500+14B 硬體頭，最大 9000）* |
| **limit**<br>**限制** | *Size of all queues managed by FQ\_CoDel instance. It is the hard limit on the real queue size in packets (Default: 10240, max 20480).*<br>*由FQ\_CoDel實例管理的所有佇列的大小。它是資料包中實際佇列大小的硬限制（預設：10240，最大 20480）。 * |
| **flows**<br>**流量** | *Sets the number of queues into which the incoming packets are classified (Default: 1024, max 65535)*<br>*設定傳入封包分類的佇列數量（預設：1024，最大 65535）* |
| **CoDel ECN** | *Enable packet marking for ECN-enabled TCP flows when queue delay becomes high. (Default: Disabled)*<br>*當佇列延遲變高時，為啟用ECN的TCP流啟用封包標記。 （預設值：停用）* |

在下面的設定步驟中，假設這些公佈的 ISP 速度：

| Mbit/s<br>兆位元/秒 | 530 | 30<br>530 30 |

| **(FQ-)CoDel interval**<br>**(FQ-)CoDel 間隔** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty for a queue*<br>*為佇列留空* |
| **(FQ-)CoDel ECN** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty for a queue*<br>*為佇列留空* |
| **description**<br>**描述** | Download-Queue<br>下載隊列 | *Free field, enter something descriptive*<br>*自由字段，輸入描述性內容* |

Note

注意事項

target, interval, ECN actually refer to CoDel and not FQ\_CoDel in the queue

target、interval、ECN實際上指的是隊列中的CoDel而不是FQ\_CoDel

**Step 2b - Create Upload Queue｜步驟 2b - 建立上傳佇列**

On the **Queues** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit queue** screen pops up.

在 **佇列**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。彈出一個空的**編輯佇列**螢幕。

Follow the same process as for the Download queue, selecting the **Upload pipe**, and entering “Upload-Queue”（上傳佇列） for the **description**

依照與下載佇列相同的過程，選擇 **上傳管道**，並輸入 “Upload-Queue”（上傳佇列） 作為**描述**

**Step 3a - Create Download Rule｜步驟 3a - 建立下載規則**

On the **Rules** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit rule** screen pops up.

在 **規則**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。彈出一個空的**編輯規則**畫面。

**Create a Rule For Download｜建立下載規則**

|   |   |   |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **enabled**<br>**啟用** | Checked<br>已檢查 | *Check to enable the rule*<br>*檢查以啟用規則* |
| **sequence**<br>**序列** | 1 | *Auto generated number, overwrite only when needed*<br>*自動產生編號，僅在需要時覆蓋* |
| **interface**<br>**介面** | WAN | *Select the interface connected to the internet*<br>*選擇連接到網際網路的介面* |
| **proto**<br>**原型** | ip | *Select the protocol, IP in our example*<br>*選擇協議，在我們的範例中為IP* |
| **source**<br>**來源** | any<br>任何 | *The source address to shape, leave on any*<br>*要整形的來源位址，保留任意* |
| **src-port**<br>**來源端口** | any<br>任何 | *The source port to shape, leave on any*<br>*要塑造的來源端口，保留任何* |
| **destination**<br>**目的地** | any<br>任何 | *The destination IP to shape, leave on any*<br>*目的地IP塑造，留下任意* |
| **dst-port**<br>**目標端口** | any<br>任何 | *The destination port to shape, leave on any*<br>*目的港自行塑造，任意留任* |
| **direction**<br>**方向** | in<br>在 | *Matches incoming or outgoing packets or both (default). We want to shape Download e.g ingress on WAN*<br>*符合傳入或傳出資料包或兩者（預設）。我們想要塑造下載，例如 WAN* 上的入口 |
| **target**<br>**目標** | Download-Queue<br>下載佇列 | *Select the Download queue*<br>*選擇下載佇列* |
| **description**<br>**描述** | Download-Rule<br>下載規則 | *Enter a descriptive name*<br>*輸入描述性名稱* |

**Step 3b - Create Upload Rule｜步驟 3b - 建立上傳規則**

On the **Rules** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit rule** screen pops up.

在 **規則**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。彈出一個空的**編輯規則**畫面。

Follow the same process as for the Download rule, using the same values except:

按照與下載規則相同的過程，使用相同的值，但以下情況除外：

-   **sequence** (set to 2);  
    **序列**（設定為2）；
    
-   **direction** (set to “out”)  
    **方向**（設定為“出”）
    
-   **target** (set to “Upload-Queue”（上傳佇列）);  
    **目标**（设置为“Upload-Queue”（上傳佇列））；
    
-   **description** (set to “Upload-Rule”（上傳規則）)  
    **描述**（设置为“Upload-Rule”（上傳規則））
    

**Step 4 - Finalizing the configuration｜第 4 步 - 完成配置**

Now press ![apply](<../images/ca819e9a-applybtn.png>) to activate the traffic shaping rules.

現在按![apply](<../images/ca819e9a-applybtn.png>)啟動流量整形規則。

###### Test for Bufferbloat｜測試緩衝區膨脹

There are several web sites that measure the latency during download and upload to give an indication of bufferbloat in your network. Each of these clearly labels the download and upload rates, as well the latency during those tests. See these screen shots below.

有幾個網站可以測量下載和上傳期間的延遲，以指示網路中的緩衝區膨脹情況。其中每一個都清楚地標記了下載和上傳速率，以及這些測試期間的延遲。請參閱下面的螢幕截圖。

They are all substantially the same. Pick one and use it for all your measurements.

它們基本上都是相同的。選擇一個並將其用於您的所有測量。

**Waveform Speed Test** [https://www.waveform.com/tools/bufferbloat](https://www.waveform.com/tools/bufferbloat)

**波形速度測試** [https://www.waveform.com/tools/bufferbloat](https://www.waveform.com/tools/bufferbloat)

[![../../_images/waveform_bufferbloat_test_post_config_tuning.png](<../images/c26a48cf-waveform_bufferbloat_test_post_config_tu.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/waveform_bufferbloat_test_post_config_tuning.png)

**Cloudflare** [https://speed.cloudflare.com/](https://speed.cloudflare.com/)

[![../../_images/cloudflare_speedtest.png](<../images/2f77ccc9-cloudflare_speedtest.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/cloudflare_speedtest.png)

**Speedtest.net** [http://speedtest.net](http://speedtest.net/)

[![../../_images/speedtest_net.png](<../images/17e13b03-speedtest_net.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/speedtest_net.png)

###### Tuning FQ\_CoDel｜調音FQ\_CoDel

After you configure the pipes and queues (above), take a few minutes to “tune” your FQ\_CoDel instance for your ISP. To do this:

配置管道和佇列（見上文）後，請花幾分鐘時間為 ISP「調整」FQ\_CoDel 實例。為此：

First, run any of the speed tests above before applying any shaper. Run several tests to get average data rates and latency. Write those values down.

首先，在應用任何整形器之前執行上述任何速度測試。運行多項測試以獲得平均數據速率和延遲。寫下這些值。

While you are configuring FQ\_CoDel, enter an initial value for the “bandwidth” that is 85% of the advertised rate from the ISP. (That is, if the download service is 100 Mbit/s, set the speed to 85 Mbit/s; for 40 Mbit/s upload, set it to 40 x 85%, or 34 Mbit/s.)

當您配置 FQ\_CoDel 時，輸入「頻寬」的初始值，即 ISP 公佈速率的 85%。 （即，如果下載業務為100Mbit/s，則將速度設定為85Mbit/s；如果上傳為40Mbit/s，則將速度設定為40×85%，即34Mbit/s。）

The remainder of the process is iterative, but brief:

該過程的其餘部分是迭代的，但很簡短：

-   Run a speed test to see the latency  
    運行速度測試以查看延遲
    
-   Increase the Download bandwidth setting a bit  
    稍微增加下載頻寬設定
    
-   Run a speed test again. If the latency remains low, increase the bandwidth setting again.  
    再次運行速度測試。如果延遲仍然較低，請再次增加頻寬設定。
    
-   Keep doing this until the latency increases, then back off the setting.  
    繼續執行此操作，直到延遲增加，然後取消設定。
    
-   Do the same with the Upload bandwidth setting  
    對上傳頻寬設定執行相同操作
    

When each of the Download and Upload bandwidth settings are as high as possible without increasing latency, you’re done.

當每個下載和上傳頻寬設定盡可能高而不增加延遲時，您就完成了。

###### Detailed FQ-CoDel Tuning｜FQ-CoDel 調音詳解

FQ\_CoDel is designed to be a “no-knobs” algorithm. After you enter the Download and Upload bandwidth settings, the defaults for the other parameters work very well out of the box for virtually all situations. Before you invest further time in tuning, try the router for a day. If it’s “good enough”, you are done.

FQ\_CoDel 被設計為「無旋鈕」演算法。輸入下載和上傳頻寬設定後，其他參數的預設值幾乎適用於所有情況。在投入更多時間進行調整之前，請先試用路由器一天。如果“足夠好”，那麼你就完成了。

Read on if you want to go further.

如果您想進一步了解，請繼續閱讀。

*FQ-CoDel “out of the box” default settings*

*FQ-CoDel「開箱即用」預設值*

<table>
<tr><th>FQ_C Parameter<br>FQ_C 參數</th><th colspan="2">Default<br>預設值</th></tr>
<tr><td>quantum<br>量子</td><td colspan="2">1514</td></tr>
<tr><td>target<br>目標</td><td colspan="2">5</td></tr>
<tr><td>interval<br>間隔</td><td colspan="2">100</td></tr>
<tr><td>limit<br>限制</td><td colspan="2">10240</td></tr>
<tr><td>flows<br>流量</td><td colspan="2">1024</td></tr>
<tr><td>ECN</td><td colspan="2">OFF</td></tr>
</table>

**quantum｜量子**

Quantum is one of these parameters that were constantly discussed what should be the proper value. Within the internet there is a lot of discussion that it should be set to 300 per 100 Mbit/s of BW. **This however is wrong.**

量子是人們不斷討論的參數之一，什麼才是適當的值。網路上有很多討論，認為應該將 BW 設定為每 100 Mbit/s 300 個。 **然而這是錯誤的。**

Quantum specifies number of bytes a queue can serve before being moved to the tail of old. As we are doing Fair Queueing we want to aim to serve all queues equally.

Quantum 指定佇列在移動到舊佇列尾部之前可以服務的位元組數。當我們進行公平排隊時，我們希望能夠平等地為所有隊列提供服務。

**The proper value of Quantum should be no more or less than is the WAN MTU.**

**正確的Quantum值不得大於或小於WAN MTU。**

Note

注意事項

At lower rates, below 100 Mbit/s, setting the quantum to 300 ensures that more smaller packets get through faster than big ones. It doesn’t matter much at higher rates. The quantum should be set to the MTU or 300 if you have low bandwidth and the cpu power. Setting the quantum lower causes more loops touching all the packets so it eats slightly more cpu

在低於 100 Mbit/s 的較低速率下，將量程設為 300 可確保更多較小的資料包比大資料包更快通過。在更高的利率下這並不重要。如果您的頻寬和 CPU 功率較低，則應將量子設定為 MTU 或 300。設定較低的量程會導致更多的循環接觸所有資料包，因此它會消耗更多的 cpu

**target & interval｜目標與間隔**

Target is the acceptable minimum standing/persistent queue delay for each FQ-CoDel queue. This minimum delay is identified by tracking the local minimum queue delay that packets experience. Target should be tuned to be at least the transmission time of a single MTU-sized packet at the WAN egress link speed.

目標是每個 FQ-CoDel 隊列可接受的最小站立/持久隊列延遲。此最小延遲是透過追蹤資料包經歷的本地最小隊列延遲來識別的。目標應至少調整為單一 MTU 大小的資料包在 WAN 出口鏈路速度下的傳輸時間。

To do this we can run excessive ping to the HOP after your OPNsense and take the **average rtt round up as your Target**. In this case 12ms

為此，我們可以在 OPNsense 之後對 HOP 運行過多 ping，並採用 **平均 rtt 向上取整作為您的目標**。在本例中為 12 毫秒

```
Example from the CLI of OPNsense

traceroute 1.1.1.1
traceroute to 1.1.1.1 (1.1.1.1), 64 hops max, 40 byte packets
1  192.168.0.1  0.463 ms  0.453 ms  0.480 ms     <<<< LAN Interface of OPN
2  10.205.5.1  10.879 ms  11.010 ms  11.079 ms   <<<< ISP directly connected Device to OPN WAN

ping -s 1472 -c 1000 -D 10.205.5.1
PING 10.205.5.1 (10.205.5.1) 1472(1500) bytes of data.
1480 bytes from 10.205.5.1: icmp_seq=0 ttl=255 time=13.1 ms
1480 bytes from 10.205.5.1: icmp_seq=1 ttl=255 time=10.4 ms

--- 10.205.5.1 ping statistics ---
1000 packets transmitted, 1000 packets received, 0.0% packet loss
round-trip min/avg/max/stddev = 7.800/11.429/45.992/4.796 ms
```

Note

注意事項

Target is a good parameter for tune to prevent CoDel being too aggressive at low BW. Otherwise Target should be around 5-10% of Interval

目標是一個很好的調整參數，可以防止 CoDel 在低 BW 時過於激進。否則目標應約為間隔的 5-10%

Interval is used to ensure that the measured minimum delay does not become too stale. It’s value is chosen to give endpoints time to react to a drop without being so long that response times suffer.

間隔用於確保測量的最小延遲不會變得太陳舊。選擇它的值是為了給端點時間來對下降做出反應，而不是太長而導致反應時間受到影響。

Note

注意事項

Interval default 100ms works usually well (10ms-1s, excels at range 10ms-300ms). If you want to tune Interval it should to be set around the worst case RTT scenario through the bottleneck

間隔預設值 100ms 通常效果很好（10ms-1s，在 10ms-300ms 範圍內表現出色）。如果你想調整間隔，它應該圍繞最壞情況RTT場景透過瓶頸設置

**limit｜限制**

Default limit size of 10240 packets is too much. The creators recommended value 1000 for sub 10 Gbit/s connections. The default limit will never be reached for sub 10 Gbit/s WAN connections. Before that could happen FQ\_CoDel would already take action. So it is healthy to reduce the limit.

10240 個資料包的預設限制大小太多了。建立者建議低於 10 Gbit/s 連線的值為 1000。對於低於 10 Gbit/s WAN 連接，永遠不會達到預設限制。在此之前，FQ\_CoDel 已經採取了行動。因此減少限制是健康的。

The over-large packet limit leads to bad results during slow start on some benchmarks. Reducing it too low could impact new flow start.

過大的資料包限制會導致某些基準測試的慢啟動期間出現不良結果。將其降低得太低可能會影響新流程的啟動。

Note

注意事項

For FreeBSD there is a [BUG](https://bugs.freebsd.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=276890) opened for CPU hogging due to excessive logging caused when the limit queue is exceeded. Additionally one of the creators of CoDel raised a [discussion](https://marc.info/?t=170776797300003&r=1&w=2) to improve the implementation of FQ\_CoDel on FreeBSD.

對於 FreeBSD，有一個 [BUG](https://bugs.freebsd.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=276890) 為 CPU 佔用而開放，因為超出限制佇列時會導致過多的日誌記錄。此外，CoDel 的一位創建者提出了[討論](https://marc.info/?t=170776797300003&r=1&w=2)，以改進 FQ\_CoDel 在 FreeBSD 上的實作。

Note

注意事項

The CPU hogging due to excessive logging was [fixed](https://github.com/opnsense/src/commit/8684f75c425) for OPNsense by the devs on release 25.7.8 Its now safe and beneficial to use the limit parameter and lower it from the default value.

由於過多日誌記錄而造成的 CPU 佔用已由開發人員在版本 25.7.8 的 OPNsense 中[修復](https://github.com/opnsense/src/commit/8684f75c425) 現在使用限制參數並將其從默認值降低是安全且有益的。

**flows｜流量**

The “flows” parameter sets the number of queues into which the incoming packets are classified. Due to the stochastic nature of hashing, multiple flows may end up being hashed into the same slot.

“flows”參數設定傳入資料包分類的佇列數量。由於散列的隨機性，多個流可能最終被散列到同一個槽。

This parameter can be set only at initialization time in the current implementation (needs reboot of device), since memory has to be allocated for the hash table.

在目前實作中，只能在初始化時設定此參數（需要重新啟動裝置），因為必須為哈希表分配記憶體。

Warning

警告

Setting too high number can cause the device to be stuck. Be careful with this one.

設定過高的數字可能會導致設備卡住。小心這個。

**ECN**

Current best practice is to turn off ECN on uplinks running at less than 4 Mbit/s (if you want good VOIP performance; a single packet at 1 Mbit/s takes 13ms, and packet drops get you this latency back).

目前的最佳實踐是在運行速度低於 4 Mbit/s 的上行鏈路上關閉 ECN（如果您想要良好的 VOIP 性能；1 Mbit/s 的單個數據包需要 13 毫秒，丟包會讓您恢復此延遲）。

ECN IS useful on downlinks on a home router, where the terminating hop is only one or two hops away, and connected to a system that handles ECN correctly.

ECN IS 對於家庭路由器的下行鏈路非常有用，其中終止跳點僅距一跳或兩跳，並且連接到正確處理 ECN 的系統。

Note

注意事項

If you are experiencing slow starts disable ECN

如果您遇到啟動緩慢的情況，請停用ECN

<a id="p-145"></a>

##### Control Plane Shaping｜控制平面整形

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/shaper_control_plane.html>

Planes of Operation is a concept to describe and divide the functionality of a network device.

操作平面是描述和劃分網路設備功能的概念。

In essence, the concept creates logical layers in which packets are categorized per their use and type.

本質上，這個概念創建了邏輯層，其中資料包根據其用途和類型進行分類。

There are 3 Planes:

有 3 個平面：

1.  **The control plane**  
    **控制平面**
    
    Affects the operability of the network.

    影響網路的可操作性。
    
    The control plane is the brain of the router. It consists of dynamic IP routing protocols (that is OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, and so on), the RIB, routing updates, in addition to other protocols such as PIM, IGMP, ICMP, ARP, BFD, LACP, and so on. In short, the control plane is responsible for maintaining the network topology and exchanging protocol information with other routers or network devices.

    控制平面是路由器的大腦。它由動態IP路由協定（即OSPF, IS-IS, BGP等）、RIB、路由更新以及其他協定如PIM, IGMP, ICMP, ARP, BFD, LACP等組成。簡而言之，控制平面負責維護網路拓撲並與其他路由器或網路設備交換協定資訊。
    
2.  **The management plane**  
    **管理平面**
    
    Affects the manageability of the network.

    影響網路的可管理性。
    
    The management plane is used to manage a device through its connection to the network. Examples of protocols processed in the management plane include Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP), Telnet, File Transfer Protocol (FTP), Secure FTP, and Secure Shell (SSH). These management protocols are used for monitoring and for command-line interface (CLI) access.

    管理平面用於透過設備與網路的連接來管理設備。在管理平面中處理的協定範例包括簡單網路管理協定（SNMP）、Telnet、檔案傳輸協定（FTP）、安全性FTP和安全Shell（SSH）。這些管理協定用於監控和命令列介面 (CLI) 存取。
    
3.  **The data plane**  
    **數據平面**
    
    Affects the applications of the user.

    影響用戶的應用程式。
    
    The data plane is the forwarding plane, which is responsible for the switching of packets through the router.

    資料平面是轉送平面，負責透過路由器進行封包的交換。
    

###### Necessity of Control Plane Shaping｜控制平面整形的必要性

The control plane is a necessary component for proper network operation. A congested state of the network, if the control plane is not properly managed, will result in network disruptions. In order to guarantee operation and avoid disruption in such events, we can take advantage of Traffic Shaping.

控制平面是網路正常運作的必要組件。如果控制平面管理不當，網路擁塞狀態將導致網路中斷。為了確保運作並避免此類事件造成中斷，我們可以利用流量整形。

**With Shaping, we can reserve dedicated bandwidth for the control plane**

**透過Shaping，我們可以為控制平面預留專用頻寬**

Attention

注意

The control plane should not share a class (Pipe or Queue) with any other traffic type.

控制平面不應與任何其他流量類型共用類別（管道或佇列）。

###### Configuring Control plane for OPNsense｜為 OPNsense 配置控制平面

The configuration will take into account the existence of an already configured shaper as per [Fighting Bufferbloat with FQ\_CoDel](#p-144)

此配置將考慮已配置的整形器的存在，依照 [Fighting Bufferbloat with FQ\_CoDel](#p-144)

In the configuration steps below, assume these tuned speeds:

在下面的配置步驟中，假設這些調整速度：

|  | Download<br>下載 | Upload<br>上傳 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mbit/s<br>兆位元/秒 | 495 | 30<br>495 30 |

Bandwidth allocation requirements for Control plane:

控制平面的頻寬分配要求：

| 1% of BW<br>BW 的 1% | Download<br>下載 | Upload<br>上傳 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mbit/s<br>兆位元/秒 | 5 | 1 |

The 1% is the default lowest value, at minimum the BW should be set to 1Mbit/s. Its subjected to be increased if needed.

1% 是預設的最低值，BW 至少應設定為 1Mbit/s。如果需要的話可以增加。

Attention

注意

BW given to a different Pipe needs to be subtracted from already existing ones.

給予不同管道的BW需要從現有的管道中減去。

Schedulers available for Control plane shaping:

可用來控制平面整形的調度程序：

| Schedulers<br>調度程序 | Usable<br>可用 | Note<br>注意 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FIFO | NO | No weight merit<br>沒有體重優勢 |
| WFQ | YES | weight merit<br>體重優點 |
| DRR | NO | causing latency<br>導致延遲 |
| QFQ | YES | weight merit<br>體重優點 |
| FQ\_CoDel | NO | AQM back-pressure<br>AQM 背壓 |
| FQ\_PIE | NO | AQM back-pressure<br>AQM 背壓 |

In this example we will create a Shaper for the IPv6 Control plane.

在此範例中，我們將為 IPv6 控制平面建立一個 Shaper。

To begin, go to Firewall ‣ Shaper ‣ Pipes. Select the *advanced mode*

首先，前往 Firewall ‣ Shaper ‣ Pipes。選擇*進階模式*

**Step 1a - Create Download Pipe｜步驟 1a - 建立下載管道**

On the **Pipes** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit Pipe** screen pops up.

在 **管道**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。彈出一個空的**編輯管道**螢幕。

**Create Control-plane-Pipe For Download｜建立控制平面管道以供下載**

| Setting<br>設定 | Default<br>預設 | Description<br>描述 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **enabled**<br>**啟用** | Checked<br>已檢查 | *Check to enable the pipe*<br>*檢查以啟用管道* |
| **bandwidth**<br>**頻寬** | 5 | *Set initially to 1% of tuned BW, increase if needed*<br>*初始設定為調諧BW的 1%，若需要則增加* |
| **bandwidth Metric**<br>**頻寬指標** | Mbit/s<br>兆位元/秒 | *Metric associated with the bandwidth*<br>*與頻寬相關的指標* |
| **queue**<br>**佇列** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty: queues are configured separately*<br>*留空：佇列單獨配置* |
| **mask**<br>**面具** | (none)<br>（無） | *Leave empty*<br>*留空* |
| **scheduler type**<br>**調度程序類型** | WFQ | *Default or QFQ, allows to use weights per queues*<br>*預設或QFQ，允許使用每個佇列的權重* |
| **Enable CoDel**<br>**啟用 CoDel** | (empty)<br>（空白） | *Leave empty*<br>*留空* |
| **(FQ-)CoDel target**<br>**(FQ-)CoDel 目標** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty*<br>*留空* |
| **(FQ-)CoDel interval**<br>**(FQ-)CoDel 間隔** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty*<br>*留空* |
| **(FQ-)CoDel ECN** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty*<br>*留空* |
| **FQ-CoDel quantum**<br>**FQ-CoDel 量子** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty*<br>*留空* |
| **FQ-CoDel limit**<br>**FQ-CoDel 限制** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty*<br>*留空* |
| **FQ-CoDel flows**<br>**FQ-CoDel 流程** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty*<br>*留空* |
| **description**<br>**描述** | Control-plane-Pipe-Download<br>控制平面管道下載 | *Free field, enter something descriptive*<br>*自由字段，輸入描述性內容* |

**Step 1b - Create Upload Pipe｜步驟 1b - 建立上傳管道**

On the **Pipes** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit Pipe** screen pops up.

在 **管道**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。彈出一個空的**編輯管道**螢幕。

Follow the same process as for the Download pipe, entering the 1% of tuned bandwidth value, and entering “Control-plane-Pipe-Upload”（控制平面管道上傳） for the **description**.

依照下載管道相同的流程，輸入 1% 的調整頻寬值，並輸入 “Control-plane-Pipe-Upload”（控制平面管道上傳） 作為 **說明**。

**Step 2a - Create Download Queue｜步驟 2a - 建立下載佇列**

On the **Queues** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit queue** screen pops up.

在 **佇列**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。彈出一個空的**編輯佇列**螢幕。

**Create Control-plane-IPv6-Queue For Download｜建立控制平面 IPv6 佇列以供下載**

|   |   |   |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **enabled**<br>**啟用** | Checked<br>已檢查 | *Check to enable the queue*<br>*檢查以啟用佇列* |
| **pipe**<br>**管道** | Control-plane-Pipe-Download<br>控制平面管道下載 | *Select our Pipe*<br>*選擇我們的管道* |
| **weight**<br>**重量** | 100 | *The higher weight the higher the ratio of BW a queue gets*<br>100 *權重越高，隊列獲得BW的比例就越高* |
| **mask**<br>**面具** | (none)<br>（無） | *Leave empty for a queue*<br>*為佇列留空* |
| **Enable CoDel**<br>**啟用 CoDel** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty for a queue*<br>*為佇列留空* |
| **(FQ-)CoDel target**<br>**(FQ-)CoDel 目標** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty for a queue*<br>*為佇列留空* |
| **(FQ-)CoDel interval**<br>**(FQ-)CoDel 間隔** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty for a queue*<br>*為佇列留空* |
| **(FQ-)CoDel ECN** | (empty)<br>（空） | *Leave empty for a queue*<br>*為佇列留空* |
| **description**<br>**描述** | Control-plane-IPv6-Queue-Download<br>控制平面 IPv6 佇列下載 | *Free field, enter something descriptive*<br>*自由字段，輸入描述性內容* |

Note

注意事項

Using WFQ or QFQ and weights, we can tell how much BW each protocol control plane will get.

使用WFQ或QFQ和權重，我們可以知道每個協議控制平面將獲得多少BW。

**Step 2b - Create Upload Queue｜步驟 2b - 建立上傳佇列**

On the **Queues** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit queue** screen pops up.

在 **佇列**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。彈出一個空的**編輯佇列**螢幕。

Follow the same process as for the Download queue, selecting the **“Control-plane-Pipe-Upload”（控制平面管道上傳）**, and entering “Control-plane-IPv6-Queue-Upload”（控制平面 IPv6 佇列上傳） for the **description**.

依照與下載佇列相同的過程，選擇 **“Control-plane-Pipe-Upload”（控制平面管道上傳）**，並輸入 “Control-plane-IPv6-Queue-Upload”（控制平面 IPv6 佇列上傳） 作為**描述**。

**Step 3a - Create Download Rule｜步驟 3a - 建立下載規則**

On the **Rules** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit rule** screen pops up.

在 **規則**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。彈出一個空的**編輯規則**畫面。

**Create a Control-plane-IPv6-Rule For Download｜建立用於下載的控制平面 IPv6 規則**

|   |   |   |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **enabled**<br>**啟用** | Checked<br>已檢查 | *Check to enable the rule*<br>*檢查以啟用規則* |
| **sequence**<br>**序列** | 1 | *Auto generated number, overwrite only when needed*<br>*自動產生編號，僅在需要時覆蓋* |
| **interface**<br>**介面** | WAN | *Select the interface connected to the internet*<br>*選擇連接到網際網路的介面* |
| **proto**<br>**原型** | ipv6-icmp<br>ipv6 icmp | *Select the protocol, ipv6-icmp in our example*<br>*在我們的範例中選擇協定 ipv6-icmp* |
| **source**<br>**來源** | any<br>任何 | *The source address to shape, leave on any*<br>*要整形的來源位址，保留任意* |
| **src-port**<br>**來源端口** | any<br>任何 | *The source port to shape, leave on any*<br>*要塑造的來源端口，保留任何* |
| **destination**<br>**目的地** | any<br>任何 | *The destination IP to shape, leave on any*<br>*目的地IP塑造，留下任意* |
| **dst-port**<br>**目標端口** | any<br>任何 | *The destination port to shape, leave on any*<br>*目的港自行塑造，任意留任* |
| **direction**<br>**方向** | in<br>在 | *Matches incoming or outgoing packets or both (default). We want to shape Download e.g ingress on WAN*<br>*符合傳入或傳出資料包或兩者（預設）。我們想要塑造下載，例如 WAN* 上的入口 |
| **target**<br>**目標** | Control-plane-IPv6-Queue-Download<br>控制平面 IPv6 佇列下載 | *Select the Download queue*<br>*選擇下載佇列* |
| **description**<br>**描述** | Control-plane-IPv6-Rule-Download<br>控制平面 IPv6 規則下載 | *Enter a descriptive name*<br>*輸入描述性名稱* |

**Step 3b - Create Upload Rule｜步驟 3b - 建立上傳規則**

On the **Rules** tab click the **+** button in the lower right corner. An empty **Edit rule** screen pops up.

在 **規則**標籤上，按一下右下角的**+**按鈕。彈出一個空的**編輯規則**畫面。

Follow the same process as for the Download rule, using the same values except:

按照與下載規則相同的過程，使用相同的值，但以下情況除外：

-   **sequence** (set to 2);  
    **序列**（設定為2）；
    
-   **direction** (set to “out”)  
    **方向**（設定為“出”）
    
-   **target** (set to “Control-plane-IPv6-Queue-Upload”（控制平面 IPv6 佇列上傳）);  
    **目標**（設定為“Control-plane-IPv6-Queue-Upload”（控制平面 IPv6 佇列上傳））；
    
-   **description** (set to “Control-plane-IPv6-Rule-Upload”（控制平面 IPv6 規則上傳）)  
    **描述**（設定為“Control-plane-IPv6-Rule-Upload”（控制平面 IPv6 規則上傳））
    

Attention

注意

The sequences needs to be at least 1 less than the default any rules or rules that would catch this traffic type and you may need to adjust the other rule sequence values accordingly.

這些序列需要比預設的任何規則或捕獲此流量類型的規則至少少 1，並且您可能需要相應地調整其他規則序列值。

**Step 4 - Finalizing the configuration｜第 4 步 - 完成配置**

Now press **Apply** to activate the traffic shaping rules.

現在按 **應用** 啟動流量整形規則。

---

###### Additional Control plane per protocol｜每個協定的附加控制平面

In case we need to create control plane of additional protocols such as BGP, PIM, etc. We can use the already created “Control-plane-Pipe”（控制平面管道）. Simple add Queues with proper weights and Rules into this specific Pipe matching the traffic.

如果我們需要建立額外協定的控制平面，例如BGP, PIM等，我們可以使用已經建立的“Control-plane-Pipe”（控制平面管道）。簡單地將具有適當權重和規則的佇列新增至與流量相符的特定管道中。
