筆記

Technical details about the options can be found in the [man](https://www.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=radvd.conf) page of radvd

#### [Configuration examples](#p-197)｜[設定範例](#p-197)

##### [Advertise a prefix on LAN](#p-197)｜[在LAN上投放前綴廣告](#p-197)

The most common configuration would be DHCPv6 on the WAN interface and receiving a routed prefix via DHCPv6-PD. When setting the LAN IPv6 configuration to either of “Track Interface (legacy)” or “Identity association” with a unique prefix ID, router advertisements can send that prefix and a default route to clients.

最常見的設定是在WAN介面上啟用 DHCPv6，並透過 DHCPv6- PD接收路由前綴。當將LAN IPv6 配置設定為“追蹤介面（傳統）”或“身份關聯”，並分配一個唯一的前綴ID時，路由器通告可以向客戶端發送該前綴和預設路由。

Go to Services ‣ Router Advertisements and add a new entry:

前往“服務”‣“路由器通告”，然後新增條目：

| **Option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled**<br>**已啟用** | X |
| **Interface**<br>**接口** | LAN |

Press **Save** and **Apply**

按**儲存**並**應用**

Per default, RDNSS and DNSSL options will be sent to clients, containing the IPv6 address of the LAN interface, and the default system domain.

預設情況下， RDNSS和DNSSL選項將傳送給客戶端，其中包含LAN介面的 IPv6 位址和預設系統域。

##### [Advertise multiple prefixes on LAN](#p-197)｜[在LAN上刊登多個前綴廣告](#p-197)

If an ULA (Unique Local Address) prefix should be sent in addition to a GUA (Global Unicast Address) prefix, create a virtual IPv6 address in Interfaces ‣ Virtual IPs. Configure it on the LAN interface, make sure the prefix length is /64.

如果除了ULA （全域單播位址）前綴之外，還需要傳送GUA （唯一本地位址）前綴，請在「介面」‣「虛擬 IP」中建立一個虛擬 IPv6 位址。將其配置在LAN介面上，並確保前綴長度為 /64。

Afterwards, applying the configuration in Services ‣ Router Advertisements will configure the additional prefix.

之後，在「服務」‣「路由器通告」中套用設定將設定附加前綴。

##### [DHCPv6](#p-197)｜[DHCPv6](#p-197)

Router Advertisements are sufficient for clients to auto-generate a SLAAC address, receive a default gateway and a DNS server. These are the basic requirement for IPv6 connectivity.

路由器通告足以讓客戶端自動產生SLAAC位址，並接收預設閘道和DNS伺服器。這些是IPv6連線的基本要求。

There can be advanced requirements like hostname registration, static reservations and DHCPv6 options.

可能存在一些進階要求，例如主機名稱註冊、靜態保留和 DHCPv6 選項。

For these cases, there are two DHCPv6 servers available: [KEA](#p-196) and [Dnsmasq](#p-194). As Dnsmasq is best used with its own router advertisement functionality, KEA is the most logical choice to pair with radvd. This is especially true for HA setups, as KEA can synchronize IPv6 leases.

對於這些情況，有兩個 DHCPv6 伺服器可用：[KEA](#p-196)和 [Dnsmasq](#p-194) 。由於 Dnsmasq 最好與自己的路由器通告功能配合使用，因此KEA是與 radvd 搭配使用的最合理選擇。對於HA設定尤其如此，因為KEA可以同步 IPv6 位址租約。

Attention

注意

A combination of KEA and radvd requires a static WAN prefix, as KEA cannot track prefixes dynamically.

KEA和 radvd 的組合需要一個靜態的WAN前綴，因為KEA無法動態追蹤前綴。

To advertise a DHCPv6 server to clients, configure the available [modes](#p-197) to your requirements.

若要向用戶端通告 DHCPv6 伺服器，請依照您的要求設定可用的 [模式](#p-197) 。

##### [High availability](#p-197)｜[高可用性](#p-197)

For high availability with IPv6, static prefixes are a requirement for seamless failover.

對於 IPv6 的高可用性而言，靜態前綴是實現無縫故障轉移的必要條件。

You can follow this setup example: [Configure CARP](#p-148)

您可以參考以下設定範例：[配置CARP](#p-148)

<a id="p-198"></a>

### OpenDNS

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/opendns.html>

[OpenDNS](https://www.opendns.com/) is a company and service that extends the Domain Name System (DNS) by adding features such as phishing protection and optional content filtering in addition to DNS lookup, if its DNS servers are used.

[OpenDNS](https://www.opendns.com/)是一家公司和服務，它擴展了域名系統 ( DNS )，除了DNS查找之外，還添加了諸如網絡釣魚保護和可選內容過濾等功能（如果使用其DNS服務器）。

When you are behind a static IP address, usually it should be enough to just enter the OpenDNS name servers in System ‣ Settings ‣ General.

當您使用靜態IP位址時，通常只需在「系統」‣「設定」‣「常規」中輸入 OpenDNS 名稱伺服器即可。

#### Settings｜設定

A minimum amount of settings is needed in order to register with OpenDNS.

要註冊 OpenDNS，只需進行最少的設定。

---

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | If enabled, the firewall will signal OpenDNS about address changes<br>若啟用，防火牆將向 OpenDNS 發出位址變更通知 |
| Username<br>使用者名稱 | Username registered with OpenDNS<br>在 OpenDNS 註冊的使用者名稱 |
| Password<br>密碼 | Associated password<br>關聯密碼 |
| Network<br>網路 | The network name configured on the [Networks Dashboard](https://www.opendns.com/dashboard/networks/) of OpenDNS under ‘Manage your networks’. Used to update the node’s IP address whenever the WAN interface changes its IP address.<br>在 OpenDNS 的 [網路控制面板](https://www.opendns.com/dashboard/networks/)下的「管理您的網路」中設定的網路名稱。用於在WAN介面更改其IP位址時更新節點的IP位址。 |

Note

筆記

When disabling the service, please check your name servers in System ‣ Settings ‣ General, since this feature removed the previous ones.

停用該服務時，請檢查系統‣設定‣常規中的網域名稱伺服器，因為此功能會刪除先前的網域名稱伺服器。

<a id="p-199"></a>

### Unbound DNS｜未綁定DNS

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/unbound.html>

Unbound is a validating, recursive, caching DNS resolver. It is designed to be fast and lean and incorporates modern features based on open standards.

Unbound 是驗證型、遞歸型、快取型的DNS解析器。它的設計目標是快速、精簡，並融合了基於開放標準的現代功能。

Since OPNsense 17.7 it has been our standard DNS service, which on a new install is enabled by default.

自 OPNsense 17.7以來，它一直是我們的標準DNS服務，在新安裝時預設為啟用。

#### General settings｜常規設定

Warning

警告

Below table contains the options to manually set **listening** and **outbound** interfaces, the recommended setting for both is `"All"` for good reasons. Unless you absolutely know what you are doing, best keep these settings default as misuse often causes startup issues.

下表列出了手動設定**監聽**和**出站**介面的選項，出於充分的理由，建議將兩者均設為`"All"` 。除非您非常清楚自己在做什麼，否則最好保持這些設定的預設值，因為誤用通常會導致啟動問題。

Below you will find the most relevant settings from the **General** menu section.

您可以在下面的**常規**選單部分找到最相關的設定。

---

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Enable<br>啟用 | Enable our DNS resolver<br>啟用我們的DNS解析器 |
| Listen Port<br>監聽埠 | Port to listen on, when blank, the default (53) is used.<br>要偵聽的端口，如果為空，則使用預設值 (53)。 |
| Network Interfaces<br>網路介面 | Interface IP addresses used for responding to queries from clients. If an interface has both IPv4 and IPv6 IPs, both are used. Queries to other interface IPs not selected are discarded. The default behavior is to respond to queries on every available IPv4 and IPv6 address.<br>介面IP位址，用於回應客戶端的查詢。如果介面同時具有 IPv4 和 IPv6 IP，則同時使用兩者。對未選擇的其他介面 IP 的查詢將被丟棄。預設行為是回應每個可用 IPv4 和 IPv6 位址的查詢。 |
| DNSSEC | Enable [DNSSEC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Domain_Name_System_Security_Extensions) to use digital signatures to validate results from upstream servers and mitigate against [cache poisoning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DNS_spoofing).<br>啟用 [DNSSEC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Domain_Name_System_Security_Extensions)使用數位簽章來驗證來自上游伺服器的結果，並緩解 [緩存中毒](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DNS_spoofing)風險。 |
| DNS64 | Enable [DNS64](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPv6_transition_mechanism#DNS64) so IPv6-only clients can reach IPv4-only servers. If enabled, Unbound synthesizes AAAA records for domains which only have A records. DNS64 requires NAT64 to be useful, e. g. the Tayga plugin or a third-party NAT64 service. The DNS64 prefix must match the IPv6 prefix used be the NAT64.<br>啟用 [DNS64](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IPv6_transition_mechanism#DNS64)，以便純 IPv6 用戶端可以存取純 IPv4 伺服器。如果啟用，Unbound 會為僅具有 A 記錄的域合成 AAAA 記錄。 DNS64 需要 NAT64 才有用，例如。 g。 Tayga 外掛程式或第三方 NAT64 服務。 DNS64 前綴必須與NAT64 使用的 IPv6 前綴相符。 |
| AAAA-only mode<br>AAAA -僅限模式 | If this option is set, Unbound will remove all A records from the answer section of all responses.<br>如果啟用此選項，Unbound 將從所有回應的答案部分中刪除所有 A 記錄。 |
| Register ISC DHCP4 Leases<br>註冊ISC DHCP4 租賃 | **IPv4 only** If this option is set, then machines that specify their hostname when requesting a DHCP lease will be registered in Unbound, so that their names can be resolved.<br>The source of this data is **client-hostname** in the [dhcpd.leases](https://www.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=dhcpd.leases) file. This can also be inspected using the [Leases](#p-192) page.<br>**僅限 IPv4**如果設定此選項，則在請求 DHCP 租約時指定其主機名的機器將在 Unbound 中註冊，以便可以解析其名稱。 <br>此資料的來源是 [dhcpd.leases](https://www.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=dhcpd.leases) 檔案中的**client-hostname**。也可以使用[Leases](#p-192)頁面檢查。 |
| DHCP Domain Override<br>DHCP域名覆蓋 | When the above registrations shouldn’t use the same domain name as configured on this firewall, you can specify a different one here.<br>如果上述註冊不應使用與此防火牆上配置的域名相同的域名，您可以在此處指定不同的域名。 |
| Register DHCP Static Mappings<br>註冊DHCP靜態映射 | Register static dhcpd entries so clients can resolve them. Supported on IPv4 and IPv6.<br>註冊靜態 DHCP 條目，以便用戶端可以解析它們。支援 IPv4 和 IPv6。 |
| No IPv6 Link-local aaddresses<br>沒有 IPv6 連結本地地址 | Do not register link local addresses for IPv6. This will prevent the return of unreachable addresses when more than one listen interface is configured.<br>不要註冊 IPv6 的鏈路本地地址。當配置多個偵聽介面時，這將防止返回無法到達的位址。 |
| System A/AAAA records<br>系統A/AAAA記錄 | If this option is set, then no A/AAAA records for the configured listen interfaces will be generated. This also means that no PTR records will be created. If desired, you can manually add A/AAAA records in [Overrides](#p-199). Use this to control which interface IP addresses are mapped to the system host/domain name as well as to restrict the amount of information exposed in replies to queries for the system host/domain name.<br>如果設定此選項，則不會為配置的監聽介面產生 A/AAAA 記錄。這也意味著不會建立任何 PTR 記錄。如果需要，您可以在[覆蓋](#p-199)中手動新增A/AAAA記錄。使用它來控制將哪個介面IP位址對應到系統主機/域名，並限制在系統主機/域名查詢的回覆中公開的資訊量。 |
| TXT Comment Support<br>TXT註解支援 | Register descriptions as comments for dhcp static host entries.<br>將描述註冊為 DHCP 靜態主機條目的註解。 |
| Force SafeSearch<br>強制使用安全搜尋 | Force the usage of SafeSearch on Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Qwant, PixaBay and YouTube.<br>強制 Google、DuckDuckGo、Bing、Qwant、PixaBay 和 YouTube 使用安全搜尋。 |
| Outgoing Network Interfaces<br>傳出網路介面 | Utilize different network interfaces that Unbound will use to send queries to authoritative servers and receive their replies. By default all interfaces are used. Note that setting explicit outgoing interfaces only works when they are statically configured.<br>利用 Unbound 將使用的不同網路介面向權威伺服器發送查詢並接收其回應。預設情況下使用所有介面。請注意，設定明確傳出介面僅在靜態配置時才有效。 |
| Local Zone Type<br>本地區域類型 | The local zone type used for the system domain. Type descriptions are available under “local-zone:” in the [unbound.conf(5)](https://nlnetlabs.nl/documentation/unbound/unbound.conf/) manual page. The default is ‘transparent’.<br>用於系統域的本地區域類型。類型描述可在 [unbound.conf(5)](https://nlnetlabs.nl/documentation/unbound/unbound.conf/)手冊頁的「local-zone:」部分找到。預設值為“transparent”。 |

Note

筆記

In order for the client to query unbound, there need to be an ACL assigned in Services ‣ Unbound DNS ‣ Access Lists. The configured interfaces should gain an ACL automatically. If the client address is not in any of the predefined networks, please add one manually.

為了讓客戶端能夠查詢非綁定資源，需要在「服務」‣「非綁定」 DNS 「存取清單」中指派ACL 。已配置的介面應自動獲得ACL 。如果用戶端位址不在任何預先定義網路中，請手動新增一個。

#### Overrides｜覆蓋

Within the overrides section you can create separate host definition entries and specify if queries for a specific domain should be forwarded to a predefined server.

在覆蓋部分，您可以建立單獨的主機定義項目，並指定是否應將特定網域的查詢轉送至預先定義的伺服器。

##### **Host override settings**｜**主機覆蓋設定**

Host overrides can be used to change DNS results from client queries or to add custom DNS records. PTR records are also generated under the hood to support reverse DNS lookups. These are generated in the following way:

主機覆蓋可用於變更客戶端查詢的 DNS 結果或新增自訂 DNS 記錄。也會在背景產生PTR記錄以支援反向DNS查找。它們是透過以下方式產生的：

-   If **System A/AAAA records** in [General settings](#p-199) is unchecked, a PTR record is created for the primary interface.  
    如果 [常規設定](#p-199)中的 **系統 A/ AAAA記錄** 未選中，則會為主介面建立PTR記錄。
    
-   Each host override entry **that does not include a wildcard for a host**, is assigned a PTR record.  
    每個主機覆蓋條目**不包含主機通配符**，都會分配一個PTR記錄。
    
-   If a host override entry **includes a wildcard for a host**, the first defined alias is assigned a PTR record.  
    如果主機覆蓋條目**包含主機的通配符**，則第一個定義的別名將被指派一個PTR記錄。
    
-   Every other alias does not get a PTR record.  
    其他所有別名都不會獲得PTR記錄。
    

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Host<br>主機名 | Name of the host, without domain part. Use “\*” to create a wildcard entry.<br>主機名，不包含網域部分。使用“*”建立通配符條目。 |
| Domain<br>網域 | Domain of the host (such as example.com)<br>主機的網域名稱（例如 example.com） |
| Type<br>類型 | Record type, A or AAA (IPv4 or IPv6 address), MX to define a mail exchange<br>記錄類型，A 或AAA （IPv4 或 IPv6 位址）， MX用於定義郵件交換 |
| IP | Address of the host<br>主機位址 |
| Description<br>描述 | User readable description, only for informational purposes<br>使用者可讀的描述，僅供參考 |
| Aliases<br>別名 | Copies of the above data for different hosts<br>上述資料在不同主機上的副本 |

**Aliases**

**別名**

You may create alternative names for a Host. E.g. when having a webserver with several virtual hosts you create a Host override entry with the IP and name for the webserver and an alias name for every virtual host on this webserver.

您可以為主機建立別名。例如，當一個 Web 伺服器有多個虛擬主機時，您可以建立一個主機覆蓋條目，其中包含IP和 Web 伺服器的名稱，以及該 Web 伺服器上每個虛擬主機的別名。

You have to select the host in the top list and it will the show you the assigned aliases in the bottom list.

您需要在頂部清單中選擇主機，然後它會在底部清單中顯示已指派的別名。

##### **Domain override settings**｜**域覆蓋設定**

Important

重要

Domain overrides has been superseded by [Query Forwarding](#p-199). Query forwarding also allows you to forward every single request.

域覆蓋已被 [查詢轉送](#p-199)取代。查詢轉發還允許您轉發每個請求。

#### Advanced｜先進的

Although the default settings should be reasonable for most setups, some need more tuning or require specific options set. Some of these settings are enabled and given a default value by Unbound, refer to [unbound.conf(5)](https://nlnetlabs.nl/documentation/unbound/unbound.conf/) for the defaults.

雖然預設設定對於大多數配置來說都比較合理，但有些配置需要進一步調整或設定特定選項。其中一些設定由 Unbound 啟用並賦予預設值，請參閱 [unbound.conf(5)](https://nlnetlabs.nl/documentation/unbound/unbound.conf/)以了解預設值。

---

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Hide Identity<br>隱藏身分 | If enabled, id.server and hostname.bind queries are refused.<br>若啟用，則會拒絕 id.server 和 hostname.bind 查詢。 |
| Hide Version<br>隱藏版本 | If enabled version.server and version.bind queries are refused.<br>如果啟用，則 version.server 和 version.bind 查詢將被拒絕。 |
| Prefetch Support<br>預取支援 | Message cache elements are prefetched before they expire to help keep the cache up to date. When enabled, this option can cause an increase of around 10% more DNS traffic and load on the server, but frequently requested items will not expire from the cache.<br>訊息快取元素在過期之前被預取，以幫助保持快取最新。啟用後，此選項可能會導致伺服器上的DNS流量和負載增加約 10%，但頻繁請求的項目不會從快取中過期。 |
| Prefetch DNS Key Support<br>預取DNS金鑰支援 | DNSKEY’s are fetched earlier in the validation process when a Delegation signer is encountered. This helps lower the latency of requests but does utilize a little more CPU.<br>DNSKEY金鑰會在驗證過程中遇到委託簽署者時提前取得。這有助於降低請求延遲，但會佔用更多CPU資源。 |
| Harden DNSSEC data<br>加強DNSSEC資料 | DNSSEC data is required for trust-anchored zones. If such data is absent, the zone becomes bogus. If this is disabled and no DNSSEC data is received, then the zone is made insecure.<br>信任錨定區域需要DNSSEC資料。如果缺少此類數據，則該區域將變為偽造區域。如果停用此功能且未收到DNSSEC數據，則該區域將變得不安全。 |
| Serve expired responses<br>提供過期回應 | Serve expired responses from the cache with a TTL of 0 without waiting for the actual resolution to finish. When checked, multiple options to customize the behaviour regarding expired responses will appear.<br>從快取中提供TTL為 0 的過期回應，無需等待實際解析完成。選取此項目後，將顯示多個選項，用於自訂過期回應的處理方式。 |
| Expired Record Reply TTL Value<br>過期記錄回復TTL值 | TTL value to use when replying with expired data. If “Client Expired Response Timeout”（客戶端回應逾時） is also used then it is recommended to use 30 as the default value as per RFC 8767. Only applicable when “Serve expired responses” is checked.<br>TTL用於回復過期資料時的值。如果同時使用“Client Expired Response Timeout”（客戶端回應逾時） ，則建議根據RFC 8767 將預設值設為 30。僅當選取「提供過期回應」時適用。 |
| TTL for Expired Responses<br>TTL 過期回覆 | Limits the serving of expired responses to the configured amount of seconds after expiration. A value of 0 disables the limit. A suggested value as per RFC 8767 is between 86400 (1 day) and 259200 (3 days). Only applicable when “Serve expired responses” is checked.<br>將過期回應的服務限制為過期後配置的秒數。值為 0 會停用該限制。根據 RFC 8767，建議值介於 86400（1 天）和 259200（3 天）之間。僅在選取「提供過期回應」時適用。 |
| Reset Expired Record TTL<br>重設過期記錄TTL | Set the TTL of expired records to the “TTL for Expired Responses”（過期回應的生存時間） value after a failed attempt to retrieve the record from an upstream server. This makes sure that the expired records will be served as long as there are queries for it. Only applicable when “Serve expired responses” is checked.<br>嘗試從上游伺服器擷取記錄失敗後，將過期記錄的 TTL 設定為 “TTL for Expired Responses”（過期回應的生存時間） 值。這可以確保只要有查詢，就會提供過期記錄。僅在選取「提供過期回應」時適用。 |
| Client Expired Response Timeout<br>客戶端回應逾時 | Time in milliseconds before replying to the client with expired data. This essentially enables the serve- stable behavior as specified in RFC 8767 that first tries to resolve before immediately responding with expired data. A recommended value per RF 8767 is 1800. Setting this to 0 will disable this behavior. Only applicable when “Serve expired responses” is checked.<br>使用過期資料回覆客戶端之前的時間（以毫秒為單位）。這本質上實現了 RFC 8767 中指定的服務穩定行為，該行為首先嘗試解決，然後立即使用過期資料進行回應。每個 RF 8767 的建議值為 1800。將其設為 0 將停用此行為。僅在選取「提供過期回應」時適用。 |
| Strict QNAME Minimisation<br>嚴格QNAME最小化 | Send minimum amount of information to upstream servers to enhance privacy. Do not fall-back to sending full QNAME to potentially broken nameservers. A lot of domains will not be resolvable when this option in enabled. Only use if you know what you are doing.<br>傳送最少量的資訊給上游伺服器以增強隱私保護。不要回退到向可能已損壞的網域名稱伺服器發送完整的QNAME資訊。啟用此選項後，許多網域將無法解析。僅在您清楚自己在做什麼的情況下使用。 |
| Extended Statistics<br>擴展統計資訊 | If enabled, extended statistics are printed to syslog.<br>如果啟用，擴展統計資訊將列印到系統日誌中。 |
| Log Queries<br>日誌查詢 | If enabled, prints one line per query to the log, with the log timestamp and IP address, name, type and class. Note that it takes time to print these lines, which makes the server (significantly) slower. Odd (non-printable) characters in names are printed as ‘?’.<br>如果啟用，則將每個查詢列印一行到日誌，其中包含日誌時間戳記和 IP 位址、名稱、類型和類別。請注意，列印這些行需要時間，這會使伺服器（顯著）變慢。名稱中的奇數（不可列印）字元將列印為“?”。 |
| Log Replies<br>記錄回覆 | If enabled, prints one line per reply to the log, with the log timestamp and IP address, name, type, class, return code, time to resolve, whether the reply is from the cache and the response size. Note that it takes time to print these lines, which makes the server (significantly) slower. Odd (non-printable) characters in names are printed as ‘?’.<br>如果啟用，則將每次回覆列印一行到日誌，其中包含日誌時間戳記和IP地址、名稱、類型、類別、回傳代碼、解析時間、回復是否來自快取以及回應大小。請注意，列印這些行需要時間，這會使伺服器（顯著）變慢。名稱中的奇數（不可列印）字元將列印為“?”。 |
| Tag Queries and Replies<br>標籤查詢和回覆 | If enabled, prints the word ‘query: ‘ and ‘reply: ‘ with logged queries and replies. This makes filtering logs easier.<br>如果啟用，將列印單字「query:」和「reply:」以及記錄的查詢和回覆。這使得過濾日誌變得更容易。 |
| Log level verbosity | Select the log verbosity. Level 0 means no verbosity, only errors. Level 1 gives operational information. Level 2 gives detailed operational information. Level 3 gives query level information, output per query. Level 4 gives algorithm level information. Level 5 logs client identification for cache misses. Default is level 1. |

| 日誌詳細程度 | 選擇日誌詳細程度。等級 0 表示不顯示任何詳細訊息，僅顯示錯誤訊息。級別 1 提供操作資訊。級別 2 提供詳細的操作資訊。等級 3 提供查詢層級的信息，輸出每個查詢的資訊。級別 4 提供演算法級別的資訊。等級 5 記錄快取未命中時的客戶端標識。預設值為等級 1。
| Private Domains<br>私有網域 | List of domains to mark as private. These domains and all its subdomains are allowed to contain private addresses.<br>要標記為私有的網域清單。這些網域及其所有子網域均允許包含私人位址。 |
| Rebind Protection networks<br>重新綁定保護網路 | These are addresses on your private network, and are not allowed to be returned for public internet names. Any occurrence of such addresses are removed from DNS answers. Additionally, the DNSSEC validator may mark the answers bogus. This protects against so-called DNS Rebinding. (Only applicable when DNS rebind check is enabled in [Administration](#p-098))<br>這些是您的專用網路上的位址，不允許傳回公共網際網路名稱。任何此類地址的出現都會從DNS答案中刪除。此外，DNSSEC驗證器可能會將答案標記為虛假。這可以防止所謂的 DNS 重新綁定。 (僅適用於[管理](#p-098)啟用DNS重新綁定檢查) |
| Insecure Domains<br>不安全的網域 | List of domains to mark as insecure. DNSSEC chain of trust is ignored towards the domain name.<br>要標記為不安全的網域清單。 DNSSEC 網域的信任鏈被忽略。 |
| Message Cache Size<br>訊息快取大小 | Size of the message cache. The message cache stores DNS rcodes and validation statuses. The RRSet cache (which contains the actual RR data) will automatically be set to twice this amount. Valid input is plain bytes, optionally appended with ‘k’, ‘m’, or ‘g’ for kilobytes, megabytes or gigabytes respectively.<br>訊息快取的大小。訊息快取儲存DNS rcodes和驗證狀態。 RRSet 快取（包含實際的RR 資料）將自動設定為此數量的兩倍。有效輸入是純字節，可選擇附加“k”、“m”或“g”，分別表示千字節、兆字節或千兆位元組。 |
| RRset Cache Size<br>RRset 快取大小 | Size of the RRset cache. Contains the actual RR data. Valid input is plain bytes, optionally appended with ‘k’, ‘m’, or ‘g’ for kilobytes, megabytes or gigabytes respectively. Automatically set to twice the amount of the Message Cache Size when empty, but can be manually modified.<br>RRset 快取的大小。包含實際的RR資料。有效輸入是純字節，可選擇附加“k”、“m”或“g”，分別表示千字節、兆字節或千兆位元組。空時自動設定為訊息快取大小的兩倍，但可以手動修改。 |
| Outgoing TCP Buffers<br>傳出 TCP 緩衝區 | The number of outgoing TCP buffers to allocate per thread. If 0 is selected then no TCP queries to authoritative servers are done.<br>每個執行緒分配的傳出 TCP 緩衝區的數量。如果選擇 0，則不會對權威伺服器進行TCP 查詢。 |
| Incoming TCP Buffers<br>傳入TCP緩衝區 | The number of incoming TCP buffers to allocate per thread. If 0 is selected then no TCP queries from clients are accepted.<br>每個執行緒分配的傳入TCP緩衝區的數量。如果選擇 0，則不接受來自客戶端的TCP查詢。 |
| Number of queries per thread<br>每個執行緒的查詢數量 | The number of queries that every thread will service simultaneously. If more queries arrive that need to be serviced, and no queries can be jostled out (see “Jostle Timeout”（推搡暫停）), then these queries are dropped. This forces the client to resend after a timeout, allowing the server time to work on the existing queries.<br>每個執行緒將同時服務的查詢數量。如果有更多需要服務的查詢到達，並且沒有查詢可以被擠出（請參閱“Jostle Timeout”（推搡暫停）），那麼這些查詢將被丟棄。這會強制客戶端在逾時後重新發送，使伺服器有時間處理現有查詢。 |
| Outgoing Range<br>傳出範圍 | The number of ports to open. This number of file descriptors can be opened per thread. Larger numbers need extra resources from the operating system. For performance a very large value is best. For reference, usually double the amount of queries per thread is used.<br>要開啟的連接埠數。每個線程可以打開這個數量的檔案描述符。較大的數字需要作業系統提供額外的資源。對於性能來說，非常大的值是最好的。作為參考，通常使用每個執行緒的查詢量的兩倍。 |
| Jostle Timeout<br>推擠逾時 | This timeout is used for when the server is very busy. Set to a value that usually results in one round-trip to the authority servers. If too many queries arrive, then 50% of the queries are allowed to run to completion, and the other 50% are replaced with the new incoming query if they have already spent more than their allowed time. This protects against denial of service by slow queries or high query rates.<br>此逾時用於伺服器非常繁忙時。設定為通常會導致與授權伺服器進行一次往返的值。如果到達的查詢過多，則允許 50% 的查詢運行完成，而另外 50% 的查詢將被新傳入的查詢取代（如果它們已經花費了超過允許的時間）。這可以防止因慢速查詢或高查詢率而導致拒絕服務。 |
| Maximum TTL for RRsets and messages<br>RRset 和訊息的最大TTL | Configure a maximum Time to live in seconds for RRsets and messages in the cache. When the internal TTL expires the cache item is expired. This can be configured to force the resolver to query for data more often and not trust (very large) TTL values.<br>配置快取中 RRset 和訊息的最大生存時間（以秒為單位）。當內部TTL過期時，快取項目即過期。此配置可強制解析器更頻繁地查詢數據，且不信任（非常大的） TTL值。 |
| Minimum TTL for RRsets and messages<br>RRsets 和訊息的最低TTL | Configure a minimum Time to live in seconds for RRsets and messages in the cache. If the minimum value kicks in, the data is cached for longer than the domain owner intended, and thus fewer queries are made to look up the data. The 0 value ensures the data in the cache is as the domain owner intended. High values can lead to trouble as the data in the cache might not match up with the actual data anymore.<br>配置快取中 RRset 和訊息的最短生存時間（以秒為單位）。如果啟用最小值，則資料的快取時間將比網域擁有者預期的時間長，因此查找資料的查詢次數會減少。 0 值確保快取中的資料符合網域擁有者的預期。高值可能會導致麻煩，因為快取中的資料可能不再與實際資料相符。 |
| TTL for Host cache entries<br>TTL主機快取條目 | Time to live in seconds for entries in the host cache. The host cache contains round-trip timing, lameness and EDNS support information.<br>主機快取條目的生存時間（以秒為單位）。主機快取包含往返時間、延遲和EDNS支援資訊。 |
| Keep probing down hosts<br>繼續探測主機 | Keep probing hosts that are down in the infrastructure host cache. Hosts that are down are probed about every 120 seconds with an exponential backoff. If hosts do not respond within this time period, they are marked as down for the duration of the host cache TTL. This setting can be used in conjunction with “TTL for Host cache entries” to increase responsiveness if internet connectivity bounces happen frequently.<br>繼續探測基礎架構主機快取中已關閉的主機。大約每 120 秒就會以指數退避方式對已關閉的主機進行一次偵測。如果主機在此時間段內沒有回應，它們將在主機快取TTL的持續時間內被標記為關閉。此設定可與「TTL用於主機快取條目」結合使用，以在網路連線頻繁發生時提高回應能力。 |
| Number of Hosts to cache<br>要快取的主機數量 | Number of hosts for which information is cached.<br>快取資訊的主機數量。 |
| Unwanted Reply Threshold<br>不需要的回覆閾值 | If enabled, a total number of unwanted replies is kept track of in every thread. When it reaches the threshold, a defensive action is taken and a warning is printed to the log file. This defensive action is to clear the RRSet and message caches, hopefully flushing away any poison.<br>如果啟用，則會在每個執行緒中追蹤不需要的回覆總數。當達到閾值時，將採取防禦操作並將警告列印到日誌檔案中。此防禦操作是清除 RRSet 和訊息緩存，希望清除任何有毒物質。 |

#### Access Lists｜訪問列表

Access lists define which clients may query our dns resolver. Records for the assigned interfaces will be automatically created and are shown in the overview. You can also define custom policies, which apply an action to predefined networks.

存取清單定義了哪些客戶端可以查詢我們的 DNS 解析器。已指派介面的記錄將自動建立並顯示在概覽中。您還可以定義自訂策略，將操作套用至預先定義的網路。

Note

筆記

The action can be as defined in the list below. The most specific netblock match is used, if none match deny is used. The order of the access-control statements therefore does not matter.

操作可以按照以下列表定義。使用最具體的網路區塊匹配，如果沒有匹配項，則使用拒絕操作。因此，存取控制語句的順序無關緊要。

##### **Actions**｜**操作**

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Deny<br>拒絕 | This action stops queries from hosts within the defined networks.<br>此操作將阻止來自已定義網路內主機的查詢。 |
| Refuse<br>拒絕 | This action also stops queries from hosts within the defined networks, but sends a DNS rcode REFUSED error message back to the client.<br>此操作也會阻止來自已定義網路內主機的查詢，但會傳送DNS rcode REFUSED錯誤訊​​息。 |
| Allow<br>允許 | This action allows queries from hosts within the defined networks.<br>此操作允許來自已定義網路內主機的查詢。 |
| Allow Snoop<br>允許窺探 | This action allows recursive and nonrecursive access from hosts within the defined networks. Used for cache snooping and ideally should only be configured for your administrative host.<br>此操作允許從已定義網路內的主機進行遞歸和非遞歸存取。用於快取窺探，理想情況下應僅配置於您的管理主機。 |
| Deny Non-local<br>拒絕非本地請求 | Allow only authoritative local-data queries from hosts within the defined networks. Messages that are disallowed are dropped.<br>僅允許來自指定網路內主機的權威本地資料查詢。被禁止的訊息將被丟棄。 |
| Refuse Non-local<br>拒絕非本地請求 | Allow only authoritative local-data queries from hosts within the defined networks. Sends a DNS rcode REFUSED error message back to the client for messages that are disallowed.<br>僅允許來自已定義網路內主機的權威本地資料查詢。對於被禁止的訊息，向客戶端發送DNS rcode REFUSED錯誤訊息。 |

#### Blocklists｜屏蔽列表

Enable integrated dns blocklisting using one of the predefined sources or custom locations.

使用預先定義的來源或自訂位置啟用整合式 DNS 黑名單。

Multiple policies can be defined, each separated by one or more source nets. This means you can use blocklists or specific (wildcard) domains on specific networks, allowing more fine-grained control over your setup. The algorithm selects the most specific subnet when domains overlap across subnet sizes. You can use the tester as described below to find such overlaps, however, as a best practice it’s advisable to keep source nets separate.

您可以定義多個策略，每個策略之間可由一個或多個來源網路分隔。這意味著您可以在特定網路上使用黑名單或特定（通配符）域名，從而對您的設定進行更精細的控制。當網域名稱在不同子網路大小上重疊時，演算法會選擇最具體的子網路。您可以使用如下所述的測試工具來尋找此類重疊，但最佳實踐是保持來源網路彼此獨立。

---

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Enable<br>啟用 | Enable blocklists<br>啟用黑名單 |
| Type of DNSBL<br>DNSBL類型 | Predefined external sources<br>預先定義外部來源 |
| URLs of Blocklists<br>封鎖清單的 URL | Additional http\[s\] location to download blocklists from, only plain text files containing a list of fqdn’s (e.g. `my.evil.domain.com`) OR wildcard domains (e.g. `*.my.evil.domain.com`) are supported.<br>用於下載封鎖清單的其他 http\[s\] 位置，僅支援包含 FQDN（例如 `my.evil.domain.com`）OR 通配符域（例如 `*.my.evil.domain.com`）清單的純文字檔案。 |
| Allowlist Domains<br>允許清單域 | When a blocklist item contains a pattern defined in this list it will be omitted from the results. e.g. `.*.nl` would exclude all .nl domains. Blocked domains explicitly allowlisted using the [Reporting: Unbound DNS](#p-082) page will show up in this list.<br>當阻止清單項目包含此清單中定義的模式時，它將從結果中省略。例如`.*.nl` 將排除所有 .nl 域。使用[報告：未綁定DNS](#p-082)頁面明確列入白名單的被封鎖網域將顯示在此清單中。 |
| Blocklist Domains<br>封鎖清單域 | List of domains to explicitly block. Regular expressions are not supported. Passed domains explicitly blocked using the [Reporting: Unbound DNS](#p-082) page will show up in this list.<br>要明確封鎖的網域清單。不支援正規表示式。使用[報告：未綁定DNS](#p-082)頁面明確封鎖的已傳遞域將顯示在此清單中。 |
| Wildcard Domains<br>通配符網域 | List of wildcard domains to blocklist. All subdomains of the given domain will be blocked. Blocking first-level domains (e.g. ‘com’) is not supported.<br>要封鎖清單的通配符域清單。給定域的所有子域都將被阻止。不支援阻止一級網域名稱（例如“com”）。 |
| Source Net(s)<br>來源網路 | Source networks to apply policy on. Examples are 192.168.1.0/24 or 192.168.1.1. Leave empty to apply on everything. All specified networks should use the same protocol family and have equal sizes to avoid priority issues.<br>要應用策略的來源網路。例如 192.168.1.0/24 或 192.168.1.1。留空以應用於所有內容。所有指定的網路應使用相同的協定族並具有相同的大小，以避免優先順序問題。 |
| Cache TTL<br>快取TTL | TTL for the blocklists cache. Remote blocklists don’t usually update more often than once a day. Therefore, when blocklists are downloaded, they are cached locally to prevent unnecessary fetches over the internet. You can change this behavior here if you know the remote files rotate faster than this.<br>TTL用於黑名單快取。遠端黑名單通常每天更新不超過一次。因此，下載黑名單時，會將其快取到本地，以避免不必要的網路下載。如果您知道遠端檔案的更新速度更快，可以在此處變更此行為。 |
| Destination Address<br>目標位址 | Specify an IP address to return when DNS records are blocked. Can be used to redirect such domains to a separate webserver informing the user that the content has been blocked. The default is 0.0.0.0. Any value in this field is skipped if “Return NXDOMAIN”（返回 NXDOMAIN） is checked.<br>指定當DNS記錄被阻止時要回傳的IP位址。可用於將此類網域重新導向到單獨的 Web 伺服器，並通知使用者內容已被封鎖。預設值為0.0.0.0 。如果選取“Return NXDOMAIN”（返回 NXDOMAIN） ，則此欄位中的任何值都會被跳過。 |
| Return NXDOMAIN<br>回NXDOMAIN | Instead of returning the “Destination Address”（目的地地址）, return the DNS return code “NXDOMAIN”. This is useful in cases where devices cannot cope with the 0.0.0.0 destination address, such as certain Apple devices.<br>不回傳“Destination Address”（目的地地址） ，而是回傳DNS回傳碼“NXDOMAIN” 。這在設備無法處理0.0.0.0目標位址的情況下非常有用，例如某些蘋果設備。 |

Note

筆記

Applying the blocklist settings will not restart Unbound, rather it will signal to Unbound to dynamically process the blocklists as soon as they’re downloaded. There may be up to a minute of delay before Unbound has loaded everything. During this time Unbound will still be just as responsive.

套用屏蔽清單設定不會重新啟動 Unbound，而是會通知 Unbound 在封鎖清單下載完成後立即動態處理。 Unbound 載入所有內容可能需要最多一分鐘的延遲。在此期間，Unbound 的反應速度仍然會保持不變。

##### *Blocklist Tester*｜*黑名單測試器*

The blocklists feature contains a tester that allows you to check whether a given domain matches a policy you have defined in the *Blocklists* tab. This tester is fully local, therefore this tester is not capable of matching domains that resolve into CNAMEs that may or may not be in the blocklists you have defined. In this scenario you can use Interfaces -> Diagnostics -> DNS lookup, or use the following command from the command line:

黑名單功能包含一個測試器，可用於檢查給定網域是否與您在「黑名單」標籤中定義的策略相符。此測試器完全本地化，因此無法匹配解析為 CNAME 記錄的域，而這些 CNAME 記錄可能在您定義的黑名單中，也可能不在。在這種情況下，您可以使用“介面”->“診斷”-> DNS 查找，或使用命令列中的以下命令：

> ```
> drill -b <source ip> <domain> <record type>
>
> 鑽頭 -b <source ip> <domain> <record type>
> ```

In the above example the source IP address must exist on the firewall.

在上面的範例中，來源位址IP必須存在於防火牆上。

| OISD - Domain Blocklist Big\*<br>OISD - 網域黑名單 Big\* | [https://big.oisd.nl/domainswild](https://big.oisd.nl/domainswild)<br>[https://big.oisd.nl/domainswild](https://big.oisd.nl/domainswild) |
| OISD - Domain Blocklist NSFW\*<br>OISD - 網域黑名單NSFW \* | [https://nsfw.oisd.nl/domainswild](https://nsfw.oisd.nl/domainswild)<br>[https://nsfw.oisd.nl/domainswild](https://nsfw.oisd.nl/domainswild) |
| Blocklist.site<br>封鎖清單網站 | [https://github.com/blocklistproject/Lists](https://github.com/blocklistproject/Lists)<br>[https://github.com/blocklistproject/Lists](https://github.com/blocklistproject/Lists) |
| EasyList<br>簡易清單 | [https://v.firebog.net/hosts/Easylist.txt](https://v.firebog.net/hosts/Easylist.txt)<br>[https://v.firebog.net/hosts/Easylist.txt](https://v.firebog.net/hosts/Easylist.txt) |
| Easyprivacy | [https://v.firebog.net/hosts/Easyprivacy.txt](https://v.firebog.net/hosts/Easyprivacy.txt)<br>[https://v.firebog.net/hosts/Easyprivacy.txt](https://v.firebog.net/hosts/Easyprivacy.txt) |
| YoYo List<br>悠悠球列表 | [https://pgl.yoyo.org/adservers/](https://pgl.yoyo.org/adservers/)<br>[https://pgl.yoyo.org/adservers/](https://pgl.yoyo.org/adservers/) |
| hagezi - \[multiple lists\]<br>hagezi - \[多個列表\] | [https://github.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists](https://github.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists)<br>[https://github.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists](https://github.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists) |

Note

筆記

The OISD lists are *wildcard* lists. Meaning that they will block all subdomains of the listed domains. For more information, refer to [OISD](https://oisd.nl/). This keeps the list small and manageable, but are more effective than regular lists.

OISD列表是*通配符*列表，這表示它們會封鎖列表中所有網域的子網域。更多信息，請參閱 [OISD](https://oisd.nl/) 。這種列表結構簡潔易管理，但比一般列表更有效。

Note

筆記

In order to automatically update the lists on timed intervals you need to add a cron task, just go to System -> Settings ->Cron and a new task for a command called “Update Unbound DNSBLs”（更新 Unbound DNSBL）.

為了按時間間隔自動更新列表，您需要新增一個 cron 任務，只需轉到系統 -> 設定 -> Cron，然後為名為“Update Unbound DNSBLs”（更新 Unbound DNSBL）的命令新增任務。

Usually once a day is a good enough interval for these type of tasks.

通常來說，一天一次對於這類任務來說就足夠了。

#### Query Forwarding｜查詢轉發

The Query Forwarding section allows for entering arbitrary nameservers to forward queries to. It is assumed that the nameservers entered here are capable of handling further recursion for any query. In this section you are able to specify nameservers to forward to for specific domains queried by clients, catch all domains and specify nondefault ports.

查詢轉發部分可讓您輸入任意名稱伺服器以轉送查詢。此處輸入的名稱伺服器必須能夠處理任何查詢的遞歸請求。您可以在此部分指定用戶端查詢的特定網域的轉送名稱伺服器、擷取所有網域以及指定非預設連接埠。

---

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Use System Nameservers<br>使用系統名稱伺服器 | The configured system nameservers will be used to forward queries to. This will override any entry made in the custom forwarding grid, except for entries targeting a specific domain. If there are no system nameservers, you will be prompted to add one in [General](#p-098). If you expected a DNS server from your WAN and it’s not listed, make sure you set “Allow DNS server list to be overridden by DHCP/PPP on WAN” there as well.<br>配置的系統名稱伺服器將用於將查詢轉送至。這將覆蓋自訂轉送網格中所做的任何條目，但針對特定網域的條目除外。如果沒有系統名稱伺服器，系統會提示您在[常規](#p-098)新增一個。如果您希望從 WAN 獲得 DNS 伺服器，但它未列出，請確保您也在那裡設定「允許 DNS 伺服器清單被 WAN 上的 DHCP/PPP 覆蓋」。 |

Warning

警告

Do not use the system nameservers option if you have a multi-WAN setup and have Unbound running alongside multiple DNS servers configured in [General](#p-098) with separate gateways assigned to them. Unbound will use the locally created routes to reach the system nameservers, which will not work when the gateway is down.

如果您部署了多台WAN伺服器，且Unbound與多台在[常規](#p-098)中配置的DNS伺服器並行運行，且每台伺服器都指派了不同的網關，請勿使用系統名稱伺服器選項。 Unbound將使用本地建立的路由來存取系統名稱伺服器，而當網關發生故障時，這些路由將無法正常運作。

Note

筆記

Keep in mind that if the “Use System Nameservers”（使用系統名稱伺服器） checkbox is checked, the system nameservers will be preferred over any **catch-all entry** in **both** Query Forwarding and DNS-over-TLS, this means that entries with a specific domain will still be forwarded to the specified nameserver.

請記住，如果 “Use System Nameservers”（使用系統名稱伺服器） 如果選取此複選框，系統名稱伺服器將優先於查詢轉發和配置中的任何**通用條目**。 DNS-超過-TLS這意味著具有特定網域名稱的條目仍將轉發到指定的名稱伺服器。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | Enable query forwarding for this domain.<br>為此網域啟用查詢轉送。 |
| Domain<br>網域 | Domain of the host. All queries for this domain will be forwarded to the nameserver specified in “Server IP”（伺服器IP）. Leave empty to catch all queries and forward them to the nameserver.<br>主機的網域名稱。所有針對此網域的查詢都將轉送到“Server IP”（伺服器IP）中指定的名稱伺服器。留空則會捕獲所有查詢並將其轉送到名稱伺服器。 |
| Server IP<br>伺服器IP | Address of the DNS server to be used for recursive resolution.<br>用於遞歸解析的DNS伺服器的位址。 |
| Port<br>連接埠 | Specify the port used by the DNS server. Default is port 53. Useful when configuring e.g. [DNSCrypt-Proxy](#p-215)<br>指定DNS伺服器所使用的連接埠。預設連接埠為 53。在配置例如 [DNSCrypt-Proxy](#p-215)時非常有用 |

Warning

警告

Be careful enabling “DNS Query Forwarding”（DNS 查詢轉送） in combination with **DNSSEC**, no DNSSEC validation will be performed for forwards with a specific domain, as the upstream server might be a local controller. If forwarding everything and the upstream server doesn’t support DNSSEC, its answers will not reach the client as no DNSSEC validation could be performed.

請謹慎啟用“DNS Query Forwarding”（DNS 查詢轉送）與 **DNSSEC** 的組合，因為上游伺服器可能是本機控制器，所以對於特定網域的轉送要求將不會執行DNSSEC驗證。如果轉送所有請求，而上游伺服器不支援DNSSEC ，則其回應將無法到達客戶端，因為無法執行DNSSEC驗證。

#### DNS over TLS｜DNS覆蓋TLS

DNS over TLS uses the same logic as Query Forwarding, except it uses TLS for transport.

DNS over TLS使用與查詢轉送相同的邏輯，只是它使用TLS進行傳輸。

---

Note

筆記

Please be aware of interactions between Query Forwarding and DNS over TLS. Since the same principle as Query Forwarding applies, a **catch-all entry** specified in both sections will be considered a duplicate zone. In our case DNS over TLS will be preferred.

請注意查詢轉發與DNS和TLS之間的交互作用。由於查詢轉發的原則相同，在兩個部分中指定的**兜底條目**將被視為重複區域。在本例中，我們將優先使用DNS而不是TLS 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | Enable DNS over TLS for this domain.<br>為此域啟用DNS而非TLS 。 |
| Domain<br>網域 | Domain of the host. All queries for this domain will be forwarded to the nameserver specified in “Server IP”（伺服器IP）. Leave empty to catch all queries and forward them to the nameserver.<br>主機的網域名稱。所有針對此網域的查詢都將轉送到“Server IP”（伺服器IP）中指定的名稱伺服器。留空則會捕獲所有查詢並將其轉送到名稱伺服器。 |
| Server IP<br>伺服器IP | Address of the DNS server to be used for recursive resolution.<br>用於遞歸解析的DNS伺服器的位址。 |
| Port<br>連接埠 | Specify the port used by the DNS server. Always enter port 853 here unless there is a good reason not to, such as when using an SSH tunnel.<br>指定DNS伺服器所使用的連接埠。除非有充分的理由（例如使用SSH隧道時），否則請務必在此輸入連接埠 853。 |
| Verify CN<br>驗證CN | The name to use for certificate verification, e.g. “445b9e.dns.nextdns.io”. Used by Unbound to check the TLS authentication certificates. It is strongly discouraged to omit this field since man-in-the-middle attacks will still be possible.<br>用於憑證驗證的名稱，例如「445b9e.dns.nextdns.io」。 Unbound 使用此名稱來檢查TLS身份驗證憑證。強烈建議不要省略此字段，因為仍然可能遭受中間人攻擊。 |

Tip

提示

To ensure a validated environment, it is a good idea to block all outbound DNS traffic on port 53 using a firewall rule when using DNS over TLS. Should clients query other nameservers directly themselves, a NAT redirect rule to 127.0.0.1:53 (the local Unbound service) can be used to force these requests over TLS.

為確保環境經過驗證，建議在使用DNS而非TLS時，使用防火牆規則阻止所有DNS端口 53 上的出站流量。如果用戶端直接查詢其他名稱伺服器，則可以使用NAT重定向規則將這些請求強制透過127.0.0.1:53 （本地TLS服務）進行。

**Public Resolvers**

**公共解析器**

<table>
<tr><th>Hosted by<br>由</th><th>Server<br>伺服器託管IP</th><th>Server Port<br>伺服器連接埠</th><th>Verify<br>驗證CN</th></tr>
<tr><td rowspan="4"><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/encryption/dns-over-tls/">Cloudflare</a></td><td>1.1.1.1</td><td rowspan="4">853</td><td rowspan="4">cloudflare-dns.com</td></tr>
<tr><td>1.0.0.1</td></tr>

<tr><td>8.8.4.4</td></tr>

<tr><td rowspan="4"><a href="https://www.quad9.net/service/service-addresses-and-features/">Quad9</a></td><td>9.9.9.9</td><td rowspan="4">853</td><td rowspan="4">dns.quad9.net</td></tr>
<tr><td>149.112.112.112</td></tr>

#### Statistics｜統計數據

The statistics page provides some insights into the running server, such as the number of queries executed, cache usage and uptime.

統計資訊頁面提供了一些關於正在運行的伺服器的信息，例如執行的查詢數量、快取使用情況和正常運行時間。

#### Advanced Configurations｜進階配置

Some installations require configuration settings that are not accessible in the UI. To support these, individual configuration files with a `.conf` extension can be put into the `/usr/local/etc/unbound.opnsense.d` directory. These files will be automatically included by the UI generated configuration. Multiple configuration files can be placed there. But note that

某些安裝需要一些在UI目錄下無法存取的設定。為了支援這些設置，可以將擴展名為`.conf`單獨設定檔放入`/usr/local/etc/unbound.opnsense.d`目錄。這些檔案將會被UI產生的設定自動包含。可以在此放置多個設定檔。但請注意：

-   As it cannot be predicted in which clause the configuration currently takes place, you must prefix the configuration with the required clause. For the concept of “clause” see the `unbound.conf(5)` documentation.  
    由於無法預測目前配置位於哪個子句中，因此必須在配置前加上所需的子句。有關「子句」的概念，請參閱`unbound.conf(5)`文件。
    
-   The wildcard include processing in Unbound is based on `glob(7)`. So the order in which the files are included is in ascending ASCII order.  
    Unbound 中的通配符包含處理基於`glob(7)` 。因此，文件的包含順序是按升序排列的ASCII順序。
    
-   Name collisions with plugin code, which use this extension point e. g. `dnsbl.conf`, may occur. So be sure to use a unique filename.  
    可能會出現與使用此副檔名（例如`dnsbl.conf` ）的插件程式碼的名稱衝突。因此，請務必使用唯一的檔案名稱。
    
-   It is a good idea to check the complete configuration via:  
    建議透過以下方式檢查完整配置：
    
    ```
    # check if the resulting configuration is valid
    configctl unbound check
    ```
    
    This will report errors that prevent Unbound from starting and also list warnings that may give hints as to why a particular configuration is not working or how it could be improved.

    這將報告封鎖 Unbound 啟動的錯誤，並列出可能提示特定配置為何不起作用或如何改進的警告。
    

This is a sample configuration file to add an option in the server clause:

這是一個用於在伺服器子句中新增選項的範例設定檔：

```yaml
server:
  private-domain: xip.io
```

Note

筆記

As a more permanent solution the template system (“[Using Templates](#p-249)”) can be used to automatically generate these files.

作為一種更持久的解決方案，可以使用範本系統（“[使用範本](#p-249) ”）自動產生這些檔案。

To get the same effect as placing the file in the sample above directly in `/usr/local/etc/unbound.opnsense.d` follow these steps:

若要達到與上述範例中將文件直接放入`/usr/local/etc/unbound.opnsense.d`相同的效果，請依照下列步驟操作：

1.  Create a `+TARGETS` file in `/usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/sampleuser/Unbound`:  
    在`/usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/sampleuser/Unbound`中建立`+TARGETS`檔案：
    
    ```
    sampleuser_additional_options.conf:/usr/local/etc/unbound.opnsense.d/sampleuser_additional_options.conf
    ```
    
2.  Place the template file as `sampleuser_additional_options.conf` in the same directory:  
    將範本檔案`sampleuser_additional_options.conf`放置在同一目錄下：
    
    ```yaml
    server:
      private-domain: xip.io
    ```
    
3.  Test the template generation by issuing the following command:  
    透過執行以下命令測試模板來產生：
    
    ```
    # generate template
    configctl template reload sampleuser/Unbound
    ```
    
4.  Check the output in the target directory:  
    檢查目標目錄中的輸出：
    
    ```
    # show generated file
    cat /usr/local/etc/unbound.opnsense.d/sampleuser_additional_options.conf
    # check if configuration is valid
    configctl unbound check
    ```
    

Warning

警告

It is the sole responsibility of the administrator which places a file in the extension directory to ensure that the configuration is valid.

管理員有責任將檔案放置在擴充目錄中，以確保配置有效。

Note

筆記

This method replaces the `Custom options` settings in the General page of the Unbound configuration, which was removed in version 21.7.

此方法取代了 Unbound 配置的常規頁面中的`Custom options`設置，該設置已在21.7版本中移除。

---

<a id="c-41"></a>

### Captive portal & GuestNET

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-200"></a>

#### Captive portal & GuestNET｜強制入口網站和 GuestNET

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/captiveportal.html>

A **Captive Portal** allows you to force authentication, or redirection to a click through page for network access. This is commonly used on hotspot networks, but is also widely used in corporate networks for an additional layer of security on wireless or Internet access.

**強制入口網站**允許您強制進行身份驗證，或將使用者重新導向至點擊跳轉頁面以存取網路。這通常用於熱點網絡，但也廣泛用於企業網絡，為無線或互聯網訪問增加一層額外的安全性。

![../_images/hotspot_login.png](<../images/a3842fa5-hotspot_login.png>)

##### Overview and terminology｜概述和術語

###### Typical Applications｜典型應用

-   Guest Network  
    賓客網路
    
-   Hotel & Camping Wi-Fi Access  
    飯店和露營地無線網路接入
    
-   Bring Your Own Device (BYOD)  
    自備設備（ BYOD ）
    

###### Template Management｜範本管理

OPNsense’s unique template manager makes setting up your own login page an easy task. At the same time it offers additional functionalities, such as:

OPNsense 獨特的範本管理器讓您輕鬆設定自訂登入頁面。同時，它還提供其他功能，例如：

-   URL redirection  
    URL重定向
    
-   Option for your own Pop-up  
    您可以選擇自訂彈出視窗
    
-   Custom Splash page  
    自訂啟動頁面
    

![../_images/captiveportal_template_folder.png](<../images/a8048f70-captiveportal_template_folder.png>)

###### Zone Management｜區域管理

Different zones can be setup on each interface or multiple interfaces can share one zone setup. Each Zone can use a different Captive Portal Template or share it with another zone.

每個介面可以設定不同的區域，也可以多個介面共用一個區域設定。每個區域可以使用不同的強制門戶模板，也可以與其他區域共用同一個模板。

###### Authentication｜驗證

Secure authentication via HTTPS or splash-only portal with URL redirection to a given page Different sources can be used to authenticate a user in a zone:

透過HTTPS或僅顯示頁面的入口網站進行安全身份驗證，並透過URL重定向到指定頁面。可以使用不同的來源對區域中的使用者進行身份驗證：

-   LDAP \[Microsoft Active Directory\]LDAP [Microsoft Active Directory]
    
-   Radius, including accounting updates  
    Radius，包括會計更新
    
-   Local user manager  
    本地用戶管理員
    
-   Vouchers / Tickets  
    代金券/門票
    
-   No authentication (Splash Screen Only)  
    無需身份驗證（僅啟動畫面）
    
-   Multiple (a combination of above)  
    多種（以上幾種的組合）
    

###### Voucher Manager｜優惠券管理器

OPNsense’s Captive Portal has an easy voucher creation system that exports the vouchers to a csv file for use with your favorite application. The export allows you to print vouchers by merging them with your Microsoft Word or LibreOffice template and create a good looking handout with your logo and company style.

OPNsense 的 Captive Portal 擁有方便的憑證建立系統，可將憑證匯出為 CSV 文件，方便您在常用應用程式中使用。匯出後，您可以將憑證與 Microsoft Word 或 LibreOffice 範本合併，輕鬆列印，並製作帶有公司徽標和風格的精美宣傳單。

###### Timeouts & Welcome Back｜暫停和歡迎回來

Connection can be terminated after the user has been idle for a certain amount of time (idle timeout) and/or force a disconnect when a number of minutes have passed even if the user is still active (hard timeout). In case a user reconnects within the idle timeout and/or a hard timeout, no login is required and the user can resume its active session.

用戶閒置一段時間後連線將終止（空閒逾時），或即使使用者仍處於活動狀態，經過數分鐘後也會被強制斷開連線（硬逾時）。如果使用者在空閒逾時或硬逾時期限內重新連接，則無需登錄，使用者可以恢復其活動會話。

###### Bandwidth Management｜頻寬管理

The Built-in traffic shaper can be utilized to:

內建的流量整形器可用於：

-   Share bandwidth evenly  
    平均分配頻寬
    
-   Give priority to protocols port numbers and/or IP addresses  
    優先考慮協定連接埠號碼和/或IP位址
    

See also: [Traffic Shaping](#p-138)

另請參閱：[流量整形](#p-138)

###### Portal bypass｜門戶繞行

MAC addresses and IP addresses/network ranges can be white listed to bypass the portal.

MAC位址和IP位址/網路範圍可以列入白名單以繞過入口網站。

###### Platform Integration｜平台集成

Through the integrated REST API the captive portal application can be integrated with other services. See: [Use the API](#p-370)

透過整合的REST API可以將強制入口網站應用程式與其他服務整合。參見：[使用API](#p-370)

###### IPv6 support｜IPv6 支援

The OPNsense Captive Portal fully supports IPv6-only and dual-stack networks. To facilitate this, the \[Roaming\] option is available and set by default in each zone. The IPv6 protocol commonly uses multiple IPv6 addresses on the same network interface of a client. These can be Link-local addressess, GUAs, ULAs, temporary/ privacy addresses or stable addresses.

OPNsense 強制門戶完全支援純 IPv6 網路和雙棧網路。為此，每個區域都預設啟用“漫遊”選項。 IPv6 協定通常會在客戶端的相同網路介面上使用多個 IPv6 位址。這些位址可以是連結本地地址、通用地址協定 (GUA)、統一地址協定 (ULA)、臨時/隱私地址或穩定地址。

Roaming allows the portal to register any IP alias a client is using, including IPv4 addresses. Once a client is connected, these IP addresses are collected in the background and are granted access.

漫遊功能允許入口網站註冊客戶端使用的任何IP別名，包括IPv4位址。客戶端連線後，這些IP位址會在背景收集並授予存取權限。

Furthermore, the following criteria must be met for IPv6 to fully function:

此外，IPv6 要完全發揮作用，還必須滿足以下條件：

-   Hostwatch (Interfaces ‣ Neighbours ‣ Automatic Discovery) must be enabled for the collection of IPv6 addresses to function.  
    若要讓 IPv6 位址收集功能正常運作，必須啟用 Hostwatch（介面 ‣ 鄰居 ‣ 自動發現）。
    
-   You must set a \[Hostname\] in the zone configuration and make sure a DNS record exists for this hostname pointing to the correct IPv6 address. If you’re using Unbound, DNS records for the configured interfaces can be synthesized with the \[DNS64\] option in Services ‣ Unbound DNS ‣ General.  
    您必須在區域設定中設定 [主機名稱]，並確保存在指向正確 IPv6 位址的DNS記錄來表示該主機名稱。如果您使用的是 Unbound，則可以使用「服務」‣「Unbound」 DNS 「常規」中的 [ DNS64 ] 選項來合成已設定介面的DNS記錄。
    

Note

筆記

The background process collecting these IP addresses does this in a fixed interval. There may be a slight delay before all addresses are collected and granted access.

後台進程會以固定的時間間隔收集這些IP位址。收集完所有地址並授予存取權限之前可能會有輕微的延遲。

###### Modern Portal support｜現代門戶支持

OPNsense implements the Captive Portal by redirecting all HTTP traffic to a local web server before authentication, hinting to the device that it is behind a portal. However, [RFC 8910](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8910) introduces a new standardized method for networks to inform clients about the presence of a portal using DHCP. Furthermore, [RFC 8908](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8908) describes an API standard implemented by the webserver pointed to by DHCP, where the client can fetch the current portal status. Apple has published a [document](https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=q78sq5rv) going into more details.

OPNsense 透過將所有HTTP流量重新導向到本機 Web 伺服器來實現強制門戶，然後再進行身份驗證，從而提示裝置它位於門戶之後。然而，[RFC 8910](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8910)引進了一種新的標準化方法，使網路能夠使用DHCP通知客戶端入口網站的存在。此外，[RFC 8908](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8908)描述了由DHCP指向的 Web 伺服器實現的API標準，客戶端可以從中取得目前的入口網站狀態。蘋果公司發布了一份 [文檔](https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=q78sq5rv) ，其中提供了更多詳細資訊。

Modern clients (especially iOS) moving towards this standardized API may experience redirection issues when connecting to a network only supporting forced redirection, which is often solved by utilizing this new standard instead.

現代用戶端（尤其是 iOS）向此標準化的API過渡時，在連接到僅支援強制重定向的網路時可能會遇到重定向問題，而使用此新標準通常可以解決此問題。

To configure this, a few steps are required:

要進行此配置，需要以下步驟：

-   You must install a valid, publicly trusted certificate on the Captive Portal zone. For example, you can use ACME client to automate this process. Doing so is best practice regardless of redirection method.  
    您必須在強制門戶區域安裝有效的、受公眾信任的憑證。例如，您可以使用ACME客戶端來自動執行此程序。無論採用何種重定向方法，這樣做都是最佳實踐。
    
-   The DHCPv4 server running in your Captive Portal zone must present option 114, of which the value must be set to the OPNsense webserver running the portal: `https://<opnsense-hostname>/api/captiveportal/access/api`. Alternatively, a client can also be pointed to the redirected webserver directly: `https://<opnsense-hostname>:<8000 + captive portal zone id>/api/captiveportal/access/api`. For example, `https://opnsense.localdomain:8001/api/captiveportal/access/api` for zone 1. See the attention block below for more details. To set this DHCP option, refer to the documentation for the respective DHCP server.  
    在您的強制入口網站區域執行的 DHCPv4 伺服器必須提供選項 114，其值必須設定為運行該入口網站的 OPNsense Web 伺服器： `https://<opnsense-hostname>/api/captiveportal/access/api` 。或者，也可以將客戶端直接指向重定向的 Web 伺服器： `https://<opnsense-hostname>:<8000 + captive portal zone id>/api/captiveportal/access/api` 。例如，區域 1 的值為`https://opnsense.localdomain:8001/api/captiveportal/access/api`有關更多詳細信息，請參閱下面的注意事項。若要設定此DHCP選項，請參閱對應DHCP伺服器的文件。
    

If a device in the captive portal zone supports this API, they will automatically use the DHCP option to determine that they are in a captive state. Keep in mind that forced redirection is still used for maximum compatibility. If you would like to excusively use this API standard instead, you can override the firewall rules for each zone and leave out the redirection rules, see [rules](#p-200).

如果強制門戶區域中的裝置支援此API ，則會自動使用DHCP選項來確定其處於強制狀態。請注意，為了最大程度地相容，仍然會使用強制重定向。如果您希望完全使用此API標準，則可以覆寫每個區域的防火牆規則並省略重定向規則，請參閱 [規則](#p-200) 。

Attention

注意

Once a client has logged in through the portal, your firewall policies define what this client can and cannot access. Unless you have configured the DHCP option to point to the portal webserver directly by specifying the port, the `/api/captiveportal/access/api` endpoint now points to the regular OPNsense WebGUI on port 443, because authenticated clients are not redirected. This also means that clients cannot determine captivity state anymore.

當用戶端透過入口網站登入後，您的防火牆策略將定義該用戶端可以存取和無法存取的內容。除非您已設定DHCP選項透過指定連接埠直接指向入口網站 Web 伺服器，否則`/api/captiveportal/access/api`端點現在指向連接埠 443 上的常規 OPNsense WebGUI，因為已認證的用戶端不會被重新導向。這也意味著客戶端無法再確定是否處於強制存取狀態。

If you would like to restrict client access to this endpoint only, you must configure the proper forwarding rule as shown below. Note that this means clients cannot access the OPNsense WebGUI anymore, which is often desirable.

如果您希望將用戶端存取權限限制為僅此端點，則必須按如下所示配置對應的轉送規則。請注意，這意味著客戶端將無法再存取 OPNsense WebGUI，而這通常是我們希望看到的。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | Destination NAT (Port Forward)<br>目標NAT （連接埠轉送） |
| **Interface**<br>**介面** | <Zone interface> |
| **Version**<br>**版本** | IPv4+IPv6 |
| **Protocol**<br>**協議** | TCP |
| **Source**<br>**來源** | \_\_captiveportal\_zone\_<zone id><br>\_\_captiveportal\_zone\_ <zone id> |
| **Destination**<br>**目標位置** | This Firewall<br>此防火牆 |
| **Destination port range**<br>**目標連接埠範圍** | 443 |
| **Redirect Target IP**<br>**重定向目標IP** | 127.0.0.1 |
| **Redirect Target Port**<br>**重定向目標連接埠** | 8000 + <zone id> |
| **NAT Reflection**<br>**NAT反射** | Disable (advanced)<br>關閉（進階） |
| **Firewall rule**<br>**防火牆規則** | Pass<br>通過 |

Note

筆記

The OPNsense `/api/captiveportal/access/api` endpoint returns the following information:

OPNsense `/api/captiveportal/access/api`端點傳回以下資訊：

-   Whether a client is ‘captive’ at this point in time.  
    客戶目前是否處於「被困」狀態。
    
-   The URL of the portal.  
    門戶的URL 。
    
-   If the client is authenticated and a hard timeout is set, how many seconds are remaining for this session.  
    如果用戶端已通過身份驗證並且設定了硬性逾時，則此會話還剩下多少秒？

管理選單提供對區域配置和範本管理的存取權限。

##### Migration notes & technical details｜遷移說明及技術細節

Important

重要

Starting from OPNsense Community edition 25.1.4 or Business edition 25.10, the underlying captive portal implementation has moved from IPFW to PF. While in most cases this has no practical impact, a more detailed description of what this means, as well as any incompatibilities are described here.

從 OPNsense 社群版25.1.4或企業版25.10開始，底層強制入口網站的實作已從IPFW升級到PF 。雖然在大多數情況下這不會產生實際影響，但本文將更詳細地說明其含義以及任何不相容性。

Previously, our Captive Portal implementation was split up into two components, IPFW and PF. Packets would enter an interface, where IPFW was the first to handle them and redirect traffic to the portal. After authentication, a rule to allow all traffic to and from this client would be inserted. Any traffic passed by IPFW would then be handled by PF. The reverse was true for outbound traffic. This process has been simplified by moving the redirection and accounting logic to PF.

之前，我們的強制門戶實作分為兩個元件： IPFW和PF 。封包進入介面後，首先由IPFW處理，並將流量重定向到入口網站。驗證後，會插入一條規則，允許所有進出該客戶端的流量。任何經由IPFW轉送的流量隨後將由PF處理。出站流量的處理流程則相反。現在，我們將重定向和計費邏輯移至PF ，從而簡化了這個過程。

This has multiple benefits:

這樣做有多重好處：

-   The generated rules are now visible in the WebGUI and are logged by default, easing troubleshooting.  
    產生的規則現在可在 WebGUI 中查看，並且預設會記錄日誌，從而簡化故障排除。
    
-   The list of clients that have been authenticated is now an alias and is visible, as well as usable in rules. The alias is called `__captiveportal_zone_<zoneid>`.  
    已通過身份驗證的客戶端清單現在是一個別名，既可見，也可以在規則中使用。該別名名為`__captiveportal_zone_<zoneid>` 。
    
-   Unless custom shaper rules are used, IPFW does not need to be loaded anymore, significantly reducing implementation complexity.  
    除非使用自訂整形規則，否則不再需要載入IPFW ，從而大大降低了實現的複雜性。
    

The following are the only functional/behavioral changes:

以下僅是功能/行為上的變化：

-   If you have forwarding rules defined on your captive portal zone that redirect a client for services other than HTTP/HTTPS, the “Filter Rule Association”（篩選規則關聯） option on this rule must be set to “Pass”（經過） so that this traffic is allowed after redirection; otherwise, this traffic will hit the default captive portal block rule. An example of such a scenario would be client DNS traffic redirected to a DNS service running on localhost.  
    如果您在強制入口網站區域中定義了轉送規則，將用戶端重定向到除HTTP/HTTPS之外的其他服務，則必須將此規則中的“Filter Rule Association”（篩選規則關聯）選項設定為“Pass”（經過）以便允許重定向後的流量；否則，此流量將觸發預設的強制入口網站阻止規則。例如，客戶端DNS流量被重定向到運行在本地主機上的DNS服務。
    
-   The “Allow Inbound”（允許入站） option has been dropped. This option only affected IPFW rules and controlled whether traffic from another network going to the captive portal zone would be allowed. This behavior is now determined by the ruleset of the network where the traffic is originating from. As an example, if some network on a non-captive interface is allowed everywhere according to the ruleset, this traffic is also allowed into the captive portal zone. If this is not desired, an explicit block rule must be configured on said interface.  
    “Allow Inbound”（允許入站）選項已移除。此選項僅影響IPFW規則，用於控制是否允許來自其他網路的流量進入強制門戶區域。現在，此行為由流量來源網路的規則集決定。例如，如果根據規則集，非強制介面上的某個網路允許所有流量進入，則該流量也允許進入強制門戶區域。如果不希望如此，則必須在該介面上配置明確阻止規則。
    
-   Unless you are overriding the (newly) automatically generated firewall rules, you don’t need an explicit pass rule for DNS (port 53) on the firewall, nor an allow rule for the captive portal zones (ports 8000-10000) anymore. These are now installed by default.  
    除非您覆蓋了（新產生的）防火牆規則，否則您不再需要在防火牆上為DNS （連接埠 53）新增明確的允許規則，也不再需要為強制入口網站區域（連接埠 8000-10000）新增允許規則。這些規則現在預設已安裝。
    

###### Captive Portal Firewall rules｜強制門戶防火牆規則

When running a default Captive Portal zone, the necessary rules for redirection are automatically installed in the zone. These rules have a higher priority than any user-defined rules. Therefore, to allow for flexibility, these rules may be overridden using the “Disable firewall rules” option in the zone administration. The automatically generated rules are listed here so they may be recreated for proper portal functionality.

執行預設強制門戶區域時，重定向所需的規則會自動安裝到該區域。這些規則的優先順序高於任何使用者定義的規則。因此，為了提高靈活性，可以使用區域管理中的「停用防火牆規則」選項來覆寫這些規則。這裡列出了自動產生的規則，以便您可以重新建立它們，確保入口網站功能正常運作。

**Redirect traffic to the zone webserver｜將流量重新導向到區域 Web 伺服器**

All HTTP traffic going to port 80 is redirected to localhost port 9000 + <zone id>.

所有發送至 80 連接埠的HTTP流量都被重定向到 localhost 9000 連接埠 + <zone id> 。

All HTTPS traffic going to the firewall on port 443 is redirected to localhost port 8000 + <zone id>.

所有發送到防火牆 443 連接埠的HTTPS流量都被重定向到本地主機 8000 連接埠 + <zone id> 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | Destination NAT (Port Forward)<br>目標NAT （連接埠轉送） |
| **Interface**<br>**介面** | <Zone interface> |
| **Protocol**<br>**協議** | TCP |
| **Source Invert**<br>**來源反轉** | Yes<br>是 |
| **Source**<br>**來源** | \_\_captiveportal\_zone\_<zone id><br>\_\_captiveportal\_zone\_ <zone id> |
| **Destination Invert**<br>**目的地反轉** | Yes<br>是 |
| **Destination**<br>**目的地** | \_\_captiveportal\_zone\_<zone id><br>\_\_captiveportal\_zone\_ <zone id> |
| **Destination port range**<br>**目標連接埠範圍** | 80 |
| **Redirect Target IP**<br>**重定向目標IP** | 127.0.0.1 |
| **Redirect Target Port**<br>**重定向目標連接埠** | 9000 + <zone id> |
| **NAT Reflection**<br>**NAT反射** | Disable (advanced)<br>關閉（進階） |

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | Destination NAT (Port Forward)<br>目標NAT （連接埠轉送） |
| **Interface**<br>**接口** | <Zone interface> |
| **Protocol**<br>**協議** | TCP |
| **Source Invert**<br>**來源反轉** | Yes<br>是 |
| **Source**<br>**來源** | \_\_captiveportal\_zone\_<zone id><br>\_\_captiveportal\_zone\_ <zone id> |
| **Destination**<br>**目標位置** | This Firewall<br>此防火牆 |
| **Destination port range**<br>**目標連接埠範圍** | 443 |
| **Redirect Target IP**<br>**重定向目標IP** | 127.0.0.1 |
| **Redirect Target Port**<br>**重定向目標連接埠** | 8000 + <zone id> |
| **NAT Reflection**<br>**NAT反射** | Disable<br>關閉 |

For IPv6, the same rules as above must be created, but the Destination must be set to the “<Zone interface> address”.

對於 IPv6，必須建立與上述相同的規則，但目標必須設定為「 <Zone interface>位址」。

The destination for HTTP traffic is the inverted zone alias, so that traffic from unauthenticated clients going to authenticated or explicitly allowed clients/servers (allowed addresses in the zone administration) is not redirected. This is useful if unauthenticated clients should be able to access servers in the same zone.

HTTP流量的目標位址是反向區域別名，這樣，來自未經身份驗證的用戶端發送至已驗證或已明確允許的用戶端/伺服器（區域管理中允許的位址）的流量就不會被重新導向。如果未經身份驗證的用戶端需要存取同一區域中的伺服器，這將非常有用。

Attention

注意

If you use [OIDC](#p-050) for authentication, the HTTPS requests would also be redirected before authentication is possible. To solve this, create an additional “No RDR (NOT)” rule **before** the other NAT rules with the identity provider IP addresses as destination.

如果您使用 [OIDC](#p-050)進行身份驗證，則HTTPS請求也會在驗證完成之前被重定向。為了解決此問題，請在其他NAT規則之前**建立**一條額外的「禁止RDR ( NOT )」規則，並將身分提供者IP位址作為目標位址。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | Destination NAT (Port Forward)<br>目標NAT （連接埠轉送） |
| **No RDR (NOT)**<br>**否RDR ( NOT )** | Yes<br>是 |
| **Interface**<br>**接口** | <Zone interface> |
| **Protocol**<br>**協議** | TCP |
| **Source**<br>**來源** | any<br>任何 |
| **Destination**<br>**目標位址** | identity\_provider\_ip\_addresses<br>identity_provider_ip_addresses |
| **Destination port range**<br>**目標連接埠範圍** | 443 |

**Allow DNS｜允許DNS**

In order to allow the client to resolve at least the OPNsense hostname, DNS must be allowed.

為了讓客戶端解析至少 OPNsense 主機名，必須允許DNS 。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | Firewall rule<br>防火牆規則 |
| **Action**<br>**行動** | Pass<br>通行證 |
| **Interface**<br>**接口** | <Zone interface> |
| **Protocol**<br>**協議** | TCP/UDP |
| **Direction**<br>**方向** | In<br>向 |
| **Source**<br>**來源** | <Zone net> |
| **Destination**<br>**目標位置** | This Firewall<br>此防火牆 |
| **Destination port range**<br>**目標埠範圍** | DNS/DNS |

We define “This Firewall”（此防火牆） as the destination since the default DNS service, Unbound, may return multiple IP addresses identifying the firewall.

我們將“This Firewall”（此防火牆）定義為目標，因為預設的DNS服務 Unbound 可能會傳回多個IP位址來標識防火牆。

**Allow access to Captive Portal｜允許存取強制門戶**

The redirection rules still need associated pass rules. These rules are also used for clients directly accessing the captive portal webserver, e.g. using port 8000 in the URL.

重定向規則仍然需要關聯的通行規則。這些規則也用於直接存取強制入口網站伺服器的用戶端，例如使用URL中的 8000 連接埠。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | Firewall rule<br>防火牆規則 |
| **Action**<br>**行動** | Pass<br>通行證 |
| **Interface**<br>**接口** | <Zone interface> |
| **Version**<br>**版本** | IPv4+IPv6 |
| **Protocol**<br>**協議** | TCP |
| **Direction**<br>**方向** | In<br>向 |
| **Source**<br>**來源** | <Zone net> |
| **Destination**<br>**目標位置** | This Firewall<br>此防火牆 |
| **Destination port range**<br>**目標連接埠範圍** | 8000 + zone id<br>8000 + 區域 ID |

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | Firewall rule<br>防火牆規則 |
| **Action**<br>**行動** | Pass<br>通行證 |
| **Interface**<br>**接口** | <Zone interface> |
| **Version**<br>**版本** | IPv4+IPv6 |
| **Protocol**<br>**協議** | TCP |
| **Direction**<br>**方向** | In<br>向 |
| **Source**<br>**來源** | <Zone net> |
| **Destination**<br>**目標位置** | This Firewall<br>此防火牆 |
| **Destination port range**<br>**目標連接埠範圍** | 9000 + zone id<br>9000 + 區域 ID |

**Default block rule for non-authenticated users｜未認證使用者的預設阻止規則**

Any traffic originating from a client that is not DNS or access to the portal web page, is blocked according to the rule below.

根據以下規則，任何來自非DNS客戶端或造訪入口網站網頁的流量均被封鎖。

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Type**<br>**類型** | Firewall rule<br>防火牆規則 |
| **Action**<br>**操作** | Block<br>阻止 |
| **Interface**<br>**接口** | <Zone interface> |
| **Protocol**<br>**協議** | Any<br>任意 |
| **Direction**<br>**方向** | In<br>向 |
| **Source Invert**<br>**來源反轉** | Yes<br>是 |
| **Source**<br>**來源** | \_\_captiveportal\_zone\_<zone id><br>\_\_captiveportal\_zone\_ <zone id> |
| **Destination Invert**<br>**目的地反轉** | Yes<br>是 |
| **Destination**<br>**目的地** | \_\_captiveportal\_zone\_<zone id><br>\_\_captiveportal\_zone\_ <zone id> |

After the above rules, an explicit pass rule is still required to allow clients to go to the internet, as would normally be the case on any interface that has no firewall rules defined.

在上述規則之後，仍然需要明確的通行規則來允許客戶端存取互聯網，這在任何沒有定義防火牆規則的介面上通常都是如此。

#### Examples

<a id="p-201"></a>

##### Setup a Guest Network｜設定訪客網絡

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/guestnet.html>

This how to will explain how to setup a guest network using the captive portal. Guest Networks are widely used to allow guests controlled internet access at hotels, RV Parks or businesses.

本指南將解釋如何使用強制門戶設定訪客網路。訪客網路廣泛用於允許訪客在飯店、 RV或企業中受控存取互聯網。

[![../../_images/opnsense_hotspot_controller.png](<../images/79cec6a8-opnsense_hotspot_controller.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/opnsense_hotspot_controller.png)

Note

筆記

For the example we expect the GUESTNET interface to be connected with your actual guest network switch or access point. This tutorial does not explain how to setup a wireless network.

在本範例中，我們預期GUESTNET介面將連接到您實際的訪客網路交換器或存取點。本教學不講解如何設定無線網路。

Security considerations

安全考量

The Captive portal functionality operates entirely on the information available in the network. Protocols such as ARP or NDP do not provide any inherent proof of ownership. Since the portal has no control over the client, it is impossible to cryptographically prove a relationship between identity and device. Therefore, to improve security, the layer 2 network(s) attached to the portal must be properly isolated on the access point/switch level.

強制門戶功能完全依賴網路中可用資訊的運作。諸如ARP或NDP之類的協議本身並未提供所有權證明。由於入口網站無法控制用戶端，因此無法透過加密方式證明身分與裝置之間的關係。因此，為了提高安全性，連接到入口網站的二層網路必須在存取點/交換器層級進行適當的隔離。

These features are often called “layer 2 isolation” for access points or “port isolation” for switches and prevent direct client-to-client communication. These features cannot prevent spoofing, but lower visibility in the network.

這些功能通常被稱為存取點的“二層隔離”或交換器的“連接埠隔離”，它們可以防止客戶端之間的直接通訊。這些功能無法阻止欺騙攻擊，但可以降低網路可見度。

If stronger identity is a requirement, the Captive Portal likely isn’t for you. Consider using 802.1X network access control backed by a RADIUS/ policy server instead.

如果需要更強大的身份驗證，那麼強制入口網站可能不適合您。您可以考慮使用由RADIUS /策略伺服器支援的802.1X網路存取控制。

Note that this is less relevant if you use a layer 3 network such as WireGuard.

請注意，如果您使用 WireGuard 等第 3 層網絡，則這一點不太重要。

###### Businesses｜企業

Businesses usually want to share internet access with their guest and show them a landing page with a welcome message and some usage guidelines (policy). At the same time it is important to make sure guests won’t be able to access the company’s local network and limit the maximum internet usage.

企業通常希望與訪客分享網路接入，並向他們展示包含歡迎資訊和使用指南（政策）的登入頁面。同時，確保訪客無法存取公司本地網路並限制最大網路使用量也至關重要。

###### Hotels and RV Parks｜飯店和RV公園

Hotels and RV parks usually utilize a captive portal to allow guests (paid) access to internet for a limited duration. Guests need to login using a voucher they can either buy or obtain for free at the reception. OPNsense has built-in support for vouchers and can easily create them on the fly. With this example we will show you how to setup the Guest Network for this purpose and setup a reception account for creating new vouchers.

飯店和RV通常使用強制入口網站，允許付費客人限時存取網路。客人需要使用憑證登錄，憑證可以在前台購買或免費領取。 OPNsense 內建了憑證支持，可以輕鬆即時建立憑證。本範例將向您展示如何為此目的設定客人網絡，以及如何設定前台帳戶以建立新憑證。

###### Prerequisites｜先決條件

We will start configuration with a fresh OPNsense installation. You will need a system with a minimum of 3 ports (LAN/WAN/GUESTNET) for this tutorial.

我們將從一個全新的 OPNsense 安裝開始進行設定。本教學需要至少有 3 個連接埠（ LAN/WAN/GUESTNET ）的系統。

###### Good to know｜知道這個很有用

As the Hotel/RV Parks setup is almost identical to the business setup we will start with that and after finishing add/change the specifics to match the Hotel Guest setup.

由於酒店/ RV公園的設置與商業設置幾乎相同，我們將從商業設置開始，完成後添加/更改具體細節以匹配酒店客人設置。

否則按其預設設定）：
