#### Dynamic Routing (FRR)｜動態路由（ FRR ）

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/dynamic_routing.html>

-   [Installation](#p-210)  
    [安裝](#p-210)
    
-   [General setup](#p-210)  
    [通用設定](#p-210)
    
-   [Dynamic routing and high availability](#p-210)  
    [動態路由與高可用性](#p-210)
    
    -   [CARP failover mode](#p-210)  
        [CARP故障轉移模式](#p-210)
        
    -   [OSPF\[6\]: CARP demote](#p-210)  
        [ OSPF \[6\]: CARP降級]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/dynamic_routing.html#ospf-6-carp-demote )
        
    -   [OSPF\[6\]: Influence interface cost based on CARP status](#p-210)  
        [ OSPF \[6\]: 基於CARP狀態的影響介面成本]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/dynamic_routing.html#ospf-6-influence-interface-cost-based-on-carp-status )
        
-   [Dynamic Routing Protocols](#p-210)  
    [動態路由協定](#p-210)
    
    -   [RIP (Routing Information Protocol) - legacy](#p-210)  
        [RIP （路由資訊協定）- 傳統版](#p-210)
        
    -   [OSPF/OSPFv3 (Open Shortest Path First)](#p-210)  
        [OSPF /OSPFv3（開放最短路徑優先）](#p-210)
        
    -   [BGP (Border Gateway Protocol)](#p-210)  
        [BGP （邊界網關協定）](#p-210)
        
-   [Supplemental Protocols](#p-210)  
    [補充方案](#p-210)
    
    -   [BFD (Bidirectional Forward Detection)](#p-210)  
        [BFD （雙向向前向偵測）](#p-210)
        
    -   [STATIC (Static Routes Daemon)](#p-210)  
        [STATIC (靜態路由守護程序)](#p-210)
        

Dynamic Routing (using routing protocols) is supported via an external plugin. Routing protocols support your network equipment in finding the best available path for your packets. We use Free Range Routing ([FRR](https://frrouting.org/)) to implement the various available protocols for dynamic routing.

動態路由（使用路由協定）透過外部插件提供支援。路由協定可協助您的網路裝置找到資料包的最佳可用路徑。我們使用自由範圍路由（[FRR](https://frrouting.org/) ）來實現各種可用的動態路由協定。

These routing protocols are used to:

這些路由協定用於：

-   Improve fault tolerance (if a connection breaks, a new route will be found if possible)  
    提高容錯能力（如果連線中斷，將盡可能尋找新的路由）
    
-   Simplify administration (you have to add fewer routes manually)  
    簡化管理（減少手動新增的路由數量）
    

It is not advisable to use dynamic routing in the following scenarios:

在以下情況下不建議使用動態路由：

-   When your network is small (it would be simpler to use static routes)  
    當你的網路規模較小時（使用靜態路由會更簡單）。
    
-   If you are working in a highly isolated environment, where you have to be in control of every route in your network  
    如果你在高度封閉的環境中工作，你需要掌控網路中的每一個路由，那麼你一定能夠勝任。
    

Routing Protocols supported by the plugin include:

該插件支援的路由協定包括：

-   RIPv1 and RIPv2  
    RIPv1 和 RIPv2
    
-   OSPFv2 and v3  
    OSPFv2 和 v3
    
-   BGPv4
    

Warning

警告

Not all routing protocols will work in any setup because they may have to be direct neighbors. Consider the limitations of a routing protocol before using it.

並非所有路由協定都能在所有環境中正常運作，因為它們可能需要是直接相鄰的節點。在使用路由協定之前，請考慮其限制。

Warning

警告

It’s strongly advised to increase the kern.ipc.maxsockbuf value via **Tunables**. Go to System ‣ Settings ‣ Tunables and check if there is already a tunable for maxsockbuf and set it to 33554432 if it is lower. Otherwise add a new one with name above and the specified value.

強烈建議透過**Tunables**設定增加 kern.ipc.maxsockbuf 的值。依序進入“系統”‣“設定”‣“Tunables”，檢查是否已存在 maxsockbuf 的調整項，如果值低於 33554432，則將其設為 33554432。否則，請新增一個名稱與上述相同的調整項，並設定其對應的值。

Warning

警告

Disabling a running routing daemon can be dangerous as it can lead to an inaccessible machine. If you want to disable a running routing daemon, make sure you do not lose routes which are required by your connection to this machine (for example when using SSH).

停用正在運行的路由守護程序可能很危險，因為它可能導致機器無法存取。如果要停用正在執行的路由守護進程，請確保不會遺失連接到該機器所需的路由（例如，使用SSH時）。

##### [Installation](#p-210)｜[安裝](#p-210)

Go to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins and select `os-frr` from the available plugins.

進入系統‣韌體‣插件，然後從可用插件中選擇`os-frr` 。

##### [General setup](#p-210)｜[通用設定](#p-210)

To use one or more of the protocols included, the plugin must be enabled in Routing ‣ General. Without any other service enabled this makes sure the zebra service is being configured, which is the coordinating master service which handles generic features such as logging and access to kernel routing.

若要使用一個或多個內建協議，必須在「路由」‣「常規」中啟用該插件。在未啟用任何其他服務的情況下，這將確保配置 Zebra 服務，該服務是協調主服務，負責處理日誌記錄和核心路由存取等通用功能。

Tip

提示

By default logging should be enabled, which sends messages to the local logging and offers remote logging over syslog. Always make sure to choose a sensible log level (default is Notifications) and check the log in Routing ‣ Diagnostics -> Log

預設應啟用日誌記錄，這會將訊息傳送至本機日誌記錄，並透過 syslog 提供遠端日誌記錄。請務必選擇適當的日誌等級（預設為「通知」），並在「路由」‣「診斷」->「日誌」中查看日誌。

Note

筆記

The plugins supports seamless reloads since version os-frr-1.4.3. When using older versions, there is no configuration reloading. This means there might be a temporary loss of service when saving settings. Normally this is only a small glitch, but in high traffic areas it might be something to take under consideration when performing maintenance.

自 os-frr- 1.4.3版本起，外掛程式支援無縫重載。使用舊版本時，配置不會重新載入。這意味著在儲存設定時可能會出現短暫的服務中斷。通常這只是一個小故障，但在高流量區域，進行維護時可能需要考慮這一點。

##### [Dynamic routing and high availability](#p-210)｜[動態路由與高可用性](#p-210)

In enterprise networks there is often a need to protect services against all sorts of failures. Dynamic routing helps to always provide a valid path for packets to travel. These nodes themselved might need to be configured more resilient to prevent single points of failures on the edges of your network.

企業網路中經常需要保護服務免受各種故障的影響。動態路由有助於始終為資料包提供有效的傳輸路徑。這些節點本身可能需要配置得更具彈性，以防止網路邊緣出現單點故障。

In OPNsense high availability and failover is organised around [carp](#p-096), which makes it a logical choice to combine both technologies here as well.

在 OPNsense 中，高可用性和故障轉移是圍繞 [carp](#p-096)組織的，因此在這裡將這兩種技術結合起來也是一個合乎邏輯的選擇。

There are different strategies ranging from disabling the daemon when in carp mode, to more fine grained control of route propagation when a machine is in backup mode.

有多種策略可供選擇，例如在 CARP 模式下停用守護進程，以及在機器處於備份模式時對路由傳播進行更精細的控制。

Note

筆記

Unicast CARP is available to use the protocol across router boundaries. This can enable the use of CARP on WAN interfaces peering with eBGP neighbors if they are not connected to the same switch.

單播CARP可用於跨路由器邊界使用此協定。如果WAN介面與eBGP鄰居建立對等連接，且這些鄰居不在同一交換器上，則可以使用CARP 。

###### [CARP failover mode](#p-210)｜[CARP故障轉移模式](#p-210)

The most simple mode available. When a node becomes Backup it will stop the FRR services. When it returns to Master it will start the FRR services.

這是最簡單的模式。當節點變成備份節點時，它將停止FRR服務。當它恢復為主節點狀態時，它將啟動FRR服務。

Note

筆記

Due to the nature of this option, it cannot be combined with other available CARP options.

由於此選項的性質，它不能與其他可用的CARP選項組合使用。

###### [OSPF\[6\]: CARP demote](#p-210)｜[ OSPF \[6\]: CARP降級]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/dynamic_routing.html#id5 )

This option registers a [status monitor](#p-246) on top of the FRR logging feed to detect changes in link status. If OSPF cannot find its neighbors, it will make this machine less attractive by increasing the demotion factor.

此選項會在FRR日誌流之上註冊一個 [狀態監視器](#p-246)以偵測鏈路狀態的變化。如果OSPF找不到其鄰居，則會透過增加降級因子來降低該機器的吸引力。

The feature is inspired by OpenBSD’s handling of CARP demotion in ospfd ([https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5](https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5)) and can be enabled using the `CARP demote` checkbox in Routing: OSPF\[v3\].

此功能受 OpenBSD 對 ospfd 中CARP降級OSPF處理方式的啟發（[https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5](https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5) ），並且可以使用路由中的`CARP demote`複選框。

Note

筆記

Since the relevant neighbor negotiation messages are only being logged when the log level (in Routing ‣ General) is configured to debug, the log will be more chatty when using this feature. When using a lower log level the status monitor is not expected to catch any relevant events.

由於只有當日誌等級（在「路由」‣「常規」中）配置為「偵錯」時，才會記錄相關的鄰居協商訊息，因此使用此功能時日誌會更加冗長。如果使用較低的日誌級別，狀態監視器預計不會捕獲任何相關事件。

###### [OSPF\[6\]: Influence interface cost based on CARP status](#p-210)｜[ OSPF \[6\]: 基於CARP狀態的影響介面成本]( https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/dynamic_routing.html#id6 )

FRR does not natively support interaction with CARP status as the variant in OpenBSD does (carp note in “depend on” keyword [https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5](https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5)), this is where our next option comes into play.

FRR本身並不像 OpenBSD 中的變體那樣原生支援與CARP狀態進行交互（參見「依賴」關鍵字中的 carp 註釋 [https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5](https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5) ），這就是我們的下一個選擇發揮作用的地方。

Using the interface settings of an OSPF interface you can choose to adjust costs for that interface based on the CARP status of the selected virtual address. Go to Routing ‣ OSPF\[v3\] -> Interface and choose an interface, here you will find the following options that influence behaviour:

使用介面設置，您可以根據所選CARP OSPF調整該介面的成本。轉到“路由”‣ OSPF \[v3\] -> “接口”，然後選擇一個接口，您將在此處找到以下影響其行為的選項：

-   Depend on (carp):  
    取決於（鯉魚）：
    
    -   Select a virtual address that this interface relies on. When this target is not in **MASTER** mode, the selected interface is considered **demoted**  
        選擇此介面所依賴的虛擬位址。當此目標不在 **MASTER** 模式時，所選介面將被視為**降級**。
        
-   Cost (when demoted):  
    降級時的成本：
    
    -   Adjust the cost to this value when going to demoted state, usually one would use a high value here to prefer other routes first  
        降級狀態時，將成本調整為該值；通常情況下，此處會使用較高的值，以便優先選擇其他路徑。
        
-   Cost:  
    成本：
    
    -   The standard cost, when provided will be used when in normal conditions. If it’s left blank FRR defaults will be used, which it will also rollback to when going back to master mode.  
        如果提供標準成本，則在正常情況下將使用該成本。如果留空FRR則將使用預設值，並且在返回主模式時也會回滾到該預設值。
        

##### [Dynamic Routing Protocols](#p-210)｜[動態路由協定](#p-210)

For more detailed information, check out the [FRR documentation](https://docs.frrouting.org/en/latest/protocols.html).

有關更多詳細信息，請查看 [FRR文檔](https://docs.frrouting.org/en/latest/protocols.html) 。

Routing ‣ General

路由 ‣ 常規

**General**

**一般的**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enable**<br>**啟用** | This will activate the routing service. Without enabling it globally, none of the individual services will run.<br>這將啟動路由服務。如果不全域啟用，所有單獨的服務都將無法運作。 |
| **Profile**<br>**設定檔** | Control FRR’s default profile: traditional reflects defaults adhering mostly to IETF standards or common practices in wide-area internet routing. datacenter reflects a single administrative domain with intradomain links using aggressive timers.<br>控制FRR的預設設定檔：傳統設定檔反映了主要遵循IETF標準或廣域網路路由常見做法的預設設定。資料中心設定檔反映了使用激進計時器的域內鏈路的單一管理域。 |
| **Enable CARP Failover**<br>**啟用CARP故障轉移** | This will activate the routing service only on the master device. The backup device will stop the service completely.<br>這將只在主設備上啟動路由服務。備用設備將完全停止該服務。 |
| **Enable SNMP AgentX Support**<br>**啟用SNMP AgentX 支援** | This will activate support for Net-SNMP AgentX.<br>這將啟動對 Net- SNMP AgentX 的支援。 |
| **Enable logging**<br>**啟用日誌記錄** | Sends logs to the OPNsense integrated syslog-ng service.<br>將日誌傳送至 OPNsense 整合的 syslog-ng 服務。 |
| **Log Level**<br>**日誌等級** | This is the detail level of the log. A higher level means more data is logged.<br>這是日誌的詳細程度。等級越高，記錄的數據越多。 |
| **Firewall Rules**<br>**防火牆規則** | Enable automatically created firewall rules, when additional policies are needed, disable this and define your own custom policies in the Firewall section.<br>啟用自動建立的防火牆規則；如果需要其他策略，請停用此功能並在防火牆部分定義您自己的自訂策略。 |

**Firewall Rules**

**防火牆規則**

| Description<br>說明 | Rule autogenerated by Firewall Rules option<br>由防火牆規則選項自動產生的規則 |
| --- | --- |
| **Pass OSPF**<br>**透過OSPF** | Allows OSPF traffic from configured network IP address ranges to multicast 224.0.0.0/24 (direction: in).<br>允許來自已配置網路OSPF位址範圍IP流量進行組播224.0.0.0/24 （方向：入）。 |
| **Pass OSPF UNICAST**<br>**透過OSPF UNICAST** | Allows OSPF unicast traffic from configured network IP address ranges to the local interface (direction: in).<br>允許來自已設定網路OSPF位址範圍IP單播流量到達本地介面（方向：入）。 |
| **Pass OSPF**<br>**透過OSPF** | Allows OSPF traffic from the local interface to multicast 224.0.0.0/24 (direction: out).<br>允許來自本地介面的OSPF流量進行組播224.0.0.0/24 （方向：出）。 |
| **Pass OSPF UNICAST**<br>**透過OSPF UNICAST** | Allows OSPF unicast traffic from the local interface to configured network IP address ranges (direction: out).<br>允許從本機介面向已設定IP OSPF範圍傳送單播流量（方向：出）。 |
| **Pass OSPF6 MULTICAST**<br>**透過OSPF6組播** | Allows OSPFv3 traffic from link-local IPv6 (fe80::0/10) to multicast address ff02::5/128 (direction: in).<br>允許來自連結本地 IPv6 位址 (fe80::0/10) 的 OSPFv3 流量傳送至組播位址 ff02::5/128（方向：入）。 |
| **Pass OSPF6 MULTICAST DR**<br>**透過OSPF6組播DR** | Allows OSPFv3 traffic from link-local IPv6 (fe80::0/10) to multicast address ff02::6/128 (direction: in).<br>允許來自連結本地 IPv6 位址 (fe80::0/10) 的 OSPFv3 流量發送至組播位址 ff02::6/128（方向：入）。 |
| **Pass OSPF6 UNICAST**<br>**透過OSPF6 UNICAST** | Allows OSPFv3 unicast traffic from link-local IPv6 (fe80::0/10) to the local interface (direction: in).<br>允許來自連結本地 IPv6 (fe80::0/10) 的 OSPFv3 單播流量到達本地介面（方向：入）。 |
| **Pass OSPF6 MULTICAST**<br>**透過OSPF6多播** | Allows OSPFv3 traffic from the local interface to multicast address ff02::5/128 (direction: out).<br>允許從本地介面到多播位址 ff02::5/128 的 OSPFv3 流量（方向：出）。 |
| **Pass OSPF6 MULTICAST DR** | Allows OSPFv3 traffic from the local interface to multicast address ff02::6/128 (direction: out).<br>允許從本地介面到組播位址 ff02::6/128 的 OSPFv3 流量（方向：出）。 |
| **Pass OSPF6 UNICAST**<br>**透過OSPF6 UNICAST** | Allows OSPFv3 unicast traffic from the local interface to link-local IPv6 (fe80::0/10) (direction: out).<br>允許從本地介面到連結本地 IPv6 (fe80::0/10) 的 OSPFv3 單播流量（方向：出）。 |

Attention

注意

Any route received with dynamic routing protocols will only be installed if no similar local route already exists. E.g., if a neighbor advertises a default gateway route, but a directly attached default gateway route already exists, the local route will be preferred and the advertised route will be discarded.

使用動態路由協定接收到的任何路由，只有在不存在類似的本地路由時才會安裝。例如，如果鄰居通告了一條預設閘道路由，但已存在一條直接連接的預設閘道路由，則優先使用本機路由，並丟棄通告的路由。

###### [RIP (Routing Information Protocol) - legacy](#p-210)｜[RIP （路由資訊協定）- 傳統版](#p-210)

Routing ‣ RIP

路由 ‣ RIP

**General**

**一般的**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |

| **Route Redistribution**<br>**路由重新分配** | Select other routing sources, which should be redistributed to the other nodes. A good choice is Connected Routes to automatically redistribute all locally attached routes to other routers with RIP. Otherwise use the Networks option to manually insert networks to distribute.<br>選擇其他路由來源，重新指派到其他節點。一個不錯的選擇是連接路由，它可以使用 RIP 自動將所有本地連接的路由重新分發到其他路由器。否則，請使用“網路”選項手動插入要分發的網路。 |

| **Default Metric**<br>**預設指標** | Set the default metric to a value between 1 and 16. Routes with lower metrics will be preferred, while higher metrics indicate less preferred or distant paths.<br>將預設度量值設為 1 到 16 之間的值。具有較低度量值的路由將是首選，而較高度量值表示較不首選或較遠的路徑。 |

The Routing Information Protocol (RIP) is a basic distance-vector routing protocol that determines the best path to a network destination based on hop count. With a maximum limit of 15 hops, RIP is suitable only for smaller networks. To prevent routing loops, RIP employs techniques like split horizon, route poisoning, and holddown timers. While easy to configure, RIP has slow convergence and limited scalability, making it less popular in modern networks compared to more efficient protocols like OSPF. It should be considered a legacy protocol.

路由資訊協定 (RIP) 是一種基本的距離向量路由協議，它根據跳數確定到達網路目的地的最佳路徑。 RIP 的最大限制為 15 跳，僅適用於較小的網路。為了防止路由環路，RIP採用了水平分割、路由中毒和抑制定時器等技術。雖然易於配置，但RIP收斂速度慢且可擴展性有限，與OSPF等更高效的協定相比，它在現代網路中不太受歡迎。它應該被視為遺留協議。

The Backbone Area connects other areas, supporting inter-area communication, while additional areas (e.g., 0.0.0.1, 0.0.0.255) segment the network logically to limit routing updates.<br>使用 0.0.0.0（骨幹區域）等標識符將網路分配到 OSPF 區域。骨幹區域連接其他區域，支援區域間通信，而附加區域（例如0.0.0.1, 0.0.0.255）則對網路進行邏輯分段以限制路由更新。 |

Note

筆記

Using a **Network** configuration with 0.0.0.0 as the Backbone Area is beneficial in larger networks, where defining broad network ranges streamlines OSPF configuration. This approach avoids the need to configure OSPF individually on each interface by including all subnets within the specified range. The Backbone Area serves as the primary route aggregation point, allowing inter-area communication which is essential in hierarchical OSPF networks. Networks and Interfaces cannot have the same Area, only one of them can be defined in the Backbone Area.

在大型網路中，使用以0.0.0.0為骨幹區域的**網路**配置非常有利，因為定義寬泛的網路範圍可以簡化OSPF的配置。這種方法避免了在每個介面上單獨配置OSPF ，因為它包含了指定範圍內的所有子網路。骨幹區域作為主要的路由聚合點，支援區域間的通信，這在分層OSPF網路中至關重要。網路和介面不能屬於同一個區域，骨幹區域中只能定義其中一個。

| **Area**<br>**面積** | Assigns the network to an OSPF area using an identifier like 0.0.0.0 (Backbone Area). | **Cost**<br>**成本** | Sets the OSPF metric for path selection; lower costs are preferred paths within the area.<br>設定路徑選擇的OSPF指標；成本越低，區域內的路徑越受青睞。 |
| **Cost (when demoted)**<br>**降級時的成本** | Specifies metric cost when interface is in backup mode via CARP, deprioritizing paths dynamically.<br>指定介面處於備份模式時（透過CARP動態降低路徑優先權）的指標成本。 |
| **Depend on (carp)**<br>**取決於（carp）** | Links the interface cost to a CARP VHID, adjusting costs based on primary or backup status.<br>將介面成本與CARP VHID關聯，並根據主備狀態調整成本。 |

| **Dead Interval**<br>**失效間隔** | Defines the timeout period for OSPF neighbors; after this period, the neighbor is marked as down.<br>定義OSPF鄰居的超時時間；超過此時間後，鄰居將被標記為宕機。 |
| **Retransmission Interval**<br>**重傳間隔** | Time (seconds) to wait before resending Link-State Advertisements (LSAs) if acknowledgment is delayed.<br>如果確認延遲，則在重新傳送連結狀態通告 (LSA) 之前等待的時間（秒）。 |

| **BFD** | Activates Bidirectional Forwarding Detection for rapid link failure detection; peer configuration required.<br>啟用雙向轉送偵測，以便快速偵測連結故障；需要對等方配置。 |
| **Network Type**<br>**網路類型** | Defines the OSPF network type, impacting adjacency and LSA flooding methods.<br>• **Broadcast Multi-Access**: Assumes networks supporting multiple routers with broadcast capability (e.g., Ethernet).<br>• **Non-Broadcast Multi-Access (NBMA)**: For networks without broadcast support (e.g., Frame Relay); requires manual neighbor setup.<br>• **Point-to-Multipoint**: Connects multiple routers over a single interface, treating each as a point-to-point link.<br>• **Point-to-Point**: Directly connects two routers, simplifying adjacency and LSA transmission.<br>定義OSPF網路類型，影響鄰接和LSA洪氾方法。 <br>•**廣播多路存取**：假設網路支援具有廣播功能的多個路由器（例如乙太網路）。 <br>•**非廣播多路存取(NBMA)**：適用於不支援廣播的網路（例如訊框中繼）；需手動鄰居設定。 <br>•**點對多點**：透過單一介面連接多個路由器，將每個路由器視為點對點連結。 <br>•**點對點**：直接連接兩個路由器，簡化鄰接和LSA 傳輸。 |

Note

筆記

**Interfaces** in OSPF are for defining how each interface participates in OSPF routing. Key settings include **Area**, **Hello Interval** and **Dead Interval** for neighbor relationships and **Cost** for path preference. Networks and Interfaces cannot have the same Area, only one of them can be defined in the Backbone Area. For simpler networks, using Interfaces is recommended.

OSPF中的**介面**用來定義每個介面如何參與OSPF路由。關鍵設定包括用於鄰居關係的**區域**、**Hello 間隔**和**Dead 間隔**，以及用於路徑優先順序的**成本**。網路和介面不能擁有相同的區域，主幹區域中只能定義其中一個。對於較簡單的網絡，建議使用介面。

**前綴列表**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |

Note

筆記

**Prefix Lists** in OSPF serve as a filter to control the distribution of specific IP ranges within the network. Though not as common as in BGP, prefix filtering can prevent or allow propagation of defined network routes.

OSPF中的**前綴列表**用作過濾器，控制特定IP範圍在網路中的分佈。雖然不如BGP中那麼常見，但前綴過濾可以阻止或允許已定義網路路由的傳播。

**Route Maps**

**路線圖**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |

| **Name**<br>**名稱** | Route-map name for matching and setting patterns, enabled via redistribution.<br>用於匹配和設定模式的路由映射名稱，透過重新分發啟用。 |

| **Set**<br>**設定** | Free text for setting options, e.g., “local-preference 300” or “community 1:1”.<br>用於設定選項的自由文本，例如「本地首選項 300」或「社區 1:1」。 |

Note

筆記

**Route Maps** act like conditional filters, allowing you to set and modify OSPF route attributes based on match criteria. They can combine prefix lists for detailed route manipulation.

**路線圖** 的作用類似於條件過濾器，允許您根據匹配條件設定和修改OSPF路線屬性。它們可以組合前綴列表，以便進行更精細的路線操作。

Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) is a widely used link-state routing protocol designed for IP networks within a single autonomous system (AS). Operating as an interior gateway protocol (IGP), OSPF builds a network topology map by gathering link-state information from routers, allowing it to create an optimal routing table for IP packet delivery. OSPFv2 (RFC 2328) supports IPv4, while v3 (RFC 5340) extends support to IPv6.

開放最短路徑優先 (OSPF) ( OSPF ) 是一種廣泛使用的鏈路狀態路由協議IP專為單一自治系統 ( AS ) 內的網路而設計。作為內部網關協定 ( IGP )， OSPF透過從路由器收集鏈路狀態資訊來建立網路拓撲圖，從而創建用於資料包傳遞的最優路由表IP )。 OSPFv2 ( RFC 2328) 支援 IPv4，而 v3 ( RFC 5340) 則擴充了對 IPv6 的支援。

**一般的**

**鄰居**

| **Local Initiater IP**<br>**本地發起方IP** | Specify the local IP address used to establish connections with the neighbor. Only relevant for MD5 authentication.<br>指定用於與鄰居建立連線的本地IP位址。僅與MD5身份驗證相關。 |
| **Update-Source Interface**<br>**更新來源介面** | Interface where BGP sessions are sourced from, typically required when using loopback addresses.<br>BGP會話的來源接口，通常在使用環回位址時需要。 |
| **IPv6 link-local interface**<br>**IPv6鏈路本地接口** | Interface for IPv6 link-local neighbors, used primarily for link-local IPv6 addressing.<br>用於IPv6鏈路本地鄰居的接口，主要用於鏈路本地IPv6尋址。 |
| **Next-Hop-Self**<br>**下一跳本身** | Sets the local router as the next hop for routes advertised to the neighbor, commonly used in Route Reflector setups.<br>將本機路由器設定為向鄰居通告的路由的下一跳，常用於路由反射器設定。 |
| **Next-Hop-Self All** | Extends Next-Hop-Self by applying the setting to all addresses, including multiple address families.<br>將 Next-Hop-Self 設定擴展到所有位址，包括多個位址族。 |
| **Multi-Hop**<br>**多跳** | Enables connections to eBGP neighbors across multiple hops; often required for peering over loopback addresses.<br>允許跨多跳與 eBGP 鄰居建立連線；通常需要透過環回位址進行對等。 |
| **Multi-Protocol**<br>**多重協定** | Enables multiprotocol BGP for support of additional address families like IPv6.<br>啟用多重協定BGP ，以支援 IPv6 等其他位址族。 |
| **Route Reflector Client**<br>**路由反射器客戶端** | Marks the neighbor as a client for a route reflector; used to reduce the number of full BGP mesh connections.<br>將鄰居標記為路由反射器的客戶端；用於減少全網狀連接BGP 。 |
| **Soft reconfiguration inbound**<br>**軟重配置入站** | Allows policy changes without resetting the session by storing inbound updates.<br>透過儲存入站更新，允許在不重置會話的情況下變更策略。 |
| **BFD** | Enable Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) for rapid link failure detection with the neighbor.<br>啟用雙向轉送偵測 ( BFD )，以便快速偵測與鄰居之間的連結故障。 |

| **BFD Strict Mode**<br>**BFD嚴格模式** | Strict mode requires the BFD session to be established before allowing BGP to connect. If BFD goes down, BGP immediately closes the session. This prevents BGP sessions from remaining up when the underlying link is down. Requires BFD to be enabled.<br>嚴格模式要求在允許BGP連接之前，必須先建立BFD會話。如果BFD發生故障， BGP會話將立即關閉。這可以防止底層鏈路故障時BGP會話仍然保持連線。需要啟用BFD 。 |
| **Hold Down Time**<br>**保持連線時間** | Time (default 180 seconds) before declaring a neighbor down if no keepalive messages are received.<br>如果未收到任何保持連線訊息，則在宣布鄰居節點宕機之前保持連線的時間（預設為 180 秒）。 |
| **Connect Timer**<br>**連接定時器** | Interval to attempt reconnecting with a neighbor after a disconnect.<br>斷開連線後嘗試與鄰居重新連線的時間間隔。 |
| **Send Defaultroute**<br>**發送預設路由** | Sends a default route to the neighbor, useful in small AS environments where a full routing table is not necessary.<br>向鄰居發送預設路由，這在不需要完整路由表的小型AS環境中非常有用。 |
| **Enable AS-Override**<br>**啟用AS -覆蓋** | Allows replacement of the neighbor’s AS with the local AS, common in BGP confederations.<br>允許將鄰居的AS替換為本地的AS ，這在BGP聯盟中很常見。 |
| **Remove Private AS**<br>**移除私有AS** | Configure how ASNs are propagated in outbound updates. Depending on selection, they can be removed or replaced. Remove Private AS: Remove Private ASNs in outbound updates. Remove All AS: Remove all ASNs in outbound updates. Replace Private AS: Replace private ASNs with our ASN in outbound updates. Replace All AS: Replace all ASNs with our ASN in outbound updates.<br>設定 ASN 在出站更新中的傳播方式。根據選擇，可以移除或替換 ASN。移除私有AS ：移除出站更新中的私有 ASN。移除所有AS AS在出站更新中，將私有 ASN 替換為我們的ASN 。替換所有AS ：在出站更新中，將所有 ASN 替換為我們的ASN 。 |
| **Allow AS In**<br>**允許AS入AS** | Accept incoming routes with AS path containing AS number with the same value as the current system AS.<br>接受包含AS路徑且編號與目前系統AS值相同的入站路由。 |
| **Disable Connected Check**<br>**停用連接檢查** | Allows eBGP connections over loopback addresses by bypassing checks for direct connections.<br>允許透過環回位址建立 eBGP 連接，繞過對直接連接的檢查。 |
| **Attribute Unchanged**<br>**屬性不變** | Keeps specified attributes (like MED, AS-Path, etc.) unchanged in updates to the neighbor.<br>在更新鄰居時，保持指定的屬性（例如MED, AS -路徑等）不變。 |
| **Enable BGP-Capabilities**<br>**啟用BGP功能** | Allows this neighbor to negotiate BGP Capabilities including link-local, extended nexthop, dynamic, and FQDN.<br>允許此鄰居協商BGP功能，包括鏈路本地、擴展下一跳、動態和FQDN功能。 |
| **Prefix-List In**<br>**入站前綴列表** | Prefix list to filter inbound prefixes from this neighbor.<br>用於過濾來自此鄰居的入站前綴的前綴列表。 |
| **Prefix-List Out**<br>**出站前綴列表** | Prefix list to filter outbound prefixes sent to this neighbor.<br>用於過濾發送到此鄰居的出站前綴的前綴列表。 |
| **Route-Map In**<br>**路由對映輸入** | Route-map to apply to routes received from this neighbor.<br>若要套用於從此鄰居接收的路由的路由對映。 |
| **Route-Map Out**<br>**路由映射輸出** | Route-map to apply to routes advertised to this neighbor.<br>套用於向此鄰居通告的路由的路由對映。 |
| **Peer Group**<br>**同級組** | Groups neighbors with similar configurations to simplify management.<br>將配置相似的鄰居分組，以簡化管理。 |

Note

筆記

**Neighbors** in BGP are external or internal peers with whom the router establishes BGP sessions. Neighbors exchange route information, and each neighbor can be configured individually or as part of a Peer Group.

BGP中的**鄰居**是指路由器與其建立BGP會話的外部或內部對等體。鄰居之間交換路由訊息，每個鄰居都可以單獨配置，也可以作為對等體組的一部分進行配置。

Note

筆記

A **Route Reflector** (RR) minimizes the need for a full mesh of BGP connections in the same AS by reflecting routes from its clients to other clients. In typical iBGP setups, all routers must directly peer with each other to avoid routing loops, but route reflectors allow clients to peer only with the RR. Clusters of RRs and clients prevent loops, and redundancy can be achieved with multiple RRs. This setup is crucial for scalability in large networks. For a small network, do not enable any of the RR specific options.

**路由反射器** ( RR ) 透過將客戶端的路由反射到其他客戶端，最大限度地減少了在同一AS中建立全網狀BGP連接的需求。在典型的 iBGP 設定中，所有路由器必須直接相互對等連接以避免路由環路，但路由反射器允許客戶端僅與RR建立對等連接。路由反射器和客戶端叢集可以防止環路，並且可以透過多個路由反射器實現冗餘。這種設定對於大型網路的可擴展性至關重要。對於小型網絡，請勿啟用任何RR特定選項。

**AS-Path Lists**

**AS -路徑列表**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled**<br>**已啟用** | Enable/Disable<br>啟用/停用 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | Optional description for the AS-Path list.<br>AS -路徑清單的可選描述。 |
| **Number**<br>**編號** | ACL rule number (0-4294967294). No sequence numbers; removing the ACL is required to insert between entries.<br>ACL規則編號（0-4294967294）。無序號；若要在條目之間插入，則必須移除ACL 。 |
| **Action**<br>**操作** | Set permit to match or deny to negate the rule.<br>設定允許以符合或拒絕以否定該規則。 |
| **AS** | AS pattern to match, with regex allowed (e.g., “.$” or “\_1$”).<br>AS要符合的模式，允許使用正規表示式（例如，「.$」或「\_1$」）。 |

Note

筆記

An **AS-Path List** is used to filter routes based on their AS-Path attributes. By matching specific AS paths, you can control the acceptance or rejection of routes from particular AS sequences. This is useful for policy enforcement in multi-AS environments but not needed for small networks.

**AS路徑清單**用於根據路由的AS路徑屬性過濾路由。透過符合特定的AS路徑，您可以控制來自特定AS序列的路由的接受或拒絕。這對於多AS環境中的策略實施非常有用，但對於小型網路則並非必需。

**Prefix Lists**

**前綴列表**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled**<br>**已啟用** | Enable/Disable<br>啟用/停用 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | Optional description for the Prefix-List.<br>前綴列表的可選描述。 |
| **Name**<br>**名稱** | Name of the Prefix-List, descriptive of its purpose. If there should be multiple entries for the same prefix list, give them all the same name.<br>前綴列表的名稱，用於描述其用途。如果同一個前綴清單有多個條目，則所有條目都應使用相同的名稱。 |
| **IP Version**<br>**IP版本** | IP version to use.<br>IP版本供使用。 |
| **Number**<br>**編號** | ACL sequence number (1-4294967294).<br>ACL序號 (1-4294967294)。 |
| **Action**<br>**操作** | Set permit to match or deny to negate the rule.<br>設定允許以符合或拒絕以否定該規則。 |
| **Network**<br>**網路** | Specifies a network pattern to match, with optional ge (greater than or equal) and le (less than or equal) attributes to control the prefix length range. For example, a pattern like 192.168.0.0/16 ge 24 le 28 matches any route within the 192.168.0.0/16 block with prefix lengths from /24 to /28.<br>指定要匹配的網路模式，並使用可選的 ge（大於或等於）和 le（小於或等於）屬性來控制前綴長度範圍。例如，類似 192.168.0.0/16 ge 24 le 28 的模式與 192.168.0.0/16 區塊內前綴長度從 /24 到 /28 的任何路由相符。 |

Note

筆記

**Prefix Lists** are used to filter prefixes in BGP. They match prefixes and control the import/export of specific IP ranges, allowing for fine-grained network control. It is very important to filter routes, especially when peering between eBGP and iBGP. Leaking routes of RFC1918 addresses to eBGP peers or announcing wrong prefixes is bad practice and could result in peering bans from external providers.

**前綴列表**用於過濾BGP中的前綴。它們匹配前綴並控制特定IP範圍的導入/導出，從而實現細粒度的網路控制。過濾路由至關重要，尤其是在eBGP和iBGP建立對等連線時。將RFC1918位址的路由洩漏給eBGP對等體或通告錯誤的前綴是不良做法，可能會導致外部提供者禁止建立對等連線。

**Community Lists**

**社區列表**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled**<br>**已啟用** | Enable/Disable<br>啟用/停用 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | Optional description for the Community-List.<br>社區列表的可選描述。 |
| **Number**<br>**編號** | Community-List number (1-99 for standard, 100-500 for expanded).<br>社區清單編號（標準編號為 1-99，擴充編號為 100-500）。 |
| **Sequence Number**<br>**序號** | ACL sequence number (10-99).<br>ACL序號（10-99）。 |
| **Action**<br>**操作** | Set permit to match or deny to negate the rule.<br>設定允許以符合或拒絕以否定該規則。 |
| **Community**<br>**社​​區** | Community pattern to match, with optional regex.<br>要符合的社區模式，可選擇使用正規表示式。 |

Note

筆記

**Community Lists** allow tagging and filtering routes based on community attributes. By assigning community tags, you can apply policies that influence route preference. Useful for large networks; not so much in small networks.

**社群清單**允許根據社群屬性標記和篩選路由。透過指派社群標籤，您可以套用影響路由優先順序的策略。這對於大型網路非常有用；但在小型網路中則不太適用。

**Route Maps**

**路線圖**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled**<br>**已啟用** | Enable/Disable<br>啟用/停用 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | Optional description for the route-map.<br>路線圖的可選描述。 |
| **Name**<br>**名稱** | Name of the route-map, used in neighbor configuration.<br>路由對映的名稱，用於鄰居設定。 |
| **Action**<br>**操作** | Set permit to match or deny to negate the rule.<br>設定允許以符合或拒絕以否定該規則。 |
| **ID** | Route-map ID (1-65535). Sorting is managed automatically.<br>路線圖ID (1-65535)。排序自動管理。 |
| **AS-Path List**<br>**AS -路徑清單** | Select the AS-Path List. If multiples with the same name exist, selecting one is enough.<br>選擇AS -路徑清單。如果存在多個同名列表，只需選擇一個即可。 |
| **Prefix List**<br>**前綴列表** | Select the Prefix List. If multiples with the same name exist, selecting one is enough.<br>選擇前綴列表。如果存在多個同名前綴，只需選擇一個即可。 |
| **Community List**<br>**社​​區清單** | Select the Community List. If multiples with the same name exist, selecting one is enough.<br>選擇社區清單。如果存在多個同名社區，只需選擇一個即可。 |
| **Set**<br>**設定** | Free text field for setting attributes, e.g., “local-preference 300” or “community 1:1”.<br>用於設定屬性的自由文字字段，例如「本地偏好 300」或「社區 1:1」。 |

Note

筆記

**Route Maps** act like conditional filters, allowing you to set and modify BGP route attributes based on match criteria. They can combine prefix lists, community lists, and AS-paths for detailed route manipulation.

**路線圖** 的作用類似於條件過濾器，允許您根據匹配條件設定和修改BGP路線屬性。它們可以組合前綴列表、社區列表和AS路徑，以進行詳細的路線操作。

**Peer Groups**

**同行群體**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled**<br>**已啟用** | Enable/Disable<br>啟用/停用 |
| **Name**<br>**姓名** | Name of the peer group.<br>同伴群體名稱。 |
| **Remote AS mode**<br>**遠端AS模式** | “Use Remote AS Number”（使用遠端 AS 號） will use the number specified in the “Remote AS”（遠端 AS） field, while “External”（外部的） or “Internal”（內部的） will ignore it in favor of the alternative “remote-as internal” and “remote-as external” settings.<br>“Use Remote AS Number”（使用遠端 AS 號）將使用“Remote AS”（遠端 AS）字段中指定的數字，而“External”（外部的）或“Internal”（內部的）將忽略該數字，而採用備選的「遠端作為內部」和「遠端作為外部」設定。 |
| **Remote AS**<br>**遠端AS** | Remote AS for the peer group.<br>遠端AS適用於同級組。 |
| **Listen Ranges**<br>**監聽範圍** | Enter one or multiple IP networks in CIDR notation. Accept connections from any peers in the specified prefix.<br>輸入一個或多個IP網路CIDR表示法）。接受來自指定前綴中任何對等方的連接。 |
| **Update-Source Interface**<br>**更新來源介面** | Physical IPv4 interface facing the peer.<br>面向對端的實體 IPv4 介面。 |
| **Next-Hop-Self**<br>**下一跳本身** | Sets the local router as the next hop for routes advertised to the peer group, commonly used in Route Reflector setups.<br>將本機路由器設定為向對等群組通告的路由的下一跳，常用於路由反射器設定。 |
| **Send Defaultroute**<br>**傳送預設路由** | Enable sending of default routes to the peer group.<br>啟用傳送預設路由給對等群組的功能。 |
| **Prefix-List In**<br>**前綴列表入站** | Prefix list to filter inbound prefixes from this peer group.<br>用於過濾來自此對等組的入站前綴的前綴列表。 |
| **Prefix-List Out**<br>**出站前綴列表** | Prefix list to filter outbound prefixes sent to this peer group.<br>用於過濾發送到此對等組的出站前綴的前綴列表。 |
| **Route-Map In**<br>**路由對映輸入** | Route-map to apply to routes received from this peer group.<br>若要套用於從該對等組接收的路由的路由對映。 |
| **Route-Map Out**<br>**路由映射輸出** | Route-map to apply to routes advertised to this peer group.<br>套用於向此對等組通告的路由的路由對映。 |

Note

筆記

A **Peer Group** in BGP simplifies configurations by grouping neighbors with similar settings. Another possibility is defining **Listen Ranges** to accept connections from multiple peers without configuring each of them as neighbor individually. This approach reduces management complexity and ensures uniform settings across peers. Peer Groups are especially useful in larger networks where multiple BGP peers require identical policy; not so much in small networks.

在BGP中，**對等組**透過將具有相似設定的鄰居分組來簡化配置。另一種方法是定義**監聽範圍**，以便接受來自多個對等體的連接，而無需將每個對等體單獨配置為鄰居。這種方法降低了管理複雜性，並確保對等體之間設定一致。對等組在大型網路中特別有用，因為多個BGP對等體需要相同的策略；但在小型網路中則較不適用。

Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) is an exterior gateway protocol used to exchange routing information between autonomous systems (AS) on the Internet. As a path-vector protocol, BGP makes routing decisions based on defined paths, network policies, or administrator-configured rules. BGP has two main types: iBGP, used for routing within a single AS (using private AS numbers from 64512 to 65534), and eBGP, which operates between different AS across the Internet (using public AS numbers 1 to 64511). BGP’s flexibility and scalability make it essential for global Internet routing and large network infrastructures.

邊界網關協定 (BGP) 是一種外部網關協議，用於在網際網路上的自治系統 (AS) 之間交換路由資訊。作為一種路徑向量協議，BGP 基於定義的路徑、網路策略或管理員配置的規則做出路由決策。 BGP 主要有兩種類型：iBGP，用於單一 AS 內部的路由（使用 64512 到 65534 的私人 AS 號）；以及 eBGP，用於互聯網上不同 AS 之間的路由（使用 1 到 64511 的公共 AS 號）。 BGP 的靈活性和可擴展性使其成為全球互聯網路由和大型網路基礎設施的關鍵組成部分。

-   [Dynamic Routing - BGP Tutorials](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/dynamic_routing_bgp.html)  
    [動態路由 - BGP教學](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/dynamic_routing_bgp.html)
    -   [Peering with Routers in internal AS (iBGP)](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/dynamic_routing_bgp.html#peering-with-routers-in-internal-as-ibgp)  
        [與內部路由器建立對等連線AS (iBGP)](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/dynamic_routing_bgp.html#peering-with-routers-in-internal-as-ibgp)
    -   [Peering with ISP for Internet Access (eBGP)](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/dynamic_routing_bgp.html#peering-with-isp-for-internet-access-ebgp)  
        [與ISP建立對等連線以存取網際網路（eBGP）](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/dynamic_routing_bgp.html#peering-with-isp-for-internet-access-ebgp)

##### [Supplemental Protocols](#p-210)｜[補充方案](#p-210)

###### [BFD (Bidirectional Forward Detection)](#p-210)｜[BFD （雙向向前向偵測）](#p-210)

Routing ‣ BFD

路由 ‣ BFD

**General**

**一般的**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enable**<br>**啟用** | This will activate the BFD service.<br>這將啟動BFD服務。 |

**BFD Neighbor**

**BFD鄰居**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled**<br>**已啟用** | Enable/Disable<br>啟用/停用 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | Set an optional description for this neighbor.<br>為此鄰居設定可選描述。 |
| **Peer-IP**<br>**對等節點IP** | Specify the IP of your neighbor.<br>請指定您鄰居的IP 。 |
| **Multihop**<br>**多跳** | Enables multi-hop mode, allowing BFD to expect packets with TTL less than 254 and listen on the multihop port (4784). Note: Echo mode is not supported in multi-hop (see RFC 5883, section 3).<br>啟用多跳模式，允許BFD預期TTL小於254的封包並偵聽多跳埠（4784）。注意：多跳不支援 Echo 模式（請參閱RFC 5883，第 3 節）。 |
| **Local Address**<br>**本地位址** | Specifies the local IP address to bind the peer listener to and to use for sending packets. This option is mandatory for IPv6.<br>指定要綁定到對等監聽器並用於傳送封包的本地IP位址。此選項對於 IPv6 是必需的。 |
| **Interface**<br>**介面** | Selects which interface to use for this BFD peer.<br>選擇要用於此BFD對等體的介面。 |
| **Detect multiplier**<br>**偵測倍數** | Configures the detection multiplier to determine packet loss. The remote transmission interval will be multiplied by this value to determine the connection loss detection timer. The default value is 3.<br>配置偵測倍數，用於判斷丟包情況。遠端傳輸間隔將乘以該值，以確定連線遺失偵測計時器。預設值為 3。 |
| **Receive interval**<br>**接收間隔** | Configures the minimum interval that this system is capable of receiving control packets. Defaults to 300 ms.<br>設定此系統接收控制封包的最小間隔。預設值為 300 毫秒。 |
| **Transmit interval**<br>**發送間隔** | The minimum transmission interval (less jitter) that this system wants to use to send BFD control packets. Defaults to 300ms.<br>此系統發送BFD控制包的最小發送間隔（抖動較小）。預設值為300毫秒。 |

Note

筆記

A **BFD Neighbor** refers to a neighboring device configured to use BFD with BGP, OSPF or other protocols. BFD neighbors exchange small, frequent packets to rapidly detect link failures, reducing convergence time in routing; usually a whole lot faster than typical keepalive or hello mechanisms.

**BFD鄰居**是指配置為使用BFD與BGP, OSPF或其他協定的鄰居設備。 BFD 鄰居交換小而頻繁的資料包，以快速偵測連結故障，減少路由收斂時間；通常比典型的 keepalive 或 hello 機制快得多。

Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) is a lightweight protocol used to detect faults between routers or switches by sending periodic Hello packets (asynchronous mode). BFD quickly identifies failing links, making it a useful companion to routing protocols like OSPF and BGP for faster convergence.

雙向轉送偵測（BFD）是一種輕量級協議，用於透過發送週期性的 Hello 封包（非同步模式）來偵測路由器或交換器之間的故障。 BFD 快速識別故障鏈路，使其成為OSPF 和 BGP 等路由協議的有用伴侶，以實現更快的收斂。

-   [Dynamic Routing - BFD Tutorials](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/dynamic_routing_bfd.html)  
    [動態路由 - BFD教學](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/dynamic_routing_bfd.html)
    -   [BFD with OSPF or BGP](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/dynamic_routing_bfd.html#bfd-with-ospf-or-bgp)  
        [BFD與OSPF或BGP](https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/dynamic_routing_bfd.html#bfd-with-ospf-or-bgp)

###### [STATIC (Static Routes Daemon)](#p-210)｜[STATIC (靜態路由守護程序)](#p-210)

Routing ‣ STATIC

路由 ‣ STATIC

**Static General**

**靜態通用**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enable**<br>**啟用** | This will activate the staticd service<br>這將啟動靜態服務 |

**Static Routes**

**靜態路由**

| Options<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled**<br>**已啟用** | Enable/Disable<br>啟用/停用 |
| **Network**<br>**網路** | Defines the target for the static route, in CIDR notation.<br>以CIDR表示法定義靜態路由的目標。 |
| **Gateway (optional)**<br>**網關（可選）** | Optional gateway IP address for this route.<br>此路由的可選網關位址IP 。 |
| **Interface**<br>**介面** | Select the interface where this setting applies.<br>選擇此設定適用的介面。 |
| **BFD** | Mark the route as dependent on the BFD neighbor session with the next hop.<br>將路由標記為依賴與下一跳的BFD鄰居會話。 |

STATIC is a daemon that handles the installation and deletion of static routes. These routes can be used supplemental to dynamic routes. It is beneficial for fine grained control over routes in more complex network environments, if redistributing directly attached routes is not an option.

STATIC是一個守護進程，負責靜態路由的安裝和刪除。這些路由可以作為動態路由的補充。在更複雜的網路環境中，如果無法直接重新分發路由，則靜態路由有利於對路由進行更精細的控制。

<a id="p-211"></a>

#### Tayga NAT64 how-to｜Tayga NAT64使用方法

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/tayga.html>

##### Introduction｜介紹

IPv6-only networks are less complex to plan, configure, maintain and troubleshoot than dual-stack networks. But many services on the Internet are still IPv4-only. NAT64 preserves access to these services by performing IPv6-to-IPv4 translation. The NAT64 implementation currently available for OPNsense is the Tayga plugin.

與雙堆疊網路相比，純 IPv6 網路的規劃、設定、維護和故障排除更為簡單。但互聯網上的許多服務仍然僅支援 IPv4。 NAT64 透過執行 IPv6 到 IPv4 的轉換來保留對這些服務的存取。目前可用於 OPNsense 的 NAT64 實作是 Tayga 插件。

Note

筆記

This how-to focuses on providing IPv6-only LANs with access to IPv4-only services. However, this is not the only use case for NAT64.

本教學課程重點在於如何為僅支援 IPv6 的區域網路提供對僅支援 IPv4 服務的存取。然而，這並非NAT64的唯一用途。

##### Prerequisites｜先決條件

OPNsense should be configured with working dual-stack Internet access and at least one IPv6-only LAN.

OPNsense 應配置為具有可用的雙堆疊網路存取和至少一個僅支援 IPv6 的LAN 。

##### Installing and configuring Tayga｜安裝和配置 Tayga

Go to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins and install the os-tayga plugin. Then go to Services ‣ Tayga.

進入“系統”‣“韌體”‣“插件”，安裝os-tayga插件。然後進入「服務」‣「Tayga」。

Tick Enable and configure all prefixes and addresses:

勾選“啟用”並配置所有前綴和位址：

IPv6 Prefix

IPv6 前綴

The IPv6 prefix which Tayga uses to translate IPv4 addresses. You can use the default well-known prefix 64:ff9b::/96 or an unused /96 from your site’s GUA prefix.

Tayga 用於轉換 IPv4 位址的 IPv6 前綴。您可以使用預設的常用前綴64:ff9b::/96 ，也可以使用您網站GUA前綴中未使用的 /96 前綴。

Note

筆記

While technically possible, using a ULA prefix for NAT64 is not recommended. This can cause issues with certain hosts, especially those which support 464XLAT.

雖然技術上可行，但不建議將ULA前綴用於NAT64 。這可能會導致某些主機出現問題，尤其是那些支援 464XLAT 的主機。

IPv4 Pool

IPv4 池

The virtual IPv4 addresses which Tayga maps to LAN IPv6 addresses. Can be left to its default value unless this overlaps with existing subnets in your network. Must be sufficiently large to fit all devices in your IPv6-only LAN(s).

Tayga 會對應到 IPv6 位址的虛擬 IPv4 位址LAN ）。除非與網路中的現有子​​網路重疊，否則可以保留預設值。必須足夠大，以容納所有 IPv6 專用子網路（ LAN ）中的裝置。

Tayga is a hop in the path, so it needs its own IP addresses for ICMP:

Tayga 是路徑上的一個跳躍點，因此它需要自己的IP位址才能存取ICMP ：

IPv4 Address

IPv4 位址

Will show up in traceroutes from the IPv4 side to the IPv6 side. Can be left to its default value unless you changed the IPv4 Pool. Should be located in the IPv4 Pool subnet.

會在從 IPv4 端到 IPv6 端的路由追蹤中顯示。除非您變更了 IPv4 位址池，否則可以保留預設值。應位於 IPv4 位址池子網路中。

IPv6 Address

IPv6 位址

Will show up in traceroutes from the IPv6 side to the IPv4 side. If left empty, Tayga will auto-generate its IPv6 address by mapping the IPv4 Address into the IPv6 Prefix. For example, if the default IPv6 Prefix 64:ff9b::/96 and IPv4 Address 192.168.255.1 are being used, Tayga’s default IPv6 address will be 64:ff9b::192.168.255.1 (64:ff9b::c0a8:ff01).

將在從 IPv6 端到 IPv4 端的路由追蹤中顯示。如果留空，Tayga 將透過將 IPv4 位址對應到 IPv6 前綴來自動產生其 IPv6 位址。例如，如果使用預設的 IPv6 前綴64:ff9b::/96和 IPv4 位址192.168.255.1 ，則 Tayga 的預設 IPv6 位址將是64:ff9b::192.168.255.1 （ 64:ff9b::c0a8:ff01 ）。

Tayga behaves like an external device connected to OPNsense via a point-to-point interface. This interface requires IP addresses for ICMP:

Tayga 的行為類似於透過點對點介面連接到 OPNsense 的外部設備。此介面需要IP位址用於ICMP ：

IPv4 NAT64 Interface Address

IPv4 NAT64介面位址

Can be left to its default value unless this conflicts with your network. Must not be located in the IPv4 Pool subnet and must not be used by another interface or VIP.

除非與您的網路衝突，否則可以保留預設值。不得位於 IPv4 位址池子網路中，也不得被其他介面或VIP使用。

IPv6 NAT64 Interface Address

IPv6 NAT64介面位址

Must not be located in the IPv6 Prefix subnet and must not be used by another interface or VIP. Can be a ULA.

不得位於 IPv6 前綴子網路中，且不得被其他介面或VIP使用。可以是ULA 。

Warning

警告

The default value must not be used since 2001:db8::/32 is a documentation-only prefix.

預設值不能使用，因為2001:db8::/32是一個僅用於文件的前綴。

Save. Tayga should now be running.

保存。 Tayga 現在應該正在奔跑。

##### Adding firewall rules｜新增防火牆規則

Tayga uses a tunnel interface for packet exchange with the system. A firewall rule is required to prevent it from blocking these packets. Additionally, a Source NAT rule is required for IPv4 Internet access.

Tayga 使用隧道介面與系統進行封包交換。需要防火牆規則來防止其阻止這些資料包。此外，還需要一條 Source NAT規則才能存取 IPv4 網路。

Go to Firewall ‣ Rules ‣ Tayga, add a new rule, set the TCP/IP Version to IPv4+IPv6, leave all other settings to their default values and save.

前往防火牆‣規則‣Tayga，新增規則，將TCP/IP版本設定為IPv4+IPv6，將所有其他設定保留為預設值並儲存。

Note

筆記

If you just enabled Tayga and can’t find Firewall ‣ Rules ‣ Tayga, go to Interfaces ‣ Assignments, click Save and reload the page.

如果您剛剛啟用 Tayga 但找不到“防火牆”‣“規則”‣“Tayga”，請前往“介面”‣“指派”，按一下“儲存”並重新載入頁面。

Go to Firewall ‣ NAT ‣ Source NAT (Outbound), add a new rule, set the Interface to WAN, set Source address to Single host or network, enter your Tayga IPv4 Pool, leave all other settings to their default values and save.

前往防火牆 ‣ NAT ‣ 來源NAT （出站），新增規則，將介面設定為WAN ，將來源位址設為單一主機或網絡，輸入您的 Tayga IPv4 池，將所有其他設定保留為預設值並儲存。

Apply the firewall changes. NAT64 should now be fully operational.

應用防火牆更改。 NAT64 現在應該可以全面運作。

##### Configuring DNS64｜配置DNS64

In most scenarios, NAT64 also requires DNS64. If you use OPNsense’s [Unbound DNS](#p-199) DNS resolver, DNS64 can be enabled by going to Services ‣ Unbound DNS ‣ General and ticking Enable DNS64 Support. If you don’t use the default 64:ff9b::/96 prefix, you also have to enter your /96 prefix there.

在大多數情況下， NAT64也需要DNS64 。如果您使用 OPNsense 的 [Unbound DNS ](#p-199) DNS解析器，則可以透過依序進入“服務”‣“Unbound DNS64 DNS ‣“常規”，然後勾選DNS64如果您不使用預設的64:ff9b::/96前綴，則還需要在此輸入您的 /96 前綴。

Note

筆記

You may also use any other DNS64 capable DNS server. If you use the default 64:ff9b::/96 prefix, using a service like Google’s Public DNS64 <https://developers.google.com/speed/public-dns/docs/dns64> is possible, too.

您也可以使用任何其他支援DNS64的DNS伺服器。如果您使用預設的64:ff9b::/96前綴，也可以使用像 Google 公共DNS64 <https://developers.google.com/speed/public-dns/docs/dns64>這樣的服務。

You may also want to advertise the NAT64 prefix in Router Advertisements. This can be configured in Services ‣ Router Advertisements by enabling the advanced mode and entering the NAT64 prefix there.

您可能還需要在路由器通告中通告NAT64前綴。這可以在「服務」‣「路由器通告」中配置，方法是啟用進階模式並輸入NAT64前綴。

##### Testing｜測試

You can use a service like [https://internet.nl/connection/](https://internet.nl/connection/) to verify that devices in your IPv6-only LAN have IPv6 and IP4 Internet access.

您可以使用類似 [https://internet.nl/connection/](https://internet.nl/connection/)的服務來驗證您的 IPv6 專用LAN中的裝置是否具有 IPv6 和IP4網路存取。

##### [Introduction](#p-212)｜[引言](#p-212)

ndp-proxy-go is a userspace host-learning IPv6 Neighbor Discovery Proxy.

ndp-proxy-go 是使用者空間主機學習型 IPv6 鄰居發現代理程式。

It can proxy SLAAC on-link prefixes to several downstream interfaces by proxying neighbor discovery protocol (NDP), router advertisements (RA) and duplicate address detection (DAD). For each discovered client it installs host routes automatically.

它可以透過代理鄰居發現協定 ( SLAAC )、路由器通告 ( NDP ) 和重複位址來偵測 ( RA )，將連結前綴代理到多個下游介面。對於每個發現的用戶端DAD它會自動安裝主機路由。

If your ISP provides only a single dynamic /64 prefix via RA - or a static prefix that is not properly routed - you can use ndp-proxy-go to proxy and route this prefix to all devices on separate downstream interfaces to create Layer 3 isolation.

如果您的ISP僅透過RA提供一個動態 /64 前綴，或提供一個未正確路由的靜態前綴，則您可以使用 ndp-proxy-go 將此前綴代理並路由到單獨的下游介面上的所有設備，以建立第 3 層隔離。

The proxy handles privacy extension and changing prefixes gracefully; the setup is fully dynamic and self healing.

該代理伺服器能夠優雅地處理隱私擴展和更改前綴；該設定完全動態且具有自我修復功能。

For the ISP, it will look like the proxy itself owns all global unicast addresses (GUA) with its WAN facing MAC address.

對於ISP ，看起來就像代理本身擁有所有全域單播位址（ GUA ），其WAN面向MAC位址。

The proxy does not support NPTv6 deployments, as it will not map internal ULA to external GUA addresses.

該代理程式不支援 NPTv6 部署，因為它不會將內部ULA對應到外部GUA位址。

More technical details: [ndp-proxy-go](https://github.com/Monviech/ndp-proxy-go/blob/main/README.md)

更多技術細節：[ndp-proxy-go](https://github.com/Monviech/ndp-proxy-go/blob/main/README.md)

##### [Installation](#p-212)｜[安裝](#p-212)

Install `os-ndp-proxy-go` from System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins.

從系統 ‣ 韌體 ‣ 插件安裝`os-ndp-proxy-go` 。

##### [Link Types](#p-212)｜[連結類型](#p-212)

The proxy supports different link types on the upstream interface with some important differences.

此代理程式在上游介面上支援不同的連結類型，這些連結類型之間存在一些重要的差異。

###### [Ethernet Links](#p-212)｜[乙太網路連結](#p-212)

-   **WAN (upstream)**:  
    **WAN （上游）**：
    
    The upstream ethernet interface must be configured to allow SLAAC, so it can configure an IPv6 address and a default route to the ISP. Periodic router advertisements must be sent from the ISP to the WAN.

    必須配置上游乙太網路介面以允許SLAAC ，以便它可以設定IPv6位址和到ISP的預設路由。必須從ISP向WAN發送定期路由器通告。
    
-   **LAN (downstreams)**:  
    **LAN （下游）**：
    
    The downstream interfaces must be ethernet and configure a link-local address (LLA).

    下游接口必須是乙太網路接口，並配置鏈路本地地址（ LLA ）。
    

Using ethernet interfaces is the recommended setup for best performance, rapid host discovery and self-healing of IPv6 after firewall reboots. Since the ISP router will perform Neighbor Discovery (ND) for every unknown client GUA, the proxy can instantly relearn clients when they send any traffic to the internet.

為了獲得最佳效能、快速主機發現以及防火牆重啟後 IPv6 的自我修復，建議使用乙太網路介面。由於ISP會為每個未知客戶端執行GUA發現（ ND ），因此代理伺服器可以在客戶端向互聯網發送任何流量時立即重新學習客戶端。

Tip

提示

You can proxy the upstream prefix to any amount of downstream interfaces. Since this proxy includes DAD messages, IP address conflicts are unlikely to cause issues even in larger proxied networks or when using this with cloud providers.

您可以將上游前綴代理到任意數量的下游介面。由於此代理包含DAD訊息，因此即使在大型代理網路中或與雲端提供者一起使用時， IP位址衝突也不太可能導致問題。

###### [Point-to-point Links](#p-212)｜[點對點連結](#p-212)

-   **WAN (upstream)**:  
    **WAN （上游）**：
    
    The upstream point-to-point interface must be configured to allow SLAAC, so it can configure an IPv6 address and a default route to the ISP. Periodic router advertisements must be sent from the ISP to the WAN.

    必須配置上游點對點介面以允許SLAAC ，以便它可以配置IPv6位址和到ISP的預設路由。必須從ISP向WAN發送定期路由器通告。
    
-   **LAN (downstreams)**:  
    **LAN （下游）**：
    
    The downstream interface must be ethernet and configure a link-local address (LLA).

    下游接口必須是乙太網路接口，並配置鏈路本地地址（ LLA ）。
    

The proxy includes experimental support for point-to-point upstream interfaces such as PPPoE. Unlike Ethernet links, a point-to-point link does not perform Neighbor Discovery (ND) for downstream GUAs. This has some important implications:

此代理包含對點對點上行介面（例如 PPPoE）的實驗性支援。與乙太網路連結不同，點對點連結不會為下行 GUA 執行鄰居發現 ( ND )。這會產生一些重要影響：

-   Only Router Solicitations (RS) are forwarded upstream.  
    只有路由器請求（ RS ）才會向上游轉送。
    
-   NS/NA forwarding is intentionally disabled on point-to-point links.  
    NS/NA在點對點鏈路上故意禁用轉送。
    
-   The cache-ttl must be increased, since there are less NA containing a GUA to learn from, otherwise routes might get removed prematurely.  
    必須增加 cache-ttl，因為包含GUA的NA的數量較少，否則路由可能會過早被刪除。
    

Attention

注意

If you receive a single /64 prefix via DHCPv6-PD on a PPPoE link, it must be terminated on a router **before** the proxy. This could be another OPNsense, or a device like a Fritzbox. The proxy does not listen and learn a prefix from DHCPv6. To use PPPoE as upstream, IPv6 configuration must be set to SLAAC.

如果透過 PPPoE 連結上的 DHCPv6 PD取得到單一 /64 前綴，則必須在代理伺服器**之前**的路由器上終止該前綴。這可以是另一個 OPNsense 設備，也可以是 Fritzbox 之類的設備。代理伺服器不會監聽和學習來自 DHCPv6 的前綴。若要使用 PPPoE 作為上行鏈路，必須將 IPv6 設定設定為SLAAC 。

Attention

注意

After a firewall reboot, IPv6 connectivity may be delayed until downstream clients perform SLAAC and DAD again. This is expected behavior on PPPoE, as the upstream (ISP) router never probes GUAs via Neighbor Discovery (ND) like on ethernet links. The behavior can be mitigated by using the Neighbor cache file option.

防火牆重新啟動後，IPv6 連線可能會延遲，直到下游客戶端再次執行SLAAC和DAD操作。這是 PPPoE 協定的預期行為，因為上游路由器 ( ISP ) 不會像乙太網路連結那樣透過鄰居發現 ( ND ) 來探測 GUA。可以透過啟用鄰居快取檔案選項來緩解此問題。

##### [Example Setup](#p-212)｜[範例設定](#p-212)

Follow if you are a user with a router in a SLAAC only network (e.g. home, cloud VPS, mobile LTE/5G networks) In such a setup, your router will not receive a prefix delegation via DHCPv6-PD, but only set an on-link /64 prefix.

如果您是路由器位於SLAAC僅限網路（例如家庭、雲端VPS 、移動LTE /5G 網路）中的用戶，請遵循此步驟。在這種設定下，您的路由器不會透過 DHCPv6- PD接收前綴委派，而只會設定鏈路上的 /64 前綴。

前往「服務」 NDP代理‣設定

After applying the configuration, all devices in your LAN network will autogenerate a GUA with SLAAC and receive the router as their default gateway. Check the firewall rules on LAN if IPv6 is allowed to any destination. Verify the setup by pinging an IPv6 location on the internet.

設定完成後， LAN網路中的所有裝置將自動產生一個GUA ，並將路由器設定為其預設閘道。檢查LAN上的防火牆規則SLAAC確認是否允許IPv6存取任何目標位址。透過ping一個互聯網上的IPv6位址來驗證設定。

Note

筆記

In the default setup, Router Advertisements from the ISP are forwarded directly. Any other Router Advertisement daemons on the LAN interface must be disabled, for example in Services ‣ Router Advertisements and Services ‣ Dnsmasq DNS & DHCP.

在預設設定中，來自ISP的路由器通告將直接轉送。必須停用LAN介面上的任何其他路由器通告守護程序，例如在「服務」‣「路由器通告」和「服務」‣「Dnsmasq」 DNS & DHCP中。

Attention

注意

The default firewall aliases (e.g., LAN network) will not contain any proxied IPv6 addresses. Either follow the Firewall Rules example, or set the source to any in your default IPv6 allow rule.

預設防火牆別名（例如， LAN網路）不會包含任何代理程式的 IPv6 位址。您可以依照防火牆規則範例進行操作，或在預設 IPv6 允許規則中將來源位址設定為「任意」。

###### [Firewall Rules](#p-212)｜[防火牆規則](#p-212)

The proxy supports populating firewall aliases with IPv6 addresses of learned clients. This can be used to only permit access to the internet, while blocking requests to other networks that also receive IPv6 addresses from the same on-link prefix.

此代理程式支援使用已學習到的用戶端 IPv6 位址填入防火牆別名。這可用於僅允許存取互聯網，同時阻止對其他也從相同鏈路前綴接收 IPv6 位址的網路的請求。

Since only learned clients are added, the alias will always have an up to date state that reflects the proxied interface.

由於只新增已學習的用戶端，因此別名將始終具有反映代理介面的最新狀態。

Note

筆記

The proxy only learns IPv6 addresses that are inside the WAN on-link prefix and only of clients it manages. After initial setup, it can take a few minutes until all clients have been learned.

代理伺服器僅學習連結前綴WAN內的IPv6位址，且僅學習其管理的客戶端的IPv6位址。初始設定完成後，可能需要幾分鐘才能學習到所有客戶端的IPv6位址。

| Option<br>選擇權 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |

If additional networks are proxied, just add more aliases (e.g., `ndp_proxy_vlan1`) and create the same rule on that interface.

如果需要代理其他網絡，只需添加更多別名（例如， `ndp_proxy_vlan1` ）並在該介面上創建相同的規則即可。

提示

If you need client specific aliases, take a look at the `MAC address` alias type in Firewall ‣ Aliases, which can dynamically track IPv4 and IPv6 addresses of a single client.

###### [NAT Rules (Redirect DNS)](#p-212)｜[NAT規則（重定向DNS ）](#p-212)

NAT rules are only required if you want to redirect DNS requests to the local running Unbound server. Most ISPs will include DNS servers as RDNSS options in the RAs, which could circumvent the local DNS server.

只有當您想要將請求DNS到本地運行的 Unbound 伺服器時，才需要NAT規則。大多數 ISP 會在 RA 中包含DNS伺服器作為RDNSS選項，這可能會繞過本地DNS伺服器。

Since IPv6 requires a routable address as target, we will configure a loopback device.

由於 IPv6 需要可路由位址作為目標，我們將設定一個環回設備。

Go to Interfaces ‣ Devices ‣ Loopback and create a new loopback device:

轉到“介面”‣“設備”‣“環回”，然後建立一個新的環回設備：

| Option<br>選擇權 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Device ID**<br>**設備ID** | `1` (automatic, if number is different just change description accordingly)<br>`1` （自動，如果編號不同，請相應地更改描述） |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | `lo1` |

-   Press **Apply**  
    按**申請**
    

Go to Interfaces ‣ Assignments and assign the new loopback device:

轉到“介面”‣“分配”，然後分配新的環回設備：

| Option<br>選擇權 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Device**<br>**設備** | `lo1` |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | `lo1_DNS` |

-   Press **Add**  
    按下**新增**
    

Go to Interfaces ‣ lo1\_DNS and assign IP addresses to the loopback device:

轉到“介面”‣ lo1\_DNS，並將IP位址指派給環回設備：

| Option<br>選擇權 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enable**<br>**啟用** | `X` |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | `lo1_DNS` |
| **IPv6 Configuration Type**<br>**IPv6 配置類型** | `Static` |
| **IPv6 address**<br>**IPv6 位址** | `fd01::1/128` |

-   Press **Save**  
    按下**儲存**
    

Go to Firewall ‣ NAT ‣ Destination NAT (Port Forward) and create a NAT rule that redirects IPv6 DNS. We will use the same firewall aliases that have been created in the Firewall Rules step:

前往「防火牆」‣ NAT ‣ 目標NAT （連接埠轉送），並建立一條NAT規則，用於重定向 IPv6 DNS 。我們將使用在「防火牆規則」步驟中建立的相同防火牆別名：

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Interface**<br>**接口** | LAN |
| **TCP/IP Version**<br>**TCP/IP版本** | IPv6 |
| **Protocol**<br>**協議** | TCP/UDP |
| **Source**<br>**來源** | `ndp_proxy_lan` |
| **Source Port**<br>**來源連接埠** | any<br>任意 |
| **Invert Destination**<br>**反轉目的地** | `X` |
| **Destination**<br>**目的地** | `ndp_proxy_global` |
| **Destination port**<br>**目的港** | DNS |
| **Redirect target IP**<br>**重定向目標IP** | `fd01::1` |
| **Redirect target port**<br>**重定向目標連接埠** | DNS |
| **Filter rule association**<br>**篩選規則關聯** | Pass<br>通過 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | Redirect LAN IPv6 DNS requests to Unbound<br>將LAN IPv6 DNS請求重新導向到 Unbound |

-   Press **Save** and **Apply**  
    按**儲存**並**應用**
    

Attention

注意

Ensure that Unbound listens on port 53 and on all network interfaces, or the loopback device will not be included and IPv6 DNS will not work.

確保 Unbound 監聽連接埠 53 和所有網路接口，否則將不會包含環回設備，IPv6 DNS將無法​​運作。

Tip

提示

If additional networks are proxied, just add more aliases (e.g., `ndp_proxy_vlan1`) and create the same NAT rule on that interface. Alternatively, any could be used as source and destination, though this will match any traffic so be careful.

如果需要代理其他網絡，只需新增更多別名（例如`ndp_proxy_vlan1` ），並在該介面上建立相同的NAT規則。或者，也可以使用任意位址作為來源位址和目標位址，但這會符合所有流量，因此請謹慎操作。

###### [Router Advertisements](#p-212)｜[路由器廣告](#p-212)

Per default, the proxy forwards Router Solicitations from downstream to upstream, and Router Advertisements from upstream to downstream. The only alterations are the sending MAC address, and the Source Link Layer (SLLA) option.

預設情況下，代理伺服器會將下游的路由器請求轉送到上游，並將上游的路由器通告轉送到下游。唯一需要修改的是發送位址MAC ）和來源連結層（ SLLA ）選項。

In most setups, the default is the best choice. In more complex environments, having full control over the RAs could be a requirement. The NDP proxy can be combined with [radvd](#p-197) to fulfill that requirement.

在大多數設定中，預設值是最佳選擇。在更複雜的環境中，可能需要對 RA 進行完全控制。 NDP代理可以與[radvd](#p-197)組合來滿足該要求。

Go to Services ‣ NDP Proxy ‣ Settings and disable Proxy router advertisements.

前往「服務」 NDP代理‣設置，然後停用代理路由器廣告。

Next go to Services ‣ Router Advertisements and create a new entry:

接下來，前往“服務”‣“路由器通告”，然後建立一個新條目：

| Option<br>選擇權 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Enabled**<br>**已啟用** | `X` |
| **Interface**<br>**接口** | `LAN` |
| **Constructor**<br>**建構器** | `WAN` |

Now the LAN interface will send RAs advertising the prefix constructed from the WAN SLAAC address. You can set custom RDNSS and DNSSL options, or set a different mode to additionally use a DHCPv6 server.

現在， LAN介面將發送 RA 通告，該通告基於WAN SLAAC位址建構的前綴。您可以設定自訂的RDNSS和DNSSL選項，或設定不同的模式以額外使用 DHCPv6 伺服器。

###### [High Availability](#p-212)｜[高可用性](#p-212)

To use the proxy in HA, enable the advanced mode in Services ‣ NDP Proxy ‣ Settings and toggle Enable CARP failover.

若要在HA中使用代理，請在「服務」‣ NDP 「代理」‣「設定」中啟用進階模式，並切換「啟用」 CARP 「故障轉移」。

The simplest is using Proxy router advertisements to proxy the RAs of the ISP. When using [radvd](#p-197) instead, advertise a CARP link-local address as source.

最簡單的方法是使用代理路由器通告來代理ISP的 RA。如果改用 [radvd](#p-197) ，則通告CARP鏈路本地位址作為來源位址。

Since Neighbor Discovery relies on a single link-layer router identity, a brief interruption may occur during failover while both the upstream ISP router and downstream clients relearn the router’s MAC address.

由於鄰居發現依賴單一鏈結層路由器身份，因此在故障切換期間可能會出現短暫中斷，因為上游ISP路由器和下游客戶端都需要重新學習路由器的MAC位址。

Tip

提示

If you use NAT to rewrite the DNS server, create the same loopback device as outlined in the NAT Rules (Redirect DNS) section on both Master and Backup with the same IPv6 address. That way, you can use the same IPv6 address as target in the NAT rule without a virtual IP address.

如果您使用NAT重寫DNS伺服器，請在主伺服器和備份伺服器上建立與NAT規則（重定向DNS ）部分所述相同的回環設備，並使用相同的 IPv6 位址。這樣，您就可以在NAT規則中使用相同的 IPv6 位址作為目標，而無需使用虛擬IP位址。

Attention

注意

Do not forget to add NDP Proxy to Services in System ‣ High Availability ‣ Settings and synchronize.

不要忘記將NDP Proxy 新增至系統 ‣ 高可用性 ‣ 設定中的服務並進行同步。

##### [Logging](#p-212)｜[日誌記錄](#p-212)

With the debug logging you can find out the details of the proxies behavior.

透過偵錯日誌，您可以了解代理行為的詳細資訊。

You can see logs of received and sent RA, NDP (NS, NA) and DAD messages. If something does not work as expected, reading the log file is the first step to troubleshoot.

您可以查看已接收和已發送的RA, NDP （ NS, NA ）和DAD訊息的日誌。如果出現任何異常情況，查看日誌檔案是排查問題的第一步。

Go to Services ‣ NDP Proxy ‣ Settings

前往「服務」 NDP代理‣設定

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| **Debug log**<br>**調試日誌** | `X` |

Apply this setting and go to Services ‣ NDP Proxy ‣ Log File

套用此設置，然後前往「服務」 NDP代理‣日誌文件

The proxy must learn the prefix from RAs:

代理必須從 RA 學習前綴：

> -   RA prefix learned: “::/64” (valid 2h0m0s)  
      RA已學習到前綴：「::/64」（有效期限 2 小時 0 分 0 秒）
>     
>     -   A prefix was learned from an RA on the upstream interface. Without this message appearing the proxy will not learn any addresses, and your downstream clients will most likely not receive RAs to autoconfigure SLAAC addresses.  
          從上游介面的RA中學習到了一個前綴。如果沒有出現此訊息，代理程式將無法學習任何位址，且您的下游用戶端很可能無法收到用於自動設定SLAAC位址的 RA（請求代理）。
>         
>     
> -   skip learn “IPv6 address” (not in allowed RA prefixes)  
      跳過學習“IPv6 位址”（不在允許的RA前綴中）
>     
>     -   No prefix was learned from RAs yet or there are clients with IPv6 addresses outside of the learned prefix. The proxy only caches neighbors in the prefixes it learned via RAs. This prevents the cache from being poisoned.  
          尚未從資源管理器 (RA) 學習到任何前綴，或存在 IPv6 位址不在已學習前綴範圍內的用戶端。代理伺服器僅快取透過資源管理器學習到的前綴範圍內的鄰居位址。這可以防止快取被污染。
>         
>     

The proxy must install host routes to target the individual downstream clients:

代理伺服器必須安裝主機路由，以定位各個下游客戶端：

> -   route installed: “IPv6 address” via eth0  
      已安裝路由：“IPv6 位址”，透過 eth0 介面
>     
>     -   A route was successfully installed, the client should be able to reach the internet now.  
          路由已成功安裝，客戶端現在應該可以存取網路了。
>         
>     
> -   route deleted: “IPv6 address”  
      已刪除路由：“IPv6 位址”
>     
>     -   A route was deleted, most likely the client was offline longer than the neighbor caching time, or it changed its IPv6 address via privacy extension.  
          路由被刪除，很可能是因為客戶端離線時間超過了鄰居快取時間，或者它透過隱私擴充更改了 IPv6 位址。
>         
>     
> -   route add err: exit status 1 (out: add host “IPv6 address”: gateway eth0 fib 0: route already in table)  
      路由新增錯誤：退出狀態 1（輸出：新增主機「IPv6 位址」：閘道 eth0 fib 0：路由已存在於表中）
>     
>     -   There is already a different route that would overlap with the one the proxy tries to install. To fix this ensure the prefix does not have static routes you manually configured, or turn off the automatic hoste route installation if you want to handle all routes manually.  
          已經存在一條與代理程式嘗試安裝的路由重疊的路由。若要解決此問題，請確保前綴中沒有您手動設定的靜態路由，或者如果您希望手動處理所有路由，請關閉自動主機路由安裝功能。
>         
>     

Attention

注意

The proxy does not clean up installed host routes when it is stopped. This is intentional to minimize downtime of IPv6 clients between service restarts. It does automatically prune routes while it runs when the `cache-ttl` of a discovered neighbor expires.

代理伺服器停止運作時不會清理已安裝的主機路由。這是為了最大限度地減少 IPv6 用戶端在服務重新啟動之間的停機時間。當發現的鄰居的`cache-ttl`過期時，代理伺服器會在運行時自動修剪路由。

---

<a id="c-46"></a>

### DNS

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-213"></a>

#### Dynamic DNS｜動態DNS

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/dynamic_dns.html>

In order to update DNS records when the firewall’s IP address changes, use a dynamic DNS service provider.

為了在防火牆的IP位址變更時更新DNS記錄，請使用動態DNS服務供應商。

Our os-ddclient plugin offers support for various dynamic DNS services using either the [ddclient](https://ddclient.net/) software or our native backend.

我們的 os-ddclient 外掛程式支援使用 [ddclient](https://ddclient.net/)軟體或我們的原生後端來運行各種動態DNS服務。

##### Prerequisites｜先決條件

Before installing and using this plugin, make sure to register an account with one of the supported DNS providers.

在安裝和使用此外掛程式之前，請確保在受支援的DNS提供者之一註冊一個帳戶。

##### Installation｜安裝

Installation of this plugin is rather easy, go to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins and search for **os-ddclient**, use the \[+\] button to install it.

安裝此外掛程式非常簡單，請前往“系統”‣“韌體”‣“插件”，搜尋**os-ddclient**，然後使用\[+\]按鈕進行安裝。

Next go to Services ‣ Dynamic DNS ‣ Settings to configure one or more Dynamic DNS services.

接下來，前往“服務”‣“動態” DNS “設定”，設定一個或多個“動態” DNS服務。

##### General settings｜常規設定

The general settings tab allows you to customize the services settings which will affect all dynamic DNS accounts.

常規設定標籤可讓您自訂服務設置，這將影響所有動態DNS帳戶。

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Enable<br>啟用 | Enable or disable the service<br>啟用或停用服務 |
| Verbose<br>詳細 | Enable or disable detailed log messages for the service<br>啟用或停用服務的詳細日誌訊息 |
| Allow IPv6<br>允許 IPv6 | Enable or disable retrieving and updating IPv6 addresses<br>啟用或停用 IPv6 位址的檢索與更新 |
| Interval<br>間隔 | How often (in seconds) the service checks if the appliance’s IP addresses have changed<br>服務檢查設備IP位址是否已更改的頻率（以秒為單位） |
| Backend<br>後端 | The system the Select the backend to use, either “ddclient” or “native” (see below)<br>選擇要使用的後端系統，可以是「ddclient」或「native」（見下文） |

Note

筆記

With `ddclient` developments sunsetting \[[\*](https://github.com/ddclient/ddclient/issues/528)\] we decided to offer an alternative written in Python. Selecting the native backend replaces the employed implementation. If your service is supported, we do advise to try out the new native backend which also offers support for custom HTTP requests.

隨著 `ddclient` 的開發逐漸衰落\[[\*](https://github.com/ddclient/ddclient/issues/528)\]，我們決定提供一個用 Python 編寫的替代方案。選擇本機後端替換所使用的實作。如果您的服務受支持，我們建議嘗試新的本機後端，它還提供對自訂 HTTP 請求的支援。

##### Accounts｜帳戶

The accounts tab allows you to configure one or more dynamic DNS providers which the service will update using an API call over HTTP(S).

帳戶標籤可讓您配置一個或多個動態DNS提供程序，該服務將使用透過API (S) 的HTTP呼叫來更新這些提供者。

| Option<br>選項 | Description<br>說明 |
| --- | --- |
| Enabled<br>已啟用 | Enable or disable the account (allows turning entries off without removing them)<br>啟用或停用帳戶（允許關閉條目而不刪除它們） |
| Description<br>描述 | A descriptive name for the account<br>帳戶的描述性名稱 |
| Service<br>服務 | The provider of your Dynamic DNS Service<br>您的動態DNS服務的供應商 |
| resourceId | A pointer to the service to be updated, currently only relevant for Azure<br>指向要更新的服務的指針，目前僅適用於 Azure |
| Username<br>使用者名稱 | Login or user name to authenticate with, left empty when using token-based authentication<br>用於身份驗證的登入名稱或使用者名，使用基於令牌的身份驗證時留空 |
| Password<br>密碼 | Password, API key or security token to authenticate with<br>用於驗證的密碼、 API金鑰或安全令牌 |
| Zone<br>區域 | Typically the second-level domain name to update. For example: *example.com*<br>通常指要更新的二級網域。例如：*example.com* |
| Hostname(s)<br>主機名稱 | A list of fully-qualified domain names to update via the selected service, separated by commas. For example: *subdomain.example.com*<br>若要透過所選服務更新的完全限定網域列表，請以逗號分隔。例如：*subdomain.example.com* |
| Check ip method<br>檢查 IP 位址方法 | The IP checking service to get the appliance’s current IP address from<br>透過IP檢查服務取得設備的目前IP位址 |
| Interface to monitor<br>要監控的接口 | The interface to connect to the IP checking service from, or if the “Check ip method” is set to “Interface”（介面） the interface to collect an address from<br>用於連接到IP檢查服務的接口，或者，如果“檢查 IP 方法”設置為“Interface”（介面）則用於從中收集地址的接口 |
| Dynamic ipv6 host<br>動態 IPv6 主機 | Optionally overwrite the interface identifier of the ipv6 address with the given value. For example: *::aabb:33ff:fe44:ccdd*<br>可選擇使用給定值覆寫 IPv6 位址的介面識別碼。例如：*::aabb:33ff:fe44:ccdd* |
| Check ip timeout<br>檢查 IP 逾時 | How long to wait in seconds for the IP checking service to respond with an IP address<br>等待IP檢查服務回傳IP位址的逾時時間（以秒為單位） |
| Force SSL<br>強制SSL | Enable connecting to IP checking and updating services over HTTPS, though majority only support HTTPS anyway<br>啟用連接到IP以檢查和更新透過HTTPS提供的服務，儘管大多數服務僅支援HTTPS |

Note

筆記

To update a fully-qualified domain name’s `A` (IPv4) record and `AAAA` (IPv6) record, you must: \* Add one account for IPv4 with the “Check ip method” set to an IPv4 service \* Add one account for IPv6 with the “Check ip method” set to an IPv6 service \* On the *General Settings* tab, enable “Allow IPv6”（允許 IPv6）

要更新完全限定域名 `A` (IPv4) 記錄和 `AAAA` 若要新增 IPv6 記錄，您必須：* 新增一個 IPv4 帳戶，並將「檢查 IP 方法」設定為 IPv4 服務；* 新增一個 IPv6 帳戶，並將「檢查 IP 方法」設定為 IPv6 服務；* 在「常規設定」標籤中啟用 “Allow IPv6”（允許 IPv6）

##### Provider-specific configuration｜提供者特定配置

###### Cloudflare

For accounts with Cloudflare as provider, there is an additional option **Zone**, which should be set as the name of the zone containing the host to be updated, not its zone ID.

對於以 Cloudflare 為提供者的帳戶，還有一個額外的選項 **Zone**，應該將其設定為包含要更新的主機的區域的名稱，而不是其區域ID的名稱。

Cloudflare accepts authorization with the global token with the options

Cloudflare 接受使用全域令牌授權的選項

| Option<br>選擇權 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| Username<br>使用者名稱 | The email of the Cloudflare account.<br>Cloudflare 帳戶的電子郵件地址。 |
| Password<br>密碼 | Global API Key.<br>全球API金鑰。 |

Using an API token is recommended for security reasons, with `Permissions` Zone ‣ DNS ‣ Edit and `Zone Resources` Include ‣ Specific zone ‣ zone with the host, and the account options

出於安全考慮，建議使用API令牌，並結合`Permissions`區域 ‣ DNS ‣ 編輯和`Zone Resources`包含 ‣ 特定區域 ‣ 區域（與主機和帳戶選項一起使用）

| Option<br>選擇權 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| Username<br>使用者名稱 | token<br>令牌 |
| Password<br>密碼 | API token.<br>API令牌。 |

###### Netcup DNS

Netcup is a German hosting provider who offers an API for DNS manipulation:

Netcup是德國主機供應商，提供API用於DNS操作：

-   Wiki: [https://www.netcup-wiki.de/wiki/DNS\_API](https://www.netcup-wiki.de/wiki/DNS_API)  
    週：[https://www.netcup-wiki.de/wiki/DNS\_API](https://www.netcup-wiki.de/wiki/DNS_API)
    
-   Technical documentation: [https://ccp.netcup.net/run/webservice/servers/endpoint.php](https://ccp.netcup.net/run/webservice/servers/endpoint.php)  
    技術文件：[https://ccp.netcup.net/run/webservice/servers/endpoint.php](https://ccp.netcup.net/run/webservice/servers/endpoint.php)
    

| Option<br>選擇權 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| Username<br>使用者名稱 | customer number<br>客戶編號 |
| Password<br>密碼 | APIPassword\|APIKey, both fields need to be concatenated using a pipe (`\|`) symbol as separator.<br>API密碼\| API金鑰，這兩個欄位需要用垂直線 ( `\|` ) 符號連接起來作為分隔符號。 |

###### Mythic Beasts｜神話生物

Mythic Beasts is a UK based hosting provider who offers an API for DNS manipulation:

Mythic Beasts 是一家基於UK的主機供應商，提供API用於DNS操作：

-   Wiki: [https://www.mythic-beasts.com/support/API/DNSv2/dynamic-DNS](https://www.mythic-beasts.com/support/API/DNSv2/dynamic-DNS)  
    維基：[https://www.mythic-beasts.com/support/API/DNSv2/dynamic-DNS](https://www.mythic-beasts.com/support/API/DNSv2/dynamic-DNS)
    
-   Technical documentation: [https://www.mythic-beasts.com/support/API/DNSv2](https://www.mythic-beasts.com/support/API/DNSv2)  
    技術文件：[https://www.mythic-beasts.com/support/API/DNSv2](https://www.mythic-beasts.com/support/API/DNSv2)
    

| Option<br>選擇權 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| Username<br>使用者名稱 | Key ID<br>金鑰ID |
| Password<br>密碼 | Secret<br>秘密 |

<a id="p-214"></a>

#### BIND Plugin｜BIND插件

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/manual/how-tos/bind.html>

##### History｜歷史

The history of the Bind plugin was a user request on OPNsense subreddit to create a plugin with a full-featured DNS server, also able to manage zonefiles with the most popular resource records. In the beginning the plugin was built with only general features so the community can contribute and adding wished features with a friendly review of the OPNsense team.

Bind 插件的誕生源自於 OPNsense 子版塊上的一個使用者請求，希望創建一個功能齊全的DNS伺服器插件，並且能夠管理包含最常用資源記錄的區域文件。最初，該外掛程式僅包含一些基本功能，以便社群成員可以貢獻程式碼，並在 OPNsense 團隊友好審查的基礎上添加用戶期望的功能。

At the time of writing the plugin is able to be used as a local resolver and as a nice replacement for pfBlockerNG or PiHole, since it is offering a DNSBL feature via BIND Reverse Policy Zones.

截至撰寫本文時，該插件可以用作本地解析器，並且可以很好地替代 pfBlockerNG 或 PiHole，因為它透過BIND反向策略區域提供了DNSBL功能。

##### Installation｜安裝

First of all, go to System ‣ Firmware ‣ Plugins and install **os-bind**. You will find the plugin at Services ‣ BIND.

首先，進入系統‣韌體‣插件，安裝**os-bind**。您可以在服務BIND中找到該插件。

##### General Settings｜常規設定

Enable BIND Daemon

啟用BIND守護進程

Enable the BIND service.

啟用BIND服務。

Listen IPs

監聽IP位址

Set the IP addresses the daemon should listen on.

設定守護程式應該監聽的IP位址。

Listen IPv6

監聽 IPv6

Set the IPv6 addresses the daemon should listen on.

設定守護程式應監聽的 IPv6 位址。

Listen Port

監聽埠

Set the port the daemon should listen on. Per default the port is 53530 to not interfere with existing Unbound/Dnsmasq setups. If you want to switch to BIND only, make sure to stop Unbound/Dnsmasq and switch to port 53 with both 0.0.0.0 and :: as listening addresses set up.

設定守護程式監聽的連接埠。預設連接埠為 53530，以避免干擾現有的 Unbound/Dnsmasq 配置。如果您只想切換到BIND ，請確保停止 Unbound/Dnsmasq 服務，並將連接埠切換到 53，同時設定0.0.0.0和 :: 作為監聽位址。

DNS Forwarders

DNS貨運代理

A list of IP addresses BIND will forward unknown DNS request to. If empty BIND tries to resolve directly via the root servers.

IP位址清單BIND將轉送未知的DNS請求。如果為空， BIND則嘗試直接透過根伺服器解析。

Logsize in MB

MB中的Logsize

The amount for each logfile it can grow.

每個日誌檔案可以增加的數量。

Maximum Cache Size

最大快取大小

This is the amount of RAM (in percent) the daemon can use for caching.

這是守護程式可用於快取的RAM （百分比）的數量。

Recursion

遞迴

You have to set a list of networks via **ACL** tab to allow them using recursion against BIND.

您必須透過 **ACL** 選項卡設定網路列表，以允許它們對BIND使用遞歸。

DNSSec Validation

DNSSec驗證

Whether to enable or disable DNSSec validation.

是否啟用或停用DNSSec驗證。

##### DNSBL

Enable DNSBL

啟用DNSBL

Enable the DNSBL service. BIND will be configured for Reverse Policy Zones to blacklist domains. Choose below the lists to use for blacklist categories.

啟用DNSBL服務。 BIND 將配置為反向策略區域以將網域列入黑名單。在清單下方選擇用於黑名單類別。

Type of DNSBL

DNSBL型

Here you can select the lists to use. Do not just select all and save. There are websites not loading content when nested ads are not loaded.

您可以在這裡選擇要使用的清單。請勿全部選擇並儲存。有些網站在巢狀廣告未載入時無法載入內容。

Whitelist Domains

將網域加入白名單

When a website is blocked due to a false positive you can enter the domain name here so it is whitelisted before the blacklists come into play.

如果某個網站因誤報而被封鎖，您可以在此輸入域名，以便在黑名單生效之前將其添加到白名單中。

The Blacklists are downloaded and updated with every **Save** within BIND configuration. For production use you can go to System ‣ Settings ‣ Cron and add a cronjob. On the dropdown list you’ll find the correct task under **Command**. Set the refresh interval as you wish and save. This will trigger an update of the selected lists and reload BIND.

黑名單會在 BIND 配置中每次**儲存**時下載並更新。對於生產用途，您可以前往 System ‣ Settings ‣ Cron 並新增一個 cronjob。在下拉清單中，您將在**命令** 下找到正確的任務。根據需要設定刷新間隔並儲存。這將觸發所選清單的更新並重新載入BIND。

##### ACLs｜前十字韌帶

On tab ACLs you can create ACLs used for configuration options like **Recursion**. Add a new ACL via **+**, give it a **Name** and add as many networks as you wish in **Network List**.

在 ACL 標籤中，您可以建立用於設定選項（例如**遞歸**）的 ACL。透過**+**新增的ACL ，為其指定**名稱**，並在**網路清單**中新增所需的任意數量的網路。
