<a id="p-235"></a>

### Development Workflow｜開發工作流程

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/workflow.html>

![../_images/flow.png](<../images/7466132a-flow.png>)

It’s pretty hard to approach a larger repository you have never worked with. The biggest issue is that few projects have defined development (as in actual coding) workflow laid out for new contributors, so one is just going to be stabbing in the dark for a few days or weeks until things start making sense. Speaking of *sense*, let’s explain how we’ve designed the development experience for [OPNsense](https://opnsense.org/developers-invitation/) and how you can start contributing code in no time.

接近一個你從未使用過的更大的儲存庫是相當困難的。最大的問題是，很少有專案為新貢獻者定義了開發（如實際編碼）工作流程，因此人們只能在黑暗中摸索幾天或幾週，直到事情開始有意義。說到 *sense*，讓我們解釋一下我們如何設計 [OPNsense](https://opnsense.org/developers-invitation/) 的開發體驗，以及如何立即開始貢獻程式碼。

#### Structure｜結構

Source, Ports, Core, Tools

原始碼、連接埠、核心、工具

The structure is pretty much FreeBSD: we have a [source code](https://github.com/opnsense/src) repository and a [ports tree](https://github.com/opnsense/ports). Historically, we also have a [core code](https://github.com/opnsense/core) and [tools repository](https://github.com/opnsense/tools). The tools repository is project shell code gluing all repositories together, producing final images, while the core is the important GUI and system configuration bits.

其結構與 FreeBSD 非常相似：我們有一個 [原始碼](https://github.com/opnsense/src)倉庫和一個 [端口樹](https://github.com/opnsense/ports)倉庫。歷史上，我們還有一個 [核心代碼](https://github.com/opnsense/core)倉庫和一個 [工具倉庫](https://github.com/opnsense/tools)倉庫。工具倉庫包含專案 shell 程式碼，用於將所有倉庫黏合在一起，產生最終鏡像；而核心程式碼則包含重要的GUI程式碼和系統配置部分。

Note

筆記

As of 16.1 there is also plugin support, the source repository is [plugins tree](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins) . Plugins are a modular way of easily extending the existing system.

從16.1開始，也支援插件，原始碼庫位於[plugins tree](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins) 。插件是一種模組化的方式，可以輕鬆擴展現有系統。

Why core is not a part of source

為什麼核心不是原始碼的一部分

The first thing that’s interesting is that the core is not part of the source repository, because it depends on third party software found in the ports. We can’t stick core into source, because ports are things that don’t fit into the base system. It also helps to keep source repository changes to the minimum to make major FreeBSD upgrades easier in the future.

首先值得注意的是，核心程式碼並不包含在原始碼庫中，因為它依賴連接埠中的第三方軟體。我們不能將核心程式碼直接放入原始碼庫，因為連接埠本身就不是基礎系統的一部分。這樣做也有助於將原始碼庫的改動降到最低，從而方便未來對 FreeBSD 進行重大升級。

Why core isn’t part of ports either

為什麼核心也不屬於連接埠的一部分？

Why is the core repository not in the ports? Well, we have a couple of custom ports in the ports tree, but these are small. The core repository as well as the ports tree itself are so big that it made sense to keep them separate. Another reason is that the core repository only contains scripts in Shell, Python and PHP. So the tools repository actually treats the core repository as a package that depends on all the ports it needs. This way, on the images, it looks like the core code is just another package. **That makes upgrading the core code very easy and fast without modifying base.** We can even upgrade to newer ports pages and add and remove them as we go forward.

為什麼核心程式碼庫不在 ports 樹中？嗯，我們在 ports 樹中確實有一些自訂端口，但它們都很小。核心程式碼庫以及 ports 樹本身都非常龐大，所以將它們分開存放更有意義。另一個原因是核心程式庫只包含 Shell、Python 和PHP的腳本。因此，工具庫實際上將核心程式碼庫視為依賴所有所需連接埠的軟體包。這樣，在鏡像中，核心程式碼看起來就像是另一個軟體包。 **這使得升級核心程式碼變得非常容易和快捷，而無需修改基礎程式碼。**我們甚至可以升級到更新的連接埠頁面，並根據需要隨時新增或刪除連接埠。

#### Building｜大樓

Not Clobbering the Build System

不破壞建造系統

The tools repository is designed to run on a stock FreeBSD using [chroot mechanics](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chroot) to keep the build contained and consistent. There’s nothing worse than a build system that modifies the build system and at some point starts to dash out working images–only to stop working some time in the future. No, no, no.

此工具庫旨在利用 [chroot 機制](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chroot)在標準的 FreeBSD 系統上運行，以確保建置過程的封閉性和一致性。最糟糕的情況莫過於建置系統修改自身，然後突然開始發布可用的鏡像——但過不了多久又會停止工作。絕對不行，絕對不行，絕對不行。

You can also “cross-build” between FreeBSD versions. We’ve successfully built images on FreeBSD 10.1 when OPNsense was still running on FreeBSD 10.0. (version 16.1 now runs on FreeBSD 10.2) That’s not a huge gap and the [ABI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Application_binary_interface) is the same, but we expect this to work with FreeBSD 11 and beyond as well so that if you have a FreeBSD box you will always be able to produce your own images if you desire–without spinning up extra machines, jails or virtual machines.

您也可以在不同 FreeBSD 版本之間進行「交叉建置」。我們已成功在 FreeBSD 10.1上建立了鏡像，當時 OPNsense 仍在 FreeBSD 10.0上運行。 （版本16.1現在運行在 FreeBSD 10.2上。）雖然版本之間的差距並不大，[ABI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Application_binary_interface)情況也類似，但我們預計此功能也適用於 FreeBSD 11 及更高版本，因此如果您擁有一台更多版 FreeBSD系統，您始終可以根據需要創建自己的鏡像，而無需啟動額外的機器、jail 或虛擬機器。

Here are the [build instructions for OPNsense](https://github.com/opnsense/tools/blob/master/README.md).

以下是 [OPNsense 的建造說明](https://github.com/opnsense/tools/blob/master/README.md) 。

Tip

提示

As of November 2015 OPNsense is equipped with a tool that can completely reinstall a running system in place for a thorough factory reset or to restore consistency of all the OPNsense files. It can also wipe the configuration directory, but won’t do that by default. The [opnsense-bootstrap](https://github.com/opnsense/update) script is particularly useful if you want to convert a hosted FreeBSD system to OPNsense.

截至 2015 年 11 月，OPNsense 配備了一個工具，可以對正在運行的系統進行完全重裝，從而實現徹底的恢復出廠設定或恢復所有 OPNsense 文件的一致性。它還可以清除配置目錄​​，但預設不會執行此操作。 [opnsense-bootstrap](https://github.com/opnsense/update)腳本在將託管的 FreeBSD 系統轉換為 OPNsense 時特別有用。

#### Virtual Machine for Development｜用於開發的虛擬機

Running: Use a Virtual Machine for Development

運作：使用虛擬機器進行開發

It’s just easier and less tedious if the kernel crashes, to revert to a previous state, or isolate and test different features. A VM can be set up easily using the ISO images. Also very good for testing installation and upgrades. Of course, at some point you will want to bring OPNsense to your actual target device—just make sure you know the system well enough before you attempt this.

如果核心崩潰，恢復到先前的狀態或隔離並測試不同的功能會更容易、更省事。使用ISO鏡像可以輕鬆設定VM 。它也非常適合測試安裝和升級。當然，最終您肯定希望將 OPNsense 部署到目標設備上——只需確保您在嘗試之前對系統足夠了解即可。

[VirtualBox](https://www.virtualbox.org/) is a solid tool for the job, but be sure to check out [FreeBSD’s Bhyve](http://bhyve.org/) as well (it was added in FreeBSD 10.0). However, If you are only interested in GUI coding, you can skip all the build parts and directly download an image and spin it up. Because…

(https://www.virtualbox.org/)是一個不錯的工具，但也要了解 FreeBSD 的(http://bhyve.org/) （它是在 FreeBSD 10.0中新增的）。不過，如果您只對GUI感興趣，您可以跳過所有建置步驟，直接下載鏡像並啟動它。因為…

#### Packages｜包裹

It Gets Even Better

更精彩的還在後頭

Once you have a running instance, how to produce and push code? Well, there’s a couple optional of packages that help you to be productive:

一旦實例運行起來，如何編寫和推送程式碼呢？其實，有一些可選的軟體包可以幫助你提高效率：

```
# pkg install vim-console emacs-nox joe nano gnu-watch git tmux screen
```

The most important one is *git* for obtaining the code, the rest is optional if you need it—mostly editors and terminal wrappers. It is also possible to mount sshfs or do sftp to sync files from the repo if you would like to use a graphical editor from your own system. As the root user do the following:

最重要的一個是用於獲取程式碼的 *git*，如果您需要，其餘的都是可選的 - 主要是編輯器和終端包裝器。如果您想在自己的系統中使用圖形編輯器，也可以安裝 sshfs 或執行 sftp 來同步儲存庫中的檔案。以 root 使用者身分執行以下操作：

```
# cd
# git clone https://github.com/opnsense/core
```

Once you have the repository, you switch it live using:

取得儲存庫後，您可以使用以下命令將其切換到上線：

```
# cd core
# make mount
```

Yes, the changes that you make in the repository will show up directly in the GUI now! Unfortunately, this will mount the repo over */usr/local* so if you modify packages the changes will light up in git. Be careful. To prevent that from happening you can temporarily unmount using:

是的，您在倉庫中所做的更改現在會直接顯示在GUI中！但遺憾的是，這會將倉庫掛載到 */usr/local* 目錄下，因此如果您修改了軟體包，這些變更也會反映到 Git 中。請務必小心。為了避免這種情況，您可以使用以下命令暫時卸載倉庫：

```
# make umount
```

To finish that off the boot sequence will mount the core repository set up in */root/core* as early as possible (if it’s available) and will use its modifications for booting up (with the exception of /usr/local/etc/rc itself). This makes it possible to work on the backend configuration and boot sequence improvements without having out of sync system files and repositories.

最後，啟動序列會儘早掛載位於 */root/core* 的核心倉庫（如果可用），並使用其中的修改進行啟動（/usr/local/etc/rc 本身除外）。這樣，就可以在不影響系統檔案和倉庫同步的情況下，進行後端設定和啟動序列的改進。

#### Summary｜概括

Easy Access is Key to Collaboration

便捷的存取是協作的關鍵

Although this is just a peek into OPNsense development workflow it brings to attention a key aspect: moving barriers out of the way to enable as many people as possible to produce quick results. Yes,there are barriers like [git](http://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Basics-Getting-a-Git-Repository) and [GitHub](https://guides.github.com/activities/contributing-to-open-source/) to deal with, maybe even learning FreeBSD intricacies, but once you have your code in the GUI and working fine, you’ll feel proud enough to endure the hardships of making sure your patch will have a place in our upstream repositories so the community as a whole can benefit from your dedication.

雖然這只是 OPNsense 開發工作流程的一個縮影，但它突出了一個關鍵方面：掃清障礙，讓盡可能多的人能夠快速產出成果。沒錯，確實存在一些障礙，例如 [git](http://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Basics-Getting-a-Git-Repository)和 [GitHub](https://guides.github.com/activities/contributing-to-open-source/)需要克服，甚至可能需要學習 FreeBSD 的一些複雜細節，但一旦你的程式碼提交到GUI並且運行良好，你就會感到無比自豪，並願意從而使你成功的整個程式碼

The OPNsense core team looks forward to your feedback; “We are seeking for more improvements in the build system and eagerly await your pull requests.” Take care and code responsibly. :)

OPNsense核心團隊期待您的回饋；「我們正在尋求對建置系統的更多改進，並熱切期盼您的拉取請求。」請謹慎編寫程式碼，並注意安全。 :)

<a id="p-237"></a>

#### Basics and Future｜基礎與未來

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/guidelines/basics.html>

This article explains the basic coding guidelines that apply and put the development effort into perspective by explaining the difficulties of legacy code and the interaction/migration to new [MVC-based](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Model%E2%80%93view%E2%80%93controller) code. It also explains guideline differences between new and legacy code.

本文闡述了適用的基本編碼規範，並透過解釋遺留程式碼的難點以及與基於新 [MVC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Model%E2%80%93view%E2%80%93controller)程式碼的互動/遷移，幫助讀者更好地理解開發工作。此外，本文也解釋了新程式碼和遺留程式碼在規範上的差異。

##### PHP code｜PHP代碼

For PHP code the [PSR-12](https://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-12/) coding standard applies.

對於PHP代碼，適用 [PSR -12](https://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-12/)編碼標準。

##### Python

For Python code the Python Enhancement Proposals (PEPs) apply. See the [Python Developer’s Guide](https://www.python.org/dev/) for detailed information.

對於 Python 程式碼，Python 增強提案 (PEP) 適用。有關詳細信息，請參閱 [Python 開發者指南](https://www.python.org/dev/) 。

##### Architecture｜建築學

Documentation is available about our [architecture](#p-242) and used [components](#p-264).

我們提供了有關[架構](#p-242)和使用的[組件](#p-264)的文檔。

##### Safeguard user input｜保護使用者輸入

We aim to validate user input before injecting it in the configuration in order to provide a more user friendly interface and prevent bad things to happen in the future.

我們的目標是在將使用者輸入註入配置之前對其進行驗證，以便提供更友善的使用者介面，並防止將來發生不良事件。

Although we do understand that the perfect validation isn’t always possible at once (too much referential constraints, not always as easy to catch) it is a best practice to ask yourself if a specific input could be validated (if not now, what about the future).

雖然我們明白完美的驗​​證並非總是能夠一次性實現（參考約束太多，而且並不總是那麼容易發現），但最佳實踐是問問自己，某個特定的輸入是否可以被驗證（如果現在不能，將來呢？）。

The issue with user input impossible to validate is that it will bite you eventually, leading to future security issues waiting to happen (for example a non authorized user can write commands that will be executed with elevated privileges, we saw this with openvpn for example).

使用者輸入無法驗證的問題在於，它最終會給你帶來麻煩，導致未來出現安全問題（例如，未經授權的使用者可以編寫以提升的權限執行的命令，例如我們在 openvpn 中就看到了這種情況）。

For this reason we do not allow plain text configuration data to be stored in our configuration (although some legacy components still use this [opnsense/core#d62015](https://github.com/opnsense/core/commit/d62015df1cdb0c0711b488bd66ced631b9a4f37b) )

因此，我們不允許在配置中儲存純文字配置資料（儘管一些舊元件仍然使用這種方式 [opnsense/core#d62015](https://github.com/opnsense/core/commit/d62015df1cdb0c0711b488bd66ced631b9a4f37b) ）。

Note

筆記

Feature requests for custom user inputs will be declined in our public repositories, defining what a feature should do also helps designing the right feature.

在我們的公共儲存庫中，我們將拒絕自訂使用者輸入的功能請求，定義一個功能應該做什麼也有助於設計正確的功能。

Tip

提示

If custom input is needed, in most cases you can use hooks to include additional configuration data in the service, most services offer this type of support (either with predefined directories or via the template system).

如果需要自訂輸入，大多數情況下可以使用鉤子將額外的配置資料包含在服務中，大多數服務都提供這種類型的支援（透過預先定義的目錄或透過模板系統）。

This prevents arbitrary users from adding undefined configuration data.

這樣可以防止任意用戶新增未定義的設定資料。

The different field types in our model system are aimed to help the developer safeguard his or her code for unexpected input.

我們模型系統中的不同欄位類型旨在幫助開發人員保護其程式碼免受意外輸入的影響。

##### Ideal Development｜理想發展

Our ideal OPNsense system looks like a standard FreeBSD system using our pluggable user interface for management, which supports both real users as “machine” users (REST).

我們理想的 OPNsense 系統看起來像一個標準的 FreeBSD 系統，使用我們可插拔的用戶介面進行管理，它既支援真實用戶，也支援「機器」用戶（ REST ）。

When developing we want the code to be clean and coded as DRY (Don’t Repeat Yourself) as possible and do not want to invent the wheel when not needed.

在開發過程中，我們希望程式碼簡潔明了，並儘可能遵循DRY （不要重複自己）原則，並且不希望在不需要的時候重新發明輪子。

The user interface should to be able to run as non-root user instead of root by restructuring the way commands are passed to the system (configd).

透過重構向系統（configd）傳遞命令的方式，使用者介面應該能夠以非 root 使用者身分執行，而不是以 root 使用者身分執行。

##### Reality: Overdue Maintenance｜實際情況：維護工作逾期

In reality we forked a system that went without code maintenance for a very long time and we needed to transition that into something more structured.

實際上，我們從一個長期缺乏程式碼維護的系統分支而來，我們需要將其過渡到更結構化的系統。

One of the first things (on the programming part of the system) we did was build components around an existing framework ([Phalcon](https://phalcon.io/)) to create new modules, which could use validated configuration data (from the config.xml), supply a RESTful API and generate HTML output using standard templates (Volt).

在系統程式設計部分，我們做的第一件事就是圍繞現有框架（[Phalcon](https://phalcon.io/) ）建立元件，以建立新模組，這些模組可以使用經過驗證的設定資料（來自 config.xml），提供 RESTful API並使用標準範本（Volt）產生HTML輸出。

We created the configd system, which can generate system configuration and execute system calls using predefined templates. And then we started using those new components for our first newly designed modules (like the proxy and the traffic shaper). More information about the “to-be” architecture can be found in our [architecture](#p-242) documentation.

我們創建了 configd 系統，它能夠產生系統配置並使用預定義模板執行系統呼叫。隨後，我們開始將這些新元件應用於我們首批新設計的模組（例如代理和流量整形器）。有關「未來」架構的更多信息，請參閱我們的 [architecture](#p-242)文件。

##### Strategy｜策略

Knowing we can’t change the world in a single day and having a lot of legacy to drag around with us, our strategy consists of three parts:

我們深知無法在一夜之間改變世界，而且肩負著沉重的歷史使命，因此我們的策略由三個部分組成：

**1)** Cleanup and maintenance

**1)** 清理與維護

Restructure old (legacy) code, basically all code in the src/www, src/etc/inc to make it better readable, easier to use and remove unused / unnecessary parts. By doing so we want to extend the lifetime of the old code a bit and make the transition in new code easier eventually.

重構舊程式碼（基本上是 src/www 和 src/etc/inc 目錄下的所有程式碼），使其更易讀、更易用，並移除未使用或不必要的部分。這樣做是為了延長舊程式碼的使用壽命，並最終使新程式碼的過渡更加順暢。

**2)** Detach

**2)** 分離

Move system configuration calls to configd where possible, which gives the administrator the advantage of running those commands from the command line and helps removing the need for root user access in the future. The ipsec VICI implementation is one example of this stage.

盡可能將系統設定呼叫移至 configd 服務，讓管理員可以直接從命令列執行這些命令，並有助於在未來消除對 root 使用者存取權限的需求。 ipsec VICI的實作就是這一階段的一個例子。

**3)** Moving on

**3)** 繼續

(re)build new parts, using our new modules, which provide a layered development system to automatically support API calls from other systems and XML based model templates to describe configuration data.

使用我們的新模組（重新）建立新部件，這些模組提供了一個分層開發系統，可以自動支援來自其他系統的API調用和基於XML的模型模板來描述配置資料。

*See also:*

*參見：*

-   [Hello World Module](#p-366)  
    [Hello World 模組](#p-366)
    
-   [Howto use the API](#p-370)  
    [如何使用API](#p-370)
    

Our guidelines somewhat depend of the stage the code is in, when writing new code, all actions should use the API system for actually changing configuration and performing configuration tasks. They should, of course, use the normal PSR coding standards for PHP code and follow the Python PEPs.

我們的指導原則在一定程度上取決於程式碼所處的階段。在編寫新程式碼時，所有操作都應使用API系統來實際更改配置和執行配置任務。當然，對於PHP代碼，它們應遵循標準的PSR編碼規範，並遵循Python PEP（Python開發者提案）。

When moving to the legacy part of the system, our goal is to stick as close to PSR1/2 as possible, knowing it will never be perfect.

在遷移到系統的遺留部分時，我們的目標是盡可能接近PSR1 /2，但我們知道它永遠不會完美。

Note

筆記

When building new (MVC based) code, its not allowed to include legacy parts directly. The main reason for this is preventing technical debt being stacked in new components and loosing oversight.

編寫新的（基於MVC的）程式碼時，不允許直接包含舊版元件。主要原因是防止技術債務堆積在新組件中，並導致監管不力。

<a id="p-238"></a>

#### PSR-1 Basic Coding Standard｜PSR -1 基本編碼標準

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/guidelines/psr1.html>

Note

筆記

The PSR1 and PSR2 Coding Standards are provided by FIG under a MIT license.

PSR1和PSR2編碼標準由FIG依據MIT授權提供。

See license details: [http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/](http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/)

查看許可詳情：[http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/](http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/)

The original content of this page can be found at [php-fig](http://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-1/)

本頁原文內容可在 [php-fig](http://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-1/)找到

This section of the standard comprises what should be considered the standard coding elements that are required to ensure a high level of technical interoperability between shared PHP code.

本標準的這一部分包含了確保共享的PHP代碼之間具有高度技術互通性所需的標準編碼元素。

The key words “MUST”（必須）, “MUST NOT”（不能）, “REQUIRED”（必需的）, “SHALL”（將）, “SHALL NOT”（不得）, “SHOULD”（應該）, “SHOULD NOT”（不應該）, “RECOMMENDED”（受到推崇的）, “MAY”（可能）, and “OPTIONAL”（選修的） in this document are to be interpreted as described in [RFC 2119](http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2119.txt).

本文檔中的關鍵字“MUST”（必須）, “MUST NOT”（不能）, “REQUIRED”（必需的）, “SHALL”（將）, “SHALL NOT”（不得）, “SHOULD”（應該）, “SHOULD NOT”（不應該）, “RECOMMENDED”（受到推崇的）, “MAY”（可能）和“OPTIONAL”（選修的）應依照[RFC](http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2119.txt)中的描述進行解釋。

##### 1\. Overview｜1. 概述

-   Files MUST use only `<?php` and `<?=` tags.  
    檔案MUST僅使用`<?php`和`<?=`標籤。
    
-   Files MUST use only UTF-8 without BOM for PHP code.  
    檔案MUST僅使用UTF -8 PHP BOM 。
    
-   Files SHOULD *either* declare symbols (classes, functions, constants, etc.) *or* cause side-effects (e.g. generate output, change .ini settings, etc.) but SHOULD NOT do both.  
    檔案SHOULD *要麼* 宣告符號（類別、函數、常數等），*要麼* 產生副作用（例如產生輸出、更改 .ini 設定等），但SHOULD NOT兩者都做。
    
-   Namespaces and classes MUST follow an “autoloading” PSR: \[[PSR-0](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-0.md), [PSR-4](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-4-autoloader.md)\].  
    命名空間與類別MUST遵循「自動載入」 PSR ：\[[PSR -0](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-0.md) , [PSR -4](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-4-autoloader.md) \]。
    
-   Class names MUST be declared in `StudlyCaps`.  
    類別名稱MUST應在`StudlyCaps`中宣告。
    
-   Class constants MUST be declared in all upper case with underscore separators.  
    類別常數MUST必須全部用大寫字母聲明，並用下劃線分隔。
    
-   Method names MUST be declared in `camelCase`.  
    方法名稱MUST應在`camelCase`中宣告。
    

##### 2\. Files｜2. 文件

###### 2.1. PHP Tags｜2.1. PHP標籤

PHP code MUST use the long `<?php ?>` tags or the short-echo `<?= ?>` tags; it MUST NOT use the other tag variations.

PHP代碼MUST使用長`<?php ?>`標籤或短迴聲`<?= ?>`標籤；它MUST NOT使用其他標籤變體。

###### 2.2. Character Encoding｜2.2 . 字元編碼

PHP code MUST use only UTF-8 without BOM.

PHP代碼MUST僅使用UTF -8 不使用BOM 。

###### 2.3. Side Effects｜2.3 . 副作用

A file SHOULD declare new symbols (classes, functions, constants, etc.) and cause no other side effects, or it SHOULD execute logic with side effects, but SHOULD NOT do both.

檔案SHOULD宣告新符號（類別、函數、常數等）且不產生其他副作用，或SHOULD執行有副作用的邏輯，但SHOULD NOT兩者兼而有之。

The phrase “side effects” means execution of logic not directly related to declaring classes, functions, constants, etc., *merely from including the file*.

「副作用」一詞指的是執行與宣告類別、函數、常數等沒有直接關係的邏輯，*僅僅因為包含了該檔案*。

“Side effects” include but are not limited to: generating output, explicit use of `require` or `include`, connecting to external services, modifying ini settings, emitting errors or exceptions, modifying global or static variables, reading from or writing to a file, and so on.

「副作用」包括但不限於：產生輸出、明確使用`require`或`include` 、連接到外部服務、修改ini設定、發出錯誤或異常、修改全域或靜態變數、從檔案讀取或寫入檔案等等。

The following is an example of a file with both declarations and side effects; i.e, an example of what to avoid:

以下是一個同時包含聲明和副作用的文件範例；也就是說，這是一個應該避免的例子：

```php
<?php
// side effect: change ini settings
ini_set('error_reporting', E_ALL);

// side effect: loads a file
include "file.php";

// side effect: generates output
echo "<html>\n";

// declaration
function foo()
{
    // function body
}
```

The following example is of a file that contains declarations without side effects; i.e., an example of what to emulate:

以下範例是一個包含無副作用聲明的文件；也就是說，這是一個需要模仿的範例：

```php
<?php
// declaration
function foo()
{
    // function body
}

// conditional declaration is *not* a side effect
if (! function_exists('bar')) {
    function bar()
    {
        // function body
    }
}
```

##### 3\. Namespace and Class Names｜3. 命名空間與類別名

Namespaces and classes MUST follow an “autoloading” PSR: \[[PSR-0](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-0.md), [PSR-4](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-4-autoloader.md)\].

命名空間與類別MUST遵循「自動載入」 PSR : \[[PSR -0](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-0.md) , [PSR -4](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-4-autoloader.md) \]。

This means each class is in a file by itself, and is in a namespace of at least one level: a top-level vendor name.

這意味著每個類別都位於單獨的檔案中，並且至少位於一個命名空間中：頂級供應商名稱。

Class names MUST be declared in `StudlyCaps`.

類別名稱MUST應在`StudlyCaps`中宣告。

Code written for PHP 5.3 and after MUST use formal namespaces.

為PHP 5.3及之後MUST所寫的程式碼使用正式命名空間。

For example:

例如：

```php
<?php
// PHP 5.3 and later:
namespace Vendor\Model;

class Foo
{
}
```

Code written for 5.2.x and before SHOULD use the pseudo-namespacing convention of `Vendor_` prefixes on class names.

為5.2 .x 和SHOULD之前所寫的程式碼使用類別名稱上的`Vendor_`前綴的偽命名空間約定。

```php
<?php
// PHP 5.2.x and earlier:
class Vendor_Model_Foo
{
}
```

##### 4\. Class Constants, Properties, and Methods｜4. 類別常數、屬性與方法

The term “class” refers to all classes, interfaces, and traits.

術語「類別」指的是所有類別、介面和特性。

###### 4.1. Constants｜4.1 . 常量

Class constants MUST be declared in all upper case with underscore separators. For example:

類別常數MUST必須全部以大寫字母聲明，並以底線分隔。例如：

```php
<?php
namespace Vendor\Model;

class Foo
{
    const VERSION = '1.0';
    const DATE_APPROVED = '2012-06-01';
}
```

###### 4.2. Properties｜4.2 . 屬性

This guide intentionally avoids any recommendation regarding the use of `$StudlyCaps`, `$camelCase`, or `$under_score` property names.

本指南刻意避免對使用`$StudlyCaps`, `$camelCase`或`$under_score`屬性名稱提出任何建議。

Whatever naming convention is used SHOULD be applied consistently within a reasonable scope. That scope may be vendor-level, package-level, class-level, or method-level.

無論採用何種命名約定SHOULD都應在合理的範圍內保持一致。此範圍可以是供應商層級、套件層級、類別層級或方法層級。

###### 4.3. Methods｜4.3 . 方法

Method names MUST be declared in `camelCase()`.

方法名稱MUST應在`camelCase()`中宣告。

---

<a id="p-239"></a>

#### PSR-2 Coding Style Guide｜PSR -2 編碼風格指南

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/guidelines/psr2.html>

Note

筆記

The PSR1 and PSR2 Coding Standards are provided by FIG under a MIT license.

PSR1和PSR2編碼標準由FIG依據MIT許可提供。

See license details: [http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/](http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/)

查看許可證詳情：[http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/](http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/)

The original content of this page can be found at [php-fig](http://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-2/)

本頁原文內容可在 [php-fig](http://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-2/)找到

This guide extends and expands on [PSR-1](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-1-basic-coding-standard.md), the basic coding standard.

本指南擴展並擴展了 [PSR -1](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-1-basic-coding-standard.md) ，即基本編碼標準。

The intent of this guide is to reduce cognitive friction when scanning code from different authors. It does so by enumerating a shared set of rules and expectations about how to format PHP code.

本指南旨在減少閱讀不同作者編寫的程式碼時的認知阻力。它透過列舉一套關於如何格式化PHP程式碼的通用規則和預期來實現這一目標。

The style rules herein are derived from commonalities among the various member projects. When various authors collaborate across multiple projects, it helps to have one set of guidelines to be used among all those projects. Thus, the benefit of this guide is not in the rules themselves, but in the sharing of those rules.

本文中的風格規則源自於各成員項目的共通性。當多位作者在多個專案中協作時，擁有一套適用於所有專案的統一準則將大有裨益。因此，本指南的價值不在於規則本身，而在於規則的共享。

The key words “MUST”（必須）, “MUST NOT”（不能）, “REQUIRED”（必需的）, “SHALL”（將）, “SHALL NOT”（不得）, “SHOULD”（應該）, “SHOULD NOT”（不應該）, “RECOMMENDED”（受到推崇的）, “MAY”（可能）, and “OPTIONAL”（選修的） in this document are to be interpreted as described in [RFC 2119](http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2119.txt).

本文檔中的關鍵字“MUST”（必須）, “MUST NOT”（不能）, “REQUIRED”（必需的）, “SHALL”（將）, “SHALL NOT”（不得）, “SHOULD”（應該）, “SHOULD NOT”（不應該）, “RECOMMENDED”（受到推崇的）, “MAY”（可能）和“OPTIONAL”（選修的）應依照[RFC](http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2119.txt)中的描述進行解釋。

##### 1\. Overview｜1. 概述

-   Code MUST follow a “coding style guide” PSR \[[PSR-1](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-1-basic-coding-standard.md)\].  
    代碼MUST遵循「編碼風格指南」 PSR \[[PSR -1](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-1-basic-coding-standard.md) \].
    
-   Code MUST use 4 spaces for indenting, not tabs.  
    代碼MUST使用 4 個空格進行縮進，而不是製表符。
    
-   There MUST NOT be a hard limit on line length; the soft limit MUST be 120 characters; lines SHOULD be 80 characters or less.  
    MUST NOT行長度有硬性限制； MUST軟性限制為 120 個字元； SHOULD行長度為 80 個字元或更少。
    
-   There MUST be one blank line after the `namespace` declaration, and there MUST be one blank line after the block of `use` declarations.  
    在MUST `namespace`之後有一個空行，在MUST `use`區塊之後有一個空白行。
    
-   Opening braces for classes MUST go on the next line, and closing braces MUST go on the next line after the body.  
    類名的左大括號MUST放在下一行，右大括號MUST放在正文後的下一行。
    
-   Opening braces for methods MUST go on the next line, and closing braces MUST go on the next line after the body.  
    方法的左大括號MUST放在下一行，右大括號MUST放在主體之後的下一行。
    
-   Visibility MUST be declared on all properties and methods; `abstract` and `final` MUST be declared before the visibility; `static` MUST be declared after the visibility.  
    可見性MUST應在所有屬性和方法上聲明； `abstract`和`final` MUST應在可見性之前聲明； `static` MUST應在可見性之後聲明。
    
-   Control structure keywords MUST have one space after them; method and function calls MUST NOT.  
    控制結構關鍵字MUST後面有一個空格；方法與函數呼叫MUST NOT 。
    
-   Opening braces for control structures MUST go on the same line, and closing braces MUST go on the next line after the body.  
    控制結構的左大括號MUST在同一行，右大括號MUST在主體之後的下一行。
    
-   Opening parentheses for control structures MUST NOT have a space after them, and closing parentheses for control structures MUST NOT have a space before.  
    控制結構的左括號MUST NOT後面有一個空格，控制結構的右括號MUST NOT前面有一個空格。
    

###### 1.1. Example｜1.1 . 範例

This example encompasses some of the rules below as a quick overview:

以下範例簡要概述了部分規則：

```php
<?php
namespace Vendor\Package;

use FooInterface;
use BarClass as Bar;
use OtherVendor\OtherPackage\BazClass;

class Foo extends Bar implements FooInterface
{
    public function sampleFunction($a, $b = null)
    {
        if ($a === $b) {
            bar();
        } elseif ($a > $b) {
            $foo->bar($arg1);
        } else {
            BazClass::bar($arg2, $arg3);
        }
    }

    final public static function bar()
    {
        // method body
    }
}
```

##### 2\. General｜2. 總則

###### 2.1 Basic Coding Standard｜2.1基本編碼標準

Code MUST follow all rules outlined in [PSR-1](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-1-basic-coding-standard.md).

代碼MUST遵循 [PSR -1](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-1-basic-coding-standard.md)中概述的所有規則。

###### 2.2 Files｜2.2文件

All PHP files MUST use the Unix LF (linefeed) line ending. All PHP files MUST end with a single blank line.

所有PHP文件MUST均使用LF （換行符）行尾符。所有PHP文​​件MUST均以一個空白行結尾。

The closing `?>` tag MUST be omitted from files containing only PHP.

僅包含PHP的檔案應省略結束標籤`?>` MUST 。

###### 2.3. Lines｜2.3 . 行

There MUST NOT be a hard limit on line length.

MUST NOT對線路長度有硬性限制。

The soft limit on line length MUST be 120 characters; automated style checkers MUST warn but MUST NOT error at the soft limit.

行長度的軟限制為MUST個字元；自動樣式檢查器MUST發出警告，但MUST NOT在軟限制處報錯。

Lines SHOULD NOT be longer than 80 characters; lines longer than that SHOULD be split into multiple subsequent lines of no more than 80 characters each.

行SHOULD NOT長度超過80個字元；超過80個字元的行SHOULD將被拆分為多個連續的行，每個行不超過80個字元。

There MUST NOT be trailing whitespace at the end of non-blank lines.

非空白行的末端會有MUST NOT空格。

Blank lines MAY be added to improve readability and to indicate related blocks of code.

新增空白行MAY以提高可讀性並指示相關的程式碼區塊。

There MUST NOT be more than one statement per line.

每行可以有多個MUST NOT 。

###### 2.4. Indenting｜2.4 . 縮排

Code MUST use an indent of 4 spaces, and MUST NOT use tabs for indenting.

代碼MUST使用 4 個空格縮進，代碼MUST NOT使用製表符縮排。

Note

筆記

N.b.: Using only spaces, and not mixing spaces with tabs, helps to avoid problems with diffs, patches, history, and annotations. The use of spaces also makes it easy to insert fine-grained sub-indentation for inter-line alignment.

注意：僅使用空格，避免空格與製表符混用，有助於避免差異比較、補丁、歷史記錄和註釋方面的問題。使用空格還可以方便地插入精細的行間縮排，實現行內對齊。

###### 2.5. Keywords and True/False/Null｜2.5 . 關鍵字與真/假/空值

PHP [keywords](http://php.net/manual/en/reserved.keywords.php) MUST be in lower case.

PHP [關鍵字](http://php.net/manual/en/reserved.keywords.php) MUST必須為小寫。

The PHP constants `true`, `false`, and `null` MUST be in lower case.

PHP常數`true`, `false`和`null` MUST應為小寫。

##### 3\. Namespace and Use Declarations｜3. 命名空間與使用聲明

When present, there MUST be one blank line after the `namespace` declaration.

如果存在， MUST在`namespace`宣告之後會有一個空白行。

When present, all `use` declarations MUST go after the `namespace` declaration.

如果存在，所有`use`聲明MUST都位於`namespace`聲明之後。

There MUST be one `use` keyword per declaration.

每個聲明中MUST有一個`use` 。

There MUST be one blank line after the `use` block.

在MUST `use`之後有一個空行。

For example:

例如：

```php
<?php
namespace Vendor\Package;

use FooClass;
use BarClass as Bar;
use OtherVendor\OtherPackage\BazClass;

// ... additional PHP code ...
```

##### 4\. Classes, Properties, and Methods｜4. 類別、屬性和方法

The term “class” refers to all classes, interfaces, and traits.

術語「類別」指的是所有類別、介面和特性。

###### 4.1. Extends and Implements｜4.1 . 擴展與實現

The `extends` and `implements` keywords MUST be declared on the same line as the class name.

關鍵字`extends`和`implements` MUST應與類別名稱在同一行宣告。

The opening brace for the class MUST go on its own line; the closing brace for the class MUST go on the next line after the body.

類別名稱MUST的左大括號單獨佔一行；類別名稱MUST的右大括號在正文之後的下一行。

```php
<?php
namespace Vendor\Package;

use FooClass;
use BarClass as Bar;
use OtherVendor\OtherPackage\BazClass;

class ClassName extends ParentClass implements \ArrayAccess, \Countable
{
    // constants, properties, methods
}
```

Lists of `implements` MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented once. When doing so, the first item in the list MUST be on the next line, and there MUST be only one interface per line.

將清單`implements` MAY拆分到多行，每行縮排一次。拆分時，清單MUST中的第一個項目位於下一行，且MUST每行只能有一個介面。

```php
<?php
namespace Vendor\Package;

use FooClass;
use BarClass as Bar;
use OtherVendor\OtherPackage\BazClass;

class ClassName extends ParentClass implements
    \ArrayAccess,
    \Countable,
    \Serializable
{
    // constants, properties, methods
}
```

###### 4.2. Properties｜4.2 . 屬性

Visibility MUST be declared on all properties.

可見性MUST應在所有屬性中聲明。

The `var` keyword MUST NOT be used to declare a property.

可以使用關鍵字`var` MUST NOT來宣告屬性。

There MUST NOT be more than one property declared per statement.

每份聲明中可以聲明多個MUST NOT 。

Property names SHOULD NOT be prefixed with a single underscore to indicate protected or private visibility.

屬性名稱SHOULD NOT可以以單一底線作為前綴，表示受保護或私有可見性。

A property declaration looks like the following.

屬性聲明如下所示。

```php
<?php
namespace Vendor\Package;

class ClassName
{
    public $foo = null;
}
```

###### 4.3. Methods｜4.3 . 方法

Visibility MUST be declared on all methods.

在所有方法上都宣告可見性MUST 。

Method names SHOULD NOT be prefixed with a single underscore to indicate protected or private visibility.

方法名稱SHOULD NOT可以用一個底線作為前綴，表示受保護或私有可見性。

Method names MUST NOT be declared with a space after the method name. The opening brace MUST go on its own line, and the closing brace MUST go on the next line following the body. There MUST NOT be a space after the opening parenthesis, and there MUST NOT be a space before the closing parenthesis.

方法名稱MUST NOT後應加空格。左大括號MUST單獨佔一行，右大括號MUST緊跟著方法體，另起一行。左括號MUST NOT後應加空格，右括號MUST NOT前應加空格。

A method declaration looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, commas, spaces, and braces:

方法聲明如下圖所示。請注意圓括號、逗號、空格和花括號的位置：

```php
<?php
namespace Vendor\Package;

class ClassName
{
    public function fooBarBaz($arg1, &$arg2, $arg3 = [])
    {
        // method body
    }
}
```

###### 4.4. Method Arguments｜4.4 . 方法參數

In the argument list, there MUST NOT be a space before each comma, and there MUST be one space after each comma.

在參數清單中，每個逗號前有一個MUST NOT ，每個逗號後面有一個MUST 。

Method arguments with default values MUST go at the end of the argument list.

具有預設值的方法參數MUST放在參數清單的末端。

```php
<?php
namespace Vendor\Package;

class ClassName
{
    public function foo($arg1, &$arg2, $arg3 = [])
    {
        // method body
    }
}
```

Argument lists MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented once. When doing so, the first item in the list MUST be on the next line, and there MUST be only one argument per line.

論證列表MAY可以拆分成多行，每行縮排一次。拆分時，列表中的第一項MUST位於下一行，並且MUST每行只能有一個論證。

When the argument list is split across multiple lines, the closing parenthesis and opening brace MUST be placed together on their own line with one space between them.

當參數清單跨越多行時，右括號和左大括號MUST應放在單獨的一行上，並在它們之間留一個空格。

```php
<?php
namespace Vendor\Package;

class ClassName
{
    public function aVeryLongMethodName(
        ClassTypeHint $arg1,
        &$arg2,
        array $arg3 = []
    ) {
        // method body
    }
}
```

###### 4.5. `abstract`, `final`, and `static`｜4.5. `abstract`, `final`和`static`

When present, the `abstract` and `final` declarations MUST precede the visibility declaration.

如果存在， `abstract`和`final`聲明MUST位於可見性聲明之前。

When present, the `static` declaration MUST come after the visibility declaration.

如果存在， `static`聲明MUST位於可見性聲明之後。

```php
<?php
namespace Vendor\Package;

abstract class ClassName
{
    protected static $foo;

    abstract protected function zim();

    final public static function bar()
    {
        // method body
    }
}
```

###### 4.6. Method and Function Calls｜4.6 . 方法與函數調用

When making a method or function call, there MUST NOT be a space between the method or function name and the opening parenthesis, there MUST NOT be a space after the opening parenthesis, and there MUST NOT be a space before the closing parenthesis. In the argument list, there MUST NOT be a space before each comma, and there MUST be one space after each comma.

呼叫方法或函數時，方法或函數名稱與左括號之間MUST NOT有一個空格，左括號後面必須有一個空格，右括號前MUST NOT有一個空格。在參數清單中，每個逗號前方必須有一個MUST NOT ，每個MUST NOT後面MUST有一個空格。

```php
<?php
bar();
$foo->bar($arg1);
Foo::bar($arg2, $arg3);
```

Argument lists MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented once. When doing so, the first item in the list MUST be on the next line, and there MUST be only one argument per line.

論證列表MAY可以拆分成多行，每行縮排一次。拆分後，列表中的第一個項目MUST位於下一行，並且MUST每行只能有一個論證。

```php
<?php
$foo->bar(
    $longArgument,
    $longerArgument,
    $muchLongerArgument
);
```

##### 5\. Control Structures｜5. 控制結構

The general style rules for control structures are as follows:

控制結構的一般風格規則如下：

-   There MUST be one space after the control structure keyword  
    MUST控制結構關鍵字後面有一個空格
    
-   There MUST NOT be a space after the opening parenthesis  
    MUST NOT左括號後面應有一個空格
    
-   There MUST NOT be a space before the closing parenthesis  
    MUST NOT右括號前應有一個空格
    
-   There MUST be one space between the closing parenthesis and the opening brace  
    MUST右括號和左大括號之間應有一個空格
    
-   The structure body MUST be indented once  
    結構體MUST縮排一次
    
-   The closing brace MUST be on the next line after the body  
    右大括號MUST應位於正文之後的下一行。
    

The body of each structure MUST be enclosed by braces. This standardizes how the structures look, and reduces the likelihood of introducing errors as new lines get added to the body.

每個結構體MUST的主體部分都應使用大括號括起來。這樣可以規範結構體的外觀，並降低在向主體部分添加新行時引入錯誤的可能性。

###### 5.1. `if`, `elseif`, `else`

An `if` structure looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces; and that `else` and `elseif` are on the same line as the closing brace from the earlier body.

`if`結構如下圖所示。請注意括號、空格和花括號的位置；以及`else`和`elseif`與前面主體部分的右花括號位於同一行。

```php
<?php
if ($expr1) {
    // if body
} elseif ($expr2) {
    // elseif body
} else {
    // else body;
}
```

The keyword `elseif` SHOULD be used instead of `else if` so that all control keywords look like single words.

使用關鍵字`elseif` SHOULD代替`else if` ，以便所有控製關鍵字看起來像單字。

###### 5.2. `switch`, `case`

A `switch` structure looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces. The `case` statement MUST be indented once from `switch`, and the `break` keyword (or other terminating keyword) MUST be indented at the same level as the `case` body. There MUST be a comment such as `// no break` when fall-through is intentional in a non-empty `case` body.

一個`switch`體如下圖所示。請注意括號、空格和花括號的位置。語句MUST比`case` `switch`縮排一次， `break` （或其他終止關鍵字）應與`case`體保持相同縮排等級。當`case`體非空時， MUST有意使用向下傳遞，則應添加註釋，例如 ` MUST `// no break` 。

```php
<?php
switch ($expr) {
    case 0:
        echo 'First case, with a break';
        break;
    case 1:
        echo 'Second case, which falls through';
        // no break
    case 2:
    case 3:
    case 4:
        echo 'Third case, return instead of break';
        return;
    default:
        echo 'Default case';
        break;
}
```

###### 5.3. `while`, `do while`

A `while` statement looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces.

`while`語句如下圖所示。請注意圓括號、空格和花括號的位置。

```php
<?php
while ($expr) {
    // structure body
}
```

Similarly, a `do while` statement looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces.

同樣， `do while`語句如下圖所示。請注意圓括號、空格和花括號的位置。

```php
<?php
do {
    // structure body;
} while ($expr);
```

###### 5.4. `for`

A `for` statement looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces.

`for`語句如下所示。請注意圓括號、空格和花括號的位置。

```php
<?php
for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
    // for body
}
```

###### 5.5. `foreach`

A `foreach` statement looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces.

`foreach`語句如下所示。請注意圓括號、空格和花括號的位置。

```php
<?php
foreach ($iterable as $key => $value) {
    // foreach body
}
```

###### 5.6. `try`, `catch`

A `try catch` block looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces.

`try catch`程式碼區塊如下所示。請注意圓括號、空格和花括號的位置。

```php
<?php
try {
    // try body
} catch (FirstExceptionType $e) {
    // catch body
} catch (OtherExceptionType $e) {
    // catch body
}
```

##### 6\. Closures｜6. 閉口

Closures MUST be declared with a space after the `function` keyword, and a space before and after the `use` keyword.

閉包MUST的宣告方式是在`function`關鍵字後面加上一個空格，在`use`關鍵字前面和後面加一個空格。

The opening brace MUST go on the same line, and the closing brace MUST go on the next line following the body.

左大括號 MUST 位於同一行，右大括號 MUST 位於主體後方的下一行。

There MUST NOT be a space after the opening parenthesis of the argument list or variable list, and there MUST NOT be a space before the closing parenthesis of the argument list or variable list.

MUST NOT參數列表或變數列表的左括號後面要有一個空格， MUST NOT參數列表或變數列表的右括號前要有一個空格。

In the argument list and variable list, there MUST NOT be a space before each comma, and there MUST be one space after each comma.

在參數清單和變數清單中， MUST NOT每個逗號前有一個空格， MUST每個逗號後面有一個空格。

Closure arguments with default values MUST go at the end of the argument list.

具有預設值的閉包參數MUST放在參數清單的末端。

A closure declaration looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, commas, spaces, and braces:

閉包聲明如下圖所示。請注意圓括號、逗號、空格和花括號的位置：

```php
<?php
$closureWithArgs = function ($arg1, $arg2) {
    // body
};

$closureWithArgsAndVars = function ($arg1, $arg2) use ($var1, $var2) {
    // body
};
```

Argument lists and variable lists MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented once. When doing so, the first item in the list MUST be on the next line, and there MUST be only one argument or variable per line.

參數列表和變數列表MAY應跨多行顯示，每行縮排一次。這樣，列表中的第一個元素MUST應位於下一行，且MUST每行只能有一個參數或變數。

When the ending list (whether or arguments or variables) is split across multiple lines, the closing parenthesis and opening brace MUST be placed together on their own line with one space between them.

當結束清單（無論是參數或變數）跨越多行時，右括號和左大括號MUST應放在單獨的一行上，並在它們之間留一個空格。

The following are examples of closures with and without argument lists and variable lists split across multiple lines.

以下是帶有參數列表和不帶有參數列表的閉包以及跨多行的變數列表的範例。

```php
<?php
$longArgs_noVars = function (
    $longArgument,
    $longerArgument,
    $muchLongerArgument
) {
   // body
};

$noArgs_longVars = function () use (
    $longVar1,
    $longerVar2,
    $muchLongerVar3
) {
   // body
};

$longArgs_longVars = function (
    $longArgument,
    $longerArgument,
    $muchLongerArgument
) use (
    $longVar1,
    $longerVar2,
    $muchLongerVar3
) {
   // body
};

$longArgs_shortVars = function (
    $longArgument,
    $longerArgument,
    $muchLongerArgument
) use ($var1) {
   // body
};

$shortArgs_longVars = function ($arg) use (
    $longVar1,
    $longerVar2,
    $muchLongerVar3
) {
   // body
};
```

Note that the formatting rules also apply when the closure is used directly in a function or method call as an argument.

請注意，當閉包直接用作函數或方法呼叫中的參數時，格式化規則也適用。

```php
<?php
$foo->bar(
    $arg1,
    function ($arg2) use ($var1) {
        // body
    },
    $arg3
);
```

##### 7\. Conclusion｜7. 結論

There are many elements of style and practice intentionally omitted by this guide. These include but are not limited to:

本指南有意省略了許多風格和實踐方面的要素。這些要素包括但不限於：

-   Declaration of global variables and global constants  
    宣告全域變數和全域常數
    
-   Declaration of functions  
    函數聲明
    
-   Operators and assignment  
    操作員和分配
    
-   Inter-line alignment  
    行間對齊
    
-   Comments and documentation blocks  
    註解和文件區塊
    
-   Class name prefixes and suffixes  
    類別名稱前綴和後綴
    
-   Best practices  
    最佳實踐
    

Future recommendations MAY revise and extend this guide to address those or other elements of style and practice.

未來的建議MAY修改和擴展本指南，以解決風格和實踐中的這些或其他要素。

---

<a id="p-240"></a>

#### PSR-12 Coding Style Guide｜PSR -12 編碼風格指南

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/guidelines/psr12.html>

Note

筆記

The PSR1, PSR2 and PSR12 Coding Standards are provided by FIG under a MIT license.

PSR1, PSR2和PSR12編碼標準由FIG依據MIT授權提供。

See license details: [http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/](http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/)

查看許可證詳情：[http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/](http://www.php-fig.org/bylaws/licensing-policies/)

The original content of this page can be found at [php-fig](http://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-12/)

本頁原文內容可在 [php-fig](http://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-12/)找到

##### 1\. Overview｜1. 概述

This specification extends, expands and replaces [PSR-2](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-2-coding-style-guide.md), the coding style guide and requires adherence to [PSR-1](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-1-basic-coding-standard.md), the basic coding standard.

本規範擴展、擴充並取代了編碼風格指南 [PSR -2](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-2-coding-style-guide.md) ，並要求遵守基本編碼標準 [PSR -1](https://github.com/php-fig/fig-standards/blob/master/accepted/PSR-1-basic-coding-standard.md) 。

Like PSR-2, the intent of this specification is to reduce cognitive friction when scanning code from different authors. It does so by enumerating a shared set of rules and expectations about how to format PHP code. This PSR seeks to provide a set way that coding style tools can implement, projects can declare adherence to and developers can easily relate to between different projects. When various authors collaborate across multiple projects, it helps to have one set of guidelines to be used among all those projects. Thus, the benefit of this guide is not in the rules themselves but the sharing of those rules.

與PSR-2一樣，此規範的目的是減少掃描不同作者的代碼時的認知摩擦。它透過列舉一組關於如何格式化 PHP 程式碼的共用規則和期望來實現這一點。這個PSR旨在提供一種編碼風格工具可以實現的固定方式，專案可以聲明遵守並且開發人員可以輕鬆地在不同專案之間進行關聯。當不同的作者在多個專案中進行協作時，擁有一套可在所有這些專案中使用的指南會有所幫助。因此，本指南的好處不在於規則本身，而在於這些規則的共享。

PSR-2 was accepted in 2012 and since then a number of changes have been made to PHP which has implications for coding style guidelines. Whilst PSR-2 is very comprehensive of PHP functionality that existed at the time of writing, new functionality is very open to interpretation. This PSR, therefore, seeks to clarify the content of PSR-2 in a more modern context with new functionality available, and make the errata to PSR-2 binding.

PSR -2 於 2012 年被採納，此後PHP進行了一系列修改，這對編碼風格指南產生了影響。雖然PSR -2 非常全面地涵蓋了編寫時已有的PHP功能，但新增功能仍有很大的解釋空間。因此，本PSR旨在結合新增功能，在更現代的背景下闡明PSR -2 的內容，並使PSR -2 的勘誤表具有約束力。

###### Previous language versions｜先前語言版本

Throughout this document, any instructions MAY be ignored if they do not exist in versions of PHP supported by your project.

在本文檔中，如果您的專案支援的PHP版本中不存在任何MAY指令，則應忽略這些指令。

###### Example｜例子

This example encompasses some of the rules below as a quick overview:

以下範例簡要概述了部分規則：

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vendor\Package;

use Vendor\Package\{ClassA as A, ClassB, ClassC as C};
use Vendor\Package\SomeNamespace\ClassD as D;

use function Vendor\Package\{functionA, functionB, functionC};

use const Vendor\Package\{ConstantA, ConstantB, ConstantC};

class Foo extends Bar implements FooInterface
{
    public function sampleFunction(int $a, int $b = null): array
    {
        if ($a === $b) {
            bar();
        } elseif ($a > $b) {
            $foo->bar($arg1);
        } else {
            BazClass::bar($arg2, $arg3);
        }
    }

    final public static function bar()
    {
        // method body
    }
}
```

##### 2\. General｜2. 總則

###### 2.1 Basic Coding Standard｜2.1基本編碼標準

Code MUST follow all rules outlined in PSR-1.

代碼MUST遵循PSR -1 中概述的所有規則。

The term ‘StudlyCaps’ in PSR-1 MUST be interpreted as PascalCase where the first letter of each word is capitalized including the very first letter.

PSR -1 MUST中的術語「StudlyCaps」應解釋為 PascalCase，其中每個單字的首字母（包括第一個字母）都大寫。

###### 2.2 Files｜2.2文件

All PHP files MUST use the Unix LF (linefeed) line ending. All PHP files MUST end with a single blank line.

所有PHP檔案MUST均使用LF （換行符）行尾符。所有PHP文件MUST均以一個空白行結尾。

The closing `?>` tag MUST be omitted from files containing only PHP.

僅包含PHP的檔案應省略結束標籤`?>` MUST 。

###### 2.3 Lines｜2.3線

There MUST NOT be a hard limit on line length.

MUST NOT對線路長度有硬性限制。

The soft limit on line length MUST be 120 characters.

行長度的軟限制為 120 個字元MUST 。

Lines SHOULD NOT be longer than 80 characters; lines longer than that SHOULD be split into multiple subsequent lines of no more than 80 characters each.

行SHOULD NOT長度超過80個字元；超過80個字元的行SHOULD將被拆分為多個連續的行，每個行不超過80個字元。

There MUST NOT be trailing whitespace at the end of lines.

MUST NOT行尾會有空格。

Blank lines MAY be added to improve readability and to indicate related blocks of code except where explicitly forbidden.

除明確禁止的情況外，應新增空白行MAY以提高可讀性並指示相關的程式碼區塊。

There MUST NOT be more than one statement per line.

每行可以有多個MUST NOT 。

###### 2.4 Indenting｜2.4縮進

Code MUST use an indent of 4 spaces for each indent level, and MUST NOT use tabs for indenting.

代碼MUST每個縮排等級使用 4 個空格，而MUST NOT使用製表符進行縮排。

###### 2.5 Keywords and Types｜2.5關鍵字與類型

All PHP reserved [keywords](http://php.net/manual/en/reserved.keywords.php) and [types](http://php.net/manual/en/reserved.types.php) MUST be in lower case.

所有PHP保留 [關鍵字](http://php.net/manual/en/reserved.keywords.php)和 [類型](http://php.net/manual/en/reserved.types.php) MUST均應為小寫。

Any new types and keywords added to future PHP versions MUST be in lower case.

未來版本PHP中新增的任何新類型和關鍵字MUST將採用小寫字母。

Short form of type keywords MUST be used i.e. bool instead of boolean, int instead of integer etc.

類型關鍵字的縮寫形式MUST可以使用，例如 bool 代替 boolean，int 代替 integer 等。

##### 3\. Declare Statements, Namespace, and Import Statements｜3.宣告語句、命名空間和導入語句

The header of a PHP file may consist of a number of different blocks. If present, each of the blocks below MUST be separated by a single blank line, and MUST NOT contain a blank line. Each block MUST be in the order listed below, although blocks that are not relevant may be omitted.

PHP 檔案的標頭可能由許多不同的區塊組成。如果存在，MUST 下面的每個區塊都由一個空白行分隔，並且 MUST NOT 包含一個空行。每個區塊MUST按照下面列出的順序排列，儘管可以省略不相關的區塊。

-   Opening `<?php` tag.  
    打開`<?php`標籤。
    
-   File-level docblock.  
    文件級文檔區塊。
    
-   One or more declare statements.  
    一個或多個聲明語句。
    
-   The namespace declaration of the file.  
    檔案命名空間聲明。
    
-   One or more class-based use import statements.  
    一個或多個基於類別的導入語句。
    
-   One or more function-based use import statements.  
    一個或多個基於函數的導入語句。
    
-   One or more constant-based use import statements.  
    使用一個或多個基於常數導入語句。
    
-   The remainder of the code in the file.  
    文件中的剩餘代碼。
    

When a file contains a mix of HTML and PHP, any of the above sections may still be used. If so, they MUST be present at the top of the file, even if the remainder of the code consists of a closing PHP tag and then a mixture of HTML and PHP.

當一個檔案包含HTML和PHP的混合時，上述任何部分仍然可以使用。如果是這樣，它們MUST應該出現在文件頂部，即使程式碼的其餘部分由一個結束的PHP標籤以及HTML和PHP的混合組成。

When the opening <?php tag is on the first line of the file, it MUST be on its own line with no other statements unless it is a file containing markup outside of PHP opening and closing tags.

當 <?php 開始標籤位於檔案的第一行時，它必須單獨MUST一行，且不能包含其他語句，除非該檔案包含位於PHP和結束標籤之外的標記。

Import statements MUST never begin with a leading backslash as they must always be fully qualified.

導入語句MUST永遠不要以反斜線開頭，因為它們必須永遠是完全限定的。

The following example illustrates a complete list of all blocks:

以下範例展示了所有程式碼區塊的完整清單：

```php
<?php

/**
 * This file contains an example of coding styles.
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vendor\Package;

use Vendor\Package\{ClassA as A, ClassB, ClassC as C};
use Vendor\Package\SomeNamespace\ClassD as D;
use Vendor\Package\AnotherNamespace\ClassE as E;

use function Vendor\Package\{functionA, functionB, functionC};
use function Another\Vendor\functionD;

use const Vendor\Package\{CONSTANT_A, CONSTANT_B, CONSTANT_C};
use const Another\Vendor\CONSTANT_D;

/**
 * FooBar is an example class.
 */
class FooBar
{
    // ... additional PHP code ...
}
```

Compound namespaces with a depth of more than two MUST NOT be used. Therefore the following is the maximum compounding depth allowed:

複合命名空間的深度不能超過兩層MUST NOT 。因此，允許的最大複合深度如下：

```php
<?php

use Vendor\Package\SomeNamespace\{
  SubnamespaceOne\ClassA,
  SubnamespaceOne\ClassB,
  SubnamespaceTwo\ClassY,
  ClassZ,
};
```

And the following would not be allowed:

以下行為是不被允許的：

```php
<?php

use Vendor\Package\SomeNamespace\{
    SubnamespaceOne\AnotherNamespace\ClassA,
    SubnamespaceOne\ClassB,
    ClassZ,
};
```

When wishing to declare strict types in files containing markup outside PHP opening and closing tags, the declaration MUST be on the first line of the file and include an opening PHP tag, the strict types declaration and closing tag.

當希望在包含PHP開始和結束標籤之外的標記的文件中聲明嚴格類型時， MUST聲明應位於文件的第一行，並包含一個開始PHP標籤、嚴格類型聲明和結束標籤。

For example:

例如：

```php
<?php declare(strict_types=1) ?>
<html>
<body>
    <?php
        // ... additional PHP code ...
    ?>
</body>
</html>
```

Declare statements MUST contain no spaces and MUST be exactly declare(strict\_types=1) (with an optional semi-colon terminator).

宣告語句MUST不包含空格，且MUST必須完全是 declare(strict\_types=1)（有可選的分號終止符）。

Block declare statements are allowed and MUST be formatted as below. Note position of braces and spacing:

允許使用區塊宣告語句， MUST格式如下。注意大括號的位置和間距：

```sql
declare(ticks=1) {
    // some code
}
```

##### 4\. Classes, Properties, and Methods｜4. 類別、屬性和方法

The term “class” refers to all classes, interfaces, and traits.

術語「類別」指的是所有類別、介面和特性。

Any closing brace MUST NOT be followed by any comment or statement on the same line.

任何右大括號MUST NOT後面都可以跟同一行的任何註解或宣告。

When instantiating a new class, parentheses MUST always be present even when there are no arguments passed to the constructor.

實例化新類別時，即使沒有向建構子傳遞任何參數，括號MUST也總是存在的。

```
new Foo();
```

###### 4.1 Extends and Implements｜4.1擴展與實現

The extends and implements keywords MUST be declared on the same line as the class name.

extends 和 implements 關鍵字MUST必須與類別名稱在同一行宣告。

The opening brace for the class MUST go on its own line; the closing brace for the class MUST go on the next line after the body.

類別名稱MUST的左大括號單獨佔一行；類別名稱MUST的右大括號在正文之後的下一行。

Opening braces MUST be on their own line and MUST NOT be preceded or followed by a blank line.

左大括號MUST應單獨佔一行， MUST NOT前面或後面應有一行。

Closing braces MUST be on their own line and MUST NOT be preceded by a blank line.

右大括號MUST應單獨佔一行， MUST NOT前面應空一行。

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

use FooClass;
use BarClass as Bar;
use OtherVendor\OtherPackage\BazClass;

class ClassName extends ParentClass implements \ArrayAccess, \Countable
{
    // constants, properties, methods
}
```

Lists of implements and, in the case of interfaces, extends MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented once. When doing so, the first item in the list MUST be on the next line, and there MUST be only one interface per line.

實作清單（以及介面的擴充列表） MAY應跨多行顯示，每行縮排一次。這樣，清單中的第一個元素MUST應位於下一行，且MUST每行只能包含一個介面。

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

use FooClass;
use BarClass as Bar;
use OtherVendor\OtherPackage\BazClass;

class ClassName extends ParentClass implements
    \ArrayAccess,
    \Countable,
    \Serializable
{
    // constants, properties, methods
}
```

###### 4.2 Using traits｜4.2使用特徵

The use keyword used inside the classes to implement traits MUST be declared on the next line after the opening brace.

在類別中用於實作特性的 use 關鍵字MUST必須在左大括號後的下一行宣告。

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

use Vendor\Package\FirstTrait;

class ClassName
{
    use FirstTrait;
}
```

Each individual trait that is imported into a class MUST be included one-per-line and each inclusion MUST have its own use import statement.

導入到類別中的每個單獨的特徵MUST都應逐行包含，並且每個包含項MUST都有自己的 use import 語句。

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

use Vendor\Package\FirstTrait;
use Vendor\Package\SecondTrait;
use Vendor\Package\ThirdTrait;

class ClassName
{
    use FirstTrait;
    use SecondTrait;
    use ThirdTrait;
}
```

When the class has nothing after the use import statement, the class closing brace MUST be on the next line after the use import statement.

當類別在 use import 語句之後沒有任何內容時，類別的右大括號MUST應位於 use import 語句之後的下一行。

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

use Vendor\Package\FirstTrait;

class ClassName
{
    use FirstTrait;
}
```

Otherwise, it MUST have a blank line after the use import statement.

否則， MUST use import 語句後面會有一個空白行。

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

use Vendor\Package\FirstTrait;

class ClassName
{
    use FirstTrait;

    private $property;
}
```

When using the insteadof and as operators they must be used as follows taking note of indentation, spacing, and new lines.

使用 insteadof 和 as 運算子時，必須如下使用，並注意縮排、間距和換行符。

```php
<?php

class Talker
{
    use A;
    use B {
        A::smallTalk insteadof B;
    }
    use C {
        B::bigTalk insteadof C;
        C::mediumTalk as FooBar;
    }
}
```

###### 4.3 Properties and Constants｜4.3性質和常數

Visibility MUST be declared on all properties.

可見性MUST應在所有屬性上聲明。

Visibility MUST be declared on all constants if your project PHP minimum version supports constant visibilities (PHP 7.1 or later).

如果您的專案MUST最低版本支援常數可見性（ PHP 7.1或更高版本）， PHP必須在所有常數上宣告可見性。

The var keyword MUST NOT be used to declare a property.

var 關鍵字MUST NOT可用來宣告屬性。

There MUST NOT be more than one property declared per statement.

每份聲明中可以申報MUST NOT房產。

Property names MUST NOT be prefixed with a single underscore to indicate protected or private visibility. That is, an underscore prefix explicitly has no meaning.

屬性名稱MUST NOT可以以單一底線作為前綴，表示受保護或私有可見性。也就是說，下劃線前綴本身並無特定意義。

There MUST be a space between type declaration and property name.

MUST類型宣告和屬性名稱之間應該有一個空格。

A property declaration looks like the following:

屬性聲明如下圖所示：

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

class ClassName
{
    public $foo = null;
    public static int $bar = 0;
}
```

###### 4.4 Methods and Functions｜4.4方法和函數

Visibility MUST be declared on all methods.

在所有方法上都宣告可見性MUST 。

Method names MUST NOT be prefixed with a single underscore to indicate protected or private visibility. That is, an underscore prefix explicitly has no meaning.

方法名稱MUST NOT應以單一底線作為前綴，以表示受保護或私有可見性。也就是說，下劃線前綴本身並無特殊意義。

Method and function names MUST NOT be declared with space after the method name. The opening brace MUST go on its own line, and the closing brace MUST go on the next line following the body. There MUST NOT be a space after the opening parenthesis, and there MUST NOT be a space before the closing parenthesis.

方法和函數名稱MUST NOT 在方法名稱後宣告時留有空格。左大括號 MUST 獨佔一行，右大括號 MUST 位於主體後方的下一行。左括號後面有 MUST NOT ，右括號前有 MUST NOT 。

A method declaration looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, commas, spaces, and braces:

方法聲明如下圖所示。請注意圓括號、逗號、空格和花括號的位置：

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

class ClassName
{
    public function fooBarBaz($arg1, &$arg2, $arg3 = [])
    {
        // method body
    }
}
```

A function declaration looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, commas, spaces, and braces:

函數聲明如下所示。請注意圓括號、逗號、空格和花括號的位置：

```php
<?php

function fooBarBaz($arg1, &$arg2, $arg3 = [])
{
    // function body
}
```

###### 4.5 Method and Function Arguments｜4.5方法和函數參數

In the argument list, there MUST NOT be a space before each comma, and there MUST be one space after each comma.

在參數清單中，每個逗號前有一個MUST NOT ，每個逗號後面有一個MUST 。

Method and function arguments with default values MUST go at the end of the argument list.

具有預設值的方法和函數參數MUST放在參數列表的末端。

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

class ClassName
{
    public function foo(int $arg1, &$arg2, $arg3 = [])
    {
        // method body
    }
}
```

Argument lists MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented once. When doing so, the first item in the list MUST be on the next line, and there MUST be only one argument per line.

論證列表MAY可以拆分成多行，每行縮排一次。拆分後，列表中的第一個項目MUST位於下一行，並且MUST每行只能有一個論證。

When the argument list is split across multiple lines, the closing parenthesis and opening brace MUST be placed together on their own line with one space between them.

當參數清單跨越多行時，右括號和左大括號MUST應放在單獨的一行上，並在它們之間留一個空格。

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

class ClassName
{
    public function aVeryLongMethodName(
        ClassTypeHint $arg1,
        &$arg2,
        array $arg3 = []
    ) {
        // method body
    }
}
```

When you have a return type declaration present, there MUST be one space after the colon followed by the type declaration. The colon and declaration MUST be on the same line as the argument list closing parenthesis with no spaces between the two characters.

當存在回傳類型聲明時， MUST冒號後應有一個空格，然後才是型別宣告。冒號與宣告MUST必須與參數清單的右括號位於同一行，且兩者之間不能有空格。

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vendor\Package;

class ReturnTypeVariations
{
    public function functionName(int $arg1, $arg2): string
    {
        return 'foo';
    }

    public function anotherFunction(
        string $foo,
        string $bar,
        int $baz
    ): string {
        return 'foo';
    }
}
```

In nullable type declarations, there MUST NOT be a space between the question mark and the type.

在可空型別聲明中， MUST NOT問號與型別之間要有一個空格。

```php
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vendor\Package;

class ReturnTypeVariations
{
    public function functionName(?string $arg1, ?int &$arg2): ?string
    {
        return 'foo';
    }
}
```

When using the reference operator & before an argument, there MUST NOT be a space after it, like in the previous example.

當在參數前使用引用運算子 & 時，其後MUST NOT一個空格，就像前面的範例一樣。

There MUST NOT be a space between the variadic three dot operator and the argument name:

MUST NOT可變參數三點運算子與參數名稱之間必須有一個空格：

```php
public function process(string $algorithm, ...$parts)
{
    // processing
}
```

When combining both the reference operator and the variadic three dot operator, there MUST NOT be any space between the two of them:

當同時使用參考運算子和可變三點運算MUST NOT ，兩者之間可以有空格：

```php
public function process(string $algorithm, &...$parts)
{
    // processing
}
```

###### 4.6 abstract, final, and static｜4.6摘要、最終版和靜態版

When present, the abstract and final declarations MUST precede the visibility declaration.

如果存在，則摘要和最終聲明MUST位於可見性聲明之前。

When present, the static declaration MUST come after the visibility declaration.

如果存在，靜態宣告MUST位於可見性宣告之後。

```php
<?php

namespace Vendor\Package;

abstract class ClassName
{
    protected static $foo;

    abstract protected function zim();

    final public static function bar()
    {
        // method body
    }
}
```

###### 4.7 Method and Function Calls｜4.7方法和函數調用

When making a method or function call, there MUST NOT be a space between the method or function name and the opening parenthesis, there MUST NOT be a space after the opening parenthesis, and there MUST NOT be a space before the closing parenthesis. In the argument list, there MUST NOT be a space before each comma, and there MUST be one space after each comma.

呼叫方法或函數時，方法或函數名稱與左括號之間必須有一個MUST NOT ，左括號後面必須有一個空格，右括號前MUST NOT有一個空格。在參數清單中，每個逗號前方必須有一個MUST NOT ，每個MUST NOT後面MUST有一個空格。

```php
<?php

bar();
$foo->bar($arg1);
Foo::bar($arg2, $arg3);
```

Argument lists MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented once. When doing so, the first item in the list MUST be on the next line, and there MUST be only one argument per line. A single argument being split across multiple lines (as might be the case with an anonymous function or array) does not constitute splitting the argument list itself.

參數列表MAY可以跨多行顯示，每行縮排一次。這樣，列表中的第一個元素MUST位於下一行，且MUST每行只能有一個參數。單一參數跨多行顯示（例如匿名函數或陣列的情況）並不等同於參數清單本身的拆分。

```php
<?php

$foo->bar(
    $longArgument,
    $longerArgument,
    $muchLongerArgument
);
```

```php
<?php

somefunction($foo, $bar, [
  // ...
], $baz);

$app->get('/hello/{name}', function ($name) use ($app) {
    return 'Hello ' . $app->escape($name);
});
```

##### 5\. Control Structures｜5. 控制結構

The general style rules for control structures are as follows:

控制結構的一般風格規則如下：

-   There MUST be one space after the control structure keyword  
    MUST控制結構關鍵字後面有一個空格
    
-   There MUST NOT be a space after the opening parenthesis  
    MUST NOT左括號後面應有一個空格
    
-   There MUST NOT be a space before the closing parenthesis  
    MUST NOT右括號前應有一個空格
    
-   There MUST be one space between the closing parenthesis and the opening brace  
    MUST右括號和左大括號之間應有一個空格
    
-   The structure body MUST be indented once  
    結構體MUST縮排一次
    
-   The body MUST be on the next line after the opening brace  
    正文MUST應位於左大括號後的下一行
    
-   The closing brace MUST be on the next line after the body  
    右大括號MUST應位於正文之後的下一行。
    

The body of each structure MUST be enclosed by braces. This standardizes how the structures look and reduces the likelihood of introducing errors as new lines get added to the body.

每個結構體MUST的主體部分都應使用大括號括起來。這樣可以規範結構體的外觀，並降低在向主體部分添加新行時引入錯誤的可能性。

###### 5.1 if, elseif, else｜5.1如果，否則如果，否則

An if structure looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces; and that else and elseif are on the same line as the closing brace from the earlier body.

一個 if 語句的結構如下圖所示。請注意括號、空格和花括號的位置；以及 else 和 elseif 與前面語句體的右花括號位於同一行。

```php
<?php

if ($expr1) {
    // if body
} elseif ($expr2) {
    // elseif body
} else {
    // else body;
}
```

The keyword elseif SHOULD be used instead of else if so that all control keywords look like single words.

使用關鍵字 elseif SHOULD取代 else if，以便所有控製關鍵字看起來像單字。

Expressions in parentheses MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented at least once. When doing so, the first condition MUST be on the next line. The closing parenthesis and opening brace MUST be placed together on their own line with one space between them. Boolean operators between conditions MUST always be at the beginning or at the end of the line, not a mix of both.

括號內的表達式MAY應跨行顯示，每行至少縮排一次。這樣，第一個條件MUST應位於下一行。右括號和左大括號MUST應放在同一行，中間留一個空格。條件之間的布林運算子MUST必須位於行首或行尾，不能混用。

```php
<?php

if (
    $expr1
    && $expr2
) {
    // if body
} elseif (
    $expr3
    && $expr4
) {
    // elseif body
}
```

###### 5.2 switch, case｜5.2開關，外殼

A switch structure looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces. The case statement MUST be indented once from switch, and the break keyword (or other terminating keywords) MUST be indented at the same level as the case body. There MUST be a comment such as // no break when fall-through is intentional in a non-empty case body.

一個 switch 語句的結構如下所示。請注意括號、空格和花括號的位置。 case 語句MUST應比 switch 語句縮排一次，break 關鍵字（或其他終止關鍵字） MUST應與 case 語句體縮排到相同層級MUST應加入註釋，例如 // 當 case 語句體非空且有意使用 fall-through 時，無需 break。

```php
<?php

switch ($expr) {
    case 0:
        echo 'First case, with a break';
        break;
    case 1:
        echo 'Second case, which falls through';
        // no break
    case 2:
    case 3:
    case 4:
        echo 'Third case, return instead of break';
        return;
    default:
        echo 'Default case';
        break;
}
```

Expressions in parentheses MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented at least once. When doing so, the first condition MUST be on the next line. The closing parenthesis and opening brace MUST be placed together on their own line with one space between them. Boolean operators between conditions MUST always be at the beginning or at the end of the line, not a mix of both.

括號內的表達式MAY應跨行顯示，每行至少縮排一次。這樣，第一個條件MUST應位於下一行。右括號和左大括號MUST應放在同一行，中間留一個空格。條件之間的布林運算子MUST必須位於行首或行尾，不能混用。

```php
<?php

switch (
    $expr1
    && $expr2
) {
    // structure body
}
```

###### 5.3 while, do while

A while statement looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces.

一個 while 迴圈語句看起來像這樣。請注意圓括號、空格和花括號的位置。

```php
<?php

while ($expr) {
    // structure body
}
```

Expressions in parentheses MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented at least once. When doing so, the first condition MUST be on the next line. The closing parenthesis and opening brace MUST be placed together on their own line with one space between them. Boolean operators between conditions MUST always be at the beginning or at the end of the line, not a mix of both.

括號內的表達式MAY應跨行顯示，每行至少縮排一次。這樣，第一個條件MUST應位於下一行。右括號和左大括號MUST應放在同一行，中間留一個空格。條件之間的布林運算子MUST必須位於行首或行尾，不能混用。

```php
<?php

while (
    $expr1
    && $expr2
) {
    // structure body
}
```

Similarly, a do while statement looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces.

同樣，do while 語句看起來像這樣。請注意圓括號、空格和花括號的位置。

```php
<?php

do {
    // structure body;
} while ($expr);
```

Expressions in parentheses MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented at least once. When doing so, the first condition MUST be on the next line. Boolean operators between conditions MUST always be at the beginning or at the end of the line, not a mix of both.

括號內的表達式MAY應跨行顯示，且每行至少縮排一次。這樣，第一個條件MUST應位於下一行。條件之間的布林運算子MUST必須位於行首或行尾，不能混用。

```php
<?php

do {
    // structure body;
} while (
    $expr1
    && $expr2
);
```

###### 5.4 for｜5.4用於

A for statement looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces.

一個 for 迴圈語句如下所示。請注意圓括號、空格和花括號的位置。

```php
<?php

for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
    // for body
}
```

Expressions in parentheses MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented at least once. When doing so, the first expression MUST be on the next line. The closing parenthesis and opening brace MUST be placed together on their own line with one space between them.

括號內的表達式MAY應跨行顯示，每行至少縮排一次。這樣，第一個表達式MUST應位於下一行。右括號和左大括號MUST應放在同一行，中間留一個空格。

```php
<?php

for (
    $i = 0;
    $i < 10;
    $i++
) {
    // for body
}
```

###### 5.5 foreach

A foreach statement looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces.

一個 foreach 語句看起來像這樣。請注意圓括號、空格和花括號的位置。

```php
<?php

foreach ($iterable as $key => $value) {
    // foreach body
}
```

###### 5.6 try, catch, finally｜5.6嘗試，捕捉，最終

A try-catch-finally block looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, spaces, and braces.

一個 try-catch-finally 程式碼區塊如下所示。請注意圓括號、空格和花括號的位置。

```php
<?php

try {
    // try body
} catch (FirstThrowableType $e) {
    // catch body
} catch (OtherThrowableType | AnotherThrowableType $e) {
    // catch body
} finally {
    // finally body
}
```

##### 6\. Operators｜6. 操作員

Style rules for operators are grouped by arity (the number of operands they take).

運算符的樣式規則以元數（運算子接受的操作數的數量）分組。

When space is permitted around an operator, multiple spaces MAY be used for readability purposes.

當運算符周圍允許留有空格時，為了方便閱讀，可以使用多個空格MAY 。

All operators not described here are left undefined.

此處未描述的所有運算子均未定義。

###### 6.1. Unary operators｜6.1 . 一元運算符

The increment/decrement operators MUST NOT have any space between the operator and operand.

增/減運算子MUST NOT運算子和運算元之間可以有空格。

```
$i++;
++$j;
```

Type casting operators MUST NOT have any space within the parentheses:

類型轉換運算子MUST NOT括號內可以有空格：

```
$intValue = (int) $input;
```

###### 6.2. Binary operators｜6.2 . 二元運算符

All binary \[arithmetic\]\[\], \[comparison\]\[\], \[assignment\]\[\], \[bitwise\]\[\], \[logical\]\[\], \[string\]\[\], and \[type\]\[\] operators MUST be preceded and followed by at least one space:

所有二進位算術運算子、比較運算子、賦值運算子、位元運算運算子、邏輯運算子、字串運算子和型別運算子MUST前後都必須至少有一個空格：

```
if ($a === $b) {
    $foo = $bar ?? $a ?? $b;
} elseif ($a > $b) {
    $foo = $a + $b * $c;
}
```

###### 6.3. Ternary operators｜6.3 。三元運算符

The conditional operator, also known simply as the ternary operator, MUST be preceded and followed by at least one space around both the ? and : characters:

條件運算子（也稱為三元運算子） MUST前後必須至少各有一個空格，且 ? 和 : 字元之間必須有空格：

```
$variable = $foo ? 'foo' : 'bar';
```

When the middle operand of the conditional operator is omitted, the operator MUST follow the same style rules as other binary \[comparison\]\[\] operators:

當條件運算子的中間運算元被省略時，運算子MUST遵循與其他二元比較運算子相同的樣式規則：

```
$variable = $foo ?: 'bar';
```

##### 7\. Closures｜7. 閉口

Closures MUST be declared with a space after the function keyword, and a space before and after the use keyword.

閉包MUST宣告時，function 關鍵字後面要加一個空格，use 關鍵字前後也要加一個空格。

The opening brace MUST go on the same line, and the closing brace MUST go on the next line following the body.

左大括號 MUST 位於同一行，右大括號 MUST 位於主體後方的下一行。

There MUST NOT be a space after the opening parenthesis of the argument list or variable list, and there MUST NOT be a space before the closing parenthesis of the argument list or variable list.

MUST NOT參數列表或變數列表的左括號後面要有一個空格， MUST NOT參數列表或變數列表的右括號前要有一個空格。

In the argument list and variable list, there MUST NOT be a space before each comma, and there MUST be one space after each comma.

在參數清單和變數清單中， MUST NOT每個逗號前有一個空格， MUST每個逗號後有一個空格。

Closure arguments with default values MUST go at the end of the argument list.

具有預設值的閉包參數MUST放在參數清單的末端。

If a return type is present, it MUST follow the same rules as with normal functions and methods; if the use keyword is present, the colon MUST follow the use list closing parentheses with no spaces between the two characters.

如果存在回傳類型，則它遵循與普通函數和方法相同的規則；如果存在 use 關鍵字， MUST MUST在 use 列表的右括號後面，兩個字元之間沒有空格。

A closure declaration looks like the following. Note the placement of parentheses, commas, spaces, and braces:

閉包聲明如下圖所示。請注意圓括號、逗號、空格和花括號的位置：

```php
<?php

$closureWithArgs = function ($arg1, $arg2) {
    // body
};

$closureWithArgsAndVars = function ($arg1, $arg2) use ($var1, $var2) {
    // body
};

$closureWithArgsVarsAndReturn = function ($arg1, $arg2) use ($var1, $var2): bool {
    // body
};
```

Argument lists and variable lists MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented once. When doing so, the first item in the list MUST be on the next line, and there MUST be only one argument or variable per line.

參數列表和變數列表MAY應跨多行顯示，每行縮排一次。這樣，列表中的第一個元素MUST應位於下一行，且MUST每行只能有一個參數或變數。

When the ending list (whether of arguments or variables) is split across multiple lines, the closing parenthesis and opening brace MUST be placed together on their own line with one space between them.

當結束清單（無論是參數還是變數）跨越多行時，右括號和左大括號MUST應放在單獨的一行上，並在它們之間留一個空格。

The following are examples of closures with and without argument lists and variable lists split across multiple lines.

以下是帶有參數列表和不帶有參數列表的閉包以及跨多行的變數列表的範例。

```php
<?php

$longArgs_noVars = function (
    $longArgument,
    $longerArgument,
    $muchLongerArgument
) {
   // body
};

$noArgs_longVars = function () use (
    $longVar1,
    $longerVar2,
    $muchLongerVar3
) {
   // body
};

$longArgs_longVars = function (
    $longArgument,
    $longerArgument,
    $muchLongerArgument
) use (
    $longVar1,
    $longerVar2,
    $muchLongerVar3
) {
   // body
};

$longArgs_shortVars = function (
    $longArgument,
    $longerArgument,
    $muchLongerArgument
) use ($var1) {
   // body
};

$shortArgs_longVars = function ($arg) use (
    $longVar1,
    $longerVar2,
    $muchLongerVar3
) {
   // body
};
```

Note that the formatting rules also apply when the closure is used directly in a function or method call as an argument.

請注意，當閉包直接用作函數或方法呼叫中的參數時，格式化規則也適用。

```php
<?php

$foo->bar(
    $arg1,
    function ($arg2) use ($var1) {
        // body
    },
    $arg3
);
```

##### 8\. Anonymous Classes｜8. 匿名類

Anonymous Classes MUST follow the same guidelines and principles as closures in the above section.

匿名類MUST遵循與上述章節中的封閉類相同的指導原則和原則。

```php
<?php

$instance = new class {};
```

The opening brace MAY be on the same line as the class keyword so long as the list of implements interfaces does not wrap. If the list of interfaces wraps, the brace MUST be placed on the line immediately following the last interface.

只要實作介面的清單不換行，左大括號MAY就應該與class關鍵字在同一行。如果介面清單換行，則大括號MUST應該放在最後一個介面之後的下一行。

```php
<?php

// Brace on the same line
$instance = new class extends \Foo implements \HandleableInterface {
    // Class content
};

// Brace on the next line
$instance = new class extends \Foo implements
    \ArrayAccess,
    \Countable,
    \Serializable
{
    // Class content
};
```

#### Python PEPs｜Python PEP

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/guidelines/peps.html>

For Python code the Python Enhancement Proposals (PEPs) apply. See the [Python Developer’s Guide](https://www.python.org/dev/) for detailed information. The most basic one is [PEP8: Style Guide for Python Code](https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0008/). Compliance with PEP8 can be checked using the [Python style guide checker](https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pycodestyle/).

對於 Python 程式碼，Python 增強提案 (PEP) 適用。有關詳細信息，請參閱 [Python 開發者指南](https://www.python.org/dev/) 。最基本的提案是 [PEP8 ：Python 程式碼風格指南](https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0008/) 。可以使用 [Python 風格指南檢查器](https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pycodestyle/)檢查是否符合PEP8 。
