<a id="p-242"></a>

### Architecture｜建築學

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/architecture.html>

The main focus of the OPNsense project is to provide a secure and manageable platform for all your security applications. This means high quality software that is easily maintainable and bug free. We think that having a framework with a clear separation of concerns is essential to achieving these goals.

OPNsense 專案的主要目標是為您的所有安全應用程式提供一個安全且易於管理的平台。這意味著高品質、易於維護且無漏洞的軟體。我們認為，擁有一個職責清晰分離的框架對於實現這些目標至關重要。

OPNsense is a fork of pfSense ®. The existing code base of pfSense ® does not always apply a clear separation of concerns. This means we need a transition of the old (legacy) code base to a new one with a clear separation. We have chosen a gradual transition to avoid a big bang and keep the product feature rich while increasing code quality. This enables simple addition of new features with less bugs and shorter time to market.

OPNsense 是 pfSense® 的一個分支。 pfSense® 現有的程式碼庫並非總是遵循清晰的職責分離原則。這意味著我們需要將舊的（遺留的）程式碼庫過渡到具有清晰職責分離的新程式碼庫。我們選擇逐步過渡，以避免重大變革，並在維持產品功能豐富性的同時提升程式碼品質。這使得增加新功能更加便捷，同時減少 bug 並縮短產品上市時間。

This article describes how this will be achieved.

本文將介紹如何實現這一目標。

#### High-level architecture｜進階架構

[![OPNsense Components.svg](<../images/c053e4e1-OPNsense_Components.svg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNsense_Components.svg)

As the above model shows there are two main areas in our stack, the frontend implemented with PHP/Phalcon and the backend using a custom service built in Python.

如上圖所示，我們的技術堆疊主要分為兩個部分：前端使用PHP /Phalcon 實現，後端使用 Python 建構的自訂服務。

The frontend handles user interaction and communicates with the backend service. Applying configuration changes, monitoring and controlling services offered by OPNsense is done by the backend service.

前端負責處理使用者互動並與後端服務通訊。後端服務負責應用設定變更、監控和控制 OPNsense 提供的服務。

By using a fully configurable backend service, we avoid hardcoding of services and ease the implementation of new features.

透過使用完全可配置的後端服務，我們避免了服務的硬編碼，並簡化了新功能的實現。

The frontend stack delivers a model driven approach to handle configuration data, including automatic validation.

前端技術堆疊採用模型驅動的方法來處理配置數據，包括自動驗證。

Manipulation of the core configuration file is handled at the frontend model; the backend service is merely a consumer of the information provided.

核心設定檔的操作由前端模型處理；後端服務只是所提供資訊的消費者。

#### Frontend Architecture｜前端架構

[![OPNsense frontend.svg](<../images/9efba41d-OPNsense_frontend.svg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNsense_frontend.svg)

##### Routing｜路由

The OPNsense framework uses standard components where possible; the first layer initializes routing, which handles requests and delivers them to the controller based on its url. User content is generated using Volt templates (using Phalcon), which are picked by the controller.

OPNsense 框架盡可能使用標準元件；第一層初始化路由，處理請求並根據其 URL 將其傳遞給控制器。使用者內容使用 Volt 模板（基於 Phalcon）生成，並由控制器選擇。

For a detailed description on the routing principles used in OPNsense, visit Frontend [Routing](#p-259).

有關 OPNsense 中使用的路由原理的詳細說明，請造訪前端 [路由](#p-259) 。

##### Controllers and views｜控制器和視圖

Not all parts of the framework are implemented, but by deriving all controllers from the base in the OPNsense project it’s easy to extend and adapt to future needs. Documentation on how to implement controllers, with the use of views, can be found at [Using controllers and views](#p-260).

框架並非所有部分都已實現，但透過從 OPNsense 專案的基礎派生所有控制器，可以輕鬆擴展並適應未來的需求。有關如何使用視圖實作控制器的文檔，請參閱 [使用控制器和視圖](#p-260) 。

##### Models｜模型

All models are defined by a combination of a class and an XML containing a (nested) definition. More information on defining models can be found at the frontend model page [Creating Models](#p-251).

所有模型均由類別和包含（嵌套）定義的XML組合定義。有關定義模型的更多信息，請參閱前端模型頁面 [創建模型](#p-251) 。

##### Communication｜溝通

Communication to the backend service is handled via a unix domain socket.

與後端服務的通訊透過 Unix 域套接字進行處理。

##### Core system｜核心系統

The core of OPNsense is powered by an almost standard FreeBSD ® system extended with packages using the pkg system. GIT is used for version control and the repositories are split into 4 parts:

OPNsense 的核心由幾乎標準的 FreeBSD ® 系統提供支持，並使用 pkg 系統擴展了軟體包。 GIT用於版本控制，儲存庫分為4部分：

-   src : the base (FreeBSD ®) system  
    src：基礎（FreeBSD®）系統
    
-   ports : the ports collection containing third party software  
    連接埠：包含第三方軟體的連接埠集合
    
-   core : the OPNsense gui and system configuration parts  
    核心部分：OPNsense 圖形使用者介面和系統配置部分
    
-   tools : easy tools to build OPNsense  
    工具：用於建構 OPNsense 的簡易工具
    

Tip

提示

For detailed information about the development workflow see:

有關開發工作流程的詳細信息，請參閱：

[OPNsense development workflow](#p-235)

[OPNsense 開發工作流程](#p-235)

#### Backend Architecture｜後端架構

##### Middleware｜中介軟體

[![OPNsense backend.svg](<../images/3ec13bdf-OPNsense_backend.svg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNsense_backend.svg)

Configd, is responsible for the core system interaction like starting and stopping of daemons and generating configuration files for used services and applications.

Configd 負責核心系統交互，例如啟動和停止守護進程，以及為使用的服務和應用程式產生設定檔。

The daemon listens on a unix domain socket and is capable of executing actions defined in it’s own configuration directory (“/usr/local/opnsense/service/conf/actions\_\*.conf”).

此守護程式監聽 Unix 網域套接字，並能夠執行在其自身配置目錄（“/usr/local/opnsense/service/conf/actions\_\*.conf”）中定義的操作。

Currently there are four types of services implemented in the daemon:

目前守護程式中實作了四種類型的服務：

-   script : execute external (rc) scripts, report back success or failure  
    腳本：執行外部（rc）腳本，並報告成功或失敗
    
-   script\_output: execute external scripts, report back their contents, usually in json format  
    script_output：執行外部腳本，並傳回其內容，通常以 JSON 格式傳回。
    
-   stream\_output: open streams to backend components  
    stream_output：開啟到後端組件的流
    
-   inline : perform inline actions which are part of configd, most notable template generation and maintenance.  
    inline：執行 configd 的一部分的內嵌操作，最值得注意的是範本產生和維護。
    

  

Template generation is handled by Jinja2 ([https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/](https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/)), more information on how to create application templates can be found at [Using Templates](#p-249).

模板生成由 Jinja2 處理（[https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/](https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/) ），有關如何創建應用程式模板的更多信息，請參閱 [使用模板](#p-249) 。

##### Operating stages｜操作階段

[![OPNsense_operating_events.svg](<../images/074cd70c-OPNsense_operating_events.svg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/OPNsense_operating_events.svg)

As all earlier layers describe how user input can be persisted and service information can be exchanged, we still have a gap in our functionality when looking at the life of a firewall. Until this point we have means to manually manage services and devices, including ways to collect information on demand, but still in a rather isolated way (events triggered via the api layer).

儘管前面的各層都描述瞭如何持久化用戶輸入以及如何交換服務訊息，但在考慮防火牆的整個生命週期時，我們的功能仍然存在不足。目前，我們雖然可以手動管理服務和設備，包括按需收集信息，但這些方式仍然相當孤立（事件透過 API 層觸發）。

This is where [syshooks](#p-245) and [plugins](#p-248) come into play, these offer mechanisms to ensure different types of services can cooperate with the shared functionality available.

這就是 [syshooks](#p-245)和 [plugins](#p-248)發揮作用的地方，它們提供了確保不同類型的服務能夠與共享功能進行協作的機制。

Between starting and stopping our firewall, we can identify three stages. After power-on, we are booting, when this initial stage has been reached we end up with a running firewall with all configured services available. During time, various events can happen, for example, someone pulling an network cable and pushing it back in, this is the running stage. Eventually, if someone decides to power-down or reboot the machine, we are entering shutdown stage, letting services know we are ending operation.

從啟動到停止防火牆，我們可以將其分為三個階段。開機後，進入啟動階段。啟動完成後，防火牆即可運行，所有已設定的服務也都可用。在此期間，可能會發生各種事件，例如有人拔下網線再重新插上，這都屬於運行階段。最後，如果有人決定關閉電源或重新啟動計算機，則進入關機階段，並通知各項服務我們即將結束運行。

Further details of each stage can be found in the [overview](#p-244) document.

各階段的更多詳情可在[概述](#p-244)文件中找到。

To avoid endless dependency loops, services should prevent hooking on events that are not strictly required for operating. For example, forcing a restart of a component when a network interface has changed is usually a sign of not following best practices for designing network services.

為了避免陷入無休止的依賴循環，服務應該避免掛鉤那些並非運作所必需事件。例如，當網路介面發生變化時強制重啟組件，通常表示沒有遵循網路服務設計的最佳實踐。

<a id="c-54"></a>

### Backend

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-243"></a>

#### Backend｜後端

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/backend.html>

The OPNsense backend consists of several components (see Architecture for a full stack description).

OPNsense 後端由多個元件構成（有關完整的堆疊描述，請參閱架構）。

Our core backend service (configd) is implemented using [Python](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python). and provides two main features:

我們的核心後端服務 (configd) 使用 [Python](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python)實現，並提供兩個主要功能：

-   Service interaction (using configd actions)  
    服務互動（使用 configd 操作）
    
-   Generation of configuration data (using templates)  
    產生配置資料（使用範本）
    

Because we need integration between (legacy) components, we provide additional plugin options for the following components:

由於我們需要整合（傳統）元件，因此我們為以下元件提供了額外的插件選項：

-   Services (the services status)  
    服務（服務狀態）
    
-   Syslog (define syslog targets)  
    系統日誌（定義系統日誌目標）
    
-   Interface (register interfaces, firewall use etc.)  
    介面（註冊介面、防火牆使用等）
    
-   Service configuration (legacy service configuration, new style uses configd templates)  
    服務配置（傳統服務配置，新式使用 configd 範本）
    

Services which need to be executed at system startup can use rc(8) or our syshook system. Our [overview](#p-244) document contains a practical write up to explain the various phases of operation and hooks available in them.

需要在系統啟動時執行的服務可以使用 rc(8) 或我們的系統鉤子系統。我們的[概述](#p-244)文件包含一份實用說明，解釋了各個操作階段以及其中可用的鉤子。

-   [Overview](#p-244)  
    [概述](#p-244)
-   [Bootup / autorun options](#p-245)  
    [啟動/自動運轉選項](#p-245)
-   [CARP status](#p-246)  
    [CARP狀態](#p-246)
-   [Using configd](#p-247)  
    [使用 configd](#p-247)
-   [Using plugins](#p-248)  
    [使用插件](#p-248)
-   [Using Templates](#p-249)  
    [使用模板](#p-249)

<a id="p-244"></a>

#### Overview｜概述

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/backend/overview.html>

The life of a service starts during the boot process, but with different hooks available, sometimes it is challenging to find the correct one. This paragraph aims to explain the various integration spots available, which are being explained in more detail in the rest of the chapter.

服務的生命週期始於啟動過程，但由於有多種鉤子可供使用，有時很難找到正確的鉤子。本段旨在解釋各種可用的整合點，本章其餘部分將對此進行更詳細的闡述。

##### Bootup｜啟動

After the kernel is loaded and the machine starts to boot, the following integration points are being executed in sequence:

核心載入完畢，機器開始啟動後，將依序執行以下整合點：

1.  [syshook/early](#p-245), simple shell scripts to run before any network services are loaded, can for example be used to load specific drivers.  
    [syshook/early](#p-245) ，在載入任何網路服務之前執行的簡單 shell 腳本，例如可用於載入特定驅動程式。
    
2.  [plugins/device](#p-248), register and create devices, services like OpenVPN use this on our end to make sure `tun` and `tap` devices exist before doing further configuration.  
    [plugins/device](#p-248) ，註冊並建立設備，OpenVPN 等服務在我們這邊使用此資訊來確保`tun`和`tap`設備存在，然後再進行進一步配置。
    
3.  [plugins/configure/early](#p-248), configure `early` event in bootup process, before normal services are being started (things like ssh and the webconfigurator use this spot)  
    [plugins/configure/early](#p-248) ，在啟動過程中設定`early`事件，在正常服務啟動之前（諸如 ssh 和 webconfigurator 之類的服務會使用此位置）
    
4.  [plugins/firewall](#p-248) allows for automatic firewall (nat) rule registration in cases where the service is able to ship its own rules. (some do this optionally for easy setup)  
    [外掛程式/防火牆](#p-248)允許在服務能夠自備規則的情況下自動註冊防火牆（NAT）規則。 （有些服務為了方便設置，會選擇性地啟用此功能）
    
5.  [plugins/configure/vpn](#p-248), configure `vpn` event, vpn type services are being configured here (e.g. IPsec, OpenVPN)  
    [plugins/configure/vpn](#p-248) ，設定`vpn`事件，此處正在設定 VPN 類型服務（例如 IPsec、OpenVPN）
    
6.  [plugins/configure/bootup](#p-248), configure `bootup` event, normal legacy service configuration, when not using the rc(8) system (for example: unbound, ntpd)  
    [plugins/configure/bootup](#p-248) ，配置`bootup`事件，常規傳統服務配置，當不使用 rc(8) 系統時（例如：unbound、ntpd）
    
7.  [syshook/start](#p-245), simple shell scripts to run after all networking has been setup.  
    [syshook/start](#p-245) ，在所有網路設定完成後執行的簡單 shell 腳本。
    
8.  [rc(8)](#p-245), regular rc(8) scripts (executed using the above `` the rc.syshook.d/start` ``)  
    [rc(8)](#p-245) ，常規 rc(8) 腳本（使用上述 ` ` the rc.syshook.d/start` `` 執行）
    

Tip

提示

Use `pluginctl -c` to display available events and the plugins attached to them.

使用`pluginctl -c`顯示可用事件及其附加的插件。

##### Running stage｜跑步階段

Now the system is booted and events may take place, some of the common integration points with their purpose are listed below:

系統啟動後，可能會發生一些事件，以下列出了一些常見的整合點及其用途：

-   [syshook/carp](#p-245), when a high-availability node changes roles from/to master or backup, these scripts are being executed. This offers the ability to prevent client services from connecting when in the wrong mode.  
    [syshook/carp](#p-245) ，當高可用節點在主節點和備份節點之間切換角色時，這些腳本將被執行。這可以防止客戶端服務在錯誤的模式下連線。
    
-   [plugins/configure/newwanip](#p-248) will be triggered after an interface retrieves a dynamic address.  
    [plugins/configure/newwanip](#p-248)在介面檢索到動態位址後將會觸發。
    
-   [plugins/configure/vpn](#p-248) will be triggered when the VPN subsystem requires reloading.  
    [plugins/configure/vpn] 當VPN子系統需要重新載入時，將觸發(https://docs.opnsense.org/development/backend/legacy.html) 。
    
-   [plugins/interface](#p-248) handles dynamic registration of new (virtual) interfaces.  
    [plugins/interface](#p-248)處理新（虛擬）介面的動態註冊。
    
-   [plugins/syslog](#p-248) registers syslog facilities  
    [plugins/syslog](#p-248)註冊 syslog 功能
    
-   [plugins/xmlrpc](#p-248) registers configuration synchronisation points.  
    [plugins/xmlrpc](#p-248)註冊設定同步點。
    

##### Shutdown (reboot)｜關機（重啟）

When the system is shutdown or being rebooted, we can hook actions using the [syshook/stop](#p-245) script directory. Services like the backup hook into this to flush contents before being terminated.

當系統關機或重新啟動時，我們可以使用 [syshook/stop](#p-245)腳本目錄來執行特定操作。諸如備份之類的服務會鉤入此腳本，以便在終止前刷新內容。

---

<a id="p-245"></a>

#### Bootup autorun options｜啟動自動運行選項

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/backend/autorun.html>

##### Bootup / autorun options｜啟動/自動運行選項

##### syshook｜系統鉤子

OPNsense offers an easy method to plug in custom scripts during boot stages and assorted system events.

OPNsense 提供了一種簡單的方法，可以在啟動階段和各種系統事件期間插入自訂腳本。

Syshook scripts should be installed in:

Syshook腳本應安裝在：

```
/usr/local/etc/rc.syshook.d/<subdir>/
```

They can contain any executable file (e.g. shell scripts) in the following subdirectories:

它們可以在以下子目錄中包含任何執行檔（例如 shell 腳本）：

-   backup  
    備份
    
    -   scripts used for periodic backup and restore  
        用於定期備份和復原的腳本
        
    
-   carp  
    鯉魚
    
    -   scripts used for CARP MASTER / BACKUP events  
        用於CARP MASTER / BACKUP事件的腳本
        
    
-   config  
    配置
    
    -   scripts used when a configuration change took place (`config.xml` changed).  
        配置變更發生時使用的腳本（ `config.xml`已更改）。
        
    

Note

筆記

This event is intended to be atomic for every changed revision, it’s triggered using configd `system event config_changed` and is loosely coupled via a `syslog-ng` handler within the standard `Config->save()` method. The syshook event contains a pointer to the backup file in question (e.g. `/conf/backup/config-1601651332.5394.xml`), so the consumer (script) knows which revision to process.

此事件旨在對每個已更改的版本保持原子性，它由 configd `system event config_changed`觸發，並透過標準`Config->save()`方法中的`syslog-ng`處理程序鬆耦合。 syshook 事件包含指向相關備份檔案的指標（例如`/conf/backup/config-1601651332.5394.xml` ），以便使用者（腳本）知道要處理哪個版本。

Tip

提示

Try to keep custom config handlers as small and efficient as possible since the number of triggered events can grow rapidly.

盡量保持自訂配置處理程序盡可能小巧高效，因為觸發事件的數量可能會迅速增長。

-   early  
    早期的
    
    -   start script before system network startup  
        在系統網路啟動之前啟動腳本
        
    
-   import  
    進口
    
    -   run very early to allow overriding the opnsense-import functionality either by providing a /conf/config.xml beforehand or modifying the default import afterwards  
        儘早運行，以便能夠透過預先提供 /conf/config.xml 檔案或之後修改預設導入來覆寫 opnsense-import 功能。
        
    
-   monitor  
    監視器
    
    -   scripts run during monitoring alerts triggered by state transitions. First argument is a comma-separated list of names of the affected gateways.  
        腳本在狀態轉換觸發的監控警報期間執行。第一個參數是以逗號分隔的受影響網關名稱清單。
        
    
-   start  
    開始
    
    -   start script after system network startup  
        系統網路啟動後啟動腳本
        
    
-   stop  
    停止
    
    -   stop script before normal system shutdown  
        在系統正常關機前停止腳本
        
    
-   update  
    更新
    
    -   update script after core package update (post-update)  
        核心軟體包更新後（postupdate）的更新腳本
        
    
-   upgrade  
    升級
    
    -   upgrade script migration tool for major upgrade (pre-upgrade)  
        主要升級（升級前）的升級腳本遷移工具
        
    

File names can use a number prefix “XX-” to retain a particular order. “20-” is typically used for core scripts, while “50-” is used for plugins.

檔案名稱可以使用數字前綴“XX-”來保持特定的順序。 「20-」通常用於核心腳本，「50-」用於插件。

Example (vmware guestd start, filename /usr/local/etc/rc.syshook.d/early/50-vmware)

範例（vmware guestd start，檔案名稱 /usr/local/etc/rc.syshook.d/early/50-vmware）

```bash
#!/bin/sh

export vmware_guest_vmblock_enable="YES"
export vmware_guest_vmhgfs_enable="YES"
export vmware_guest_vmmemctl_enable="YES"
export vmware_guest_vmxnet_enable="YES"

/usr/local/etc/rc.d/vmware-kmod start
```

Do not forget to set executable permissions on your syshook files.

別忘了為你的系統鉤子檔案設定可執行權限。

##### rc(8)

Part of the bootup process of OPNsense is probing the available rc(8) configuration files in */etc/rc.conf.d/*, when a daemon is enabled, the system will call the regular rc(8) start command.

OPNsense 啟動過程的一部分是探測 */etc/rc.conf.d/* 中的可用 rc(8) 配置文件，當守護程序啟用時，系統將呼叫常規的 rc(8) start 命令。

In case the daemon needs some extra preparation, an additional “bootup” script can be provided, which will be run before executing normal “start”.

如果守護程式需要一些額外的準備工作，可以提供一個額外的「啟動」腳本，該腳本將在執行正常的「啟動」命令之前執行。

Example (from a configured squid proxy server using */etc/rc.conf.d/squid*):

範例（來自使用 */etc/rc.conf.d/squid* 配置的 Squid 代理伺服器）：

```
squid_setup="/usr/local/opnsense/scripts/proxy/setup.sh"
squid_enable="YES"
```

The configd template system can be used to generate the necessary configuration file(s).

可以使用 configd 模板系統產生必要的設定檔。

---

<a id="p-246"></a>

#### CARP status｜CARP狀態

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/backend/carp.html>

##### General｜一般的

The CARP (Common Address Redundancy Protocol) protocol is quite a powerful feature of the firewall, which allows multiple machines to share IPv4 / IPv6 addresses among each other.

CARP （通用位址冗餘協定）協定是防火牆的非常強大的功能，它允許多台機器彼此共用 IPv4 / IPv6 位址。

To determine if a host should be master, it listens on the network for carp broadcast packets and determines if its priority is higher than the others on the network (the highest advertising frequency wins).

為了確定主機是否應該成為主主機，它會在網路上監聽 carp 廣播資料包，並確定其優先順序是否高於網路上的其他主機（廣播頻率最高的主機獲勝）。

A higher advskew (Advertising Frequency Skew) will lower its advertisements and renders the node less attractive of being a master.

廣告頻率偏差（advskew）越高，其廣告投放量就越少，節點作為主節點的吸引力就越低。

Combined with the `advskew` value, the system also uses the current demotion value (`sysctl net.inet.carp.demotion`) which will be added to its preset `advskew` in the gui. This value informs the user about the health of the node. When its value is `0`, all is ok, when some cable is unplugged it will for example add a value to the “demotion counter”.

系統結合`advskew`值，也會使用目前的降級值（ `sysctl net.inet.carp.demotion` ），並將其加入圖形使用者介面（GUI）中的預設`advskew`中。該值用於告知使用者節點的健康狀況。當其值為`0`時，一切正常；例如，當某個電纜被拔出時，系統會將一個值加到「降級計數器」中。

The following demotion events are available by default in the kernel.

內核預設提供以下降級事件。

-   Interface down (net.inet.carp.ifdown\_demotion\_factor)  
    介面關閉（net.inet.carp.ifdown\_demotion\_factor）
    
-   Error sending announcements (net.inet.carp.senderr\_demotion\_factor)  
    發送公告時發生錯誤 (net.inet.carp.sender\_demotion\_factor)
    
-   Busy processing pfsync updates (net.pfsync.carp\_demotion\_factor)  
    正在處理 pfsync 更新 (net.pfsync.carp\_demotion\_factor)
    

##### Custom service hooks｜客製化服務鉤子

In some cases the status of the node should be influenced by the services on the machine, for example when a dynamic routing system isn’t initialized yet, it might be better to wait before propagating as being a better alternative in the cluster.

在某些情況下，節點的狀態應該受到機器上服務的影響，例如，當動態路由系統尚未初始化時，最好等待一段時間再將其傳播為叢集中更好的替代方案。

This mechanism should be comparable to what is available for pfsync ( when states are being synced, we propagate with a higher `advskew` using the value in `net.pfsync.carp_demotion_factor`)

此機制應與 pfsync 的機制類似（當狀態同步時，我們使用`net.pfsync.carp_demotion_factor`中的值，以更高的`advskew`進行傳播）。

The idea of the service status hook is to register service check scripts into a single directory and validate status as a whole (if any of the test scripts fail, we add a demotion factor for “services”).

服務狀態鉤子的想法是將服務檢查腳本註冊到單一目錄中，並驗證整體狀態（如果任何測試腳本失敗，我們將為「服務」添加降級因子）。

Note

筆記

Some inspiration for this hook came from how OpenBSD handles demotion in ospfd ([https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5](https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5) –> demote)

這個鉤子的設計靈感部分來自 OpenBSD 在 ospfd 中處理降級的方式（[https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5](https://man.openbsd.org/ospfd.conf.5) –> 降級）

To create new tests, just add executable scripts in the following directory, which exits `0` if all is good and something other than 0 on issues (e.g. `exit 1`).

要建立新的測試，只需在以下目錄中新增可執行腳本，如果一切正常且出現問題時退出 `0`（例如 `exit 1`）。

```
/usr/local/etc/rc.carp_service_status.d/<service_test>
```

Tip

提示

Make sure test scripts are as lightweight as possible, so it wouldn’t mind of they run more often than strictly needed.

確保測試腳本盡可能輕量級，這樣即使運行頻率高於實際需求也不會造成問題。

Note

筆記

We use a high demotion value (\\(2^{20}\\)) when one of the services fails its test, so we don’t need to remember our current state (reading `sysctl net.inet.carp.demotion` would be enough) and can use a bitwise `and` to check if it’s set.

當某個服務測試失敗時，我們使用較高的降級值（\\(2^{20}\\)），因此我們不需要記住當前狀態（讀取`sysctl net.inet.carp.demotion`就足夠了），並且可以使用位元運算`and`來檢查它是否已設定。

A simple test which always reports service as being down, can be as simple as the following:

一個簡單的測試，總是報告服務已關閉，可以像下面這樣簡單：

/usr/local/etc/rc.carp\_service\_status.d/test\_service

```bash
#!/bin/sh

exit 1
```

###### Trigger event｜觸發事件

To ask the system to evaluate status again, we should call the `carp_service_status` script, using configd so we don’t need to be root to trigger a test.

要讓系統再次評估狀態，我們應該呼叫`carp_service_status`腳本，使用 configd，這樣我們就不需要 root 權限來觸發測試。

```
configctl interface update carp service_status
```

Note

筆記

Services using this facility should emit this event themself after normal operation has proceeded.

使用此功能的各項服務應在正常運作結束後自行發出此事件。

###### Logging｜日誌記錄

Carp status changes are usually logged to syslog (System ‣ Log Files ‣ General), so does our carp service status check.

鯉魚狀態變化通常會記錄到系統日誌（系統 ‣ 日誌檔案 ‣ 常規）中，我們的鯉魚服務狀態檢查也是如此。

When the test service example is installed, we would expect a log line which looks like the following after triggering an event:

安裝測試服務範例後，觸發事件後，我們預期會看到類似如下的日誌行：

```
....  OPNsense carp: carp demoted by 1048576 due to service disruption (services: test_service)
```

This informs the user about the amount of demotion and which services are responsible for it.

這會告知用戶降級的程度以及哪些服務導致了降級。

When service status is recovered again, it will send something like the following to syslog.

當服務狀態恢復後，它會向系統日誌發送類似以下內容的資訊。

```
..... carp promoted by 1048576 due to service recovery
```

---

<a id="p-247"></a>

#### Using configd｜使用 configd

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/backend/configd.html>

##### General｜一般的

To add new services and system calls, which can be used from the frontend system or command line, you can create configd actions.

若要新增可從前端系統或命令列使用的新服務和系統調用，您可以建立 configd 操作。

All available templates should be installed at the following location on the OPNsense system:

所有可用的模板都應安裝在 OPNsense 系統的以下位置：

```
/usr/local/opnsense/service/conf/actions.d/
```

*Please note that all actions which should be accessible from the frontend should have a registered configd action, if possible use standard rc(8) scripts for service start/stop.*

*請注意，所有需要從前端存取的操作都應該註冊一個 configd 操作；如果可能，請使用標準的 rc(8) 腳本來啟動/停止服務。 *

##### Naming convention｜命名規則

Service templates should use distinctive names to identify your service and contain simple / clear actions.

服務模板應使用獨特的名稱來識別您的服務，並包含簡單/清晰的操作。

For example, we will describe the template for ssh, which is installed by default.

例如，我們將介紹預設安裝的 ssh 範本。

**File name:**

**檔名：**

```
/usr/local/opnsense/service/conf/actions.d/actions_sshd.conf
```

Our ssh service has two actions available:

我們的 SSH 服務提供兩種操作：

-   restart  
    重啟
    
    -   starts / restarts ssh service  
        啟動/重啟 SSH 服務
        
    
-   stop  
    停止
    
    -   stops / kills all ssh daemons  
        停止/終止所有 SSH 守護程式
        
    

```
[restart]
command:/usr/local/etc/rc.sshd
parameters:
type:script
message:starting sshd

[stop]
command:/bin/pkill -TERM sshd; exit 0
parameters:
type:script
message:stop sshd
```

Between brackets \[\] you find the name of the action, the definition of the actual call is defined in the following parameter:value pairs. When a service or module provides a lot of actions, it sometimes is practical to add another level of operation.

在方括號 [] 內是操作名稱，實際呼叫的定義則由後面的參數:值對構成。當服務或模組提供大量操作時，有時添加另一層操作會很實用。

For example, the restart service call for this service will translate to: **sshd restart**

例如，此服務的重啟呼叫將轉換為：**sshd restart**

In case we have an action like **filter diag info**, you can create an actions\_filter.conf which contains a section \[diag.info\].

如果我們有像 **filter diag info** 這樣的操作，您可以建立一個 actions\_filter.conf，其中包含 \[diag.info\] 部分。

##### Action properties｜動作屬性

| Property<br>屬性 | Syntax<br>語法 | Description<br>描述 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| command<br>指令 | text<br>文字 | shell command string to execute<br>要執行的 shell 指令字串 |
| parameters<br>參數 | %s for every parameter<br>%s 代表每個參數 | list of parameters to use, example : /i %s<br>要使用的參數列表，例如：/i %s |
| type<br>類型 | script\|script\_output<br>腳本\| script\_output | type of call:<br>• script (only return exit status)<br>• script\_output (return result)<br>• stream\_output (return result in streaming mode)<br>呼叫類型： <br> • 腳本（僅返回退出狀態） <br> • script\_output（返回結果） <br> • stream\_output（以流模式傳回結果） |
| errors<br>錯誤 | text \[no\]<br>文字 [否] | `errors:no` ignores the scripts exit code<br>`errors:no`忽略腳本退出代碼 |
| allowed\_groups | text | list of groups allowed to execute this action (e.g. wheel)<br>允許執行此操作（例如 wheel）的群組清單 |
| message<br>訊息 | text<br>文字 | Message to send to syslog (you can use %s parameters)<br>要傳送到系統日誌的訊息（可以使用 %s 參數） |
| description<br>描述 | text<br>文字 | User-friendly description, also allows GUI usage<br>使用者友善的描述，也允許GUI使用 |

##### Test action｜測試操作

To test a new configd action, please restart the configd service first using:

若要測試新的 configd 操作，請先使用下列指令重新啟動 configd 服務：

```
service configd restart
```

Next use the supplied helper command to execute our action:

接下來，使用提供的輔助命令來執行我們的操作：

```
configctl sshd restart
```

##### Extending the Environment｜擴展環境

Configd’s own configuration can be found in the [configd.conf](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/master/src/opnsense/service/conf/configd.conf) file. In some cases it can be practical to extend the environment with additional settings for the configd actions to use.

Configd 本身的設定資訊位於 [configd.conf](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/master/src/opnsense/service/conf/configd.conf)檔案中。在某些情況下，為 configd 操作新增額外的設定會很實用。

To add environment variables, create a new config file in the `conf/configd.conf.d/` directory using the `.conf` extension containing an `[environment]` section. For example, to add a proxy server (for the firmware updater), use settings like these:

若要新增環境變量，請在`conf/configd.conf.d/`目錄中建立新的設定文件，並使用`.conf`副檔名，其中包含一個`[environment]`部分。例如，若要新增代理伺服器（用於韌體更新程式），請使用下列設定：

/usr/local/opnsense/service/conf/configd.conf.d/proxy.conf

```
[environment]
HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy-adddress:8080
HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy-adddress:8080
NO_PROXY=192.168.1.2
```

Note

筆記

After changing the configd configuration, don’t forget to restart the configd service via the gui or service configd restart (as root).

更改 configd 設定後，不要忘記透過圖形介面或使用 service configd restart 命令（以 root 使用者身分）重新啟動 configd 服務。

Warning

警告

When using the same settings as already specified in the base configuration, these settings will be overwritten. The parsing order of configuration files is to read all vendor shipped properties first and read additional files next. Last property found is the one being used (e.g. specifying a new `PATH` in the environment, will overwrite the one being shipped in our `configd.conf`.)

如果使用與基本配置中已指定的設定相同的設置，則這些設定將被覆蓋。設定檔的解析順序是先讀取供應商提供的所有屬性，然後再讀取其他檔案。最後找到的屬性將被使用（例如，在環境中指定一個新的`PATH`將覆蓋我們`configd.conf`中提供的同名屬性）。

Note

筆記

The `NO_PROXY` setting may be used to exclude hosts from using a proxy, which is usually practical for xmlrpc sync

`NO_PROXY`設定可用於排除某些主機使用代理，這通常對 XMLRPC 同步很實用。

---

<a id="p-248"></a>

#### Using plugins｜使用插件

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/backend/legacy.html>

##### General｜一般的

Plugins are located in the following location:

插件位於以下位置：

```
/usr/local/etc/inc/plugins.inc.d/
```

And contain files with the extension “.inc”.

並且包含副檔名為“.inc”的檔案。

All automatically registered functions start with the name of the file (without the extension), followed by the purpose. For example *vpn\_configure* would be the *configure* handle in a plugin file name vpn.inc.

所有自動註冊的函數都以檔案名稱（不含副檔名）開頭，後面接著函數用途。例如，*vpn\_configure* 表示插件檔案 vpn.inc 中的 *configure* 句柄。

With the use of these plugins, you have the ability to hook into different areas of the system, such as registration of new interface types and making sure services are shown in the regular service overview.

透過這些插件，您可以存取系統的不同區域，例如註冊新的介面類型，並確保服務顯示在常規服務概覽中。

Note

筆記

When plugins fail and cause PHP errors, these will be collected in `/tmp/PHP_errors.log`, these plugins are not registered and executed when emitting such errors

當插件發生故障並導致PHP錯誤時，這些錯誤將被收集到`/tmp/PHP_errors.log`中。這些插件在發生此類錯誤時不會被註冊和執行。

##### Services｜服務

To register services, the `<plugin>_services()` function should return a structure containing its name, description and operating properties.

要註冊服務， `<plugin>_services()`函數應傳回一個包含其名稱、描述和運行屬性的結構。

```php
function myplugin_services()
{
    $service = array();
    $service['name'] = 'myservice';
    $service['description'] = gettext('My service');
    $service['configd']['restart'] = array('myservice restart');
    $service['configd']['start'] = array('myservice start');
    $service['configd']['stop'] = array('myservice stop');
    $services[] = $pconfig;
    return $services;
}
```

| **option**<br>**選項** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- |
| name<br>名稱 | Service identifier<br>服務標識符 |
| id | Optional identifier to suffix the service, only used in specific cases where one “service” can actually be a list of them (e.g. `openvpn`)<br>可選的標識符，用於附加到服務名稱後綴，僅在特定情況下使用，即一個「服務」實際上可以是多個服務的列表（例如`openvpn` ） |
| description<br>描述 | User friendly description<br>使用者友善描述 |
| pidfile<br>pid檔 | Validate running based on specified pid file (instead of “name”)<br>根據指定的pid檔（而非「名稱」）驗證運行情況 |
| nocheck | \[boolean\] ignore pid or process name and always report running<br>\[boolean\] 忽略進程 ID 或進程名稱，並且始終報告正在運行 |
| {type} | Type could be one of `configd`, `php`, `mwexec`<br>類型可以是`configd`, `php`, `mwexec` |
| {type}.start | Action to call when starting the service<br>啟動服務時要呼叫的操作 |
| {type}.stop | Action to call when stopping the service<br>停止服務時要呼叫的動作 |
| {type}.restart | Action to call when restarting the service<br>重啟服務時要呼叫的動作 |

To list all available services from the command line, you can use pluginctl (bundled with our core system).

若要從命令列列出所有可用服務，您可以使用pluginctl（與我們的核心系統捆綁在一起）。

```
pluginctl -s
```

The same tool can also be used to execute the \[re\]start/stop operations, for the example above, a restart would look like:

同一個工具也可以用來執行重啟/停止操作，例如，上面的重啟操作如下所示：

```
pluginctl -s myservice restart
```

##### Configure｜配置

The configure plugin can be used to catch certain events, such as `bootup`, `newwanip` and others.

配置插件可用於捕捉某些事件，例如`bootup`, `newwanip`等。

A small sample of a registration is shown below, which registers the functions `myplugin_configure()` on bootup and `myplugin_configure_vpn()` on vpn state change where the latter is accepting two (:2) parameters at most. Note that the default number of arguments passed to the listeners is one (:1) which is the `$verbose` parameter steering whether the function is allowed to print progress or not. The maximum number of arguments passed depends on the particular event provider. For more details see below.

下面展示了一個註冊範例，它註冊了啟動時觸發的函數`myplugin_configure()`和VPN狀態改變時觸發的函數`myplugin_configure_vpn()` ，其中後者最多接受兩個(:2)參數。請注意，傳遞給監聽器的預設參數數量為1(:1)，即`$verbose`參數，此參數控制函數是否允許列印進度。傳遞的最大參數數量取決於特定的事件提供者。更多詳情請見下文。

```js
function myplugin_configure()
{
    return [
        'bootup' => ['myplugin_configure'],
        'vpn' => ['myplugin_configure_vpn:2'],
    ];
}
```

To list all available hooks, you can use `pluginctl` without parameters:

要列出所有可用的鉤子，可以使用不含參數的`pluginctl` ：

```
pluginctl -c
```

Below you will find an incomplete list of the most common used events that are handled at the moment:

以下是目前處理的部分最常用事件清單（不完整）：

| **Event**<br>**活動** | **When**<br>**時間** |
| --- | --- |
| early<br>早期 | Early in bootup process, before normal services are started (things like ssh and the webconfigurator use this spot)<br>在啟動過程的早期階段，在常規服務啟動之前（例如 SSH 和 Web 設定器等服務會在這個階段啟動） |
| bootup<br>啟動 | Bootup, normal legacy service configuration, when not using the `rc(8)` system (for example: unbound, ntpd)<br>啟動，常規傳統服務配置，當不使用`rc(8)`系統時（例如：unbound、ntpd） |
| newwanip<br>紐瓦尼普 | Triggered after configuration of a dynamic interface address, expects a maximum of three positional parameters (`$verbose` and `$interfaces` and `$family`). `$interfaces` is an array all relevant interfaces that require reloading or null for all. $:code:family is the address family type that triggered the event, either `inet` for IPv4 or `inet6` for IPv6.<br>配置動態介面位址後觸發，最多需要三個位置參數（`$verbose`、`$interfaces` 和`$family`）。 `$interfaces` 是一個數組，所有需要重新載入的相關介面或全部為空。 $:code:family 是觸發事件的位址族類型，對於 IPv4 為`inet`，對於 IPv6 為`inet6`。 |
| vpn<br>VPN | Triggered in multiple places that require a reload of the VPN based subsystems, expects a maximum of two parameters (`$verbose` and `$interfaces`). `$interfaces` is an array of all relevant interfaces that require reloading or null for all.<br>在需要重新載入基於VPN的子系統的多個位置觸發，最多需要兩個參數（`$verbose`和`$interfaces`）。 `$interfaces` 是所有需要重新載入的相關介面的數組，或全部為 null。 |

`pluginctl` can also be used to trigger a specific event, such as:

`pluginctl`也可用於觸發特定事件，例如：

```
pluginctl -c monitor
```

##### Firewall｜防火牆

To register firewall rules, create a function called `<plugin>_firewall()`, this will pass a plugin object you can use to generate new firewall rules.

要註冊防火牆規則，請建立一個名為`<plugin>_firewall()`的函數，該函數將傳遞一個插件對象，您可以使用該對象產生新的防火牆規則。

A very simplified example of such a rule is included below:

下面給出一個非常簡化的此類規則範例：

```php
function myplugin_firewall(\OPNsense\Firewall\Plugin $fw) {
    $fw->registerFilterRule(500000, array("direction" => "in", "protocol" => "udp", "to_port" => 9999));
}
```

`configctl` can be used to reload the firewall and test your plugin:

`configctl`可用於重新載入防火牆並測試您的外掛程式：

```
configctl filter reload
```

This will generate a rule like (in /tmp/rules.debug):

這將產生類似這樣的規則（位於 /tmp/rules.debug 中）：

```
pass in quick proto udp from {any} to {any} port {9999}
```

##### Interface｜介面

To register new (virtual) interfaces, create a function called `<plugin>_interfaces()`, which should return a named array containing the unique interface name as key (enc0 for ipsec for example).

若要註冊新的（虛擬）接口，請建立名為`<plugin>_interfaces()`的函數，該函數應傳回命名數組，其中包含唯一的介面名稱作為鍵（例如，ipsec 的 enc0）。

Every item should contain the following properties:

每個物品都應包含以下屬性：

| **Property**<br>**屬性** | **Syntax**<br>**語法** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| enable<br>啟用 | boolean<br>布林值 | interface enabled, if so it will be saved in the config<br>介面是否已啟用，如果已啟用，則會將配置儲存到配置中 |
| descr<br>描述 | text<br>文字 | User readable description<br>使用者可讀描述 |
| networks<br>網路 | array, \[network, mask\]<br>數組，\[網絡，遮罩\] | list of named arrays containing remote networks<br>包含遠端網路的命名數組列表 |
| type<br>類型 | text<br>文字 | “none”<br>“無” |
| if<br>如果 | text<br>文字 | physical interface (e.g. enc0)<br>實體介面（例如 enc0） |
| virtual<br>虛擬 | boolean<br>布林值 | Virtual interface, true/false<br>虛擬接口，真/假 |

Example:

例子：

```php
function myplugin_interfaces()
{
    global $config;

    $interfaces = array();
    if (isset($config['myplugin']['enable'])) {
        $oic = array("enable" => true);
        $oic['if'] = 'tun0';
        $oic['descr'] = 'myplugin';
        $oic['type'] = "none";
        $oic['virtual'] = true;
        $oic['networks'] = array();
        $interfaces['tun0'] = $oic;
    }

    return $interfaces;
}
```

##### Device｜裝置

To register virtual network devices types which can be used verbatim or manually assigned to interfaces, the `<plugin>_devices()` function should return a structure containing such devices and additional definitions.

若要註冊可直接使用或手動指派給介面的虛擬網路設備類型， `<plugin>_devices()`函數應傳回一個包含此類設備和其他定義的結構。

Device registration covers a number of aspects such as interfaces assignment page presentation, external (re)configuration function, automatic configuration of assigned devices, and matching device name pattern amongst others. Available settings are described below:

設備註冊涵蓋多個方面，例如介面分配頁面顯示、外部（重新）配置功能、已分配設備的自動配置以及設備名稱匹配等。可用設定如下：

| **Property**<br>**屬性** | **Syntax**<br>**語法** | **Description**<br>**描述** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| function<br>函數 | text<br>文字 | Calls function of that name with device name as argument<br>呼叫該名稱的函數，並將裝置名稱作為參數 |
| volatile<br>易失性 | boolean<br>布林值 | This interface can disappear so do not attempt boot recovery<br>此介面可能會消失，因此請勿嘗試啟動恢復 |
| configurable<br>可設定 | boolean<br>布林值 | Assigned interface can set IPv4/IPv6 mode if true or missing<br>指派的介面可以設定 IPv4/IPv6 模式（若為真或缺失） |
| pattern<br>模式 | text<br>文字 | Regex to identify device names in bulk<br>用於批次識別設備名稱的正規表示式 |
| type<br>類型 | text<br>文字 | Unique type setting required for assignments page<br>作業頁面需要唯一的類型設定 |
| names<br>名稱 | array \[ see below \]<br>數組 \[見下文\] | List of devices with individual names as associative keys<br>設備列表，每個設備的名稱作為關聯鍵 |
| …descr | text<br>文本 | Descriptive text of device, e.g. for assignments page<br>設備描述文本，例如用於任務頁面 |
| …ifdescr | text<br>文字 | Verbatim description, e.g. as stored in config.xml<br>原文描述，例如儲存在 config.xml 中的描述 |
| …name<br>…名稱 | text<br>文字 | Device name same as array key for convenient access<br>設備名稱與陣列鍵相同，方便存取 |

Example:

例子：

```php
function myplugin_devices()
{
    $devices = [];

    $devices[] = [
        'function' => 'function_name_to_configure',
        'names' => ['dev0' => [
            'descr' => 'descriptive text',
            'ifdescr' => 'verbatim description',
            'name' => 'dev0',
        ]],
        'pattern' => '^dev',
        'volatile' => true,
        'type' => 'bridge',
    ];

    return $devices;
}
```

##### Syslog｜系統日誌

To register syslog targets, the `<plugin>_syslog()` function should return a structure containing targets and definitions.

要註冊 syslog 目標， `<plugin>_syslog()`函數應傳回一個包含目標和定義的結構。

```php
function myplugin_syslog()
{
    $logfacilities = array();
    $logfacilities['myplugin'] = array(
        'facility' => array('myplugin'),
    );
    return $logfacilities;
}
```

Note

筆記

As of OPNsense 19.7 Syslog-NG is included in our base system, these files will only be used to identify applications for custom syslog remote targets in System->Settings->Logging / targets.

從 OPNsense 19.7 Syslog- NG開始，這些檔案將僅用於在「系統」->「設定」->「日誌記錄」/「目標」中識別自訂 syslog 遠端目標的應用程式。

To test if a service registration functions properly, just restart the syslog facility:

要測試服務註冊是否正常運作，只需重新啟動系統日誌服務：

```
pluginctl -s syslogd restart
```

Note

筆記

In order to define local targets for Syslog-NG you can just add **local** filters (e.g. by creating `src/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Syslog/local/helloworld.conf`) which will be collected into one large syslog configuration. The readme on [GitHub](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/master/src/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Syslog/local/README) describes the process. When running into issues, always make sure to manually restart syslog-ng first (`service syslog-ng restart`), definition errors won’t be written into any log. You will also have to restart the plugin (`pluginctl -s syslog-ng restart`) for the syslog-ng configuration files to be regenerated.

要為 Syslog 定義本地目標NG ，您可以新增**本地**過濾器（例如，建立`src/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Syslog/local/helloworld.conf` ），這些過濾器將被收集到一個大型的 syslog 配置中。 [GitHub 上的 readme 檔案](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/master/src/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Syslog/local/README)描述了此過程。遇到問題時，請務必先手動重新啟動 syslog-ng（ `service syslog-ng restart` ），否則定義錯誤將不會寫入任何日誌。您還需要重新啟動插件（ `pluginctl -s syslog-ng restart` ）才能重新產生 syslog-ng 設定檔。

Note

筆記

In case additional source sockets should be used by Syslog-NG you can add files in `/usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Syslog/sources/` containing definitions. The [001-local.conf](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/22.1.7/src/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Syslog/sources/001-local.conf#L5) file contains examples from jailed core services.

如果 Syslog 需要使用額外的來源套接字`/usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Syslog/sources/` NG新增包含定義的檔案。 [001-local.conf](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/22.1.7/src/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Syslog/sources/001-local.conf#L5)檔案包含來自受限核心服務的範例。

##### XMLRPC (HA) sync｜XMLRPC ( HA ) 同步

When a configuration section should be exposed to High Availability sync, you can use the xmlrpc plugin hook.

當需要將配置部分暴露給高可用性同步時，可以使用 xmlrpc 插件鉤子。

If a plugin exposes a configuration section to ha sync, it can be enabled separately in the synchronization settings System->High Availability->Settings.

如果外掛程式向 ha sync 公開了設定部分，則可以在同步設定「系統->高可用性->設定」中單獨啟用它。

A simple example to expose the configuration section Myplugin within the OPNsense xml path looks like this:

以下是一個在 OPNsense XML 路徑中公開 Myplugin 配置部分的簡單範例：

```php
function myplugin_xmlrpc_sync()
{
    $result = array();
    $result[] = array(
        'description' => gettext('My Plugin'),
        'section' => 'OPNsense.Myplugin',
        'id' => 'myplugin',
        'services' => 'myplugin', // optional, in case a service with the same name exists
    );
    return $result;
}
```

Note

筆記

If your plugin depends on other components in the system, make sure you enable synchronization for those as well.

如果您的外掛程式依賴系統中的其他元件，請確保也為這些元件啟用同步功能。

<a id="p-249"></a>

#### Using Templates｜使用模板

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/backend/templates.html>

##### General｜一般的

For config file generation, we provide a backend service which can bind config.xml data to templates written in Jinja2 ([https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/](https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/)).

對於設定檔生成，我們提供了一個後端服務，可以將 config.xml 資料綁定到用 Jinja2 編寫的模板（[https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/](https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/) ）。

All available templates should be installed at the following location on the OPNsense system:

所有可用的模板都應安裝在 OPNsense 系統的以下位置：

1.  /usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/
    

##### Naming convention｜命名規則

All templates should be put into a directory structure containing the vendor and package/application name, our sample application is placed inside the directory:

所有模板都應放入包含供應商名稱和軟體包/應用程式名稱的目錄結構中，我們的範例應用程式就放在該目錄中：

/usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/*OPNsense/Sample*

Template package content

模板包內容

Every template directory should contain at least 2 files:

每個範本目錄至少應包含 2 個檔案：

1.  a content descriptor, containing the actual targets, named +TARGETS  
    包含實際目標的描述符，命名為 + TARGETS
    
2.  one or more template(s)  
    一個或多個模板
    

##### Targets｜目標

The +TARGETS file contains the source template name inside the template directory and the (dynamic) target filename divided by a colon (:) multiple lines may be inserted per file.

+ TARGETS檔案包含範本目錄中的來源範本名稱和（動態）目標檔名，兩者之間以冒號 (:) 分隔，每個檔案可以插入多行。

For example :

例如 ：

```
example_simple_page.txt:/tmp/template_sample/simple_page.txt
```

Will create a file /tmp/template\_sample/simple\_page.txt using the template example\_simple\_page.txt.

將使用模板 example\_simple\_page.txt 建立檔案 /tmp/template\_sample/simple\_page.txt。

Note

筆記

Optionally you can specify which file or files to remove on call of “template cleanup”, which can be specified by using an extra tag next to the target, such as: `example_simple_page.txt:/tmp/template_sample/simple_page.txt:/tmp/template_sample/simple_page.*`

您也可以選擇在呼叫「範本清理」時指定要刪除的文件，這可以透過在目標旁邊使用額外的標籤來指定，例如： `example_simple_page.txt:/tmp/template_sample/simple_page.txt:/tmp/template_sample/simple_page.*`

By default all targets will be removed when calling cleanup.

預設情況下，呼叫清理函數時會移除所有目標。

If you want to use information from within the config.xml file as output filename, you can use tags to address the content, like \[version\] to input the tag version from the xml file. When generating multiple files from 1 template, you can use one wildcard (%) to address a section of the config file, for example \[interfaces.%.if\] loops over the interfaces and outputs the value of **if**.

如果您想使用 config.xml 檔案中的資訊作為輸出檔名，您可以使用標籤來定址內容，例如 \[version\] 從 xml 檔案輸入標籤版本。當從 1 個範本產生多個檔案時，您可以使用通配符 (%) 來定址設定檔的一部分，例如 \[interfaces.%.if\] 循環遍歷介面並輸出 **if** 的值。

##### Target overwrites｜目標覆蓋

Every template package can specify overwrites, which can be used by vendors who implement and maintain their own templates for features in OPNsense.

每個模板包都可以指定覆蓋規則，供在 OPNsense 中實現和維護自身功能模板的供應商使用。

Simply add files using the target definition in the **+TARGETS.D** directory of the templates folder using as extension **.TARGET**.

只需在模板資料夾的 **+ TARGETS .D**目錄中使用目標定義新增文件，並使用**. TARGET ** 作為副檔名。

For example an overwrite for OPNsense/Sample can use the following name and location `/usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Sample/+TARGETS.D/custom.TARGET`

例如，OPNsense/Sample 的覆蓋範圍可以使用以下名稱和位置`/usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Sample/+TARGETS.D/custom.TARGET`

Note

筆記

Be vey careful using this feature, you need to maintain these templates yourself and features may break after upgrades of OPNsense.

使用此功能時請務必小心，您需要自行維護這些模板，並且 OPNsense 升級後功能可能會失效。

##### Templates｜範本

For more information of the template language itself, please look at [https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/](https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/) and the examples installed in /usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Sample.

有關模板語言本身的更多信息，請參閱 [https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/](https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/)以及安裝在 /usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/Sample 中的範例。

There’s one special case when using the template engine, every wildcard used for the output file generation is also provided to the template, so you are able to determine which filter let to this output.

使用模板引擎時有一個特殊情況，用於產生輸出檔案的每個通配符也會提供給模板，因此您可以確定哪個過濾器會輸出到該輸出。

Those filters are stored in the variable TARGET\_FILTERS.

這些過濾器儲存在變數TARGET \_FILTERS中。

```
{% if TARGET_FILTERS['interfaces.wan'] %}
{% endif %}
```

##### Test usage｜測試用途

The templates can be rendered via the backend service (configd), to test this functionality on a running OPNsense system, use:

模板可透過後端服務 (configd) 進行渲染。若要在執行中的 OPNsense 系統上測試此功能，請使用下列命令：

```
# generate template package
configctl template reload OPNsense/Sample
# cleanup files
configctl template cleanup OPNsense/Sample
```

  

##### Python template usage example｜Python 範本使用範例

The template system itself is a separate module which is used by configd, to use (or test) the system without the daemon, use:

模板系統本身就是一個獨立的模組，由 configd 使用。若要在不使用守護程式的情況下使用（或測試）該系統，請使用：

```
# import template system and config.xml handling
from modules import template
from modules import config

# construct a new template object, set root to /tmp/
tmpl = template.Template(target_root_directory='/tmp/')
# open the config.xml and bind to template object
conf = config.Config('/config.xml')
tmpl.set_config(conf.get())

# generate output for OPNsense/Sample
generated_filenames = tmpl.generate('OPNsense/Sample')

# print results
for filename in generated_filenames:
  print ('.. generated : %s'%filename)
```

<a id="c-55"></a>

### Frontend

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-250"></a>

#### Frontend｜前端

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend.html>

The OPNsense frontend is implemented with [PHP/Phalcon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phalcon_\(framework\)).

OPNsense 前端採用 [PHP /Phalcon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phalcon_\(framework\)實現。

-   [Creating Models](#p-251)

<a id="c-56"></a>

#### Creating Models

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-251"></a>

##### Creating Models｜創建模型

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/models.html>

A model represents the data which the application will use and takes care of the interaction to that data. In OPNsense most of the relevant data is physically stored in an XML structure (config.xml). The primary goal for OPNsense models is to structure the use of configuration data, by creating a clear abstraction layer.

模型代表應用程式將使用的數據，並負責處理與這些數據的交互作用。在 OPNsense 中，大部分相關資料都以XML結構（config.xml）的形式物理儲存。 OPNsense 模型的主要目標是透過建立清晰的抽象層來規範配置資料的使用。

In this chapter we will explain how models are designed and build.

本章我們將解釋模型的設計和建構方式。

-   [Designing the model](#p-252)  
    [模型設計](#p-252)
