<a id="p-252"></a>

##### Designing the model｜模型設計

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/models_design.html>

###### [Designing the model](#p-252)｜[模型設計](#p-252)

Index

指數

-   [Designing the model](#p-252)  
    [模型設計](#p-252)
    
    -   [volatile fields](#p-252)  
        [易失性場](#p-252)
        
-   [Special model types](#p-252)  
    [特殊型號](#p-252)
    
    -   [In memory models](#p-252)  
        [記憶體模型](#p-252)
        
    -   [Legacy wrappers](#p-252)  
        [舊版封裝器](#p-252)
        
-   [Cached data](#p-252)  
    [快取資料](#p-252)
    

Creating models for OPNsense is divided into two separate blocks:

OPNsense 模型的創建分為兩個獨立的部分：

1.  A PHP class describing the actions on our data (also acts as a wrapper to our data),  
    PHP類描述了對我們資料的操作（也充當我們資料的包裝器），
    
2.  The definition of the data and the rules it should apply to.  
    資料的定義及其適用的規則。
    

Every model’s class should be derived from OPNsense\\Base\\BaseModel, a very simple model without any (additional) logic is defined with:

每個模型的類別都應該派生自 OPNsense\\Base\\BaseModel，這是一個非常簡單的模型，沒有任何（額外的）邏輯，定義如下：

```php
<?php
namespace myVendorName\myModule;

use OPNsense\Base\BaseModel;

class myModel extends BaseModel
{
}
```

This class should be placed inside the model directory of our project, in this case the full path for our class file would be

這個類別應該放在我們專案的模型目錄中，在這種情況下，類別檔案的完整路徑是：

-   /usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/**myVendorName/myModule/myModel.php**
    

When you design a model, the next thing to do is to figure out what data is relevant for your application or module and think of the rules it should comply to (for example, if you need an email address you might want to validate the input). Designing the actual model is as simple as creating an xml file and putting in your structure, the name of our XML file should be the same as the base name of our model suffixed by .xml.

設計模型時，下一步是確定哪些資料與你的應用程式或模組相關，並考慮它應該遵循的規則（例如，如果你需要電子郵件地址，你可能需要驗證輸入）。設計實際的模型非常簡單，只需建立一個 XML 檔案並將你的結構放入其中即可。我們的XML檔案的名稱應該與模型的基本名稱相同，並且加上 .xml 後綴。

Using the same model, we would create the following file:

使用相同的模型，我們將建立以下文件：

-   /usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/**myVendorName/myModule/myModel.xml**
    

And start describing our (information) model, like this:

然後開始描述我們的（資訊）模型，像這樣：

```xml
<model>
    <mount>//myManufacturer/myModule</mount>
    <description>A description of this model (metadata)</description>
    <version>1.0.0</version>
    <items>
        <exampleNumber type="TextField">
            <Mask>/^([0-9]){0,1}$/</Mask>
            <Default>5</Default>
            <ValidationMessage>you should input a number from 0 to 9</ValidationMessage>
        </exampleNumber>
        <contacts>
            <entity type="ArrayField">
                <email type="EmailField">
                    <ValidationMessage>you should input a valid email address!</ValidationMessage>
                </email>
                <name type="TextField"/>
            </entity>
            <someText type="TextField"/>
        </contacts>
    </items>
</model>
```

Now let’s explain what’s happing here one tag at a time.

現在讓我們逐一標籤地解釋一下這裡發生了什麼。

1.  the <model> tag is used for identification of the file. (this is a model file)  
    <model>標籤用於識別文件。 （這是一個模型檔）
    
2.  Next in line is the <mount> tag, this tells the system where this information lives in the configuration file, in this case ROOT\_tag/myManufacturer/myModule  
    接下來是<mount>標籤，它告訴系統此資訊在設定檔中的位置，在本例中ROOT \_tag/myManufacturer/myModule
    
3.  If desired, there is some space reserved to explain the usage of the model, the <description> tag  
    如果需要，可以預留一些空間來解釋模型的用法，即<description>標籤。
    
4.  A version tag is added, which is used to support migrations. These are described in more details in the [migration](#p-257) topic  
    新增了一個版本標籤，用於支援遷移。這些內容在 [migration](#p-257)主題中有更詳細的描述。
    
5.  Last item on the top of our list is the <items> tag, this is where the magic begins.  
    清單頂部的最後一項是<items>標籤，神奇之處就在這裡。
    

The content of a items tag describes the full tree based structure which holds our data, in theory this could be as large as you want it to be, but keep in mind that the content for your model should be logical and understandable. Every node in the tree could have a type, which defines its behavior, nodes without a type are just containers.

items 標籤的內容描述了包含我們資料的完整樹狀結構。理論上，這個結構可以根據需要任意大小，但請記住，模型的內容應該是邏輯清晰、易於理解。樹中的每個節點都可以有一個類型，用於定義其行為；沒有類型的節點只是容器。

From top to bottom we find the following nodes in our tree:

從上到下，我們在樹中找到了以下節點：

-   exampleNumber, defined as a TextField  
    exampleNumber，定義為 TextField
    
    -   Mask, validation can be performed by a regex expression, this sets the expression  
        掩碼驗證可以透過正規表示式執行，這將設定表達式
        
    -   Default, this field is default filled with a number: 5  
        預設情況下，此欄位填入的數字為：5
        
    -   ValidationMessage, when validation fails, this message is returned  
        驗證失敗時，將傳回 ValidationMessage 訊息。
        
-   contacts, this is a container  
    聯絡人，這是一個容器
    
-   entity, is defined as a recurring item, which holds the next items  
    實體被定義為一個循環項，它包含下一個項。
    
-   email, defined as an EmailField  
    電子郵件，定義為 EmailField
    
    -   when validation fails, the **ValidationMessage** is returned  
        驗證失敗時，將傳回 **ValidationMessage**。
        
-   name, defined as a TextField without any validations  
    名稱，定義為一個沒有任何驗證的文字字段
    
-   someText, not part of the entity tag and also defined as text without validation  
    someText，它不是實體標籤的一部分，也被定義為未經驗證的文本
    

The fieldtypes are easily extendable in the base system and all common ones live in their own namespace at *OPNsense\\Base\\FieldTypes* deriving from *BaseField*.

基本系統中的欄位類型很容易擴展，所有常見的欄位類型都位於自己的命名空間 *OPNsense\\Base\\FieldTypes* 中，該命名空間衍生自 *BaseField*。

Note

筆記

When designing application specific fieldtypes, you can point to a field type within the application namespace using a full or partial path.

在設計應用程式特定的欄位類型時，可以使用完整路徑或部分路徑指向應用程式命名空間中的欄位類型。

For example using *Vendor\\Component\\FieldTypes\\MyFieldType* to point to a specific non common field type or *.\\MyFieldType* when linked from the application model itself (which assumes a namespace FieldTypes exists)

例如，可以使用 *Vendor\\Component\\FieldTypes\\MyFieldType* 指向特定的非通用欄位類型，或在從應用程式模型本身連結時使用 *.\\MyFieldType*（假設存在命名空間 FieldTypes）。

###### [volatile fields](#p-252)｜[易失性場](#p-252)

In some cases it can be practical to define fields which act as standard fields, but will not be persisted in the configuration. Examples of this are fields used to generate other type of content, such as a certificate or fields that reflect data stored elsewhere.

在某些情況下，定義一些功能類似於標準欄位但不會被持久化到配置中的欄位會很實用。例如，用於產生其他類型內容（如憑證）的字段，或反映儲存在其他位置的資料的字段。

To make a field volatile, just add the tag `volatile="true"` in the xml clause, for example:

若要將字段設為易失性字段，只需在 XML 子句中新增標籤`volatile="true"` ，例如：

```xml
<serial type="IntegerField" volatile="true"/>
```

###### [Special model types](#p-252)｜[特殊型號](#p-252)

###### [In memory models](#p-252)｜[記憶體模型](#p-252)

In same cases it might be practical to use all of the standard model tools, but prevent data from being persisted. For this purpose the memory model may be used. Examples of such applications are diagnostic tools, which do require user input, but is only relevant for that particular call.

在某些情況下，使用所有標準模型工具可能很實用，但需要阻止資料持久化。為此，可以使用記憶體模型。診斷工具就是此類應用的典型例子，它們確實需要使用者輸入，但這些輸入僅與特定呼叫相關。

To use these models, use the following mountpoint: `<mount>:memory:</mount>`

若要使用這些模型，請使用以下掛載點： `<mount>:memory:</mount>`

###### [Legacy wrappers](#p-252)｜[舊版封裝器](#p-252)

While migrating legacy components, sometimes the distance between the current situation (using raw xml access) and the desired one (being a fully validated model) is hard to overcome. It’s not always clear which type of data is being used, and when moving data inside a new model and changing it’s access path, a proper validation is mandatory.

在遷移遺留元件時，有時很難彌合當前狀態（使用原始 XML 存取）與理想狀態（完全驗證的模型）之間的差距。有時很難明確所使用的資料類型，而且當在新模型中移動資料並更改其存取路徑時，必須進行適當的驗證。

When data lives inside it’s own easy to distinct “container”, a standard model may be overlaid. An example of such a case is the static route component. Which underneath looks like this (without payload):

當資料儲存在易於區分的“容器”中時，可以應用標準模型。靜態路由組件就是一個例子。其底層結構如下（不含有效負載）：

```xml
<staticroutes>
   <route/>
   <route/>
</staticroutes>
```

The other case is when a collection of items does not live inside a unique container, for example the following payload:

另一種情況是，當一組項目不位於唯一的容器中時，例如以下有效負載：

```xml
<cert/>
<cert/>
<cert/>
```

Legacy modules would iterate over `$config['cert']` in this case. Since `cert` does not have an upper container the model is able to control in full (as it’s the root of the `config.xml`), we can not overlay a standard model to specify the fields used and their constraints.

在這種情況下，舊版模組會遍歷`$config['cert']` 。由於`cert`沒有模型能夠完全控制的上層容器（因為它是`config.xml`的根），因此我們無法覆蓋標準模型來指定使用的字段及其約束。

This is where our legacy wrapper comes into play. In order to use this feature, you have to use the following mountpoint format:

這時就需要用到我們原有的封裝庫了。若要使用此功能，您必須使用下列掛載點格式：

> `/tag+` << start with an exact path \[`/`\] and end with a plus \[`+`\]
>
> `/tag+` << 以精確路徑開始 \[ `/` \] 並以加號結束 \[ `+` \]

In the “cert” example our mountpoint would like like : `<mount>/cert+</mount>`

在「cert」範例中，我們的掛載點類似： `<mount>/cert+</mount>`

Note

筆記

All used fields still need to be specified, fields left out of the model, will be removed from the configuration in the same way a regular model would act.

所有使用的欄位仍然需要指定，模型中未包含的欄位將以與常規模型相同的方式從配置中刪除。

Note

筆記

As legacy wrappers can not be versioned, migrations do not apply. In the long run it’s always better to use full models, but these constructions offer an option for a “softer landing”.

由於舊版封裝器無法進行版本控制，因此遷移並不適用。從長遠來看，使用完整模型始終是更好的選擇，但這些構造提供了一種「更平滑的過渡」方案。

When target fields contain structures, it is possible to apply an inline conversion using custom (app specific) field types. This pattern is likely best explained with an example.

當目標欄位包含結構時，可以使用自訂（套用特定）欄位類型進行內聯轉換。這種模式最好透過範例來解釋。

Below an example implementation which unpacks multiple `<priv>` tags per user object and converts them to a comma separated lists.

下面是一個範例實現，它將每個使用者物件的多個`<priv>`標籤解包並轉換為逗號分隔的清單。

The first block `actionPostLoadingEvent()` just collects the available options, which is part of the `BaseListField` type. The `setValue()` is where the magic happens, when the input is of type `SimpleXMLElement`, we know this is being set by the loader, if in that case the underlying config contains multiple values, we merge them into a single list.

第一個區塊`actionPostLoadingEvent()`僅收集可用選項，它是`BaseListField`類型的一部分。 `setValue()` 是神奇發生的地方，當輸入是 `SimpleXMLElement` 類型時，我們知道這是由載入器設定的，如果在這種情況下底層配置包含多個值，我們將它們合併到一個清單中。

```php
class PrivField extends BaseListField
{
   protected $internalIsContainer = false;
   private static $priv_list = null;

   protected function actionPostLoadingEvent()
   {
      if (self::$priv_list === null) {
            self::$priv_list = [];
            foreach ((new \OPNsense\Core\ACL())->getPrivList() as $aclKey => $priv) {
               self::$priv_list[$aclKey] = $priv['name'];
            }

      }
      $this->internalOptionList = self::$priv_list;
   }

   /**
   * {@inheritdoc}
   */
   public function setValue($value)
   {
      if (is_a($value, 'SimpleXMLElement') && $value->count() > 1) {
            return parent::setValue(implode(',', (array)$value));
      } else {
            return parent::setValue($value);
      }
   }
}
```

###### [Cached data](#p-252)｜[快取資料](#p-252)

In some cases access to model data requires too much handling for the time the user is willing to wait, in these cases it is possible to serve cached data to the user of the model.

在某些情況下，存取模型資料需要處理的時間過長，使用者可能不願意等待。在這種情況下，可以向模型使用者提供快取資料。

For this purpose, each model node in the config contains a `persisted_at` field with the most recent update time, in which case a static function `getCachedData()` can be used to fetch the data. This quickly checks if an object was changed (via an xpath expression) returning the data of the model in an array structure.

為此，配置中的每個模型節點都包含一個`persisted_at`字段，其中包含最近更新時間。在這種情況下，可以使用靜態函數`getCachedData()`來取得資料。此函數可以快速檢查物件是否已更改（透過 XPath 表達式），並以數組結構傳回模型資料。

Note

筆記

Although the cache will contain programmaticly generated rows using `getStaticChildren()` in `ArrayField`, it can’t automatically figure out if this content has changed.

儘管快取將包含使用`getStaticChildren()`在`ArrayField`中以程式設計方式產生的行，但它無法自動確定此內容是否已更改。

In cases you need to ensure these records are updated as well, you do need to call `flushCacheData()` on the static model. (e.g. `OPNsenseFirewallAlias::flushCacheData()`)

如果您需要確保這些記錄也更新，則需要對靜態模型呼叫`flushCacheData()` 。 （例如`OPNsenseFirewallAlias::flushCacheData()` ）

---

<a id="p-253"></a>

##### Usage example｜使用範例

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/models_example.html>

Now let’s test our model using a small PHP script (in /usr/local/opnsense/mvc/script/ ):

現在讓我們使用一個簡單的PHP腳本（位於/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/script/）來測試我們的模型：

```php
<?php
// initialize phalcon components for our script
require_once("load_phalcon.php");

// include myModel and the shared config component
use myVendorName\myModule\myModel;
use OPNsense\Core\Config;

// create a new model, reading the model definition and the current data from our config.xml
$myMdl = new myModel();
$myMdl->exampleNumber =1;
$myMdl->contacts->someText = "just a test";

// add a new contact node
$node = $myMdl->contacts->entity->add();
$node->email = "test@test.com";
$node->name = "my test user";

// perform validation on the data in our model
$validationMessages = $myMdl->performValidation();
foreach ($validationMessages as  $messsage) {
    echo "validation failure on field ". $messsage->getField()."  returning message : ". $messsage->getMessage()."\n";
}

// if validation succeeded, write data back to config
if ($validationMessages->count() == 0) {
    // serialize our model to the config file (config.xml)
    // (this raises an error on validation failures)
    $myMdl->serializeToConfig();
    $cnf = Config::getInstance();
    $cnf->save();
}
```

If you fill in an invalid value to one of the validated fields, you can easily try the validation. Try to input the text “X” into the field exampleNumber to try out.

如果您在某個已驗證的欄位中填寫了無效值，您可以輕鬆地測試驗證結果。例如，您可以嘗試在 exampleNumber 欄位中輸入文字“X”來進行測試。

When inspecting our config.xml file, you will notice the following content has been added to the root:

檢查 config.xml 檔案時，您會注意到根目錄下方新增了以下內容：

```xml
<myManufacturer>
  <myModule>
    <exampleNumber>1</exampleNumber>
    <contacts>
      <entity>
        <email>test@test.com</email>
        <name>my test user</name>
      </entity>
      <someText>just a test</someText>
    </contacts>
  </myModule>
</myManufacturer>
```

---

<a id="p-254"></a>

##### Guidelines｜指南

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/models_guidelines.html>

Some (simple) guidelines developing models

一些（簡單的）模型開發指南

1.  One model should always be completely responsible for the its mount point, so if there’s a model at mount point /A/B there can’t be a model at /A/B/C  
    一個模型應該始終完全負責其掛載點，因此如果掛載點 /A/B 上有一個模型，則掛載點 /A/B/C 上就不能再有模型。
    
2.  Try to keep models logical and understandable, it’s better to build two models for you application if the content of two parts aren’t related to each other. It’s no issue to create models at deeper levels of the structure.  
    盡量保持模型邏輯清晰、易於理解。如果應用程式的兩個部分內容彼此無關，最好建立兩個模型。在更深層的結構中創建模型也沒有問題。
    
    1.  When using more models in a application/module, you might want to consider the following naming convention: /Vendor/Module/Model  
        當在應用程式/模組中使用多個模型時，您可能需要考慮以下命名約定：/供應商/模組/模型
        
3.  Try to avoid more disc i/o actions than necessary, only call save() if you actually want to save content, serializeToConfig just keeps the data in memory.  
    盡量避免不必要的磁碟 I/O 操作，只有在真正想要保存內容時才呼叫 save()，serializeToConfig 只是將資料保存在記憶體中。

---

<a id="p-255"></a>

##### Custom (app specific) field types｜自訂（應用特定）欄位類型

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/models_customfields.html>

Applications can add their own custom field types, which should be derived from `BaseField` or one of its descendants. A very simple single item custom field type could look like this:

應用程式可以新增自訂欄位類型，這些欄位類型應派生自`BaseField`或其子類型之一。一個非常簡單的單項自訂欄位類型可能如下所示：

###### Build the field type｜建置字段類型

```php
<?php
namespace myVendorName\myModule;
use OPNsense\Base\FieldTypes\BaseField;
use OPNsense\Base\Validators\Regex;

class SimpleCustomField extends BaseField
{
    protected $internalIsContainer = false;
    protected $internalValidationMessage = "standard error";
    public function getValidators()
    {
        $validators = parent::getValidators();
        $reservedwords = array('all', 'pass', 'block', 'out');
        $validators[] = new ExclusionIn(array(
            'message' => 'can not use a reserved word',
            'domain' => $reservedwords));
    }
    return $validators;
}
```

This example extends the standard validations with a list of reserved words, in which case it would yield `can not use a reserved word` if one of the reserved words are provided.

此範例透過保留字列表擴展了標準驗證，在這種情況下，如果提供了其中一個保留字，則會產生`can not use a reserved word` 。

Note

筆記

This file should be placed in the subdirectory `FieldTypes` of the model itself.

該檔案應放置在模型本身的子目錄`FieldTypes`中。

Tip

提示

Use `BaseListField` as simple template for list type items.

使用`BaseListField`作為清單類型項目的簡單範本。

###### Use in model｜模型中的使用

The validation can be used as any standard type, when prefixed with `.` the model knows it concerns a local field.

驗證可以像任何標準類型一樣使用，當以`.`為前綴時，模型就知道它與本地字段有關。

```xml
<model>
    <mount>//OPNsense/MyFirst/App</mount>
    <version>1.0.0</version>
    <description>
        My first application
    </description>
    <items>
        <general>
            <name type=".\SimpleCustomField">
                <Required>Y</Required>
            </name>
        </general>
    </items>
</model>
```

Tip

提示

Inspect the [basic field](https://github.com/opnsense/core/tree/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Base/FieldTypes) types for inspiration, a concrete example of a custom field type can be found in the [firewall](https://github.com/opnsense/core/tree/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Firewall) section

可以參考 [基本欄位](https://github.com/opnsense/core/tree/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Base/FieldTypes)類型取得靈感，自訂欄位類型的具體範例可以在 [防火牆](https://github.com/opnsense/core/tree/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Firewall)部分找到。

---

<a id="p-256"></a>

##### Adding constraints｜新增約束

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/models_constraints.html>

Constraints can be used on top of type validations provided by the base fields described in the previous chapter. The base class BaseConstraint is used as base type and contains shared functionality.

約束可以與上一章描述的基本欄位提供的類型驗證結合使用。基底類別 BaseConstraint 用作基本類型，並包含共享功能。

Since fields are usually only validated when there’s change detected, it’s usually necessary to add back references to chain validations.

由於欄位通常只在偵測到變更時才進行驗證，因此通常需要新增參考以進行鍊式驗證。

###### DependConstraint｜依賴約束

When choices depend on each other, you can use the DependConstraint type. The following example makes sslurlonly depend on the sslbump option, since the <reference> tag is needed to make sure when one of the settings changes, the other is validated again too.

當選項之間存在依賴關係時，可以使用 DependConstraint 類型。以下範例使 sslurlonly 僅依賴 sslbump 選項，因為需要使用<reference>標籤來確保當其中一個設定變更時，另一個設定也會重新驗證。

```xml
<sslbump type="BooleanField">
    <Constraints>
        <check001>
            <type>DependConstraint</type>
            <addFields>
                <field1>sslurlonly</field1>
            </addFields>
        </check001>
    </Constraints>
</sslbump>
<sslurlonly type="BooleanField">
    <Constraints>
        <check001>
            <reference>sslbump.check001</reference>
        </check001>
    </Constraints>
</sslurlonly>
```

###### AllOrNoneConstraint｜全或無約束

Make sure that options are only valid when selected in combination.

請確保只有組合選擇這些選項時才有效。

###### SingleSelectConstraint｜單選約束

When options are not valid in combination, you can hook options together so only one of the options can be selected at the same time.

當選項不能組合使用時，您可以將選項連接起來，以便一次只能選擇一個選項。

###### UniqueConstraint｜唯一約束

This constraint helps to make sure all items within an ArrayField are unique, such as the following example which makes sure all “filenames” in this set are unique.

此限制有助於確保 ArrayField 中的所有項目都是唯一的，例如以下範例確保此集合中的所有「檔案名稱」都是唯一的。

```xml
<filename type="TextField">
    <Constraints>
        <check001>
            <type>UniqueConstraint</type>
        </check001>
    </Constraints>
</filename>
```

###### ComparedToFieldConstraint｜與字段約束相比

The ComparedToFieldConstraint compares the value of the current field to the value of a referenced field on the same level (for example in the same ArrayField). It is for example used for the [rspamd](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/mail/rspamd/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Rspamd/RSpamd.xml) plugin, to ensure that some values are in the correct order. This constraint can be used to compare numeric values.

ComparedToFieldConstraint 將目前欄位的值與相同層級（例如，同一個 ArrayField 中）的參考欄位的值進行比較。例如，它用於 [rspamd](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/mail/rspamd/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Rspamd/RSpamd.xml)插件，以確保某些值的順序正確。此約束可用於比較數值。

Example:

例子：

```xml
<check003>
  <ValidationMessage>This field must be bigger than the greylist score.</ValidationMessage>
  <type>ComparedToFieldConstraint</type>
  <field>greylistscore</field>
  <operator>gt</operator>
</check003>
```

In this example, the valueof the current field must be greater than the value of the field “greylistscore”.

在這個範例中，目前欄位的值必須大於欄位「greylistscore」的值。

Field values:

欄位值：

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| ValidationMessage<br>驗證訊息 | Validation message (translateable) which will be shown in case the validation fails.<br>驗證失敗時將顯示的驗證訊息（可翻譯）。 |
| type<br>類型 | ComparedToFieldConstraint<br>與字段約束比較 |
| field<br>字段 | the other field which we reference<br>我們引用的另一個字段 |
| operator<br>運算子 | The operator to check the value. Valid operators are gt, gte, lt, lte, eq, neq<br>用於檢查值的運算子。有效運算子包括 gt、gte、lt、lte、eq、neq |

Operators:

操作員：

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| gt | greater than<br>大於 |
| gte | greater than or equal<br>大於或等於 |
| lt | lesser than<br>小於 |
| lte | lesser than or equal<br>小於或等於 |
| eq | equal<br>相等 |
| neq | not equal<br>不等於 |

###### SetIfConstraint｜設定If約束

The SetIfConstraint is used to make some fields conditionally mandatory. It is mainly used in the [nginx](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/www/nginx/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Nginx/Nginx.xml) plugin for example to choose an implementation type. In general the other field should be an OptionField, but does not need to. In general it is a good idea to hide or show fields which are (not) required by an implementation in the frontend as well to simplify the web interface. Please note: the checked field is intended to be on the same level (for example ArrayField).

SetIfConstraint 用於使某些欄位在特定條件下成為必填項。它主要用於 [nginx](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/blob/master/www/nginx/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Nginx/Nginx.xml)插件，例如用於選擇實作類型。通常，另一個欄位應該是 OptionField，但並非必須如此。一般來說，為了簡化 Web 介面，最好在前端也隱藏或顯示實作中（非）必需的欄位。請注意：選取的欄位應與另一個欄位處於相同層級（例如 ArrayField）。

Example:

例子：

```xml
<check001>
  <ValidationMessage>This field must be set.</ValidationMessage>
  <type>SetIfConstraint</type>
  <field>match_type</field>
  <check>id</check>
</check001>
```

In this example, the value will be mandatory, if the field “match\_type” has the value “id”.

在這個範例中，如果欄位“match\_type”的值為“id”，則該值將是必填項。

Field Values:

欄位值：

|   |   |
| --- | --- |
| ValidationMessage<br>驗證訊息 | Validation message (translateable) which will be shown in case the validation fails.<br>驗證失敗時將顯示的驗證訊息（可翻譯）。 |
| type<br>類型 | SetIfConstraint<br>設定條件約束 |
| field<br>字段 | the other field which we reference<br>我們引用的另一個字段 |
| check<br>檢查 | The value of the other field which makes this field required<br>另一個欄位的值使得此欄位為必填項 |

---

<a id="p-257"></a>

##### Migrations｜遷徙

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/models_migrations.html>

When using the `<version/>` tag in the model xml you automatically allow upgrades of your configuration data. If the tag is missing, it will automatically assume your at version `0.0.0` (initial version).

在模型 XML 中使用`<version/>`標籤時，會自動允許升級配置資料。如果缺少該標籤，則會自動假定目前版本為`0.0.0` （初始版本）。

The migration feature provides a pluggable framework to offer new and changed attributes after installation of new software and is therefore automatically triggered when performing upgrades or installing packages.

遷移功能提供了一個可插拔的框架，以便在安裝新軟體後提供新的和變更的屬性，因此在執行升級或安裝軟體包時會自動觸發。

Tip

提示

You can always trigger migrations manually by executing `/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/script/run_migrations.php` from a console. This will output all installed modules and the upgrades performed.

您始終可以透過在控制台中執行`/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/script/run_migrations.php`來手動觸發遷移。這將輸出所有已安裝的模組和已執行的升級。

If no overrides are provided and the module version of the running configuration doesn’t equal the one installed, there automatically will be a migration created using the `BaseModelMigration` base class. This will take care of basic changes, such as adding new fields and applying defaults.

如果未提供任何覆蓋設置，且運行配置的模組版本與已安裝的模組版本不一致，則會自動使用`BaseModelMigration`基類別建立遷移。這將處理一些基本更改，例如添加新欄位和應用預設值。

Note

筆記

The current version will always be saved as an attribute on the model xml (e.g. `<Alias version="1.0.0">`)

當前版本將始終保存為模型 XML 中的一個屬性（例如`<Alias version="1.0.0">` ）。

###### Custom migrations｜自訂遷移

In some cases one wants to perform custom actions when upgrading between version, such as gathering data from legacy configuration settings.

在某些情況下，升級版本時需要執行自訂操作，例如從舊組態設定中收集資料。

The directory `Migrations` in the model directory is used to hold the migration code on a per version basis. By default classes (and files) in there use the following naming scheme: `M1_0_0` which stands for \[M\]igration version \[1.0.0\].

模型目錄中的`Migrations`目錄用於存放每個版本的遷移程式碼。預設情況下，其中的類別（和檔案）使用以下命名方案： `M1_0_0` ，表示 \[M\]遷移版本 \[ 1.0.0 \]。

Note

筆記

If different models share a namespace, you can change the prefix of the migration files, when nothing is provided the default is **M**, the tag `<migration_prefix/>` can be used to change this to something else. (e.g. `<migration_prefix>MFP</migration_prefix>`)

如果不同的模型共用同一個命名空間，您可以變更遷移檔案的前綴。如果未提供任何前綴，則預設值為 **M**，可以使用標籤`<migration_prefix/>`將其變更為其他值（例如`<migration_prefix>MFP</migration_prefix>` ）。

The boilerplate for a model migration looks like this (for a migration to 1.0.0):

模型遷移的樣板程式碼如下所示（以遷移到1.0.0為例）：

```php
class M1_0_0 extends BaseModelMigration
{
    /**
     * default model migration
     * @param $model
     */
    public function run($model)
    {
        parent::run($model);
    }

    /**
     * post migration action, run after config sync
     * @param $model
     */
    public function post($model)
    {
        return;
    }
}
```

It contains two methods, `run()` and `post()`. The first one is executed in memory, before serializing data back to the running configuration and for all version steps in sequence. (an upgrade from 1.0.0 to 1.0.2 might execute 1.0.1, 1.0.2, 1.0.3). The configuration data itself will be synced ones in this case.

它包含兩個方法， `run()`和`post()` 。第一個方法在記憶體中執行，之後將資料序列化回運行配置，並按順序對所有版本步驟執行。 （例如，從1.0.0升級到1.0.2可能會執行1.0.1, 1.0.2, 1.0.3 ）。在這種情況下，配置資料本身將進行同步。

Note

筆記

Except in special cases, a `run()` method should always contain a parent method call `parent::run($model);` to perform the basic migration function.

除了特殊情況外， `run()`方法應始終包含對`parent::run($model);`父方法的調用，以執行基本遷移功能。

The post action is called after normal model configuration and can sometimes be practical to alter the raw model xml, for example if model versions require a move of datasets, without actually changing content.

在正常的模型配置之後呼叫 post 操作，有時可以方便地更改原始模型 xml，例如，如果模型版本需要移動資料集，而無需實際更改內容。

Note

筆記

Although there are toggles in place, data migration can easily lead to race conditions. Always try to design your software for change, adding fields which pass validation by default for example is always preferred above situations which will fail by default.

儘管設定了切換開關，但資料遷移很容易導致競態條件。始終要確保軟體設計能夠適應變化，例如，添加預設情況下通過驗證的欄位總是比預設會失敗的欄位更可取。

---

<a id="p-258"></a>

#### Creating Models Field types｜建立模型欄位類型

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/models_fieldtypes.html>

##### Creating Models / Field types｜建立模型/欄位類型

OPNsense comes with a collection of standard field types, which can be used to perform standard field type validations. These field types can be found in [/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Base/FieldTypes/](https://github.com/opnsense/core/tree/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Base/FieldTypes) and usually decent from the BaseField type.

OPNsense 提供了一系列標準欄位類型，可用於執行標準欄位類型驗證。這些欄位類型位於 [/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Base/FieldTypes/](https://github.com/opnsense/core/tree/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Base/FieldTypes)中，通常與 BaseField 類型類似。

This paragraph aims to provide an overview of the types included by default and their use.

本段旨在概述預設包含的類型及其用途。

Tip

提示

When using lists, the `Multiple` (Y/N) keyword defines if there may be more than one item selected at a time.

使用清單時， `Multiple` (Y/N) 關鍵字定義是否可以一次選擇多個項目。

Tip

提示

The xml keyword `Required` can be used to mark a field as being required.

可以使用 xml 關鍵字`Required`將欄位標記為必填項。

##### ArrayField

The basic field type to describe a container of objects, such as a list of addresses.

用於描述物件容器（例如位址清單）的基本欄位類型。

Note

筆記

This type can’t be nested, only one level of ArrayField types is supported, you can use ModelRelationField to describe master-detail constructions.

這種類型不能嵌套，只支援一層 ArrayField 類型，可以使用 ModelRelationField 來描述主從結構。

Tip

提示

In case a model needs static (non persistent) records, the `getStaticChildren()` method may be implemented to spawn static entries. See also the custom field chapter for implementation scenarios.

如果模型需要靜態（非持久化）記錄，可以使用`getStaticChildren()`方法產生靜態條目。有關實作方案，請參閱自訂欄位章節。

##### AuthGroupField

Returns and validates system (user) groups (found in System ‣ Access ‣ Groups)

返回並驗證系統（使用者）群組（位於「系統」‣「存取」‣「群組」中）

*AuthGroupField*

| Parameter<br>參數 | Options<br>選項 | Purpose<br>用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default<br>預設值 | `text` | Default value for new attributes<br>新屬性的預設值 |
| Required<br>必填 | Y,N | Mark field as required<br>將此欄位標記為必填項 |
| ValidationMessage<br>驗證訊息 | `text` | Error message on validation failure<br>驗證失敗時的錯誤訊息 |
| BlankDesc | `text` | Set a label for the empty option<br>為空白選項設定標籤 |
| Multiple<br>多重選擇 | Y,N<br>是/否 | Allow to select multiple options<br>允許選擇多個選項 |

##### AuthenticationServerField｜身份驗證伺服器字段

Select and validate authentication providers, maintained in System ‣ Access ‣ Servers.

選擇並驗證身份驗證提供程序，該提供程序在“系統”‣“訪問”‣“伺服器”中維護。

*AuthenticationServerField*

| Parameter<br>參數 | Options<br>選項 | Purpose<br>用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default<br>預設值 | `text` | Default value for new attributes<br>新屬性的預設值 |
| Required<br>必填 | Y,N | Mark field as required<br>將此欄位標記為必填項 |
| ValidationMessage<br>驗證訊息 | `text` | Error message on validation failure<br>驗證失敗時的錯誤訊息 |
| BlankDesc | `text` | Set a label for the empty option<br>為空白選項設定標籤 |
| Multiple<br>多重選擇 | Y,N<br>是/否 | Allow to select multiple options<br>允許選擇多個選項 |
| Filters<br>篩選條件 | Y,N | A structure of regex filters per attribute to exclude certain options from the list<br>每個屬性使用正規表示式篩選器，從清單中排除某些選項 |

##### AutoNumberField｜自動編號字段

An integer sequence, which automatically increments on every new item of the same type in the same level.

一個整數序列，在同一層級中，每當出現一個相同類型的新項目時，該序列都會自動遞增。

*AutoNumberField*

*自動編號欄位*

| Parameter<br>參數 | Options<br>選項 | Purpose<br>用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default<br>預設值 | `text` | Default value for new attributes<br>新屬性的預設值 |
| Required<br>必填 | Y,N | Mark field as required<br>將此欄位標記為必填項 |
| ValidationMessage<br>驗證訊息 | `text` | Error message on validation failure<br>驗證失敗時的錯誤訊息 |
| MinimumValue<br>最小值 | `int` | Minimum number also starting point of the sequence<br>最小值，也是序列的起始點 |
| MaximumValue<br>最大值 | `int` | Maximum number<br>最大值 |

##### Base64Field｜Base64字段

Validate if a given string contains a valid base64 decodable value.

驗證給定的字串是否包含有效的 base64 可解碼值。

*Base64Field*

*Base64字段*

| Parameter<br>參數 | Options<br>選項 | Purpose<br>用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default<br>預設值 | `text` | Default value for new attributes<br>新屬性的預設值 |
| Required<br>必填 | Y,N | Mark field as required<br>將此欄位標記為必填項 |
| ValidationMessage<br>驗證訊息 | `text` | Error message on validation failure<br>驗證失敗時的錯誤訊息 |
| Mask<br>遮罩 | `regex` | Optional validation regex<br>可選驗證正規表示式 |

##### BooleanField｜布林域

Boolean field, where 0 means `false` and 1 is defined as `true`

布爾域，其中 0 表示`false` ，1 定義為`true`

*BooleanField*

*布林字段*

| Parameter<br>參數 | Options<br>選項 | Purpose<br>用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |

##### JsonKeyValueStoreField

A construct to validate against a json dataset retrieved via configd, such as

```xml
<program type="JsonKeyValueStoreField">
  <ConfigdPopulateAct>syslog list applications</ConfigdPopulateAct>
  <SourceFile>/tmp/syslog_applications.json</SourceFile>
  <ConfigdPopulateTTL>20</ConfigdPopulateTTL>
  <SortByValue>Y</SortByValue>
</program>
```

In which case `syslog list applications` is called to retrieved options, which is valid for 20 seconds (TTL) before fetching again.

##### LegacyLinkField｜遺產連結字段

Read-only pointer to legacy config data, reads (single) property from the legacy configuration and returns its content when it exists (`null` if xml item doesn’t exist).

指向舊版配置資料的唯讀指針，從舊版配置中讀取（單一）屬性，並在其存在時返回其內容（ `null`如果 xml 項不存在）。

The following example would read the enabled property from the config xml, which resides in `<ipsec><enabled>1</enabled></ipsec>`

以下範例將從位於`<ipsec><enabled>1</enabled></ipsec>`配置 XML 檔案中讀取 enabled 屬性。

```xml
<enabled type="LegacyLinkField">
    <Source>ipsec.enable</Source>
</enabled>
```

Note

筆記

Values stored into this fieldtype will be discarded without further notice, which practically means the target structure will always contain an empty field as long as its used as a pointer. When functionality migrates to mvc, you can switch the type and supply migration code to load the initial values.

儲存在此欄位類型的值將被丟棄，且不會另行通知。實際上，只要目標結構用作指針，它就會始終包含一個空白字段。當功能遷移到 MVC 時，您可以切換欄位類型並提供遷移代碼來載入初始值。

##### ModelRelationField｜模型關係字段

Define relations to other nodes in the model, such as to point the attribute `pipe` to a `pipe` node in the TrafficShaper model.

定義與模型中其他節點的關係，例如將屬性`pipe`指向TrafficShaper模型中的`pipe`節點。

```xml
<pipe type="ModelRelationField">
    <Model>
        <pipes>
            <source>OPNsense.TrafficShaper.TrafficShaper</source>
            <items>pipes.pipe</items>
            <display>description</display>
        </pipes>
    </Model>
</pipe>
```

To display multiple fields, the `display_format` is required.

要顯示多個字段，需要使用`display_format` 。

```xml
<pipe type="ModelRelationField">
    <Model>
        <pipes>
            <source>OPNsense.TrafficShaper.TrafficShaper</source>
            <items>pipes.pipe</items>
            <display>number,description</display>
            <display_format>%s - %s</display_format>
        </pipes>
    </Model>
</pipe>
```

| Required<br>必填 | Y,N | Mark field as required<br>將此欄位標記為必填項 |
| ValidationMessage<br>驗證訊息 | `text` | Error message on validation failure<br>驗證失敗時的錯誤訊息 |
| MinimumValue<br>最低值 | `int` | Minimum number<br>最小數量 |
| MaximumValue<br>最大值 | `int` | Maximum number<br>最大值 |

##### OptionField｜選項字段

Validate against a static list of options.

根據靜態選項清單進行驗證。

*OptionField*

*選項欄位*

| Parameter<br>參數 | Options<br>選項 | Purpose<br>用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default<br>預設值 | `text` | Default value for new attributes<br>新屬性的預設值 |
| Required<br>必填 | Y,N | Mark field as required<br>將此欄位標記為必填項 |
| ValidationMessage<br>驗證訊息 | `text` | Error message on validation failure<br>驗證失敗時的錯誤訊息 |
| BlankDesc | `text` | Set a label for the empty option<br>為空白選項設定標籤 |
| Multiple<br>多重選擇 | Y,N<br>是/否 | Allow to select multiple options<br>允許選擇多個選項 |
| OptionValues | `xml` | Xml structure containing keys and values, when keys should be numeric, the value tag is also supported `<opt1 value='1'>option1</opt1>`<br>包含鍵與值的 XML 結構，當鍵為數字時，也支援值標籤`<opt1 value='1'>option1</opt1>` |

When the list of available options is relatively large, its also possible to nest the options one level, which generates `<optgroup>` clauses in our model. As of 24.1 they can be defined using the following structure:

當可用選項清單相對較大時，也可以將選項嵌套一層，這會在我們的模型中產生`<optgroup>`子句。從24.1開始，它們可以使用以下結構定義：

```xml
<field type="OptionField">
    <OptionValues>
        <opt1 value='option group 1'>
           <opt1 value='option1'>option 1</opt1>
        </opt1>
        <option_group2>
           <opt2>option 2</option2>
        </option_group2>
    </OptionValues>
</field>
```

##### PortField｜連接埠場

Check if the input contains a valid port number or (optionally) predefined service name. Can be a range when `EnableRanges` is set to `Y`.

檢查輸入是否包含有效的連接埠號碼或（可選）預先定義的服務名稱。當`EnableRanges`設定為`Y`時，它可以是一個範圍。

| ValidationMessage<br>驗證訊息 | `text` | Error message on validation failure<br>驗證失敗時的錯誤訊息 |

| EnableWellKnown | Y,N | Allow the usage of well known names such as ‘http’ and ‘ssh’<br>允許使用諸如“http”和“ssh”之類的常用名稱 |
| EnableRanges | Y,N | Allow the usage of ranges, such as `80:100`<br>允許使用範圍，例如`80:100` |

列出欄位類型，以驗證提供的值是否為 /etc/protocols 定義的有效協定名稱（例如TCP, UDP ），並擴展了`any`選項。

| ValidationMessage<br>驗證訊息 | `text` | Error message on validation failure<br>驗證失敗時的錯誤訊息 |
| BlankDesc | `text` | Set a label for the empty option<br>為空白選項設定標籤 |
| Multiple<br>多重選擇 | Y,N<br>是/否 | Allow to select multiple options<br>允許選擇多個選項 |

使用正規表示式驗證正規文字。

此欄位預設會停用文字中的某些特殊字元。

| AllowSpaces<br>允許空格 | Y,N | N | Allow spaces or tabs<br>允許空格或製表符 |

使用正規表示式驗證正規文字。

<a id="p-259"></a>

#### Routing｜路由

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/routing.html>

##### General｜一般的

To retain backward compatibility with legacy code, we try to keep the old pages at their original location. For the new code, we define two root folders in the url:

為了保持與舊程式碼的向後相容性，我們盡量將舊頁面保留在原來的位置。對於新程式碼，我們在 URL 中定義了兩個根資料夾：

-   /ui/ for the new user interface parts  
    /ui/ 用於新的使用者介面部分
    
-   /api/ used for webservices (REST)  
    /api/ 用於 Web 服務 ( REST )
    

This part of the routing is handled by lighthttpd using mod\_alias and mod\_rewrite.

路由的這一部分由 lighthttpd 使用 mod_alias 和 mod_rewrite 處理。

##### User interface Routing｜使用者介面路由

If you look at the controller directory in OPNsense, you will notice there are different directory levels under the root controller directory in /usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers. To support different apps and vendors eventually, we already used a structure which is automatically used to setup the routing.

如果您查看 OPNsense 中的控制器目錄，您會注意到 /usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers 根控制器目錄下存在不同的目錄層級。為了最終支援不同的應用程式和供應商，我們已經使用了自動配置路由的結構。

At the first level we use the vendor of the app, in our case that will always be OPNsense.

在第一層，我們使用應用程式的供應商，在我們的例子中，它始終是 OPNsense。

The next level is used to name the topic (or app), for example we use Sample for our example application.

下一級用於命名主題（或應用程式），例如，我們使用 Sample 來命名我們的範例應用程式。

Finally you may place your standard Phalcon classes for controllers in that directory, so if you want to create a page helloworld, that should come with a controller helloworldController.php (and a indexAction to define the index action for that page).

最後，您可以將標準的 Phalcon 控制器類別放在該目錄中，因此，如果您想要建立一個名為 helloworld 的頁面，則應該包含一個名為 helloworldController.php 的控制器（以及一個 indexAction 來定義該頁面的索引操作）。

The complete path of the helloworld page would eventually be:

helloworld 頁面的完整路徑最終將是：

```
/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/Sample/helloworldController.php
```

When publishing the page, the vendor part of the controller is not used in the mapping, so in this example the helloworld index page will be at:

發佈頁面時，控制器中的 vendor 部分不會用於映射，因此在本例中，helloworld 索引頁面將位於：

```
https://{url}/ui/sample/helloworld/
```

All the parts of the url are automatically converted to lower-case, so **S**ample will be mapped to **s**ample.

URL 的所有部分都會自動轉換為小寫，因此 **S**ample 將會對應到**s**ample。

This routing is setup via the index page of our new code base and uses `/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/config/services.php` to wire it all together.

此路由是透過我們新程式碼庫的索引頁面設定的，並使用`/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/config/services.php`將其全部連接起來。

##### API routing｜API路由

Routing for API functions is quite similar to routing UI components, just create a Api directory under the app path and place a controller class to handle the request. The only major difference is that it’s handled by a separate PHP file (called api.php) instead of the index.php file used to configure the ui part, details of the routing can be found in /usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/config/services\_api.php .

API函數的路由與UI元件的路由非常相似，只需在應用程式路徑下建立 API 目錄，並在其中放置一個控制器類別來處理請求即可。唯一的主要區別在於，它由一個單獨的PHP檔案（名為 api.php）處理，而不是由用於配置 UI 部分的 index.php 檔案處理。路由的詳細資訊可以在 /usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/config/services\_api.php 中找到。

If our sample app needs an API to echo something back via a controller called tools it could be put into a file called:

如果我們的範例應用程式需要一個API透過名為 tools 的控制器回顯某些內容，則可以將其放入一個名為以下的檔案中：

```
/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/Sample/Api/toolsController.api
```

And called via the following url:

並透過以下網址呼叫：

```
https://{host}}/api/sample/tools/echo
```

When the controller has a method called echoAction.

當控制器有一個名為 echoAction 的方法。

---

<a id="p-260"></a>

#### Using controllers and views｜使用控制器和視圖

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/controller.html>

##### General｜一般的

After routing is performed, the controller takes care of the actual code to execute for the request. Because we want to implement some basics for every request that gets processed you should inherit from our base classes to ensure basic functionality such as authorisation and CSRF protection.

路由完成後，控制器會負責處理請求的實際程式碼。由於我們希望為每個處理的請求實現一些基本功能，因此您應該繼承我們的基類，以確保諸如授權和CSRF保護等基本功能。

Controllers are placed in the directory /usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/<Vendor\_name>/<Module\_name>/ and should use the following naming conventions, suffix Controller.php on every class file and suffix Action on all action methods.

控制器位於目錄 /usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/ <Vendor\_name>/<Module\_name> / 中，並且應該使用以下命名約定，每個類別檔案都以 Controller.php 為後綴，所有操作方法都以 Action 為後綴。

##### Class structure｜類別結構

Most components inherit from a set of standard controllers, which are specified in the diagram below including their primary usage scope (/ui or /api)

大多數元件都繼承自一組標準控制器，這些控制器在下圖中進行了指定，包括它們的主要使用範圍（/ui 或 /api）。

[![../../_images/Controller_class_hierarchy.svg](<../images/c987c9a4-Controller_class_hierarchy.svg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/Controller_class_hierarchy.svg)

##### View based controllers｜基於視圖的控制器

For rendering standard pages we have chosen to use Volt templates, the base controller to inherit from in this case is OPNsense\\Base\\ControllerBase and should take care of binding a template to the controller. Every template automatically receives standard features (such as the menu system).

為了渲染標準頁面，我們選擇使用 Volt 範本。在這種情況下，要繼承的基礎控制器是 OPNsense\\Base\\ControllerBase，它負責將模板綁定到控制器。每個範本都會自動獲得標準功能（例如選單系統）。

The wireframe for implementing a single action should look like this:

實現單一操作的線框圖應如下所示：

```php
<?php
    public function indexAction()
    {
       // address some variables to pass through the view
        $this->view->my_variable1 = 'test 1';
        $this->view->my_variable2 = 'test 2';
       // pick a template
        $this->view->pick('SampleVendor/Sample/index');
    }
```

And the volt template SampleVendor/Sample/index.volt could contain something like:

而 volt 模板 SampleVendor/Sample/index.volt 可能包含類似以下內容：

```
the contents of my_variable1 => <b> {{ my_variable1 }} </b> <br>
the contents of my_variable2 => <b> {{ my_variable2 }} </b> <br>
```

A full example can be found in the OPNsense\\Sample controller directory.

完整的範例可以在 OPNsense\\Sample 控制器目錄中找到。

More information on how to write Volt pages can be found here : [https://docs.phalcon.io/latest/volt/](https://docs.phalcon.io/latest/volt/)

有關如何編寫 Volt 頁面的更多信息，請參閱此處：[https://docs.phalcon.io/latest/volt/](https://docs.phalcon.io/latest/volt/)

##### User forms｜使用者表單

When designers need forms for users to input data, they can use the `getForm()` method on our standard controller to feed a simple xml file as definition for the template engine to use. The example section contains a step by step guide how to use these.

當設計人員需要建立供使用者輸入資料的表單時，他們可以使用我們標準控制器上的`getForm()`方法，將一個簡單的 XML 檔案作為模板引擎使用的定義檔。範例部分提供了使用這些方法的詳細步驟指南。

The `getForm()` method itself merely passes the structure to the view, which can use this information to render forms on page load (statically). In our standard layout [partials](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/views/layout_partials/form_input_tr.volt) we offer some different record types which we will detail below:

`getForm()`方法本身只是將結構傳遞給視圖，視圖可以使用此資訊在頁面載入時（靜態地）渲染表單。在我們的標準佈局 [局部視圖](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/views/layout_partials/form_input_tr.volt)中，我們提供了幾種不同的記錄類型，以下將詳細介紹：

**Attributes**

**屬性**

| Name<br>名稱 | Description<br>描述 |
| --- | --- |
| id | unique id of the attribute<br>屬性的唯一識別碼 |
| type<br>類型 | type of input or field. For a list of valid types, use the Type table below<br>輸入或欄位的類型。有關有效類型的列表，請使用下面的類型表 |
| label<br>標籤 | attribute label (visible text)<br>屬性標籤（可見文字） |
| size<br>尺寸 | size (width in characters) attribute if applicable<br>若適用，請提供尺寸（字元寬度）屬性 |
| height | height (length in characters) attribute if applicable<br>若適用，則顯示 height（字元長度）屬性 |
| help<br>幫助 | help text<br>幫助文本 |
| advanced<br>進階 | property “is advanced”, only display in advanced mode<br>屬性“是進階的”，僅在進階模式下顯示 |
| hint<br>提示 | input control hint<br>輸入控制提示 |
| style<br>樣式 | css class(es) to add, helps identifying items easier using jQuery selectors<br>要新增的 CSS 類，有助於使用 jQuery 選擇器更輕鬆地識別項目 |
| width<br>寬度 | width in pixels if applicable<br>若適用，請以像素為單位顯示寬度 |
| allownew | allow new items (for list) if applicable<br>允許新增項目（如果適用，適用於清單） |
| readonly<br>唯讀 | if true, input fields will be readonly<br>若為真，則輸入欄位為唯讀 |

**Types**

**類型**

| Name<br>名稱 | Description<br>描述 |
| --- | --- |
| header<br>標題 | Header row<br>標題行 |
| text<br>文字 | Single line of text<br>單行文字 |
| password<br>密碼 | Password field for sensitive input. The contents will not be displayed.<br>用於輸入敏感資訊的密碼欄位。內容將不會顯示。 |
| textbox<br>文字方塊 | Multiline text box<br>多行文字方塊 |
| checkbox<br>複選框 | Checkbox<br>複選框 |
| dropdown<br>下拉式選單 | Single item selection from dropdown<br>從下拉式選單中選擇單一項目 |
| select\_multiple | Multiple item select from dropdown<br>從下拉式選單中選擇多個項目 |
| hidden<br>隱藏 | Hidden fields not for user interaction<br>不供使用者互動的隱藏欄位 |
| info<br>資訊 | Static text (help icon, no input or editing)<br>靜態文字（幫助圖標，不可輸入或編輯） |
| info\_link | Static text as a link (converted to clickable links)<br>靜態文字連結（轉換為可點擊連結） |

##### API based controllers｜API控制器

For API calls a separate class is used to derive from, which implements a simple interface to handle calls. The main difference with the view controllers is that an action should return a named array containing response data instead of picking a template.

對於API調用，會使用一個單獨的類別來繼承，該類別實作了一個簡單的介面來處理呼叫。與視圖控制器的主要區別在於，操作應該傳回一個包含回應資料的命名數組，而不是選擇一個模板。

A simple index controller to echo a request back looks like this:

一個簡單的索引控制器，用於回顯請求，如下所示：

```php
class TestController extends ApiControllerBase
{
    /**
     * @return array
     */
    public function echoAction()
    {
        if ($this->request->hasPost("message")) {
            $message = $this->request->getPost("message");
        } else {
            $message = " " ;
        }

        return ["message" => $message];
    }
}
```

When placed inside the API directory of Vendor/Sample can be called by sending a post request to /api/sample/test/echo, using jQuery:

當放置在 Vendor/Sample 目錄下的API目錄中時，可以使用 jQuery 向 /api/sample/test/echo 發送 POST 請求來呼叫它：

```
$.ajax({
    type: "POST",
    url: "/api/sample/test/echo",
    success: function(data){
        alert(data.message) ;
    },
    data:{message:"test message"}
});
```

Tip

提示

OPNsense ships with two standard controllers to incorporate default action scenario’s, such as mutating models and restarting services. These can be found in our repository [here](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/Base/) and are named `ApiMutableModelControllerBase`, `ApiMutableServiceControllerBase`. Both extend `ApiControllerBase` as described in this chapter. The mutable model controller is explained in more detail in [using grids](#p-367), the service controller is explained in [api enable services](#p-368)

OPNsense 隨附兩個標準控制器，用於實現預設操作場景，例如模型變更和服務重新啟動。這兩個控制器可以在我們的程式碼庫[此處](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/Base/)中找到，並命名為`ApiMutableModelControllerBase`, `ApiMutableServiceControllerBase` 。它們都繼承自`ApiControllerBase` ，具體內容請參考本章。可變模型控制器在[使用網格](#p-367)中有更詳細的說明，服務控制器在[啟用服務的 API](#p-368)中有詳細說明。

##### Searchable recordsets｜可搜尋記錄集

The tip in the previous chapter described how to use grids when using models, but in some cases there are datasets without being bound to a model. For example when traversing legacy data or gathering system statistics.

上一章的技巧介紹如何在使用模型時使用網格，但在某些情況下，資料集可能並未綁定到任何模型。例如，在處理歷史資料或收集系統統計資料時。

For this reason we added the method `searchRecordsetBase()` in `ApiControllerBase`. Using this method offers the ability to hook a recordset into the same search functionality as being available in model grids.

因此，我們在`ApiControllerBase`中加入了方法`searchRecordsetBase()` 。使用此方法可以將記錄集連接到與模型網格中相同的搜尋功能。

The following parameters are being offered:

可提供以下參數：

| Name<br>名稱 | Description<br>描述 |
| --- | --- |
| $records | array as record set, e.g. \[ \[‘id’ => ‘1’\], \[‘id’ => ‘2’\], … \]<br>數組作為記錄集，例如 \[ \['id' => '1'\], \['id' => '2'\], … \] |
| $fields | Optional list of fields when not all data should be returned<br>選用欄位列表，用於指定並非所有資料都應傳回的欄位 |
| $defaultSort | Optional default sort order (fielndname in recordset)<br>可選的預設排序順序（記錄集中的欄位名稱） |
| $filter\_funct | Optional pluggable filter function, which is call with the record in question<br>可選的可插拔篩選函數，使用相關記錄呼叫函數 |
| $sort\_flags | Default set to `SORT_NATURAL \| SORT_FLAG_CASE`<br>預設值為`SORT_NATURAL \| SORT_FLAG_CASE` |

Note

筆記

In order to filter sets on fields, make sure all records contain the requested field. Currently it’s not possible to omit fields when being sorted.

若要按欄位篩選資料集，請確保所有記錄都包含所需的欄位。目前排序時無法省略字段。

Implementing this into your own controller should be as simple as:

將此功能整合到您自己的控制器中應該非常簡單：

```php
class TestController extends ApiControllerBase
{
    /**
     * @return array
     */
    public function searchAction()
    {
        $records = [];
        $records[] = ['id' => '1', 'description' => 'test 1'];
        $records[] = ['id' => '2', 'description' => 'test 2'];
        $records[] = ['id' => '3', 'description' => 'test 3'];
        return $this->searchRecordsetBase($records);
    }
}
```

##### Easy csv export/import helpers｜簡易的 CSV 匯出/匯入助手

In order to export or import csv structured data, some helpers are available to ease these operations. The `ApiControllerBase` adds a simple recordset export method (`exportCsv()`) and `ApiMutableModelControllerBase` contains a method to import data (`importCsv()`).

為了匯出或匯入 csv 結構化數據，可以使用一些助手來簡化這些操作。 `ApiControllerBase`新增了一個簡單的記錄集導出方法（`exportCsv()`），`ApiMutableModelControllerBase`包含了一個匯入資料的方法（`importCsv()`）。

When data is being exported from a model using an `ArrayField` type, the `asRecordSet()` method can be used to extract the data easily.

當使用`ArrayField`類型從模型匯出資料時，可以使用`asRecordSet()`方法輕鬆擷取資料。

The smallest functional example to download a file from a controller implemented with `ApiMutableModelControllerBase` would look like:

使用`ApiMutableModelControllerBase`實作的控制器下載檔案的最小功能範例如下所示：

```php
public function downloadAction()
{
    $this->exportCsv($this->getModel()->path->to->items->asRecordSet());
}
```

Feeding data back into the model:

將數據回饋到模型中：

```php
public function uploadReservationsAction()
{
    if ($this->request->isPost() && $this->request->hasPost('payload')) {
        return $this->importCsv(
            'path.to.items',
            $this->request->getPost('payload'),
            ['my_key']
        );
    }
}
```

<a id="p-261"></a>

#### View construction (and tools)｜查看施工（和工具）

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/view_js_helpers.html>

Although most of our code base is being processed server side, some things just require interaction on the clients machine for a fluent user experience.

雖然我們的程式碼庫大部分都是在伺服器端處理的，但有些事情為了提供流暢的使用者體驗，還是需要在客戶端機器上進行互動。

In this chapter we will try to explain some of the components we use when designing pages and how pages are usually constructed.

在本章中，我們將嘗試解釋我們在設計頁面時使用的一些元件以及頁面通常是如何建構的。

##### Layout｜佈局

To ease reading of volt templates, we recommend using a fixed layout when creating templates. The base of our rendered page always contains the standard [layout](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/views/layouts/default.volt) which is hooked via our standard frontend controller.

為了方便閱讀 Volt 模板，我們建議在建立模板時使用固定佈局。渲染頁面的底部始終包含標準的 [佈局](https://github.com/opnsense/core/blob/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/views/layouts/default.volt) ，該佈局透過我們的標準前端控制器進行綁定。

Below you will find the sections and their order, which we will describe briefly.

下面列出了各個部分及其順序，我們將簡要介紹一下。

```
{#
  {1} Copyright notice
#}
<script>
$( document ).ready(function() {
  {2} UI code
});
</script>
{3} page html
{{ partial("layout_partials/base_dialog",...)}}  {4} dialog forms (see getForm())
```

1.  The copyright block, 2 clause BSD with the authors on top  
    版權聲明，第 2 條BSD作者資訊位於頂部
    
2.  Javascript code which belongs to this page  
    屬於此頁面的 Javascript 程式碼
    
3.  HTML code, usually starts with some `<div>` containers and uses standard Bootstrap 3 layouting  
    HTML程式碼通常以一些`<div>`容器開頭，並使用標準的 Bootstrap 3 佈局。
    
4.  When forms are used, these are placed last, these will be generated to the client as standard html code  
    使用表單時，這些程式碼會放在最後，它們將以標準 HTML 程式碼的形式產生並傳送給用戶端。
    

##### ajaxCall｜ajax調用

`ajaxCall(url, sendData, callback)` is a wrapper around jQuery’s `$.ajax` call preset to a `POST` type request and wrapping the sendData into a json object. The `callback` function will be called with the data and status received from the endpoint.

`ajaxCall(url, sendData, callback)` 是 jQuery 的 `$.ajax` 呼叫的包裝器，預設為 `POST` 類型請求，並將 sendData 包裝到 json 物件中。將使用從端點接收到的資料和狀態來呼叫`callback`函數。

example usage

用法範例

```
ajaxCall('/api/monit/status/get/xml', {}, function(data, status) {
    console.log(data)
});
```

##### ajaxGet

`ajaxGet(url,sendData,callback)` is also a wrapper around jQuery’s `$.ajax` call, but for a `GET` type request.

`ajaxGet(url,sendData,callback)`也是 jQuery 的`$.ajax`所呼叫的包裝器，但用於`GET`類型的請求。

example usage

用法範例

```
ajaxGet('/api/diagnostics/interface/getInterfaceNames', {}, function(data, status) {
    console.log(data);
});
```

##### mapDataToFormUI

The `mapDataToFormUI(data_get_map, server_params)` can be used to map data retrieved from a controller to a form in the browser.

`mapDataToFormUI(data_get_map, server_params)`可用於將從控制器擷取的資料對應到瀏覽器中的表單。

This function accepts two parameters, data\_get\_map contains a mapping between form id’s and server endpoints, server\_params is optional and can be used to set option in the `GET` type request.

此函數接受兩個參數，data\_get\_map 包含表單 ID 和伺服器端點之間的映射，server\_params 是可選的，可用於設定`GET`類型請求中的選項。

When the endpoint is successfully called it should return a json type structure containing the path to the item, as an example using `data_get_map = {'myform': '/api/path/to/formdata'};`:

當端點呼叫成功時，它應該會傳回一個包含專案路徑的 JSON 類型結構，例如使用`data_get_map = {'myform': '/api/path/to/formdata'};` ：

```
{
  "netflow": {
    "capture": {
      "interfaces": {
        "lan": {
          "value": "LAN",
          "selected": 1
        },
        "wan": {
          "value": "WAN",
          "selected": 0
        }
      },
    },
    "collect": {
      "enable": "1"
    }
  }
}
```

Which maps to the fields in this simplified structure (usually rendered via our volt templates):

這對應於此簡化結構中的字段（通常透過我們的 volt 模板渲染）：

```xml
<form id="myform">
    <select multiple="multiple" id="netflow.capture.interfaces">
    </select>
    <input type="checkbox" id="netflow.collect.enable">
</form>
```

The function returns a `$.Deferred()` which will be resolved when all endpoints are called.

該函數傳回一個`$.Deferred()`，當所有端點被呼叫時，它將被解析。

##### saveFormToEndpoint｜儲存表單到端點

`saveFormToEndpoint(url, formid, callback_ok, disable_dialog, callback_fail)` is the opposite of `mapDataToFormUI()` and retrieves the data from the form and sends it to the configured (url) endpoint as json structure. Underneath this function uses `getFormData(parent)` defined in opnsense.js which is responsible for extracting values from different form types such as `<input>` and `<select>` types. When the attributes should be type safe (e.g. an *integer* in json format should be presented as `1` and not as `"1"`), there is the possibility to “cleanse” the data first using a filter. In this case define an attribute on the input tag with the name `type_formatter` containing the function to call.

`saveFormToEndpoint(url, formid, callback_ok, disable_dialog, callback_fail)`與`mapDataToFormUI()`相反，它從表單中檢索數據，並以 JSON 結構將其發送到配置的 (url) 端點。此函數底層使用了 opnsense.js 中定義的`getFormData(parent)`後者負責從不同的表單類型（例如`<input>`和`<select>`類型）中提取值。當屬性需要類型安全性時（例如，JSON 格式中的 *整數* 應表示為`1`而不是`"1"` ），可以先使用過濾器「清理」資料。在這種情況下，可以在輸入標籤上定義一個名為`type_formatter`的屬性，其中包含要呼叫的函數。

```xml
<input type="text" type_formatter="my_convert_to_int_function" id="myform.myintval">
```

Which could be implemented in the form javascript as:

這可以用 JavaScript 實作如下：

```js
function my_convert_to_int_function(payload)
{
    if (/^[+-]?[0-9]*$/.test(payload)) {
        return  parseInt(payload);
    } else {
        return payload;
    }
}
```

The response data looks similar to the example data in mapDataToFormUI, but more condensed since selections will be returned as single (separated) values, such as `lan,wan` if both options where set.

回應資料看起來與 mapDataToFormUI 中的範例資料類似，但更簡潔，因為選擇將作為單一（分隔的）值傳回，例如，如果兩個選項都已設置，則傳回`lan,wan` 。

Using the example with the function above, a valid integer would offer a json object similar to `{"myform": {"myintval": 1}}`, unparsable data would look like `{"myform": {"myintval": "1x"}}`, in which case backend validations are able to feedback validation results.

以上述函數為例，一個有效的整數將提供一個類似`{"myform": {"myintval": 1}}`的json對象，無法解析的資料將類似於`{"myform": {"myintval": "1x"}}` ，在這種情況下，後端驗證能夠回饋驗證結果。

##### updateServiceControlUI｜更新服務控制 UI

The `updateServiceControlUI(serviceName)` function hooks the service control on top of the standard template, where you can find the \[re\]start, stop and status of the service.

`updateServiceControlUI(serviceName)`函數將服務控制項連接到標準範本之上，您可以在其中找到服務的啟動、停止和狀態。

It assumes the following endpoints exists for the module:

它假定模組存在以下端點：

-   /api/{{serviceName}}/service/status
    
    -   returns the status of the service (running, stopped) in a field named “status”  
        傳回名為「status」的字段，其中包含服務的狀態（運行中、已停止）。
        
    
-   /api/{{serviceName}}/service/start
    
    -   start the service  
        啟動服務
        
    
-   /api/{{serviceName}}/service/restart
    
    -   restart the service  
        重啟服務
        
    
-   /api/{{serviceName}}/service/stop
    
    -   stop the service  
        停止服務
        
    

##### Dialog wrappers｜對話框包裝器

We are using [BootstrapDialog](https://nakupanda.github.io/bootstrap3-dialog/) to display standard dialogs, to limit the boilerplates needed to show these dialog we added the following wrapper functions:

我們使用 [BootstrapDialog](https://nakupanda.github.io/bootstrap3-dialog/)來顯示標準對話框，為了減少顯示這些對話框所需的樣板程式碼，我們加入了以下包裝函數：

###### stdDialogInform(title, message, close, callback, type, cssClass)

Informational dialog with a single close button, using the following parameters:

使用以下參數建立帶有單一關閉按鈕的資訊對話框：

-   title: `string` dialog title  
    標題： `string`對話標題
    
-   message: `string` dialog message  
    訊息： `string`對話訊息
    
-   close: `string` close button text  
    關閉： `string`關閉按鈕文字
    
-   callback: `function()` to be called after close  
    回呼函數： `function()`在關閉後調用
    
-   type: `string` dialog type. one of: danger, default, info, primary, success, warning  
    類型： `string`對話框類型。選項包括：危險、預設、訊息、主要、成功、警告
    
-   cssClass: `string` css class to use  
    cssClass: `string`要使用的 css 類
    

###### stdDialogConfirm(title, message, accept, decline, callback, type)｜stdDialogConfirm(title, message, accept, reject, callback, type)

Ok/Cancel dialog type using the following parameters:

使用以下參數建立“確定/取消”對話方塊類型：

-   title: `string` dialog title  
    標題： `string`對話標題
    
-   message: `string` dialog message  
    訊息： `string`對話訊息
    
-   accept: `string` accept button text  
    接受： `string`接受按鈕文本
    
-   decline: `string` decline button text  
    拒絕： `string`拒絕按鈕文本
    
-   callback: `function()` to be called after close  
    回呼函數： `function()`在關閉後調用
    
-   type: `string` dialog type. one of: danger, default, info, primary, success, warning  
    類型： `string`對話框類型。選項包括：危險、預設、訊息、主要、成功、警告
    

###### stdDialogRemoveItem(message, callback)

Simple remove item (warning) dialog, using a message and optionally a callback.

使用訊息和可選的回調函數，建立簡單的刪除項目（警告）對話框。

##### $.SimpleActionButton

Using the jQuery extension `SimpleActionButton` one can register simple ajax calls on components click events, which will call the selected endpoint and show a progress animation (spinner) to the user.

使用 jQuery 擴充功能`SimpleActionButton`可以在元件點擊事件上註冊簡單的 ajax 調用，這將調用選定的端點並向使用者顯示進度動畫（旋轉器）。

The following parameters can be supplied as data attributes on the target object:

以下參數可以作為目標物件的資料屬性提供：

-   endpoint: endpoint to call (e.g. `/api/my/action`)  
    端點：要呼叫的端點（例如`/api/my/action` ）
    
-   label: button label text  
    標籤：按鈕標籤文字
    
-   service-widget: the service widget to refresh after execution, see `updateServiceControlUI()`  
    service-widget：執行後要刷新的服務小部件，請參閱`updateServiceControlUI()`
    
-   error-title: error dialog title  
    錯誤標題：錯誤對話框標題
    

The method itself can be fed with callbacks to call before (`onPreAction()`) and after (`onAction()`) execution.

此方法本身可以接收回呼函數，以便在執行之前（ `onPreAction()` ）和執行之後（ `onAction()` ）呼叫。

An example of a button could look like this:

按鈕的範例可能如下所示：

```xml
<button class="btn btn-primary" id="reconfigureAct"
        data-endpoint='/api/component/service/reconfigure'
        data-label="{{ lang._('Apply') }}"
        data-service-widget="component"
        data-error-title="{{ lang._('Error reconfiguring component') }}"
        type="button"
></button>
```

To utilize the callbacks, one could use:

要使用回呼函數，可以使用以下方法：

```
$('#btnTest').SimpleActionButton({
    onPreAction: function() {
        const dfObj = new $.Deferred();
        console.log("called before endpoint execution, returning a promise.");
        return dfObj;
    },
    onAction: function(data, status){
        console.log("action has been executed.");
    }
});
```

`SimpleActionButton` will also show a reminder to the user to save their settings if prompted. To do so, simply call `$(document).trigger("settings-changed");`.

如果提示， `SimpleActionButton`也會向使用者顯示已儲存設定的提醒。要保存設置，只需調用`$(document).trigger("settings-changed");`即可。

##### $.SimpleFileUploadDlg

The simple file upload dialog can be used to select a file and upload it to a specified endpoint.

可以使用簡單的檔案上傳對話方塊選擇檔案並將其上傳到指定的端點。

To define a button sending data to /api/path/to/import\_controller, the following code could be used:

要定義一個傳送資料給 /api/path/to/import\_controller 的按鈕，可以使用下列程式碼：

```html
<button
    id="upload"
    type="button"
    data-title="Import"
    data-endpoint='/api/path/to/import_controller'
    class="btn btn-xs"
><span class="fa fa-fw fa-table"></span></button>
```

Note

筆記

The structure of this `POST` contains a `payload` and a `filename` property.

此`POST`結構包含`payload`和`filename`性質。

Initializing this button could be done using:

可以使用以下方法初始化此按鈕：

```
$("#upload").SimpleFileUploadDlg();
```

Tip

提示

The `SimpleFileUploadDlg` action supports an `onAction` handler similar to the one described in `$.SimpleActionButton`

`SimpleFileUploadDlg`操作支援類似於`$.SimpleActionButton`中所描述的`onAction`處理程序。

<a id="p-262"></a>

#### UIBootgrid

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/frontend/bootgrid.html>

The UIBootgrid system is a wrapper around [Tabulator](https://tabulator.info/) and provides a generic table system that is reusable on all pages requiring data listing and manipulation.

UIBootgrid 系統是 [Tabulator](https://tabulator.info/)的封裝，它提供了一個通用的表格系統，可以在所有需要資料清單和操作的頁面上重複使用。

##### Setup｜設定

To get started, see [Using grids module & plugin](#p-367). The example will show you how to get started with a minimal grid setup and how this front-end code ties to the controller layer.

首先，請參閱[使用網格模組和插件](#p-367) 。此範例將向您展示如何使用最小的網格設定開始，以及此前端程式碼如何與控制器層關聯。

##### Basic Layout｜基本佈局

Since the controller layer defines standardized output and expects standardized input, it’s possible to construct and feed a grid by simply defining a set of endpoints as explained in the setup:

由於控制器層定義了標準化的輸出並期望標準化的輸入，因此只需定義一組端點即可建立網格並為其提供數據，如設定中所述：

```
$("#{{formGridAddress['table_id']}}").UIBootgrid(
    {
        search:'/api/gridexample/settings/search_item/',
        get:'/api/gridexample/settings/get_item/',
        set:'/api/gridexample/settings/set_item/',
        add:'/api/gridexample/settings/add_item/',
        del:'/api/gridexample/settings/del_item/',
        toggle:'/api/gridexample/settings/toggle_item/',
        info:'/api/gridexample/settings/info'
    }
);
```

You can use the browser developer tool to inspect the request/response structures of each operation. For example, the `search` endpoint looks like this:

您可以使用瀏覽器開發者工具來檢查每個操作的請求/回應結構。例如， `search`端點如下圖所示：

**Request:**

**要求：**

```json
{
    "current": 1,
    "rowCount": 50,
    "sort": {}
}
```

**Response:**

**回覆:**

```
{
    "rows": [
        {
            "uuid": "3b4e949d-443b-4127-a709-1e41589db462",
            ...
        },
        ...
    ],
    "rowCount": 1,
    "total": 1,
    "current": 1
}
```

Note

筆記

`info` endpoints are not used very often (and can safely be omitted), these are mainly intended as simple trigger to display an info dialog.

`info`端點不常用（可以安全地省略），它們主要用作顯示訊息對話框的簡單觸發器。

##### Column Setup｜列設定

The columns and the associated properties can be defined in two ways:

列及其相關屬性可以透過兩種方式定義：

-   Through a form, if creation, deletion, updating and adding are to be supported.  
    透過表單，支援建立、刪除、更新和新增操作。
    
-   Through a `<table>` structure, only if the `search` endpoint is exclusively required (static data)  
    透過`<table>`結構，僅當`search`端點是絕對必需的（靜態資料）時才需要。
    

##### `form`

In forms, column properties are defined in the `<grid_view>` tag as explained in [Define dialog items](#p-367)

在表單中，列屬性在`<grid_view>`標籤中定義，如 [定義對話方塊項目](#p-367)中所述。

##### `table`

When using a table, column properties are set as `data-` attributes. For example:

使用表格時，列屬性設定為`data-`屬性。例如：

```xml
<table id="livelog-table" class="table table-condensed table-hover table-striped table-responsive">
    <thead>
        <tr>
            <th data-column-id="interface" data-formatter="interface" data-sortable="false" data-width="80">{{ lang._('Interface') }}</th>
            <th data-column-id="dir" data-type="string" data-formatter="direction" data-sortable="false" data-width="30"></th>
            ...
        <tr>
    </thead>
</table>
```

If constructing using a `table`, the minimum setup requires a `data-column-id` to be set in order to map the row data to the appropriate cell. Additionally, column header text (`label`) is set on the element itself.

如果使用`table`進行構造，則最低設定要求是設定`data-column-id`以便將行資料對應到對應的儲存格。此外，還需要在元素本身上設定列標題文字 ( `label` )。

Note

筆記

Internally, forms are translated to table structures.

在內部，表單被轉換為表格結構。

##### `properties`

The following column properties are available:

以下列屬性可用：

| Property<br>屬性 | Type<br>類型 | Default<br>預設值 | Description<br>描述 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sorter` | `string` | `null` | Sorter function to use if `ajax: false`.<br>如果`ajax: false`則使用排序函數。 |
| `formatter` | `string` | `null` | Formatter function to use for this column. See [options.formatters](#p-262).<br>此列要使用的格式化函數。請參閱 [options.formatters](#p-262) 。 |
| `headerFormatter` | `string` | `null` | Header formatter function to use for this column. See [options.headerFormatters](#p-262).<br>此列所使用的標題格式化函數。請參閱 [options.headerFormatters](#p-262) 。 |
| `visible` | `boolean` | `true` | If this column should be rendered by default. Users are always allow to toggle the column visibility, unless this has been disabled through `selectable`.<br>如果此列預設顯示，則使用者可以隨時切換列的可見性，除非已透過`selectable`停用此功能。 |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `true` | If the visibility of this column can be toggled on/off. Use this if you require columns to be (in)visible at all times.<br>是否可以開啟/關閉該列的可見性。如果您需要列始終可見（不可見），請使用此選項。 |
| `sequence` | `number` | `null` | Sequence number to force columns in a certain order. Keep in mind that users can re-order columns.<br>用於強制列依特定順序排列的序號。請注意，使用者可以重新排列列的順序。 |
| `width` | `number` | `null` | Default width in pixels. Users can change this by resizing the columns.<br>預設寬度（像素）。使用者可以透過調整列寬來變更此值。 |
| `min-width` | `number` | `null` | Minimum width in pixels. Use this to prevent users resizing lower than this given threshold.<br>最小寬度（像素）。使用此設定可防止使用者將影像調整到小於此閾值的大小。 |
| `max-width` | `number` | `null` | Maximum width in pixels. Use this to prevent users resizing higher than this given threshold.<br>最大寬度（像素）。使用此設定可防止使用者將影像調整到超過此閾值的大小。 |
| `sortable` | `boolean` | `true` | If this columnm header can be clicked to sort on this column.<br>若可以點選此列標題依此列排序。 |

##### Configuration Reference｜配置參考

The `UIBootgrid` initialization object starts with the CRUD methods as stated above, but the whole structure contaions a lot of options to modify the behavior to fit your purpose.

`UIBootgrid`初始化物件以上面提到的CRUD方法開始，但整個結構包含許多選項，可以修改行為以適應您的目的。

The top-level options are layed out as follows:

頂級選項如下：

```
config
├── search
├── get
├── set
├── add
├── del
├── toggle
├── info
├── options
│   ├── ...
│   ├── ...
│   └── ...
├── commands
│   ├── ...
│   └── ...
├── tabulatorOptions
    ├── ...
    └── ...
```

Batching involves taking all of the<br>操作。批次處理是指取得所有選取行的<code>datakey</code>strings of the selected rows and splitting these up into<br>字串，並將它們拆分成<code>batchDeleteSize</code>-length chunks, and firing one delete request per batch. The request contains all<br>長度的區塊，然後為每個區塊發送刪除請求。該請求包含所有<code>datakey</code>strings as a single comma-separate parameter. Therefore, the controller should be capable of dealing with these keys. Set this to<br>字串，它們作為一個以逗號分隔的參數。因此，控制器應該能夠處理這些鍵。只有當您的控制器端點無法處理單一請求中的多個值時，才將此項目設定為<code>false</code>only if your controller endpoint is not capable of dealing with multiple values in one request.<br></td></tr>

Adjust this number if the<br>的長度小於其最大值。如果<code>datakey</code>is not a<br>不是UUID.</td></tr>

This is used in cases where we are referred to from a different page to load both the grid and immediately open the right entity for editing.<br>datakey這用於從不同頁面引用我們來載入網格並立即開啟正確實體進行編輯的情況。<br>If we came from a different page, the<br>如果我們來自不同頁面，<code>edit</code> URLparameter will be set to the<br>參數將設定為<code>datakey</code>value. This parameter can be fetched through<br>值。此參數可以透過<code>getUrlHash('edit')</code>.<br>In most cases, if triggering an edit on referral is necessary,<br>取得。大多數情況下，如果需要觸發引用編輯，則應使用<code>getUrlHash('edit')</code>should be used. If the referrer sets a different<br>。如果引薦來源設定了不同的URLparameter, adjust your logic accordingly.<br>參數，請相應地調整您的邏輯。</td></tr>
