<a id="p-366"></a>

#### Hello world module & plugin｜你好世界模組和插件

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/examples/helloworld.html>

Creating the hello world module

建立 hello world 模組

[![../../_images/Hello-World.jpg](<../images/c297a591-Hello-World.jpg>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/Hello-World.jpg)

##### Goal｜目標

Goal for this sample

此樣本的目標

---

The goal of the “Hello world” module we’re creating in the example is to control a program on our system named “testConnection.py”, which is part of [the example package available on GitHub](#p-366). It will try to send an email using plain smtp and will respond with a json text message about the result of that attempt.

我們在範例中建立的「Hello world」模組的目標是控制系統上名為「testConnection.py」的程序，該程式是[GitHub 上提供的範例套件](#p-366) 的一部分。它將嘗試使用純 smtp 發送電子郵件，並使用有關該嘗試結果的 json 文字訊息進行回應。

Our application will need some settings to operate correctly, like an ip address and an email address and we need to be able to run that application. Because this application returns some valuable data for our users, we need to be able to fetch the response data back.

我們的應用程式需要一些設定才能正確運行，例如 IP 位址和電子郵件地址，並且我們需要能夠運行該應用程式。由於此應用程式為我們的用戶返回一些有價值的數據，因此我們需要能夠取回回應數據。

[![overview](<../images/bc1dc75e-Helloworld_overview.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/Helloworld_overview.png)

---

##### Guidelines｜指南

Guidelines and coding style

準則和編碼風格

For all OPNsense modules and applications there are some basic style and coding guides which you should use.

對於所有 OPNsense 模組和應用程序，您應該使用一些基本樣式和編碼指南。

###### Naming｜命名

When creating modules for OPNsense, always name your components like this: VendorName/ModuleName

為 OPNsense 建立模組時，請務必以下列方式命名元件：VendorName/ModuleName

In our sample case this will be: OPNsense/HelloWorld

在我們的範例案例中，這將是：OPNsense/HelloWorld

###### PHP code｜PHP代碼

Please use PSR-12 style ([https://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-12/](https://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-12/)) for all new code.

所有新程式碼請使用PSR-12樣式（[https://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-12/](https://www.php-fig.org/psr/psr-12/)）。

###### Architecture｜建築學

Always make sure there’s a clear separation of concerns, back-end calls (like shell scripts) should be implemented using the configd system, all communication to the client should be handled from an API endpoint. (the example provides more insights on how this works).

始終確保有明確的關注點分離，後端呼叫（如 shell 腳本）應使用 configd 系統實現，所有與客戶端的通訊應從 API 端點處理。 （此範例提供了有關其工作原理的更多見解）。

Back-end programs should not access the config.xml directly, if data is needed let the template system handle the desired output (most applications, daemons and tools deliver their own desired configuration format). There’s generally no good reason to avoid the standards that are already there.

後端程式不應直接存取 config.xml，如果需要數據，請讓模板系統處理所需的輸出（大多數應用程式、守護程式和工具提供自己所需的配置格式）。通常沒有充分的理由來避免現有的標準。

If you follow this basic rules, you’re automatically building a command structure for the system administrators and provide a connector to third party tools to the API of your component.

如果遵循此基本規則，您將自動為系統管理員建立命令結構，並為組件的API提供第三方工具的連接器。

###### Directory structure｜目錄結構

We will build our HelloWorld example step by step and create several files. Here is the directory structure and the files which will get created:

我們將逐步建立 HelloWorld 範例並建立幾個檔案。這是目錄結構和將要建立的檔案：

```
./src/opnsense/
  ├── mvc/
  |   └── app/
  |       ├── controllers/
  |       |   └── OPNsense/HelloWorld/
  |       |       ├── IndexController.php
  |       |       ├── Api/
  |       |       |   ├── ServiceController.php
  |       |       |   ├── SettingsController.php
  |       |       └── forms/
  |       |           └── general.xml
  |       ├── models/
  |       |   └── OPNsense/HelloWorld/
  |       |       ├── HelloWorld.php
  |       |       ├── HelloWorld.xml
  |       |       ├── ACL/
  |       |       |   └── ACL.xml
  |       |       └── Menu/
  |       |           └── Menu.xml
  |       └── views/
  |           └── OPNsense/HelloWorld/
  |               └── index.volt
  ├── scripts/
  |   └── helloworld/
  |       └── testConnection.py
  └── service/
      ├── templates/
      |   └── OPNsense/HelloWorld/
      |       ├── +TARGETS
      |       └── helloworld.conf
      └── conf/actions.d/
          └── actions_helloworld.conf
```

##### Skeleton｜骷髏

Setup a skeleton for the frontend / middleware

設定前端/中介軟體的骨架

First step for our project is to build a skeleton which holds the structure for our frontend/middleware. Do keep in mind to only build the structure, if you add empty files this will cause errors.

我們專案的第一步是建立一個框架，用於保存前端/中間件的結構。請記住僅構建結構，如果添加空文件，這將導致錯誤。

###### Model｜型號

For our sample application we want to setup some configuration data, which for all new style projects should live in it’s own model.

對於我們的範例應用程序，我們想要設定一些配置數據，對於所有新樣式項目來說，這些數據應該存在於它自己的模型中。

First we start by creating two files inside the models/OPNsense/HelloWorld directory.

首先，我們先在 models/OPNsense/HelloWorld 目錄中建立兩個檔案。

The first one is the boilerplate for the model class, which should contain model specific methods and (by deriving it from BaseModel) automatically understands the second file.

第一個是模型類別的樣板，它應該包含模型特定的方法，並且（透過從 BaseModel 派生）自動理解第二個檔案。

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/HelloWorld/HelloWorld.php

```php
<?php
namespace OPNsense\HelloWorld;

use OPNsense\Base\BaseModel;

class HelloWorld extends BaseModel
{
}
```

Not all modules contain additional code in the PHP class, sometimes all the standard behaviour is already sufficient for your modules/application.

並非所有模組都在 PHP 類別中包含附加程式碼，有時所有標準行為對於您的模組/應用程式來說已經足夠了。

Note

筆記

When stored data has derivatives, the model is usually the place to build these. Good examples are a flag to figure out if a service is enabled in cases where it depends on structures inside the data. (such as a list of interfaces which can all be enabled and/or disabled)

當儲存的資料具有導數時，模型通常是建立這些導數的地方。很好的例子是一個標誌，用於確定在服務依賴資料內部結構的情況下是否啟用服務。 （例如可以全部啟用和/或停用的介面清單）

Which is the model XML template, our skeleton starts with something like this:

這是模型XML模板，我們的骨架是這樣開始的：

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/HelloWorld/HelloWorld.xml

```xml
<model>
    <mount>//OPNsense/helloworld</mount>
    <description>the OPNsense "Hello World" application</description>
    <items>
        <!-- container -->
    </items>
</model>
```

The content of the mount tag is very important, this is the location within the config.xml file where this model is responsible. Other models cannot write data into the same area. You should name this location with your vendor and module name to make sure others could easily identify it.

mount 標籤的內容非常重要，這是該模型負責的 config.xml 檔案中的位置。其他型號無法將資料寫入同一區域。您應該使用您的供應商和模組名稱來命名此位置，以確保其他人可以輕鬆識別它。

Use the description tag to identify your model, the last tag in place is the items tag, where the actual definition will live. We leave it empty for now as we proceed with the next step of creating our skeleton.

使用描述標籤來標識您的模型，最後一個標籤是項目標籤，實際定義將位於其中。當我們繼續創建骨架的下一步時，我們暫時將其留空。

###### View｜查看

Page template (View)

頁面模板（視圖）

We should add a (Volt) template to use for the index page of our module; we will use the same naming convention here.

我們應該添加一個（Volt）模板用於我們模組的索引頁面；我們將在這裡使用相同的命名約定。

Create a template named index.volt inside the views/OPNsense/HelloWorld directory containing the following data:

在views/OPNsense/HelloWorld 目錄中建立一個名為index.volt 的模板，其中包含以下資料：

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/views/OPNsense/HelloWorld/index.volt

```xml
<h1>Hello World!</h1>
```

###### Controller｜控制器

Next step is to add controllers, which will be automatically picked up by the system routing. A controller connects the user interaction to logic and presentation.

下一步是新增控制器，系統路由將自動選擇這些控制器。控制器將使用者互動連接到邏輯和表示。

Every OPNsense module should separate presentation from logic, that’s why there should always be multiple controllers per module.

每個 OPNsense 模組都應將表示與邏輯分開，這就是每個模組應該始終有多個控制器的原因。

Our first controller handles the template rendering to the user and connects the user view we just created. We start by creating a PHP file in controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/ with the following name IndexController.php and contents:

我們的第一個控制器處理向使用者渲染的模板並連接我們剛剛建立的使用者視圖。我們首先在controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/ 中建立一個 PHP 文件，其名稱如下 IndexController.php 和內容：

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/IndexController.php

```php
<?php
namespace OPNsense\HelloWorld;
class IndexController extends \OPNsense\Base\IndexController
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        // pick the template to serve to our users.
        $this->view->pick('OPNsense/HelloWorld/index');
    }
}
```

At this point you should be able to test if your work so far was successful, by going to the following location (after being logged in to the firewall as root user):

此時，您應該能夠透過前往以下位置（以 root 使用者身分登入防火牆後）來測試到目前為止您的工作是否成功：

```
http[s]://<your ip>/ui/helloworld/
```

Which should serve you the “Hello World!” text you’ve added in the template.

這應該為您提供“Hello World！”您在模板中添加的文字。

[![Serving the first "hello world" page](<../images/c91981d5-HelloWorld_Empty_template.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/HelloWorld_Empty_template.png)

Next two controllers we are going to create are to be used for the api to the system, they should take care of service actions and the retrieval/changing of configuration data.

接下來我們要建立的兩個控制器將用於系統的 api，它們應該負責服務操作和配置資料的檢索/更改。

They should live in a subdirectory of the controller called Api and extend the corresponding class.

它們應該位於控制器的名為 Api 的子目錄中並擴展相應的類別。

For our modules we create two API controllers, one for controlling settings and one for performing service actions. (Named SettingsController.php and ServiceController.php)

對於我們的模組，我們創建了兩個 API 控制器，一個用於控制設置，另一個用於執行服務操作。 （命名為SettingsController.php和ServiceController.php）

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/SettingsController.php

```php
<?php
namespace OPNsense\HelloWorld\Api;

use \OPNsense\Base\ApiMutableModelControllerBase;
class SettingsController extends ApiMutableModelControllerBase
{
}
```

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/ServiceController.php

```php
<?php
namespace OPNsense\HelloWorld\Api;

use \OPNsense\Base\ApiMutableServiceControllerBase;
class ServiceController extends ApiMutableServiceControllerBase
{
}
```

Note

筆記

For the sake of simplicity we use `ApiMutableModelControllerBase` in our example, in practice this class derives from `ApiControllerBase` which is the essential requirement for an api endpoint. Using `ApiMutableModelControllerBase` prevents duplicating boilerplate code.

為了簡單起見，我們在範例中使用 `ApiMutableModelControllerBase`，實際上，此類派生自 `ApiControllerBase`，這是 api 端點的基本要求。使用`ApiMutableModelControllerBase`可以防止重複樣板程式碼。

##### First Input Form｜第一個輸入表格

Building your first input form

建立您的第一個輸入表單

The first step in building forms is to determine what information we should collect.

建立表單的第一步是確定我們應該收集哪些資訊。

Our simple application will send an email using data in our configuration xml. For this very module we want to collect the following:

我們的簡單應用程式將使用配置 xml 中的資料發送電子郵件。對於這個模組，我們希望收集以下內容：

| Property<br>物業 | Default<br>預設 | Description<br>描述 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| General.Enabled<br>常規.啟用 | Enabled (1)<br>已啟用 (1) | Should this module be enabled (Boolean)<br>是否應啟用此模組（布林值） |
| General.SMTPHost<br>常規.SMTPHost | <empty> | IP address for the remote smtp host<br>IP 遠端 smtp 主機位址 |
| General.FromEmail<br>常規.FromEmail | [sample@example.com](mailto:sample%40example.com) | Email address of the sender<br>寄件人的電子郵件地址 |
| General.ToEmail<br>常規.ToEmail | <empty> | Email address to send our test email to<br>將我們的測試電子郵件發送至的電子郵件地址 |
| General.Description<br>一般說明 | <empty> | Description, used as subject of the email.<br>描述，用作電子郵件的主題。 |

###### Adding Fields｜新增字段

Adding fields to your model

將欄位加入模型中

When building the skeleton, we have created an empty model (XML), which we are going to fill with some attributes now. The items section of the model XML should contain the structure you want to use for your application, you can create trees to hold data in here. All leaves should contain a field type to identify and validate it’s content. The list of attributes for our application can be translated to this:

在建立骨架時，我們創建了一個空模型（XML），現在我們將填充一些屬性。模型XML的專案部分應包含您要用於應用程式的結構，您可以在此處建立樹來保存資料。所有葉子都應包含一個字段類型來識別和驗證其內容。我們的應用程式的屬性清單可以轉換為：

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/HelloWorld/HelloWorld.xml

```
………
<items>
    <!-- container -->
    <general>
        <!-- fields -->
        <Enabled type="BooleanField">
            <default>1</default>
            <Required>Y</Required>
        </Enabled>
        <SMTPHost type="NetworkField">
            <Required>Y</Required>
        </SMTPHost>
        <FromEmail type="EmailField">
            <default>sample@example.com</default>
            <Required>Y</Required>
        </FromEmail>
        <ToEmail type="EmailField">
            <Required>Y</Required>
        </ToEmail>
        <Description type="TextField">
            <Required>Y</Required>
        </Description>
    </general>
</items>
………
```

All available field types can be found in the models/OPNsense/Base/FieldTypes directory. If specific field types support additional parameters, for example for validation, they should be registered in the model as well (just like the default tag in Enabled).

所有可用的欄位類型都可以在 models/OPNsense/Base/FieldTypes 目錄中找到。如果特定欄位類型支援其他參數（例如用於驗證），則它們也應該在模型中註冊（就像啟用中的預設標籤一樣）。

Tip

提示

Read more about field types in [Creating Models](#p-251).

有關字段類型的更多信息，請參閱[創建模型](#p-251)。

###### Presentation XML｜介紹XML

Create a presentation XML to feed your template

建立簡報 XML 來填滿您的模板

Because creating forms is one of the key assets of the system, we have build some easy to use wrappers to guide you through the process. First we create an XML file for the presentation, which defines fields to use and adds some information for your template to render. Create a file in your controller directory using the sub directory forms and name it general.xml. Next copy in the following content:

由於建立表單是系統的關鍵資產之一，因此我們建立了一些易於使用的包裝器來引導您完成整個過程。首先，我們為簡報建立一個 XML 文件，它定義要使用的欄位並添加一些供模板渲染的資訊。使用子目錄 forms 在控制器目錄中建立一個文件，並將其命名為 generic.xml。接下來複製以下內容：

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/forms/general.xml

```xml
<form>
    <field>
        <id>helloworld.general.Enabled</id>
        <label>enabled</label>
        <type>checkbox</type>
        <help>Enable this feature</help>
    </field>
    <field>
        <id>helloworld.general.SMTPHost</id>
        <label>SMTPHost</label>
        <type>text</type>
        <help><![CDATA[ip address of the mail host]]></help>
        <hint>choose a valid IPv4/v6 address</hint>
    </field>
    <field>
        <id>helloworld.general.FromEmail</id>
        <label>Email (from)</label>
        <type>text</type>
    </field>
    <field>
        <id>helloworld.general.ToEmail</id>
        <label>Email (to)</label>
        <type>text</type>
    </field>
    <field>
        <id>helloworld.general.Description</id>
        <label>Description</label>
        <type>text</type>
    </field>
 </form>
```

All items should contain at least an id (where to map data from/to), a type (how to display) and a label, which identifies it to the user. Optional you may add additional fields like help or mark features as being only for advanced users. (The Volt template defines which attributes are usable.)

所有項目都應至少包含一個 id（將資料對應到何處）、一個類型（如何顯示）和一個標籤，用於向使用者標識它。您可以選擇新增其他字段，例如協助或將功能標記為僅適用於進階使用者。 （Volt 模板定義了哪些屬性可用。）

Now we need to tell the controller to use this information and pass it to your template, so change the IndexController.php and add this line:

現在我們需要告訴控制器使用此資訊並將其傳遞給您的模板，因此請更改 IndexController.php 並添加以下行：

```
$this->view->generalForm = $this->getForm("general");
```

And we are ready to update the (Volt) template with this information. Let’s remove the “<h1>Hello World!</h1>” line and replace it with something like this:

我們準備使用此資訊更新 (Volt) 模板。讓我們刪除「<h1>Hello World！</h1>」行並將其替換為如下內容：

```
{{ partial("layout_partials/base_form",['fields':generalForm,'id':'frm_GeneralSettings'])}}
```

This tells the template system to add a form using the contents of generalForm and name it frm\_GeneralSettings in the HTML page. Based on a standard template part which is already part of the standard system, named base\_form.volt.

這告訴範本系統使用generalForm的內容新增一個表單，並在HTML頁面中將其命名為frm\_GeneralSettings。基於標準模板部件，該部件已經是標準系統的一部分，名為base\_form.volt。

When opening the page again it will render like this:

再次開啟頁面時，效果如下：

[![Template with fields without content](<../images/ced1cee3-HelloWorld_Template_no_content.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/HelloWorld_Template_no_content.png)

###### Create API calls｜建立 API 呼叫

Create API calls to retrieve and store data

建立 API 呼叫來檢索和儲存數據

The framework provides some helpful utilities to get and set data from and to the configuration XML by using your defined model. First step in binding your model to the system is to point the `SettingsController` to the model and teach it how it should return the data. For this we add two lines to the controller created earlier:

該框架提供了一些有用的實用程序，可使用您定義的模型從配置 XML 取得資料或向配置 XML 設定資料。將模型綁定到系統的第一步是將 `SettingsController` 指向模型並教它如何返回資料。為此，我們為先前建立的控制器新增兩行：

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/SettingsController.php

```php
 class SettingsController extends ApiMutableModelControllerBase
 {
     protected static $internalModelClass = 'OPNsense\HelloWorld\HelloWorld';
     protected static $internalModelName = 'helloworld';

     public function getAction()
     {
         $data = parent::getAction();
         $data[self::$internalModelName]['general']['%ToEmail'] = gettext('Enter recipient here');

         return $data;
     }
 }
```

Note

筆記

The `getAction()` function can add dynamic extra information to data fetches. When we get to fetching the data this will be further explained.

`getAction()`函數可以為資料獲取添加動態額外資訊。當我們開始獲取數據時，將進一步解釋這一點。

The `$internalModelClass` creates the model for you, so you don’t have to create one manually (and define get and set actions), `$internalModelName` names the response container.

`$internalModelClass` 為您建立模型，因此您不必手動建立模型（並定義 get 和 set 操作），`$internalModelName` 命名回應容器。

Similarly, we will do this for the `ServiceController` as well

同樣，我們也會對 `ServiceController` 執行此操作

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/SettingsController.php

```
 class ServiceController extends ApiMutableServiceControllerBase
 {
     protected static $internalServiceClass = 'OPNsense\HelloWorld\HelloWorld';
     protected static $internalServiceClass = 'helloworld';
 }
```

You can test the result (while logged in as root), by going to this address:

您可以透過造訪以下位址來測試結果（以 root 身分登入時）：

```
http[s]://<your ip>/api/helloworld/settings/get
```

Which will output a json structure in your browser like:

這將在瀏覽器中輸出一個 json 結構，如下所示：

```json
{
    "helloworld": {
        "general": {
        "Enabled": "1",
        "SMTPHost": "",
        "FromEmail": "sample@example.com",
        "ToEmail": "",
        "%ToEmail": "Enter recipient here",
        "Description": ""
        }
    }
}
```

Note

筆記

The outer container is named “helloworld” and contains all fields defined in the model.

外部容器名為“helloworld”，包含模型中定義的所有欄位。

Note

筆記

`ApiMutableModelControllerBase` contains more shared functionality for grid like operations as well, most of our api controllers use this as a base. When interested in the internals of the get action itself, search for `getAction` in `ApiMutableModelControllerBase.php`.

`ApiMutableModelControllerBase` 也包含更多類似網格操作的共享功能，我們的大多數 api 控制器都以此為基礎。如果對 get 操作本身的內部結構感興趣，請在 `ApiMutableModelControllerBase.php` 中搜尋 `getAction`。

Note

筆記

`%ToEmail` is similar to `<hint>Enter recipient here</hint>` except that it can be used to generate a dynamic hint during data fetch. Fields with a `%` prefix cannot be stored and are not relevant to the model data, but do refer to the respective field type without the prefix.

`%ToEmail` 與 `<hint>Enter recipient here</hint>` 類似，不同之處在於它可用於在資料擷取期間產生動態提示。帶有 `%` 前綴的字段無法存儲，並且與模型數據無關，但確實引用不帶前綴的相應字段類型。

###### Support jQuery API calls｜支援 jQuery API 調用

Update the view to support the API calls using jQuery

使用 jQuery 更新視圖以支援 API 調用

Now we need to link the events to the backend code to be able to load and save our form, by using the OPNsense libraries you can validate your data automatically.

現在我們需要將事件連結到後端程式碼，以便能夠載入和保存我們的表單，透過使用 OPNsense 庫，您可以自動驗證資料。

Add this to the index.volt template from the HelloWorld module:

將其新增至 HelloWorld 模組中的 index.volt 範本：

```html
<script type="text/javascript">
    $( document ).ready(function() {
        mapDataToFormUI({'frm_GeneralSettings':"/api/helloworld/settings/get"}).done(function(data){
            // place actions to run after load, for example update form styles.
        });

        // link save button to API set action
        $("#saveAct").click(function(){
            saveFormToEndpoint("/api/helloworld/settings/set",'frm_GeneralSettings',function(){
                // action to run after successful save, for example reconfigure service.
            });
        });
    });
</script>

<div class="col-md-12">
    <button class="btn btn-primary"  id="saveAct" type="button"><b>{{ lang._('Save') }}</b></button>
</div>
```

The first piece of javascript code handles the loading of data when opening the form, then a button is linked to the save event.

第一段 JavaScript 程式碼處理開啟表單時的資料加載，然後將按鈕連結到儲存事件。

Let’s give it a try and save our data, without modifying it first.

讓我們嘗試一下並保存我們的數據，而不先修改它。

[![Form with validation errors](<../images/e2509714-HelloWorld_form_validation_error.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/HelloWorld_form_validation_error.png)

Next correct the errors and save again, on successful save the data should be stored in the config.xml. If you want to change validation messages, just edit the model XML and add your message in the ValidationMessage tag. For example:

接下來更正錯誤並再次儲存，成功保存後資料應儲存在 config.xml 中。如果您想變更驗證訊息，只需編輯模型 XML 並將您的訊息新增至 ValidationMessage 標籤。例如：

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/HelloWorld/HelloWorld.xml

```xml
<ToEmail type="EmailField">
    <Required>Y</Required>
    <ValidationMessage>Please specify a valid email address.</ValidationMessage>
</ToEmail>
```

Changes the “Email address is invalid.” into “Please specify a valid email address.” when an invalid email address is provided. Since this field is required the validation message for an empty field will always be “A value is required.” instead.

更改“電子郵件地址無效”。進入「請指定有效的電子郵件地址」。當提供無效的電子郵件地址時。由於此欄位是必需的，因此空白欄位的驗證訊息將始終是「需要一個值」。反而。

###### Add actions｜新增操作

Add some activity to the module

在模組中添加一些活動

Our basic module provides a way to read and modify configuration data using the web interface (and in time also other consumers using the api). Next step is to add some activity to our system, all backend applications should use their own configuration, which in real life we would keep as standard as possible.

我們的基本模組提供了一種使用 Web 介面（以及其他使用 API 的消費者）讀取和修改配置資料的方法。下一步是為我們的系統添加一些活動，所有後端應用程式都應該使用自己的配置，在現實生活中我們將盡可能保持標準。

For our example we will follow the same process as for any other service and start writing some configuration data for our sample application. Which means, creating a template and hooking it into our save action.

對於我們的範例，我們將遵循與任何其他服務相同的流程，並開始為我們的範例應用程式編寫一些配置資料。這意味著，建立一個範本並將其掛接到我們的保存操作中。

Our example will write a simple configuration file, stored in /usr/local/etc/helloworld/helloworld.conf

我們的範例將編寫一個簡單的設定文件，儲存在 /usr/local/etc/helloworld/helloworld.conf 中

The configd system is responsible for updating the contents of that file when requested, it does so by using a definition found in its template folder. This sample will use the following path to store the backend templates:

configd 系統負責在請求時更新該檔案的內容，它透過使用其範本資料夾中的定義來執行此操作。本範例將使用以下路徑來儲存後端範本：

```
/usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/HelloWorld/
```

First we add a content definition, by creating a file named +TARGETS, which should hold the following information:

首先，我們透過建立名為 +TARGETS 的檔案來新增內容定義，該檔案應包含以下資訊：

```
helloworld.conf:/usr/local/etc/helloworld/helloworld.conf
```

This basically tells the engine that there will be a file in the same folder named “helloworld.conf” which provides, together with config.xml, data for the file in /usr/local/etc/helloworld/helloworld.conf

這基本上告訴引擎在同一資料夾中將有一個名為“helloworld.conf”的文件，該文件與 config.xml 一起提供 /usr/local/etc/helloworld/helloworld.conf 中文件的數據

Next thing to do is create that helloworld.conf file in the templates directory. We will keep things very simple for this one and just copy in our data into an ini file structured configuration, when the module is enabled.

接下來要做的就是在 templates 目錄中建立 helloworld.conf 檔案。對於這一點，我們將保持事情非常簡單，只需在啟用模組時將資料複製到 ini 檔案結構化配置中即可。

/usr/local/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/HelloWorld/helloworld.conf

```
{% if not helpers.empty('OPNsense.helloworld.general.Enabled') %}
[general]
SMTPHost={{ OPNsense.helloworld.general.SMTPHost|default("") }}
FromEmail={{ OPNsense.helloworld.general.FromEmail|default("") }}
ToEmail={{ OPNsense.helloworld.general.ToEmail|default("") }}
Subject={{ OPNsense.helloworld.general.Description|default("") }}
{% endif %}
```

Now we need to be able to reload this module (or in real life, this would probably be a service) by adding a service action into our ServiceController. Edit controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/ServiceController.php and add the backend module to the use section, like this:

現在我們需要能夠透過將服務操作新增至我們的 ServiceController 中來重新載入此模組（或者在現實生活中，這可能是一個服務）。編輯controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/ServiceController.php並將後端模組加入到use部分，如下所示：

```
use \OPNsense\Core\Backend;
```

By doing this we can use the backend communication in this class. Next add a new action to the class called “reloadAction” using this piece of code:

透過這樣做，我們可以在這個類別中使用後端通訊。接下來使用這段程式碼為名為「reloadAction」的類別新增一個新動作：

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/ServiceController.php

```php
public function reloadAction()
{
    $status = "failed";
    if ($this->request->isPost()) {
        $status = strtolower(trim((new Backend())->configdRun('template reload OPNsense/HelloWorld')));
    }
    return ["status" => $status];
}
```

This validates the type of action (it should always be POST to enable CSRF protection) and adds a backend action for reloading the template. When successful the action will return “status”:”ok” as json object back to the client.

這將驗證操作類型（應始終為POST以啟用CSRF保護）並新增用於重新載入範本的後端操作。成功後，該操作會將「status」:「ok」作為 json 物件傳回給客戶端。

Now we are able to refresh the template content, but the user interface doesn’t know about it yet. To hook loading of the template into the save action, we will go back to the index.volt view and add the following jQuery / framework code between the braces of “saveFormToEndPoint”.

現在我們可以刷新模板內容，但使用者介面還不知道這一點。要將範本載入掛鉤到儲存作業中，我們將返回 index.volt 視圖並在「saveFormToEndPoint」的大括號之間新增下列 jQuery/框架程式碼。

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/views/OPNsense/HelloWorld/index.volt

```
ajaxCall(url="/api/helloworld/service/reload", sendData={},callback=function(data,status) {
    // action to run after reload
});
```

If you save the form now (when enabled), you should see a new file in

如果您現在儲存表單（啟用後），您應該會在以下位置看到一個新文件

```
helloworld.conf:/usr/local/etc/helloworld/helloworld.conf
```

Containing something like this:

包含這樣的內容：

```
[general]
SMTPHost=127.0.0.1
FromEmail=sample@example.com
ToEmail=sample@example.com
Subject=test
```

What have we accomplished now, we can input data, validate it and save it to the corresponding format of the actual service or application, which uses this data. So if you have a third party application, which you want to integrate into the user interface. You should be able to generate what it needs now. (There’s more to learn, but these are the basics).

現在我們已經完成了，我們可以輸入數據，驗證它並將其保存為使用該數據的實際服務或應用程式的相應格式。因此，如果您有第三方應用程序，您想將其整合到用戶介面中。您現在應該能夠產生它所需的內容。 （還有更多東西要學習，但這些是基礎知識）。

But how do should we control that third part program now? That’s the next step.

但是我們現在應該如何控制第三方程式呢？這是下一步。

##### Controlling the sample｜控制樣品

Instead of running all kinds of shell commands directly from the PHP code, which very often need root access (starting/stopping services, etc.), we should always communicate to our backend process which holds templates of possible things to run and protects your system from executing arbitrary commands.

我們不應該直接從 PHP 程式碼運行各種 shell 命令，這些命令通常需要 root 存取權限（啟動/停止服務等），而應該始終與後端進程通信，該進程保存可能要運行的內容的模板，並保護您的系統免於執行任意命令。

Another advantage of this approach is that all commands defined here, can also be ran from the command line of the firewall providing easier serviceability. For example, the command to refresh the helloworld configuration can be run from the command line by running:

這種方法的另一個優點是，此處定義的所有命令也可以從防火牆的命令列運行，從而提供更輕鬆的可維護性。例如，可以透過執行以下命令從命令列執行刷新 helloworld 配置的命令：

```
configctl template reload OPNsense/HelloWorld
```

First thing to do when registering new actions to the system for a new application is to create a config template.

為新應用程式向系統註冊新操作時要做的第一件事是建立配置範本。

```
/usr/local/opnsense/service/conf/actions.d/actions_helloworld.conf
```

And add a command to the template like this:

並在模板上新增一個命令，如下所示：

```yaml
[test]
command:/usr/local/opnsense/scripts/helloworld/testConnection.py
parameters:
type:script_output
message:hello world module test
```

Let’s test our new command by restarting configd from the command line:

讓我們透過從命令列重新啟動 configd 來測試我們的新命令：

```
service configd restart
```

And test our new command using:

並使用以下命令測試我們的新命令：

```
configctl helloworld test
```

Which should return some response in json format.

它應該會傳回一些 json 格式的回應。

Next step is to use this command in our controller (middleware), just like we did with the template action. For consistency we call our action testAction and let it pass json data to our clients when using a POST type request.

下一步是在我們的控制器（中間件）中使用此命令，就像我們對模板操作所做的那樣。為了保持一致性，我們將操作稱為 testAction，並讓它在使用 POST 類型請求時將 json 資料傳遞給我們的客戶端。

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/ServiceController.php

```php
public function testAction()
{
    if ($this->request->isPost()) {
        $bckresult = json_decode(trim((new Backend())->configdRun("helloworld test")), true);
        if ($bckresult !== null) {
            // only return valid json type responses
            return $bckresult;
        }
    }
    return ["message" => "unable to run config action"];
}
```

And now we can make our user interface aware of the action, place a button and link an action in the index.volt. Using the following elements:

現在我們可以讓我們的使用者介面了解該操作，放置一個按鈕並在index.volt 中連結一個操作。使用以下元素：

  

(in script section)

（在腳本部分）

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/views/OPNsense/HelloWorld/index.volt

```
$("#testAct").SimpleActionButton({
    onAction: function(data) {
        $("#responseMsg").removeClass("hidden").html(data['message']);
    }
});
```

(in HTML section)

（HTML部分）

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/views/OPNsense/HelloWorld/index.volt

```html
<div class="alert alert-info hidden" role="alert" id="responseMsg">

</div>
<button class="btn btn-primary" id="testAct" data-endpoint="/api/helloworld/service/test" data-label="{{ lang._('Test') }}"></button>
```

Tip

提示

As you might have noticed the `testAct` button uses a different method to call an endpoint, it uses the [SimpleActionButton](#p-261) wrapper which eases the implementation of simple actions

您可能已經注意到 `testAct` 按鈕使用不同的方法來呼叫端點，它使用 [SimpleActionButton](#p-261) 包裝器，可以簡化簡單操作的實現

Now go back to the page and save some data using the save button, next press test to see some results.

現在返回頁面並使用儲存按鈕儲存一些數據，然後按測試查看一些結果。

[![test the application action](<../images/2756af97-HelloWorld_first_test_action.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/HelloWorld_first_test_action.png)

##### Multi language / Translations｜多語言/翻譯

OPNsense is available in may different languages like english, german or japanese. This works because we are using the gettext library which is available to all GUI components. While the XML based user interfaces are supporting it automatically, there may still the need to call it manually (buttons, tabs etc.).

OPNsense 有多種語言版本，例如英語、德語或日語。這是可行的，因為我們使用的是所有 GUI 元件都可用的 gettext 函式庫。雖然基於 XML 的使用者介面自動支援它，但可能仍需要手動呼叫它（按鈕、選項卡等）。

If you have a static string, you should add it like this into a classic PHP page:

如果你有一個靜態字串，你應該像這樣將它添加到經典的PHP頁面中：

```
<?= gettext('your string here') ?>
```

And this way into a volt template:

這樣就進入了伏特模板：

```
{{ lang._('your string here') }}
```

If your string is not only plaintext because it contains non-static words, HTML tags and other dynamic content, you need to use a format string. This way, you can use placeholders for such elements which should not land in the translation file.

如果您的字串不僅僅是純文本，因為它包含非靜態單字、HTML標籤和其他動態內容，則需要使用格式字串。這樣，您可以對不應出現在翻譯檔案中的元素使用佔位符。

For php it works this way:

對於 php 來說，它是這樣運作的：

```
<?= sprintf(gettext('your %s here'), $data) ?>
```

And for volt templates it works this way:

對於伏特模板，它的工作方式如下：

```
{{ lang._('your %s here') | format(data) }}
```

Note

筆記

You should NEVER split strings which should belong together like a sentence. This makes plugins hard to translate and will decrease the quality of OPNsense in other languages.

您應該 NEVER 拆分應該像句子一樣屬於在一起的字串。這使得插件難以翻譯，並且會降低 OPNsense 在其他語言中的品質。

##### Plugin to the menu system｜選單系統插件

Most modules and applications need a place in the menu system, you could easily arrange that by creating a Menu.xml definition for your module in the model directory under Menu/Menu.xml.

大多數模組和應用程式都需要在選單系統中佔有一席之地，您可以透過在 Menu/Menu.xml 下的模型目錄中為模組建立 Menu.xml 定義來輕鬆安排這一點。

Now let’s register our “hello world” in the user section of our menu, by adding this content into the Menu.xml:

現在讓我們在選單的使用者部分註冊“hello world”，將此內容新增到 Menu.xml 中：

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Menu/Menu.xml

```xml
<menu>
    <Lobby>
        <HelloWorld VisibleName="Hello World!" cssClass="fa fa-comment-o fa-fw" url="/ui/helloworld"/>
    </Lobby>
</menu>
```

The menu system is subject to caching, so you may not see your changes in the UI yet. Delete the `/tmp/opnsense_menu_cache.xml` file, if it exists. Now, when you refresh your page, you should notice the menu system automatically picks up the new information.

選單系統受快取影響，因此您可能還看不到UI中的變更。刪除 `/tmp/opnsense_menu_cache.xml` 檔案（如果存在）。現在，當您刷新頁面時，您應該注意到選單系統會自動獲取新資訊。

[![menu registration](<../images/bca19158-HelloWorld_menu_registration.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/HelloWorld_menu_registration.png)

##### Plugin to access control (ACL)｜存取控制插件 (ACL)

If we want to authorize users to access this module, we can add an ACL to this module. Without it, only admin users can access it. Create an XML file in the model directory name ACL/ACL.xml and place the following content in it:

如果我們想要授權使用者存取這個模組，我們可以在這個模組中新增一個ACL。沒有它，只有管理員使用者可以存取它。在模型目錄下建立一個XML文件，名稱為ACL/ACL.xml，並在其中放置以下內容：

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/HelloWorld/ACL/ACL.xml

```xml
<acl>
    <!-- unique acl key, must be globally unique for all ACLs  -->
    <page-user-helloworld>
        <name>WebCfg - Users: Hello World! </name>
        <description>Allow access to the Hello World! module</description>
        <patterns>
            <pattern>ui/helloworld/*</pattern>
            <pattern>api/helloworld/*</pattern>
        </patterns>
    </page-user-helloworld>
</acl>
```

This creates an ACL key named “page-user-helloworld” which authorizes access to both the ui and API urls of this application. You can now grant access to this module from the system user manager.

這將建立一個名為「page-user-helloworld」的 ACL 鍵，該鍵授權存取該應用程式的 ui 和 API url。現在您可以從系統使用者管理員授予對此模組的存取權限。

The ACL system is subject to caching, so you may not see your changes in the user manager page yet. Delete the `/tmp/opnsense_acl_cache.json` file, if it exists. Now, when you refresh the user manager page, you should see that the new ACL is available to be assigned.

ACL系統受快取影響，因此您可能還看不到使用者管理員頁面中的變更。刪除 `/tmp/opnsense_acl_cache.json` 檔案（如果存在）。現在，當您重新整理使用者管理員頁面時，您應該會看到新的ACL可以指派。

##### Create an installable plugin｜創建可安裝的插件

All files are created in their original locations (on the OPNsense machine /usr/local/…), now we are ready to create a package from them. To fully use this process and create the actual package, it’s best to setup a full build environment (explained over here: [https://github.com/opnsense/tools](https://github.com/opnsense/tools) )

所有文件都在其原始位置創建（在 OPNsense 計算機 /usr/local/... 上），現在我們準備從它們創建包。要充分使用此過程並創建實際的包，最好設定一個完整的建置環境（此處解釋：[https://github.com/opnsense/tools](https://github.com/opnsense/tools)）

When everything is in place, we will create a new plugin directory. For this example we will use the following:

當一切就位後，我們將建立一個新的插件目錄。對於此範例，我們將使用以下內容：

```
/usr/plugins/devel/helloworld/
```

Add a new Makefile, containing the information for our plugin:

新增一個新的 Makefile，其中包含我們插件的資訊：

```
PLUGIN_NAME=     helloworld
PLUGIN_VERSION=        1.0
PLUGIN_COMMENT=        A sample framework application
#PLUGIN_DEPENDS=
PLUGIN_MAINTAINER= user@domain

.include "../../Mk/plugins.mk"
```

  

Then create an src directory in here:

然後在這裡建立一個 src 目錄：

```
/usr/plugins/devel/helloworld/src/
```

Next copy all files created and located in /usr/local/ into this new src directory, which results in the following file listing:

接下來，將 /usr/local/ 中建立並位於的所有檔案複製到這個新的 src 目錄中，這將產生以下檔案清單：

```
src/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/ServiceController.php
src/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/SettingsController.php
src/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/IndexController.php
src/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/forms/general.xml
src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/HelloWorld/ACL/ACL.xml
src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/HelloWorld/HelloWorld.php
src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/HelloWorld/HelloWorld.xml
src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Menu/Menu.xml
src/opnsense/mvc/app/views/OPNsense/HelloWorld/index.volt
src/opnsense/scripts/helloworld/testConnection.py
src/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/HelloWorld/+TARGETS
src/opnsense/service/templates/OPNsense/HelloWorld/helloworld.conf
src/opnsense/service/conf/actions.d/actions_helloworld.conf
```

With everything in place, you could build the plugin package using the “make plugins” command in the /usr/tools directory. The result of this will be a standard pkg package, which you can install on any OPNsense system and will be usable right after installing. All plugins are prefixed with os-, our new package file will be called:

一切就緒後，您可以使用 /usr/tools 目錄中的“make plugins”命令建立插件包。其結果將是一個標準的 pkg 軟體包，您可以將其安裝在任何 OPNsense 系統上，並且在安裝後即可使用。所有插件都以 os- 為前綴，我們的新套件檔案將被呼叫：

```
os-helloworld-1.0.txz
```

(-1.0 comes from the version in the makefile)

(-1.0來自makefile中的版本)

Reference

參考

-   source of this example : [https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/tree/master/devel/helloworld](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/tree/master/devel/helloworld)  
    此範例的來源：[https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/tree/master/devel/helloworld](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/tree/master/devel/helloworld)

    實用前端開發：[https://github.com/opnsense/ui\_devtools](https://github.com/opnsense/ui_devtools)

<a id="p-367"></a>

#### Using grids module & plugin｜使用網格模組和插件

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/examples/using_grids.html>

Creating grid enabled forms

建立啟用網格的表單

[![../../_images/grid-sample.png](<../images/e6b9bb05-grid-sample.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/grid-sample.png)

##### Goal｜目標

The purpose of this example is to show how to build data grids in OPNsense, using the various components within our framework.

此範例的目的是展示如何使用我們框架內的各種元件在 OPNsense 中建立資料網格。

If you haven’t read the HelloWorld example yet, we advise you to start there. This example assumes you already know the basics.

如果您還沒有閱讀 HelloWorld 範例，我們建議您從這裡開始。此範例假設您已經了解基礎知識。

Our topic of choice for this module is a basic list for email addresses, for which you should be able to add, remove and change items.

我們為此模組選擇的主題是電子郵件地址的基本列表，您應該能夠新增、刪除和變更項目。

In-depth documentation for the grid system can be found in [UIBootgrid](#p-262).

網格系統的深入文件可以在 [UIBootgrid](#p-262) 中找到。

##### Model｜型號

Our example starts with a model, which is constructed by creating a php class deriving from `BaseModel` and an XML file containing the actual model definition.

我們的範例從一個模型開始，該模型是透過建立一個派生自 `BaseModel` 的 php 類別和一個包含實際模型定義的 XML 檔案來建構的。

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/GridExample/GridExample.php

```php
<?php
namespace OPNsense\GridExample;

use OPNsense\Base\BaseModel;

class GridExample extends BaseModel
{
}
```

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/GridExample/GridExample.xml

```xml
<model>
    <mount>//OPNsense/GridExample</mount>
    <description>
        the OPNsense "GridExample" application
    </description>
    <items>
        <addresses>
            <address type="ArrayField">
                <enabled type="BooleanField">
                    <default>1</default>
                    <Required>Y</Required>
                </enabled>
                <email type="EmailField">
                    <Required>Y</Required>
                </email>
                <schedule type="OptionField">
                    <Default>wly</Default>
                    <Required>Y</Required>
                    <OptionValues>
                        <dly>Daily</dly>
                        <wly>Weekly</wly>
                        <mly>Monthly</mly>
                    </OptionValues>
                </schedule>
                <description type="DescriptionField"/>
            </address>
        </addresses>
    </items>
</model>
```

Note the `ArrayField` type in the XML, this is a special field type for nested items in automatically includes an internal uuid for easy referencing when written to disk. Both other field types are also used in the HelloWorld example earlier. All the preinstalled types can be found in our field type directory on [GitHub](https://github.com/opnsense/core/tree/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Base/FieldTypes).

請注意 XML 中的 `ArrayField` 類型，這是嵌套項目的特殊字段類型，自動包含內部 uuid，以便在寫入磁碟時輕鬆引用。前面的 HelloWorld 範例中也使用了其他兩種欄位類型。所有預先安裝的類型都可以在 [GitHub](https://github.com/opnsense/core/tree/master/src/opnsense/mvc/app/models/OPNsense/Base/FieldTypes) 上的欄位類型目錄中找到。

##### API controller｜API控制器

The `ApiMutableModelControllerBase` class supports most model manipulations, all `*Base` methods embody shared functionality to operate on either new or existing model items.

`ApiMutableModelControllerBase`類別支援大多數模型操作，所有`*Base`方法都體現了對新的或現有的模型項進行操作的共享功能。

Our example below uses the base methods to link all operations we need and link them on endpoints ending at `Item`:

下面的範例使用基本方法來連結我們需要的所有操作，並將它們連結到以 `Item` 結尾的端點上：

-   searchItemAction, queries the items in your configuration  
    searchItemAction，查詢配置中的項目
    
-   getItemAction, fetches an existing record (or returns a blank one with all defaults)  
    getItemAction，取得現有記錄（或傳回具有所有預設值的空白記錄）
    
-   addItemAction, add a new record  
    addItemAction，新增一筆新記錄
    
-   setItemAction, update a record  
    setItemAction，更新一筆記錄
    
-   delItemAction, delete a record  
    delItemAction，刪除一筆記錄
    
-   toggleItemAction, toggle \[0|1\] the “enabled” property (see the enabled `BooleanField` in the model)  
    toggleItemAction，切換\[0|1\]「enabled」屬性（請參閱模型中啟用的`BooleanField`）
    

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/GridExample/Api/SettingsController.php

```php
namespace OPNsense\GridExample\Api;

use \OPNsense\Base\ApiMutableModelControllerBase;

class SettingsController extends ApiMutableModelControllerBase
{
    protected static $internalModelName = 'gridexample';
    protected static $internalModelClass = 'OPNsense\GridExample\GridExample';

    public function searchItemAction()
    {
        return $this->searchBase("addresses.address", null, "email");
    }

    public function setItemAction($uuid)
    {
        return $this->setBase("address", "addresses.address", $uuid);
    }

    public function addItemAction()
    {
        return $this->addBase("address", "addresses.address");
    }

    public function getItemAction($uuid = null)
    {
        return $this->getBase("address", "addresses.address", $uuid);
    }

    public function delItemAction($uuid)
    {
        return $this->delBase("addresses.address", $uuid);
    }

    public function toggleItemAction($uuid, $enabled = null)
    {
        return $this->toggleBase("addresses.address", $uuid, $enabled);
    }
}
```

The parameters of all methods contain at least the root of the `ArrayField` type you want to operate on and in cases the action involves form data the name of the root property used as in the container to transport data in.

所有方法的參數至少包含您想要操作的 `ArrayField` 類型的根，並且在操作涉及表單資料的情況下，根屬性的名稱用作容器中傳輸資料的名稱。

For example, a getItem (/api/gridexample/settings/getItem/my-uuid-id) would return a response like this (highlighted the container):

例如， getItem (/api/gridexample/settings/getItem/my-uuid-id) 將傳回如下回應（反白容器）：

```
{
  "address": {
    "enabled": "1",
    "email": "test@example.com"
    "description": "Test Address"
  }
}
```

##### Define dialog items｜定義對話框項目

To edit the data we define which fields should be presented to the user and how they are formatted. Below a simple layout, the id fields reference the actual data points to map (`address.enabled` for example), which is exactly what the api endpoint returns.

為了編輯數據，我們定義應向使用者呈現哪些欄位以及它們的格式。在簡單的佈局下，id 欄位引用要對應的實際資料點（例如`address.enabled`），這正是 api 端點傳回的內容。

For the grid creation, the same form will also create columns for each field id. The grid column formatting can be controlled via the `grid_view` tag. Inside this tag, we can define `width`, `type`, `formatter`, `sequence`, `visible`, `ignore` and other tags.

對於網格創建，相同的表單也會為每個欄位 id 建立列。網格列格式可以透過 `grid_view` 標籤控制。在這個標籤內，我們可以定義`width`, `type`, `formatter`, `sequence`, `visible`, `ignore`和其他標籤。

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/GridExample/forms/dialogAddress.xml

```xml
<form>
    <field>
        <id>address.enabled</id>
        <label>Enabled</label>
        <type>checkbox</type>
        <help>Enable this address.</help>
        <grid_view>
            <width>6em</width>
            <type>boolean</type>
            <formatter>rowtoggle</formatter>
        </grid_view>
    </field>
    <field>
        <id>address.email</id>
        <label>Email</label>
        <type>text</type>
        <help>Enter the email address.</help>
    </field>
    <field>
        <id>address.schedule</id>
        <label>Schedule</label>
        <type>dropdown</type>
        <help>Select your preferred schedule.</help>
    </field>
    <field>
        <id>address.description</id>
        <label>Description</label>
        <type>text</type>
        <help>Enter an optional description.</help>
        <grid_view>
            <visible>false</visible>
        </grid_view>
    </field>
</form>
```

##### UI controller｜UI控制器

The user interface controller sets the template (view) to use and collects the dialog form and grid properties from the xml file defined earlier.

使用者介面控制器設定要使用的範本（視圖），並從先前定義的 xml 檔案中收集對話方塊表單和網格屬性。

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/GridExample/IndexController.php

```php
namespace OPNsense\GridExample;

class IndexController extends \OPNsense\Base\IndexController
{
    public function indexAction()
    {
        $this->view->pick('OPNsense/GridExample/index');
        $this->view->formDialogAddress = $this->getForm("dialogAddress");
        $this->view->formGridAddress = $this->getFormGrid("dialogAddress");
    }
}
```

##### Constructing the volt template｜建構 volt 模板

We ship a generic grid system as documented in [UIBootgrid](#p-262). To use this in our template (view), we define three different blocks.

我們提供了一個通用網格系統，如 [UIBootgrid](#p-262) 中所述。為了在我們的模板（視圖）中使用它，我們定義了三個不同的區塊。

First of all we bind a table by id `{{formGridAddress['table_id']}}` using `UIBootgrid()`. Then we define the table which will be changed into a dynamic searchable grid and we link our dialog content. Both grid (base\_bootgrid\_table) and dialog (base\_dialog) use a volt `partial()`.

首先，我們使用 `UIBootgrid()` 透過 id `{{formGridAddress['table_id']}}` 綁定一個表。然後我們定義將被變更為動態可搜尋網格的表格，並連結我們的對話方塊內容。網格（base\_bootgrid\_table）和對話框（base\_dialog）都使用伏特`partial()`。

The basic “UIBootgrid” bind connects all actions which we have defined in our API controller earlier, there are more options available, but these are not needed for this use-case.

基本的 “UIBootgrid” 綁定連接我們之前在 API 控制器中定義的所有操作，還有更多可用選項，但此用例不需要這些。

Our edit dialog is being written in advance so the javascript code can open the statically defined form when needed, the last highlighted block takes care of this. The partial uses three argument, the variable connected via the controller containing all form entries, the name (id) of the form `'id':formGridAddress['edit_dialog_id']`, which is referenced in the table `{{formGridAddress['table_id']}}`, and finally the caption of the dialog.

我們的編輯對話方塊是事先編寫的，因此 JavaScript 程式碼可以在需要時開啟靜態定義的表單，最後突出顯示的區塊負責處理此問題。此部分使用三個參數，透過包含所有表單條目的控制器連接的變量，表單`'id':formGridAddress['edit_dialog_id']`的名稱（id）（在表`{{formGridAddress['table_id']}}`中引用），最後是對話框的標題。

To apply changes, there is a (base\_apply\_button) volt `partial()` which calls a reconfigure API endpoint. The event listener is attached to SimpleActionButton(), a shared javascript function for most reconfiguration use cases.

要應用更改，有一個（base\_apply\_button）電壓`partial()`，它呼叫重新配置API端點。事件偵聽器附加到 SimpleActionButton()，這是一個適用於大多數重新配置用例的共用 JavaScript 函數。

Whenever a change in the grid is performed, the (base\_apply\_button) will automatically show a data change dialog.

每當在網格中執行變更時，（base\_apply\_button）將自動顯示資料變更對話方塊。

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/views/OPNsense/GridExample/index.volt

```html
<script>
    $(document).ready(function() {
        $("#{{formGridAddress['table_id']}}").UIBootgrid(
            {   search:'/api/gridexample/settings/search_item/',
                get:'/api/gridexample/settings/get_item/',
                set:'/api/gridexample/settings/set_item/',
                add:'/api/gridexample/settings/add_item/',
                del:'/api/gridexample/settings/del_item/',
                toggle:'/api/gridexample/settings/toggle_item/'
            }
        );

        $("#reconfigureAct").SimpleActionButton();
    });

</script>

<div class="content-box">
    {{ partial('layout_partials/base_bootgrid_table', formGridAddress) }}
</div>
{{ partial('layout_partials/base_apply_button', {'data_endpoint': '/api/gridexample/service/reconfigure'}) }}
{{ partial("layout_partials/base_dialog",['fields':formDialogAddress,'id':formGridAddress['edit_dialog_id'],'label':lang._('Edit address')])}}
```

##### Service controller｜服務控制器

The service controller in this example is a stub and generates a generic status response when calling `/api/gridexample/service/reconfigure` via the SimpleActionButton().

此範例中的服務控制器是一個存根，並在透過 SimpleActionButton() 呼叫 `/api/gridexample/service/reconfigure` 時產生通用狀態回應。

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/GridExample/Api/ServiceController.php

```php
namespace OPNsense\GridExample\Api;

use OPNsense\Base\ApiControllerBase;

class ServiceController extends ApiControllerBase
{
    public function reconfigureAction()
    {
        sleep(1);
        return ["status" => "ok"];
    }
}
```

##### Menu and ACL｜菜單和ACL

The sample package on [GitHub](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/tree/master/devel/grid_example) also contains a menu definition (xml) and ACL (xml), which are similar to the ones explained in the hello world example.

[GitHub](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/tree/master/devel/grid_example)上的範例套件還包含選單定義（xml）和ACL（xml），與hello world範例中解釋的類似。

##### Test drive your app｜測試驅動您的應用程式

Now go to http\[s\]://your.host/ui/gridexample and try it out.

現在到 http\[s\]://your.host/ui/gridexample 並嘗試一下。

[![../../_images/grid-test-drive.png](<../images/cad3b5fe-grid-test-drive.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/grid-test-drive.png)

<a id="p-368"></a>

#### API enable standard services｜API啟用標準服務

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/examples/api_enable_services.html>

OPNsense contains a simple wrapper which handles standard service actions like starting and stopping services. For this example, we assume the HelloWorld example is created and the model exists.

OPNsense 包含一個簡單的包裝器，用於處理標準服務作業，例如啟動和停止服務。對於此範例，我們假設已建立 HelloWorld 範例且模型存在。

##### Prerequisites｜先決條件

The HelloWorld example forms the basis for this one, please make sure you read and try it first before starting with this one.

HelloWorld 範例構成了本範例的基礎，請確保在開始本範例之前先閱讀並嘗試。

##### Configd actions｜配置動作

Since the example didn’t contain a service, we’re going to extend the configd template first. Edit `/usr/local/opnsense/service/conf/actions.d/actions_helloworld.conf` and expand with the following sections:

由於該範例不包含服務，因此我們將首先擴展 configd 模板。編輯 `/usr/local/opnsense/service/conf/actions.d/actions_helloworld.conf` 並擴充以下部分：

```yaml
[start]
command:exit 0
parameters:
type:script
message:hello world service start

[stop]
command:exit 0
parameters:
type:script
message:hello world service stop

[restart]
command:exit 0
parameters:
type:script
message:hello world service restart

[reload]
command:exit 0
parameters:
type:script
message:hello world service restart

[status]
command: echo "hello world is running"
parameters:
type:script_output
message:hello world service status
```

Next restart configd using `service configd restart` and test these new calls using the following commands

接下來使用 `service configd restart` 重新啟動 configd 並使用以下命令測試這些新調用

```
# configctl helloworld start
OK
# configctl helloworld stop
OK
# configctl helloworld status
hello world is running
# configctl helloworld restart
OK
```

Our template only simulates a service, it doesn’t actually do anything (`exit 0`).

我們的模板只是模擬一個服務，它實際上並沒有做任何事情（`exit 0`）。

##### Update the service controller｜更新服務控制器

Next we change the existing controller to use `ApiMutableServiceControllerBase`, which links the existing model to the service callouts defined. The `testAction` used in the HelloWorld example is left out to avoid confusion.

接下來，我們將現有控制器更改為使用`ApiMutableServiceControllerBase`，它將現有模型連結到定義的服務標註。 HelloWorld 範例中使用的 `testAction` 被省略以避免混淆。

/usr/local/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/HelloWorld/Api/ServiceController.php

```php
use OPNsense\Base\ApiMutableServiceControllerBase;

class ServiceController extends ApiMutableServiceControllerBase
{
    protected static $internalServiceClass = '\OPNsense\HelloWorld\HelloWorld';
    protected static $internalServiceTemplate = 'OPNsense/HelloWorld';
    protected static $internalServiceEnabled = 'general.enabled';
    protected static $internalServiceName = 'helloworld';

    protected function reconfigureForceRestart()
    {
        return 0;
    }
}
```

The service above defines the following static variables:

上面的服務定義了以下靜態變數：

-   $internalServiceClass
    
    -   reference the model class, which is used to determine if this service is enabled (links the model to the service)  
        引用模型類，用於確定是否啟用此服務（將模型連結到服務）
        
    
-   $internalServiceTemplate
    
    -   before starting the service it will call configd to generate configuration data, in this case it would execute the equivalent of `configctl template reload OPNsense/HelloWorld` on the console  
        在啟動服務之前，它將呼叫 configd 來產生配置數據，在這種情況下，它將在控制台上執行相當於 `configctl template reload OPNsense/HelloWorld` 的操作
        
    
-   $internalServiceEnabled
    
    -   Which section of the model contains a boolean defining if the service is enabled (general.enabled)  
        模型的哪個部分包含定義服務是否啟用的布林值 (general.enabled)
        
    
-   $internalServiceName
    
    -   refers to the action template, where it can find start/stop/restart/status/reload actions (actions\_helloworld.conf)  
        指操作模板，可以在其中找到啟動/停止/重新啟動/狀態/重新載入操作（actions\_helloworld.conf）
        
    

The `reconfigureForceRestart` overwrite tells the controller if it should always stop the service before trying a start, some services can be signaled to do a reconfigure without stopping.

`reconfigureForceRestart`覆蓋告訴控制器是否應該在嘗試啟動之前始終停止服務，可以向某些服務發出信號以在不停止的情況下進行重新配置。

Tip

提示

When a service may register new [interfaces](#p-248), one could implement the protected method `invokeInterfaceRegistration` and make it return `true`, after which the plugin system will detect changes to the interface registrations automatically.

當服務可能註冊新的[介面](#p-248)時，可以實現受保護的方法`invokeInterfaceRegistration`並使其返回`true`，之後插件系統將自動偵測介面註冊的變更。

##### Endpoints｜端點

When deploying this controller into the HelloWorld module it would expose the following endpoints

將此控制器部署到 HelloWorld 模組中時，它將公開以下端點

| Method<br>方法 | Endpoint<br>端點 |
| --- | --- |
| `POST` | /api/helloworld/service/stop |
| `POST` | /api/helloworld/service/start |

| `POST` | /api/helloworld/service/start | /api/helloworld/service/start |
| `POST` | /api/helloworld/service/restart |
| `POST` | /api/helloworld/service/reconfigure<br>/api/helloworld/service/重新設定 |
| `GET` | /api/helloworld/service/status<br>/api/helloworld/服務/狀態 |

<a id="p-370"></a>

#### Use the API｜使用API

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/how-tos/api.html>

##### [Use the API](#p-370)｜[使用API](#p-370)

Index

索引
