##### [Overview](#p-370)｜[概述](#p-370)

All components that are using the full architecture of OPNsense automatically receive API capabilities, for this simple tutorial we use the firmware module but others will function in the same way. API access is part of the local user authentication system, but uses key/secret pairs to separate account information from machine to machine communication. Secrets are not stored on OPNsense and can be downloaded only once, if lost, a new key has to be generated for your application.

使用 OPNsense 完整架構的所有元件都會自動接收 API 功能，在這個簡單的教學中，我們使用韌體模組，但其他元件將以相同的方式運作。 API 存取是本機使用者驗證系統的一部分，但使用金鑰/秘密對將帳戶資訊與機器到機器通訊分開。秘密不會儲存在 OPNsense 上，只能下載一次，如果遺失，則必須為您的應用程式產生新金鑰。

A user can have multiple keys, our advice is to create a unique key for every application in use.

使用者可以擁有多個金鑰，我們的建議是為每個使用的應用程式建立一個唯一的金鑰。

##### [Creating keys](#p-370)｜[建立金鑰](#p-370)

API keys are managed in the user manager (system\_usermanager.php), go to the user manager page and select a user. Somewhere down the page you will find the API section for this user.

API 金鑰在使用者管理員（system\_usermanager.php）中管理，進入使用者管理員頁面並選擇一個使用者。在頁面下方的某個位置，您會找到該使用者的 API 部分。

[![Usermanager add api key.png](<../images/fd0cdef1-Usermanager_add_api_key.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/Usermanager_add_api_key.png)

Click on the + sign to add a new key. When the key is created, you will receive a (single download) with the credentials in one text file (ini formatted). The contents of this file look like this:

點選+號新增密鑰。建立金鑰後，您將收到一份（單一下載），其中包含一個文字檔案（ini 格式）中的憑證。該文件的內容如下所示：

```
key=w86XNZob/8Oq8aC5r0kbNarNtdpoQU781fyoeaOBQsBwkXUt
secret=XeD26XVrJ5ilAc/EmglCRC+0j2e57tRsjHwFepOseySWLM53pJASeTA3
```

##### [Code sample (python)](#p-370)｜[程式碼範例（python）](#p-370)

For the python code sample we use the nice “requests” library ([http://docs.python-requests.org/en/latest/](http://docs.python-requests.org/en/latest/)), which makes HTTP calls very easy.

對於Python程式碼範例，我們使用很好的「請求」函式庫（[http://docs.python-requests.org/en/latest/](http://docs.python-requests.org/en/latest/)），這使得HTTP呼叫非常容易。

Before you can start, make sure your OPNsense has a valid SSL certificate (or choose to ignore it for testing purposes by setting verify=False), don’t forget to verify that the selected user may access the firmware page.

在開始之前，請確保您的 OPNsense 具有有效的 SSL 憑證（或透過設定 verify=False 選擇忽略它以進行測試），不要忘記驗證所選用戶是否可以存取韌體頁面。

The web interface uses the same logic that will be available for the api, in this example we will collect some status information from the firmware module and print it out for the user.

Web 介面使用與 api 可用的邏輯相同的邏輯，在本例中，我們將從韌體模組收集一些狀態資訊並將其列印給使用者。

It all starts with creating the request and waiting for the response, all data interaction is using json format, both for the responses as for the request data (when sending POST data).

一切都從創建請求和等待回應開始，所有資料互動都使用 json 格式，無論是回應還是請求資料（發送POST資料時）。

First step of the example is importing the required libraries, then define the endpoint url and credentials to use and finally fire the (get type) request. As soon as we receive the response, we parse the json string back to a dictionary and print some data depending on the response.

此範例的第一步是匯入所需的庫，然後定義要使用的端點 url 和憑證，最後觸發（取得類型）請求。一旦我們收到回應，我們就會將 json 字串解析回字典，並根據回應列印一些資料。

```js
# import libraries
import json
import requests

# define endpoint and credentials
api_key = 'w86XNZob/8Oq8aC5hxh2he+vLN00r0kbNarNtdpoQU781fyoeaOBQsBwkXUt'
api_secret = 'puOyw0Ega3xZXeD26XVrJ5WYFepOseySWLM53pJASeTA3'
url = 'https://192.168.1.1/api/core/firmware/status'

# request data
r = requests.get(url,
                 verify='OPNsense.pem',
                 auth=(api_key, api_secret))

if r.status_code == 200:
    response = json.loads(r.text)

    if response['status'] == 'ok':
        print ('OPNsense can be upgraded')
        print ('download size : %s' % response['download_size'])
        print ('number of packages : %s' % response['updates'])
        if response['upgrade_needs_reboot'] == '1':
            print ('REBOOT REQUIRED')
    elif 'status_msg' in response:
        print (response['status_msg'])
else:
    print ('Connection / Authentication issue, response received:')
    print r.text
```

##### [Using cURL](#p-370)｜[使用cURL](#p-370)

Simple testing with curl is also possible, the sample below uses the same credentials, but ignores the SSL certificate check (-k) for testing.

也可以使用curl進行簡單測試，下面的範例使用相同的憑證，但忽略SSL證書檢查（-k）進行測試。

```bash
curl -k -u "w86XNZob/8Oq8aC5hxh2he+vLN00r0kbNarNtdpoQU781fyoeaOBQsBwkXUt":"puOyw0Ega3xZXeD26XVrJ5WYFepOseySWLM53pJASeTA3" https://192.168.1.1/api/core/firmware/status
```

And schedule the actual update of all packages using:

並使用以下命令安排所有套件的實際更新：

```bash
curl -XPOST -k -u "w86XNZob/8Oq8aC5hxh2he+vLN00r0kbNarNtdpoQU781fyoeaOBQsBwkXUt":"puOyw0Ega3xZXeD26XVrJ5WYFepOseySWLM53pJASeTA3" https://10.211.55.100/api/core/firmware/update
```

##### [Using browser console to inspect API](#p-370)｜[使用瀏覽器控制台檢查API](#p-370)

All API endpoints are used by the WebGUI to interact between view and controller. There are only very few endpoints that are not directly used in the WebGUI. This makes inspecting the API requests and responses in a browser console the best way to inspect the correct usage of the API.

WebGUI 使用所有 API 端點在視圖和控制器之間進行互動。只有極少數端點不直接在 WebGUI 中使用。這使得在瀏覽器控制台中檢查 API 請求和回應成為檢查 API 正確使用的最佳方法。

All API requests can be easily reproduced using command-line tools like cURL.

所有 API 請求都可以使用 cURL 等命令列工具輕鬆重現。

Below is a simple guide using Google Chrome and Firefox:

以下是使用 Google Chrome 和 Firefox 的簡單指南：

###### [1\. Open an UI Component](#p-370)｜[1\.打開UI組件](#p-370)

In our example, we want to inspect how to create a new group in System ‣ Access ‣ Groups.

在我們的範例中，我們想要檢查如何在 System ‣ Access ‣ Groups 中建立新群組。

First we browse to the UI page that offers the option to add a new group. Afterwards we press the **+** button to open the form dialog for input. We will input the following data:

首先，我們瀏覽到 UI 頁面，該頁面提供新增群組的選項。然後我們按下**+**按鈕開啟表單對話框輸入。我們將輸入以下數據：

| Option<br>選項 | Value<br>價值 |
| --- | --- |
| **Group name**<br>**群組名稱** | HelloWorld<br>你好世界 |
| **Description**<br>**描述** | HelloWorld<br>你好世界 |
| **Privileges**<br>**特權** | Lobby: Dashboard<br>大廳：儀表板 |
| **Members**<br>**會員** | root<br>根 |

Before pressing **Save**, we will open the browser developer tools to inspect what happens when we do.

在按**儲存**之前，我們將開啟瀏覽器開發人員工具來檢查執行時會發生什麼。

###### [2\. Open Browser Developer Tools](#p-370)｜[2\.開啟瀏覽器開發者工具](#p-370)

Google Chrome or Firefox:

Google瀏覽器或火狐瀏覽器：

Press F12 or Ctrl+Shift+I (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+Option+I (macOS).

按 F12 或 Ctrl+Shift+I (Windows/Linux) 或 Cmd+Option+I (macOS)。

Navigate to the **Network** tab.

導航至 **網路** 標籤。

Now press the **Save** button in the open form dialog. This will trigger the serialization of the data via API endpoint. You will see the `add/` in the network tab.

現在按下開啟的表單對話方塊中的 **儲存** 按鈕。這將透過API端點觸發資料的序列化。您將在網路標籤中看到`add/`。

###### [3\. Inspect the API Call](#p-370)｜[3\.檢查API通話](#p-370)

Click on the relevant request (e.g., /api/auth/group/add/).

點選相關請求（例如 /api/auth/group/add/）。

Inspect the following details:

檢查以下詳細資訊：

-   Headers: Method (POST, GET), URL, headers (like content-type, accept, authorization, and cookie).  
    標頭：方法 (POST, GET)、URL、標頭（如內容類型、接受、授權和 cookie）。
    
-   Payload: Inspect the request payload in the Payload tab.  
    有效負載：在「有效負載」標籤中檢查請求有效負載。
    
-   Response: View the response data under the Response tab.  
    回應：在「回應」標籤下查看回應資料。
    

In our case it will look like this:

在我們的例子中，它看起來像這樣：

-   Request URL: `https://192.168.1.1/api/auth/group/add/`  
    要求URL: `https://192.168.1.1/api/auth/group/add/`
    
-   Request Method: `POST`  
    請求方式：`POST`
    
-   Request Payload: `group: {name: "HelloWorld", description: "HelloWorld", priv: "page-system-login-logout", member: "0"}`  
    請求負載：`group: {name: "HelloWorld", description: "HelloWorld", priv: "page-system-login-logout", member: "0"}`
    
-   Response: `{"result":"saved","uuid":"569118e0-006b-4a2d-8eb6-332d29300a2a"}`  
    回覆：`{"result":"saved","uuid":"569118e0-006b-4a2d-8eb6-332d29300a2a"}`
    

With this information, you know exactly how to use the group API to add a new group.

有了這些信息，您就可以確切地知道如何使用群組API來新增群組了。

###### [4\. Replicate the API Call with cURL](#p-370)｜[4\.使用 cURL 複製 API 呼叫](#p-370)

In Chrome and Firefox, you can easily generate a cURL command out of the previous API call.

在 Chrome 和 Firefox 中，您可以輕鬆地從先前的 API 呼叫中產生 cURL 命令。

Right-click the request entry (e.g., `add/`), select Copy → Copy as cURL.

右鍵點選請求條目（例如，`add/`），選擇複製 → 複製為 cURL。

This provides a complete cURL command that can be completed with an API token for authorization.

這提供了完整的 cURL 命令，可以使用 API 令牌來完成授權。

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://172.16.0.254:4444/api/auth/group/add/' \
-H 'accept: application/json, text/javascript, */*; q=0.01' \
-H 'content-type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{"group":{"name":"HelloWorld","description":"HelloWorld","priv":"page-system-login-logout","member":"0"}}' \
--insecure
```

This approach allows you to test or automate API interactions outside of the GUI for debugging, automation and scripting.

這種方法允許您在 GUI 之外測試或自動化 API 交互，以進行調試、自動化和腳本編寫。

---

<a id="p-371"></a>

#### ProfilingDebugging the kernel｜分析調試內核

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/how-tos/dtrace.html>

##### Profiling/Debugging the kernel｜分析/調試內核

##### Overview｜概述

Kernel development often involves writing code without an IDE. Even if an IDE is used, proper profiling support is often lacking. Luckily, FreeBSD includes DTrace.

核心開發通常涉及在沒有 IDE 的情況下編寫程式碼。即使使用了IDE，通常也缺乏適當的分析支持。幸運的是，FreeBSD 包含 DTrace。

Since OPNsense runs on a fork of FreeBSD, DTrace is natively available on the system for developers to use in debugging and profiling. To quote the FreeBSD handbook on DTrace:

由於 OPNsense 在 FreeBSD 的一個分支上運行，因此系統本身就可以使用 DTrace 供開發人員在偵錯和分析中使用。引用 FreeBSD DTrace 手冊：

```
“DTrace, also known as Dynamic Tracing, was developed by Sun™ as a tool
for locating performance bottlenecks in production and pre-production
systems. In addition to diagnosing performance problems, DTrace can be used
to help investigate and debug unexpected behavior in both the FreeBSD kernel
and in userland programs.

DTrace is a remarkable profiling tool, with an impressive array of features
for diagnosing system issues. It may also be used to run pre-written scripts
to take advantage of its capabilities. Users can author their own utilities
using the DTrace D Language, allowing them to customize their profiling based
on specific needs.”
```

We will be looking at setting up DTrace on OPNsense, and running a sample script to perform some useful analysis on kernel space. An example for generating a FlameGraph will also be presented. Keep in mind that user space can also be analyzed using DTrace, but this is beyond the scope of this document.

我們將考慮在 OPNsense 上設定 DTrace，並執行範例腳本來對核心空間執行一些有用的分析。也將介紹產生 FlameGraph 的範例。請記住，也可以使用 DTrace 分析使用者空間，但這超出了本文檔的範圍。

Although detailed steps for enabling DTrace in a custom kernel are widely available, this document provides an explanation in combination with the use of OPNsense-specific tools. Further resources will be provided at the end of this document.

儘管在自訂核心中啟用 DTrace 的詳細步驟已廣泛提供，但本文檔結合 OPNsense 特定工具的使用提供了解釋。本文件末尾將提供更多資源。

Note

筆記

All generic DTrace concepts, as well as default probe providers are documented [here](http://dtrace.org/guide/preface.html#preface). If you are interested in using DTrace to profile performance issues, we suggest reading the documentation before proceeding. We will not go into too much detail here to prevent cluttering the document and keep it simple and to-the-point.

所有通用 DTrace 概念以及預設探針提供者都記錄在[此處](http://dtrace.org/guide/preface.html#preface)。如果您有興趣使用 DTrace 來分析效能問題，我們建議您在繼續之前閱讀文件。我們不會在這裡討論太多細節，以免文件混亂並保持簡單明了。

##### Enabling DTrace｜啟用DTrace

Make sure the OPNsense/src repository is present on the system and navigate to `/usr/src/sys/[ARCHITECTURE, e.g. amd64]/conf` and open up `GENERIC`. Add the following options:

確保系統上存在 OPNsense/src 儲存庫並導航至 `/usr/src/sys/[ARCHITECTURE, e.g. amd64]/conf` 並開啟 `GENERIC`。新增以下選項：

```
makeoptions     DEBUG=-g                # Will build a debug kernel (using gdb debug symbols)
makeoptions     WITH_CTF=1              # Adds CTF type data to built executables
options         KDTRACE_FRAME           # Ensure frames are compiled in
```

Note

筆記

CTF type data is described [here](https://www.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=ctf&sektion=5&manpath=freebsd-release-ports). The idea is to represent the types used in a C program within the executable, allowing users of DTrace to access symbols and function parameters during runtime.

CTF型資料在[此處](https://www.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=ctf&sektion=5&manpath=freebsd-release-ports)進行了描述。這個想法是在可執行檔中表示 C 程式中使用的類型，允許 DTrace 使用者在執行時間存取符號和函數參數。

As a best practice, under stock FreeBSD you would save the file under a different name (e.g. DTRACE) and build the kernel by specifying `KERNCONF=DTRACE`. The opnsense-tools require the name to be `GENERIC`, so we will leave it as is. It is advisable to create a backup of the original `GENERIC` file though. Make sure the OPNsense-tools repository is installed and navigate to `/usr/tools/config/[VERSION]`. Open up `SMP` and make sure the following line is either removed or commented out:

作為最佳實踐，在 FreeBSD 下，您可以使用不同的名稱保存檔案（例如 DTRACE），並透過指定 `KERNCONF=DTRACE` 來建立核心。 opnsense-tools 要求名稱為 `GENERIC`，因此我們將保持原樣。不過，建議建立原始 `GENERIC` 檔案的備份。確保 OPNsense-tools 儲存庫已安裝並導航至 `/usr/tools/config/[VERSION]`。打開 `SMP` 並確保以下行已刪除或註解掉：

```
nomakeoptions DEBUG
```

Furthermore, should you wish to enable DTrace in Userspace, it is imperative that you also add the following line to `/usr/tools/conf/[VERSION]/make.conf`

此外，如果您希望在使用者空間中啟用 DTrace，您也必須將以下行新增至 `/usr/tools/conf/[VERSION]/make.conf`

```
STRIP=
CFLAGS+=-fno-omit-frame-pointer
```

Now clean and build the new kernel

現在清理並建立新內核

```
# make clean-obj,kernel kernel
```

A kernel package will be available at the following location:

內核包將在以下位置提供：

> `/usr/local/opnsense/build/[Version]/[Architecture]/sets/kernel*.txz`

Install the package using our `opnsense-update` command:

使用我們的 `opnsense-update` 指令安裝軟體包：

```
# opnsense-update -ikfr [version] -l /location/from/
```

Where \[version\] is the version part of the kernel package, such as `21.1.a_83`

其中\[version\]是核心套件的版本部分，如`21.1.a_83`

##### Test the installation｜測試安裝

Follow the steps described in the section ‘Getting Started’ [here](https://wiki.freebsd.org/DTrace/KernelSupport)

請依照「入門」部分所述的步驟進行[此處](https://wiki.freebsd.org/DTrace/KernelSupport)

##### DTrace program｜DTrace程式

Although it is possible to instruct DTrace to execute a certain function on the command line (and there are a lot of one-liners for this [here](https://wiki.freebsd.org/DTrace/One-Liners)), instead we present a D script that measures some statistics on the ixgbe 10GbE driver and shows some interesting capabilities of DTrace in one go. Specifically, it measures the amount of interrupts fired on the packet receive side, as well as the time spent in the relevant functions in nanoseconds. It also measures how many threads on average are waiting to be serviced because another thread is busy.

儘管可以指示 DTrace 在命令列上執行某個函數（[此處](https://wiki.freebsd.org/DTrace/One-Liners) 有很多單行程式碼），但我們提供了一個 D 腳本，用於測量 ixgbe 10GbE 驅動程式的一些統計信息，並一次性展示 DTrace 的一些有趣功能。具體來說，它測量資料包接收端觸發的中斷數量，以及相關函數花費的時間（以奈秒為單位）。它還測量平均有多少線程因為另一個線程正忙而等待服務。

```
/* RX threads, retrieved from procstat -a -t, listing thread information for all (kernel) processes */
inline int	qg0 = 100018;
inline int	qg1 = 100019;
inline int 	qg2 = 100020;
inline int	qg3 = 100021;
inline int	qg4 = 100022;
inline int	qg5 = 100023;
inline int	qg6 = 100024;
inline int 	qg7 = 100025;

/* Because of this preprocessor statement, this script should be compiled with -C option */
#define PROBE_PREDICATE 		\
			pid == 0 &&	\
			(tid == qg0 || 	\
			 tid == qg1 || 	\
			 tid == qg2 || 	\
			 tid == qg3 || 	\
			 tid == qg4 || 	\
			 tid == qg5 || 	\
			 tid == qg6 || 	\
			 tid == qg7)	\
					\

#define DRIVER_CHECK self->driver_prefix == "ix"

/********************************************/
/* Iflib rx info & interrupt info */
/********************************************/

struct iflib_intr_info {
	uint64_t fast_intr_ts;
	uint64_t fast_intr_elapsed;
	uint64_t filter_routine_ts;
	uint64_t task_tx_ts;
};

struct iflib_intr_info ii[int];

struct iflib_task_info {
	uint64_t task_rx_ts; 
	uint64_t rxeof_ts;
};

struct iflib_task_info iti[int];

/* RX (and TX) interrupt entry point, will call driver supplied filter */
fbt::iflib_fast_intr:entry
{
	ii[tid].fast_intr_ts = timestamp;
	this->info = ((kernel`iflib_filter_info_t)arg0);
	self->rxq_id = (uint16_t)((kernel`iflib_rxq_t)this->info->ifi_ctx)->ifr_id;
	@intcounts[tid, self->rxq_id, probefunc] = count();

}

fbt::iflib_fast_intr:return
/ii[tid].fast_intr_ts/
{
	@time[tid, self->rxq_id, probefunc] = avg(timestamp - ii[tid].fast_intr_ts);
	@fi_time_min[tid, self->rxq_id, probefunc] = min(timestamp - ii[tid].fast_intr_ts);
	@fi_time_max[tid, self->rxq_id, probefunc] = max(timestamp - ii[tid].fast_intr_ts);
}

/* axgbe driver filter routine */
fbt::axgbe_msix_que:entry, fbt::ixgbe_msix_que:entry
{
	ii[tid].filter_routine_ts = timestamp;	
	@intcounts[tid, self->rxq_id, probefunc] = count();
}

fbt::axgbe_msix_que:return, fbt::ixgbe_msix_que:return
/ii[tid].filter_routine_ts/
{
	@fr_time_avg[tid, self->rxq_id, probefunc] = avg(timestamp - ii[tid].filter_routine_ts);
	@fr_time_min[tid, self->rxq_id, probefunc] = min(timestamp - ii[tid].filter_routine_ts);
	@fr_time_max[tid, self->rxq_id, probefunc] = max(timestamp - ii[tid].filter_routine_ts);
}

/* 
 * at this point, iflib has enqueued the _task_fn_rx / _task_fn_tx function,
 * we could measure some relevant things here.
 * The threads that run the queued functions are all in the range of the threads
 * defined at the top of this file
 * We could also inspect the queue structure to determine the average amount of functions
 * waiting to be serviced, this information could be pulled out of the iflib interrupt handler
 * Also, the thread that runs the queued function is different from the thread that runs the interrupt handler,
 * so query again for the relevant drivers and include it in the probe predicates
 */

char *driver_name[2];

fbt::_task_fn_rx:entry
/PROBE_PREDICATE && (!self->prefix_set)/
{

	/* get taskqueue structure information to determine amount of functions waiting to be serviced */
	this->rxq = ((kernel`iflib_rxq_t)arg0);
	this->grouptask = (struct grouptask)(this->rxq->ifr_task);
	self->gt_name = stringof(this->grouptask.gt_name);
	this->if_ctx = (if_ctx_t)(this->rxq)->ifr_ctx;
	this->dev = (device_t)(this->if_ctx)->ifc_dev;
	this->driver = (driver_t *)(this->dev)->driver;
	driver_name[0] = (const char *)(this->driver)->name;
	driver_name[1] = (const char *)(this->driver)->name + 1;
	self->driver_prefix = stringof(*(driver_name));
	self->prefix_set = 1;

}

fbt::_task_fn_rx:entry
/PROBE_PREDICATE && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	iti[tid].task_rx_ts = timestamp;
	@_task_fn_rx_count[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = count();
}

fbt::_task_fn_rx:return
/PROBE_PREDICATE && iti[tid].task_rx_ts && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	@task_rx_avg[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = avg(timestamp - iti[tid].task_rx_ts);
	@task_rx_min[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = min(timestamp - iti[tid].task_rx_ts);
	@task_rx_max[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = max(timestamp - iti[tid].task_rx_ts);
}

fbt::iflib_rxeof:entry
/PROBE_PREDICATE && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	iti[tid].rxeof_ts = timestamp;
	@rxeof_count[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = count();

}

fbt::iflib_rxeof:return
/PROBE_PREDICATE && iti[tid].rxeof_ts && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	@rxeof_avg[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = avg(timestamp - iti[tid].rxeof_ts);
	@rxeof_min[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = min(timestamp - iti[tid].rxeof_ts);
	@rxeof_max[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = max(timestamp - iti[tid].rxeof_ts);

}

fbt::ixgbe_isc_rxd_refill:entry
/PROBE_PREDICATE && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	this->ts = timestamp;
	@rxd_refill_count[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = count();
}

fbt::ixgbe_isc_rxd_refill:return
/PROBE_PREDICATE && this->ts && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	
	@rxd_refill_avg[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = avg(timestamp - this->ts);
	@rxd_refill_min[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = min(timestamp - this->ts);
	@rxd_refill_max[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = max(timestamp - this->ts);
}

/* notice how the ixgbe driver is missing, this is because of the dtrace compiler optimization - the return probe is missing */
fbt::ixgbe_isc_rxd_available:entry
/PROBE_PREDICATE && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	this->ts = timestamp;
	@rxd_avail_count[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = count();
}

fbt::ixgbe_isc_rxd_available:return
/PROBE_PREDICATE && (this->ts != 0) && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	@rxd_avail_avg[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = avg(timestamp - this->ts);
	@rxd_avail_min[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = min(timestamp - this->ts);
	@rxd_avail_max[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = max(timestamp - this->ts);
}

fbt::ixgbe_isc_rxd_pkt_get:entry
/PROBE_PREDICATE && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	this->ts = timestamp;
	@rxd_pkt_get_count[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = count();
}

fbt::ixgbe_isc_rxd_pkt_get:return
/PROBE_PREDICATE && (this->ts != 0) && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	@rxd_pkt_get_avg[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = avg(timestamp - this->ts);	
	@rxd_pkt_get_min[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = min(timestamp - this->ts);	
	@rxd_pkt_get_max[tid, self->gt_name, probefunc] = max(timestamp - this->ts);	
}

/********************************************/
/* Queue behaviour */
/********************************************/

int qlen[int];

/* enqueue and deqeueue probes to determine the run length of the queues */
sched:::enqueue
/PROBE_PREDICATE && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	this->q_len = qlen[tid]++;

	@q_len_all_threads_avg[tid] = avg(this->q_len);
	@q_len_all_threads_min[tid] = min(this->q_len);
	@q_len_all_threads_max[tid] = max(this->q_len);
}

sched:::dequeue
/PROBE_PREDICATE && qlen[tid] && DRIVER_CHECK/
{
	qlen[tid]--;

}

END
{
	printf("\n");
	printf("\n");
	printf("\n");
	printf("\n");
	printf("-------INTERRUPTS-------\n");
	printf("\n");
	printf("thread  core               function            count  avg time(ns)  min time  max time  avg time(driver)  min time(driver)  max time(driver)\n");
	printf("------  ----  ---------------------  ---------------  ------------  --------  --------  ----------------  ----------------  ----------------\n");
	printa("%6d  %4d  %21s  %@15d  %@12d  %@8d  %@8d  %@16d  %@16d  %@16d\n", @intcounts, @time, @fi_time_min, @fi_time_max, @fr_time_avg, @fr_time_min, @fr_time_max);
	printf("\n");

	printf("-------DRIVER/IFLIB FUNCTIONS RX-------\n");
	printf("thread  grouptask name                        function  avg time(ns)  min time(ns)  max time(ns)        count\n");
	printf("------  --------------  ------------------------------  ------------  ------------  ------------  -----------\n");
	printa("%6d  %14s  %30s  %@12d  %@12d  %@12d  %@11d\n", @task_rx_avg, @task_rx_min, @task_rx_max, @_task_fn_rx_count);
	printa("%6d  %14s  %30s  %@12d  %@12d  %@12d  %@11d\n", @rxeof_avg, @rxeof_min, @rxeof_max, @rxeof_count);
	printa("%6d  %14s  %30s  %@12d  %@12d  %@12d  %@11d\n", @rxd_refill_avg, @rxd_refill_min, @rxd_refill_max, @rxd_refill_count);
	printa("%6d  %14s  %30s  %@12d  %@12d  %@12d  %@11d\n", @rxd_avail_avg, @rxd_avail_min, @rxd_avail_max, @rxd_avail_count);
	printa("%6d  %14s  %30s  %@12d  %@12d  %@12d  %@11d\n", @rxd_pkt_get_avg, @rxd_pkt_get_min, @rxd_pkt_get_max, @rxd_pkt_get_count);
	printf("\n");

	printf("---------QUEUE BEHAVIOUR---------\n");
	printf("thread  avg run length  min run length  max run length\n");
	printf("------  --------------  --------------  --------------\n");
	printa("%6d  %@14d  %@14d  %@14d\n", @q_len_all_threads_avg, @q_len_all_threads_min, @q_len_all_threads_max);
	printf("\n");
}
```

The one-line command to pre-process, compile and run the script is:

預處理、編譯和運行腳本的一行命令是：

```
# dtrace -C -s example.d
```

The `-C` option specifies that the standard C preprocessor should evaluate the file, ensuring that the C-specific code like macro definitions are defined.

`-C` 選項指定標準 C 預處理器應評估該文件，確保定義了特定於 C 的程式碼（如巨集定義）。

The output (when pinging the device):

輸出（當 ping 設備時）：

![Dtrace Output](<../images/4a236ebd-dtrace_output_docs.png>)

Notice how the queue behaviour section shows no output, this is because there is no actual queue behaviour going on. There is simply too little traffic for the kernel to be queueing threads. When stressing the driver, it might look something like this:

請注意隊列行為部分如何顯示沒有輸出，這是因為沒有實際的隊列行為發生。核心的流量太少，無法對線程進行排隊。當給駕駛員施加壓力時，它可能看起來像這樣：

![Queue behaviour](<../images/f0748187-queue_behaviour.png>)

##### Flame Graphs｜火焰圖

If you run the following command:

如果您執行以下命令：

```
# dtrace -n 'uiomove:entry{ @[stack()] = count(); }'
```

Let it run for a while, and exit using `CTRL-C`

讓它運行一段時間，然後使用`CTRL-C`退出

You will see all [stack frames](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Call_stack) associated with `uiomove()` that have taken place, aggregated to only unique frames. The number below the individual frame represents the amount of times that particular frame was executed. Although this is nice, it isn’t particularly visually pleasing or helpful in spotting potential bottlenecks.

您將看到與已發生的 `uiomove()` 關聯的所有[堆疊幀](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Call_stack)，僅聚合到唯一的幀。各個影格下方的數字表示該特定影格的執行次數。雖然這很好，但它在視覺上並不是特別令人愉悅，也不能幫助發現潛在的瓶頸。

A senior performance analyst at Netflix, named Brendan Gregg, developed the [FlameGraph](https://github.com/brendangregg/FlameGraph) for use with DTrace (and other profiling tools). The program consists of a set of Perl files that take in the data produced by a command similar to the one we executed, and generate a graph that helps spot ‘hot code paths’. This time however, we will look at the kernel as a whole and sample it in a set interval.

Netflix 的高級性能分析師 Brendan Gregg 開發了 [FlameGraph](https://github.com/brendangregg/FlameGraph) 與 DTrace（和其他分析工具）一起使用。該程式由一組 Perl 檔案組成，這些檔案接收與我們執行的命令類似的命令產生的數據，並產生一個圖表來幫助發現「熱門程式碼路徑」。然而這一次，我們將把內核作為一個整體來看待，並以設定的時間間隔對其進行採樣。

1\. Clone the [repository](https://github.com/brendangregg/FlameGraph) and instruct dtrace to sample kernel stacks at a rate of 997 Hertz for 60 seconds:

1\.克隆 [repository](https://github.com/brendangregg/FlameGraph) 並指示 dtrace 以 997 赫茲的速率對內核堆疊進行取樣 60 秒：

```
# dtrace -x stackframes=100 -n 'profile-997 /arg0/ { @[stack()] = count(); } tick-60s { exit(0); }' -o out.kern_stacks
```

2.  Collapse the individual lines in the output file by folding it into single lines:  
    透過將輸出檔案中的各行折疊成單行來折疊它：
    

```
# ./stackcollapse.pl out.kern_stacks > out.kern_folded
```

Having a separate folded input file allows for grepping functions of interest:

擁有一個單獨的折疊輸入檔允許 grep 感興趣的函數：

```
# grep cpuid out.kern_folded | ./flamegraph.pl > cpuid.svg
```

Note

筆記

If you get the message “Command not found”, use the command `perl stackcollapse.pl out.kern_stacks > out.kern_folded`

如果您收到訊息“未找到命令”，請使用命令`perl stackcollapse.pl out.kern_stacks > out.kern_folded`

3.  Generate a flame graph:  
    生成火焰圖：
    

```
# ./flamegraph.pl out.kern_folded > kernel.svg
```

![FlameGraph](<../images/26b1ff0b-example-dtrace.svg>)

The output image is an SVG file, enabling interaction within a browser.

輸出影像是一個SVG文件，可以在瀏覽器中進行互動。

在 DTrace 中使用正確的資料型別來提升分析效能：[http://dtrace.org/blogs/brendan/2011/11/25/dtrace-variable-types/](http://dtrace.org/blogs/brendan/2011/11/25/dtrace-variable-types/)

FreeBSD DTrace 手冊頁：[https://www.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=dtrace](https://www.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=dtrace)

FreeBSD DTrace one-liners: [https://wiki.freebsd.org/DTrace/One-Liners](https://wiki.freebsd.org/DTrace/One-Liners)

FreeBSD DTrace 一行程式碼：[https://wiki.freebsd.org/DTrace/One-Liners](https://wiki.freebsd.org/DTrace/One-Liners)

#### Remote debugging the kernel｜遠端調試內核

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/development/how-tos/kernel_debugging.html>

FreeBSD supports remote debugging using a serial interface. Since most virtual solutions support serial interfaces it can be quite convenient to deploy a kernel and start a debug session on another machine.

FreeBSD 支援使用序列介面進行遠端除錯。由於大多數虛擬解決方案都支援串行接口，因此在另一台計算機上部署內核並啟動調試會話會非常方便。

The setup assumes two (virtual) machines with a serial (rs232) connection in between.

此設定假設兩台（虛擬）機器之間有串列（rs232）連接。

[![](<../images/b800c804-blockdiag-51ee775ab4d0b0956e2879627609be.png>)](https://docs.opnsense.org/_images/blockdiag-51ee775ab4d0b0956e2879627609bee55b87586f.png)

##### Configure and build a kernel｜配置並建構內核

Use our toolchain described in detail [here](https://github.com/opnsense/tools) and add the following options to your `SMP` file in `/usr/tools/config/[VERSION]/SMP`

使用[此處](https://github.com/opnsense/tools)詳細描述的我們的工具鏈，並將以下選項新增至`/usr/tools/config/[VERSION]/SMP`中的`SMP`檔案中

```
#nomakeoptions DEBUG
options        GDB                     # Support remote GDB.
makeoptions    DEBUG=-g
```

Next clean and build a kernel

接下來清理並建立內核

```
make clean-obj,kernel kernel
```

##### Install the kernel on test vm｜在測試虛擬機器上安裝內核

With the build finished, we should have a kernel package on the build machine available at the following location:

建置完成後，我們應該在建置機器上有一個核心包，位於以下位置：

> `/usr/local/opnsense/build/[Version]/[Architecture]/sets/kernel*.txz`

Copy this package to the test vm and install it using our `opnsense-update` command:

將此套件複製到測試虛擬機器並使用我們的 `opnsense-update` 命令安裝它：

```
opnsense-update -ikfr [version] -l /location/from/
```

Where \[version\] is the version part of the kernel package, such as `19.1.2`

其中\[version\]是核心套件的版本部分，如`19.1.2`

##### Configure the test vm｜配置測試虛擬機

To be able to connect to the test machine using `kgdb`, you need to make sure some settings are set.

為了能夠使用`kgdb`連接到測試機，您需要確保設定一些設定。

Edit `/boot/device.hints` and change or add `hint.uart.0.flags` to the following:

編輯 `/boot/device.hints` 並將 `hint.uart.0.flags` 更改或新增至以下內容：

```
hint.uart.0.flags="0xc0"
```

Also /boot/loader.conf.local should have a baud-rate configured for the serial device:

另外 /boot/loader.conf.local 應該為串列設備配置波特率：

```
comconsole_speed="115200"
```

##### Test your setup｜測試您的設置

Login to the test machine and force a debug session in gdb, using the following commands:

登入測試機器並使用以下命令在 gdb 中強制進行調試會話：

```
# sysctl debug.kdb.current=gdb
# sysctl debug.kdb.enter=1
db> gdb
Step to enter the remote GDB backend.
db> c (continue)
```

Then go to the build machine, make sure gdb is installed (`pkg install gdb`) and go to the directory where the debug symbols are and start a session, ask a backtrace `bt` and continue normal operation `c`:

然後轉到構建機器，確保安裝了 gdb（`pkg install gdb`）並轉到調試符號所在的目錄並啟動會話，詢問回溯`bt`並繼續正常操作`c`：

#### About FreeBSD｜關於 FreeBSD

FreeBSD is an operating system for a variety of platforms which focuses on features, speed, and stability. It is derived from BSD, the version of UNIX® developed at the University of California, Berkeley. It is developed and maintained by a large community.

#### Relations with OPNsense｜與 OPNsense 的關係

OPNsense is built on top of FreeBSD. The aim of the OPNsense team is to stay as close to the original source as possible. OPNsense can be installed on a standard FreeBSD installation, this way a hosted system can be converted easily to run OPNsense. A bootstrap script is available to make the installation process a joyful experience.

OPNsense 建構在 FreeBSD 之上。 OPNsense 團隊的目標是盡可能接近原始來源。 OPNsense 可以安裝在標準 FreeBSD 安裝上，這樣託管系統就可以輕鬆轉換為運行 OPNsense。引導腳本可以使安裝過程成為一種愉快的體驗。

<a id="p-376"></a>

### M0n0wall｜M0n0牆

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/relations/m0n0wall.html>

![../_images/index.png](<../images/e7e45ab0-index.png>)

#### Background｜背景

*Manuel Kasper*

*曼努埃爾·卡斯帕*

```
Ever since I started playing with packet filters on embedded PCs, I wanted to
have a nice web-based GUI to control all aspects of my firewall without having
to type a single shell command.

There are numerous efforts to create nice firewall packages with web
interfaces on the Internet (most of them Linux based), but none met all my
requirements (free, fast, simple, clean and with all the features I need).
So, I eventually started writing my own web GUI. But soon I figured out that
I didn't want to create another incarnation of webmin – I wanted to create a
complete, new embedded firewall software package.

It all evolved to the point where one could plug in the box, set the LAN IP
address via the serial console, log into the web interface and set it up.

Then I decided that I didn't like the usual bootup system configuration with
shell scripts (I already had to write a C program to generate the filter rules
since that's almost impossible in a shell script), and since my web interface
was based on PHP, it didn't take me long to figure out that I might use PHP
for the system configuration as well.

That way, the configuration data would no longer have to be stored in text
files that can be parsed in a shell script – it could now be stored in an XML
file. So I completely rewrote the whole system again, not changing much in the
look-and-feel, but quite a lot "under the hood".
```

#### End of the m0n0wall project｜m0n0wall 計畫結束

The active development of m0n0wall ended in 2015.

m0n0wall 的積極開發於 2015 年結束。

Manuel Kasper, wrote the following on 15 February 2015:

Manuel Kasper 在 2015 年 2 月 15 日寫道：

```
Dear m0n0wall enthusiasts,

on this day 12 years ago, I have released the first version of m0n0wall to
the public. In theory, one could still run that version - pb1 it was called -
on a suitably old PC and use it to control the Internet access of a small LAN
(not that it would be recommended security-wise). However, the world keeps
turning, and while m0n0wall has made an effort to keep up, there are now better
solutions available and under active development.

Therefore, today I announce that the m0n0wall project has officially ended.
No development will be done anymore, and there will be no further releases.

The forums and the mailing list will be frozen at the end of this month.
All the contents of the website, repository, downloads, mailing list and forum
will be archived in a permanent location on the web so that they remain
accessible indefinitely to anyone who might be interested in them.

m0n0wall has served as the seed for several other well known open source
projects, like pfSense, FreeNAS and AskoziaPBX.

The newest offspring, OPNsense (https://opnsense.org), aims to continue the open source spirit of
m0n0wall while updating the technology to be ready for the future. In my view,
it is the perfect way to bring the m0n0wall idea into 2015, and I encourage all
current m0n0wall users to check out OPNsense and contribute if they can.

Finally, I would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone who has been
involved in the m0n0wall project and helped in some way or another -
by contributing code, documentation, answering questions on the mailing
list or the forum, donating or just spreading the word. It has been a great
journey for me, and I'm convinced that even now that it has come to an end,
the m0n0wall spirit will live on in the various projects it has spawned.
```

#### Relations with OPNsense｜與 OPNsense 的關係

Deciso B.V. the founder of OPNsense has taken over the m0n0wall websites from Manuel Kasper and continues to offer all the sources, website & forum content both as a historical reference as well as to preserve knowledge gained.

OPNsense 創辦人 Deciso B.V. 已從 Manuel Kasper 手中接管了 m0n0wall 網站，並繼續提供所有來源、網站和論壇內容，既作為歷史參考，又保存所獲得的知識。

The OPNsense core team would like to thank Manuel for all his efforts, as without him OPNsense would not have been possible.

OPNsense 核心團隊感謝 Manuel 所做的一切努力，因為沒有他，OPNsense 就不可能實現。

## Support Options｜支援選項

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/support.html>

![_images/support-1024x492.jpg](<../images/d6d75aec-support-1024x492.jpg>)

### Software Support Levels｜軟體支援等級

OPNsense is used in infrastructures of all sizes, in some cases it is very important to know what to expect when running into issues, certainly if part of the knowledge to maintain the infrastructure needs to be acquired from third parties.

OPNsense 用於各種規模的基礎設施，在某些情況下，了解遇到問題時會發生什麼非常重要，當然，如果維護基礎設施的部分知識需要從第三方獲取的話。

Our platform is easily extendable, which encourages people to work on components not directly supported by us but very valuable to our users.

我們的平台易於擴展，這鼓勵人們使用我們不直接支援但對我們的用戶非常有價值的元件。

In order to offer clarity for all involved, we decided to explain how we treat the components available in this chapter.

為了讓所有相關人員清楚了解，我們決定解釋如何處理本章中可用的元件。

We currently distinct three different tiers of support, ranging from Critical to Community, where critical is always directly supported by the OPNsense® Core Team and Community you may safely assume the core team has no (or very limited) involvement.

目前，我們區分了三個不同的支援級別，從關鍵到社區，其中關鍵始終由 OPNsense® 核心團隊和社區直接支持，您可以放心地假設核心團隊沒有（或非常有限）參與。

Tip

提示

When designing infrastructures and in need of commercial support from the creators of OPNsense for community plugins, you can always contact us and discuss options.

當設計基礎設施並需要 OPNsense 創建者的社群插件商業支援時，您可以隨時與我們聯繫並討論選項。

If community plugins are very popular it is possible to promote in terms of support options, but in order to grow out of the community tier some conditions have to be met.

如果社群插件非常受歡迎，則可以在支援選項方面進行推廣，但為了脫離社群層，必須滿足一些條件。

-   The software should be usable and understandable.  
    該軟體應該可用且易於理解。
    
-   Maintainability of the plugin should be good (code quality, following best practices)  
    插件的可維護性應該良好（程式碼質量，遵循最佳實踐）
    
-   Documentation should be available and at least explain the purpose of the component including the most common settings.  
    文件應該可用，並且至少解釋該組件的用途，包括最常見的設定。
    

These are the tiers in question:

這些是有問題的層級：

#### Critical (Tier 1)｜嚴重（1 級）

-   Core team develops and supports  
    核心團隊開發與支持
    
-   Compiler errors or functional failures block git merges and releases  
    編譯器錯誤或功能故障阻止 git 合併和發布
    
-   Functionality is part of the standard installation or an officially supported plugin  
    功能是標準安裝或官方支援的插件的一部分
    

#### Supplemental (Tier 2)｜補充（第 2 級）

-   Core team develops and supports or the functionality is deemed to be important enough to invest their time into bringing the plugin to its desired state in the long run.  
    核心團隊開發和支持，或功能被認為足夠重要，需要投入時間來使插件達到長期所需的狀態。
    
-   Compiler errors or functional failures block git merges  
    編譯器錯誤或功能故障阻止 git 合併
    
-   Functionality problems such as ‘known issues’ might still go into releases  
    諸如“已知問題”之類的功能問題可能仍會出現在版本中
    
-   Features require user to install the plugin / functionality not installed by default  
    功能需要用戶安裝預設未安裝的插件/功能
    

#### Community (Tier 3)｜社區（第 3 級）

-   Tier 3 is community supported, this means the OPNsense core development team won’t support it to avoid overloading the team  
    第 3 層是社群支援的，這意味著 OPNsense 核心開發團隊不會支援它，以避免團隊超載
    
-   When accepting a Tier 3 feature into the code base, it will come with a number of limits and conditions:  
    當第 3 層功能接受到程式碼庫時，它將附帶許多限制和條件：
    
    -   Submitter must commit to maintaining it:  
        提交者必須承諾維護它：
        
    
    > -   Make sure code compiles and correctly functions after OPNsense and/or external (e.g. library) changes  
          確保 OPNsense 和/或外部（例如庫）更改後程式碼可以編譯並正確運行
    >     
    > -   Support users when they encounter problems (forum / git issue tracker – all related issues will be assigned to the maintainer)  
          當使用者遇到問題時提供支援（論壇/git問題追蹤器 - 所有相關問題將分配給維護者）
    >     
    
-   The code is offered as plugin and will not be part of the default OPNsense installation. The OPNsense core team will not be responsible for QA  
    該程式碼作為插件提供，不會成為預設 OPNsense 安裝的一部分。 OPNsense 核心團隊將不負責QA
    
-   If the feature get lots of traction, and/or if the team just considers it very useful, it may get ‘promoted’ to being officially supported (Tier 2)  
    如果該功能受到很大關注，和/或團隊認為它非常有用，它可能會「升級」為官方支援（第 2 層）
    
-   The feature will be removed if the submitter stops maintaining it and no-one steps up to take over  
    如果提交者停止維護該功能並且無人接手，則該功能將被刪除
    

#### Development or unknown (Tier 4)｜開發或未知（第 4 級）

-   As an extension of tier 3, this tier is reserved for development version of plugins, when the plugin failed to set a tier or any other custom third party repository  
    作為第 3 層的擴展，當插件無法設定層或任何其他自訂第三方儲存庫時，此層保留用於插件的開發版本
    

### Community｜社群

If you need help with OPNsense you can always try the community options first. When resorting to community support it is important to understand that anyone helping you is doing so for free and at their own time. Even though your issue or question may not be answered fully, it would be nice to thank the people who help you.

如果您需要 OPNsense 的協助，您始終可以先嘗試社群選項。在尋求社區支持時，重要的是要了解任何幫助您的人都是在自己的時間免費這樣做的。儘管您的問題可能沒有完全解答，但還是要感謝幫助您的人。

To receive community support, the following options are available:

要獲得社區支持，可以使用以下選項：

-   Start searching this documentation & wiki  
    開始搜尋此文件和 wiki
    
-   The [OPNsense forum](https://forum.opnsense.org/)  
    [OPNsense論壇](https://forum.opnsense.org/)
    
-   Ask online users on [IRC Libera Chat](https://libera.chat/) #opnsense  
    在 [IRC Libera Chat](https://libera.chat/) #opnsense 上詢問線上用戶
    
-   Open a GitHub ticket ([core](https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues), [plugins](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/issues)) using one of our templates  
    使用我們的範本之一開啟 GitHub 票證（[核心](https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues)、[外掛程式](https://github.com/opnsense/plugins/issues)）
    

Note

筆記

When a Github ticket is opened, it often is being tagged “support”, but its status may change over time when more details are known. Triaging issues takes time, the easier one can replicate an issue on a clean install, the higher the chance tickets are being solved.

當打開 Github 票證時，它通常會被標記為“支持”，但當了解更多詳細資訊時，其狀態可能會隨著時間的推移而變化。將問題分類需要時間，在全新安裝中複製問題越容易，問題解決的機會就越高。

### Commercial｜商業

As we build and maintain the software used by individuals and companies all around the globe, we are able to help you out when it comes to network design choices, solving issues and custom development around OPNsense.

當我們建立和維護全球個人和公司使用的軟體時，我們能夠在網頁設計選擇、解決問題和圍繞 OPNsense 進行客製化開發方面為您提供幫助。

Extended professional support services are available for an annual fee. You can find our options in [the OPNsense webshop](https://shop.opnsense.com/product-categorie/support/) or you may [contact us](https://shop.opnsense.com/contact-us/) directly.

擴展的專業支援服務需支付年費。您可以在 [OPNsense 網上商店](https://shop.opnsense.com/product-categorie/support/) 找到我們的選項，或者您可以直接[聯絡我們](https://shop.opnsense.com/contact-us/)。

| www/caddy<br>www/球童 | Fast and extensible multi-platform HTTP/1-2-3 web server with automatic HTTPS<br>快速且可擴展的多平台HTTP/1-2-3 Web 伺服器，具有自動HTTPS |
| www/nginx | NGINX is a high performance edge web server with the lowest memory footprint and the key features to build modern and efficient web infrastructure.<br>NGINX 是一款高效能邊緣 Web 伺服器，具有最低的記憶體佔用量和建構現代高效 Web 基礎架構的關鍵功能。 |
| www/OPNProxy | OPNsense proxy additions to support more fine grained access management<br>新增 OPNsense 代理程式以支援更細粒度的存取管理 |
| www/squid<br>www/魷魚 | Squid is a fully-featured HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, etc. proxy offering rich access control, authorization and logging environment to develop web proxy and content serving applications.<br>Squid 是一個功能齊全的HTTP, HTTPS, FTP 等代理，提供豐富的存取控制、授權和日誌記錄環境，用於開發 Web 代理和內容服務應用程式。 |
| www/web-proxy-sso | Allow to use the web proxy with Single Sign-On against an Active Directory instead of using a bundled authentication.<br>允許使用針對 Active Directory 進行單一登入的 Web 代理，而不是使用捆綁身份驗證。 |

## Contribute｜貢獻

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/contribute.html>

OPNsense is an open source community project that depends on your contributions for its continuing development & success.

OPNsense 是一個開源社群項目，其持續發展和成功取決於您的貢獻。

There are plenty of opportunities to contribute and help OPNsense reach its goal of becoming the most widely used open source security & firewall platform. Financial contributions are always welcome and will allow us to develop parts of the system that may otherwise stay untouched.

有許多機會做出貢獻並幫助 OPNsense 實現成為最廣泛使用的開源安全和防火牆平台的目標。財政捐助總是受歡迎的，這將使我們能夠開發系統中原本可能保持不變的部分。

The OPNsense core team wants to thank everyone who contributed already.

OPNsense 核心團隊要感謝所有做出貢獻的人。

---

### Financially｜財務上

“*An open source project can only thrive by the community around it.*” We are grateful of all the kind words and support the users of OPNsense are giving us.

「*開源專案只有在其周圍的社區的支持下才能蓬勃發展。*」我們感謝 OPNsense 用戶給予我們的所有善意的話語和支持。

Frequently users ask us how they can contribute to the project. To make the software better we need your involvement in testing and providing feedback and if you can spare a few bucks that would be great.

用戶經常詢問我們他們如何為該專案做出貢獻。為了使軟體變得更好，我們需要您參與測試並提供回饋，如果您能花一些錢那就太好了。

---

#### Donations｜捐款

To enable us to continue development and keep on improving the project you can contribute by donating to the project, this a simple non recurring - no strings attached - way of supporting the project. Any amount will be gratefully accepted!

為了使我們能夠繼續開發並不斷改進該項目，您可以透過向該項目捐款來做出貢獻，這是一種簡單的非經常性（無附加條件）支持該項目的方式。任何金額都將感激地接受！

  

---

#### Partner program｜合作夥伴計劃

The OPNsense project offers a partner program where businesses receive project benefits while supporting the project financially.

OPNsense 專案提供了一個合作夥伴計劃，企業可以在為專案提供財務支援的同時獲得專案效益。

Main benefits include:

主要好處包括：

-   Listing on our [OPNsense partner page](https://opnsense.org/partners/)  
    列在我們的 [OPNsense 合作夥伴頁面](https://opnsense.org/partners/)
    
-   Access to the core team  
    接觸核心團隊
    

To get enlisted as partner of the OPNsense project means a minimum annual investment of € 2500.Partners that made an exceptional contribution to the project are assigned the Platinum Partner status.

要成為 OPNsense 計畫的合作夥伴，每年至少投資 2500 歐元。為此專案做出傑出貢獻的合作夥伴將授予白金合作夥伴身分。

---

#### Support Contract｜支持合約

with a support contract we support you and you support us as OPNsense is fully supported by Deciso.

透過支持合同，我們支持您，您也支持我們，因為 OPNsense 得到 Deciso 的全力支持。

For support options see [OPNsense Commercial Support](https://opnsense.org/support-overview/commercial-support/)

有關支援選項，請參閱 [OPNsense 商業支援](https://opnsense.org/support-overview/commercial-support/)

### Development｜發展

Contributing to the ongoing development of OPNsense can be done by:

可以透過以下方式為 OPNsense 的持續開發做出貢獻：

-   Testing a development version and  
    測試開發版本並
    
-   Report issues and/or  
    報告問題和/或
    
-   Help fixing issues as well as by  
    幫助解決問題以及透過
    
-   Contributing new functionality  
    貢獻新功能
    
-   Share your code with the project by manner of a pull request.  
    透過拉取請求的方式與專案分享您的程式碼。
    

Note

筆記

Before you send in your pull request, please read our [Coding Guidelines](#p-236) and see the community support levels in the [Support Options](#p-379). It is important for plugin developers to maintain their plugin and interact with users for QA.

在發送拉取請求之前，請閱讀我們的[編碼指南](#p-236)，並在[支援選項](#p-379)中查看社區支援等級。對於插件開發者來說，維護他們的插件並與使用者互動QA非常重要。

#### Testing｜測試

Contribute by testing the latest development version to make the next release even better than the last. If you like to test a development version then the easiest way is to login to the console and type:

透過測試最新的開發版本做出貢獻，使下一個版本比上一個版本更好。如果您想測試開發版本，那麼最簡單的方法是登入控制台並輸入：

```
pkg install -y opnsense-devel
```

And to revert back to the production version:

並恢復到生產版本：

```
pkg install -y opnsense
```

That is all there is to it to test the latest development release. Development releases are usually built at the same day the latest production release comes available.

這就是測試最新開發版本的全部內容。開發版本通常是在最新生產版本發布的同一天建立的。

---

#### Reporting an issue｜報告問題

Issues can be easily reported on github, please consider carefully if the issue could be a configuration or user error before reporting it. If you are unsure, report your issue on the [forum](https://forum.opnsense.org/) or on [IRC](https://web.libera.chat/#opnsense).

問題可以輕鬆地在 github 上報告，請在報告之前仔細考慮問題是否可能是配置或使用者錯誤。如果您不確定，請在[論壇](https://forum.opnsense.org/)或[IRC](https://web.libera.chat/#opnsense)上回報您的問題。

---

#### Fixing issues｜解決問題

If you are a programmer or just know how to fix a certain issue then you can help by either sharing your ideas on or send in a pull request on github.

如果您是程式設計師或只是知道如何解決某個問題，那麼您可以透過在 github 上分享您的想法或發送拉取請求來提供協助。

---

#### Designing new features｜設計新功能

If you like to help designing new features then start with reading the [Development manual](#p-234) and checkout our [roadmap](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/) as well as our [issue tracker](https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues). Before starting it is always a good to share your idea first with a core developer, to do so you can use either:

如果您想幫助設計新功能，請開始閱讀[開發手冊](#p-234)，並查看我們的[路線圖](https://opnsense.org/about/road-map/)以及我們的[問題追蹤器](https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues)。在開始之前，最好先與核心開發人員分享您的想法，為此您可以使用：

-   [github](https://github.com/opnsense/core/) and [create a issue](https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues/new) and mention you volunteer for taking on the development task (we will correctly label it as enhancement or feature)  
    [github](https://github.com/opnsense/core/) 和 [創建問題](https://github.com/opnsense/core/issues/new) 並提及您自願承擔開發任務（我們將正確地將其標記為增強或功能）
    
-   find one of us on IRC/Libera Chat (#opnsense) and see if we are available to discuss your idea.  
    在 IRC/Libera Chat (#opnsense) 上找到我們之一，看看我們是否可以討論您的想法。

Working on translations is time consuming, but if you feel up to it and would like to help adding another language, then please contact us via email (contact @ opnsense.org).

翻譯工作非常耗時，但如果您願意並願意協助添加另一種語言，請透過電子郵件與我們聯繫（contact@opnsense.org）。

### Documentation & wiki articles｜文檔和 wiki 文章

The easiest way to help with documentation is to write how-to type articles. As the wiki & documentation project itself is written in **reStructuredText** you can offer your content in this format (preferably as a [pull request](https://github.com/opnsense/docs)). Other formats are also possible, such as:

幫助編寫文件的最簡單方法是編寫如何輸入文章。由於 wiki 和文件專案本身是用 **reStructuredText** 編寫的，因此您可以以此格式提供內容（最好是作為 [拉取請求](https://github.com/opnsense/docs)）。其他格式也是可能的，例如：

-   markup with ./images/directory including the used images (if any)  
    帶有 ./images/directory 的標記，包括使用的圖像（如果有）
    
-   word document with embedded images (if any)  
    帶有嵌入圖像的Word文件（如果有）
    

To include you documentation send it to contact @ opnsense.org. Make sure that:

要包含您的文檔，請將其發送至聯絡人@opnsense.org。確保：

-   Your content does not include copyrighted material if you do not own the copyright yourself  
    如果您自己不擁有版權，您的內容不包含受版權保護的資料
    
-   State that we may use the content under our Documentation Copyright as listed in the [Legal notices](#p-378) section.  
    聲明我們可以使用[法律聲明](#p-378)部分中列出的文檔版權下的內容。

### Forum & IRC｜論壇&IRC

If you are an experienced network engineer, know a lot about firewall technology or if you are excited about OPNsense, then you can contribute to the project by helping others on the [forum](https://forum.opnsense.org/) or on [IRC](https://web.libera.chat/#opnsense).

如果您是一位經驗豐富的網路工程師，對防火牆技術了解很多，或者您對 OPNsense 感到興奮，那麼您可以透過在 [論壇](https://forum.opnsense.org/) 或 [IRC](https://web.libera.chat/#opnsense) 上幫助其他人來為該專案做出貢獻。

Contribute to the success of the project by letting others know how OPNsense helped solving your network or security challenges. Let others know about OPNsense and/or follow us & retweet our messages on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/opnsense).

讓其他人了解 OPNsense 如何幫助您解決網路或安全挑戰，為專案的成功做出貢獻。讓其他人了解 OPNsense 和/或在 [Twitter](https://twitter.com/opnsense) 上關注我們並轉發我們的訊息。

Anything you can do to spread the word about OPNsense will help to reach our goal to become the most widely used open source security & firewall platform.

您為宣傳 OPNsense 所做的一切都將有助於實現我們成為使用最廣泛的開源安全和防火牆平台的目標。

如果您對其他人如何為 OPNsense 做出貢獻有任何建議，但此頁面尚未列出，請告訴我們。您可以透過 contact@opnsense.org 聯繫我們。

<a id="c-65"></a>

## History

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

<a id="p-382"></a>

### About the Fork｜關於叉子

<sub>[↑ 回目錄](#toc)</sub>

> 來源：<https://docs.opnsense.org/history/thefork.html>

Welcome to about the fork. This page is intended to explain the original motivation for forking, but keep in mind that currently less than 10% of the original legacy code base remains. As it stands today, OPNsense has evolved from being a fork to a whole new security platform with leading innovations such as weekly security updates for all components, a REST API, inline Intrusion Prevention and an intuitive modern user interface.

歡迎來到關於叉子。本頁旨在解釋分叉的原始動機，但請記住，目前原始遺留程式碼庫的剩餘量不足 10%。就目前而言，OPNsense 已從一個分支發展成為一個全新的安全平台，具有領先的創新，例如所有組件的每周安全更新、REST API、內聯入侵防禦和直觀的現代用戶界面。

Let’s fork and lift the project!

讓我們分叉並提升該項目！

![../_images/fork-lift_new.jpg](<../images/d7285c5b-fork-lift_new.jpg>)

#### So why did we fork?｜那我們為什麼要分叉呢？

Back in 2014, after having sponsored pfSense® for years, we felt that there was no other option than to fork the project and to keep the spirit of the - original m0n0wall based fork - alive. Below you can read about our original motivations and the birth of OPNsense®.

早在 2014 年，在贊助 pfSense® 多年後，我們覺得除了分叉這個計畫並保持基於 m0n0wall 的原始分叉精神之外，別無選擇。您可以在下面了解我們的初衷和 OPNsense® 的誕生。

##### Technical｜科技

We had technical reasons to fork. As much as we love the functionality/feature set of pfSense, we do not enjoy the [code quality](#p-237) and dispersed development method. We like structure, achievable goals set forth in a [roadmap](https://opnsense.org/roadmap/) with regular releases and a decent [framework](#p-242).

我們出於技術原因進行分叉。儘管我們非常喜歡 pfSense 的功能/特性集，但我們不喜歡[程式碼品質](#p-237) 和分散的開發方法。我們喜歡[路線圖](https://opnsense.org/roadmap/)中規定的結構、可實現的目標，定期發布和體面的[框架](#p-242)。

##### Security｜安全性

On the security part the main issue was the need to separate logic. The GUI should not perform tasks that require root access, and potential security issues should be fixed before they become a real problem.

在安全部分，主要問題是需要分離邏輯。 GUI 不應執行需要 root 存取權的任務，並且應在潛在的安全問題成為真正的問題之前將其修復。

##### Quality｜品質

As for quality, all new features will be built using a solid [framework](#p-242) with a Model View Controller. For this purpose we choose [Phalcon](https://phalcon.io/) as it is the fastest open source PHP framework available. And we will gradually migrate parts inherited from pfSense to the new framework to avoid a big-bang approach.

至於質量，所有新功能都將使用具有模型視圖控制器的可靠[框架](#p-242)來構建。為此，我們選擇[Phalcon](https://phalcon.io/)，因為它是可用的最快的開源PHP框架。我們將逐步將從 pfSense 繼承的部分遷移到新框架，以避免大爆炸。

##### Community｜社群

A thriving community can only exist when people are willing to share. We want to make it easier for people to join and help to build the community. With pfSense, this has been rather difficult, as the tools to build it are difficult to use and often do not work in the first few attempts. And since 2014 they are not freely available any more, you need to apply for access with ESF. We believe a good open source project has nothing to hide so access to the sources should be there for all. It will remain a mystery why ESF made that move, as commit rights and read rights are totally different.

只有當人們願意分享時，一個繁榮的社區才能存在。我們希望讓人們更容易加入並幫助建立社區。對於 pfSense，這相當困難，因為建造它的工具很難使用，並且在最初的幾次嘗試中通常不起作用。自 2014 年起，它們不再免費提供，您需要透過 ESF 申請訪問。我們相信一個好的開源專案沒有什麼可隱藏的，因此所有人都應該能夠存取原始碼。 ESF 為何採取這項措施仍是個謎，因為提交權和讀取權完全不同。

Note

筆記

ESF has since changed their policy several times with different license models, including the ESF 6 clause license and the latest being a Apache style license.

此後，ESF 使用不同的授權模型多次更改了其政策，包括 ESF 6 條款授權和最新的 Apache 樣式授權。

##### Transparency｜透明度

A real concern with pfSense is transparency. Since Netgate bought the majority share of pfSense and renamed the company to ESF, it has been difficult to understand the direction they want the project to go. Removing the tools from GitHub without prior warning and using the brand name to fence off competitors has scared quite a lot of people. Also the license had changed for no apparent reason…

pfSense 真正關心的是透明度。自從 Netgate 收購了 pfSense 的大部分股份並將公司更名為ESF以來，人們一直很難理解他們希望專案發展的方向。在沒有事先警告的情況下從 GitHub 上刪除這些工具並使用品牌名稱來隔離競爭對手已經讓許多人感到害怕。而且許可證也無緣無故地發生了變化…

##### Restore a firm open source project｜恢復一個堅定的開源項目

With OPNsense, we have restored a stable project with clear goals and a very simple license that is suitable for forking and making OEM versions. We think a community project is there for all to use and work with.

透過 OPNsense，我們恢復了一個穩定的項目，具有明確的目標和非常簡​​單的許可證，適合分叉和製作 OEM 版本。我們認為社區計畫可供所有人使用和合作。

#### First Release｜首次發布

Much work had already been done before the [first official release](https://web.archive.org/web/20150503182123/https://opnsense.org/opnsense-version-15-1-released/):

在[第一次正式發布](https://web.archive.org/web/20150503182123/https://opnsense.org/opnsense-version-15-1-released/)之前已經做了很多工作：

-   The build-tools had been completely rewritten from the ground up with clear and easy to read build scripts that are portable and small,  
    建置工具已從頭開始完全重寫，具有清晰易讀的建置腳本，這些腳本可移植且小巧，
    
-   OPNsense is now a package that can be installed on top of our custom FreeBSD build (you can literally do pkg remove opnsense and you are left with an almost standard FreeBSD base system),  
    OPNsense 現在是一個可以安裝在我們自訂 FreeBSD 建置之上的軟體套件（您實際上可以執行 pkg remove opnsense ，然後您就剩下一個幾乎標準的 FreeBSD 基本系統），
    
-   The firmware upgrade process is now done with pkgng,  
    韌體升級過程現在透過 pkgng 完成，
    
-   Captive portal has been rewritten and does not make use of kernel patches anymore,  
    強制門戶已重寫，不再使用核心補丁，
    
-   New features (captive portal) have been implemented with a clear structure,  
    新功能（強制門戶）已以清晰的結構實施，
    
-   The check\_reload\_status functionality, effectively the backend daemon starting and stopping components, has been fully rewritten in Python (configd),  
    check\_reload\_status 功能（實際上是後端守護程式啟動和停止元件）已用 Python (configd) 完全重寫，
    
-   Fully reworked the GUI to a modern Bootstrap based one that is also easier to customize if you want to.  
    將 GUI 完全重新設計為基於 Bootstrap 的現代版本，如果您願意，也可以更輕鬆地進行自訂。
    

#### Future Development & Focus｜未來發展及重點

Moving forward the focus will remain on code quality and security.

展望未來，重點仍將放在程式碼品質和安全性上。

Note

筆記

A lot of work has been done to improve the code quality and with weekly updates we have proven to be able to act quickly on known security threats. For current status of the project and future development see our [roadmap](https://opnsense.org/roadmap/).

我們已經做了大量工作來提高程式碼質量，並且透過每週更新，我們已經證明能夠對已知的安全威脅快速採取行動。有關專案的當前狀態和未來的發展，請參閱我們的[路線圖](https://opnsense.org/roadmap/)。

##### Deciso’s involvement｜Deciso的參與

That being said it is important to know that [Deciso](https://www.deciso.com/) has been a long time sponsor of pfSense and invested a lot of time and money into the project. Deciso helped to make it a success in Europe. Until Netgate bought the company there was room for many others like us, but that has changed unfortunately.

話雖如此，重要的是要知道 [Deciso](https://www.deciso.com/) 一直是 pfSense 的長期贊助商，並為該專案投入了大量時間和金錢。 Deciso 幫助其在歐洲取得了成功。在 Netgate 收購該公司之前，還有許多像我們這樣的其他人的空間，但不幸的是，這種情況已經改變了。

##### Closing thoughts｜結束語

In the end it all boils down to the direction we will go both technical as well as community involvement and transparency.

最終，這一切都歸結為我們在技術、社區參與和透明度方面的發展方向。

You are invited! Try OPNsense, be part of the community and help the project move forward. OPNsense is rapidly becoming the number one open source firewall platform!

誠摯邀請您！嘗試 OPNsense，成為社區的一部分並幫助專案向前發展。 OPNsense 正迅速成為排名第一的開源防火牆平台！
